`app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
// app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs
//
// supervises the c++ engine sidecar and tells the web ui where to reach it
// the engine is a separate process because the c++ tree links the static crt
// and rust links the dynamic one, loopback costs a json round trip and buys
// crash isolation, the supervisor (supervisor.rs) respawns it when it dies

mod engine_log;
mod payload;
mod supervisor;

use engine_log::EngineLog;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use supervisor::{Endpoint, Engine, Status, HANDSHAKE_DEADLINE};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Manager, RunEvent, State, WindowEvent};

/// blocks until the current engine has a port, through a restart in progress;
/// errors only once the supervisor gave up or the handshake deadline passes
#[tauri::command]
async fn engine_endpoint(app: AppHandle) -> Result<Endpoint, String> {
    // the wait can take minutes, keep it off the ipc thread
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || app.state::<Engine>().wait(HANDSHAKE_DEADLINE))
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("engine wait failed: {e}"))?
}

/// the supervisor's handshake deadline, the ui health gate uses the same one
#[tauri::command]
fn startup_deadline_ms() -> u64 {
    HANDSHAKE_DEADLINE.as_millis() as u64
}

#[tauri::command]
fn engine_status(engine: State<'_, Engine>) -> Status {
    engine.status()
}

/// re-arms a supervisor that gave up, or cycles a running engine
#[tauri::command]
fn restart_engine(app: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    supervisor::request_restart(&app)
}

/// Reveal a file (its folder opens with it selected) or open a folder in the
/// OS file manager. The crash banner uses it for the engine log, Settings for
/// the data dir. explorer.exe reports a non-zero exit even on success, so the
/// child is spawned and not waited on.
#[tauri::command]
fn open_path(path: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    let p = std::path::Path::new(&path);
    if !p.exists() {
        return Err(format!("{path} does not exist"));
    }
    std::process::Command::new("explorer.exe")
        .arg(p)
        .spawn()
        .map(|_| ())
        .map_err(|e| format!("cannot open {path}: {e}"))
}

/// Open an http(s) URL in the default browser (the command palette's help
/// results). Only http(s) is accepted: a docs result must never hand the shell
/// an arbitrary scheme.
#[tauri::command]
fn open_url(url: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    if !(url.starts_with("https://") || url.starts_with("http://")) {
        return Err("only http(s) URLs can be opened".into());
    }
    std::process::Command::new("rundll32.exe")
        .args(["url.dll,FileProtocolHandler", &url])
        .spawn()
        .map(|_| ())
        .map_err(|e| format!("cannot open {url}: {e}"))
}

/// Write a UTF-8 text file the user picked in a save dialog (Settings layout
/// export). The dialog owns the path choice; this only does the write.
#[tauri::command]
fn write_text_file(path: String, text: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::write(&path, text).map_err(|e| format!("cannot write {path}: {e}"))
}

/// Read a UTF-8 text file the user picked in an open dialog (layout import).
#[tauri::command]
fn read_text_file(path: String) -> Result<String, String> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read {path}: {e}"))
}

/// where the engine binary lives: next to us once installed; debug builds
/// check the cmake tree first on purpose, tauri copies the resource engine at
/// cargo build time and a stale copy cost an afternoon of debugging once
fn sidecar_path(app: &AppHandle) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    const NAME: &str = "reverse-slop-engine.exe";

    let installed = || -> Option<PathBuf> {
        if let Ok(dir) = app.path().resource_dir() {
            let bundled = dir.join("engine").join(NAME);
            if bundled.is_file() {
                return Some(bundled);
            }
        }
        let exe = std::env::current_exe().ok()?;
        let dir = exe.parent()?;
        [dir.join(NAME), dir.join("engine").join(NAME)]
            .into_iter()
            .find(|c| c.is_file())
    };

    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    let found = dev_tree(NAME)
        .or_else(installed)
        .or_else(|| embedded_engine(app));
    #[cfg(not(debug_assertions))]
    let found = installed().or_else(|| embedded_engine(app));

    found.ok_or_else(|| {
        format!("{NAME} not found, build it with tools/build.ps1 (SLOP_BUILD_ENGINE=ON)")
    })
}

/// The packaging job can append the engine to this exe as an overlay:
/// `[ui exe][engine bytes][b"SLOPENG1"][u64 offset][u64 size]`. PE loaders
/// ignore the overlay, so a portable build is one file. The bytes are
/// extracted once into the app-local data dir and reused by size (an upgrade
/// changes the size and re-extracts).
fn embedded_engine(app: &AppHandle) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    use std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom};

    let exe = std::env::current_exe().ok()?;
    let mut file = std::fs::File::open(&exe).ok()?;
    let len = file.metadata().ok()?.len();
    if len < 24 {
        return None;
    }
    file.seek(SeekFrom::End(-24)).ok()?;
    let mut footer = [0u8; 24];
    file.read_exact(&mut footer).ok()?;
    if &footer[..8] != b"SLOPENG1" {
        return None;
    }
    let offset = u64::from_le_bytes(footer[8..16].try_into().ok()?);
    let size = u64::from_le_bytes(footer[16..24].try_into().ok()?);
    if size == 0 || offset.checked_add(size)? > len - 24 {
        return None;
    }

    let dir = app.path().app_local_data_dir().ok()?.join("engine");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).ok()?;
    let path = dir.join(format!("reverse-slop-engine-{size}.exe"));
    if std::fs::metadata(&path).map(|m| m.len() == size).unwrap_or(false) {
        return Some(path);
    }

    let mut bytes = vec![0u8; size as usize];
    file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset)).ok()?;
    file.read_exact(&mut bytes).ok()?;
    let tmp = path.with_extension("exe.tmp");
    std::fs::write(&tmp, &bytes).ok()?;
    // a wrong-size stale copy can exist from an interrupted run; rename over
    // it only after removing it (Windows rename does not replace)
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
    std::fs::rename(&tmp, &path).ok()?;
    Some(path)
}

/// the cmake output tree, compiled into debug builds only so release binaries
/// never carry or probe a build-machine path
#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
fn dev_tree(name: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let p = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
        .join("../../build/src/engine")
        .join(name);
    p.is_file().then(|| p.canonicalize().unwrap_or(p))
}

/// kill on close job object: the engine exits cleanly through the graceful
/// stop or its parent-pid watch, this is the backstop that guarantees a wedged
/// engine never outlives the ui and keeps holding the port and console sockets
#[cfg(windows)]
mod job {
    use std::os::windows::io::AsRawHandle;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, HANDLE};
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::JobObjects::{
        AssignProcessToJobObject, CreateJobObjectW, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation,
        SetInformationJobObject, JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION,
        JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE,
    };

    /// the handle is leaked deliberately on success: it must outlive every
    /// scope in this process, because closing it is exactly what kills the engine
    pub fn adopt(child: &std::process::Child) -> Result<(), String> {
        // SAFETY: plain win32 calls on handles we own, every failure is checked
        unsafe {
            let handle = CreateJobObjectW(std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null());
            if handle.is_null() {
                return Err("CreateJobObject failed".into());
            }
            let mut info: JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION = std::mem::zeroed();
            info.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;
            if SetInformationJobObject(
                handle,
                JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation,
                &info as *const _ as *const core::ffi::c_void,
                std::mem::size_of::<JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION>() as u32,
            ) == 0
            {
                CloseHandle(handle);
                return Err("SetInformationJobObject failed".into());
            }
            if AssignProcessToJobObject(handle, child.as_raw_handle() as HANDLE) == 0 {
                CloseHandle(handle);
                return Err("AssignProcessToJobObject failed".into());
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// panics in the ui process go to the engine log too, release builds have no
/// console to print them on
fn install_panic_hook(log: Arc<EngineLog>) {
    let previous = std::panic::take_hook();
    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
        log.try_line("ui-panic", &info.to_string());
        previous(info);
    }));
}

#[cfg_attr(mobile, tauri::mobile_entry_point)]
pub fn run() {
    let log = Arc::new(EngineLog::default_location());
    install_panic_hook(Arc::clone(&log));

    let app = tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_dialog::init())
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build())
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_process::init())
        .manage(Engine::new(Arc::clone(&log)))
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            engine_endpoint,
            startup_deadline_ms,
            engine_status,
            restart_engine,
            open_path,
            open_url,
            write_text_file,
            read_text_file,
            payload::ps4debug_payload,
            payload::ps4debug_payload_latest,
            payload::ps4debug_payload_download,
            payload::ps4debug_payload_save
        ])
        .setup(|app| {
            // the devtools toggle permission exists only in debug builds, release
            // builds are compiled without devtools at all
            #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
            app.add_capability(
                tauri::ipc::CapabilityBuilder::new("debug-devtools")
                    .window("main")
                    .permission("core:webview:allow-internal-toggle-devtools"),
            )?;

            let handle = app.handle().clone();
            let path = sidecar_path(&handle);
            std::thread::Builder::new()
                .name("engine-supervisor".into())
                .spawn(move || supervisor::run(handle, path))?;
            Ok(())
        })
        .on_window_event(|window, event| {
            if let WindowEvent::CloseRequested { api, .. } = event {
                // hide now and stop the engine off the event loop, the window
                // thread never blocks on the engine's teardown
                api.prevent_close();
                let _ = window.hide();
                let app = window.app_handle().clone();
                std::thread::spawn(move || {
                    supervisor::shutdown(&app);
                    app.exit(0);
                });
            }
        })
        .build(tauri::generate_context!());

    let app = match app {
        Ok(app) => app,
        Err(e) => {
            log.line("supervisor", &format!("ui failed to start: {e}"));
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    };

    app.run(|handle, event| {
        // exits that skip CloseRequested (session end, app.exit from elsewhere)
        // still stop the engine; no window is left to block by now, and this is
        // a no-op when the close path already did it
        if let RunEvent::Exit = event {
            supervisor::shutdown(handle);
        }
    });
}
```

```rs
// app/src-tauri/src/payload.rs
// ps4debug-NG payload: the build stages the latest release under
// payloads/ps4debug-ng; the app can check GitHub and download a newer one.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Manager};

const REPO: &str = "Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG";
const API: &str = "https://api.github.com/repos/Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG/releases/latest";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct PayloadInfo {
    pub tag: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset: String,
    pub url: String,
    pub sha256: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub source: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct PayloadStatus {
    pub bundled: Option<PayloadInfo>,
    pub local: Option<PayloadInfo>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Manifest {
    tag: String,
    name: String,
    asset: String,
    url: String,
    sha256: String,
    source: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Release {
    tag_name: String,
    name: String,
    assets: Vec<Asset>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Asset {
    name: String,
    browser_download_url: String,
}

fn read_manifest(dir: &Path) -> Option<PayloadInfo> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("manifest.json")).ok()?;
    // PowerShell 5.1's utf8 encoding writes a BOM; tolerate it.
    let text = text.trim_start_matches('\u{feff}');
    let m: Manifest = serde_json::from_str(text).ok()?;
    let bin = dir.join("ps4debug-ng.bin");
    if !bin.is_file() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(PayloadInfo {
        tag: m.tag,
        name: m.name,
        asset: m.asset,
        url: m.url,
        sha256: m.sha256,
        path: bin.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        source: m.source,
    })
}

fn bundled_dir(app: &AppHandle) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    Some(app.path().resource_dir().ok()?.join("payloads").join("ps4debug-ng"))
}

fn local_dir(app: &AppHandle) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    Some(app.path().app_local_data_dir().ok()?.join("payloads").join("ps4debug-ng"))
}

fn sha256_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    h.update(bytes);
    format!("{:x}", h.finalize())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn ps4debug_payload(app: AppHandle) -> PayloadStatus {
    PayloadStatus {
        bundled: bundled_dir(&app).and_then(|d| read_manifest(&d)),
        local: local_dir(&app).and_then(|d| read_manifest(&d)),
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn ps4debug_payload_latest() -> Result<PayloadInfo, String> {
    let client = reqwest::Client::new();
    let release: Release = client
        .get(API)
        .header("User-Agent", "SlopStation")
        .header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("ps4debug-NG release check failed: {e}"))?
        .error_for_status()
        .map_err(|e| format!("ps4debug-NG release check failed: {e}"))?
        .json()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("ps4debug-NG release parse failed: {e}"))?;
    let asset = release
        .assets
        .into_iter()
        .find(|a| a.name.ends_with(".bin"))
        .ok_or_else(|| "the latest ps4debug-NG release has no .bin asset".to_string())?;
    Ok(PayloadInfo {
        tag: release.tag_name,
        name: release.name,
        asset: asset.name,
        url: asset.browser_download_url,
        sha256: String::new(),
        path: String::new(),
        source: format!("https://github.com/{REPO}"),
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn ps4debug_payload_download(app: AppHandle) -> Result<PayloadInfo, String> {
    let latest = ps4debug_payload_latest().await?;
    let dir = local_dir(&app).ok_or("no app data directory for the payload")?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("create payload dir: {e}"))?;
    let bytes = reqwest::Client::new()
        .get(&latest.url)
        .header("User-Agent", "SlopStation")
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("payload download failed: {e}"))?
        .error_for_status()
        .map_err(|e| format!("payload download failed: {e}"))?
        .bytes()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("payload download failed: {e}"))?;
    let bin = dir.join("ps4debug-ng.bin");
    std::fs::write(&bin, &bytes).map_err(|e| format!("write payload: {e}"))?;
    let sha = sha256_hex(&bytes);
    let manifest = serde_json::json!({
        "repo": REPO,
        "tag": &latest.tag,
        "name": &latest.name,
        "published_at": "",
        "asset": &latest.asset,
        "url": &latest.url,
        "sha256": &sha,
        "fetched_at": "",
        "license": "GPL-3.0",
        "source": &latest.source,
    });
    std::fs::write(
        dir.join("manifest.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&manifest).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
    )
    .map_err(|e| format!("write payload manifest: {e}"))?;
    Ok(PayloadInfo {
        sha256: sha,
        path: bin.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        ..latest
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn ps4debug_payload_save(source: String, dest: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::copy(&source, &dest)
        .map(|_| ())
        .map_err(|e| format!("save payload: {e}"))
}

```

`app/src-tauri/src/supervisor.rs`:

```rs
// app/src-tauri/src/supervisor.rs
//
// owns the engine sidecar for the whole app lifetime: spawns it, reads the
// stdout handshake, notices when it dies after the handshake, respawns it with
// backoff and republishes the endpoint, and stops it gracefully on exit
// the ui hears about all of it through two tauri events:
//   engine-crashed   {reason, exit_code, restarts, retry_in_ms, log_path}
//                    retry_in_ms is null once the supervisor gives up
//   engine-restarted {port, generation}
// after engine-restarted (or an sse drop) the ui re-invokes engine_endpoint

use crate::engine_log::EngineLog;
use serde::Serialize;
use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read, Write};
use std::net::{Ipv4Addr, SocketAddr, TcpStream};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Child, Command, ExitStatus, Stdio};
use std::sync::{Arc, Condvar, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter, Manager};

/// how long a launch may take to report its port, long because a human might
/// be clicking through an elevation prompt; the ui uses the same number
pub const HANDSHAKE_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(180);
/// a run this long resets the crash counter, so one crash an hour never
/// accumulates into giving up
const STABLE_RUN: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
/// consecutive short-lived runs before the supervisor stops respawning
const MAX_FAST_FAILURES: u32 = 5;
/// how long a graceful stop may take before the process is killed
const STOP_GRACE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(4);

pub const EVENT_CRASHED: &str = "engine-crashed";
pub const EVENT_RESTARTED: &str = "engine-restarted";

/// lock that survives a panic elsewhere, the guarded data is plain state that
/// stays consistent between statements, so a poisoned lock is still usable
fn lock<T>(m: &Mutex<T>) -> MutexGuard<'_, T> {
    m.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Endpoint {
    pub port: u16,
    pub token: String,
    /// bumps on every successful handshake, a changed value means a new engine
    pub generation: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Serialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum Phase {
    Starting,
    Running,
    Restarting,
    Failed,
    Stopped,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct Status {
    pub phase: Phase,
    pub generation: u64,
    pub restarts: u32,
    pub port: Option<u16>,
    pub last_error: Option<String>,
    pub log_path: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
struct CrashedEvent {
    reason: String,
    exit_code: Option<i32>,
    restarts: u32,
    retry_in_ms: Option<u64>,
    log_path: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
struct RestartedEvent {
    port: u16,
    generation: u64,
}

struct Inner {
    endpoint: Option<Endpoint>,
    /// set only when the supervisor gave up, wakes engine_endpoint waiters
    failure: Option<String>,
    phase: Phase,
    generation: u64,
    restarts: u32,
    last_error: Option<String>,
    /// the current endpoint belongs to an engine some other process started
    adopted: bool,
    restart_requested: bool,
    shutting_down: bool,
}

pub struct Engine {
    inner: Mutex<Inner>,
    changed: Condvar,
    child: Mutex<Option<Child>>,
    /// per-launch bearer token handed to the engine through SLOP_MCP_TOKEN so
    /// it never travels through stdout; empty when no secure rng was available,
    /// then the engine prints its persisted token instead
    token: String,
    log: Arc<EngineLog>,
}

impl Engine {
    pub fn new(log: Arc<EngineLog>) -> Self {
        let token = match random_token() {
            Ok(t) => t,
            Err(e) => {
                log.line("supervisor", &format!("no secure rng for a launch token ({e}); using the engine's persisted token"));
                String::new()
            }
        };
        Self {
            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {
                endpoint: None,
                failure: None,
                phase: Phase::Starting,
                generation: 0,
                restarts: 0,
                last_error: None,
                adopted: false,
                restart_requested: false,
                shutting_down: false,
            }),
            changed: Condvar::new(),
            child: Mutex::new(None),
            token,
            log,
        }
    }

    pub fn status(&self) -> Status {
        let inner = lock(&self.inner);
        Status {
            phase: inner.phase,
            generation: inner.generation,
            restarts: inner.restarts,
            port: inner.endpoint.as_ref().map(|e| e.port),
            last_error: inner.last_error.clone(),
            log_path: self.log.path().display().to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// returns the generation and whether an earlier engine was live before
    fn publish(&self, port: u16, token: String) -> (u64, bool) {
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        inner.generation += 1;
        let generation = inner.generation;
        inner.endpoint = Some(Endpoint { port, token, generation });
        inner.failure = None;
        // a handover line (SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING) follows and flips this back
        inner.adopted = false;
        inner.phase = Phase::Running;
        drop(inner);
        self.changed.notify_all();
        (generation, generation > 1)
    }

    fn note_error(&self, reason: &str) {
        lock(&self.inner).last_error = Some(reason.to_string());
    }

    fn begin_restart(&self, reason: &str) -> u32 {
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        inner.endpoint = None;
        inner.adopted = false;
        inner.phase = Phase::Restarting;
        inner.last_error = Some(reason.to_string());
        inner.restarts += 1;
        inner.restarts
    }

    pub fn give_up(&self, reason: &str) {
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        inner.endpoint = None;
        inner.adopted = false;
        inner.phase = Phase::Failed;
        inner.failure = Some(reason.to_string());
        inner.last_error = Some(reason.to_string());
        drop(inner);
        self.changed.notify_all();
    }

    fn shutting_down(&self) -> bool {
        lock(&self.inner).shutting_down
    }

    fn interrupted(&self) -> bool {
        let inner = lock(&self.inner);
        inner.shutting_down || inner.restart_requested
    }

    fn take_restart_request(&self) -> bool {
        std::mem::take(&mut lock(&self.inner).restart_requested)
    }

    /// waits for the handshake of the current or next engine; blocks through a
    /// restart in progress and only errors once the supervisor gave up
    pub fn wait(&self, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Endpoint, String> {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        loop {
            if let Some(ep) = inner.endpoint.clone() {
                return Ok(ep);
            }
            if let Some(err) = inner.failure.clone() {
                return Err(err);
            }
            if inner.shutting_down {
                return Err("engine is shutting down".into());
            }
            let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
            if remaining.is_zero() {
                return Err("engine did not report a listening port in time".into());
            }
            inner = self
                .changed
                .wait_timeout(inner, remaining)
                .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
                .0;
        }
    }

    /// sleeps through a backoff delay; false when shutdown interrupted it
    /// a restart request cuts the delay short
    fn backoff_sleep(&self, delay: Duration) -> bool {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + delay;
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        loop {
            if inner.shutting_down {
                return false;
            }
            if inner.restart_requested {
                return true;
            }
            let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
            if remaining.is_zero() {
                return true;
            }
            inner = self
                .changed
                .wait_timeout(inner, remaining)
                .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
                .0;
        }
    }

    /// parks a supervisor that gave up until restart_engine or shutdown
    fn park_until_restart(&self) -> bool {
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        loop {
            if inner.shutting_down {
                return false;
            }
            if inner.restart_requested {
                return true;
            }
            inner = self.changed.wait(inner).unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        }
    }

    /// marks shutdown; false when another caller already started it
    fn begin_shutdown(&self) -> bool {
        let mut inner = lock(&self.inner);
        if inner.shutting_down {
            return false;
        }
        inner.shutting_down = true;
        drop(inner);
        self.changed.notify_all();
        true
    }

    fn owned_endpoint(&self) -> Option<Endpoint> {
        let inner = lock(&self.inner);
        if inner.adopted {
            None
        } else {
            inner.endpoint.clone()
        }
    }

    fn child_running(&self) -> bool {
        lock(&self.child)
            .as_mut()
            .is_some_and(|c| matches!(c.try_wait(), Ok(None)))
    }

    /// polls the current child until it exits, then forgets it
    fn reap(&self) -> Option<ExitStatus> {
        loop {
            {
                let mut slot = lock(&self.child);
                let status = slot.as_mut()?.try_wait();
                match status {
                    Ok(Some(st)) => {
                        *slot = None;
                        return Some(st);
                    }
                    Ok(None) => {}
                    Err(_) => {
                        *slot = None;
                        return None;
                    }
                }
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
        }
    }

    /// asks our own engine to quit through its api, kills it after the grace
    /// period; the child stays in the slot so the supervisor still reaps it
    fn stop_child(&self, reason: &str) {
        if !self.child_running() {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(ep) = self.owned_endpoint() {
            if let Err(e) = request_quit(ep.port, &ep.token, reason) {
                self.log.line("supervisor", &format!("graceful stop request failed: {e}"));
            }
        }
        let deadline = Instant::now() + STOP_GRACE;
        while Instant::now() < deadline {
            if !self.child_running() {
                return;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
        }
        let mut slot = lock(&self.child);
        if let Some(c) = slot.as_mut() {
            if matches!(c.try_wait(), Ok(None)) {
                self.log.line("supervisor", "engine did not stop in time, killing it");
                let _ = c.kill();
                let _ = c.wait();
            }
        }
    }
}

/// shutdown for app exit, safe to call more than once and from any thread
pub fn shutdown(app: &AppHandle) {
    let engine = app.state::<Engine>();
    if !engine.begin_shutdown() {
        return;
    }
    engine.log.line("supervisor", "app exiting, stopping engine");
    engine.stop_child("front end exited");
    lock(&engine.inner).phase = Phase::Stopped;
}

/// restart on request: re-arms a supervisor that gave up, or cycles a live
/// engine without counting it as a crash
pub fn request_restart(app: &AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    let engine = app.state::<Engine>();
    {
        let mut inner = lock(&engine.inner);
        if inner.shutting_down {
            return Err("engine is shutting down".into());
        }
        if inner.restart_requested {
            return Ok(());
        }
        inner.restart_requested = true;
        inner.failure = None;
        inner.endpoint = None;
        inner.phase = Phase::Restarting;
    }
    engine.changed.notify_all();
    engine.log.line("supervisor", "restart requested by the ui");
    let app = app.clone();
    std::thread::spawn(move || app.state::<Engine>().stop_child("restart requested"));
    Ok(())
}

/// supervisor thread entry, never panics out: a panic is logged and turned
/// into the failed state so the ui sees it rather than a silent dead engine
pub fn run(app: AppHandle, path: Result<PathBuf, String>) {
    let result = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| supervise(&app, path)));
    if result.is_err() {
        let engine = app.state::<Engine>();
        let reason = format!("engine supervisor crashed; see {}", engine.log.path().display());
        engine.give_up(&reason);
        emit_crashed(&app, &engine, &reason, None, None);
    }
}

fn supervise(app: &AppHandle, path: Result<PathBuf, String>) {
    let engine = app.state::<Engine>();
    let path = match path {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => {
            // nothing to retry, the binary is missing
            engine.log.line("supervisor", &e);
            engine.give_up(&e);
            emit_crashed(app, &engine, &e, None, None);
            return;
        }
    };

    let mut fast_failures = 0u32;
    loop {
        if engine.shutting_down() {
            break;
        }
        engine.take_restart_request();
        let started = Instant::now();
        let outcome = run_once(app, &engine, &path);
        if engine.shutting_down() {
            break;
        }
        if engine.take_restart_request() {
            fast_failures = 0;
            let restarts = engine.begin_restart("restart requested");
            engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("restarting engine on request (restart #{restarts})"));
            continue;
        }

        let reason = outcome.describe();
        engine.log.line("supervisor", &reason);
        if outcome.published && started.elapsed() >= STABLE_RUN {
            fast_failures = 0;
        }
        fast_failures += 1;
        let exit_code = outcome.exit.and_then(|s| s.code());

        if fast_failures > MAX_FAST_FAILURES {
            let msg = format!(
                "{reason}; gave up after {MAX_FAST_FAILURES} restarts in quick succession (log: {})",
                engine.log.path().display()
            );
            engine.log.line("supervisor", &msg);
            engine.give_up(&msg);
            emit_crashed(app, &engine, &msg, exit_code, None);
            if !engine.park_until_restart() {
                break;
            }
            fast_failures = 0;
            continue;
        }

        let delay = backoff(fast_failures);
        let restarts = engine.begin_restart(&reason);
        engine.log.line(
            "supervisor",
            &format!("restarting engine in {} ms (restart #{restarts})", delay.as_millis()),
        );
        emit_crashed(app, &engine, &reason, exit_code, Some(delay));
        if !engine.backoff_sleep(delay) {
            break;
        }
    }
    lock(&engine.inner).phase = Phase::Stopped;
}

/// 0.5s, 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s ... capped at 30s, failures counts from 1
pub fn backoff(failures: u32) -> Duration {
    let shift = failures.saturating_sub(1).min(16);
    Duration::from_millis((500u64 << shift).min(30_000))
}

fn emit_crashed(
    app: &AppHandle,
    engine: &Engine,
    reason: &str,
    exit_code: Option<i32>,
    retry: Option<Duration>,
) {
    let payload = CrashedEvent {
        reason: reason.to_string(),
        exit_code,
        restarts: lock(&engine.inner).restarts,
        retry_in_ms: retry.map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64),
        log_path: engine.log.path().display().to_string(),
    };
    if let Err(e) = app.emit(EVENT_CRASHED, payload) {
        engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("could not emit {EVENT_CRASHED}: {e}"));
    }
}

struct Outcome {
    published: bool,
    exit: Option<ExitStatus>,
    /// spawn error or the engine's own SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED message
    error: Option<String>,
    /// the child handed over to an engine that was already running
    adopted: bool,
    adopted_pid: Option<u32>,
}

impl Outcome {
    fn describe(&self) -> String {
        if self.adopted && self.published {
            let pid = self.adopted_pid.map_or_else(|| "?".to_string(), |p| p.to_string());
            return format!("adopted engine (pid {pid}) is gone");
        }
        let code = self.exit.map(describe_exit).unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown exit status".into());
        match (&self.error, self.published) {
            (Some(e), _) => format!("{e} ({code})"),
            (None, true) => format!("engine exited unexpectedly ({code})"),
            (None, false) => format!("engine exited before reporting a port ({code})"),
        }
    }
}

fn describe_exit(status: ExitStatus) -> String {
    match status.code() {
        // ntstatus crash codes read better in hex, 0xC0000005 and friends
        Some(c) if c < 0 => format!("exit code 0x{:08X}", c as u32),
        Some(c) => format!("exit code {c}"),
        None => "terminated by signal".into(),
    }
}

/// one stdout line from the engine
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Line<'a> {
    Ready { port: u16, token: Option<&'a str> },
    Malformed,
    Existing(Option<u32>),
    Failed(&'a str),
    Log,
}

pub fn parse_line(line: &str) -> Line<'_> {
    let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
    match parts.next() {
        Some("SLOP_ENGINE_READY") => match parts.next().and_then(|p| p.parse::<u16>().ok()) {
            Some(port) if port != 0 => Line::Ready { port, token: parts.next() },
            _ => Line::Malformed,
        },
        Some("SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING") => Line::Existing(parts.next().and_then(|p| p.parse().ok())),
        Some("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED") => {
            Line::Failed(line.trim_start().trim_start_matches("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED").trim())
        }
        _ => Line::Log,
    }
}

fn run_once(app: &AppHandle, engine: &Engine, path: &Path) -> Outcome {
    let mut out = Outcome { published: false, exit: None, error: None, adopted: false, adopted_pid: None };

    let mut cmd = Command::new(path);
    cmd.arg("--headless")
        .arg("--parent-pid")
        .arg(std::process::id().to_string())
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped());
    if !engine.token.is_empty() {
        cmd.env("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", &engine.token);
    }
    // the engine is a console subsystem binary; without this a black console
    // flashes up beside the window on every launch
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        const CREATE_NO_WINDOW: u32 = 0x0800_0000;
        cmd.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
    }

    engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("starting {}", path.display()));
    let mut child = match cmd.spawn() {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            out.error = Some(format!("failed to start {}: {e}", path.display()));
            return out;
        }
    };

    #[cfg(windows)]
    if let Err(e) = crate::job::adopt(&child) {
        engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("engine job object unavailable ({e}); relying on parent watch"));
    }

    let stdout = child.stdout.take();
    if let Some(stderr) = child.stderr.take() {
        let app = app.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let engine = app.state::<Engine>();
            for line in BufReader::new(stderr).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
                engine.log.line("engine", &line);
            }
        });
    }
    *lock(&engine.child) = Some(child);

    if let Some(stdout) = stdout {
        for line in BufReader::new(stdout).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
            match parse_line(&line) {
                Line::Ready { port, token } => {
                    let token = token.map(str::to_string).unwrap_or_else(|| engine.token.clone());
                    let (generation, restarted) = engine.publish(port, token);
                    out.published = true;
                    engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("engine listening on 127.0.0.1:{port} (generation {generation})"));
                    if restarted {
                        if let Err(e) = app.emit(EVENT_RESTARTED, RestartedEvent { port, generation }) {
                            engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("could not emit {EVENT_RESTARTED}: {e}"));
                        }
                    }
                }
                Line::Existing(pid) => {
                    out.adopted = true;
                    out.adopted_pid = pid;
                    lock(&engine.inner).adopted = true;
                    engine.log.line("supervisor", &format!("handed over to an engine that was already running (pid {})", pid.map_or("?".into(), |p| p.to_string())));
                }
                Line::Failed(msg) => {
                    let msg = format!("engine reported failure: {msg}");
                    engine.note_error(&msg);
                    engine.log.line("supervisor", &msg);
                    out.error = Some(msg);
                }
                Line::Malformed => {
                    let msg = format!("malformed handshake: {line}");
                    engine.note_error(&msg);
                    engine.log.line("supervisor", &msg);
                    out.error = Some(msg);
                }
                Line::Log => engine.log.line("stdout", &line),
            }
        }
    }

    // stdout closed: the process is exiting or gone
    out.exit = engine.reap();

    // a handed-over engine outlives our short-lived child, supervise that one
    if out.published && out.adopted && lock(&engine.inner).adopted {
        let port = lock(&engine.inner).endpoint.as_ref().map(|e| e.port).unwrap_or(0);
        watch_external(engine, out.adopted_pid, port);
    }
    out
}

/// blocks until the adopted engine is gone, or shutdown or a restart request
fn watch_external(engine: &Engine, pid: Option<u32>, port: u16) {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    if let Some(pid) = pid {
        if let Some(handle) = win::open_sync(pid) {
            while !engine.interrupted() {
                if handle.wait(Duration::from_millis(250)) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
    }
    let _ = pid;
    // no handle to wait on: three refused connections in a row means it's gone
    let mut misses = 0;
    while !engine.interrupted() {
        let addr = SocketAddr::from((Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port));
        if TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr, Duration::from_millis(500)).is_ok() {
            misses = 0;
        } else {
            misses += 1;
            if misses >= 3 {
                return;
            }
        }
        for _ in 0..10 {
            if engine.interrupted() {
                return;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
        }
    }
}

/// POST /api/v1 {tool: app, action: shutdown}, the same request File > Exit sends
fn request_quit(port: u16, token: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let body = serde_json::json!({
        "tool": "app",
        "action": "shutdown",
        "params": { "reason": reason },
    })
    .to_string();
    let addr = SocketAddr::from((Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port));
    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr, Duration::from_millis(1000))
        .map_err(|e| format!("connect: {e}"))?;
    let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(1500)));
    let _ = stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(1500)));
    let auth = if token.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!("Authorization: Bearer {token}\r\n") };
    let request = format!(
        "POST /api/v1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:{port}\r\n{auth}Content-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{body}",
        body.len()
    );
    stream.write_all(request.as_bytes()).map_err(|e| format!("send: {e}"))?;
    let mut head = [0u8; 64];
    let n = stream.read(&mut head).map_err(|e| format!("receive: {e}"))?;
    let status_line = String::from_utf8_lossy(&head[..n]);
    match status_line.split_whitespace().nth(1) {
        Some("200") => Ok(()),
        Some(code) => Err(format!("engine answered HTTP {code}")),
        None => Err("engine closed the connection without answering".into()),
    }
}

/// 32 random bytes as hex from the os csprng
fn random_token() -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut bytes = [0u8; 32];
    fill_random(&mut bytes)?;
    Ok(bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect())
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn fill_random(buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::Cryptography::{BCryptGenRandom, BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG};
    // SAFETY: buf is a valid writable slice of the length passed
    let status = unsafe {
        BCryptGenRandom(std::ptr::null_mut(), buf.as_mut_ptr(), buf.len() as u32, BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG)
    };
    if status == 0 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(format!("BCryptGenRandom failed with 0x{:08X}", status as u32))
    }
}

#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn fill_random(buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::File::open("/dev/urandom")
        .and_then(|mut f| f.read_exact(buf))
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod win {
    use std::time::Duration;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, HANDLE, WAIT_OBJECT_0};
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{OpenProcess, WaitForSingleObject, PROCESS_SYNCHRONIZE};

    pub struct ProcessHandle(HANDLE);

    pub fn open_sync(pid: u32) -> Option<ProcessHandle> {
        // SAFETY: plain win32 call, a null result is handled
        let h = unsafe { OpenProcess(PROCESS_SYNCHRONIZE, 0, pid) };
        (!h.is_null()).then_some(ProcessHandle(h))
    }

    impl ProcessHandle {
        /// true once the process has exited
        pub fn wait(&self, timeout: Duration) -> bool {
            // SAFETY: the handle is open for SYNCHRONIZE until drop
            unsafe { WaitForSingleObject(self.0, timeout.as_millis() as u32) == WAIT_OBJECT_0 }
        }
    }

    impl Drop for ProcessHandle {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            // SAFETY: we own the handle
            unsafe { CloseHandle(self.0) };
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn parses_handshake_lines() {
        assert_eq!(
            parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_READY 8765 abc"),
            Line::Ready { port: 8765, token: Some("abc") }
        );
        // tokenless form used when the supervisor passes SLOP_MCP_TOKEN
        assert_eq!(parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_READY 8765"), Line::Ready { port: 8765, token: None });
        assert_eq!(parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_READY 0 abc"), Line::Malformed);
        assert_eq!(parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_READY nope"), Line::Malformed);
        assert_eq!(parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_READY"), Line::Malformed);
        assert_eq!(parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING 4242"), Line::Existing(Some(4242)));
        assert_eq!(parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING"), Line::Existing(None));
        assert_eq!(
            parse_line("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED mcp server did not bind"),
            Line::Failed("mcp server did not bind")
        );
        assert_eq!(parse_line("boot: stage 3/6"), Line::Log);
        assert_eq!(parse_line(""), Line::Log);
    }

    #[test]
    fn backoff_doubles_and_caps() {
        let ms: Vec<u128> = (1..=8).map(|n| backoff(n).as_millis()).collect();
        assert_eq!(ms, [500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 30000, 30000]);
        assert_eq!(backoff(0).as_millis(), 500);
        assert_eq!(backoff(u32::MAX).as_millis(), 30000);
    }

    #[test]
    fn outcome_descriptions_distinguish_cases() {
        let none = Outcome { published: false, exit: None, error: None, adopted: false, adopted_pid: None };
        assert!(none.describe().starts_with("engine exited before reporting a port"));
        let crashed = Outcome { published: true, ..none };
        assert!(crashed.describe().starts_with("engine exited unexpectedly"));
        let failed = Outcome {
            published: false,
            exit: None,
            error: Some("engine reported failure: x".into()),
            adopted: false,
            adopted_pid: None,
        };
        assert!(failed.describe().starts_with("engine reported failure: x"));
        let adopted = Outcome { published: true, exit: None, error: None, adopted: true, adopted_pid: Some(7) };
        assert_eq!(adopted.describe(), "adopted engine (pid 7) is gone");
        let unknown = Outcome { adopted_pid: None, ..adopted };
        assert_eq!(unknown.describe(), "adopted engine (pid ?) is gone");
    }

    #[test]
    fn random_tokens_are_64_hex_and_distinct() {
        let a = random_token().unwrap();
        let b = random_token().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a.len(), 64);
        assert!(a.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()));
        assert_ne!(a, b);
    }

    fn engine() -> Engine {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("slop-supervisor-test-{}", std::process::id()));
        Engine::new(Arc::new(EngineLog::at(dir.join("engine.log"), 1 << 20)))
    }

    #[test]
    fn wait_blocks_through_restart_and_returns_new_endpoint() {
        let e = Arc::new(engine());
        let (g1, restarted) = e.publish(1000, "t".into());
        assert_eq!((g1, restarted), (1, false));
        e.begin_restart("crash");
        assert_eq!(e.status().phase, Phase::Restarting);
        let e2 = Arc::clone(&e);
        let waiter = std::thread::spawn(move || e2.wait(Duration::from_secs(10)));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
        let (g2, restarted) = e.publish(2000, "t".into());
        assert_eq!((g2, restarted), (2, true));
        let ep = waiter.join().unwrap().unwrap();
        assert_eq!((ep.port, ep.generation), (2000, 2));
        assert_eq!(e.status().restarts, 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn wait_errors_once_supervisor_gives_up_and_times_out_otherwise() {
        let e = engine();
        assert!(e.wait(Duration::from_millis(30)).unwrap_err().contains("in time"));
        e.give_up("boom");
        assert_eq!(e.wait(Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap_err(), "boom");
        assert_eq!(e.status().phase, Phase::Failed);
    }

    #[test]
    fn shutdown_interrupts_backoff_and_parking() {
        let e = Arc::new(engine());
        let e2 = Arc::clone(&e);
        let sleeper = std::thread::spawn(move || e2.backoff_sleep(Duration::from_secs(30)));
        let e3 = Arc::clone(&e);
        let parked = std::thread::spawn(move || e3.park_until_restart());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
        assert!(e.begin_shutdown());
        assert!(!e.begin_shutdown(), "second shutdown is a no-op");
        assert!(!sleeper.join().unwrap());
        assert!(!parked.join().unwrap());
        assert!(e.wait(Duration::from_secs(1)).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn poisoned_state_lock_is_recovered() {
        let e = Arc::new(engine());
        let e2 = Arc::clone(&e);
        let _ = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let _guard = e2.inner.lock().unwrap();
            panic!("poison it");
        })
        .join();
        assert!(e.inner.is_poisoned());
        e.publish(3000, "t".into());
        assert_eq!(e.wait(Duration::from_secs(1)).unwrap().port, 3000);
    }

    #[test]
    fn quit_request_reaches_api_with_bearer_token() {
        let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind((Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, 0)).unwrap();
        let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
        let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (mut s, _) = listener.accept().unwrap();
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; 4096];
            let mut got = Vec::new();
            loop {
                let n = s.read(&mut buf).unwrap();
                got.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&got);
                if let Some(at) = text.find("\r\n\r\n") {
                    let len: usize = text
                        .lines()
                        .find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("Content-Length: "))
                        .unwrap()
                        .trim()
                        .parse()
                        .unwrap();
                    if got.len() >= at + 4 + len {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if n == 0 {
                    break;
                }
            }
            s.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\n{}").unwrap();
            String::from_utf8(got).unwrap()
        });
        request_quit(port, "secret", "bye").unwrap();
        let req = server.join().unwrap();
        assert!(req.starts_with("POST /api/v1 HTTP/1.1\r\n"));
        assert!(req.contains("Authorization: Bearer secret\r\n"));
        let body: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(req.split("\r\n\r\n").nth(1).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(body["tool"], "app");
        assert_eq!(body["action"], "shutdown");
        assert_eq!(body["params"]["reason"], "bye");
    }
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/App.tsx
// the shell, css grid layout driven by splitter custom properties

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { FolderOpen, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";
import ActivityRail from "@/components/ActivityRail";
import CommandPalette from "@/components/CommandPalette";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import SettingsModal from "@/components/SettingsModal";
import Splash from "@/components/Splash";
import Splitter from "@/components/Splitter";
import StatusBar from "@/components/StatusBar";
import TitleBar from "@/components/TitleBar";
import TooltipLayer from "@/components/TooltipLayer";
import InspectorPanel from "@/components/panels/InspectorPanel";
import ModulesPanel from "@/components/panels/ModulesPanel";
import OutputPanel from "@/components/panels/OutputPanel";
import ScannerPanel from "@/components/panels/ScannerPanel";
import ScriptsPanel from "@/components/panels/ScriptsPanel";
import TargetsPanel from "@/components/panels/TargetsPanel";
import WorkspacePanel from "@/components/panels/WorkspacePanel";
import { panelId, tabId } from "@/components/Tabs";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { useShortcuts } from "@/lib/shortcuts";
import { openPath } from "@/lib/shell";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useOutput } from "@/store/output";
import { kLayoutVars, useUi, type LayoutVar } from "@/store/ui";
import { useUpdater } from "@/store/updater";
import { useWatch } from "@/store/watch";

/** Post-boot failures (snapshot, engine crash) surface here, not on the splash. */
function EngineBanner() {
  const t = useT();
  const startupError = useEngine((s) => s.startupError);
  const crash = useEngine((s) => s.crash);
  const retry = useEngine((s) => s.retry);
  const dismiss = useEngine((s) => s.dismissError);
  if (startupError === null && crash === null) return null;
  const text =
    crash !== null
      ? crash.retry_in_ms === null
        ? t("app.crashStopped", { reason: crash.reason })
        : t("app.crashRestarting", {
            reason: crash.reason,
            seconds: Math.ceil(crash.retry_in_ms / 1000),
          })
      : t("app.engineError", { error: startupError ?? "" });
  return (
    <div className="engine-banner" role="alert">
      <span>
        {text}
        {crash !== null && crash.log_path !== "" ? t("app.logPath", { path: crash.log_path }) : ""}
      </span>
      <div className="spacer" />
      {crash !== null && crash.log_path !== "" && (
        <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void openPath(crash.log_path)}>
          <FolderOpen size={11} aria-hidden /> {t("app.openLogFolder")}
        </button>
      )}
      <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void retry()}>
        <RotateCcw size={11} aria-hidden /> {t("common.retry")}
      </button>
      {crash === null && (
        <IconButton tip={t("common.dismiss")} onClick={dismiss}>
          <X size={13} />
        </IconButton>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Update check, download and restart, surfaced above the workspace. */
function UpdateBanner() {
  const t = useT();
  const phase = useUpdater((s) => s.phase);
  const version = useUpdater((s) => s.version);
  const progress = useUpdater((s) => s.progress);
  const error = useUpdater((s) => s.error);
  const dismissed = useUpdater((s) => s.dismissed);
  const install = useUpdater((s) => s.install);
  const dismiss = useUpdater((s) => s.dismiss);
  const check = useUpdater((s) => s.check);
  if (dismissed || phase === "idle" || phase === "checking") return null;
  if (phase === "available") {
    return (
      <div className="engine-banner update-banner" role="status">
        <span>{t("app.updateAvailable", { version: version ?? "" })}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void install()}>
          {t("app.installRestart")}
        </button>
        <IconButton tip={t("common.dismiss")} onClick={dismiss}>
          <X size={13} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (phase === "downloading") {
    const pct = progress < 0 ? null : Math.round(progress * 100);
    return (
      <div className="engine-banner update-banner" role="status">
        <span>
          {t("app.updateDownloading", {
            version: version ?? "",
            percent: pct === null ? "" : ` ${pct}%`,
          })}
        </span>
        <div className="update-progress" aria-hidden>
          <span style={{ width: pct === null ? "100%" : `${pct}%` }} />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (phase === "ready") {
    return (
      <div className="engine-banner update-banner" role="status">
        <span>{t("app.updateInstalled")}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="engine-banner update-banner" role="alert">
      <span>{t("app.updateFailed", { error: error ?? "" })}</span>
      <div className="spacer" />
      <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void check(true)}>
        <RotateCcw size={11} aria-hidden /> {t("common.retry")}
      </button>
      <IconButton tip={t("common.dismiss")} onClick={dismiss}>
        <X size={13} />
      </IconButton>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  const t = useT();
  const rail = useUi((s) => s.rail);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const settingsOpen = useUi((s) => s.settingsOpen);
  const openSettings = useUi((s) => s.openSettings);
  const closeSettings = useUi((s) => s.closeSettings);
  const inspectorOpen = useUi((s) => s.inspectorOpen);
  const appRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const boot = useEngine((s) => s.boot);
  const start = useEngine((s) => s.start);
  const attachOutput = useOutput((s) => s.attach);
  const attachWatch = useWatch((s) => s.attach);
  const sizes = useUi((s) => s.sizes);

  // Persisted splitter sizes drive the grid's CSS variables; an unset entry
  // (fresh install, Reset layout) falls back to the stylesheet default
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = appRef.current;
    if (root === null) return;
    for (const key of Object.keys(kLayoutVars) as LayoutVar[]) {
      const px = sizes[key];
      if (px === undefined) root.style.removeProperty(key);
      else root.style.setProperty(key, `${px}px`);
    }
  }, [sizes]);

  useShortcuts();

  useEffect(() => {
    // Event handlers must be registered before connect() so the first frames
    // after the stream opens are not dropped
    const detachOutput = attachOutput();
    const detachWatch = attachWatch();
    void start();
    // Release builds check for a newer installer once per launch; browser dev
    // and offline runs resolve to a no-op.
    void useUpdater.getState().check();
    return () => {
      detachOutput();
      detachWatch();
    };
  }, [start, attachOutput, attachWatch]);

  const leftPanel = () => {
    // Keyed so switching rails remounts the panel and replays its enter
    // animation (see `.panel` in the motion section of app.css)
    switch (rail) {
      case "targets":
        return <TargetsPanel key="targets" />;
      case "modules":
        return <ModulesPanel key="modules" />;
      case "scripts":
        return <ScriptsPanel key="scripts" />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="app" ref={appRef}>
      <TitleBar />

      {!boot.done ? (
        <Splash />
      ) : (
        <div className="app-shell">
          {/* Always present: with no banner the main would land in the auto
              row and the 1fr row would stay empty (black lower half). */}
          <div className="banner-slot">
            <EngineBanner />
            <UpdateBanner />
          </div>
          <main className="app-body" data-inspector={inspectorOpen ? "open" : "closed"}>
            <ActivityRail active={rail} onSelect={setRail} onSettings={openSettings} />

            <section
              className="left-slot"
              role="tabpanel"
              id={panelId("rail", rail)}
              aria-labelledby={tabId("rail", rail)}
            >
              {leftPanel()}
            </section>
            <Splitter
              axis="x"
              variable="--left-w"
              target={appRef}
              min={200}
              max={620}
              label={t("app.resizeSidePanel")}
            />

            <div className="center-col">
              <div className="center-top">
                <ScannerPanel />
                <Splitter
                  axis="x"
                  variable="--scan-w"
                  target={appRef}
                  min={220}
                  max={620}
                  label={t("app.resizeScanner")}
                />
                <WorkspacePanel />
              </div>
              <Splitter
                axis="y"
                variable="--bottom-h"
                target={appRef}
                min={100}
                max={640}
                invert
                label={t("app.resizeOutput")}
              />
              <OutputPanel />
            </div>

            {inspectorOpen && (
              <>
                <Splitter
                  axis="x"
                  variable="--right-w"
                  target={appRef}
                  min={220}
                  max={620}
                  invert
                  label={t("app.resizeInspector")}
                />
                <InspectorPanel />
              </>
            )}
          </main>
        </div>
      )}

      <StatusBar />
      {settingsOpen && <SettingsModal onClose={closeSettings} />}
      <CommandPalette />
      <TooltipLayer />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/bench/VirtualListBench.tsx
// bench-only fixture: a virtualized list of 1,000,000 synthetic rows shaped
// like the disassembly listing, with no engine behind it. Loaded by
// app/scripts/bench-ui.mjs, never by the app.

import { useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";

export const kBenchRows = 1_000_000;
const kRow = 20;

/** Synthetic row text; the filter matches on it. */
export function benchRow(i: number): string {
  return `sub_${(0x140000000 + i * 16).toString(16)} mov rax, [rbx+${i & 0xff}]`;
}

export default function VirtualListBench({ filter = "" }: { filter?: string }) {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const matches = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === "") return null;
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < kBenchRows; i++) if (benchRow(i).includes(filter)) out.push(i);
    return out;
  }, [filter]);
  const count = matches === null ? kBenchRows : matches.length;
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 25,
  });
  return (
    <div ref={scrollRef} style={{ height: 600, overflow: "auto" }}>
      <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
        {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => (
          <div key={v.index} style={{ position: "absolute", top: v.start, height: kRow }}>
            {benchRow(matches === null ? v.index : matches[v.index])}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/CfgGraph.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/CfgGraph.tsx
// Control-flow graph for one function: disasm.blocks / xray.cfg return
// {nodes:[{id,start,end,size,insn_count,summary?}], edges:[{from,to,kind}]}
// and this draws it. Layered layout: one column per BFS depth from the entry,
// rows ordered by address, so the same function always draws the same way.
// Nodes are HTML buttons (keyboard reachable, data-tip works on them); edges
// are SVG, dashed for fallthrough, solid with an arrowhead for a branch

import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { hex } from "@/lib/format";
import { kMaxCfgBlocks, type CfgGraphData, type CfgNode } from "@/store/decomp";

const kNodeW = 168;
const kGapX = 56;
const kGapY = 12;
const kPad = 12;

/** Box height grows with the block, clamped so one huge block cannot dominate. */
function nodeHeight(insnCount: number): number {
  return Math.max(30, Math.min(96, 24 + insnCount * 5));
}

type Placed = { node: CfgNode; x: number; y: number; h: number; depth: number };

/**
 * BFS depth from the entry gives the column; blocks the walk never reaches
 * (should not happen inside one function) land in the first column too.
 */
function layoutGraph(
  graph: CfgGraphData,
  entry?: number | null,
): { placed: Placed[]; width: number; height: number } {
  const ids = new Set(graph.nodes.map((n) => n.id));
  const root =
    entry !== undefined && entry !== null && ids.has(entry)
      ? entry
      : graph.nodes.reduce((a, b) => (b.start < a.start ? b : a)).id;

  const depth = new Map<number, number>([[root, 0]]);
  const queue = [root];
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const cur = queue.shift() as number;
    const d = depth.get(cur) as number;
    for (const e of graph.edges) {
      if (e.from !== cur || !ids.has(e.to) || depth.has(e.to)) continue;
      depth.set(e.to, d + 1);
      queue.push(e.to);
    }
  }

  const columns = new Map<number, CfgNode[]>();
  for (const n of graph.nodes) {
    const d = depth.get(n.id) ?? 0;
    const col = columns.get(d);
    if (col === undefined) columns.set(d, [n]);
    else col.push(n);
  }

  const placed: Placed[] = [];
  let width = 0;
  let height = 0;
  for (const d of [...columns.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
    const col = (columns.get(d) as CfgNode[]).sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
    let y = kPad;
    for (const node of col) {
      const h = nodeHeight(node.insn_count);
      const x = kPad + d * (kNodeW + kGapX);
      placed.push({ node, x, y, h, depth: d });
      y += h + kGapY;
      width = Math.max(width, x + kNodeW + kPad);
      height = Math.max(height, y);
    }
  }
  return { placed, width, height: height + kPad };
}

/** Forward edges curve down; back edges leave right and re-enter on the left. */
function edgePath(a: Placed, b: Placed): string {
  if (b.depth > a.depth) {
    const ax = a.x + kNodeW / 2;
    const ay = a.y + a.h;
    const bx = b.x + kNodeW / 2;
    const by = b.y;
    const mid = (ay + by) / 2;
    return `M ${ax} ${ay} C ${ax} ${mid}, ${bx} ${mid}, ${bx} ${by}`;
  }
  const sx = a.x + kNodeW;
  const sy = a.y + a.h / 2;
  const tx = b.x;
  const ty = b.y + b.h / 2;
  const out = Math.max(sx, tx) + kGapX / 2;
  return `M ${sx} ${sy} C ${out} ${sy}, ${out} ${ty}, ${tx} ${ty}`;
}

type Props = {
  graph: CfgGraphData | null;
  entry?: number | null;
  /** Jump the listing to a block. */
  onPick: (va: number) => void;
};

export default function CfgGraph({ graph, entry, onPick }: Props) {
  const t = useT();
  if (graph === null || graph.nodes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="empty">
        <div className="empty-title">{t("cfg.empty")}</div>
        <div className="empty-hint">{t("cfg.emptyHint")}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (graph.nodes.length > kMaxCfgBlocks) {
    return (
      <div className="empty" role="status">
        <div className="empty-title">{t("cfg.tooMany", { count: graph.nodes.length })}</div>
        <div className="empty-hint">{t("cfg.tooManyHint", { max: kMaxCfgBlocks })}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { placed, width, height } = layoutGraph(graph, entry);
  const at = new Map(placed.map((p) => [p.node.id, p]));
  const edges = graph.edges.filter((e) => at.has(e.from) && at.has(e.to));

  return (
    <div className="cfg" role="group" aria-label={t("cfg.group")}>
      <div className="cfg-viewport">
        <div className="cfg-canvas" style={{ width, height }}>
          <svg className="cfg-edges" width={width} height={height} aria-hidden="true">
            <defs>
              <marker
                id="cfg-arrow"
                viewBox="0 0 8 8"
                refX="7"
                refY="4"
                markerWidth="7"
                markerHeight="7"
                orient="auto-start-reverse"
              >
                <path d="M 0 0 L 8 4 L 0 8 z" className="cfg-arrow" />
              </marker>
            </defs>
            {edges.map((e) => {
              const a = at.get(e.from) as Placed;
              const b = at.get(e.to) as Placed;
              return (
                <path
                  key={`${e.from}-${e.to}`}
                  className="cfg-edge"
                  data-edge={e.kind}
                  data-from={e.from}
                  data-to={e.to}
                  d={edgePath(a, b)}
                  markerEnd="url(#cfg-arrow)"
                />
              );
            })}
          </svg>
          {placed.map(({ node, x, y, h }) => {
            const tip = t("cfg.blockTip", {
              start: hex(node.start, 8),
              end: hex(node.end, 8),
              count: node.insn_count,
              summary:
                node.summary !== undefined && node.summary !== "" ? ` · ${node.summary}` : "",
            });
            return (
              <button
                key={node.id}
                type="button"
                className="cfg-node"
                style={{ left: x, top: y, width: kNodeW, height: h }}
                data-tip={tip}
                aria-label={t("cfg.blockAria", {
                  addr: hex(node.start, 8),
                  count: node.insn_count,
                })}
                onClick={() => onPick(node.start)}
              >
                <span className="cfg-node-va mono">{hex(node.start, 8)}</span>
                <span className="cfg-node-sum mono">
                  {node.summary ?? t("cfg.insns", { count: node.insn_count })}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/CommandPalette.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/CommandPalette.tsx
// Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P command palette (cmdk): jump to a function by name or
// address, go to an address in the listing or the hex view, switch tabs and
// panels, and run the shell actions the menus carry

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Command } from "cmdk";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";
import { openBinary } from "@/lib/openBinary";
import { browserLabel, hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { loadHelpIndex, openHelp, searchHelp, type HelpEntry } from "@/lib/help";
import { functionLabel, useDisasm, type FunctionRow } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useDecomp } from "@/store/decomp";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useMemory } from "@/store/memory";
import { kThemes, useTheme } from "@/store/theme";
import { useUi, type RailView, type WorkspaceTab } from "@/store/ui";

type Action = {
  id: string;
  group: "navigate" | "actions" | "theme";
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  run: () => void;
  enabled?: boolean;
};

const kSearchLimit = 50;
const kSearchDebounceMs = 120;
const kHelpLimit = 8;

const kGroupLabels: Record<Action["group"], Key> = {
  navigate: "palette.navigate",
  actions: "palette.actions",
  theme: "palette.theme",
};

export default function CommandPalette() {
  const t = useT();
  const open = useUi((s) => s.paletteOpen);
  const setOpen = useUi((s) => s.setPaletteOpen);
  const setWorkspaceTab = useUi((s) => s.setWorkspaceTab);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const openSettings = useUi((s) => s.openSettings);
  const inspectorOpen = useUi((s) => s.inspectorOpen);
  const setInspectorOpen = useUi((s) => s.setInspectorOpen);
  const resetLayout = useUi((s) => s.resetLayout);
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);
  const searchFunctions = useDisasm((s) => s.searchFunctions);
  const attached = useEngine((s) => s.target.attached);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [found, setFound] = useState<FunctionRow[]>([]);
  const [help, setHelp] = useState<HelpEntry[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) setQuery("");
  }, [open]);

  // The docs index is a generated chunk: load it the first time the palette
  // opens, never at startup
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let alive = true;
    void loadHelpIndex().then((entries) => alive && setHelp(entries));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [open]);

  const helpHits = useMemo(() => searchHelp(help, query.trim(), kHelpLimit), [help, query]);

  // Function search is server-side: the list can hold far more functions
  // than the UI ever loads
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !image.ready || query.trim() === "") {
      setFound([]);
      return;
    }
    let alive = true;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      searchFunctions(query.trim(), kSearchLimit)
        .then((rows) => alive && setFound(rows))
        .catch(() => alive && setFound([]));
    }, kSearchDebounceMs);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [open, query, image.ready, searchFunctions]);

  const close = () => setOpen(false);
  const tab = (id: WorkspaceTab) => () => setWorkspaceTab(id);
  const rail = (id: RailView) => () => setRail(id);
  // Pseudocode follows the listing selection, so the tab only has to be shown
  const showDecomp = (split: boolean) => () => {
    const sel = useDisasm.getState().selected;
    setWorkspaceTab("decomp");
    useDecomp.getState().setSplit(split);
    if (sel !== null) void useDecomp.getState().load(sel);
  };

  const actions: Action[] = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        id: "tab-disassembly",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("workspace.disassembly"),
        run: tab("disassembly"),
      },
      { id: "tab-decomp", group: "navigate", label: t("workspace.decomp"), run: tab("decomp") },
      {
        id: "show-pseudocode",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("palette.showPseudocode"),
        enabled: image.ready,
        run: showDecomp(false),
      },
      {
        id: "show-cfg",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("palette.showCfg"),
        enabled: image.ready,
        run: showDecomp(true),
      },
      { id: "tab-strings", group: "navigate", label: t("workspace.strings"), run: tab("strings") },
      { id: "tab-memory", group: "navigate", label: t("workspace.memory"), run: tab("memory") },
      {
        id: "tab-debugger",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("workspace.debugger"),
        run: tab("debugger"),
      },
      { id: "tab-pe", group: "navigate", label: browserLabel(image.format), run: tab("pe") },
      {
        id: "rail-targets",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("palette.targetsPanel"),
        run: rail("targets"),
      },
      {
        id: "rail-modules",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("palette.modulesPanel"),
        run: rail("modules"),
      },
      {
        id: "rail-scripts",
        group: "navigate",
        label: t("palette.scriptsPanel"),
        run: rail("scripts"),
      },
      {
        id: "open",
        group: "actions",
        label: t("common.openBinary"),
        hint: "Ctrl+O",
        run: () => void openBinary(),
      },
      {
        id: "close",
        group: "actions",
        label: t("palette.closeBinary"),
        enabled: image.ready,
        run: () => void useDisasm.getState().unload(),
      },
      {
        id: "settings",
        group: "actions",
        label: t("titlebar.settings"),
        hint: "Ctrl+,",
        run: openSettings,
      },
      {
        id: "inspector",
        group: "actions",
        label: t(inspectorOpen ? "titlebar.hideInspector" : "titlebar.showInspector"),
        run: () => setInspectorOpen(!inspectorOpen),
      },
      { id: "layout", group: "actions", label: t("titlebar.resetLayout"), run: resetLayout },
      {
        id: "reload",
        group: "actions",
        label: t("titlebar.reload"),
        run: () => window.location.reload(),
      },
      ...kThemes.map((th): Action => ({
        id: `theme-${th.id}`,
        group: "theme",
        label: t("palette.themeItem", { theme: t(th.labelKey) }),
        run: () => setTheme(th.id),
      })),
    ],
    // tab/rail are stable closures over stable setters
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [
      image.format,
      image.ready,
      inspectorOpen,
      openSettings,
      setInspectorOpen,
      resetLayout,
      setTheme,
      t,
    ],
  );

  const addr = parseAddress(query);
  const runAndClose = (fn: () => void) => () => {
    close();
    fn();
  };

  return (
    <Command.Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={setOpen}
      label={t("palette.label")}
      className="palette"
      overlayClassName="palette-scrim"
      contentClassName="palette-content"
    >
      <Command.Input
        className="palette-input"
        value={query}
        onValueChange={setQuery}
        placeholder={t("palette.placeholder")}
      />
      <Command.List className="palette-list">
        <Command.Empty className="palette-empty">{t("palette.noMatches")}</Command.Empty>

        {addr !== null && (
          <Command.Group heading={t("palette.gotoAddress")}>
            {image.ready && (
              <Command.Item
                value={`goto-disasm ${query}`}
                onSelect={runAndClose(() => {
                  setWorkspaceTab("disassembly");
                  void useDisasm.getState().gotoAddress(addr);
                })}
              >
                {t("palette.disasmAt", { addr: hex(addr, 1) })}
              </Command.Item>
            )}
            {image.ready && (
              <Command.Item
                value={`pseudocode ${query}`}
                onSelect={runAndClose(() => {
                  setWorkspaceTab("decomp");
                  void useDecomp.getState().load(addr);
                })}
              >
                {t("palette.pseudocodeAt", { addr: hex(addr, 1) })}
              </Command.Item>
            )}
            {attached && (
              <Command.Item
                value={`goto-memory ${query}`}
                onSelect={runAndClose(() => {
                  setWorkspaceTab("memory");
                  useMemory.getState().goto(addr);
                })}
              >
                {t("palette.memoryAt", { addr: hex(addr, 1) })}
              </Command.Item>
            )}
          </Command.Group>
        )}

        {found.length > 0 && (
          <Command.Group heading={t("palette.functions")}>
            {found.map((fn) => (
              <Command.Item
                key={fn.va}
                value={`fn ${functionLabel(fn)} ${fn.va.toString(16)}`}
                keywords={[functionLabel(fn), fn.va.toString(16), query]}
                onSelect={runAndClose(() => {
                  setWorkspaceTab("disassembly");
                  void useDisasm.getState().select(fn.va, fn);
                })}
              >
                <span className="mono">{functionLabel(fn)}</span>
                <span className="palette-hint mono">{hex(fn.va, 1)}</span>
              </Command.Item>
            ))}
          </Command.Group>
        )}

        {helpHits.length > 0 && (
          <Command.Group heading={t("palette.help")}>
            {helpHits.map((e) => (
              <Command.Item
                key={`${e.path}#${e.anchor}`}
                // cmdk filters on `value`, so the excerpt has to be in it or a
                // body-text match from searchHelp would be dropped again
                value={`help ${e.title} ${e.section} ${e.path} ${e.text}`}
                onSelect={runAndClose(() => void openHelp(e.url))}
              >
                <span>{e.title}</span>
                <span className="palette-hint">{e.path.replace(/\.md$/, "")}</span>
              </Command.Item>
            ))}
          </Command.Group>
        )}

        {(["navigate", "actions", "theme"] as const).map((group) => (
          <Command.Group heading={t(kGroupLabels[group])} key={group}>
            {actions
              .filter((a) => a.group === group && a.enabled !== false)
              .map((a) => (
                <Command.Item key={a.id} value={a.label} onSelect={runAndClose(a.run)}>
                  <span>{a.label}</span>
                  {a.hint !== undefined && <span className="palette-hint">{a.hint}</span>}
                </Command.Item>
              ))}
          </Command.Group>
        ))}
      </Command.List>
    </Command.Dialog>
  );
}
```
