`app/src/components/IconButton.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/IconButton.tsx
// Icon-only button. The tooltip text doubles as the accessible name: the
// global tooltip layer is pointer/focus driven and invisible to screen
// readers, so every icon button must carry an aria-label

import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";

type Props = Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "aria-label"> & {
  /** Tooltip and accessible name. */
  tip: string;
  /** Pressed state for toggles (renders aria-pressed + data-active). */
  pressed?: boolean;
  /** Visual style: square icon button, bordered row action, or only `className`. */
  variant?: "icon" | "row" | "bare";
  children: ReactNode;
};

const IconButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, Props>(function IconButton(
  { tip, pressed, variant = "icon", className, children, type = "button", ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  const base = variant === "icon" ? "icon-button" : variant === "row" ? "row-action" : "";
  const cls = [base, className ?? ""].filter((c) => c !== "").join(" ");
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type}
      className={cls}
      data-tip={tip}
      aria-label={tip}
      {...(pressed !== undefined ? { "aria-pressed": pressed, "data-active": pressed } : {})}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

export default IconButton;
```

`app/src/components/Modal.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/Modal.tsx
// Accessible modal dialog: role=dialog + aria-modal, labelled by its title,
// Escape and scrim click close it, focus moves in on open, Tab is trapped
// inside, and focus returns to whatever opened it on close

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";

type Props = {
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
  /** Extra class on the dialog box (width variants). */
  className?: string;
};

const kFocusable =
  'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children, className }: Props) {
  const t = useT();
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
  onCloseRef.current = onClose;

  useEffect(() => {
    const opener = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
    closeRef.current?.focus();
    return () => {
      // Restore focus only if it is still inside the (now removed) dialog or
      // nowhere; never steal it from something the user moved to
      if (opener !== null && opener.isConnected) opener.focus();
    };
  }, []);

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.stopPropagation();
      onCloseRef.current();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
    const root = dialogRef.current;
    if (root === null) return;
    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(kFocusable));
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    const first = items[0];
    const last = items[items.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="modal-scrim" onMouseDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <div
        ref={dialogRef}
        className={className !== undefined ? `modal ${className}` : "modal"}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      >
        <div className="panel-head">
          <span className="panel-title" id={titleId}>
            {title}
          </span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <IconButton ref={closeRef} tip={t("common.close")} onClick={onClose}>
            <X size={14} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/ProcessIcon.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/ProcessIcon.tsx
// The per-row app icon from the mockup. Falls back to a generic glyph for system
// processes and anything the shell has no icon for

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AppWindow } from "lucide-react";
import { iconFor, onIconsResolved } from "@/lib/icons";

type Props = { path?: string; size?: number };

export default function ProcessIcon({ path, size = 14 }: Props) {
  const [, bump] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => onIconsResolved(() => bump((n) => n + 1)), []);

  const url = iconFor(path);

  if (typeof url === "string") {
    return (
      <img
        src={url}
        width={size}
        height={size}
        alt=""
        draggable={false}
        style={{ display: "block", flex: "none" }}
      />
    );
  }

  // undefined = still resolving, null = no icon. Both render the placeholder so
  // the row height never shifts
  return (
    <span
      className="faint"
      style={{
        display: "grid",
        placeItems: "center",
        width: size,
        height: size,
        flex: "none",
        opacity: url === undefined ? 0.25 : 0.5,
      }}
    >
      <AppWindow size={size - 2} strokeWidth={1.75} />
    </span>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx
// App settings. Language, theme, theme editor and motion are local; everything
// under "Engine" is engine-side state, read and written over /api
// (app.settings_get/_set) the same way an agent would

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy, KeyRound } from "lucide-react";
import { save as saveDialog } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import logoUrl from "@/assets/reverse-slop-icon.png";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import Modal from "@/components/Modal";
import { kLanguages, useI18n, useT } from "@/i18n";
import { call, getEndpoint } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { readLayoutFile, saveLayoutFile } from "@/lib/layoutFile";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { kMotionOptions, osPrefersReduced, useMotion } from "@/store/motion";
import { useSettings } from "@/store/settings";
import { kThemeTokens, kThemes, useTheme, type ThemeColors, type ThemeName } from "@/store/theme";
import { layoutChanges, layoutFile, parseLayoutFile, useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import { useUpdater } from "@/store/updater";

type Props = { onClose: () => void };

function CopyButton({ text, tip }: { text: string; tip: string }) {
  const t = useT();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const reset = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(reset.current), []);
  return (
    <IconButton
      tip={copied ? t("settings.copied") : tip}
      onClick={() => {
        void copyText(text).then(() => {
          setCopied(true);
          clearTimeout(reset.current);
          reset.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
        });
      }}
    >
      {copied ? <Check size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}
    </IconButton>
  );
}

function Toggle({
  label,
  hint,
  checked,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  checked: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange: (v: boolean) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="settings-toggle">
      <input
        type="checkbox"
        checked={checked}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.checked)}
      />
      <span>
        <span>{label}</span>
        <span className="settings-hint">{hint}</span>
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}

/** Current palette values as hex, so the color inputs start on the live theme. */
function readColors(): ThemeColors {
  const style = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const out: ThemeColors = {};
  for (const { id } of kThemeTokens) {
    const value = style.getPropertyValue(id).trim();
    if (/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(value)) out[id] = value;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Base palette, per-token color inputs with live preview, named saves and a
 *  JSON round-trip. Overrides are inline custom properties on <html>. */
function ThemeEditor() {
  const t = useT();
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const customThemes = useTheme((s) => s.customThemes);
  const activeCustom = useTheme((s) => s.activeCustom);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const previewColors = useTheme((s) => s.previewColors);
  const saveCustom = useTheme((s) => s.saveCustom);
  const applyCustom = useTheme((s) => s.applyCustom);
  const deleteCustom = useTheme((s) => s.deleteCustom);
  const exportCustom = useTheme((s) => s.exportCustom);
  const importCustom = useTheme((s) => s.importCustom);
  const [base, setBase] = useState<ThemeName>(theme);
  const [colors, setColors] = useState<ThemeColors>(readColors);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [json, setJson] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const pickBase = (next: ThemeName) => {
    setBase(next);
    setTheme(next);
    setColors(readColors());
  };

  const editColor = (token: keyof ThemeColors, value: string) => {
    const next = { ...colors, [token]: value };
    setColors(next);
    previewColors(next);
  };

  const save = () => {
    const saved = saveCustom(name, base, colors);
    if (saved === null) return;
    setName("");
    setNote(t("settings.themeSaved", { name: saved.name }));
  };

  const importJson = () => {
    const imported = importCustom(json);
    setNote(
      imported === null
        ? t("settings.importFailed")
        : t("settings.themeSaved", { name: imported.name }),
    );
  };

  return (
    <>
      <fieldset className="settings-group">
        <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.themeEditor")}</legend>
        <div className="settings-choices">
          {kThemes.map((th) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={th.id}
              className="row-action"
              data-active={base === th.id}
              aria-pressed={base === th.id}
              onClick={() => pickBase(th.id)}
            >
              {t(th.labelKey)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="theme-grid">
          {kThemeTokens.map((token) => (
            <label className="theme-token" key={token.id}>
              <input
                type="color"
                aria-label={t(token.labelKey)}
                value={colors[token.id] ?? "#000000"}
                onChange={(e) => editColor(token.id, e.target.value)}
              />
              <span>{t(token.labelKey)}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="settings-choices">
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            aria-label={t("settings.themeName")}
            placeholder={t("settings.themeNamePlaceholder")}
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button type="button" className="row-action" disabled={name.trim() === ""} onClick={save}>
            {t("settings.saveTheme")}
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => previewColors(null)}>
            {t("settings.previewReset")}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="settings-rows">
          <div className="faint">{t("settings.customThemes")}</div>
          {customThemes.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="faint">{t("settings.noCustomThemes")}</div>
          ) : (
            customThemes.map((custom) => (
              <div className="settings-copy-row" key={custom.name}>
                <span className="settings-copy-text" data-active={custom.name === activeCustom}>
                  {custom.name}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="row-action"
                  onClick={() => applyCustom(custom.name)}
                >
                  {t("settings.applyTheme")}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="row-action"
                  onClick={() => setJson(exportCustom(custom.name) ?? "")}
                >
                  {t("settings.exportTheme")}
                </button>
                <IconButton
                  tip={t("settings.deleteTheme", { name: custom.name })}
                  onClick={() => deleteCustom(custom.name)}
                >
                  <KeyRound size={11} />
                </IconButton>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
        <label className="settings-field">
          <span>{t("settings.themeJson")}</span>
          <textarea
            className="code-area mono settings-textarea"
            aria-label={t("settings.themeJson")}
            value={json}
            rows={4}
            spellCheck={false}
            onChange={(e) => setJson(e.target.value)}
          />
        </label>
        <div className="settings-choices">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={json.trim() === ""}
            onClick={importJson}
          >
            {t("settings.importTheme")}
          </button>
        </div>
        {note !== null && <div className="settings-status mono">{note}</div>}
      </fieldset>
    </>
  );
}

export default function SettingsModal({ onClose }: Props) {
  const t = useT();
  const language = useI18n((s) => s.language);
  const setLanguage = useI18n((s) => s.setLanguage);
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const motion = useMotion((s) => s.motion);
  const setMotion = useMotion((s) => s.setMotion);
  const backend = useEngine((s) => s.backend);
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const {
    settings,
    error,
    revealedToken,
    clientsUpdated,
    restartRequired,
    load,
    setValue,
    rotateToken,
    hideToken,
  } = useSettings();
  const [allowlist, setAllowlist] = useState("");
  const [proxyToken, setProxyToken] = useState("");
  const [onboardClients, setOnboardClients] = useState("");
  const [confirmRotate, setConfirmRotate] = useState(false);
  const [appVersion, setAppVersion] = useState("");
  const [diag, setDiag] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [diagBusy, setDiagBusy] = useState(false);
  const [layoutStatus, setLayoutStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const endpoint = getEndpoint();
  const updatePhase = useUpdater((s) => s.phase);
  const updateVersion = useUpdater((s) => s.version);
  const updateProgress = useUpdater((s) => s.progress);
  const updateError = useUpdater((s) => s.error);
  const checkUpdates = useUpdater((s) => s.check);
  const installUpdate = useUpdater((s) => s.install);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTauri()) return;
    let alive = true;
    void import("@tauri-apps/api/app")
      .then(({ getVersion }) => getVersion())
      .then((v) => {
        if (alive) setAppVersion(v);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    return () => hideToken();
  }, [load, hideToken]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setAllowlist((settings?.web_allowlist ?? []).join("\n"));
    setProxyToken(typeof settings?.proxy_token === "string" ? settings.proxy_token : "");
    setOnboardClients((settings?.mcp_onboard_clients ?? []).join("\n"));
  }, [settings?.web_allowlist, settings?.proxy_token, settings?.mcp_onboard_clients]);

  // The MCP endpoint is the one value here a user needs outside the app,
  // wiring an MCP client by hand, so it gets a copy affordance
  const mcpUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${endpoint.port}/mcp`;
  const tokenState =
    settings?.mcp_token === "set" ? "set" : settings?.mcp_token === "unset" ? "unset" : "unknown";
  const updateStatus =
    updatePhase === "checking"
      ? t("settings.updateChecking")
      : updatePhase === "available"
        ? t("settings.updateAvailable", { version: updateVersion ?? "" })
        : updatePhase === "downloading"
          ? t("settings.updateDownloading", {
              percent: updateProgress >= 0 ? ` ${Math.round(updateProgress * 100)}%` : "",
            })
          : updatePhase === "ready"
            ? t("settings.updateInstalling")
            : updatePhase === "error"
              ? t("settings.updateFailed", { error: updateError ?? "" })
              : t("settings.updateUpToDate");

  const saveAllowlist = () => {
    const hosts = allowlist
      .split(/[\s,]+/)
      .map((h) => h.trim())
      .filter((h) => h !== "");
    void setValue("web_allowlist", hosts);
  };

  // keep both
  const saveOnboardClients = () => {
    const clients = onboardClients
      .split(/[\n,]+/)
      .map((c) => c.trim())
      .filter((c) => c !== "");
    void setValue("mcp_onboard_clients", clients);
  };

  const plaintextConfigs = settings?.mcp_plaintext_configs ?? [];
  const setxCommand = 'setx SLOP_MCP_TOKEN "<engine token>"';

  // Support hand-off: one JSON file carries the shell layout, theme and motion
  const exportLayout = async () => {
    try {
      const path = await saveLayoutFile(`${JSON.stringify(layoutFile(), null, 2)}\n`);
      if (path !== null) setLayoutStatus(t("settings.exportedTo", { path }));
    } catch (e) {
      setLayoutStatus(
        t("settings.layoutExportFailed", { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }),
      );
    }
  };

  const importLayout = async () => {
    try {
      const raw = await readLayoutFile();
      if (raw === null) return;
      const file = parseLayoutFile(raw);
      const changes = layoutChanges(layoutFile(), file);
      useUi.getState().importLayout(file);
      setLayoutStatus(
        changes.length === 0
          ? t("settings.importedNothing")
          : t("settings.imported", { changes: changes.join(", ") }),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      setLayoutStatus(
        t("settings.layoutImportFailed", { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }),
      );
    }
  };

  // one zip a user can attach to a bug report: engine log tail, redacted
  // settings, versions and the console status (engine side: app.diag_bundle)
  const copyDiagnostics = async () => {
    setDiagBusy(true);
    setDiag(null);
    try {
      const path = await saveDialog({
        defaultPath: "slopstation-diagnostics.zip",
        filters: [{ name: "Zip archive", extensions: ["zip"] }],
      });
      if (path === null) return;
      await call("app", "diag_bundle", { path });
      setDiag(t("settings.saved", { path }));
    } catch (e) {
      setDiag(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setDiagBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <Modal title={t("settings.title")} onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="modal-body">
        <div className="settings-brand">
          <img src={logoUrl} alt="" draggable={false} />
          <div className="settings-brand-name">SlopStation</div>
          <div className="settings-brand-sub">
            {t("settings.brand", { version: appVersion || "dev", badge: backend.badge })}
          </div>
        </div>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.language")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-choices">
            {kLanguages.map((l) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={l.id}
                className="row-action"
                data-active={language === l.id}
                aria-pressed={language === l.id}
                onClick={() => setLanguage(l.id)}
              >
                {l.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.theme")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-choices">
            {kThemes.map((th) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={th.id}
                className="row-action"
                data-active={theme === th.id}
                aria-pressed={theme === th.id}
                onClick={() => setTheme(th.id)}
              >
                {t(th.labelKey)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <ThemeEditor />

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.motion")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-choices">
            {kMotionOptions.map((o) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={o.id}
                className="row-action"
                data-active={motion === o.id}
                aria-pressed={motion === o.id}
                data-tip={t(o.hintKey)}
                onClick={() => setMotion(o.id)}
              >
                {t(o.labelKey)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {osPrefersReduced() && <div className="settings-rows">{t("settings.motionOs")}</div>}
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.layout")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-rows">
            <div className="faint">{t("settings.layoutHint")}</div>
            <div className="settings-choices">
              <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void exportLayout()}>
                {t("settings.exportLayout")}
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void importLayout()}>
                {t("settings.importLayout")}
              </button>
            </div>
            {layoutStatus !== null && (
              <div className="settings-status mono" role="status">
                {layoutStatus}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.target")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-rows mono">
            <div>
              {t("settings.backend", { badge: backend.badge })}
              {backend.ps4 ? t("settings.backendPs4") : ""}
            </div>
            <div>
              ps4: {backend.ps4 ? t("settings.ps4Connected") : t("settings.ps4Disconnected")}
            </div>
            <div>
              {t("settings.targetValue", {
                value: target.attached
                  ? t("settings.attached", {
                      pid: target.pid ?? 0,
                      name: target.name ?? "?",
                    })
                  : t("common.none"),
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.engine")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-rows mono">
            <div>{t("settings.api", { port: endpoint.port })}</div>
            <div className="settings-copy-row">
              <span className="settings-copy-text">{t("settings.mcp", { url: mcpUrl })}</span>
              <CopyButton text={mcpUrl} tip={t("settings.copyMcp")} />
            </div>
            <div>
              {t("settings.uiAuth", {
                value: endpoint.token === "" ? t("settings.authNone") : t("settings.authBearer"),
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="settings-choices">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              disabled={!isTauri() || diagBusy}
              data-tip={t("settings.diagnosticsTip")}
              onClick={() => void copyDiagnostics()}
            >
              {diagBusy ? t("settings.bundling") : t("settings.copyDiagnostics")}
            </button>
          </div>
          {diag !== null && <div className="settings-status mono">{diag}</div>}
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.updates")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-rows">
            <div>{t("settings.version", { version: appVersion || "dev" })}</div>
            <div>{updateStatus}</div>
            <div className="settings-choices">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                disabled={updatePhase === "checking" || updatePhase === "downloading"}
                onClick={() => void checkUpdates(true)}
              >
                {updatePhase === "checking"
                  ? t("settings.updateChecking")
                  : t("settings.checkUpdates")}
              </button>
              {updatePhase === "available" && (
                <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void installUpdate()}>
                  {t("settings.installRestart", { version: updateVersion ?? "" })}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group">
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.mcpToken")}</legend>
          <div className="settings-rows">
            <div>
              {t("settings.mcpTokenIntro")}{" "}
              <strong>{tokenState === "unknown" ? t("settings.tokenUnknown") : tokenState}</strong>
              {t("settings.mcpTokenOutro")}
            </div>
            <div className="settings-copy-row">
              <span className="settings-copy-text mono">{setxCommand}</span>
              <CopyButton text={setxCommand} tip={t("settings.copySetx")} />
            </div>
            <div className="faint">
              {t("settings.tokenEnvIntro")} <code>${"${SLOP_MCP_TOKEN}"}</code>
              {t("settings.tokenEnvOutro")}
            </div>
            {plaintextConfigs.length > 0 && (
              <div className="settings-status" role="alert">
                {t("settings.plaintext", { list: plaintextConfigs.join(", ") })}{" "}
                {t("settings.plaintextHint")}
              </div>
            )}
            {revealedToken !== null && (
              <div className="settings-copy-row mono">
                <span className="settings-copy-text" data-testid="revealed-token">
                  {revealedToken}
                </span>
                <CopyButton text={revealedToken} tip={t("settings.copyNewToken")} />
              </div>
            )}
            {revealedToken === null && clientsUpdated.length > 0 && (
              <div>{t("settings.rotated", { list: clientsUpdated.join(", ") })}</div>
            )}
            {revealedToken !== null && (
              <div className="faint">
                {t("settings.shownOnce", { list: clientsUpdated.join(", ") || t("common.none") })}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="settings-choices">
              {confirmRotate ? (
                <>
                  <span>{t("settings.rotateWarning")}</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="row-action"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setConfirmRotate(false);
                      void rotateToken();
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("settings.confirmRegenerate")}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="row-action"
                    onClick={() => setConfirmRotate(false)}
                  >
                    {t("common.cancel")}
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => setConfirmRotate(true)}>
                  <KeyRound size={11} aria-hidden /> {t("settings.regenerate")}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className="settings-group" disabled={settings === null}>
          <legend className="settings-label">{t("settings.enginePolicy")}</legend>
          <Toggle
            label={t("settings.unsafeLabel")}
            hint={t("settings.unsafeHint")}
            checked={settings?.script_unsafe === true}
            onChange={(v) => void setValue("script_unsafe", v)}
          />
          <Toggle
            label={t("settings.privateLabel")}
            hint={t("settings.privateHint")}
            checked={settings?.web_allow_private === true}
            onChange={(v) => void setValue("web_allow_private", v)}
          />
          <label className="settings-field">
            <span>{t("settings.allowlistLabel")}</span>
            <textarea
              className="code-area mono settings-textarea"
              value={allowlist}
              rows={3}
              spellCheck={false}
              onChange={(e) => setAllowlist(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={saveAllowlist}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="settings-field">
            <span>{t("settings.proxyLabel")}</span>
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              style={{ width: "100%" }}
              type="password"
              value={proxyToken}
              spellCheck={false}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              onChange={(e) => setProxyToken(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={() => {
                if (proxyToken !== (settings?.proxy_token ?? ""))
                  void setValue("proxy_token", proxyToken);
              }}
            />
          </label>
          <Toggle
            label={t("settings.writeTokenLabel")}
            hint={t("settings.writeTokenHint")}
            checked={settings?.mcp_token_in_configs === true}
            onChange={(v) => void setValue("mcp_token_in_configs", v)}
          />
          <label className="settings-field">
            <span>{t("settings.onboardLabel")}</span>
            <textarea
              className="code-area mono settings-textarea"
              value={onboardClients}
              rows={3}
              spellCheck={false}
              onChange={(e) => setOnboardClients(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={saveOnboardClients}
            />
          </label>
          {restartRequired.length > 0 && (
            <div className="settings-status">
              {t("settings.restartRequired", { keys: restartRequired.join(", ") })}
            </div>
          )}
        </fieldset>

        {error !== null && (
          <div className="settings-status" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/Splash.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/Splash.tsx
// boot checklist fed by boot.stage events so the uac pause doesnt look like a hang

import { RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { kStageLabels, useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useOutput } from "@/store/output";
import logoUrl from "@/assets/reverse-slop-icon.png";

export default function Splash() {
  const t = useT();
  const boot = useEngine((s) => s.boot);
  const stageLabels = useEngine((s) => s.stageLabels);
  const connected = useEngine((s) => s.connected);
  const startupError = useEngine((s) => s.startupError);
  const crash = useEngine((s) => s.crash);
  const retry = useEngine((s) => s.retry);
  const lines = useOutput((s) => s.lines);
  const tail = lines.slice(-4);
  // One row per stage the engine counts, labelled as the engine reports them
  const rows = Array.from(
    { length: Math.max(1, boot.total) },
    (_, i) =>
      stageLabels[i] ??
      (kStageLabels[i] !== undefined ? t(kStageLabels[i]) : t("splash.stage", { n: i + 1 })),
  );
  const failed = startupError !== null || (crash !== null && crash.retry_in_ms === null);

  return (
    <div className="splash">
      <div className="splash-card">
        <img className="splash-logo" src={logoUrl} alt="SlopStation" draggable={false} />
        <div className="splash-title">SlopStation</div>
        <div className="faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
          {t("splash.tagline")}
        </div>

        <ol className="splash-rows" aria-label={t("splash.stages")}>
          {rows.map((label, i) => {
            const status = i < boot.stage ? "ok" : i === boot.stage ? "run" : "wait";
            const marker = status === "ok" ? "[ ok ]" : status === "run" ? "[ .. ]" : "[    ]";
            return (
              <li className="splash-row" data-status={status} key={i}>
                {marker} {label}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>

        {tail.length > 0 && (
          <div className="log" style={{ padding: 0, marginBottom: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            {tail.map((l) => (
              <div className="log-row faint" key={l.seq}>
                {l.text}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div
          className="progress"
          role="progressbar"
          aria-label={t("splash.progress")}
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={boot.total}
          aria-valuenow={boot.stage}
        >
          <div
            className="progress-fill"
            style={{ width: `${Math.round((boot.stage / Math.max(1, boot.total)) * 100)}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="empty-hint" style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
          {failed ? (
            <div className="splash-error" role="alert">
              <span>
                {t("splash.failed", {
                  reason: startupError ?? crash?.reason ?? t("splash.exited"),
                })}
                {crash !== null && crash.log_path !== ""
                  ? t("splash.log", { path: crash.log_path })
                  : ""}
              </span>
              <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void retry()}>
                <RotateCcw size={11} aria-hidden /> {t("common.retry")}
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : crash !== null ? (
            t("splash.crashed", { reason: crash.reason })
          ) : connected ? (
            t("splash.tip")
          ) : (
            t("splash.waiting")
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/Splitter.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/Splitter.tsx
// drag handle that writes a css custom property, keeps the layout in css grid.
// Keyboard reachable (role=separator, arrows / Home / End) and persisted via
// the ui store, so a resized layout survives a reload

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent,
} from "react";
import { kLayoutVars, useUi, type LayoutVar } from "@/store/ui";

/**
 * Read-only view of a ref. Splitter only reads `current`, never writes it, so
 * taking the readonly shape keeps `RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>` assignable
 * (a mutable `RefObject<HTMLElement>` would be invariant under React 19 types).
 */
type RefTarget = { readonly current: HTMLElement | null };

type Props = {
  axis: "x" | "y";
  /** CSS variable to drive, e.g. "--left-w". */
  variable: LayoutVar;
  /** Element the variable is set on. Defaults to the app root. */
  target?: RefTarget;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  /** Drag right/down shrinks instead of grows (handles on a panel's left edge). */
  invert?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name, e.g. "Resize left panel". */
  label: string;
};

const kStep = 16;

export default function Splitter({ axis, variable, target, min, max, invert, label }: Props) {
  const dragging = useRef(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const stored = useUi((s) => s.sizes[variable]);
  const setSize = useUi((s) => s.setSize);
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(stored ?? kLayoutVars[variable]);

  const host = useCallback(() => target?.current ?? document.documentElement, [target]);

  const apply = useCallback(
    (px: number, persist: boolean) => {
      const next = Math.round(Math.min(max, Math.max(min, px)));
      host().style.setProperty(variable, `${next}px`);
      setValue(next);
      if (persist) setSize(variable, next);
    },
    [host, variable, min, max, setSize],
  );

  // The persisted size itself is applied by the shell (App.tsx); mirror it for
  // aria-valuenow, including after Reset layout
  useEffect(() => {
    setValue(stored ?? kLayoutVars[variable]);
  }, [stored, variable]);

  const current = () => parseFloat(getComputedStyle(host()).getPropertyValue(variable)) || value;

  const onPointerDown = (down: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const start = current();
    const origin = axis === "x" ? down.clientX : down.clientY;
    let last = start;

    dragging.current = true;
    ref.current?.setAttribute("data-dragging", "true");
    down.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(down.pointerId);

    const onMove = (move: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!dragging.current) return;
      const now = axis === "x" ? move.clientX : move.clientY;
      last = start + (now - origin) * (invert === true ? -1 : 1);
      apply(last, false);
    };

    const onUp = () => {
      dragging.current = false;
      ref.current?.removeAttribute("data-dragging");
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      apply(last, true);
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    // Arrow direction follows the visual edge: for an inverted (right/bottom)
    // panel, moving the handle left/up grows it
    const grow =
      axis === "x" ? (invert ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowRight") : invert ? "ArrowUp" : "ArrowDown";
    const shrink =
      axis === "x" ? (invert ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowLeft") : invert ? "ArrowDown" : "ArrowUp";
    const step = e.shiftKey ? kStep * 4 : kStep;
    let next: number | null = null;
    if (e.key === grow) next = current() + step;
    else if (e.key === shrink) next = current() - step;
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = min;
    else if (e.key === "End") next = max;
    if (next === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    apply(next, true);
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="splitter"
      data-axis={axis}
      role="separator"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={label}
      // a vertical bar separates columns (axis x), a horizontal one rows
      aria-orientation={axis === "x" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"}
      aria-valuenow={value}
      aria-valuemin={min}
      aria-valuemax={max}
      onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      onDoubleClick={() => apply(kLayoutVars[variable], true)}
    />
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/StatusBar.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/StatusBar.tsx
// indicator row, everything here is pushed by the engine so nothing polls

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Command, MonitorCog, Settings2, SunMoon } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { formatLabel } from "@/lib/format";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useTargets } from "@/store/targets";
import { kThemes, useTheme } from "@/store/theme";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";

type DotState = "ok" | "busy" | "bad" | "idle";

function Pill({ label, state }: { label: string; state: DotState }) {
  return (
    <span className="status-pill">
      <span className="dot" data-state={state} aria-hidden />
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function StatusBar() {
  const t = useT();
  const connected = useEngine((s) => s.connected);
  const backend = useEngine((s) => s.backend);
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const hype = useEngine((s) => s.hype);
  const crash = useEngine((s) => s.crash);
  // The image pill reads the disasm mirror (refreshed on image.changed and
  // every reconnect), so a binary loaded by an agent over MCP shows up too
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const openSettings = useUi((s) => s.openSettings);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const setPaletteOpen = useUi((s) => s.setPaletteOpen);
  const consoles = useTargets((s) => s.consoles);
  const activeConsole = useTargets((s) => s.activeConsole);
  const loadConsoles = useTargets((s) => s.loadConsoles);
  const switchConsole = useTargets((s) => s.switchConsole);
  const [consoleMenu, setConsoleMenu] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadConsoles();
  }, [loadConsoles]);

  const cycleTheme = () => {
    const i = kThemes.findIndex((th) => th.id === theme);
    setTheme(kThemes[(i + 1) % kThemes.length].id);
  };

  const analysis: DotState = hype.running
    ? "busy"
    : hype.ready
      ? "ok"
      : hype.error !== ""
        ? "bad"
        : "idle";

  const engineLabel = connected
    ? t("status.engineConnected")
    : crash !== null
      ? crash.retry_in_ms === null
        ? t("status.engineCrashed")
        : t("status.engineRestarting")
      : t("status.engineOffline");

  return (
    <footer className="statusbar" aria-label={t("status.label")}>
      <span role="status">
        {target.attached
          ? `${target.name ?? t("status.unknownTarget")} (${target.pid ?? 0})`
          : connected
            ? t("status.ready")
            : t("status.disconnected")}
      </span>

      <div className="spacer" />

      {consoles.length > 0 && (
        <div className="menu-root">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="status-pill console-switch"
            aria-haspopup="menu"
            aria-expanded={consoleMenu}
            data-tip={t("status.consoleSwitch")}
            onClick={() => setConsoleMenu((v) => !v)}
          >
            <span className="dot" data-state={activeConsole === "" ? "idle" : "ok"} aria-hidden />
            {activeConsole === "" ? t("status.noConsole") : activeConsole}
          </button>
          {consoleMenu && (
            <div
              className="menu-pop up"
              role="menu"
              aria-label={t("status.consoles")}
              onClick={() => setConsoleMenu(false)}
            >
              {consoles.map((c) => (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={c.name}
                  role="menuitemradio"
                  aria-checked={c.name === activeConsole}
                  className="menu-item"
                  onClick={() => void switchConsole(c.name)}
                >
                  <span>{c.name}</span>
                  <span className="faint">
                    {c.host}:{c.port}
                    {c.last_fw !== "" ? t("status.fw", { fw: c.last_fw }) : ""}
                  </span>
                  {c.name === activeConsole && <span className="faint">●</span>}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <Pill
        label={t("status.backend", { badge: backend.badge })}
        state={backend.ps4 ? "ok" : "idle"}
      />
      <Pill
        label={engineLabel}
        state={connected ? "ok" : crash !== null && crash.retry_in_ms !== null ? "busy" : "bad"}
      />
      <Pill
        label={target.attached ? t("status.memoryReady") : t("status.memoryIdle")}
        state={target.attached ? "ok" : "idle"}
      />
      <Pill
        label={
          image.ready
            ? t("status.image", { name: image.name ?? "?" }) +
              (image.format !== undefined
                ? t("status.imageFormat", { format: formatLabel(image.format) })
                : "")
            : t("status.imageNone")
        }
        state={image.ready ? "ok" : "idle"}
      />
      <Pill
        label={
          hype.running
            ? t("status.analysisProgress", { percent: Math.round(hype.progress * 100) })
            : hype.ready
              ? t("status.analysisReady")
              : t("status.analysisIdle")
        }
        state={analysis}
      />

      <div className="status-actions">
        <IconButton tip={t("status.paletteTip")} onClick={() => setPaletteOpen(true)}>
          <Command size={14} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton tip={t("status.themeTip", { theme })} onClick={cycleTheme}>
          <SunMoon size={14} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton tip={t("rail.scripts")} onClick={() => setRail("scripts")}>
          <MonitorCog size={14} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton tip={t("common.settings")} onClick={openSettings}>
          <Settings2 size={14} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/Tabs.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/Tabs.tsx
// WAI-ARIA tablist: role=tab buttons with aria-selected, roving tabindex and
// arrow / Home / End navigation. Used by the workspace, output and image
// browser tab strips and (vertically) by the activity rail

import { useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";

export type TabItem<T extends string> = {
  id: T;
  label: ReactNode;
  /** Accessible name when `label` is not text (icons). */
  ariaLabel?: string;
  tip?: string;
};

type Props<T extends string> = {
  items: readonly TabItem<T>[];
  active: T;
  onChange: (id: T) => void;
  /** Accessible name of the tab strip. */
  label: string;
  /** Prefix for tab / panel ids, so panels can reference their tab. */
  idPrefix: string;
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  tabClassName?: string;
};

export function tabId(prefix: string, id: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-tab-${id}`;
}

export function panelId(prefix: string, id: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-panel-${id}`;
}

export default function Tabs<T extends string>({
  items,
  active,
  onChange,
  label,
  idPrefix,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  tabClassName = "tab",
}: Props<T>) {
  const refs = useRef(new Map<T, HTMLButtonElement>());

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {
    const prev = orientation === "horizontal" ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowUp";
    const next = orientation === "horizontal" ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowDown";
    let target = -1;
    if (e.key === prev) target = (index - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
    else if (e.key === next) target = (index + 1) % items.length;
    else if (e.key === "Home") target = 0;
    else if (e.key === "End") target = items.length - 1;
    if (target < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = items[target].id;
    onChange(id);
    refs.current.get(id)?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div role="tablist" aria-label={label} aria-orientation={orientation} className="tablist">
      {items.map((t, i) => {
        const selected = t.id === active;
        return (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            ref={(el) => {
              if (el) refs.current.set(t.id, el);
              else refs.current.delete(t.id);
            }}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id={tabId(idPrefix, t.id)}
            aria-selected={selected}
            aria-controls={panelId(idPrefix, t.id)}
            aria-label={t.ariaLabel}
            tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
            className={tabClassName}
            data-active={selected}
            data-tip={t.tip}
            onClick={() => onChange(t.id)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => onKeyDown(e, i)}
          >
            {t.label}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/TitleBar.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/TitleBar.tsx
// custom titlebar, drag region and buttons through the tauri window api

import { Fragment, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Minus, Square, X } from "lucide-react";
import { getCurrentWindow } from "@tauri-apps/api/window";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";
import { isInsecureDev, isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { openBinary } from "@/lib/openBinary";
import { kShortcuts } from "@/lib/shortcuts";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useTheme, kThemes } from "@/store/theme";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import logoUrl from "@/assets/reverse-slop-icon.png";

type MenuName = "file" | "view" | "window" | "theme" | "help";

const kMenuLabels: Record<MenuName, Key> = {
  file: "titlebar.file",
  view: "titlebar.view",
  window: "titlebar.window",
  theme: "titlebar.theme",
  help: "titlebar.help",
};

async function windowAction(action: "minimize" | "toggleMaximize" | "close") {
  // Running in a plain browser (npm run dev): nothing to drive
  if (!isTauri()) return;
  const win = getCurrentWindow();
  if (action === "minimize") await win.minimize();
  else if (action === "toggleMaximize") await win.toggleMaximize();
  else await win.close();
}

export default function TitleBar() {
  const t = useT();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<MenuName | null>(null);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const theme = useTheme((s) => s.theme);
  const setTheme = useTheme((s) => s.setTheme);
  const quitting = useEngine((s) => s.quitting);
  const rail = useUi((s) => s.rail);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const openSettings = useUi((s) => s.openSettings);
  const setPaletteOpen = useUi((s) => s.setPaletteOpen);
  const inspectorOpen = useUi((s) => s.inspectorOpen);
  const setInspectorOpen = useUi((s) => s.setInspectorOpen);
  const resetLayout = useUi((s) => s.resetLayout);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open === null) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(null);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") setOpen(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const menu = (name: MenuName, body: ReactNode) => (
    <div className="menu-root" key={name}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="menu-button"
        data-open={open === name}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open === name}
        onClick={() => setOpen(open === name ? null : name)}
        onMouseEnter={() => open !== null && setOpen(name)}
      >
        {t(kMenuLabels[name])}
      </button>
      {open === name && (
        <div
          className="menu-pop"
          role="menu"
          aria-label={t(kMenuLabels[name])}
          onClick={() => setOpen(null)}
        >
          {body}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const item = (label: ReactNode, onClick: () => void, hint?: string, checked?: boolean) => (
    <button
      type="button"
      role={checked === undefined ? "menuitem" : "menuitemradio"}
      aria-checked={checked}
      className="menu-item"
      onClick={onClick}
    >
      <span>{label}</span>
      {hint !== undefined && <span className="faint">{hint}</span>}
      {checked === true && <span className="faint">●</span>}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="titlebar" ref={rootRef}>
      <div className="brand">
        <img src={logoUrl} width={16} height={16} alt="" draggable={false} />
      </div>

      {menu(
        "file",
        <>
          {item(t("common.openBinary"), () => void openBinary(), "Ctrl+O")}
          {item(t("titlebar.attachToProcess"), () => setRail("targets"))}
          <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />
          {item(
            t("titlebar.exit"),
            () => {
              // Ask the engine to run its own teardown before the window goes
              // away, so a closed UI never orphans state
              void call("app", "shutdown", { reason: "File > Exit" }).finally(() =>
                windowAction("close"),
              );
            },
            "Alt+F4",
          )}
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "view",
        <>
          {item(t("titlebar.commandPalette"), () => setPaletteOpen(true), "Ctrl+K")}
          <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />
          {(
            [
              ["targets", "rail.targets"],
              ["modules", "rail.modules"],
              ["scripts", "rail.scripts"],
            ] as const
          ).map(([id, labelKey]) => (
            <Fragment key={id}>
              {item(t(labelKey), () => setRail(id), undefined, rail === id)}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
          <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />
          {item(
            t(inspectorOpen ? "titlebar.hideInspector" : "titlebar.showInspector"),
            () => setInspectorOpen(!inspectorOpen),
            "Ctrl+Alt+I",
          )}
          {item(t("titlebar.resetLayout"), resetLayout)}
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "window",
        <>
          {item(t("titlebar.settings"), openSettings, "Ctrl+,")}
          <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />
          {item(t("titlebar.reload"), () => window.location.reload())}
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "theme",
        <>
          {kThemes.map((th) => (
            <Fragment key={th.id}>
              {item(t(th.labelKey), () => setTheme(th.id), undefined, theme === th.id)}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </>,
      )}

      {menu(
        "help",
        <>
          {kShortcuts.map((s) => (
            <div className="menu-item menu-static" key={s.keys}>
              <span>{t(s.labelKey)}</span>
              <span className="faint">{s.keys}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />
          <div className="menu-item menu-static">SlopStation</div>
        </>,
      )}

      <div className="titlebar-drag" data-tauri-drag-region />

      {isInsecureDev() && (
        <span className="insecure-badge" role="status" data-tip={t("titlebar.insecureTip")}>
          {t("titlebar.insecure")}
        </span>
      )}
      {quitting !== null && <span className="faint">{t("titlebar.shuttingDown")}</span>}

      <div className="win-buttons">
        <IconButton
          tip={t("titlebar.minimize")}
          variant="bare"
          className="win-button"
          onClick={() => void windowAction("minimize")}
        >
          <Minus size={14} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton
          tip={t("titlebar.maximize")}
          variant="bare"
          className="win-button"
          onClick={() => void windowAction("toggleMaximize")}
        >
          <Square size={12} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton
          tip={t("common.close")}
          variant="bare"
          className="win-button close"
          onClick={() => void windowAction("close")}
        >
          <X size={14} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/TooltipLayer.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/TooltipLayer.tsx
// one global tooltip instead of the native title attribute, any element can
// opt in with data-tip

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Placed = {
  text: string;
  left: number;
  top: number;
  below: boolean;
};

/** Long enough not to flicker while the cursor crosses a toolbar. */
const kDelayMs = 380;
const kGap = 7;
const kMargin = 6;

export default function TooltipLayer() {
  const [tip, setTip] = useState<Placed | null>(null);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const bubbleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const cancel = () => {
      if (timer.current !== null) {
        clearTimeout(timer.current);
        timer.current = null;
      }
      setTip(null);
    };

    const show = (host: HTMLElement, delay: number) => {
      const text = host.dataset.tip ?? "";
      if (text === "") {
        cancel();
        return;
      }
      if (timer.current !== null) clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        const r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Prefer below; flip above when the element sits near the bottom edge
        // (the status bar and Output pane are full of tooltip targets)
        const below = r.bottom + 34 < window.innerHeight;
        setTip({
          text,
          left: r.left + r.width / 2,
          top: below ? r.bottom + kGap : r.top - kGap,
          below,
        });
      }, delay);
    };

    const onOver = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const host = (e.target as Element | null)?.closest?.("[data-tip]");
      if (!(host instanceof HTMLElement)) {
        cancel();
        return;
      }
      show(host, kDelayMs);
    };

    // Keyboard users get the same hint when tabbing onto a control; mouse
    // clicks also move focus but do not match :focus-visible
    const onFocusIn = (e: FocusEvent) => {
      const el = e.target;
      if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement) || !el.matches(":focus-visible")) return;
      const host = el.closest("[data-tip]");
      if (host instanceof HTMLElement) show(host, 120);
    };

    // Any interaction dismisses: a tooltip lingering over a menu that just
    // opened is worse than no tooltip
    document.addEventListener("pointerover", onOver, true);
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", cancel, true);
    document.addEventListener("wheel", cancel, true);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", cancel, true);
    document.addEventListener("focusin", onFocusIn, true);
    document.addEventListener("focusout", cancel, true);
    window.addEventListener("blur", cancel);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerover", onOver, true);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", cancel, true);
      document.removeEventListener("wheel", cancel, true);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", cancel, true);
      document.removeEventListener("focusin", onFocusIn, true);
      document.removeEventListener("focusout", cancel, true);
      window.removeEventListener("blur", cancel);
      if (timer.current !== null) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Clamp horizontally once the bubble has a measured width
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = bubbleRef.current;
    if (el === null || tip === null) return;
    const half = el.offsetWidth / 2;
    const clamped = Math.min(
      Math.max(tip.left, half + kMargin),
      window.innerWidth - half - kMargin,
    );
    if (Math.abs(clamped - tip.left) > 0.5) setTip({ ...tip, left: clamped });
  }, [tip]);

  if (tip === null) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={bubbleRef}
      className="tooltip"
      role="tooltip"
      style={{
        left: tip.left,
        top: tip.top,
        transform: `translate(-50%, ${tip.below ? "0" : "-100%"})`,
      }}
    >
      {tip.text}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
describe("disassembly minimap (audit 88)", () => {
  const insns = Array.from({ length: 320 }, (_, i) => ({
    va: 0x1000 + i * 4,
    len: 4,
    text: `insn ${i}`,
    flow: i === 10 ? "cond_jump" : "next",
    target: i === 10 ? 0x1000 + 300 * 4 : undefined,
  }));

  it("folds the whole function into fixed buckets and marks branch targets", () => {
    const buckets = bucketize(insns);
    expect(buckets).toHaveLength(kBuckets);
    expect(buckets.reduce((n, b) => n + b.density, 0)).toBe(insns.length);
    expect(buckets.filter((b) => b.branch)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(buckets[Math.floor((300 * kBuckets) / insns.length)].branch).toBe(true);
    expect(bucketize([])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("renders one strip with a viewport marker over the listing", () => {
    useDisasm.setState({
      insns,
      selected: 0x1000,
      selectedFn: { va: 0x1000, size: 1280 },
    });
    render(<DisassemblyView />);
    const strip = screen.getByRole("scrollbar", { name: "Function overview" });
    expect(strip.querySelectorAll(".minimap-bar").length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(strip.querySelectorAll(".minimap-view")).toHaveLength(1);
    // a press on the strip jumps without needing layout from jsdom
    fireEvent.pointerDown(strip, { clientY: 300 });
    fireEvent.pointerUp(strip, { clientY: 300 });
  });
});

        value: true,

    );
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Regenerate token/ }));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm regenerate" }));
    expect(await screen.findByTestId("revealed-token")).toHaveTextContent(newToken);
  });

  it("exports the shell layout and applies an imported one (item 90)", async () => {
    mockApi(() => ({}));
    useTheme.getState().setTheme("obsidian");
    useUi.getState().setSize("--left-w", 340);
    render(<SettingsModal onClose={() => undefined} />);
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Export layout…" }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("slopstation-layout.json");
    const text = vi.mocked(saveLayoutFile).mock.calls[0]?.[0] ?? "";
    const exported = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(exported).toMatchObject({ version: 1, rail: "targets", theme: "obsidian" });
    expect(exported.sizes).toEqual({ "--left-w": 340 });

    vi.mocked(readLayoutFile).mockResolvedValueOnce(
      JSON.stringify({ ...exported, rail: "modules", theme: "daylight" }),
    );
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Import layout…" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(useUi.getState().rail).toBe("modules"));
    expect(useTheme.getState().theme).toBe("daylight");
    expect(screen.getByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("theme obsidian → daylight");

    // a file from another build is refused and nothing is applied
    vi.mocked(readLayoutFile).mockResolvedValueOnce('{"version":1,"rail":"bogus"}');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Import layout…" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("Import failed"));
    expect(useUi.getState().rail).toBe("modules");
    useTheme.getState().setTheme("obsidian");
  });
});

describe("scripts panel: snippets, completion, unsafe consent (68, 69, 70)", () => {
  const apiList = {
    functions: [
      { name: "slop.mem.read_hex", signature: "(addr, len) -> hex string", doc: "read" },
      { name: "slop.mem.read_bytes", signature: "(addr, len) -> string", doc: "raw" },
      { name: "slop.target.status", signature: "() -> status", doc: "target" },
    ],
  };

  it("offers the built-in examples and loads one into the editor", async () => {
    mockApi(({ action }) => (action === "list" ? { snippets: [] } : apiList));
    render(<ScriptsPanel />);
    const area = screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Lua script" }) as HTMLTextAreaElement;
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "bp + wait" }));
    expect(area.value).toContain("slop.debugger.bp_set");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "find value" }));
    expect(area.value).toContain("slop.mem.scan");
  });

  it("completes slop.* names from script.api", async () => {
    mockApi(({ action }) => (action === "list" ? { snippets: [] } : apiList));
    render(<ScriptsPanel />);
    const area = screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Lua script" }) as HTMLTextAreaElement;
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole("listbox")).toBeNull());
    await userEvent.clear(area);
    await userEvent.type(area, "slop.me");
    const list = await screen.findByRole("listbox", { name: "slop completions" });
    expect(within(list).getByText("slop.mem.read_hex")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.keyboard("{Enter}");
    expect(area.value).toBe("slop.mem.read_hex");
  });

  it("sends unsafe consent for one run only", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action, params }) =>
      action === "list"
        ? { snippets: [] }
        : action === "api"
          ? apiList
          : { ok: true, output: "", params },
    );
    render(<ScriptsPanel />);
    const consent = screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: "Allow unsafe for this run" });
    await userEvent.click(consent);
    expect(consent).toBeChecked();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Run (Ctrl+Enter)" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "run")).toBe(true));
    const run = calls.find((c) => c.action === "run");
    expect(run?.params.unsafe).toBe(true);
    expect(run?.params.confirm).toBe(true);
    // consent does not stick: the next run is sandboxed again
    await waitFor(() => expect(consent).not.toBeChecked());
  });

  it("lists saved snippets and loads one into the editor", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action, params }) => {
      if (action === "api") return apiList;
      if (action === "list") return { snippets: [{ name: "mine" }] };
      if (action === "load") return { name: params.name, code: "return 7" };
      return { ok: true };
    });
    render(<ScriptsPanel />);
    const item = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "mine" });
    await userEvent.click(item);
    const area = screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Lua script" }) as HTMLTextAreaElement;
    await waitFor(() => expect(area.value).toBe("return 7"));

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Snippet name" }), "saved-one");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save snippet" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "save")).toBe(true));
    expect(calls.find((c) => c.action === "save")?.params.name).toBe("saved-one");
  });
});

// disasm.blocks / xray.cfg graph shape: nodes carry the range and an
// instruction count, edges the successor kind
const cfgFixture = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 0x1000, start: 0x1000, end: 0x1010, size: 16, insn_count: 3, summary: "test eax, eax" },
    { id: 0x1010, start: 0x1010, end: 0x1020, size: 16, insn_count: 2, summary: "mov ecx, 4" },
    { id: 0x1020, start: 0x1020, end: 0x1030, size: 16, insn_count: 5, summary: "call memcpy" },
    { id: 0x1030, start: 0x1030, end: 0x1038, size: 8, insn_count: 1, summary: "ret" },
  ],
  edges: [
    { from: 0x1000, to: 0x1010, kind: "fallthrough" },
    { from: 0x1000, to: 0x1020, kind: "branch" },
    { from: 0x1010, to: 0x1030, kind: "fallthrough" },
    { from: 0x1020, to: 0x1030, kind: "branch" },
    { from: 0x1030, to: 0x1000, kind: "branch" },
  ],
};

describe("pseudocode view (audit 52)", () => {
  const decompFixture = {
    signature: "int Player::Update(int arg_10)",
    callconv: "win64",
    function_va: 0x4dda48,
    insn_count: 12,
    call_sites: [{ va: 0x4ddb00, arg_types: ["int", "char *"] }],
    types_generation: 7,
    lines: [
      { va: 0x4dda48, text: "if (arg_10 == 0x10) {" },
      { va: 0, text: "  return memcpy(dst, src, 4);" },
      { va: 0x4dda60, text: "} // done" },
    ],
  };

  it("highlights tokens and follows a function name into the listing", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ tool, action }) => {
      if (tool === "decomp") return decompFixture;
      if (action === "blocks") return { entry: 0x4dda48, graph: cfgFixture };
      if (action === "functions")
        return {
          functions: [{ va: 0x4d0000, size: 32, name: "memcpy" }],
          total: 1,
          matched: 1,
        };
      return { instructions: [] };
    });
    useDisasm.setState({ selected: 0x4dda48, image: { ready: true, format: "elf" } });
    const { container } = render(<DecompView />);

    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelector(".decomp-kw")?.textContent).toBe("if"));
    expect(container.querySelector(".decomp-num")?.textContent).toBe("0x10");
    expect(container.querySelector(".decomp-com")?.textContent).toBe("// done");
    expect(container.querySelector(".decomp-meta")?.textContent).toContain("types gen 7");
    expect(container.querySelector(".decomp-meta")?.textContent).toContain("12 insns");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "call site 004DDB00" })).toBeInTheDocument();

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "go to memcpy" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(useDisasm.getState().selected).toBe(0x4d0000));
    expect(useUi.getState().workspaceTab).toBe("disassembly");
    expect(calls.find((c) => c.action === "functions")?.params.filter).toBe("memcpy");
  });

  it("shows the CFG beside the code and jumps to a block", async () => {
    mockApi(({ tool, action }) => {
      if (tool === "decomp") return decompFixture;
      if (action === "blocks") return { entry: 0x4dda48, graph: cfgFixture };
      return { instructions: [] };
    });
    useDisasm.setState({ selected: 0x4dda48, image: { ready: true, format: "elf" } });
    const { container } = render(<DecompView />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Control-flow graph" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(container.querySelectorAll(".cfg-node")).toHaveLength(4));
    expect(container.querySelectorAll(".cfg-edge")).toHaveLength(5);

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^block 00001020/ }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(useDisasm.getState().selected).toBe(0x1020));
    expect(useUi.getState().workspaceTab).toBe("disassembly");
  });
});

describe("CFG graph layout", () => {
  it("draws one box per block, one edge per successor, one column per depth", () => {
    const onPick = vi.fn();
    const { container } = render(<CfgGraph graph={cfgFixture} entry={0x1000} onPick={onPick} />);
    const boxes = [...container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".cfg-node")];
    expect(boxes).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(container.querySelectorAll(".cfg-edge")).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(container.querySelectorAll('.cfg-edge[data-edge="fallthrough"]')).toHaveLength(2);

    // 0x1010 and 0x1020 are both one hop from the entry: same column
    const left = (va: number) =>
      boxes.find((b) => b.getAttribute("aria-label")?.includes(hex(va, 8)))?.style.left;
    expect(left(0x1010)).toBe(left(0x1020));
    expect(left(0x1000)).not.toBe(left(0x1010));

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^block 00001020/ }));
    expect(onPick).toHaveBeenCalledWith(0x1020);
  });

  it("has an empty state and refuses more than 500 blocks", () => {
    const { container, rerender } = render(<CfgGraph graph={null} onPick={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText("No control-flow graph.")).toBeInTheDocument();

    const nodes = Array.from({ length: 501 }, (_, i) => ({
      id: 0x1000 + i * 0x10,
      start: 0x1000 + i * 0x10,
      end: 0x1010 + i * 0x10,
      size: 16,
      insn_count: 2,
    }));
    rerender(<CfgGraph graph={{ nodes, edges: [] }} onPick={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText("Too many blocks (501).")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(container.querySelectorAll(".cfg-node")).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("opens the CFG from the palette", async () => {
    mockApi(() => ({}));
    useDisasm.setState({ image: { ready: true, format: "elf" } });
    render(<CommandPalette />);
    act(() => useUi.getState().setPaletteOpen(true));
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByPlaceholderText(/Type a command/), "CFG");
    await userEvent.keyboard("{Enter}");
    expect(useUi.getState().workspaceTab).toBe("decomp");
    expect(useDecomp.getState().split).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("struct editor (item 114)", () => {
  it("adds and removes members through the engine catalog", async () => {
    const fields = [{ name: "hp", type: "u32", offset: 0, size: 4, array_count: 0 }];
    const def = () => ({
      name: "Player",
      size: fields.length * 4,
      packed: false,
      fields: [...fields],
    });
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ tool, action, params }) => {
      if (tool !== "types") return {};
      if (action === "list_structs") return { structs: [def()], count: 1 };
      if (action === "list_enums") return { enums: [], count: 0 };
      if (action === "get_struct") return def();
      if (action === "add_member") {
        fields.push({
          name: String(params.field),
          type: String(params.type),
          offset: fields.length * 4,
          size: 4,
          array_count: 0,
        });
        return def();
      }
      if (action === "declare") {
        // the test only removes members, so the rebuilt struct is empty
        fields.splice(0, fields.length);
        return { declared: 1 };
      }
      return {};
    });
    render(<StructEditor />);
    await screen.findByRole("button", { name: /^Player/ });
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText("Member name"), "mp");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "add member" }));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "add_member" && c.params.field === "mp")).toBe(true),
    );
    await screen.findByText("mp");
    expect(screen.getByText(/decompiler cache invalidated/)).toBeInTheDocument();

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove member mp" }));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(
        calls.some((c) => c.action === "declare" && !String(c.params.decl).includes("mp")),
      ).toBe(true),
    );
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByText("mp")).not.toBeInTheDocument());
  });
});

        return reverted
          ? { patches: [], total: 0 }
          : { patches: [{ va: 0x401000, before: 0x90, after: 0xcc }], total: 1 };
      if (tool === "patch" && action === "revert_all") {
        reverted = true;

      return {};
    });
    render(<UnpackerView />);
    expect(await screen.findByText("000000401000")).toBeInTheDocument();

    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "revert_all")).toBe(true));
    expect(await screen.findByText("no edits recorded")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```
