```tsx
describe("theme editor (audit 87)", () => {
  it("round-trips a custom theme through save, apply, export, import and delete", async () => {
    mockApi(() => ({}));
    render(<SettingsModal onClose={() => undefined} />);

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Theme name" }), "midnight");
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText("Accent"), { target: { value: "#123456" } });
    // live preview writes the override on <html>
    expect(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue("--accent")).toBe("#123456");

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save theme" }));
    expect(useTheme.getState().customThemes.map((theme) => theme.name)).toEqual(["midnight"]);

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Apply" }));
    expect(useTheme.getState().activeCustom).toBe("midnight");
    expect(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue("--accent")).toBe("#123456");

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Export" }));
    const json = screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Theme JSON" }) as HTMLTextAreaElement;
    expect(json.value).toContain("midnight");
    expect(json.value).toContain("#123456");

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete midnight" }));
    expect(useTheme.getState().customThemes).toHaveLength(0);

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Import" }));
    expect(useTheme.getState().customThemes.map((theme) => theme.name)).toEqual(["midnight"]);
    expect(useTheme.getState().customThemes[0].colors["--accent"]).toBe("#123456");
  });
});

describe("xray panel", () => {
  it("renders pass rows with severity and jumps to the address", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action }) =>
      action === "hooks"
        ? {
            hooks: [
              { address: 0x401000, hook_type: "jmp", target: 0x500000, prologue_bytes: "E9" },
            ],
            functions_checked: 12,
            hooks_found: 1,
            source: "index",
          }
        : {},
    );
    useDisasm.setState({ image: { ready: true, name: "eboot.bin", format: "elf" } });
    render(<XrayPanel />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Hooks" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("jmp")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/1 hooks in 12 functions/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    const row = screen.getByText("jmp").closest("tr");
    expect(row).toHaveAttribute("data-severity", "bad");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "0x401000" }));
    expect(useUi.getState().workspaceTab).toBe("disassembly");
    expect(calls.some((c) => c.tool === "xray" && c.action === "hooks")).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("patch panel", () => {
  it("lists the journal and reverts after a confirm", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action }) =>
      action === "journal"
        ? {
            patches: [{ va: 0x401000, before: 0x90, after: 0xcc }],
            total: 1,
            indexes_dirty: false,
          }
        : { ok: true, bytes_changed: 1, journal_total: 0, patches: [] },
    );
    render(<PatchPanel />);
    expect(await screen.findByText("401000")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("90")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("CC")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Revert all…" }));
    expect(screen.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Confirm patch" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm Revert all" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "revert_all")).toBe(true));
  });
});

describe("network panel", () => {
  const status = {
    capture_running: true,
    capture_filter: { host: "", port: 0, protocol: 0 },
    store_packets: 1,
    proxy_running: false,
    proxy_port: 0,
    proxy_mitm: false,
  };

  it("shows captured packets and exports a pcap", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action }) => {
      if (action === "status") return status;
      if (action === "packets")
        return {
          packets: [
            {
              id: 1,
              at_ms: 1000,
              protocol: 6,
              protocol_str: "tcp",
              direction: 0,
              direction_str: "outbound",
              ip_version: 4,
              local: "10.0.0.5:1234",
              remote: "1.2.3.4:80",
              payload_bytes: 10,
              wire_bytes: 54,
            },
          ],
          last_id: 1,
        };
      if (action === "export_pcap") return { exported: true, packets: 1 };
      return {};
    });
    render(<NetworkPanel />);
    expect(await screen.findByText("10.0.0.5:1234")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Export PCAP…" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "export_pcap")).toBe(true));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/1 packets written/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows an Administrator error verbatim", async () => {
    mockApi(({ action }) => {
      if (action === "status") return { ...status, capture_running: false };
      if (action === "capture_start")
        throw new Error("capture needs Administrator: run reverse-slop elevated");
      return {};
    });
    render(<NetworkPanel />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Start capture" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/capture needs Administrator/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe("emulator panel", () => {
  it("renders a run result and the backward slice", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action }) => {
      if (action === "run")
        return {
          ok: true,
          stopped_reason: "count",
          instructions: 1,
          arch: "x64",
          abi: "win64",
          regs: { rip: 0x1000, rax: 0 },
          trace: [{ ip: 0x1000, text: "nop" }],
          trace_id: 3,
        };
      if (action === "slice")
        return { trace_id: 3, count: 1, instructions: [{ ip: 0x1000, text: "nop" }] };
      return {};
    });
    render(<EmulatorPanel />);
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText("Code bytes (hex)"), "90");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Run" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/count · 1 instructions/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("rip")).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Slice" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "slice")).toBe(true));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/1 instructions for trace 3/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe("PS5 connect", () => {
  it("auto-connects and shows the console firmware", async () => {
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action }) => {
      if (action === "status")
        return {
          ps5: {
            endpoint: "10.0.0.9:744",
            branding: "ps5debug-NG",
            server_version: "1.0",
            caps: "0x3",
            fw: "3.00",
            platform: "ps5",
            connected: true,
            lost: false,
            lost_reason: "",
            drops: 0,
            debug_attached: false,
            debug_pid: 0,
          },
        };
      if (action === "ps5_auto")
        return { connected: true, pid: 5, name: "game.elf", debug_attached: true };
      return {};
    });
    useEngine.setState({ backend: { badge: "user", ps4: false } });
    render(<TargetsPanel />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(/fw 3\.00/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText("PS5 IP address"), "10.0.0.9");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Auto connect" }));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "ps5_auto" && c.params.host === "10.0.0.9")).toBe(true),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText(/pid 5 game\.elf/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

```

`app/src/components/panels/DebuggerView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/DebuggerView.tsx
// PS4 live-debug panel: attach state, run control, breakpoints/watchpoints,
// registers, callstack, event feed - every action goes over the ps4debug-NG
// wire via the debugger ps4_* MCP actions

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Ban, FolderOpen, Gamepad2, Play, Plus, StepForward, Timer } from "lucide-react";
import { save } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { showInDisassembly } from "@/lib/navigate";
import { kRegOrder, useDebugger } from "@/store/debugger";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";

const kScanTypes = ["u8", "i8", "u16", "i16", "u32", "i32", "u64", "i64", "f32", "f64"];
const kCompares = [
  "exact",
  "bigger",
  "smaller",
  "between",
  "increased",
  "decreased",
  "changed",
  "unchanged",
  "unknown",
];
const kWaitMs = 5000;
/** Fallback poll while attached; the push stream is the primary source. */
const kFallbackPollMs = 15_000;

export default function DebuggerView() {
  const t = useT();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const backend = useEngine((s) => s.backend);
  const setRail = useUi((s) => s.setRail);
  const {
    status,
    regs,
    regsLwpid,
    frames,
    events,
    breakpoints,
    watchpoints,
    scan,
    app,
    error,
    waitNote,
    logs,
    busy,
    connectStream,
    refresh,
    attach,
    detach,
    cont,
    step,
    waitHalt,
    bpSet,
    bpClear,
    wpSet,
    wpClear,
    scanFirst,
    scanRescan,
    scanAob,
    scanReset,
    notify,
    dumpModule,
  } = useDebugger();
  const [bpAddr, setBpAddr] = useState("");
  const [wpAddr, setWpAddr] = useState("");
  const [wpType, setWpType] = useState(1);
  const [wpLen, setWpLen] = useState(8);
  const [lwp, setLwp] = useState("0");
  const [scAddr, setScAddr] = useState("");
  const [scLen, setScLen] = useState("0x10000");
  const [scType, setScType] = useState("u32");
  const [scCmp, setScCmp] = useState("exact");
  const [scVal, setScVal] = useState("");
  const [scAob, setScAob] = useState("");
  const [notifyMsg, setNotifyMsg] = useState("");
  const [dumpName, setDumpName] = useState("eboot.bin");
  const [dumpPath, setDumpPath] = useState("");
  const [inputError, setInputError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
    // stop events arrive over /events; the poll below is only a fallback for
    // a dropped stream (and catches state the engine does not push)
    const off = connectStream();
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      const s = useDebugger.getState().status;
      if (s.ps4_connected) void refresh();
    }, kFallbackPollMs);
    return () => {
      off();
      clearInterval(id);
    };
  }, [connectStream, refresh, target.pid, backend.ps4]);

  const pid = target.pid ?? status.debug_pid;

  if (!backend.ps4) {
    return (
      <div className="empty">
        <div className="empty-glyph">
          <Gamepad2 size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
        </div>
        <div className="empty-title">{t("debugger.noConsole")}</div>
        <div className="empty-hint">{t("debugger.noConsoleHint")}</div>
        <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => setRail("targets")}>
          {t("debugger.openTargets")}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /** Parse an address field; reports instead of silently ignoring bad input. */
  const addrOf = (text: string, what: string): number | null => {
    const a = parseAddress(text);
    if (a === null || a === 0) {
      setInputError(t("debugger.badAddress", { what, text }));
      return null;
    }
    setInputError(null);
    return a;
  };

  const addBp = () => {
    const a = addrOf(bpAddr, t("debugger.breakpoint"));
    if (a !== null) {
      void bpSet(a);
      setBpAddr("");
    }
  };
  const addWp = () => {
    const a = addrOf(wpAddr, t("debugger.watchpoint"));
    if (a !== null) {
      void wpSet(a, wpType, wpLen);
      setWpAddr("");
    }
  };
  // an empty box steps the thread that last stopped (the engine's lwpid 0
  // means all threads, which is rarely what the panel wants)
  const lwpNum = lwp.trim() === "" ? regsLwpid : (parseAddress(lwp) ?? 0);

  const pickDumpPath = async () => {
    if (!isTauri()) return;
    const picked = await save({
      title: t("modules.dumpTitle", { name: dumpName }),
      defaultPath: `${dumpName}.elf`,
      filters: [{ name: "ELF", extensions: ["elf", "bin", "prx"] }],
    });
    if (typeof picked === "string") setDumpPath(picked);
  };

  return (
    <div className="stack dbg-stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <span
          className="pill"
          style={{ color: status.debug_attached ? "var(--success)" : undefined }}
        >
          {status.debug_attached
            ? t("debugger.attached", { pid: status.debug_pid })
            : t("debugger.notAttached")}
        </span>
        {status.ps4_connected && (
          <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            {t("debugger.ps4", {
              fw:
                status.fw !== undefined && status.fw !== ""
                  ? t("debugger.fw", { fw: status.fw })
                  : "",
              pending: status.pending_events,
            })}
          </span>
        )}
        {(status.events_dropped ?? 0) > 0 && (
          <span className="pill warn-pill" data-tip={t("debugger.droppedTip")}>
            {t("debugger.dropped", { count: status.events_dropped ?? 0 })}
          </span>
        )}

        <div className="spacer" />

        {!status.debug_attached ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={pid === 0 || busy}
            onClick={() => pid !== 0 && void attach(pid)}
          >
            {pid === 0 ? t("debugger.attachFirst") : t("debugger.attach")}
          </button>
        ) : (
          <>
            <IconButton
              tip={t("debugger.continue")}
              variant="row"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void cont()}
            >
              <Play size={11} />
            </IconButton>
            <IconButton
              tip={t("debugger.step")}
              variant="row"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void step(lwpNum)}
            >
              <StepForward size={11} />
            </IconButton>
            <IconButton
              tip={t("debugger.wait", { seconds: kWaitMs / 1000 })}
              variant="row"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void waitHalt(kWaitMs)}
            >
              <Timer size={11} />
            </IconButton>
            <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void detach()}>
              <Ban size={11} aria-hidden /> {t("debugger.detach")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Always present: the view is a three-row grid (bar / notes / columns) */}
      <div className="dbg-notes">
        {waitNote !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint" role="status">
            {waitNote}
          </div>
        )}
        {(error ?? inputError) !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
            {error ?? inputError}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="dbg">
        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">
            {t("debugger.registers")}
            <div className="spacer" />
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              style={{ width: 64 }}
              aria-label={t("debugger.thread")}
              value={lwp}
              placeholder={t("debugger.lwpidPlaceholder")}
              onChange={(e) => setLwp(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {regs === null ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {status.debug_attached
                  ? t("debugger.registersHint")
                  : t("debugger.registersNotAttached")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <table className="table">
                <caption className="faint table-caption">
                  {t("debugger.lwp", { lwpid: regsLwpid })}
                </caption>
                <thead className="sr-only">
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">{t("debugger.register")}</th>
                    <th scope="col">{t("debugger.value")}</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {kRegOrder.map((name) => (
                    <tr key={name}>
                      <th scope="row" className="mono faint reg-name">
                        {name}
                      </th>
                      <td>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="mono link"
                          data-tip={t("debugger.showInDisasm")}
                          onClick={() => showInDisassembly(regs[name] ?? 0)}
                        >
                          {hex(regs[name] ?? 0)}
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="dbg-head">{t("debugger.callStack")}</div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {frames.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {t("debugger.noFrames")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ol className="plain-list" aria-label={t("debugger.callStack")}>
                {frames.map((f, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="fn-row"
                      style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }}
                      onClick={() => showInDisassembly(f.ret_addr ?? 0)}
                      data-tip={f.snippet !== undefined && f.snippet !== "" ? f.snippet : undefined}
                    >
                      <span className="faint" style={{ width: 20 }}>
                        {i}
                      </span>
                      <span className="fn-name mono">{hex(f.ret_addr ?? 0)}</span>
                      {f.scanned === true && (
                        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                          {t("debugger.scanMarker")}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">
            {t("debugger.breakpoints")}
            <div className="spacer" />
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              style={{ width: 110 }}
              aria-label={t("debugger.bpAddress")}
              value={bpAddr}
              placeholder={t("debugger.addressPlaceholder")}
              onChange={(e) => setBpAddr(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && addBp()}
            />
            <IconButton tip={t("debugger.setBp")} onClick={addBp} disabled={!status.debug_attached}>
              <Plus size={13} />
            </IconButton>
          </div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {breakpoints.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {t("debugger.noneSet")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              breakpoints.map((b) => (
                <div className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} key={b.addr}>
                  <span className="faint" style={{ width: 44 }}>
                    {t("debugger.slot", { index: b.index })}
                  </span>
                  <span className="fn-name mono">{hex(b.addr)}</span>
                  {(b.count ?? 0) > 0 && (
                    <span
                      className="faint mono"
                      style={{ fontSize: 10 }}
                      data-tip={
                        b.hits !== undefined && b.hits > 0
                          ? t("debugger.hitOn", { hits: b.hits, mode: b.hit_mode ?? "eq" })
                          : t("debugger.hitEvery")
                      }
                    >
                      {b.count}
                      {b.hits !== undefined && b.hits > 0 ? `/${b.hits}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {b.owner !== undefined && b.owner !== "" && (
                    <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }} data-tip={t("debugger.owner")}>
                      {b.owner}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <IconButton
                    tip={t("debugger.clearBp", { addr: hex(b.addr, 1) })}
                    onClick={() => void bpClear(b.addr)}
                  >
                    <Ban size={11} />
                  </IconButton>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
            <div className="dbg-head" style={{ marginTop: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              {t("debugger.watchpoints")}
              <div className="spacer" />
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ width: 110 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.wpAddress")}
                value={wpAddr}
                placeholder={t("debugger.addressPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setWpAddr(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && addWp()}
              />
              <select
                className="addr-input"
                style={{ width: 64 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.wpType")}
                value={wpType}
                onChange={(e) => setWpType(Number(e.target.value))}
              >
                <option value={0}>{t("debugger.wpExec")}</option>
                <option value={1}>{t("debugger.wpWrite")}</option>
                <option value={3}>{t("debugger.wpRdwr")}</option>
              </select>
              <select
                className="addr-input"
                style={{ width: 44 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.wpLength")}
                value={wpLen}
                onChange={(e) => setWpLen(Number(e.target.value))}
              >
                {[1, 2, 4, 8].map((n) => (
                  <option key={n} value={n}>
                    {n}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <IconButton
                tip={t("debugger.setWp")}
                onClick={addWp}
                disabled={!status.debug_attached}
              >
                <Plus size={13} />
              </IconButton>
            </div>
            {watchpoints.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {t("debugger.noneSet")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              watchpoints.map((w) => (
                <div className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} key={w.addr}>
                  <span className="faint" style={{ width: 44 }}>
                    {t("debugger.dr", { index: w.index })}
                  </span>
                  <span className="fn-name mono">{hex(w.addr)}</span>
                  <IconButton
                    tip={t("debugger.clearWp", { addr: hex(w.addr, 1) })}
                    onClick={() => void wpClear(w.addr)}
                  >
                    <Ban size={11} />
                  </IconButton>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">
            {t("debugger.consoleScan")}
            <div className="spacer" />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void scanReset()}
            >
              {t("debugger.reset")}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            <div className="dbg-form">
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ width: 100 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.scanAddr")}
                value={scAddr}
                placeholder={t("debugger.addrPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setScAddr(e.target.value)}
              />
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ width: 64 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.scanLen")}
                value={scLen}
                placeholder={t("debugger.lenPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setScLen(e.target.value)}
              />
              <select
                className="addr-input"
                aria-label={t("debugger.scanType")}
                value={scType}
                onChange={(e) => setScType(e.target.value)}
              >
                {kScanTypes.map((w) => (
                  <option key={w} value={w}>
                    {w}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <select
                className="addr-input"
                aria-label={t("debugger.scanCompare")}
                value={scCmp}
                onChange={(e) => setScCmp(e.target.value)}
              >
                {kCompares.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>
                    {c}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ width: 80 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.scanValue")}
                value={scVal}
                placeholder={t("debugger.valuePlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setScVal(e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                disabled={busy || !scAddr || !scVal}
                onClick={() => {
                  const a = addrOf(scAddr, t("debugger.scanStart"));
                  const l = parseAddress(scLen);
                  if (a === null || l === null) return;
                  const v = scVal.trim();
                  const num = Number(v);
                  void scanFirst({
                    addr: a,
                    len: l,
                    value_type: scType,
                    compare: scCmp,
                    value: Number.isFinite(num) && v !== "" ? num : v,
                  });
                }}
              >
                {t("debugger.scan")}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                disabled={busy || !scan?.used}
                onClick={() =>
                  void scanRescan(
                    scCmp === "exact" ? "changed" : scCmp,
                    scCmp === "exact" && scVal !== "" ? Number(scVal) : undefined,
                  )
                }
              >
                {t("debugger.rescan")}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="dbg-form">
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.aobPattern")}
                value={scAob}
                placeholder={t("debugger.aobPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setScAob(e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                disabled={busy || !scAddr || !scAob}
                onClick={() => {
                  const a = addrOf(scAddr, t("debugger.scanStart"));
                  const l = parseAddress(scLen);
                  if (a !== null && l !== null) void scanAob(a, l, scAob);
                }}
              >
                {t("debugger.aob")}
              </button>
            </div>
            {scan === null || !scan.used ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {t("debugger.noNativeScan")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="faint mono" style={{ padding: "2px var(--pad-md)", fontSize: 11 }}>
                  {t("debugger.scanBase", {
                    base: scan.base_hex ?? hex(scan.base ?? 0),
                    count: scan.count ?? 0,
                  })}
                  {scan.truncated === true ? t("debugger.capped") : ""}
                </div>
                {(scan.hits ?? []).slice(0, 100).map((h, i) => (
                  <div className="fn-row" style={{ position: "static", height: 20 }} key={i}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="fn-name mono link"
                      onClick={() => showInDisassembly(h.addr)}
                    >
                      {h.addr_hex ?? hex(h.addr)}
                    </button>
                    <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                      {h.value_hex ?? ""}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="dbg-head">{t("debugger.console")}</div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            <div className="faint" style={{ padding: "2px var(--pad-md)", fontSize: 11 }}>
              {app === null
                ? t("debugger.appUnknown")
                : app.running === false || app.pid === 0
                  ? t("debugger.noForeground")
                  : t("debugger.foreground", {
                      name: app.name ?? "?",
                      titleid: app.titleid ?? "",
                      version: app.app_ver ?? "?",
                      pid: app.pid,
                    })}
            </div>
            <div className="dbg-form">
              <input
                className="addr-input"
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.notification")}
                value={notifyMsg}
                placeholder={t("debugger.notificationPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setNotifyMsg(e.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                disabled={!notifyMsg}
                onClick={() => {
                  void notify(notifyMsg);
                  setNotifyMsg("");
                }}
              >
                {t("debugger.notify")}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="dbg-form">
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ width: 90 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.moduleToDump")}
                value={dumpName}
                onChange={(e) => setDumpName(e.target.value)}
              />
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ flex: 1 }}
                aria-label={t("debugger.dumpPath")}
                value={dumpPath}
                placeholder={t("debugger.dumpPathPlaceholder")}
                onChange={(e) => setDumpPath(e.target.value)}
              />
              {isTauri() && (
                <IconButton tip={t("debugger.browse")} onClick={() => void pickDumpPath()}>
                  <FolderOpen size={12} />
                </IconButton>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                disabled={busy || !dumpName || !dumpPath}
                onClick={() => void dumpModule(dumpName, dumpPath, true)}
                data-tip={t("debugger.dumpLoadTip")}
              >
                {t("debugger.dumpLoad")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dbg-col">
          <div className="dbg-head">{t("debugger.events")}</div>
          <div className="panel-body">
            {logs.length > 0 && (
              <ol className="plain-list" aria-label={t("debugger.logLines")}>
                {logs.slice(0, 20).map((line, i) => (
                  <li
                    className="log-row mono"
                    key={`log-${i}`}
                    style={{ padding: "1px var(--pad-md)", fontSize: 11 }}
                  >
                    {line}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            )}
            {events.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {t("debugger.noEvents")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ol className="plain-list" aria-label={t("debugger.stopEvents")}>
                {events.slice(0, 40).map((e, i) => (
                  <li
                    className="log-row mono"
                    key={i}
                    style={{ padding: "1px var(--pad-md)", fontSize: 11 }}
                  >
                    <span className="faint">
                      {t("debugger.lwp", { lwpid: e.lwpid })}
                      {e.thread !== undefined && e.thread !== ""
                        ? t("debugger.eventThread", { thread: e.thread })
                        : ""}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      style={{
                        color: e.signal !== 0 && e.signal !== 5 ? "var(--danger)" : undefined,
                      }}
                    >
                      {t("debugger.signal", { signal: e.signal })}
                    </span>
                    {e.rip !== undefined && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="mono link"
                        onClick={() => showInDisassembly(e.rip ?? 0)}
                      >
                        {hex(e.rip, 12)}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/DecompView.tsx
// Pseudocode tab: decomp.function for the selected function, highlighted in
// React (no editor library) with clickable identifiers, plus the CFG in a
// split pane. Function names jump the listing; there is no struct editor yet,
// so clicking a type only selects it

import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Network } from "lucide-react";
import CfgGraph from "@/components/CfgGraph";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { on } from "@/lib/events";
import { hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { showInDisassembly } from "@/lib/navigate";
import { functionLabel, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useDecomp, type DecompLine } from "@/store/decomp";

type Kind = "kw" | "type" | "num" | "str" | "com" | "fn" | "id" | "punct" | "ws";
type Token = { kind: Kind; text: string };

const kKeywords: Record<string, true> = {
  if: true,
  else: true,
  while: true,
  for: true,
  do: true,
  return: true,
  switch: true,
  case: true,
  break: true,
  continue: true,
  goto: true,
  default: true,
  sizeof: true,
  typedef: true,
  struct: true,
  union: true,
  enum: true,
  static: true,
  const: true,
  volatile: true,
  extern: true,
  inline: true,
  register: true,
};

const kTypes: Record<string, true> = {
  void: true,
  char: true,
  short: true,
  int: true,
  long: true,
  float: true,
  double: true,
  bool: true,
  unsigned: true,
  signed: true,
  size_t: true,
  ssize_t: true,
  uint: true,
  ulong: true,
  ushort: true,
  uchar: true,
  byte: true,
  word: true,
  dword: true,
  qword: true,
  code: true,
  true: true,
  false: true,
  nullptr: true,
  NULL: true,
  BYTE: true,
  WORD: true,
  DWORD: true,
  QWORD: true,
  BOOL: true,
  HANDLE: true,
  LPVOID: true,
  __int8: true,
  __int16: true,
  __int32: true,
  __int64: true,
};

const kNumber = /^(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[uUlLfF]*/;
const kIdent = /[A-Za-z0-9_$]/;
const kIdentStart = /[A-Za-z_$]/;
/** Hyperion spells unknown-width values `undefined4`; C widths end in `_t`. */
const kTypeName = /^(?:undefined\d*|u?int(?:8|16|32|64)|.*_t)$/;

function classify(text: string, call: boolean): Kind {
  if (kKeywords[text] === true) return "kw";
  if (kTypes[text] === true || kTypeName.test(text)) return "type";
  if (call) return "fn";
  return "id";
}

/** Split one pseudocode line into highlighted tokens; no library, no state. */
function tokenize(line: string): Token[] {
  const out: Token[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < line.length) {
    const c = line[i];
    if (c === "/" && line[i + 1] === "/") {
      out.push({ kind: "com", text: line.slice(i) });
      break;
    }
    if (c === "/" && line[i + 1] === "*") {
      const close = line.indexOf("*/", i + 2);
      const end = close < 0 ? line.length : close + 2;
      out.push({ kind: "com", text: line.slice(i, end) });
      i = end;
      continue;
    }
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < line.length && line[j] !== c) j += line[j] === "\\" ? 2 : 1;
      j = Math.min(j + 1, line.length);
      out.push({ kind: "str", text: line.slice(i, j) });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }
    if (c >= "0" && c <= "9") {
      const m = kNumber.exec(line.slice(i));
      const text = m === null ? c : m[0];
      out.push({ kind: "num", text });
      i += text.length;
      continue;
    }
    if (kIdentStart.test(c)) {
      // `Player::Update` is one name, and a following `(` makes it a call
      let j = i;
      for (;;) {
        while (j < line.length && kIdent.test(line[j])) j++;
        if (line[j] === ":" && line[j + 1] === ":") {
          j += 2;
          continue;
        }
        break;
      }
      const text = line.slice(i, j);
      out.push({ kind: classify(text, line[j] === "("), text });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }
    if (/\s/.test(c)) {
      let j = i;
      while (j < line.length && /\s/.test(line[j])) j++;
      out.push({ kind: "ws", text: line.slice(i, j) });
      i = j;
      continue;
    }
    out.push({ kind: "punct", text: c });
    i++;
  }
  return out;
}

/** `sub_4DDA48` carries its own address; anything else needs a name lookup. */
async function goToFunction(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const sub = /^sub_([0-9A-Fa-f]+)$/.exec(name);
  if (sub !== null) {
    showInDisassembly(Number.parseInt(sub[1], 16));
    return;
  }
  const rows = await useDisasm.getState().searchFunctions(name, 8);
  const hit = rows.find((f) => functionLabel(f) === name);
  if (hit !== undefined) showInDisassembly(hit.va);
}

function Tokens({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const t = useT();
  const selectedType = useDecomp((s) => s.selectedType);
  const selectType = useDecomp((s) => s.selectType);
  return (
    <>
      {tokenize(text).map((token, i) => {
        if (token.kind === "ws") return token.text;
        if (token.kind === "fn")
          return (
            <button
              key={i}
              type="button"
              className="decomp-fn"
              aria-label={t("decomp.goTo", { name: token.text })}
              onClick={() => void goToFunction(token.text)}
            >
              {token.text}
            </button>
          );
        if (token.kind === "type")
          return (
            <button
              key={i}
              type="button"
              className="decomp-type"
              aria-pressed={selectedType === token.text}
              aria-label={t("decomp.selectType", { name: token.text })}
              onClick={() => selectType(selectedType === token.text ? null : token.text)}
            >
              {token.text}
            </button>
          );
        return (
          <span key={i} className={`decomp-${token.kind}`}>
            {token.text}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function Line({ line }: { line: DecompLine }) {
  return (
    <div className="decomp-line">
      <span className="decomp-gutter">{line.va !== 0 ? hex(line.va, 8) : ""}</span>
      <span className="decomp-src">
        <Tokens text={line.text} />
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function DecompView(): ReactNode {
  const t = useT();
  const selected = useDisasm((s) => s.selected);
  const selectedFn = useDisasm((s) => s.selectedFn);
  const va = useDecomp((s) => s.va);
  const load = useDecomp((s) => s.load);
  const split = useDecomp((s) => s.split);
  const setSplit = useDecomp((s) => s.setSplit);
  const signature = useDecomp((s) => s.signature);
  const callconv = useDecomp((s) => s.callconv);
  const insnCount = useDecomp((s) => s.insnCount);
  const callSites = useDecomp((s) => s.callSites);
  const typesGeneration = useDecomp((s) => s.typesGeneration);
  const lines = useDecomp((s) => s.lines);
  const graph = useDecomp((s) => s.graph);
  const entry = useDecomp((s) => s.entry);
  const busy = useDecomp((s) => s.busy);
  const error = useDecomp((s) => s.error);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");

  // The view follows the listing: opening the tab decompiles what is selected
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected !== null && selected !== va) void load(selected);
  }, [selected, va, load]);

  // A struct edit changes inferred types, so the listing is stale
  useEffect(() => on("types.changed", () => void useDecomp.getState().reload()), []);

  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const addr = parseAddress(text);
    if (addr !== null) void load(addr);
  };

  const name = va === null ? null : selectedFn !== null && selectedFn.va === va ? selectedFn : null;

  return (
    <div className="decomp">
      <div className="decomp-head">
        <form className="decomp-goto" onSubmit={submit}>
          <input
            className="decomp-input mono"
            aria-label={t("decomp.address")}
            placeholder={t("decomp.addressPlaceholder")}
            value={text}
            onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button type="submit" className="row-action">
            {t("decomp.decompile")}
          </button>
        </form>
        <span className="decomp-title mono">
          {va === null ? t("decomp.noFunction") : name !== null ? functionLabel(name) : hex(va, 8)}
        </span>
        <IconButton tip={t("decomp.cfgTip")} pressed={split} onClick={() => setSplit(!split)}>
          <Network size={14} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>

      {error !== null && (
        <div className="decomp-note error-text" role="alert">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="decomp-body" data-split={split}>
        <div className="decomp-pane" role="region" aria-label={t("decomp.pseudocode")}>
          {va === null ? (
            <div className="empty">
              <div className="empty-title">{t("decomp.noFunctionSelected")}</div>
              <div className="empty-hint">{t("decomp.noFunctionHint")}</div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="decomp-sig mono">
                <Tokens text={signature} />
              </div>
              <div className="decomp-meta mono">
                {callconv !== "" && <span>{callconv}</span>}
                <span>{t("decomp.insns", { count: insnCount })}</span>
                <span>{t("decomp.callSites", { count: callSites.length })}</span>
                {typesGeneration !== null && (
                  <span>{t("decomp.typesGen", { gen: typesGeneration })}</span>
                )}
                {busy && <span className="faint">{t("decomp.decompiling")}</span>}
              </div>
              <div className="decomp-code">
                {lines.map((line, i) => (
                  <Line key={i} line={line} />
                ))}
              </div>
              {callSites.length > 0 && (
                <div className="decomp-calls">
                  {callSites.map((c) => (
                    <button
                      key={c.va}
                      type="button"
                      className="decomp-call mono"
                      aria-label={t("decomp.callSite", { addr: hex(c.va, 8) })}
                      onClick={() => showInDisassembly(c.va)}
                    >
                      {hex(c.va, 8)} {c.arg_types.join(", ")}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        {split && (
          <div className="decomp-cfg">
            <CfgGraph graph={graph} entry={entry} onPick={(addr) => showInDisassembly(addr)} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/DisassemblyView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/DisassemblyView.tsx
// port of the disasm view, function list and instruction listing, both
// virtualized since a real binary has tens of thousands of each. The function
// list is paged and filtered server-side (disasm.functions offset/limit/filter)

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { Pencil, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { functionLabel, hex, rowAt, useDisasm, type FunctionRow } from "@/store/disasm";
import Minimap from "@/components/panels/Minimap";

const kRow = 20;

function flowColor(flow: string): string | undefined {
  switch (flow) {
    case "call":
      return "var(--accent)";
    case "jump":
    case "cond_jump":
      return "var(--warning)";
    case "ret":
      return "var(--danger)";
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

function FunctionList() {
  const t = useT();
  const pages = useDisasm((s) => s.pages);
  const total = useDisasm((s) => s.total);
  const matched = useDisasm((s) => s.matched);
  const selected = useDisasm((s) => s.selected);
  const filter = useDisasm((s) => s.filter);
  const setFilter = useDisasm((s) => s.setFilter);
  const select = useDisasm((s) => s.select);
  const rename = useDisasm((s) => s.rename);
  const ensureRows = useDisasm((s) => s.ensureRows);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: matched,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 15,
  });

  const items = virtualizer.getVirtualItems();
  const first = items[0]?.index ?? 0;
  const last = items[items.length - 1]?.index ?? 0;
  // Fetch the pages that scrolled into view
  useEffect(() => {
    ensureRows(first, last);
  }, [first, last, matched, pages, ensureRows]);

  const commit = async (fn: FunctionRow, value: string) => {
    setEditing(null);
    if (value !== functionLabel(fn)) await rename(fn.va, value);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fn-list">
      <div className="search">
        <Search size={13} aria-hidden />
        <input
          value={filter}
          aria-label={t("disasm.filter")}
          placeholder={t("disasm.filterPlaceholder", { total })}
          onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
        />
        {filter !== "" && <span className="faint fn-count">{matched}</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef} role="listbox" aria-label={t("disasm.functions")}>
        <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
          {items.map((v) => {
            const fn = rowAt({ pages }, v.index);
            if (fn === undefined) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={`pending-${v.index}`}
                  className="fn-row faint"
                  style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                >
                  …
                </div>
              );
            }
            return (
              <div
                key={fn.va}
                className="fn-row"
                role="option"
                aria-selected={fn.va === selected}
                tabIndex={fn.va === selected ? 0 : -1}
                data-selected={fn.va === selected}
                style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                onClick={() => void select(fn.va, fn)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter") void select(fn.va, fn);
                  if (e.key === "F2") setEditing(fn.va);
                }}
                onDoubleClick={() => setEditing(fn.va)}
                data-tip={t("disasm.rowTip", {
                  addr: hex(fn.va),
                  size: fn.size,
                  callconv: fn.callconv ? t("disasm.callconv", { callconv: fn.callconv }) : "",
                })}
              >
                {editing === fn.va ? (
                  <input
                    className="fn-rename mono"
                    aria-label={t("disasm.rename", { name: functionLabel(fn) })}
                    autoFocus
                    defaultValue={functionLabel(fn)}
                    onBlur={(e) => void commit(fn, e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      if (e.key === "Enter") void commit(fn, e.currentTarget.value);
                      if (e.key === "Escape") setEditing(null);
                    }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span className="fn-name">{functionLabel(fn)}</span>
                    {fn.noreturn === true && <span className="pill">{t("disasm.noret")}</span>}
                    {fn.blocks !== undefined && (
                      <span className="faint">{t("disasm.blocks", { count: fn.blocks })}</span>
                    )}
                    <Pencil className="fn-edit" size={11} aria-hidden />
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Listing() {
  const t = useT();
  const insns = useDisasm((s) => s.insns);
  const selected = useDisasm((s) => s.selected);
  const fn = useDisasm((s) => s.selectedFn);
  const gotoAddress = useDisasm((s) => s.gotoAddress);
  const linear = useDisasm((s) => s.linear);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: insns.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 25,
  });

  const items = virtualizer.getVirtualItems();
  const first = items[0]?.index ?? 0;
  const last = items[items.length - 1]?.index ?? 0;
  const jumpTo = useCallback(
    (index: number) => virtualizer.scrollToIndex(index, { align: "start" }),
    [virtualizer],
  );

  return (
    <div className="listing">
      <div className="listing-head mono">
        {fn !== null && fn.va === selected ? (
          <>
            <span style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}>{functionLabel(fn)}</span>
            <span className="faint">
              {t("disasm.head", {
                addr: hex(fn.va),
                size: fn.size,
                count: insns.length,
                callconv: fn.callconv ? t("disasm.callconv", { callconv: fn.callconv }) : "",
              })}
            </span>
            {linear && (
              <span className="pill" data-tip={t("disasm.linearTip")}>
                {t("disasm.linear")}
              </span>
            )}
          </>
        ) : selected !== null ? (
          <span className="faint">
            {t("disasm.noFunctionAt", { addr: hex(selected), count: insns.length })}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="faint">{t("disasm.noSelection")}</span>
        )}
      </div>
      {/* Keyed on the selection so picking a new function fades its listing in
          rather than swapping rows underneath the cursor. Remounting also puts
          the scroll back at the top. */}
      <div className="listing-body">
        <Minimap insns={insns} first={first} last={last} onJump={jumpTo} />
        <div className="panel-body swap-fade" key={selected ?? "none"} ref={scrollRef}>
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {items.map((v) => {
              const insn = insns[v.index];
              const target = insn.target;
              return (
                <div key={insn.va} className="insn-row mono" style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}>
                  <span className="insn-va">{hex(insn.va)}</span>
                  <span className="insn-text" style={{ color: flowColor(insn.flow) }}>
                    {insn.text}
                  </span>
                  {target !== undefined && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="insn-target"
                      onClick={() => void gotoAddress(target)}
                      data-tip={t("disasm.follow", { addr: hex(target) })}
                      aria-label={t("disasm.follow", { addr: hex(target) })}
                    >
                      → {hex(target, 8)}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function DisassemblyView() {
  return (
    <div className="disasm">
      <FunctionList />
      <Listing />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/EmulatorPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/EmulatorPanel.tsx
// Unicorn emulation (tool: emulate): one-shot runs with stop conditions, dump
// windows, trace and taint, plus persistent sessions and the backward slice
// over a recorded trace

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { Cpu, Play, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { useEmulator, type EmuParams, type EmuRegs, type EmuTraceRow } from "@/store/emulator";

const kRow = 18;

function RegTable({ regs }: { regs: EmuRegs }) {
  const names = Object.keys(regs).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  return (
    <table className="table">
      <caption className="sr-only">Registers</caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Register</th>
          <th scope="col">Value</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {names.map((name) => (
          <tr key={name}>
            <td className="mono">{name}</td>
            <td className="mono">{hex(regs[name], 1)}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function TraceList({ rows }: { rows: EmuTraceRow[] }) {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
  });
  return (
    <div className="tool-table-wrap">
      <div className="tool-table-scroll" ref={scrollRef}>
        <table className="table">
          <caption className="sr-only">Execution trace</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">IP</th>
              <th scope="col">Instruction</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const t = rows[v.index];
              return (
                <tr
                  key={`${t.ip}-${v.index}`}
                  style={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    top: v.start,
                    left: 0,
                    width: "100%",
                    height: kRow,
                    display: "table",
                    tableLayout: "fixed",
                  }}
                >
                  <td className="mono faint">{hex(t.ip, 1)}</td>
                  <td className="mono">{t.text}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type Dump = { addr: string; len: string };

export default function EmulatorPanel() {
  const {
    run,
    session,
    slice,
    busy,
    error,
    emulate,
    backSlice,
    sessionCreate,
    sessionStep,
    sessionDestroy,
    snapshot,
    restore,
  } = useEmulator();
  const [source, setSource] = useState<"hex" | "file_addr" | "target_addr">("hex");
  const [hexText, setHexText] = useState("");
  const [fileAddr, setFileAddr] = useState("");
  const [targetAddr, setTargetAddr] = useState("");
  const [arch, setArch] = useState("x64");
  const [until, setUntil] = useState("");
  const [count, setCount] = useState("1000");
  const [timeoutMs, setTimeoutMs] = useState("5000");
  const [trace, setTrace] = useState(true);
  const [traceMax, setTraceMax] = useState("256");
  const [orbis, setOrbis] = useState(false);
  const [taintOn, setTaintOn] = useState(false);
  const [taintAddr, setTaintAddr] = useState("");
  const [taintLen, setTaintLen] = useState("16");
  const [dumps, setDumps] = useState<Dump[]>([]);
  const [traceId, setTraceId] = useState("");
  const [sliceReg, setSliceReg] = useState("");
  const [sliceAddr, setSliceAddr] = useState("");
  const [sliceLen, setSliceLen] = useState("8");
  const [sliceAt, setSliceAt] = useState("");

  const params = (): EmuParams | null => {
    const p: EmuParams = { arch };
    if (source === "hex") {
      if (hexText.trim() === "") return null;
      p.hex = hexText.trim();
    } else if (source === "file_addr") {
      const va = parseAddress(fileAddr);
      if (va === null) return null;
      p.file_addr = va;
    } else {
      const va = parseAddress(targetAddr);
      if (va === null) return null;
      p.target_addr = va;
    }
    const untilVa = parseAddress(until);
    if (untilVa !== null) p.until = untilVa;
    const countValue = Number.parseInt(count, 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(countValue) && countValue > 0) p.count = countValue;
    const timeoutValue = Number.parseInt(timeoutMs, 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(timeoutValue) && timeoutValue > 0) p.timeout_ms = timeoutValue;
    if (trace) {
      p.trace = true;
      const maxValue = Number.parseInt(traceMax, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(maxValue) && maxValue > 0) p.trace_max = maxValue;
    }
    if (orbis) p.orbis_syscalls = true;
    const windows = dumps
      .map((d) => ({ addr: parseAddress(d.addr), len: Number.parseInt(d.len, 10) }))
      .filter(
        (d): d is { addr: number; len: number } =>
          d.addr !== null && Number.isFinite(d.len) && d.len > 0,
      );
    if (windows.length > 0) p.dump = windows;
    const taintVa = parseAddress(taintAddr);
    const taintLength = Number.parseInt(taintLen, 10);
    if (taintOn && taintVa !== null && Number.isFinite(taintLength) && taintLength > 0)
      p.taint = [{ addr: taintVa, len: taintLength }];
    return p;
  };

  const doRun = async () => {
    const p = params();
    if (p === null) return;
    await emulate(p);
    const id = useEmulator.getState().run?.trace_id;
    if (id !== undefined) setTraceId(String(id));
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel tool-panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Emulator</span>
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
          Unicorn · isolated
        </span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null}
          onClick={() => void doRun()}
        >
          <Play size={11} aria-hidden /> Run
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body tool-body">
        <div className="tool-form">
          <select
            className="select"
            aria-label="Code source"
            value={source}
            onChange={(e) => setSource(e.target.value as typeof source)}
          >
            <option value="hex">hex bytes</option>
            <option value="file_addr">image address</option>
            <option value="target_addr">target address</option>
          </select>
          <select
            className="select"
            aria-label="Architecture"
            value={arch}
            onChange={(e) => setArch(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="x64">x86-64</option>
            <option value="arm64">arm64</option>
          </select>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            until
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              style={{ width: 96 }}
              aria-label="Stop at address (hex)"
              placeholder="stop VA"
              value={until}
              onChange={(e) => setUntil(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            count
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              style={{ width: 64 }}
              aria-label="Instruction count"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={count}
              onChange={(e) => setCount(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            timeout ms
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              style={{ width: 64 }}
              aria-label="Timeout in milliseconds"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={timeoutMs}
              onChange={(e) => setTimeoutMs(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
        </div>

        {source === "hex" ? (
          <textarea
            className="tool-hex mono"
            aria-label="Code bytes (hex)"
            placeholder="48 31 C0 C3"
            rows={3}
            value={hexText}
            onChange={(e) => setHexText(e.target.value)}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="tool-form">
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              style={{ width: 130 }}
              aria-label={source === "file_addr" ? "Image address (hex)" : "Target address (hex)"}
              placeholder={source === "file_addr" ? "file_addr" : "target_addr"}
              value={source === "file_addr" ? fileAddr : targetAddr}
              onChange={(e) =>
                source === "file_addr" ? setFileAddr(e.target.value) : setTargetAddr(e.target.value)
              }
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="tool-form">
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label="Record trace"
              checked={trace}
              onChange={(e) => setTrace(e.target.checked)}
            />
            trace
          </label>
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 64 }}
            aria-label="Trace max instructions"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={traceMax}
            onChange={(e) => setTraceMax(e.target.value)}
          />
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label="Orbis syscalls"
              checked={orbis}
              onChange={(e) => setOrbis(e.target.checked)}
            />
            orbis syscalls
          </label>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label="Enable taint"
              checked={taintOn}
              onChange={(e) => setTaintOn(e.target.checked)}
            />
            taint
          </label>
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 96 }}
            aria-label="Taint source address (hex)"
            placeholder="taint VA"
            value={taintAddr}
            onChange={(e) => setTaintAddr(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 56 }}
            aria-label="Taint source length"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={taintLen}
            onChange={(e) => setTaintLen(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="tool-form">
          <span className="faint">dump windows</span>
          {dumps.map((d, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="tool-field">
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                style={{ width: 96 }}
                aria-label={`Dump ${i + 1} address`}
                placeholder="addr"
                value={d.addr}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setDumps(dumps.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, addr: e.target.value } : x)))
                }
              />
              <input
                className="addr-input"
                style={{ width: 56 }}
                aria-label={`Dump ${i + 1} length`}
                placeholder="len"
                inputMode="numeric"
                value={d.len}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setDumps(dumps.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, len: e.target.value } : x)))
                }
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                aria-label={`Remove dump ${i + 1}`}
                onClick={() => setDumps(dumps.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}
              >
                <Trash2 size={11} aria-hidden />
              </button>
            </span>
          ))}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            onClick={() => setDumps([...dumps, { addr: "", len: "16" }])}
          >
            <Plus size={11} aria-hidden /> Add
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="tool-form">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null}
            onClick={() => {
              const p = params();
              if (p !== null) void sessionCreate(p);
            }}
          >
            Create session
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null || session === null}
            onClick={() => void sessionStep(1, false)}
          >
            Step
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null || session === null}
            onClick={() => void sessionStep(0, true)}
          >
            Run session
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null || session === null}
            onClick={() => void snapshot()}
          >
            Snapshot
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null || session === null}
            onClick={() => void restore()}
          >
            Restore
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null || session === null}
            onClick={() => void sessionDestroy()}
          >
            Destroy
          </button>
          {busy !== null && <span className="faint">{busy}…</span>}
        </div>

        {error !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {run !== null && (
          <div className="tool-summary">
            <div className="faint">
              {run.stopped_reason} · {run.instructions} instructions · {run.arch} / {run.abi}
              {run.exited === true ? ` · exited ${run.exit_code ?? 0}` : ""}
              {run.paged_in !== undefined ? ` · ${run.paged_in} pages in` : ""}
              {run.trace_id !== undefined ? ` · trace ${run.trace_id}` : ""}
            </div>
            {run.fault !== undefined && (
              <div className="sev-bad mono">
                fault at {hex(run.fault.ip, 1)} accessing {hex(run.fault.addr, 1)} (
                {run.fault.access})
              </div>
            )}
            {run.note !== undefined && <div className="faint">{run.note}</div>}
            {run.stdout !== undefined && <pre className="tool-pre">{run.stdout}</pre>}
          </div>
        )}

        {run !== null && <RegTable regs={run.regs} />}

        {run?.trace !== undefined && run.trace.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <div className="tool-section-head">
              <span className="panel-title">Trace</span>
              <span className="faint">{run.trace.length} instructions</span>
            </div>
            <TraceList rows={run.trace} />
          </>
        )}

        {run?.taint_ranges !== undefined && (
          <div className="tool-summary">
            <div className="faint">
              taint: {run.taint_ranges.length} ranges
              {run.output_tainted === true ? " · output tainted" : " · output clean"}
            </div>
            <ul className="tool-steps mono">
              {run.taint_ranges.map((r, i) => (
                <li key={i}>
                  {hex(r.addr, 1)} + {r.len}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}

        {run?.memory !== undefined && run.memory.length > 0 && (
          <div className="tool-summary">
            {run.memory.map((m, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="mono">
                dump {hex(m.addr, 1)} · {m.len}/{m.requested} B · {m.hex}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="tool-section-head">
          <span className="panel-title">Backward slice</span>
          <span className="faint">needs trace=true</span>
        </div>
        <div className="tool-form">
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 64 }}
            aria-label="Trace id"
            placeholder="trace id"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={traceId}
            onChange={(e) => setTraceId(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 64 }}
            aria-label="Slice register"
            placeholder="reg"
            value={sliceReg}
            onChange={(e) => setSliceReg(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 96 }}
            aria-label="Slice address (hex)"
            placeholder="addr"
            value={sliceAddr}
            onChange={(e) => setSliceAddr(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 56 }}
            aria-label="Slice length"
            placeholder="len"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={sliceLen}
            onChange={(e) => setSliceLen(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 56 }}
            aria-label="Slice trace index"
            placeholder="at"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={sliceAt}
            onChange={(e) => setSliceAt(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null}
            onClick={() => {
              const id = Number.parseInt(traceId, 10);
              if (!Number.isFinite(id)) return;
              const at = Number.parseInt(sliceAt, 10);
              const len = Number.parseInt(sliceLen, 10);
              const addr = parseAddress(sliceAddr);
              void backSlice({
                trace_id: id,
                ...(sliceReg.trim() !== "" ? { reg: sliceReg.trim() } : {}),
                ...(addr !== null ? { addr } : {}),
                ...(Number.isFinite(len) && len > 0 ? { len } : {}),
                ...(Number.isFinite(at) ? { at } : {}),
              });
            }}
          >
            Slice
          </button>
        </div>
        {slice !== null && (
          <div className="tool-summary">
            <div className="faint">
              {slice.count} instructions for trace {slice.trace_id}
            </div>
            <ol className="tool-steps mono">
              {slice.instructions.map((i, n) => (
                <li key={n}>
                  {hex(i.ip, 1)} {i.text}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
          </div>
        )}

        {session !== null && (
          <div className="tool-summary">
            <div className="faint">
              session {session.session} · {session.arch} · {session.instructions} instructions ·{" "}
              {session.snapshots} snapshots
              {session.stopped_reason !== undefined ? ` · ${session.stopped_reason}` : ""}
              {session.restored === true ? " · restored" : ""}
            </div>
            <RegTable regs={session.regs} />
          </div>
        )}

        {run === null && session === null && error === null && (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-glyph">
              <Cpu size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            </div>
            <div className="empty-title">Emulate code.</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">
              Paste hex bytes, or point at the loaded image or an attached target. The VM is
              isolated from the target process.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
