`app/src/components/panels/InspectorPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/InspectorPanel.tsx
// right hand pane, whatever the engine knows about the target and image

import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { formatLabel } from "@/lib/format";
import { hex as hexAddr, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useTargets } from "@/store/targets";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";

function Row({ k, v }: { k: string; v: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="inspector-row">
      <span className="faint inspector-key">{k}</span>
      {/* Ellipsis rather than break-all: a wrapped path or process name split
          mid-word ("reverse-slo p-engine.ex e") is harder to read than a
          truncated one with the full value on hover. */}
      <span className="mono inspector-value" data-tip={v}>
        {v}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function InspectorPanel() {
  const t = useT();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const backend = useEngine((s) => s.backend);
  const hype = useEngine((s) => s.hype);
  // Kept current by the engine store on target.changed (MCP attach included)
  const modules = useTargets((s) => s.modules);
  const ps4 = useTargets((s) => s.ps4);
  const setInspectorOpen = useUi((s) => s.setInspectorOpen);
  // Image facts come from the disasm store, not from `hype.image`: the
  // workspace reads `disasm.loaded` and the event mirror can lag it, which had
  // the Inspector naming one image while the listing showed another
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);

  return (
    <aside className="panel" aria-label={t("inspector.title")}>
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">{t("inspector.title")}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <IconButton tip={t("inspector.hide")} onClick={() => setInspectorOpen(false)}>
          <X size={14} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body">
        {!target.attached && !image.ready ? (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-glyph">
              <Search size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            </div>
            <div className="empty-title">{t("inspector.empty")}</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">{t("inspector.emptyHint")}</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="inspector">
            {target.attached && (
              <>
                <Row k={t("inspector.process")} v={target.name ?? "?"} />
                <Row k={t("inspector.pid")} v={String(target.pid ?? 0)} />
                <Row k={t("inspector.backend")} v={backend.badge} />
                {backend.ps4 && ps4 !== null && ps4.endpoint !== "" && (
                  <Row k={t("inspector.console")} v={ps4.endpoint} />
                )}
                <Row k={t("inspector.modules")} v={String(modules.length)} />
              </>
            )}
            {image.ready && (
              <>
                {target.attached && <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />}
                <Row k={t("inspector.image")} v={image.name ?? "?"} />
                {image.format !== undefined && (
                  <Row k={t("inspector.format")} v={formatLabel(image.format)} />
                )}
                {image.arch !== undefined && <Row k={t("inspector.arch")} v={image.arch} />}
                {image.encrypted !== undefined && (
                  <Row
                    k={t("inspector.encrypted")}
                    v={image.encrypted ? t("common.yes") : t("common.no")}
                  />
                )}
                <Row
                  k={t("inspector.base")}
                  v={image.base !== undefined ? hexAddr(image.base) : t("common.na")}
                />
                {image.entry_va !== undefined && (
                  <Row k={t("inspector.entry")} v={hexAddr(image.entry_va)} />
                )}
                <Row k={t("inspector.functions")} v={String(image.functions ?? 0)} />
                {image.strings !== undefined && (
                  <Row k={t("inspector.strings")} v={String(image.strings)} />
                )}
                <Row
                  k={t("inspector.analysis")}
                  v={
                    hype.running
                      ? `${Math.round(hype.progress * 100)}%`
                      : hype.ready
                        ? t("common.ready")
                        : hype.error || t("common.idle")
                  }
                />
                {image.bundle !== undefined && (
                  <>
                    <div className="menu-sep" role="separator" />
                    <Row k={t("inspector.appDir")} v={image.bundle.app_dir} />
                    <Row k={t("inspector.executable")} v={image.bundle.executable} />
                    <Row k={t("inspector.archivePath")} v={image.bundle.executable_path} />
                    {image.bundle.bundle_id !== "" && (
                      <Row k={t("inspector.bundleId")} v={image.bundle.bundle_id} />
                    )}
                    {image.bundle.version !== "" && (
                      <Row k={t("inspector.version")} v={image.bundle.version} />
                    )}
                    {image.bundle.build !== "" && (
                      <Row k={t("inspector.build")} v={image.bundle.build} />
                    )}
                    {image.bundle.min_os !== "" && (
                      <Row k={t("inspector.minOs")} v={image.bundle.min_os} />
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

```

`app/src/components/panels/MemoryView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/MemoryView.tsx
// Hex editor over live target memory, port of src/ui/view_memory.cpp
// Region list on the left, 16-bytes-per-row grid on the right, edit in place.
// The grid scrolls continuously through a 1 MiB window of the region, pages
// are read as they scroll in; prev/next move the window along the region

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import {
  ArrowRight,
  Camera,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  GitCompare,
  Microscope,
  RefreshCw,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { escapeControl, hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { byteAt, kHexCols, kHexRowPx, kWindowBytes, protectName, useMemory } from "@/store/memory";
import { useTypes } from "@/store/types";

const kRow = kHexRowPx;
const kCols = kHexCols;

function ascii(b: number | undefined): string {
  return b === undefined ? " " : b >= 0x20 && b < 0x7f ? String.fromCharCode(b) : ".";
}

interface DissectRow {
  offset: number;
  hex: string;
  kind: string;
  value?: unknown;
  target?: { kind: string; text?: string; symbol?: string; vtable_symbol?: string };
}

function describe(r: DissectRow): string {
  if (r.target) {
    const target = r.target;
    const what =
      target.text !== undefined
        ? `"${target.text}"`
        : (target.vtable_symbol ?? target.symbol ?? "");
    return `→ ${target.kind}${what ? ` ${what}` : ""}`;
  }
  return r.value === undefined ? "" : JSON.stringify(r.value);
}

// one row per 8-byte slot from memory.dissect: a first draft of a struct
function DissectPane({ addr, onClose }: { addr: number; onClose: () => void }) {
  const t = useT();
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<DissectRow[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    setRows(null);
    setError(null);
    call<{ rows: DissectRow[] }>("memory", "dissect", { addr, size: 0x100 })
      .then((r) => setRows(r.rows))
      .catch((e: unknown) => setError(errorText(e)));
  }, [addr]);
  return (
    <div className="stack" style={{ maxHeight: "40%", borderTop: "1px solid var(--border)" }}>
      <div className="view-bar">
        <span className="panel-title">{t("memory.dissect", { addr: hex(addr, 12) })}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <IconButton tip={t("memory.closeDissect")} onClick={onClose}>
          <X size={13} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        {error !== null && (
          <div className="error-text" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        {rows === null && error === null && <div className="faint">{t("memory.reading")}</div>}
        {rows?.map((r) => (
          <div key={r.offset} style={{ display: "flex", gap: 12 }}>
            <span className="faint">+{r.offset.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(3, "0")}</span>
            <span style={{ minWidth: 150 }}>{r.hex}</span>
            <span style={{ minWidth: 70 }}>{r.kind}</span>
            <span>{describe(r)}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type SnapshotRec = { id: number; addr: number; size: number; bytes: number; complete: boolean };
type DiffRange = { offset: number; length: number };

function bytesOf(text: string): Uint8Array {
  const clean = text.replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, "");
  const out = new Uint8Array(clean.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = Number.parseInt(clean.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
  return out;
}

/** The caret's bytes as every width the engine can read, little-endian. */
function interpret(bytes: Uint8Array): { label: string; text: string }[] {
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const has = (n: number) => bytes.byteLength >= n;
  const text = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes).split("\0")[0] ?? "";
  return [
    { label: "u8", text: has(1) ? String(view.getUint8(0)) : "—" },
    { label: "u16", text: has(2) ? String(view.getUint16(0, true)) : "—" },
    { label: "u32", text: has(4) ? String(view.getUint32(0, true)) : "—" },
    { label: "u64", text: has(8) ? String(view.getBigUint64(0, true)) : "—" },
    { label: "f32", text: has(4) ? view.getFloat32(0, true).toPrecision(6) : "—" },
    { label: "f64", text: has(8) ? view.getFloat64(0, true).toPrecision(10) : "—" },
    { label: "utf8", text: escapeControl(text) },
    {
      label: "pointer",
      text: has(8)
        ? `0x${view.getBigUint64(0, true).toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(16, "0")}`
        : "—",
    },
  ];
}

/** Side pane: interpreted caret value, plus the selected struct rendered there. */
function CaretInspector({ addr }: { addr: number }) {
  const t = useT();
  const structType = useTypes((s) => s.selected);
  const [bytes, setBytes] = useState<Uint8Array | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rendered, setRendered] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    setError(null);
    call<{ hex?: string }>("memory", "read", { addr, len: 16, format: "hex" })
      .then((r) => {
        if (alive) setBytes(bytesOf(r.hex ?? ""));
      })
      .catch((e: unknown) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        setBytes(null);
        setError(errorText(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [addr]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (structType === null) {
      setRendered(null);
      return;
    }
    let alive = true;
    call<{ rendered: string }>("types", "format_at", { addr, type: structType })
      .then((r) => {
        if (alive) setRendered(r.rendered);
      })
      .catch((e: unknown) => {
        if (alive) setRendered(`format_at ${structType}: ${errorText(e)}`);
      });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [addr, structType]);

  return (
    <div className="mem-inspect">
      <div className="view-bar" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        <span className="panel-title">{t("memory.caret")}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint mono">{hex(addr, 12)}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body mono mem-values">
        {error !== null && (
          <div className="error-text" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        {bytes !== null &&
          interpret(bytes).map((r) => (
            <div key={r.label} className="mem-value">
              <span className="faint">{r.label}</span>
              <span>{r.text}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        {rendered !== null && <pre className="mem-struct">{rendered}</pre>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Snapshot capture/compare pane; the diff it produces highlights the grid. */
function SnapshotPane({
  base,
  size,
  onDiff,
  onClose,
}: {
  base: number;
  size: number;
  onDiff: (diff: { base: number; ranges: DiffRange[] } | null) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const [snaps, setSnaps] = useState<SnapshotRec[]>([]);
  const [a, setA] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [b, setB] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [ranges, setRanges] = useState<DiffRange[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ snapshots: SnapshotRec[] }>("memory", "snapshots");
      const list = res.snapshots ?? [];
      setSnaps(list);
      setA((v) => v ?? list[0]?.id ?? null);
      setB((v) => v ?? list[1]?.id ?? null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const capture = async () => {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await call("memory", "snapshot", { addr: base, len: size });
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  };

  const compare = async () => {
    if (a === null || b === null) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await call<{ changed: DiffRange[] }>("memory", "diff", { a, b, limit: 512 });
      const snap = snaps.find((s) => s.id === a);
      setRanges(res.changed);
      onDiff(snap ? { base: snap.addr, ranges: res.changed } : null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="stack mem-snap">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <span className="panel-title">{t("memory.snapshotDiff")}</span>
        <select
          className="select"
          aria-label={t("memory.snapshotA")}
          value={a ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => setA(Number(e.target.value))}
        >
          <option value="">A…</option>
          {snaps.map((s) => (
            <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
              {`#${s.id} ${hex(s.addr, 12)} (${s.size})`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select
          className="select"
          aria-label={t("memory.snapshotB")}
          value={b ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => setB(Number(e.target.value))}
        >
          <option value="">B…</option>
          {snaps.map((s) => (
            <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
              {`#${s.id} ${hex(s.addr, 12)} (${s.size})`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={a === null || b === null || a === b}
          onClick={() => void compare()}
        >
          {t("memory.compare")}
        </button>
        <IconButton tip={t("memory.capture")} disabled={size === 0} onClick={() => void capture()}>
          <Camera size={13} />
        </IconButton>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {ranges !== null && (
          <span className="faint">{t("memory.changedRanges", { count: ranges.length })}</span>
        )}
        <IconButton tip={t("memory.closeSnapshot")} onClick={onClose}>
          <X size={13} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        {error !== null && (
          <div className="error-text" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        {snaps.length === 0 && <div className="faint">{t("memory.noSnapshots")}</div>}
        {ranges?.map((r) => (
          <div key={r.offset}>
            <span className="faint">+{r.offset.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(4, "0")}</span>{" "}
            <span>{t("memory.bytes", { count: r.length })}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function RegionList() {
  const t = useT();
  const regions = useMemory((s) => s.regions);
  const cursor = useMemory((s) => s.cursor);
  const loadRegions = useMemory((s) => s.loadRegions);
  const goto = useMemory((s) => s.goto);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  // PS4 targets can report thousands of mappings
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: regions.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  return (
    <div className="mem-regions">
      <div className="view-bar" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
        <span className="panel-title">{t("memory.regions")}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {regions.length}
        </span>
        <IconButton tip={t("memory.refreshRegions")} onClick={() => void loadRegions()}>
          <RefreshCw size={13} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
        <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
          {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
            const r = regions[v.index];
            return (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={r.base}
                className="fn-row"
                data-selected={cursor >= r.base && cursor < r.base + r.size}
                style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                onClick={() => goto(r.base)}
                data-tip={t("memory.regionTip", { size: r.size, protect: protectName(r.protect) })}
              >
                <span className="fn-name">{hex(r.base, 12)}</span>
                <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                  {protectName(r.protect)}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function MemoryView() {
  const t = useT();
  const regions = useMemory((s) => s.regions);
  const cursor = useMemory((s) => s.cursor);
  const windowBase = useMemory((s) => s.windowBase);
  const windowSize = useMemory((s) => s.windowSize);
  const pages = useMemory((s) => s.pages);
  const loading = useMemory((s) => s.loading);
  const error = useMemory((s) => s.error);
  const gotoText = useMemory((s) => s.gotoText);
  const gotoSeq = useMemory((s) => s.gotoSeq);
  const {
    loadRegions,
    goto,
    ensurePages,
    writeBytes,
    setGotoText,
    setScrollTop,
    reload,
    setCursor,
  } = useMemory.getState();
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [gotoError, setGotoError] = useState(false);
  const [dissectAt, setDissectAt] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [snapOpen, setSnapOpen] = useState(false);
  const [diff, setDiff] = useState<{ base: number; ranges: DiffRange[] } | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadRegions();
  }, [loadRegions]);

  // Land on the first readable region so the pane is never blank; a position
  // the user already had (tab switch, remount) is kept
  useEffect(() => {
    if (windowSize === 0 && regions.length > 0) goto(regions[0].base);
  }, [regions, windowSize, goto]);

  const rowCount = Math.ceil(windowSize / kCols);
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rowCount,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
    initialOffset: () => useMemory.getState().scrollTop,
    onChange: (v) => setScrollTop(v.scrollOffset ?? 0),
  });

  const items = virtualizer.getVirtualItems();
  const firstRow = items[0]?.index ?? 0;
  const lastRow = items[items.length - 1]?.index ?? 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (windowSize === 0) return;
    ensurePages(windowBase + firstRow * kCols, windowBase + (lastRow + 1) * kCols);
  }, [firstRow, lastRow, windowBase, windowSize, ensurePages]);

  // Bring the goto target into view on every new goto. A remount (tab switch)
  // sees the same sequence number and keeps the restored scroll offset instead
  const seenGoto = useRef(gotoSeq);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (gotoSeq === seenGoto.current) return;
    seenGoto.current = gotoSeq;
    if (cursor < windowBase || cursor >= windowBase + windowSize) return;
    virtualizer.scrollToIndex(Math.floor((cursor - windowBase) / kCols), { align: "start" });
    // keyed on the goto only; scrolling itself must not re-pin the cursor
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [gotoSeq]);

  const jump = () => {
    const parsed = parseAddress(gotoText);
    setGotoError(parsed === null);
    if (parsed !== null) goto(parsed);
  };

  const commitByte = async (addr: number, text: string) => {
    setEdit(null);
    const value = Number.parseInt(text, 16);
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{1,2}$/i.test(text.trim()) || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
    if (byteAt(pages, addr) === value) return;
    await writeBytes(addr, new Uint8Array([value]));
  };

  return (
    <div className="mem">
      <RegionList />

      <div className="stack">
        <div className="view-bar">
          <label className="view-label">
            {t("memory.goto")}
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              value={gotoText}
              placeholder="0x400000"
              aria-invalid={gotoError}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setGotoText(e.target.value);
                setGotoError(false);
              }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && jump()}
            />
          </label>
          <IconButton tip={t("memory.gotoTip")} variant="row" onClick={jump}>
            <ArrowRight size={11} />
          </IconButton>
          <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
            {windowSize > 0
              ? `${hex(windowBase, 12)}–${hex(windowBase + windowSize, 12)}`
              : t("memory.noRegion")}
            {loading ? t("memory.readingWindow") : ""}
          </span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <IconButton
            tip={t("memory.snapshotTip")}
            pressed={snapOpen}
            onClick={() => {
              setSnapOpen((v) => !v);
              if (snapOpen) setDiff(null);
            }}
          >
            <GitCompare size={13} />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            tip={t("memory.dissectTip")}
            disabled={windowSize === 0}
            onClick={() => setDissectAt(cursor)}
          >
            <Microscope size={13} />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton tip={t("memory.reread")} onClick={reload}>
            <RefreshCw size={13} />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            tip={t("memory.previous")}
            variant="row"
            disabled={windowBase === 0}
            onClick={() => goto(Math.max(0, windowBase - kWindowBytes / 2))}
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={11} /> {t("memory.prev")}
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            tip={t("memory.next")}
            variant="row"
            disabled={windowSize === 0}
            onClick={() => goto(windowBase + windowSize)}
          >
            {t("memory.nextShort")} <ChevronRight size={11} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>

        <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
          {error !== null && (
            <div
              className="empty-hint error-text"
              role="alert"
              style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}
            >
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {items.map((v) => {
              const rowAddr = windowBase + v.index * kCols;
              const cells = Array.from({ length: kCols }, (_, i) => byteAt(pages, rowAddr + i));
              // changed spans are snapshot-relative; mark the cells this row covers
              const changed = diff === null ? null : new Uint8Array(kCols);
              if (diff !== null && changed !== null)
                for (const r of diff.ranges) {
                  const start = Math.max(0, diff.base + r.offset - rowAddr);
                  const end = Math.min(kCols, diff.base + r.offset + r.length - rowAddr);
                  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) changed[i] = 1;
                }
              return (
                <div key={rowAddr} className="hex-row mono" style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}>
                  <span className="insn-va">{hex(rowAddr, 12)}</span>
                  <span className="hex-cells">
                    {cells.map((b, i) => {
                      const addr = rowAddr + i;
                      const text =
                        b === undefined ? "??" : b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase();
                      return edit === addr ? (
                        <input
                          key={i}
                          className="hex-edit mono"
                          aria-label={t("memory.byteAria", { addr: hex(addr, 12) })}
                          autoFocus
                          maxLength={2}
                          defaultValue={b === undefined ? "" : text}
                          onBlur={(e) => void commitByte(addr, e.target.value)}
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === "Enter") void commitByte(addr, e.currentTarget.value);
                            if (e.key === "Escape") setEdit(null);
                          }}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          key={i}
                          className="hex-cell"
                          data-zero={b === 0}
                          data-unread={b === undefined}
                          data-diff={changed?.[i] === 1}
                          disabled={b === undefined}
                          aria-label={
                            t("memory.cellAria", { addr: hex(addr, 12), text }) +
                            (changed?.[i] === 1 ? t("memory.changed") : "")
                          }
                          onClick={() => {
                            setCursor(addr);
                            setEdit(addr);
                          }}
                          data-tip={
                            b === undefined
                              ? undefined
                              : t("memory.cellTip", { addr: hex(addr, 12), value: b })
                          }
                        >
                          {text}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </span>
                  <span className="hex-ascii">{cells.map(ascii).join("")}</span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
        {snapOpen && (
          <SnapshotPane
            base={windowBase}
            size={windowSize}
            onDiff={setDiff}
            onClose={() => {
              setSnapOpen(false);
              setDiff(null);
            }}
          />
        )}
        {dissectAt !== null && <DissectPane addr={dissectAt} onClose={() => setDissectAt(null)} />}
      </div>

      <CaretInspector addr={cursor} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/Minimap.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/Minimap.tsx
// whole-function overview strip beside the listing: instruction density,
// branch targets and the current viewport. The bars are folded once per
// function and the viewport is one separate rect, so scrolling re-renders a
// single element instead of the strip.

import { memo, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import type { Insn } from "@/store/disasm";

/** Bars in the strip; a function of any size folds down to this many. */
export const kBuckets = 160;

export type MinimapBucket = { density: number; branch: boolean };

/**
 * Fold the listing into `kBuckets` equal slices. `density` is the number of
 * instructions in the slice, `branch` marks a slice holding a jump target.
 */
export function bucketize(insns: Insn[]): MinimapBucket[] {
  const out: MinimapBucket[] = [];
  const n = insns.length;
  if (n === 0) return out;
  const indexOf = new Map<number, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) indexOf.set(insns[i].va, i);
  for (let b = 0; b < kBuckets; b++) out.push({ density: 0, branch: false });
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const b = Math.min(kBuckets - 1, Math.floor((i * kBuckets) / n));
    out[b].density += 1;
    const target = insns[i].target;
    if (target !== undefined) {
      const at = indexOf.get(target);
      if (at !== undefined)
        out[Math.min(kBuckets - 1, Math.floor((at * kBuckets) / n))].branch = true;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

type Props = {
  insns: Insn[];
  /** First and last listing row currently on screen. */
  first: number;
  last: number;
  /** Scroll the listing so `index` is at the top. */
  onJump: (index: number) => void;
};

function Minimap({ insns, first, last, onJump }: Props) {
  const t = useT();
  const buckets = useMemo(() => bucketize(insns), [insns]);
  const dragging = useRef(false);
  const n = insns.length;
  if (n === 0) return null;
  const peak = buckets.reduce((m, b) => Math.max(m, b.density), 0) || 1;
  const unit = 1000 / kBuckets;

  const jump = (clientY: number, el: Element) => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.height <= 0) return;
    const frac = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (clientY - rect.top) / rect.height));
    onJump(Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(frac * n)));
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="minimap"
      role="scrollbar"
      aria-label={t("disasm.overview")}
      aria-orientation="vertical"
      aria-valuemin={1}
      aria-valuemax={n}
      aria-valuenow={first + 1}
      onPointerDown={(e) => {
        dragging.current = true;
        e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
        jump(e.clientY, e.currentTarget);
      }}
      onPointerMove={(e) => {
        if (dragging.current) jump(e.clientY, e.currentTarget);
      }}
      onPointerUp={(e) => {
        dragging.current = false;
        e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
      }}
      onPointerCancel={() => {
        dragging.current = false;
      }}
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 1000" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden>
        {buckets.map((b, i) =>
          b.density === 0 ? null : (
            <rect
              key={i}
              className="minimap-bar"
              x={0}
              y={i * unit}
              width={100}
              height={unit}
              opacity={0.15 + (0.85 * b.density) / peak}
            />
          ),
        )}
        {buckets.map((b, i) =>
          b.branch ? (
            <rect
              key={`b${i}`}
              className="minimap-branch"
              x={0}
              y={i * unit}
              width={100}
              height={unit}
            />
          ) : null,
        )}
        <rect
          className="minimap-view"
          x={0}
          y={(first / n) * 1000}
          width={100}
          height={Math.max(unit, ((last - first + 1) / n) * 1000)}
        />
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(Minimap);
```

`app/src/components/panels/ModulesPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/ModulesPanel.tsx
// Module list for the attached target, with the dump / dump+analyze workflow the
// ImGui Targets view carried (src/ui/view_targets.cpp, module table). On a PS4
// the module is pulled over the ps4debug wire and rebuilt as an ELF

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { Download, RefreshCw, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { save } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { hex, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useTargets } from "@/store/targets";

const kRow = 22;

/** `target.dump_module` / `target.ps4_dump_module` result. */
type DumpResult = {
  dumped?: boolean;
  complete?: boolean;
  path?: string;
  bytes_written?: number;
  sections?: number;
  loaded?: boolean;
  warnings?: string[];
};

function dumpFileName(name: string, base: number, ps4: boolean): string {
  if (ps4) return name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".elf") ? name : `${name}.elf`;
  return `${name}_${hex(base, 12)}.dump.${name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".dll") ? "dll" : "exe"}`;
}

export default function ModulesPanel() {
  const t = useT();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const ps4 = useEngine((s) => s.backend.ps4);
  // The engine store refreshes this list on every target.changed
  const modules = useTargets((s) => s.modules);
  const refreshModules = useTargets((s) => s.refreshModules);
  const refreshLoaded = useDisasm((s) => s.refreshLoaded);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const rows = modules.filter((m) => m.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()));

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  // dump_module reconstructs a loadable image from the mapped one; load=true
  // hands it straight to the shared analysis session, which is the fast path
  // from "attached to a packed process" to "looking at real code"
  const dump = async (base: number, name: string) => {
    let path: string | null;
    if (isTauri()) {
      path = await save({
        title: t("modules.dumpTitle", { name }),
        defaultPath: dumpFileName(name, base, ps4),
      });
    } else {
      // Browser dev mode has no native dialog
      path = window.prompt(t("modules.dumpPrompt", { name }), dumpFileName(name, base, ps4));
    }
    if (path === null || path.trim() === "") {
      setStatus(null);
      return;
    }
    setStatus(t("modules.dumping", { name }));
    try {
      // strict=false so a packed image with unreadable spans still produces a
      // file; the engine zero-fills those and reports complete=false
      const res = ps4
        ? await call<DumpResult>(
            "target",
            "ps4_dump_module",
            { name, path, load: true },
            { timeoutMs: 600_000 },
          )
        : await call<DumpResult>(
            "target",
            "dump_module",
            { base, path, load: true, strict: false },
            { timeoutMs: 600_000 },
          );
      const size =
        res.bytes_written !== undefined
          ? t("modules.size", { kib: Math.round(res.bytes_written / 1024) })
          : "";
      const partial = res.complete === false ? t("modules.partial") : "";
      const warn =
        res.warnings !== undefined && res.warnings.length > 0
          ? t("modules.warnings", { count: res.warnings.length, first: res.warnings[0] })
          : "";
      const sections =
        res.sections !== undefined ? t("modules.sections", { count: res.sections }) : "";
      setStatus(t("modules.dumped", { name, size, sections, partial, warn }));
      await refreshLoaded();
    } catch (e) {
      setStatus(errorText(e));
    }
  };

  if (!target.attached) {
    return (
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="panel-head">
          <span className="panel-title">{t("modules.title")}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="empty">
          <div className="empty-hint">{t("modules.empty")}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">{t("modules.title")}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {modules.length}
        </span>
        <IconButton tip={t("modules.refresh")} onClick={() => void refreshModules()}>
          <RefreshCw size={14} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>

      <div className="modules-body">
        <div className="search">
          <Search size={13} aria-hidden />
          <input
            value={filter}
            aria-label={t("modules.filter")}
            placeholder={t("modules.filterPlaceholder")}
            onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const m = rows[v.index];
              return (
                <div
                  key={`${m.base}-${m.name}`}
                  className="fn-row"
                  style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                  data-tip={m.path ?? m.name}
                >
                  <span className="fn-name">{m.name}</span>
                  <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                    {hex(m.base, 12)}
                  </span>
                  <IconButton
                    tip={t("modules.dump", { name: m.name })}
                    onClick={() => void dump(m.base, m.name)}
                  >
                    <Download size={11} />
                  </IconButton>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {status !== null && (
          <div
            className="empty-hint"
            role="status"
            style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm) var(--pad-md)" }}
          >
            {status}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/NetworkPanel.tsx
// Packet capture (tool: network) and the HTTP proxy (tool: proxy): start and
// stop with a filter, a live packet table, DNS/streams/deep-inspect views,
// PCAP export/import and the proxy log with replay. Engine errors are shown
// verbatim: an Administrator/Npcap failure must not look like an empty table

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { open as openDialog, save as saveDialog } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import {
  useNetwork,
  type InspectRow,
  type PacketRow,
  type ProxyEntryDetail,
} from "@/store/network";

const kRow = 19;
const kPacketLimit = 2000;

async function pickSavePath(title: string, defaultPath: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (isTauri()) return saveDialog({ title, defaultPath });
  return window.prompt(title, defaultPath);
}

async function pickOpenPath(title: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (isTauri()) {
    const picked = await openDialog({ title, multiple: false });
    return typeof picked === "string" ? picked : null;
  }
  return window.prompt(title, "capture.pcap");
}

/** One deep-inspect row's application label, QUIC included. */
function appLabel(row: InspectRow): string {
  switch (row.app_protocol) {
    case "QUIC":
      return `QUIC ${row.quic_version ?? ""} ${row.quic_type ?? ""}`.trim();
    case "TLS":
      return `TLS ${row.tls_version ?? ""} ${row.tls_sni ?? ""}`.trim();
    case "HTTP":
      return row.http_method !== undefined
        ? `${row.http_method} ${row.http_host ?? ""}${row.http_path ?? ""}`
        : `HTTP ${row.http_status ?? ""}`.trim();
    case "DNS":
      return `DNS ${row.dns_domain ?? ""} ${row.dns_resolved ?? ""}`.trim();
    default:
      return "-";
  }
}

function PacketTable({ rows }: { rows: PacketRow[] }) {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<PacketRow | null>(null);
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  return (
    <div className="tool-table-wrap">
      <div className="tool-table-scroll" ref={scrollRef}>
        <table className="table">
          <caption className="sr-only">Captured packets</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col" style={{ width: 52 }}>
                #
              </th>
              <th scope="col" style={{ width: 66 }}>
                Time
              </th>
              <th scope="col" style={{ width: 44 }}>
                Proto
              </th>
              <th scope="col" style={{ width: 52 }}>
                Dir
              </th>
              <th scope="col">Local</th>
              <th scope="col">Remote</th>
              <th scope="col" style={{ width: 56 }}>
                Bytes
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const p = rows[v.index];
              return (
                <tr
                  key={p.id}
                  data-selected={selected?.id === p.id}
                  style={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    top: v.start,
                    left: 0,
                    width: "100%",
                    height: kRow,
                    display: "table",
                    tableLayout: "fixed",
                  }}
                  data-tip={p.payload_hex ?? undefined}
                  onClick={() => setSelected(p)}
                >
                  <td className="mono faint">{p.id}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">{(p.at_ms % 100000) / 1000}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className="pill">{p.protocol_str}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="faint">{p.direction_str === "inbound" ? "in" : "out"}</td>
                  <td className="mono">{p.local}</td>
                  <td className="mono">{p.remote}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">{p.wire_bytes}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {selected !== null && (
        <div className="tool-summary mono" data-testid="packet-detail">
          #{selected.id} {selected.protocol_str} {selected.local} → {selected.remote} ·{" "}
          {selected.payload_bytes} payload bytes
          {selected.payload_hex !== undefined ? ` · ${selected.payload_hex}` : ""}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function NetworkPanel() {
  const {
    status,
    packets,
    stats,
    dns,
    streams,
    inspect,
    proxy,
    entries,
    error,
    busy,
    refreshStatus,
    start,
    stop,
    refreshPackets,
    refreshStats,
    refreshDns,
    refreshStreams,
    refreshInspect,
    exportPcap,
    importPcap,
    refreshProxy,
    startProxy,
    stopProxy,
    refreshEntries,
    entry,
    replay,
  } = useNetwork();

  const [host, setHost] = useState("");
  const [port, setPort] = useState("");
  const [protocol, setProtocol] = useState("0");
  const [format, setFormat] = useState("pcap");
  const [maxPackets, setMaxPackets] = useState("4096");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [secondary, setSecondary] = useState<"dns" | "streams" | "inspect">("dns");
  const [proxyPort, setProxyPort] = useState("8080");
  const [proxyBind, setProxyBind] = useState("127.0.0.1");
  const [allowHosts, setAllowHosts] = useState("");
  const [replayText, setReplayText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<ProxyEntryDetail | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshStatus();
    void refreshProxy();
  }, [refreshStatus, refreshProxy]);

  // Poll only while a capture runs: an idle panel must not spin the engine
  const running = status?.capture_running === true;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return;
    void refreshPackets();
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      void refreshPackets();
      void refreshStats();
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [running, refreshPackets, refreshStats]);

  const doExport = async () => {
    const path = await pickSavePath("Export capture", `capture.${format}`);
    if (path === null) return;
    const n = Number.parseInt(maxPackets, 10);
    const msg = await exportPcap(path, format, Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 4096);
    setNotice(msg);
  };

  const doImport = async () => {
    const path = await pickOpenPath("Import capture");
    if (path === null) return;
    setNotice(await importPcap(path));
  };

  const shown = packets.slice(-kPacketLimit);

  return (
    <div className="panel tool-panel">

          {status?.store_packets ?? 0} stored
        </span>

          Refresh

      </div>
      <div className="panel-body tool-body">

            style={{ width: 120 }}

            placeholder="host (e.g. PS4 IP)"
            value={host}
            onChange={(e) => setHost(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 64 }}
            aria-label="Capture port filter"
            placeholder="port"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={port}
            onChange={(e) => setPort(e.target.value)}
          />
          <select
            className="select"
            aria-label="Capture protocol"
            value={protocol}
            onChange={(e) => setProtocol(e.target.value)}
          >

            <option value="6">tcp</option>
            <option value="17">udp</option>
          </select>

            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null}
            onClick={() => {
              const p = Number.parseInt(port, 10);
              void start({
                host: host.trim(),
                port: Number.isFinite(p) ? p : 0,
                protocol: Number.parseInt(protocol, 10),
              });
            }}
          >
            Start capture
          </button>

              else void refreshInspect();

                <th scope="col">TTL</th>

                <th scope="col">Client</th>
                <th scope="col">Server</th>
                <th scope="col">Bytes</th>
                <th scope="col">Packets</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {streams.map((s) => (

                  <td className="mono faint">{s.id}</td>

                  <td className="mono">{s.server}</td>

                <th scope="col">Payload</th>

              {proxy.running && (

                </span>
              )}
              {proxy.mitm && <span className="pill sev-warn">MITM</span>}
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="tool-form">
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 110 }}
            aria-label="Proxy bind"
            value={proxyBind}
            onChange={(e) => setProxyBind(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 64 }}
            aria-label="Proxy port"
            inputMode="numeric"
            value={proxyPort}
            onChange={(e) => setProxyPort(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}
            aria-label="Proxy destination allowlist"
            placeholder="allow hosts, comma separated"
            value={allowHosts}
            onChange={(e) => setAllowHosts(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null}
            onClick={() => {
              const p = Number.parseInt(proxyPort, 10);
              void startProxy({
                port: Number.isFinite(p) ? p : 8080,
                bind: proxyBind.trim() === "" ? "127.0.0.1" : proxyBind.trim(),
                allow_hosts: allowHosts
                  .split(",")
                  .map((s) => s.trim())
                  .filter((s) => s !== ""),
                allow_clients: [],
              });
            }}
          >
            Start proxy
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null || proxy?.running !== true}
            onClick={() => void stopProxy()}
          >
            Stop
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void refreshEntries()}>
            Load log
          </button>
        </div>

        {proxy !== null && (
          <div className="tool-summary faint">
            {proxy.active_connections ?? 0} active · {proxy.total_connections ?? 0} total · rejected{" "}
            {(proxy.rejected?.auth ?? 0) +
              (proxy.rejected?.host ?? 0) +
              (proxy.rejected?.client ?? 0) +
              (proxy.rejected?.capacity ?? 0)}{" "}
            · {proxy.log_entries ?? 0} log entries
          </div>
        )}

        <table className="table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">#</th>
              <th scope="col">Method</th>
              <th scope="col">Host</th>
              <th scope="col">Path</th>
              <th scope="col">Status</th>
              <th scope="col">Flags</th>
              <th scope="col">Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {entries.map((e) => (
              <tr key={e.id}>
                <td className="mono faint">{e.id}</td>
                <td>{e.method}</td>
                <td className="mono">
                  {e.host}:{e.port}
                </td>
                <td className="mono">{e.path}</td>
                <td className="mono faint">{e.status}</td>
                <td>
                  {e.redacted && <span className="pill sev-warn">redacted</span>}
                  {e.intercepted === true && <span className="pill">MITM</span>}
                  {e.error !== undefined && <span className="pill sev-bad">{e.error}</span>}
                </td>
                <td>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="row-action"
                    onClick={() => void entry(e.id).then(setDetail)}
                  >
                    Detail
                  </button>{" "}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="row-action"
                    disabled={!e.replayable || busy !== null}
                    onClick={() => {
                      void replay(e.id).then(setReplayText);
                    }}
                  >
                    Replay
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        {entries.length === 0 && (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            No proxy entries. Start the proxy and point a client at it.
          </div>
        )}

        {detail !== null && (
          <div className="tool-summary" data-testid="proxy-entry">
            <div className="mono faint">
              #{detail.id} {detail.method} {detail.host}:{detail.port}
              {detail.path}
              {detail.redacted ? " · redacted" : ""}
              {detail.request_truncated === true ? " · request truncated" : ""}
            </div>
            {detail.request_text !== undefined && (
              <pre className="tool-pre">{detail.request_text}</pre>
            )}
            {detail.response_head_text !== undefined && (
              <pre className="tool-pre">{detail.response_head_text}</pre>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {replayText !== null && (
          <pre className="tool-pre" data-testid="replay-text">
            {replayText}
          </pre>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/OutputPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/OutputPanel.tsx
// output and log tabs, the app ring and the tagged diag ring side by side

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { ChevronDown, Eraser, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import Tabs, { panelId, tabId } from "@/components/Tabs";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { useOutput } from "@/store/output";
import { useUi, type OutputTab } from "@/store/ui";

type DiagEntry = { ms: number; level: string; tag: string; message: string };

const timeFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
  hour: "2-digit",
  minute: "2-digit",
  second: "2-digit",
  hour12: false,
});
const clock = (ms: number) => timeFormat.format(ms);

export default function OutputPanel() {
  const t = useT();
  const tab = useUi((s) => s.outputTab);
  const setTab = useUi((s) => s.setOutputTab);
  const [diag, setDiag] = useState<DiagEntry[]>([]);
  const [follow, setFollow] = useState(true);
  const lines = useOutput((s) => s.lines);
  const clear = useOutput((s) => s.clear);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const count = tab === "output" ? lines.length : diag.length;
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count,
    getScrollElement: () => bodyRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => 20,
    overscan: 12,
    initialRect: { width: 800, height: 300 },
    getItemKey: (index) => (tab === "output" ? `output-${lines[index].seq}` : `diag-${index}`),
  });
  const totalSize = virtualizer.getTotalSize();

  // While following, a re-measured row must not nudge the scroll position; the
  // pin below owns it. Configured in an effect: render must stay side-effect free
  useEffect(() => {
    virtualizer.shouldAdjustScrollPositionOnItemSizeChange = follow ? () => false : undefined;
  }, [virtualizer, follow]);

  // diag has no push channel: it is a high-volume ring that would swamp the
  // event stream, so the Log tab polls it while it is the visible tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== "log") return;
    let alive = true;
    let revision = 0;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const pull = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await call<{ entries: DiagEntry[]; revision: number }>("app", "diag", {
          limit: 1000,
          since_revision: revision,
        });
        if (alive) {
          const reset = res.revision < revision;
          const replace = revision === 0 || reset;
          if (res.entries.length || reset)
            setDiag((previous) =>
              (replace ? res.entries : [...previous, ...res.entries]).slice(-1000),
            );
          revision = reset ? 0 : res.revision;
        }
      } catch {
        /* engine down: keep the last snapshot */
      } finally {
        if (alive) timer = setTimeout(() => void pull(), 1000);
      }
    };
    void pull();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [tab]);

  // Follow mode: one observer per pane watching the content's height; it fires
  // when lines arrive (total size grows), so nothing re-subscribes per line
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = bodyRef.current;
    const content = el?.firstElementChild;
    if (!follow || !el || !content) return;
    const pin = () => {
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    };
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(pin);
    observer.observe(content);
    pin();
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [follow, tab]);

  return (
    <div className="panel output-panel">
      <div className="tabs">
        <Tabs<OutputTab>
          items={[
            { id: "output", label: t("output.output") },
            { id: "log", label: t("output.log") },
          ]}
          active={tab}
          onChange={setTab}
          label={t("output.panes")}
          idPrefix="output"
        />
        <div className="spacer" />
        <div className="tab-actions">
          <IconButton
            tip={tab === "output" ? t("output.clear") : t("output.clearLog")}
            onClick={() => void (tab === "output" ? clear() : setDiag([]))}
          >
            <Trash2 size={14} />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton tip={t("output.clearRing")} onClick={() => void clear()}>
            <Eraser size={14} />
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton
            tip={follow ? t("output.following") : t("output.locked")}
            pressed={follow}
            style={{ color: follow ? "var(--accent)" : undefined }}
            onClick={() => setFollow((v) => !v)}
          >
            <ChevronDown size={14} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Keyed so switching Output <-> Log replays the enter animation and
          resets the scroll position to the new pane's tail. */}
      <div
        className="panel-body log swap-fade"
        key={tab}
        ref={bodyRef}
        role="tabpanel"
        id={panelId("output", tab)}
        aria-labelledby={tabId("output", tab)}
        aria-live="off"
      >
        <div style={{ height: totalSize, position: "relative", width: "100%" }}>
          {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((row) => {
            const l = lines[row.index];
            const e = diag[row.index];
            return (
              <div
                key={row.key}
                data-index={row.index}
                ref={virtualizer.measureElement}
                style={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  top: 0,
                  left: 0,
                  width: "100%",
                  transform: `translateY(${row.start}px)`,
                }}
              >
                {tab === "output" ? (
                  <div className="log-row">
                    <span className="log-time">{clock(l.ms)}</span>
                    <span>{l.text}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="log-row">
                    <span className="log-time">{clock(e.ms)}</span>
                    <span className="log-level" data-level={e.level}>
                      {e.level}
                    </span>
                    <span className="log-tag">{e.tag}</span>
                    <span>{e.message}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/PatchPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/PatchPanel.tsx
// Image patch journal and the heuristic passes (tool: patch). Every mutating
// action is a button with a confirm step, and the journal delta is shown
// after each run

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";

type JournalEntry = { va: number; before: number; after: number };
type JournalReply = { patches?: JournalEntry[]; total?: number; indexes_dirty?: boolean };
type PatchHit = { va: number; action: string; detail?: string };
type Step = { step: string; success: boolean; note: string };
type OpReply = {
  ok?: boolean;
  dry_run?: boolean;
  patches?: PatchHit[];
  bytes_changed?: number;
  journal_total?: number;
  detected_key?: number;
  key_confidence?: number;
  strings_found?: number;
  note?: string;
  steps?: Step[];
  pre_obfuscation_score?: number;
  post_obfuscation_score?: number;
  score_reduction?: number;
};

type Pending = { label: string; action: string; params: Record<string, unknown> };

const kPasses: readonly { action: string; label: string }[] = [
  { action: "nop_junk", label: "Nop junk" },
  { action: "resolve_opaque", label: "Resolve opaque" },
  { action: "patch_antidebug", label: "Patch anti-debug" },
  { action: "unpack_xor", label: "Unpack XOR" },
  { action: "decode_strings", label: "Decode strings" },
  { action: "full_pass", label: "Full pass" },
];

const kXorMethods = ["auto", "xor_single", "xor_multi", "xor_rolling"] as const;

export default function PatchPanel() {
  const selected = useDisasm((s) => s.selected);
  const [journal, setJournal] = useState<JournalEntry[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [addrText, setAddrText] = useState("");
  const [hexText, setHexText] = useState("");
  const [size, setSize] = useState("4096");
  const [keyHex, setKeyHex] = useState("");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<string>(kXorMethods[0]);
  const [dryRun, setDryRun] = useState(false);
  const [aggressive, setAggressive] = useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<Pending | null>(null);
  const [last, setLast] = useState<OpReply | null>(null);
  const [delta, setDelta] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refreshJournal = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<JournalReply>("patch", "journal", { limit: 100 });
      setJournal(res.patches ?? []);
      setTotal(res.total ?? 0);
      setDirty(res.indexes_dirty === true);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshJournal();
  }, [refreshJournal]);

  const addr = parseAddress(addrText) ?? selected ?? undefined;

  const runOp = async (action: string, params: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    const before = total;
    try {
      const res = await call<OpReply>("patch", action, params);
      setLast(res);
      setDelta((res.journal_total ?? before) - before);
      await refreshJournal();
    } catch (e) {
      setLast(null);
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const ask = (label: string, action: string, params: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    setPending({ label, action, params });

  const passParams = (action: string): Record<string, unknown> => {
    const params: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (addr !== undefined) params.addr = addr;
    if (action === "nop_junk") {
      params.aggressive = aggressive;
    }
    if (action === "resolve_opaque" || action === "patch_antidebug" || action === "full_pass") {
      params.dry_run = dryRun;
    }
    if (action === "unpack_xor") {
      const sizeValue = Number.parseInt(size, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(sizeValue) && sizeValue > 0) params.size = sizeValue;
      params.method = method;
      if (keyHex.trim() !== "") params.key_hex = keyHex.trim();
    }
    return params;
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel tool-panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">Patch journal</span>
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
          {total} {total === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"}
        </span>
        {dirty && (
          <span className="pill sev-warn" data-tip="Indexes are stale until rebuilt">
            indexes dirty
          </span>
        )}
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void refreshJournal()}>
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body tool-body">
        <div className="tool-form">
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 110 }}
            aria-label="Function address (hex)"
            placeholder={selected === null ? "function VA" : hex(selected, 1)}
            value={addrText}
            onChange={(e) => setAddrText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            size
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              style={{ width: 72 }}
              aria-label="XOR size"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={size}
              onChange={(e) => setSize(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label="Dry run"
              checked={dryRun}
              onChange={(e) => setDryRun(e.target.checked)}
            />
            dry run
          </label>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label="Aggressive nop"
              checked={aggressive}
              onChange={(e) => setAggressive(e.target.checked)}
            />
            aggressive
          </label>
          <select
            className="select"
            aria-label="XOR method"
            value={method}
            onChange={(e) => setMethod(e.target.value)}
          >
            {kXorMethods.map((m) => (
              <option key={m} value={m}>
                {m}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 120 }}
            aria-label="XOR key (hex)"
            placeholder="key hex"
            value={keyHex}
            onChange={(e) => setKeyHex(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="tool-grid" role="group" aria-label="Patch passes">
          {kPasses.map((p) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={p.action}
              className="row-action"
              disabled={busy || (addr === undefined && p.action !== "patch_antidebug")}
              onClick={() => ask(p.label, p.action, passParams(p.action))}
            >
              {p.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <form
          className="tool-form"
          aria-label="Write bytes"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (addr === undefined || hexText.trim() === "") return;
            ask("Write bytes", "write_bytes", { addr, hex: hexText.trim() });
          }}
        >
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 110 }}
            aria-label="Write address (hex)"
            placeholder="address"
            value={addrText}
            onChange={(e) => setAddrText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 140 }}
            aria-label="Bytes to write (hex)"
            placeholder="hex bytes, e.g. 90 90 C3"
            value={hexText}
            onChange={(e) => setHexText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy || addr === undefined || hexText.trim() === ""}
          >
            Write bytes…
          </button>
        </form>

        {pending !== null && (
          <div className="confirm-bar" role="alertdialog" aria-label="Confirm patch">
            <span>
              Apply {pending.label}? This edits the loaded image session
              {pending.action === "write_bytes" ? ` at ${hex(addr ?? 0, 1)}` : ""}.
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              onClick={() => {
                const p = pending;
                setPending(null);
                void runOp(p.action, p.params);
              }}
            >
              Confirm {pending.label}
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => setPending(null)}>
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="tool-form">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy || total === 0}
            onClick={() => ask("Revert all", "revert_all", {})}
          >
            Revert all…
          </button>
          {busy && <span className="faint">Working…</span>}
        </div>

        {error !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {last !== null && (
          <div className="tool-summary">
            <span className="faint">
              {last.dry_run === true ? "preview" : "applied"} · {last.bytes_changed ?? 0} bytes ·{" "}
              {delta >= 0 ? `+${delta}` : delta} journal
              {last.detected_key !== undefined
                ? ` · key ${hex(last.detected_key, 2)} (${last.key_confidence ?? 0}%)`
                : ""}
              {last.strings_found !== undefined ? ` · ${last.strings_found} strings` : ""}
              {last.score_reduction !== undefined
                ? ` · score ${last.pre_obfuscation_score ?? "?"} → ${
                    last.post_obfuscation_score ?? "?"
                  }`
                : ""}
            </span>
            {last.note !== undefined && <div className="faint">{last.note}</div>}
            {last.steps !== undefined && (
              <ul className="tool-steps">
                {last.steps.map((s) => (
                  <li key={s.step} data-ok={s.success}>
                    {s.step}: {s.success ? "ok" : "skipped"} {s.note}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            {last.patches !== undefined && last.patches.length > 0 && (
              <ul className="tool-steps">
                {last.patches.map((p, i) => (
                  <li key={`${p.va}-${i}`} className="mono">
                    {hex(p.va, 1)} {p.action} {p.detail ?? ""}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <table className="table">
          <caption className="sr-only">Patch journal</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Address</th>
              <th scope="col">Before</th>
              <th scope="col">After</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {journal.map((p, i) => (
              <tr key={`${p.va}-${i}`}>
                <td className="mono">{hex(p.va, 1)}</td>
                <td className="mono">{hex(p.before, 2)}</td>
                <td className="mono">{hex(p.after, 2)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        {journal.length === 0 && (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            No patches recorded.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/PeView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/PeView.tsx
// Image browser: ELF/SELF/PE/Mach-O sections, imports and exports. Port of
// src/ui/view_pe.cpp

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Tabs, { panelId, tabId } from "@/components/Tabs";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { formatLabel } from "@/lib/format";
import { showInDisassembly } from "@/lib/navigate";
import { hex, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { usePe } from "@/store/pe";

type Sub = "sections" | "imports" | "exports";

export default function PeView() {
  const t = useT();
  const { pe, loading, error, load } = usePe();
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);
  const [sub, setSub] = useState<Sub>("sections");

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load, image.name, image.path]);

  const base = pe.image_base ?? image.base ?? 0;
  const format = image.format ?? pe.format;
  const arch = image.arch ?? pe.arch;
  const isPe = format === "pe" || (format === undefined && pe.pe32plus !== undefined);
  const isElf = format === "elf" || format === "self";
  const importGroup = isElf ? "library" : isPe ? "DLL" : "dylib";

  const counts: Record<Sub, number> = {
    sections: pe.sections.length,
    imports: pe.imports.length,
    exports: pe.exports.length,
  };

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <Tabs<Sub>
          items={(["sections", "imports", "exports"] as const).map((s) => ({
            id: s,
            label: (
              <>
                {t(`pe.${s}`)}
                <span className="faint">{counts[s]}</span>
              </>
            ),
          }))}
          active={sub}
          onChange={setSub}
          label={t("pe.metadata")}
          idPrefix="image"
        />
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
          {t("pe.meta", {
            format: formatLabel(format, isPe ? pe.pe32plus : undefined),
            arch: arch !== undefined ? t("pe.metaArch", { arch }) : "",
            base: hex(base),
            entry: hex(image.entry_va ?? base + (pe.entry_rva ?? 0)),
          })}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div
        className="panel-body swap-fade"
        key={sub}
        role="tabpanel"
        id={panelId("image", sub)}
        aria-labelledby={tabId("image", sub)}
      >
        {error !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        {loading && (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            {t("pe.reading")}
          </div>
        )}

        {sub === "sections" && (
          <table className="table">
            <caption className="sr-only">
              {t("pe.sectionsCaption", { format: formatLabel(format) })}
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" style={{ width: 90 }}>
                  {t("pe.name")}
                </th>
                <th scope="col" style={{ width: 130 }}>
                  {t("pe.va")}
                </th>
                <th scope="col" style={{ width: 90 }}>
                  {t("pe.rva")}
                </th>
                <th scope="col" style={{ width: 90 }}>
                  {t("pe.virtual")}
                </th>
                <th scope="col" style={{ width: 90 }}>
                  {t("pe.raw")}
                </th>
                <th scope="col">{t("pe.flags")}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {pe.sections.map((s) => (
                <tr key={`${s.name}-${s.rva}`}>
                  <th scope="row" className="mono table-rowhead">
                    {s.name}
                  </th>
                  <td>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="mono link"
                      onClick={() => showInDisassembly(base + s.rva)}
                    >
                      {hex(base + s.rva)}
                    </button>
                  </td>
                  <td className="mono faint">0x{s.rva.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">0x{s.vsize.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</td>
                  <td className="mono faint">0x{s.raw_size.toString(16).toUpperCase()}</td>
                  <td>
                    {s.exec && <span className="pill">{t("pe.exec")}</span>}{" "}
                    {s.writable && <span className="pill">{t("pe.write")}</span>}{" "}
                    {(isPe || isElf) && s.characteristics !== 0 && (
                      <span className="faint mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
                        0x{s.characteristics.toString(16).toUpperCase()}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}

        {sub === "imports" && (
          <div>
            {pe.imports.map((d) => (
              <details key={d.dll} className="tree">
                <summary>
                  <span className="mono">
                    {d.dll === "" ? (isPe ? t("pe.unnamed") : t("pe.dynamic")) : d.dll}
                  </span>
                  <span className="faint">{d.functions.length}</span>
                </summary>
                <ul
                  className="plain-list"
                  aria-label={t("pe.importsFrom", { group: d.dll || importGroup })}
                >
                  {d.functions.map((fn, i) => (
                    <li className="tree-leaf mono" key={`${d.dll}-${i}`}>
                      {fn}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </details>
            ))}
            {pe.imports.length === 0 && !loading && (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                {t("pe.noImports")}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {sub === "exports" && (
          <table className="table">
            <caption className="sr-only">
              {t("pe.exportsCaption", { format: formatLabel(format) })}
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                {isPe && (
                  <th scope="col" style={{ width: 70 }}>
                    {t("pe.ordinal")}
                  </th>
                )}
                <th scope="col" style={{ width: 130 }}>
                  {t("pe.va")}
                </th>
                <th scope="col">{t("pe.name")}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {pe.exports.map((e, i) => (
                <tr key={`${e.name}-${i}`}>
                  {isPe && <td className="mono faint">{e.ordinal}</td>}
                  <td>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="mono link"
                      onClick={() => showInDisassembly(base + e.rva)}
                    >
                      {hex(base + e.rva)}
                    </button>
                  </td>
                  <td className="mono">{e.name}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/ScannerPanel.tsx
// scanner config, results and watchlist, a scan started here is the scan an
// agent sees over mcp

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
```
