```tsx
const kRow = 19;
/** Widths a watch can hold ("all" is a scan-only mode). */
const kWatchWidths = kWidths.filter((w) => w !== "all");

/** Native save dialog in the app, a prompt in browser dev mode. */
async function pickSavePath(title: string, defaultPath: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (isTauri()) return saveDialog({ title, defaultPath });
  return window.prompt(title, defaultPath);
}

/** Native open dialog in the app, a prompt in browser dev mode. */
async function pickOpenPath(title: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (isTauri()) {
    const picked = await openDialog({ title, multiple: false });
    return typeof picked === "string" ? picked : null;
  }
  return window.prompt(title, "table.CT");
}

/** Inline add-watch row: validated address, width and optional label. */
function AddWatchRow({ onDone, defaultWidth }: { onDone: () => void; defaultWidth: string }) {
  const t = useT();
  const add = useWatch((s) => s.add);
  const [addr, setAddr] = useState("");
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(
    kWatchWidths.includes(defaultWidth as never) ? defaultWidth : "u32",
  );
  const [label, setLabel] = useState("");
  const [intervalMs, setIntervalMs] = useState("100");
  const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState(false);

  const submit = async () => {
    const parsed = parseAddress(addr);
    if (parsed === null) {
      setInvalid(true);
      return;
    }
    const rate = Number.parseInt(intervalMs, 10);
    if (await add(parsed, width, label.trim() || undefined, Number.isFinite(rate) ? rate : 100))
      onDone();
  };

  return (
    <form
      className="watch-add"
      aria-label={t("scanner.addWatch")}
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        void submit();
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Escape" && onDone()}
    >
      <input
        className="addr-input mono"
        style={{ width: 110 }}
        autoFocus
        aria-label={t("scanner.watchAddress")}
        aria-invalid={invalid}
        placeholder={t("scanner.addressPlaceholder")}
        value={addr}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setAddr(e.target.value);
          setInvalid(false);
        }}
      />
      <select
        className="select"
        aria-label={t("scanner.watchWidth")}
        value={width}
        onChange={(e) => setWidth(e.target.value)}
      >
        {kWatchWidths.map((w) => (
          <option key={w} value={w}>
            {w}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      <input
        className="addr-input"
        style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 60 }}
        aria-label={t("scanner.watchLabel")}
        placeholder={t("scanner.labelPlaceholder")}
        value={label}
        onChange={(e) => setLabel(e.target.value)}
      />
      <input
        className="addr-input mono"
        style={{ width: 52 }}
        aria-label={t("scanner.watchInterval")}
        title={t("scanner.watchIntervalTip")}
        inputMode="numeric"
        value={intervalMs}
        onChange={(e) => setIntervalMs(e.target.value)}
      />
      <button type="submit" className="row-action" disabled={addr.trim() === ""}>
        {t("common.add")}
      </button>
      <IconButton tip={t("common.cancel")} onClick={onDone}>
        <X size={12} />
      </IconButton>
    </form>
  );
}

export default function ScannerPanel() {

                            style={{ width: 70 }}
                            aria-label={t("scanner.newValue", {
                              label: e.label || hex(e.addr, 12),
                            })}
                            autoFocus
                            defaultValue={v?.text ?? ""}
                            onBlur={() => setEditing(null)}
                            onKeyDown={(e2) => {

                                void poke(e.id, e2.currentTarget.value);
                                setEditing(null);
                              }
                              if (e2.key === "Escape") setEditing(null);

                          />
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            {v?.ok === true ? v.text : "-"}
                            {e.freeze && <span className="faint"> *</span>}
                          </>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 26 }}>
                        <IconButton
                          tip={e.freeze ? t("scanner.unfreeze") : t("scanner.freeze")}
                          pressed={e.freeze}
                          style={{ color: e.freeze ? "var(--accent)" : undefined }}

                          tip={t("scanner.removeWatch")}
                          onClick={() => void remove(e.id)}
                        >
                          <X size={11} />
                        </IconButton>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/ScriptsPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/ScriptsPanel.tsx
// Lua scratchpad over the `script.run` tool, the engine's embedded interpreter
// with the core bindings. Snippets live in the engine (<app_data>\scripts), so
// the same names show up for the MCP script tool; completion comes from
// script.api, which the engine generates from its registration tables.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Play, Save, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

const kScriptTimeoutMs = 10_000;

export const kSampleScript = `-- engine Lua: the bindings the script tool exposes
local st = slop.target.status()
print("backend:", st.backend)
print("attached:", st.attached, st.name or "", st.pid or 0)
-- on a PS4 the running game is eboot.bin; SceShellUI / SceShellCore are system
for _, p in ipairs(slop.target.list()) do
  if p.name:find("eboot") or p.name:find("SceShell") then print(p.pid, p.name, p.arch) end
end
`;

/** Built-in examples (audit 68): the four workflows the docs promise. */
export const kExamples: readonly { nameKey: Key; code: string }[] = [
  {
    nameKey: "scripts.exampleFindValue",
    code: `-- first scan for a 4-byte value, then narrow it
local hits = slop.mem.scan({ kind = "exact", width = "i32", value = 100, alignment = 4 })
print("hits:", #hits)
for i = 1, math.min(#hits, 20) do print(string.format("0x%X", hits[i])) end
`,
  },
  {
    nameKey: "scripts.exampleDumpModule",
    code: `-- load the attached process's main module into the shared session
slop.image.load_from_target()
local st = slop.image.status()
print("module:", st.name, string.format("base=0x%X entry=0x%X", st.base, st.entry))
slop.image.wait_ready(30000)
print("functions:", slop.image.status().functions)
`,
  },
  {
    nameKey: "scripts.exampleDecompile",
    code: `-- largest functions of the loaded image, decompiled
slop.image.wait_ready(30000)
local fns = slop.disasm.functions(4000)
table.sort(fns, function(a, b) return a.size > b.size end)
for i = 1, 3 do
  local d = slop.decomp.decompile(fns[i].va)
  print(("-- %s (%d bytes) %s"):format(d.name, fns[i].size, d.signature))
  for _, l in ipairs(d.lines) do
    print(string.rep("  ", l.indent) .. l.text)
  end
end
`,
  },
  {
    nameKey: "scripts.exampleBpWait",
    code: `-- console breakpoint + wait (slop.debugger, not slop.ps4)
local st = slop.target.status()
slop.debugger.attach(st.pid)
slop.debugger.bp_set(0x484490)
local ev = slop.debugger.wait(5000)
print(("stop: rip=0x%X thread=%s"):format(ev.rip, ev.thread))
`,
  },
];

type Run = { ok: boolean; output: string; error?: string; ms: number };
type ApiEntry = { name: string; signature: string; doc: string };
type Snippet = { name: string };

type Suggest = { items: ApiEntry[]; start: number; end: number };

/** The `slop.*` token the caret sits in, or null outside one. */
function tokenAt(text: string, caret: number): { token: string; start: number } | null {
  const m = /[A-Za-z0-9_.]+$/.exec(text.slice(0, caret));
  if (!m) return null;
  const token = m[0];
  if (!token.startsWith("slop")) return null;
  return { token, start: caret - token.length };
}

export default function ScriptsPanel() {
  const t = useT();
  const [code, setCode] = useState(kSampleScript);
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<Run[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [unsafe, setUnsafe] = useState(false);
  const [api, setApi] = useState<ApiEntry[]>([]);
  const [snippets, setSnippets] = useState<Snippet[]>([]);
  const [snippetName, setSnippetName] = useState("");
  const [suggest, setSuggest] = useState<Suggest | null>(null);
  const [sel, setSel] = useState(0);
  const areaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  const refreshSnippets = useCallback(
    () =>
      void call<{ snippets: Snippet[] }>("script", "list")
        .then((r) => setSnippets(r.snippets ?? []))
        .catch(() => setSnippets([])),
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void call<{ functions: ApiEntry[] }>("script", "api")
      .then((r) => setApi(r.functions ?? []))
      .catch(() => setApi([]));
    refreshSnippets();
  }, [refreshSnippets]);

  const run = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    const started = Date.now();
    try {
      const res = await call<{ ok: boolean; output: string; error?: string }>(
        "script",
        "run",
        // unsafe is per-run consent: the flag resets after every run
        { code, timeout_ms: kScriptTimeoutMs, ...(unsafe ? { unsafe: true, confirm: true } : {}) },
        // the engine enforces the script timeout; leave it room to report
        { timeoutMs: kScriptTimeoutMs + 15_000 },
      );
      setRuns((r) => [...r.slice(-19), { ...res, ms: Date.now() - started }]);
    } catch (e) {
      setRuns((r) => [
        ...r.slice(-19),
        { ok: false, output: "", error: errorText(e), ms: Date.now() - started },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setUnsafe(false);
    }
  };

  const updateSuggest = (text: string, caret: number) => {
    const tok = tokenAt(text, caret);
    if (!tok) {
      setSuggest(null);
      return;
    }
    const items = api
      .filter((e) => e.name.startsWith(tok.token) && e.name !== tok.token)
      .slice(0, 20);
    setSel(0);
    setSuggest(items.length > 0 ? { items, start: tok.start, end: caret } : null);
  };

  const accept = (entry: ApiEntry) => {
    if (!suggest) return;
    const at = suggest.start + entry.name.length;
    setCode(code.slice(0, suggest.start) + entry.name + code.slice(suggest.end));
    setSuggest(null);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const el = areaRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      el.focus();
      el.setSelectionRange(at, at);
    });
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (suggest) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSel((s) => (s + 1) % suggest.items.length);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSel((s) => (s - 1 + suggest.items.length) % suggest.items.length);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "Tab") {
        e.preventDefault();
        accept(suggest.items[sel]);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSuggest(null);
        return;
      }
    }
    if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      void run();
    }
  };

  const loadSnippet = (name: string) => {
    void call<{ code: string }>("script", "load", { name })
      .then((r) => setCode(r.code ?? ""))
      .catch((e) =>
        setRuns((r) => [...r.slice(-19), { ok: false, output: "", error: errorText(e), ms: 0 }]),
      );
  };

  const saveSnippet = () => {
    const name = snippetName.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    void call<{ ok: boolean }>("script", "save", { name, code })
      .then(() => {
        setSnippetName("");
        refreshSnippets();
      })
      .catch((e) =>
        setRuns((r) => [...r.slice(-19), { ok: false, output: "", error: errorText(e), ms: 0 }]),
      );
  };

  const deleteSnippet = (name: string) => {
    void call<{ ok: boolean }>("script", "delete", { name })
      .then(refreshSnippets)
      .catch((e) =>
        setRuns((r) => [...r.slice(-19), { ok: false, output: "", error: errorText(e), ms: 0 }]),
      );
  };

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">{t("scripts.title")}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <label
          className="faint"
          style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, fontSize: 11 }}
          title={t("scripts.unsafeTip")}
        >
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            aria-label={t("scripts.unsafeAria")}
            checked={unsafe}
            onChange={(e) => setUnsafe(e.target.checked)}
          />
          {t("scripts.unsafe")}
        </label>
        <IconButton tip={t("scripts.clearOutput")} onClick={() => setRuns([])}>
          <Trash2 size={14} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton tip={t("scripts.run")} disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run()}>
          <Play size={14} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: "flex", minHeight: 0 }}>
        <aside
          aria-label={t("scripts.snippets")}
          style={{
            width: 170,
            flex: "0 0 auto",
            overflowY: "auto",
            padding: "var(--pad-sm)",
            borderRight: "1px solid var(--border-soft)",
            fontSize: 12,
          }}
        >
          <div className="faint" style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
            {t("scripts.examples")}
          </div>
          {kExamples.map((ex) => (
            <button
              key={ex.nameKey}
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              style={{ display: "block", width: "100%", textAlign: "left" }}
              onClick={() => setCode(ex.code)}
            >
              {t(ex.nameKey)}
            </button>
          ))}
          <div className="faint" style={{ margin: "var(--pad-sm) 0 4px" }}>
            {t("scripts.saved")}
          </div>
          {snippets.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="faint">{t("scripts.noneYet")}</div>
          ) : (
            snippets.map((s) => (
              <div key={s.name} style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 2 }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="row-action"
                  style={{
                    flex: 1,
                    textAlign: "left",
                    overflow: "hidden",
                    textOverflow: "ellipsis",
                  }}
                  onClick={() => loadSnippet(s.name)}
                >
                  {s.name}
                </button>
                <IconButton
                  tip={t("scripts.delete", { name: s.name })}
                  onClick={() => deleteSnippet(s.name)}
                >
                  <Trash2 size={12} />
                </IconButton>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, marginTop: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
            <input
              aria-label={t("scripts.snippetName")}
              placeholder={t("scripts.namePlaceholder")}
              value={snippetName}
              onChange={(e) => setSnippetName(e.target.value)}
              style={{ minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}
            />
            <IconButton tip={t("scripts.saveSnippet")} onClick={saveSnippet}>
              <Save size={12} />
            </IconButton>
          </div>
        </aside>

        <div className="scripts-body" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <div style={{ position: "relative", display: "flex", minHeight: 0 }}>
            <textarea
              ref={areaRef}
              className="code-area mono"
              aria-label={t("scripts.luaScript")}
              value={code}
              spellCheck={false}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCode(e.target.value);
                updateSuggest(e.target.value, e.target.selectionStart);
              }}
              onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
              onBlur={() => setSuggest(null)}
            />
            {suggest && (
              <div
                role="listbox"
                aria-label={t("scripts.completions")}
                style={{
                  position: "absolute",
                  left: 8,
                  bottom: 8,
                  maxHeight: 140,
                  overflowY: "auto",
                  background: "var(--bg-1)",
                  border: "1px solid var(--border)",
                  borderRadius: 4,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  zIndex: 5,
                }}
              >
                {suggest.items.map((entry, i) => (
                  <div
                    key={entry.name}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={i === sel}
                    title={entry.doc}
                    style={{
                      padding: "2px 6px",
                      cursor: "pointer",
                      background: i === sel ? "var(--bg-2)" : "transparent",
                    }}
                    onMouseDown={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      accept(entry);
                    }}
                  >
                    <span className="mono">{entry.name}</span>{" "}
                    <span className="faint">{entry.signature}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="dbg-head" style={{ borderTop: "1px solid var(--border-soft)" }}>
            {t("scripts.output")}
            <div className="spacer" />
            <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
              {busy ? t("scripts.running") : t("scripts.runs", { count: runs.length })}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="panel-body log" aria-live="polite">
            {runs.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="empty-hint">{t("scripts.runHint")}</div>
            ) : (
              runs.map((r, i) => (
                <div key={i} style={{ marginBottom: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
                  <div className="log-row faint">
                    <span>{r.ok ? t("scripts.ok") : t("scripts.error")}</span>
                    <span>{r.ms}ms</span>
                  </div>
                  {r.output !== "" && <div className="log-row">{r.output}</div>}
                  {r.error !== undefined && r.error !== "" && (
                    <div className="log-row error-text">{r.error}</div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/StringsView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/StringsView.tsx
// Port of src/ui/view_strings.cpp. Virtualized because a real image yields
// thousands of hits, and the engine caps at 10k

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { escapeControl } from "@/lib/format";
import { showInDisassembly } from "@/lib/navigate";
import { hex, useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";

const kRow = 20;

export default function StringsView() {
  const t = useT();
  const { strings, stringsTruncated, loadStrings, busy } = useDisasm();
  const [minChars, setMinChars] = useState(4);
  const [includeExec, setIncludeExec] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStrings(minChars, includeExec);
  }, [loadStrings, minChars, includeExec]);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === "") return strings;
    const needle = filter.toLowerCase();
    return strings.filter((s) => s.text.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
  }, [strings, filter]);

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRow,
    overscan: 20,
  });

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="view-bar">
        <div className="search" style={{ margin: 0, flex: 1 }}>
          <Search size={13} aria-hidden />
          <input
            value={filter}
            aria-label={t("strings.filter")}
            placeholder={t("strings.filterPlaceholder", { count: strings.length })}
            onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <label className="view-label">
          {t("strings.min")}
          <select
            className="select"
            value={minChars}
            onChange={(e) => setMinChars(Number(e.target.value))}
          >
            {[3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16].map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>
                {n}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="view-label">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={includeExec}
            onChange={(e) => setIncludeExec(e.target.checked)}
          />
          {t("strings.exec")}
        </label>
        {stringsTruncated && <span className="pill">{t("common.truncated")}</span>}
      </div>

      <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
            {busy ? t("strings.scanning") : t("strings.empty")}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
            {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
              const s = rows[v.index];
              return (
                <div
                  key={`${s.va}-${v.index}`}
                  className="insn-row mono"
                  style={{ top: v.start, height: kRow }}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="insn-va link"
                    onClick={() => showInDisassembly(s.va)}
                    data-tip={t("strings.follow")}
                    aria-label={t("strings.followAria", { addr: hex(s.va) })}
                  >
                    {hex(s.va)}
                  </button>
                  {s.utf16 && <span className="pill">w</span>}
                  <span className="insn-text" style={{ userSelect: "text" }}>
                    {/* one line per row: a raw newline would spill into the next row */}
                    {escapeControl(s.text)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/StructEditor.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/StructEditor.tsx
// ReClass-style struct/enum editor over the engine `types` tool. The catalog
// lives in the engine (persisted per binary hash); this view is a thin client:
// left list of structs/enums, right member table with a live value column read
// at a user-supplied address. Every mutation bumps the catalog generation,
// which invalidates decompiled functions, so the hint below the table says so

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Braces, Pencil, Plus, RefreshCw, Save, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { parseEnumValues, useTypes } from "@/store/types";

const kPrimitiveTypes = [
  "u8",
  "u16",
  "u32",
  "u64",
  "i8",
  "i16",
  "i32",
  "i64",
  "f32",
  "f64",
  "ptr",
  "char",
];

export default function StructEditor() {
  const t = useT();
  const {
    structs,
    enums,
    selected,
    selectedEnum,
    addr,
    values,
    busy,
    error,
    invalidated,
    load,
    select,
    selectEnum,
    setAddr,
    readValues,
    createStruct,
    deleteStruct,
    addMember,
    removeMember,
    renameMember,
    saveEnum,
    deleteEnum,
  } = useTypes();

  const [newStruct, setNewStruct] = useState("");
  const [fieldType, setFieldType] = useState("u32");
  const [fieldName, setFieldName] = useState("");
  const [fieldCount, setFieldCount] = useState("0");
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [renameText, setRenameText] = useState("");
  const [enumName, setEnumName] = useState("");
  const [underlying, setUnderlying] = useState("u32");
  const [enumValues, setEnumValues] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  // the form always mirrors the selected enum so Save upserts what is shown
  useEffect(() => {
    const def = enums.find((e) => e.name === selectedEnum);
    setEnumName(def?.name ?? "");
    setUnderlying(def?.underlying ?? "u32");
    setEnumValues(def ? def.values.map((v) => `${v.name}=${v.value}`).join(", ") : "");
  }, [selectedEnum, enums]);

  const def = structs.find((s) => s.name === selected);
  const addrOk = parseAddress(addr) !== null;
  const typeNames = [
    ...kPrimitiveTypes,
    ...structs.map((s) => s.name),
    ...enums.map((e) => e.name),
  ];

  const submitField = async () => {
    if (fieldName.trim() === "") return;
    const ok = await addMember({
      name: fieldName.trim(),
      type: fieldType.trim() || "u8",
      offset: 0,
      size: 0,
      array_count: Math.max(0, Number(fieldCount) || 0),
    });
    if (ok) {
      setFieldName("");
      setFieldCount("0");
    }
  };

  const submitRename = async (from: string) => {
    const to = renameText.trim();
    setRenaming(null);
    if (to !== "" && to !== from) await renameMember(from, to);
  };

  return (
    <div className="types">
      <div className="types-list">
        <div className="view-bar" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
          <span className="panel-title">{t("types.title")}</span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <IconButton tip={t("types.reload")} onClick={() => void load()}>
            <RefreshCw size={13} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>
        <div className="panel-body">
          <div className="types-group">{t("types.structs")}</div>
          {structs.length === 0 && <div className="faint types-hint">{t("types.noStructs")}</div>}
          {structs.map((s) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={s.name}
              className="types-row"
              data-selected={s.name === selected}
              onClick={() => select(s.name)}
            >
              <Braces size={12} aria-hidden />
              <span className="fn-name">{s.name}</span>
              <span className="faint">{s.size}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
          <div className="types-create">
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              style={{ width: "100%" }}
              aria-label={t("types.newStructName")}
              placeholder={t("types.newStructPlaceholder")}
              value={newStruct}
              onChange={(e) => setNewStruct(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key !== "Enter" || newStruct.trim() === "") return;
                void createStruct(newStruct.trim()).then((ok) => ok && setNewStruct(""));
              }}
            />
            <IconButton
              tip={t("types.createStruct")}
              disabled={busy || newStruct.trim() === ""}
              onClick={() =>
                void createStruct(newStruct.trim()).then((ok) => ok && setNewStruct(""))
              }
            >
              <Plus size={13} />
            </IconButton>
          </div>

          <div className="types-group">{t("types.enums")}</div>
          {enums.length === 0 && <div className="faint types-hint">{t("types.noEnums")}</div>}
          {enums.map((e) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={e.name}
              className="types-row"
              data-selected={e.name === selectedEnum}
              onClick={() => selectEnum(e.name)}
            >
              <span className="fn-name">{e.name}</span>
              <span className="faint">{e.underlying}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
          <div className="types-create">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              onClick={() => selectEnum(null)}
              disabled={busy}
            >
              <Plus size={11} /> {t("types.newEnum")}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="stack">
        <div className="view-bar">
          <span className="panel-title">
            {def ? t("types.structTitle", { name: def.name }) : t("types.editor")}
          </span>
          {def && (
            <IconButton
              tip={t("types.deleteStruct", { name: def.name })}
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void deleteStruct(def.name)}
            >
              <Trash2 size={13} />
            </IconButton>
          )}
          <div className="spacer" />
          <label className="view-label">
            {t("types.addr")}
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              aria-label={t("types.addrAria")}
              placeholder="0x400000"
              value={addr}
              aria-invalid={!addrOk && addr !== ""}
              onChange={(e) => setAddr(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && void readValues()}
            />
          </label>
          <IconButton tip={t("types.reread")} disabled={!addrOk} onClick={() => void readValues()}>
            <RefreshCw size={13} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>

        <div className="panel-body">
          {error !== null && (
            <div className="error-text" role="alert" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm)" }}>
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
          {def === undefined ? (
            <div className="faint types-hint">{t("types.selectHint")}</div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <table className="table types-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>{t("types.offset")}</th>
                    <th>{t("types.size")}</th>
                    <th>{t("types.type")}</th>
                    <th>{t("types.name")}</th>
                    <th>{t("types.value")}</th>
                    <th aria-label={t("types.actions")} />
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {def.fields.map((f) => {
                    const v = values[f.name];
                    return (
                      <tr key={f.name}>
                        <td className="mono">
                          {f.offset.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(3, "0")}
                        </td>
                        <td className="mono">{f.size}</td>
                        <td className="mono">{f.type}</td>
                        <td>
                          {renaming === f.name ? (
                            <input
                              className="addr-input mono"
                              aria-label={t("types.rename", { name: f.name })}
                              autoFocus
                              value={renameText}
                              onChange={(e) => setRenameText(e.target.value)}
                              onBlur={() => void submitRename(f.name)}
                              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                                if (e.key === "Enter") void submitRename(f.name);
                                if (e.key === "Escape") setRenaming(null);
                              }}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            f.name
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="mono">
                          {v === undefined ? (
                            <span className="faint">{addrOk ? "…" : "—"}</span>
                          ) : "error" in v ? (
                            <span className="faint">{v.error}</span>
                          ) : (
                            v.hex
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="types-actions">
                          <IconButton
                            tip={t("types.renameMember", { name: f.name })}
                            disabled={busy}
                            onClick={() => {
                              setRenaming(f.name);
                              setRenameText(f.name);
                            }}
                          >
                            <Pencil size={12} />
                          </IconButton>
                          <IconButton
                            tip={t("types.removeMember", { name: f.name })}
                            disabled={busy}
                            onClick={() => void removeMember(f.name)}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={12} />
                          </IconButton>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>

              <div className="types-create">
                <input
                  className="addr-input mono"
                  aria-label={t("types.memberType")}
                  list="types-member-types"
                  placeholder={t("types.typePlaceholder")}
                  value={fieldType}
                  onChange={(e) => setFieldType(e.target.value)}
                />
                <datalist id="types-member-types">
                  {typeNames.map((typeName) => (
                    <option key={typeName} value={typeName} />
                  ))}
                </datalist>
                <input
                  className="addr-input mono"
                  aria-label={t("types.memberName")}
                  placeholder={t("types.namePlaceholder")}
                  value={fieldName}
                  onChange={(e) => setFieldName(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && void submitField()}
                />
                <input
                  className="addr-input mono"
                  style={{ width: 56 }}
                  aria-label={t("types.arrayCount")}
                  placeholder={t("types.countPlaceholder")}
                  value={fieldCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setFieldCount(e.target.value)}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="row-action"
                  disabled={busy || fieldName.trim() === ""}
                  onClick={() => void submitField()}
                >
                  <Plus size={11} /> {t("types.addMember")}
                </button>
              </div>

              {invalidated > 0 && (
                <div className="types-note" role="status">
                  {t("types.invalidated", {
                    count: invalidated,
                    s: invalidated === 1 ? "" : "s",
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          <div className="types-enum">
            <div className="types-group">{t("types.enum")}</div>
            <div className="types-create">
              <input
                className="addr-input mono"
                aria-label={t("types.enumName")}
                placeholder={t("types.namePlaceholder")}
                value={enumName}
                onChange={(e) => setEnumName(e.target.value)}
              />
              <select
                className="select"
                aria-label={t("types.enumUnderlying")}
                value={underlying}
                onChange={(e) => setUnderlying(e.target.value)}
              >
                {["u8", "u16", "u32", "u64", "i32"].map((typeName) => (
                  <option key={typeName} value={typeName}>
                    {typeName}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <IconButton
                tip={t("types.saveEnum")}
                disabled={
                  busy || enumName.trim() === "" || parseEnumValues(enumValues).length === 0
                }
                onClick={() =>
                  void saveEnum({
                    name: enumName.trim(),
                    underlying,
                    values: parseEnumValues(enumValues),
                  })
                }
              >
                <Save size={13} />
              </IconButton>
              {selectedEnum !== null && (
                <IconButton
                  tip={t("types.deleteEnum", { name: selectedEnum })}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void deleteEnum(selectedEnum)}
                >
                  <Trash2 size={13} />
                </IconButton>
              )}
            </div>
            <textarea
              className="types-enum-values mono"
              aria-label={t("types.enumValues")}
              placeholder={t("types.enumValuesPlaceholder")}
              value={enumValues}
              onChange={(e) => setEnumValues(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/TargetsPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/TargetsPanel.tsx
// process list and attach flow, stays on the list after attaching so targets
// can be switched without detaching. With no console connected the engine is
// on its local fallback backend; its processes are this PC's, so the panel
// asks for a console instead of listing them (host listing is opt-in)

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useVirtualizer } from "@tanstack/react-virtual";
import { save as saveDialog } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import { Gamepad2, RefreshCw, Search, ShieldAlert, Unplug } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import ProcessIcon from "@/components/ProcessIcon";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { payloadDownload, payloadLatest, payloadSave, payloadStatus } from "@/lib/ps4debug";
import type { PayloadInfo, PayloadStatus } from "@/lib/ps4debug";
import { matchesFilter, useTargets, type ConsoleRow, type ProcessRow } from "@/store/targets";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";

const kRowHeight = 22;
const kDefaultPs4Port = 744;
const kScanWidths = ["i8", "u8", "i16", "u16", "i32", "u32", "i64", "u64", "f32", "f64"];

function ConnectForm({
  compact,
  host,
  port,
  onHost,
  onPort,
}: {
  compact: boolean;
  host: string;
  port: number;
  onHost: (v: string) => void;
  onPort: (v: number) => void;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const connectPs4 = useTargets((s) => s.connectPs4);
  const saveConsole = useTargets((s) => s.saveConsole);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [discovering, setDiscovering] = useState(false);
  const [found, setFound] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [discoverError, setDiscoverError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // a discovered console can be kept as an endpoint without connecting now
  const saveEndpoint = async (ip: string) => {
    setDiscoverError(null);
    if (!(await saveConsole({ name: ip, host: ip, port })))
      setDiscoverError(t("targets.saveFailed", { ip }));
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    if (host.trim() === "" || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await connectPs4(host.trim(), port);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const discover = async () => {
    setDiscovering(true);
    setDiscoverError(null);
    setFound([]);
    try {
      const res = await call<{ consoles?: { ip: string }[] }>("target", "ps4_discover", {
        timeout_ms: 2000,
      });
      const ips = (res.consoles ?? []).map((c) => c.ip).filter((ip) => ip !== "");
      setFound(ips);
      if (ips.length > 0) onHost(ips[0]);
      else setDiscoverError(t("targets.discoverFailed"));
    } catch (e) {
      setDiscoverError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setDiscovering(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form
      className={compact ? "connect-bar" : "connect-form"}
      aria-label={t("targets.connectForm")}
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        void submit();
      }}
    >
      <input
        className="addr-input"
        aria-label={t("targets.ip")}
        placeholder={t("targets.ipPlaceholder")}
        value={host}
        onChange={(e) => onHost(e.target.value)}
      />
      <input
        className="addr-input"
        style={{ width: 64 }}
        aria-label={t("targets.port")}
        type="number"
        min={1}
        max={65535}
        value={port}
        onChange={(e) => onPort(Number(e.target.value) || kDefaultPs4Port)}
      />
      <button type="submit" className="row-action" disabled={host.trim() === "" || busy}>
        {busy ? t("targets.connecting") : t("targets.connect")}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="row-action"
        disabled={discovering}
        onClick={() => void discover()}
      >
        {discovering ? t("targets.searching") : t("targets.discover")}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="row-action"
        disabled={host.trim() === ""}
        data-tip={t("targets.saveEndpointTip")}
        onClick={() => void saveEndpoint(host.trim())}
      >
        {t("targets.saveEndpoint")}
      </button>
      {found.length > 1 &&
        found.map((ip) => (
          <button type="button" key={ip} className="link-button" onClick={() => onHost(ip)}>
            {ip}
          </button>
        ))}
      {discoverError !== null && <span className="faint error-text">{discoverError}</span>}
    </form>
  );
}

type ConsoleForm = {
  name: string;
  host: string;
  port: number;
  default_pid: number;
  watchlist: string;
  scan_width: string;
};

const kEmptyConsoleForm: ConsoleForm = {
  name: "",
  host: "",
  port: kDefaultPs4Port,
  default_pid: 0,
  watchlist: "",
  scan_width: "u32",
};

/** Saved endpoints: add/edit/remove, connect or quick-switch, with the
 *  firmware/caps the engine recorded on the last connection. */
function ConsolesCard() {
  const t = useT();
  const consoles = useTargets((s) => s.consoles);
  const activeConsole = useTargets((s) => s.activeConsole);
  const saveConsole = useTargets((s) => s.saveConsole);
  const removeConsole = useTargets((s) => s.removeConsole);
  const switchConsole = useTargets((s) => s.switchConsole);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ConsoleForm>(kEmptyConsoleForm);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  if (consoles.length === 0 && !open) return null;

  const edit = (c: ConsoleRow) => {
    setForm({
      name: c.name,
      host: c.host,
      port: c.port,
      default_pid: c.default_pid,
      watchlist: c.profile.watchlist,
      scan_width: c.profile.scan_width === "" ? "u32" : c.profile.scan_width,
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const submit = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const ok = await saveConsole({
        name: form.name.trim(),
        host: form.host.trim(),
        port: form.port,
        default_pid: form.default_pid,
        profile: { watchlist: form.watchlist.trim(), scan_width: form.scan_width },
      });
      if (ok) {
        setOpen(false);
        setForm(kEmptyConsoleForm);
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="consoles-card">
      <div className="payload-head">
        <span className="payload-title">{t("targets.consoles")}</span>
        <span className="faint">{t("targets.saved", { count: consoles.length })}</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          onClick={() => {
            setForm(kEmptyConsoleForm);
            setOpen((v) => !v);
          }}
        >
          {open ? t("common.cancel") : t("common.add")}
        </button>
      </div>
      {consoles.length > 0 && (
        <div className="console-list">
          {consoles.map((c) => (
            <div className="console-row" key={c.name} data-active={c.name === activeConsole}>
              <span className="console-name">{c.name}</span>
              <span className="faint mono">
                {c.host}:{c.port}
              </span>
              <span className="faint">
                {c.last_fw !== ""
                  ? t("targets.fw", { fw: c.last_fw })
                  : t("targets.neverConnected")}
                {c.last_seen_ms > 0 ? ` · ${new Date(c.last_seen_ms).toLocaleDateString()}` : ""}
              </span>
              {c.last_caps !== "" && <span className="pill">{c.last_caps}</span>}
              {c.notes !== "" && <span className="faint console-note">{c.notes}</span>}
              <div className="spacer" />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="row-action"
                data-active={c.name === activeConsole}
                onClick={() => void switchConsole(c.name)}
              >
                {c.name === activeConsole ? t("targets.reconnect") : t("targets.switch")}
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => edit(c)}>
                {t("common.edit")}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="link-button"
                onClick={() => void removeConsole(c.name)}
              >
                {t("common.remove")}
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {open && (
        <form
          className="console-form"
          aria-label={t("targets.saveConsoleForm")}
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            void submit();
          }}
        >
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            aria-label={t("targets.consoleName")}
            placeholder={t("targets.namePlaceholder")}
            value={form.name}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            aria-label={t("targets.consoleHost")}
            placeholder={t("targets.hostPlaceholder")}
            value={form.host}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, host: e.target.value })}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 64 }}
            aria-label={t("targets.consolePort")}
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={65535}
            value={form.port}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, port: Number(e.target.value) || kDefaultPs4Port })}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            style={{ width: 70 }}
            aria-label={t("targets.defaultPid")}
            type="number"
            min={0}
            value={form.default_pid}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, default_pid: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })}
          />
          <input
            className="addr-input"
            aria-label={t("targets.watchlistSet")}
            placeholder={t("targets.watchlistSet")}
            value={form.watchlist}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, watchlist: e.target.value })}
          />
          <select
            className="addr-input"
            aria-label={t("targets.scanWidth")}
            value={form.scan_width}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, scan_width: e.target.value })}
          >
            {kScanWidths.map((w) => (
              <option key={w} value={w}>
                {w}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy || form.name.trim() === "" || form.host.trim() === ""}
          >
            {busy ? t("targets.saving") : t("targets.saveConsole")}
          </button>
        </form>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function PayloadCard({ host }: { host: string }) {
  const t = useT();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<PayloadStatus | null>(null);
  const [latest, setLatest] = useState<PayloadInfo | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"check" | "download" | "save" | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loaderPort, setLoaderPort] = useState(9090);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    void payloadStatus().then(setStatus);
  }, []);
  if (!isTauri()) return null;
  const installed = status?.local ?? status?.bundled ?? null;
  const newer = latest !== null && installed !== null && latest.tag !== installed.tag;
  const check = async () => {
    setBusy("check");
    setError(null);
    try {
      setLatest(await payloadLatest());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };
  const download = async () => {
    setBusy("download");
    setError(null);
    try {
      const info = await payloadDownload();
      setStatus((s) => (s === null ? s : { ...s, local: info }));
      setLatest(info);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };
  const save = async () => {
    if (installed === null) return;
    setBusy("save");
    setError(null);
    try {
      const dest = await saveDialog({
        defaultPath: "ps4debug-ng.bin",
        filters: [{ name: "Payload", extensions: ["bin"] }],
      });
      if (dest !== null) await payloadSave(installed.path, dest);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };
  const send = async () => {
    if (installed === null || host.trim() === "") return;
    setSending(true);
    setSendError(null);
    setSent(null);
    try {
      const res = await call<{ bytes: number }>("target", "ps4_send_payload", {
        host: host.trim(),
        port: loaderPort,
        path: installed.path,
      });
      setSent(res.bytes);
    } catch (e) {
      setSendError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="payload-card">
      <div className="payload-head">
        <span className="payload-title">{t("targets.payloadTitle")}</span>
        <span className="faint">
          {installed === null
            ? t("targets.notBundled")
            : t("targets.payloadVersion", { tag: installed.tag })}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="payload-hint">
        {installed === null
          ? t("targets.payloadMissing")
          : t("targets.payloadBundled", { source: installed.source })}
        {latest !== null ? t("targets.payloadLatest", { tag: latest.tag }) : ""}
      </div>
      <div className="payload-actions">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null}
          onClick={() => void check()}
        >
          {busy === "check" ? t("targets.checking") : t("targets.checkLatest")}
        </button>
        {newer && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null}
            onClick={() => void download()}
          >
            {busy === "download"
              ? t("targets.downloading")
              : t("targets.download", { tag: latest?.tag ?? "" })}
          </button>
        )}
        {installed !== null && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy !== null}
            onClick={() => void save()}
          >
            {busy === "save" ? t("targets.saving") : t("targets.savePayload")}
          </button>
        )}
        <input
          className="addr-input"
          style={{ width: 70 }}
          aria-label={t("targets.loaderPort")}
          type="number"
          min={1}
          max={65535}
          value={loaderPort}
          onChange={(e) => setLoaderPort(Number(e.target.value) || 9090)}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={installed === null || host.trim() === "" || sending}
          onClick={() => void send()}
        >
          {sending ? t("targets.sending") : t("targets.send")}
        </button>
      </div>
      {sent !== null && (
        <div className="payload-hint">
          {t("targets.sent", { bytes: sent, host, port: loaderPort })}
        </div>
      )}
      {sendError !== null && (
        <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
          {sendError}
        </div>
      )}
      {error !== null && (
        <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function elevationLabel(p: ProcessRow): string | null {
  switch (p.elevation) {
    case "admin":
      return "admin";
    case "system":
      return "system";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

type Ps5Status = {
  endpoint: string;
  branding: string;
  server_version: string;
  caps: string;
  fw: string;
  platform: string;
  connected: boolean;
  lost: boolean;
  lost_reason: string;
  drops: number;
  debug_attached: boolean;
  debug_pid: number;
};

type Ps5AutoReply = {
  pid?: number;
  name?: string;
  debug_attached?: boolean;
  debug_error?: string;
  candidates?: { pid: number; name: string; game: boolean }[];
};

/** PS5 console card: ps5debug-NG connect/auto/reconnect and the console state. */
function Ps5Card() {
  const [host, setHost] = useState("");
  const [port, setPort] = useState(kDefaultPs4Port);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Ps5Status | null>(null);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refresh = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ ps5?: Ps5Status }>("target", "status");
      setStatus(res.ps5 ?? null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, []);

  const run = async (label: string, action: string, params: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    setBusy(label);
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const res = await call<Ps5AutoReply & { connected?: boolean }>("target", action, params);
      if (action === "ps5_auto") {
        setNotice(
          `pid ${res.pid ?? "?"} ${res.name ?? ""}${
            res.debug_attached === true ? " · debug attached" : " · debug not attached"
          }${res.debug_error !== undefined ? ` (${res.debug_error})` : ""}`,
        );
      }
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const send = async () => {
    if (msg.trim() === "") return;
    setBusy("notify");
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const res = await call<{ bytes: number }>("target", "ps5_notify", { msg: msg.trim() });
      setNotice(`Notification sent (${res.bytes} bytes).`);
      setMsg("");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="payload-card ps5-card" aria-label="PS5 console">
      <div className="payload-head">
        <span className="payload-title">PS5</span>
        {status !== null ? (
          <span className="pill" data-active={status.connected}>
            {status.connected ? "connected" : status.lost ? "lost" : "idle"}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="faint">not connected</span>
        )}
        <div className="spacer" />
        <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void refresh()}>
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      {status !== null && (
        <div className="payload-hint">
          {status.endpoint !== "" ? `${status.endpoint} · ` : ""}
          {status.branding !== "" ? `${status.branding} · ` : ""}
          fw {status.fw !== "" ? status.fw : "unknown"}
          {status.platform !== "" ? ` · platform ${status.platform}` : ""}
          {status.server_version !== "" ? ` · server ${status.server_version}` : ""}
          {status.caps !== "" ? ` · caps ${status.caps}` : ""}
          {" · "}
          {status.debug_attached ? `debug pid ${status.debug_pid}` : "debugger idle"}
          {" · "}
          drops {status.drops}
          {status.lost && status.lost_reason !== "" ? ` · lost: ${status.lost_reason}` : ""}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="payload-actions">
        <input
          className="addr-input"
          aria-label="PS5 IP address"
          placeholder="PS5 IP, e.g. 192.168.1.30"
          value={host}
          onChange={(e) => setHost(e.target.value)}
        />
        <input
          className="addr-input"
          style={{ width: 64 }}
          aria-label="ps5debug port"
          type="number"
          min={1}
          max={65535}
          value={port}
          onChange={(e) => setPort(Number(e.target.value) || kDefaultPs4Port)}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null || host.trim() === ""}
          onClick={() => void run("connect", "ps5_connect", { host: host.trim(), port })}
        >
          {busy === "connect" ? "Connecting…" : "Connect"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null || host.trim() === ""}
          data-tip="Connect, pick the game process, attach a session and the debugger"
          onClick={() => void run("auto", "ps5_auto", { host: host.trim(), port })}
        >
          {busy === "auto" ? "Setting up…" : "Auto connect"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null || status?.connected !== true}
          onClick={() => void run("disconnect", "ps5_disconnect", {})}
        >
          Disconnect
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null || status?.lost !== true}
          onClick={() => void run("reconnect", "ps5_reconnect", {})}
        >
          Reconnect
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="payload-actions">
        <input
          className="addr-input"
          style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}
          aria-label="PS5 notification message"
          placeholder="on-screen message"
          value={msg}
          onChange={(e) => setMsg(e.target.value)}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="row-action"
          disabled={busy !== null || msg.trim() === "" || status?.connected !== true}
          onClick={() => void send()}
        >
          {busy === "notify" ? "Sending…" : "Notify"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {notice !== null && <div className="payload-hint">{notice}</div>}
      {error !== null && (
        <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function TargetsPanel() {
  const t = useT();
  const {
    processes,
    filter,
    loading,
    error,
    setFilter,
    refresh,
    attach,
    detach,
    ps4,
    disconnectPs4,
    showHost,
    setShowHost,
    loadConsoles,
  } = useTargets();
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const backend = useEngine((s) => s.backend);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [showConnect, setShowConnect] = useState(false);
  const [host, setHost] = useState("");
  const [port, setPort] = useState(kDefaultPs4Port);
  const listing = backend.ps4 || showHost;

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadConsoles();
  }, [loadConsoles]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (listing) void refresh();
  }, [refresh, listing, backend.ps4]);

  const rows = useMemo(
    () => (listing ? processes.filter((p) => matchesFilter(p, filter)) : []),
    [processes, filter, listing],
  );

  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => scrollRef.current,
    estimateSize: () => kRowHeight,
    overscan: 12,
  });

  const banner = backend.ps4 ? (
    <div className="connect-bar" role="status">
      <span className="faint connect-text">
        PS4 {ps4?.endpoint ?? ""}
        {ps4?.branding ? ` · ${ps4.branding}` : ""}
      </span>
      <div className="spacer" />
      <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void disconnectPs4()}>
        {t("targets.detach")}
      </button>
    </div>
  ) : showConnect && showHost ? (
    <ConnectForm compact host={host} port={port} onHost={setHost} onPort={setPort} />
  ) : null;

  return (
    <div className="panel targets-panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">
          {backend.ps4
            ? t("targets.ps4Processes")
            : showHost
              ? t("targets.hostProcesses")
              : t("targets.title")}
        </span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        {listing && (
          <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
            {t("targets.processCount", { count: processes.length })}
          </span>
        )}
        {target.attached && (
          <IconButton
            tip={t("targets.detachNamed", { name: target.name ?? "" })}
            onClick={() => void detach()}
          >
            <Unplug size={14} />
          </IconButton>
        )}
        {!backend.ps4 && showHost && (
          <IconButton
            tip={t("targets.connectTip")}
            pressed={showConnect}
            onClick={() => setShowConnect((v) => !v)}
          >
            <Gamepad2 size={14} />
          </IconButton>
        )}
        {listing && (
          <IconButton tip={t("targets.refresh")} onClick={() => void refresh()}>
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? "spin" : undefined} />
          </IconButton>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Always present so the grid rows stay head / banner (auto) / list (1fr):
          a bare banner child used to land in the 1fr track and stretch */}
      <div className="banner-slot">
        {banner}
        <ConsolesCard />
        <Ps5Card />
      </div>

      {!listing ? (
        <div className="empty connect-empty">
          <div className="empty-glyph">
            <Gamepad2 size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          </div>
          <div className="empty-title">{t("targets.connectConsole")}</div>
          <div className="empty-hint">{t("targets.connectHint")}</div>
          <ConnectForm compact={false} host={host} port={port} onHost={setHost} onPort={setPort} />
          <PayloadCard host={host} />
          {error !== null && (
            <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => setShowHost(true)}>
            {t("targets.listHost")}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="targets-list">
          <div className="search">
            <Search size={13} aria-hidden />
            <input
              value={filter}
              aria-label={t("targets.filter")}
              placeholder={t("targets.filterPlaceholder")}
              onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
            {!backend.ps4 && (
              <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => setShowHost(false)}>
                {t("targets.hideHost")}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {error !== null && (
            <div
              className="empty-hint error-text"
              role="alert"
              style={{ padding: "var(--pad-sm) var(--pad-md)" }}
            >
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="panel-body" ref={scrollRef}>
            <table className="table">
              <caption className="sr-only">
                {backend.ps4 ? t("targets.captionPs4") : t("targets.captionHost")}
              </caption>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col" style={{ width: 58 }}>
                    {t("targets.colPid")}
                  </th>
                  <th scope="col">{t("targets.colName")}</th>
                  <th scope="col" style={{ width: 44 }}>
                    {t("targets.colArch")}
                  </th>
                  <th scope="col" style={{ width: 60 }}>
                    {t("targets.colAction")}
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize(), position: "relative" }}>
                {virtualizer.getVirtualItems().map((v) => {
                  const p = rows[v.index];
                  const isTarget = target.attached && target.pid === p.pid;
                  const elevated = elevationLabel(p);
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={p.pid}
                      data-selected={isTarget}
                      style={{
                        position: "absolute",
                        top: v.start,
                        left: 0,
                        width: "100%",
                        height: kRowHeight,
                        display: "table",
                        tableLayout: "fixed",
                      }}
                      data-tip={p.path ?? p.name}
                    >
                      <td style={{ width: 58 }} className="mono faint">
                        {p.pid}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span className="proc-name">
                          <ProcessIcon path={p.path} />
                          <span className="proc-name-text">{p.name}</span>
                          {elevated !== null && (
                            <span
                              className="pill elevation"
                              data-elevation={p.elevation}
                              data-tip={
                                p.elevation === "system"
                                  ? t("targets.systemTip")
                                  : t("targets.adminTip")
                              }
                            >
                              <ShieldAlert size={10} aria-hidden /> {elevated}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 44 }}>
                        {p.arch === "unknown" ? (
                          <span className="faint">-</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="pill">{p.arch}</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ width: 60 }}>
                        {isTarget ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="row-action"
                            data-active="true"
                            onClick={() => void detach()}
                          >
                            {t("targets.detach")}
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="row-action"
                            onClick={() => void attach(p.pid)}
                          >
                            {t("targets.attach")}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
