`app/src/components/panels/UnpackerView.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/UnpackerView.tsx
// Unpacker parity with the ImGui shell for the static patch passes: the
// packer verdict from analyze, the mutating patch actions (unpack_xor,
// decode_strings, full_pass) behind explicit buttons, and the edit journal
// with revert_all. Read-mostly: every run reports the journal delta so the
// user can see exactly what it wrote

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Play, RefreshCw, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import { hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";

type PackerVerdict = {
  image: string;
  packed: boolean;
  family: string;
  confidence: number;
  file_entropy: number;
  detections: { type: string; protector: string; detail: string; location: string }[];
  sections: {
    name: string;
    rva: number;
    raw_size: number;
    entropy: number;
    writable_exec: boolean;
  }[];
  hype_packer?: { name: string; confidence: number; details: string }[];
};

type JournalRec = { va: number; before: number; after: number };

type RunResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  dry_run: boolean;
  bytes_changed: number;
  journal_total: number;
  detected_key?: number;
  key_confidence?: number;
  strings_found?: number;
  score_reduction?: number;
  steps?: { step: string; success: boolean; note: string }[];
};

const kMethods = ["auto", "xor_single", "xor_multi", "xor_rolling"];

export default function UnpackerView() {
  const t = useT();
  const image = useDisasm((s) => s.image);
  const [packer, setPacker] = useState<PackerVerdict | null>(null);
  const [journal, setJournal] = useState<JournalRec[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [addr, setAddr] = useState("");
  const [size, setSize] = useState("4096");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState("auto");
  const [keyHex, setKeyHex] = useState("");
  const [dryRun, setDryRun] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [last, setLast] = useState<RunResult | null>(null);

  const loadJournal = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ patches: JournalRec[]; total: number }>("patch", "journal", {
        limit: 200,
      });
      setJournal(res.patches ?? []);
      setTotal(res.total ?? 0);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  }, []);

  const loadPacker = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setPacker(await call<PackerVerdict>("analyze", "packer"));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadJournal();
    void loadPacker();
  }, [loadJournal, loadPacker]);

  // a newly loaded image moves the default address to its entry point
  useEffect(() => {
    const va = image.entry_va ?? image.base;
    if (va !== undefined) setAddr(`0x${hex(va, 8)}`);
  }, [image.entry_va, image.base]);

  const run = async (action: "unpack_xor" | "decode_strings" | "full_pass") => {
    const va = parseAddress(addr);
    if (va === null) {
      setError(t("unpacker.badAddress"));
      return;
    }
    const before = total;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setNote(null);
    setLast(null);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, unknown> =
        action === "unpack_xor"
          ? {
              addr: va,
              size: Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(size, 10) || 4096),
              method,
              ...(keyHex.trim() === "" ? {} : { key_hex: keyHex.trim() }),
            }
          : action === "full_pass"
            ? { addr: va, dry_run: dryRun }
            : { addr: va };
      const res = await call<RunResult>("patch", action, params);
      setLast(res);
      setNote(
        t("unpacker.note", {
          action,
          bytes: res.bytes_changed,
          before,
          after: res.journal_total,
        }),
      );
      await loadJournal();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const revert = async () => {
    const before = total;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setNote(null);
    setLast(null);
    try {
      const res = await call<RunResult>("patch", "revert_all");
      setNote(t("unpacker.reverted", { bytes: res.bytes_changed, before }));
      await loadJournal();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="unpacker">
      <div className="stack">
        <div className="view-bar">
          <span className="panel-title">{t("unpacker.packer")}</span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <IconButton tip={t("unpacker.rerun")} onClick={() => void loadPacker()}>
            <RefreshCw size={13} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>
        <div className="panel-body unpacker-verdict">
          {packer === null ? (
            <div className="faint">{t("unpacker.analyzing")}</div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div>
                <span className={packer.packed ? "unpacker-packed" : "unpacker-clean"}>
                  {packer.packed ? t("unpacker.packed") : t("unpacker.notPacked")}
                </span>
                <span className="faint">
                  {t("unpacker.verdict", {
                    family: packer.family || t("unpacker.unknownFamily"),
                    percent: (packer.confidence * 100).toFixed(0),
                    entropy: packer.file_entropy.toFixed(2),
                  })}
                </span>
              </div>
              {packer.detections.map((d) => (
                <div key={`${d.type}:${d.location}`} className="unpacker-row">
                  <span className="mono">{d.type}</span>
                  <span>{d.protector}</span>
                  <span className="faint">{d.detail}</span>
                  <span className="faint mono">{d.location}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
              {packer.hype_packer?.map((h) => (
                <div key={h.name} className="unpacker-row">
                  <span className="mono">hyperion</span>
                  <span>{h.name}</span>
                  <span className="faint">
                    {(h.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}% {h.details}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div className="unpacker-row faint">
                {packer.sections
                  .filter((s) => s.entropy > 7)
                  .map((s) => `${s.name} entropy ${s.entropy.toFixed(2)}`)
                  .join(" · ") || t("unpacker.noHighEntropy")}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="stack">
        <div className="view-bar">
          <span className="panel-title">{t("unpacker.passes")}</span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="row-action"
            disabled={busy || total === 0}
            onClick={() => void revert()}
          >
            <Undo2 size={11} /> {t("unpacker.revertAll")}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="panel-body unpacker-options">
          <label className="view-label">
            {t("unpacker.addr")}
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              aria-label={t("unpacker.passAddr")}
              placeholder="0x400000"
              value={addr}
              onChange={(e) => setAddr(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="view-label">
            {t("unpacker.size")}
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              style={{ width: 76 }}
              aria-label={t("unpacker.xorSize")}
              value={size}
              onChange={(e) => setSize(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="view-label">
            {t("unpacker.method")}
            <select
              className="select"
              aria-label={t("unpacker.xorMethod")}
              value={method}
              onChange={(e) => setMethod(e.target.value)}
            >
              {kMethods.map((m) => (
                <option key={m} value={m}>
                  {m}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="view-label">
            {t("unpacker.key")}
            <input
              className="addr-input mono"
              aria-label={t("unpacker.xorKey")}
              placeholder="auto"
              value={keyHex}
              onChange={(e) => setKeyHex(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="view-label">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              aria-label={t("unpacker.dryRun")}
              checked={dryRun}
              onChange={(e) => setDryRun(e.target.checked)}
            />
            {t("unpacker.dryRunLabel")}
          </label>
          <div className="unpacker-buttons">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void run("unpack_xor")}
            >
              <Play size={11} /> {t("unpacker.unpackXor")}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void run("decode_strings")}
            >
              <Play size={11} /> {t("unpacker.decodeStrings")}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="row-action"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void run("full_pass")}
            >
              <Play size={11} /> {t("unpacker.fullPass")}
            </button>
          </div>
          {error !== null && (
            <div className="error-text" role="alert">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
          {note !== null && (
            <div className="unpacker-note" role="status">
              {note}
            </div>
          )}
          {last?.steps !== undefined && (
            <div className="unpacker-steps">
              {last.steps.map((s) => (
                <div key={s.step} className="unpacker-row">
                  <span className="mono">{s.step}</span>
                  <span className={s.success ? "unpacker-clean" : "error-text"}>
                    {s.success ? t("unpacker.ok") : t("unpacker.failed")}
                  </span>
                  <span className="faint">{s.note}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
              {last.score_reduction !== undefined && (
                <div className="faint">
                  {t("unpacker.scoreReduced", { score: last.score_reduction })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="stack">
        <div className="view-bar">
          <span className="panel-title">{t("unpacker.journal")}</span>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <span className="faint">{total}</span>
          <IconButton tip={t("unpacker.reloadJournal")} onClick={() => void loadJournal()}>
            <RefreshCw size={13} />
          </IconButton>
        </div>
        <div className="panel-body mono unpacker-journal">
          {journal.length === 0 && <div className="faint">{t("unpacker.noEdits")}</div>}
          {journal.map((p) => (
            <div key={p.va} className="unpacker-row">
              <span className="insn-va">{hex(p.va, 12)}</span>
              <span className="faint">{p.before.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase()}</span>
              <span>→</span>
              <span>{p.after.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase()}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          {total > journal.length && (
            <div className="faint">
              {t("unpacker.olderEdits", { count: total - journal.length })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/WorkspacePanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/WorkspacePanel.tsx
// The tabbed centre area, shared across ELF, PE, Mach-O and live-target views.

import { FolderOpen, ScanSearch, X } from "lucide-react";
import IconButton from "@/components/IconButton";
import Tabs, { panelId, tabId } from "@/components/Tabs";
import DisassemblyView from "@/components/panels/DisassemblyView";
import DecompView from "@/components/panels/DecompView";
import DebuggerView from "@/components/panels/DebuggerView";
import EmulatorPanel from "@/components/panels/EmulatorPanel";
import MemoryView from "@/components/panels/MemoryView";
import NetworkPanel from "@/components/panels/NetworkPanel";
import PatchPanel from "@/components/panels/PatchPanel";
import PeView from "@/components/panels/PeView";
import StringsView from "@/components/panels/StringsView";
import StructEditor from "@/components/panels/StructEditor";
import UnpackerView from "@/components/panels/UnpackerView";
import XrayPanel from "@/components/panels/XrayPanel";
import { useT } from "@/i18n";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";
import { browserLabel, formatLabel } from "@/lib/format";
import { openBinary } from "@/lib/openBinary";
import { useEngine } from "@/store/engine";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useUi, type WorkspaceTab } from "@/store/ui";

// Which tabs read the static analysis session and which need a live process.
// Getting this wrong is what made Memory and Debugger look broken behind a
// "no binary loaded" wall they never needed. The debugger renders its own
// console / attach states.
const kTabs: readonly {
  id: WorkspaceTab;
  labelKey: Key;
  needs: "image" | "target" | "none";
}[] = [
  { id: "disassembly", labelKey: "workspace.disassembly", needs: "image" },
  { id: "decomp", labelKey: "workspace.decomp", needs: "image" },
  { id: "strings", labelKey: "workspace.strings", needs: "image" },
  { id: "memory", labelKey: "workspace.memory", needs: "target" },
  { id: "debugger", labelKey: "workspace.debugger", needs: "none" },
  { id: "pe", labelKey: "workspace.imageBrowser", needs: "image" },
  { id: "structs", labelKey: "workspace.structs", needs: "image" },
  { id: "unpacker", labelKey: "workspace.unpacker", needs: "image" },
  { id: "xray", labelKey: "workspace.xray", needs: "image" },
  { id: "patch", labelKey: "workspace.patches", needs: "image" },
  { id: "network", labelKey: "workspace.network", needs: "none" },
  { id: "emulate", labelKey: "workspace.emulate", needs: "none" },
];

export default function WorkspacePanel() {
  const t = useT();
  const active = useUi((s) => s.workspaceTab);
  const setActive = useUi((s) => s.setWorkspaceTab);
  const target = useEngine((s) => s.target);
  const hype = useEngine((s) => s.hype);
  // The session is shared with agents, so the image can change without this
  // window doing anything; the engine store refreshes the mirror on
  // image.changed / hype.progress and on every reconnect
  const { image, busy, error, unload } = useDisasm();

  const tabLabel = (tab: (typeof kTabs)[number]) =>
    tab.id === "pe" ? browserLabel(image.format) : t(tab.labelKey);

  const body = () => {
    const tab = kTabs.find((item) => item.id === active);

    if (tab?.needs === "target" && !target.attached) {
      return (
        <div className="empty">
          <div className="empty-glyph">
            <ScanSearch size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
          </div>
          <div className="empty-title">{t("workspace.noTarget")}</div>
          <div className="empty-hint">{t("workspace.noTargetHint", { tab: t(tab.labelKey) })}</div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (tab?.needs === "image") {
      if (busy && !image.ready) {
        return (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-title">{t("common.loading")}</div>
          </div>
        );
      }
      if (!image.ready) {
        return (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-glyph">
              <ScanSearch size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            </div>
            <div className="empty-title">{t("workspace.noBinary")}</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">
              {target.attached ? t("workspace.noBinaryHintTarget") : t("workspace.noBinaryHint")}
            </div>
            <button type="button" className="row-action" onClick={() => void openBinary()}>
              <FolderOpen size={12} style={{ marginRight: 6, verticalAlign: -2 }} aria-hidden />
              {t("common.openBinary")}
            </button>
            {error !== null && (
              <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      }
    }

    switch (active) {
      case "disassembly":
        return <DisassemblyView />;
      case "decomp":
        return <DecompView />;
      case "strings":
        return <StringsView />;
      case "pe":
        return <PeView />;
      case "memory":
        return <MemoryView />;
      case "debugger":
        return <DebuggerView />;
      case "structs":
        return <StructEditor />;
      case "unpacker":
        return <UnpackerView />;
      case "xray":
        return <XrayPanel />;
      case "patch":
        return <PatchPanel />;
      case "network":
        return <NetworkPanel />;
      case "emulate":
        return <EmulatorPanel />;
    }
  };

  const warning =
    image.warning || (image.encrypted === true ? t("workspace.encrypted") : undefined);

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="tabs">
        <Tabs<WorkspaceTab>
          items={kTabs.map((tab) => ({ id: tab.id, label: tabLabel(tab) }))}
          active={active}
          onChange={setActive}
          label={t("workspace.views")}
          idPrefix="workspace"
        />
        <div className="spacer" />
        {image.ready && (
          <span className="faint workspace-meta">
            {image.name}
            {image.format !== undefined
              ? t("workspace.metaFormat", { format: formatLabel(image.format) })
              : ""}
            {image.arch !== undefined ? t("workspace.metaArch", { arch: image.arch }) : ""}
            {hype.running
              ? t("workspace.metaAnalyzing", { percent: Math.round(hype.progress * 100) })
              : ""}
          </span>
        )}
        <IconButton
          tip={image.ready ? t("workspace.closeBinary") : t("common.openBinary")}
          style={{ alignSelf: "center", marginRight: 6 }}
          onClick={() => void (image.ready ? unload() : openBinary())}
        >
          {image.ready ? <X size={14} /> : <FolderOpen size={14} />}
        </IconButton>
      </div>
      <div className="workspace-body">
        {image.ready && warning !== undefined && (
          <div className="workspace-warning" role="alert">
            {warning}
          </div>
        )}
        <div
          className="panel-body"
          style={{ overflow: "hidden" }}
          role="tabpanel"
          id={panelId("workspace", active)}
          aria-labelledby={tabId("workspace", active)}
        >
          {/* Keyed on the active tab so the enter animation replays on every
              switch rather than only on first mount. */}
          <div className="view-swap" key={active}>
            {body()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/components/panels/XrayPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
// app/src/components/panels/XrayPanel.tsx
// Read-only static-analysis passes (tool: xray) over the selected function or
// the whole image, one compact table per pass. A row with an address jumps to
// that address in the listing

import { useState } from "react";
import { ScanSearch } from "lucide-react";
import CfgGraph from "@/components/CfgGraph";
import { hex, parseAddress } from "@/lib/format";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useUi } from "@/store/ui";
import {
  kFunctionPasses,
  kHashAlgorithms,
  kXrayPasses,
  useXray,
  type XrayPass,
} from "@/store/xray";

const kRangePasses: readonly XrayPass[] = ["entropy", "pages", "crypto_range"];
const kLimitedPasses: readonly XrayPass[] = ["entropy", "pages", "crypto_range", "gadgets"];

const kLabels: Record<XrayPass, string> = {
  cfg: "CFG",
  complexity: "Complexity",
  cff: "Flattening",
  obfuscation: "Obfuscation",
  strings_recon: "String recon",
  indirect_calls: "Indirect calls",
  anti_analysis: "Anti-analysis",
  hooks: "Hooks",
  syscalls: "Syscalls",
  apihash: "API hashes",
  entropy: "Entropy",
  pages: "Pages",
  crypto_range: "Crypto constants",
  gadgets: "Gadgets",
};

export default function XrayPanel() {
  const selected = useDisasm((s) => s.selected);
  const { action, table, summary, graph, note, busy, error, run } = useXray();
  const [addrText, setAddrText] = useState("");
  const [size, setSize] = useState("4096");
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState("64");
  const [algorithm, setAlgorithm] = useState<string>(kHashAlgorithms[0]);
  const [hash, setHash] = useState("");

  const typed = parseAddress(addrText);
  const addr = typed ?? selected ?? undefined;

  const go = (va: number) => {
    useUi.getState().setWorkspaceTab("disassembly");
    void useDisasm.getState().gotoAddress(va);
  };

  const runPass = (pass: XrayPass) => {
    const params: Record<string, number | string> = {};
    if (kFunctionPasses.includes(pass)) {
      if (addr === undefined) return;
      params.addr = addr;
    }
    // size is a scan length only for the range passes; syscalls would read it
    // as a VA+size window from 0, and the rest ignore it
    const sizeValue = Number.parseInt(size, 10);
    if (kRangePasses.includes(pass) && Number.isFinite(sizeValue) && sizeValue > 0)
      params.size = sizeValue;
    const limitValue = Number.parseInt(limit, 10);
    if (kLimitedPasses.includes(pass) && Number.isFinite(limitValue) && limitValue > 0)
      params.limit = limitValue;
    if (pass === "apihash") {
      params.algorithm = algorithm;
      if (hash.trim() !== "") params.hash = hash.trim();
    }
    void run(pass, params);
  };

  const needsAddr = action !== null && kFunctionPasses.includes(action);

  return (
    <div className="panel tool-panel">
      <div className="panel-head">
        <span className="panel-title">X-ray</span>
        <div className="spacer" />
        <span className="faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--type-small)" }}>
          read-only
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body tool-body">
        <div className="tool-form">
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 110 }}
            aria-label="Function address (hex)"
            placeholder={selected === null ? "function VA" : hex(selected, 1)}
            value={addrText}
            onChange={(e) => setAddrText(e.target.value)}
          />
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            size
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              style={{ width: 72 }}
              aria-label="Scan size"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={size}
              onChange={(e) => setSize(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="faint tool-field">
            limit
            <input
              className="addr-input"
              style={{ width: 60 }}
              aria-label="Result limit"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={limit}
              onChange={(e) => setLimit(e.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <select
            className="select"
            aria-label="Hash algorithm"
            value={algorithm}
            onChange={(e) => setAlgorithm(e.target.value)}
          >
            {kHashAlgorithms.map((a) => (
              <option key={a} value={a}>
                {a}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <input
            className="addr-input mono"
            style={{ width: 140 }}
            aria-label="API hash or name"
            placeholder="hash / API name"
            value={hash}
            onChange={(e) => setHash(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="tool-grid" role="group" aria-label="X-ray passes">
          {kXrayPasses.map((pass) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={pass}
              className="row-action"
              data-active={action === pass}
              disabled={busy || (kFunctionPasses.includes(pass) && addr === undefined)}
              onClick={() => runPass(pass)}
            >
              {kLabels[pass]}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {busy && <div className="tool-summary faint">Running…</div>}
        {error !== null && (
          <div className="empty-hint error-text" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        {note !== "" && <div className="tool-summary faint">{note}</div>}

        {table !== null && (
          <>
            <div className="tool-summary faint">
              {kLabels[action as XrayPass]}: {summary}
            </div>
            {graph !== null && (
              <div className="xray-graph">
                <CfgGraph graph={graph} entry={needsAddr ? addr : undefined} onPick={go} />
              </div>
            )}
            <table className="table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {table.columns.map((c) => (
                    <th key={c} scope="col">
                      {c}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {table.rows.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr key={`${row.addr ?? "row"}-${i}`} data-severity={row.severity ?? "ok"}>
                    {row.cells.map((cell, j) => (
                      <td key={j} className={j === 0 ? "mono" : undefined}>
                        {j === 0 && row.addr !== undefined ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="link-button mono"
                            onClick={() => go(row.addr as number)}
                          >
                            {cell}
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          cell
                        )}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {table.rows.length === 0 && (
              <div className="empty-hint" style={{ padding: "var(--pad-md)" }}>
                No rows for this pass.
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {table === null && !busy && error === null && (
          <div className="empty">
            <div className="empty-glyph">
              <ScanSearch size={28} strokeWidth={1.5} />
            </div>
            <div className="empty-title">Pick a pass.</div>
            <div className="empty-hint">
              Function passes use the address above, or the listing selection. Image passes scan the
              loaded binary.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`app/src/i18n/index.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/i18n/index.ts
// Typed message catalog. `t()` reads the active language outside React;
// `useT()` subscribes a component so a language switch re-renders it. The
// language is a local preference (localStorage) because it must apply on the
// first paint, before the engine answers app.settings_get.

import { useCallback } from "react";
import { create } from "zustand";
import { de } from "@/i18n/de";
import { en, type Key } from "@/i18n/en";

export type { Key };

export type Language = "en" | "de";

export type Params = Record<string, string | number>;

export const kLanguages: readonly { id: Language; label: string }[] = [
  { id: "en", label: "English" },
  { id: "de", label: "Deutsch" },
];

const kCatalog: Record<Language, Record<Key, string>> = { en, de };

const kStorageKey = "reverse-slop.language";

function initial(): Language {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(kStorageKey);
  return saved === "en" || saved === "de" ? saved : "en";
}

function apply(language: Language): void {
  // Screen readers and hyphenation follow the document language. The catalog is
  // also imported by stores that run without a DOM (SSR smoke test, workers)
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  document.documentElement.lang = language;
}

/** Interpolate `{name}` placeholders; an unknown one stays verbatim. */
export function translate(language: Language, key: Key, params?: Params): string {
  const text = kCatalog[language][key];
  if (params === undefined) return text;
  return text.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, name: string) =>
    params[name] === undefined ? match : String(params[name]),
  );
}

type I18nStore = {
  language: Language;
  setLanguage: (language: Language) => void;
};

export const useI18n = create<I18nStore>((set) => {
  const language = initial();
  apply(language);
  return {
    language,
    setLanguage: (next) => {
      apply(next);
      localStorage.setItem(kStorageKey, next);
      set({ language: next });
    },
  };
});

/** Message in the active language, for code outside a render. */
export function t(key: Key, params?: Params): string {
  return translate(useI18n.getState().language, key, params);
}

/** `t` bound to the active language; the caller re-renders on a switch. */
export function useT(): (key: Key, params?: Params) => string {
  const language = useI18n((s) => s.language);
  return useCallback((key: Key, params?: Params) => translate(language, key, params), [language]);
}
```

`app/src/lib/clipboard.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/clipboard.ts
// copy to clipboard with a hidden textarea fallback for stubborn webviews

export async function copyText(text: string): Promise<void> {
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      return;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to the legacy path rather than failing the copy
    }
  }

  const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
  ta.value = text;
  // Off-screen and inert: present in the layout so it can be selected, but
  // never visible and never part of a tab order
  ta.style.position = "fixed";
  ta.style.opacity = "0";
  ta.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.select();
  try {
    if (!document.execCommand("copy")) throw new Error("execCommand copy returned false");
  } finally {
    ta.remove();
  }
}
```

`app/src/lib/endpoint.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/endpoint.ts
// where the engine is, the tauri command first, then the well known port for
// plain browser dev. Also the supervisor contract: deadline, status, restart
// and the crash / restart events (app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs)

import { setEndpoint, type Endpoint, health } from "./rpc";
import { invoke, isTauri as inTauri } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { listen } from "@tauri-apps/api/event";

const kDefaultPort = 8765;

/** Matches the supervisor's UAC handshake wait; asked from it when available. */
export const kDefaultStartupDeadlineMs = 180_000;

export const isTauri = (): boolean => typeof window !== "undefined" && inTauri();

/**
 * Browser dev mode connects to whatever answers on 127.0.0.1:8765 without a
 * handshake. The engine only accepts a tokenless request when it was started
 * with --insecure-dev (audit 103), so nothing proves that listener is ours and
 * the shell shows a visible badge while it is in effect.
 */
export const isInsecureDev = (): boolean => !isTauri();

export async function resolveEndpoint(): Promise<Endpoint> {
  if (isTauri()) {
    // SDK IPC is available even when withGlobalTauri is disabled. Native
    // failures must not silently connect to an unrelated default-port engine.
    // While the supervisor is restarting a crashed engine this blocks until the
    // new one has handshaken (or rejects once the supervisor gives up).
    const ep = await invoke<Partial<Endpoint>>("engine_endpoint");
    const port = ep?.port;
    const token = ep?.token;
    if (
      typeof port !== "number" ||
      !Number.isInteger(port) ||
      port < 1 ||
      port > 65535 ||
      typeof token !== "string"
    ) {
      throw new Error("invalid engine endpoint from native bridge");
    }
    const resolved: Endpoint = { port, token };
    setEndpoint(resolved);
    return resolved;
  }

  // Browser dev mode: the well-known port, or VITE_SLOP_PORT / VITE_SLOP_TOKEN
  // from app/.env.local for an engine with a non-default port or a token
  const envPort = Number(import.meta.env.VITE_SLOP_PORT);
  const envToken = import.meta.env.VITE_SLOP_TOKEN;
  const fallback: Endpoint = {
    port: Number.isInteger(envPort) && envPort > 0 && envPort < 65536 ? envPort : kDefaultPort,
    token: typeof envToken === "string" ? envToken : "",
  };
  setEndpoint(fallback);
  return fallback;
}

/** How long the UI waits for /health; the supervisor owns the number. */
export async function startupDeadlineMs(): Promise<number> {
  if (!isTauri()) return kDefaultStartupDeadlineMs;
  try {
    const ms = await invoke<number>("startup_deadline_ms");
    return typeof ms === "number" && Number.isFinite(ms) && ms > 0 ? ms : kDefaultStartupDeadlineMs;
  } catch {
    return kDefaultStartupDeadlineMs;
  }
}

export type EnginePhase = "starting" | "running" | "restarting" | "failed" | "stopped";

export type EngineStatus = {
  phase: EnginePhase;
  generation: number;
  restarts: number;
  port: number | null;
  last_error: string | null;
  log_path: string;
};

/** Supervisor view of the engine process, null outside the Tauri shell. */
export async function engineStatus(): Promise<EngineStatus | null> {
  if (!isTauri()) return null;
  try {
    return await invoke<EngineStatus>("engine_status");
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Re-arm the supervisor (after it gave up) or restart a running engine. */
export async function restartEngine(): Promise<void> {
  if (!isTauri()) return;
  await invoke("restart_engine");
}

export type EngineCrash = {
  reason: string;
  exit_code: number | null;
  restarts: number;
  /** null: the supervisor gave up after too many fast crashes. */
  retry_in_ms: number | null;
  log_path: string;
};

export type EngineLifecycle = {
  onCrashed: (crash: EngineCrash) => void;
  onRestarted: (info: { port: number; generation: number }) => void;
};

/** Subscribe to supervisor events. Resolves to an unsubscribe function. */
export async function onEngineLifecycle(handlers: EngineLifecycle): Promise<() => void> {
  if (!isTauri()) return () => undefined;
  const offCrash = await listen<EngineCrash>("engine-crashed", (e) =>
    handlers.onCrashed(e.payload),
  );
  const offRestart = await listen<{ port: number; generation: number }>("engine-restarted", (e) =>
    handlers.onRestarted(e.payload),
  );
  return () => {
    offCrash();
    offRestart();
  };
}

/** Poll /health until the engine answers or the deadline passes. */
export async function waitForEngine(timeoutMs = kDefaultStartupDeadlineMs): Promise<boolean> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (await health()) return true;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250));
  }
  return false;
}
```

`app/src/lib/events.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/events.ts
// eventsource wrapper over the engine stream, the engine pushes state
// changes and this hands them to subscribers

import { baseUrl, call, getEndpoint } from "./rpc";

export type ImageFormat = "pe" | "macho" | "elf" | "self";

export type EngineEvent =
  | { type: "hello"; data: { output_revision: number } }
  | { type: "output"; data: { seq: number; ms: number; text: string } }
  | { type: "output.cleared"; data: Record<string, never> }
  | {
      type: "boot.stage";
      data: { stage: number; total: number; label: string; done: boolean };
    }
  | {
      type: "target.changed";
      data: { attached: boolean; pid?: number; name?: string };
    }
  | { type: "backend.changed"; data: { badge: string; ps4: boolean } }
  | {
      type: "hype.progress";
      data: {
        has_image: boolean;
        image: string;
        present: boolean;
        ready: boolean;
        running: boolean;
        progress: number;
        error: string;
      };
    }
  | { type: "image.changed"; data: { loaded: boolean; name?: string; format?: ImageFormat } }
  | { type: "types.changed"; data: { generation: number } }
  | { type: "watch.list"; data: { entries: WatchEntry[] } }
  | { type: "watch.values"; data: { attached: boolean; values: WatchValue[] } }
  | { type: "debugger.stop"; data: DebuggerStop }
  | { type: "debugger.state"; data: DebuggerState }
  | { type: "debugger.log"; data: DebuggerLog }
  | { type: "app.quitting"; data: { reason: string } }
  | { type: "server.stopping"; data: Record<string, never> };

/** Pushed when the console debugger stops (breakpoint, watchpoint, step, signal). */
export type DebuggerStop = {
  lwpid: number;
  signal: number;
  status?: number;
  thread?: string;
  rip?: number;
  rsp?: number;
  rbp?: number;
  [reg: string]: number | string | undefined;
};

export type DebuggerState = {
  attached: boolean;
  pid: number;
  held?: boolean;
  reason?: string;
};

/** One log-breakpoint line (also appended to the output panel). */
export type DebuggerLog = { lwpid: number; rip: number; rip_hex: string; text: string };

export type WatchEntry = {
  id: number;
  addr: number;
  width: string;
  label: string;
  freeze: boolean;
  frozen_bits: number;
  frozen_text: string;
  /** Per-entry service rate in ms (default 100). */
  interval_ms?: number;
};

export type WatchValue = {
  id: number;
  addr: number;
  ok: boolean;
  held: boolean;
  bits: number;
  text: string;
};

export type EventName = EngineEvent["type"];
type Handler = (data: unknown) => void;

const kEventNames: EventName[] = [
  "hello",
  "output",
  "output.cleared",
  "boot.stage",
  "target.changed",
  "backend.changed",
  "hype.progress",
  "image.changed",
  "types.changed",
  "watch.list",
  "watch.values",
  "debugger.stop",
  "debugger.state",
  "debugger.log",
  "app.quitting",
  "server.stopping",
];

/** Reconnect delay grows on repeated failures so a dead engine is not hammered. */
const kRetryMinMs = 1_000;
const kRetryMaxMs = 8_000;

const handlers = new Map<EventName, Set<Handler>>();
let source: EventSource | null = null;
let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
let retry: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
let retryDelay = kRetryMinMs;
let isOpen = false;
/** Bumped by every connect/disconnect so stale async work can tell it lost. */
let generation = 0;
let reconnectHook: (() => Promise<void>) | null = null;
const statusHandlers = new Set<(open: boolean) => void>();

function emitValue(name: EventName, value: unknown): void {
  const set = handlers.get(name);
  if (!set || set.size === 0) return;
  for (const fn of set) fn(value);
}

function emit(name: EventName, raw: string): void {
  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return;
  }
  emitValue(name, parsed);
}

/** Subscribe to one event name. Returns an unsubscribe function. */
export function on<K extends EventName>(
  name: K,
  fn: (data: Extract<EngineEvent, { type: K }>["data"]) => void,
): () => void {
  const set = handlers.get(name) ?? new Set<Handler>();
  set.add(fn as Handler);
  handlers.set(name, set);
  return () => {
    set.delete(fn as Handler);
  };
}

/** Notified when the stream opens or drops, for the status-bar indicator. */
export function onConnectionChange(fn: (open: boolean) => void): () => void {
  statusHandlers.add(fn);
  return () => {
    statusHandlers.delete(fn);
  };
}

/**
 * Runs before every automatic reconnect. The Tauri shell uses it to re-resolve
 * the endpoint, a restarted engine can come back on a different port.
 */
export function setReconnectHook(fn: (() => Promise<void>) | null): void {
  reconnectHook = fn;
}

function setOpen(open: boolean): void {
  // A drop is reported once; every open is reported, each one is a fresh
  // stream and subscribers re-seed their snapshot on it
  if (!open && !isOpen) return;
  isOpen = open;
  for (const fn of statusHandlers) fn(open);
}

export function isConnected(): boolean {
  return isOpen;
}

function scheduleRetry(gen: number): void {
  if (retry !== null || gen !== generation) return;
  const delay = retryDelay;
  retryDelay = Math.min(kRetryMaxMs, retryDelay * 2);
  retry = setTimeout(() => {
    retry = null;
    if (gen !== generation) return;
    const hook = reconnectHook;
    if (hook === null) {
      connect();
      return;
    }
    hook()
      .catch(() => undefined)
      .finally(() => {
        if (gen === generation) connect();
      });
  }, delay);
}

function streamUrl(ticket: string | null, ws: boolean): string {
  const base = ws ? baseUrl().replace(/^http/, "ws") : baseUrl();
  const path = ws ? "/api/v1/events/ws" : "/api/v1/events";
  return ticket === null ? `${base}${path}` : `${base}${path}?ticket=${encodeURIComponent(ticket)}`;
}

function openSse(gen: number, ticket: string | null): void {
  const es = new EventSource(streamUrl(ticket, false));
  source = es;
  es.onopen = () => {
    retryDelay = kRetryMinMs;
    setOpen(true);
  };
  es.onerror = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    // The engine may still be booting, or was restarted. A ticket is single
    // use, so the browser's own auto-reconnect cannot work: close and come
    // back through connect() with a fresh one
    if (source !== es) return;
    es.close();
    source = null;
    scheduleRetry(gen);
  };
  for (const name of kEventNames) {
    es.addEventListener(name, (ev) => emit(name, (ev as MessageEvent<string>).data));
  }
}

/**
 * The engine serves the same stream over a websocket, which skips chunked SSE
 * parsing and gives the server a real close handshake. An engine that predates
 * the route answers 404 without spending the ticket, so the first failure
 * silently falls back to SSE. A constructor that throws (a CSP without ws:,
 * no WebSocket at all) never sent the ticket, so SSE reuses it.
 */
function openWs(gen: number, ticket: string | null): void {
  let ws: WebSocket;
  try {
    ws = new WebSocket(streamUrl(ticket, true));
  } catch {
    openSse(gen, ticket);
    return;
  }
  socket = ws;
  let opened = false;
  ws.onopen = () => {
    opened = true;
    retryDelay = kRetryMinMs;
    setOpen(true);
  };
  ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
    let msg: { event?: unknown; data?: unknown };
    try {
      msg = JSON.parse(String(ev.data)) as { event?: unknown; data?: unknown };
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (typeof msg.event !== "string") return;
    if (!kEventNames.includes(msg.event as EventName)) return;
    emitValue(msg.event as EventName, msg.data);
  };
  ws.onclose = () => {
    if (socket !== ws) return;
    socket = null;
    setOpen(false);
    if (opened) {
      scheduleRetry(gen);
      return;
    }
    // never opened: no websocket on this engine, take the same stream over SSE
    fetchTicket()
      .then((t) => {
        if (gen === generation) openSse(gen, t);
      })
      .catch(() => scheduleRetry(gen));
  };
}

/**
 * EventSource cannot send an Authorization header. A token-protected engine
 * hands out a single-use, short-lived ticket over the authenticated /api, and
 * the stream URL carries only that, never the bearer token itself.
 */
function fetchTicket(): Promise<string | null> {
  if (getEndpoint().token === "") return Promise.resolve(null);
  return call<{ ticket?: string }>("app", "events_ticket", {}, { timeoutMs: 10_000 }).then(
    (res) => {
      if (typeof res.ticket !== "string" || res.ticket === "") throw new Error("no ticket");
      return res.ticket;
    },
  );
}

export function connect(): void {
  disconnect();
  const gen = ++generation;
  fetchTicket()
    .then((t) => {
      if (gen === generation) openWs(gen, t);
    })
    .catch(() => scheduleRetry(gen));
}

export function disconnect(): void {
  generation++;
  if (retry !== null) {
    clearTimeout(retry);
    retry = null;
  }
  if (source) {
    source.close();
    source = null;
  }
  if (socket) {
    socket.close();
    socket = null;
  }
  setOpen(false);
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/format.ts
// display helpers shared by the views: addresses, image formats, escaped text

import { t } from "@/i18n";
import type { ImageFormat } from "./events";

export function hex(va: number, pad = 16): string {
  return va.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(pad, "0");
}

/**
 * Canonical unnamed-function label, identical to the engine's
 * disasm::default_function_name(): VA in uppercase hex, no padding.
 */
export function defaultFunctionName(va: number): string {
  return `sub_${va.toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;
}

/**
 * Parse a user-typed address. Hex by default (with or without 0x, separators
 * like ` or _ allowed); returns null for anything that is not a non-negative
 * integer within the safe range.
 */
export function parseAddress(text: string): number | null {
  const clean = text
    .trim()
    .replace(/[`_\s]/g, "")
    .replace(/^0x/i, "");
  if (clean === "" || !/^[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(clean)) return null;
  const value = Number.parseInt(clean, 16);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) ? value : null;
}

/** Short format name for headers and the inspector. */
export function formatLabel(format: ImageFormat | undefined, pe32plus?: boolean): string {
  switch (format) {
    case "elf":
      return "ELF";
    case "self":
      return "SELF";
    case "macho":
      return "Mach-O";
    case "pe":
      return pe32plus === undefined ? "PE" : pe32plus ? "PE32+" : "PE32";
    default:
      return t("format.image");
  }
}

/** Title of the image-browser tab for the loaded format. */
export function browserLabel(format: ImageFormat | undefined): string {
  return t("format.browser", { format: formatLabel(format) });
}

const kEscapes: Record<string, string> = {
  "\n": "\\n",
  "\r": "\\r",
  "\t": "\\t",
  "\0": "\\0",
  "\\": "\\\\",
};

/**
 * Render a string one-line: control characters become C escapes so a string
 * containing a newline cannot spill into the next virtualized row.
 */
export function escapeControl(text: string): string {
  let out = "";
  for (const ch of text) {
    const mapped = kEscapes[ch];
    if (mapped !== undefined) {
      out += mapped;
      continue;
    }
    const code = ch.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;
    if (
      code < 0x20 ||
      code === 0x7f ||
      (code >= 0x80 && code < 0xa0) ||
      code === 0x2028 ||
      code === 0x2029
    ) {
      out +=
        code <= 0xff
          ? `\\x${code.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
          : `\\u${code.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")}`;
    } else {
      out += ch;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

`app/src/lib/help.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/help.ts
// In-app help search: the docs index `tools/gen_help_index.mjs` writes
// (`npm run help:index` -> src/generated/help-index.json), the ranking the
// command palette uses, and the URL a result opens. The index is a build
// artifact, so it is loaded lazily and a missing one just means no results

import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { openUrl } from "@/lib/shell";

export type HelpEntry = {
  title: string;
  anchor: string;
  section: string;
  text: string;
  url: string;
  path: string;
};

export type HelpIndex = {
  generated: string;
  source: string;
  count: number;
  entries: HelpEntry[];
};

/** mdBook site base (book.toml `site-url`); browser dev opens the page relative. */
const kDocsSite = "https://netvar1337.github.io/SlopStation/";

// glob, not a static import: the file is generated, and an unbuilt tree (fresh
// clone, `npx vitest` before `npm run help:index`) must still boot
const kIndexModules = import.meta.glob<HelpIndex>("../generated/help-index.json", {
  import: "default",
});

let pending: Promise<HelpEntry[]> | null = null;

/** The generated index entries, loaded once per session. Never hits the network. */
export function loadHelpIndex(): Promise<HelpEntry[]> {
  const load = Object.values(kIndexModules)[0];
  if (load === undefined) return Promise.resolve([]);
  pending ??= load().then(
    (index) => index.entries,
    () => [],
  );
  return pending;
}

/**
 * Rank entries against a query: every whitespace-separated term must match, and
 * a title hit outranks a section hit, which outranks body text. Ties keep the
 * book's reading order.
 */
export function searchHelp(entries: HelpEntry[], query: string, limit = 20): HelpEntry[] {
  const terms = query
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((t) => t !== "");
  if (terms.length === 0) return [];
  const hits: { entry: HelpEntry; score: number }[] = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const title = entry.title.toLowerCase();
    const section = entry.section.toLowerCase();
    const body = `${entry.text} ${entry.path}`.toLowerCase();
    let score = 0;
    let all = true;
    for (const term of terms) {
      if (title.includes(term)) score += 4;
      else if (section.includes(term)) score += 3;
      else if (body.includes(term)) score += 1;
      else {
        all = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (all) hits.push({ entry, score });
  }
  return hits
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .slice(0, limit)
    .map((h) => h.entry);
}

/** Where a result opens: the published site inside the shell, the page itself in dev. */
export function helpHref(url: string): string {
  return isTauri() ? kDocsSite + url : url;
}

/** Open a docs result in the default browser (new tab in browser dev). */
export async function openHelp(url: string): Promise<void> {
  await openUrl(helpHref(url));
}
```

`app/src/lib/icons.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/icons.ts
// process icon cache, the engine hands back raw bgra and the canvas turns it
// into a data url, requests deduped and batched

import { call } from "./rpc";

type IconBits = { width: number; height: number; bgra_b64?: string };

const cache = new Map<string, string | null>(); // path -> data URL, null = none
const pending = new Set<string>();
const waiters = new Set<() => void>();
let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

/** Notified when a batch resolves, so components can re-render. */
export function onIconsResolved(fn: () => void): () => void {
  waiters.add(fn);
  return () => {
    waiters.delete(fn);
  };
}

function toDataUrl(bits: IconBits): string | null {
  if (!bits.bgra_b64 || bits.width === 0 || bits.height === 0) return null;

  const binary = atob(bits.bgra_b64);
  const expected = bits.width * bits.height * 4;
  if (binary.length < expected) return null;

  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = bits.width;
  canvas.height = bits.height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (ctx === null) return null;

  const image = ctx.createImageData(bits.width, bits.height);
  // BGRA (Win32 DIB order) -> RGBA (ImageData order)
  for (let i = 0; i < expected; i += 4) {
    image.data[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i + 2);
    image.data[i + 1] = binary.charCodeAt(i + 1);
    image.data[i + 2] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    image.data[i + 3] = binary.charCodeAt(i + 3);
  }
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  return canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
}

async function flush(): Promise<void> {
  flushTimer = null;
  // The engine caps a single request at 64 paths; drain in chunks so a full
  // process list still resolves
  const batch = [...pending].slice(0, 64);
  if (batch.length === 0) return;
  for (const p of batch) pending.delete(p);

  try {
    const res = await call<{ icons: Record<string, IconBits> }>("target", "icon", {
      paths: batch,
    });
    for (const path of batch) {
      const bits = res.icons[path];
      cache.set(path, bits ? toDataUrl(bits) : null);
    }
  } catch {
    // Mark them resolved-as-missing so a failing path is not retried forever
    for (const path of batch) cache.set(path, null);
  }

  for (const fn of waiters) fn();
  if (pending.size > 0) schedule();
}

function schedule(): void {
  if (flushTimer !== null) return;
  // One frame of coalescing: a virtualized table asks for every visible row in
  // the same tick
  flushTimer = setTimeout(() => void flush(), 16);
}

/**
 * Data URL for a process image, or null when there is no icon. Returns
 * undefined while the lookup is still in flight, render a placeholder and wait
 * for onIconsResolved.
 */
export function iconFor(path: string | undefined): string | null | undefined {
  if (!path) return null;
  const hit = cache.get(path);
  if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
  if (!pending.has(path)) {
    pending.add(path);
    schedule();
  }
  return undefined;
}
```

`app/src/lib/layoutFile.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/layoutFile.ts
// Layout export/import file plumbing: the native save/open dialogs inside the
// Tauri shell, a download and a file picker in browser dev. The JSON shape and
// its validation live in store/ui.ts

import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { open as openDialog, save as saveDialog } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";

const kFileName = "slopstation-layout.json";
const kFilter = [{ name: "Layout JSON", extensions: ["json"] }];

/** Write the layout JSON to a file the user picks; null when cancelled. */
export async function saveLayoutFile(text: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!isTauri()) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" }));
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = kFileName;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    return kFileName;
  }
  const path = await saveDialog({ defaultPath: kFileName, filters: kFilter });
  if (path === null) return null;
  await invoke("write_text_file", { path, text });
  return path;
}

/** Read the layout file the user picks; null when cancelled. */
export async function readLayoutFile(): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!isTauri()) {
    const file = await pickFile();
    return file === null ? null : await file.text();
  }
  const path = await openDialog({ multiple: false, directory: false, filters: kFilter });
  if (typeof path !== "string") return null;
  return await invoke<string>("read_text_file", { path });
}

// `new Promise`, not `Promise.withResolvers`: the build targets chrome110,
// which predates it (tsconfig lib ES2022)
function pickFile(): Promise<File | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = ".json,application/json";
    input.onchange = () => resolve(input.files?.[0] ?? null);
    input.oncancel = () => resolve(null);
    input.click();
  });
}
```

`app/src/lib/rpc.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/rpc.ts
// thin transport over the engines /api/v1 surface, the ui and an ai agent drive
// exactly the same tool actions

export type Endpoint = { port: number; token: string };

export type ApiEnvelope<T> = { ok: boolean; data: T; id?: number | string };

/** Default per-request deadline. A wedged engine must never strand `busy`. */
export const kDefaultTimeoutMs = 30_000;

let endpoint: Endpoint = { port: 8765, token: "" };

export function setEndpoint(next: Endpoint): void {
  endpoint = next;
}

export function getEndpoint(): Endpoint {
  return endpoint;
}

export function baseUrl(): string {
  return `http://127.0.0.1:${endpoint.port}`;
}

function headers(): HeadersInit {
  const h: Record<string, string> = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
  if (endpoint.token) h["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${endpoint.token}`;
  return h;
}

/** Thrown when a tool reports failure; `tool`/`action` aid the error surface. */
export class ToolError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly tool: string,
    readonly action: string,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(`${tool}.${action}: ${message}`);
    this.name = "ToolError";
  }
}

/** Thrown when the engine does not answer within the request deadline. */
export class TimeoutError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly what: string,
    readonly timeoutMs: number,
  ) {
    super(`${what}: engine did not answer within ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s`);
    this.name = "TimeoutError";
  }
}

export type CallOptions = {
  /** Abort the request after this many milliseconds (default 30 s). */
  timeoutMs?: number;
};

type ToolFailure = { error?: string };

/** Message of any thrown value, for store error fields. */
export function errorText(e: unknown): string {
  return e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
}

async function post(body: unknown, what: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<unknown> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl()}/api/v1`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${what}: engine returned HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    if (controller.signal.aborted) throw new TimeoutError(what, timeoutMs);
    throw e;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

/** Invoke one action. Rejects with ToolError when the tool reports failure. */
export async function call<T>(
  tool: string,
  action: string,
  params?: Record<string, unknown>,
  options?: CallOptions,
): Promise<T> {
  const env = (await post(
    { tool, action, params: params ?? {} },
    `${tool}.${action}`,
    options?.timeoutMs ?? kDefaultTimeoutMs,
  )) as ApiEnvelope<T>;
  if (!env.ok) {
    const failure = env.data as ToolFailure | undefined;
    throw new ToolError(tool, action, failure?.error ?? "unknown failure");
  }
  return env.data;
}

export type BatchRequest = {
  tool: string;
  action: string;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

/**
 * One round trip for several unrelated reads, opening a view usually needs
 * status plus a list plus module info, and stacking those latencies is the
 * difference between a snappy first paint and a visibly staged one.
 * Per-request failures are returned rather than thrown; the caller decides.
 */
export async function batch(
  requests: readonly BatchRequest[],
  options?: CallOptions,
): Promise<ApiEnvelope<unknown>[]> {
  if (requests.length === 0) return [];
  const body = requests.map((r, i) => ({
    tool: r.tool,
    action: r.action,
    params: r.params ?? {},
    id: i,
  }));
  const res = await post(body, "batch", options?.timeoutMs ?? kDefaultTimeoutMs);
  if (!Array.isArray(res)) throw new Error("batch: engine returned a non-array reply");
  // Replies carry the request index as id; order by it so a reordering engine
  // cannot hand one request's data to another
  const out: ApiEnvelope<unknown>[] = requests.map(() => ({
    ok: false,
    data: { error: "missing from batch reply" },
  }));
  (res as ApiEnvelope<unknown>[]).forEach((env, i) => {
    const slot = typeof env.id === "number" ? env.id : i;
    if (slot >= 0 && slot < out.length) out[slot] = env;
  });
  return out;
}

/** Data of a batch slot, or undefined when that request failed. */
export function batchData<T>(env: ApiEnvelope<unknown> | undefined): T | undefined {
  return env !== undefined && env.ok ? (env.data as T) : undefined;
}

/** Liveness probe used while waiting for a spawned engine to come up. */
export async function health(timeoutMs = 2_000): Promise<boolean> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl()}/health`, { signal: controller.signal });
    return res.ok;
  } catch {
    return false;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

```

`app/src/lib/shell.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/lib/shell.ts
// OS file-manager hand-off for the two support paths: the engine log from the
// crash banner and the data dir from Settings (app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs)

import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { isTauri } from "@/lib/endpoint";

/** Reveal a file or open a folder in File Explorer. No-op in browser dev. */
export async function openPath(path: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!isTauri() || path === "") return;
  await invoke("open_path", { path });
}

/** Open an http(s) URL in the default browser; a new tab in browser dev. */
export async function openUrl(url: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!isTauri()) {
    window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
    return;
  }
  await invoke("open_url", { url });
}
```

```ts
// app/src/lib/shortcuts.ts
// Global keyboard shortcuts. One window-level keydown listener so every
// shortcut advertised in a menu or tooltip actually does something

import { useEffect } from "react";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";
import { openBinary } from "@/lib/openBinary";
import { useUi, type WorkspaceTab } from "@/store/ui";

export type Shortcut = { keys: string; labelKey: Key };

/** What the Help menu lists; keep in sync with `handle` below. */
export const kShortcuts: readonly Shortcut[] = [
  { keys: "Ctrl+K", labelKey: "shortcut.commandPalette" },
  { keys: "Ctrl+Shift+P", labelKey: "shortcut.commandPalette" },
  { keys: "Ctrl+G", labelKey: "shortcut.goto" },
  { keys: "Ctrl+O", labelKey: "shortcut.openBinary" },
  { keys: "Ctrl+,", labelKey: "shortcut.settings" },
  { keys: "Ctrl+1…5", labelKey: "shortcut.tabs" },
  { keys: "Ctrl+Alt+I", labelKey: "shortcut.inspector" },
];

const kTabByDigit: Record<string, WorkspaceTab> = {
  "1": "disassembly",
  "2": "strings",
  "3": "memory",
  "4": "debugger",
  "5": "pe",
};

/** Returns true when the event was a shortcut and has been handled. */
export function handleShortcut(e: KeyboardEvent): boolean {
  if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) return false;
  const ui = useUi.getState();
  const key = e.key.toLowerCase();

  if ((key === "k" && !e.shiftKey) || (key === "p" && e.shiftKey) || (key === "g" && !e.shiftKey)) {
    ui.setPaletteOpen(!ui.paletteOpen);
    return true;
  }
  if (e.altKey && key === "i") {
    ui.setInspectorOpen(!ui.inspectorOpen);
    return true;
  }
  if (e.altKey || e.shiftKey) return false;
  if (key === "o") {
    void openBinary();
    return true;
  }
  if (key === ",") {
    ui.openSettings();
    return true;
  }
  const tab = kTabByDigit[e.key];
  if (tab !== undefined) {
    ui.setWorkspaceTab(tab);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Install the global listener for the lifetime of the calling component. */
export function useShortcuts(): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.defaultPrevented || e.repeat) return;
      if (handleShortcut(e)) e.preventDefault();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, []);
}
```
