`app/src/store/debugger.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/debugger.ts
// PS4 live-debug control surface over the ps4debug-NG wire: attach/detach,
// run control, breakpoints/watchpoints, registers, callstack, event feed.
// Every call maps to a debugger ps4_* MCP action

import { create } from "zustand";
import * as events from "@/lib/events";
import { batch, batchData, call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type Ps4Status = {
  backend: string;
  ps4_connected: boolean;
  debug_attached: boolean;
  debug_pid: number;
  pending_events: number;
  /** Console firmware, e.g. "11.00" (debugger.ps4_status). */
  fw?: string;
  /** Stop events the engine discarded because its queue was full. */
  events_dropped?: number;
};

export type Regs = Record<string, number>;

export type Frame = {
  ret_addr?: number;
  frame_ptr?: number;
  snippet?: string;
  scanned?: boolean;
};

export type Ps4Event = {
  lwpid: number;
  signal: number;
  status?: number;
  thread?: string;
  rip?: number;
  dr?: number[];
};

/** `debugger.ps4_wait`: the stop event with its register context inline. */
export type WaitResult = Partial<Ps4Event> &
  Partial<Regs> & { halted: boolean; pending?: number; timeout_ms?: number };

/** A breakpoint/watchpoint slot; the engine adds the rule it keeps for it. */
export type SlotEntry = {
  addr: number;
  index: number;
  armed?: boolean;
  /** MCP session (or "ui") that armed the slot. */
  owner?: string;
  /** Stop only on the Nth hit (0 = every hit). */
  hits?: number;
  hit_mode?: string;
  /** Hits the engine has seen since the rule was armed. */
  count?: number;
  log?: string;
  condition?: string;
};

export type ScanHit = { addr: number; addr_hex?: string; value_hex?: string };

export type ScanState = {
  used: boolean;
  count?: number;
  base?: number;
  base_hex?: string;
  hits?: ScanHit[];
  truncated?: boolean;
  note?: string;
};

export type AppInfo = {
  pid: number;
  titleid?: string;
  contentid?: string;
  name?: string;
  app_ver?: string;
  running?: boolean;
};

export const kRegOrder = [
  "rip",
  "rsp",
  "rbp",
  "rax",
  "rbx",
  "rcx",
  "rdx",
  "rsi",
  "rdi",
  "r8",
  "r9",
  "r10",
  "r11",
  "r12",
  "r13",
  "r14",
  "r15",
  "flags",
] as const;

const kIdle: Ps4Status = {
  backend: "user",
  ps4_connected: false,
  debug_attached: false,
  debug_pid: 0,
  pending_events: 0,
};

const kMaxEvents = 200;

/** Register file out of an event / wait reply that carries the context inline. */
export function regsFrom(source: Record<string, unknown>): Regs | null {
  const regs: Regs = {};
  for (const name of kRegOrder) {
    const v = source[name];
    if (typeof v !== "number") return null;
    regs[name] = v;
  }
  return regs;
}

type DebuggerStore = {
  status: Ps4Status;
  regs: Regs | null;
  regsLwpid: number;
  frames: Frame[];
  events: Ps4Event[];
  breakpoints: SlotEntry[];
  watchpoints: SlotEntry[];
  scan: ScanState | null;
  app: AppInfo | null;
  error: string | null;
  /** Result line of the last wait ("halted lwp 101 sig 5" / "no stop in 5s"). */
  waitNote: string | null;
  /** Log-breakpoint lines pushed over /events, newest first. */
  logs: string[];
  busy: boolean;

  /** Subscribe to the pushed debugger events; returns the unsubscribe. */
  connectStream: () => () => void;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  attach: (pid: number) => Promise<void>;
  detach: () => Promise<void>;
  cont: () => Promise<void>;
  step: (lwpid: number) => Promise<void>;
  waitHalt: (timeoutMs: number) => Promise<void>;
  bpSet: (addr: number) => Promise<void>;
  bpClear: (addr: number) => Promise<void>;
  wpSet: (addr: number, type: number, len: number) => Promise<void>;
  wpClear: (addr: number) => Promise<void>;
  readRegs: (lwpid: number) => Promise<void>;
  readStack: (lwpid: number) => Promise<void>;
  scanFirst: (a: {
    addr: number;
    len: number;
    value_type: string;
    compare: string;
    value?: number | string;
    hex?: string;
  }) => Promise<void>;
  scanRescan: (compare: string, value?: number | string) => Promise<void>;
  scanAob: (
    addr: number,
    len: number,
    pattern: string,
  ) => Promise<{ found?: boolean; addr?: number; addr_hex?: string } | null>;
  scanReset: () => Promise<void>;
  scanRefreshInternal: () => Promise<void>;
  notify: (msg: string) => Promise<void>;
  readApp: () => Promise<void>;
  dumpModule: (name: string, path: string, load: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  reset: () => void;
};

export const useDebugger = create<DebuggerStore>((set, get) => {
  /** Run a mutating action with busy/error bookkeeping. */
  const guarded = async (fn: () => Promise<void>, busy = true): Promise<void> => {
    if (busy) set({ busy: true });
    try {
      await fn();
      set({ error: null });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      if (busy) set({ busy: false });
    }
  };

  return {
    status: kIdle,
    regs: null,
    regsLwpid: 0,
    frames: [],
    events: [],
    breakpoints: [],
    watchpoints: [],
    scan: null,
    app: null,
    error: null,
    waitNote: null,
    logs: [],
    busy: false,

    connectStream: () => {
      // the engine pushes every console stop over /events; the slow poll in
      // the view is only a fallback for a dropped stream
      const offStop = events.on("debugger.stop", (e) => {
        const ev: Ps4Event = {
          lwpid: e.lwpid,
          signal: e.signal,
          ...(e.status !== undefined ? { status: e.status } : {}),
          ...(e.thread !== undefined ? { thread: e.thread } : {}),
          ...(e.rip !== undefined ? { rip: e.rip } : {}),
        };
        const regs = regsFrom(e as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
        set((s) => ({
          events: [ev, ...s.events].slice(0, kMaxEvents),
          ...(regs !== null ? { regs, regsLwpid: ev.lwpid } : {}),
          waitNote: `stopped lwp ${ev.lwpid}${ev.thread ? ` (${ev.thread})` : ""} · signal ${ev.signal}`,
        }));
        if (regs === null) void get().readRegs(ev.lwpid);
        void get().readStack(ev.lwpid);
      });
      const offState = events.on("debugger.state", (e) => {
        set((s) => ({
          status: { ...s.status, debug_attached: e.attached, debug_pid: e.pid },
          ...(e.attached
            ? {}
            : { regs: null, frames: [], breakpoints: [], watchpoints: [], waitNote: null }),
        }));
      });
      const offLog = events.on("debugger.log", (e) => {
        set((s) => ({ logs: [e.text, ...s.logs].slice(0, 50) }));
      });
      return () => {
        offStop();
        offState();
        offLog();
      };
    },

    refresh: async () => {
      // One round trip for the whole view instead of six stacked ones;
      // per-request failures (not connected, not attached) come back inline
      try {
        const [st, ps4, bps, wps, evs, scan, app] = await batch([
          { tool: "debugger", action: "status" },
          { tool: "debugger", action: "ps4_status" },
          { tool: "debugger", action: "ps4_bp_list" },
          { tool: "debugger", action: "ps4_watch_list" },
          { tool: "debugger", action: "ps4_events", params: { max: 64, clear: true } },
          { tool: "debugger", action: "ps4_scan_state" },
          { tool: "debugger", action: "ps4_app" },
        ]);
        const base = batchData<Ps4Status>(st);
        if (base === undefined) throw new Error("debugger.status failed");
        const extra = batchData<{ fw?: string; events_dropped?: number }>(ps4);
        const status: Ps4Status = {
          ...base,
          ...(extra?.fw !== undefined ? { fw: extra.fw } : {}),
          ...(extra?.events_dropped !== undefined ? { events_dropped: extra.events_dropped } : {}),
        };
        set({
          status,
          error: null,
          scan: status.ps4_connected ? (batchData<ScanState>(scan) ?? null) : null,
          app: status.ps4_connected ? (batchData<AppInfo>(app) ?? null) : null,
        });
        if (!status.ps4_connected || !status.debug_attached) {
          set({ regs: null, frames: [], breakpoints: [], watchpoints: [] });
          return;
        }
        // ps4_events returns oldest first; the feed shows newest first
        const fresh = [...(batchData<{ events?: Ps4Event[] }>(evs)?.events ?? [])].reverse();
        set((s) => ({
          breakpoints: batchData<{ breakpoints?: SlotEntry[] }>(bps)?.breakpoints ?? [],
          watchpoints: batchData<{ watchpoints?: SlotEntry[] }>(wps)?.watchpoints ?? [],
          events: [...fresh, ...s.events].slice(0, kMaxEvents),
        }));
        // after a stop event, pull registers + callstack of the stopped thread
        const last = fresh[0];
        if (last !== undefined) {
          const inline = regsFrom(last as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
          if (inline !== null) set({ regs: inline, regsLwpid: last.lwpid });
          else await get().readRegs(last.lwpid);
          await get().readStack(last.lwpid);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        set({ status: kIdle, error: errorText(e) });
      }
    },

    attach: (pid) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_attach", { pid });
        await get().refresh();
      }),

    detach: async () => {
      try {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_detach");
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: errorText(e) });
      } finally {
        set({ regs: null, frames: [], breakpoints: [], watchpoints: [], waitNote: null });
        await get().refresh();
      }
    },

    cont: () =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_continue", { stop: 0 });
        set({ regs: null, frames: [], waitNote: null });
      }),

    step: (lwpid) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_step", { lwpid });
      }),

    waitHalt: (timeoutMs) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        // ps4_wait pops the stop event off the engine queue, so the result IS
        // the halt: render it directly. A refresh afterwards would drain an
        // already-empty queue and never show the registers
        const res = await call<WaitResult>(
          "debugger",
          "ps4_wait",
          { timeout_ms: timeoutMs },
          { timeoutMs: timeoutMs + 15_000 },
        );
        set((s) => ({
          status: { ...s.status, pending_events: res.pending ?? s.status.pending_events },
        }));
        if (!res.halted || res.lwpid === undefined) {
          set({ waitNote: `no stop event within ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s` });
          return;
        }
        const ev: Ps4Event = {
          lwpid: res.lwpid,
          signal: res.signal ?? 0,
          ...(res.status !== undefined ? { status: res.status } : {}),
          ...(res.thread !== undefined ? { thread: res.thread } : {}),
          ...(res.rip !== undefined ? { rip: res.rip } : {}),
          ...(res.dr !== undefined ? { dr: res.dr } : {}),
        };
        const regs = regsFrom(res as Record<string, unknown>);
        set((s) => ({
          events: [ev, ...s.events].slice(0, kMaxEvents),
          regs,
          regsLwpid: ev.lwpid,
          waitNote: `halted lwp ${ev.lwpid}${ev.thread ? ` (${ev.thread})` : ""} · signal ${ev.signal}`,
        }));
        if (regs === null) await get().readRegs(ev.lwpid);
        await get().readStack(ev.lwpid);
      }),

    bpSet: (addr) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_bp_set", { addr });
        await get().refresh();
      }, false),

    bpClear: (addr) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_bp_clear", { addr });
        set((s) => ({ breakpoints: s.breakpoints.filter((b) => b.addr !== addr) }));
      }, false),

    wpSet: (addr, type, len) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_watch_set", { addr, type, len });
        await get().refresh();
      }, false),

    wpClear: (addr) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_watch_clear", { addr });
        set((s) => ({ watchpoints: s.watchpoints.filter((w) => w.addr !== addr) }));
      }, false),

    readRegs: async (lwpid) => {
      try {
        const regs = await call<Regs>("debugger", "ps4_regs", { lwpid });
        set({ regs, regsLwpid: lwpid, error: null });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ regs: null, error: errorText(e) });
      }
    },

    readStack: async (lwpid) => {
      try {
        const stack = await call<{ frames?: Frame[] }>("debugger", "ps4_callstack", {
          lwpid,
          depth: 32,
        });
        set({ frames: stack.frames ?? [] });
      } catch {
        set({ frames: [] });
      }
    },

    scanFirst: (a) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_scan", a, { timeoutMs: 300_000 });
        await get().scanRefreshInternal();
      }),

    scanRescan: (compare, value) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        const args: Record<string, unknown> = { compare };
        if (value !== undefined) args.value = value;
        await call("debugger", "ps4_rescan", args, { timeoutMs: 300_000 });
        await get().scanRefreshInternal();
      }),

    scanAob: async (addr, len, pattern) => {
      set({ busy: true });
      try {
        const r = await call<{ found?: boolean; addr?: number; addr_hex?: string }>(
          "debugger",
          "ps4_scan_aob",
          { addr, len, pattern },
          { timeoutMs: 300_000 },
        );
        set({ error: null });
        return r;
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: errorText(e) });
        return null;
      } finally {
        set({ busy: false });
      }
    },

    scanReset: () =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_scan_reset");
        set({ scan: null });
      }, false),

    scanRefreshInternal: async () => {
      try {
        const scan = await call<ScanState>("debugger", "ps4_scan_state");
        set({ scan });
      } catch {
        set({ scan: null });
      }
    },

    notify: (msg) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("debugger", "ps4_notify", { msg });
      }, false),

    readApp: async () => {
      try {
        const app = await call<AppInfo>("debugger", "ps4_app");
        set({ app });
      } catch {
        set({ app: null });
      }
    },

    dumpModule: (name, path, load) =>
      guarded(async () => {
        await call("target", "ps4_dump_module", { name, path, load }, { timeoutMs: 600_000 });
      }),

    reset: () =>
      set({
        status: kIdle,
        regs: null,
        regsLwpid: 0,
        frames: [],
        events: [],
        breakpoints: [],
        watchpoints: [],
        scan: null,
        app: null,
        waitNote: null,
        logs: [],
        error: null,
      }),
  };
});

```

`app/src/store/decomp.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/decomp.ts
// Pseudocode view state: the decompiled function, its control-flow graph and
// the split toggle. The CFG comes from disasm.blocks (same shape as
// xray.cfg's graph) because decomp.function returns lines, not blocks

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

/** One emitted pseudocode line; `va` is 0 for lines with no instruction. */
export type DecompLine = { va: number; text: string };
/** Callee parameter types recovered at one direct call. */
export type CallSite = { va: number; arg_types: string[] };

export type CfgNode = {
  id: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  size: number;
  insn_count: number;
  /** First instruction of the block, when the engine sent one. */
  summary?: string;
};
export type CfgEdge = { from: number; to: number; kind: string };
export type CfgGraphData = { nodes: CfgNode[]; edges: CfgEdge[] };

/** Above this the layered layout is unreadable, so the view refuses it. */
export const kMaxCfgBlocks = 500;

type DecompReply = {
  signature?: string;
  callconv?: string;
  function_va?: number;
  insn_count?: number;
  call_sites?: CallSite[];
  types_generation?: number;
  lines?: DecompLine[];
};

type BlocksReply = { entry?: number; graph?: CfgGraphData };

type DecompStore = {
  /** Function being shown; null until one is picked. */
  va: number | null;
  signature: string;
  callconv: string;
  insnCount: number;
  callSites: CallSite[];
  /** re::type_catalog generation the listing was built against. */
  typesGeneration: number | null;
  lines: DecompLine[];
  graph: CfgGraphData | null;
  entry: number | null;
  /** Code + CFG side by side. */
  split: boolean;
  /** Type name the user clicked; there is no struct editor yet. */
  selectedType: string | null;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;

  load: (va: number) => Promise<void>;
  /** Re-run the current function (types.changed invalidates the listing). */
  reload: () => Promise<void>;
  setSplit: (split: boolean) => void;
  selectType: (name: string | null) => void;
};

const kEmpty = {
  signature: "",
  callconv: "",
  insnCount: 0,
  callSites: [] as CallSite[],
  typesGeneration: null,
  lines: [] as DecompLine[],
  graph: null,
  entry: null,
};

export const useDecomp = create<DecompStore>((set, get) => ({
  va: null,
  ...kEmpty,
  split: false,
  selectedType: null,
  busy: false,
  error: null,

  load: async (va) => {
    set({ va, busy: true, error: null, selectedType: null });
    // The CFG is a separate tool and may be unavailable (no hyperion); a
    // missing graph must not hide the pseudocode that did come back
    const [code, blocks] = await Promise.all([
      call<DecompReply>("decomp", "function", { addr: va }).then(
        (r) => ({ ok: true as const, r }),
        (e: unknown) => ({ ok: false as const, e }),
      ),
      call<BlocksReply>("disasm", "blocks", { addr: va }).catch(() => null),
    ]);
    if (get().va !== va) return; // a newer request won
    if (!code.ok) {
      set({ ...kEmpty, busy: false, error: errorText(code.e) });
      return;
    }
    const r = code.r;
    set({
      signature: r.signature ?? "",
      callconv: r.callconv ?? "",
      insnCount: r.insn_count ?? 0,
      callSites: r.call_sites ?? [],
      typesGeneration: r.types_generation ?? null,
      lines: r.lines ?? [],
      graph: blocks?.graph ?? null,
      entry: blocks?.entry ?? r.function_va ?? null,
      busy: false,
      error: null,
    });
  },

  reload: async () => {
    const va = get().va;
    if (va !== null) await get().load(va);
  },

  setSplit: (split) => set({ split }),
  selectType: (selectedType) => set({ selectedType }),
}));

```

`app/src/store/disasm.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/disasm.ts
// the shared analysis session, a binary opened here is the binary an agent sees

import { create } from "zustand";
import type { ImageFormat } from "@/lib/events";
import { defaultFunctionName, hex } from "@/lib/format";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

export { hex };
export type { ImageFormat };

export type FunctionRow = {
  va: number;
  size: number;
  symbol?: string;
  name?: string;
  blocks?: number;
  callconv?: string;
  loops?: number;
  noreturn?: boolean;
};

export type Insn = {
  va: number;
  len: number;
  text: string;
  flow: string;
  target?: number;
  rip_rel?: number;
};

export type ImageArch = "x86" | "x64" | "arm" | "arm64";

export type LoadedImage = {
  ready: boolean;
  // Optional for engines predating Mach-O / ELF support.
  format?: ImageFormat;
  arch?: ImageArch;
  encrypted?: boolean;
  warning?: string;
  bundle?: {
    app_dir: string;
    executable: string;
    executable_path: string;
    bundle_id: string;
    version: string;
    build: string;
    min_os: string;
  };
  name?: string;
  path?: string;
  base?: number;
  entry_va?: number;
  functions?: number;
  strings?: number;
  hype?: { available: boolean; ready?: boolean; progress?: number; error?: string };
};

export type StringHit = { va: number; text: string; utf16: boolean };

/** Rows per `disasm.functions` page; the list fetches pages as they scroll in. */
export const kFnPageSize = 512;
/** Typing in the filter box waits this long before asking the engine. */
export const kFilterDebounceMs = 150;

type FunctionsReply = {
  functions?: FunctionRow[];
  total?: number;
  matched?: number;
  returned?: number;
};

type DisasmStore = {
  image: LoadedImage;
  /** Every function the index knows. */
  total: number;
  /** Functions matching the current filter (== total when unfiltered). */
  matched: number;
  /** Loaded pages of the filtered list, keyed by page index. */
  pages: Record<number, FunctionRow[]>;
  /** Bumped on every filter/image change; stale page replies are dropped. */
  query: number;
  selected: number | null;
  /** The selected row, kept even when its page scrolls out of the cache. */
  selectedFn: FunctionRow | null;
  insns: Insn[];
  /** True when the listing ran past the function bounds (unreliable size). */
  linear: boolean;
  filter: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** Last hyperion-ready state seen on the event stream, for edge detection. */
  hypeReady: boolean;

  setFilter: (v: string) => void;
  /** Re-read the image summary; `force` treats it as a new binary even if the path matches. */
  refreshLoaded: (force?: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  loadFile: (path: string) => Promise<void>;
  unload: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshFunctions: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Make sure rows [start, end] of the filtered list are loaded. */
  ensureRows: (start: number, end: number) => void;
  /** Server-side name/address search, for the command palette. */
  searchFunctions: (text: string, limit: number) => Promise<FunctionRow[]>;
  /** Fed by the engine's `hype.progress` stream (see store/engine.ts). */
  onHypeProgress: (ready: boolean, hasImage: boolean) => void;
  /** Fed by the engine's `image.changed` stream. */
  onImageChanged: (loaded: boolean) => void;
  select: (va: number, row?: FunctionRow) => Promise<void>;
  gotoAddress: (va: number) => Promise<void>;
  rename: (va: number, name: string) => Promise<void>;

  strings: StringHit[];
  stringsTruncated: boolean;
  loadStrings: (minChars: number, includeExec: boolean) => Promise<void>;
};

/** Display name: user symbol, then engine name, then the canonical sub_ label. */
export function functionLabel(fn: FunctionRow): string {
  return fn.symbol ?? fn.name ?? defaultFunctionName(fn.va);
}

/** Row `index` of the filtered list, or undefined while its page loads. */
export function rowAt(s: Pick<DisasmStore, "pages">, index: number): FunctionRow | undefined {
  return s.pages[Math.floor(index / kFnPageSize)]?.[index % kFnPageSize];
}

function loadedRows(s: Pick<DisasmStore, "pages">): FunctionRow[] {
  return Object.values(s.pages).flat();
}

/** Identity of a loaded image; a change means a different binary is open. */
function imageKey(image: LoadedImage): string {
  return image.ready ? `${image.path ?? image.name ?? ""}|${image.base ?? 0}` : "";
}

function matchesLocally(fn: FunctionRow, filter: string): boolean {
  if (filter === "") return true;
  const needle = filter.toLowerCase();
  const bare = needle.replace(/^0x/, "");
  return (
    functionLabel(fn).toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    (bare !== "" && fn.va.toString(16).includes(bare))
  );
}

const kEmptyFunctions = {
  total: 0,
  matched: 0,
  pages: {} as Record<number, FunctionRow[]>,
  selected: null,
  selectedFn: null,
  insns: [] as Insn[],
  linear: false,
};

const inflight = new Set<string>();
let filterTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

export const useDisasm = create<DisasmStore>((set, get) => {
  const fetchPage = async (page: number, query: number): Promise<void> => {
    const key = `${query}:${page}`;
    if (inflight.has(key)) return;
    inflight.add(key);
    try {
      const filter = get().filter;
      const res = await call<FunctionsReply>("disasm", "functions", {
        limit: kFnPageSize,
        offset: page * kFnPageSize,
        ...(filter !== "" ? { filter } : {}),
      });
      if (get().query !== query) return;
      const rows = res.functions ?? [];
      if (res.matched === undefined) {
        // Engine without server-side paging: the reply is the whole list.
        const filtered = rows.filter((f) => matchesLocally(f, filter));
        const pages: Record<number, FunctionRow[]> = {};
        for (let i = 0; i < filtered.length; i += kFnPageSize)
          pages[i / kFnPageSize] = filtered.slice(i, i + kFnPageSize);
        set({ pages, total: res.total ?? rows.length, matched: filtered.length });
        return;
      }
      set((s) => ({
        pages: { ...s.pages, [page]: rows },
        total: res.total ?? s.total,
        matched: res.matched ?? s.matched,
      }));
    } catch (e) {
      if (get().query === query) set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      inflight.delete(key);
    }
  };

  return {
    image: { ready: false },
    ...kEmptyFunctions,
    query: 0,
    filter: "",
    busy: false,
    error: null,
    hypeReady: false,

    setFilter: (filter) => {
      set({ filter });
      clearTimeout(filterTimer);
      filterTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        void get().refreshFunctions();
      }, kFilterDebounceMs);
    },

    refreshLoaded: async (force = false) => {
      try {
        const image = await call<LoadedImage>("disasm", "loaded");
        const changed = force || imageKey(image) !== imageKey(get().image);
        set({ image });
        if (!image.ready) {
          set({ ...kEmptyFunctions, query: get().query + 1, strings: [] });
          return;
        }
        if (changed) {
          // A different binary (possibly opened by an agent over MCP): the old
          // selection and listing belong to the previous image
          set({ ...kEmptyFunctions, strings: [] });
          await get().refreshFunctions();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: errorText(e) });
      }
    },

    loadFile: async (path) => {
      // A fresh image restarts analysis; clear the ready edge so its completion
      // re-pulls the function list (see onHypeProgress).
      set({ busy: true, error: null, hypeReady: false });
      try {
        await call("disasm", "load", { path }, { timeoutMs: 120_000 });
        await get().refreshLoaded();
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: errorText(e) });
      } finally {
        set({ busy: false });
      }
    },

    unload: async () => {
      try {
        await call("disasm", "unload");
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: errorText(e) });
        return;
      }
      set({
        image: { ready: false },
        ...kEmptyFunctions,
        query: get().query + 1,
        hypeReady: false,
        strings: [],
      });
    },

    onHypeProgress: (ready, hasImage) => {
      // The engine streams background-analysis status. At load time the function
      // list is seeded from the fast native index, which for a .NET/IL image
      // holds only the entry stub — every managed method surfaces only once
      // hyperion analysis finishes. Re-pull the listing (and the loaded summary)
      // on the not-ready -> ready edge so the panel isn't stuck on that stale,
      // native-only view.
      const wasReady = get().hypeReady;
      // Only emit when it actually changes: hype.progress streams continuously
      // during analysis, and an unconditional set re-renders every wholesale
      // store subscriber (e.g. the Strings filter) on each tick.
      if (ready !== wasReady) set({ hypeReady: ready });
      if (ready && !wasReady && hasImage && get().image.ready) {
        void get().refreshLoaded();
        void get().refreshFunctions();
      }
    },

    onImageChanged: (loaded) => {
      if (!loaded) {
        set({
          image: { ready: false },
          ...kEmptyFunctions,
          query: get().query + 1,
          hypeReady: false,
          strings: [],
        });
        return;
      }
      // the engine says the image changed, even when it is the same path again
      void get().refreshLoaded(true);
    },

    refreshFunctions: async () => {
      const query = get().query + 1;
      set({ query, pages: {}, busy: true, error: null });
      try {
        await fetchPage(0, query);
        if (get().query !== query) return;
        // Land on the entry point (or the first function) so the pane is never
        // blank after a load
        const s = get();
        if (s.selected === null && s.filter === "") {
          const first = rowAt(s, 0);
          const entry = s.image.entry_va;
          const atEntry = loadedRows(s).find((f) => f.va === entry);
          if (atEntry !== undefined) await get().select(atEntry.va, atEntry);
          else if (entry !== undefined && entry !== 0) await get().select(entry);
          else if (first !== undefined) await get().select(first.va, first);
        }
      } finally {
        if (get().query === query) set({ busy: false });
      }
    },

    ensureRows: (start, end) => {
      const s = get();
      if (s.matched === 0) return;
      const last = Math.min(end, s.matched - 1);
      for (
        let p = Math.floor(Math.max(0, start) / kFnPageSize);
        p <= Math.floor(last / kFnPageSize);
        p++
      ) {
        if (s.pages[p] === undefined) void fetchPage(p, s.query);
      }
    },

    searchFunctions: async (text, limit) => {
      const res = await call<FunctionsReply>("disasm", "functions", {
        limit,
        offset: 0,
        ...(text !== "" ? { filter: text } : {}),
      });
      const rows = res.functions ?? [];
      return res.matched === undefined
        ? rows.filter((f) => matchesLocally(f, text)).slice(0, limit)
        : rows;
    },

    select: async (va, row) => {
      const s = get();
      const fn =
        row ??
        loadedRows(s).find((f) => f.va === va) ??
        (s.selectedFn?.va === va ? s.selectedFn : null);
      set({ selected: va, selectedFn: fn });
      // Ask for more than the function should need, then trim: the engine
      // disassembles linearly and will happily run past the end into the next
      // function, which made the header's byte count disagree with the listing
      const size = fn?.size ?? 0;
      const count = Math.min(4000, Math.max(64, Math.ceil(size / 2)));
      try {
        const res = await call<{ instructions: Insn[] }>("disasm", "disassemble", {
          addr: va,
          count,
        });
        if (get().selected !== va) return;
        const all = res.instructions ?? [];
        const inRange = size > 0 ? all.filter((i) => i.va < va + size) : all;
        // A function index can under-report size (tail merging, jump tables). If
        // trimming leaves almost nothing, show the linear sweep instead of a
        // misleadingly empty function
        const clamped = inRange.length >= 4;
        set({ insns: clamped ? inRange : all, linear: !clamped });
      } catch (e) {
        if (get().selected === va) set({ insns: [], error: errorText(e) });
      }
    },

    gotoAddress: async (va) => {
      // Prefer the enclosing function so the listing keeps its context
      const fn = loadedRows(get()).find((f) => va >= f.va && va < f.va + f.size);
      await get().select(fn ? fn.va : va, fn);
    },

    rename: async (va, name) => {
      try {
        await call("disasm", "symbol_set", { addr: va, name });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: errorText(e) });
        return;
      }
      const patch = (f: FunctionRow): FunctionRow =>
        f.va === va ? { ...f, symbol: name || undefined } : f;
      set((s) => {
        const pages: Record<number, FunctionRow[]> = {};
        for (const [k, rows] of Object.entries(s.pages)) pages[Number(k)] = rows.map(patch);
        return {
          pages,
          selectedFn: s.selectedFn !== null ? patch(s.selectedFn) : null,
          error: null,
        };
      });
    },

    strings: [],
    stringsTruncated: false,

    loadStrings: async (minChars, includeExec) => {
      set({ busy: true });
      try {
        const res = await call<{ strings: StringHit[]; truncated: boolean }>(
          "disasm",
          "strings",
          { min_chars: minChars, include_exec: includeExec, limit: 10000 },
          { timeoutMs: 120_000 },
        );
        set({ strings: res.strings ?? [], stringsTruncated: res.truncated === true });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ strings: [], error: errorText(e) });
      } finally {
        set({ busy: false });
      }
    },
  };
});

```

```ts
// app/src/store/emulator.ts
// Unicorn emulation: one-shot runs, persistent sessions and the backward
// slice over a recorded trace. The engine owns the VM; this holds the last
// result the panel renders

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type EmuRegs = Record<string, number>;

export type EmuTraceRow = { ip: number; text: string };
export type EmuFault = { ip: number; addr: number; access: string };
export type EmuMemory = { addr: number; len: number; requested: number; hex: string };
export type EmuTaintRange = { addr: number; len: number };
export type EmuTaintEvent = { ip: number; insn: string; kind: string; target: number };
export type EmuSyscall = {
  ip: number;
  num: number;
  ret: number;
  args: number[];
  name?: string;
  enosys?: boolean;
};
export type EmuApiCall = { ip: number; ret: number; name: string; args: number[] };

export type EmuRun = {
  ok: boolean;
  stopped_reason: string;
  instructions: number;
  arch: string;
  abi: string;
  regs: EmuRegs;
  trace?: EmuTraceRow[];
  trace_id?: number;
  fault?: EmuFault;
  note?: string;
  error?: string;
  memory?: EmuMemory[];
  taint_ranges?: EmuTaintRange[];
  taint_events?: EmuTaintEvent[];
  output_tainted?: boolean;
  syscalls?: EmuSyscall[];
  total_syscalls?: number;
  api_calls?: EmuApiCall[];
  total_api_calls?: number;
  stdout?: string;
  exited?: boolean;
  exit_code?: number;
  paged_in?: number;
};

export type EmuSession = {
  session: number;
  arch: string;
  instructions: number;
  regs: EmuRegs;
  snapshots: number;
  stopped_reason?: string;
  stdout?: string;
  exited?: boolean;
  exit_code?: number;
  pages?: number;
  restored?: boolean;
};

export type EmuSlice = {
  trace_id: number;
  count: number;
  instructions: EmuTraceRow[];
};

/** Everything emulate.run / session_create accept, minus the action. */
export type EmuParams = {
  hex?: string;
  arch?: string;
  file_addr?: number;
  target_addr?: number;
  code_len?: number;
  until?: number;
  count?: number;
  timeout_ms?: number;
  trace?: boolean;
  trace_max?: number;
  orbis_syscalls?: boolean;
  dump?: { addr: number; len: number }[];
  taint?: { addr: number; len: number }[];
};

export type SliceParams = {
  trace_id: number;
  reg?: string;
  addr?: number;
  len?: number;
  at?: number;
};

type EmulatorStore = {
  run: EmuRun | null;
  session: EmuSession | null;
  slice: EmuSlice | null;
  busy: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  emulate: (params: EmuParams) => Promise<void>;
  backSlice: (params: SliceParams) => Promise<void>;
  sessionCreate: (params: EmuParams) => Promise<void>;
  sessionStep: (count: number, runAll: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  sessionDestroy: () => Promise<void>;
  snapshot: () => Promise<void>;
  restore: () => Promise<void>;
  reset: () => void;
};

export const useEmulator = create<EmulatorStore>((set, get) => ({
  run: null,
  session: null,
  slice: null,
  busy: null,
  error: null,

  emulate: async (params) => {
    set({ busy: "run", error: null, slice: null });
    try {
      set({ run: await call<EmuRun>("emulate", "run", params) });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ run: null, error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  backSlice: async (params) => {
    set({ busy: "slice", error: null });
    try {
      set({ slice: await call<EmuSlice>("emulate", "slice", params) });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ slice: null, error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  sessionCreate: async (params) => {
    set({ busy: "session", error: null });
    try {
      set({ session: await call<EmuSession>("emulate", "session_create", params) });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ session: null, error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  sessionStep: async (count, runAll) => {
    const id = get().session?.session;
    if (id === undefined) return;
    set({ busy: "session", error: null });
    try {
      set({
        session: await call<EmuSession>("emulate", runAll ? "session_run" : "session_step", {
          session: id,
          count,
        }),
      });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  sessionDestroy: async () => {
    const id = get().session?.session;
    if (id === undefined) return;
    set({ busy: "session", error: null });
    try {
      await call("emulate", "session_destroy", { session: id });
      set({ session: null });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  snapshot: async () => {
    const id = get().session?.session;
    if (id === undefined) return;
    set({ busy: "session", error: null });
    try {
      set({ session: await call<EmuSession>("emulate", "snapshot", { session: id }) });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  restore: async () => {
    const id = get().session?.session;
    if (id === undefined) return;
    set({ busy: "session", error: null });
    try {
      set({ session: await call<EmuSession>("emulate", "restore", { session: id }) });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  reset: () => set({ run: null, session: null, slice: null, error: null, busy: null }),
}));
```

`app/src/store/engine.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/engine.ts
// connection, boot progress and the state the status bar mirrors, all fed by
// events, nothing polls. Engine events also fan out to the stores that mirror
// engine-side state (image, targets, modules), so a change made by an agent
// over MCP shows up here without the user doing anything

import { create } from "zustand";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";
import * as events from "@/lib/events";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";
import {
  engineStatus,
  isTauri,
  onEngineLifecycle,
  resolveEndpoint,
  restartEngine,
  startupDeadlineMs,
  waitForEngine,
  type EngineCrash,
} from "@/lib/endpoint";
import { useDebugger } from "@/store/debugger";
import { useDisasm } from "@/store/disasm";
import { useMemory } from "@/store/memory";
import { usePe } from "@/store/pe";
import { useTargets } from "@/store/targets";

export type BootStage = {
  stage: number;
  total: number;
  label: string;
  done: boolean;
};

export type TargetState = { attached: boolean; pid?: number; name?: string };

export type HypeState = {
  has_image: boolean;
  image: string;
  present: boolean;
  ready: boolean;
  running: boolean;
  progress: number;
  error: string;
};

export type BackendState = { badge: string; ps4: boolean };

type EngineStore = {
  connected: boolean;
  boot: BootStage;
  /** Stage labels as the engine reported them, by stage index. */
  stageLabels: string[];
  backend: BackendState;
  target: TargetState;
  hype: HypeState;
  quitting: string | null;
  startupError: string | null;
  /** Last supervisor crash report; cleared once the engine is back. */
  crash: EngineCrash | null;
  start: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Start over after a failure, re-arming the supervisor if it gave up. */
  retry: () => Promise<void>;
  dismissError: () => void;
};

/**
 * Engine boot stages (src/core/infra/lifecycle.hpp, kStageCount = 5). Labels
 * are only the fallback: the engine sends its own with every boot.stage.
 */
export const kStageLabels: readonly Key[] = [
  "splash.stageRuntime",
  "splash.stageTargets",
  "splash.stageSettings",
  "splash.stageMcp",
  "splash.stageInterface",
];

const kInitialBoot: BootStage = {
  stage: 0,
  total: kStageLabels.length,
  label: "connecting",
  done: false,
};
const kInitialHype: HypeState = {
  has_image: false,
  image: "",
  present: false,
  ready: false,
  running: false,
  progress: 0,
  error: "",
};

/** The engine badge is "PS4"/"user"; never trust its case. */
export function backendFrom(badge: string, ps4?: boolean): BackendState {
  return { badge, ps4: typeof ps4 === "boolean" ? ps4 : badge.toLowerCase() === "ps4" };
}

let starting: Promise<void> | undefined;
let subscribed = false;

/** Mirror a backend switch into the target-side stores. */
function syncBackend(backend: BackendState): void {
  const targets = useTargets.getState();
  void targets.syncPs4(backend.ps4);
  if (backend.ps4 || targets.showHost) void targets.refresh();
  else useTargets.setState({ processes: [] });
  if (!backend.ps4) useDebugger.getState().reset();
}

/** Mirror an attach/detach (from the UI or an agent) into modules/memory. */
function syncTarget(prev: TargetState, next: TargetState): void {
  const targets = useTargets.getState();
  if (next.attached) void targets.refreshModules();
  else useTargets.setState({ modules: [] });
  if (prev.pid !== next.pid || prev.attached !== next.attached) useMemory.getState().reset();
}

export const useEngine = create<EngineStore>((set, get) => {
  const refreshStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const status = await call<{ backend: string; ps4?: boolean; target: TargetState }>(
        "app",
        "status",
      );
      const backend = backendFrom(status.backend, status.ps4);
      const prevTarget = get().target;
      const total = get().boot.total;
      set({
        backend,
        target: status.target,
        boot: { stage: total, total, label: "ready", done: true },
        startupError: null,
        crash: null,
      });
      // State changed while the stream was down is only visible in the
      // snapshot: re-seed every mirror from it
      syncBackend(backend);
      syncTarget(prevTarget, status.target);
      void useDisasm.getState().refreshLoaded();
    } catch (error) {
      set({ startupError: errorText(error) });
    }
  };

  const subscribe = () => {
    // Boot/backend events can precede subscription. Snapshot after each stream
    // open, not before the engine accepts connections, and again on reconnect.
    events.onConnectionChange((connected) => {
      set({ connected });
      if (connected) void refreshStatus();
    });
    events.on("boot.stage", (boot) =>
      set((s) => {
        const stageLabels = [...s.stageLabels];
        if (!boot.done && boot.stage >= 0 && boot.stage < 64) stageLabels[boot.stage] = boot.label;
        return { boot, stageLabels };
      }),
    );
    events.on("backend.changed", (data) => {
      const backend = backendFrom(data.badge, data.ps4);
      set({ backend });
      syncBackend(backend);
    });
    events.on("target.changed", (target) => {
      const prev = get().target;
      set({ target });
      syncTarget(prev, target);
      // An attach can start/stop a process (spawn, crash): refresh the list
      // the Targets panel shows, when it shows one
      const targets = useTargets.getState();
      if (get().backend.ps4 || targets.showHost) void targets.refresh();
    });
    events.on("hype.progress", (hype) => {
      const prev = get().hype;
      set({ hype });
      // Let the disassembly store refresh its function list when background
      // analysis completes (the fast native index queried at load time misses
      // hyperion-only functions, e.g. every method of a .NET/IL image).
      useDisasm.getState().onHypeProgress(hype.ready, hype.has_image);
      // An engine without image.changed still moves hype.image on a load
      if (prev.has_image !== hype.has_image || prev.image !== hype.image)
        void useDisasm.getState().refreshLoaded();
    });
    events.on("image.changed", ({ loaded }) => {
      usePe.getState().reset();
      useDisasm.getState().onImageChanged(loaded);
    });
    events.on("app.quitting", ({ reason }) => set({ quitting: reason }));

    if (isTauri()) {
      // A restarted engine may listen on a new port: ask the supervisor where
      // it is before every reconnect (this blocks while a restart is underway)
      events.setReconnectHook(async () => {
        await resolveEndpoint();
      });
      void onEngineLifecycle({
        onCrashed: (crash) => set({ crash, connected: false }),
        onRestarted: () => {
          set({ crash: null });
          void resolveEndpoint()
            .then(() => events.connect())
            .catch((e: unknown) => set({ startupError: errorText(e) }));
        },
      }).catch(() => undefined);
    }
  };

  return {
    connected: false,
    boot: kInitialBoot,
    stageLabels: [],
    backend: { badge: "user", ps4: false },
    target: { attached: false },
    hype: kInitialHype,
    quitting: null,
    startupError: null,
    crash: null,

    start: () =>
      (starting ??= (async () => {
        set({ startupError: null });
        await resolveEndpoint();
        // the endpoint can resolve before the engine accepts connections; gate the
        // event stream on /health so the first connect does not race the listener
        const deadline = await startupDeadlineMs();
        if (!(await waitForEngine(deadline)))
          throw new Error(`engine did not answer /health within ${Math.round(deadline / 1000)}s`);
        if (!subscribed) {
          subscribed = true;
          subscribe();
        }
        events.connect();
      })().catch((error: unknown) => {
        starting = undefined;
        set({ startupError: errorText(error) });
      })),

    retry: async () => {
      starting = undefined;
      set({ startupError: null });
      try {
        const st = await engineStatus();
        if (st !== null && (st.phase === "failed" || st.phase === "stopped")) await restartEngine();
      } catch (e) {
        set({ startupError: errorText(e) });
        return;
      }
      set({ crash: null });
      if (subscribed) {
        // Booted before: the stream just needs a fresh endpoint + connection
        try {
          await resolveEndpoint();
          events.connect();
        } catch (e) {
          set({ startupError: errorText(e) });
        }
        return;
      }
      await get().start();
    },

    dismissError: () => set({ startupError: null }),
  };
});
```

`app/src/store/memory.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/memory.ts
// Live memory browsing for the hex editor: regions, a scrollable window over
// one region filled page by page as it scrolls, and writes through the active
// backend (ps4 wire when a console is connected). Everything the view shows
// lives here so switching tabs does not lose the position

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type Region = {
  base: number;
  size: number;
  protect: number;
  state: number;
  type: number;
};

/** Page size for one read. 4 KiB keeps a scroll responsive over loopback. */
export const kPageBytes = 0x1000;
/**
 * Bytes one scroll window spans. Bounded because a browser caps element height
 * (~33M px); 1 MiB is 65536 rows. Prev/next move the window along the region.
 */
export const kWindowBytes = 0x100000;
/** Pages read concurrently ahead of the viewport. */
const kReadAhead = 2;
/** Hex grid geometry, shared with MemoryView so scroll offsets agree. */
export const kHexCols = 16;
export const kHexRowPx = 19;

type MemoryStore = {
  regions: Region[];
  /** Address the user navigated to (goto, region click). */
  cursor: number;
  /** First byte of the scroll window. */
  windowBase: number;
  /** Bytes in the scroll window. */
  windowSize: number;
  /** Page base -> bytes, or null when the page could not be read. */
  pages: Record<number, Uint8Array | null>;
  /** Text in the goto box, kept across remounts. */
  gotoText: string;
  /** Scroll offset of the hex grid, restored on remount. */
  scrollTop: number;
  /** Bumped by every goto so the grid scrolls the target into view. */
  gotoSeq: number;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;

  loadRegions: () => Promise<void>;
  goto: (addr: number) => void;
  /** Read every not-yet-loaded page overlapping [start, end). */
  ensurePages: (start: number, end: number) => void;
  /** Drop the page cache and re-read what is visible. */
  reload: () => void;
  writeBytes: (addr: number, data: Uint8Array) => Promise<boolean>;
  setGotoText: (text: string) => void;
  setScrollTop: (px: number) => void;
  /** Move the caret without scrolling (the hex grid sets it on click). */
  setCursor: (addr: number) => void;
  reset: () => void;
};

function hexToBytes(hex: string): Uint8Array {
  const clean = hex.replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, "");
  const out = new Uint8Array(clean.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = parseInt(clean.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
  return out;
}

function bytesToHex(data: Uint8Array): string {
  let s = "";
  for (const b of data) s += b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0").toUpperCase();
  return s;
}

/** PAGE_* protection constants, rendered the way the region table shows them. */
export function protectName(protect: number): string {
  const base = protect & 0xff;
  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x01: "NOACCESS",
    0x02: "R",
    0x04: "RW",
    0x08: "WC",
    0x10: "X",
    0x20: "RX",
    0x40: "RWX",
    0x80: "XWC",
  };
  let out = names[base] ?? `0x${protect.toString(16)}`;
  if ((protect & 0x100) !== 0) out += "+G";
  if ((protect & 0x200) !== 0) out += "+NC";
  return out;
}

const alignDown = (v: number, a: number): number => v - (v % a);

/** Window placement for `addr`: inside its region, centred where room allows. */
export function windowFor(
  regions: readonly Region[],
  addr: number,
): { base: number; size: number } {
  const region = regions.find((r) => addr >= r.base && addr < r.base + r.size);
  const page = alignDown(addr, kPageBytes);
  if (region === undefined) return { base: page, size: kWindowBytes };
  const end = region.base + region.size;
  let base = Math.max(region.base, page - kWindowBytes / 2);
  base = Math.max(region.base, Math.min(base, end - kWindowBytes));
  return { base, size: Math.min(kWindowBytes, end - base) };
}

/** Byte at `addr`, or undefined when its page is not loaded / unreadable. */
export function byteAt(pages: Record<number, Uint8Array | null>, addr: number): number | undefined {
  const page = pages[alignDown(addr, kPageBytes)];
  return page?.[addr % kPageBytes];
}

const inflight = new Set<number>();

export const useMemory = create<MemoryStore>((set, get) => {
  const readPage = async (page: number, windowBase: number): Promise<void> => {
    if (inflight.has(page)) return;
    inflight.add(page);
    set({ loading: true });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ hex?: string }>("memory", "read", {
        addr: page,
        len: kPageBytes,
        format: "hex",
      });
      if (get().windowBase !== windowBase) return;
      set((s) => ({ pages: { ...s.pages, [page]: hexToBytes(res.hex ?? "") }, error: null }));
    } catch (e) {
      if (get().windowBase !== windowBase) return;
      set((s) => ({ pages: { ...s.pages, [page]: null }, error: errorText(e) }));
    } finally {
      inflight.delete(page);
      if (inflight.size === 0) set({ loading: false });
    }
  };

  return {
    regions: [],
    cursor: 0,
    windowBase: 0,
    windowSize: 0,
    pages: {},
    gotoText: "",
    scrollTop: 0,
    gotoSeq: 0,
    loading: false,
    error: null,

    loadRegions: async () => {
      try {
        const res = await call<{ regions: Region[] }>("target", "regions");
        // MEM_COMMIT only: reserved and free ranges are not readable, and listing
        // them just gives the user rows that always fail
        const regions = (res.regions ?? []).filter((r) => r.state === 0x1000);
        set({ regions, error: null });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ regions: [], error: errorText(e) });
      }
    },

    goto: (addr) => {
      const { base, size } = windowFor(get().regions, addr);
      const same = base === get().windowBase && size === get().windowSize;
      set({
        cursor: addr,
        windowBase: base,
        windowSize: size,
        gotoSeq: get().gotoSeq + 1,
        // Where the grid should land; a view mounting after the goto (palette
        // jump into the Memory tab) starts there
        scrollTop: Math.floor((addr - base) / kHexCols) * kHexRowPx,
        ...(same ? {} : { pages: {} }),
        error: null,
      });
      get().ensurePages(addr, addr + kPageBytes);
    },

    ensurePages: (start, end) => {
      const { windowBase, windowSize, pages } = get();
      if (windowSize === 0) return;
      const lo = Math.max(windowBase, alignDown(start, kPageBytes));
      const hi = Math.min(windowBase + windowSize, end + kReadAhead * kPageBytes);
      for (let p = lo; p < hi; p += kPageBytes) {
        if (!(p in pages)) void readPage(p, windowBase);
      }
    },

    reload: () => {
      const { cursor } = get();
      set({ pages: {} });
      get().ensurePages(cursor, cursor + kPageBytes);
    },

    writeBytes: async (addr, data) => {
      try {
        await call("memory", "write", { addr, hex: bytesToHex(data) });
      } catch (e) {
        set({ error: `write at 0x${addr.toString(16).toUpperCase()} failed: ${errorText(e)}` });
        return false;
      }
      // Re-read the page so the grid shows what the target actually holds
      const page = alignDown(addr, kPageBytes);
      set((s) => {
        const pages = { ...s.pages };
        delete pages[page];
        return { pages, error: null };
      });
      await readPage(page, get().windowBase);
      return true;
    },

    setGotoText: (gotoText) => set({ gotoText }),
    setScrollTop: (scrollTop) => set({ scrollTop }),
    setCursor: (addr) => set({ cursor: addr }),

    reset: () =>
      set({
        regions: [],
        pages: {},
        cursor: 0,
        windowBase: 0,
        windowSize: 0,
        scrollTop: 0,
        error: null,
      }),
  };
});
```

`app/src/store/motion.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/motion.ts
// motion preference, the os reduced motion setting is the default not the law

import { create } from "zustand";
import type { Key } from "@/i18n/en";

export type MotionPref = "on" | "auto" | "off";

export const kMotionOptions: readonly { id: MotionPref; labelKey: Key; hintKey: Key }[] = [
  { id: "on", labelKey: "motion.on", hintKey: "motion.onHint" },
  { id: "auto", labelKey: "motion.auto", hintKey: "motion.autoHint" },
  { id: "off", labelKey: "motion.off", hintKey: "motion.offHint" },
];

const kStorageKey = "reverse-slop.motion";

function initial(): MotionPref {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(kStorageKey);
  // Unset means "auto": the OS reduced-motion setting decides until the user
  // explicitly overrides it here
  return saved === "on" || saved === "auto" || saved === "off" ? saved : "auto";
}

/** CSS reads `data-motion` on <html>; see the motion section of app.css. */
function apply(pref: MotionPref): void {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-motion", pref);
}

/** Whether the OS currently asks for reduced motion, for the Settings hint. */
export function osPrefersReduced(): boolean {
  return window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
}

type MotionStore = {
  motion: MotionPref;
  setMotion: (pref: MotionPref) => void;
};

export const useMotion = create<MotionStore>((set) => {
  const motion = initial();
  apply(motion);
  return {
    motion,
    setMotion: (pref) => {
      apply(pref);
      localStorage.setItem(kStorageKey, pref);
      set({ motion: pref });
    },
  };
});
```

```ts
export const useNetwork = create<NetworkStore>((set, get) => ({
  status: null,
  packets: [],
  lastId: 0,
  stats: null,
  dns: [],
  streams: [],
  inspect: [],
  proxy: null,
  entries: [],
  error: null,
  busy: null,

  refreshStatus: async () => {
    try {
      set({ status: await call<NetworkStatus>("network", "status") });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  start: async (filter) => {
    set({ busy: "capture", error: null });
    try {
      // port 0 and protocol 0 mean "both", the engine's own defaults
      await call("network", "capture_start", {
        ...(filter.host !== "" ? { host: filter.host } : {}),
        ...(filter.port > 0 ? { port: filter.port } : {}),
        ...(filter.protocol > 0 ? { protocol: filter.protocol } : {}),
      });
      await get().refreshStatus();
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  stop: async () => {
    set({ busy: "capture", error: null });
    try {
      await call("network", "capture_stop");
      await get().refreshStatus();
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  refreshPackets: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<PacketsReply>("network", "packets", {
        from: get().lastId,
        limit: kPacketPage,
      });
      const rows = res.packets ?? [];
      if (rows.length === 0) return;
      set({
        packets: [...get().packets, ...rows].slice(-2000),
        lastId: res.last_id ?? rows[rows.length - 1].id,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  refreshStats: async () => {
    try {
      set({ stats: await call<NetworkStats>("network", "stats") });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  refreshDns: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ dns?: DnsRow[] }>("network", "dns", { limit: 500 });
      set({ dns: res.dns ?? [] });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  refreshStreams: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ streams?: StreamRow[] }>("network", "streams", { limit: 500 });
      set({ streams: res.streams ?? [] });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  refreshInspect: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ results?: InspectRow[] }>("network", "deep_inspect", {
        limit: 200,
      });
      set({ inspect: res.results ?? [] });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  exportPcap: async (path, format, maxPackets) => {
    set({ busy: "export", error: null });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ packets: number }>("network", "export_pcap", {
        path,
        format,
        max_packets: maxPackets,
      });
      return `${res.packets} packets written to ${path}`;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return null;
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  importPcap: async (path) => {
    set({ busy: "import", error: null });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ packets: number; skipped: number }>("network", "import_pcap", {
        path,
      });
      set({ packets: [], lastId: 0 });
      await get().refreshStatus();
      await get().refreshPackets();
      return `${res.packets} packets imported (${res.skipped} skipped)`;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return null;
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  refreshProxy: async () => {
    try {
      set({ proxy: await call<ProxyStatus>("proxy", "status") });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  startProxy: async (options) => {
    set({ busy: "proxy", error: null });
    try {
      await call("proxy", "start", {
        port: options.port,
        bind: options.bind,
        allow_hosts: options.allow_hosts,
        allow_clients: options.allow_clients,
      });
      await get().refreshProxy();
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  stopProxy: async () => {
    set({ busy: "proxy", error: null });
    try {
      await call("proxy", "stop");
      await get().refreshProxy();
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  refreshEntries: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ entries?: ProxyEntry[] }>("proxy", "entries", { limit: 100 });
      set({ entries: res.entries ?? [] });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    }
  },

  entry: async (id) => {
    try {
      return await call<ProxyEntryDetail>("proxy", "entry", { id });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return null;
    }
  },

  replay: async (id) => {
    set({ busy: "replay", error: null });
    try {
      const res = await call<{ status: number; text: string }>("proxy", "replay", { id });
      return `HTTP ${res.status}\n${res.text}`;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return null;
    } finally {
      set({ busy: null });
    }
  },

  reset: () =>
    set({
      status: null,
      packets: [],
      lastId: 0,
      stats: null,
      dns: [],
      streams: [],
      inspect: [],
      proxy: null,
      entries: [],
      error: null,
      busy: null,
    }),
}));
```

`app/src/store/output.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/output.ts
// output pane, lines live in the engine ring so a reconnect replays what was
// missed via the seq cursor

import { create } from "zustand";
import * as events from "@/lib/events";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type OutputLine = { seq: number; ms: number; text: string };

export const kMaxLines = 4096;
/**
 * Streamed lines are coalesced and committed at most once per this interval.
 * Committing per line copied the 4096-entry ring for every frame, quadratic in
 * a reconnect burst; batching makes a burst one copy per flush.
 */
export const kFlushMs = 16;

type OutputStore = {
  lines: OutputLine[];
  revision: number;
  clear: () => Promise<void>;
  attach: () => () => void;
  replayFrom: (revision: number) => Promise<void>;
  /** Commit buffered lines now (tests and teardown). */
  flush: () => void;
};

let pending: OutputLine[] = [];
let pendingRevision = 0;
let flushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

/** Append `extra` to `lines`, keeping only the newest kMaxLines. */
function appendBounded(lines: OutputLine[], extra: OutputLine[]): OutputLine[] {
  if (extra.length >= kMaxLines) return extra.slice(-kMaxLines);
  const keep = Math.max(0, lines.length + extra.length - kMaxLines);
  return keep === 0 ? lines.concat(extra) : lines.slice(keep).concat(extra);
}

export const useOutput = create<OutputStore>((set, get) => ({
  lines: [],
  revision: 0,

  flush: () => {
    clearTimeout(flushTimer);
    flushTimer = undefined;
    if (pending.length === 0) return;
    const batch = pending;
    pending = [];
    set((s) => ({
      lines: appendBounded(s.lines, batch),
      revision: Math.max(s.revision, pendingRevision),
    }));
  },

  attach: () => {
    const offOutput = events.on("output", (line) => {
      // Out-of-order or duplicate frames (reconnect overlap) are dropped by
      // sequence rather than deduplicated by text
      const head = Math.max(get().revision, pendingRevision);
      if (line.seq <= head) return;
      pending.push(line);
      pendingRevision = line.seq;
      // A burst bigger than the ring only keeps its tail anyway
      if (pending.length > kMaxLines) pending = pending.slice(-kMaxLines);
      flushTimer ??= setTimeout(() => get().flush(), kFlushMs);
    });

    const offClear = events.on("output.cleared", () => {
      pending = [];
      pendingRevision = 0;
      set({ lines: [], revision: 0 });
    });

    // On (re)connect the engine tells us where its ring is; pull the gap
    const offHello = events.on("hello", ({ output_revision }) => {
      get().flush();
      if (output_revision < get().revision) {
        pendingRevision = 0;
        set({ lines: [], revision: 0 });
      }
      void get().replayFrom(
        get().revision > 0 ? get().revision : Math.max(0, output_revision - kMaxLines),
      );
    });
    return () => {
      get().flush();
      offOutput();
      offClear();
      offHello();
    };
  },

  replayFrom: async (revision) => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ revision: number; lines: OutputLine[] }>("app", "output", {
        since: revision,
      });
      if (res.lines.length === 0) return;
      get().flush();
      set((s) => {
        // Live output can advance `revision` past this replay window while the
        // request is in flight. Merge by seq instead of dropping everything
        // already <= revision, or the missed backlog would never appear.
        const have = new Set(s.lines.map((l) => l.seq));
        const add = res.lines.filter((l) => !have.has(l.seq));
        if (add.length === 0) return s;
        const merged = s.lines.concat(add).sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
        return {
          lines: merged.slice(-kMaxLines),
          revision: Math.max(s.revision, res.revision),
        };
      });
      pendingRevision = Math.max(pendingRevision, get().revision);
    } catch {
      // Nothing to show is better than a thrown error in a log pane
    }
  },

  clear: async () => {
    await call("app", "output_clear");
    pending = [];
    pendingRevision = 0;
    set({ lines: [], revision: 0 });
  },
}));
```

```ts
// app/src/store/pe.ts
// Static image metadata: native PE headers or the synthesized Mach-O section,
// import and export map used by the image browser (src/ui/view_pe.cpp).

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call } from "@/lib/rpc";
import type { ImageArch, ImageFormat } from "@/store/disasm";

export type Section = {
  name: string;
  rva: number;
  vsize: number;
  raw_size: number;
  exec: boolean;
  writable: boolean;
  characteristics: number;
};

export type ImportDll = { dll: string; functions: string[] };
export type ExportEntry = { name: string; rva: number; ordinal: number };

export type PeInfo = {
  image?: string;
  format?: ImageFormat;
  arch?: ImageArch;
  pe32plus?: boolean;
  image_base?: number;
  entry_rva?: number;
  size_of_image?: number;
  sections: Section[];
  imports: ImportDll[];
  exports: ExportEntry[];
};

const kEmpty: PeInfo = { sections: [], imports: [], exports: [] };

type PeStore = {
  pe: PeInfo;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  load: () => Promise<void>;
  reset: () => void;
};

export const usePe = create<PeStore>((set) => ({
  pe: kEmpty,
  loading: false,
  error: null,

  load: async () => {
    set({ loading: true, error: null });
    try {
      const pe = await call<PeInfo>("disasm", "pe");
      set({
        pe: {
          ...pe,
          sections: pe.sections ?? [],
          imports: pe.imports ?? [],
          exports: pe.exports ?? [],
        },
      });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ pe: kEmpty, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ loading: false });
    }
  },

  reset: () => set({ pe: kEmpty, error: null }),
}));
```

`app/src/store/scanner.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/scanner.ts
// scanner parameters and the displayed page of hits, the result set itself
// lives in the engine

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, errorText } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type Hit = {
  addr: number;
  bits: number;
  formatted: string;
  type: string;
};

export type ScanState = {
  active: boolean;
  pid: number;
  total: number;
  width: string;
  kind: string;
};

export const kWidths = [
  "i8",
  "u8",
  "i16",
  "u16",
  "i32",
  "u32",
  "i64",
  "u64",
  "f32",
  "f64",
  "all",
] as const;

/** First pass can only seed; the comparison kinds need a previous result set. */
export const kFirstKinds = ["exact", "unknown"] as const;
export const kNextKinds = [
  "exact",
  "between",
  "bigger",
  "smaller",
  "increased",
  "increased_by",
  "decreased",
  "decreased_by",
  "changed",
  "unchanged",
  "changed_by_more_than",
  "changed_by_less_than",
] as const;

type ScannerStore = {
  width: string;
  kind: string;
  value: string;
  value2: string;
  hits: Hit[];
  total: number;
  hasState: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;

  set: (patch: Partial<Pick<ScannerStore, "width" | "kind" | "value" | "value2">>) => void;
  refreshState: () => Promise<void>;
  scan: (rescan: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  /** Write the engine's full result set (not just this page) as CSV. */
  exportCsv: (path: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  reset: () => Promise<void>;
};

export const useScanner = create<ScannerStore>((set, get) => ({
  width: "u32",
  kind: "exact",
  value: "",
  value2: "",
  hits: [],
  total: 0,
  hasState: false,
  busy: false,
  error: null,

  set: (patch) => set(patch),

  refreshState: async () => {
    try {
      const st = await call<ScanState>("memory", "scan_state");
      set({ hasState: st.active === true, total: st.total ?? 0 });
    } catch {
      set({ hasState: false });
    }
  },

  scan: async (rescan) => {
    const { width, kind, value, value2 } = get();
    set({ busy: true, error: null });
    try {
      // max_results caps the scan itself; limit caps the page handed back, and
      // it defaults to 100, without it the results pane silently shows a
      // hundredth of what was found
      const params: Record<string, unknown> = {
        width,
        kind,
        max_results: 100000,
        limit: 1000,
      };
      // `unknown` seeds a snapshot with no comparand; every other kind needs one
      if (kind !== "unknown") {
        params.value = value.includes(".") ? Number(value) : value;
        if (kind === "between") params.value2 = value2.includes(".") ? Number(value2) : value2;
      }
      const res = await call<{ hits: Hit[]; total: number }>(
        "memory",
        rescan ? "rescan" : "scan",
        params,
        // a full first pass over a large process takes a while; it still ends
        { timeoutMs: 300_000 },
      );
      set({ hits: res.hits ?? [], total: res.total ?? 0, hasState: true });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ busy: false });
    }
  },

  reset: async () => {
    await call("memory", "scan_reset").catch(() => undefined);
    set({ hits: [], total: 0, hasState: false, error: null });
  },

  exportCsv: async (path) => {
    try {
      await call("memory", "scan_export", { path });
      set({ error: null });
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return false;
    }
  },
}));

```

`app/src/store/settings.ts`:

```ts
// app/src/store/settings.ts
// Engine-side settings (settings.json in the engine's app-data dir), read and
// written over /api app.settings_get / app.settings_set. The MCP token is
// never returned by the engine, only whether one is set; rotating it goes
// through app.rotate_token

import { create } from "zustand";
import { call, errorText, getEndpoint, setEndpoint } from "@/lib/rpc";

export type EngineSettings = Record<string, unknown> & {
  mcp_token?: "set" | "unset" | string;
  script_unsafe?: boolean;
  web_allow_private?: boolean;
  web_allowlist?: string[];
  proxy_token?: string;
  /** Clients the onboarder writes into; empty/absent = auto. */
  mcp_onboard_clients?: string[];
  /** Write the bearer token into client configs instead of ${SLOP_MCP_TOKEN}. */
  mcp_token_in_configs?: boolean;
  /** Client configs that still hold a literal bearer token (audit 72). */
  mcp_plaintext_configs?: string[];
};

type RotateReply = { rotated: boolean; clients_updated?: string[]; token?: string };

type SettingsStore = {
  settings: EngineSettings | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** Keys whose change only applies after an engine restart. */
  restartRequired: string[];
  /** A freshly rotated token, shown once so the user can copy it. */
  revealedToken: string | null;
  clientsUpdated: string[];
  load: () => Promise<void>;
  setValue: (key: string, value: unknown) => Promise<boolean>;
  rotateToken: () => Promise<boolean>;
  hideToken: () => void;
};

export const useSettings = create<SettingsStore>((set, get) => ({
  settings: null,
  loading: false,
  error: null,
  restartRequired: [],
  revealedToken: null,
  clientsUpdated: [],

  load: async () => {
    set({ loading: true });
    try {
      const settings = await call<EngineSettings>("app", "settings_get");
      set({ settings, error: null });
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
    } finally {
      set({ loading: false });
    }
  },

  setValue: async (key, value) => {
    try {
      const res = await call<{ ok?: boolean; value?: unknown; restart_required?: boolean }>(
        "app",
        "settings_set",
        { key, value },
      );
      set((s) => ({
        settings: { ...(s.settings ?? {}), [key]: res.value !== undefined ? res.value : value },
        error: null,
        restartRequired:
          res.restart_required === true && !s.restartRequired.includes(key)
            ? [...s.restartRequired, key]
            : s.restartRequired,
      }));
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return false;
    }
  },

  rotateToken: async () => {
    try {
      const res = await call<RotateReply>("app", "rotate_token");
      // The engine includes the new value only when this request authenticated
      // with the old mcp_token, i.e. this UI was using it as its own bearer:
      // switch to it, or the next request is refused
      if (typeof res.token === "string" && res.token !== "") {
        if (getEndpoint().token !== "") setEndpoint({ ...getEndpoint(), token: res.token });
      }
      set({
        revealedToken: typeof res.token === "string" && res.token !== "" ? res.token : null,
        clientsUpdated: res.clients_updated ?? [],
        error: null,
        settings: { ...(get().settings ?? {}), mcp_token: "set" },
      });
      return res.rotated !== false;
    } catch (e) {
      set({ error: errorText(e) });
      return false;
    }
  },

  hideToken: () => set({ revealedToken: null }),
}));

```

```ts
    expect(useTargets.getState().error).toContain("detach failed");
  });

  it("remembers the console vs local-process choice across launches (item 82)", () => {
    expect(readShowHost()).toBe(false);
    useTargets.getState().setShowHost(true);
    expect(localStorage.getItem("reverse-slop.show-host-processes")).toBe("1");
    // a fresh launch reads the same key
    expect(readShowHost()).toBe(true);
    useTargets.getState().setShowHost(false);
    expect(readShowHost()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("loads saved consoles and switches between them", async () => {
    const consoles = [
      {
        name: "devkit-a",
        host: "10.0.0.5",
        port: 744,
        notes: "",
        default_pid: 0,
        title_filter: "",
        auto_connect: false,
        profile: { watchlist: "a", scan_width: "u32", scan_kind: "exact" },
        last_seen_ms: 0,
        last_fw: "11.00",
        last_branding: "ps4debug-NG",
        last_caps: "1.1",
        active: true,
      },
      {
        name: "devkit-b",
        host: "10.0.0.6",
        port: 744,
        notes: "",
        default_pid: 0,
        title_filter: "",
        auto_connect: false,
        profile: { watchlist: "b", scan_width: "f32", scan_kind: "changed" },
        last_seen_ms: 0,
        last_fw: "",
        last_branding: "",
        last_caps: "",
        active: false,
      },
    ];
    const { calls } = mockApi(({ action }) => {
      if (action === "consoles_list") return { consoles, active: "devkit-a" };
      if (action === "consoles_switch")
        return { endpoint: "10.0.0.6:744", branding: "ps4debug-NG" };
      return { processes: [] };
    });
    await useTargets.getState().loadConsoles();
    expect(useTargets.getState().consoles).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(useTargets.getState().activeConsole).toBe("devkit-a");

    expect(await useTargets.getState().switchConsole("devkit-b")).toBe(true);
    expect(calls.some((c) => c.action === "consoles_switch" && c.params.name === "devkit-b")).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(useTargets.getState().ps4?.endpoint).toBe("10.0.0.6:744");
  });
});

describe("output batching (item 104)", () => {
  it("commits a burst of streamed lines in one update", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    events.connect();
    const stream = await lastStream();
    let commits = 0;
    const stop = useOutput.subscribe(() => commits++);
    const detach = useOutput.getState().attach();
    for (let seq = 1; seq <= 1000; seq++) stream?.emit("output", { seq, ms: 0, text: `l${seq}` });
    expect(useOutput.getState().lines).toHaveLength(0);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(kFlushMs + 1);
    expect(useOutput.getState().lines).toHaveLength(1000);
    expect(commits).toBe(1);
    // duplicates (reconnect overlap) are dropped by sequence
    stream?.emit("output", { seq: 1000, ms: 0, text: "dup" });
    useOutput.getState().flush();
    expect(useOutput.getState().lines.at(-1)?.text).toBe("l1000");
    detach();
    stop();
    events.disconnect();
    await flushPromises();
  });

  it("keeps the replayed backlog when live output races the reconnect replay", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    // Engine ring holds the gap 5..7; replayFrom(since) returns what is newer.
    mockApi((c) => {
      if (c.tool === "app" && c.action === "output") {
        const since = Number(c.params.since ?? 0);
        return {
          revision: 7,
          lines: [5, 6, 7].filter((s) => s > since).map((seq) => ({ seq, ms: 0, text: `g${seq}` })),
        };
      }
      return {};
    });
    events.connect();
    const stream = await lastStream();
    const detach = useOutput.getState().attach();
    stream?.emit("output.cleared", {}); // reset module-level seq cursor from prior tests
    for (let seq = 1; seq <= 4; seq++) stream?.emit("output", { seq, ms: 0, text: `l${seq}` });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(kFlushMs + 1);
    expect(useOutput.getState().revision).toBe(4);

    // Reconnect: hello kicks off the async replayFrom(4); before it resolves,
    // live lines 8,9 flush and advance revision past the replay window.
    stream?.emit("hello", { output_revision: 7 });
    for (const seq of [8, 9]) stream?.emit("output", { seq, ms: 0, text: `live${seq}` });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(kFlushMs + 1);
    expect(useOutput.getState().revision).toBe(9);

    // The replay reply (5,6,7) must not be dropped just because revision is now 9.
    await flushPromises();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(kFlushMs + 1);
    expect(useOutput.getState().lines.map((l) => l.seq)).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]);

    detach();
    events.disconnect();
    await flushPromises();
  });
});
```
