```cpp
// src/core/disasm/hyperion_session.cpp

// available RAM, for sizing the analysis budget
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#include "core/disasm/hyperion_session.hpp"

#include "core/disasm/capstone_disasm.h"
#include "core/infra/diag.hpp"
#include "core/loader/elf_loader.h"
#include "core/loader/macho_loader.h"
#include "core/loader/self_loader.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdlib>

namespace slop::core::disasm::hyperion_session {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// shared decoder

hype::Disassembler& shared_decoder() {
    // The Zydis decoder/formatter carry no cross-call state; concurrent use
    // is serialized by g_decoder_mu at the call sites below
    static hype::Disassembler dec;
    return dec;
}

size_t analysis_insn_budget() {
    static const size_t budget = [] {
        if (const char* env = std::getenv("SLOP_HYPERION_INSN_BUDGET")) {
            char* end = nullptr;
            const unsigned long long v = std::strtoull(env, &end, 10);
            if (end != env) return static_cast<size_t>(v);
        }
#ifdef _WIN32
        MEMORYSTATUSEX mem{};
        mem.dwLength = sizeof(mem);
        if (!GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&mem)) return static_cast<size_t>(1'000'000);
        const uint64_t avail_phys = mem.ullAvailPhys;
#else
        const long pages = ::sysconf(_SC_AVPHYS_PAGES);
        const long page_size = ::sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
        if (pages <= 0 || page_size <= 0) return static_cast<size_t>(1'000'000);
        const uint64_t avail_phys = static_cast<uint64_t>(pages) * static_cast<uint64_t>(page_size);
#endif

        // The instruction map, sweep cache, CFG copy, xrefs and allocator
        // overhead coexist during analysis. Leave most currently available
        // memory to the loaded image, the UI and the operating system.
        constexpr uint64_t kBytesPerInsn = 1024;
        const uint64_t affordable = (avail_phys / 4) / kBytesPerInsn;
        return static_cast<size_t>(std::clamp<uint64_t>(affordable, 250'000, 2'000'000));
    }();
    return budget;
}

namespace {

std::mutex g_decoder_mu;

std::string upper_mnemonic(const char* s) {
    std::string out(s);
    for (char& c : out)
        c = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return out;
}

insn_t convert_arm(const hype::Insn& in) {
    insn_t out;
    out.va     = in.addr;
    out.length = in.len < ZYDIS_MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH ? in.len
                                                        : ZYDIS_MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH;
    std::memcpy(out.bytes, in.bytes, out.length);
    out.text = upper_mnemonic(in.mnemonic);
    if (in.op_str[0] != '\0') out.text += " ", out.text += in.op_str;

    switch (in.type) {
    case hype::InsnType::Call: out.flow = flow_t::call; break;
    case hype::InsnType::Jmp:  out.flow = flow_t::jmp;  break;
    case hype::InsnType::Jcc:  out.flow = flow_t::jcc;  break;
    case hype::InsnType::Ret:  out.flow = flow_t::ret;  break;
    default:                   out.flow = flow_t::none; break;
    }

    // operand records with Capstone register ids in the arm_* fields
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < in.op_count && out.op_count < ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT_VISIBLE; ++i) {
        const hype::Operand& src = in.ops[i];
        operand_t&           o   = out.ops[out.op_count++];
        o.read  = src.read;
        o.write = src.write;
        switch (src.type) {
        case hype::OpType::Reg:
            o.cls     = op_class_t::reg;
            o.arm_reg = src.reg;
            break;
        case hype::OpType::Imm:
            o.cls = op_class_t::imm;
            o.imm = src.val;
            break;
        case hype::OpType::Mem:
            o.cls       = op_class_t::mem;
            o.arm_base  = src.mem.base;
            o.arm_index = src.mem.index;
            o.scale     = src.mem.scale ? src.mem.scale : 1;
            o.disp      = src.mem.disp;
            break;
        default:
            o.cls = op_class_t::none;
            break;
        }
    }

    // b/bl/b.cond carry only the target; cbz/cbnz test a register first and
    // tbz/tbnz a register and a bit number, so the target is the last imm.
    // Register branches (br/blr/ret) have no immediate at all
    if (out.flow == flow_t::call || out.flow == flow_t::jmp ||
        out.flow == flow_t::jcc) {
        for (uint8_t i = in.op_count; i-- > 0;) {
            if (in.ops[i].type != hype::OpType::Imm) continue;
            out.has_rel_target = true;
            out.rel_target     = in.ops[i].val;
            break;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

bool is_arm(hype::Arch arch) {
    return arch == hype::Arch::ARM || arch == hype::Arch::ARM64;
}

} // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// compat shim

insn_t session_t::convert(const hype::Insn& in) {
    insn_t out;
    out.va     = in.addr;
    out.length = in.len < ZYDIS_MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH ? in.len
                                                        : ZYDIS_MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH;
    std::memcpy(out.bytes, in.bytes, out.length);

    // x86/x64: hyperion stores the raw Zydis enums as u16
    out.mnemonic = static_cast<ZydisMnemonic>(in.mnemonic_id);
    out.text     = upper_mnemonic(in.mnemonic);
    if (in.op_str[0] != '\0') out.text += " ", out.text += in.op_str;

    switch (in.type) {
    case hype::InsnType::Call: out.flow = flow_t::call; break;
    case hype::InsnType::Jmp:  out.flow = flow_t::jmp;  break;
    case hype::InsnType::Jcc:  out.flow = flow_t::jcc;  break;
    case hype::InsnType::Ret:  out.flow = flow_t::ret;  break;
    default:                   out.flow = flow_t::none; break;
    }

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < in.op_count && i < ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT_VISIBLE; ++i) {
        const hype::Operand& src = in.ops[i];
        operand_t&           o   = out.ops[out.op_count++];
        o.read = src.read;
        o.write = src.write;
        switch (src.type) {
        case hype::OpType::Reg:
            o.cls = op_class_t::reg;
            o.reg = static_cast<ZydisRegister>(src.reg);
            break;
        case hype::OpType::Imm:
            o.cls = op_class_t::imm;
            o.imm = src.val;
            break;
        case hype::OpType::Mem:
            o.cls       = op_class_t::mem;
            o.mem_base  = static_cast<ZydisRegister>(src.mem.base);
            o.mem_index = static_cast<ZydisRegister>(src.mem.index);
            o.scale     = src.mem.scale ? src.mem.scale : 1;
            o.disp      = src.mem.disp;
            break;
        default:
            o.cls = op_class_t::none;
            break;
        }
    }

    // Branch destination: first immediate operand (hyperion's own
    // branch_target() contract)
    if (out.flow == flow_t::call || out.flow == flow_t::jmp ||
        out.flow == flow_t::jcc) {
        if (in.op_count > 0 && in.ops[0].type == hype::OpType::Imm) {
            out.has_rel_target = true;
            out.rel_target     = in.ops[0].val;
        }
    }

    // First rip-relative memory operand, hyperion precomputed the absolute
    // address into Operand::val for RIP/EIP-based operands
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < in.op_count; ++i) {
        const hype::Operand& src = in.ops[i];
        if (src.type != hype::OpType::Mem) continue;
        if (src.mem.base != static_cast<uint16_t>(ZYDIS_REGISTER_RIP) &&
            src.mem.base != static_cast<uint16_t>(ZYDIS_REGISTER_EIP))
            continue;
        out.has_rip_rel    = true;
        out.rip_rel_target = src.val;
        break;
    }

    return out;
}

bool session_t::decode(uint64_t va, const uint8_t* buf, size_t len,
                       insn_t& out, hype::Arch arch) {
    if (!buf || len == 0) return false;
    hype::Insn in;
    if (is_arm(arch)) {
        // per-thread handle: concurrent MCP/UI decodes no longer serialize
        if (!hype::thread_capstone(arch).decode(va, buf, len, in)) return false;
        out = convert_arm(in);
        return true;
    }
    std::lock_guard lk(g_decoder_mu);
    if (!shared_decoder().decode(va, buf, len, in)) return false;
    out = convert(in);
    return true;
}

std::vector<insn_t> session_t::decode_range(uint64_t va, const uint8_t* buf,
                                             size_t len, size_t count) {
    std::vector<insn_t> out;
    if (!buf || len == 0 || count == 0) return out;

    std::lock_guard lk(g_decoder_mu);
    out.reserve(count);
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < len && out.size() < count) {
        hype::Insn in;
        if (shared_decoder().decode(va + off, buf + off, len - off, in)) {
            out.push_back(convert(in));
            off += in.len ? in.len : 1;
        } else {
            ++off;  // 1-byte resync on bad bytes
        }
    }
    return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// lifecycle

session_t::session_t()  = default;

session_t::~session_t() {
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    if (analyzer_ && !ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        analyzer_->request_cancel();
    if (worker_.joinable()) worker_.join();
    analyzer_.reset();
}

void session_t::join_worker() {
    // caller holds start_mu_
    if (worker_.joinable()) worker_.join();
}

void session_t::set_error(std::string msg) {
    std::lock_guard lk(err_mu_);
    err_ = std::move(msg);
    ready_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
}

bool session_t::begin(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t len, uint64_t base_override) {
    // caller holds start_mu_ and the worker is joined
    ready_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    block_ranges_.clear();
    invalidate_decomp_cache();
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(err_mu_);
        err_.clear();
    }

    // thin or FAT Mach-O (an .ipa was already reduced to its executable by
    // image_open), ELF (a SELF is unwrapped to its ELF first), else PE
    std::optional<hype::PEImage> parsed;
    const char* kind = "PE";
    std::string why;
    if (hype::MachOLoader::is_macho(bytes, len)) {
        kind = "Mach-O";
        hype::MachOLoader loader;
        parsed = loader.load_buffer(bytes, len);
    } else if (hype::SELFLoader::is_self(bytes, len)) {
        kind = "SELF";
        auto ex = hype::SELFLoader::extract_elf(bytes, len);
        if (!ex.ok) {
            why = ": " + ex.error;
        } else {
            // the image borrows the rebuilt ELF, keep it alive with it
            auto elf = std::make_shared<std::vector<uint8_t>>(std::move(ex.elf));
            hype::ELFLoader loader;
            parsed = loader.load_buffer(elf->data(), elf->size());
            if (parsed) parsed->storage.push_back(std::move(elf));
        }
    } else if (hype::ELFLoader::is_elf(bytes, len)) {
        kind = "ELF";
        hype::ELFLoader loader;
        parsed = loader.load_buffer(bytes, len);
    } else {
        hype::PELoader loader;
        parsed = loader.load_buffer(bytes, len);
    }
    if (!parsed) {
        set_error(std::string("hyperion: ") + kind + " parse failed" + why);
        return false;
    }
    img_ = std::move(*parsed);
    base_override_ = base_override;
    if (base_override) {
        // Rebase: shift every segment VA and the image base
        const uint64_t delta = base_override - img_.base;
        img_.base = base_override;
        img_.entry += delta;
        for (auto& seg : img_.segments) seg.va += delta;
        for (auto& imp : img_.imports)   imp.iat_addr += delta;
        for (auto& ex : img_.exports)    ex.addr += delta;
        for (auto& sym : img_.symbols)   sym.addr += delta;
        for (auto& rf : img_.runtime_funcs) { rf.start += delta; rf.end += delta; }
    }

    analyzer_ = std::make_unique<hype::Analyzer>(img_, pool_);
    analyzer_->set_insn_budget(analysis_insn_budget());
    return true;
}

void session_t::run_pipeline() {
    // Clear the running flag on every exit path (including the cancel
    // return and exceptions)
    struct flag_guard_t {
        std::atomic<bool>& f;
        ~flag_guard_t() { f.store(false, std::memory_order_release); }
    } run_flag{running_};

    try {
        analyzer_->run();
        if (analyzer_->was_cancelled()) {
            set_error("analysis cancelled");
            return;
        }
        // Re-apply user renames queued while analysis was running (and the
        // pre-load set from the persisted symbol store)
        {
            std::lock_guard plk(pending_mu_);
            for (const auto& [va, name] : pending_names_)
                analyzer_->db().names[va] = name;
        }
        ready_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        build_interval_index();
        slop::core::infra::diag::info(
            "hyperion", "analysis done — " +
                std::to_string(db().funcs.size()) + " functions, " +
                std::to_string(db().insns.size()) + " insns" +
                (analyzer_->budget_reached()
                     ? " (partial: instruction budget of " +
                           std::to_string(analyzer_->insn_budget()) + " reached)"
                     : std::string{}));
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        set_error(std::string("hyperion analysis failed: ") + e.what());
    } catch (...) {
        set_error("hyperion analysis failed: unknown error");
    }
}

void session_t::queue_names(
        const std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::string>& names) {
    std::lock_guard plk(pending_mu_);
    for (const auto& [va, name] : names) {
        if (name.empty()) pending_names_.erase(va);
        else              pending_names_[va] = name;
    }
    // Late arrivals after analysis completed: apply straight to the DB and
    // drop cached pseudocode (renames change emitted call names)
    if (ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        invalidate_decomp_cache();
        for (const auto& [va, name] : names) {
            if (name.empty()) analyzer_->db().names.erase(va);
            else              analyzer_->db().names[va] = name;
        }
    }
}

bool session_t::start(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t len, uint64_t base_override) {
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    join_worker();
    if (!begin(bytes, len, base_override)) return false;
    // Flip before spawning so running() is true the instant start()
    // returns, no "stopped" gap while the thread spins up
    running_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    worker_ = std::thread([this] { run_pipeline(); });
    return true;
}

bool session_t::start_sync(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t len,
                           uint64_t base_override) {
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    join_worker();
    if (!begin(bytes, len, base_override)) return false;
    running_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    run_pipeline();
    return ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

void session_t::reanalyze(const std::vector<uint8_t>& patched_bytes) {
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    invalidate_decomp_cache();
    if (analyzer_ && !ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        analyzer_->request_cancel();
    join_worker();
    if (!begin(patched_bytes.data(), patched_bytes.size(), base_override_)) return;
    running_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    worker_ = std::thread([this] { run_pipeline(); });
}

void session_t::stop() {
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    if (analyzer_ && !ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        analyzer_->request_cancel();
    join_worker();
    // A completed run between the flag and the join is fine, stop() is a
    // no-op then. A cancelled one left ready_ false with the error set
}

bool session_t::truncated() const {
    if (!ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    return analyzer_ && analyzer_->budget_reached();
}

bool session_t::running() const {
    if (ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;
    return running_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

float session_t::progress() const {
    if (ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return 1.f;
    std::lock_guard lk(start_mu_);
    // analyzer_ exists between begin() and destruction (both under
    // start_mu_); run() itself never touches the pointer
    return analyzer_ ? analyzer_->progress() : 0.f;
}

std::string session_t::error() const {
    if (ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return {};
    std::lock_guard lk(err_mu_);
    return err_;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// results

const hype::AnalysisDB& session_t::db() const { return analyzer_->db(); }
hype::AnalysisDB& session_t::db_mut() { return analyzer_->db(); }
const hype::RTTIParser& session_t::rtti() const { return analyzer_->rtti_parser(); }

const hype::SignatureMatcher& session_t::signatures() const {
    return analyzer_->sig_matcher();
}

const hype::DotNetDisassembler& session_t::dotnet() const { return analyzer_->dotnet(); }
bool session_t::is_dotnet() const { return analyzer_->is_dotnet(); }

const hype::Function* session_t::function_entry(uint64_t va) const {
    if (!ready()) return nullptr;
    const auto& funcs = db().funcs;
    const auto  it    = funcs.find(va);
    return it != funcs.end() ? &it->second : nullptr;
}

const hype::Function* session_t::function_at(uint64_t va) const {
    if (!ready()) return nullptr;
    // Exact entries win (deterministic), then the interval index
    if (const hype::Function* exact = function_entry(va)) return exact;
    // sorted interval index built once per analysis, binary search with a
    // short walk back for the rare overlaps
    auto it = std::upper_bound(
        block_ranges_.begin(), block_ranges_.end(), va,
        [](uint64_t value, const BlockRange& range) { return value < range.start; });
    while (it != block_ranges_.begin()) {
        --it;
        if (va < it->end) return it->func;
        if (va - it->start > (1ull << 20)) break;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void session_t::build_interval_index() {
    block_ranges_.clear();
    for (const auto& [entry, f] : db().funcs) {
        (void)entry;
        for (const auto& [start, bb] : f.blocks) {
            if (bb.end <= start) continue;
            block_ranges_.push_back({start, bb.end, &f});
        }
    }
    std::sort(block_ranges_.begin(), block_ranges_.end(),
              [](const BlockRange& a, const BlockRange& b) { return a.start < b.start; });
}

void session_t::invalidate_decomp_cache() {
    std::lock_guard lk(decomp_mu_);
    decomp_cache_.clear();
    decomp_lru_.clear();
}

void session_t::set_type_generation(std::function<uint64_t()> fn) {
    std::lock_guard lk(decomp_mu_);
    type_gen_ = std::move(fn);
}

void session_t::set_decomp_cache_capacity(size_t n) {
    std::lock_guard lk(decomp_mu_);
    decomp_cache_cap_ = n ? n : 1;
    while (decomp_cache_.size() > decomp_cache_cap_) {
        decomp_cache_.erase(decomp_lru_.back().entry);
        decomp_lru_.pop_back();
    }
}

size_t session_t::decomp_cache_size() const {
    std::lock_guard lk(decomp_mu_);
    return decomp_cache_.size();
}

bool session_t::decomp_cached(uint64_t entry) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(decomp_mu_);
    return decomp_cache_.count(entry) != 0;
}

bool session_t::decompile(uint64_t va, std::vector<hype::PseudoLine>& out,
                          std::string& err) {
    if (!ready()) {
        err = "hyperion analysis not ready";
        return false;
    }
    const hype::Function* f = function_at(va);
    if (!f) {
        err = "no function contains address " + std::to_string(va);
        return false;
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(decomp_mu_);
        const uint64_t gen = type_gen_ ? type_gen_() : 0;
        auto cached = decomp_cache_.find(f->entry);
        if (cached != decomp_cache_.end()) {
            if (cached->second->gen == gen) {
                // hit: move to the most-recently-used end
                decomp_lru_.splice(decomp_lru_.begin(), decomp_lru_, cached->second);
                out = cached->second->lines;
                return true;
            }
            // types/names changed since this entry was rendered
            decomp_lru_.erase(cached->second);
            decomp_cache_.erase(cached);
        }
        hype::Decompiler dec;
        out = dec.decompile(*f, db(), &rtti());
        if (out.empty()) {
            err = "decompiler produced no output";
            return false;
        }
        // Bounded LRU: evict the least recently used function, never the
        // whole cache (a full flush made every big-binary session thrash)
        if (decomp_cache_.size() >= decomp_cache_cap_ && !decomp_lru_.empty()) {
            decomp_cache_.erase(decomp_lru_.back().entry);
            decomp_lru_.pop_back();
        }
        decomp_lru_.push_front({f->entry, gen, out});
        decomp_cache_[f->entry] = decomp_lru_.begin();
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace slop::core::disasm::hyperion_session
```

`src/core/disasm/hyperion_session.hpp`:

```hpp
// src/core/disasm/hyperion_session.hpp
// the bridge between the vendored hyperion engine and our disasm stack
// analysis runs on its own thread and ready() only flips when its done so
// db reads after that never race a write, decompile is serialized because
// the pipeline objects are not re-entrant

#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <list>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "core/disasm/engine.hpp"

#include "core/analysis/analyzer.h"
#include "core/decompiler/decompiler.h"
#include "core/loader/pe_loader.h"
#include "threading/parallel.h"
#include "threading/worker_pool.h"

namespace slop::core::disasm::hyperion_session {

struct session_t {
    session_t();
    ~session_t();

    session_t(const session_t&)            = delete;
    session_t& operator=(const session_t&) = delete;

    // lifecycle

    // parse and analyze async on a private thread, base_override rebases the image
    bool start(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t len, uint64_t base_override);
    // Synchronous variant (tests / small images): runs on the caller thread
    bool start_sync(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t len, uint64_t base_override);
    // Re-run analysis from an in-memory (possibly patched) copy of the image
    void reanalyze(const std::vector<uint8_t>& patched_bytes);

    // cooperative cancel, flags the analyzer and waits for the worker to land
    void stop();

    // analysis landed but had to stop short of the whole image, see
    // analysis_insn_budget()
    bool        truncated() const;

    bool        ready() const { return ready_.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }
    // True while the background worker is running a pipeline (between
    // start()/reanalyze() and ready()/stop()/failure)
    bool        running() const;
    float       progress() const;
    std::string error() const;   // last analysis failure, "" when healthy

    // analysis results (only meaningful when ready())

    const hype::AnalysisDB&  db() const;       // analyzer_->db()
    hype::AnalysisDB&        db_mut();         // annotation merges (persist.hype_load)
    const hype::RTTIParser&  rtti() const;     // analyzer_->rtti_parser()
    const hype::PEImage&     image() const { return img_; }
    hype::Arch               arch() const { return img_.arch; }   // set by begin()
    const hype::SignatureMatcher& signatures() const;

    // Managed (.NET/CLI) view. is_dotnet() is only true after ready() on a CLI
    // image; dotnet().image() then carries the full type/member/IL model.
    const hype::DotNetDisassembler& dotnet() const;
    bool                            is_dotnet() const;

    // Containing function (any block spans va), or exact-entry lookup
    // function_at uses an interval index built once when analysis completes
    const hype::Function* function_at(uint64_t va) const;
    const hype::Function* function_entry(uint64_t va) const;

    // Decompile the function containing `va` to pseudo-C lines. Results are
    // cached per function entry (LRU, kDecompCacheCapacity functions) and
    // invalidated by reanalysis, renames, or a changed type generation
    bool decompile(uint64_t va, std::vector<hype::PseudoLine>& out,
                   std::string& err);
    static constexpr size_t kDecompCacheCapacity = 256;
    void   set_decomp_cache_capacity(size_t n);   // >= 1; trims on shrink
    size_t decomp_cache_size() const;
    bool   decomp_cached(uint64_t entry) const;

    // Source of the types/names generation the decompile cache stamps entries
    // with (binary_state wires this to re::type_catalog::generation). A
    // changed value re-renders the next decompile instead of serving stale
    // pseudocode. Null source means generation 0 (never invalidates)
    void set_type_generation(std::function<uint64_t()> fn);

    // User renames to apply onto the AnalysisDB once analysis lands (names
    // the analyzer derives would otherwise clobber mid-analysis renames)
    void queue_names(const std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::string>& names);

    // hyperion decode through the slop insn abi, lossless for everything
    // consumers read, operand flags are heuristic. x86/x64 only: the insn_t
    // mnemonic and register fields are Zydis enums
    static insn_t convert(const hype::Insn& in);

    // One-shot decode of a raw buffer. X86/X64 go through hyperion's Zydis
    // core (convert() above). ARM/ARM64 decode with this thread's Capstone
    // handle: text is "<MNEMONIC> <op_str>", flow comes from the instruction
    // type, rel_target is the last immediate of a direct branch (b.cond/cbz/
    // tbz put the target after the tested operands), operands carry Capstone
    // register ids in operand_t::arm_* (the Zydis enum fields stay NONE)
    static bool decode(uint64_t va, const uint8_t* buf, size_t len,
                       insn_t& out, hype::Arch arch = hype::Arch::X64);
    // Decode `count` instructions starting at va with 1-byte resync on bad
    // bytes (same contract as the old engine-based MCP path)
    static std::vector<insn_t> decode_range(uint64_t va, const uint8_t* buf,
                                             size_t len, size_t count);

private:
    void run_pipeline();          // caller: worker_ or start_sync
    void join_worker();
    bool begin(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t len, uint64_t base_override);
    void set_error(std::string msg);   // err_mu_-guarded
    void build_interval_index();       // after analysis completes
    void invalidate_decomp_cache();

    hype::WorkerPool pool_{hype::worker_thread_count()};
    hype::PEImage    img_;
    uint64_t         base_override_ = 0;
    std::unique_ptr<hype::Analyzer> analyzer_;

    // Immutable after ready_: sorted [start, end) block ranges → function
    struct BlockRange { uint64_t start; uint64_t end; const hype::Function* func; };
    std::vector<BlockRange> block_ranges_;

    // Decompile cache, keyed by function entry, most recent first. Valid
    // until reanalyze/queue_names or a type generation change; guarded by
    // decomp_mu_
    struct decomp_entry_t {
        uint64_t                      entry = 0;
        uint64_t                      gen   = 0;
        std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> lines;
    };
    using decomp_lru_t = std::list<decomp_entry_t>;
    decomp_lru_t decomp_lru_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, decomp_lru_t::iterator> decomp_cache_;
    size_t decomp_cache_cap_ = kDecompCacheCapacity;
    std::function<uint64_t()> type_gen_;   // guarded by decomp_mu_

    std::thread        worker_;
    mutable std::mutex start_mu_;   // serializes start/reanalyze/stop/dtor
    mutable std::mutex err_mu_;     // err_ is read cross-thread
    mutable std::mutex decomp_mu_;  // Decompiler pipeline not re-entrant; decomp cache
    std::mutex         pending_mu_; // pending_names_ (queue_names vs worker)
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::string> pending_names_;
    std::atomic<bool>  ready_{false};
    std::atomic<bool>  running_{false};
    std::string        err_;        // written before ready_ flip / on failure
};

// Shared decode engine (thread-guarded; hyperion's Zydis decoder carries no
// cross-call state, but the C++ wrapper is cheap to lock)
hype::Disassembler& shared_decoder();

// How many instructions a single analysis may put in the database. The DB
// holds one record per instruction plus another per basic block, so a few
// hundred megabytes of code would need tens of gigabytes; past the budget the
// run stops descending and reports truncated() instead of thrashing.
//
// Derived from available RAM, floor 250K, ceiling 2M. SLOP_HYPERION_INSN_BUDGET
// overrides it (0 disables the cap entirely)
size_t analysis_insn_budget();

} // namespace slop::core::disasm::hyperion_session
```

`src/core/disasm/image_open.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/disasm/image_open.cpp

#include "core/disasm/image_open.hpp"

#include "core/loader/elf_loader.h"
#include "core/loader/macho_loader.h"
#include "core/loader/self_loader.h"
#include "core/util/zip_reader.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace slop::core::disasm {

namespace {

constexpr uint16_t kMachineX86   = 0x014C;
constexpr uint16_t kMachineX64   = 0x8664;
constexpr uint16_t kMachineArmNt = 0x01C4;
constexpr uint16_t kMachineArm64 = 0xAA64;

constexpr uint64_t kMaxRva = std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();

bool arch_from_hype(hype::Arch a, image_arch_t& out) {
    switch (a) {
    case hype::Arch::X86:   out = image_arch_t::x86;   return true;
    case hype::Arch::X64:   out = image_arch_t::x64;   return true;
    case hype::Arch::ARM:   out = image_arch_t::arm;   return true;
    case hype::Arch::ARM64: out = image_arch_t::arm64; return true;
    default:                return false;
    }
}

uint16_t machine_for(image_arch_t a) {
    switch (a) {
    case image_arch_t::x86:   return kMachineX86;
    case image_arch_t::x64:   return kMachineX64;
    case image_arch_t::arm:   return kMachineArmNt;
    case image_arch_t::arm64: return kMachineArm64;
    }
    return 0;
}

// the hyperion loader parses, the legacy stack gets the same facts as a
// pe_image_t so rva/offset/section/string consumers need no Mach-O branch
void synthesize_section_map(const hype::PEImage& img, image_arch_t arch,
                            size_t file_size, pe_image_t& pe) {
    pe.ok         = true;
    pe.pe32plus   = arch == image_arch_t::x64 || arch == image_arch_t::arm64;
    pe.machine    = machine_for(arch);
    pe.image_base = img.base;
    if (img.entry >= img.base && img.entry - img.base <= kMaxRva)
        pe.entry_rva = static_cast<uint32_t>(img.entry - img.base);

    uint64_t image_end = 0;
    for (const auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.va < img.base || seg.va - img.base > kMaxRva) continue;
        pe_section_t s;
        const size_t n = std::min(seg.name.size(), sizeof(s.name) - 1);
        std::memcpy(s.name, seg.name.data(), n);
        s.rva          = static_cast<uint32_t>(seg.va - img.base);
        s.virtual_size = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(seg.size, kMaxRva - s.rva));
        if (seg.file_sz && seg.file_off < file_size) {
            s.raw_offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(seg.file_off, kMaxRva));
            s.raw_size   = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(
                {seg.file_sz, file_size - seg.file_off, kMaxRva}));
        }
        s.characteristics = seg.flags;
        image_end = std::max<uint64_t>(image_end, uint64_t{s.rva} + s.virtual_size);
        pe.sections.push_back(s);
    }
    pe.size_of_image = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min(image_end, kMaxRva));

    // group slots per dylib in first-seen order, like a PE import directory
    std::unordered_map<std::string, size_t> dll_index;
    for (const auto& imp : img.imports) {
        if (imp.iat_addr < img.base || imp.iat_addr - img.base > kMaxRva) continue;
        const std::string dll = imp.dll.empty() ? "(flat namespace)" : imp.dll;
        auto [it, fresh] = dll_index.try_emplace(dll, pe.imports.size());
        if (fresh) pe.imports.push_back({dll, {}});
        pe_import_func_t fn;
        fn.name    = imp.name;
        fn.iat_rva = static_cast<uint32_t>(imp.iat_addr - img.base);
        pe.imports[it->second].functions.push_back(std::move(fn));
    }

    for (const auto& ex : img.exports) {
        if (ex.addr < img.base || ex.addr - img.base > kMaxRva) continue;
        pe_export_t e;
        e.name = ex.name;
        e.rva  = static_cast<uint32_t>(ex.addr - img.base);
        pe.exports.push_back(std::move(e));
    }

    for (const auto& rf : img.runtime_funcs) {
        if (rf.start < img.base || rf.end <= rf.start || rf.end - img.base > kMaxRva) continue;
        pe.runtime_funcs.push_back({static_cast<uint32_t>(rf.start - img.base),
                                    static_cast<uint32_t>(rf.end - img.base)});
    }
}

// `format` is elf for a plain ELF, self when `raw` is an ELF rebuilt from a
// SELF. The loader borrows out.file, so the bytes move in first
void open_elf(std::vector<uint8_t> raw, image_format_t format, opened_image_t& out) {
    out.file = std::move(raw);
    hype::ELFLoader loader;
    const auto img = loader.load_buffer(out.file.data(), out.file.size());
    if (!img) {
        out.error = "elf: could not parse ELF (unsupported arch or truncated file)";
        return;
    }
    if (!arch_from_hype(img->arch, out.arch)) {
        out.error = "elf: unsupported cpu type (only x86/x64/arm/arm64 are mapped)";
        return;
    }
    out.format      = format;
    out.header_base = loader.header_base();
    synthesize_section_map(*img, out.arch, out.file.size(), out.pe);
    if (out.pe.sections.empty()) {
        out.error = "elf: no loadable segments";
        return;
    }
    out.ok = true;
}

void open_macho(std::vector<uint8_t> raw, opened_image_t& out) {
    const auto slice = hype::MachOLoader::select_slice(raw.data(), raw.size());
    if (!slice) {
        out.error = "macho: no supported architecture slice (arm64, x86_64, arm, x86)";
        return;
    }
    // analyze one thin slice so file offsets, patches and the annotation
    // hash all refer to the bytes the section map describes
    if (slice->offset == 0 && slice->size == raw.size()) {
        out.file = std::move(raw);
    } else {
        const auto first = raw.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(slice->offset);
        out.file.assign(first, first + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(slice->size));
    }

    hype::MachOLoader loader;
    const auto img = loader.load_buffer(out.file.data(), out.file.size());
    if (!img) {
        out.error = "macho: load commands could not be parsed";
        return;
    }
    if (!arch_from_hype(img->arch, out.arch)) {
        out.error = "macho: unsupported cpu type";
        return;
    }
    out.format    = image_format_t::macho;
    out.encrypted = img->encrypted;
    synthesize_section_map(*img, out.arch, out.file.size(), out.pe);
    if (out.pe.sections.empty()) {
        out.error = "macho: no mapped sections";
        return;
    }
    out.ok = true;
}

} // namespace

const char* image_format_name(image_format_t f) noexcept {
    switch (f) {
    case image_format_t::pe:    return "pe";
    case image_format_t::macho: return "macho";
    case image_format_t::elf:   return "elf";
    case image_format_t::self:  return "self";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

const char* image_arch_name(image_arch_t a) noexcept {
    switch (a) {
    case image_arch_t::x86:   return "x86";
    case image_arch_t::x64:   return "x64";
    case image_arch_t::arm:   return "arm";
    case image_arch_t::arm64: return "arm64";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

hype::Arch hype_arch(image_arch_t a) noexcept {
    switch (a) {
    case image_arch_t::x86:   return hype::Arch::X86;
    case image_arch_t::x64:   return hype::Arch::X64;
    case image_arch_t::arm:   return hype::Arch::ARM;
    case image_arch_t::arm64: return hype::Arch::ARM64;
    }
    return hype::Arch::X64;
}

opened_image_t open_image(std::vector<uint8_t> raw) {
    opened_image_t out;

    if (util::zip::has_zip_magic(raw.data(), raw.size())) {
        if (!ipa::looks_like_ipa(raw.data(), raw.size())) {
            out.error = "zip archive without a Payload/<name>.app bundle (not an .ipa)";
            return out;
        }
        auto ex = ipa::extract_main_binary(raw.data(), raw.size());
        if (!ex.ok) {
            out.error = ex.error;
            return out;
        }
        if (!hype::MachOLoader::is_macho(ex.binary.data(), ex.binary.size())) {
            out.error = "ipa: main executable '" + ex.bundle.executable_path +
                        "' is not a Mach-O";
            return out;
        }
        out.bundle = std::move(ex.bundle);
        raw = std::move(ex.binary);
    }

    if (hype::MachOLoader::is_macho(raw.data(), raw.size())) {
        open_macho(std::move(raw), out);
        return out;
    }

    if (hype::ELFLoader::is_elf(raw.data(), raw.size())) {
        open_elf(std::move(raw), image_format_t::elf, out);
        return out;
    }

    if (hype::SELFLoader::is_self(raw.data(), raw.size())) {
        auto ex = hype::SELFLoader::extract_elf(raw.data(), raw.size());
        if (!ex.ok) {
            out.error = std::move(ex.error);
            return out;
        }
        open_elf(std::move(ex.elf), image_format_t::self, out);
        return out;
    }

    out.pe = pe_parse(raw.data(), raw.size());
    if (!out.pe.ok) {
        out.error = "unrecognized image format (expected PE, Mach-O, ELF, PS4 SELF or .ipa)";
        return out;
    }
    // same rule the hyperion PE loader applies: the optional header picks
    // the decoder
    out.format = image_format_t::pe;
    out.arch   = out.pe.pe32plus ? image_arch_t::x64 : image_arch_t::x86;
    out.file   = std::move(raw);
    out.ok     = true;
    return out;
}

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

`src/core/disasm/image_open.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/disasm/image_open.hpp
// turns file bytes into something the disasm stack can analyze: a PE as is,
// the main Mach-O of an .ipa / a thin or FAT Mach-O reduced to one thin
// slice, an ELF, or a PS4 SELF unwrapped to its ELF, plus a synthesized
// pe_image_t section map so offset, section and string consumers work
// unchanged. detection is by content, never extension
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "core/disasm/ipa.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp"
#include "core/types.h"

namespace slop::core::disasm {

enum class image_format_t : uint8_t { pe, macho, elf, self };
enum class image_arch_t   : uint8_t { x86, x64, arm, arm64 };

const char* image_format_name(image_format_t f) noexcept;   // "pe" | "macho" | "elf" | "self"
const char* image_arch_name(image_arch_t a) noexcept;       // "x86" | "x64" | "arm" | "arm64"
hype::Arch  hype_arch(image_arch_t a) noexcept;

struct opened_image_t {
    bool                          ok = false;
    std::string                   error;
    image_format_t                format = image_format_t::pe;
    image_arch_t                  arch   = image_arch_t::x64;
    std::vector<uint8_t>          file;   // analyzed bytes: the PE, the thin Mach-O slice, or the (unwrapped) ELF
    pe_image_t                    pe;     // section/import/export map, synthesized for Mach-O/ELF
    bool                          encrypted = false;
    std::optional<ipa::bundle_t>  bundle; // set when opened from an .ipa
    // ELF/SELF: address of the ELF header when it sits below the first
    // loadable segment (pe.image_base otherwise). A runtime base equal to it
    // means "mapped at these vas", not "shift by the difference"
    uint64_t                      header_base = 0;

    bool is_x86() const noexcept {
        return arch == image_arch_t::x86 || arch == image_arch_t::x64;
    }
};

// PE, thin or FAT Mach-O, ELF, PS4 SELF (fake-signed/unencrypted; encrypted
// ones fail with a pointer to the console dump path) or .ipa. On failure ok
// is false and error says why
opened_image_t open_image(std::vector<uint8_t> raw);

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

`src/core/disasm/ipa.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/disasm/ipa.cpp

#include "core/disasm/ipa.hpp"

#include "core/util/zip_reader.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>

namespace slop::core::disasm::ipa {

namespace {

namespace zip = slop::core::util::zip;

// top-level dict string values only
using plist_map_t = std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>;

constexpr uint64_t         kMaxInfoPlist = 16ull << 20;   // 16 MiB
constexpr std::string_view kPayload      = "Payload/";

void append_utf8(std::string& s, uint32_t cp) {
    if (cp < 0x80) {
        s += static_cast<char>(cp);
    } else if (cp < 0x800) {
        s += static_cast<char>(0xC0 | (cp >> 6));
        s += static_cast<char>(0x80 | (cp & 0x3F));
    } else if (cp < 0x10000) {
        s += static_cast<char>(0xE0 | (cp >> 12));
        s += static_cast<char>(0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3F));
        s += static_cast<char>(0x80 | (cp & 0x3F));
    } else {
        s += static_cast<char>(0xF0 | (cp >> 18));
        s += static_cast<char>(0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3F));
        s += static_cast<char>(0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3F));
        s += static_cast<char>(0x80 | (cp & 0x3F));
    }
}

// ---- binary plist (bplist00) ------------------------------------------------

uint64_t rd_be(const uint8_t* p, size_t n) noexcept {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) v = (v << 8) | p[i];
    return v;
}

bool parse_bplist(const uint8_t* d, size_t len, plist_map_t& out) {
    constexpr size_t kHeader  = 8;
    constexpr size_t kTrailer = 32;
    if (len < kHeader + kTrailer || std::memcmp(d, "bplist00", kHeader) != 0) return false;

    const uint8_t* t        = d + len - kTrailer;
    const size_t   oint     = t[6];
    const size_t   ref      = t[7];
    const uint64_t num      = rd_be(t + 8, 8);
    const uint64_t top      = rd_be(t + 16, 8);
    const uint64_t table    = rd_be(t + 24, 8);
    const size_t   objs_end = len - kTrailer;
    if (oint < 1 || oint > 8 || ref < 1 || ref > 8) return false;
    if (num == 0 || top >= num) return false;
    if (table < kHeader || table > objs_end) return false;
    if (num > (objs_end - table) / oint) return false;

    auto obj_off = [&](uint64_t idx, size_t& off) {
        if (idx >= num) return false;
        const uint64_t o = rd_be(d + table + static_cast<size_t>(idx) * oint, oint);
        if (o < kHeader || o >= objs_end) return false;
        off = static_cast<size_t>(o);
        return true;
    };
    // marker nibbles + element count; `pos` lands on the payload
    auto obj_head = [&](size_t off, uint8_t& type, uint64_t& count, size_t& pos) {
        const uint8_t m = d[off];
        type  = static_cast<uint8_t>(m >> 4);
        count = m & 0x0F;
        pos   = off + 1;
        if (count == 0x0F) {
            if (pos >= objs_end) return false;
            const uint8_t im = d[pos++];
            if ((im >> 4) != 0x1 || (im & 0x0F) > 3) return false;
            const size_t n = size_t(1) << (im & 0x0F);
            if (n > objs_end - pos) return false;
            count = rd_be(d + pos, n);
            pos += n;
        }
        return true;
    };
    auto read_string = [&](uint64_t idx, std::string& s) {
        size_t   off = 0, pos = 0;
        uint8_t  type = 0;
        uint64_t count = 0;
        if (!obj_off(idx, off) || !obj_head(off, type, count, pos)) return false;
        const size_t avail = objs_end - pos;
        if (type == 0x5) {
            if (count > avail) return false;
            s.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + pos), static_cast<size_t>(count));
            return true;
        }
        if (type == 0x6) {
            if (count > avail / 2) return false;
            s.clear();
            const uint8_t* p = d + pos;
            const size_t   n = static_cast<size_t>(count);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                uint32_t u = (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[i * 2]) << 8) | p[i * 2 + 1];
                if (u >= 0xD800 && u <= 0xDBFF && i + 1 < n) {
                    const uint32_t lo = (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[i * 2 + 2]) << 8) | p[i * 2 + 3];
                    if (lo >= 0xDC00 && lo <= 0xDFFF) {
                        append_utf8(s, 0x10000 + ((u - 0xD800) << 10) + (lo - 0xDC00));
                        ++i;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (u >= 0xD800 && u <= 0xDFFF) u = 0xFFFD;   // unpaired surrogate
                append_utf8(s, u);
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    };

    size_t   off = 0, pos = 0;
    uint8_t  type = 0;
    uint64_t count = 0;
    if (!obj_off(top, off) || !obj_head(off, type, count, pos) || type != 0xD) return false;
    if (count > (objs_end - pos) / ref / 2) return false;
    const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(count);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const uint64_t kref = rd_be(d + pos + i * ref, ref);
        const uint64_t vref = rd_be(d + pos + (n + i) * ref, ref);
        if (kref >= num || vref >= num) return false;
        std::string key, value;
        if (!read_string(kref, key)) continue;     // non-string key
        if (!read_string(vref, value)) continue;   // non-string value
        out[std::move(key)] = std::move(value);
    }
    return true;
}

// ---- xml plist --------------------------------------------------------------

enum class tag_kind_t : uint8_t { open, close, empty };

struct tag_t {
    tag_kind_t       kind = tag_kind_t::open;
    std::string_view name;
};

bool is_space(char c) noexcept {
    return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n';
}

// position just past `term` searched from `from`
bool skip_past(std::string_view s, size_t from, std::string_view term, size_t& pos) {
    const size_t e = s.find(term, from);
    if (e == std::string_view::npos) return false;
    pos = e + term.size();
    return true;
}

// next element tag at or after `pos`, skipping text, comments, processing
// instructions, doctype and cdata
bool next_tag(std::string_view s, size_t& pos, tag_t& tag) {
    for (;;) {
        const size_t lt = s.find('<', pos);
        if (lt == std::string_view::npos) return false;
        const std::string_view rest = s.substr(lt);
        if (rest.starts_with("<!--")) {
            if (!skip_past(s, lt + 4, "-->", pos)) return false;
            continue;
        }
        if (rest.starts_with("<![CDATA[")) {
            if (!skip_past(s, lt + 9, "]]>", pos)) return false;
            continue;
        }
        if (rest.starts_with("<?")) {
            if (!skip_past(s, lt + 2, "?>", pos)) return false;
            continue;
        }
        if (rest.starts_with("<!")) {
            if (!skip_past(s, lt + 2, ">", pos)) return false;
            continue;
        }

        size_t p       = lt + 1;
        bool   closing = false;
        if (p < s.size() && s[p] == '/') { closing = true; ++p; }
        const size_t name_start = p;
        while (p < s.size() && !is_space(s[p]) && s[p] != '/' && s[p] != '>') ++p;
        if (p == name_start) return false;
        tag.name = s.substr(name_start, p - name_start);

        char quote = 0;
        for (; p < s.size(); ++p) {
            const char c = s[p];
            if (quote) {
                if (c == quote) quote = 0;
            } else if (c == '"' || c == '\'') {
                quote = c;
            } else if (c == '>') {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (p >= s.size()) return false;
        tag.kind = closing ? tag_kind_t::close
                 : s[p - 1] == '/' ? tag_kind_t::empty
                 : tag_kind_t::open;
        pos = p + 1;
        return true;
    }
}

void decode_entities(std::string_view t, std::string& out) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < t.size();) {
        if (t[i] != '&') { out += t[i++]; continue; }
        const size_t semi = t.find(';', i);
        if (semi == std::string_view::npos || semi - i > 12) { out += t[i++]; continue; }
        const std::string_view ent = t.substr(i + 1, semi - i - 1);
        if      (ent == "amp")  out += '&';
        else if (ent == "lt")   out += '<';
        else if (ent == "gt")   out += '>';
        else if (ent == "quot") out += '"';
        else if (ent == "apos") out += '\'';
        else if (ent.size() >= 2 && ent[0] == '#') {
            const bool hex   = ent[1] == 'x' || ent[1] == 'X';
            size_t     k     = hex ? 2 : 1;
            uint32_t   cp    = 0;
            bool       valid = k < ent.size();
            for (; valid && k < ent.size(); ++k) {
                const char c = ent[k];
                uint32_t   digit = 0;
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')             digit = static_cast<uint32_t>(c - '0');
                else if (hex && c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') digit = static_cast<uint32_t>(c - 'a' + 10);
                else if (hex && c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') digit = static_cast<uint32_t>(c - 'A' + 10);
                else { valid = false; break; }
                cp = cp * (hex ? 16 : 10) + digit;
                if (cp > 0x10FFFF) valid = false;
            }
            if (!valid || cp == 0 || (cp >= 0xD800 && cp <= 0xDFFF)) { out += t[i++]; continue; }
            append_utf8(out, cp);
        } else {
            out += t[i++];
            continue;
        }
        i = semi + 1;
    }
}

// character content up to the matching `</name>` (pos is just past the open tag)
bool read_text(std::string_view s, size_t& pos, std::string_view name, std::string& out) {
    out.clear();
    for (;;) {
        const size_t lt = s.find('<', pos);
        if (lt == std::string_view::npos) return false;
        decode_entities(s.substr(pos, lt - pos), out);
        const std::string_view rest = s.substr(lt);
        if (rest.starts_with("<![CDATA[")) {
            const size_t e = s.find("]]>", lt + 9);
            if (e == std::string_view::npos) return false;
            out.append(s.substr(lt + 9, e - lt - 9));
            pos = e + 3;
            continue;
        }
        if (rest.starts_with("<!--")) {
            if (!skip_past(s, lt + 4, "-->", pos)) return false;
            continue;
        }
        pos = lt;
        tag_t t;
        if (!next_tag(s, pos, t)) return false;
        return t.kind == tag_kind_t::close && t.name == name;
    }
}

// skip the rest of an element whose open tag was just consumed
bool skip_element(std::string_view s, size_t& pos) {
    size_t depth = 1;
    tag_t  t;
    while (depth) {
        if (!next_tag(s, pos, t)) return false;
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::open)       ++depth;
        else if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::close) --depth;
    }
    return true;
}

bool parse_xml_plist(std::string_view s, plist_map_t& out) {
    size_t pos = 0;
    tag_t  t;
    // root: optional <plist>, then the top-level <dict>
    for (;;) {
        if (!next_tag(s, pos, t)) return false;
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::open && t.name == "plist") continue;
        if (t.name == "dict" && t.kind == tag_kind_t::empty) return true;
        if (t.name == "dict" && t.kind == tag_kind_t::open) break;
        return false;
    }

    // inside the top dict: only depth-1 <key> elements count
    bool pending = false;   // `t` already holds the next tag
    for (;;) {
        if (!pending && !next_tag(s, pos, t)) return false;
        pending = false;
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::close) return t.name == "dict";
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::empty) continue;
        if (t.name != "key") {
            if (!skip_element(s, pos)) return false;
            continue;
        }

        std::string key;
        if (!read_text(s, pos, "key", key)) return false;
        if (!next_tag(s, pos, t)) return false;
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::close) return t.name == "dict";   // key without value
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::open && t.name == "key") { pending = true; continue; }
        if (t.name == "string") {
            std::string value;
            if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::open && !read_text(s, pos, "string", value)) return false;
            out[std::move(key)] = std::move(value);
            continue;
        }
        if (t.kind == tag_kind_t::open && !skip_element(s, pos)) return false;
    }
}

bool parse_plist(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, plist_map_t& out) {
    if (bytes.size() >= 8 && std::memcmp(bytes.data(), "bplist00", 8) == 0)
        return parse_bplist(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), out);
    return parse_xml_plist(std::string_view(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),
                                            bytes.size()), out);
}

// ---- bundle layout ----------------------------------------------------------

// "Payload/<X>.app/" when `name` lives under a top-level app bundle
std::optional<std::string_view> top_app_dir(std::string_view name) {
    if (!name.starts_with(kPayload)) return std::nullopt;
    const std::string_view rest  = name.substr(kPayload.size());
    const size_t           slash = rest.find('/');
    if (slash == std::string_view::npos) return std::nullopt;
    const std::string_view comp = rest.substr(0, slash);
    if (comp.size() <= 4 || !comp.ends_with(".app")) return std::nullopt;
    return name.substr(0, kPayload.size() + slash + 1);
}

std::optional<std::string> find_app_dir(const zip::archive_t& ar) {
    std::optional<std::string_view> best;
    for (const auto& e : ar.entries()) {
        const auto dir = top_app_dir(e.name);
        if (dir && (!best || *dir < *best)) best = dir;
    }
    if (!best) return std::nullopt;
    return std::string(*best);
}

std::string plist_value(const plist_map_t& m, const char* key) {
    const auto it = m.find(key);
    return it == m.end() ? std::string() : it->second;
}

} // namespace

bool looks_like_ipa(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    if (!zip::has_zip_magic(data, len)) return false;
    zip::archive_t ar;
    if (!ar.open(data, len)) return false;
    for (const auto& e : ar.entries())
        if (top_app_dir(e.name)) return true;
    return false;
}

extract_result_t extract_main_binary(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    extract_result_t r;
    if (!zip::has_zip_magic(data, len)) {
        r.error = "ipa: not a zip archive";
        return r;
    }
    zip::archive_t ar;
    std::string    err;
    if (!ar.open(data, len, &err)) {
        r.error = "ipa: " + err;
        return r;
    }
    const auto app_dir = find_app_dir(ar);
    if (!app_dir) {
        r.error = "ipa: no Payload/<name>.app/ bundle found";
        return r;
    }

    bundle_t& b = r.bundle;
    b.app_dir   = *app_dir;
    const std::string stem =
        b.app_dir.substr(kPayload.size(), b.app_dir.size() - kPayload.size() - 5);   // drop ".app/"

    plist_map_t info;
    if (const zip::entry_t* pe = ar.find(b.app_dir + "Info.plist")) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        if (!ar.extract(*pe, bytes, nullptr, kMaxInfoPlist) || !parse_plist(bytes, info))
            info.clear();
    }
    b.executable = plist_value(info, "CFBundleExecutable");
    if (b.executable.empty()) b.executable = stem;
    b.bundle_id = plist_value(info, "CFBundleIdentifier");
    b.version   = plist_value(info, "CFBundleShortVersionString");
    b.build     = plist_value(info, "CFBundleVersion");
    b.min_os    = plist_value(info, "MinimumOSVersion");
    b.executable_path = b.app_dir + b.executable;

    const zip::entry_t* exe = ar.find(b.executable_path);
    if (!exe || exe->is_directory()) {
        r.error = "ipa: main executable '" + b.executable_path + "' not found";
        return r;
    }
    if (!ar.extract(*exe, r.binary, &err)) {
        r.error = "ipa: cannot extract '" + b.executable_path + "': " + err;
        r.binary.clear();
        return r;
    }
    r.ok = true;
    return r;
}

} // namespace slop::core::disasm::ipa
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/disasm/ipa.hpp
// iOS app archive (.ipa): locate Payload/<Name>.app/, read Info.plist
// (xml or binary) and pull out the main executable

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::disasm::ipa {

struct bundle_t {
    std::string app_dir;          // "Payload/Foo.app/"
    std::string executable;       // CFBundleExecutable, or the .app stem fallback
    std::string executable_path;  // archive path of the main binary
    std::string bundle_id;        // CFBundleIdentifier (may be empty)
    std::string version;          // CFBundleShortVersionString
    std::string build;            // CFBundleVersion
    std::string min_os;           // MinimumOSVersion
};

struct extract_result_t {
    bool                 ok = false;
    std::string          error;
    bundle_t             bundle;
    std::vector<uint8_t> binary;   // main executable bytes as stored (thin or FAT)
};

// ZIP with a top-level "Payload/<name>.app/" bundle
bool looks_like_ipa(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);
extract_result_t extract_main_binary(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);
```

`src/core/disasm/pe_parser.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/disasm/pe_parser.cpp

#include "core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp"

#include <cstring>

namespace slop::core::disasm {

namespace {

template <typename T>
bool read_at(const uint8_t* d, size_t len, size_t off, T& out) {
    if (off + sizeof(T) > len) return false;
    std::memcpy(&out, d + off, sizeof(T));
    return true;
}

uint16_t rd16(const uint8_t* p) { uint16_t v; std::memcpy(&v, p, 2); return v; }
uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t* p) { uint32_t v; std::memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
uint64_t rd64(const uint8_t* p) { uint64_t v; std::memcpy(&v, p, 8); return v; }

std::string read_cstring_at(const uint8_t* d, size_t len, size_t off) {
    std::string s;
    if (off >= len) return s;
    const size_t cap = std::min<size_t>(len - off, 4096);
    s.reserve(64);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < cap; ++i) {
        const char c = static_cast<char>(d[off + i]);
        if (c == '\0') break;
        s.push_back(c);
    }
    return s;
}

} // namespace

std::optional<size_t> pe_image_t::rva_to_offset(uint32_t rva) const {
    for (const auto& s : sections) {
        if (!s.contains_rva(rva)) continue;
        // BSS-like tail: no file backing. `continue`, not `break`: a later
        // section can still map this RVA (overlapping/zero-raw-size entries).
        if (rva - s.rva >= s.raw_size) continue;
        return static_cast<size_t>(s.raw_offset) + (rva - s.rva);
    }
    // Headers region
    if (rva < 0x400) return static_cast<size_t>(rva);
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::optional<size_t> pe_image_t::va_to_offset(uint64_t va) const {
    // a Mach-O dylib/bundle legitimately maps __TEXT at 0, so gate on ok
    if (!ok) return std::nullopt;
    if (va < image_base || va - image_base > 0xFFFFFFFFull) return std::nullopt;
    return rva_to_offset(static_cast<uint32_t>(va - image_base));
}

std::optional<uintptr_t> pe_image_t::offset_to_va(size_t off) const {
    for (const auto& s : sections) {
        // widen before adding: raw_offset + raw_size wraps in u32 on a
        // crafted section table and would accept an out-of-section offset
        const uint64_t begin = s.raw_offset;
        const uint64_t end   = begin + s.raw_size;
        if (off < begin || off >= end) continue;
        return image_base + s.rva + static_cast<uint32_t>(off - begin);
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

const pe_section_t* pe_image_t::section_for_rva(uint32_t rva) const {
    for (const auto& s : sections)
        if (s.contains_rva(rva)) return &s;
    return nullptr;
}

pe_image_t pe_parse(const uint8_t* d, size_t len) {
    pe_image_t img;

    // DOS header
    if (len < 0x40 || d[0] != 'M' || d[1] != 'Z') return img;
    uint32_t e_lfanew = 0;
    if (!read_at(d, len, 0x3C, e_lfanew)) return img;
    // size_t: `e_lfanew + 0x18` wraps in uint32_t for a crafted header
    // (0xFFFFFFF0 + 0x18 == 8), which let the signature compare below read at
    // a wild address. Found by src/fuzz/fuzz_pe.cpp.
    if (e_lfanew == 0 || static_cast<size_t>(e_lfanew) + 0x18 > len) return img;

    // PE signature + COFF
    if (std::memcmp(d + e_lfanew, "PE\0\0", 4) != 0) return img;
    const size_t coff = static_cast<size_t>(e_lfanew) + 4;
    if (coff + 20 > len) return img;
    img.machine = rd16(d + coff);

    const uint16_t num_sections = rd16(d + coff + 2);
    // size_t: e_lfanew + 24 used to be truncated to uint16_t, so a file with
    // e_lfanew > 0xFFE8 parsed the optional header at the wrong offset
    const size_t   opt_header_off = static_cast<size_t>(e_lfanew) + 24;
    const uint16_t opt_size       = rd16(d + coff + 16);
    if (opt_size == 0 || opt_header_off + opt_size > len) return img;

    // Optional header
    const uint16_t magic = rd16(d + opt_header_off);
    if (magic != 0x10B && magic != 0x20B) return img;
    img.pe32plus = (magic == 0x20B);

    if (img.pe32plus) {
        if (opt_size < 112) return img;
        img.image_base = rd64(d + opt_header_off + 24);
        img.entry_rva  = rd32(d + opt_header_off + 16);
    } else {
        if (opt_size < 96) return img;
        img.image_base = rd32(d + opt_header_off + 28);
        img.entry_rva  = rd32(d + opt_header_off + 16);
    }
    img.subsystem     = rd16(d + opt_header_off + 68);   // Subsystem sits at +68 in PE32 and PE32+
    img.size_of_image = rd32(d + opt_header_off + 56);

    // Data directories: PE32+ at offset 112, PE32 at 96
    const size_t dd_off = opt_header_off + (img.pe32plus ? 112 : 96);
    if (opt_size >= (img.pe32plus ? 120 : 104)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
            const size_t o = dd_off + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 8;
            if (o + 8 > len) break;
            img.data_dirs[i].rva  = rd32(d + o);
            img.data_dirs[i].size = rd32(d + o + 4);
        }
    }

    // Sections
    const size_t sec_table = opt_header_off + opt_size;
    const size_t sec_entry = 40;   // section header is 40 bytes in PE32 and PE32+
    if (sec_table + static_cast<size_t>(num_sections) * sec_entry > len) return img;

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < num_sections; ++i) {
        const size_t o = sec_table + static_cast<size_t>(i) * sec_entry;
        pe_section_t s;
        std::memcpy(s.name, d + o, 8);
        s.virtual_size    = rd32(d + o + 8);
        s.rva             = rd32(d + o + 12);
        s.raw_size        = rd32(d + o + 16);
        s.raw_offset      = rd32(d + o + 20);
        s.characteristics = rd32(d + o + 36);
        img.sections.push_back(s);
    }

    img.ok = true;

    // Imports (directory index 1)
    {
        const uint32_t imp_rva  = img.data_dirs[1].rva;
        const uint32_t imp_size = img.data_dirs[1].size;
        if (imp_rva && imp_size) {
            auto off_opt = img.rva_to_offset(imp_rva);
            if (off_opt) {
                size_t desc = *off_opt;
                while (desc + 20 <= len) {
                    const uint32_t oft_rva = rd32(d + desc);
                    const uint32_t name_rva = rd32(d + desc + 12);
                    if (oft_rva == 0 && name_rva == 0) break;

                    pe_import_dll_t dll;
                    // An unmapped name RVA used to fall back to offset 0 and
                    // read the DLL name out of the DOS header.
                    if (auto name_off = img.rva_to_offset(name_rva))
                        dll.dll = read_cstring_at(d, len, *name_off);

                    const uint32_t thunk_rva = oft_rva ? oft_rva : rd32(d + desc + 16);
                    const uint32_t iat_rva  = rd32(d + desc + 16);   // FirstThunk
                    auto thunk_off = img.rva_to_offset(thunk_rva);
                    auto iat_off   = img.rva_to_offset(iat_rva);
                    if (thunk_off && !dll.dll.empty()) {
                        size_t t = *thunk_off;
                        size_t it = iat_off.value_or(0);
                        const size_t thunk_size = img.pe32plus ? 8 : 4;
                        constexpr int kMaxFuncs = 4096;
                        for (int f = 0; f < kMaxFuncs && t + thunk_size <= len;
                             ++f, t += thunk_size, it += thunk_size) {
                            const uint64_t thunk = img.pe32plus ? rd64(d + t) : rd32(d + t);
                            if (thunk == 0) break;
                            pe_import_func_t fn;
                            const uint64_t ordinal_flag = img.pe32plus
                                ? (1ull << 63) : (1ull << 31);
                            if (thunk & ordinal_flag) { // import by ordinal
                                fn.by_ordinal = true;
                                fn.ordinal    = static_cast<uint16_t>(thunk & 0xFFFF);
                            } else {
                                auto noff = img.rva_to_offset(static_cast<uint32_t>(thunk));
                                if (!noff) break;
                                fn.name = read_cstring_at(d, len, *noff + 2); // skip hint
                                if (fn.name.empty()) { if (!iat_off) continue; else break; }
                            }
                            // the iat slot is first thunk plus index times thunk size, consumers want
                            // the slot address not its content
                            fn.iat_rva = iat_rva + static_cast<uint32_t>(f) *
                                static_cast<uint32_t>(thunk_size);
                            dll.functions.push_back(std::move(fn));
                        }
                    }
                    img.imports.push_back(std::move(dll));

                    if (img.imports.size() >= 256) break; // sanity
                    desc += 20;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Exports (directory index 0)
    {
        const uint32_t exp_rva = img.data_dirs[0].rva;
        if (exp_rva) {
            auto dir_off = img.rva_to_offset(exp_rva);
            if (dir_off && *dir_off + 40 <= len) {
                const uint32_t ordinal_base = rd32(d + *dir_off + 16);
                const uint32_t num_funcs     = std::min<uint32_t>(rd32(d + *dir_off + 20), 65536);
                const uint32_t num_names     = std::min<uint32_t>(rd32(d + *dir_off + 24), 65536);
                const uint32_t funcs_rva     = rd32(d + *dir_off + 28);
                const uint32_t names_rva     = rd32(d + *dir_off + 32);
                const uint32_t ordinals_rva  = rd32(d + *dir_off + 36);

                auto funcs_off = img.rva_to_offset(funcs_rva);
                auto names_off = img.rva_to_offset(names_rva);
                auto ords_off  = img.rva_to_offset(ordinals_rva);
                if (funcs_off) {
                    std::vector<std::string> names(num_funcs);
                    if (names_off && ords_off) {
                        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < num_names; ++i) {
                            const size_t no = *names_off + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 4;
                            const size_t oo = *ords_off + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 2;
                            if (no + 4 > len || oo + 2 > len) break;
                            const uint16_t index = rd16(d + oo);
                            const auto str_off = img.rva_to_offset(rd32(d + no));
                            if (index < names.size() && str_off)
                                names[index] = read_cstring_at(d, len, *str_off);
                        }
                    }
                    const uint64_t exp_end = static_cast<uint64_t>(exp_rva) + img.data_dirs[0].size;
                    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < num_funcs; ++index) {
                        const size_t fo = *funcs_off + static_cast<size_t>(index) * 4;
                        if (fo + 4 > len) break;
                        const uint32_t func_rva = rd32(d + fo);
                        if (!func_rva) continue;
                        pe_export_t e;
                        e.name = names[index];
                        e.ordinal = static_cast<uint16_t>(ordinal_base + index);
                        e.rva = func_rva;
                        if (func_rva >= exp_rva && static_cast<uint64_t>(func_rva) < exp_end) {
                            e.forwarded = true;
                            const auto forwarder_off = img.rva_to_offset(func_rva);
                            if (forwarder_off) e.forwarder = read_cstring_at(d, len, *forwarder_off);
                        }
                        img.exports.push_back(std::move(e));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Exception directory (index 3): RUNTIME_FUNCTION entries give exact
    // function bounds on x64. Parsed structurally (no decode), so the
    // function index can seed from the compiler's own data instead of
    // validating every prologue by decoding toward a ret.
    {
        const uint32_t exc_rva  = img.data_dirs[3].rva;
        const uint32_t exc_size = img.data_dirs[3].size;
        if (exc_rva && exc_size >= 12) {
            auto dir_off = img.rva_to_offset(exc_rva);
            if (dir_off && *dir_off + 12 <= len) {
                // Clamp the entry count the same way the table size does:
                // a corrupt size must not turn into millions of entries.
                size_t count = exc_size / 12;
                constexpr size_t kMaxEntries = 500'000;
                if (count > kMaxEntries) count = kMaxEntries;
                const size_t avail = (len - *dir_off) / 12;
                if (count > avail) count = avail;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                    const size_t o = *dir_off + i * 12;
                    const uint32_t begin = rd32(d + o);
                    const uint32_t end   = rd32(d + o + 4);
                    if (begin == 0 || end <= begin) continue;
                    img.runtime_funcs.push_back({begin, end});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return img;
}

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

`src/core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// dependency free pe32+ parser over in memory file images. pe_image_t doubles
// as the format-neutral section map for Mach-O images (see image_open.hpp)

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::disasm {

struct pe_section_t {
    // NUL-padded; PE names use 8 chars, Mach-O ones are "<seg>.<sect>"
    char     name[34]    = {};
    uint32_t rva         = 0;
    uint32_t virtual_size = 0;
    uint32_t raw_offset  = 0;
    uint32_t raw_size    = 0;
    uint32_t characteristics = 0;

    bool is_executable() const noexcept { return (characteristics & 0x20000000) != 0; } // IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE
    bool contains_rva(uint32_t r) const noexcept {
        return r >= rva && r < rva + (virtual_size ? virtual_size : raw_size);
    }
};

struct pe_import_func_t {
    std::string name;
    uint16_t    ordinal = 0;
    bool        by_ordinal = false;
    uint32_t    iat_rva = 0;   // RVA of this function's IAT slot (PE32+)
};

struct pe_import_dll_t {
    std::string                   dll;
    std::vector<pe_import_func_t> functions;
};

struct pe_export_t {
    std::string name;
    uint32_t    rva     = 0;
    uint16_t    ordinal = 0;
    bool        forwarded = false;
    std::string forwarder;
};

// One IMAGE_RUNTIME_FUNCTION_ENTRY from the Exception directory (x64 .pdata):
// exact [begin, end) function bounds from the compiler, independent of any
// decode heuristic.
struct pe_runtime_func_t {
    uint32_t begin_rva = 0;
    uint32_t end_rva   = 0;   // exclusive
};

struct pe_data_dir_t {
    uint32_t rva  = 0;
    uint32_t size = 0;
};

struct pe_image_t {
    bool     ok            = false;
    bool     pe32plus      = false;
    uint16_t machine       = 0;
    uint16_t subsystem     = 0;
    uint64_t image_base    = 0;
    uint32_t entry_rva     = 0;
    uint32_t size_of_image = 0;

    std::vector<pe_section_t> sections;
    std::vector<pe_import_dll_t> imports;
    std::vector<pe_export_t>     exports;
    std::vector<pe_runtime_func_t> runtime_funcs;   // Exception dir, may be empty

    pe_data_dir_t data_dirs[16] = {};

    std::optional<size_t> rva_to_offset(uint32_t rva) const;
    std::optional<size_t> va_to_offset(uint64_t va) const;   // uses image_base
    std::optional<uintptr_t> offset_to_va(size_t off) const;

    const pe_section_t* section_for_rva(uint32_t rva) const;
};

// Parse a file image. Returns ok=false (with everything zeroed) on failure
pe_image_t pe_parse(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```
