`src/core/disasm/strings.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/disasm/strings.cpp

#include "core/disasm/strings.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>

namespace slop::core::disasm {

namespace {

bool ascii_printable(uint8_t c) noexcept {
    return (c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E) || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r';
}

bool utf16_printable(uint8_t lo, uint8_t hi) noexcept {
    return hi == 0x00 && ascii_printable(lo);
}

} // namespace

std::vector<string_hit_t> extract_strings(const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                                          uintptr_t va_base,
                                          size_t min_chars,
                                          size_t max_results,
                                          string_stats_t* stats) {
    std::vector<string_hit_t> out;
    string_stats_t local{};
    auto& st = stats ? *stats : local;
    st.scanned = 0;
    st.hits = 0;
    st.truncated = false;

    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < len) {
        ++st.scanned;

        // UTF-16LE candidate: printable, NUL, printable, NUL ..
        if (i + 2 * static_cast<int>(min_chars) <= len &&
            utf16_printable(data[i], data[i + 1])) {
            size_t j = i;
            std::string s;
            s.reserve(64);
            while (j + 1 < len && utf16_printable(data[j], data[j + 1]) && s.size() < 4096) {
                s.push_back(static_cast<char>(data[j]));
                j += 2;
            }
            // Must be terminated by NUL pair and long enough
            if (s.size() >= min_chars && j + 1 < len &&
                data[j] == 0x00 && data[j + 1] == 0x00) {
                string_hit_t h;
                h.va    = va_base + i;
                h.text  = std::move(s);
                h.utf16 = true;
                out.push_back(std::move(h));
                ++st.hits;
                if (out.size() >= max_results) { st.truncated = true; return out; }
                i = j + 2;
                continue;
            }
            // Fall through to ASCII handling for this byte
        }

        // ASCII run
        if (ascii_printable(data[i])) {
            size_t j = i;
            std::string s;
            s.reserve(64);
            while (j < len && ascii_printable(data[j]) && s.size() < 4096) {
                s.push_back(static_cast<char>(data[j]));
                ++j;
            }
            const bool terminated = j < len && data[j] == 0x00;
            if (terminated && s.size() >= min_chars) {
                // Skip pure-whitespace noise
                const bool meaningful = s.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n") != std::string::npos;
                if (meaningful) {
                    string_hit_t h;
                    h.va   = va_base + i;
                    h.text = std::move(s);
                    out.push_back(std::move(h));
                    ++st.hits;
                    if (out.size() >= max_results) { st.truncated = true; return out; }
                    i = j + 1;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            i = j > i ? j : i + 1;
            continue;
        }

        ++i;
    }

    st.hits = out.size();
    return out;
}

double shannon_entropy(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    if (!data || len == 0) return 0.0;
    double counts[256] = {};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) counts[data[i]] += 1.0;
    double h = 0.0;
    for (double c : counts) {
        if (c == 0.0) continue;
        const double p = c / static_cast<double>(len);
        h -= p * std::log2(p);
    }
    return h;
}

namespace {

// Fraction of bytes that are printable ASCII; NULs and controls drag it down
double printable_ratio(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) return 0.0;
    size_t ok = 0;
    for (unsigned char c : s)
        if ((c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E) || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r') ++ok;
    return static_cast<double>(ok) / static_cast<double>(s.size());
}

// A preview is only interesting when it is mostly readable text
bool plausible(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.size() < 6) return false;
    if (printable_ratio(s) < 0.92) return false;
    // reject runs of one repeated character (padding, 0x00 XOR 0x00)
    char first = s[0];
    bool all_same = true;
    for (char c : s)
        if (c != first) { all_same = false; break; }
    return !all_same;
}

double score_of(const std::string& s) {
    // printable ratio dominates; word characters (letters, digits, spaces)
    // separate real text from punctuation soup that XOR keys also produce
    const double ratio = printable_ratio(s);
    const double len_w = std::min<double>(1.0, static_cast<double>(s.size()) / 32.0);
    size_t word = 0;
    for (unsigned char c : s)
        if (std::isalnum(c) || c == ' ' || c == '_' || c == '\t' ||
            c == '\n' || c == '\r')
            ++word;
    const double word_w = s.empty() ? 0.0
                                    : static_cast<double>(word) / static_cast<double>(s.size());
    return ratio * 0.6 + word_w * 0.3 + len_w * 0.1;
}

int b64_value(unsigned char c) {
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c - 'A';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') return c - 'a' + 26;
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0' + 52;
    if (c == '+') return 62;
    if (c == '/') return 63;
    return -1;
}

std::string base64_decode(const std::string& in) {
    std::string out;
    int acc = 0, bits = 0;
    for (unsigned char c : in) {
        if (c == '=') break;
        const int v = b64_value(c);
        if (v < 0) return {};
        acc = (acc << 6) | v;
        bits += 6;
        if (bits >= 8) {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>((acc >> bits) & 0xFF));
        }
    }
    return out;
}

bool looks_base64(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.size() < 8) return false;
    size_t pad = 0;
    for (unsigned char c : s) {
        if (c == '=') { ++pad; continue; }
        if (b64_value(c) < 0) return false;
    }
    return pad <= 2 && s.size() % 4 == 0;
}

} // namespace

std::vector<decode_candidate_t> decode_candidates(const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                                                  size_t max_candidates) {
    std::vector<decode_candidate_t> out;
    if (!data || len < 6) return out;
    // previews are text: cap the blob so a 1 MiB section cannot stall a call
    const size_t n = std::min<size_t>(len, 512);

    auto consider = [&](std::string scheme, std::string text) {
        if (!plausible(text)) return;
        decode_candidate_t c;
        c.text   = std::move(text);
        c.score  = score_of(c.text);
        c.scheme = std::move(scheme);
        out.push_back(std::move(c));
    };

    // single-byte XOR: the classic string obfuscation, key 0 is the input
    for (int key = 1; key < 256; ++key) {
        std::string s;
        s.reserve(n);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            s.push_back(static_cast<char>(data[i] ^ static_cast<uint8_t>(key)));
        consider("xor:0x" + [&] {
            char hex[8];
            std::snprintf(hex, sizeof(hex), "%02X", static_cast<unsigned>(key));
            return std::string(hex);
        }(), std::move(s));
    }

    // ROT13 / ROT47 over the ASCII interpretation of the blob
    std::string ascii(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), n);
    {
        std::string s = ascii;
        for (char& c : s) {
            if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') c = static_cast<char>('a' + (c - 'a' + 13) % 26);
            else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>('A' + (c - 'A' + 13) % 26);
        }
        consider("rot13", std::move(s));
    }
    {
        std::string s = ascii;
        for (char& c : s) {
            const int v = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
            if (v >= 33 && v <= 126)
                c = static_cast<char>(33 + (v - 33 + 47) % 94);
        }
        consider("rot47", std::move(s));
    }

    // base64: decode the printable prefix up to the first NUL
    {
        std::string b64;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            const unsigned char c = data[i];
            if (c == 0) break;
            b64.push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
        }
        if (looks_base64(b64)) {
            std::string decoded = base64_decode(b64);
            // only ASCII payloads are useful as a string preview
            if (!decoded.empty() && printable_ratio(decoded) >= 0.92)
                consider("base64", std::move(decoded));
        }
    }

    // UTF-16LE: printable byte + NUL pairs
    {
        std::string s;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < n; i += 2) {
            if (data[i + 1] != 0x00) { s.clear(); break; }
            s.push_back(static_cast<char>(data[i]));
        }
        if (!s.empty()) consider("utf16le", std::move(s));
    }

    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(),
              [](const decode_candidate_t& a, const decode_candidate_t& b) {
                  return a.score > b.score;
              });
    if (out.size() > max_candidates) out.resize(max_candidates);
    return out;
}

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

`src/core/disasm/strings.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/disasm/strings.hpp
// ASCII + UTF-16LE string extraction over a byte image

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::disasm {

struct string_hit_t {
    uintptr_t   va    = 0;
    std::string text;
    bool        utf16 = false;
};

struct string_stats_t {
    size_t scanned   = 0;
    size_t hits      = 0;
    bool   truncated = false;
};

// Scan [data, data+len) mapped at va_base. Strings must be NUL-terminated
// and >= min_chars. UTF-16 runs are preferred when they qualify
std::vector<string_hit_t> extract_strings(const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                                          uintptr_t va_base,
                                          size_t min_chars = 4,
                                          size_t max_results = 200'000,
                                          string_stats_t* stats = nullptr);

// Shannon entropy of a byte run, bits per byte (0..8). Used to pick the
// high-entropy blobs worth a decode preview
double shannon_entropy(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);

// One decoded preview of an obfuscated blob
struct decode_candidate_t {
    std::string scheme;   // "xor:0x5A", "rot13", "rot47", "base64", "utf16le"
    std::string text;
    double      score = 0.0;   // printable ratio * length weight, 0..1
};

// Try single-byte XOR keys, ROT13/ROT47, base64 and UTF-16LE over a blob and
// return the readable candidates, best score first. Pure and bounded: at most
// 256 keys and max_candidates results per blob
std::vector<decode_candidate_t> decode_candidates(const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                                                  size_t max_candidates = 8);

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

`src/core/disasm/xrefs.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/disasm/xrefs.cpp

#include "core/disasm/xrefs.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace slop::core::disasm {

const std::vector<xref_t> xref_index_t::kEmpty{};

namespace {

// Skip high entropy sections: compressed blobs only produce garbage refs and
// can eat the cap before real code is indexed.
//
// The cutoff has to clear real compiled code, which is noisier than it looks —
// a large optimised x64 .text measures around 6.6, and the old 6.5 cutoff
// silently produced zero xrefs for exactly the big binaries this index matters
// most for. Packed and encrypted payloads sit at 7.5 and up
constexpr double kPackedEntropy = 7.2;

double entropy(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    if (!data || len == 0) return 0.0;
    uint32_t hist[256] = {};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) ++hist[data[i]];
    double e = 0.0;
    const double n = static_cast<double>(len);
    for (uint32_t c : hist) {
        if (!c) continue;
        const double p = static_cast<double>(c) / n;
        e -= p * std::log2(p);
    }
    return e;
}

// The gate is judged per region, not per section: a plain code head with a
// packed tail (or the reverse) only loses the packed part. A region shorter
// than kMinRegion measures low no matter what it holds, so it inherits its
// predecessor's verdict (sections that small are never skipped)
constexpr size_t kRegion    = 64 * 1024;
constexpr size_t kMinRegion = 4096;

std::vector<bool> packed_regions(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    std::vector<bool> packed((len + kRegion - 1) / kRegion, false);
    if (len <= kMinRegion) return packed;
    for (size_t r = 0; r < packed.size(); ++r) {
        const size_t off = r * kRegion;
        const size_t n = std::min(kRegion, len - off);
        packed[r] = (n < kMinRegion && r > 0)
            ? packed[r - 1]
            : entropy(data + off, n) > kPackedEntropy;
    }
    return packed;
}

} // namespace

bool xref_index_t::build(const pe_image_t& pe, const std::vector<uint8_t>& file,
                         engine_t& eng, uint64_t base, size_t max_refs) {
    by_target_.clear();
    total_ = 0;
    if (!pe.ok || !eng.ok()) return false;

    for (const auto& s : pe.sections) {
        if (!s.is_executable() || s.raw_size == 0) continue;
        if (static_cast<size_t>(s.raw_offset) + s.raw_size > file.size()) continue;

        const uint8_t* data = file.data() + s.raw_offset;
        const uint64_t sec_va = base + s.rva;

        // Skip high-entropy regions (compressed/encrypted blobs produce
        // only noise refs and burn through the max_refs budget)
        const auto packed = packed_regions(data, s.raw_size);

        size_t off = 0;
        while (off < s.raw_size) {
            if (total_ >= max_refs) return true;   // index full, still usable
            if (packed[off / kRegion]) {
                off = (off / kRegion + 1) * kRegion;
                continue;
            }

            auto insn = eng.decode(sec_va + off, data + off, s.raw_size - off, false);
            if (!insn) { ++off; continue; }        // resync by one byte

            const uint64_t from = insn->va;
            if (insn->has_rel_target && insn->flow != flow_t::none) {
                // Validate target is within the image VA range to reduce noise
                const uint64_t target = insn->rel_target;
                if (target >= base && target < base + pe.size_of_image) {
                    const xref_kind_t k = (insn->flow == flow_t::call)
                                              ? xref_kind_t::call
                                              : xref_kind_t::jmp;
                    by_target_[target].push_back({from, target, k});
                    ++total_;
                }
            }
            if (insn->has_rip_rel) {
                const uint64_t target = insn->rip_rel_target;
                if (target >= base && target < base + pe.size_of_image) {
                    by_target_[target].push_back(
                        {from, target, xref_kind_t::data});
                    ++total_;
                }
            }

            off += insn->length;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

const std::vector<xref_t>& xref_index_t::refs_to(uint64_t va) const {
    const auto it = by_target_.find(va);
    return it != by_target_.end() ? it->second : kEmpty;
}

std::vector<uint64_t> xref_index_t::targets() const {
    std::vector<uint64_t> out;
    out.reserve(by_target_.size());
    for (const auto& [va, refs] : by_target_) out.push_back(va);
    return out;
}

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// static xref index over executable sections, calls jumps and rip relative
// data refs, linear sweep with byte resync

#include <cstdint>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "core/disasm/engine.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp"

namespace slop::core::disasm {

enum class xref_kind_t : uint8_t { call, jmp, data };

struct xref_t {
    uint64_t     from = 0;
    uint64_t     to   = 0;
    xref_kind_t  kind = xref_kind_t::call;
};

class xref_index_t {
public:
    bool build(const pe_image_t& pe, const std::vector<uint8_t>& file,
               engine_t& eng, uint64_t base,
               size_t max_refs = 4'000'000);

    // All references pointing AT va
    const std::vector<xref_t>& refs_to(uint64_t va) const;

    // Distinct target VAs (for iteration/inspection)
    std::vector<uint64_t> targets() const;

    size_t total() const noexcept { return total_; }

private:
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<xref_t>> by_target_;
    static const std::vector<xref_t> kEmpty;
    size_t total_ = 0;
};

} // namespace slop::core::disasm
```

`src/core/emu/orbis.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/emu/orbis.cpp
// the minimal Orbis syscall set the PS4 emulation path implements: process
// and thread ids, stdout capture, anonymous mappings on the emulated address
// space, a deterministic clock, sysctl basics and exit. Everything else is
// logged by the caller and answered with ENOSYS.

#include "core/emu/orbis.hpp"

// Vendored header defines an unused static helper (usleep shim) that trips
// C4505 at TU end, suppressed for this include only
#ifdef _MSC_VER
#pragma warning(push)
#pragma warning(disable : 4505)
#endif
#include <unicorn/unicorn.h>
#ifdef _MSC_VER
#pragma warning(pop)
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace slop::core::emu {

namespace {

constexpr uint64_t kPage     = 0x1000;
constexpr uint64_t kMapFixed = 0x10;   // MAP_FIXED
constexpr uint32_t kProtRead  = 1;
constexpr uint32_t kProtWrite = 2;
constexpr uint32_t kProtExec  = 4;

uc_engine* eng(void* uc) { return static_cast<uc_engine*>(uc); }

uint64_t align_up(uint64_t v) { return (v + kPage - 1) & ~(kPage - 1); }

bool read_guest(void* uc, uint64_t addr, void* out, size_t len) {
    if (!addr || !len) return false;
    return uc_mem_read(eng(uc), addr, out, len) == UC_ERR_OK;
}

bool write_guest(void* uc, uint64_t addr, const void* in, size_t len) {
    if (!addr || !len) return false;
    return uc_mem_write(eng(uc), addr, in, len) == UC_ERR_OK;
}

orbis_result_t errno_result(uint64_t e) { return {false, e}; }

// write(fd, buf, n): stdout/stderr go to the capture, other fds are EBADF
orbis_result_t sys_write(void* uc, orbis_state_t& st, const uint64_t args[6]) {
    const uint64_t fd = args[0], buf = args[1], n = args[2];
    if (fd != 1 && fd != 2) return errno_result(kOrbisEBADF);
    if (!n) return {true, 0};
    const size_t want = static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(n, 1u << 20));
    std::vector<uint8_t> tmp(want);
    if (!read_guest(uc, buf, tmp.data(), tmp.size())) return errno_result(kOrbisEFAULT);
    const size_t room = st.max_stdout > st.stdout_data.size()
                            ? st.max_stdout - st.stdout_data.size() : 0;
    const size_t keep = std::min(room, tmp.size());
    st.stdout_data.insert(st.stdout_data.end(), tmp.begin(),
                          tmp.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(keep));
    return {true, n};   // the full count is reported even when the capture is full
}

// mmap(addr, len, prot, flags, fd, pad): anonymous mappings only
orbis_result_t sys_mmap(void* uc, orbis_state_t& st, const uint64_t args[6]) {
    const uint64_t len = align_up(args[1]);
    if (!len) return errno_result(kOrbisEINVAL);
    if (st.maps.size() >= st.max_maps) return errno_result(kOrbisENOMEM);
    uint64_t base = 0;
    if ((args[3] & kMapFixed) && args[0]) {
        base = args[0] & ~(kPage - 1);
        uc_mem_unmap(eng(uc), base, len);   // MAP_FIXED replaces what is there
    } else {
        base = align_up(st.mmap_next);
        st.mmap_next = base + len;
    }
    const uint32_t prot = (args[2] & kProtRead ? UC_PROT_READ : 0) |
                          (args[2] & kProtWrite ? UC_PROT_WRITE : 0) |
                          (args[2] & kProtExec ? UC_PROT_EXEC : 0);
    if (uc_mem_map(eng(uc), base, static_cast<size_t>(len),
                   prot ? prot : static_cast<uint32_t>(UC_PROT_ALL)) != UC_ERR_OK)
        return errno_result(kOrbisENOMEM);
    st.maps[base] = static_cast<size_t>(len);
    return {true, base};
}

orbis_result_t sys_munmap(void* uc, orbis_state_t& st, const uint64_t args[6]) {
    const uint64_t base = args[0] & ~(kPage - 1);
    auto it = st.maps.find(base);
    if (it == st.maps.end()) return errno_result(kOrbisEINVAL);
    uc_mem_unmap(eng(uc), base, it->second);
    st.maps.erase(it);
    return {true, 0};
}

orbis_result_t sys_mprotect(void* uc, const uint64_t args[6]) {
    const uint64_t base = args[0] & ~(kPage - 1);
    const uint64_t len  = align_up(args[1]);
    if (!len) return errno_result(kOrbisEINVAL);
    const uint32_t prot = (args[2] & kProtRead ? UC_PROT_READ : 0) |
                          (args[2] & kProtWrite ? UC_PROT_WRITE : 0) |
                          (args[2] & kProtExec ? UC_PROT_EXEC : 0);
    if (uc_mem_protect(eng(uc), base, static_cast<size_t>(len), prot) != UC_ERR_OK)
        return errno_result(kOrbisEINVAL);
    return {true, 0};
}

// gettimeofday(tp, tz) / clock_gettime(clk, tp): the deterministic clock
orbis_result_t sys_time(void* uc, const orbis_state_t& st, uint64_t addr,
                        bool timespec) {
    if (!addr) return {true, 0};
    uint64_t tv[2] = {st.clock_us / 1000000, 0};
    tv[1] = timespec ? (st.clock_us % 1000000) * 1000 : st.clock_us % 1000000;
    if (!write_guest(uc, addr, tv, sizeof(tv))) return errno_result(kOrbisEFAULT);
    return {true, 0};
}

// __sysctl(name, namelen, oldp, oldlenp, newp, newlen): no kernel variables,
// every query reports a zero-length answer
orbis_result_t sys_sysctl(void* uc, const uint64_t args[6]) {
    if (args[3]) {
        const uint32_t zero = 0;
        if (!write_guest(uc, args[3], &zero, sizeof(zero)))
            return errno_result(kOrbisEFAULT);
    }
    return {true, 0};
}

} // namespace

orbis_result_t orbis_syscall(void* uc, orbis_state_t& st, uint64_t num,
                             const uint64_t args[6]) {
    switch (num) {
    case 1:   // exit(status)
        st.exited = true;
        st.exit_code = args[0];
        return {true, 0};
    case 4:   // write(fd, buf, n)
        return sys_write(uc, st, args);
    case 6:   // close(fd): nothing is open, closing is a no-op
        return {true, 0};
    case 20:  // getpid
        return {true, st.pid};
    case 24:  // getuid
        return {true, st.uid};
    case 25:  // geteuid
        return {true, st.uid};
    case 39:  // getppid
        return {true, st.ppid};
    case 73:  // munmap(addr, len)
        return sys_munmap(uc, st, args);
    case 74:  // mprotect(addr, len, prot)
        return sys_mprotect(uc, args);
    case 116: // gettimeofday(tp, tz)
        return sys_time(uc, st, args[0], /*timespec*/ false);
    case 202: // __sysctl(...)
        return sys_sysctl(uc, args);
    case 232: // clock_gettime(clk, tp)
        return sys_time(uc, st, args[1], /*timespec*/ true);
    case 432: // thr_self(idp)
        return args[0] && !write_guest(uc, args[0], &st.tid, sizeof(st.tid))
                   ? errno_result(kOrbisEFAULT)
                   : orbis_result_t{true, 0};
    case 477: // mmap(addr, len, prot, flags, fd, pad)
        return sys_mmap(uc, st, args);
    default:
        ++st.enosys;
        return errno_result(kOrbisENOSYS);
    }
}

} // namespace slop::core::emu

```

`src/core/emu/orbis.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// Deterministic Orbis (FreeBSD 9) syscall emulation for emulated PS4 code.
// The handler runs on the emulation thread with the live unicorn engine, so
// mmap/munmap/mprotect act on the emulated address space and write() reads
// the emulated buffer. Numbers come from the shared Orbis table
// (core/analysis/ps4_syscalls.hpp), names are not duplicated here.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::emu {

// FreeBSD errno values the handler returns
inline constexpr uint64_t kOrbisENOSYS  = 78;
inline constexpr uint64_t kOrbisEINVAL  = 22;
inline constexpr uint64_t kOrbisENOMEM  = 12;
inline constexpr uint64_t kOrbisEBADF   = 9;
inline constexpr uint64_t kOrbisEFAULT  = 14;

struct orbis_state_t {
    uint64_t pid  = 1000;
    uint64_t ppid = 1;
    uint64_t tid  = 1001;
    uint64_t uid  = 1000;

    // Deterministic clock: every call reports this fixed time, so a rerun of
    // the same code produces the same values
    uint64_t clock_us = 0x5F5E100;   // 100 ms, arbitrary but stable

    uint64_t mmap_next = 0x700000000000ull;   // next anonymous mapping
    size_t   max_stdout = 1u << 20;           // captured write() bytes
    size_t   max_maps   = 256;                // live mmap regions

    std::vector<uint8_t>       stdout_data;
    std::map<uint64_t, size_t> maps;          // base -> length
    size_t enosys = 0;                        // calls answered with ENOSYS
    bool   exited = false;                    // exit() was called
    uint64_t exit_code = 0;
};

struct orbis_result_t {
    bool     ok = true;    // false: CF set, value is the errno
    uint64_t value = 0;    // rax on return
};

// `uc` is the live uc_engine (void* keeps unicorn headers out of here)
orbis_result_t orbis_syscall(void* uc, orbis_state_t& st, uint64_t num,
                             const uint64_t args[6]);

} // namespace slop::core::emu
```
