`src/core/mcp/tools_analyze.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_analyze.cpp
// tool: analyze (hyperion analysis, packer, signatures, bindiff)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

// async bindiff jobs (analyze.diff_start/diff_job/diff_cancel)
struct diff_job_rec_t {
    std::string path_a, path_b;
    std::string stage = "queued";   // loading|analyzing_a|analyzing_b|comparing|done
    float       progress = -1.0f;   // -1 = indeterminate
    bool        done = false;
    json        result;              // full diff payload on success/partial
    std::string error;               // set when the job failed outright
};
std::mutex g_diff_mu;
std::map<uint64_t, diff_job_rec_t> g_diff_jobs;
constexpr size_t kMaxDiffJobs = 32;

} // namespace

namespace {

// tool: analyze

// Shared bindiff core for sync `diff` and the async diff_start jobs.
// Returns the FULL result (all non-identical diffs); callers slice `diffs`
// to their limit. Throws (fail) on load/analyze failure or when cancelled
// between phases. `cancelled()` is polled between phases and inside the
// compare; `report(stage, progress)` feeds job polling (-1 = indeterminate).
json run_diff_core(const std::string& pa, const std::string& pb,
                   uint32_t timeout_ms, size_t max_pairs,
                   const std::function<bool()>& cancelled,
                   const std::function<void(const std::string&, float)>& report) {
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
                          std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
    auto ms_left = [&]() -> uint64_t {
        const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        if (now >= deadline) return 0;
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                deadline - now).count());
    };
    auto check_cancel = [&](const char* what) {
        if (cancelled && cancelled()) fail(std::string(what) + " cancelled");
        if (ms_left() == 0)
            fail(std::string(what) + " timed out (timeout_ms exceeded)");
    };

    auto load_bytes = [](const std::string& path) {
        std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!f) fail("cannot open " + path);
        f.seekg(0, std::ios::end);
        const auto sz = f.tellg();
        if (sz <= 0) fail("empty file: " + path);
        if (sz > (256ll << 20)) fail("file too large for diff (>256MB): " + path);
        f.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(sz));
        f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()), sz);
        if (!f) fail("short read on " + path);
        auto opened = disasm::open_image(std::move(bytes));
        if (!opened.ok) fail("cannot open " + path + ": " + opened.error);
        if (opened.file.size() > (256u << 20))
            fail("analyzed image too large for diff (>256 MiB): " + path);
        return std::move(opened.file);
    };

    report("loading", -1.0f);
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes_a = load_bytes(pa);
    check_cancel("diff");
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes_b = load_bytes(pb);
    check_cancel("diff");

    // NOTE: start_sync has no cancel hook, so each side can still take a
    // while on huge binaries; the deadline applies to the compare phase
    // and to the boundary between the two analyses.
    report("analyzing_a", -1.0f);
    auto sa = std::make_unique<hs::session_t>();
    if (cancelled && cancelled()) fail("diff cancelled");
    if (!sa->start_sync(bytes_a.data(), bytes_a.size(), 0)) {
        if (cancelled && cancelled()) fail("diff cancelled");
        fail("hyperion analysis failed for " + pa + ": " + sa->error());
    }
    check_cancel("diff");
    report("analyzing_b", -1.0f);
    auto sb = std::make_unique<hs::session_t>();
    if (cancelled && cancelled()) fail("diff cancelled");
    if (!sb->start_sync(bytes_b.data(), bytes_b.size(), 0)) {
        if (cancelled && cancelled()) fail("diff cancelled");
        fail("hyperion analysis failed for " + pb + ": " + sb->error());
    }
    if (cancelled && cancelled()) fail("diff cancelled");

    report("comparing", 0.0f);
    hype::BinDiff differ;
    hype::BinDiff::options_t opt;
    opt.max_pairs = max_pairs;
    opt.cancel = cancelled ? &cancelled : nullptr;
    // absolute steady-clock deadline in BinDiff::now_ms() terms
    opt.deadline_ms = static_cast<uint64_t>(
        std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count()) +
        timeout_ms;
    std::function<void(float)> progress_fn = [&](float p) {
        report("comparing", p * 0.95f + 0.05f);
    };
    opt.progress = &progress_fn;
    auto outcome = differ.compare_budgeted(sa->db(), sb->db(), opt);

    json arr = json::array();
    const char* status_name[] = {"added", "removed", "modified", "identical"};
    for (const auto& r : outcome.results) {
        if (r.status == hype::DiffResult::Identical) continue;  // noise
        arr.push_back({{"addr_a", r.addr_a}, {"addr_b", r.addr_b},
                       {"name", r.name},
                       {"similarity", r.similarity},
                       {"status", status_name[r.status]}});
    }
    size_t counts[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (const auto& r : outcome.results) ++counts[r.status];
    json out = {{"ok", true}, {"diffs", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
                {"totals", {{"added", counts[0]}, {"removed", counts[1]},
                            {"modified", counts[2]},
                            {"identical", counts[3]}}},
                {"funcs_a", sa->db().funcs.size()},
                {"funcs_b", sb->db().funcs.size()},
                {"pairs_evaluated", outcome.pairs_evaluated},
                {"pairs_skipped_size", outcome.pairs_skipped_size},
                {"timed_out", outcome.timed_out},
                {"cancelled", outcome.cancelled}};
    if (outcome.timed_out)
        out["note"] = "pair budget/deadline hit: results are partial "
                      "(raise max_pairs/timeout_ms for a fuller diff)";
    if (outcome.cancelled) out["note"] = "diff cancelled: results are partial";
    report("done", 1.0f);
    return out;
}

} // namespace


json tool_analyze(const json& args, const infra::cancel_token_t& cancel) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    if (action != "packer" && action != "signatures" && action != "diff" &&
        action != "diff_start" && action != "diff_job" &&
        action != "diff_cancel")
        fail("analyze: unknown action "
             "(packer|signatures|diff|diff_start|diff_job|diff_cancel)");

    // diff is heavy (two full Hyperion analyses + quadratic compare), so it
    // runs WITHOUT the global tool mutex (see call_tool), honors cancel +
    // timeout_ms, and caps the pair budget instead of hanging the engine.
    // diff_start/diff_job/diff_cancel are the async job flavor with progress.
    if (action == "diff_start") {
        if (!args.contains("path_a") || !args.contains("path_b"))
            fail("missing path_a/path_b");
        const std::string pa = args.at("path_a").get<std::string>();
        const std::string pb = args.at("path_b").get<std::string>();
        const uint32_t timeout_ms = static_cast<uint32_t>(
            std::clamp(args.value("timeout_ms", 600000), 5000, 1800000));
        const size_t max_pairs = std::min<size_t>(
            args.value("max_pairs", 500000u), 10000000u);

        infra::job_desc_t desc;
        desc.label = "bindiff";
        desc.owner = "analyze.diff_start";
        desc.cancellable = true;
        // Placeholder id: replaced with the real job id after submit; the
        // body looks its record up by id captured below.
        std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<uint64_t>> job_id =
            std::make_shared<std::atomic<uint64_t>>(0);
        desc.body = [pa, pb, timeout_ms, max_pairs, job_id](
                        infra::job_context_t& ctx) {
            // submit() assigns the id after spawning us; wait for it.
            uint64_t id = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 5000 && id == 0 && !ctx.cancelled(); ++i) {
                id = job_id->load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                if (!id)
                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
            }
            if (!id) { ctx.fail("diff job id never assigned"); return; }
            auto report = [&](const std::string& stage, float p) {
                std::lock_guard lk(g_diff_mu);
                auto it = g_diff_jobs.find(id);
                if (it == g_diff_jobs.end()) return;
                it->second.stage = stage;
                it->second.progress = p;
            };
            try {
                json res = run_diff_core(
                    pa, pb, timeout_ms, max_pairs,
                    [&]() { return ctx.cancelled(); }, report);
                std::lock_guard lk(g_diff_mu);
                auto it = g_diff_jobs.find(id);
                if (it != g_diff_jobs.end()) {
                    it->second.result = std::move(res);
                    it->second.stage = "done";
                    it->second.progress = 1.0f;
                    it->second.done = true;
                }
            } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                std::lock_guard lk(g_diff_mu);
                auto it = g_diff_jobs.find(id);
                if (it != g_diff_jobs.end()) {
                    it->second.error = e.what();
                    it->second.stage = "done";
                    it->second.done = true;
                }
                ctx.fail(e.what());
            }
        };
        const uint64_t id = infra::jobs::submit(std::move(desc));
        if (!id) fail("diff job queue full, retry shortly");
        job_id->store(id, std::memory_order_release);
        {
            std::lock_guard lk(g_diff_mu);
            auto& rec = g_diff_jobs[id];
            rec.path_a = pa;
            rec.path_b = pb;
            rec.stage = "queued";
            while (g_diff_jobs.size() > kMaxDiffJobs)
                g_diff_jobs.erase(g_diff_jobs.begin());
        }
        return {{"ok", true}, {"job_id", id},
                {"hint", "poll analyze.diff_job(id) for stage/progress, "
                         "cancel with analyze.diff_cancel(id)"}};
    }

    if (action == "diff_job") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "id");
        const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 500u), 5000u);
        std::lock_guard lk(g_diff_mu);
        const auto it = g_diff_jobs.find(id);
        if (it == g_diff_jobs.end())
            fail("unknown diff job (expired or never submitted)");
        const auto& rec = it->second;
        if (!rec.done) {
            json out = {{"ok", true}, {"job_id", id},
                        {"state", infra::jobs::alive(id) ? "running" : "queued"},
                        {"stage", rec.stage}, {"progress", rec.progress}};
            return out;
        }
        if (!rec.error.empty()) fail(rec.error);
        json res = rec.result;
        if (res.contains("diffs") && res.at("diffs").is_array() &&
            res.at("diffs").size() > limit) {
            json sliced = json::array();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < limit; ++i)
                sliced.push_back(res.at("diffs").at(i));
            res["diffs"] = std::move(sliced);
            res["count"] = res["diffs"].size();
            res["truncated"] = true;
        }
        res["job_id"] = id;
        res["state"] = "succeeded";
        return res;
    }

    if (action == "diff_cancel") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "id");
        if (!infra::jobs::cancel(id)) {
            std::lock_guard lk(g_diff_mu);
            if (g_diff_jobs.find(id) == g_diff_jobs.end())
                fail("unknown diff job");
            // Known but already finished: cancel is a no-op success.
            return {{"job_id", id}, {"cancelled", false},
                    {"note", "job already finished"}};
        }
        return {{"job_id", id}, {"cancelled", true}};
    }

    if (action == "diff") {
        if (!args.contains("path_a") || !args.contains("path_b"))
            fail("missing path_a/path_b");
        const std::string pa = args.at("path_a").get<std::string>();
        const std::string pb = args.at("path_b").get<std::string>();
        const uint32_t timeout_ms = static_cast<uint32_t>(
            std::clamp(args.value("timeout_ms", 120000), 5000, 1800000));
        const size_t max_pairs = std::min<size_t>(
            args.value("max_pairs", 500000u), 10000000u);
        const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 500u), 5000u);
        auto noop = [](const std::string&, float) {};
        json full = run_diff_core(
            pa, pb, timeout_ms, max_pairs,
            [&]() { return cancel.cancelled(); }, noop);
        if (full.contains("diffs") && full.at("diffs").is_array() &&
            full.at("diffs").size() > limit) {
            json sliced = json::array();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < limit; ++i)
                sliced.push_back(full.at("diffs").at(i));
            full["diffs"] = std::move(sliced);
            full["count"] = full["diffs"].size();
            full["truncated"] = true;
        }
        full["hint"] = "for huge binaries prefer async "
                       "analyze.diff_start + diff_job (progress + cancel)";
        return full;
    }

    // explicit path into the private cache, else the app loaded binary
    std::optional<ds::binary_lock_t> shared_lock;
    const disasm::pe_image_t*   pe   = nullptr;
    const std::vector<uint8_t>* file = nullptr;
    std::string img_name;

    if (args.contains("path") && args.at("path").is_string()) {
        auto& img = load_image(args.at("path").get<std::string>());
        if (action == "packer") {
            require_x86_image(img.arch, img.format, "analyze.packer", true);
            require_pe_image(img.arch, img.format, "analyze.packer", true);
        }
        pe = &img.pe; file = &img.file;
        const size_t slash = img.path.find_last_of("\\/");
        img_name = (slash == std::string::npos) ? img.path : img.path.substr(slash + 1);
    } else {
        shared_lock.emplace();
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready)
            fail("no image: pass 'path' or load a binary in reverse-slop "
                 "(see disasm.loaded)");
        if (action == "packer") {
            require_x86_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "analyze.packer");
            require_pe_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "analyze.packer");
        }
        pe = &bin.pe; file = &bin.file;
        img_name = bin.name;
    }

    if (action == "packer") {
        auto v = analysis::packer_analyze(*pe, *file);
        json dets = json::array();
        for (const auto& d : v.detections)
            dets.push_back({{"type", d.type}, {"protector", d.protector},
                            {"detail", d.detail}, {"location", d.location}});
        json secs = json::array();
        for (const auto& s : v.sections)
            secs.push_back({{"name", s.name}, {"rva", s.rva},
                            {"raw_size", s.raw_size}, {"virtual_size", s.virtual_size},
                            {"entropy", s.entropy}, {"writable_exec", s.writable_exec},
                            // raw characteristics here too for consistency
                            {"exec", (s.characteristics & 0x20000000u) != 0},
                            {"writable", (s.characteristics & 0x80000000u) != 0},
                            {"characteristics", s.characteristics}});
        json out = {{"image", img_name}, {"packed", v.packed}, {"family", v.family},
                    {"confidence", v.confidence}, {"file_entropy", v.file_entropy},
                    {"detections", dets}, {"sections", secs}};

        // the hyperion packer verdict rides along when the session is analyzed
        if (!args.contains("path")) {
            auto& bin = ds::get();
            if (bin.ready && bin.hype) {
                hype::PackerDetector det;
                auto infos = det.detect(bin.hype->image());
                json harr = json::array();
                for (const auto& i : infos)
                    harr.push_back({{"name", i.name},
                                    {"confidence", i.confidence},
                                    {"details", i.details}});
                out["hype_packer"] = harr;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 256u), 1000u);

    // raw crypto constants plus analyzer-derived names when available
    if (!args.contains("path")) {
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (bin.ready && bin.hype && bin.hype->ready()) {
            auto hits = analysis::crypto_hunt(*pe, *file, limit);
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& h : hits) {
                json o = {{"name", h.name}, {"offset", h.offset},
                          {"in_overlay", h.in_overlay}};
                if (h.va) o["va"] = h.va;
                arr.push_back(std::move(o));
            }

            // analyzer derived names, nothing here is flirt verified
            json named = json::array();
            for (const auto& [va, name] : bin.hype->db().names) {
                if (name.find("j_") == 0 || name.find("__imp_") == 0) continue;
                if (named.size() >= limit) break;
                named.push_back({{"va", va}, {"name", name}});
            }
            return {{"image", img_name}, {"signatures", arr},
                    {"count", arr.size()}, {"named_functions", named},
                    {"named_count", named.size()}};
        }
    }

    auto hits = analysis::crypto_hunt(*pe, *file, limit);
    json arr = json::array();
    for (const auto& h : hits) {
        json o = {{"name", h.name}, {"offset", h.offset},
                  {"in_overlay", h.in_overlay}};
        if (h.va) o["va"] = h.va;
        arr.push_back(std::move(o));
    }
    return {{"image", img_name}, {"signatures", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/mcp/tools_app_guide.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_app_guide.cpp
// tools: app (ui-only plumbing on /api) and guide

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include "core/infra/lifecycle.hpp"
#include "core/infra/mcp_onboard.hpp"
#include "core/infra/paths.hpp"
#include "core/util/zip_writer.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

// tool: app
// app plumbing for the ui, stays off tools/list and lives on /api only

const int64_t g_app_start_ms = infra::steady_ms();

const char* diag_level_name(infra::diag::level_t l) noexcept {
    switch (l) {
    case infra::diag::level_t::trace: return "trace";
    case infra::diag::level_t::info:  return "info";
    case infra::diag::level_t::warn:  return "warn";
    case infra::diag::level_t::error: return "error";
    }
    return "?";
}

// typed keys the engine reads; anything else is stored as given
void validate_setting(const std::string& key, const json& v) {
    if (key.empty()) fail("app.settings_set: missing key");
    if (key == "mcp_token")
        fail("app.settings_set: mcp_token is not settable, use app.rotate_token");
    if (v.is_null()) return;   // erase
    if (key == "mcp_enabled" || key == "mcp_onboarded" || key == "script_unsafe" ||
        key == "web_allow_private") {
        if (!v.is_boolean()) fail("app.settings_set: " + key + " must be a boolean");
    } else if (key == "mcp_port") {
        if (!v.is_number_integer() || v.get<int64_t>() < 1 || v.get<int64_t>() > 65535)
            fail("app.settings_set: mcp_port must be an integer in 1..65535");
    } else if (key == "web_allowlist") {
        if (!v.is_array()) fail("app.settings_set: web_allowlist must be an array of strings");
        for (const auto& e : v)
            if (!e.is_string()) fail("app.settings_set: web_allowlist must be an array of strings");
    } else if (key == "events_max_streams") {
        if (!v.is_number_integer() || v.get<int64_t>() < 1 || v.get<int64_t>() > 1024)
            fail("app.settings_set: events_max_streams must be an integer in 1..1024");
    } else if (key == "mcp_rate_limits") {
        if (!v.is_object())
            fail("app.settings_set: mcp_rate_limits must be an object of {tool: {rate, burst}}");
        for (const auto& [tool, lim] : v.items()) {
            if (!lim.is_object() || !lim.contains("rate") || !lim.contains("burst") ||
                !lim.at("rate").is_number() || !lim.at("burst").is_number() ||
                lim.at("rate").get<double>() <= 0.0 || lim.at("burst").get<double>() < 1.0)
                fail("app.settings_set: mcp_rate_limits." + tool +
                     " must be {rate: >0, burst: >=1}");
        }
    } else if (key == "proxy_token") {
        if (!v.is_string()) fail("app.settings_set: proxy_token must be a string");
    }
}

json redacted_settings() {
    json s = infra::settings::snapshot();
    const std::string tok = s.value("mcp_token", std::string{});
    s["mcp_token"] = tok.empty() ? "unset" : "set";
    if (s.contains("proxy_token") && s.at("proxy_token").is_string())
        s["proxy_token"] = s.at("proxy_token").get_ref<const std::string&>().empty() ? "unset" : "set";
    return s;
}

} // namespace


json tool_app(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    if (action == "status" || action == "ping") {
        json out = app_state_unlocked();
        out["uptime_ms"]   = infra::steady_ms() - g_app_start_ms;
        out["mcp"]         = {{"running", running()}, {"port", port()}};
        out["subscribers"] = infra::event_bus::subscriber_count();
        out["output_revision"] = infra::event_bus::output_revision();
        out["diag_revision"]   = infra::diag::revision();
        out["watch_entries"]   = memory::watch::size();
        out["quit_requested"]  = infra::app_control::quit_requested();
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "output") {
        const uint64_t since = args.value("since", uint64_t{0});
        auto lines = infra::event_bus::output_since(since);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& l : lines)
            arr.push_back({{"seq", l.seq}, {"ms", l.ms}, {"text", l.text}});
        return {{"revision", infra::event_bus::output_revision()},
                {"count", arr.size()},
                {"lines", std::move(arr)}};
    }

    if (action == "output_clear") {
        infra::event_bus::output_clear();
        return {{"ok", true}};
    }

    if (action == "log") {
        const std::string text = args.value("text", std::string{});
        if (text.empty()) fail("app.log: missing text");
        infra::event_bus::output(text);
        return {{"ok", true}, {"revision", infra::event_bus::output_revision()}};
    }

    if (action == "diag") {
        const uint64_t since = args.value("since_revision", uint64_t{0});
        const size_t   limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", size_t{2000}), 8192);
        auto snap = infra::diag::snapshot(since, limit);
        json arr = json::array();
        const size_t begin = snap.entries.size() > limit ? snap.entries.size() - limit : 0;
        for (size_t i = begin; i < snap.entries.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& e = snap.entries[i];
            arr.push_back({{"ms", e.timestamp_ms},
                           {"level", diag_level_name(e.level)},
                           {"tag", e.tag},
                           {"message", e.message}});
        }
        return {{"revision", snap.revision},
                {"count", arr.size()},
                {"entries", std::move(arr)}};
    }

    if (action == "diag_bundle") {
        // support hand-off: one zip with the engine log tail, the settings
        // (secrets redacted), versions and the console status
        const std::string path = args.value("path", std::string{});
        if (path.empty()) fail("app.diag_bundle requires 'path' (the .zip to write)");

        constexpr size_t kTail = 2000;
        std::string diag_text;
        for (const auto& e : infra::diag::snapshot(0, kTail).entries) {
            diag_text += std::to_string(e.timestamp_ms);
            diag_text += ' ';
            diag_text += diag_level_name(e.level);
            diag_text += " [";
            diag_text += e.tag;
            diag_text += "] ";
            diag_text += e.message;
            diag_text += "\r\n";
        }
        std::string output_text;
        const auto lines = infra::event_bus::output_since(0);
        for (size_t i = lines.size() > kTail ? lines.size() - kTail : 0; i < lines.size(); ++i) {
            output_text += std::to_string(lines[i].ms);
            output_text += ' ';
            output_text += lines[i].text;
            output_text += "\r\n";
        }

        json status = json::object();
        try {
            status = tool_target({{"action", "status"}});
        } catch (...) {
            // a bundle is most useful when the engine is unhealthy: a failing
            // status call must never block it
        }
        json ps4 = status.contains("ps4") ? status["ps4"] : json::object();
        ps4["backend"] = status.value("backend", std::string{});
        ps4["console"] = status.value("console", std::string{});

        json versions = {{"engine", server_version()},
                         {"platform", "windows"},
                         {"ps4_fw", ps4.value("fw", std::string{})},
                         {"ps4_branding", ps4.value("branding", std::string{})}};
        json manifest = {{"created_ms", infra::steady_ms()},
                         {"engine_version", server_version()},
                         {"note", "settings.json has mcp_token/proxy_token redacted to "
                                  "'set'/'unset'"}};

        std::vector<util::zip::file_t> files;
        files.push_back({"versions.json", versions.dump(2)});
        files.push_back({"settings.json", redacted_settings().dump(2)});
        files.push_back({"ps4_status.json", ps4.dump(2)});
        files.push_back({"diag.log", std::move(diag_text)});
        files.push_back({"output.log", std::move(output_text)});
        files.push_back({"bundle.json", manifest.dump(2)});

        json names = json::array();
        for (const auto& f : files) names.push_back(f.name);
        std::string zip;
        std::string err;
        if (!util::zip::write_stored(files, zip, &err)) fail("app.diag_bundle: " + err);
        if (!infra::paths::write_file_atomic(path, zip))
            fail("app.diag_bundle: cannot write " + path);
        return {{"ok", true}, {"path", path}, {"bytes", zip.size()},
                {"entries", std::move(names)}};
    }

    if (action == "shutdown") {
        infra::app_control::request_quit(
            args.value("reason", std::string{"front end requested shutdown"}));
        return {{"ok", true}, {"reason", infra::app_control::quit_reason()}};
    }

    if (action == "settings_get") return redacted_settings();

    if (action == "settings_set") {
        const std::string key = args.value("key", std::string{});
        const json value = args.contains("value") ? args.at("value") : json(nullptr);
        validate_setting(key, value);
        if (!infra::settings::set(key, value))
            fail("app.settings_set: could not write " + infra::settings::file());
        json out = {{"ok", true}, {"key", key}, {"value", value}};
        if (key == "mcp_port" || key == "mcp_enabled" || key == "events_max_streams")
            out["restart_required"] = true;
        if (key == "proxy_token" && value.is_string()) out["value"] = "set";
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "events_ticket") return {{"ticket", issue_events_ticket()}, {"ttl_ms", 60000}};

    if (action == "rotate_token") {
        // the in-flight request already passed auth, so its response still arrives;
        // every later request needs the new token (the per-launch SLOP_MCP_TOKEN
        // supervisor token is unaffected). The Tauri supervisor and the UI use a
        // per-launch extra token, so rotation must stay available to it; the new
        // bearer is returned only in this response and never via settings_get.
        const bool caller_primary = request_used_primary_token();
        const std::string tok = infra::settings::generate_token();
        if (tok.empty()) fail("app.rotate_token: random generator failed");
        if (!infra::settings::set("mcp_token", tok))
            fail("app.rotate_token: could not write " + infra::settings::file());
        set_primary_token(tok);
        infra::lifecycle::refresh_endpoint();
        json updated = json::array();
        for (const auto& r : infra::mcp_onboard::refresh_existing(port(), tok))
            if (r.installed) updated.push_back(r.client);
        return {{"rotated", true},
                {"token", tok},   // shown once; never readable via settings_get
                {"caller_must_switch", caller_primary},
                {"clients_updated", std::move(updated)}};
    }

    if (action == "register_token") {
        if (!request_used_primary_token())
            fail("app.register_token: requires the primary bearer token");
        const std::string tok = args.value("token", std::string{});
        if (tok.size() < 32) fail("app.register_token: token must be at least 32 characters");
        add_extra_token(tok);
        return {{"ok", true}};
    }
    fail("app: unknown action");
    return {};
}

json topic_json(const guide_topic_t& t) {
    json steps = json::array();
    for (const auto& s : t.steps) {
        json st;
        st["tool"] = s.tool;
        st["action"] = s.action;
        st["params"] = json::parse(s.params, nullptr, false);
        st["why"] = s.why;
        steps.push_back(std::move(st));
    }
    return {{"topic", t.id}, {"title", t.title}, {"summary", t.summary}, {"steps", steps}};
}

} // namespace

json guide_topics() {
    json arr = json::array();
    for (const auto& t : guide_table())
        arr.push_back({{"topic", t.id}, {"title", t.title}, {"summary", t.summary}});
    return arr;
}

json guide_topic(const std::string& id) {
    for (const auto& t : guide_table())
        if (id == t.id) return topic_json(t);
    return nullptr;
}

json tool_guide(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    if (action == "list") {
        json arr = guide_topics();
        return {{"topics", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
                {"note", "call guide get {topic:<id>} for the exact tool-call sequence"}};
    }
    if (action == "get") {
        if (!args.contains("topic") || !args.at("topic").is_string())
            fail("guide get requires 'topic' (see guide list)");
        const std::string want = args.at("topic").get<std::string>();
        if (json out = guide_topic(want); !out.is_null()) return out;
        json ids = json::array();
        for (const auto& t : guide_topics()) ids.push_back(t.at("topic"));
        fail("unknown guide topic '" + want + "' (available: " + ids.dump() + ")");
    }
    fail("guide: unknown action (list|get)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_common.cpp
// shared state and helpers for the tool handlers

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"
#include "core/compat/portable.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

std::mutex g_tool_mu;
std::mutex g_image_mu;

std::mutex& tool_mutex() { return g_tool_mu; }

scan_state_t                g_scan;
image_cache_t               g_image;
std::vector<mcp_snapshot_t> g_snaps;
uint64_t                    g_snap_next_id = 1;
network::traffic_store_t    g_traffic;
network::http_proxy_t       g_proxy;

namespace {

const char* arch_from_hype(hype::Arch a) {
    switch (a) {
    case hype::Arch::X86:   return "x86";
    case hype::Arch::X64:   return "x64";
    case hype::Arch::ARM:   return "arm";
    case hype::Arch::ARM64: return "arm64";
    case hype::Arch::MIPS:  return "mips";
    case hype::Arch::PPC:   return "ppc";
    default:                return "unknown";
    }
}

} // namespace


// helpers

[[noreturn]] void fail(std::string msg) { throw std::runtime_error(std::move(msg)); }

void require_x86_image(disasm::image_arch_t arch, disasm::image_format_t format,
                       std::string_view action, bool path_image) {
    if (arch == disasm::image_arch_t::x86 || arch == disasm::image_arch_t::x64)
        return;
    if (path_image)
        fail(fmt::format("{} is x86/x64 only for 'path' images; the image is {} ({}); "
                         "load it with disasm.load to use the hyperion analyzer",
                         action, disasm::image_arch_name(arch),
                         disasm::image_format_name(format)));
    fail(fmt::format("{} supports x86/x64 only; the loaded image is {} ({})",
                     action, disasm::image_arch_name(arch),
                     disasm::image_format_name(format)));
}

void require_pe_image(disasm::image_arch_t arch, disasm::image_format_t format,
                      std::string_view action, bool path_image) {
    if (format == disasm::image_format_t::pe) return;
    fail(fmt::format("{} requires a PE image; the {} image is {} ({})",
                     action, path_image ? "'path'" : "loaded",
                     disasm::image_arch_name(arch), disasm::image_format_name(format)));
}


const char* arch_name(runtime::arch_t a) {
    switch (a) {
    case runtime::arch_t::x64:    return "x64";
    case runtime::arch_t::x86:    return "x86";
    case runtime::arch_t::arm64:  return "arm64";
    case runtime::arch_t::unknown: break;
    }
    return "unknown";
}


std::shared_ptr<runtime::session_t> need_session() {
    auto s = process::active_session();
    if (!s || !s->valid()) fail("no target attached (use target.attach first)");
    return s;
}

uint64_t parse_addr(const json& args, const char* key) {
    if (!args.contains(key))
        fail(std::string("missing numeric argument '") + key + "'");
    const json& v = args.at(key);
    if (v.is_string()) {
        const std::string s = v.get<std::string>();
        // allow surrounding whitespace; stoull throws invalid_argument on
        // names/expressions instead of leaking a bare conversion error
        size_t beg = s.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
        size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n");
        const std::string t =
            (beg == std::string::npos) ? std::string{} : s.substr(beg, end - beg + 1);
        if (t.empty()) fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "': empty string");
        try {
            size_t pos = 0;
            const uint64_t val = std::stoull(t, &pos, 0);
            if (pos != t.size())
                fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key +
                     "': trailing characters in '" + t + "'");
            return val;
        } catch (const std::invalid_argument&) {
            fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "': '" + t +
                 "' is not a number (use 0x... hex or decimal)");
        } catch (const std::out_of_range&) {
            fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "': '" + t + "' out of range");
        }
    }
    if (v.is_number_unsigned()) return v.get<uint64_t>();
    if (v.is_number_integer()) {
        const int64_t sv = v.get<int64_t>();
        if (sv < 0) fail("negative address");
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(sv);
    }
    if (v.is_number_float()) {
        const double dv = v.get<double>();
        if (!(dv >= 0.0) || dv > 1.8446744073709552e19)
            fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "': out of range");
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(dv);
    }
    fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "'");
}

// First present key wins; used where agents naturally say base/va/address
// instead of the canonical addr, or len instead of size.
uint64_t parse_addr_alias(const json& args, std::initializer_list<const char*> keys) {
    for (const char* k : keys) {
        if (args.contains(k)) return parse_addr(args, k);
    }
    std::string want;
    for (const char* k : keys) {
        if (!want.empty()) want += "|";
        want += k;
    }
    fail("missing numeric argument (expected one of: " + want + ")");
}

bool has_any(const json& args, std::initializer_list<const char*> keys) {
    for (const char* k : keys) {
        if (args.contains(k)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

std::string require_action(const json& args) {
    if (!args.contains("action") || !args.at("action").is_string())
        fail("missing 'action' string");
    return args.at("action").get<std::string>();
}

std::vector<uint8_t> hex_decode(const std::string& hex) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    std::string err;
    if (!infra::fmt::parse_hex(hex, out, err)) fail("bad hex payload: " + err);
    return out;
}

std::string to_hex(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    return infra::fmt::format_hex_packed({data, len});
}

std::string hex64(uint64_t v) {
    char buf[32] = "";
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(v));
    return buf;
}

std::string addr_hex_str(uint64_t v) {
    char buf[32] = "";
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "0x%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(v));
    return buf;
}


bool icontains(const std::string& haystack, const std::string& needle) {
    if (needle.empty()) return true;
    const size_t n = needle.size(), h = haystack.size();
    if (n > h) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i + n <= h; ++i)
        if (_strnicmp(haystack.c_str() + i, needle.c_str(), n) == 0)
            return true;
    return false;
}


// image cache

image_cache_t& load_image(const std::string& path) {
    std::lock_guard ilk(g_image_mu);
    if (g_image.path == path && !g_image.file.empty()) return g_image;

    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) fail("cannot open image file");
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    const long size = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    if (size <= 0 || size > (256L << 20)) { fclose(f); fail("image file too large or empty"); }
    image_cache_t c;
    c.file.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
    const size_t rd = fread(c.file.data(), 1, c.file.size(), f);
    fclose(f);
    if (rd != c.file.size()) fail("short read on image file");

    auto opened = disasm::open_image(std::move(c.file));
    if (!opened.ok) fail(opened.error);
    if (opened.file.size() > (256u << 20)) fail("analyzed image too large (>256 MiB)");
    c.file = std::move(opened.file);
    c.pe = std::move(opened.pe);
    c.format = opened.format;
    c.arch = opened.arch;

    g_image = std::move(c);
    g_image.path = path;
    return g_image;
}

disasm::engine_t& shared_engine() {
    static disasm::engine_t eng;   // guarded by g_tool_mu
    return eng;
}

// hw bp and snapshot helpers

mcp_snapshot_t* find_snapshot(uint64_t id) {
    for (auto& rec : g_snaps)
        if (rec.id == id) return &rec;
    return nullptr;
}

// app session context
// what the app has going right now, shown at initialize and in the status actions

json loaded_image_json() {
    std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
    auto& bin = ds::get();
    json out = {{"ready", bin.ready}};
    if (!bin.ready) return out;
    out["name"]          = bin.name;
    out["path"]          = bin.path;
    out["format"]        = disasm::image_format_name(bin.format);
    out["arch"]          = disasm::image_arch_name(bin.arch);
    out["encrypted"]     = bin.encrypted;
    if (bin.encrypted)
        out["warning"] = "FairPlay-encrypted executable: decrypt first (for example, "
                         "use a dumped/decrypted IPA); analysis of encrypted code is noise";
    if (bin.bundle) {
        const auto& bundle = *bin.bundle;
        out["bundle"] = {{"app_dir", bundle.app_dir},
                         {"executable", bundle.executable},
                         {"executable_path", bundle.executable_path},
                         {"bundle_id", bundle.bundle_id},
                         {"version", bundle.version},
                         {"build", bundle.build},
                         {"min_os", bundle.min_os}};
    }
    out["base"]          = bin.base;
    out["entry_va"]      = bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva;
    out["size_of_image"] = bin.pe.size_of_image;
    out["sections"]      = bin.pe.sections.size();
    out["functions"]     = bin.fns.functions().size();
    out["xrefs"]         = bin.xrefs.total();
    out["strings"]       = bin.strings.size();
    out["symbols"]       = bin.symbols.size();

    // hyperion is the decompiler plus the rich analysis db
    json hype = {{"available", static_cast<bool>(bin.hype)}};
    if (bin.hype) {
        const bool rdy    = bin.hype->ready();
        hype["ready"]     = rdy;
        hype["progress"]  = bin.hype->progress();
        hype["arch"]      = arch_from_hype(bin.hype->db().arch);
        hype["managed"]   = bin.hype->is_dotnet();
        if (rdy) {
            hype["functions"]       = bin.hype->db().funcs.size();
            hype["instructions"]    = bin.hype->db().insns.size();
            hype["xrefs"]           = bin.hype->db().xrefs.size();
            hype["vtables"]         = bin.hype->db().vtables.size();
            hype["globals"]         = bin.hype->db().globals.size();
            hype["rtti_classes"]    = bin.hype->rtti().classes().size();
        }
        const std::string herr = bin.hype->error();
        if (!herr.empty()) hype["error"] = herr;
    }
    out["hype"] = hype;
    return out;
}

json attached_target_json() {
    json out = {{"attached", false}};
    if (auto s = process::active_session(); s && s->valid()) {
        out["attached"] = true;
        out["pid"]      = s->pid();
        out["name"]     = s->name();
        out["arch"]     = arch_name(s->arch());
    }
    return out;
}

// caller holds the mutex
json app_state_unlocked() {
    json out;
    out["backend"] = runtime::active_badge();
    out["target"]  = attached_target_json();
    out["image"]   = loaded_image_json();
    // surfacing a live debug session keeps an agent from stomping it
    out["debugger"] = "ps4 (debugger ps4_* actions)";
    return out;
}

std::optional<progress_sample_t> sample_progress(const std::string& tool,
                                                 const std::string& action,
                                                 int64_t elapsed_ms) {
    // memory scans expose a live byte/hit counter
    if (tool == "memory" && (action == "scan" || action == "rescan")) {
        const auto& p = g_scan.engine.progress();
        const uint64_t bytes = p.bytes.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const uint64_t found = p.found.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return progress_sample_t{static_cast<double>(bytes), std::nullopt,
                                 "scanned " + std::to_string(bytes) + " bytes, " +
                                     std::to_string(found) + " hits"};
    }
    // hyperion analysis has a 0..1 fraction
    if (tool == "disasm" && action == "loaded") {
        const double pct = static_cast<double>(ds::hype_progress()) * 100.0;
        return progress_sample_t{pct, 100.0,
                                 "hyperion analysis " + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(pct)) + "%"};
    }
    // no live counter: report elapsed time so a long call still proves liveness
    static const std::unordered_set<std::string> kLong = {
        "memory.pointerscan",   "memory.pointerscan_verify", "emulate.run",
        "devirt.themida_start", "devirt.themida_job",        "analyze.diff",
        "analyze.diff_start",   "disasm.load",               "script.run",
        "patch.full_pass",      "re.rtti_scan",              "fs.grep_in_files",
        "fs.search_files",      "network.reassemble_stream",
    };
    if (kLong.count(tool + "." + action) == 0) return std::nullopt;
    const double secs = static_cast<double>(elapsed_ms) / 1000.0;
    return progress_sample_t{static_cast<double>(elapsed_ms), std::nullopt,
                             tool + "." + action + " running (" +
                                 std::to_string(static_cast<int>(secs)) + "s)"};
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_debugger.cpp
// tool: debugger (PS4 live debugging, composite flows on PS4 and the local
// test-lab backend, ps4 native scan)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include "core/debugger/composite.hpp"
#include "core/debugger/local_debugger.hpp"
#include "core/debugger/ps4_debug_target.hpp"
#include "core/memory/console_scan.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/broker.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

namespace dbg = slop::core::debugger;

// tool: debugger - PS4 live debugging (ps4debug-NG debug session on the console)

json ps4_ctx_json(const runtime::thread_context_t& c) {
    return {{"rip", c.rip}, {"rsp", c.rsp}, {"rbp", c.rbp},
            {"rax", c.rax}, {"rbx", c.rbx}, {"rcx", c.rcx}, {"rdx", c.rdx},
            {"rsi", c.rsi}, {"rdi", c.rdi},
            {"r8", c.r8}, {"r9", c.r9}, {"r10", c.r10}, {"r11", c.r11},
            {"r12", c.r12}, {"r13", c.r13}, {"r14", c.r14}, {"r15", c.r15},
            {"flags", c.flags}};
}

json ps4_event_json(const runtime::ps4_event_t& e) {
    json o = {{"lwpid", e.lwpid}, {"signal", e.signal}, {"status", e.status},
              {"thread", e.thread_name}};
    // name the context json first: items() on a temporary dangles
    json cx = ps4_ctx_json(e.ctx);
    for (auto& kv : cx.items()) o[kv.key()] = kv.value();
    json dr = json::array();
    for (uint64_t d : e.dr) dr.push_back(d);
    o["dr"] = dr;
    return o;
}

// ---- conditional breakpoints (client-side) ----
// The payload has no condition support: the engine keeps "<reg> <op> <value>"
// per breakpoint address and ps4_wait auto-resumes while the condition is false.

struct bp_condition_t {
    std::string reg;
    std::string op;
    uint64_t    value = 0;
};

// one rule per breakpoint address: condition, hit count, log format and the
// client that armed it (slots are shared by the UI, MCP sessions and scripts)
struct bp_rule_t {
    bool           has_condition = false;
    bp_condition_t condition;
    std::string    condition_text;
    uint64_t       hits = 0;          // 0 = stop on every hit
    std::string    hit_mode = "eq";   // eq | ge | every
    std::string    log;               // empty = no log line
    bool           log_continue = false;   // log and auto-resume
    uint64_t       count = 0;         // hits the engine has seen
    std::string    owner;             // client id that armed the slot
};

std::unordered_map<uint64_t, bp_rule_t> g_bp_rules;

bool parse_bp_condition(const std::string& text, bp_condition_t& out, std::string& err) {
    std::string s;
    for (char c : text)
        if (!std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) s.push_back(c);
    if (s.empty()) { err = "empty condition"; return false; }
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.size() &&
           (std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i])) || s[i] == '_')) ++i;
    out.reg = s.substr(0, i);
    for (char& c : out.reg) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    static const char* kRegs[] = {
        "rax", "rbx", "rcx", "rdx", "rsi", "rdi", "rbp", "rsp",
        "r8", "r9", "r10", "r11", "r12", "r13", "r14", "r15", "rip", "eflags"
    };
    if (std::find(std::begin(kRegs), std::end(kRegs), out.reg) == std::end(kRegs)) {
        err = "unknown register '" + out.reg + "'";
        return false;
    }
    if (i >= s.size()) { err = "missing operator"; return false; }
    if (s.compare(i, 2, "==") == 0)      { out.op = "=="; i += 2; }
    else if (s.compare(i, 2, "!=") == 0) { out.op = "!="; i += 2; }
    else if (s.compare(i, 2, ">=") == 0) { out.op = ">="; i += 2; }
    else if (s.compare(i, 2, "<=") == 0) { out.op = "<="; i += 2; }
    else if (s[i] == '>')                { out.op = ">";  ++i; }
    else if (s[i] == '<')                { out.op = "<";  ++i; }
    else if (s[i] == '&')                { out.op = "&";  ++i; }
    else { err = "expected ==, !=, >, <, >=, <= or &"; return false; }
    const std::string v = s.substr(i);
    if (v.empty()) { err = "missing value"; return false; }
    char* end = nullptr;
    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(v.c_str(), &end, 0);
    if (!end || *end != '\0') { err = "bad value '" + v + "'"; return false; }
    out.value = parsed;
    return true;
}

uint64_t bp_reg_value(const runtime::thread_context_t& c, const std::string& r) {
    if (r == "rax") return c.rax;
    if (r == "rbx") return c.rbx;
    if (r == "rcx") return c.rcx;
    if (r == "rdx") return c.rdx;
    if (r == "rsi") return c.rsi;
    if (r == "rdi") return c.rdi;
    if (r == "rbp") return c.rbp;
    if (r == "rsp") return c.rsp;
    if (r == "r8")  return c.r8;
    if (r == "r9")  return c.r9;
    if (r == "r10") return c.r10;
    if (r == "r11") return c.r11;
    if (r == "r12") return c.r12;
    if (r == "r13") return c.r13;
    if (r == "r14") return c.r14;
    if (r == "r15") return c.r15;
    if (r == "rip") return c.rip;
    return c.flags;
}

bool eval_bp_condition(const bp_condition_t& c, const runtime::thread_context_t& ctx) {
    const uint64_t v = bp_reg_value(ctx, c.reg);
    if (c.op == "==") return v == c.value;
    if (c.op == "!=") return v != c.value;
    if (c.op == ">")  return v > c.value;
    if (c.op == "<")  return v < c.value;
    if (c.op == ">=") return v >= c.value;
    if (c.op == "<=") return v <= c.value;
    if (c.op == "&")  return (v & c.value) != 0;
    return true;
}

bool bp_reg_by_name(const runtime::thread_context_t& c, const std::string& r, uint64_t& v) {
    if (r == "rax") { v = c.rax; return true; }
    if (r == "rbx") { v = c.rbx; return true; }
    if (r == "rcx") { v = c.rcx; return true; }
    if (r == "rdx") { v = c.rdx; return true; }
    if (r == "rsi") { v = c.rsi; return true; }
    if (r == "rdi") { v = c.rdi; return true; }
    if (r == "rbp") { v = c.rbp; return true; }
    if (r == "rsp") { v = c.rsp; return true; }
    if (r == "r8")  { v = c.r8;  return true; }
    if (r == "r9")  { v = c.r9;  return true; }
    if (r == "r10") { v = c.r10; return true; }
    if (r == "r11") { v = c.r11; return true; }
    if (r == "r12") { v = c.r12; return true; }
    if (r == "r13") { v = c.r13; return true; }
    if (r == "r14") { v = c.r14; return true; }
    if (r == "r15") { v = c.r15; return true; }
    if (r == "rip") { v = c.rip; return true; }
    if (r == "flags" || r == "eflags") { v = c.flags; return true; }
    return false;
}

std::string hex64(uint64_t v) {
    char buf[24];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "0x%llx", static_cast<unsigned long long>(v));
    return buf;
}

std::string lower_ascii(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return s;
}

// "[rsp+8]" / "[rax]" / "[rbp-0x10]:u32" -> base register, displacement, width
bool parse_mem_token(const std::string& t, std::string& reg, int64_t& disp, uint32_t& width) {
    if (t.size() < 3 || t.front() != '[') return false;
    const size_t close = t.find(']');
    if (close == std::string::npos) return false;
    std::string inner;
    for (char c : t.substr(1, close - 1))
        if (!std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) inner.push_back(c);
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < inner.size() &&
           (std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(inner[i])) || inner[i] == '_')) ++i;
    reg = lower_ascii(inner.substr(0, i));
    disp = 0;
    if (i < inner.size()) {
        if (inner[i] != '+' && inner[i] != '-') return false;
        const bool neg = inner[i] == '-';
        char* end = nullptr;
        const unsigned long long d = std::strtoull(inner.c_str() + i + 1, &end, 0);
        if (!end || *end != '\0') return false;
        disp = neg ? -static_cast<int64_t>(d) : static_cast<int64_t>(d);
    }
    width = 8;
    if (close + 1 < t.size()) {
        if (t[close + 1] != ':') return false;
        const std::string w = lower_ascii(t.substr(close + 2));
        if (w == "u8") width = 1;
        else if (w == "u16") width = 2;
        else if (w == "u32") width = 4;
        else if (w == "u64") width = 8;
        else return false;
    }
    return !reg.empty();
}

using bp_read_fn = std::function<bool(uint64_t, void*, size_t)>;

// log breakpoint format: {rax} {rip} {[rsp+8]:u64}; unknown tokens stay literal
std::string format_bp_log(const std::string& fmt, const runtime::thread_context_t& ctx,
                          const bp_read_fn& read) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(fmt.size() + 32);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < fmt.size();) {
        if (fmt[i] != '{') { out.push_back(fmt[i++]); continue; }
        const size_t end = fmt.find('}', i + 1);
        if (end == std::string::npos) { out.append(fmt.substr(i)); break; }
        const std::string token = fmt.substr(i + 1, end - i - 1);
        bool done = false;
        if (!token.empty() && token[0] != '[') {
            uint64_t v = 0;
            if (bp_reg_by_name(ctx, lower_ascii(token), v)) {
                out += hex64(v);
                done = true;
            }
        } else {
            std::string reg;
            int64_t disp = 0;
            uint32_t width = 8;
            uint64_t base = 0;
            if (parse_mem_token(token, reg, disp, width) &&
                bp_reg_by_name(ctx, reg, base)) {
                uint8_t buf[8]{};
                if (read(base + static_cast<uint64_t>(disp), buf, width)) {
                    uint64_t v = 0;
                    std::memcpy(&v, buf, width);
                    out += hex64(v);
                } else {
                    out += "<unreadable>";
                }
                done = true;
            }
        }
        if (!done) out.append(fmt, i, end - i + 1);
        i = end + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

// count this hit and decide whether the debugger stops (false = auto-resume).
// log_line is filled when the rule has a log format.
bool bp_rule_hit(bp_rule_t& r, const runtime::thread_context_t& ctx, const bp_read_fn& read,
                 std::string& log_line) {
    if (r.has_condition && !eval_bp_condition(r.condition, ctx)) return false;
    ++r.count;
    if (!r.log.empty()) log_line = format_bp_log(r.log, ctx, read);
    if (r.log_continue) return false;   // log-only breakpoint
    if (r.hits == 0) return true;
    if (r.hit_mode == "ge") return r.count >= r.hits;
    if (r.hit_mode == "every") return r.count % r.hits == 0;
    return r.count == r.hits;           // eq
}

void emit_bp_log(const std::string& text, uint32_t lwpid, uint64_t rip) {
    if (text.empty()) return;
    infra::event_bus::output(text);
    infra::event_bus::publish("debugger.log", json{{"lwpid", lwpid}, {"rip", rip},
                                                   {"rip_hex", addr_hex_str(rip)},
                                                   {"text", text}});
}

// rule fields merged into ps4_bp_list entries
json bp_rule_json(uint64_t addr) {
    const auto it = g_bp_rules.find(addr);
    if (it == g_bp_rules.end()) return json::object();
    const auto& r = it->second;
    json o = {{"hits", r.hits}, {"hit_mode", r.hit_mode}, {"count", r.count},
              {"log", r.log}, {"log_continue", r.log_continue}};
    if (r.has_condition) o["condition"] = r.condition_text;
    if (!r.owner.empty()) o["owner"] = r.owner;
    return o;
}

// parse the rule arguments shared by the console and local ps4_bp_set paths
bp_rule_t parse_bp_rule_args(const json& args) {
    bp_rule_t r;
    if (args.contains("condition") && args.at("condition").is_string()) {
        const std::string text = args.at("condition").get<std::string>();
        if (!text.empty()) {
            std::string err;
            if (!parse_bp_condition(text, r.condition, err))
                fail("ps4_bp_set: bad condition: " + err);
            r.has_condition = true;
            r.condition_text = text;
        }
    }
    if (args.contains("hits")) {
        r.hits = parse_addr(args, "hits");
        if (r.hits == 0) fail("ps4_bp_set: hits must be greater than 0");
    }
    r.hit_mode = args.value("hit_mode", std::string{"eq"});
    if (r.hit_mode != "eq" && r.hit_mode != "ge" && r.hit_mode != "every")
        fail("ps4_bp_set: hit_mode must be eq|ge|every");
    if (args.contains("log") && args.at("log").is_string())
        r.log = args.at("log").get<std::string>();
    r.log_continue = args.value("continue", false);
    if (r.log_continue && r.log.empty())
        fail("ps4_bp_set: continue:true needs a log format");
    r.owner = mcp::client_id();
    return r;
}

// a slot armed by another client is not silently clobbered
void require_bp_owner(uint64_t addr, bool force, const char* what) {
    const auto it = g_bp_rules.find(addr);
    if (it == g_bp_rules.end() || it->second.owner.empty() || force) return;
    const std::string me = mcp::client_id();
    if (it->second.owner == me) return;
    fail(std::string(what) + ": " + addr_hex_str(addr) + " is owned by client '" +
         it->second.owner + "'; pass force:true to take it over");
}

// a generic stop (console or local) in the same shape as ps4_event_json
json stop_json(const dbg::stop_event_t& e) {
    json o = {{"lwpid", e.tid}, {"signal", e.signal}, {"status", e.status},
              {"thread", e.thread}, {"reason", e.reason}};
    json cx = ps4_ctx_json(e.ctx);
    for (auto& kv : cx.items()) o[kv.key()] = kv.value();
    o["rip_hex"] = addr_hex_str(e.ctx.rip);
    json dr = json::array();
    for (uint64_t d : e.dr) dr.push_back(d);
    o["dr"] = dr;
    return o;
}

json frames_json(const std::vector<dbg::frame_rec_t>& frames) {
    json arr = json::array();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < frames.size(); ++i)
        arr.push_back({{"index", i}, {"ret_addr", frames[i].ret_addr},
                       {"ret_addr_hex", addr_hex_str(frames[i].ret_addr)},
                       {"frame_ptr", frames[i].frame_ptr}});
    return arr;
}

[[noreturn]] void io_fail(const std::string& what, const runtime::io_result_t& io) {
    fail(what + ": " + runtime::ps4::io_error_str(io.error));
}

runtime::backend_ps4_t& need_ps4() {
    auto* p = runtime::registry_ps4();
    if (!p)
        fail("PS4 debug actions require a connected console (target.ps4_connect {host})");
    if (!p->connected())
        fail("the console connection was lost (" + p->lost_reason() +
             "); target.ps4_reconnect restores it with the debug session and breakpoints");
    return *p;
}

uint32_t ps4_pid_arg(const json& args) {
    if (args.contains("pid"))
        return static_cast<uint32_t>(parse_addr(args, "pid"));
    if (auto s = process::active_session(); s && s->valid())
        return s->pid();
    fail("missing pid (no PS4 target attached either; use target.attach {pid})");
}

// lwpid argument, or the first thread of the debuggee when omitted
uint32_t ps4_lwpid_arg(runtime::backend_ps4_t& p, const json& args) {
    if (args.contains("lwpid"))
        return static_cast<uint32_t>(parse_addr(args, "lwpid"));
    const uint32_t pid = ps4_pid_arg(args);
    auto thr = p.enum_threads(pid);
    if (thr.ok && !thr.items.empty()) return thr.items.front().tid;
    fail("missing lwpid (target.threads lists the debuggee's lwpids)");
}

std::string ps4_hex_str(const uint8_t* bytes, size_t n) {
    static const char* kHex = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(n * 2);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        out.push_back(kHex[bytes[i] >> 4]);
        out.push_back(kHex[bytes[i] & 0xF]);
    }
    return out;
}

std::string ps4_hex_str(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    return ps4_hex_str(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
}

// ---- debug target selection for the composite flows ------------------------
// The console debugger when a PS4 is the session's backend, otherwise the
// local Win32 debugger on the attached test-lab process (so the composite
// flows run, and are tested, without a console)

dbg::local_debugger_t& local_debugger() {
    static dbg::local_debugger_t d;
    return d;
}

struct picked_target_t {
    std::shared_ptr<runtime::session_t> session;
    std::unique_ptr<dbg::ps4_debug_target_t> ps4;
    dbg::debug_target_t* t = nullptr;
    runtime::backend_ps4_t* p4 = nullptr;
};

picked_target_t pick_debug_target(const std::string& action) {
    picked_target_t pk;
    pk.session = process::active_session();
    runtime::backend_t* b = pk.session && pk.session->valid() ? pk.session->backend()
                                                              : &runtime::active();
    if (b->kind() == runtime::backend_kind_t::ps4) {
        auto& p = need_ps4();
        if (!p.ps4_debug_attached()) fail(action + " requires ps4_attach first");
        pk.p4 = &p;
        pk.ps4 = std::make_unique<dbg::ps4_debug_target_t>(p, pk.session);
        pk.t = pk.ps4.get();
        return pk;
    }
    if (!pk.session || !pk.session->valid())
        fail(action + " needs an attached target (target.attach {pid}, or target.ps4_connect)");
    auto& d = local_debugger();
    if (!d.attached() || d.pid() != pk.session->pid()) {
        std::string err;
        if (!d.attach(pk.session->pid(), err))
            fail(action + ": local debugger attach failed: " + err);
    }
    pk.t = &d;
    return pk;
}

json tool_debugger_composite(const std::string& action, const json& args) {
    auto pk = pick_debug_target(action);
    auto& t = *pk.t;

    if (action == "ps4_until") {
        // one-call "run until addr": arm a one-shot bp, continue, wait, clear
        const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        const int timeout_ms = std::min(args.value("timeout_ms", 30000), 60000);
        auto r = dbg::run_until(t, addr, timeout_ms);
        if (!r.ok) fail("ps4_until: " + r.error);
        json o = r.halted ? stop_json(r.ev) : json::object();
        o["halted"] = r.halted;
        o["until"] = addr;
        o["until_hex"] = addr_hex_str(addr);
        o["index"] = r.index;
        o["bp_was_armed"] = r.reused;
        o["skipped_stops"] = r.skipped;
        o["debugger"] = t.kind();
        if (!r.halted) {
            o["timeout_ms"] = timeout_ms;
            if (r.ev.reason == "exit") o["process_exited"] = true;
        }
        return o;
    }
    if (action == "ps4_find_write") {
        // one-call "who writes here": write watchpoint, continue, wait, callstack
        const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        const uint64_t len = args.contains("len") ? parse_addr(args, "len") : 8;
        const int timeout_ms = std::min(args.value("timeout_ms", 30000), 60000);
        const size_t depth = std::min<size_t>(args.value("depth", 32u), 64u);
        auto r = dbg::find_write(t, addr, static_cast<uint32_t>(len), timeout_ms, depth);
        if (!r.ok) fail("ps4_find_write: " + r.error);
        json out = {{"halted", r.halted}, {"addr", addr}, {"addr_hex", addr_hex_str(addr)},
                    {"len", len}, {"timeout_ms", timeout_ms}, {"index", r.index},
                    {"debugger", t.kind()}};
        if (r.halted) {
            out["event"] = stop_json(r.ev);
            out["callstack"] = frames_json(r.frames);
            out["writer_rip"] = r.ev.ctx.rip;
            out["writer_rip_hex"] = addr_hex_str(r.ev.ctx.rip);
        }
        return out;
    }
    if (action == "ps4_trace_calls") {
        // breakpoint arg logger: continue+wait loop recording the 6 arg regs
        const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        const size_t count = std::min<size_t>(args.value("count", 64u), 4096u);
        const int timeout_ms = std::min(args.value("timeout_ms", 5000), 60000);
        auto r = dbg::trace_calls(t, addr, count, timeout_ms);
        if (!r.ok) fail("ps4_trace_calls: " + r.error);
        json hits = json::array();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < r.hits.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& ev = r.hits[i];
            hits.push_back({{"index", i}, {"lwpid", ev.tid},
                            {"thread", ev.thread}, {"signal", ev.signal},
                            {"rip", ev.ctx.rip}, {"rdi", ev.ctx.rdi},
                            {"rsi", ev.ctx.rsi}, {"rdx", ev.ctx.rdx},
                            {"rcx", ev.ctx.rcx}, {"r8", ev.ctx.r8},
                            {"r9", ev.ctx.r9}});
        }
        return {{"addr", addr}, {"addr_hex", addr_hex_str(addr)}, {"hits", hits},
                {"hits_count", hits.size()}, {"stop_reason", r.stop_reason},
                {"skipped_stops", r.skipped}, {"debugger", t.kind()},
                {"note", "args are the SysV order rdi,rsi,rdx,rcx,r8,r9 (local Win64 targets "
                         "pass rcx,rdx,r8,r9); the target stays stopped at the last hit, "
                         "ps4_continue resumes"}};
    }
    // ps4_trace_steps: single-step execution trace with disassembly
    uint32_t tid = 0;
    if (args.contains("lwpid")) tid = static_cast<uint32_t>(parse_addr(args, "lwpid"));
    else if (pk.p4) tid = ps4_lwpid_arg(*pk.p4, args);
    const size_t count = std::min<size_t>(args.value("count", 64u), 4096u);
    const int timeout_ms = std::min(args.value("timeout_ms", 5000), 60000);
    auto r = dbg::trace_steps(t, tid, count, timeout_ms);
    if (!r.ok) fail("ps4_trace_steps: " + r.error);
    auto& eng = shared_engine();
    if (!eng.ok() && !eng.init()) fail("zydis engine init failed");
    json steps = json::array();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < r.steps.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& s = r.steps[i];
        json rec = {{"index", i}, {"lwpid", s.tid}, {"rip", s.rip}, {"rip_hex", addr_hex_str(s.rip)}};
        if (s.nbytes) {
            if (auto in = eng.decode(s.rip, s.bytes, s.nbytes)) rec["text"] = in->text;
        }
        steps.push_back(std::move(rec));
    }
    return {{"lwpid", tid}, {"steps", steps}, {"steps_count", steps.size()},
            {"stop_reason", r.stop_reason}, {"debugger", t.kind()}};
}

// ---- local (usermode test-lab) debugger actions ---------------------------
// The same engine-side breakpoint rules apply to a local test-lab process, so
// conditions, hit counts and log breakpoints are testable without a console.

bool local_debug_session() {
    if (runtime::registry_ps4()) return false;
    auto s = process::active_session();
    return s && s->valid() && s->backend()->kind() == runtime::backend_kind_t::user_mode;
}

dbg::local_debugger_t& need_local() {
    auto s = process::active_session();
    if (!s || !s->valid())
        fail("debugger: no local target attached (target.attach {pid})");
    auto& d = local_debugger();
    if (!d.attached() || d.pid() != s->pid()) {
        std::string err;
        if (!d.attach(s->pid(), err)) fail("debugger: local debugger attach failed: " + err);
    }
    return d;
}

json tool_ps4_trace(const std::string& action, const json& args);

json local_bp_list_json(const dbg::local_debugger_t& d) {
    json arr = json::array();
    for (const auto& s : d.breakpoints()) {
        json o = {{"addr", s.addr}, {"addr_hex", addr_hex_str(s.addr)},
                  {"index", s.index}, {"armed", true}};
        if (auto r = bp_rule_json(s.addr); r.is_object())
            for (auto& kv : r.items()) o[kv.key()] = kv.value();
        arr.push_back(std::move(o));
    }
    return arr;
}

// .pdata callstack over the local debugger's newest stop context
json local_callstack(const json& args) {
    auto& d = need_local();
    const uint32_t lwpid = args.contains("lwpid")
        ? static_cast<uint32_t>(parse_addr(args, "lwpid")) : 0;
    const size_t depth = std::min<size_t>(args.value("depth", 32u), 64u);
    runtime::thread_context_t ctx{};
    if (!d.last_stop_context(lwpid, ctx))
        fail("ps4_callstack: the local debuggee has no stop context yet (arm a breakpoint and wait)");

    auto s = process::active_session();
    std::vector<runtime::module_info_t> mods;
    if (s && s->valid()) {
        auto r = s->backend()->enum_modules(s->handle());
        if (r.ok) mods = std::move(r.items);
    }
    const auto module_of = [&mods](uint64_t addr, unwind::module_span_t& out) {
        for (const auto& m : mods) {
            const uint64_t base = static_cast<uint64_t>(m.base);
            if (addr >= base && addr < base + m.size) {
                out.base = base;
                out.size = m.size;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    };
    struct local_reader_t final : unwind::reader_t {
        dbg::local_debugger_t& d;
        explicit local_reader_t(dbg::local_debugger_t& x) : d(x) {}
        bool read(uint64_t addr, void* dst, size_t len) override {
            return d.read(addr, dst, len);
        }
    } rdr(d);

    std::vector<unwind::frame_t> frames;
    std::string note;
    const bool pdata = unwind::pe_unwind(rdr, ctx, depth, module_of, frames, &note);
    if (!pdata) {
        // no .pdata for the paused module: rbp chain, the old behaviour
        frames.clear();
        for (const auto& f : dbg::rbp_frames(d, ctx, depth)) {
            unwind::frame_t uf;
            uf.ret_addr = f.ret_addr;
            uf.frame_ptr = f.frame_ptr;
            frames.push_back(uf);
        }
    }
    json arr = json::array();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < frames.size(); ++i)
        arr.push_back({{"index", i}, {"ret_addr", frames[i].ret_addr},
                       {"ret_addr_hex", addr_hex_str(frames[i].ret_addr)},
                       {"frame_ptr", frames[i].frame_ptr}});
    json o = {{"lwpid", lwpid}, {"frames", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
              {"debugger", "user"}, {"unwind", pdata ? "pdata" : "rbp"}};
    if (!pdata) o["note"] = note;
    return o;
}

json tool_debugger_local(const std::string& action, const json& args) {
    auto& d = need_local();
    if (action == "ps4_bp_set") {
        const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        if (addr == 0) fail("ps4_bp_set: addr required");
        require_bp_owner(addr, args.value("force", false), "ps4_bp_set");
        uint32_t index = 0;
        bool reused = false;
        auto io = d.bp_arm(addr, index, reused);
        if (!io.ok) io_fail("ps4_bp_set failed", io);
        bp_rule_t rule = parse_bp_rule_args(args);
        g_bp_rules[addr] = rule;
        return {{"set", true}, {"addr", addr}, {"addr_hex", addr_hex_str(addr)},
                {"index", index}, {"hw", false}, {"already_armed", reused},
                {"condition", rule.has_condition ? json(rule.condition_text) : json(nullptr)},
                {"hits", rule.hits}, {"hit_mode", rule.hit_mode},
                {"log", rule.log}, {"log_continue", rule.log_continue},
                {"owner", rule.owner}, {"count", 0}, {"debugger", "user"}};
    }
    if (action == "ps4_bp_clear") {
        uint64_t addr = 0;
        uint32_t index = 0;
        runtime::io_result_t io;
        if (args.contains("addr")) {
            addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
            require_bp_owner(addr, args.value("force", false), "ps4_bp_clear");
            io = d.bp_disarm(addr);
        } else if (args.contains("index")) {
            index = static_cast<uint32_t>(parse_addr(args, "index"));
            for (const auto& s : d.breakpoints())
                if (s.index == index) addr = s.addr;
            if (addr == 0)
                fail("ps4_bp_clear: no local breakpoint in slot " + std::to_string(index));
            require_bp_owner(addr, args.value("force", false), "ps4_bp_clear");
            io = d.bp_disarm(addr);
        } else {
            fail("ps4_bp_clear requires addr or index");
        }
        if (!io.ok) io_fail("ps4_bp_clear failed", io);
        g_bp_rules.erase(addr);
        return {{"cleared", true}, {"addr", addr}, {"index", index}, {"debugger", "user"}};
    }
    if (action == "ps4_bp_list") {
        json arr = local_bp_list_json(d);
        return {{"breakpoints", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}, {"debugger", "user"},
                {"note", "client-side record; owner is the MCP session (or \"ui\") that "
                         "armed the slot"}};
    }
    if (action == "ps4_continue") {
        auto io = d.resume();
        if (!io.ok) io_fail("ps4_continue failed", io);
        return {{"continued", true}, {"stop", 0}, {"debugger", "user"}};
    }
    if (action == "ps4_step") {
        const uint32_t lwpid = args.contains("lwpid")
            ? static_cast<uint32_t>(parse_addr(args, "lwpid")) : 0;   // 0 = the held thread
        auto io = d.step(lwpid);
        if (!io.ok) io_fail("ps4_step failed", io);
        return {{"stepped", true}, {"lwpid", lwpid}, {"debugger", "user"}};
    }
    if (action == "ps4_wait") {
        const int timeout_ms = std::min(args.value("timeout_ms", 5000), 60000);
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
                              std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
        const bp_read_fn read = [&d](uint64_t a, void* dst, size_t n) {
            return d.read(a, dst, n);
        };
        int skipped = 0;
        for (;;) {
            const auto left = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                deadline - std::chrono::steady_clock::now()).count();
            if (left <= 0)
                return {{"halted", false}, {"timeout_ms", timeout_ms},
                        {"condition_skipped", skipped}, {"debugger", "user"}};
            dbg::stop_event_t ev;
            if (!d.wait_event(ev, static_cast<int>(left)))
                return {{"halted", false}, {"timeout_ms", timeout_ms},
                        {"condition_skipped", skipped}, {"debugger", "user"}};
            if (ev.reason == "exit") {
                json o = stop_json(ev);
                o["halted"] = true;
                o["process_exited"] = true;
                o["debugger"] = "user";
                return o;
            }
            const auto it = g_bp_rules.find(ev.ctx.rip);
            if (it != g_bp_rules.end()) {
                std::string line;
                const bool stop = bp_rule_hit(it->second, ev.ctx, read, line);
                emit_bp_log(line, ev.tid, ev.ctx.rip);
                if (!stop) {
                    if (++skipped > 64)
                        return {{"halted", false}, {"reason", "condition_skip_limit"},
                                {"condition_skipped", skipped}, {"debugger", "user"}};
                    if (!d.resume().ok)
                        return {{"halted", false}, {"reason", "resume_failed"},
                                {"condition_skipped", skipped}, {"debugger", "user"}};
                    continue;
                }
            }
            json o = stop_json(ev);
            o["halted"] = true;
            o["condition_skipped"] = skipped;
            o["debugger"] = "user";
            return o;
        }
    }
    if (action == "ps4_callstack") return local_callstack(args);
    if (action == "ps4_trace_start" || action == "ps4_trace_stop" ||
        action == "ps4_trace_status")
        return tool_ps4_trace(action, args);
    fail("debugger: " + action + " needs a connected console (target.ps4_connect)");
}

bool is_local_action(const std::string& action) {
    return action == "ps4_bp_set" || action == "ps4_bp_clear" || action == "ps4_bp_list" ||
           action == "ps4_continue" || action == "ps4_step" || action == "ps4_wait" ||
           action == "ps4_callstack" || action == "ps4_trace_start" ||
           action == "ps4_trace_stop" || action == "ps4_trace_status";
}

// ---- continuous trace (ring buffer in memory, flushed as JSONL) -----------

struct trace_session_t {
    std::mutex mu;
    std::thread th;
    std::atomic<bool> running{false};
    std::atomic<bool> stop{false};
    std::string mode, path, stop_reason, error;
    size_t ring_size = 4096;
    std::deque<json> ring;
    uint64_t total = 0, dropped = 0;
    int64_t started_ms = 0;
    uint32_t lwpid = 0;
    uint64_t addr = 0;
    size_t limit = 0;
    bool flushed = false;
};

struct trace_holder_t {
    trace_session_t s;
    ~trace_holder_t() {
        s.stop = true;
        if (s.th.joinable()) s.th.join();
    }
};

trace_session_t& trace_sess() {
    static trace_holder_t h;
    return h.s;
}

void trace_record(trace_session_t& ts, json rec) {
    std::lock_guard lk(ts.mu);
    if (ts.ring.size() >= ts.ring_size) {
        ts.ring.pop_front();
        ++ts.dropped;
    }
    ts.ring.push_back(std::move(rec));
    ++ts.total;
}

bool trace_flush(trace_session_t& ts) {
    std::deque<json> recs;
    std::string path;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(ts.mu);
        recs = ts.ring;
        path = ts.path;
    }
    std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!out) {
        std::lock_guard lk(ts.mu);
        ts.error = "cannot create " + path;
        return false;
    }
    for (const auto& r : recs) out << r.dump() << '\n';
    if (!out) {
        std::lock_guard lk(ts.mu);
        ts.error = "write failed: " + path;
        return false;
    }
    std::lock_guard lk(ts.mu);
    ts.flushed = true;
    return true;
}

void trace_run(trace_session_t& ts, std::unique_ptr<picked_target_t> pk, std::string mode,
               uint32_t lwpid, uint64_t addr, size_t limit, int timeout_ms) {
    auto& t = *pk->t;
    const int64_t started = infra::steady_ms();
    std::string reason = "stopped";
    std::string err;
    size_t produced = 0;
    // short waits keep ps4_trace_stop responsive (it joins this thread)
    const int poll_ms = std::min(timeout_ms, 1000);
    const auto gate = [] { return std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex>(runtime::broker_gate()); };
    try {
        if (mode == "steps") {
            while (!ts.stop.load()) {
                if (limit != 0 && produced >= limit) { reason = "count_reached"; break; }
                runtime::io_result_t io;
                { auto g = gate(); io = t.step(lwpid); }
                if (!io.ok) {
                    reason = "step_failed";
                    err = runtime::ps4::io_error_str(io.error);
                    break;
                }
                dbg::stop_event_t ev;
                bool got = false;
                { auto g = gate(); got = t.wait_event(ev, poll_ms); }
                if (!got) { reason = "timeout"; break; }
                if (ev.reason == "exit") { reason = "process_exited"; break; }
                if (lwpid == 0) lwpid = ev.tid;
                trace_record(ts, {{"seq", produced},
                                  {"ms", infra::steady_ms() - started},
                                  {"lwpid", ev.tid},
                                  {"rip", ev.ctx.rip},
                                  {"rip_hex", addr_hex_str(ev.ctx.rip)},
                                  {"reason", ev.reason}});
                ++produced;
            }
        } else {
            uint32_t index = 0;
            bool reused = false;
            runtime::io_result_t io;
            { auto g = gate(); io = t.bp_arm(addr, index, reused); }
            if (!io.ok) {
                reason = "arm_failed";
                err = runtime::ps4::io_error_str(io.error);
            } else {
                { auto g = gate(); if (t.stopped()) t.resume(); }
                while (!ts.stop.load()) {
                    if (limit != 0 && produced >= limit) { reason = "count_reached"; break; }
                    dbg::stop_event_t ev;
                    bool got = false;
                    { auto g = gate(); got = t.wait_event(ev, poll_ms); }
                    if (!got) { reason = "timeout"; break; }
                    if (ev.reason == "exit") { reason = "process_exited"; break; }
                    if (dbg::stop_at(ev, addr)) {
                        trace_record(ts, {{"seq", produced},
                                          {"ms", infra::steady_ms() - started},
                                          {"lwpid", ev.tid},
```
