```cpp
                for (size_t k = 0; k < blen && !referenced; k += 8)
                    referenced = !xidx->refs_to(bva + k).empty();
                if (!referenced && hdb) {
                    for (size_t k = 0; k < blen && !referenced; k += 8)
                        referenced = hdb->xrefs_to.count(bva + k) != 0;
                }
                if (!referenced) continue;
                for (const auto& c : disasm::decode_candidates(bp, blen, 4)) {
                    decoded.push_back({{"va", bva}, {"scheme", c.scheme},
                                       {"text", c.text}, {"score", c.score}});
                    if (decoded.size() >= limit) break;
                }
                if (decoded.size() >= limit) break;
            }
        }
        json out = {{"image", img_name}, {"strings", arr},
                    {"total_scanned", stats.scanned}, {"truncated", stats.truncated}};
        if (decode) {
            out["decoded"] = decoded;
            out["decoded_count"] = decoded.size();
        }
        return out;
    }

    // hyperion backed actions, shared session only
    // these read the analyzer db which only exists for the app loaded image

    if (action == "blocks" || action == "globals" || action == "vtables") {
        if (have_path)
            fail(action + " requires the app-loaded image (no 'path' support, "
                 "load the binary in reverse-slop first)");
        // the lock above still guards the session
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.hype) fail("hyperion engine unavailable for this image");
        if (!bin.hype->ready()) {
            const std::string herr = bin.hype->error();
            if (!herr.empty())
                fail("hyperion analysis not running, " + herr +
                     " (re-run disasm.load to restart)");
            fail("hyperion analysis in progress (" +
                 std::to_string(static_cast<int>(bin.hype->progress() * 100)) +
                 "%), retry shortly");
        }
        const auto& db = bin.hype->db();

        if (action == "blocks") {
            const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
            const hype::Function* f = bin.hype->function_at(addr);
            if (!f) fail("no hyperion function contains address " + hex64(addr));
            json arr = json::array();
            // Graph shape for the UI canvas: nodes carry the address range and
            // an instruction summary, edges the successor kind
            // (fallthrough when the target is the block's own end, else branch)
            json nodes = json::array(), edges = json::array();
            for (const auto& [start, bb] : f->blocks) {
                json succs = json::array(), preds = json::array();
                for (auto s : bb.succs) succs.push_back(s);
                for (auto p : bb.preds) preds.push_back(p);
                arr.push_back({{"start", start}, {"end", bb.end},
                               {"size", bb.end - start},
                               {"insn_count", bb.insns.size()},
                               {"succs", succs}, {"preds", preds}});
                std::string summary;
                if (!bb.insns.empty()) {
                    const auto& first = bb.insns.front();
                    summary = first.mnemonic;
                    if (first.op_str[0]) summary += std::string(" ") + first.op_str;
                    if (bb.insns.size() > 1)
                        summary += " ... (" + std::to_string(bb.insns.size()) + " insns)";
                }
                nodes.push_back({{"id", start}, {"start", start}, {"end", bb.end},
                                 {"size", bb.end - start},
                                 {"insn_count", bb.insns.size()},
                                 {"summary", summary}});
                for (auto s : bb.succs)
                    edges.push_back({{"from", start}, {"to", s},
                                     {"kind", s == bb.end ? "fallthrough" : "branch"}});
            }
            json loops = json::array();
            for (const auto& lp : f->loops)
                loops.push_back({{"header", lp.header},
                                 {"back_edge_src", lp.back_edge_src}});
            return {{"ok", true}, {"entry", f->entry},
                    {"name", bin.hype->db().names.count(f->entry)
                                  ? bin.hype->db().names.at(f->entry)
                                  : disasm::default_function_name(f->entry)},
                    {"blocks", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
                    {"graph", {{"nodes", nodes}, {"edges", edges}}},
                    {"loops", loops}};
        }

        if (action == "vtables") {
            const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 500u), 10000u);
            json arr = json::array();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < db.vtables.size() && arr.size() < limit; ++i) {
                const auto& vt = db.vtables[i];
                json entries = json::array();
                for (auto e : vt.entries) entries.push_back(e);
                arr.push_back({{"va", vt.addr}, {"entries", entries},
                               {"count", vt.entries.size()}});
            }
            json out = {{"ok", true}, {"vtables", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
                        {"total", db.vtables.size()}};
            if (db.vtables.size() > arr.size()) out["truncated"] = true;
            return out;
        }

        // globals
        {
            const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 500u), 10000u);
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& [va, g] : db.globals) {
                if (arr.size() >= limit) break;
                arr.push_back({{"va", va}, {"size", g.size}, {"name", g.name}});
            }
            json out = {{"ok", true}, {"globals", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
                        {"total", db.globals.size()}};
            if (db.globals.size() > arr.size()) out["truncated"] = true;
            return out;
        }
    }

    fail("disasm: unknown action (assemble|disassemble|loaded|pe|functions|"
         "xrefs|strings|symbols|symbol_set|blocks|globals|vtables|load|load_self|"
         "unload|analyze_stop|managed)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail

```

`src/core/mcp/tools_emulate.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_emulate.cpp
// tool: emulate (unicorn emulation over the loaded image / target)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include "core/analysis/ps4_syscalls.hpp"

#include <memory>
#include <mutex>

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

struct image_view_t {
    struct reloc_t { uint32_t rva = 0; uint8_t width = 0; };   // width 4 | 8

    uint64_t hash   = 0;
    uint64_t extent = 0;            // SizeOfImage, or the section span
    uint64_t delta  = 0;            // session base - ImageBase, mod 2^64
    std::vector<reloc_t> relocs;    // sorted by rva, empty when not rebased

    // Raw mapped bytes for [rva, rva + len), no relocation. Caller holds
    // the state mutex
    static void copy_mapped(const ds::binary_t& bin, uint64_t rva, size_t len, uint8_t* out) {
        std::memset(out, 0, len);
        const uint64_t end = rva + len;
        if (bin.format == disasm::image_format_t::pe) {
            uint64_t headers = emu::kPageSize;
            for (const auto& s : bin.pe.sections)
                if (s.raw_size) headers = std::min<uint64_t>(headers, s.raw_offset);
            headers = std::min<uint64_t>(headers, bin.file.size());
            if (rva < headers)
                std::memcpy(out, bin.file.data() + rva,
                            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(end, headers) - rva));
        }
        for (const auto& s : bin.pe.sections) {
            // file bytes past VirtualSize are not mapped by the loader
            const uint64_t backed = std::min<uint64_t>(
                s.virtual_size ? s.virtual_size : s.raw_size, s.raw_size);
            const uint64_t lo = std::max<uint64_t>(rva, s.rva);
            const uint64_t hi = std::min<uint64_t>(end, s.rva + backed);
            if (lo >= hi) continue;
            const uint64_t off = uint64_t{s.raw_offset} + (lo - s.rva);
            if (off >= bin.file.size()) continue;
            const uint64_t n = std::min<uint64_t>(hi - lo, bin.file.size() - off);
            std::memcpy(out + (lo - rva), bin.file.data() + off, static_cast<size_t>(n));
        }
    }

    // Caller holds the state mutex
    static std::shared_ptr<const image_view_t> make(const ds::binary_t& bin) {
        auto v = std::make_shared<image_view_t>();
        v->hash   = bin.file_hash;
        v->extent = bin.pe.size_of_image;
        if (!v->extent)
            for (const auto& s : bin.pe.sections)
                v->extent = std::max<uint64_t>(
                    v->extent, uint64_t{s.rva} + (s.virtual_size ? s.virtual_size : s.raw_size));
        v->delta = bin.base - bin.pe.image_base;

        // IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC: blocks of {page rva, size, u16
        // entries}, type in the top 4 bits (3 HIGHLOW, 10 DIR64)
        const auto& dir = bin.pe.data_dirs[5];
        if (v->delta == 0 || bin.format != disasm::image_format_t::pe ||
            !dir.rva || !dir.size || dir.size > (64u << 20))
            return v;
        std::vector<uint8_t> raw(dir.size);
        copy_mapped(bin, dir.rva, raw.size(), raw.data());
        for (size_t pos = 0; pos + 8 <= raw.size();) {
            uint32_t page = 0, block = 0;
            std::memcpy(&page, raw.data() + pos, 4);
            std::memcpy(&block, raw.data() + pos + 4, 4);
            if (block < 8 || block > raw.size() - pos) break;
            for (size_t e = pos + 8; e + 2 <= pos + block; e += 2) {
                uint16_t entry = 0;
                std::memcpy(&entry, raw.data() + e, 2);
                const uint32_t at = page + (entry & 0xFFFu);
                if ((entry >> 12) == 10)     v->relocs.push_back({at, 8});
                else if ((entry >> 12) == 3) v->relocs.push_back({at, 4});
            }
            pos += block;
        }
        std::sort(v->relocs.begin(), v->relocs.end(),
                  [](const reloc_t& a, const reloc_t& b) { return a.rva < b.rva; });
        return v;
    }

    // Relocated mapped bytes for [rva, rva + len). Caller holds the state mutex
    void read(const ds::binary_t& bin, uint64_t rva, size_t len, uint8_t* out) const {
        copy_mapped(bin, rva, len, out);
        if (relocs.empty()) return;
        // a fixup starting up to 7 bytes before the range still reaches into it
        const uint64_t from = rva >= 7 ? rva - 7 : 0;
        auto it = std::lower_bound(relocs.begin(), relocs.end(), from,
                                   [](const reloc_t& r, uint64_t a) { return r.rva < a; });
        for (; it != relocs.end() && it->rva < rva + len; ++it) {
            uint8_t v[8] = {};
            copy_mapped(bin, it->rva, it->width, v);
            if (it->width == 8) {
                uint64_t x = 0;
                std::memcpy(&x, v, 8);
                x += delta;
                std::memcpy(v, &x, 8);
            } else {
                uint32_t x = 0;
                std::memcpy(&x, v, 4);
                x += static_cast<uint32_t>(delta);
                std::memcpy(v, &x, 4);
            }
            for (uint8_t i = 0; i < it->width; ++i) {
                const uint64_t at = uint64_t{it->rva} + i;
                if (at >= rva && at < rva + len) out[at - rva] = v[i];
            }
        }
    }
};

// Demand pages over the shared image. The run is off every tool lock, so
// each page is copied under the state mutex and the source goes dry once
// another image replaces this one

emu::page_source_t image_page_source(std::shared_ptr<const image_view_t> view) {
    return [view = std::move(view)](uint64_t page, uint8_t* out) {
        std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
        const auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready || bin.file_hash != view->hash || page < bin.base) return false;
        const uint64_t rva = page - bin.base;
        if (rva >= view->extent) return false;
        view->read(bin, rva, emu::kPageSize, out);
        return true;
    };
}

// api_returns values: integers (negative allowed, -1 = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
// or numeric strings
uint64_t parse_api_value(const json& v, const std::string& key) {
    if (v.is_number_integer() && v.get<int64_t>() < 0)
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(v.get<int64_t>());
    const json wrap = {{key, v}};
    return parse_addr(wrap, key.c_str());
}

std::string lower_ascii(std::string s) {
    for (char& ch : s) ch = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
    return s;
}

// IAT slots of a PE32+ image, or the GOT / pointer slots the ELF and Mach-O
// loaders report for their imports; the stub mechanism is format agnostic
// and works for x86-64 and arm64 (the stub RET is arch specific)
std::vector<emu::import_slot_t> image_import_slots(const ds::binary_t& bin,
                                                   std::map<std::string, uint64_t>& returns) {
    std::vector<emu::import_slot_t> out;
    if (bin.arch != disasm::image_arch_t::x64 && bin.arch != disasm::image_arch_t::arm64)
        return out;
    std::vector<std::string> used;
    for (const auto& dll : bin.pe.imports) {
        for (const auto& fn : dll.functions) {
            if (!fn.iat_rva) continue;
            if (out.size() >= emu::kMaxImports) break;
            emu::import_slot_t slot;
            slot.slot = bin.base + fn.iat_rva;
            const std::string func = fn.by_ordinal ? "#" + std::to_string(fn.ordinal) : fn.name;
            slot.name = dll.dll + "!" + func;
            for (const std::string& key : {lower_ascii(slot.name), lower_ascii(func)}) {
                if (auto it = returns.find(key); it != returns.end()) {
                    slot.has_ret = true;
                    slot.ret = it->second;
                    used.push_back(key);
                    break;
                }
            }
            out.push_back(std::move(slot));
        }
    }
    for (const auto& key : used) returns.erase(key);
    return out;
}

// "x64" | "x86_64" | "amd64" | "arm64" | "aarch64"; nullopt means derive
std::optional<emu::arch_t> requested_arch(const json& args) {
    const auto it = args.find("arch");
    if (it == args.end() || it->is_null()) return std::nullopt;
    if (!it->is_string()) fail("arch must be \"x64\" or \"arm64\"");
    const std::string a = lower_ascii(it->get<std::string>());
    if (a == "x64" || a == "x86_64" || a == "amd64") return emu::arch_t::x86_64;
    if (a == "arm64" || a == "aarch64") return emu::arch_t::arm64;
    fail("arch must be \"x64\" or \"arm64\"");
}

void require_image_arch(const ds::binary_t& bin, emu::arch_t arch) {
    const auto want = arch == emu::arch_t::arm64 ? disasm::image_arch_t::arm64
                                                 : disasm::image_arch_t::x64;
    if (bin.arch == want) return;
    fail(std::string("emulate executes ") +
         (arch == emu::arch_t::arm64 ? "arm64" : "x86-64") +
         " code only; the loaded image is " + disasm::image_arch_name(bin.arch) +
         " (" + disasm::image_format_name(bin.format) + ")");
}

void require_x64_target(runtime::session_t& s) {
    // a ps4 console is always x86-64 (AMD Jaguar)
    if (runtime::active_kind() == runtime::backend_kind_t::ps4) return;
    runtime::arch_t a = s.arch();
    if (a == runtime::arch_t::unknown) a = runtime::active().query_arch(s.handle());
    if (a == runtime::arch_t::x64) return;
    fail(std::string("emulate.run executes x86-64 code only; the attached target is ") +
         (a == runtime::arch_t::x86 ? "a 32-bit x86 process" : "of unknown architecture"));
}

bool is_sysv_format(disasm::image_format_t f) {
    return f == disasm::image_format_t::elf || f == disasm::image_format_t::self ||
           f == disasm::image_format_t::macho;
}

// PS4 environments name their syscalls from the Orbis table; Mach-O is SysV
// too but its syscall numbers are Darwin's
bool is_ps4_format(disasm::image_format_t f) {
    return f == disasm::image_format_t::elf || f == disasm::image_format_t::self;
}

// "auto" | "win64" | "sysv"; nullopt means auto
std::optional<emu::abi_t> requested_abi(const json& args) {
    const auto it = args.find("abi");
    if (it == args.end() || it->is_null()) return std::nullopt;
    if (!it->is_string()) fail("abi must be \"auto\", \"win64\" or \"sysv\"");
    const std::string a = lower_ascii(it->get<std::string>());
    if (a == "auto") return std::nullopt;
    if (a == "win64" || a == "windows" || a == "ms") return emu::abi_t::win64;
    if (a == "sysv" || a == "systemv" || a == "freebsd" || a == "ps4") return emu::abi_t::sysv;
    fail("abi must be \"auto\", \"win64\" or \"sysv\"");
}

// syscall_returns keys: a number (decimal or 0x hex) or a PS4 syscall name
// (with or without the sys_ prefix)
uint64_t syscall_number_key(const std::string& key) {
    if (!key.empty() && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(key[0]))) {
        char* end = nullptr;
        const uint64_t n = std::strtoull(key.c_str(), &end, 0);
        if (end && *end == '\0') return n;
    }
    std::string name = lower_ascii(key);
    if (name.rfind("sys_", 0) == 0) name.erase(0, 4);
    for (uint64_t n = 0; n < 4096; ++n) {
        const char* s = analysis::ps4_syscall_name(n);
        if (s && name == s) return n;
    }
    fail("syscall_returns: '" + key + "' is neither a number nor a PS4 syscall name");
}

const char* abi_label(const emu::run_request_t& req) {
    return req.arch == emu::arch_t::arm64 ? "aapcs64" : emu::abi_name(req.abi);
}

// === request building ======================================================
// Shared by emulate.run and emulate.session_create: everything that reads the
// shared image or the attached target happens under g_tool_mu, the run itself
// never does

struct parsed_request_t {
    emu::run_request_t req;
    bool ps4_env = false;
    std::vector<std::string> unmatched_api_returns;
};

parsed_request_t build_request(const json& args, infra::cancel_token_t cancel) {
    // Input bounds: these all run before unicorn's timer starts (stack commit,
    // per-byte taint marking, trace growth), so an unbounded value hangs the
    // request regardless of timeout_ms
    constexpr size_t   kMaxStackSize = 64u << 20;
    constexpr size_t   kMaxTaintLen  = 1u << 20;
    constexpr size_t   kMaxTraceMax  = 16384;
    constexpr size_t   kMaxDumpLen   = 1u << 20;

    parsed_request_t out;
    emu::run_request_t& req = out.req;
    req.cancel = cancel;
    const bool page_in = args.value("page_in", true);

    // lowercase "func" or "dll!func" -> that import's stub return value
    std::map<std::string, uint64_t> api_returns;
    if (auto it = args.find("api_returns"); it != args.end()) {
        if (!it->is_object()) fail("api_returns must be an object of import name -> value");
        for (auto r = it->begin(); r != it->end(); ++r)
            api_returns[lower_ascii(r.key())] = parse_api_value(r.value(), r.key());
    }

    // Building the request reads the shared image / attached session, so it
    // runs under g_tool_mu. The run itself owns a private unicorn instance and
    // must not hold it, or every other tool (and initialize) queues behind the
    // emulation until the client times out
    std::unique_lock tool_lk(g_tool_mu);

    const auto abi_req = requested_abi(args);
    const auto arch_req = requested_arch(args);
    emu::arch_t arch = arch_req.value_or(emu::arch_t::x86_64);
    emu::abi_t auto_abi = emu::abi_t::win64;
    bool ps4_env = false;   // name syscalls from the Orbis table

    // hex wins over file_addr wins over target_addr, code runs at its real va unless base says otherwise
    bool have_code = false;
    if (args.contains("hex") && args.at("hex").is_string()) {
        // raw bytes carry no architecture of their own; x64 unless arch says otherwise
        req.code = hex_decode(args.at("hex").get<std::string>());
        have_code = !req.code.empty();
        if (have_code && arch == emu::arch_t::x86_64) {
            // a console session or a loaded PS4/ELF image means PS4 code
            if (runtime::active_kind() == runtime::backend_kind_t::ps4) {
                auto_abi = emu::abi_t::sysv;
                ps4_env = true;
            } else {
                std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
                const auto& bin = ds::get();
                if (bin.ready && is_sysv_format(bin.format)) {
                    auto_abi = emu::abi_t::sysv;
                    ps4_env = is_ps4_format(bin.format);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (!have_code && args.contains("file_addr")) {
        std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready) fail("no image loaded in reverse-slop (see disasm.loaded)");
        if (arch_req) arch = *arch_req;
        else arch = bin.arch == disasm::image_arch_t::arm64 ? emu::arch_t::arm64
                                                           : emu::arch_t::x86_64;
        require_image_arch(bin, arch);
        const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "file_addr");
        uint64_t len = args.contains("code_len") ? parse_addr(args, "code_len") : 64;
        if (len == 0 || len > (1ull << 20)) fail("bad code_len");
        auto off = bin.offset_of(addr);   // session va, follows a rebased load
        if (!off) fail("file_addr not mapped in the loaded image");
        len = std::min<uint64_t>(len, bin.file.size() - *off);
        // relocated like the demand pages, or a rebased slice keeps
        // ImageBase pointers the pages around it no longer have
        auto view = image_view_t::make(bin);
        req.code.resize(static_cast<size_t>(len));
        view->read(bin, addr - bin.base, req.code.size(), req.code.data());
        req.code_base  = addr;
        req.image_base = bin.base;
        if (arch == emu::arch_t::x86_64 && is_sysv_format(bin.format))
            auto_abi = emu::abi_t::sysv;
        ps4_env = arch == emu::arch_t::x86_64 && is_ps4_format(bin.format);
        if (page_in) req.page_in = image_page_source(std::move(view));
        if (args.value("stub_imports", true))
            req.imports = image_import_slots(bin, api_returns);
        have_code = true;
    }
    if (!have_code && args.contains("target_addr")) {
        auto s = process::active_session();
        if (!s || !s->valid()) fail("no target attached for target_addr");
        require_x64_target(*s);
        if (arch_req && *arch_req != emu::arch_t::x86_64)
            fail("emulate can only read x86-64 code from an attached target");
        arch = emu::arch_t::x86_64;
        if (runtime::active_kind() == runtime::backend_kind_t::ps4) {
            auto_abi = emu::abi_t::sysv;
            ps4_env = true;
        }
        const uint64_t addr = parse_addr(args, "target_addr");
        uint64_t len = args.contains("code_len") ? parse_addr(args, "code_len") : 64;
        if (len == 0 || len > (1ull << 20)) fail("bad code_len");
        req.code.resize(static_cast<size_t>(len));
        auto io = s->read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), req.code.data(),
                          req.code.size());
        if (!io.ok || io.bytes == 0) fail("cannot read target memory");
        req.code.resize(io.bytes);
        req.code_base = addr;
        if (page_in) {
            req.page_in = [s](uint64_t page, uint8_t* out) {
                if (!s->valid()) return false;
                auto rd = s->read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(page), out, emu::kPageSize);
                return rd.ok && rd.bytes == emu::kPageSize;
            };
        }
        have_code = true;
    }
    if (!have_code)
        fail("no code source: pass 'hex', 'file_addr' or 'target_addr'");

    req.arch = arch;
    req.abi = abi_req.value_or(auto_abi);
    if (req.arch == emu::arch_t::x86_64 && req.abi == emu::abi_t::sysv && (ps4_env || abi_req)) {
        // an explicit sysv run on a non-Mach-O source is treated as PS4 code
        const bool macho_image = [&] {
            if (!args.contains("file_addr") || args.contains("hex")) return false;
            std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
            return ds::get().ready && ds::get().format == disasm::image_format_t::macho;
        }();
        if (!macho_image) req.syscall_name = analysis::ps4_syscall_name;
    }
    out.ps4_env = ps4_env;

    if (args.contains("base")) req.code_base = parse_addr(args, "base");
    const uint64_t start_va = args.contains("entry")
        ? parse_addr(args, "entry")
        : req.code_base;
    if (start_va < req.code_base || start_va >= req.code_base + req.code.size())
        fail("entry outside code range");
    req.entry_absolute = true;
    req.entry          = start_va;

    if (args.contains("stack_base")) req.stack_base = parse_addr(args, "stack_base");
    if (args.contains("stack_size")) {
        const uint64_t ss = parse_addr(args, "stack_size");
        if (ss < 0x1000 || ss > kMaxStackSize)
            fail("stack_size must be 0x1000..0x4000000 (64 MiB)");
        req.stack_size = static_cast<size_t>(ss);
    }
    if (args.contains("sp")) { req.sp_set = true; req.sp = parse_addr(args, "sp"); }

    if (auto it = args.find("regs"); it != args.end() && it->is_object()) {
        for (auto r = it->begin(); r != it->end(); ++r) {
            const json& v = r.value();
            uint64_t value = 0;
            if (v.is_number_unsigned()) value = v.get<uint64_t>();
            else if (v.is_number_integer() && v.get<int64_t>() >= 0) value = static_cast<uint64_t>(v.get<int64_t>());
            else if (v.is_string()) value = std::stoull(v.get<std::string>(), nullptr, 0);
            else fail("regs values must be non-negative integers or hex strings");
            req.regs[r.key()] = value;
        }
    }

    if (auto it = args.find("maps"); it != args.end() && it->is_array()) {
        for (const auto& m : *it) {
            if (!m.contains("addr") || !m.contains("hex"))
                fail("maps entries need addr + hex");
            emu::emu_mem_region_t reg;
            reg.addr = parse_addr(m, "addr");
            reg.bytes = hex_decode(m.at("hex").is_string()
                                       ? m.at("hex").get<std::string>()
                                       : std::string{});
            if (reg.bytes.empty()) fail("empty map region");
            req.maps.push_back(std::move(reg));
        }
    }

    if (args.contains("until"))       req.until_addr       = parse_addr(args, "until");
    if (args.contains("count"))       req.max_instructions = parse_addr(args, "count");
    if (args.contains("timeout_ms"))
        req.timeout_ms = static_cast<uint32_t>(
            std::min<uint64_t>(parse_addr(args, "timeout_ms"), emu::kMaxTimeoutMs));
    if (args.contains("trace"))       req.trace            = args.value("trace", false);
    if (args.contains("trace_max"))
        req.trace_max = static_cast<size_t>(
            std::min<uint64_t>(parse_addr(args, "trace_max"), kMaxTraceMax));
    // a trace is the raw material of a backward slice, so record the bytes and
    // the memory reads with it; record_slice forces the trace on
    if (args.contains("record_slice") && args.value("record_slice", false)) {
        req.record_slice = true;
        req.trace = true;
    } else if (req.trace) {
        req.record_slice = true;
    }

    if (auto it = args.find("taint"); it != args.end() && it->is_array()) {
        uint64_t taint_total = 0;
        for (const auto& t : *it) {
            if (!t.contains("addr") || !t.contains("len"))
                fail("taint entries need addr + len");
            emu::run_request_t::taint_source_t s;
            s.addr = parse_addr(t, "addr");
            const uint64_t len = parse_addr(t, "len");
            if (len == 0) fail("taint len must be > 0");
            taint_total += len;
            if (len > kMaxTaintLen || taint_total > kMaxTaintLen)
                fail("taint ranges must total <= 1048576 bytes");
            s.len = static_cast<size_t>(len);
            req.taint_sources.push_back(s);
        }
    }
    if (args.contains("watch_addr") && args.contains("watch_len")) {
        req.watch_addr = parse_addr(args, "watch_addr");
        req.watch_len  = static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr(args, "watch_len"));
        if (req.watch_len > kMaxTaintLen) fail("watch_len must be <= 1048576");
    }
    if (auto it = args.find("dump"); it != args.end() && it->is_array()) {
        uint64_t dump_total = 0;
        for (const auto& d : *it) {
            if (!d.contains("addr") || !d.contains("len"))
                fail("dump entries need addr + len");
            emu::run_request_t::dump_range_t r;
            r.addr = parse_addr(d, "addr");
            const uint64_t len = parse_addr(d, "len");
            if (len == 0) fail("dump len must be > 0");
            dump_total += len;
            if (len > kMaxDumpLen || dump_total > kMaxDumpLen)
                fail("dump ranges must total <= 1048576 bytes");
            r.len = static_cast<size_t>(len);
            req.dumps.push_back(r);
        }
    }
    if (args.contains("api_ret")) req.api_ret = parse_api_value(args.at("api_ret"), "api_ret");
    if (args.contains("syscall_ret"))
        req.syscall_ret = parse_api_value(args.at("syscall_ret"), "syscall_ret");
    if (auto it = args.find("syscall_returns"); it != args.end()) {
        if (!it->is_object())
            fail("syscall_returns must be an object of syscall number or name -> value");
        for (auto r = it->begin(); r != it->end(); ++r)
            req.syscall_returns[syscall_number_key(r.key())] = parse_api_value(r.value(), r.key());
    }
    // Orbis syscall emulation is opt-in: it serves the numbers that have no
    // explicit syscall_returns entry, so a fixed return still wins
    if (args.value("orbis_syscalls", false)) {
        if (req.arch != emu::arch_t::x86_64)
            fail("orbis_syscalls are x86-64 only");
        req.orbis_syscalls = true;
        if (args.contains("pid")) req.orbis.pid = parse_addr(args, "pid");
    }
    for (const auto& [key, value] : api_returns) out.unmatched_api_returns.push_back(key);
    return out;
}

// === trace store (for emulate.slice) ======================================

struct trace_store_t {
    std::mutex mu;
    std::map<uint64_t, emu::run_result_t> entries;
    uint64_t next = 1;
};

trace_store_t& trace_store() {
    static trace_store_t s;
    return s;
}

uint64_t store_trace(emu::run_result_t run) {
    auto& s = trace_store();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    constexpr size_t kMaxTraces = 8;
    while (s.entries.size() >= kMaxTraces) s.entries.erase(s.entries.begin());
    const uint64_t id = s.next++;
    s.entries.emplace(id, std::move(run));
    return id;
}

// === persistent session store =============================================

struct session_store_t {
    std::mutex mu;
    std::map<uint64_t, std::shared_ptr<emu::emulation_session_t>> entries;
    uint64_t next = 1;
};

session_store_t& session_store() {
    static session_store_t s;
    return s;
}

constexpr size_t kMaxSessions = 8;

json regs_json(const std::map<std::string, uint64_t>& regs) {
    json out = json::object();
    for (const auto& [name, value] : regs) out[name] = value;
    return out;
}

json session_state_json(const emu::emulation_session_t& session) {
    const auto& r = session.state();
    json out = {{"ok", true},
                {"arch", emu::arch_name(session.arch())},
                {"instructions", r.instructions},
                {"regs", regs_json(r.regs)},
                {"snapshots", session.snapshot_count()}};
    if (!r.stopped_reason.empty()) out["stopped_reason"] = r.stopped_reason;
    if (!r.stdout_data.empty())
        out["stdout"] = std::string(r.stdout_data.begin(), r.stdout_data.end());
    if (r.syscall_enosys) out["syscall_enosys"] = r.syscall_enosys;
    if (r.exited) {
        out["exited"] = true;
        out["exit_code"] = r.exit_code;
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace

json tool_emulate(const json& args, infra::cancel_token_t cancel) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    // === run =================================================================
    if (action == "run") {
        auto parsed = build_request(args, cancel);
        const emu::run_request_t& req = parsed.req;

        auto r = emu::emulate_run(req);
        if (!r.ok && !r.error.empty()) fail(r.error);

        json out = {{"ok", r.ok},
                    {"stopped_reason", r.stopped_reason},
                    {"instructions", r.instructions},
                    {"arch", emu::arch_name(req.arch)},
                    {"abi", abi_label(req)}};
        if (r.teb_mapped) out["teb_mapped"] = true;
        if (r.tls_mapped) out["tls_mapped"] = true;
        if (!r.error.empty()) out["error"] = r.error;

        out["regs"] = regs_json(r.regs);

        if (!r.trace.empty()) {
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& t : r.trace)
                arr.push_back({{"ip", t.ip}, {"text", t.text}});
            out["trace"] = arr;
        }
        {
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& w : r.writes) {
                json e = {{"ip", w.ip}, {"addr", w.addr}, {"len", w.len}, {"value", w.value}};
                if (w.truncated) e["truncated"] = true;
                arr.push_back(std::move(e));
            }
            out["writes"] = arr;
            out["total_writes"] = r.total_writes;
        }
        if (!req.imports.empty()) {
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& c : r.api_calls) {
                json a = json::array();
                for (uint8_t i = 0; i < c.arg_count; ++i) a.push_back(c.args[i]);
                arr.push_back({{"ip", c.ip}, {"ret", c.ret}, {"name", c.name}, {"args", std::move(a)}});
            }
            out["api_calls"]       = arr;
            out["total_api_calls"] = r.total_api_calls;
        }
        if (r.total_syscalls) {
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& sc : r.syscalls) {
                json e = {{"ip", sc.ip}, {"num", sc.num}, {"ret", sc.ret},
                          {"args", json::array({sc.args[0], sc.args[1], sc.args[2],
                                                sc.args[3], sc.args[4], sc.args[5]})}};
                if (!sc.name.empty()) e["name"] = sc.name;
                if (sc.enosys) e["enosys"] = true;
                arr.push_back(std::move(e));
            }
            out["syscalls"]       = arr;
            out["total_syscalls"] = r.total_syscalls;
        }
        if (req.orbis_syscalls) {
            if (!r.stdout_data.empty())
                out["stdout"] = std::string(r.stdout_data.begin(), r.stdout_data.end());
            out["syscall_enosys"] = r.syscall_enosys;
            if (r.exited) {
                out["exited"] = true;
                out["exit_code"] = r.exit_code;
            }
        }
        if (!parsed.unmatched_api_returns.empty()) {
            json keys = json::array();
            for (const auto& key : parsed.unmatched_api_returns) keys.push_back(key);
            out["api_returns_unmatched"] = keys;
        }
        if (req.page_in) out["paged_in"] = r.paged_in;
        if (!req.dumps.empty()) {
            json arr = json::array();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < r.memory.size(); ++i) {
                const auto& m = r.memory[i];
                arr.push_back({{"addr", m.addr}, {"len", m.bytes.size()},
                               {"requested", req.dumps[i].len},
                               {"hex", to_hex(m.bytes.data(), m.bytes.size())}});
            }
            out["memory"] = arr;
        }
        if (r.fault) {
            out["fault"] = {{"ip", r.fault->ip}, {"addr", r.fault->addr},
                            {"access", r.fault->access}};
            if (r.page_in_exhausted)
                out["note"] = "demand paging hit its 4096-page (16 MiB) budget; "
                              "lower count or start closer to the code of interest";
            else if (req.page_in)
                out["note"] = "the address is outside the code source: file_addr "
                              "pages come from the loaded image (its sections, "
                              "inside SizeOfImage), target_addr pages from the "
                              "attached process. Map anything else (heap, other "
                              "modules, PEB.Ldr) with maps=[{addr,hex}]";
            else
                out["note"] = "only the requested code bytes (+ optional maps=) are "
                              "mapped: CALL/JMP to unmapped callees and loads from "
                              "unmapped data stop with invalid_mem_* (trace shows "
                              "<unmapped>, never synthetic ADD [rax],al). Use "
                              "file_addr/target_addr with page_in (default on) to "
                              "pull the rest on demand, or map it via "
                              "maps=[{addr,hex}]";
        }

        if (!req.taint_sources.empty()) {
            json ranges = json::array();
            for (const auto& rg : r.taint_ranges)
                ranges.push_back({{"addr", rg.addr}, {"len", rg.len}});
            json events = json::array();
            for (const auto& e : r.taint_events)
                events.push_back({{"ip", e.ip}, {"insn", e.insn},
                                  {"kind", e.kind}, {"target", e.target}});
            out["taint_ranges"]   = ranges;
            out["taint_events"]   = events;
            out["output_tainted"] = r.output_tainted;
        }
        // a recorded trace stays addressable for emulate.slice
        if (req.trace && !r.trace.empty()) out["trace_id"] = store_trace(std::move(r));
        return out;
    }

    // === slice ===============================================================
    if (action == "slice") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "trace_id");
        emu::run_result_t run;
        {
            auto& s = trace_store();
            std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
            const auto it = s.entries.find(id);
            if (it == s.entries.end())
                fail("unknown trace_id (run emulate.run with trace=true first; "
                     "the store keeps the last 8 traces)");
            run = it->second;
        }
        emu::slice_request_t sr;
        if (auto it = args.find("reg"); it != args.end() && it->is_string())
            sr.reg = it->get<std::string>();
        if (args.contains("addr")) sr.addr = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        if (args.contains("len"))  sr.len  = static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr(args, "len"));
        if (args.contains("at"))   sr.at   = parse_addr(args, "at");
        const auto r = emu::emulate_slice(run, sr);
        if (!r.ok) fail(r.error);
        json insns = json::array();
        for (const auto& i : r.insns)
            insns.push_back({{"ip", i.ip}, {"text", i.text}});
        return json{{"ok", true}, {"trace_id", id}, {"count", r.insns.size()},
                    {"instructions", std::move(insns)}};
    }

    // === persistent sessions ================================================
    if (action == "session_create") {
        auto parsed = build_request(args, cancel);
        std::string err;
        auto session = emu::emulation_session_t::create(parsed.req, &err);
        if (!session) fail(err.empty() ? "session create failed" : err);
        auto& store = session_store();
        std::lock_guard lk(store.mu);
        if (store.entries.size() >= kMaxSessions)
            fail("too many live sessions (max 8): destroy one first");
        const uint64_t id = store.next++;
        json out = session_state_json(*session);
        out["session"] = id;
        out["abi"] = abi_label(parsed.req);
        store.entries.emplace(id, std::move(session));
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "session_step" || action == "session_run") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "session");
        std::shared_ptr<emu::emulation_session_t> session;
        {
            auto& store = session_store();
            std::lock_guard lk(store.mu);
            const auto it = store.entries.find(id);
            if (it == store.entries.end()) fail("unknown session id");
            session = it->second;
        }
        const uint64_t count = args.contains("count")
            ? parse_addr(args, "count")
            : (action == "session_run" ? 0 : 1);
        const uint32_t timeout_ms = args.contains("timeout_ms")
            ? static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(parse_addr(args, "timeout_ms"),
                                                       emu::kMaxTimeoutMs))
            : (action == "session_run" ? 5000u : 1000u);
        std::string err;
        if (!session->step(count, timeout_ms, cancel, &err))
            fail(err.empty() ? "session step failed" : err);
        json out = session_state_json(*session);
        out["session"] = id;
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "session_destroy") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "session");
        auto& store = session_store();
        std::lock_guard lk(store.mu);
        if (!store.entries.erase(id)) fail("unknown session id");
        return json{{"ok", true}, {"session", id}, {"destroyed", true}};
    }

    if (action == "snapshot") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "session");
        std::shared_ptr<emu::emulation_session_t> session;
        {
            auto& store = session_store();
            std::lock_guard lk(store.mu);
            const auto it = store.entries.find(id);
            if (it == store.entries.end()) fail("unknown session id");
            session = it->second;
        }
        std::string err;
        if (!session->snapshot(&err)) fail(err);
        json out = session_state_json(*session);
        out["session"] = id;
        out["snapshot"] = session->snapshot_count();
        out["pages"] = session->snapshot_pages();
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "restore") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "session");
        std::shared_ptr<emu::emulation_session_t> session;
        {
            auto& store = session_store();
            std::lock_guard lk(store.mu);
            const auto it = store.entries.find(id);
            if (it == store.entries.end()) fail("unknown session id");
            session = it->second;
        }
        std::string err;
        if (!session->restore(&err)) fail(err);
        json out = session_state_json(*session);
        out["session"] = id;
        out["restored"] = true;
        return out;
    }

    fail("emulate: unknown action");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/mcp/tools_fs_web.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_fs_web.cpp
// tools: fs and web

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include <filesystem>

#include "core/infra/paths.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {


namespace {

constexpr size_t kReadDefault = 64u << 10;   // fs.read_file default page
constexpr size_t kReadMax     = 1u << 20;    // per call, the response carries it twice at most

// The engine data dir holds the bearer token, the audit log and the session
// store. fs is intentionally broad, but a token holder must not be able to
// read or rewrite those files through it.
bool under_engine_data(const std::string& p) {
    if (p.empty()) return false;
    const std::string& data_dir = infra::paths::app_data();
    if (data_dir.empty()) return false;   // paths not initialised: no jail target
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto root = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(
        std::filesystem::path(data_dir), ec);
    if (ec) return false;
    const auto full = std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::path(p), ec);
    if (ec) return false;
    const auto rel = std::filesystem::relative(full, root, ec);
    if (ec || rel.empty()) return false;
    const auto first = rel.begin();
    return first != rel.end() && *first != "..";
}

void guard_engine_data(const std::string& key, const std::string& p) {
    if (under_engine_data(p))
        fail("fs: " + key + " points into the engine data directory; settings, "
             "tokens and session stores are not reachable through fs");
}

// settings fs_root: optional allowlist of folders. Unset (the default) keeps
// the historic whole-profile access; set, every fs action is confined to it
std::vector<std::string> fs_roots() {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    const json j = infra::settings::get_json("fs_root");
    if (j.is_string()) {
        out.push_back(j.get<std::string>());
    } else if (j.is_array()) {
        for (const auto& e : j)
            if (e.is_string()) out.push_back(e.get<std::string>());
    }
    return out;
}

// Every action goes through here. The path is canonicalised first, so `..`,
// junctions, 8.3 names, \\?\ prefixes and ADS streams cannot walk out of a
// root; walks only ever descend from a checked root and never follow reparse
// points, so their hits stay inside it too
void guard_fs(const std::string& key, const std::string& p) {
    guard_engine_data(key, p);
    const json setting = infra::settings::get_json("fs_root");
    if (setting.is_null()) return;   // unset: the historic whole-profile access
    const auto roots = fs_roots();
    if (roots.empty())
        fail("fs: the fs_root setting holds no usable folder; set it to a path "
             "or a list of paths, or remove it");
    std::string canon, err;
    if (!util::canonical_path(p, &canon, &err))
        fail("fs: " + key + " cannot be resolved: " + err);
    for (const auto& root : roots) {
        std::string root_canon;
        if (util::canonical_path(root, &root_canon) &&
            util::path_within(canon, root_canon))
            return;
    }
    fail("fs: " + key + " is outside fs_root (" + canon +
         "); add the folder to the fs_root setting to allow it");
}

// valid utf-8 without NULs reads back as text, anything else as hex
bool looks_text(const std::vector<uint8_t>& b) {
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < b.size()) {
        const uint8_t c = b[i];
        if (c == 0) return false;
        size_t n = c < 0x80 ? 1 : (c >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2 : (c >> 4) == 0xE ? 3 : (c >> 3) == 0x1E ? 4 : 0;
        if (n == 0) return false;
        // a sequence cut by the page end is fine, the next page continues it
        for (size_t k = 1; k < n && i + k < b.size(); ++k)
            if ((b[i + k] & 0xC0) != 0x80) return false;
        i += n;
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace

// tool: fs (host filesystem; runs off the tool lock, walks honor cancellation)

json tool_fs(const json& args, const infra::cancel_token_t& cancel) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    if (action == "read_file") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        const std::string path = args.at("path").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("path", path);
        const uint64_t offset = args.contains("offset") ? parse_addr(args, "offset") : 0;
        const size_t want = args.contains("max_bytes")
            ? static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(parse_addr(args, "max_bytes"), kReadMax))
            : kReadDefault;
        const std::string encoding = args.value("encoding", std::string{"auto"});
        if (encoding != "auto" && encoding != "text" && encoding != "hex")
            fail("fs.read_file: encoding must be auto|text|hex");
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        uint64_t total = 0;
        std::string err;
        if (!util::read_file(path, offset, &bytes, want, &total, &err)) fail(err);
        const uint64_t next = offset + bytes.size();
        json out = {{"path", path},
                    {"size", total},
                    {"offset", offset},
                    {"bytes", bytes.size()},
                    {"eof", next >= total}};
        if (next < total) out["next_offset"] = next;
        const bool as_text = encoding == "text" || (encoding == "auto" && looks_text(bytes));
        if (as_text) {
            out["encoding"] = "text";
            out["text"] = std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size());
        } else {
            out["encoding"] = "hex";
            out["hex"] = to_hex(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
        }
        return out;
    }
    if (action == "write_file") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        const std::string path = args.at("path").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("path", path);
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        if (args.contains("hex"))
            bytes = hex_decode(args.at("hex").get<std::string>());
        else if (args.contains("text")) {
            // bind once, two get calls make two different strings and thats ub
            const std::string text = args.at("text").get<std::string>();
            bytes.assign(text.begin(), text.end());
        }
        std::string err;
        if (!util::write_file(path, bytes, args.value("append", false), &err))
            fail(err);
        return {{"written", bytes.size()}, {"path", path}};
    }
    if (action == "list_directory") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        const std::string path = args.at("path").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("path", path);
        std::string err;
        auto items = util::list_directory(path, &err);
        if (items.empty() && !err.empty()) fail(err);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& e : items)
            arr.push_back({{"name", e.name}, {"size", e.size},
                           {"directory", e.directory}, {"reparse", e.reparse}});
        json out = {{"entries", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
        if (!err.empty()) {
            out["truncated"] = true;
            out["warning"] = err;
        }
        return out;
    }
    if (action == "create_directory") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        const std::string path = args.at("path").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("path", path);
        std::string err;
        if (!util::create_directory(path, &err))
            fail(err);
        return {{"created", true}};
    }
    if (action == "delete_path") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        const std::string path = args.at("path").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("path", path);
        std::string err;
        if (!util::delete_path(path, &err))
            fail(err);
        return {{"deleted", true}};
    }
    if (action == "search_files") {
        if (!args.contains("root") || !args.contains("needle"))
            fail("missing root/needle");
        const std::string root = args.at("root").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("root", root);
        auto hits = util::search_files(
            root, args.at("needle").get<std::string>(),
            std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 200u), 2000u), cancel);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits) {
            if (under_engine_data(h.path)) continue;   // a walk may cross the data dir
            arr.push_back({{"path", h.path}, {"size", h.size},
                           {"directory", h.directory}});
        }
        return {{"matches", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}, {"cancelled", cancel.cancelled()}};
    }
    if (action == "grep_in_files") {
        if (!args.contains("root") || !args.contains("needle"))
            fail("missing root/needle");
        const std::string root = args.at("root").get<std::string>();
        guard_fs("root", root);
        auto hits = util::grep_in_files(
            root, args.at("needle").get<std::string>(),
            args.value("suffix", std::string{}),
            std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 200u), 2000u), cancel);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits) {
            if (under_engine_data(h.path)) continue;   // never echo settings/token lines
            arr.push_back({{"path", h.path}, {"line", h.line},
                           {"text", h.text}});
        }
        return {{"hits", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}, {"cancelled", cancel.cancelled()}};
    }

    fail("fs: unknown action (read_file|write_file|list_directory|"
         "create_directory|delete_path|search_files|grep_in_files)");
}


// tool: web

namespace {

bool valid_utf8(const std::string& s) {
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.size()) {
        const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
        size_t n = c < 0x80 ? 1 : (c >> 5) == 0x6 ? 2 : (c >> 4) == 0xE ? 3 : (c >> 3) == 0x1E ? 4 : 0;
        if (n == 0 || i + n > s.size()) return false;
        for (size_t k = 1; k < n; ++k)
            if ((static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i + k]) & 0xC0) != 0x80) return false;
        i += n;
    }
    return true;
}

util::egress_policy_t web_policy() {
    util::egress_policy_t p;
    p.allow_private = infra::settings::get<bool>("web_allow_private", false);
    const json list = infra::settings::get_json("web_allowlist");
    if (list.is_array())
        for (const auto& e : list)
            if (e.is_string()) p.allowlist.push_back(e.get<std::string>());
    return p;
}


std::string base64(const std::string& in) {
    static constexpr char kAlpha[] =
        "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve((in.size() + 2) / 3 * 4);
    size_t i = 0;
    const auto byte = [&](size_t k) { return static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(in[k])); };
    for (; i + 3 <= in.size(); i += 3) {
        const uint32_t v = (byte(i) << 16) | (byte(i + 1) << 8) | byte(i + 2);
        out += kAlpha[(v >> 18) & 63];
        out += kAlpha[(v >> 12) & 63];
        out += kAlpha[(v >> 6) & 63];
        out += kAlpha[v & 63];
    }
    if (i < in.size()) {
        uint32_t v = byte(i) << 16;
        if (i + 1 < in.size()) v |= byte(i + 1) << 8;
        out += kAlpha[(v >> 18) & 63];
        out += kAlpha[(v >> 12) & 63];
        out += i + 1 < in.size() ? kAlpha[(v >> 6) & 63] : '=';
        out += '=';
    }
    return out;
}
} // namespace

json tool_web(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    if (action == "fetch" || action == "post") {
        if (!args.contains("url") || !args.at("url").is_string()) fail("missing url");
        util::http_request_t req;
        req.url = args.at("url").get<std::string>();
        req.timeout_ms = static_cast<int>(std::clamp<uint64_t>(
            args.contains("timeout_ms") ? parse_addr(args, "timeout_ms") : 15000, 1000, 60000));
        if (action == "post") {
            if (!args.contains("body")) fail("missing body");
            const json& b = args.at("body");
            req.method = "POST";
            req.body = b.is_string() ? b.get<std::string>()
                                     : b.dump(-1, ' ', false, json::error_handler_t::replace);
            req.content_type = args.value("content_type", std::string{"application/json"});
        }
        const uint64_t offset = args.contains("offset") ? parse_addr(args, "offset") : 0;
        const size_t max_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(std::clamp<uint64_t>(
            args.contains("max_bytes") ? parse_addr(args, "max_bytes") : 65536, 1, 1u << 20));
        const std::string encoding = args.value("encoding", std::string{"auto"});
        if (encoding != "auto" && encoding != "text" && encoding != "base64")
            fail("encoding must be auto, text or base64");

        std::string err;
        auto resp = util::http_request(req, web_policy(), &err);
        if (!resp) fail(err);

        const std::string& body = resp->body;
        const size_t start = static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(offset, body.size()));
        size_t end = std::min(body.size(), start + max_bytes);
        const bool as_text = encoding == "text" || (encoding == "auto" && valid_utf8(body));
        if (as_text)   // never split a UTF-8 sequence across pages
            while (end > start && end < body.size() &&
                   (static_cast<unsigned char>(body[end]) & 0xC0) == 0x80)
                --end;
        const std::string slice = body.substr(start, end - start);
        json out = {{"status", resp->status},
                    {"content_type", resp->content_type},
                    {"total_bytes", body.size()},
                    {"offset", start},
                    {"returned", slice.size()},
                    {"next_offset", end < body.size() ? json(end) : json(nullptr)},
                    {"body_truncated", resp->body_truncated},
                    {"final_url", resp->final_url},
                    {"redirects", resp->redirects},
                    {"remote_addr", resp->remote_addr},
                    {"encoding", as_text ? "text" : "base64"}};
        if (as_text)
            out["text"] = slice;
        else
            out["base64"] = base64(slice);
        return out;
    }

    fail("web: unknown action (use fetch or post)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_gdb.cpp
// tool: gdb — control the GDB Remote Serial Protocol bridge (gdb_rsp) that
// lets GDB/LLDB/Binary Ninja share the console debug session with the UI and
// the MCP tools. Memory/register writes over RSP (M/G/P) are refused unless
// the bridge was started with allow_writes=true.

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/broker.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/gdb_rsp.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

json tool_gdb(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    auto& srv = runtime::gdb_rsp();

    if (action == "status") {
        json out = {{"running", srv.running()},
                    {"port", srv.port()},
                    {"allow_writes", srv.allow_writes()},
                    {"rsp_clients", srv.client_count()}};
        if (srv.running())
            out["hint"] = "connect with: gdb -ex 'target remote 127.0.0.1:" +
                          std::to_string(srv.port()) + "' (needs debugger.ps4_attach first)";
        json clients = json::array();
        for (const auto& [name, since] : runtime::broker_clients())
            clients.push_back({{"name", name}, {"since_ms", since}});
        out["broker_clients"] = clients;
        auto* p = runtime::registry_ps4();
        out["console"] = p && p->connected()
            ? json{{"connected", true}, {"endpoint", p->endpoint()},
                   {"debug_attached", p->ps4_debug_attached()},
                   {"debug_pid", p->ps4_debug_pid()}}
            : json{{"connected", false}};
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "start") {
        if (srv.running())
            fail("gdb.start: already running on port " + std::to_string(srv.port()) +
                 " (stop first)");
        const uint64_t port = args.contains("port") ? parse_addr(args, "port")
                                                    : 2331;
        if (port == 0 || port > 0xFFFF) fail("gdb.start: bad port");
        const std::string bind = args.value("bind", "127.0.0.1");
        const bool allow_writes = args.value("allow_writes", false);
        if (bind != "127.0.0.1" && bind != "localhost" && bind != "::1")
            fail("gdb.start: non-loopback bind is refused; the bridge exposes the "
                 "console debug session, keep it on loopback (use an SSH tunnel "
                 "for remote GDB)");
        std::string err;
        if (!srv.start(bind, static_cast<uint16_t>(port), allow_writes, err))
            fail("gdb.start failed: " + err);
        return {{"running", true},
                {"port", srv.port()},
                {"bind", bind},
                {"allow_writes", allow_writes},
                {"hint", "gdb -ex 'target remote 127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(srv.port()) +
                             "' — the console needs debugger.ps4_attach {pid} first"}};
    }

    if (action == "stop") {
        srv.stop();
        return {{"running", false}};
    }

    fail("gdb: unknown action '" + action + "' (start|stop|status)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/mcp/tools_host.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_host.cpp
// tool: host — serve a payload directory over HTTP (afterglow-web style payload
// host): index page, per-file download under /files/<name>, and an
// auto-generated /manifest.json with sha256 per file. A non-loopback bind
// always requires a token (arg "token" or the host_token setting)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"
#include "core/infra/paths.hpp"
#include "core/util/sha256.hpp"

#include <httplib.h>

#include <filesystem>

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

constexpr uint64_t kMaxServeBytes = 64ull * 1024 * 1024;   // one file cap

struct host_state_t {
    std::mutex mu;
    std::unique_ptr<httplib::Server> srv;
    std::thread th;
    std::string bind = "127.0.0.1";
    int port = 0;
    std::string dir;
    std::string token;                 // enforced when non-empty
    std::atomic<bool> running{false};
};

host_state_t& host_state() {
    static host_state_t h;
    return h;
}

std::string sha256_file_hex(const fs::path& p, bool& ok) {
    ok = false;
    std::error_code ec;
    const auto size = fs::file_size(p, ec);
    if (ec || size > kMaxServeBytes) return {};
    std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return {};
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(static_cast<size_t>(size));
    if (!f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(buf.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(buf.size())) &&
        buf.size() != 0)
        return {};
    ok = true;
    return util::sha256_hex(buf.data(), buf.size());
}

// joins rel under root and refuses anything that escapes it (absolute paths,
// drive letters, ".." segments)
bool safe_join(const std::string& root, const std::string& rel, fs::path& out) {
    if (rel.empty() || rel.front() == '/' || rel.front() == '\\' ||
        rel.find(':') != std::string::npos)
        return false;
    const fs::path base = fs::path(root).lexically_normal();
    const fs::path cand = (base / fs::path(rel)).lexically_normal();
    const std::string bs = base.generic_string();
    const std::string cs = cand.generic_string();
    if (cs.size() <= bs.size() || cs.compare(0, bs.size(), bs) != 0 ||
        cs[bs.size()] != '/')
        return false;
    out = cand;
    return true;
}

bool is_loopback_bind(const std::string& bind) {
    return bind == "localhost" || bind == "::1" ||
           bind.rfind("127.", 0) == 0;
}

const char* content_type_for(const fs::path& p) {
    const std::string e = p.extension().string();
    if (e == ".json") return "application/json";
    if (e == ".html" || e == ".htm") return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
    if (e == ".js") return "text/javascript; charset=utf-8";
    if (e == ".css") return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
    if (e == ".png") return "image/png";
    if (e == ".txt" || e == ".md") return "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
    return "application/octet-stream";   // .bin .elf .sprx .pkg ...
}

json build_manifest_locked(host_state_t& h) {
    json files = json::array();
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::recursive_directory_iterator it(h.dir, ec), end;
    while (!ec && it != end) {
        if (it->is_regular_file(ec)) {
            const auto rel = fs::relative(it->path(), h.dir, ec);
            if (!ec && !rel.empty()) {
                bool ok = false;
                const std::string digest = sha256_file_hex(it->path(), ok);
                const auto size = fs::file_size(it->path(), ec);
                if (ok && !ec)
                    files.push_back({{"name", rel.generic_string()},
                                     {"size", size},
                                     {"sha256", digest},
                                     {"url", "/files/" + rel.generic_string()}});
            }
        }
        it.increment(ec);
    }
    return {{"version", 1}, {"generator", "reverse-slop host"}, {"files", files}};
}

std::string index_html_locked(host_state_t& h) {
    const json man = build_manifest_locked(h);
    std::string s = "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf-8><title>reverse-slop "
                    "payload host</title><style>body{font:14px system-ui;background:#101014;"
                    "color:#ddd;margin:2em} a{color:#8ab4f8} li{margin:.3em 0}code{color:#9e9e9e}"
                    "</style></head><body><h1>payload host</h1><p>manifest: <a "
                    "href=/manifest.json>/manifest.json</a></p><ul>";
    for (const auto& f : man["files"])
        s += "<li><a href=\"" + f["url"].get<std::string>() + "\">" +
             f["name"].get<std::string>() + "</a> <code>" +
             std::to_string(f["size"].get<uint64_t>()) + " B sha256:" +
             f["sha256"].get<std::string>().substr(0, 16) + "…</code></li>";
    s += "</ul></body></html>";
    return s;
}

void register_handlers(host_state_t& h) {
    auto& srv = *h.srv;
    srv.set_exception_handler([](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res,
                                 std::exception_ptr) {
        res.status = 500;
        res.set_content("internal error", "text/plain");
    });
    srv.set_pre_routing_handler(
        [&h](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            if (h.token.empty()) return httplib::Server::HandlerResponse::Unhandled;
            bool ok = false;
            if (req.has_header("Authorization"))
                ok = req.get_header_value("Authorization") == "Bearer " + h.token;
            if (!ok && req.has_param("token"))
                ok = req.get_param_value("token") == h.token;
            if (!ok) {
                res.status = 401;
                res.set_header("WWW-Authenticate", "Bearer");
                res.set_content("unauthorized", "text/plain");
                return httplib::Server::HandlerResponse::Handled;
            }
            return httplib::Server::HandlerResponse::Unhandled;
        });
    srv.Get("/", [&h](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        res.set_content(index_html_locked(h), "text/html; charset=utf-8");
    });
    srv.Get("/manifest.json", [&h](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        res.set_content(build_manifest_locked(h).dump(2), "application/json");
        res.set_header("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    });
    srv.Get("/files/(.*)", [&h](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        fs::path f;
        if (!safe_join(h.dir, req.matches[1], f)) {
            res.status = 400;
            res.set_content("bad path", "text/plain");
            return;
        }
        std::error_code ec;
        if (!fs::is_regular_file(f, ec) || fs::file_size(f, ec) > kMaxServeBytes) {
            res.status = 404;
            res.set_content("not found", "text/plain");
            return;
        }
        std::ifstream ifs(f, std::ios::binary);
        std::string data((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(ifs)),
                         std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        res.set_content(std::move(data), content_type_for(f));
        res.set_header("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    });
}

} // namespace

json tool_host(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    auto& h = host_state();

    if (action == "status") {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        json out = {{"running", h.running.load()},
                    {"bind", h.bind},
                    {"port", h.port},
                    {"dir", h.dir},
                    {"token_required", !h.token.empty()}};
        if (h.running.load()) {
            out["url"] = "http://" + h.bind + ":" + std::to_string(h.port) + "/";
            out["manifest_url"] = out["url"].get<std::string>() + "manifest.json";
        }
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "files" || action == "manifest") {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        if (h.dir.empty()) fail("host." + action + ": the host is not started");
        return build_manifest_locked(h);
    }

    if (action == "start") {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        if (h.running.load()) fail("host.start: already running on " + h.bind + ":" +
                                   std::to_string(h.port) + " (stop first)");
        const uint64_t p = args.contains("port") ? parse_addr(args, "port") : 8080;
        if (p == 0 || p > 0xFFFF) fail("host.start: bad port");
        const std::string bind = args.value("bind", "127.0.0.1");
        std::string dir = args.value("dir", std::string{});
        if (dir.empty()) {
            const std::string& ad = infra::paths::app_data();
            dir = ad.empty() ? "payloads" : ad + "\\payloads";
        }
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::create_directories(dir, ec);
        if (!fs::is_directory(dir, ec))
            fail("host.start: dir is not a directory: " + dir);
        std::string token = args.value("token", std::string{});
        if (token.empty()) token = infra::settings::get<std::string>("host_token", {});
        if (!is_loopback_bind(bind) && token.empty())
            fail("host.start: a non-loopback bind (" + bind + ") requires a token "
                 "(arg \"token\" or the host_token setting) so the payload dir is "
                 "not exposed unauthenticated; clients send Authorization: Bearer "
                 "<token> or ?token=<token>");
        h.srv = std::make_unique<httplib::Server>();
        // no port sharing with another process (httplib defaults to SO_REUSEADDR)
        h.srv->set_socket_options([](socket_t s) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        BOOL excl = TRUE;
        ::setsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&excl), sizeof(excl));
#else
        int reuse = 1;
        ::setsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &reuse, sizeof(reuse));
#endif
        });
        register_handlers(h);
        const int sock = h.srv->bind_to_port(bind, static_cast<int>(p));
        if (sock < 0)
            fail("host.start: cannot bind " + bind + ":" + std::to_string(p) +
                 " (in use?)");
        h.bind = bind;
        h.port = static_cast<int>(p);
        h.dir  = fs::path(dir).lexically_normal().generic_string();
        h.token = token;
        httplib::Server* raw = h.srv.get();
        h.th = std::thread([raw] { raw->listen_after_bind(); });
        h.running = true;
        json out = {{"running", true}, {"bind", h.bind}, {"port", h.port},
                    {"dir", h.dir}, {"token_required", !h.token.empty()},
                    {"url", "http://" + h.bind + ":" + std::to_string(h.port) + "/"},
                    {"manifest_url", "http://" + h.bind + ":" + std::to_string(h.port) + "/manifest.json"}};
        if (!token.empty()) out["token"] = token;
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "stop") {
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        if (!h.running.load()) return {{"running", false}};
        if (h.srv) h.srv->stop();
        if (h.th.joinable()) h.th.join();
        h.srv.reset();
        h.running = false;
        return {{"running", false}};
    }

    if (action == "put") {
        // drop a payload file into the served dir (mutating: confirm-gated)
        if (!args.contains("name") || !args.at("name").is_string())
            fail("host.put requires string 'name' (relative path under the served dir)");
        const std::string name = args.at("name").get<std::string>();
        std::string data;
        if (args.contains("hex")) {
            const auto bytes = hex_decode(args.at("hex").get<std::string>());
            data.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size());
        } else if (args.contains("text")) {
            data = args.at("text").get<std::string>();
        } else {
            fail("host.put requires 'hex' or 'text'");
        }
        std::lock_guard lk(h.mu);
        if (h.dir.empty()) fail("host.put: the host is not started");
        fs::path f;
        if (!safe_join(h.dir, name, f)) fail("host.put: bad name (path escapes the served dir)");
        fs::create_directories(f.parent_path());
        if (!infra::paths::write_file_atomic(f.generic_string(), data))
            fail("host.put: write failed: " + f.generic_string());
        bool ok = false;
        const std::string digest = sha256_file_hex(f, ok);
        return {{"written", true}, {"name", name}, {"size", data.size()},
                {"sha256", ok ? digest : ""}, {"url", "/files/" + name}};
    }

    fail("host: unknown action '" + action +
         "' (start|stop|status|files|manifest|put)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/mcp/tools_memory.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_memory.cpp
// tool: memory (read/write/scan/aob/pointer scan/snapshots/watch)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"
#include "core/compat/portable.hpp"

#include <filesystem>

#include "core/infra/paths.hpp"
#include "core/memory/console_scan.hpp"
#include "core/memory/dissect.hpp"
#include "core/memory/offsets.hpp"
#include "core/memory/session_reader.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

using memory::session_reader_t;

// Saved scans live under the engine data dir; the name is a plain stem so a
// caller cannot escape the folder with separators or dots.
std::filesystem::path scan_file_path(const std::string& name, bool& ok) {
    ok = !name.empty() && name.size() <= 64 && name != "." && name != ".." &&
         name.find_first_not_of("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789._-")
             == std::string::npos;
    if (!ok) return {};
    const auto dir = std::filesystem::path(infra::paths::app_data()) / "scans";
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir, ec);
    return dir / (name + ".json");
}

// optional numeric argument through the shared parser, so "0x1000" strings
// work everywhere and bad input fails with a readable message
uint64_t opt_u64(const json& args, const char* key, uint64_t def) {
    return args.contains(key) ? parse_addr(args, key) : def;
}

// signed variant for offsets: accepts -0x10 / "-16" / -16
int64_t opt_i64(const json& args, const char* key, int64_t def) {
    if (!args.contains(key)) return def;
    const json& v = args.at(key);
    if (v.is_number_integer()) return v.get<int64_t>();
    if (v.is_string()) {
        std::string t = v.get<std::string>();
        const size_t b = t.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        const bool neg = b != std::string::npos && t[b] == '-';
        if (neg) t.erase(b, 1);
        const uint64_t mag = parse_addr(json{{key, t}}, key);
        if (mag > static_cast<uint64_t>(INT64_MAX))
            fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "': out of range");
        return neg ? -static_cast<int64_t>(mag) : static_cast<int64_t>(mag);
    }
    fail(std::string("bad numeric argument '") + key + "': expected a signed integer");
}

bool opt_bool(const json& args, const char* key, bool def) {
    if (!args.contains(key)) return def;
    const json& v = args.at(key);
    if (v.is_boolean()) return v.get<bool>();
    if (v.is_number_integer()) return v.get<int64_t>() != 0;
    fail(std::string("bad argument '") + key + "': expected true/false");
}

json io_hints_json(const memory::reader_hints_t& h) {
    return {{"remote", h.max_workers == 1},
            {"max_workers", h.max_workers},
            {"chunk_bytes", h.chunk_bytes ? h.chunk_bytes : infra::limits::scan_chunk_bytes},
            {"read_ahead", h.read_ahead},
            {"coalesce_gap", h.coalesce_gap}};
}

// last pointer scan result, the input of pointerscan_verify
struct ptr_list_t {
    bool                                         valid = false;
    uint32_t                                     pid = 0;
    uintptr_t                                    target = 0;
    std::vector<memory::pointer_chain_result_t>  chains;
};
ptr_list_t g_ptr_last;

json chains_json(const std::vector<memory::pointer_chain_result_t>& chains, size_t limit) {
    json arr = json::array();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < chains.size() && i < limit; ++i) {
        json addrs = json::array();
        json offs  = json::array();
        for (uintptr_t a : chains[i].addresses) addrs.push_back(static_cast<uint64_t>(a));
        for (int64_t o : chains[i].offsets)     offs.push_back(o);
        json row = {{"addresses", addrs}, {"offsets", offs},
                    {"base_hex", addr_hex_str(chains[i].addresses.empty()
                                                  ? 0 : chains[i].addresses.front())},
                    {"depth", chains[i].depth()}};
        // a root inside a module survives a restart: name + offset is the
        // portable form pointerscan_verify accepts back
        if (!chains[i].module.empty()) {
            row["module"]        = chains[i].module;
            row["module_offset"] = chains[i].module_offset;
        }
        arr.push_back(std::move(row));
    }
    return arr;
}

std::vector<uintptr_t> committed_ranges(runtime::session_t& s) {
    std::vector<uintptr_t> out;
    auto res = runtime::active().enum_regions(s.handle());
    if (!res.ok) return out;
    out.reserve(res.items.size() * 2);
    for (const auto& r : res.items) {
        const bool commit = (r.state & 0x1000) != 0;   // MEM_COMMIT
        if (!commit || r.size == 0) continue;
        const bool guard = (r.protect & 0x100) != 0;   // PAGE_GUARD
        if (guard) continue;
        out.push_back(r.base);
        out.push_back(r.base + r.size);
    }
    return out;
}

// string argument with a readable error instead of a json type_error
std::string opt_str(const json& args, const char* key, const char* def) {
    if (!args.contains(key)) return def;
    const json& v = args.at(key);
    if (!v.is_string()) fail(std::string("bad argument '") + key + "': expected a string");
    return v.get<std::string>();
}

memory::value_width_t parse_width(const json& args) {
    // byte counts (1/2/4/8) map to the unsigned widths
    if (args.contains("width") && args.at("width").is_number_integer()) {
        switch (args.at("width").get<int64_t>()) {
        case 1: return memory::value_width_t::u8;
        case 2: return memory::value_width_t::u16;
        case 4: return memory::value_width_t::u32;
        case 8: return memory::value_width_t::u64;
        default: fail("bad width: byte widths are 1, 2, 4 or 8");
        }
    }
    const std::string w = opt_str(args, "width", "i32");
    if (w == "i8")  return memory::value_width_t::i8;
    if (w == "u8")  return memory::value_width_t::u8;
    if (w == "i16") return memory::value_width_t::i16;
    if (w == "u16") return memory::value_width_t::u16;
    if (w == "i32") return memory::value_width_t::i32;
    if (w == "u32") return memory::value_width_t::u32;
    if (w == "i64") return memory::value_width_t::i64;
    if (w == "u64") return memory::value_width_t::u64;
    if (w == "f32") return memory::value_width_t::f32;
    if (w == "f64") return memory::value_width_t::f64;
    if (w == "all") return memory::value_width_t::u32; // handled via scan_all_types
    fail("bad width '" + w + "' (i8|u8|i16|u16|i32|u32|i64|u64|f32|f64|all, or 1/2/4/8 bytes)");
}

memory::scan_type_t parse_scan_kind(const json& args) {
    const std::string k = opt_str(args, "kind", "exact");
    if (k == "exact")        return memory::scan_type_t::exact_value;
    if (k == "between")      return memory::scan_type_t::between;
    if (k == "bigger")       return memory::scan_type_t::bigger_than;
    if (k == "smaller")      return memory::scan_type_t::smaller_than;
    if (k == "unknown")      return memory::scan_type_t::unknown_initial;
    if (k == "increased")    return memory::scan_type_t::increased;
```
