```cpp
                           {"query_type", d.query_type}, {"domain", d.domain},
                           {"resolved", d.resolved_addr}, {"answers", d.answers},
                           {"response_code", d.response_code}, {"ttl", d.ttl},
                           {"client", d.client_addr}, {"server", d.server_addr}});
        return {{"dns", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "stats") {
        network::capture::poll(g_traffic, 4096);
        const auto s = network::capture::stats();
        const auto st = g_traffic.stats();
        const int64_t now = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                                std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
        return json{{"capture_active", s.capture_active},
                    {"filter", filter_json(s.filter)},
                    {"packets_seen", s.packets_seen},
                    {"packets_in", s.packets_in},
                    {"packets_out", s.packets_out},
                    {"bytes_in", s.bytes_in},
                    {"bytes_out", s.bytes_out},
                    {"filtered_out", s.filtered_out},
                    {"parse_errors", s.parse_errors},
                    {"non_tcp_udp", s.non_tcp_udp},
                    {"fragments", s.fragments},
                    {"fragments_reassembled", s.fragments_reassembled},
                    {"fragments_dropped", s.fragments_dropped},
                    {"queue_dropped", s.queue_dropped},
                    {"payload_truncated", s.payload_truncated},
                    {"dns_logged_total", s.dns_logged_total},
                    {"dns_buffered", s.dns_buffered},
                    {"interfaces", ifaces_json(s.interfaces)},
                    {"store_packets", st.packets},
                    {"store_packets_total", st.packets_total},
                    {"store_packets_evicted", st.packets_evicted},
                    {"streams", st.streams},
                    {"active_streams_60s", g_traffic.active_streams(now, 60000)},
                    {"stream_bytes", st.stream_bytes},
                    {"streams_evicted", st.streams_evicted},
                    {"stream_bytes_dropped", st.stream_bytes_dropped},
                    {"quic_packets", st.quic_packets}};
    }
    if (action == "export_pcap") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        const std::string format = args.value("format", std::string{"pcap"});
        if (format != "pcap" && format != "pcapng")
            fail("format must be pcap or pcapng");
        const uint64_t maxp = args.contains("max_packets") ? parse_addr(args, "max_packets") : 4096;
        size_t exported = 0;
        bool truncated = false;
        auto err = network::capture::export_pcap(
            g_traffic, args.at("path").get<std::string>(),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(maxp, 65536ull)), &exported, &truncated,
            format);
        if (!err.empty()) fail(err);
        json out = {{"exported", true}, {"path", args.at("path")}, {"packets", exported},
                    {"older_omitted", truncated}, {"format", format},
                    {"linktype", "raw (101)"}};
        if (format == "pcapng") out["comments"] = "packet and stream annotations become epb_comment";
        return out;
    }
    if (action == "import_pcap") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) fail("missing path");
        network::pcap::import_result_t r;
        const std::string err =
            network::pcap::import_file(g_traffic, args.at("path").get<std::string>(), &r);
        if (!err.empty()) fail(err);
        return {{"imported", true}, {"path", args.at("path")}, {"format", r.format},
                {"packets", r.packets}, {"skipped", r.skipped}, {"truncated", r.truncated},
                {"store_packets", g_traffic.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "annotate") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "id");
        if (!args.contains("comment") || !args.at("comment").is_string())
            fail("comment must be a string");
        const std::string comment = args.at("comment").get<std::string>();
        if (comment.size() > 512) fail("comment is capped at 512 bytes");
        const std::string kind = args.value("kind", std::string{"packet"});
        if (kind != "packet" && kind != "stream") fail("kind must be packet or stream");
        const bool ok = kind == "stream" ? g_traffic.annotate_stream(id, comment)
                                         : g_traffic.annotate_packet(id, comment);
        if (!ok) fail("unknown " + kind + " id " + std::to_string(id));
        return {{"annotated", true}, {"kind", kind}, {"id", id}, {"comment", comment},
                {"cleared", comment.empty()}};
    }
    if (action == "streams") {
        network::capture::poll(g_traffic, 4096);
        const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 500u), 4096u);
        auto all = g_traffic.streams(limit);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& s : all) {
            arr.push_back({{"id", s.id}, {"key", s.key}, {"protocol", proto_str(s.protocol)},
                           {"client", s.client_addr + ":" + std::to_string(s.client_port)},
                           {"server", s.server_addr + ":" + std::to_string(s.server_port)},
                           {"bytes", s.bytes}, {"packets", s.packets},
                           {"truncated", s.truncated},
                           {"first_ms", s.first_ms}, {"last_ms", s.last_ms}});
        }
        return {{"streams", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "stream_data") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "id");
        const uint64_t off =
            args.contains("offset") ? parse_addr(args, "offset") : 0;
        uint64_t len = args.contains("len") ? parse_addr(args, "len") : 4096;
        len = std::min<uint64_t>(len, 1 << 20);
        auto bytes = g_traffic.stream_bytes(
            id, static_cast<size_t>(off), static_cast<size_t>(len));
        if (!bytes) fail("unknown stream id");
        const auto sum = g_traffic.stream(id);
        json out = {{"id", id}, {"offset", off}, {"bytes", bytes->size()},
                    {"total", sum ? sum->bytes : 0}};
        const size_t text_len = std::min<size_t>(bytes->size(), 4096);
        out["text"] = printable(bytes->data(), text_len);
        out["hex"]  = to_hex(bytes->data(), text_len);
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "reassemble_stream") {
        // host-side reassembly over the capture store (TCP payloads in capture order)
        network::capture::poll(g_traffic, 4096);
        const auto host = host_arg(args);
        const uint32_t src_port = static_cast<uint32_t>(args.value("src_port", 0u));
        const uint32_t dst_port = static_cast<uint32_t>(args.value("dst_port", 0u));
        std::vector<uint8_t> data;
        uint32_t packets = 0;
        bool truncated = false;
        uint64_t from = 0;
        for (;;) {
            auto page = g_traffic.packets(from, 1000);
            if (page.items.empty()) break;
            from = page.items.back().id;
            for (const auto& p : page.items) {
                if (p.protocol != 6 || p.payload.empty()) continue;   // TCP with payload
                if (host && !packet_has_host(p, *host)) continue;
                if (src_port && p.local_port != src_port && p.remote_port != src_port) continue;
                if (dst_port && p.local_port != dst_port && p.remote_port != dst_port) continue;
                if (data.size() + p.payload.size() > (16u << 20)) { truncated = true; break; }
                data.insert(data.end(), p.payload.begin(), p.payload.end());
                ++packets;
            }
            if (truncated || !page.truncated) break;
        }
        const size_t text_len = std::min<size_t>(data.size(), 4096);
        return {{"bytes", data.size()}, {"packets", packets},
                {"truncated", truncated},
                {"hex", to_hex(data.data(), text_len)}, {"text", printable(data.data(), text_len)}};
    }

    if (action == "connections") {
        // unique 4-tuples seen in the capture store
        network::capture::poll(g_traffic, 4096);
        const auto host = host_arg(args);
        const uint32_t protocol = protocol_arg(args);
        struct conn_t { uint32_t protocol = 0; std::string local, remote; uint64_t packets = 0; uint64_t bytes = 0; };
        std::map<std::string, conn_t> by_key;
        uint64_t from = 0;
        for (;;) {
            auto page = g_traffic.packets(from, 1000);
            if (page.items.empty()) break;
            from = page.items.back().id;
            for (const auto& p : page.items) {
                if (host && !packet_has_host(p, *host)) continue;
                if (protocol && p.protocol != protocol) continue;
                const std::string local  = p.local_addr  + ":" + std::to_string(p.local_port);
                const std::string remote = p.remote_addr + ":" + std::to_string(p.remote_port);
                auto& c = by_key[std::to_string(p.protocol) + "|" + local + "|" + remote];
                c.protocol = p.protocol; c.local = local; c.remote = remote;
                c.packets += 1; c.bytes += std::max<uint64_t>(p.wire_len, p.payload.size());
            }
            if (!page.truncated) break;
        }
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& kv : by_key)
            arr.push_back({{"protocol", kv.second.protocol}, {"protocol_str", proto_str(kv.second.protocol)},
                           {"local", kv.second.local}, {"remote", kv.second.remote},
                           {"packets", kv.second.packets}, {"bytes", kv.second.bytes}});
        return {{"connections", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }

    if (action == "deep_inspect") {
        // per-packet application classification over the capture store
        network::capture::poll(g_traffic, 4096);
        const auto host = host_arg(args);
        const uint32_t protocol = protocol_arg(args);
        const uint32_t port     = static_cast<uint32_t>(args.value("port", 0u));
        const size_t limit      = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 200u), 2000u);
        json arr = json::array();
        uint64_t from = 0;
        for (;;) {
            auto page = g_traffic.packets(from, 1000);
            if (page.items.empty()) break;
            from = page.items.back().id;
            for (const auto& p : page.items) {
                if (arr.size() >= limit) break;
                if (host && !packet_has_host(p, *host)) continue;
                if (protocol && p.protocol != protocol) continue;
                if (port && p.local_port != port && p.remote_port != port) continue;
                if (p.payload.empty()) continue;
                json o = {{"id", p.id}, {"timestamp", p.at_ms}, {"direction", p.direction},
                          {"protocol", p.protocol},
                          {"local", p.local_addr  + ":" + std::to_string(p.local_port)},
                          {"remote", p.remote_addr + ":" + std::to_string(p.remote_port)},
                          {"payload_size", p.payload.size()}};
                const auto& b = p.payload;
                if (p.protocol == 17 && (p.local_port == 53 || p.remote_port == 53)) {
                    o["app_protocol"] = "DNS";
                    if (auto d = parse::parse_dns(b.data(), b.size())) {
                        o["dns_domain"] = d->domain;
                        if (!d->resolved_addr.empty()) o["dns_resolved"] = d->resolved_addr;
                    }
                } else if (p.protocol == 6) {
                    const size_t head_end = parse::find_head_end(b.data(), b.size());
                    const std::string_view text(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b.data()),
                                                head_end == std::string::npos ? 0 : head_end);
                    if (auto h = text.empty() ? std::nullopt : parse::parse_http_head(text, false)) {
                        o["app_protocol"] = "HTTP";
                        o["http_method"]  = parse::escape_nonprintable(h->method);
                        o["http_path"]    = parse::escape_nonprintable(h->target);
                        if (const std::string* hh = h->get("host"))
                            o["http_host"] = parse::escape_nonprintable(*hh);
                    } else if (auto r = text.empty() ? std::nullopt : parse::parse_http_head(text, true)) {
                        o["app_protocol"] = "HTTP";
                        o["http_status"]  = r->status;
                    } else if (b.size() >= 5 && (b[0] >= 20 && b[0] <= 23) && b[1] == 0x03) {
                        o["app_protocol"]     = "TLS";
                        o["tls_version"]      = tls_version_name((uint32_t(b[1]) << 8) | b[2]);
                        o["tls_content_type"] = tls_content_type_name(b[0]);
                        const std::string sni = parse::extract_sni(b.data(), b.size());
                        if (!sni.empty()) o["tls_sni"] = sni;
                    }
                } else if (p.protocol == 17 && (p.local_port == 443 || p.remote_port == 443)) {
                    // QUIC long header: version and connection ids, no decryption
                    if (auto q = parse::parse_quic(b.data(), b.size())) {
                        o["app_protocol"]  = "QUIC";
                        o["quic_version"]  = parse::quic_version_name(q->version);
                        o["quic_type"]     = parse::quic_type_name(q->type);
                        o["quic_dcid"]     = q->dcid;
                        o["quic_scid"]     = q->scid;
                    }
                }
                arr.push_back(std::move(o));
            }
            if (arr.size() >= limit || !page.truncated) break;
        }
        return {{"results", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "clear") {
        network::capture::poll(g_traffic, SIZE_MAX);
        g_traffic.clear();
        return {{"cleared", true}};
    }
    fail("network: unknown action (status|capture_start|capture_stop|packets|dns|"
         "stats|export_pcap|import_pcap|annotate|streams|stream_data|reassemble_stream|"
         "connections|deep_inspect|clear)");
}


// tool: proxy

json tool_proxy(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    if (action == "start") {
        network::proxy_options_t o;
        if (args.contains("port")) {
            const uint64_t port = parse_addr(args, "port");
            if (port > 65535) fail("port must be 0..65535");
            o.port = static_cast<uint16_t>(port);
        }
        o.bind = args.value("bind", std::string{"127.0.0.1"});
        o.allow_hosts = string_list(args, "allow_hosts");
        o.allow_clients = string_list(args, "allow_clients");
        if (args.contains("max_connections"))
            o.max_connections = static_cast<size_t>(
                std::clamp<uint64_t>(parse_addr(args, "max_connections"), 1, 1024));
        o.token = infra::settings::get<std::string>("proxy_token", "");
        o.redact_secrets = infra::settings::get<bool>("proxy_redact_secrets", true);
        std::string err;
        if (!g_proxy.start(o, &err)) fail(err);
        return {{"running", true}, {"port", g_proxy.port()}, {"bind", o.bind},
                {"token_required", !o.token.empty()}, {"allow_hosts", o.allow_hosts},
                {"allow_clients", o.allow_clients}, {"mitm", g_proxy.mitm_enabled()}};
    }
    if (action == "stop") {
        g_proxy.stop();
        return {{"running", false}};
    }
    if (action == "status") {
        const auto o = g_proxy.options();
        const auto s = g_proxy.stats();
        auto& k = pki();
        k.load_existing();
        json mitm = {{"enabled", g_proxy.mitm_enabled()},
                     {"ca_exists", k.has_ca()},
                     {"ca_path", k.has_ca() ? k.ca_path() : std::string{}},
                     {"ca_thumbprint", k.has_ca() ? k.ca_thumbprint() : std::string{}},
                     {"root_installed", k.root_installed()},
                     {"leaf_certs_issued", k.issued()},
                     {"key_storage",
                      "the CA private key is a CNG key in the Microsoft Software KSP "
                      "(DPAPI-protected per user); only the public ca.cer is written to disk "
                      "and leaf certificates stay in memory"},
                     {"uninstall_hint",
                      k.root_installed()
                          ? "proxy.mitm_uninstall removes the CA trust, the CNG keys and ca.cer"
                          : "the CA is not trusted; nothing to uninstall"}};
        return json{{"running", g_proxy.running()}, {"port", g_proxy.port()},
                    {"bind", g_proxy.running() ? o.bind : std::string{}},
                    {"token_required", g_proxy.running() && !o.token.empty()},
                    {"allow_hosts", o.allow_hosts}, {"allow_clients", o.allow_clients},
                    {"mitm", g_proxy.mitm_enabled()},
                    {"mitm_state", mitm},
                    {"redact_secrets", o.redact_secrets},
                    {"active_connections", s.active_connections},
                    {"total_connections", s.total_connections},
                    {"rejected", {{"capacity", s.rejected_capacity}, {"auth", s.rejected_auth},
                                  {"host", s.rejected_host}, {"client", s.rejected_client}}},
                    {"log_entries", s.log_entries}, {"log_bytes", s.log_bytes}};
    }
    if (action == "entries") {
        auto entries = g_proxy.recent(std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 100u), 512u));
        const std::string kind = args.value("kind", std::string{});
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& e : entries)
            if (kind.empty() || e.kind == kind) arr.push_back(entry_summary(e));
        return {{"entries", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "entry") {
        const uint64_t id = parse_addr(args, "id");
        auto e = g_proxy.entry(id);
        if (!e) fail("unknown entry id");
        json o = entry_summary(*e);
        o["request_truncated"] = e->request_truncated;
        // A redacted entry stores only the masked form; reveal:true returns the
        // unmasked request kept in memory, and stays redacted for the audit log.
        const bool reveal = args.value("reveal", false);
        std::vector<uint8_t> raw = e->raw_request;
        if (reveal && e->redacted) {
            auto kept = g_proxy.raw_request(id);
            if (!kept.empty()) raw = std::move(kept);
        }
        o["redacted"] = e->redacted && !reveal;
        if (!raw.empty()) {
            const size_t n = std::min<size_t>(raw.size(), 4096);
            std::string head = printable(raw.data(), n);
            o["request_text"] = reveal ? head : network::redact::http_head(head);
            o["request_bytes_captured"] = raw.size();
        }
        if (!e->response_head.empty()) {
            std::string head = printable(e->response_head.data(),
                                         std::min<size_t>(e->response_head.size(), 4096));
            o["response_head_text"] = reveal ? head : network::redact::http_head(head);
        }
        return o;
    }
    if (action == "replay") {
        std::string err;
        const int timeout = static_cast<int>(std::clamp<uint64_t>(
            args.contains("timeout_ms") ? parse_addr(args, "timeout_ms") : 15000, 1000, 60000));
        const bool with_secrets = args.value("with_secrets", false);
        auto r = g_proxy.replay(parse_addr(args, "id"), &err, timeout, with_secrets);
        if (!r) fail(err);
        const size_t n = std::min<size_t>(r->bytes.size(), 16384);
        json out = {{"status", r->status}, {"bytes", r->bytes.size()}, {"complete", r->complete},
                    {"truncated", r->truncated}, {"text_truncated", r->bytes.size() > n},
                    {"with_secrets", with_secrets},
                    {"text", printable(r->bytes.data(), n)}};
        if (!r->note.empty()) out["note"] = r->note;
        return out;
    }
    if (action == "clear") {
        g_proxy.clear_log();
        return {{"cleared", true}};
    }
    if (action == "mitm_status") return mitm_status_json();
    if (action == "mitm_enable") {
        if (!args.contains("consent") || !args.at("consent").is_boolean() ||
            !args.at("consent").get<bool>())
            fail("mitm_enable decrypts TLS inside proxy tunnels with a locally generated CA and "
                 "(unless install_root=false) adds that CA to CurrentUser\\ROOT, which Windows "
                 "confirms with its own dialog. Pass consent:true after the user agreed");
        auto& k = pki();
        std::string err;
        if (!k.ensure_ca(&err)) fail("CA setup failed: " + err);
        if (args.value("install_root", true) && !k.root_installed() && !k.install_root(&err))
            fail(err);
        g_proxy.set_mitm(pki_slot());
        json out = mitm_status_json();
        out["note"] = "clients must trust the CA (ca_path) for interception to succeed; "
                      "untrusting clients fail their TLS handshake and are logged with an error";
        return out;
    }
    if (action == "mitm_disable") {
        g_proxy.set_mitm(nullptr);
        return mitm_status_json();
    }
    if (action == "mitm_uninstall") {
        g_proxy.set_mitm(nullptr);
        auto& k = pki();
        std::string err;
        const bool ok = k.destroy(&err);
        std::string legacy_err;
        const size_t legacy = network::mitm::remove_legacy_artifacts(&legacy_err);
        if (!ok) fail("uninstall incomplete: " + err);
        json out = mitm_status_json();
        out["uninstalled"] = true;
        out["legacy_artifacts_removed"] = legacy;
        if (!legacy_err.empty()) out["legacy_error"] = legacy_err;
        return out;
    }

    fail("proxy: unknown action (start|stop|status|entries|entry|replay|clear|mitm_status|"
         "mitm_enable|mitm_disable|mitm_uninstall)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_patch.cpp
// tool: patch

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {


// tool: patch

json tool_patch(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    if (!ds::has_binary()) fail("no image loaded in reverse-slop (see disasm.loaded)");

    ds::binary_lock_t lk;
    auto& bin = ds::get();
    if (action == "nop_junk" || action == "resolve_opaque" ||
        action == "patch_antidebug" || action == "decode_strings" ||
        action == "full_pass" || action == "rebuild")
        require_x86_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "patch." + action);
    if (action == "patch_antidebug" || action == "full_pass")
        require_pe_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "patch." + action);

    imgpatch::op_result_t r;

    if (action == "nop_junk") {
        const uint64_t fn_va = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        r = imgpatch::nop_junk(bin, fn_va,
                               args.value("aggressive", false),
                               static_cast<size_t>(args.value("nop_threshold", 4u)));
    } else if (action == "resolve_opaque") {
        r = imgpatch::resolve_opaque_predicates(bin, parse_addr(args, "addr"),
                                                args.value("dry_run", false));
    } else if (action == "patch_antidebug") {
        imgpatch::anti_debug_opts_t opts;
        opts.patch_api_calls = args.value("patch_api_calls", true);
        opts.patch_int_traps = args.value("patch_int_traps", true);
        opts.patch_timing    = args.value("patch_timing", true);
        // Per-function operation: no addr scans the entry-point function.
        const bool defaulted_addr = !args.contains("addr");
        const uint64_t ad_va = defaulted_addr
            ? bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva
            : parse_addr(args, "addr");
        r = imgpatch::patch_anti_debug(bin, ad_va, opts,
                                       args.value("dry_run", false));
        if (defaulted_addr) r.note = "no addr given: scanned entry-point function";
    } else if (action == "unpack_xor") {
        const std::string method = args.value("method", std::string{"auto"});
        if (method == "auto")
            require_x86_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "patch.unpack_xor (method=auto)");
        const uint64_t va = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        size_t size = args.contains("size")
            ? static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr(args, "size"))
            : 4096;
        r = imgpatch::unpack_xor(bin, va, size,
                                 method,
                                 args.value("key_hex", std::string{}));
    } else if (action == "decode_strings") {
        r = imgpatch::decode_strings(bin, parse_addr(args, "addr"));
    } else if (action == "write_bytes") {
        if (!args.contains("hex")) fail("missing hex payload");
        r = imgpatch::write_bytes(bin, parse_addr(args, "addr"),
                                  hex_decode(args.at("hex").get<std::string>()));
    } else if (action == "revert_all") {
        r = imgpatch::revert_all(bin);
    } else if (action == "journal") {
        json arr = json::array();
        const size_t cap = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 100u), bin.patches.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < cap; ++i) {
            const auto& p = bin.patches[i];
            arr.push_back({{"va", p.va}, {"before", p.before}, {"after", p.after}});
        }
        return {{"patches", arr}, {"total", bin.patches.size()},
                {"indexes_dirty", bin.indexes_dirty}};
    } else if (action == "full_pass") {
        auto fp_r = imgpatch::full_pass(bin, parse_addr(args, "addr"),
                                        args.value("dry_run", false));
        if (!fp_r.ok) fail(fp_r.error);
        json steps = json::array();
        for (const auto& s : fp_r.steps)
            steps.push_back({{"step", s.name}, {"success", s.success},
                             {"note", s.note}});
        return {{"ok", true},
                {"dry_run", fp_r.dry_run},
                {"steps", steps},
                {"pre_obfuscation_score", fp_r.pre_score},
                {"post_obfuscation_score", fp_r.post_score},
                {"score_reduction", fp_r.pre_score - fp_r.post_score},
                {"strings_found", fp_r.strings_found},
                {"bytes_changed", fp_r.bytes_changed},
                {"journal_total", bin.patches.size()}};
    } else if (action == "rebuild") {
        auto rb_r = imgpatch::rebuild(bin, parse_addr(args, "addr"));
        if (!rb_r.ok) fail(rb_r.error);
        json insns = json::array();
        for (const auto& [va, text] : rb_r.insns)
            insns.push_back({{"va", va}, {"text", text}});
        return {{"ok", true},
                {"instruction_count", rb_r.instruction_count},
                {"insns", insns},
                {"indexes_dirty", bin.indexes_dirty}};
    } else {
        fail("patch: unknown action (nop_junk|resolve_opaque|patch_antidebug|"
             "unpack_xor|decode_strings|write_bytes|revert_all|journal|"
             "full_pass|rebuild)");
    }

    if (!r.ok) fail(r.error);
    json pats = json::array();
    for (const auto& p : r.patches) {
        json o = {{"va", p.va}, {"action", p.action}};
        if (!p.detail.empty()) o["detail"] = p.detail;
        pats.push_back(std::move(o));
    }
    json out = {{"ok", true},
                {"dry_run", r.dry_run},
                {"patches", pats},
                {"bytes_changed", r.bytes_changed},
                {"journal_total", bin.patches.size()}};
    if (r.detected_key) {
        out["detected_key"] = r.detected_key;
        out["key_confidence"] = r.key_confidence;
    }
    if (r.strings_found) out["strings_found"] = r.strings_found;
    if (!r.note.empty()) out["note"] = r.note;
    return out;
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/mcp/tools_persist.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_persist.cpp
// tool: persist (session / analysis database save and load)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

// what an MCP client may push into the app database in one call
constexpr size_t kMaxSessionBytes = 16u << 20;   // save: serialized data
constexpr size_t kMaxValueBytes   = 1u << 20;    // kv_set: value
constexpr size_t kMaxNameBytes    = 256;         // save name / kv key

void check_name(const json& args, const char* key) {
    if (args.contains(key) && args.at(key).is_string() &&
        args.at(key).get_ref<const std::string&>().size() > kMaxNameBytes)
        fail(std::string(key) + " longer than " + std::to_string(kMaxNameBytes) + " bytes");
}

void check_payload(const std::string& what, size_t bytes, size_t cap) {
    if (bytes > cap)
        fail(what + " is " + std::to_string(bytes) + " bytes; the limit is " +
             std::to_string(cap) + " (store large artifacts as files via fs and save the path)");
}

} // namespace

// tool: persist

json tool_persist(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    // size checks come first: an oversized request never touches the store
    std::string payload;
    if (action == "save") {
        if (!args.contains("name") || !args.contains("data"))
            fail("missing name/data");
        check_name(args, "name");
        payload = args.at("data").dump(-1, ' ', false, json::error_handler_t::replace);
        check_payload("data", payload.size(), kMaxSessionBytes);
    } else if (action == "kv_set") {
        if (!args.contains("key") || !args.contains("value"))
            fail("missing key/value");
        check_name(args, "key");
        const json& v = args.at("value");
        payload = v.is_string() ? v.get<std::string>() : v.dump();
        check_payload("value", payload.size(), kMaxValueBytes);
    }

    // one store per process, opened on first use
    static persist::session_store_t store;
    static bool store_open = false;
    if (!store_open) {
        std::string err;
        if (!store.open(persist::default_store_path(), &err))
            fail("store open failed: " + err);
        store_open = true;
    }

    if (action == "save") {
        auto id = store.save_session(args.at("name").get<std::string>(), payload);
        if (!id) fail("save failed");
        return {{"saved", true}, {"id", *id}, {"bytes", payload.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "list") {
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& m : store.list_sessions())
            arr.push_back({{"id", m.id}, {"name", m.name},
                           {"created_at", m.created_at}});
        return {{"sessions", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "load") {
        auto row = store.load_session(parse_addr(args, "id"));
        if (!row) fail("unknown session id");
        json data = json::parse(row->data, nullptr, false);
        return {{"id", row->id}, {"name", row->name},
                {"created_at", row->created_at},
                {"data", data.is_discarded() ? json(row->data) : data}};
    }
    if (action == "delete") {
        if (!store.delete_session(parse_addr(args, "id")))
            fail("unknown session id");
        return {{"deleted", true}};
    }
    if (action == "kv_set") {
        if (!store.kv_set(args.at("key").get<std::string>(), payload))
            fail("kv_set failed");
        return {{"set", true}};
    }
    if (action == "kv_get") {
        auto v = store.kv_get(args.value("key", ""));
        if (!v) fail("no value for key");
        json parsed = json::parse(*v, nullptr, false);
        return {{"value", parsed.is_discarded() ? json(*v) : parsed}};
    }

    // hyperion project files (.hdb, see core/database/database.h): save
    // writes names, comments, functions, xrefs, types and applied types;
    // load validates the project and merges all of it into the live DB

    if (action == "hype_save") {
        if (!args.contains("dir") || !args.at("dir").is_string())
            fail("missing dir (project directory to write)");
        std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready || !bin.hype || !bin.hype->ready())
            fail("no analyzed image loaded (see disasm.loaded)");
        hype::Database dbio;
        const std::string dir = args.at("dir").get<std::string>();
        std::string err;
        if (!dbio.save(dir, bin.hype->image(), bin.hype->db(), &err))
            fail("hype_save failed: " + err);
        const auto& db = bin.hype->db();
        return {{"ok", true}, {"dir", dir}, {"version", hype::Database::kVersion},
                {"names", db.names.size()},
                {"comments", db.comments.size()},
                {"functions", db.funcs.size()},
                {"xrefs", db.xrefs.size()},
                {"types", db.types.all().size()},
                {"applied_types", db.applied_types.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "hype_load") {
        if (!args.contains("dir") || !args.at("dir").is_string())
            fail("missing dir (project directory to read)");
        std::lock_guard lk(ds::state_mutex());
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready || !bin.hype || !bin.hype->ready())
            fail("no analyzed image loaded to merge into (see disasm.loaded)");
        const std::string dir = args.at("dir").get<std::string>();
        hype::PEImage  img{};
        hype::AnalysisDB loaded;
        hype::Database dbio;
        std::string err;
        if (!dbio.load(dir, img, loaded, &err)) fail("hype_load failed: " + err);
        json out = {{"ok", true}, {"dir", dir}};
        if (img.base != bin.hype->image().base)
            out["warning"] = "project base differs from the loaded image; VAs merged as saved";
        const auto st = hype::Database::merge(loaded, bin.hype->db_mut());
        out["merged_names"] = st.names;
        out["merged_comments"] = st.comments;
        out["merged_functions"] = st.functions;
        out["merged_xrefs"] = st.xrefs;
        out["merged_types"] = st.types;
        out["merged_applied_types"] = st.applied_types;
        return out;
    }

    fail("persist: unknown action (save|list|load|delete|kv_set|kv_get|"
         "hype_save|hype_load)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/mcp/tools_re.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_re.cpp
// tool: re (rtti, vtables, danger imports, libsig, symbols)

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include "core/loader/elf_loader.h"

#include <cstring>

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {


// tool: re

json tool_re(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    // app loaded binary unless a path is given
    std::optional<ds::binary_lock_t> shared_lock;
    disasm::pe_image_t const*   pe   = nullptr;
    std::vector<uint8_t> const* file = nullptr;
    disasm::function_index_t*   fidx = nullptr;
    disasm::xref_index_t*       xidx = nullptr;
    uint64_t                    session_base = 0;   // VA base of the source
    const hype::AnalysisDB*     hdb  = nullptr;     // hyperion DB when analyzed
    disasm::image_format_t format = disasm::image_format_t::pe;
    disasm::image_arch_t arch = disasm::image_arch_t::x64;
    const bool have_path = args.contains("path") && args.at("path").is_string();

    if (have_path) {
        auto& img = load_image(args.at("path").get<std::string>());
        format = img.format;
        arch = img.arch;
        if (action == "danger")
            require_x86_image(arch, format, "re.danger", true);
        pe = &img.pe; file = &img.file; fidx = &img.fidx; xidx = &img.xidx;
        session_base = pe->image_base;
        // signature matching needs bounds, not decoding; import callsites
        // need the legacy x86 xref index when there is no hyperion session
        if (action == "libsig" && !img.fidx_ok) {
            if (arch == disasm::image_arch_t::x86 || arch == disasm::image_arch_t::x64) {
                auto& eng = shared_engine();
                if (!eng.ok() && !eng.init()) fail("zydis engine init failed");
                if (!fidx->build(*pe, *file, eng, session_base))
                    fail("function index build failed");
            } else if (!fidx->build_from_bounds(*pe, *file, session_base)) {
                fail("function bounds index build failed");
            }
            img.fidx_ok = true;
        }
        if (action == "danger" && !img.xidx_ok) {
            auto& eng = shared_engine();
            if (!eng.ok() && !eng.init()) fail("zydis engine init failed");
            if (!xidx->build(*pe, *file, eng, session_base))
                fail("xref index build failed");
            img.xidx_ok = true;
        }
    } else {
        shared_lock.emplace();
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready)
            fail("no image: pass 'path' or load a binary in reverse-slop");
        format = bin.format;
        arch = bin.arch;
        if (bin.indexes_dirty && (action == "danger" || action == "libsig"))
            ds::rebuild_indexes_locked(bin);
        pe = &bin.pe; file = &bin.file; fidx = &bin.fns; xidx = &bin.xrefs;
        session_base = bin.base;
        if (bin.hype && bin.hype->ready()) hdb = &bin.hype->db();
    }
    const uint64_t base = args.contains("base")
        ? parse_addr(args, "base")
        : session_base;
    (void)base;

    if (action == "rtti_scan") {
        // MSVC RTTI on x86/x64 PE; Itanium (clang/gcc) RTTI on ELF/SELF of any
        // arch the hyperion loader maps
        const bool itanium = format == disasm::image_format_t::elf ||
                             format == disasm::image_format_t::self;
        if (!itanium) {
            require_x86_image(arch, format, "re.rtti_scan", have_path);
            require_pe_image(arch, format, "re.rtti_scan", have_path);
        }
        // Case-insensitive substring filter over mangled + demangled names,
        // plus limit/total so 600-class dumps stop truncating the session.
        const std::string filter = args.value("filter", std::string{});
        auto match_filter = [&](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
            return filter.empty() || icontains(a, filter) || icontains(b, filter);
        };
        const size_t rtti_limit =
            std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 500u), 10000u);
        const char* abi = itanium ? "itanium" : "msvc";
        // hyperion rtti beats the quick scanner when its ready
        // the lock above already pins the session
        if (!args.contains("path")) {
            auto& bin = ds::get();
            if (bin.ready && bin.hype && bin.hype->ready()) {
                const auto& classes = bin.hype->rtti().classes();
                json arr = json::array();
                size_t matched = 0;
                for (const auto& c : classes) {
                    const std::string shown = c.demangled_name.empty()
                                                  ? c.mangled_name
                                                  : c.demangled_name;
                    if (!match_filter(shown, c.mangled_name)) continue;
                    ++matched;
                    if (arr.size() >= rtti_limit) continue;
                    json methods = json::array();
                    for (auto m : c.methods) methods.push_back(m);
                    json e = {{"name", shown},
                              {"mangled", c.mangled_name},
                              {"td_va", c.type_descriptor},
                              {"vtable_va", c.vtable},
                              {"methods", methods},
                              {"method_count", c.methods.size()}};
                    if (itanium) e["bases"] = c.bases;
                    arr.push_back(std::move(e));
                }
                json out = {{"engine", "hyperion"}, {"abi", abi}, {"classes", arr},
                            {"count", arr.size()}, {"total", matched}};
                if (!filter.empty()) out["filter"] = filter;
                if (matched > arr.size()) out["truncated"] = true;
                return out;
            }
        }
        re::rtti_result_t r;
        if (itanium) {
            const unsigned ptr_size = (arch == disasm::image_arch_t::x64 ||
                                       arch == disasm::image_arch_t::arm64) ? 8 : 4;
            if (have_path && file->size() >= 4 && std::memcmp(file->data(), "\x7F" "ELF", 4) == 0) {
                // the path cache holds the ELF as read (a SELF's extracted
                // ELF too); vtable and type_info pointers only exist once
                // its relocations are applied
                std::vector<uint8_t> relocated = *file;
                hype::ELFLoader::apply_relocations(relocated, pe->image_base);
                r = re::rtti_scan_itanium(*pe, relocated, ptr_size);
            } else {
                r = re::rtti_scan_itanium(*pe, *file, ptr_size);
            }
        } else {
            r = re::rtti_scan(*pe, *file);
        }
        json arr = json::array();
        size_t matched = 0;
        for (const auto& c : r.classes) {
            if (!match_filter(c.name, c.mangled.empty() ? c.name : c.mangled)) continue;
            ++matched;
            if (arr.size() >= rtti_limit) continue;
            json vfs = json::array();
            for (auto v : c.vftables) vfs.push_back(v);
            json e = {{"name", c.name}, {"td_va", c.td_va}, {"vftables", vfs}};
            if (itanium) {
                e["mangled"] = c.mangled;
                e["bases"] = c.bases;
                e["methods"] = c.methods;
                e["method_count"] = c.methods.size();
            }
            arr.push_back(std::move(e));
        }
        json rout = {{"abi", abi}, {"classes", arr}, {"count", arr.size()},
                     {"total", matched},
                     {"scanned_bytes", r.scanned_bytes}};
        if (!filter.empty()) rout["filter"] = filter;
        if (matched > arr.size()) rout["truncated"] = true;
        return rout;
    }
    if (action == "vftable") {
        if (!args.contains("path")) {
            auto& bin = ds::get();
            if (bin.ready && bin.hype && bin.hype->ready()) {
                // serve from the db when the address is indexed
                const uint64_t vva = parse_addr(args, "addr");
                for (const auto& vt : bin.hype->db().vtables) {
                    if (vt.addr != vva) continue;
                    json arr = json::array();
                    for (auto e : vt.entries) arr.push_back(e);
                    return {{"engine", "hyperion"}, {"vftable_va", vva},
                            {"targets", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
                }
                // raw read for everything else
            }
        }
        if (!args.contains("addr")) fail("missing addr");
        const uint64_t va = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        auto slots = re::read_vftable(
            *pe, *file, va,
            static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(
                args.contains("slots") ? parse_addr(args, "slots") : 32,
                256)));
        if (!slots) fail("vftable not readable in image");
        json arr = json::array();
        for (auto v : *slots) arr.push_back(v);
        return {{"vftable_va", va}, {"targets", arr},
                {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "danger") {
        if (arch != disasm::image_arch_t::x86 && arch != disasm::image_arch_t::x64 && !hdb)
            fail("re.danger requires completed hyperion analysis for this image; "
                 "wait for disasm.loaded hype.ready");
        // hyperion knows the iat refs, the legacy index covers explicit paths
        auto hits = analysis::danger_scan(
            *pe,
            [xidx, hdb](uint64_t target_va) {
                std::vector<uint64_t> out;
                if (hdb) {
                    // one instruction can emit two records, dedupe by from
                    std::set<uint64_t> seen;
                    const auto it = hdb->xrefs_to.find(target_va);
                    if (it != hdb->xrefs_to.end())
                        for (const auto& x : it->second)
                            if (seen.insert(x.from).second)
                                out.push_back(x.from);
                    return out;
                }
                for (const auto& r : xidx->refs_to(target_va))
                    out.push_back(r.from);
                return out;
            },
            session_base);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits) {
            json cs = json::array();
            for (auto c : h.callsites) cs.push_back(c);
            arr.push_back({{"function", h.function},
                           {"category", h.category},
                           {"iat_va", h.iat_va},
                           {"callsites", cs},
                           {"count", cs.size()}});
        }
        return {{"hits", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "libsig") {
        std::vector<analysis::libsig_t> sigs;
        json out = json::object();
        if (args.contains("sig_path") && args.at("sig_path").is_string()) {
            // IDA FLIRT .sig import: parsed into the same pattern matcher
            const std::string sig_path = args.at("sig_path").get<std::string>();
            std::ifstream f(sig_path, std::ios::binary);
            if (!f) fail("cannot open signature file " + sig_path);
            std::vector<uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)),
                                       std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{});
            std::string sig_err;
            auto parsed = analysis::parse_flirt_sig(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), &sig_err);
            if (!parsed) fail(sig_err.empty() ? "bad FLIRT signature file" : sig_err);
            sigs = std::move(parsed->sigs);
            out["library"]       = parsed->library;
            out["ctype"]         = parsed->ctype;
            out["flirt_version"] = parsed->version;
        } else {
            if (!args.contains("sigset")) fail("missing sigset JSON or sig_path");
            std::string sig_err;
            auto parsed = analysis::parse_sig_set(
                args.at("sigset").get<std::string>(), &sig_err);
            if (!parsed) fail(sig_err.empty() ? "bad sigset" : sig_err);
            sigs = std::move(*parsed);
        }
        auto hits = analysis::libsig_scan(*pe, *file, *fidx, sigs);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits) {
            json o = {{"name", h.sig_name}, {"va", h.va}};
            if (h.function_va) o["function_va"] = *h.function_va;
            arr.push_back(std::move(o));
        }
        out["hits"]      = arr;
        out["count"]     = arr.size();
        out["requested"] = sigs.size();
        return out;
    }

    fail("re: unknown action (rtti_scan|vftable|danger|libsig)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_script.cpp
// tool: script (lua)
//
// runs outside the tool mutex (see call_tool): the lua engine takes it per
// slop.* binding and the slop.debugger / slop.ps4 bindings go back through
// call_tool, so other tools keep answering while a script runs

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include "core/infra/paths.hpp"
#include "core/infra/settings.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

// run: code + timeout, with per-run consent for the unsafe stdlib
json script_run(const json& args, infra::cancel_token_t cancel) {
    std::string code;
    if (args.contains("code") && args.at("code").is_string())
        code = args.at("code").get<std::string>();
    if (code.empty()) fail("missing code string");

    // one clamp shared with the engine, small budgets are honoured as given
    int64_t timeout_ms = script::kDefaultTimeoutMs;
    if (auto it = args.find("timeout_ms"); it != args.end()) {
        if (it->is_number_integer())
            timeout_ms = it->get<int64_t>();
        else if (it->is_string())
            timeout_ms = static_cast<int64_t>(
                std::min<uint64_t>(parse_addr(args, "timeout_ms"), script::kMaxTimeoutMs));
        else
            fail("timeout_ms must be an integer");
    }

    // unsafe is per-run consent: script_unsafe stays the admin override, and
    // without it an agent must pass confirm:true, so a script can never widen
    // its own sandbox silently
    const bool admin_unsafe = infra::settings::get<bool>("script_unsafe", false);
    const bool want_unsafe  = args.value("unsafe", false);
    if (want_unsafe && !admin_unsafe && !args.value("confirm", false))
        fail("script.run unsafe:true needs confirm:true (per-run consent) "
             "unless the script_unsafe setting is on");

    script::lua_run_options_t opt;
    opt.timeout_ms = script::clamp_timeout_ms(timeout_ms);
    opt.unsafe     = want_unsafe || admin_unsafe;
    opt.cancel     = std::move(cancel);
    opt.tool_mutex = &tool_mutex();
    auto r = script::lua_run(code, opt);

    json out = {{"ok", r.ok},
                {"output", r.output},
                {"timeout_ms", r.timeout_ms},
                {"sandboxed", !r.unsafe},
                {"peak_mem", r.peak_mem}};
    if (r.output_truncated) out["output_truncated"] = true;
    if (!r.error.empty()) out["error"] = r.error;
    return out;
}

} // namespace

json tool_script(const json& args, infra::cancel_token_t cancel) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    if (action == "run") return script_run(args, std::move(cancel));

    if (action == "api") {
        json entries = json::array();
        for (const auto& e : script::api_entries()) {
            const std::string name = e.group.empty()
                                         ? "slop." + e.name
                                         : "slop." + e.group + "." + e.name;
            entries.push_back({{"name", name},
                               {"group", e.group},
                               {"signature", e.signature},
                               {"doc", e.doc},
                               {"callable", e.callable}});
        }
        return {{"count", entries.size()}, {"functions", std::move(entries)}};
    }

    // snippets: named scripts under <app_data>\scripts
    std::string err;
    if (action == "list") {
        json items = json::array();
        for (const auto& s : script::snippet_list(err))
            items.push_back({{"name", s.name}, {"updated_ms", s.updated_ms}});
        if (!err.empty()) fail(err);
        return {{"snippets", std::move(items)}, {"dir", infra::paths::app_data() + "\\scripts"}};
    }

    const std::string name = args.value("name", std::string{});
    if (action == "save") {
        const std::string code = args.value("code", std::string{});
        if (code.empty()) fail("missing code string");
        if (!script::snippet_save(name, code, err)) fail(err);
        return {{"ok", true}, {"name", name}};
    }
    if (action == "load") {
        script::snippet_t s;
        if (!script::snippet_load(name, s, err)) fail(err);
        return {{"name", s.name}, {"code", s.code}, {"updated_ms", s.updated_ms}};
    }
    if (action == "delete") {
        if (!script::snippet_delete(name, err)) fail(err);
        return {{"ok", true}, {"name", name}};
    }
    fail("script: unknown action");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```
