`src/core/mcp/tools_types_notes.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_types_notes.cpp
// tools: types and notes

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

#include "core/network/web_fetch.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {

namespace {

// tool: types

json struct_to_json(const re::type_catalog::struct_def_t& s) {
    json fields = json::array();
    for (const auto& f : s.fields)
        fields.push_back({{"name", f.name}, {"type", f.type},
                          {"offset", f.offset}, {"size", f.size},
                          {"array_count", f.array_count}});
    return {{"name", s.name}, {"size", s.size}, {"packed", s.packed},
            {"fields", fields}};
}

json enum_to_json(const re::type_catalog::enum_def_t& e) {
    json vals = json::array();
    for (const auto& [n, v] : e.values)
        vals.push_back({{"name", n}, {"value", v}});
    return {{"name", e.name}, {"underlying", e.underlying}, {"values", vals}};
}

// --- Git-shareable annotation files (notes.export / notes.import) ---
//
// symbols/<hash>.json holds everything an analyst would want reviewed: names,
// comments, bookmarks and the struct/enum catalog. Keys are zero padded so a
// lexicographic sort is a numeric VA sort, arrays are sorted and the dump is
// indented: two sessions that changed different addresses produce a diff with
// exactly those lines in it.

constexpr const char* kSymbolsFormat = "reverse-slop-symbols";

std::string va_key(uint64_t va) {
    char k[24];
    std::snprintf(k, sizeof(k), "%016llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(va));
    return k;
}

struct notes_snapshot_t {
    uint64_t                        hash = 0;
    uint64_t                        base = 0;
    std::string                     image;
    std::map<uint64_t, std::string> names;
    std::map<uint64_t, std::string> comments;
    std::vector<uint64_t>           bookmarks;
    std::vector<re::type_catalog::struct_def_t> structs;
    std::vector<re::type_catalog::enum_def_t>   enums;
};

notes_snapshot_t snapshot_notes() {
    notes_snapshot_t s;
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& b = ds::get();
        s.hash = b.file_hash;
        s.base = b.base;
        s.image = b.name;
        s.names.insert(b.symbols.begin(), b.symbols.end());
        s.comments.insert(b.comments.begin(), b.comments.end());
        s.bookmarks = b.bookmarks;
    }
    s.structs = re::type_catalog::list_structs();   // sorted by name
    s.enums   = re::type_catalog::list_enums();
    return s;
}

json notes_doc(const notes_snapshot_t& s) {
    json names = json::object();
    for (const auto& [va, name] : s.names) names[va_key(va)] = name;
    json comments = json::object();
    for (const auto& [va, text] : s.comments) comments[va_key(va)] = text;
    std::vector<uint64_t> marks = s.bookmarks;
    std::sort(marks.begin(), marks.end());
    marks.erase(std::unique(marks.begin(), marks.end()), marks.end());
    json bookmarks = json::array();
    for (uint64_t va : marks) bookmarks.push_back(va_key(va));
    json structs = json::array();
    for (const auto& st : s.structs) structs.push_back(struct_to_json(st));
    json enums = json::array();
    for (const auto& e : s.enums) enums.push_back(enum_to_json(e));
    return {{"format", kSymbolsFormat},
            {"version", 1},
            {"image", {{"hash", va_key(s.hash)},
                       {"base", va_key(s.base)},
                       {"name", s.image}}},
            {"names", names},
            {"comments", comments},
            {"bookmarks", bookmarks},
            {"structs", structs},
            {"enums", enums}};
}

std::string notes_file_path(const std::string& dir, uint64_t hash) {
    return (std::filesystem::path(dir) / "symbols" / (va_key(hash) + ".json")).string();
}

std::optional<re::type_catalog::struct_def_t> struct_from_json(const json& j) {
    if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains("name") || !j.at("name").is_string()) return std::nullopt;
    re::type_catalog::struct_def_t s;
    s.name   = j.at("name").get<std::string>();
    s.packed = j.value("packed", false);
    if (j.contains("fields") && j.at("fields").is_array())
        for (const auto& f : j.at("fields")) {
            re::type_catalog::field_t fld;
            fld.name = f.value("name", std::string{});
            fld.type = f.value("type", std::string{});
            fld.offset = f.value("offset", 0ull);   // create_struct re-lays out
            fld.size = f.value("size", 0ull);
            fld.array_count = f.value("array_count", 0u);
            if (!fld.name.empty() && !fld.type.empty()) s.fields.push_back(std::move(fld));
        }
    return s;
}

std::optional<re::type_catalog::enum_def_t> enum_from_json(const json& j) {
    if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains("name") || !j.at("name").is_string()) return std::nullopt;
    re::type_catalog::enum_def_t e;
    e.name = j.at("name").get<std::string>();
    e.underlying = j.value("underlying", std::string{"u32"});
    if (j.contains("values") && j.at("values").is_array())
        for (const auto& v : j.at("values"))
            if (v.is_object() && v.contains("name") && v.at("name").is_string())
                e.values.emplace_back(v.at("name").get<std::string>(),
                                      v.value("value", static_cast<int64_t>(0)));
    return e;
}

// apply an annotation document to the session; shared by notes.import (a file
// an analyst committed) and notes.pull (the same file fetched from a shared
// symbol store). mode: ours = only fill gaps, theirs = the document wins,
// union = sets merge and local text stays.
json merge_notes_doc(const json& doc, const std::string& mode) {
    const bool theirs = mode == "theirs";
    size_t n_names = 0, n_comments = 0, n_marks = 0, n_structs = 0, n_enums = 0;
    auto for_each_entry = [&](const char* key, auto&& apply) {
        if (!doc.contains(key) || !doc.at(key).is_object()) return;
        for (auto it = doc.at(key).begin(); it != doc.at(key).end(); ++it) {
            if (!it.value().is_string()) continue;
            const uint64_t va = std::strtoull(it.key().c_str(), nullptr, 16);
            if (va) apply(va, it.value().get_ref<const std::string&>());
        }
    };
    for_each_entry("names", [&](uint64_t va, const std::string& name) {
        const std::string have = ds::symbol_name(va);
        if (have == name || (!theirs && !have.empty())) return;
        ds::set_symbol(va, name);
        ++n_names;
    });
    for_each_entry("comments", [&](uint64_t va, const std::string& text) {
        const std::string have = ds::comment_for(va);
        if (have == text || (!theirs && !have.empty())) return;
        ds::set_comment(va, text);
        ++n_comments;
    });
    if (doc.contains("bookmarks") && doc.at("bookmarks").is_array())
        for (const auto& v : doc.at("bookmarks")) {
            if (!v.is_string()) continue;
            const uint64_t va = std::strtoull(v.get_ref<const std::string&>().c_str(),
                                              nullptr, 16);
            if (va && !ds::is_bookmarked(va)) {
                ds::toggle_bookmark(va);
                ++n_marks;
            }
        }
    if (doc.contains("structs") && doc.at("structs").is_array())
        for (const auto& j : doc.at("structs")) {
            auto def = struct_from_json(j);
            if (!def) continue;
            const bool exists = re::type_catalog::get_struct(def->name).has_value();
            if (exists && !theirs) continue;
            if (exists) re::type_catalog::remove_struct(def->name);
            std::string err;
            if (re::type_catalog::create_struct(std::move(*def), &err)) ++n_structs;
        }
    if (doc.contains("enums") && doc.at("enums").is_array())
        for (const auto& j : doc.at("enums")) {
            auto def = enum_from_json(j);
            if (!def) continue;
            const bool exists = re::type_catalog::get_enum(def->name).has_value();
            if (exists && !theirs) continue;
            if (exists) re::type_catalog::remove_enum(def->name);
            std::string err;
            if (re::type_catalog::create_enum(std::move(*def), &err)) ++n_enums;
        }
    return {{"names", n_names},
            {"comments", n_comments},
            {"bookmarks", n_marks},
            {"structs", n_structs},
            {"enums", n_enums}};
}

} // namespace


json tool_types(const json& args) {
    namespace tc = re::type_catalog;
    const std::string action = require_action(args);

    // every mutation bumps the catalog generation; tell the UI so it can
    // refresh rendered types and decompiled functions
    const auto publish_types_changed = [] {
        slop::core::infra::event_bus::publish(
            "types.changed", {{"generation", tc::generation()}});
    };

    if (action == "create_struct" || action == "declare") {
        std::string decl_text;
        if (args.contains("decl") && args.at("decl").is_string())
            decl_text = args.at("decl").get<std::string>();
        else if (args.contains("name") && args.at("name").is_string())
            decl_text = "struct " + args.at("name").get<std::string>() + " {};";

        tc::decl_parse_result_t pr = tc::parse_decls(decl_text);
        if (!pr.error.empty()) fail(pr.error);
        size_t n = 0;
        std::string errs;
        for (auto& s : pr.structs)
            if (tc::create_struct(std::move(s), &errs)) ++n;
        for (auto& e : pr.enums)
            if (tc::create_enum(std::move(e), &errs)) ++n;
        if (n == 0) fail(errs.empty() ? "nothing declared" : errs);
        publish_types_changed();
        return {{"declared", n}};
    }

    if (action == "get_struct") {
        auto s = tc::get_struct(args.at("name").get<std::string>());
        if (!s) fail("unknown struct");
        return struct_to_json(*s);
    }
    if (action == "list_structs") {
        auto all = tc::list_structs(args.value("filter", std::string{}));
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& s : all) arr.push_back(struct_to_json(s));
        return {{"structs", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "add_member") {
        tc::field_t f;
        f.name  = args.at("field").get<std::string>();
        f.type  = args.at("type").get<std::string>();
        f.array_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(args.value("array_count", 0u));
        std::string err;
        if (!tc::add_member(args.at("name").get<std::string>(), f, &err)) fail(err);
        publish_types_changed();
        auto s = tc::get_struct(args.at("name").get<std::string>());
        return struct_to_json(*s);
    }
    if (action == "remove_struct") {
        const bool removed = tc::remove_struct(args.at("name").get<std::string>());
        if (removed) publish_types_changed();
        return {{"removed", removed}};
    }

    if (action == "create_enum") {
        tc::enum_def_t e;
        e.name = args.at("name").get<std::string>();
        e.underlying = args.value("underlying", std::string{"u32"});
        for (const auto& v : args.at("values")) {
            int64_t val = 0;
            const json& jv = v.contains("value") ? v.at("value") : json();
            if (jv.is_number_integer()) val = jv.get<int64_t>();
            else if (jv.is_string())    val = static_cast<int64_t>(std::stoull(jv.get<std::string>(), nullptr, 0));
            e.values.emplace_back(v.at("name").get<std::string>(), val);
        }
        std::string err;
        if (!tc::create_enum(std::move(e), &err)) fail(err);
        publish_types_changed();
        return {{"created", true}};
    }
    if (action == "get_enum") {
        auto e = tc::get_enum(args.at("name").get<std::string>());
        if (!e) fail("unknown enum");
        return enum_to_json(*e);
    }
    if (action == "list_enums") {
        auto all = tc::list_enums(args.value("filter", std::string{}));
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& e : all) arr.push_back(enum_to_json(e));
        return {{"enums", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "remove_enum") {
        const bool removed = tc::remove_enum(args.at("name").get<std::string>());
        if (removed) publish_types_changed();
        return {{"removed", removed}};
    }

    if (action == "format_at") {
        // pretty print typed memory like MYSTRUCT @ 140001234
        if (!args.contains("addr")) fail("missing addr");
        if (!args.contains("type") && !args.contains("struct"))
            fail("missing type (struct or enum name)");
        const std::string type_name =
            args.value("type", args.value("struct", std::string{}));
        const uint64_t base = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        const size_t   want =
            static_cast<size_t>(args.value("size", 256u)) & 0xFFFF;

        // sync the catalog into a hyperion type system per call, theyre small
        hype::TypeSystem ts;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, uint32_t> ids;
        for (const auto& e : tc::list_enums()) {
            const uint32_t id = ts.add_enum(e.name);
            for (const auto& [n, v] : e.values) ts.add_member(id, n, v);
            ids[e.name] = id;
        }
        for (const auto& s : tc::list_structs()) {
            const uint32_t id = ts.add_struct(s.name,
                static_cast<uint32_t>(s.size ? s.size : 1));
            ids[s.name] = id;
        }
        // second pass so struct to struct references resolve
        for (const auto& s : tc::list_structs()) {
            for (const auto& f : s.fields) {
                uint32_t tid = 0;
                auto it = ids.find(f.type);
                if (it != ids.end()) {
                    tid = it->second;
                } else {
                    // map catalog names to hyperion builtins
                    static const std::unordered_map<std::string, const char*> prim = {
                        {"u8", "u8"}, {"u16", "u16"}, {"u32", "u32"}, {"u64", "u64"},
                        {"i8", "i8"}, {"i16", "i16"}, {"i32", "i32"}, {"i64", "i64"},
                        {"f32", "float"}, {"f64", "double"},
                        {"ptr", "ptr64"}, {"char", "char"},
                    };
                    auto pit = prim.find(f.type);
                    const char* pname = pit != prim.end() ? pit->second : "u8";
                    if (const auto* td = ts.find_by_name(pname)) tid = td->id;
                }
                ts.add_field(ids[s.name], f.name, tid,
                             static_cast<uint32_t>(f.offset));
            }
        }
        const auto* td = ts.find_by_name(type_name);
        if (!td) fail("unknown type: " + type_name);

        // live target when asked, else the file image
        std::vector<uint8_t> buf(want);
        std::string source = "file";
        bool got = false;
        if (args.value("live", false)) {
            if (auto sess = process::active_session(); sess && sess->valid()) {
                auto io = sess->read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(base), buf.data(),
                                     buf.size());
                if (io.ok && io.bytes) {
                    buf.resize(io.bytes);
                    got = true;
                    source = "live";
                }
            }
            if (!got) fail("live read failed (target attached?)");
        } else {
            ds::binary_lock_t lk;
            auto& bin = ds::get();
            if (bin.ready) {
                if (auto off = bin.offset_of(base)) {
                    const size_t n = std::min(want, bin.file.size() - *off);
                    std::memcpy(buf.data(), bin.file.data() + *off, n);
                    buf.resize(n);
                    got = true;
                }
            }
            if (!got)
                fail("address not mapped in loaded image (load a binary or "
                     "pass live=true with a target attached)");
        }

        return {{"ok", true}, {"addr", base}, {"type", type_name},
                {"source", source},
                {"rendered", ts.format_at(base, td->id, buf.data(),
                                          buf.size())}};
    }

    if (action == "read_field") {
        auto s = tc::get_struct(args.at("struct").get<std::string>());
        if (!s) fail("unknown struct");
        const uint64_t base = parse_addr(args, "addr");

        // file image first, live memory when asked
        bool live = args.value("live", false);
        if (!live) {
            ds::binary_lock_t lk;
            auto& bin = ds::get();
            if (bin.ready) {
                auto off = bin.offset_of(base);
                if (off) {
                    auto v = tc::read_field(*s, args.at("field").get<std::string>(),
                                            0 /*offset already translated*/,
                                            bin.file.data() + *off,
                                            bin.file.size() - *off,
                                            nullptr, nullptr);
                    if (v.ok) return {{"ok", true}, {"hex", v.hex},
                                      {"uint", v.uint_val}, {"int", v.int_val},
                                      {"double", v.dbl_val}, {"source", "file"}};
                }
            }
        }
        auto sess = process::active_session();
        if (!live || !sess || !sess->valid())
            fail("no image data for that address (attach a target or use a mapped VA)");

        struct cb_ctx { runtime::session_t* s; } ctx{sess.get()};
        auto cb = [](uint64_t addr, void* dst, size_t len, void* user) -> bool {
            auto* c = static_cast<cb_ctx*>(user);
            auto io = c->s->read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), dst, len);
            return io.ok && io.bytes == len;
        };
        auto v = tc::read_field(*s, args.at("field").get<std::string>(),
                                base, nullptr, 0, cb, &ctx);
        if (!v.ok) fail(v.error);
        return {{"ok", true}, {"hex", v.hex}, {"uint", v.uint_val},
                {"int", v.int_val}, {"double", v.dbl_val}, {"source", "target"}};
    }

    fail("types: unknown action (declare|create_struct|get_struct|list_structs|"
         "add_member|remove_struct|create_enum|get_enum|list_enums|remove_enum|"
         "read_field|format_at)");
}


// tool: notes

json tool_notes(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    if (!ds::has_binary()) fail("no image loaded in reverse-slop (see disasm.loaded)");

    if (action == "set_comment") {
        const uint64_t va = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        const std::string text = args.value("text", std::string{});
        ds::set_comment(va, text);          // saved, empty clears
        return {{"va", va}, {"cleared", text.empty()}};
    }
    if (action == "get_comment") {
        const uint64_t va = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        return {{"va", va}, {"comment", ds::comment_for(va)}};
    }
    if (action == "comments") {
        auto snaps = ds::comments_snapshot();
        std::sort(snaps.begin(), snaps.end());
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& [va, text] : snaps)
            arr.push_back({{"va", va}, {"comment", text}});
        return {{"comments", arr}, {"count", arr.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "bookmark_toggle") {
        const uint64_t va = parse_addr(args, "addr");
        return {{"va", va}, {"bookmarked", ds::toggle_bookmark(va)}};
    }
    if (action == "bookmarks") {
        auto marks = ds::bookmarks_snapshot();
        std::sort(marks.begin(), marks.end());
        return {{"bookmarks", marks}, {"count", marks.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "export") {
        if (!args.contains("path") || !args.at("path").is_string())
            fail("missing path (folder to write symbols/<hash>.json into)");
        const notes_snapshot_t snap = snapshot_notes();
        const std::string file = notes_file_path(args.at("path").get<std::string>(), snap.hash);
        std::error_code ec;
        std::filesystem::create_directories(
            std::filesystem::path(file).parent_path(), ec);
        if (ec) fail("cannot create " + std::filesystem::path(file).parent_path().string() +
                     ": " + ec.message());
        std::ofstream f(file, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
        if (!f) fail("cannot write " + file);
        f << notes_doc(snap).dump(2) << "\n";
        f.close();
        if (!f) fail("write failed: " + file);
        return {{"path", file},
                {"hash", va_key(snap.hash)},
                {"names", snap.names.size()},
                {"comments", snap.comments.size()},
                {"bookmarks", snap.bookmarks.size()},
                {"structs", snap.structs.size()},
                {"enums", snap.enums.size()}};
    }
    if (action == "import") {
        if (!args.contains("path") || !args.at("path").is_string())
            fail("missing path (folder holding symbols/<hash>.json)");
        const std::string mode = args.value("merge", std::string{"ours"});
        if (mode != "ours" && mode != "theirs" && mode != "union")
            fail("merge must be ours|theirs|union");
        const notes_snapshot_t snap = snapshot_notes();
        const std::string file = notes_file_path(args.at("path").get<std::string>(), snap.hash);
        std::ifstream f(file, std::ios::binary);
        if (!f) fail("no annotation file for this image: " + file);
        const json doc = json::parse(f, nullptr, false);
        if (doc.is_discarded() || !doc.is_object()) fail("not a JSON object: " + file);
        if (doc.value("format", std::string{}) != kSymbolsFormat)
            fail("not a " + std::string(kSymbolsFormat) + " file: " + file);

        const json counts = merge_notes_doc(doc, mode);
        return {{"path", file},
                {"merge", mode},
                {"names", counts.at("names")},
                {"comments", counts.at("comments")},
                {"bookmarks", counts.at("bookmarks")},
                {"structs", counts.at("structs")},
                {"enums", counts.at("enums")}};
    }
    if (action == "push" || action == "pull") {
        // shared symbol server: any HTTP endpoint that serves the same
        // symbols/<hash>.json files (a static file server, a gist mirror, a
        // small team service). The egress policy of the `web` tool applies, so
        // a LAN server needs web_allow_private or a web_allowlist entry.
        if (!args.contains("url") || !args.at("url").is_string())
            fail("missing url (base of the shared symbol store)");
        std::string base = args.at("url").get<std::string>();
        while (!base.empty() && base.back() == '/') base.pop_back();
        const notes_snapshot_t snap = snapshot_notes();
        const std::string url = base + "/symbols/" + va_key(snap.hash) + ".json";

        util::egress_policy_t policy;
        policy.allow_private = infra::settings::get<bool>("web_allow_private", false);
        const json allow = infra::settings::get_json("web_allowlist");
        if (allow.is_array())
            for (const auto& e : allow)
                if (e.is_string()) policy.allowlist.push_back(e.get<std::string>());

        std::string err;
        if (action == "push") {
            const std::string body = notes_doc(snap).dump(2) + "\n";
            auto resp = util::http_post(url, body, "application/json", policy, 15000, &err);
            if (!resp) fail("push failed: " + err);
            if (resp->status < 200 || resp->status >= 300)
                fail("push rejected: HTTP " + std::to_string(resp->status));
            return {{"pushed", true},
                    {"url", url},
                    {"status", resp->status},
                    {"bytes", body.size()},
                    {"names", snap.names.size()},
                    {"comments", snap.comments.size()},
                    {"bookmarks", snap.bookmarks.size()}};
        }
        auto resp = util::http_get(url, policy, 15000, &err);
        if (!resp) fail("pull failed: " + err);
        if (resp->status == 404) fail("no annotations for this image yet: " + url);
        if (resp->status < 200 || resp->status >= 300)
            fail("pull rejected: HTTP " + std::to_string(resp->status));
        const json doc = json::parse(resp->body, nullptr, false);
        if (doc.is_discarded() || !doc.is_object()) fail("not a JSON object: " + url);
        if (doc.value("format", std::string{}) != kSymbolsFormat)
            fail("not a " + std::string(kSymbolsFormat) + " file: " + url);
        const std::string mode = args.value("merge", std::string{"ours"});
        if (mode != "ours" && mode != "theirs" && mode != "union")
            fail("merge must be ours|theirs|union");
        const json counts = merge_notes_doc(doc, mode);
        return {{"pulled", true},
                {"url", url},
                {"merge", mode},
                {"names", counts.at("names")},
                {"comments", counts.at("comments")},
                {"bookmarks", counts.at("bookmarks")},
                {"structs", counts.at("structs")},
                {"enums", counts.at("enums")}};
    }
    fail("notes: unknown action (set_comment|get_comment|comments|"
         "bookmark_toggle|bookmarks|export|import|push|pull)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

```cpp
// src/core/mcp/tools_xray.cpp
// tool: xray

#include "core/mcp/tools_common.hpp"

namespace slop::core::mcp::detail {


// tool: xray

json tool_xray(const json& args) {
    const std::string action = require_action(args);
    const bool needs_x86 = action != "entropy" && action != "apihash";
    // anti_analysis looks for Windows debug/VM APIs; syscalls knows the NT
    // and the Orbis/FreeBSD (ELF) numbering
    const bool needs_pe = action == "anti_analysis";

    // explicit path or the app loaded binary
    std::optional<ds::binary_lock_t> shared_lock;
    xray::image_ref_t img;
    std::string img_name;
    const disasm::pe_image_t*   pe   = nullptr;
    const std::vector<uint8_t>* file = nullptr;
    uint64_t default_base = 0;
    disasm::image_format_t format = disasm::image_format_t::pe;

    if (args.contains("path") && args.at("path").is_string()) {
        auto& cache = load_image(args.at("path").get<std::string>());
        if (needs_x86) require_x86_image(cache.arch, cache.format, "xray." + action, true);
        if (needs_pe) require_pe_image(cache.arch, cache.format, "xray." + action, true);
        pe = &cache.pe; file = &cache.file;
        format = cache.format;
        default_base = cache.pe.image_base;
        const size_t slash = cache.path.find_last_of("\\/");
        img_name = (slash == std::string::npos) ? cache.path : cache.path.substr(slash + 1);
        // reuse the path cache; byte-only queries never build an x86 index
        if (needs_x86 && !cache.fidx_ok) {
            auto& eng = shared_engine();
            if (!eng.ok() && !eng.init()) fail("zydis engine init failed");
            if (!cache.fidx.build(cache.pe, cache.file, eng, default_base))
                fail("function index build failed");
            cache.fidx_ok = true;
        }
        img.fns = &cache.fidx;
    } else {
        shared_lock.emplace();
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        if (!bin.ready)
            fail("no image: pass 'path' or load a binary in reverse-slop");
        if (needs_x86) require_x86_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "xray." + action);
        if (needs_pe) require_pe_image(bin.arch, bin.format, "xray." + action);
        pe = &bin.pe; file = &bin.file;
        format = bin.format;
        default_base = bin.base;
        img_name = bin.name;
        img.fns = &bin.fns;
    }
    if (action == "syscalls" && format == disasm::image_format_t::macho)
        fail("xray.syscalls knows the Windows NT and PS4 (Orbis/FreeBSD) syscall numbering; "
             "the image is Mach-O. Load the PE or PS4 ELF to scan");
    img.pe = pe; img.file = file; img.base = default_base;
    const bool orbis = format == disasm::image_format_t::elf ||
                       format == disasm::image_format_t::self;
    img.abi = orbis ? xray::syscall_abi_t::ps4 : xray::syscall_abi_t::windows;

    if (needs_x86) {
        auto& engine = shared_engine();
        if (!engine.ok() && !engine.init()) fail("zydis engine init failed");
        img.eng = &engine;
    }

    const uint64_t base = args.contains("base")
        ? parse_addr(args, "base") : default_base;
    (void)base;

    json out;
    out["image"] = img_name;

    if (action == "cfg" || action == "complexity" || action == "cff" ||
        action == "obfuscation" || action == "strings_recon" ||
        action == "indirect_calls" || action == "anti_analysis") {
        const uint64_t fn_va = parse_addr(args, "addr");

        if (action == "cfg" || action == "complexity") {
            auto r = xray::build_cfg(img, fn_va);
            if (!r.ok) fail(r.error);
            if (action == "cfg") {
                json blocks = json::array();
                json nodes = json::array(), edges = json::array();
                for (const auto& b : r.blocks) {
                    blocks.push_back({{"start", b.start}, {"end", b.end},
                                      {"instructions", b.instructions},
                                      {"successors", b.successors}});
                    nodes.push_back({{"id", b.start}, {"start", b.start},
                                     {"end", b.end}, {"size", b.end - b.start},
                                     {"insn_count", b.instructions}});
                    for (uint64_t s : b.successors)
                        edges.push_back({{"from", b.start}, {"to", s},
                                         {"kind", s == b.end ? "fallthrough" : "branch"}});
                }
                out["blocks"] = blocks;
                out["block_count"] = r.blocks.size();
                out["graph"] = {{"nodes", nodes}, {"edges", edges}};
            } else {
                auto c = xray::function_complexity(img, fn_va);
                out["instruction_count"]  = c.instruction_count;
                out["basic_block_count"]  = c.basic_block_count;
                out["edge_count"]         = c.edge_count;
                out["cyclomatic_complexity"] = c.cyclomatic;
                out["call_count"]      = c.call_count;
                out["branch_count"]    = c.branch_count;
                out["return_count"]    = c.return_count;
                out["arithmetic_ops"]  = c.arithmetic_ops;
                out["memory_accesses"] = c.memory_accesses;
                out["string_operations"] = c.string_operations;
                out["unique_operators"] = c.unique_operators;
                out["unique_operands"]  = c.unique_operands;
                out["complexity_rating"] = c.rating;
            }
            out["edge_count"] = r.edge_count;
            out["back_edges"] = r.back_edges;
            out["cyclomatic_complexity"] = r.cyclomatic;
            return out;
        }

        if (action == "cff") {
            auto r = xray::detect_cff(img, fn_va);
            out["flattened"] = r.flattened;
            out["block_count"] = r.block_count;
            if (r.flattened) {
                out["dispatcher"] = r.dispatcher;
                out["dispatcher_backedges"] = r.dispatcher_backedges;
                out["state_variable"] = r.state_var_desc;
                json sbs = json::array();
                for (const auto& sb : r.state_blocks)
                    sbs.push_back({{"start", sb.start}, {"end", sb.end},
                                   {"next_state", sb.has_next ? json(sb.next_state) : json()},
                                   {"assign_addr", sb.assign_addr}});
                out["state_blocks"] = sbs;
                out["state_block_count"] = r.state_blocks.size();
            }
            return out;
        }

        if (action == "obfuscation") {
            // report a diagnostic when nothing decodes instead of a wall of zeros
            auto r = xray::detect_obfuscation(img, fn_va);
            json pats = json::array();
            for (const auto& p : r.patterns)
                pats.push_back({{"type", p.type}, {"address", p.address},
                                {"detail", p.detail}});
            out["patterns"] = pats;
            out["opaque_predicates"] = r.opaque_predicates;
            out["dead_heads"] = r.dead_heads;
            out["junk_sequences"] = r.junk_sequences;
            out["indirect_jumps"] = r.indirect_jumps;
            out["push_ret"] = r.push_ret;
            out["privileged"] = r.privileged;
            out["obfuscation_score_pct"] = r.score_pct;
            // check it actually decoded
            auto probe = xray::decode_range(img, fn_va, 4);
            if (probe.empty()) {
                out["warning"] = "no instructions decoded at addr, region may be "
                                 "compressed/encrypted data; obfuscation analysis "
                                 "requires decodable code";
            }
            return out;
        }

        if (action == "strings_recon") {
            auto hits = xray::string_decrypt_recon(img, fn_va);
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& h : hits) {
                json o = {{"type", h.type}, {"address", h.address}};
                if (!h.reconstructed.empty()) o["reconstructed"] = h.reconstructed;
                if (h.xor_key) o["xor_key"] = h.xor_key;
                o["length"] = h.length;
                arr.push_back(std::move(o));
            }
            out["candidates"] = arr;
            out["count"] = arr.size();
            return out;
        }

        if (action == "indirect_calls") {
            auto hits = xray::indirect_calls(img, fn_va);
            json arr = json::array();
            for (const auto& h : hits) {
                json o = {{"address", h.address}, {"text", h.text},
                          {"classification", h.classification}};
                if (!h.base_register.empty()) {
                    o["base_register"] = h.base_register;
                    o["offset"] = h.offset;
                }
                if (h.target) o["target"] = h.target;
                arr.push_back(std::move(o));
            }
            out["indirect_calls"] = arr;
            out["total"] = arr.size();
            return out;
        }

        // anti_analysis
        auto r = xray::detect_anti_analysis(img, fn_va);
        json dets = json::array();
        for (const auto& d : r.detections)
            dets.push_back({{"type", d.type}, {"address", d.address},
                            {"detail", d.detail}});
        out["detections"] = dets;
        out["anti_debug"] = r.anti_debug;
        out["anti_vm"] = r.anti_vm;
        out["timing_checks"] = r.timing_checks;
        out["traps"] = r.traps;
        out["anti_analysis_score_pct"] = r.score_pct;
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "hooks") {
        const size_t maxf = std::min<size_t>(args.value("max_functions", 500u), 10000u);
        const size_t indexed = img.fns ? img.fns->functions().size() : 0;
        std::vector<xray::hook_hit_t> hits;
        size_t checked = 0;
        std::string source = "index";
        if (indexed > 0) {
            hits = xray::detect_hooks(img, maxf);
            checked = std::min(indexed, maxf);
        } else if (shared_lock) {
            // Legacy index empty (stripped/packed headers): fall back to
            // Hyperion's recovered functions so hooks still get checked.
            auto& bin = ds::get();
            if (bin.ready && bin.hype && bin.hype->ready()) {
                std::vector<uint64_t> vas;
                vas.reserve(bin.hype->db().funcs.size());
                for (const auto& [va, hf] : bin.hype->db().funcs) {
                    (void)hf;
                    vas.push_back(va);
                }
                std::sort(vas.begin(), vas.end());
                hits = xray::detect_hooks_at(img, vas, maxf);
                checked = std::min(vas.size(), maxf);
                source = "hyperion";
            }
        }
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits)
            arr.push_back({{"address", h.address}, {"hook_type", h.hook_type},
                           {"target", h.target}, {"prologue_bytes", h.prologue_hex}});
        out["functions_checked"] = checked;
        out["hooks_found"] = hits.size();
        out["hooks"] = arr;
        out["source"] = source;
        if (checked == 0)
            out["note"] = "no functions available: legacy index empty and "
                          "hyperion not ready (wait for hype.ready or pass path)";
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "syscalls") {
        uint64_t va = args.contains("addr") ? parse_addr(args, "addr") : 0;
        size_t size = args.contains("size")
            ? static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr(args, "size")) : 0;
        auto hits = xray::detect_syscalls(img, va, size);
        const bool ps4 = img.abi == xray::syscall_abi_t::ps4;
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits) {
            json e = {{"address", h.address}, {"syscall_number", h.ssn},
                      {"pattern", h.pattern}};
            if (ps4) e["name"] = h.name.empty() ? json(nullptr) : json(h.name);
            arr.push_back(std::move(e));
        }
        out["abi"] = ps4 ? "ps4" : "windows";
        out["syscalls_found"] = hits.size();
        out["syscalls"] = arr;
        if (!ps4)
            out["note"] = "Windows SSNs differ per build; resolve them against the "
                          "matching ntdll export order";
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "apihash") {
        std::string algo = args.value("algorithm", std::string{"ror13"});
        if (algo != "ror13" && algo != "djb2" && algo != "crc32" &&
            algo != "fnv1a" && algo != "sdbm")
            fail("bad algorithm (ror13|djb2|crc32|fnv1a|sdbm)");
        // Accept both integer hashes ("0x..."/decimal/number) and plain API
        // names ("LoadLibraryA", "kernel32!CreateFileW"). Names are hashed
        // with the requested algorithm so callers never need to pre-hash.
        std::vector<uint64_t> hashes;
        json name_echo = json::array();
        auto push_hash = [&](std::vector<uint64_t>& v, const json& h) {
            if (h.is_string()) {
                const std::string s = h.get<std::string>();
                try {
                    size_t pos = 0;
                    const uint64_t num = std::stoull(s, &pos, 0);
                    if (pos == s.size()) {
                        v.push_back(num);
                        return;
                    }
                } catch (...) {}
                // not numeric: treat as an API name
                const uint32_t hv = xray::hash_api(s, algo, s.find('!') != std::string::npos);
                v.push_back(hv);
                name_echo.push_back({{"name", s}, {"hash", hv}});
                return;
            }
            if (h.is_number_unsigned()) v.push_back(h.get<uint64_t>());
            else if (h.is_number_integer() && h.get<int64_t>() >= 0)
                v.push_back(static_cast<uint64_t>(h.get<int64_t>()));
            else if (h.is_number_float())
                v.push_back(static_cast<uint64_t>(h.get<double>()));
            else fail("bad hash value (string name, hex, or integer)");
        };
        if (args.contains("hashes") && args.at("hashes").is_array())
            for (const auto& h : args.at("hashes")) push_hash(hashes, h);
        else {
            if (!args.contains("hash")) fail("missing hash/hashes");
            push_hash(hashes, args.at("hash"));
        }
        auto hits = xray::resolve_api_hashes(img, hashes, algo);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits)
            arr.push_back({{"hash", h.hash}, {"api", h.api}, {"dll", h.dll}});
        out["algorithm"] = algo;
        out["total_queried"] = hashes.size();
        out["resolved_count"] = arr.size();
        out["resolved"] = arr;
        if (!name_echo.empty()) out["name_inputs"] = name_echo;
        if (hits.empty() && !hashes.empty())
            out["hint"] = "no import matched; pass algorithm=ror13|djb2|crc32|fnv1a|sdbm "
                          "matching the sample, or pass plain API names (they are hashed for you)";
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "entropy" || action == "pages" || action == "crypto_range") {
        // accept base/va/address aliases: agents naturally say base=.
        // No address at all scans from the image base (a limit-only call
        // like pages limit=10 then works instead of erroring).
        const uint64_t va = has_any(args, {"addr", "base", "va", "address"})
            ? parse_addr_alias(args, {"addr", "base", "va", "address"})
            : default_base;
        const size_t size = has_any(args, {"size", "len", "length"})
            ? static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr_alias(args, {"size", "len", "length"})) : 4096;
        out["scan_base"] = va;
        out["scan_size"] = size;

        if (action == "entropy") {
            const size_t window = has_any(args, {"window_size", "window"})
                ? static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr_alias(args, {"window_size", "window"})) : 256;
            // honor limit as well as window_limit (zero means summary only)
            size_t win_limit = args.value("window_limit", size_t{64});
            if (args.contains("limit") && !args.contains("window_limit")) {
                const json& lv = args.at("limit");
                if (lv.is_number_unsigned()) win_limit = lv.get<size_t>();
                else if (lv.is_number_integer() && lv.get<int64_t>() >= 0)
                    win_limit = static_cast<size_t>(lv.get<int64_t>());
                else if (lv.is_string()) {
                    try { win_limit = static_cast<size_t>(std::stoull(lv.get<std::string>(), nullptr, 0)); }
                    catch (...) {}
                }
            }
            win_limit = std::min(win_limit, size_t{4096});
            auto r = xray::entropy_scan(img, va, size, window);
            out["overall_entropy"] = r.overall;
            out["min_window_entropy"] = r.min_window;
            out["max_window_entropy"] = r.max_window;
            out["window_size"] = window;
            out["verdict"] = r.verdict;
            out["truncated"] = r.truncated;
            out["total_windows"] = r.windows.size();
            json wins = json::array();
            if (win_limit > 0) {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < r.windows.size() && i < win_limit; ++i) {
                    const auto& w = r.windows[i];
                    wins.push_back({{"offset", w.offset}, {"entropy", w.entropy},
                                    {"verdict", w.verdict}});
                }
            }
            out["windows"] = wins;
            return out;
        }
        if (action == "pages") {
            const size_t ps = has_any(args, {"page_size", "window_size", "window"})
                ? static_cast<size_t>(parse_addr_alias(args, {"page_size", "window_size", "window"})) : 4096;
            const size_t page_limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 1024u), 10000u);
            auto pages = xray::classify_pages(img, va, size, ps);
            json arr = json::array();
            json summary = {{"code", 0}, {"data", 0}, {"encrypted", 0},
                            {"padding", 0}, {"mixed", 0}};
            auto bump = [&summary](const char* k) {
                summary[k] = summary[k].get<int>() + 1;
            };
            for (size_t i = 0; i < pages.size() && arr.size() < page_limit; ++i) {
                const auto& p = pages[i];
                arr.push_back({{"address", p.address}, {"size", p.size},
                               {"class", p.klass}, {"entropy", p.entropy},
                               {"insn_ratio", p.insn_ratio},
                               {"zero_ratio", p.zero_ratio},
                               {"string_ratio", p.string_ratio}});
                const std::string k = p.klass;
                if (k == "code") bump("code");
                else if (k == "padding") bump("padding");
                else if (k == "encrypted_or_compressed" ||
                         k == "single_byte_encrypted") bump("encrypted");
                else if (k == "mixed") bump("mixed");
                else bump("data");
            }
            out["total_pages"] = pages.size();
            out["summary"] = summary;
            out["pages"] = arr;
            out["count"] = arr.size();
            out["truncated"] = pages.size() > arr.size();
            return out;
        }
        // crypto_range
        const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 256u), 1000u);
        auto hits = xray::crypto_range(img, va, size, limit);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& h : hits)
            arr.push_back({{"va", h.va}, {"algorithm", h.algorithm},
                           {"constant", h.constant_name}, {"value", h.value},
                           {"source", h.source}});
        out["matches"] = arr;
        out["count"] = arr.size();
        return out;
    }

    if (action == "gadgets") {
        const size_t limit = std::min<size_t>(args.value("limit", 200u), 2000u);
        auto hits = xray::rop_gadgets(img, limit);
        json arr = json::array();
        for (const auto& g : hits)
            arr.push_back({{"address", g.address}, {"text", g.text}});
        out["gadgets"] = arr;
        out["count"] = arr.size();
        return out;
    }

    fail("xray: unknown action (cfg|complexity|cff|obfuscation|strings_recon|"
         "indirect_calls|anti_analysis|hooks|syscalls|apihash|entropy|pages|"
         "crypto_range|gadgets)");
}

} // namespace slop::core::mcp::detail
```

`src/core/memory/aob.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/aob.cpp
// aob scan, a port of the cheat engine nibble wildcard logic with chunked reads

#include "core/memory/aob.hpp"

#include "core/infra/limits.hpp"
#include "core/memory/read_util.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace slop::core::memory {

// Pattern compile

namespace {

int hex_val(char c) noexcept {
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') return c - 'a' + 10;
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') return c - 'A' + 10;
    return -1;
}

} // namespace

bool aob_pattern_t::has_wildcards() const noexcept {
    for (uint8_t m : nibble_mask)
        if (m != 0xFF) return true;
    return false;
}

std::optional<aob_pattern_t> aob_compile(std::string_view text, std::string& err) {
    err.clear();
    aob_pattern_t p;

    // Tokenize on spaces / commas
    std::vector<std::string> tokens;
    std::string cur;
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == ',') {
            if (!cur.empty()) { tokens.push_back(cur); cur.clear(); }
        } else {
            cur.push_back(c);
        }
    }
    if (!cur.empty()) tokens.push_back(cur);

    if (tokens.empty()) {
        err = "empty pattern";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    const bool has_wild = text.find('?') != std::string_view::npos ||
                          text.find('*') != std::string_view::npos;

    // Compact hex string ("DEADBEEF") only valid without wildcards
    if (tokens.size() == 1 && !has_wild) {
        std::string t = tokens[0];
        if (t.size() > 2 && (t.rfind("0x", 0) == 0 || t.rfind("0X", 0) == 0))
            t.erase(0, 2);
        const bool all_hex = !t.empty() &&
            t.find_first_not_of("0123456789abcdefABCDEF") == std::string::npos;
        if (t.size() > 2 && t.size() % 2 == 0 && all_hex) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < t.size(); i += 2) {
                p.bytes.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(
                    (hex_val(t[i]) << 4) | hex_val(t[i + 1])));
                p.nibble_mask.push_back(0xFF);
            }
            return p;
        }
    }

    for (std::string t : tokens) {
        if (t.rfind("0x", 0) == 0 || t.rfind("0X", 0) == 0) t.erase(0, 2);
        if (t.empty()) {
            err = "empty token";
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        if (t == "??" || t == "*" || t == "?") {
            p.bytes.push_back(0);
            p.nibble_mask.push_back(0x00);
            continue;
        }
        if (t.size() > 2) {
            err = "bad token '" + t + "'";
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        // Per-nibble parse: '?' or '*' = wildcard nibble
        int hi = -1, lo = -1;
        uint8_t mask = 0;
        if (t[0] == '?' || t[0] == '*') {
            mask &= 0x0F;
        } else {
            hi = hex_val(t[0]);
            if (hi < 0) { err = "bad token '" + t + "'"; return std::nullopt; }
            mask |= 0xF0;
        }
        if (t.size() == 2) {
            if (t[1] == '?' || t[1] == '*') {
                mask &= 0xF0;
            } else {
                lo = hex_val(t[1]);
                if (lo < 0) { err = "bad token '" + t + "'"; return std::nullopt; }
                mask |= 0x0F;
            }
        } else {
            mask = 0x0F; // single nibble token: low nibble only
        }
        p.bytes.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(((hi < 0 ? 0 : hi) << 4) |
                                               (lo < 0 ? 0 : lo)));
        p.nibble_mask.push_back(mask);
    }

    if (p.bytes.empty()) {
        err = "empty pattern";
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    return p;
}

bool aob_match(const aob_pattern_t& p, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) noexcept {
    // Anchored: the pattern must match at offset 0
    if (p.size() == 0 || len < p.size()) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        const uint8_t m = p.nibble_mask[i];
        if (m == 0) continue;
        if ((data[i] & m) != (p.bytes[i] & m)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool aob_contains(const aob_pattern_t& p, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) noexcept {
    if (p.size() == 0 || len < p.size()) return false;
    const size_t last = len - p.size();
    for (size_t off = 0; off <= last; ++off)
        if (aob_match(p, data + off, len - off)) return true;
    return false;
}

std::string aob_to_string(const aob_pattern_t& p) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(p.size() * 3);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        const uint8_t m = p.nibble_mask[i];
        if (m == 0xFF) {
            char buf[3];
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%02X", p.bytes[i]);
            out += buf;
        } else if (m == 0xF0) {
            char buf[3];
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%X?", (p.bytes[i] >> 4) & 0xF);
            out += buf;
        } else if (m == 0x0F) {
            char buf[3];
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "?%X", p.bytes[i] & 0xF);
            out += buf;
        } else {
            out += "??";
        }
        if (i + 1 < p.size()) out += ' ';
    }
    return out;
}

std::string aob_from_bytes(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(len * 3);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        char buf[3];
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%02X", data[i]);
        out += buf;
        if (i + 1 < len) out += ' ';
    }
    return out;
}

namespace {

// one byte in a byte-wildcard dialect: full match, nibble match or "?"
std::string sig_byte(const aob_pattern_t& p, size_t i, bool ida_style) {
    const uint8_t m = p.nibble_mask[i];
    char buf[4];
    if (m == 0xFF) {
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%02X", p.bytes[i]);
        return buf;
    }
    if (m == 0xF0) {
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%X?", (p.bytes[i] >> 4) & 0xF);
        return buf;
    }
    if (m == 0x0F) {
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "?%X", p.bytes[i] & 0xF);
        return buf;
    }
    return ida_style ? "?" : "??";
}

std::string sig_join(const aob_pattern_t& p, bool ida_style) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(p.size() * 3);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        if (i) out += ' ';
        out += sig_byte(p, i, ida_style);
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace

std::string aob_to_ida(const aob_pattern_t& p)    { return sig_join(p, true); }
std::string aob_to_x64dbg(const aob_pattern_t& p) { return sig_join(p, false); }
std::string aob_to_ce(const aob_pattern_t& p)     { return sig_join(p, false); }

aob_code_sig_t aob_to_code(const aob_pattern_t& p) {
    aob_code_sig_t out;
    out.bytes.reserve(p.size() * 4);
    out.mask.reserve(p.size() * 2);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        char buf[8];
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\\x%02X", p.bytes[i]);
        out.bytes += buf;
        // one mask char per byte, so mask[i] pairs with byte i: x = compare,
        // ? = wildcard (nibble wildcards are not exact, so they read as ?)
        out.mask += p.nibble_mask[i] == 0xFF ? 'x' : '?';
    }
    return out;
}

// Region scan

std::vector<uintptr_t> aob_scan(reader_t& r,
                                const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions,
                                const aob_pattern_t& p,
                                const aob_scan_options_t& opt,
                                const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                                aob_stats_t* stats) {
    aob_stats_t local{};
    aob_stats_t& st = stats ? *stats : local;

    std::vector<uintptr_t> matches;
    if (p.size() == 0) return matches;

    const reader_hints_t hints = r.hints();
    const size_t max_results = opt.max_results ? opt.max_results
                                               : infra::limits::max_aob_matches;
    const size_t chunk = opt.chunk_bytes ? opt.chunk_bytes
                       : hints.chunk_bytes ? hints.chunk_bytes
                                           : infra::limits::scan_chunk_bytes;
    const size_t align = std::max<size_t>(opt.alignment ? opt.alignment : 1, 1);

    // Contiguous region pairs (begin/end), honoring alignment start
    std::vector<detail::read_range_t> spans;
    for (const auto& reg : regions) {
        if (reg.size < p.size()) continue;
        const uintptr_t b = (reg.base + align - 1) / align * align;
        const uintptr_t e = reg.base + reg.size;
        if (e <= b || e - b < p.size()) continue;
        spans.push_back({b, static_cast<size_t>(e - b)});
    }

    unsigned nw = opt.threads ? opt.threads
                              : std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
    if (hints.max_workers) nw = std::min(nw, hints.max_workers);
    nw = std::max(1u, std::min(nw, 64u));
    if (!spans.empty()) nw = std::min<unsigned>(nw, static_cast<unsigned>(spans.size()));

    // Chunks carry a pattern-1 overlap tail so matches spanning chunk
    // borders are seen whole; only starts before the chunk limit count
    detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
    walk.chunk      = chunk;
    walk.overlap    = p.size() - 1;
    walk.min_leaf   = 4096;
    walk.read_ahead = hints.read_ahead;

    std::mutex mu;
    std::atomic<size_t> next_span{0};

    auto worker = [&] {
        std::vector<uintptr_t> local_matches;
        uint64_t local_bytes = 0;
        bool     local_trunc = false;

        auto sink = [&](size_t, uintptr_t run_addr, const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                        uintptr_t limit) -> bool {
            local_bytes += std::min<uint64_t>(len, limit > run_addr ? limit - run_addr : 0);
            if (len < p.size()) return true;
            // first aligned start inside the run
            uintptr_t a = (run_addr + align - 1) / align * align;
            const uintptr_t run_end = run_addr + len - p.size();
            for (; a <= run_end && a < limit; a += align) {
                if (aob_match(p, data + (a - run_addr),
                              len - static_cast<size_t>(a - run_addr))) {
                    if (local_matches.size() >= max_results) {
                        local_trunc = true;
                        return false;
                    }
                    local_matches.push_back(a);
                }
            }
            return true;
        };

        if (nw == 1) {
            // one worker: a single walk so read-ahead streams across spans
            detail::chunked_read(r, spans, walk, tok, sink);
        } else {
            std::vector<detail::read_range_t> one(1);
            while (!tok.cancelled() && !local_trunc) {
                const size_t si = next_span.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                if (si >= spans.size()) break;
                one[0] = spans[si];
                detail::chunked_read(r, one, walk, tok, sink);
            }
        }

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mu);
        st.bytes_scanned += local_bytes;
        st.truncated = st.truncated || local_trunc;
        for (uintptr_t m : local_matches) {
            if (matches.size() >= max_results) { st.truncated = true; break; }
            matches.push_back(m);
        }
    };

    if (nw == 1) {
        worker();
    } else {
        std::vector<std::thread> pool;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nw; ++i) pool.emplace_back(worker);
        for (auto& t : pool) t.join();
    }

    std::sort(matches.begin(), matches.end());
    matches.erase(std::unique(matches.begin(), matches.end()), matches.end());
    st.matches = matches.size();
    st.cancelled = tok.cancelled();
    return matches;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// aob scan ported from cheat engine, ?? and * wildcard bytes, nibble
// wildcards, compact hex, chunked reads that bisect holes

#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include "core/infra/cancel.hpp"
#include "core/memory/memscan.hpp"
#include "core/memory/reader.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

struct aob_pattern_t {
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;      // literal nibbles (wildcard nibbles hold 0)
    std::vector<uint8_t> nibble_mask; // bit per nibble: 1 = must match

    size_t size() const noexcept { return bytes.size(); }
    bool   has_wildcards() const noexcept;
};

// Compile a user pattern. On failure returns nullopt and fills err
std::optional<aob_pattern_t> aob_compile(std::string_view text, std::string& err);

// Match pattern AT the start of the buffer (anchored). Pattern longer than
// buffer never matches
bool aob_match(const aob_pattern_t& p, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) noexcept;

// Match pattern at ANY offset in the buffer (sliding search)
bool aob_contains(const aob_pattern_t& p, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) noexcept;

// Render pattern back to canonical spaced text ("AA ?? B?")
std::string aob_to_string(const aob_pattern_t& p);

// Format raw selection bytes as a copy-paste-ready pattern ("41 42 43")
std::string aob_from_bytes(const uint8_t* data, size_t len);

// Signature text renderings of the same pattern, one per consumer: IDA
// ("48 8B ? ?"), x64dbg ("48 8B ?? ??"), Cheat Engine AOB ("48 8B ?? ??")
// and the C string + mask pair ("\x48\x8B" / "xx??"). A nibble wildcard
// renders as ? in the byte form and as ? in its mask position
std::string aob_to_ida(const aob_pattern_t& p);
std::string aob_to_x64dbg(const aob_pattern_t& p);
std::string aob_to_ce(const aob_pattern_t& p);

struct aob_code_sig_t {
    std::string bytes;   // "\x48\x8B\x00"
    std::string mask;    // "xx??", one char per byte: x = compare, ? = wildcard
};
aob_code_sig_t aob_to_code(const aob_pattern_t& p);

struct aob_scan_options_t {
    uint32_t alignment = 1;                    // fastscan: addr % N == 0
    size_t   max_results = 0;                  // 0 -> infra::limits::max_aob_matches
    size_t   chunk_bytes = 0;                  // 0 -> infra::limits::scan_chunk_bytes
    uint32_t threads     = 0;                  // 0 -> hardware concurrency
};

struct aob_stats_t {
    uint64_t bytes_scanned = 0;
    size_t   matches       = 0;
    bool     truncated     = false;
    bool     cancelled     = false;
};

// Scan the given regions (pre-filtered by the caller, typically
// filter_regions with the scan config's preferences)
std::vector<uintptr_t> aob_scan(reader_t& r,
                                const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions,
                                const aob_pattern_t& p,
                                const aob_scan_options_t& opt,
                                const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                                aob_stats_t* stats);

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/console_scan.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/console_scan.cpp

#include "core/memory/console_scan.hpp"

#include "core/infra/limits.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace slop::core::memory {

std::vector<uint64_t> console_aob_all(const console_find_fn& find,
                                      const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions,
                                      const console_aob_options_t& opt,
                                      const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                                      console_aob_stats_t* stats) {
    console_aob_stats_t local{};
    console_aob_stats_t& st = stats ? *stats : local;
    st = {};

    std::vector<uint64_t> hits;
    const uint64_t plen = opt.pattern_len;
    if (plen == 0 || !find) return hits;

    const size_t   max_results = opt.max_results ? opt.max_results
                                                 : infra::limits::max_aob_matches;
    const uint32_t align  = opt.alignment ? opt.alignment : 1;
    // a window must hold the pattern; the protocol length is a u32
    const uint64_t window = std::max<uint64_t>(opt.window ? opt.window : 1u, plen);

    std::vector<scan_region_t> sorted = regions;
    std::sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end(),
              [](const scan_region_t& a, const scan_region_t& b) { return a.base < b.base; });

    for (const auto& reg : sorted) {
        if (reg.size < plen) continue;
        const uint64_t end = static_cast<uint64_t>(reg.base) + reg.size;
        uint64_t cursor = std::max<uint64_t>(reg.base, hits.empty() ? 0 : hits.back() + 1);

        while (end > cursor && end - cursor >= plen) {
            if (tok.cancelled()) { st.cancelled = true; return hits; }
            const uint64_t win_end = std::min<uint64_t>(end, cursor + window);
            uint64_t hit = 0;
            ++st.calls;
            if (!find(cursor, static_cast<uint32_t>(win_end - cursor), hit)) {
                st.failed    = true;
                st.failed_at = cursor;
                return hits;
            }
            if (hit == 0) {
                // window exhausted: slide on, keeping a pattern-1 overlap so a
                // match straddling the window border is still found whole
                st.bytes += win_end - cursor;
                if (win_end >= end) break;
                cursor = win_end - (plen - 1);
                continue;
            }
            if (hit < cursor || hit + plen > win_end) {
                // the payload answered outside the window we asked about
                st.failed    = true;
                st.bad_reply = true;
                st.failed_at = cursor;
                return hits;
            }
            st.bytes += hit + 1 - cursor;
            if (hit % align == 0) {
                if (hits.size() >= max_results) {
                    st.truncated = true;
                    st.matches   = hits.size();
                    return hits;
                }
                hits.push_back(hit);
                st.matches = hits.size();
            }
            cursor = hit + 1;
        }
    }
    st.matches = hits.size();
    return hits;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/console_scan.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// console-native AOB walk: the ps4debug payload's CMD_PROC_SCAN_AOB answers
// one match per call (scanning on-device at memory speed). This walks every
// match in a region set by re-issuing the call from just past each hit, so
// callers get the full hit list instead of a single address

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>

#include "core/infra/cancel.hpp"
#include "core/memory/memscan.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

// One on-device search over [addr, addr+len): set hit to the first match
// (0 = none) and return true, or return false on a transport/protocol error
using console_find_fn = std::function<bool(uint64_t addr, uint32_t len, uint64_t& hit)>;

struct console_aob_options_t {
    size_t   pattern_len = 0;           // bytes in the pattern (>= 1)
    uint32_t alignment   = 1;           // keep only hits with addr % alignment == 0
    size_t   max_results = 0;           // 0 -> infra::limits::max_aob_matches
    uint32_t window      = 256u << 20;  // bytes per call (bounds on-device time)
};

struct console_aob_stats_t {
    size_t   calls     = 0;     // on-device searches issued
    size_t   matches   = 0;
    uint64_t bytes     = 0;     // bytes covered by completed windows
    bool     truncated = false; // stopped at max_results
    bool     cancelled = false;
    bool     failed    = false; // find_fn reported an error (results are partial)
    uint64_t failed_at = 0;     // window start of the failing call
    bool     bad_reply = false; // payload answered with a hit outside the window
};

// Walk every match of the pattern in the regions (ascending, deduplicated)
std::vector<uint64_t> console_aob_all(const console_find_fn& find,
                                      const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions,
                                      const console_aob_options_t& opt,
                                      const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                                      console_aob_stats_t* stats);

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/dissect.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/dissect.cpp
#include "core/memory/dissect.hpp"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

namespace slop::core::memory {

namespace {

using nlohmann::json;

std::string hex(uint64_t v) {
    char b[24];
    std::snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "0x%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(v));
    return b;
}

bool printable(uint8_t c) { return c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7F; }

// >= 4 printable ASCII chars then NUL (or the buffer end): the text, else ""
std::string ascii_at(const uint8_t* p, size_t n) {
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < n && printable(p[i])) ++i;
    if (i < 4 || (i < n && p[i] != 0)) return {};
    return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(p), i);
}

// same for UTF-16LE restricted to ASCII code points
std::string utf16_at(const uint8_t* p, size_t n) {
    std::string s;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 1 < n && printable(p[i]) && p[i + 1] == 0; i += 2) s.push_back(static_cast<char>(p[i]));
    if (s.size() < 4 || (i + 1 < n && (p[i] | p[i + 1]) != 0)) return {};
    return s;
}

bool plausible_float(double v) {
    return std::isfinite(v) && (v == 0.0 || (std::fabs(v) >= 1e-4 && std::fabs(v) <= 1e7));
}

json describe_target(uint64_t ptr, const dissect_env_t& env) {
    json t = {{"addr", ptr}};
    if (const std::string sym = env.symbolize(ptr); !sym.empty()) t["symbol"] = sym;
    if (env.executable(ptr)) {
        t["kind"] = "code";
        return t;
    }
    uint8_t buf[64] = {};
    const size_t got = env.read(ptr, buf, sizeof(buf));
    uint64_t first = 0;
    if (got >= 8) std::memcpy(&first, buf, 8);
    if (got >= 8 && first != 0 && env.executable(first)) {
        t["kind"] = "function_ptr";   // a pointer to a pointer into code
        return t;
    }
    // an object starts with a vtable: a pointer into data whose first slot is code
    uint64_t slot0 = 0;
    if (got >= 8 && first != 0 && env.readable(first) && env.read(first, &slot0, 8) == 8 &&
        slot0 != 0 && env.executable(slot0)) {
        t["kind"] = "object";
        t["vtable"] = first;
        if (const std::string sym = env.symbolize(first); !sym.empty()) t["vtable_symbol"] = sym;
        return t;
    }
    if (const std::string s = ascii_at(buf, got); !s.empty()) {
        t["kind"] = "char*";
        t["text"] = s;
    } else if (const std::string w = utf16_at(buf, got); !w.empty()) {
        t["kind"] = "wchar_t*";
        t["text"] = w;
    } else {
        t["kind"] = "data";
    }
    return t;
}

} // namespace

json dissect(uint64_t base, const uint8_t* data, size_t len, const dissect_env_t& env) {
    json rows = json::array();
    for (size_t off = 0; off + 8 <= len; off += 8) {
        const uint8_t* p = data + off;
        uint64_t v = 0;
        std::memcpy(&v, p, 8);
        json row = {{"offset", off}, {"addr", base + off}, {"hex", hex(v)}};
        float f[2];
        double d = 0;
        std::memcpy(f, p, 8);
        std::memcpy(&d, p, 8);
        uint32_t lo = 0, hi = 0;
        std::memcpy(&lo, p, 4);
        std::memcpy(&hi, p + 4, 4);

        if (v == 0) {
            row["kind"] = "zero";
        } else if (env.readable(v)) {
            json t = describe_target(v, env);
            row["kind"] = "pointer";
            row["value"] = t.value("symbol", hex(v));
            row["target"] = std::move(t);
        } else if (const std::string s = ascii_at(p, 8); !s.empty()) {
            row["kind"] = "text";
            row["value"] = s;
        } else if (lo != 0 && hi != 0 && plausible_float(f[0]) && plausible_float(f[1]) &&
                   (lo >> 23) != 0 && (hi >> 23) != 0) {
            // before double: a float pair also reads as a plausible double, but a
            // round double has lo == 0 and other doubles fail the float test on lo
            row["kind"] = "float2";
            row["value"] = json::array({f[0], f[1]});
        } else if (plausible_float(d) && (hi >> 20) != 0) {   // exponent bits set, not a small int
            row["kind"] = "double";
            row["value"] = d;
        } else if (hi == 0 || hi == 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
            row["kind"] = "int64";
            row["value"] = static_cast<int64_t>(v);
        } else {
            row["kind"] = "int32x2";
            row["value"] = json::array({static_cast<int32_t>(lo), static_cast<int32_t>(hi)});
        }
        rows.push_back(std::move(row));
    }
    return rows;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory

```

`src/core/memory/dissect.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// "Dissect data structures": guess what each 8-byte slot of an unknown object
// is (pointer to code / object / string / data, float, double, int, inline
// text, zero) so a struct layout can be drafted from live memory.

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string>

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

namespace slop::core::memory {

struct dissect_env_t {
    std::function<bool(uint64_t)> readable;            // committed + readable
    std::function<bool(uint64_t)> executable;
    std::function<std::string(uint64_t)> symbolize;    // "eboot.bin+0x1234" or ""
    std::function<size_t(uint64_t, void*, size_t)> read;   // bytes read
};

// rows: [{offset, hex, kind, value, target?}], one per 8-byte slot of data
nlohmann::json dissect(uint64_t base, const uint8_t* data, size_t len, const dissect_env_t& env);

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```
