`src/core/memory/memscan.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/memscan.cpp
// the scan engine, a behavioral port of cheat engines memscan (gpl 3.0 upstream)
// rounding windows, fastscan stepping and region preferences all follow upstream

#include "core/memory/memscan.hpp"

#include "core/infra/limits.hpp"
#include "core/memory/read_util.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace slop::core::memory {

// Width helpers

size_t value_size(value_width_t w) noexcept {
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::i8:
    case value_width_t::u8: return 1;
    case value_width_t::i16:
    case value_width_t::u16: return 2;
    case value_width_t::i32:
    case value_width_t::u32:
    case value_width_t::f32: return 4;
    case value_width_t::i64:
    case value_width_t::u64:
    case value_width_t::f64: return 8;
    }
    return 0;
}

bool width_is_signed(value_width_t w) noexcept {
    return w == value_width_t::i8 || w == value_width_t::i16 ||
           w == value_width_t::i32 || w == value_width_t::i64;
}

bool width_is_float(value_width_t w) noexcept {
    return w == value_width_t::f32 || w == value_width_t::f64;
}

// Value text helpers (UI + tests)

namespace {

int64_t sign_extend(uint64_t bits, value_width_t w) noexcept {
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::i8:  return static_cast<int64_t>(static_cast<int8_t>(bits));
    case value_width_t::i16: return static_cast<int64_t>(static_cast<int16_t>(bits));
    case value_width_t::i32: return static_cast<int64_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(bits));
    default:                 return static_cast<int64_t>(bits);
    }
}

template <typename T>
T bits_as(uint64_t bits) noexcept {
    T v;
    std::memcpy(&v, &bits, sizeof(T));
    return v;
}

uint64_t load_bits(const uint8_t* p, size_t n) noexcept {
    uint64_t bits = 0;
    std::memcpy(&bits, p, n);
    return bits;
}

// Delphi RoundTo(v, -digits): nearest multiple of 10^-digits, ties to even
// (matches FPC/Delphi banker's rounding)
double round_to(double v, uint32_t digits) noexcept {
    const double p = std::pow(10.0, static_cast<double>(digits));
    return std::nearbyint(v * p) / p;
}

// CE extreme/truncated window epsilon: 10^-accuracy, or 1 when the value
// text carried no decimals (configurescanroutine: maxsvalue:=svalue+1)
double round_eps(uint32_t accuracy) noexcept {
    return accuracy ? std::pow(10.0, -static_cast<double>(accuracy)) : 1.0;
}

} // namespace

uint64_t value_from_double(value_width_t w, double v) {
    uint64_t bits = 0;
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::f32: { const float f = static_cast<float>(v); std::memcpy(&bits, &f, 4); break; }
    case value_width_t::f64: { std::memcpy(&bits, &v, 8); break; }
    case value_width_t::i8:  bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(static_cast<int8_t>(v))); break;
    case value_width_t::u8:  bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint8_t>(v)); break;
    case value_width_t::i16: bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(static_cast<int16_t>(v))); break;
    case value_width_t::u16: bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(v)); break;
    case value_width_t::i32: bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int32_t>(v))); break;
    case value_width_t::u32: bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(v)); break;
    case value_width_t::i64: bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(v)); break;
    case value_width_t::u64: bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(v); break;
    }
    return bits;
}

double value_to_double(value_width_t w, uint64_t bits) {
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::f32: return static_cast<double>(bits_as<float>(bits));
    case value_width_t::f64: return bits_as<double>(bits);
    case value_width_t::i8:
    case value_width_t::i16:
    case value_width_t::i32:
    case value_width_t::i64: return static_cast<double>(sign_extend(bits, w));
    default:                 return static_cast<double>(bits);
    }
}

bool parse_value_text(value_width_t w, std::string_view text, uint64_t& out_bits) {
    while (!text.empty() && (text.front() == ' ' || text.front() == '\t')) text.remove_prefix(1);
    while (!text.empty() && (text.back() == ' ' || text.back() == '\t')) text.remove_suffix(1);
    if (text.empty() || text.size() >= 64) return false;

    char buf[64]{};
    std::memcpy(buf, text.data(), text.size());

    char* endp = nullptr;

    if (width_is_float(w)) {
        const double v = std::strtod(buf, &endp);
        if (endp != buf + text.size()) return false;
        out_bits = value_from_double(w, v);
        return true;
    }

    errno = 0;
    if (width_is_signed(w)) {
        const long long v = std::strtoll(buf, &endp, 0);
        if (errno != 0 || endp != buf + text.size()) return false;
        out_bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(v);
    } else {
        if (buf[0] == '-') return false;
        const unsigned long long v = std::strtoull(buf, &endp, 0);
        if (errno != 0 || endp != buf + text.size()) return false;
        out_bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(v);
    }

    const size_t n = value_size(w);
    if (n < 8) {
        const uint64_t mask = (1ull << (n * 8)) - 1;
        out_bits &= mask;
    }
    return true;
}

std::string format_value_text(value_width_t w, uint64_t bits) {
    char buf[48]{};
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::i8:
    case value_width_t::i16:
    case value_width_t::i32:
    case value_width_t::i64:
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%lld", static_cast<long long>(sign_extend(bits, w)));
        break;
    case value_width_t::u8:
    case value_width_t::u16:
    case value_width_t::u32:
    case value_width_t::u64:
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu", static_cast<unsigned long long>(bits));
        break;
    case value_width_t::f32:
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.9g", static_cast<double>(bits_as<float>(bits)));
        break;
    case value_width_t::f64:
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%.17g", bits_as<double>(bits));
        break;
    }
    return std::string(buf);
}

uint32_t float_accuracy_from_text(std::string_view text) noexcept {
    // CE floataccuracy derivation: digits after the decimal separator; 0
    // when absent or when the text uses exponent notation
    const size_t dot = text.find('.');
    if (dot == std::string_view::npos) return 0;
    const size_t e = text.find_first_of("eE");
    if (e != std::string_view::npos && e < dot) return 0;
    const size_t end = (e == std::string_view::npos) ? text.size() : e;
    if (end <= dot + 1) return 0;
    if (end - dot - 1 > 15) return 15;
    return static_cast<uint32_t>(end - dot - 1);
}

// Region filtering (TScanController walk)

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kPageNoAccess      = 0x01;
constexpr uint32_t kPageGuard         = 0x100;
constexpr uint32_t kPageNoCache       = 0x200;
constexpr uint32_t kPageWriteCombine  = 0x400;
constexpr uint32_t kMemImage          = 0x1000000;
constexpr uint32_t kMemMapped         = 0x40000;
constexpr uint32_t kMemPrivate        = 0x20000;

bool pref_pass(region_pref_t pref, bool flag) noexcept {
    switch (pref) {
    case region_pref_t::any:     return true;
    case region_pref_t::include: return flag;
    case region_pref_t::exclude: return !flag;
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace

std::vector<scan_region_t> filter_regions(const std::vector<scan_region_t>& in,
                                          const scan_config_t& cfg) {
    std::vector<scan_region_t> out;
    out.reserve(in.size());

    const uintptr_t begin = cfg.begin;
    const uintptr_t end   = cfg.end;

    for (const auto& reg : in) {
        if (reg.size == 0) continue;

        // Clip to the caller range first
        uintptr_t rbase = reg.base;
        uintptr_t rend  = reg.base + reg.size;
        if (end != 0) {
            if (rbase >= end) continue;
            if (rend > end) rend = end;
        }
        if (begin != 0) {
            if (rend <= begin) continue;
            if (rbase < begin) rbase = begin;
        }
        if (rend <= rbase) continue;

        const uint32_t prot = reg.protect;

        // CE validRegion core: no guard, no noaccess, no nocache/writecombine
        if (prot & kPageGuard)        continue;
        if (prot & kPageNoAccess)     continue;
        if (prot & kPageNoCache)      continue;
        if (prot & kPageWriteCombine) continue;

        // Memory-type checkboxes (scan_mem_private/image/mapped)
        const bool is_image   = (reg.type & kMemImage)   != 0;
        const bool is_mapped  = (reg.type & kMemMapped)  != 0;
        const bool is_private = (reg.type & kMemPrivate) != 0;
        if (is_image   && !cfg.mem_image)   continue;
        if (is_mapped  && !cfg.mem_mapped)  continue;
        if (is_private && !cfg.mem_private) continue;

        // Tri-state writable / executable / copy-on-write preferences
        const bool writable = (prot & 0x04 /*PAGE_READWRITE*/)        != 0 ||
                              (prot & 0x08 /*PAGE_WRITECOPY*/)         != 0 ||
                              (prot & 0x40 /*PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE*/) != 0 ||
                              (prot & 0x80 /*PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY*/) != 0;
        const bool executable = (prot & 0x10 /*PAGE_EXECUTE*/)      != 0 ||
                                (prot & 0x20 /*PAGE_EXECUTE_READ*/) != 0 ||
                                (prot & 0x40) != 0 || (prot & 0x80) != 0;
        const bool cow = (prot & 0x08) != 0 || (prot & 0x80) != 0;

        if (!pref_pass(cfg.writable, writable))         continue;
        if (!pref_pass(cfg.executable, executable))     continue;
        if (!pref_pass(cfg.copy_on_write, cow))         continue;

        out.push_back({rbase, static_cast<size_t>(rend - rbase), prot, reg.type});
    }
    return out;
}

// Comparison kernel (TCheckRoutine family)

namespace {

bool is_relational(scan_type_t t) noexcept {
    switch (t) {
    case scan_type_t::unknown_initial:
    case scan_type_t::increased:
    case scan_type_t::increased_by:
    case scan_type_t::decreased:
    case scan_type_t::decreased_by:
    case scan_type_t::increased_percent:
    case scan_type_t::decreased_percent:
    case scan_type_t::changed:
    case scan_type_t::unchanged:
    case scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than:
    case scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

template <typename F>
bool float_check(const scan_config_t& cfg, F curr, F prev) noexcept {
    // ce parses the operand into the scan types own precision so windows and
    // comparisons run in float space
    const F v1 = static_cast<F>(cfg.value1);
    const F v2 = static_cast<F>(cfg.value2);
    const F p  = prev;
    const uint32_t acc = cfg.float_accuracy;

    switch (cfg.type) {
    case scan_type_t::unknown_initial:
        return true;

    case scan_type_t::exact_value:
        switch (cfg.rounding) {
        case rounding_t::exact:
            return curr == v1;
        case rounding_t::rounded:
            return round_to(static_cast<double>(curr), acc) ==
                   round_to(static_cast<double>(v1), acc);
        case rounding_t::truncated: {
            const F hi = static_cast<F>(static_cast<double>(v1) + round_eps(acc));
            return curr >= v1 && curr < hi;
        }
        case rounding_t::extreme: {
            const F eps = static_cast<F>(round_eps(acc));
            return curr >= static_cast<F>(static_cast<double>(v1) - static_cast<double>(eps)) &&
                   curr <= static_cast<F>(static_cast<double>(v1) + static_cast<double>(eps));
        }
        }
        return false;

    case scan_type_t::between:
        return curr >= v1 && curr <= v2;
    case scan_type_t::bigger_than:
        return curr > v1;
    case scan_type_t::smaller_than:
        return curr < v1;

    case scan_type_t::increased:
        return curr > p;
    case scan_type_t::increased_by:
        return curr != p &&
               round_to(static_cast<double>(curr), acc) ==
                   round_to(static_cast<double>(p) + static_cast<double>(v1), acc);
    case scan_type_t::decreased:
        return curr < p;
    case scan_type_t::decreased_by:
        return curr != p &&
               round_to(static_cast<double>(curr), acc) ==
                   round_to(static_cast<double>(p) - static_cast<double>(v1), acc);

    case scan_type_t::increased_percent:
        return static_cast<double>(curr) >
                   static_cast<double>(p) + static_cast<double>(p) * cfg.value1 &&
               static_cast<double>(curr) <
                   static_cast<double>(p) + static_cast<double>(p) * cfg.value2;
    case scan_type_t::decreased_percent:
        return static_cast<double>(curr) >
                   static_cast<double>(p) - static_cast<double>(p) * cfg.value2 &&
               static_cast<double>(curr) <
                   static_cast<double>(p) - static_cast<double>(p) * cfg.value1;

    case scan_type_t::changed:
        return curr != p;
    case scan_type_t::unchanged:
        return curr == p;

    case scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than:
        return std::fabs(static_cast<double>(curr) - static_cast<double>(p)) >
               static_cast<double>(v1);
    case scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than:
        return curr != p &&
               std::fabs(static_cast<double>(curr) - static_cast<double>(p)) <
               static_cast<double>(v1);
    }
    return false;
}

bool int_check(const scan_config_t& cfg, value_width_t w,
               uint64_t curr, uint64_t prev) noexcept {
    if (cfg.type == scan_type_t::unknown_initial) return true;
    if (cfg.type == scan_type_t::changed)   return curr != prev;
    if (cfg.type == scan_type_t::unchanged) return curr == prev;

    if (cfg.type == scan_type_t::increased_percent ||
        cfg.type == scan_type_t::decreased_percent)
        return false; // percentage scans are float-only (CE)

    // Widen to signed 64-bit space; zero-extend unsigned, sign-extend signed
    const int64_t sc = width_is_signed(w) ? sign_extend(curr, w)
                                          : static_cast<int64_t>(curr);
    const int64_t sp = width_is_signed(w) ? sign_extend(prev, w)
                                          : static_cast<int64_t>(prev);
    auto operand = [&](double v) -> int64_t {
        uint64_t bits = value_from_double(w, v);
        const size_t n = value_size(w);
        if (n < 8) bits &= (1ull << (n * 8)) - 1;
        return width_is_signed(w) ? sign_extend(bits, w)
                                  : static_cast<int64_t>(bits);
    };
    const int64_t s1 = operand(cfg.value1);
    const int64_t s2 = operand(cfg.value2);

    switch (cfg.type) {
    case scan_type_t::exact_value:  return sc == s1;
    case scan_type_t::between:      return sc >= s1 && sc <= s2;
    case scan_type_t::bigger_than:  return sc > s1;
    case scan_type_t::smaller_than: return sc < s1;
    case scan_type_t::increased:    return sc > sp;
    case scan_type_t::decreased:    return sc < sp;
    case scan_type_t::increased_by: return sc - sp == s1;
    case scan_type_t::decreased_by: return sp - sc == s1;
    case scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than:
    case scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than: {
        // unsigned magnitude so INT64_MIN/INT64_MAX neighbours do not overflow
        const uint64_t d = sc >= sp ? static_cast<uint64_t>(sc) - static_cast<uint64_t>(sp)
                                    : static_cast<uint64_t>(sp) - static_cast<uint64_t>(sc);
        const uint64_t n = s1 > 0 ? static_cast<uint64_t>(s1) : 0;
        return cfg.type == scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than ? d > n : (d != 0 && d < n);
    }
    default:                        return false;
    }
}

} // namespace

bool check_value(const scan_config_t& cfg, value_width_t w,
                 uint64_t curr, uint64_t prev) noexcept {
    if (width_is_float(w)) {
        if (w == value_width_t::f32)
            return float_check<float>(cfg, bits_as<float>(curr), bits_as<float>(prev));
        return float_check<double>(cfg, bits_as<double>(curr), bits_as<double>(prev));
    }
    return int_check(cfg, w, curr, prev);
}

// Fastscan stepping (FirstScanmem fastscan setup)

namespace {

struct fastscan_t {
    size_t    step    = 1;   // candidate stride in bytes
    uintptr_t require = 0;   // alignment mode: 0; ends_with: tail value
    uintptr_t mask    = 0;   // ends_with: step-1

    // First candidate offset >= base where the constraint holds
    size_t first_offset(uintptr_t base) const noexcept {
        if (step <= 1) return 0;
        if (mask == 0) { // alignment mode: addr % step == 0
            const uintptr_t r = base % step;
            return static_cast<size_t>(r ? step - r : 0);
        }
        // ends_with mode: (base + off) & mask == require
        const uintptr_t cur = base & mask;
        if (cur == require) return 0;
        const uintptr_t delta = (require - cur) & mask;
        return static_cast<size_t>(delta ? delta : step);
    }
};

fastscan_t make_fastscan(const scan_config_t& cfg) noexcept {
    fastscan_t fs;
    switch (cfg.fast) {
    case fastscan_method_t::off:
        break;
    case fastscan_method_t::alignment:
        fs.step = cfg.fast_alignment ? cfg.fast_alignment : 1;
        break;
    case fastscan_method_t::ends_with: {
        const uint32_t digits = std::min<uint32_t>(cfg.fast_digits, 8);
        uint64_t step = 1;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < digits; ++i) step *= 16;
        fs.step    = static_cast<size_t>(step);
        fs.mask    = fs.step - 1;
        fs.require = cfg.fast_tail & fs.mask;
        break;
    }
    }
    if (fs.step == 0) fs.step = 1;
    return fs;
}

// Widths participating in an all-scan, CE order (byte..double)
constexpr value_width_t kAllWidths[] = {
    value_width_t::u8, value_width_t::u16, value_width_t::u32,
    value_width_t::u64, value_width_t::f32, value_width_t::f64
};

// ce alignment gating, word needs even addresses and the bigger widths
// need 4 alignment under fastscan
bool width_gate(const fastscan_t& fs, value_width_t w, uintptr_t addr) noexcept {
    if (fs.step <= 1) return true;
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::u16:
    case value_width_t::i16:
        return (addr % 2) == 0;
    case value_width_t::u32:
    case value_width_t::i32:
    case value_width_t::u64:
    case value_width_t::i64:
    case value_width_t::f32:
    case value_width_t::f64:
        return (addr % 4) == 0;
    default:
        return true;
    }
}

// Worker-local accumulator; merged once at the end (zero contention)
struct worker_out_t {
    std::vector<scan_result_t> results;
    std::vector<region_copy_t> stash;
    uint64_t bytes_scanned   = 0;
    uint64_t slots_scanned   = 0;
    uint64_t regions_scanned = 0;
    size_t   slots_tracked   = 0;
    bool     truncated       = false;
};

// Run the value-scan kernel over one contiguous run of memory. `old` holds
// the previous contents (firstnext scans) or is null (first scan). Values
// may extend into the run's tail, but only slots starting before
// `start_limit` are candidates (the rest belong to the next chunk)
void scan_run(const scan_config_t& cfg, const fastscan_t& fs,
              uintptr_t base, const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
              const uint8_t* old, worker_out_t& out, scan_progress_t& prog,
              uintptr_t start_limit = std::numeric_limits<uintptr_t>::max()) {
    const size_t slot = value_size(cfg.width);
    if (slot == 0) return;
    const size_t cap = cfg.max_results ? cfg.max_results : infra::limits::max_scan_hits;
    if (out.results.size() >= cap) { out.truncated = true; return; }

    const bool all = cfg.scan_all_types;
    if (len < (all ? 1 : slot)) return;

    const size_t last_off = all ? len - 1 : len - slot;
    size_t off = fs.first_offset(base);

    for (; off <= last_off; off += fs.step) {
        const uintptr_t addr = base + off;
        if (addr >= start_limit) break;

        if (all) {
            for (const value_width_t w : kAllWidths) {
                const size_t n = value_size(w);
                if (off + n > len) continue;
                if (!width_gate(fs, w, addr)) continue;
                const uint64_t curr = load_bits(data + off, n);
                const uint64_t prev = old ? load_bits(old + off, n) : 0;
                if (check_value(cfg, w, curr, prev)) {
                    out.results.push_back({addr, curr, w});
                    ++prog.found;
                    if (out.results.size() >= cap) { out.truncated = true; return; }
                }
            }
            ++out.slots_scanned;
        } else {
            if (off + slot > len) break;
            const uint64_t curr = load_bits(data + off, slot);
            const uint64_t prev = old ? load_bits(old + off, slot) : 0;
            ++out.slots_scanned;
            if (check_value(cfg, cfg.width, curr, prev)) {
                out.results.push_back({addr, curr, cfg.width});
                ++prog.found;
                if (out.results.size() >= cap) { out.truncated = true; return; }
            }
        }
    }
}

void merge_workers(std::vector<worker_out_t>& outs,
                   size_t max_results,
                   std::vector<scan_result_t>& results_out,
                   scan_stats_t& st) {
    size_t total = 0;
    for (const auto& o : outs) total += o.results.size();
    results_out.clear();
    results_out.reserve(std::min(total, max_results));

    bool truncated = false;
    for (auto& o : outs) {
        truncated |= o.truncated;
        st.bytes_scanned   += o.bytes_scanned;
        st.slots_scanned   += o.slots_scanned;
        st.regions_scanned += o.regions_scanned;
        st.slots_tracked   += o.slots_tracked;
        for (auto& hit : o.results) {
            if (results_out.size() >= max_results) { truncated = true; break; }
            results_out.push_back(std::move(hit));
        }
    }
    std::sort(results_out.begin(), results_out.end(),
              [](const scan_result_t& a, const scan_result_t& b) {
                  if (a.address != b.address) return a.address < b.address;
                  return a.matched < b.matched;
              });
    st.truncated |= truncated;
    st.found = results_out.size();
}

unsigned worker_count(const scan_config_t& cfg, const reader_hints_t& h) noexcept {
    unsigned n = cfg.threads ? cfg.threads : std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
    // a serialized reader (one remote connection) gains nothing from more
    // workers than it can serve; they would only queue on its socket lock
    if (h.max_workers) n = std::min(n, h.max_workers);
    return std::max(1u, std::min(n, 64u));
}

// Effective chunk size: explicit config wins, then the reader's preference
size_t effective_chunk(const scan_config_t& cfg, const reader_hints_t& h) noexcept {
    if (cfg.chunk_bytes) return cfg.chunk_bytes;
    if (h.chunk_bytes)   return h.chunk_bytes;
    return infra::limits::scan_chunk_bytes;
}

// Bytes past a chunk border a value slot can reach (all-scans read up to 8)
size_t value_overlap(const scan_config_t& cfg) noexcept {
    const size_t widest = cfg.scan_all_types ? 8 : value_size(cfg.width);
    return widest ? widest - 1 : 0;
}

// First scan (TScanController.firstScan thread fan-out)

// Walk one worker's share of the regions in a single chunked pass (so the
// read-ahead thread keeps streaming across region borders). Region scans
// stash readable runs into the worker copy; the value kernel only runs for
// address-list scans. `aborted` lets sibling workers stop this one
void walk_regions(reader_t& r, const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regs,
                  const scan_config_t& cfg, const fastscan_t& fs,
                  const infra::cancel_token_t& tok, bool stash_mode, bool read_ahead,
                  std::atomic<uint64_t>& stash_used, uint64_t stash_budget,
                  const std::atomic<bool>& aborted,
                  worker_out_t& out, scan_progress_t& prog) {
    if (regs.empty()) return;
    detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
    walk.chunk      = cfg.chunk_bytes ? cfg.chunk_bytes : infra::limits::scan_chunk_bytes;
    // The stash needs the same overlap as a normal walk: without it the last
    // width-1 slots of every chunk are never compared by the rescan, because
    // the old bytes for a value straddling the chunk boundary are missing.
    // Duplicate comparisons are avoided by start_limit in scan_run, which only
    // accepts slots that start before the chunk's owned end.
    walk.overlap    = value_overlap(cfg);
    walk.min_leaf   = 4096;
    walk.read_ahead = read_ahead;

    std::vector<detail::read_range_t> ranges;
    ranges.reserve(regs.size());
    for (const auto& reg : regs) ranges.push_back({reg.base, reg.size});

    // regions count as done once the walk moves past them
    size_t done_upto = 0;
    auto finish_upto = [&](size_t n) {
        for (; done_upto < n; ++done_upto) {
            ++out.regions_scanned;
            prog.regions_done++;
        }
    };

    auto sink = [&](size_t range, uintptr_t run_addr, const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                    uintptr_t limit) -> bool {
        finish_upto(range);
        if (aborted.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return false;
        const size_t owned = static_cast<size_t>(
            std::min<uint64_t>(len, limit > run_addr ? limit - run_addr : 0));
        out.bytes_scanned += owned;
        prog.bytes += owned;

        if (stash_mode) {
            // Atomic add-then-check: tiny over-admission is acceptable
            const uint64_t used = stash_used.fetch_add(len,
                                                       std::memory_order_relaxed) + len;
            if (used > stash_budget) {
                out.truncated = true;
                return false;
            }
            region_copy_t rc;
            rc.base  = run_addr;
            rc.bytes.assign(data, data + len);
            out.stash.push_back(std::move(rc));
            out.slots_tracked += len;
            out.slots_scanned += len / value_size(cfg.width);
            return true; // no address rows for region scans
        }

        scan_run(cfg, fs, run_addr, data, len, nullptr, out, prog, limit);
        return !out.truncated;
    };

    detail::chunked_read(r, ranges, walk, tok, sink);
    // a walk that ran to completion visited every region (holes included)
    if (!out.truncated && !tok.cancelled() && !aborted.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
        finish_upto(ranges.size());
    else
        finish_upto(std::min(done_upto + 1, ranges.size()));
}

} // namespace

// memscan_t

void memscan_t::reset() {
    results_.clear();
    results_.shrink_to_fit();
    stash_.clear();
    stash_.shrink_to_fit();
    stats_ = {};
    progress_.clear();
    region_scan_active_ = false;
    address_list_ = false;
    last_width_ = value_width_t::u32;
}

bool memscan_t::export_results(std::vector<scan_result_t>& out, value_width_t& width) const {
    if (!address_list_ && !region_scan_active_) return false;
    out = results_;
    width = last_width_;
    return true;
}

bool memscan_t::import_results(std::vector<scan_result_t> results, value_width_t width) {
    if (results.empty()) return false;
    results_ = std::move(results);
    stash_.clear();
    stash_.shrink_to_fit();
    region_scan_active_ = false;
    address_list_ = true;
    last_width_ = width;
    stats_ = {};
    stats_.found = results_.size();
    progress_.clear();
    progress_.found.store(results_.size(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return true;
}

bool memscan_t::first_scan(reader_t& r,
                           std::vector<scan_region_t> regions,
                           const scan_config_t& cfg,
                           const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                           std::string* err) {
    (void)err;
    reset();
    last_width_ = cfg.width;

    const size_t max_results = cfg.max_results ? cfg.max_results
                                               : infra::limits::max_scan_hits;
    const fastscan_t fs = make_fastscan(cfg);

    regions = filter_regions(regions, cfg);
    stats_.regions = regions.size();
    if (regions.empty()) return true;

    // CE: relational types on a first scan degrade to an unknown scan
    scan_config_t run_cfg = cfg;
    if (is_relational(run_cfg.type)) run_cfg.type = scan_type_t::unknown_initial;
    const bool region_scan = run_cfg.type == scan_type_t::unknown_initial;
    const reader_hints_t hints = r.hints();
    run_cfg.chunk_bytes = effective_chunk(run_cfg, hints);

    const uint64_t stash_budget = region_scan
        ? (run_cfg.stash_bytes ? run_cfg.stash_bytes : infra::limits::max_stash_bytes)
        : 0;

    const unsigned nw = std::max(1u, std::min(worker_count(run_cfg, hints),
                                              static_cast<unsigned>(regions.size())));
    std::vector<worker_out_t> outs(nw);
    std::vector<std::thread>  pool;
    std::atomic<uint64_t>     stash_used{0};
    std::atomic<bool>         aborted{false};

    // Round-robin the regions; each worker walks its share in one chunked
    // pass. Address-list scans cap rows per worker (scan_run) so one thread
    // cannot hog the whole budget; the merge still enforces the global cap
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nw; ++i) {
        pool.emplace_back([&, i] {
            worker_out_t& out = outs[i];
            std::vector<scan_region_t> mine;
            for (size_t k = i; k < regions.size(); k += nw) mine.push_back(regions[k]);
            walk_regions(r, mine, run_cfg, fs, tok, region_scan, hints.read_ahead,
                         stash_used, stash_budget, aborted, out, progress_);
            if (out.truncated) aborted.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        });
    }
    for (auto& t : pool) t.join();

    std::vector<scan_result_t> results;
    merge_workers(outs, region_scan ? 0 : max_results, results, stats_);
    if (region_scan) stats_.found = 0; // the stash is the result set

    if (region_scan) {
        size_t total = 0;
        for (const auto& o : outs) total += o.stash.size();
        stash_.reserve(total);
        for (auto& o : outs)
            for (auto& rc : o.stash) stash_.push_back(std::move(rc));
        std::sort(stash_.begin(), stash_.end(),
                  [](const region_copy_t& a, const region_copy_t& b) {
                      return a.base < b.base;
                  });
        region_scan_active_ = !stash_.empty();
        address_list_ = false;
        results_.clear();
        progress_.found.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    } else {
        results_ = std::move(results);
        address_list_ = !results_.empty();
        region_scan_active_ = false;
        progress_.found.store(results_.size(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    stats_.cancelled = tok.cancelled();
    return true;
}

bool memscan_t::next_scan(reader_t& r,
                          const scan_config_t& cfg,
                          const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                          std::string* err) {
    if (!region_scan_active_ && !address_list_) {
        if (err) *err = "no previous scan";
        return false;
    }
    if (cfg.type == scan_type_t::unknown_initial) return true; // passthrough

    const size_t max_results = cfg.max_results ? cfg.max_results
                                               : infra::limits::max_scan_hits;
    const fastscan_t fs = make_fastscan(cfg);

    scan_config_t run_cfg = cfg;
    const reader_hints_t hints = r.hints();
    run_cfg.chunk_bytes = effective_chunk(run_cfg, hints);

    scan_stats_t st{};
    st.regions = stats_.regions;

    std::vector<scan_result_t> out;

    if (region_scan_active_) {
        // FirstNextScan: re-read the stashed memory, compare old vs new per
        // slot, emit the first address list, then drop the stash
        const unsigned nw = std::max(1u, std::min(worker_count(run_cfg, hints),
            static_cast<unsigned>(stash_.size() ? stash_.size() : 1)));
        std::vector<worker_out_t> outs(nw);
        std::vector<std::thread>  pool;
        std::atomic<bool>         aborted{false};

        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nw; ++i) {
            pool.emplace_back([&, i] {
                worker_out_t& out = outs[i];
                std::vector<detail::read_range_t> ranges;
                std::vector<size_t>               owner;   // range -> stash index
                for (size_t k = i; k < stash_.size(); k += nw) {
                    ranges.push_back({stash_[k].base, stash_[k].bytes.size()});
                    owner.push_back(k);
                }
                detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
                walk.chunk      = run_cfg.chunk_bytes;
                walk.overlap    = value_overlap(run_cfg);
                walk.min_leaf   = 4096;
                walk.read_ahead = hints.read_ahead;

                auto sink = [&](size_t range, uintptr_t run_addr, const uint8_t* fresh,
                                size_t len, uintptr_t limit) -> bool {
                    if (aborted.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return false;
                    const region_copy_t& rc = stash_[owner[range]];
                    const size_t old_off = static_cast<size_t>(run_addr - rc.base);
                    if (old_off >= rc.bytes.size()) return true;
                    const size_t comparable = std::min(len, rc.bytes.size() - old_off);
                    const size_t owned = static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(
                        comparable, limit > run_addr ? limit - run_addr : 0));
                    out.bytes_scanned += owned;
                    progress_.bytes += owned;
                    scan_run(run_cfg, fs, run_addr, fresh, comparable,
                             rc.bytes.data() + old_off, out, progress_, limit);
                    if (out.results.size() >= max_results) out.truncated = true;
                    return !out.truncated;
                };

                detail::chunked_read(r, ranges, walk, tok, sink);
                if (out.truncated) aborted.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            });
        }
        for (auto& t : pool) t.join();

        merge_workers(outs, max_results, out, st);
        stash_.clear();
        stash_.shrink_to_fit();
        region_scan_active_ = false;
    } else {
        // NextNextScan: re-read each stored address, compare stored bits.
        // Rows are address sorted; readers that ask for it get neighbouring
        // rows fetched with one read (a remote roundtrip per row is the cost
        // that dominates console rescans)
        const std::vector<scan_result_t> prev = std::move(results_);
        const unsigned nw = worker_count(run_cfg, hints);
        std::vector<worker_out_t> outs(nw);
        std::vector<std::thread>  pool;
        std::atomic<size_t>       next_item{0};
        const size_t gap   = hints.coalesce_gap;
        const size_t span  = std::max<size_t>(run_cfg.chunk_bytes, 4096);
        // coalescing wants long sorted runs per grab; per-row readers keep
        // small grabs so the workers stay balanced
        const size_t kBatch = gap ? 4096 : 64;

        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nw; ++i) {
            pool.emplace_back([&, i] {
                worker_out_t& out = outs[i];
                std::vector<uint8_t> buf;

                // compare one row against fresh bits; false = result cap hit
                auto judge = [&](const scan_result_t& row, uint64_t bits) -> bool {
                    ++out.slots_scanned;
                    if (!check_value(run_cfg, row.matched, bits, row.bits)) return true;
                    out.results.push_back({row.address, bits, row.matched});
                    if (out.results.size() >= max_results) {
                        out.truncated = true;
                        return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                };
                auto single = [&](const scan_result_t& row) -> bool {
                    uint64_t bits = 0;
                    if (!r.read(row.address, &bits, value_size(row.matched)))
                        return true; // freed
                    return judge(row, bits);
                };

                while (!tok.cancelled()) {
                    const size_t idx = next_item.fetch_add(kBatch, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                    if (idx >= prev.size()) break;
                    const size_t n = std::min<size_t>(kBatch, prev.size() - idx);
                    size_t k = 0;
                    while (k < n) {
                        if (tok.cancelled()) return;
                        const scan_result_t& first = prev[idx + k];
                        const uintptr_t g_begin = first.address;
                        uintptr_t g_end = first.address + value_size(first.matched);
                        size_t j = k + 1;
                        if (gap) {
                            for (; j < n; ++j) {
                                const scan_result_t& nx = prev[idx + j];
                                const uintptr_t nx_end = nx.address + value_size(nx.matched);
                                if (nx.address > g_end + gap) break;
                                if (nx_end - g_begin > span) break;
                                g_end = std::max(g_end, nx_end);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j == k + 1) {
                            if (!single(first)) return;
                            k = j;
                            continue;
                        }
                        buf.resize(static_cast<size_t>(g_end - g_begin));
                        const bool ok = r.read(g_begin, buf.data(), buf.size());
                        for (size_t m = k; m < j; ++m) {
                            const scan_result_t& row = prev[idx + m];
                            if (!ok) {
                                // part of the span is gone: settle row by row
                                if (!single(row)) return;
                                continue;
                            }
                            uint64_t bits = 0;
                            std::memcpy(&bits, buf.data() + (row.address - g_begin),
                                        value_size(row.matched));
                            if (!judge(row, bits)) return;
                        }
                        k = j;
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        for (auto& t : pool) t.join();

        merge_workers(outs, max_results, out, st);
    }

    results_ = std::move(out);
    address_list_ = !results_.empty();
    st.regions_scanned += stats_.regions_scanned;
    st.bytes_scanned   += stats_.bytes_scanned;
    st.slots_tracked   = stats_.slots_tracked;
    stats_ = st;
    last_width_ = cfg.width;
    progress_.found.store(results_.size(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
    stats_.cancelled = tok.cancelled();
    return true;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// the scan engine port, every ce scan type, int and float widths with
// rounding modes, all width scans, fastscan and region preferences
// first scan stashes the memory for relational rescans then switches to
// per address re reads, regions split across worker threads
// reads ride the injected reader so no user mode handle touches the target

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include "core/infra/cancel.hpp"
#include "core/memory/reader.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

// Widths (kept for parse/format/watchlist + result rows)

enum class value_width_t : uint8_t {
    i8, u8,
    i16, u16,
    i32, u32,
    i64, u64,
    f32, f64
};

size_t value_size(value_width_t w) noexcept;
bool   width_is_signed(value_width_t w) noexcept;
bool   width_is_float(value_width_t w) noexcept;

// CE scan option (TScanOption)

enum class scan_type_t : uint8_t {
    exact_value,
    between,           // value1 <= v <= value2
    bigger_than,
    smaller_than,
    unknown_initial,   // first scan only: record the whole region set
    increased,
    increased_by,      // value1 = delta
    decreased,
    decreased_by,
    increased_percent, // value1/value2 = pct window (value2 defaults to value1)
    decreased_percent,
    changed,
    unchanged,
    changed_by_more_than, // |curr-prev| > value1 (either direction)
    changed_by_less_than  // 0 < |curr-prev| < value1 (a real change, just small)
};

// CE float rounding (TRoundingType)

enum class rounding_t : uint8_t {
    exact,             // bit/value equality
    rounded,           // RoundTo(v, -accuracy) == RoundTo(value, -accuracy)
    truncated,         // value <= v < value + 10^-accuracy
    extreme            // value - 10^-accuracy <= v <= value + 10^-accuracy
};

// CE fastscan method (TFastScanMethod)

enum class fastscan_method_t : uint8_t {
    off,               // step 1 (every byte)
    alignment,         // step = fast_alignment (addr % N == 0)
    ends_with          // step = 16^fast_digits, addr & (step-1) == fast_tail
};

// CE region preference (Tscanregionpreference)

enum class region_pref_t : uint8_t { any, include, exclude };

// Regions

struct scan_region_t {
    uintptr_t base    = 0;
    size_t    size    = 0;
    uint32_t  protect = 0;   // Win32 PAGE_* flags
    uint32_t  type    = 0;   // MEM_PRIVATE / MEM_MAPPED / MEM_IMAGE
};

// CE region walk: drop guard/noaccess (and nocache/writecombine) regions and
// apply the tri-state writable/executable/copy-on-write + memory-type prefs
std::vector<scan_region_t> filter_regions(const std::vector<scan_region_t>& in,
                                          const struct scan_config_t& cfg);

// Config

struct scan_config_t {
    scan_type_t     type     = scan_type_t::exact_value;
    value_width_t   width    = value_width_t::u32;
    bool            scan_all_types = false;   // CE vtAll
    rounding_t      rounding = rounding_t::exact;

    double          value1 = 0;   // operand (or lower bound / delta / pct)
    double          value2 = 0;   // upper bound (between) / pct window end
    uint32_t        float_accuracy = 0;   // decimals derived from value text

    fastscan_method_t fast    = fastscan_method_t::off;
    uint32_t          fast_alignment = 4;   // alignment mode step
    uint32_t          fast_digits    = 0;   // ends_with: hex digit count
    uint64_t          fast_tail      = 0;   // ends_with: required tail value

    region_pref_t  writable     = region_pref_t::any;
    region_pref_t  executable   = region_pref_t::any;
    region_pref_t  copy_on_write= region_pref_t::any;
    bool           mem_private  = true;
    bool           mem_image    = true;
    bool           mem_mapped   = true;

    uintptr_t      begin = 0;      // optional [begin,end) clamp
    uintptr_t      end   = 0;

    size_t         max_results = 0;   // 0 -> infra::limits::max_scan_hits
    uint32_t       threads     = 0;   // 0 -> hardware concurrency
    size_t         chunk_bytes = 0;   // 0 -> infra::limits::scan_chunk_bytes
    size_t         stash_bytes = 0;   // unknown-initial copy cap, 0 -> limits::max_stash_bytes
};

// Results

struct scan_result_t {
    uintptr_t     address = 0;
    uint64_t      bits    = 0;             // raw value in `matched` encoding
    value_width_t matched = value_width_t::u32; // type that hit (all-scans)
};

struct scan_stats_t {
    uint64_t regions         = 0;
    uint64_t regions_scanned = 0;
    uint64_t bytes_scanned   = 0;
    uint64_t slots_scanned   = 0;
    size_t   found           = 0;
    size_t   slots_tracked   = 0;   // unknown-initial stash size
    bool     truncated       = false;
    bool     cancelled       = false;
};

// Live progress (atomics, shared with worker threads)
struct scan_progress_t {
    std::atomic<uint64_t> bytes{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> found{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> regions_done{0};
    std::atomic<bool>     cancelled{false};

    void clear() noexcept {
        bytes.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        found.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        regions_done.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        cancelled.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
};

// CE previousMemoryBuffer entry: one copy of a successfully read run
struct region_copy_t {
    uintptr_t            base = 0;
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
};

// Comparison kernel

// CE-port predicate. `curr` = freshly read bits, `prev` = stored bits
// (ignored for first-scan types). `w` selects the encoding
bool check_value(const scan_config_t& cfg, value_width_t w,
                 uint64_t curr, uint64_t prev) noexcept;

// Value text helpers (UI + tests)

bool        parse_value_text(value_width_t w, std::string_view text, uint64_t& out_bits);
std::string format_value_text(value_width_t w, uint64_t bits);
uint64_t    value_from_double(value_width_t w, double v);
double      value_to_double(value_width_t w, uint64_t bits);

// Count decimals in a value string (CE floataccuracy derivation); returns 0
// when the text has no fractional part (CE then uses +/-1 windows)
uint32_t    float_accuracy_from_text(std::string_view text) noexcept;

// The engine (TMemScan)

class memscan_t {
public:
    memscan_t() = default;
    ~memscan_t() = default;
    memscan_t(const memscan_t&)            = delete;
    memscan_t& operator=(const memscan_t&) = delete;

    // first scan walks the regions, relational types degrade to unknown
    // initial, the engine stashes a copy for the next relational scan
    bool first_scan(reader_t& r,
                    std::vector<scan_region_t> regions,
                    const scan_config_t& cfg,
                    const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                    std::string* err = nullptr);

    // next scan re walks the stash while its alive then switches to per
    // address re reads
    bool next_scan(reader_t& r,
                   const scan_config_t& cfg,
                   const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                   std::string* err = nullptr);

    void reset();

    // Persist/restore the address-list state so a scan survives an engine
    // restart. Only the result rows are portable; the region stash is not.
    bool export_results(std::vector<scan_result_t>& out, value_width_t& width) const;
    bool import_results(std::vector<scan_result_t> results, value_width_t width);

    const std::vector<scan_result_t>& results() const noexcept { return results_; }
    scan_stats_t                      stats()   const noexcept { return stats_; }
    const scan_progress_t&            progress() const noexcept { return progress_; }

    // Region scans keep no address rows (the stash is the result set) but
    // still count as "has results" so the UI offers a next scan
    bool has_results() const noexcept {
        return !results_.empty() || address_list_ || region_scan_active_;
    }
    bool region_scan_active() const noexcept { return region_scan_active_; }
    value_width_t last_width() const noexcept { return last_width_; }

private:
    std::vector<scan_result_t> results_;
    std::vector<region_copy_t> stash_;
    scan_stats_t               stats_{};
    scan_progress_t            progress_{};
    value_width_t              last_width_ = value_width_t::u32;
    bool                       region_scan_active_ = false;
    bool                       address_list_      = false; // results_ hold live addresses
};

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/offsets.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/offsets.cpp
#include "core/memory/offsets.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

#include "core/memory/aob.hpp"
#include "core/util/sha256.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

namespace {

using nlohmann::json;

bool parse_u64(const json& v, uint64_t& out) {
    if (v.is_number_unsigned()) { out = v.get<uint64_t>(); return true; }
    if (v.is_number_integer() && v.get<int64_t>() >= 0) { out = v.get<uint64_t>(); return true; }
    if (!v.is_string()) return false;
    const std::string s = v.get<std::string>();
    if (s.empty()) return false;
    size_t used = 0;
    try { out = std::stoull(s, &used, 0); } catch (...) { return false; }
    return used == s.size();
}

std::string lower(std::string s) {
    std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(),
                   [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
    return s;
}

} // namespace

json verify_offsets(const json& m, const offsets_input_t& in) {
    json errors = json::array();
    json checks = json::object();
    const auto out = [&] {
        return json{{"ok", errors.empty()}, {"errors", errors}, {"checks", checks},
                    {"resolved", json::object()}};
    };
    if (!m.is_object()) {
        errors.push_back("manifest must be a JSON object");
        return out();
    }

    // build fingerprint first: nothing below is trusted on a different build
    for (const char* key : {"title_id", "app_ver"}) {
        if (!m.contains(key)) continue;
        const std::string want = m[key].is_string() ? m[key].get<std::string>() : "";
        const std::string& have = std::string(key) == "title_id" ? in.title_id : in.app_ver;
        checks[key] = {{"want", want}, {"have", have}};
        if (have.empty()) errors.push_back(std::string(key) + ": the target does not report one");
        else if (want != have) errors.push_back(std::string(key) + ": manifest " + want + ", target " + have);
    }
    const std::string want_sha = m.value("text_sha256", std::string{});
    if (want_sha.size() != 64) {
        errors.push_back("text_sha256 (64 hex chars) is required");
    } else if (!in.text || in.text_len == 0) {
        errors.push_back("no executable segment to hash");
    } else {
        const std::string have_sha = util::sha256_hex(in.text, in.text_len);
        checks["text_sha256"] = {{"want", lower(want_sha)}, {"have", have_sha}};
        if (have_sha != lower(want_sha)) errors.push_back("text_sha256 mismatch: different build");
    }
    if (!m.contains("offsets") || !m["offsets"].is_array() || m["offsets"].empty())
        errors.push_back("offsets must be a non-empty array");
    if (!errors.empty()) return out();

    json resolved = json::object();
    json entries = json::array();
    for (const auto& e : m["offsets"]) {
        const std::string name = e.is_object() ? e.value("name", std::string{}) : "";
        const auto bad = [&](const std::string& why) {
            errors.push_back((name.empty() ? std::string("<unnamed>") : name) + ": " + why);
        };
        if (name.empty()) { bad("missing name"); continue; }
        if (resolved.contains(name)) { bad("duplicate name"); continue; }
        std::string err;
        const auto pat = e.contains("aob") && e["aob"].is_string()
                             ? aob_compile(e["aob"].get<std::string>(), err)
                             : std::nullopt;
        if (!pat) { bad("anchor aob " + (err.empty() ? "missing" : err)); continue; }
        int64_t delta = 0;
        if (e.contains("aob_offset")) {
            if (!e["aob_offset"].is_number_integer()) { bad("aob_offset must be an integer"); continue; }
            delta = e["aob_offset"].get<int64_t>();
        }

        // the anchor must be unique in the executable segment
        size_t hits = 0;
        uint64_t at = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + pat->size() <= in.text_len && hits < 2; ++i)
            if (aob_match(*pat, in.text + i, in.text_len - i)) { ++hits; at = in.text_base + i; }
        if (hits != 1) { bad(hits == 0 ? "anchor not found" : "anchor is not unique"); continue; }

        const uint64_t addr = at + static_cast<uint64_t>(delta);
        if (e.contains("rva")) {
            uint64_t rva = 0;
            if (!parse_u64(e["rva"], rva)) { bad("rva must be a non-negative number or hex string"); continue; }
            if (in.text_base + rva != addr) {
                bad("anchor resolves to rva " + std::to_string(addr - in.text_base) +
                    ", manifest says " + std::to_string(rva));
                continue;
            }
        }
        resolved[name] = addr;
        entries.push_back({{"name", name}, {"addr", addr}, {"anchor", at}});
    }
    json r = out();
    r["entries"] = entries;
    if (errors.empty()) r["resolved"] = std::move(resolved);   // fail closed
    return r;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/offsets.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// Fingerprint-gated offset manifests. A manifest pins the game build (title
// id, app version, SHA-256 of the module's executable segment) and gives every
// offset an anchor signature that must match exactly once. Verification is
// fail closed: one mismatch and no address is returned at all.
//
// {
//   "title_id": "CUSA00000", "app_ver": "01.00",   (optional; checked when given)
//   "module": "eboot.bin",
//   "text_sha256": "<64 hex>",                       (required)
//   "offsets": [
//     { "name": "player_base", "rva": "0x1234", "aob": "48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ??", "aob_offset": 0 }
//   ]
// }
// rva is relative to the executable segment base; the anchor must sit at
// text_base + rva - aob_offset. Without rva the anchor alone resolves the
// address (match + aob_offset).

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

namespace slop::core::memory {

struct offsets_input_t {
    std::string title_id;   // empty when the target cannot say (non-PS4)
    std::string app_ver;
    uint64_t text_base = 0;
    const uint8_t* text = nullptr;
    size_t text_len = 0;
};

// {ok, errors[], checks{}, resolved{name: addr}}; resolved is empty unless ok
nlohmann::json verify_offsets(const nlohmann::json& manifest, const offsets_input_t& in);

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/pointer_scan.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/pointer_scan.cpp
// backward pointer scan, sweep the aligned qwords then walk the sorted edges

#include "core/memory/pointer_scan.hpp"

#include "core/infra/limits.hpp"
#include "core/memory/read_util.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace slop::core::memory {

namespace {

struct edge_t {
    uint64_t  value;   // qword read from the region set
    uintptr_t holder;  // address of that qword
};

struct node_t {
    uintptr_t addr      = 0;   // holder address
    int64_t   parent    = -1;  // index into nodes of the destination
    int64_t   offset    = 0;   // *addr + offset == nodes[parent].addr (or target)
};

bool in_module_backed(uintptr_t addr,
                      const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions) noexcept {
    constexpr uint32_t kMemImage = 0x1000000;
    for (const auto& reg : regions) {
        if (!(reg.type & kMemImage)) continue;
        if (addr >= reg.base && addr < reg.base + reg.size) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

} // namespace

std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t>
pointer_scan(reader_t& r,
             const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions,
             const pointer_scan_options_t& opt,
             const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
             pointer_scan_stats_t* stats) {

    std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t> results;
    pointer_scan_stats_t local{};
    pointer_scan_stats_t& st = stats ? *stats : local;

    // Level table: explicit levels win, otherwise depth copies of the global
    // range. The sweep walks from the target backwards, so the level used at
    // iteration k is levels[depth-1-k] (chain order is root first)
    std::vector<pointer_level_t> levels;
    if (!opt.levels.empty()) {
        levels = opt.levels;
        if (levels.size() > static_cast<size_t>(infra::limits::max_pointer_depth))
            levels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(infra::limits::max_pointer_depth));
    } else {
        const uint32_t d = std::min<uint32_t>(
            opt.depth ? opt.depth : 1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(infra::limits::max_pointer_depth));
        levels.assign(d, pointer_level_t{opt.min_offset, opt.max_offset, 0, false});
    }
    for (auto& lv : levels) {
        if (!lv.wildcard && lv.max_offset < lv.min_offset)
            std::swap(lv.min_offset, lv.max_offset);
        if (lv.alignment == 0) lv.alignment = opt.alignment ? opt.alignment : 1;
    }
    const uint32_t depth = static_cast<uint32_t>(levels.size());
    if (depth == 0) return results;

    // one sweep at the coarsest alignment; per-level alignment filters holders
    size_t align = 1;
    for (const auto& lv : levels) align = std::max<size_t>(align, lv.alignment);

    // Merge the region set into aligned spans
    std::vector<detail::read_range_t> spans;
    for (const auto& reg : regions) {
        if (reg.size < 8) continue;
        const uintptr_t b = (reg.base + align - 1) / align * align;
        const uintptr_t e = reg.base + reg.size;
        if (e <= b + 8) continue;
        spans.push_back({b, static_cast<size_t>(e - b)});
    }

    std::vector<node_t> nodes;

    // Level-0 frontier is the pseudo-node standing in for the target
    nodes.push_back({opt.target, -1, 0});
    std::vector<size_t> frontier{0};

    // One sweep over all spans: collect every aligned non-null qword. Chunks
    // carry a 7-byte tail so qwords straddling a chunk border are kept
    std::vector<edge_t> edges;
    const reader_hints_t hints = r.hints();
    detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
    walk.chunk      = hints.chunk_bytes ? hints.chunk_bytes : size_t{1} << 20;
    walk.overlap    = 7;
    walk.min_leaf   = 4096;   // unreadability is page granular
    walk.read_ahead = hints.read_ahead;

    auto sink = [&](size_t, uintptr_t run_addr, const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
                    uintptr_t limit) -> bool {
        const uintptr_t run_end = run_addr + len;
        // runs may start unaligned to `align`
        uintptr_t p = (run_addr + align - 1) / align * align;
        for (; p + 8 <= run_end && p < limit; p += align) {
            uint64_t v;
            std::memcpy(&v, data + (p - run_addr), 8);
            if (v == 0) continue; // null pointers are noise
            edges.push_back({v, p});
            ++st.edges_explored;
            if (st.edges_explored > infra::limits::max_pointer_edges) {
                st.truncated = true;
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    detail::chunked_read(r, spans, walk, tok, sink);

    if (tok.cancelled()) { st.cancelled = true; }
    if (!edges.empty() && !st.cancelled) {
        std::sort(edges.begin(), edges.end(),
                  [](const edge_t& a, const edge_t& b) { return a.value < b.value; });

        for (uint32_t level = 0; level < depth && !frontier.empty(); ++level) {
            if (tok.cancelled()) { st.cancelled = true; break; }

            // iteration k walks backwards from the target, so it applies the
            // chain-order level depth-1-k
            const pointer_level_t& lv = levels[depth - 1 - level];
            const int64_t min_off = lv.wildcard ? INT32_MIN : lv.min_offset;
            const int64_t max_off = lv.wildcard ? INT32_MAX : lv.max_offset;

            // Expand every frontier address against the sorted edge list
            std::vector<size_t> next_frontier;
            bool frontier_full = false;

            for (const size_t fidx : frontier) {
                if (tok.cancelled()) { st.cancelled = true; break; }
                if (frontier_full) break;

                const uintptr_t dest = nodes[fidx].addr;

                // Accept V where diff = dest - V in [min_off, max_off]
                // => V in [dest - max_off, dest - min_off] (unsigned window)
                if (min_off > 0 && static_cast<uint64_t>(min_off) > dest) continue;
                const uint64_t lo = (max_off > 0 && static_cast<uint64_t>(max_off) > dest)
                    ? 0u
                    : dest - static_cast<uint64_t>(max_off);
                const uint64_t hi = dest - static_cast<uint64_t>(min_off); // wraps on negative
                if (hi < lo) continue;

                auto first = std::lower_bound(edges.begin(), edges.end(), lo,
                    [](const edge_t& e, uint64_t v) { return e.value < v; });
                auto last = std::upper_bound(edges.begin(), edges.end(), hi,
                    [](uint64_t v, const edge_t& e) { return v < e.value; });

                for (auto it = first; it != last; ++it) {
                    if (lv.alignment > 1 && (it->holder % lv.alignment) != 0) continue;
                    const int64_t off = static_cast<int64_t>(dest - it->value);
                    nodes.push_back({it->holder, static_cast<int64_t>(fidx), off});
                    next_frontier.push_back(nodes.size() - 1);
                    if (next_frontier.size() >= opt.frontier_cap) {
                        st.truncated = true;
                        frontier_full = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            frontier = std::move(next_frontier);
            if (st.truncated && frontier.empty()) break;
        }
    }

    // build chains from every node, the parent walk yields root first
    for (size_t i = 1; i < nodes.size(); ++i) {
        if (results.size() >= infra::limits::max_pointer_chains) {
            st.truncated = true;
            break;
        }
        // Root (the holder the chain starts from, i.e. node i itself) must
        // live in a module-backed region so it survives restarts
        if (opt.only_module_backed && !in_module_backed(nodes[i].addr, regions))
            continue;
        pointer_chain_result_t chain;
        for (int64_t n = static_cast<int64_t>(i); n > 0;
             n = nodes[static_cast<size_t>(n)].parent) {
            const node_t& nd = nodes[static_cast<size_t>(n)];
            chain.addresses.push_back(nd.addr);
            chain.offsets.push_back(nd.offset);
        }
        // a root inside a module is reported module-relative so the chain
        // survives a restart at a different base
        if (!opt.modules.empty() && !chain.addresses.empty()) {
            const uintptr_t root = chain.addresses.front();
            for (const auto& m : opt.modules) {
                if (m.size == 0 || root < m.base || root >= m.base + m.size) continue;
                chain.module        = m.name;
                chain.module_offset = static_cast<uint64_t>(root - m.base);
                break;
            }
        }
        results.push_back(std::move(chain));
    }

    return results;
}

namespace {

// one pass worth of qword reads; chains sharing a root/prefix hit the cache
class link_reader_t {
public:
    link_reader_t(reader_t& r, uint64_t& reads) : r_(r), reads_(reads) {}
    std::optional<uint64_t> qword(uintptr_t addr) {
        auto it = cache_.find(addr);
        if (it != cache_.end()) return it->second;
        uint64_t v = 0;
        ++reads_;
        std::optional<uint64_t> got;
        if (r_.read(addr, &v, sizeof(v))) got = v;
        cache_.emplace(addr, got);
        return got;
    }
private:
    reader_t&                                              r_;
    uint64_t&                                              reads_;
    std::unordered_map<uintptr_t, std::optional<uint64_t>> cache_;
};

template <class Q>
std::optional<uintptr_t> resolve_with(Q&& qword, const pointer_chain_result_t& chain) {
    if (chain.addresses.empty() || chain.offsets.size() != chain.addresses.size())
        return std::nullopt;
    uintptr_t p = chain.addresses.front();
    for (const int64_t off : chain.offsets) {
        const std::optional<uint64_t> v = qword(p);
        if (!v) return std::nullopt;
        p = static_cast<uintptr_t>(*v + static_cast<uint64_t>(off));
    }
    return p;
}

} // namespace

std::optional<uintptr_t> pointer_chain_resolve(reader_t& r,
                                               const pointer_chain_result_t& chain) {
    return resolve_with([&](uintptr_t a) -> std::optional<uint64_t> {
        uint64_t v = 0;
        if (!r.read(a, &v, sizeof(v))) return std::nullopt;
        return v;
    }, chain);
}

std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t>
pointer_verify(reader_t& r,
               std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t> chains,
               const pointer_verify_options_t& opt,
               const infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
               pointer_verify_stats_t* stats) {
    pointer_verify_stats_t local{};
    pointer_verify_stats_t& st = stats ? *stats : local;
    st = {};
    st.checked = chains.size();

    const uint32_t samples  = std::clamp<uint32_t>(opt.samples, 1u, 64u);
    const uint32_t interval = std::min<uint32_t>(opt.interval_ms, 60'000u);

    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < samples && !chains.empty(); ++s) {
        if (s > 0 && interval) {
            // cancellable wait between samples
            const auto until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
                               std::chrono::milliseconds(interval);
            while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < until && !tok.cancelled())
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
        }
        if (tok.cancelled()) { st.cancelled = true; break; }

        link_reader_t links(r, st.reads);
        auto qword = [&](uintptr_t a) { return links.qword(a); };
        size_t keep = 0;
        size_t i    = 0;
        for (; i < chains.size(); ++i) {
            if (tok.cancelled()) break;
            const std::optional<uintptr_t> landed = resolve_with(qword, chains[i]);
            if (!landed) { ++st.dropped_unreadable; continue; }
            if (*landed != opt.target) { ++st.dropped_mismatch; continue; }
            if (keep != i) chains[keep] = std::move(chains[i]);
            ++keep;
        }
        // a cancelled pass keeps the chains it never got to (unverified)
        for (; i < chains.size(); ++i, ++keep)
            if (keep != i) chains[keep] = std::move(chains[i]);
        chains.resize(keep);
        if (tok.cancelled()) { st.cancelled = true; break; }
        ++st.samples_done;
    }

    st.kept = chains.size();
    return chains;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/pointer_scan.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// multi level backward pointer scan, one sweep per level, the frontier
// filters each aligned qword read, optional module backed roots only

#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <vector>

#include "core/infra/cancel.hpp"
#include "core/memory/memscan.hpp"
#include "core/memory/reader.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

// One hop of the chain, in chain order: levels[0] is the hop out of the root
// (the same order as pointer_chain_result_t::offsets). A wildcard level
// accepts any offset, which is how CE finds chains whose intermediate offset
// is unknown
struct pointer_level_t {
    int32_t  min_offset = -4096;
    int32_t  max_offset =  4096;
    uint32_t alignment  = 0;      // 0 -> pointer_scan_options_t::alignment
    bool     wildcard   = false;  // accept any 32-bit offset, ignores min/max
};

// A loaded module, so a root inside one is reported module-relative and
// survives a restart
struct pointer_module_t {
    std::string name;
    uintptr_t   base = 0;
    size_t      size = 0;
};

struct pointer_scan_options_t {
    uintptr_t target     = 0;
    uint32_t  depth      = 3;        // clamped to infra::limits::max_pointer_depth
    int32_t   min_offset = -4096;
    int32_t   max_offset =  4096;
    uint32_t  alignment  = 4;        // qword holder alignment
    size_t    frontier_cap = 100'000; // per-level expansion guard
    bool      only_module_backed = false; // roots must live in MEM_IMAGE regions

    // Per-level overrides, chain order (levels[0] = root hop). When non-empty
    // the level count is levels.size() and min_offset/max_offset/alignment
    // above only supply the defaults for levels that leave them at 0
    std::vector<pointer_level_t> levels;
    // Modules to attribute roots to (name + module_offset in the result)
    std::vector<pointer_module_t> modules;
};

struct pointer_chain_result_t {
    std::vector<uintptr_t> addresses;  // [root-most holder, ..., final holder]
    std::vector<int64_t>   offsets;    // offsets[i] applies to addresses[i]'s value
    std::string            module;     // root's module, empty when none matched
    uint64_t               module_offset = 0;  // root - module base

    size_t depth() const noexcept { return addresses.size(); }
};

struct pointer_scan_stats_t {
    uint64_t edges_explored = 0;
    bool     truncated      = false;
    bool     cancelled      = false;
};

std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t>
pointer_scan(reader_t& r,
             const std::vector<scan_region_t>& regions,
             const pointer_scan_options_t& opt,
             const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
             pointer_scan_stats_t* stats);

// Re-resolve a chain against live memory: start at addresses[0], each link
// reads the qword at the current address and adds offsets[i]. Returns the
// address the chain lands on, nullopt when a link is unreadable. Only the
// root address and the offsets matter; intermediate holders may have moved
std::optional<uintptr_t> pointer_chain_resolve(reader_t& r,
                                               const pointer_chain_result_t& chain);

struct pointer_verify_options_t {
    uintptr_t target      = 0;   // address every surviving chain must land on
    uint32_t  samples     = 1;   // passes over the list (clamped to 1..64)
    uint32_t  interval_ms = 0;   // wait between passes (clamped to 60 s)
};

struct pointer_verify_stats_t {
    size_t   checked            = 0;   // chains in
    size_t   kept               = 0;   // chains that matched on every sample
    size_t   dropped_unreadable = 0;   // a link could not be read
    size_t   dropped_mismatch   = 0;   // landed somewhere other than target
    uint32_t samples_done       = 0;
    uint64_t reads              = 0;   // qword reads issued (memoized per pass)
    bool     cancelled          = false;
};

// Cheat-Engine "rescan pointer list": re-read every chain over N samples and
// keep only the ones that land on target each time. Survivors keep their
// input order. Reads are memoized within a pass (chains share prefixes)
std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t>
pointer_verify(reader_t& r,
               std::vector<pointer_chain_result_t> chains,
               const pointer_verify_options_t& opt,
               const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
               pointer_verify_stats_t* stats);

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/read_util.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/read_util.cpp

#include "core/memory/read_util.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <exception>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <thread>

namespace slop::core::memory::detail {

void resilient_read_into(reader_t& r, uintptr_t addr, size_t len, size_t min_leaf,
                         const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                         uint8_t* dst, std::vector<read_run_t>& runs) {
    runs.clear();
    if (len == 0) return;
    if (min_leaf == 0) min_leaf = 1;

    struct seg_t { size_t off; size_t len; };
    // LIFO with the upper half pushed first: segments pop in ascending order
    std::vector<seg_t> stack{ {0, len} };

    while (!stack.empty()) {
        if (tok.cancelled()) return;
        const seg_t s = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();

        if (r.read(addr + s.off, dst + s.off, s.len)) {
            if (!runs.empty() && runs.back().off + runs.back().len == s.off)
                runs.back().len += s.len;
            else
                runs.push_back({s.off, s.len});
            continue;
        }
        if (s.len <= min_leaf) continue; // unreadable leaf: contribute nothing
        const size_t half = std::max<size_t>((s.len / 2 / min_leaf) * min_leaf, min_leaf);
        stack.push_back({s.off + half, s.len - half});
        stack.push_back({s.off, half});
    }
}

void resilient_read(reader_t& r, uintptr_t addr, size_t len, size_t min_leaf,
                    const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                    const std::function<void(uintptr_t, const uint8_t*, size_t)>& sink) {
    if (len == 0) return;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(len);
    std::vector<read_run_t> runs;
    resilient_read_into(r, addr, len, min_leaf, tok, buf.data(), runs);
    for (const auto& run : runs) {
        if (tok.cancelled()) return;
        sink(addr + run.off, buf.data() + run.off, run.len);
    }
}

namespace {

struct chunk_buf_t {
    size_t                  range = 0;
    uintptr_t               base  = 0;
    uintptr_t               limit = 0;   // first address owned by the next chunk
    std::vector<uint8_t>    bytes;
    std::vector<read_run_t> runs;
};

// position of the next chunk to read across the range list
struct walk_cursor_t {
    size_t    range = 0;
    uintptr_t cur   = 0;
};

} // namespace

void chunked_read(reader_t& r, const std::vector<read_range_t>& ranges,
                  const chunk_walk_t& walk,
                  const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                  const chunk_sink_t& sink) {
    // step over exhausted/empty ranges so the cursor only lands on real bytes
    auto settle = [&](walk_cursor_t& c) {
        while (c.range < ranges.size()) {
            const read_range_t& rg = ranges[c.range];
            if (rg.len && c.cur >= rg.addr && c.cur < rg.addr + rg.len) return;
            ++c.range;
            if (c.range < ranges.size()) c.cur = ranges[c.range].addr;
        }
    };
    walk_cursor_t start{0, ranges.empty() ? 0 : ranges[0].addr};
    settle(start);
    if (start.range >= ranges.size()) return;

    // fill the chunk at c and advance c past it
    auto fill = [&](chunk_buf_t& b, walk_cursor_t& c) {
        const read_range_t& rg = ranges[c.range];
        const uintptr_t end   = rg.addr + rg.len;
        const size_t    chunk = walk.chunk ? walk.chunk : rg.len;
        const size_t own  = static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(chunk, end - c.cur));
        const size_t tail = static_cast<size_t>(
            std::min<uint64_t>(walk.overlap, end - c.cur - own));
        b.range = c.range;
        b.base  = c.cur;
        b.limit = c.cur + own;
        b.bytes.resize(own + tail);
        resilient_read_into(r, c.cur, own + tail, walk.min_leaf, tok, b.bytes.data(), b.runs);
        c.cur = b.limit;
        settle(c);
    };
    auto drain = [&](const chunk_buf_t& b) -> bool {
        for (const auto& run : b.runs) {
            if (tok.cancelled()) return false;
            if (!sink(b.range, b.base + run.off, b.bytes.data() + run.off, run.len, b.limit))
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    };

    // a single chunk overall gains nothing from a helper thread
    bool single_chunk = false;
    {
        walk_cursor_t probe = start;
        const read_range_t& rg = ranges[probe.range];
        const size_t chunk = walk.chunk ? walk.chunk : rg.len;
        if (rg.addr + rg.len - probe.cur <= chunk) {
            probe.cur = rg.addr + rg.len;
            settle(probe);
            single_chunk = probe.range >= ranges.size();
        }
    }

    if (!walk.read_ahead || single_chunk) {
        chunk_buf_t   b;
        walk_cursor_t c = start;
        while (c.range < ranges.size()) {
            if (tok.cancelled()) return;
            fill(b, c);
            if (!drain(b)) return;
        }
        return;
    }

    // double buffered: the producer reads chunk k+1 while the caller's sink
    // chews on chunk k; buffers are recycled so steady state allocates nothing
    std::mutex                 mu;
    std::condition_variable    cv;
    std::optional<chunk_buf_t> ready;
    std::vector<chunk_buf_t>   spare;
    bool                       done = false;
    bool                       stop = false;
    std::exception_ptr         producer_error;

    std::thread producer([&] {
        try {
            walk_cursor_t c = start;
            while (c.range < ranges.size()) {
                chunk_buf_t b;
                {
                    std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                    if (stop) break;
                    if (!spare.empty()) {
                        b = std::move(spare.back());
                        spare.pop_back();
                    }
                }
                if (tok.cancelled()) break;
                fill(b, c);
                std::unique_lock lk(mu);
                cv.wait(lk, [&] { return !ready.has_value() || stop; });
                if (stop) break;
                ready = std::move(b);
                cv.notify_all();
            }
        } catch (...) {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            producer_error = std::current_exception();
        }
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        done = true;
        cv.notify_all();
    });

    auto halt = [&] {
        {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            stop = true;
        }
        cv.notify_all();
        producer.join();
    };

    try {
        for (;;) {
            chunk_buf_t b;
            {
                std::unique_lock lk(mu);
                cv.wait(lk, [&] { return ready.has_value() || done; });
                if (!ready) break;
                b = std::move(*ready);
                ready.reset();
            }
            cv.notify_all();
            const bool more = drain(b);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                spare.push_back(std::move(b));
            }
            if (!more || tok.cancelled()) break;
        }
    } catch (...) {
        halt();
        throw;
    }
    halt();
    if (producer_error) std::rethrow_exception(producer_error);
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory::detail
```
