`src/core/memory/read_util.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// fault tolerant read helpers: bisect unreadable ranges down to a leaf size,
// walk big ranges chunk by chunk with an optional read-ahead thread

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>

#include "core/infra/cancel.hpp"
#include "core/memory/reader.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory::detail {

// one readable run inside a caller buffer (offsets relative to its base)
struct read_run_t {
    size_t off = 0;
    size_t len = 0;
};

// read [addr, addr+len) straight into dst; unreadable parts are halved down
// to min_leaf and left untouched in dst. runs receives the readable parts in
// ascending order with adjacent runs merged
void resilient_read_into(reader_t& r, uintptr_t addr, size_t len, size_t min_leaf,
                         const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                         uint8_t* dst, std::vector<read_run_t>& runs);

// read the range, unreadable parts get halved down to min leaf, every
// readable run goes to the sink in ascending address order
void resilient_read(reader_t& r, uintptr_t addr, size_t len, size_t min_leaf,
                    const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                    const std::function<void(uintptr_t, const uint8_t*, size_t)>& sink);

struct chunk_walk_t {
    size_t chunk      = 0;     // bytes owned by each chunk (0 -> whole range)
    size_t overlap    = 0;     // extra bytes read past each chunk so values
                               // straddling the border are seen whole
    size_t min_leaf   = 4096;  // bisect floor for unreadable parts
    bool   read_ahead = false; // fetch chunk k+1 on a helper thread while the
                               // sink works on chunk k (double buffered)
};

// one address range to walk
struct read_range_t {
    uintptr_t addr = 0;
    size_t    len  = 0;
};

// sink(range_index, run_addr, data, len, start_limit): candidates starting at
// or past start_limit belong to the next chunk and must be skipped (they sit
// in the overlap tail). Return false to stop the walk
using chunk_sink_t =
    std::function<bool(size_t, uintptr_t, const uint8_t*, size_t, uintptr_t)>;

// walk every range in order, chunk by chunk in ascending address order. Each
// chunk is read with resilient_read_into; every readable run reaches the
// sink. With read_ahead the next chunk (possibly of the next range) is read
// while the sink processes the current one
void chunked_read(reader_t& r, const std::vector<read_range_t>& ranges,
                  const chunk_walk_t& walk,
                  const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                  const chunk_sink_t& sink);
} // namespace slop::core::memory::detail
```

`src/core/memory/reader.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// minimal read abstraction, a session in production and a fake in tests

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace slop::core::memory {

// How the scan engines should drive a reader. Local readers keep the
// defaults (fan out across cores, default chunk size). Remote readers that
// funnel every read through one serialized connection (the ps4debug socket)
// ask for a single worker, bigger chunks and a read-ahead thread so the next
// chunk is in flight while the current one is being compared
struct reader_hints_t {
    unsigned max_workers  = 0;     // 0 = no limit
    size_t   chunk_bytes  = 0;     // 0 = engine default
    bool     read_ahead   = false; // double-buffer chunk reads
    size_t   coalesce_gap = 0;     // address-list rescans: merge reads of rows
                                   // whose gap is <= this (0 = one read per row)
};

// Hints for a reader backed by one serialized remote connection
inline constexpr size_t kRemoteChunkBytes   = 8u << 20;  // 8 MiB per wire read
inline constexpr size_t kRemoteCoalesceGap  = 4096;      // one page of slack
// largest chunk a caller may request over the wire: the ps4debug transfer cap
// (16 MiB) minus a page for the overlap tail chunk walks append
inline constexpr size_t kRemoteMaxChunkBytes = (16u << 20) - 4096;

constexpr reader_hints_t remote_reader_hints() noexcept {
    return reader_hints_t{1u, kRemoteChunkBytes, true, kRemoteCoalesceGap};
}

class reader_t {
public:
    virtual ~reader_t() = default;

    // Read len bytes at addr. Returns false if any part is unreadable
    // (unmapped, no access, target died). Partial reads never happen
    virtual bool read(uintptr_t addr, void* dst, size_t len) = 0;

    // Scheduling hints for the scan engines (see reader_hints_t)
    virtual reader_hints_t hints() const noexcept { return {}; }
};

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/session_reader.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// reader over an attached runtime session. Reads ride the active backend; on
// a console (ps4debug) every read is a command on one serialized socket, so
// the reader asks the scan engines for one worker, big chunks, read-ahead and
// coalesced rescans instead of fanning threads onto that socket

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

#include "core/memory/reader.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/backend_registry.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/session.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

// scheduling hints for whichever backend serves session reads right now
inline reader_hints_t hints_for_backend(runtime::backend_kind_t kind) noexcept {
    return kind == runtime::backend_kind_t::ps4 ? remote_reader_hints() : reader_hints_t{};
}

class session_reader_t final : public reader_t {
public:
    explicit session_reader_t(runtime::session_t& s)
        : s_(s), hints_(hints_for_backend(runtime::active_kind())) {}

    bool read(uintptr_t addr, void* dst, size_t len) override {
        const auto io = s_.read(addr, dst, len);
        return io.ok && io.bytes == len;
    }

    reader_hints_t hints() const noexcept override { return hints_; }

private:
    runtime::session_t& s_;
    reader_hints_t      hints_;
};

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/snapshot.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/snapshot.cpp

#include "core/memory/snapshot.hpp"

#include "core/infra/limits.hpp"
#include "core/memory/read_util.hpp"

#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::memory {

region_snapshot_t snapshot_capture(reader_t& r, uintptr_t base, size_t size,
                                   const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                                   uint64_t max_bytes) {
    region_snapshot_t snap;
    snap.base = base;

    if (size == 0) { snap.complete = true; return snap; }

    bool clamped = false;
    if (static_cast<uint64_t>(size) > max_bytes) {
        size = static_cast<size_t>(max_bytes);
        clamped = true;
    }

    snap.bytes.assign(size, 0x00);
    snap.size = size;

    // chunked walk honouring the reader's hints: a console gets big chunks
    // with read-ahead and page-granular hole probing (byte bisects would cost
    // thousands of roundtrips per unreadable page); local readers keep the
    // byte-exact hole map
    const reader_hints_t hints = r.hints();
    detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
    walk.chunk      = hints.chunk_bytes ? hints.chunk_bytes : size_t{1} << 20;
    walk.min_leaf   = hints.max_workers == 1 ? 4096 : 1;
    walk.read_ahead = hints.read_ahead;

    uint64_t covered = 0;
    detail::chunked_read(r, {{base, size}}, walk, tok,
        [&](size_t, uintptr_t addr, const uint8_t* data, size_t len, uintptr_t) {
            std::memcpy(snap.bytes.data() + (addr - base), data, len);
            covered += len;
            return true;
        });
    if (tok.cancelled()) { snap.complete = false; return snap; }

    // unreadable leaves stay zero-filled
    const bool holes = covered < size;
    snap.complete = !holes && !clamped;
    return snap;
}

snapshot_diff_t snapshot_diff(const region_snapshot_t& a, const region_snapshot_t& b) {
    snapshot_diff_t d;
    if (a.base != b.base || a.size != b.size || a.bytes.size() != b.bytes.size())
        return d; // valid stays false

    d.valid = true;
    const size_t n = a.bytes.size();

    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        if (a.bytes[i] == b.bytes[i]) { ++i; continue; }
        const size_t start = i;
        while (i < n && a.bytes[i] != b.bytes[i]) ++i;
        d.changed.push_back({start, i - start});
        if (d.changed.size() >= infra::limits::max_diff_ranges) break;
    }
    return d;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory

```

`src/core/memory/snapshot.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/memory/snapshot.hpp
// Region snapshots + byte-level diffing for state-change analysis

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

#include "core/infra/cancel.hpp"
#include "core/memory/reader.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory {

struct region_snapshot_t {
    uintptr_t              base     = 0;
    size_t                 size     = 0;
    std::vector<uint8_t>   bytes;
    bool                   complete = false;  // false if capped or partially unreadable
};

// Capture up to max_bytes of [base, base+size). Unreadable chunks are
// bisected; holes are zero-filled and marked via complete=false
region_snapshot_t snapshot_capture(reader_t& r, uintptr_t base, size_t size,
                                   const slop::core::infra::cancel_token_t& tok,
                                   uint64_t max_bytes);

struct snapshot_span_t {
    size_t offset;   // relative to region base
    size_t length;
};

struct snapshot_diff_t {
    std::vector<snapshot_span_t> changed;
    bool valid = false;   // false when inputs mismatch (base/size differ)
};

// Byte-precise diff with adjacent-byte coalescing into spans
// Capped at infra::limits::max_diff_ranges spans
snapshot_diff_t snapshot_diff(const region_snapshot_t& a, const region_snapshot_t& b);

} // namespace slop::core::memory
```

`src/core/memory/watch_service.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/memory/watch_service.cpp

#include "core/memory/watch_service.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>

#include "core/infra/clock.hpp"
#include "core/infra/event_bus.hpp"
#include "core/infra/limits.hpp"
#include "core/infra/text_format.hpp"
#include "core/process/target_service.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory::watch {

namespace {

using json = nlohmann::json;
namespace bus = infra::event_bus;

// Per-pass target budgets: the watch pane never issued more than 64 reads per
// pass (so a 4096-entry list could not stall the caller), and freeze
// write-backs are capped too, each one is a full roundtrip on a console
constexpr detail::pass_limits_t kPassLimits{64, 16};
constexpr int64_t kSampleIntervalMs = 100;   // ~10 Hz

struct state_t {
    std::mutex           mu;
    std::vector<entry_t> entries;
    std::vector<value_t> last;
    uint64_t             next_id     = 1;
    int64_t              last_pass_ms = 0;
    size_t               cursor       = 0;   // round-robin start for the budgets
};

state_t& st() {
    static state_t s;
    return s;
}

entry_t* find(state_t& s, uint64_t id) {
    auto it = std::find_if(s.entries.begin(), s.entries.end(),
                           [id](const entry_t& e) { return e.id == id; });
    return it == s.entries.end() ? nullptr : &*it;
}

const char* width_name(value_width_t w) noexcept {
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::i8:  return "i8";
    case value_width_t::u8:  return "u8";
    case value_width_t::i16: return "i16";
    case value_width_t::u16: return "u16";
    case value_width_t::i32: return "i32";
    case value_width_t::u32: return "u32";
    case value_width_t::i64: return "i64";
    case value_width_t::u64: return "u64";
    case value_width_t::f32: return "f32";
    case value_width_t::f64: return "f64";
    }
    return "?";
}

json entry_json(const entry_t& e) {
    return json{{"id", e.id},
                {"addr", e.addr},
                {"width", width_name(e.width)},
                {"label", e.label},
                {"freeze", e.freeze},
                {"frozen_bits", e.frozen_bits},
                {"frozen_text", format_value_text(e.width, e.frozen_bits)},
                {"interval_ms", e.interval_ms}};
}

void publish_list_locked(const state_t& s) {
    json arr = json::array();
    for (const auto& e : s.entries) arr.push_back(entry_json(e));
    bus::publish("watch.list", json{{"entries", std::move(arr)}});
}

} // namespace

uint64_t add(uint64_t addr, value_width_t width, std::string label) {
    state_t& s = st();
    uint64_t id = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        if (s.entries.size() >= infra::limits::max_watch_entries) return 0;
        entry_t e;
        e.id          = s.next_id++;
        e.addr        = addr;
        e.width       = width;
        e.label       = std::move(label);
        e.freeze      = false;
        e.frozen_bits = 0;
        id = e.id;
        s.entries.push_back(std::move(e));
        publish_list_locked(s);
    }
    return id;
}

bool remove(uint64_t id) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    const auto before = s.entries.size();
    s.entries.erase(std::remove_if(s.entries.begin(), s.entries.end(),
                                   [id](const entry_t& e) { return e.id == id; }),
                    s.entries.end());
    if (s.entries.size() == before) return false;
    s.last.erase(std::remove_if(s.last.begin(), s.last.end(),
                                [id](const value_t& v) { return v.id == id; }),
                 s.last.end());
    publish_list_locked(s);
    return true;
}

void clear() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    s.entries.clear();
    s.last.clear();
    publish_list_locked(s);
}

bool set_freeze(uint64_t id, bool on) {
    state_t& s = st();
    uint64_t addr = 0;
    size_t   n    = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        entry_t* e = find(s, id);
        if (!e) return false;
        if (on && !e->freeze) {
            // Latch whatever the last sample saw, exactly like ticking the
            // ImGui checkbox did. A fresh entry has no sample yet, so read the
            // live value below instead of leaving frozen_bits at 0 (which made
            // the next pass write zero over the target).
            auto it = std::find_if(s.last.begin(), s.last.end(),
                                   [id](const value_t& v) { return v.id == id; });
            if (it != s.last.end() && it->ok) {
                e->frozen_bits = it->bits;
                e->pre_freeze_bits = it->bits;
                e->pre_freeze_valid = true;
            } else {
                addr = e->addr;
                n = value_size(e->width);
            }
        }
        e->freeze = on;
        publish_list_locked(s);
    }
    if (on && n != 0) {
        auto session = process::active_session();
        if (!session || !session->valid()) {
            std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
            if (entry_t* e = find(s, id)) e->freeze = false;
            publish_list_locked(s);
            return false;
        }
        uint64_t live = 0;
        const auto res = session->read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), &live, n);
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        entry_t* e = find(s, id);
        if (!e || !e->freeze) return false;
        if (!res.ok) {
            e->freeze = false;   // never leave a freeze armed with a zero hold
            publish_list_locked(s);
            return false;
        }
        e->frozen_bits = live & (n >= 8 ? ~uint64_t{0} : ((uint64_t{1} << (n * 8)) - 1));
        e->pre_freeze_bits = e->frozen_bits;
        e->pre_freeze_valid = true;
        publish_list_locked(s);
    }
    return true;
}

bool set_freeze_once(uint64_t id) {
    if (!set_freeze(id, true)) return false;
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    entry_t* e = find(s, id);
    if (!e) return false;
    e->freeze_once = true;
    publish_list_locked(s);
    return true;
}

bool undo_freeze(uint64_t id, std::string* err) {
    state_t& s = st();
    uint64_t addr = 0, bits = 0;
    size_t   n = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        entry_t* e = find(s, id);
        if (!e) { if (err) *err = "no such watch entry"; return false; }
        if (!e->freeze && !e->pre_freeze_valid) {
            if (err) *err = "this entry has no freeze to undo";
            return false;
        }
        addr = e->addr;
        bits = e->pre_freeze_bits;
        n    = value_size(e->width);
    }
    auto session = process::active_session();
    if (!session || !session->valid()) { if (err) *err = "no target attached"; return false; }
    const auto res = session->write(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), &bits, n);
    if (!res.ok) { if (err) *err = "restore write failed"; return false; }
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    if (entry_t* e = find(s, id)) {
        e->freeze = false;
        e->freeze_once = false;
        e->pre_freeze_valid = false;
    }
    publish_list_locked(s);
    return true;
}

bool poke(uint64_t id, uint64_t bits, std::string* err) {
    state_t& s = st();
    uint64_t  addr  = 0;
    size_t    n     = 0;
    bool      found = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        entry_t* e = find(s, id);
        if (!e) {
            if (err) *err = "no such watch entry";
            return false;
        }
        addr  = e->addr;
        n     = value_size(e->width);
        found = true;
        e->frozen_bits = bits;   // frozen or not, this is now the held value
    }
    if (!found) return false;

    auto session = process::active_session();
    if (!session || !session->valid()) {
        if (err) *err = "no target attached";
        return false;
    }
    const auto res = session->write(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), &bits, n);
    if (!res.ok && err) *err = "write failed";
    if (res.ok) {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        publish_list_locked(s);
    }
    return res.ok;
}

bool set_width(uint64_t id, value_width_t width) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    entry_t* e = find(s, id);
    if (!e) return false;
    e->width = width;
    publish_list_locked(s);
    return true;
}

bool set_label(uint64_t id, std::string label) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    entry_t* e = find(s, id);
    if (!e) return false;
    e->label = std::move(label);
    publish_list_locked(s);
    return true;
}

bool set_interval(uint64_t id, uint32_t interval_ms) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    entry_t* e = find(s, id);
    if (!e) return false;
    e->interval_ms = std::clamp<uint32_t>(interval_ms ? interval_ms : 100, 10, 60'000);
    publish_list_locked(s);
    return true;
}

std::vector<entry_t> list() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    return s.entries;
}

std::vector<value_t> values() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    return s.last;
}

size_t size() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    return s.entries.size();
}

// Cheat Engine .CT round trip

namespace {

const char* ce_variable_type(value_width_t w) noexcept {
    switch (w) {
    case value_width_t::i8:
    case value_width_t::u8:  return "Byte";
    case value_width_t::i16:
    case value_width_t::u16: return "2 Bytes";
    case value_width_t::i32:
    case value_width_t::u32: return "4 Bytes";
    case value_width_t::i64:
    case value_width_t::u64: return "8 Bytes";
    case value_width_t::f32: return "Float";
    case value_width_t::f64: return "Double";
    }
    return "4 Bytes";
}

bool ce_width_from_name(std::string_view name, value_width_t& out) noexcept {
    while (!name.empty() && (name.back() == ' ' || name.back() == '\t')) name.remove_suffix(1);
    while (!name.empty() && (name.front() == ' ' || name.front() == '\t')) name.remove_prefix(1);
    if (name == "Byte" || name == "byte")   { out = value_width_t::i8;  return true; }
    if (name == "2 Bytes")                  { out = value_width_t::i16; return true; }
    if (name == "4 Bytes")                  { out = value_width_t::i32; return true; }
    if (name == "8 Bytes")                  { out = value_width_t::i64; return true; }
    if (name == "Float" || name == "float") { out = value_width_t::f32; return true; }
    if (name == "Double")                   { out = value_width_t::f64; return true; }
    return false;
}

void xml_escape(std::string& out, std::string_view text) {
    for (const char c : text) {
        switch (c) {
        case '&':  out += "&amp;";  break;
        case '<':  out += "&lt;";   break;
        case '>':  out += "&gt;";   break;
        case '"':  out += "&quot;"; break;
        default:   out += c;        break;
        }
    }
}

std::string xml_unescape(std::string_view text) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(text.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < text.size(); ++i) {
        if (text[i] != '&') { out += text[i]; continue; }
        const size_t semi = text.find(';', i);
        if (semi == std::string_view::npos) { out += text[i]; continue; }
        const std::string_view ent = text.substr(i + 1, semi - i - 1);
        if      (ent == "amp")  out += '&';
        else if (ent == "lt")   out += '<';
        else if (ent == "gt")   out += '>';
        else if (ent == "quot") out += '"';
        else if (ent == "apos") out += '\'';
        else { out += text.substr(i, semi - i + 1); }
        i = semi;
    }
    return out;
}

// text between the first <tag> after `from` and its closing tag
std::optional<std::string_view> xml_text(std::string_view xml, size_t from,
                                         std::string_view tag) {
    const std::string open  = "<" + std::string(tag) + ">";
    const std::string close = "</" + std::string(tag) + ">";
    const size_t b = xml.find(open, from);
    if (b == std::string_view::npos) return std::nullopt;
    const size_t s = b + open.size();
    const size_t e = xml.find(close, s);
    if (e == std::string_view::npos) return std::nullopt;
    return xml.substr(s, e - s);
}

// CE writes descriptions quoted; strip the quotes so labels round trip
std::string ct_text(std::string_view raw) {
    std::string text = xml_unescape(raw);
    if (text.size() >= 2 && text.front() == '"' && text.back() == '"')
        text = text.substr(1, text.size() - 2);
    return text;
}

bool parse_hex_address(std::string_view text, uint64_t& out) noexcept {
    while (!text.empty() && (text.front() == ' ' || text.front() == '\t')) text.remove_prefix(1);
    while (!text.empty() && (text.back() == ' ' || text.back() == '\t')) text.remove_suffix(1);
    if (text.size() > 2 && text[0] == '0' && (text[1] == 'x' || text[1] == 'X'))
        text.remove_prefix(2);
    if (text.empty() || text.size() > 16) return false;
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (const char c : text) {
        int d;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')      d = c - '0';
        else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') d = c - 'a' + 10;
        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') d = c - 'A' + 10;
        else return false;
        v = (v << 4) | static_cast<uint64_t>(d);
    }
    out = v;
    return true;
}

} // namespace

std::string export_ct() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);

    std::string out =
        "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\"?>\n"
        "<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion=\"45\">\n"
        "  <CheatEntries>\n";
    uint64_t id = 1;
    char addr[24];
    for (const auto& e : s.entries) {
        std::snprintf(addr, sizeof(addr), "%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(e.addr));
        out += "    <CheatEntry>\n";
        out += "      <ID>" + std::to_string(id++) + "</ID>\n";
        out += "      <Description>\"";
        xml_escape(out, e.label.empty() ? addr : e.label);
        out += "\"</Description>\n";
        out += "      <VariableType>" + std::string(ce_variable_type(e.width)) +
               "</VariableType>\n";
        out += "      <Address>" + std::string(addr) + "</Address>\n";
        out += "    </CheatEntry>\n";
    }
    out += "  </CheatEntries>\n</CheatTable>\n";
    return out;
}

size_t import_ct(std::string_view xml, std::string* err) {
    size_t imported = 0;
    size_t skipped  = 0;
    size_t at = 0;
    while (true) {
        const size_t b = xml.find("<CheatEntry>", at);
        if (b == std::string_view::npos) break;
        const size_t e = xml.find("</CheatEntry>", b);
        if (e == std::string_view::npos) break;
        const std::string_view entry = xml.substr(b, e - b);
        at = e + 1;

        const auto addr_text = xml_text(entry, 0, "Address");
        uint64_t addr = 0;
        if (!addr_text || !parse_hex_address(*addr_text, addr)) { ++skipped; continue; }
        value_width_t width = value_width_t::i32;
        if (const auto vt = xml_text(entry, 0, "VariableType"))
            if (!ce_width_from_name(*vt, width)) { ++skipped; continue; }
        std::string label;
        if (const auto d = xml_text(entry, 0, "Description")) label = ct_text(*d);
        if (label.empty()) label = infra::fmt::format_address(addr);
        if (add(addr, width, std::move(label)) == 0) { ++skipped; continue; }
        ++imported;
    }
    if (err) {
        if (imported == 0)
            *err = skipped ? "no importable CheatEntry (module-relative or unknown "
                             "VariableType addresses are skipped)"
                           : "no CheatEntry found in the table";
        else if (skipped)
            *err = std::to_string(skipped) + " entries skipped";
        else
            err->clear();
    }
    return imported;
}

namespace detail {

namespace {

uint64_t width_mask(size_t n) noexcept {
    return n >= 8 ? ~uint64_t{0} : ((uint64_t{1} << (n * 8)) - 1);
}

} // namespace

std::vector<value_t> sample_pass(const std::vector<entry_t>& entries,
                                 const std::vector<value_t>& prev,
                                 pass_io_t& io, const pass_limits_t& lim,
                                 size_t& cursor, pass_stats_t* stats,
                                 int64_t now_ms) {
    pass_stats_t local{};
    pass_stats_t& st = stats ? *stats : local;
    st = {};

    const size_t count = entries.size();
    std::vector<value_t> out(count);
    if (count == 0) { cursor = 0; return out; }

    auto previous = [&](uint64_t id) -> const value_t* {
        for (const auto& v : prev) if (v.id == id) return &v;
        return nullptr;
    };

    const size_t start = cursor % count;
    bool   have_next = false;
    size_t next      = start;
    auto defer = [&](size_t idx) {
        ++st.deferred;
        if (!have_next) { have_next = true; next = idx; }
    };

    for (size_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
        const size_t   idx = (start + k) % count;
        const entry_t& e   = entries[idx];
        const size_t   n   = value_size(e.width);
        value_t&       v   = out[idx];
        v.id   = e.id;
        v.addr = e.addr;
        v.held = e.freeze;

        // per-entry rate: not due yet, so show the last sample and keep the
        // cursor where it is (this is not a budget deferral)
        if (now_ms != 0 && e.last_sample_ms != 0 &&
            now_ms - e.last_sample_ms < static_cast<int64_t>(e.interval_ms)) {
            if (const value_t* p = previous(e.id)) {
                v.ok = p->ok; v.bits = p->bits; v.hold_failed = p->hold_failed;
            }
            v.text = v.ok ? format_value_text(e.width, v.bits) : std::string("-");
            ++st.rate_skipped;
            continue;
        }

        if (st.reads >= lim.max_reads) {
            // out of read budget: keep showing what the last pass saw
            if (const value_t* p = previous(e.id)) {
                v.ok = p->ok; v.bits = p->bits; v.hold_failed = p->hold_failed;
            }
            defer(idx);
            v.text = v.ok ? format_value_text(e.width, v.bits) : std::string("-");
            continue;
        }

        uint64_t live = 0;
        ++st.reads;
        const bool read_ok = io.read(e.addr, &live, n);
        live &= width_mask(n);
        v.ok   = read_ok;
        v.bits = read_ok ? live : 0;
        v.sampled = true;

        if (e.freeze) {
            const uint64_t hold = e.frozen_bits & width_mask(n);
            if (read_ok && live == hold) {
                // dirty check: the target already holds the value
                ++st.clean_holds;
                v.ok = true;
                v.wrote = true;
                v.bits = hold;
            } else if (st.writes >= lim.max_writes) {
                // drifted but the write budget is spent: next pass starts here
                if (const value_t* p = previous(e.id)) v.hold_failed = p->hold_failed;
                defer(idx);
            } else {
                ++st.writes;
                uint64_t buf = hold;
                if (io.write(e.addr, &buf, n)) {
                    v.ok = true;
                    v.wrote = true;
                    v.bits = hold;
                } else {
                    // the console rejected the hold (read-only page, detached
                    // session...): surface it instead of claiming success
                    ++st.write_failures;
                    v.ok = false;
                    v.hold_failed = true;
                }
            }
        }

        v.text = v.ok ? format_value_text(e.width, v.bits) : std::string("-");
    }

    cursor = have_next ? next : start;
    return out;
}

} // namespace detail

namespace {

class session_io_t final : public detail::pass_io_t {
public:
    explicit session_io_t(runtime::session_t& s) : s_(s) {}
    bool read(uint64_t addr, void* dst, size_t n) override {
        const auto io = s_.read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), dst, n);
        return io.ok && io.bytes == n;
    }
    bool write(uint64_t addr, const void* src, size_t n) override {
        const auto io = s_.write(static_cast<uintptr_t>(addr), src, n);
        return io.ok && io.bytes == n;
    }
private:
    runtime::session_t& s_;
};

} // namespace

void tick() {
    state_t& s = st();

    // Snapshot under the lock, then touch the target outside it: a kernel-path
    // read must never be holding the list mutex that the UI thread wants
    std::vector<entry_t> snap;
    std::vector<value_t> prev;
    size_t cursor = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        if (s.entries.empty()) {
            if (!s.last.empty()) s.last.clear();
            return;
        }
        const int64_t now = infra::steady_ms();
        if (now - s.last_pass_ms < kSampleIntervalMs) return;
        s.last_pass_ms = now;
        snap   = s.entries;
        prev   = s.last;
        cursor = s.cursor;
    }

    auto session = process::active_session();
    if (!session || !session->valid()) {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        if (!s.last.empty()) {
            s.last.clear();
            bus::publish("watch.values", json{{"attached", false},
                                              {"values", json::array()}});
        }
        return;
    }

    session_io_t io(*session);
    const int64_t now = infra::steady_ms();
    const std::vector<value_t> sampled =
        detail::sample_pass(snap, prev, io, kPassLimits, cursor, nullptr, now);

    // Track live values into frozen_bits while unfrozen so that flipping the
    // freeze on latches the value the caller is looking at
    bool changed = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        s.cursor = cursor;
        for (const auto& v : sampled) {
            entry_t* e = find(s, v.id);
            if (!e) continue;
            if (!v.sampled) continue;   // rate-skipped or budget-deferred
            e->last_sample_ms = now;
            if (!e->freeze && v.ok) e->frozen_bits = v.bits;
            // freeze-once: release as soon as the hold actually landed
            if (e->freeze && e->freeze_once && v.wrote) {
                e->freeze = false;
                e->freeze_once = false;
                e->pre_freeze_valid = false;
            }
        }
        changed = s.last.size() != sampled.size();
        if (!changed) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < sampled.size(); ++i) {
                if (s.last[i].id != sampled[i].id ||
                    s.last[i].ok != sampled[i].ok ||
                    s.last[i].held != sampled[i].held ||
                    s.last[i].hold_failed != sampled[i].hold_failed ||
                    s.last[i].bits != sampled[i].bits) {
                    changed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        s.last = sampled;
    }

    if (!changed) return;   // nothing moved: keep the event stream quiet

    json arr = json::array();
    for (const auto& v : sampled)
        arr.push_back(json{{"id", v.id},
                           {"addr", v.addr},
                           {"ok", v.ok},
                           {"held", v.held},
                           {"hold_failed", v.hold_failed},
                           {"bits", v.bits},
                           {"text", v.text}});
    bus::publish("watch.values", json{{"attached", true},
                                      {"values", std::move(arr)}});
}

void shutdown() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    s.entries.clear();
    s.last.clear();
    s.last_pass_ms = 0;
}

} // namespace slop::core::memory::watch
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// the watchlist with freeze writes, lifted out of the scanner view so the
// ui, agents and front ends all share one list, the app tick services it
// and values go out as a batched event

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#include "core/memory/memscan.hpp"

namespace slop::core::memory::watch {

struct entry_t {
    uint64_t      id          = 0;
    uint64_t      addr        = 0;
    value_width_t width       = value_width_t::u32;
    std::string   label;
    bool          freeze      = false;
    bool          freeze_once = false;   // release after the first write-back
    uint64_t      frozen_bits = 0;
    uint64_t      pre_freeze_bits = 0;   // value before the hold, for undo
    bool          pre_freeze_valid = false;
    uint32_t      interval_ms = 100;     // per-entry service rate (freeze write-back included)
    int64_t       last_sample_ms = 0;    // steady clock of the last sampled pass
};

struct value_t {
    uint64_t    id   = 0;
    uint64_t    addr = 0;
    bool        ok   = false;   // live read succeeded on the last pass
    bool        held = false;   // value is being held by a freeze write
    bool        wrote = false;  // the hold landed (write or already-equal)
    bool        hold_failed = false; // the freeze write-back was rejected
    bool        sampled = false;     // serviced this pass (not rate-skipped/deferred)
    uint64_t    bits = 0;
    std::string text;           // format_value_text(width, bits)
};

// Add an entry. Returns its id, or 0 when the watch cap is reached
uint64_t add(uint64_t addr, value_width_t width, std::string label);

bool remove(uint64_t id);
void clear();

// Toggle the freeze hold. Turning it on latches the most recently sampled
// value, matching the ImGui checkbox behaviour it replaces
bool set_freeze(uint64_t id, bool on);

// Freeze until the first successful write-back, then release (safe poke)
bool set_freeze_once(uint64_t id);

// Release the hold and restore the value captured when it was armed
bool undo_freeze(uint64_t id, std::string* err = nullptr);

// Overwrite the target now and, when frozen, latch the new value as the hold
bool poke(uint64_t id, uint64_t bits, std::string* err = nullptr);

bool set_width(uint64_t id, value_width_t width);
bool set_label(uint64_t id, std::string label);
// Per-entry service rate in ms (clamped to 10..60000). 0 restores the default
bool set_interval(uint64_t id, uint32_t interval_ms);

std::vector<entry_t> list();

// Values from the most recent service pass (no target reads on this path)
std::vector<value_t> values();

size_t size();

// Cheat Engine .CT round trip (audit #84): one CheatEntry per watch, with the
// CE VariableType name for its width. import_ct accepts the same shape (plus
// any .CT whose entries carry Address/VariableType) and appends to the list.
// Entries with a module-relative address (name+offset) are skipped: this app
// has no module base to resolve them against at import time
std::string export_ct();
size_t import_ct(std::string_view xml, std::string* err = nullptr);

// one service pass, sample values, apply freezes, publish when anything
// moved, rate limited to about 10hz
void tick();

// Drop every entry and forget the sampling clock (app shutdown / detach)
void shutdown();

namespace detail {

// target access for one pass (the session in production, a fake in tests)
class pass_io_t {
public:
    virtual ~pass_io_t() = default;
    virtual bool read(uint64_t addr, void* dst, size_t n) = 0;
    virtual bool write(uint64_t addr, const void* src, size_t n) = 0;
};

// Per-pass budgets. Every read/write is a roundtrip on a remote target, so
// both are capped; long lists are serviced round-robin across passes
struct pass_limits_t {
    size_t max_reads  = 64;
    size_t max_writes = 16;
};

struct pass_stats_t {
    size_t reads          = 0;
    size_t writes         = 0;   // freeze write-backs issued
    size_t clean_holds    = 0;   // frozen value already in place, no write
    size_t deferred       = 0;   // entries left for the next pass (budget)
    size_t rate_skipped   = 0;   // entries not due yet (per-entry interval_ms)
    size_t write_failures = 0;
};

// One sampling pass over entries (in list order in the result). Unfrozen
// entries are read; frozen entries are read and written back only when the
// target drifted from the hold (dirty check). A rejected write reports
// ok=false + hold_failed. Entries the budgets could not reach this pass keep
// their previous value from `prev` and are serviced first next pass via
// `cursor` (an index into entries, updated in place). `now_ms` (steady clock)
// enforces each entry's interval_ms; 0 disables the rate gate
std::vector<value_t> sample_pass(const std::vector<entry_t>& entries,
                                 const std::vector<value_t>& prev,
                                 pass_io_t& io, const pass_limits_t& lim,
                                 size_t& cursor, pass_stats_t* stats = nullptr,
                                 int64_t now_ms = 0);

} // namespace detail

} // namespace slop::core::memory::watch
```

```cpp
// src/core/network/capture_service.cpp
// host-side raw-socket capture (SIO_RCVALL) feeding the traffic store

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX

constexpr int64_t kIfaceRefreshMs = 15000;

int64_t now_ms() {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
               std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
        .count();
}

struct sock_t {
    SOCKET          s = INVALID_SOCKET;
    capture_iface_t info;

};

struct state_t {

    std::thread th;
    std::atomic<bool> stop_flag{false};
    std::atomic<bool> active{false};
    bool wsa = false;

    uint64_t non_tcp_udp = 0, fragments = 0, queue_dropped = 0, payload_truncated = 0;
    uint64_t dns_total = 0;
};

state_t& st() {
    static state_t s;
    return s;
}

#ifdef _WIN32
std::string wsa_error_text(int e) {
    switch (e) {
        case WSAEACCES: return "access denied - run the engine elevated for SIO_RCVALL";
        case WSAEINVAL: return "invalid argument (interface does not support SIO_RCVALL)";
        case WSAEADDRNOTAVAIL: return "address not available";
        case WSAEAFNOSUPPORT: return "address family not supported";
        default: return "winsock error " + std::to_string(e);
    }
}

std::string narrow(const wchar_t* w) {
    if (!w) return {};
    const int n = ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (n <= 1) return {};
    std::string out(static_cast<size_t>(n - 1), '\0');
    ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, out.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}
#endif

struct adapter_addr_t {
    std::string key, name;
    sockaddr_storage sa{};
    int sa_len = 0;
    uint8_t family = 4;
    parse::ip_addr_t ip;
};

// up, non-loopback adapters: one bind address per family; every unicast
// address (loopback included) goes into `locals`
#ifdef _WIN32
std::vector<adapter_addr_t> enumerate(std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t>& locals) {
    std::vector<adapter_addr_t> out;
    locals.clear();
    ULONG size = 16 * 1024;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf;
    ULONG rc = ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW;
    for (int tries = 0; tries < 4 && rc == ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW; ++tries) {
        buf.resize(size);
        rc = ::GetAdaptersAddresses(AF_UNSPEC,
                                    GAA_FLAG_SKIP_ANYCAST | GAA_FLAG_SKIP_MULTICAST |
                                        GAA_FLAG_SKIP_DNS_SERVER,
                                    nullptr,
                                    reinterpret_cast<IP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES*>(buf.data()), &size);
    }
    if (rc != NO_ERROR) return out;
    for (auto* a = reinterpret_cast<IP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES*>(buf.data()); a; a = a->Next) {
        const bool usable = a->OperStatus == IfOperStatusUp &&
                            a->IfType != IF_TYPE_SOFTWARE_LOOPBACK;
        bool have4 = false, have6 = false;
        for (auto* u = a->FirstUnicastAddress; u; u = u->Next) {
            const sockaddr* sa = u->Address.lpSockaddr;
            if (!sa) continue;
            adapter_addr_t aa;
            if (sa->sa_family == AF_INET) {
                const auto* sin = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in*>(sa);
                aa.ip = parse::make_v4(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin->sin_addr));
                aa.family = 4;
                aa.sa_len = sizeof(sockaddr_in);
            } else if (sa->sa_family == AF_INET6) {
                const auto* sin6 = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in6*>(sa);
                aa.ip = parse::make_v6(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin6->sin6_addr));
                aa.family = 6;
                aa.sa_len = sizeof(sockaddr_in6);
            } else {
                continue;
            }
            locals.push_back(aa.ip);
            if (!usable) continue;
            bool& have = aa.family == 4 ? have4 : have6;
            if (have) continue;
            have = true;
            std::memcpy(&aa.sa, sa, static_cast<size_t>(aa.sa_len));
            aa.name = narrow(a->FriendlyName);
            aa.key = std::string(a->AdapterName ? a->AdapterName : "") + (aa.family == 4 ? "/4" : "/6");
            out.push_back(std::move(aa));
        }
    }
    return out;
}
#else
// one AF_PACKET socket per interface (both families arrive on it), every
// unicast address goes into `locals`
std::vector<adapter_addr_t> enumerate(std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t>& locals) {
    std::vector<adapter_addr_t> out;
    locals.clear();
    ifaddrs* ifs = nullptr;
    if (::getifaddrs(&ifs) != 0) return out;
    for (ifaddrs* i = ifs; i; i = i->ifa_next) {
        if (!i->ifa_addr) continue;
        const int fam = i->ifa_addr->sa_family;
        adapter_addr_t aa;
        if (fam == AF_INET) {
            const auto* sin = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in*>(i->ifa_addr);
            aa.ip = parse::make_v4(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin->sin_addr));
            aa.family = 4;
        } else if (fam == AF_INET6) {
            const auto* sin6 = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in6*>(i->ifa_addr);
            aa.ip = parse::make_v6(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin6->sin6_addr));
            aa.family = 6;
        } else {
            continue;
        }
        locals.push_back(aa.ip);
        if ((i->ifa_flags & IFF_UP) == 0 || (i->ifa_flags & IFF_LOOPBACK) != 0) continue;
        aa.name = i->ifa_name;
        aa.key = aa.name;
        if (std::any_of(out.begin(), out.end(),
                        [&](const adapter_addr_t& e) { return e.key == aa.key; }))
            continue;
        out.push_back(std::move(aa));
    }
    ::freeifaddrs(ifs);
    return out;
}
#endif

#ifdef _WIN32
// opens a raw socket on one adapter address with RCVALL enabled
sock_t open_socket(const adapter_addr_t& a) {
    sock_t s;
    s.key = a.key;
    s.info.name = a.name;
    s.info.address = parse::to_string(a.ip);
    s.info.family = a.family;
    const int af = a.family == 4 ? AF_INET : AF_INET6;
    SOCKET sk = ::socket(af, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_IP);
    if (sk == INVALID_SOCKET && af == AF_INET6) sk = ::socket(af, SOCK_RAW, IPPROTO_IPV6);
    if (sk == INVALID_SOCKET) {
        s.info.error = "raw socket: " + wsa_error_text(::WSAGetLastError());
        return s;
    }
    if (::bind(sk, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&a.sa), a.sa_len) != 0) {
        s.info.error = "bind: " + wsa_error_text(::WSAGetLastError());
        ::closesocket(sk);
        return s;
    }
    DWORD on = RCVALL_ON, bytes = 0;
    if (::WSAIoctl(sk, SIO_RCVALL, &on, sizeof(on), nullptr, 0, &bytes, nullptr, nullptr) ==
        SOCKET_ERROR) {
        s.info.error = "SIO_RCVALL: " + wsa_error_text(::WSAGetLastError());
        ::closesocket(sk);
        return s;
    }
    u_long nonblock = 1;
    ::ioctlsocket(sk, FIONBIO, &nonblock);
    int rcvbuf = 4 << 20;
    ::setsockopt(sk, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&rcvbuf), sizeof(rcvbuf));
    if (af == AF_INET6) {
        DWORD on6 = 1;   // destination address of each datagram via WSARecvMsg
        ::setsockopt(sk, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_PKTINFO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&on6), sizeof(on6));
    }
    s.s = sk;
    s.info.active = true;
    return s;
}

void close_socket(sock_t& s) {
    if (s.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return;
    DWORD off = RCVALL_OFF, bytes = 0;
    ::WSAIoctl(s.s, SIO_RCVALL, &off, sizeof(off), nullptr, 0, &bytes, nullptr, nullptr);
    ::closesocket(s.s);
    s.s = INVALID_SOCKET;
    s.info.active = false;
}
#else
// AF_PACKET socket bound to one interface: receives both families' frames.
// Needs CAP_NET_RAW (root or `setcap cap_net_raw+ep`); the error says so.
sock_t open_socket(const adapter_addr_t& a) {
    sock_t s;
    s.key = a.key;
    s.info.name = a.name;
    s.info.address = parse::to_string(a.ip);
    s.info.family = 4;
    const int sk = ::socket(AF_PACKET, SOCK_RAW, htons(ETH_P_ALL));
    if (sk < 0) {
        s.info.error = "AF_PACKET raw socket: " + std::string(std::strerror(errno)) +
                       " (capture needs CAP_NET_RAW)";
        return s;
    }
    sockaddr_ll ll{};
    ll.sll_family = AF_PACKET;
    ll.sll_protocol = htons(ETH_P_ALL);
    ll.sll_ifindex = static_cast<int>(::if_nametoindex(a.name.c_str()));
    if (ll.sll_ifindex == 0 ||
        ::bind(sk, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&ll), sizeof(ll)) != 0) {
        s.info.error = "bind to " + a.name + ": " + std::strerror(errno);
        ::close(sk);
        return s;
    }
    const int flags = ::fcntl(sk, F_GETFL, 0);
    ::fcntl(sk, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
    int rcvbuf = 4 << 20;
    ::setsockopt(sk, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &rcvbuf, sizeof(rcvbuf));
    s.s = sk;
    s.info.active = true;
    return s;
}

void close_socket(sock_t& s) {
    if (s.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return;
    ::close(s.s);
    s.s = INVALID_SOCKET;
    s.info.active = false;
}
#endif

bool is_local(const state_t& s, const parse::ip_addr_t& a) {
    return std::find(s.locals.begin(), s.locals.end(), a) != s.locals.end();
}

// caller holds s.mu
void handle_l4(state_t& s, const parse::ip_addr_t& src, const parse::ip_addr_t& dst,
               uint8_t proto, const uint8_t* l4, size_t l4_len, uint32_t l4_wire_len,
               size_t ip_bytes, int64_t at) {
    if (proto != 6 && proto != 17) {
        ++s.non_tcp_udp;
        return;
    }
    parse::l4_info_t l;
    if (parse::parse_l4(proto, l4, l4_len, l4_wire_len, l) != parse::status_t::ok) {
        ++s.parse_errors;
        return;
    }
    if (s.filter_host && !(src == *s.filter_host || dst == *s.filter_host)) {
        ++s.filtered_out;
        return;
    }

    // direction: this host first, then the filtered peer (a console behind
    // ICS / a mirror port), then the ephemeral-port side as the client
    bool outbound;
    if (is_local(s, src)) outbound = true;
    else if (is_local(s, dst)) outbound = false;
    else if (s.filter_host) outbound = src == *s.filter_host;
    else outbound = l.src_port >= l.dst_port;

    if (proto == 17 && (l.src_port == 53 || l.dst_port == 53) && l.payload_len) {
        if (auto r = parse::parse_dns(l.payload, l.payload_len)) {
            r->timestamp = static_cast<uint64_t>(at);
            const bool from_server = l.src_port == 53;
            r->client_addr = parse::to_string(from_server ? dst : src);
            r->server_addr = parse::to_string(from_server ? src : dst);
            s.dns.push_back(std::move(*r));
            if (s.dns.size() > kDnsCap) s.dns.pop_front();
            ++s.dns_total;
        }
    }

    if (s.filter.protocol && s.filter.protocol != proto) { ++s.filtered_out; return; }
    if (s.filter.port && l.src_port != s.filter.port && l.dst_port != s.filter.port) {
        ++s.filtered_out;
        return;
    }
    if (proto == 6 && l.payload_wire_len == 0) return;   // bare ACK / handshake

    packet_record_t rec;
    rec.at_ms = at;
    rec.protocol = proto;
    rec.ip_version = src.family;
    rec.direction = outbound ? 0 : 1;
    rec.local_addr = parse::to_string(outbound ? src : dst);
    rec.local_port = outbound ? l.src_port : l.dst_port;
    rec.remote_addr = parse::to_string(outbound ? dst : src);
    rec.remote_port = outbound ? l.dst_port : l.src_port;
    rec.wire_len = l.payload_wire_len;
    rec.tcp_seq = l.tcp_seq;
    rec.tcp_ack = l.tcp_ack;
    rec.tcp_flags = l.tcp_flags;
    const size_t keep = std::min(l.payload_len, kMaxPayload);
    if (l.payload_wire_len > keep) ++s.payload_truncated;
    rec.payload.assign(l.payload, l.payload + keep);

    if (outbound) { ++s.packets_out; s.bytes_out += ip_bytes; }
    else          { ++s.packets_in;  s.bytes_in += ip_bytes; }
    if (s.pending.size() >= kPendingCap) {
        s.pending.pop_front();
        ++s.queue_dropped;
    }
    s.pending.push_back(std::move(rec));
}

// caller holds s.mu
void handle_fragment(state_t& s, const parse::ip_info_t& ip, int64_t at) {
    ++s.fragments;
    auto dg = s.frags.add(ip, at);
    if (!dg) return;
    uint8_t proto = dg->proto;
    const uint8_t* p = dg->l4.data();
    size_t len = dg->l4.size();
    if (ip.src.family == 6 && parse::skip_v6_ext(proto, p, len) != parse::status_t::ok) {
        ++s.parse_errors;
        return;
    }
    handle_l4(s, ip.src, ip.dst, proto, p, len, static_cast<uint32_t>(len),
              dg->l4.size() + (ip.src.family == 4 ? 20 : 40), at);
}

void handle_datagram(state_t& s, const uint8_t* d, size_t n, int64_t at) {
    ++s.packets_seen;
    parse::ip_info_t ip;
    if (parse::parse_ip(d, n, ip) != parse::status_t::ok) {
        ++s.parse_errors;
        return;
    }
    if (ip.fragment) return handle_fragment(s, ip, at);
    handle_l4(s, ip.src, ip.dst, ip.proto, ip.l4, ip.l4_len, ip.l4_wire_len, n, at);
}

// IPv6 raw sockets hand over the bytes after the last IPv6 header only; the
// addresses come from WSARecvMsg and the transport is inferred
void handle_v6_transport(state_t& s, const parse::ip_addr_t& src, const parse::ip_addr_t& dst,
                         const uint8_t* d, size_t n, int64_t at) {
    ++s.packets_seen;
    const uint8_t proto = parse::infer_v6_transport(src, dst, d, n);
    if (proto == 6 || proto == 17)
        return handle_l4(s, src, dst, proto, d, n, static_cast<uint32_t>(n), n + 40, at);
    if (proto == 58) {
        ++s.non_tcp_udp;
        return;
    }
    if (proto != 44) {
        ++s.parse_errors;
        return;
    }
    parse::ip_info_t ip;
    ip.src = src;
    ip.dst = dst;
    ip.proto = d[0];
    ip.l4 = d + 8;
    ip.l4_len = n - 8;
    ip.l4_wire_len = static_cast<uint32_t>(n - 8);
    const uint16_t fo = static_cast<uint16_t>((static_cast<uint16_t>(d[2]) << 8) | d[3]);
    ip.frag_offset = fo & 0xFFF8u;
    ip.more_fragments = (fo & 1) != 0;
    ip.frag_id = (static_cast<uint32_t>(d[4]) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(d[5]) << 16) |
                 (static_cast<uint32_t>(d[6]) << 8) | d[7];
    ip.fragment = ip.frag_offset != 0 || ip.more_fragments;
    if (ip.fragment) return handle_fragment(s, ip, at);
    handle_l4(s, src, dst, ip.proto, ip.l4, ip.l4_len, ip.l4_wire_len, n + 40, at);
}

#ifdef _WIN32
LPFN_WSARECVMSG wsa_recvmsg(SOCKET sk) {
    static LPFN_WSARECVMSG fn = nullptr;
    if (!fn) {
        GUID guid = WSAID_WSARECVMSG;
        DWORD bytes = 0;
        ::WSAIoctl(sk, SIO_GET_EXTENSION_FUNCTION_POINTER, &guid, sizeof(guid), &fn,
                   sizeof(fn), &bytes, nullptr, nullptr);
    }
    return fn;
}

// one IPv6 datagram: payload, source from the sender address, destination
// from IPV6_PKTINFO. Returns the byte count or <= 0
int recv_v6(SOCKET sk, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf, parse::ip_addr_t& src, parse::ip_addr_t& dst) {
    LPFN_WSARECVMSG fn = wsa_recvmsg(sk);
    if (!fn) return -1;
    sockaddr_in6 from{};
    char control[WSA_CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(IN6_PKTINFO))]{};
    WSABUF data{static_cast<ULONG>(buf.size()), reinterpret_cast<CHAR*>(buf.data())};
    WSAMSG msg{};
    msg.name = reinterpret_cast<LPSOCKADDR>(&from);
    msg.namelen = sizeof(from);
    msg.lpBuffers = &data;
    msg.dwBufferCount = 1;
    msg.Control = {sizeof(control), control};
    DWORD got = 0;
    if (fn(sk, &msg, &got, nullptr, nullptr) != 0) return -1;
    src = parse::make_v6(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&from.sin6_addr));
    dst = parse::ip_addr_t{};
    for (WSACMSGHDR* c = WSA_CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&msg); c; c = WSA_CMSG_NXTHDR(&msg, c)) {
        if (c->cmsg_level == IPPROTO_IPV6 && c->cmsg_type == IPV6_PKTINFO) {
            const auto* pi = reinterpret_cast<const IN6_PKTINFO*>(WSA_CMSG_DATA(c));
            dst = parse::make_v6(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&pi->ipi6_addr));
        }
    }
    return dst.valid() ? static_cast<int>(got) : -1;
}
#endif

// re-enumerates adapters: refreshes the local address set, opens sockets for
// new interfaces and closes those whose adapter went away. Socket thread only
void refresh_interfaces(state_t& s) {
    std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> locals;
    auto addrs = enumerate(locals);
    std::vector<sock_t> keep;
    for (auto& sk : s.socks) {
        const bool present = std::any_of(addrs.begin(), addrs.end(), [&](const adapter_addr_t& a) {
            return a.key == sk.key && parse::to_string(a.ip) == sk.info.address;
        });
        if (present) keep.push_back(sk);
        else close_socket(sk);
    }
    std::vector<capture_iface_t> ifaces;
    for (const auto& a : addrs) {
        auto it = std::find_if(keep.begin(), keep.end(), [&](const sock_t& k) { return k.key == a.key; });
        if (it != keep.end()) {
            ifaces.push_back(it->info);
            continue;
        }
        sock_t ns = open_socket(a);
        ifaces.push_back(ns.info);
        if (ns.s != INVALID_SOCKET) keep.push_back(std::move(ns));
    }
    s.socks = std::move(keep);
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    s.locals = std::move(locals);
    s.locals_at = now_ms();
    s.ifaces = std::move(ifaces);
}

void capture_thread() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(65536);
    std::vector<WSAPOLLFD> fds;
    while (!s.stop_flag.load()) {
        if (now_ms() - s.locals_at > kIfaceRefreshMs) refresh_interfaces(s);
        fds.clear();
        for (const auto& sk : s.socks) fds.push_back({sk.s, POLLRDNORM, 0});
        if (fds.empty()) {
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(250));
            continue;
        }
        const int r = ::WSAPoll(fds.data(), static_cast<ULONG>(fds.size()), 250);
        if (r <= 0) continue;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < fds.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& fd = fds[i];
            if (!(fd.revents & (POLLRDNORM | POLLERR | POLLHUP))) continue;
#ifdef _WIN32
            const bool v6 = s.socks[i].info.family == 6;
#endif
            // drain what is queued on this socket, bounded per wakeup
            for (int burst = 0; burst < 256; ++burst) {
#ifdef _WIN32
                if (v6) {
                    parse::ip_addr_t src, dst;
                    const int n = recv_v6(fd.fd, buf, src, dst);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
                    handle_v6_transport(s, src, dst, buf.data(), static_cast<size_t>(n), now_ms());
                    continue;
                }
                const int n = ::recv(fd.fd, reinterpret_cast<char*>(buf.data()),
                                     static_cast<int>(buf.size()), 0);
                if (n <= 0) break;
                std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
                handle_datagram(s, buf.data(), static_cast<size_t>(n), now_ms());
#else
                // AF_PACKET hands over the link-layer frame; skip Ethernet
                // (and one 802.1Q tag) to reach the IP datagram
                const ssize_t n = ::recv(fd.fd, buf.data(), buf.size(), 0);
                if (n <= 0) break;
                size_t off = 0;
                if (n >= 14) {
                    const uint16_t ethertype =
                        static_cast<uint16_t>((buf[12] << 8) | buf[13]);
                    if (ethertype == 0x8100 && n >= 18)
                        off = 18;
                    else if (ethertype == 0x0800 || ethertype == 0x86DD)
                        off = 14;
                    else
                        continue;   // ARP and friends are not IP
                } else {
                    continue;
                }
                std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
                handle_datagram(s, buf.data() + off, static_cast<size_t>(n) - off, now_ms());
#endif
            }
        }
    }
    for (auto& sk : s.socks) close_socket(sk);
    s.socks.clear();
    s.active.store(false);
}

std::string apply_filter(state_t& s, const capture_filter_t& f) {
    std::optional<parse::ip_addr_t> host;
    if (!f.host.empty()) {
        host = parse::parse_ip(f.host);
        if (!host) return "capture filter host must be an IPv4/IPv6 address, got '" + f.host + "'";
    }
    if (f.protocol != 0 && f.protocol != 6 && f.protocol != 17)
        return "capture filter protocol must be 6 (tcp), 17 (udp) or 0";
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    s.filter = f;
    if (host) s.filter.host = parse::to_string(*host);
    s.filter_host = host;
    return {};
}

} // namespace

bool running() {
    return st().active.load();
}

std::string start(const capture_filter_t& filter, bool* updated) {
    state_t& s = st();
    if (updated) *updated = false;
    if (s.active.load()) {
        auto err = apply_filter(s, filter);
        if (err.empty() && updated) *updated = true;
        return err;
    }
    // the previous run's thread has exited on its own; reclaim it
    if (s.th.joinable()) s.th.join();
    if (auto err = apply_filter(s, filter); !err.empty()) return err;

    if (!s.wsa) {
        WSADATA wsa{};
        if (::WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa) != 0) return "WSAStartup failed";
        s.wsa = true;
    }
    std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> locals;
    const auto addrs = enumerate(locals);
    std::vector<sock_t> socks;
    std::vector<capture_iface_t> ifaces;
    for (const auto& a : addrs) {
        sock_t sk = open_socket(a);
        ifaces.push_back(sk.info);
        if (sk.s != INVALID_SOCKET) socks.push_back(std::move(sk));
    }
    if (socks.empty()) {
        std::string why = addrs.empty() ? "no active network interfaces" : ifaces.front().error;
        for (size_t i = 1; i < ifaces.size(); ++i)
            if (ifaces[i].error != ifaces.front().error) why += "; " + ifaces[i].error;
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        s.ifaces = std::move(ifaces);
        return "capture failed on every interface: " + why;
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        s.locals = std::move(locals);
        s.locals_at = now_ms();
        s.ifaces = std::move(ifaces);
        s.frags.clear();
    }
    s.socks = std::move(socks);
    s.stop_flag.store(false);
    s.active.store(true);
    s.th = std::thread(capture_thread);
    return {};
}

std::string stop() {
    state_t& s = st();
    s.stop_flag.store(true);
    if (s.th.joinable()) s.th.join();
    s.active.store(false);
    if (s.wsa) {
        ::WSACleanup();
        s.wsa = false;
    }
    return {};
}

size_t poll(traffic_store_t& sink, size_t max_packets) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::deque<packet_record_t> batch;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
        const size_t n = std::min(max_packets, s.pending.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            batch.push_back(std::move(s.pending.front()));
            s.pending.pop_front();
        }
    }
    for (auto& rec : batch) sink.add(std::move(rec));
    return batch.size();
}

std::vector<dns_record_t> dns_queries(const std::string& host) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    if (host.empty()) return {s.dns.begin(), s.dns.end()};
    const auto want = parse::parse_ip(host);
    const std::string canon = want ? parse::to_string(*want) : host;
    std::vector<dns_record_t> out;
    for (const auto& r : s.dns)
        if (r.client_addr == canon || r.server_addr == canon) out.push_back(r);
    return out;
}

net_stats_t stats() {
    state_t& s = st();
    net_stats_t out;
    out.capture_active = s.active.load();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    out.packets_seen = s.packets_seen;
    out.packets_in = s.packets_in;
    out.packets_out = s.packets_out;
    out.bytes_in = s.bytes_in;
    out.bytes_out = s.bytes_out;
    out.filtered_out = s.filtered_out;
    out.parse_errors = s.parse_errors;
    out.non_tcp_udp = s.non_tcp_udp;
    out.fragments = s.fragments;
    out.fragments_reassembled = s.frags.completed();
    out.fragments_dropped = s.frags.dropped();
    out.queue_dropped = s.queue_dropped;
    out.payload_truncated = s.payload_truncated;
    out.dns_logged_total = s.dns_total;
    out.dns_buffered = static_cast<uint32_t>(s.dns.size());
    out.pending = static_cast<uint32_t>(s.pending.size());
    out.filter = s.filter;
    out.interfaces = s.ifaces;
    return out;
}

std::string export_pcap(traffic_store_t& store, const std::string& path,
                        uint32_t max_packets, size_t* exported, bool* truncated,
                        const std::string& format) {
    if (format != "pcap" && format != "pcapng")
        return "format must be pcap or pcapng, got '" + format + "'";
    while (poll(store, 4096) > 0) {}
    const auto page = store.packets_tail(max_packets);
    std::string err;
    const bool ok = format == "pcapng" ? store.write_pcapng(path, page.items, &err)
                                       : store.write_pcap(path, page.items, &err);
    if (!ok) return err.empty() ? format + " write failed" : err;
    if (exported) *exported = page.items.size();
    if (truncated) *truncated = page.truncated;
    return {};
}

namespace testing {

void reset() {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    s.pending.clear();
    s.dns.clear();
    s.frags.clear();
    s.locals.clear();
    s.filter = {};
    s.filter_host.reset();
    s.packets_seen = s.packets_in = s.packets_out = s.bytes_in = s.bytes_out = 0;
    s.filtered_out = s.parse_errors = s.non_tcp_udp = s.fragments = 0;
    s.queue_dropped = s.payload_truncated = s.dns_total = 0;
}

void set_local_addresses(const std::vector<std::string>& addrs) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    s.locals.clear();
    for (const auto& a : addrs)
        if (auto ip = parse::parse_ip(a)) s.locals.push_back(*ip);
    s.locals_at = now_ms();
}

std::string set_filter(const capture_filter_t& filter) {
    return apply_filter(st(), filter);
}

void inject(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, int64_t at) {
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    handle_datagram(s, d, n, at);
}

void inject_v6_transport(const std::string& src, const std::string& dst, const uint8_t* d,
                         size_t n, int64_t at) {
    const auto s6 = parse::parse_ip(src);
    const auto d6 = parse::parse_ip(dst);
    if (!s6 || !d6) return;
    state_t& s = st();
    std::lock_guard lk(s.mu);
    handle_v6_transport(s, *s6, *d6, d, n, at);
}

} // namespace testing

} // namespace capture
} // namespace slop::core::network
```

`src/core/network/capture_service.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// host-side packet capture: one raw socket per (interface, address family)
// in promiscuous mode via SIO_RCVALL (needs administrator). SIO_RCVALL
// delivers IP datagrams without link-layer framing; IPv4 and IPv6 are both
// captured, fragments are reassembled, and the interface/address set is
// refreshed while running. Raw capture cannot attribute packets to processes,
// so capture filters are host (e.g. the PS4's IP) / port / protocol

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"
#include "core/network/traffic_store.hpp"

namespace slop::core::network {

using dns_record_t = parse::dns_record_t;

struct capture_filter_t {
    std::string host;          // IP literal: keep only packets to/from it ("" = all)
    uint16_t    port = 0;      // either side (0 = all)
    uint8_t     protocol = 0;  // 6 | 17 (0 = both)
};

struct capture_iface_t {
    std::string name;          // adapter friendly name
    std::string address;       // bound address
    uint8_t     family = 4;
    bool        active = false;
    std::string error;         // why it is not capturing
};

struct net_stats_t {
    bool     capture_active = false;
    uint64_t packets_seen = 0;           // datagrams read off the sockets
    uint64_t packets_in = 0, packets_out = 0;   // accepted (after filters)
    uint64_t bytes_in = 0, bytes_out = 0;       // IP-layer bytes of accepted packets
    uint64_t filtered_out = 0;           // rejected by the capture filter
    uint64_t parse_errors = 0;           // truncated / malformed / not IP
    uint64_t non_tcp_udp = 0;            // ICMP etc. (not stored)
    uint64_t fragments = 0;
    uint64_t fragments_reassembled = 0;
    uint64_t fragments_dropped = 0;
    uint64_t queue_dropped = 0;          // pending queue overflow before poll()
    uint64_t payload_truncated = 0;      // payload longer than the per-packet cap
    uint64_t dns_logged_total = 0;
    uint32_t dns_buffered = 0;
    uint32_t pending = 0;
    capture_filter_t filter;
    std::vector<capture_iface_t> interfaces;
};

namespace capture {

// payload bytes kept per packet; the wire length is recorded separately
inline constexpr size_t kMaxPayload = 2048;

bool running();

// Starts capture: enumerates interfaces, opens and binds a raw socket per
// interface/family and enables SIO_RCVALL synchronously, so failures are
// reported here. When already running the filter is replaced in place and
// *updated is set. Invalid filters (non-IP host, bad protocol) are errors
std::string start(const capture_filter_t& filter, bool* updated = nullptr);
std::string stop();

// Moves captured packets into the store. Returns the number moved
size_t poll(traffic_store_t& sink, size_t max_packets = 512);

// DNS messages seen (queries and responses), oldest first; `host` limits to
// one client/server address ("" = all)
std::vector<dns_record_t> dns_queries(const std::string& host = {});

net_stats_t stats();

// drains pending packets into the store, then writes the newest
// `max_packets` stored packets as pcap (default) or pcapng; pcapng carries the
// store's annotations as per-packet comments
std::string export_pcap(traffic_store_t& store, const std::string& path,
                        uint32_t max_packets = 4096, size_t* exported = nullptr,
                        bool* truncated = nullptr, const std::string& format = "pcap");

// deterministic hooks: feed datagrams through the exact socket-thread path
namespace testing {
void reset();
void set_local_addresses(const std::vector<std::string>& addrs);
// sets the filter without opening sockets
std::string set_filter(const capture_filter_t& filter);
void inject(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, int64_t now_ms);
// what an IPv6 raw socket delivers: transport bytes plus the addresses
// reported by WSARecvMsg
void inject_v6_transport(const std::string& src, const std::string& dst, const uint8_t* d,
                         size_t n, int64_t now_ms);
} // namespace testing

} // namespace capture
} // namespace slop::core::network
```
