`src/core/network/mitm_pki.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/mitm_pki.hpp
// local CA + per-host leaf certificates for the proxy's opt-in TLS
// interception. Keys are CNG keys (RSA-2048) in the Microsoft Software KSP;
// leaf certificates live in memory only. Trusting the CA (CurrentUser\ROOT)
// and removing that trust are separate, explicit operations; tests point the
// trust store at an in-memory store and destroy their keys afterwards

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

struct _CERT_CONTEXT;

namespace slop::core::network::mitm {

struct pki_options_t {
    // CNG key names are "<key_prefix>-ca" and "<key_prefix>-leaf"
    std::wstring key_prefix = L"reverse-slop-mitm";
    // directory holding ca.cer (DER) so the CA survives restarts; empty keeps
    // the CA in memory for this instance only (its key is then ephemeral)
    std::string dir;
    // HCERTSTORE used by install/uninstall/installed instead of
    // CurrentUser\ROOT (tests pass a CERT_STORE_PROV_MEMORY store)
    void* trust_store = nullptr;
    size_t max_cached_leaves = 256;
};

class pki_t {
public:
    explicit pki_t(pki_options_t opt);
    ~pki_t();
    pki_t(const pki_t&) = delete;
    pki_t& operator=(const pki_t&) = delete;

    // loads the persisted CA (dir/ca.cer + its CNG key, verified to match) or
    // creates a new one
    bool ensure_ca(std::string* error = nullptr);
    // loads a persisted CA without ever creating one; false when absent/invalid
    bool load_existing();
    bool has_ca() const;
    const _CERT_CONTEXT* ca_cert() const;      // borrowed; null until ensure_ca
    std::vector<uint8_t> ca_der() const;
    std::string ca_path() const;               // dir/ca.cer ("" in memory mode)
    std::string ca_thumbprint() const;         // SHA-1 hex, uppercase

    // leaf for `host` (DNS name or IP literal, validated; nothing touches the
    // filesystem). Serial: 128-bit random positive; valid now-1d .. now+397d;
    // SAN, serverAuth EKU, CA:false. Cached in memory (LRU)
    std::shared_ptr<const _CERT_CONTEXT> leaf_for(const std::string& host,
                                                  std::string* error = nullptr);
    size_t issued() const;

    // CA trust (CurrentUser\ROOT unless options.trust_store). Adding to the
    // real ROOT store makes Windows show its own confirmation dialog
    bool install_root(std::string* error = nullptr);
    bool root_installed() const;
    bool uninstall_root(std::string* error = nullptr);

    // removes trust, deletes both CNG keys and ca.cer, forgets all state
    bool destroy(std::string* error = nullptr);

private:
    struct impl_t;
    std::unique_ptr<impl_t> p_;
};

// removes what the previous PKI implementation left behind ("reverse-slop
// Local CA" in CurrentUser\MY and \ROOT, the "reverse-slop-ca-key" and
// "reverse-slop-host-*" CAPI containers, %LOCALAPPDATA%\reverse-slop\certs).
// Returns how many objects were removed
size_t remove_legacy_artifacts(std::string* error = nullptr);

} // namespace slop::core::network::mitm
```

```cpp
// src/core/network/mitm_pki_posix.cpp
// The MITM certificate authority is CNG/cert-store based on Windows. On POSIX
// there is no equivalent local key service wired up here, so every operation
// reports that instead of half-working: the proxy's TLS interception stays

    "integration (Windows CNG only)";

    if (error) *error = kNoCa;
    return nullptr;
```

`src/core/network/net_socket.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/net_socket.cpp

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#else
#include "core/compat/posix_socket.hpp"
#endif

#include "core/network/net_socket.hpp"
#include "core/compat/portable.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>

#ifdef _WIN32
#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")
#endif

namespace slop::core::network::sock {

namespace {

bool fill_sockaddr(const parse::ip_addr_t& ip, uint16_t port, sockaddr_storage& ss, int& len) {
    std::memset(&ss, 0, sizeof(ss));
    if (ip.family == 4) {
        auto* sin = reinterpret_cast<sockaddr_in*>(&ss);
        sin->sin_family = AF_INET;
        sin->sin_port = htons(port);
        std::memcpy(&sin->sin_addr, ip.b.data(), 4);
        len = sizeof(sockaddr_in);
        return true;
    }
    if (ip.family == 6) {
        auto* sin6 = reinterpret_cast<sockaddr_in6*>(&ss);
        sin6->sin6_family = AF_INET6;
        sin6->sin6_port = htons(port);
        std::memcpy(&sin6->sin6_addr, ip.b.data(), 16);
        len = sizeof(sockaddr_in6);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

std::string sockaddr_text(const sockaddr_storage& ss, uint16_t* port) {
    if (ss.ss_family == AF_INET) {
        const auto* sin = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in*>(&ss);
        if (port) *port = ntohs(sin->sin_port);
        return parse::to_string(parse::make_v4(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin->sin_addr)));
    }
    if (ss.ss_family == AF_INET6) {
        const auto* sin6 = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in6*>(&ss);
        if (port) *port = ntohs(sin6->sin6_port);
        return parse::to_string(parse::make_v6(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin6->sin6_addr)));
    }
    return {};
}

} // namespace

void ensure_wsa() {
    static std::once_flag once;
    std::call_once(once, [] {
        WSADATA d{};
        // best effort: if winsock init fails every later socket call reports
        // its own error, so there is nothing to do here beyond not ignoring
        // the status
        if (::WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &d) != 0) return;   // never cleaned up
    });
}

std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> resolve(const std::string& host_in, std::string* error) {
    ensure_wsa();
    std::string host = host_in;
    if (host.size() >= 2 && host.front() == '[' && host.back() == ']') host = host.substr(1, host.size() - 2);
    if (auto lit = parse::parse_ip(host)) return {*lit};
    if (!parse::valid_host(host)) {
        if (error) *error = "invalid host name '" + parse::escape_nonprintable(host) + "'";
        return {};
    }
    addrinfo hints{};
    hints.ai_family = AF_UNSPEC;
    hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
    addrinfo* res = nullptr;
    const int rc = ::getaddrinfo(host.c_str(), nullptr, &hints, &res);
    if (rc != 0 || !res) {
        if (error) *error = "cannot resolve '" + host + "' (error " + std::to_string(rc) + ")";
        return {};
    }
    std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> v4, v6;
    for (addrinfo* p = res; p; p = p->ai_next) {
        if (p->ai_family == AF_INET && p->ai_addrlen >= sizeof(sockaddr_in)) {
            const auto* sin = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in*>(p->ai_addr);
            auto a = parse::make_v4(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin->sin_addr));
            if (std::find(v4.begin(), v4.end(), a) == v4.end()) v4.push_back(a);
        } else if (p->ai_family == AF_INET6 && p->ai_addrlen >= sizeof(sockaddr_in6)) {
            const auto* sin6 = reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr_in6*>(p->ai_addr);
            auto a = parse::make_v6(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sin6->sin6_addr));
            if (std::find(v6.begin(), v6.end(), a) == v6.end()) v6.push_back(a);
        }
    }
    ::freeaddrinfo(res);
    v4.insert(v4.end(), v6.begin(), v6.end());
    if (v4.empty() && error) *error = "'" + host + "' has no addresses";
    return v4;
}

socket_t connect(const parse::ip_addr_t& ip, uint16_t port, int timeout_ms,
                 const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, std::string* error) {
    ensure_wsa();
    sockaddr_storage ss{};
    int len = 0;
    if (!fill_sockaddr(ip, port, ss, len)) {
        if (error) *error = "bad address";
        return kInvalid;
    }
    SOCKET s = ::socket(ss.ss_family, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) {
        if (error) *error = "socket() failed (" + std::to_string(::WSAGetLastError()) + ")";
        return kInvalid;
    }
    u_long nb = 1;
    ::ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &nb);
    const std::string where = parse::to_string(ip) + ":" + std::to_string(port);
    if (::connect(s, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&ss), len) != 0) {
        const int e = ::WSAGetLastError();
        if (e != WSAEWOULDBLOCK) {
            ::closesocket(s);
            if (error) *error = "connect to " + where + " failed (" + std::to_string(e) + ")";
            return kInvalid;
        }
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
        for (;;) {
            if (cancel && cancel->load()) {
                ::closesocket(s);
                if (error) *error = "cancelled";
                return kInvalid;
            }
            const auto left = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                                  deadline - std::chrono::steady_clock::now()).count();
            if (left <= 0) {
                ::closesocket(s);
                if (error) *error = "connect to " + where + " timed out";
                return kInvalid;
            }
            WSAPOLLFD fd{s, POLLWRNORM, 0};
            const int r = ::WSAPoll(&fd, 1, static_cast<INT>(std::min<long long>(left, 250)));
            if (r < 0) break;
            if (r == 0) continue;
            int soerr = 0;
#ifdef _WIN32
            int sl = sizeof(soerr);
            ::getsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, reinterpret_cast<char*>(&soerr), &sl);
#else
            socklen_t sl = sizeof(soerr);
            ::getsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, &soerr, &sl);
#endif
            if (soerr != 0 || (fd.revents & (POLLERR | POLLHUP))) {
                ::closesocket(s);
                if (error)
                    *error = "connect to " + where + " failed (" +
                             std::to_string(soerr ? soerr : WSAECONNREFUSED) + ")";
                return kInvalid;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    nb = 0;
    ::ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &nb);
    BOOL nodelay = TRUE;
    ::setsockopt(s, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&nodelay), sizeof(nodelay));
    return static_cast<socket_t>(s);
}

bool send_all(socket_t s, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    while (n > 0) {
        const int w = ::send(static_cast<SOCKET>(s), reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d),
                             static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(n, 1 << 20)), SLOP_SEND_FLAGS);
        if (w <= 0) return false;
        d += w;
        n -= static_cast<size_t>(w);
    }
    return true;
}

void set_timeouts(socket_t s, int rcv_ms, int snd_ms) {
    const DWORD r = static_cast<DWORD>(rcv_ms), w = static_cast<DWORD>(snd_ms);
    ::setsockopt(static_cast<SOCKET>(s), SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&r), sizeof(r));
    ::setsockopt(static_cast<SOCKET>(s), SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&w), sizeof(w));
}

bool wait_readable(socket_t s, int timeout_ms, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel) {
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
    for (;;) {
        if (cancel && cancel->load()) return false;
        const auto left = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                              deadline - std::chrono::steady_clock::now()).count();
        if (left <= 0) return false;
        WSAPOLLFD fd{static_cast<SOCKET>(s), POLLRDNORM, 0};
        const int r = ::WSAPoll(&fd, 1, static_cast<INT>(std::min<long long>(left, 250)));
        if (r < 0) return true;   // let the caller's recv surface the error
        if (r > 0) return true;
    }
}

void close(socket_t s) {
    if (s != kInvalid) ::closesocket(static_cast<SOCKET>(s));
}

std::string peer_address(socket_t s, uint16_t* port) {
    sockaddr_storage ss{};
#ifdef _WIN32
    int len = sizeof(ss);
#else
    socklen_t len = sizeof(ss);
#endif
    if (::getpeername(static_cast<SOCKET>(s), reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&ss), &len) != 0) return {};
    return sockaddr_text(ss, port);
}

std::string local_address(socket_t s, uint16_t* port) {
    sockaddr_storage ss{};
#ifdef _WIN32
    int len = sizeof(ss);
#else
    socklen_t len = sizeof(ss);
#endif
    if (::getsockname(static_cast<SOCKET>(s), reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&ss), &len) != 0) return {};
    return sockaddr_text(ss, port);
}

bool split_authority(const std::string& a, uint16_t default_port, std::string* host,
                     uint16_t* port) {
    std::string h = a, p;
    if (!a.empty() && a.front() == '[') {
        const size_t close = a.find(']');
        if (close == std::string::npos) return false;
        h = a.substr(1, close - 1);
        if (close + 1 < a.size()) {
            if (a[close + 1] != ':') return false;
            p = a.substr(close + 2);
        }
    } else if (std::count(a.begin(), a.end(), ':') == 1) {
        const size_t colon = a.find(':');
        h = a.substr(0, colon);
        p = a.substr(colon + 1);
    }
    uint32_t v = default_port;
    if (!p.empty()) {
        if (p.size() > 5) return false;
        v = 0;
        for (char c : p) {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') return false;
            v = v * 10 + static_cast<uint32_t>(c - '0');
        }
        if (v == 0 || v > 65535) return false;
    }
    if (h.empty()) return false;
    *host = h;
    *port = static_cast<uint16_t>(v);
    return true;
}

} // namespace slop::core::network::sock
```

`src/core/network/net_socket.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/net_socket.hpp
// small blocking-socket helpers shared by the proxy, replay and the web
// client: resolve once, connect to an already vetted address with a deadline
// and a cancel flag, bounded waits

#include <atomic>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"

namespace slop::core::network::sock {

using socket_t = uintptr_t;   // SOCKET
inline constexpr socket_t kInvalid = ~static_cast<uintptr_t>(0);

// WSAStartup once per process
void ensure_wsa();

// all addresses of `host` (literal or DNS name), IPv4 first
std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> resolve(const std::string& host, std::string* error);

// connects to exactly `ip`:`port`; aborts when `cancel` becomes true
socket_t connect(const parse::ip_addr_t& ip, uint16_t port, int timeout_ms,
                 const std::atomic<bool>* cancel, std::string* error);

bool send_all(socket_t s, const uint8_t* d, size_t n);
void set_timeouts(socket_t s, int rcv_ms, int snd_ms);
// true when readable (or closed/errored), false on timeout or cancel
bool wait_readable(socket_t s, int timeout_ms, const std::atomic<bool>* cancel);
void close(socket_t s);
std::string peer_address(socket_t s, uint16_t* port = nullptr);
std::string local_address(socket_t s, uint16_t* port = nullptr);

// "host:port", "[v6]:port" or "host" (default_port); false on a bad port
bool split_authority(const std::string& authority, uint16_t default_port,
                     std::string* host, uint16_t* port);

} // namespace slop::core::network::sock

```

`src/core/network/parsers.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/parsers.cpp

#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#else
#include "core/compat/posix_socket.hpp"
#endif

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstring>

namespace slop::core::network::parse {

namespace {

uint16_t be16(const uint8_t* p) {
    return static_cast<uint16_t>((static_cast<uint16_t>(p[0]) << 8) | p[1]);
}

uint32_t be32(const uint8_t* p) {
    return (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[0]) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[1]) << 16) |
           (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[2]) << 8) | p[3];
}

std::string_view trim(std::string_view s) {
    while (!s.empty() && (s.front() == ' ' || s.front() == '\t')) s.remove_prefix(1);
    while (!s.empty() && (s.back() == ' ' || s.back() == '\t')) s.remove_suffix(1);
    return s;
}

bool in_v4(const uint8_t* a, uint8_t b0, uint8_t b1, int prefix) {
    const uint32_t v = be32(a);
    const uint32_t net = (static_cast<uint32_t>(b0) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(b1) << 16);
    const uint32_t mask = prefix == 0 ? 0u : 0xFFFFFFFFu << (32 - prefix);
    return (v & mask) == (net & mask);
}

bool v4_non_public(const uint8_t* a) {
    if (a[0] == 0 || a[0] == 10 || a[0] == 127) return true;
    if (in_v4(a, 100, 64, 10)) return true;              // CGNAT
    if (in_v4(a, 169, 254, 16)) return true;             // link-local
    if (in_v4(a, 172, 16, 12)) return true;
    if (in_v4(a, 192, 168, 16)) return true;
    if (a[0] == 192 && a[1] == 0 && (a[2] == 0 || a[2] == 2)) return true;
    if (in_v4(a, 198, 18, 15)) return true;              // benchmarking
    if (a[0] == 198 && a[1] == 51 && a[2] == 100) return true;
    if (a[0] == 203 && a[1] == 0 && a[2] == 113) return true;
    if (a[0] >= 224) return true;                        // multicast, reserved, broadcast
    return false;
}

bool is_token_char(char c) {
    if (std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) return true;
    return std::strchr("!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~", c) != nullptr && c != '\0';
}

bool parse_u64_digits(std::string_view s, uint64_t& out) {
    if (s.empty() || s.size() > 15) return false;
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c < '0' || c > '9') return false;
        v = v * 10 + static_cast<uint64_t>(c - '0');
    }
    out = v;
    return true;
}

} // namespace

// addresses

ip_addr_t make_v4(const uint8_t* four) {
    ip_addr_t a;
    a.family = 4;
    std::memcpy(a.b.data(), four, 4);
    return a;
}

ip_addr_t make_v6(const uint8_t* sixteen) {
    ip_addr_t a;
    a.family = 6;
    std::memcpy(a.b.data(), sixteen, 16);
    return a;
}

std::optional<ip_addr_t> parse_ip(std::string_view text) {
    text = trim(text);
    if (text.size() >= 2 && text.front() == '[' && text.back() == ']')
        text = text.substr(1, text.size() - 2);
    if (const size_t pct = text.find('%'); pct != std::string_view::npos)
        text = text.substr(0, pct);
    if (text.empty() || text.size() > 45) return std::nullopt;
    const std::string s(text);
    uint8_t buf[16]{};
    if (s.find(':') == std::string::npos) {
        // inet_pton accepts only strict dotted quads
        if (::inet_pton(AF_INET, s.c_str(), buf) == 1) return make_v4(buf);
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (::inet_pton(AF_INET6, s.c_str(), buf) == 1) return make_v6(buf);
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::string to_string(const ip_addr_t& a) {
    char buf[INET6_ADDRSTRLEN]{};
    if (a.family == 4)
        return ::inet_ntop(AF_INET, a.b.data(), buf, sizeof(buf)) ? buf : std::string{};
    if (a.family == 6)
        return ::inet_ntop(AF_INET6, a.b.data(), buf, sizeof(buf)) ? buf : std::string{};
    return {};
}

std::optional<cidr_t> parse_cidr(std::string_view text) {
    text = trim(text);
    const size_t slash = text.find('/');
    auto addr = parse_ip(slash == std::string_view::npos ? text : text.substr(0, slash));
    if (!addr) return std::nullopt;
    cidr_t c;
    c.net = *addr;
    const int max = addr->family == 4 ? 32 : 128;
    c.prefix = max;
    if (slash != std::string_view::npos) {
        uint64_t p = 0;
        if (!parse_u64_digits(text.substr(slash + 1), p) || p > static_cast<uint64_t>(max))
            return std::nullopt;
        c.prefix = static_cast<int>(p);
    }
    return c;
}

bool cidr_contains(const cidr_t& c, const ip_addr_t& a) {
    if (c.net.family != a.family || !a.valid()) return false;
    int bits = c.prefix;
    for (size_t i = 0; bits > 0; ++i, bits -= 8) {
        const uint8_t mask = bits >= 8 ? 0xFF : static_cast<uint8_t>(0xFF << (8 - bits));
        if ((c.net.b[i] & mask) != (a.b[i] & mask)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool is_non_public(const ip_addr_t& a) {
    if (a.family == 4) return v4_non_public(a.b.data());
    if (a.family != 6) return true;
    const uint8_t* b = a.b.data();
    bool first12_zero = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) first12_zero = first12_zero && b[i] == 0;
    if (first12_zero) return true;                        // ::, ::1, v4-compatible
    bool mapped = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) mapped = mapped && b[i] == 0;
    if (mapped && b[10] == 0xFF && b[11] == 0xFF) return v4_non_public(b + 12);
    if (b[0] == 0x00 && b[1] == 0x64 && b[2] == 0xFF && b[3] == 0x9B) {   // 64:ff9b::/96 NAT64
        bool zero = true;
        for (int i = 4; i < 12; ++i) zero = zero && b[i] == 0;
        if (zero) return v4_non_public(b + 12);
    }
    if (b[0] == 0x20 && b[1] == 0x02) return v4_non_public(b + 2);        // 6to4
    if ((b[0] & 0xFE) == 0xFC) return true;               // ULA fc00::/7
    if (b[0] == 0xFE && (b[1] & 0xC0) == 0x80) return true;   // link-local
    if (b[0] == 0xFE && (b[1] & 0xC0) == 0xC0) return true;   // site-local
    if (b[0] == 0xFF) return true;                        // multicast
    if (b[0] == 0x01 && b[1] == 0x00 && b[2] == 0 && b[3] == 0 &&
        b[4] == 0 && b[5] == 0 && b[6] == 0 && b[7] == 0) return true;    // 100::/64 discard
    if (b[0] == 0x20 && b[1] == 0x01 && b[2] == 0x0D && b[3] == 0xB8) return true;   // docs
    return false;
}

std::string lower(std::string_view s) {
    std::string out(s);
    for (char& c : out)
        c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return out;
}

bool valid_host(std::string_view host) {
    if (host.empty() || host.size() > 253) return false;
    if (parse_ip(host)) return true;
    size_t label = 0;
    char prev = '.';
    for (char c : host) {
        if (c == '.') {
            if (label == 0 || prev == '-') return false;
            label = 0;
        } else {
            const bool ok = std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '-' || c == '_';
            if (!ok) return false;
            if (label == 0 && c == '-') return false;
            if (++label > 63) return false;
        }
        prev = c;
    }
    return label != 0 && prev != '-';
}

bool host_pattern_match(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view host,
                        const ip_addr_t* addr) {
    const std::string p = lower(trim(pattern));
    std::string_view hv = trim(host);
    if (hv.size() >= 2 && hv.front() == '[' && hv.back() == ']') hv = hv.substr(1, hv.size() - 2);
    const std::string h = lower(hv);
    if (p.empty() || h.empty()) return false;
    if (p.size() > 2 && p[0] == '*' && p[1] == '.') {
        const std::string_view suffix = std::string_view(p).substr(1);   // ".example.com"
        return h.size() > suffix.size() &&
               h.compare(h.size() - suffix.size(), suffix.size(), suffix) == 0;
    }
    if (p.find('/') != std::string::npos || parse_ip(p)) {
        const auto c = parse_cidr(p);
        if (!c) return false;
        if (const auto lit = parse_ip(h); lit && cidr_contains(*c, *lit)) return true;
        return addr && cidr_contains(*c, *addr);
    }
    return h == p;
}

std::string escape_nonprintable(std::string_view s) {
    static constexpr char kHex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(s.size());
    for (char ch : s) {
        const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(ch);
        if (c >= 0x20 && c <= 0x7E && c != '\\') {
            out.push_back(ch);
        } else {
            out += "\\x";
            out.push_back(kHex[c >> 4]);
            out.push_back(kHex[c & 0xF]);
        }
    }
    return out;
}

std::optional<std::string> base64_decode(std::string_view in) {
    auto val = [](char c) -> int {
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c - 'A';
        if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') return c - 'a' + 26;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0' + 52;
        if (c == '+') return 62;
        if (c == '/') return 63;
        return -1;
    };
    in = trim(in);
    while (!in.empty() && in.back() == '=') in.remove_suffix(1);
    if (in.size() % 4 == 1) return std::nullopt;
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(in.size() * 3 / 4);
    uint32_t acc = 0;
    int bits = 0;
    for (char c : in) {
        const int v = val(c);
        if (v < 0) return std::nullopt;
        acc = (acc << 6) | static_cast<uint32_t>(v);
        bits += 6;
        if (bits >= 8) {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push_back(static_cast<char>((acc >> bits) & 0xFF));
        }
    }
    return out;
}

std::string base64_encode(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    static constexpr char kAlpha[] =
        "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve((n + 2) / 3 * 4);
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 3 <= n; i += 3) {
        const uint32_t v = (static_cast<uint32_t>(d[i]) << 16) |
                           (static_cast<uint32_t>(d[i + 1]) << 8) | d[i + 2];
        out.push_back(kAlpha[(v >> 18) & 63]);
        out.push_back(kAlpha[(v >> 12) & 63]);
        out.push_back(kAlpha[(v >> 6) & 63]);
        out.push_back(kAlpha[v & 63]);
    }
    if (i < n) {
        uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(d[i]) << 16;
        if (i + 1 < n) v |= static_cast<uint32_t>(d[i + 1]) << 8;
        out.push_back(kAlpha[(v >> 18) & 63]);
        out.push_back(kAlpha[(v >> 12) & 63]);
        out.push_back(i + 1 < n ? kAlpha[(v >> 6) & 63] : '=');
        out.push_back('=');
    }
    return out;
}

// IP / L4

const char* status_name(status_t s) {
    switch (s) {
        case status_t::ok: return "ok";
        case status_t::truncated: return "truncated";
        case status_t::not_ip: return "not_ip";
        case status_t::malformed: return "malformed";
        case status_t::unsupported: return "unsupported";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

status_t skip_v6_ext(uint8_t& proto, const uint8_t*& d, size_t& n) {
    for (int hops = 0; hops < 8; ++hops) {
        if (proto != 0 && proto != 43 && proto != 60 && proto != 51) return status_t::ok;
        if (n < 8) return status_t::truncated;
        const size_t len = proto == 51 ? (static_cast<size_t>(d[1]) + 2) * 4
                                       : (static_cast<size_t>(d[1]) + 1) * 8;
        if (len > n) return status_t::truncated;
        proto = d[0];
        d += len;
        n -= len;
    }
    return status_t::malformed;
}

status_t parse_ip(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, ip_info_t& out) {
    out = ip_info_t{};
    if (!d || n < 1) return status_t::truncated;
    const uint8_t ver = d[0] >> 4;
    if (ver == 4) {
        if (n < 20) return status_t::truncated;
        const size_t ihl = static_cast<size_t>(d[0] & 0x0F) * 4;
        if (ihl < 20) return status_t::malformed;
        if (n < ihl) return status_t::truncated;
        const size_t total = be16(d + 2);
        if (total < ihl) return status_t::malformed;
        const size_t avail = std::min(n, total);
        const uint16_t ff = be16(d + 6);
        out.src = make_v4(d + 12);
        out.dst = make_v4(d + 16);
        out.proto = d[9];
        out.l4 = d + ihl;
        out.l4_len = avail - ihl;
        out.l4_wire_len = static_cast<uint32_t>(total - ihl);
        out.frag_offset = static_cast<uint32_t>(ff & 0x1FFF) * 8;
        out.more_fragments = (ff & 0x2000) != 0;
        out.fragment = out.frag_offset != 0 || out.more_fragments;
        out.frag_id = be16(d + 4);
        return status_t::ok;
    }
    if (ver == 6) {
        if (n < 40) return status_t::truncated;
        const size_t plen = be16(d + 4);
        if (plen == 0) return status_t::unsupported;      // jumbogram / no payload
        out.src = make_v6(d + 8);
        out.dst = make_v6(d + 24);
        uint8_t proto = d[6];
        const uint8_t* p = d + 40;
        size_t avail = std::min(n, 40 + plen) - 40;
        size_t declared = plen;
        for (int hops = 0; hops < 8; ++hops) {
            if (proto == 44) {                             // fragment header
                if (avail < 8) return status_t::truncated;
                const uint16_t fo = be16(p + 2);
                out.frag_offset = fo & 0xFFF8u;
                out.more_fragments = (fo & 1) != 0;
                out.frag_id = be32(p + 4);
                out.fragment = out.frag_offset != 0 || out.more_fragments;
                proto = p[0];
                p += 8;
                avail -= 8;
                declared -= 8;
                if (out.fragment) break;                   // rest is fragmentable data
                continue;                                  // atomic fragment
            }
            if (proto != 0 && proto != 43 && proto != 60 && proto != 51) break;
            if (avail < 8) return status_t::truncated;
            const size_t len = proto == 51 ? (static_cast<size_t>(p[1]) + 2) * 4
                                           : (static_cast<size_t>(p[1]) + 1) * 8;
            if (len > declared) return status_t::malformed;
            if (len > avail) return status_t::truncated;
            proto = p[0];
            p += len;
            avail -= len;
            declared -= len;
        }
        if (proto == 0 || proto == 43 || proto == 60 || proto == 51 || proto == 44)
            if (!out.fragment) return status_t::malformed;
        if (proto == 59) return status_t::unsupported;    // no next header
        out.proto = proto;
        out.l4 = p;
        out.l4_len = avail;
        out.l4_wire_len = static_cast<uint32_t>(declared);
        return status_t::ok;
    }
    return status_t::not_ip;
}

namespace {

bool v6_checksum_ok(const ip_addr_t& src, const ip_addr_t& dst, uint8_t proto,
                    const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    uint64_t sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i += 2) {
        sum += be16(src.b.data() + i);
        sum += be16(dst.b.data() + i);
    }
    sum += static_cast<uint32_t>(n >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
    sum += static_cast<uint32_t>(n) & 0xFFFF;
    sum += proto;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 1 < n; i += 2) sum += be16(d + i);
    if (i < n) sum += static_cast<uint64_t>(d[i]) << 8;
    while (sum >> 16) sum = (sum & 0xFFFF) + (sum >> 16);
    return sum == 0xFFFF;
}

} // namespace

uint8_t infer_v6_transport(const ip_addr_t& src, const ip_addr_t& dst, const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    if (!d || n < 4 || src.family != 6 || dst.family != 6) return 0;
    const bool udp_len = n >= 8 && be16(d + 4) == n;
    if (udp_len && be16(d + 6) != 0 && v6_checksum_ok(src, dst, 17, d, n)) return 17;
    if (n >= 20 && v6_checksum_ok(src, dst, 6, d, n)) return 6;
    if (v6_checksum_ok(src, dst, 58, d, n)) return 58;
    if (udp_len) return 17;
    if (n >= 8 && d[1] == 0 && (d[0] == 6 || d[0] == 17 || d[0] == 58 || d[0] == 60) &&
        (d[3] & 0x06) == 0)
        return 44;
    if (n >= 20) {
        const size_t doff = static_cast<size_t>(d[12] >> 4) * 4;
        if (doff >= 20 && doff <= n && (d[12] & 0x0E) == 0) return 6;
    }
    return 0;
}

status_t parse_l4(uint8_t proto, const uint8_t* l4, size_t l4_len,
                  uint32_t l4_wire_len, l4_info_t& out) {
    out = l4_info_t{};
    if (l4_len > l4_wire_len) l4_len = l4_wire_len;
    if (proto == 6) {
        if (l4_wire_len < 20) return status_t::malformed;
        if (l4_len < 20) return status_t::truncated;
        const size_t doff = static_cast<size_t>(l4[12] >> 4) * 4;
        if (doff < 20 || doff > l4_wire_len) return status_t::malformed;
        if (doff > l4_len) return status_t::truncated;
        out.src_port = be16(l4);
        out.dst_port = be16(l4 + 2);
        out.tcp_seq = be32(l4 + 4);
        out.tcp_ack = be32(l4 + 8);
        out.tcp_flags = l4[13];
        out.payload = l4 + doff;
        out.payload_len = l4_len - doff;
        out.payload_wire_len = static_cast<uint32_t>(l4_wire_len - doff);
        return status_t::ok;
    }
    if (proto == 17) {
        if (l4_wire_len < 8) return status_t::malformed;
        if (l4_len < 8) return status_t::truncated;
        const uint32_t ulen = be16(l4 + 4);
        if (ulen < 8 || ulen > l4_wire_len) return status_t::malformed;
        out.src_port = be16(l4);
        out.dst_port = be16(l4 + 2);
        out.payload = l4 + 8;
        out.payload_wire_len = ulen - 8;
        out.payload_len = std::min<size_t>(l4_len - 8, out.payload_wire_len);
        return status_t::ok;
    }
    return status_t::unsupported;
}

// reassembly

void reassembler_t::clear() {
    parts_.clear();
    bytes_ = 0;
}

void reassembler_t::drop(std::map<key_t, part_t>::iterator it) {
    bytes_ -= it->second.data.size();
    parts_.erase(it);
    ++dropped_;
}

void reassembler_t::expire(int64_t now_ms) {
    for (auto it = parts_.begin(); it != parts_.end();) {
        auto next = std::next(it);
        if (now_ms - it->second.first_ms > lim_.timeout_ms) drop(it);
        it = next;
    }
}

std::optional<reassembler_t::datagram_t> reassembler_t::add(const ip_info_t& ip,
                                                            int64_t now_ms) {
    if (!ip.fragment || (ip.l4 == nullptr && ip.l4_len != 0)) return std::nullopt;
    expire(now_ms);

    key_t k;
    k.family = ip.src.family;
    k.proto = ip.src.family == 4 ? ip.proto : 0;   // v6 next-header can differ per fragment
    k.src = ip.src.b;
    k.dst = ip.dst.b;
    k.id = ip.frag_id;

    auto it = parts_.find(k);
    const size_t len = ip.l4_len;
    const uint64_t start = ip.frag_offset;
    const uint64_t end = start + len;
    const bool bad = ip.l4_len != ip.l4_wire_len ||        // capture truncated it
                     end > 65535 || (ip.more_fragments && (len == 0 || len % 8 != 0));
    if (bad) {
        if (it != parts_.end()) drop(it);
        else ++dropped_;
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (it == parts_.end()) {
        while (parts_.size() >= lim_.max_datagrams && !parts_.empty()) {
            auto oldest = parts_.begin();
            for (auto j = parts_.begin(); j != parts_.end(); ++j)
                if (j->second.first_ms < oldest->second.first_ms) oldest = j;
            drop(oldest);
        }
        part_t p;
        p.first_ms = now_ms;
        it = parts_.emplace(k, std::move(p)).first;
    }
    part_t& p = it->second;
    if (!ip.more_fragments) {
        if ((p.total != 0 && p.total != end) ||
            (!p.have.empty() && std::prev(p.have.end())->second > end)) {
            drop(it);
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        p.total = static_cast<uint32_t>(end);
    } else if (p.total != 0 && end > p.total) {
        drop(it);
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (start == 0) {
        p.proto = ip.proto;
        p.have_first = true;
    }
    if (end > p.data.size()) {
        const size_t grow = static_cast<size_t>(end) - p.data.size();
        bytes_ += grow;
        p.data.resize(static_cast<size_t>(end));
        while (bytes_ > lim_.max_bytes) {
            auto victim = parts_.end();
            for (auto j = parts_.begin(); j != parts_.end(); ++j)
                if (j != it && (victim == parts_.end() ||
                                j->second.first_ms < victim->second.first_ms))
                    victim = j;
            if (victim == parts_.end()) {
                drop(it);
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            drop(victim);
        }
    }
    if (len) std::memcpy(p.data.data() + start, ip.l4, len);

    // merge [start, end) into the coverage map
    uint32_t s = static_cast<uint32_t>(start), e = static_cast<uint32_t>(end);
    if (e > s) {
        auto lo = p.have.upper_bound(s);
        if (lo != p.have.begin() && std::prev(lo)->second >= s) --lo;
        while (lo != p.have.end() && lo->first <= e) {
            s = std::min(s, lo->first);
            e = std::max(e, lo->second);
            lo = p.have.erase(lo);
        }
        p.have.emplace(s, e);
    }

    if (p.total != 0 && p.have_first && p.have.size() == 1 &&
        p.have.begin()->first == 0 && p.have.begin()->second == p.total) {
        datagram_t out;
        out.proto = p.proto;
        bytes_ -= p.data.size();
        out.l4 = std::move(p.data);
        out.l4.resize(p.total);
        parts_.erase(it);
        ++completed_;
        return out;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

// DNS

std::optional<dns_record_t> parse_dns(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    if (!d || n < 12) return std::nullopt;
    const uint16_t flags = be16(d + 2);
    const uint16_t qd = be16(d + 4);
    const uint16_t an = be16(d + 6);
    if (qd == 0) return std::nullopt;
    if ((flags >> 11) & 0xF) return std::nullopt;          // only standard queries

    auto read_name = [&](size_t& off, std::string& name) -> bool {
        name.clear();
        size_t pos = off;
        size_t resume = 0;
        int jumps = 0;
        size_t wire_len = 0;
        for (;;) {
            if (pos >= n) return false;
            const uint8_t l = d[pos];
            if (l == 0) {
                if (resume == 0) resume = pos + 1;
                break;
            }
            if ((l & 0xC0) == 0xC0) {
                if (pos + 1 >= n) return false;
                const size_t ptr = (static_cast<size_t>(l & 0x3F) << 8) | d[pos + 1];
                if (ptr >= pos || ++jumps > 16) return false;   // backwards only
                if (resume == 0) resume = pos + 2;
                pos = ptr;
                continue;
            }
            if (l & 0xC0) return false;                    // extended label types
            if (pos + 1 + l > n) return false;
            wire_len += 1u + l;
            if (wire_len > 255) return false;
            if (!name.empty()) name += '.';
            name += escape_nonprintable(
                std::string_view(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + pos + 1), l));
            pos += 1u + l;
        }
        off = resume;
        return true;
    };

    dns_record_t r;
    r.is_response = (flags >> 15) & 1;
    r.response_code = flags & 0xF;
    size_t off = 12;
    std::string qname;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < qd; ++i) {
        std::string name;
        if (!read_name(off, name) || off + 4 > n) return std::nullopt;
        if (i == 0) {
            qname = std::move(name);
            r.query_type = be16(d + off);
        }
        off += 4;
    }
    if (qname.empty()) qname = ".";
    r.domain = std::move(qname);
    if (!r.is_response) return r;

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < an; ++i) {
        std::string aname;
        if (!read_name(off, aname) || off + 10 > n) break;
        const uint16_t type = be16(d + off);
        const uint32_t ttl = be32(d + off + 4);
        const size_t rdlen = be16(d + off + 8);
        off += 10;
        if (off + rdlen > n) break;
        std::string addr;
        if (type == 1 && rdlen == 4) addr = to_string(make_v4(d + off));
        else if (type == 28 && rdlen == 16) addr = to_string(make_v6(d + off));
        if (!addr.empty()) {
            if (r.answers.empty()) {
                r.resolved_addr = addr;
                r.ttl = ttl;
            }
            if (r.answers.size() < 16) r.answers.push_back(std::move(addr));
        }
        off += rdlen;
    }
    return r;
}

// TLS

std::string extract_sni(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    if (!d || n < 5 || d[0] != 0x16 || d[1] != 0x03) return {};
    const size_t rec_end = std::min(n, 5 + static_cast<size_t>(be16(d + 3)));
    size_t off = 5;
    if (off + 4 > rec_end || d[off] != 0x01) return {};    // ClientHello
    const size_t hs_len = (static_cast<size_t>(d[off + 1]) << 16) |
                          (static_cast<size_t>(d[off + 2]) << 8) | d[off + 3];
    off += 4;
    const size_t end = std::min(rec_end, off + hs_len);
    if (off + 2 + 32 + 1 > end) return {};
    off += 2 + 32;                                         // version + random
    off += 1 + static_cast<size_t>(d[off]);                // session id
    if (off + 2 > end) return {};
    off += 2 + static_cast<size_t>(be16(d + off));         // cipher suites
    if (off + 1 > end) return {};
    off += 1 + static_cast<size_t>(d[off]);                // compression methods
    if (off + 2 > end) return {};
    const size_t ext_end = std::min(end, off + 2 + static_cast<size_t>(be16(d + off)));
    off += 2;
    while (off + 4 <= ext_end) {
        const uint16_t type = be16(d + off);
        const size_t len = be16(d + off + 2);
        off += 4;
        if (off + len > ext_end) return {};
        if (type == 0x0000) {                              // server_name
            if (len < 2) return {};
            const size_t list_end = std::min(off + len, off + 2 + static_cast<size_t>(be16(d + off)));
            size_t p = off + 2;
            while (p + 3 <= list_end) {
                const uint8_t name_type = d[p];
                const size_t name_len = be16(d + p + 1);
                p += 3;
                if (p + name_len > list_end) return {};
                if (name_type == 0) {
                    const std::string_view name(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + p), name_len);
                    return valid_host(name) ? lower(name) : std::string{};
                }
                p += name_len;
            }
            return {};
        }
        off += len;
    }
    return {};
}

// QUIC

namespace {

// QUIC variable-length integer (RFC 9000 §16): the top two bits give the width
bool read_varint(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, size_t& pos, uint64_t& out) {
    if (pos >= n) return false;
    const size_t len = size_t{1} << (d[pos] >> 6);
    if (pos + len > n) return false;
    uint64_t v = d[pos] & 0x3F;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < len; ++i) v = (v << 8) | d[pos + i];
    pos += len;
    out = v;
    return true;
}

std::string hex_bytes(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    static const char* kHex = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(n * 2);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        out += kHex[d[i] >> 4];
        out += kHex[d[i] & 0x0F];
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace

const char* quic_type_name(uint8_t type) {
    switch (type) {
        case 0: return "initial";
        case 1: return "0-rtt";
        case 2: return "handshake";
        case 3: return "retry";
        default: return "unknown";
    }
}

const char* quic_version_name(uint32_t version) {
    switch (version) {
        case 0x00000000: return "negotiation";
        case 0x00000001: return "1";
        case 0x6b3343cf: return "2";
        case 0xff00001d: return "draft-29";
        default: return "unknown";
    }
}

std::optional<quic_info_t> parse_quic(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    if (!d || n < 7) return std::nullopt;
    if ((d[0] & 0x80) == 0) return std::nullopt;          // short header: no version
    quic_info_t q;
    q.version = be32(d + 1);
    q.type = static_cast<uint8_t>((d[0] >> 4) & 0x03);
    size_t pos = 5;
    const size_t dlen = d[pos++];
    if (dlen > 20 || pos + dlen > n) return std::nullopt;
    q.dcid = hex_bytes(d + pos, dlen);
    pos += dlen;
    if (pos >= n) return std::nullopt;
    const size_t slen = d[pos++];
    if (slen > 20 || pos + slen > n) return std::nullopt;
    q.scid = hex_bytes(d + pos, slen);
    pos += slen;
    if (q.version == 0) return q;                         // version negotiation
    if (q.type == 3) return q;                            // retry: integrity tag, no length
    if (q.type == 0) {                                    // initial: token
        uint64_t token_len = 0;
        if (!read_varint(d, n, pos, token_len)) return std::nullopt;
        if (token_len > n - pos) return std::nullopt;
        pos += static_cast<size_t>(token_len);
    }
    uint64_t len = 0;
    if (!read_varint(d, n, pos, len)) return std::nullopt;
    q.has_length = true;
    q.length = len;
    return q;
}

// HTTP

const std::string* http_head_t::get(std::string_view name) const {
    for (const auto& [k, v] : headers)
        if (k == name) return &v;
    return nullptr;
}

size_t find_head_end(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, size_t from) {
    if (n < 4) return std::string::npos;
    for (size_t i = from; i + 4 <= n; ++i)
        if (d[i] == '\r' && d[i + 1] == '\n' && d[i + 2] == '\r' && d[i + 3] == '\n')
            return i + 4;
    return std::string::npos;
}

std::optional<http_head_t> parse_http_head(std::string_view head, bool response) {
    http_head_t h;
    size_t eol = head.find("\r\n");
    if (eol == std::string_view::npos || eol == 0) return std::nullopt;
    const std::string_view start = head.substr(0, eol);
    for (char c : start)
        if (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) < 0x20 || static_cast<unsigned char>(c) > 0x7E)
            return std::nullopt;
    const size_t sp1 = start.find(' ');
    if (sp1 == std::string_view::npos || sp1 == 0) return std::nullopt;
    if (response) {
        h.version = std::string(start.substr(0, sp1));
        if (h.version.rfind("HTTP/", 0) != 0) return std::nullopt;
        const std::string_view rest = start.substr(sp1 + 1);
        const std::string_view code = rest.substr(0, std::min<size_t>(rest.find(' '), rest.size()));
        uint64_t st = 0;
        if (code.size() != 3 || !parse_u64_digits(code, st)) return std::nullopt;
        h.status = static_cast<uint32_t>(st);
        if (rest.size() > 4) h.reason = std::string(rest.substr(4));
    } else {
        const size_t sp2 = start.find(' ', sp1 + 1);
        if (sp2 == std::string_view::npos || sp2 == sp1 + 1) return std::nullopt;
        h.method = std::string(start.substr(0, sp1));
        for (char c : h.method)
            if (!is_token_char(c)) return std::nullopt;
        h.target = std::string(start.substr(sp1 + 1, sp2 - sp1 - 1));
        h.version = std::string(start.substr(sp2 + 1));
        if (h.version.rfind("HTTP/", 0) != 0) return std::nullopt;
    }
    size_t pos = eol + 2;
    while (pos < head.size()) {
        eol = head.find("\r\n", pos);
        if (eol == std::string_view::npos) return std::nullopt;
        if (eol == pos) break;                             // blank line ends the head
        const std::string_view line = head.substr(pos, eol - pos);
        pos = eol + 2;
        if (line.front() == ' ' || line.front() == '\t') return std::nullopt;   // obs-fold
        const size_t colon = line.find(':');
        if (colon == std::string_view::npos || colon == 0) return std::nullopt;
        const std::string_view name = line.substr(0, colon);
        for (char c : name)
            if (!is_token_char(c)) return std::nullopt;
        if (h.headers.size() >= 256) return std::nullopt;
        h.headers.emplace_back(lower(name), std::string(trim(line.substr(colon + 1))));
    }
    return h;
}

bool decode_chunked(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    out.clear();
    size_t pos = 0;
    for (;;) {
        size_t eol = pos;
        while (eol + 1 < n && !(d[eol] == '\r' && d[eol + 1] == '\n')) ++eol;
        if (eol + 1 >= n || eol - pos > 1024) return false;
        uint64_t size = 0;
        size_t digits = 0;
        for (size_t i = pos; i < eol && d[i] != ';'; ++i) {
            const char h = static_cast<char>(d[i]);
            int x;
            if (h >= '0' && h <= '9') x = h - '0';
            else if (h >= 'a' && h <= 'f') x = h - 'a' + 10;
            else if (h >= 'A' && h <= 'F') x = h - 'A' + 10;
            else if (h == ' ' || h == '\t') continue;
            else return false;
            if (++digits > 10) return false;
            size = size * 16 + static_cast<uint64_t>(x);
        }
        if (digits == 0) return false;
        pos = eol + 2;
        if (size == 0) {
            // trailers until an empty line
            for (;;) {
                size_t e = pos;
                while (e + 1 < n && !(d[e] == '\r' && d[e + 1] == '\n')) ++e;
                if (e + 1 >= n) return false;
                if (e == pos) return true;
                pos = e + 2;
            }
        }
        if (size > n - pos || n - pos - static_cast<size_t>(size) < 2) return false;
        out.insert(out.end(), d + pos, d + pos + size);
        pos += static_cast<size_t>(size);
        if (d[pos] != '\r' || d[pos + 1] != '\n') return false;
        pos += 2;
    }
}

void http_framer_t::fail(const char* why) {
    state_ = st_t::broken;
    error_ = why;
    head_buf_.clear();
    line_buf_.clear();
}

void http_framer_t::message_done(size_t at, std::vector<event_t>* events) {
    ++completed_;
    state_ = st_t::head;
    if (events) events->push_back({event_t::kind_t::end, at, false, {}});
}

void http_framer_t::on_head(size_t at, std::vector<event_t>* events) {
    auto h = parse_http_head(head_buf_, response_);
    if (!h) return fail("unparseable message head");
    const bool interim = response_ && h->status >= 100 && h->status < 200;
    if (events) events->push_back({event_t::kind_t::head, at, interim, head_buf_});
    head_buf_.clear();

    bool chunked = false;
    std::optional<uint64_t> length;
    for (const auto& [k, v] : h->headers) {
        if (k == "transfer-encoding") {
            const std::string tv = lower(v);
            chunked = tv.size() >= 7 && tv.compare(tv.size() - 7, 7, "chunked") == 0;
            if (!chunked) return fail("unsupported transfer-encoding");
        } else if (k == "content-length") {
            uint64_t cl = 0;
            if (!parse_u64_digits(v, cl)) return fail("bad content-length");
            if (length && *length != cl) return fail("conflicting content-length");
            length = cl;
        }
    }

    auto done = [&] { message_done(at, events); };
    if (!response_) {
        if (h->method == "CONNECT") return fail("tunnel request");
        if (chunked) { state_ = st_t::chunk_size; line_buf_.clear(); return; }
        if (length && *length) { remaining_ = *length; state_ = st_t::body; return; }
        return done();
    }
    std::string method;
    if (h->status >= 100 && h->status < 200) {
        if (h->status == 101) return fail("protocol switch");
        state_ = st_t::head;                               // interim, request still pending
        return;
    }
    if (!pending_methods_.empty()) {
        method = std::move(pending_methods_.front());
        pending_methods_.pop_front();
    }
    if (h->status == 204 || h->status == 304 || method == "HEAD") return done();
    if (chunked) { state_ = st_t::chunk_size; line_buf_.clear(); return; }
    if (length) {
        if (*length == 0) return done();
        remaining_ = *length;
        state_ = st_t::body;
        return;
    }
    state_ = st_t::until_close;
}

void http_framer_t::feed(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, std::vector<event_t>* events) {
    constexpr size_t kMaxHead = 64 * 1024;
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        switch (state_) {
        case st_t::broken:
        case st_t::until_close:
            return;
        case st_t::head: {
            if (head_buf_.empty())
                while (i < n && (d[i] == '\r' || d[i] == '\n')) ++i;   // tolerate stray CRLF
            if (i >= n) return;
            const size_t before = head_buf_.size();
            const size_t scan_from = before >= 3 ? before - 3 : 0;
            const size_t take = std::min(n - i, kMaxHead + 4 - before);
            head_buf_.append(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(d + i), take);
            const size_t end = find_head_end(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(head_buf_.data()),
                                             head_buf_.size(), scan_from);
            if (end == std::string::npos) {
                if (head_buf_.size() > kMaxHead) return fail("message head too large");
                i += take;
                break;
            }
            i += end - before;
            head_buf_.resize(end);
            on_head(i, events);
            break;
        }
        case st_t::body: {
            const uint64_t take = std::min<uint64_t>(remaining_, n - i);
            remaining_ -= take;
            i += static_cast<size_t>(take);
            if (remaining_ == 0) {
                message_done(i, events);
            }
            break;
        }
        case st_t::chunk_size:
        case st_t::trailer: {
            const char c = static_cast<char>(d[i++]);
            line_buf_.push_back(c);
            if (line_buf_.size() > (state_ == st_t::trailer ? kMaxHead : 1024))
                return fail("chunk line too long");
            if (line_buf_.size() < 2 || line_buf_[line_buf_.size() - 2] != '\r' || c != '\n')
                break;
            const std::string line = line_buf_.substr(0, line_buf_.size() - 2);
            line_buf_.clear();
            if (state_ == st_t::trailer) {
                if (line.empty()) {
                    message_done(i, events);
                }
                break;
            }
            const std::string_view sz = trim(std::string_view(line).substr(0, line.find(';')));
            if (sz.empty() || sz.size() > 10) return fail("bad chunk size");
            uint64_t v = 0;
            for (char h : sz) {
                int x;
                if (h >= '0' && h <= '9') x = h - '0';
                else if (h >= 'a' && h <= 'f') x = h - 'a' + 10;
                else if (h >= 'A' && h <= 'F') x = h - 'A' + 10;
                else return fail("bad chunk size");
                v = v * 16 + static_cast<uint64_t>(x);
            }
            if (v == 0) {
                state_ = st_t::trailer;
            } else {
                remaining_ = v;
                state_ = st_t::chunk_data;
            }
            break;
        }
        case st_t::chunk_data: {
            const uint64_t take = std::min<uint64_t>(remaining_, n - i);
            remaining_ -= take;
            i += static_cast<size_t>(take);
            if (remaining_ == 0) {
                state_ = st_t::chunk_crlf;
                line_buf_.clear();
            }
            break;
        }
        case st_t::chunk_crlf: {
            line_buf_.push_back(static_cast<char>(d[i++]));
            if (line_buf_.size() == 2) {
                if (line_buf_ != "\r\n") return fail("missing chunk terminator");
                line_buf_.clear();
                state_ = st_t::chunk_size;
            }
            break;
        }
        }
    }
}

void http_framer_t::finish(std::vector<event_t>* events) {
    if (state_ == st_t::until_close) message_done(0, events);
}

} // namespace slop::core::network::parse

```

`src/core/network/parsers.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/parsers.hpp
// pure parsers for attacker-controlled bytes: IPv4/IPv6 datagrams from the raw
// capture sockets (+ fragment reassembly), TCP/UDP headers, DNS messages, TLS
// ClientHello SNI, HTTP/1.x message framing, plus address/host helpers shared
// by the capture filter, the proxy allowlist and the web egress guard.
// No sockets and no globals: every routine is bounds-checked against its input
// length and is driven by the deterministic mutation fuzz tests in
// src/tests/test_network.cpp

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <map>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::network::parse {

// addresses

struct ip_addr_t {
    uint8_t family = 0;                // 4 | 6, 0 = unset
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> b{};       // v4 uses b[0..3]
    bool operator==(const ip_addr_t&) const = default;
    bool valid() const { return family == 4 || family == 6; }
};

// dotted IPv4 or IPv6 literal ("[::1]" brackets and "%scope" accepted)
std::optional<ip_addr_t> parse_ip(std::string_view text);
std::string to_string(const ip_addr_t& a);
ip_addr_t make_v4(const uint8_t* four);
ip_addr_t make_v6(const uint8_t* sixteen);

struct cidr_t {
    ip_addr_t net;
    int prefix = 0;
};
// "10.0.0.0/8", "fe80::/10", or a bare address (full-length prefix)
std::optional<cidr_t> parse_cidr(std::string_view text);
bool cidr_contains(const cidr_t& c, const ip_addr_t& a);

// loopback, unspecified, RFC1918, CGNAT, link-local, ULA, multicast, reserved,
// benchmark nets, and IPv4-mapped / NAT64 / 6to4 embeddings of any of those
bool is_non_public(const ip_addr_t& a);

// DNS hostname (LDH labels 1-63, total <= 253, at least one char) or IP literal
bool valid_host(std::string_view host);
std::string lower(std::string_view s);

// allowlist pattern: exact host (case-insensitive), "*.suffix" (subdomains
// only), IP literal, or CIDR. `addr` is the resolved address when known
bool host_pattern_match(std::string_view pattern, std::string_view host,
                        const ip_addr_t* addr);

// bytes outside 0x20..0x7E become \xHH so strings stay valid UTF-8 / JSON
std::string escape_nonprintable(std::string_view s);

// base64 (standard alphabet, padding optional); nullopt on bad input
std::optional<std::string> base64_decode(std::string_view in);
std::string base64_encode(const uint8_t* d, size_t n);

// IP / L4

enum class status_t : uint8_t {
    ok,
    truncated,      // fewer captured bytes than the headers need
    not_ip,         // version nibble is neither 4 nor 6
    malformed,      // inconsistent lengths / header fields
    unsupported,    // valid IP but not TCP/UDP (or no upper layer)
};
const char* status_name(status_t s);

struct ip_info_t {
    ip_addr_t src, dst;
    uint8_t   proto = 0;           // upper-layer protocol after v6 ext headers
    const uint8_t* l4 = nullptr;
    size_t    l4_len = 0;          // captured bytes, clamped to the declared length
    uint32_t  l4_wire_len = 0;     // l4 length declared by the IP header
    bool      fragment = false;    // part of a fragmented datagram
    uint32_t  frag_id = 0;
    uint32_t  frag_offset = 0;     // bytes
    bool      more_fragments = false;
};

// parses the IP header at offset 0 (SIO_RCVALL delivers IP datagrams, no
// link-layer framing). total_len / payload_len bound everything after it
status_t parse_ip(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, ip_info_t& out);

// skips IPv6 extension headers (hop-by-hop, routing, destination options, AH)
// in a reassembled fragmentable part; updates proto/data/len in place
status_t skip_v6_ext(uint8_t& proto, const uint8_t*& d, size_t& n);

// Windows IPv6 raw sockets (even with SIO_RCVALL) deliver only the bytes
// after the last IPv6 header; source/destination come from the socket API.
// The next-header value is inferred: UDP/TCP/ICMPv6 by checksum over the
// pseudo-header, then UDP by length, an IPv6 fragment header by shape, and
// TCP by a sane data offset (outbound packets may carry offloaded, not yet
// computed checksums). Returns 6, 17, 58, 44 or 0 (unknown)
uint8_t infer_v6_transport(const ip_addr_t& src, const ip_addr_t& dst, const uint8_t* d, size_t n);

struct l4_info_t {
    uint16_t src_port = 0, dst_port = 0;
    const uint8_t* payload = nullptr;
    size_t   payload_len = 0;      // captured payload bytes
    uint32_t payload_wire_len = 0; // payload length on the wire
    uint32_t tcp_seq = 0, tcp_ack = 0;
    uint8_t  tcp_flags = 0;
};

// TCP payload = l4_wire_len - data offset; UDP payload is clamped to udp.len
status_t parse_l4(uint8_t proto, const uint8_t* l4, size_t l4_len,
                  uint32_t l4_wire_len, l4_info_t& out);

// bounded IPv4/IPv6 fragment reassembly; unfinished datagrams expire after
// `timeout_ms` and the oldest are dropped when either cap is exceeded
class reassembler_t {
public:
    struct limits_t {
        size_t  max_datagrams = 64;
        size_t  max_bytes = 4u << 20;
        int64_t timeout_ms = 30000;
    };
    struct datagram_t {
        uint8_t proto = 0;
        std::vector<uint8_t> l4;   // complete fragmentable part
    };

    reassembler_t() = default;
    explicit reassembler_t(limits_t l) : lim_(l) {}

    // feed one fragment (ip.fragment == true). Returns the datagram once every
    // byte of it has arrived
    std::optional<datagram_t> add(const ip_info_t& ip, int64_t now_ms);

    size_t   pending() const { return parts_.size(); }
    size_t   bytes() const { return bytes_; }
    uint64_t dropped() const { return dropped_; }
    uint64_t completed() const { return completed_; }
    void     clear();

private:
    struct key_t {
        uint8_t family = 0, proto = 0;
        std::array<uint8_t, 16> src{}, dst{};
        uint32_t id = 0;
        auto operator<=>(const key_t&) const = default;
    };
    struct part_t {
        std::vector<uint8_t> data;
        std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> have;   // merged [start, end) ranges
        uint32_t total = 0;                  // 0 until the last fragment arrives
        int64_t  first_ms = 0;
        uint8_t  proto = 0;                  // from the offset-0 fragment (v6)
        bool     have_first = false;
    };

    limits_t lim_{};
    std::map<key_t, part_t> parts_;
    size_t   bytes_ = 0;
    uint64_t dropped_ = 0;
    uint64_t completed_ = 0;

    void expire(int64_t now_ms);
    void drop(std::map<key_t, part_t>::iterator it);
};

// DNS

struct dns_record_t {
    uint64_t    timestamp = 0;
    bool        is_response = false;
    uint32_t    query_type = 0;
    std::string domain;
    std::string resolved_addr;           // first A/AAAA answer
    std::vector<std::string> answers;    // all A/AAAA answers (capped)
    uint32_t    response_code = 0;
    uint32_t    ttl = 0;
    std::string client_addr;             // filled by the capture service
    std::string server_addr;
};

// parses one DNS message (UDP payload). Names are escaped printable ASCII;
// compression pointers must point backwards and are hop-limited
std::optional<dns_record_t> parse_dns(const uint8_t* d, size_t n);

// TLS

// server_name from a TLS ClientHello in the first record of `d`; every length
// field is clamped against both the record and the buffer. Empty when absent
// or not a valid hostname
std::string extract_sni(const uint8_t* d, size_t n);

// QUIC

// long-header packet (RFC 9000 §17.2): version, connection ids and the packet
// type. Short headers carry no version, so they are not identified. nullopt
// when the bytes are not a complete long header
struct quic_info_t {
    uint32_t    version = 0;
    uint8_t     type = 0;          // 0 initial, 1 0-RTT, 2 handshake, 3 retry
    std::string dcid, scid;        // hex, 0..20 bytes each
    bool        has_length = false;
    uint64_t    length = 0;        // declared bytes after the length field
};
std::optional<quic_info_t> parse_quic(const uint8_t* d, size_t n);
const char* quic_type_name(uint8_t type);
const char* quic_version_name(uint32_t version);

// HTTP/1.x

struct http_head_t {
    std::string method, target, version;      // request line
    uint32_t    status = 0;                   // status line (responses)
    std::string reason;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> headers;   // name lowercased
    // first value of `name` (lowercase), nullptr when absent
    const std::string* get(std::string_view name) const;
};

// parses a head up to and including CRLFCRLF; `response` selects the start line
std::optional<http_head_t> parse_http_head(std::string_view head, bool response);
// offset just past CRLFCRLF in [d, d+n) starting the scan at `from`, or npos
size_t find_head_end(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, size_t from = 0);

// decodes a complete chunked body (chunk extensions and trailers ignored);
// false when the encoding is malformed or incomplete
bool decode_chunked(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, std::vector<uint8_t>& out);

// incremental message framer for one direction of an HTTP/1.x connection;
// reports where each message head ends and each message ends, tracking
// Content-Length / chunked / close-delimited bodies so keep-alive streams
// stay aligned
class http_framer_t {
public:
    struct event_t {
        enum class kind_t { head, end } kind = kind_t::head;
        size_t      at = 0;          // offset in the fed chunk just past the head / message
        bool        interim = false; // 1xx response: the request is still pending
        std::string head;            // raw head incl. CRLFCRLF (head events)
    };

    explicit http_framer_t(bool response) : response_(response) {}

    // the method of the request this response answers (HEAD has no body)
    void expect_response_to(std::string method) { pending_methods_.push_back(std::move(method)); }

    void feed(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, std::vector<event_t>* events = nullptr);
    // signals EOF; a close-delimited body completes here (end event at 0)
    void finish(std::vector<event_t>* events = nullptr);

    bool   broken() const { return state_ == st_t::broken; }
    bool   idle() const { return state_ == st_t::head && head_buf_.empty(); }
    bool   until_close() const { return state_ == st_t::until_close; }
    size_t messages_completed() const { return completed_; }
    const std::string& error() const { return error_; }

private:
    enum class st_t { head, body, chunk_size, chunk_data, chunk_crlf, trailer,
                      until_close, broken };
    bool        response_;
    st_t        state_ = st_t::head;
    std::string head_buf_;
    std::string line_buf_;
    uint64_t    remaining_ = 0;
    size_t      completed_ = 0;
    std::deque<std::string> pending_methods_;
    std::string error_;

    void on_head(size_t at, std::vector<event_t>* events);
    void message_done(size_t at, std::vector<event_t>* events);
    void fail(const char* why);
};

} // namespace slop::core::network::parse
```

`src/core/network/pcap_import.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/pcap_import.cpp

#include "core/network/pcap_import.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"

namespace slop::core::network::pcap {

namespace {

constexpr size_t kMaxFileBytes = 512u << 20;   // refuse to load bigger captures
constexpr size_t kMaxRecords = 500000;
constexpr size_t kMaxRecordBytes = 1u << 20;   // one frame / packet block
constexpr size_t kMaxPayload = 65535;

uint16_t rd16(const uint8_t* p, bool le) {
    return le ? static_cast<uint16_t>(p[0] | (p[1] << 8))
              : static_cast<uint16_t>((p[0] << 8) | p[1]);
}

uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t* p, bool le) {
    return le ? (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[0]) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[1]) << 8) |
                 (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[2]) << 16) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[3]) << 24))
              : ((static_cast<uint32_t>(p[0]) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[1]) << 16) |
                 (static_cast<uint32_t>(p[2]) << 8) | static_cast<uint32_t>(p[3]));
}

// link types we can strip: Ethernet (with one VLAN tag), Linux cooked SLL,
// raw IP and the family-specific raw types
enum class link_t { unsupported, ethernet, sll, raw };

link_t link_kind(uint32_t linktype) {
    switch (linktype) {
        case 1: return link_t::ethernet;
        case 113: return link_t::sll;
        case 12: case 101: case 228: case 229: return link_t::raw;
        default: return link_t::unsupported;
    }
}

// offset of the IP header inside one frame, or npos
size_t ip_offset(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, link_t kind) {
    switch (kind) {
        case link_t::ethernet: {
            if (n < 14) return std::string::npos;
            size_t off = 14;
            uint16_t type = rd16(d + 12, false);
            if (type == 0x8100 || type == 0x88A8) {
                if (n < 18) return std::string::npos;
                type = rd16(d + 16, false);
                off = 18;
            }
            if (type != 0x0800 && type != 0x86DD) return std::string::npos;
            return off;
        }
        case link_t::sll:
            return n < 16 ? std::string::npos : 16;
        case link_t::raw:
            return 0;
        default:
            return std::string::npos;
    }
}

bool frame_to_packet(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, link_t kind, int64_t at_ms,
                     packet_record_t& out) {
    const size_t off = ip_offset(d, n, kind);
    if (off == std::string::npos || off >= n) return false;
    parse::ip_info_t ip;
    if (parse::parse_ip(d + off, n - off, ip) != parse::status_t::ok) return false;
    if (ip.fragment || (ip.proto != 6 && ip.proto != 17)) return false;
    parse::l4_info_t l4;
    if (parse::parse_l4(ip.proto, ip.l4, ip.l4_len, ip.l4_wire_len, l4) !=
        parse::status_t::ok)
        return false;

    out.at_ms = at_ms;
    out.protocol = ip.proto;
    out.direction = 0;
    out.ip_version = ip.src.family;
    out.local_addr = parse::to_string(ip.src);
    out.local_port = l4.src_port;
    out.remote_addr = parse::to_string(ip.dst);
    out.remote_port = l4.dst_port;
    const size_t payload = std::min({l4.payload_len, kMaxPayload, n - off});
    out.payload.assign(l4.payload, l4.payload + payload);
    out.wire_len = std::max<uint32_t>(l4.payload_wire_len,
                                      static_cast<uint32_t>(out.payload.size()));
    out.tcp_seq = l4.tcp_seq;
    out.tcp_ack = l4.tcp_ack;
    out.tcp_flags = l4.tcp_flags;
    return true;
}

struct cursor_t {
    const uint8_t* d = nullptr;
    size_t n = 0;
    size_t pos = 0;
    bool le = true;

    size_t left() const { return n - pos; }
    bool take(size_t k) { return k <= left(); }
};

std::string parse_pcap(cursor_t& c, traffic_store_t& store, import_result_t& out) {
    // magic, version, thiszone, sigfigs, snaplen, linktype
    if (!c.take(24)) return "pcap: truncated global header";
    const uint8_t* h = c.d;
    bool le = true;
    bool nano = false;
    if (h[0] == 0xa1 && h[1] == 0xb2 && h[2] == 0xc3 && h[3] == 0xd4) le = false;
    else if (h[0] == 0xd4 && h[1] == 0xc3 && h[2] == 0xb2 && h[3] == 0xa1) le = true;
    else if (h[0] == 0xa1 && h[1] == 0xb2 && h[2] == 0x3c && h[3] == 0x4d) { le = false; nano = true; }
    else if (h[0] == 0x4d && h[1] == 0x3c && h[2] == 0xb2 && h[3] == 0xa1) { le = true; nano = true; }
    else return "pcap: not a pcap file (bad magic)";
    c.le = le;
    c.pos = 24;
    const uint32_t linktype = rd32(h + 20, le);
    const link_t kind = link_kind(linktype);
    if (kind == link_t::unsupported)
        return "pcap: unsupported link type " + std::to_string(linktype) +
               " (Ethernet, Linux SLL and raw IP only)";

    while (c.left() >= 16) {
        if (out.packets + out.skipped >= kMaxRecords) return "pcap: record cap reached";
        const uint8_t* r = c.d + c.pos;
        const uint32_t ts_sec = rd32(r, le);
        const uint32_t ts_frac = rd32(r + 4, le);
        const uint32_t incl = rd32(r + 8, le);
        const uint32_t orig = rd32(r + 12, le);
        if (incl > kMaxRecordBytes) return "pcap: record length " + std::to_string(incl) + " exceeds the cap";
        if (!c.take(16 + static_cast<size_t>(incl))) return "pcap: truncated record";
        const int64_t at_ms = static_cast<int64_t>(ts_sec) * 1000 +
                              (nano ? ts_frac / 1000000 : ts_frac / 1000);
        packet_record_t p;
        if (frame_to_packet(r + 16, incl, kind, at_ms, p)) {
            store.add(std::move(p));
            ++out.packets;
        } else {
            ++out.skipped;
        }
        if (incl < orig) ++out.truncated;
        c.pos += 16 + static_cast<size_t>(incl);
    }
    if (c.left() != 0) return "pcap: trailing bytes after the last record";
    return {};
}

// one interface of the current section: link type and timestamp resolution
struct iface_t {
    link_t kind = link_t::unsupported;
    uint64_t ticks_per_s = 1000000;   // default: microseconds
};

std::string parse_pcapng(cursor_t& c, traffic_store_t& store, import_result_t& out) {
    std::vector<iface_t> ifaces;
    bool have_section = false;
    if (c.left() < 12) return "pcapng: truncated section header";
    while (c.left() >= 12) {
        const uint8_t* b = c.d + c.pos;
        const bool shb = b[0] == 0x0a && b[1] == 0x0d && b[2] == 0x0d && b[3] == 0x0a;
        if (shb) {
            if (!c.take(28)) return "pcapng: truncated section header";
            const uint8_t* bom = b + 8;
            if (rd32(bom, true) == 0x1A2B3C4D) c.le = true;
            else if (rd32(bom, false) == 0x1A2B3C4D) c.le = false;
            else return "pcapng: bad byte-order magic";
            ifaces.clear();
            have_section = true;
        }
        if (!have_section) return "pcapng: no section header block";
        const uint32_t type = rd32(b, c.le);
        const uint32_t total = rd32(b + 4, c.le);
        if (total < 12 || total % 4 != 0) return "pcapng: invalid block length";
        if (total > kMaxRecordBytes + 4096) return "pcapng: block length " + std::to_string(total) + " exceeds the cap";
        if (!c.take(total)) return "pcapng: truncated block";
        if (rd32(b + total - 4, c.le) != total) return "pcapng: block length mismatch";
        const uint8_t* body = b + 8;
        const size_t body_len = total - 12;

        if (type == 0x00000001u) {                       // interface description
            if (body_len < 8) return "pcapng: truncated interface block";
            iface_t iface;
            iface.kind = link_kind(rd16(body, c.le));
            size_t opt = 8;
            while (opt + 4 <= body_len) {
                const uint16_t code = rd16(body + opt, c.le);
                const uint16_t len = rd16(body + opt + 2, c.le);
                opt += 4;
                if (code == 0) break;
                if (opt + len > body_len) return "pcapng: truncated interface option";
                if (code == 9 && len >= 1) {             // if_tsresol
                    const uint8_t v = body[opt];
                    const uint64_t exp = v & 0x7F;
                    if (exp > 63) return "pcapng: invalid timestamp resolution";
                    const uint64_t base = (v & 0x80) ? 2 : 10;
                    uint64_t ticks = 1;
                    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < exp; ++i) ticks *= base;
                    iface.ticks_per_s = ticks;
                }
                opt += (static_cast<size_t>(len) + 3) & ~size_t{3};
            }
            ifaces.push_back(iface);
        } else if (type == 0x00000006u) {                // enhanced packet
            if (body_len < 20) return "pcapng: truncated packet block";
            const uint32_t iface_id = rd32(body, c.le);
            const uint64_t ts = (static_cast<uint64_t>(rd32(body + 4, c.le)) << 32) |
                                rd32(body + 8, c.le);
            const uint32_t caplen = rd32(body + 12, c.le);
            const uint32_t origlen = rd32(body + 16, c.le);
            if (caplen > kMaxRecordBytes) return "pcapng: packet length exceeds the cap";
            if (20 + static_cast<size_t>(caplen) > body_len) return "pcapng: truncated packet data";
            if (iface_id >= ifaces.size()) return "pcapng: packet for an unknown interface";
            if (out.packets + out.skipped >= kMaxRecords) return "pcapng: record cap reached";
            const iface_t& iface = ifaces[iface_id];
            const int64_t at_ms = static_cast<int64_t>(
                static_cast<double>(ts) * 1000.0 / static_cast<double>(iface.ticks_per_s));
            packet_record_t p;
            if (frame_to_packet(body + 20, caplen, iface.kind, at_ms, p)) {
                store.add(std::move(p));
                ++out.packets;
            } else {
                ++out.skipped;
            }
            if (caplen < origlen) ++out.truncated;
        } else if (type == 0x00000003u) {                // simple packet
            if (body_len < 4) return "pcapng: truncated simple packet block";
            if (ifaces.empty()) return "pcapng: packet before any interface";
            const uint32_t origlen = rd32(body, c.le);
            const size_t caplen = std::min<size_t>(origlen, body_len - 4);
            if (caplen > kMaxRecordBytes) return "pcapng: packet length exceeds the cap";
            if (out.packets + out.skipped >= kMaxRecords) return "pcapng: record cap reached";
            packet_record_t p;
            if (frame_to_packet(body + 4, caplen, ifaces.front().kind, 0, p)) {
                store.add(std::move(p));
                ++out.packets;
            } else {
                ++out.skipped;
            }
            if (caplen < origlen) ++out.truncated;
        }
        c.pos += total;
    }
    if (c.left() != 0) return "pcapng: trailing bytes after the last block";
    return {};
}

} // namespace

std::string import_file(traffic_store_t& store, const std::string& path,
                        import_result_t* out) {
    std::FILE* fp = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!fp) return "cannot open '" + path + "'";
    std::vector<uint8_t> file;
    {
        if (std::fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_END) != 0) { std::fclose(fp); return "cannot seek '" + path + "'"; }
        const long size = std::ftell(fp);
        if (size < 0) { std::fclose(fp); return "cannot size '" + path + "'"; }
        if (static_cast<size_t>(size) > kMaxFileBytes) {
            std::fclose(fp);
            return "capture is larger than the 512 MiB import cap";
        }
        std::rewind(fp);
        file.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
        const size_t got = file.empty() ? 0 : std::fread(file.data(), 1, file.size(), fp);
        std::fclose(fp);
        if (got != file.size()) return "short read from '" + path + "'";
    }

    import_result_t result;
    cursor_t c;
    c.d = file.data();
    c.n = file.size();
    std::string err;
    const bool ng = file.size() >= 4 && file[0] == 0x0a && file[1] == 0x0d &&
                    file[2] == 0x0d && file[3] == 0x0a;
    if (file.empty()) err = "capture is empty";
    else if (ng) {
        result.format = "pcapng";
        err = parse_pcapng(c, store, result);
    } else {
        result.format = "pcap";
        err = parse_pcap(c, store, result);
    }
    if (out) *out = result;
    return err;
}

} // namespace slop::core::network::pcap
```

`src/core/network/pcap_import.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/pcap_import.hpp
// imports classic pcap (little/big endian, microsecond or nanosecond
// timestamps) and pcapng (SHB/IDB/EPB/SPB) captures into the traffic store so
// streams, dns, stats and deep_inspect work on them. The parser eats untrusted
// input: every length is bounds-checked against the buffer and the record,
// file-size and record-size caps below

#include <cstddef>
#include <string>

#include "core/network/traffic_store.hpp"

namespace slop::core::network::pcap {

struct import_result_t {
    std::string format;              // "pcap" | "pcapng"
    size_t      packets = 0;         // stored
    size_t      skipped = 0;         // not TCP/UDP, fragmented, or unparseable
    size_t      truncated = 0;       // records shorter than their original length
};

// "" on success, otherwise why the file was rejected. Packets already stored
// when a later record is malformed stay in the store
std::string import_file(traffic_store_t& store, const std::string& path,
                        import_result_t* out = nullptr);

} // namespace slop::core::network::pcap
```
