`src/core/network/redact.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/redact.cpp

#include "core/network/redact.hpp"

#include <cctype>
#include <string>

namespace slop::core::network::redact {

namespace {

constexpr std::string_view kMask = "<redacted>";

// header names whose value is a credential or a session token
bool secret_header(std::string_view name) {
    static constexpr std::string_view kNames[] = {
        "authorization", "proxy-authorization", "cookie", "set-cookie",
        "x-api-key", "x-auth-token", "x-csrf-token",
    };
    for (std::string_view n : kNames)
        if (name == n) return true;
    return false;
}

// query parameter name that carries a token-ish value
bool secret_param(std::string_view name) {
    static constexpr std::string_view kNames[] = {
        "token", "key", "auth", "sig", "session", "password", "secret",
    };
    for (std::string_view n : kNames)
        if (name.find(n) != std::string_view::npos) return true;
    return false;
}

std::string lowered(std::string_view s) {
    std::string out(s);
    for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return out;
}

// rewrites the query string of `path`; `strip` drops the parameter instead of
// masking its value
std::string rewrite_query(std::string_view path, bool strip) {
    const size_t q = path.find('?');
    if (q == std::string_view::npos) return std::string(path);
    std::string out(path.substr(0, q));
    size_t pos = q + 1;
    bool any = false;
    while (pos <= path.size()) {
        const size_t amp = path.find('&', pos);
        const size_t end = amp == std::string_view::npos ? path.size() : amp;
        const std::string pair(path.substr(pos, end - pos));
        const size_t eq = pair.find('=');
        const bool secret = eq != std::string::npos && secret_param(pair.substr(0, eq));
        if (!(secret && strip)) {
            out += any ? "&" : "?";
            out += secret ? pair.substr(0, eq + 1) + std::string(kMask) : pair;
            any = true;
        }
        if (amp == std::string_view::npos) break;
        pos = amp + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

// masks or drops the query of the request target on a request line
std::string rewrite_request_line(std::string_view line, bool strip) {
    const size_t first = line.find(' ');
    if (first == std::string_view::npos) return std::string(line);
    const size_t last = line.rfind(' ');
    if (last == first) return std::string(line);
    return std::string(line.substr(0, first + 1)) +
           rewrite_query(line.substr(first + 1, last - first - 1), strip) +
           std::string(line.substr(last));
}

std::string rewrite(std::string_view in, bool strip) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(in.size());
    size_t pos = 0;
    bool first_line = true;
    while (pos < in.size()) {
        const size_t eol = in.find("\r\n", pos);
        const size_t end = eol == std::string_view::npos ? in.size() : eol;
        const std::string_view line = in.substr(pos, end - pos);
        if (line.empty()) {                       // end of head: body stays verbatim
            out.append(in.substr(pos));
            return out;
        }
        if (first_line) {
            out += rewrite_request_line(line, strip);
            first_line = false;
        } else {
            const size_t colon = line.find(':');
            const bool secret =
                colon != std::string_view::npos && secret_header(lowered(line.substr(0, colon)));
            if (!secret)
                out += line;
            else if (!strip)
                out += std::string(line.substr(0, colon + 1)) + " " + std::string(kMask);
        }
        if (eol == std::string_view::npos) break;
        out += "\r\n";
        pos = eol + 2;
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace

std::string http_head(std::string_view head) { return rewrite(head, false); }

std::string strip_secrets(std::string_view head) { return rewrite(head, true); }

std::string query(std::string_view path) { return rewrite_query(path, false); }

} // namespace slop::core::network::redact
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/redact.hpp
// secret redaction for captured HTTP/1.x traffic. Captured traffic is
// credentials by default: Authorization / Proxy-Authorization / Cookie /
// Set-Cookie and token-ish query values are masked before an entry is stored
// (proxy_redact_secrets, default on) and the masked form is never replayed.
// Pure string transforms, no globals

#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace slop::core::network::redact {

// masks the values of the secret headers and of token-ish query parameters in
// the request line. Everything after the blank line (the body) is untouched
std::string http_head(std::string_view head);

// removes those header lines and query parameters instead of masking them:
// what replay sends when the stored request is redacted
std::string strip_secrets(std::string_view head);

// masks token-ish query values in a path ("/x?token=1" -> "/x?token=<redacted>")
std::string query(std::string_view path);
```

```cpp
// src/core/network/tls_stream.cpp

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <wincrypt.h>
#include <subauth.h>
#define SECURITY_WIN32
#include <security.h>
#include <sspi.h>
#define SCHANNEL_USE_BLACKLISTS
#include <schannel.h>

#include "core/network/tls_stream.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "secur32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "crypt32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")

namespace slop::core::network::tls {

namespace {

std::string hr_text(SECURITY_STATUS ss) {
    char buf[32];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "0x%08lX", static_cast<unsigned long>(ss));
    return buf;
}

std::wstring widen(const std::string& s) {
    std::wstring w;
    w.reserve(s.size());
    for (char c : s) w.push_back(static_cast<wchar_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return w;
}

bool send_all(SOCKET s, const uint8_t* p, size_t n) {
    while (n > 0) {
        const int w = ::send(s, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(p),
                             static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(n, 1 << 20)), 0);
        if (w <= 0) return false;
        p += w;
        n -= static_cast<size_t>(w);
    }
    return true;
}

void set_timeouts(SOCKET s, int ms) {
    const DWORD t = static_cast<DWORD>(ms);
    ::setsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&t), sizeof(t));
    ::setsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&t), sizeof(t));
}

// TLS 1.0-1.1 and SSL are never offered
constexpr DWORD kDisabledProtocols = SP_PROT_SSL2 | SP_PROT_SSL3 | SP_PROT_TLS1_0 | SP_PROT_TLS1_1;

// SCH_CREDENTIALS (TLS 1.3 capable) with a SCHANNEL_CRED fallback for older systems
SECURITY_STATUS acquire(bool server, PCCERT_CONTEXT cert, CredHandle* out) {
    TimeStamp expiry{};
    PCCERT_CONTEXT certs[1] = {cert};
    TLS_PARAMETERS tp{};
    tp.grbitDisabledProtocols = kDisabledProtocols;
    SCH_CREDENTIALS sc{};
    sc.dwVersion = SCH_CREDENTIALS_VERSION;
    sc.cCreds = cert ? 1 : 0;
    sc.paCred = cert ? certs : nullptr;
    sc.cTlsParameters = 1;
    sc.pTlsParameters = &tp;
    sc.dwFlags = server ? 0 : (SCH_CRED_MANUAL_CRED_VALIDATION | SCH_CRED_NO_DEFAULT_CREDS |
                               SCH_USE_STRONG_CRYPTO);
    SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::AcquireCredentialsHandleW(
        nullptr, const_cast<LPWSTR>(UNISP_NAME_W),
        server ? SECPKG_CRED_INBOUND : SECPKG_CRED_OUTBOUND, nullptr, &sc, nullptr, nullptr,
        out, &expiry);
    if (ss == SEC_E_OK) return ss;

    SCHANNEL_CRED legacy{};
    legacy.dwVersion = SCHANNEL_CRED_VERSION;
    legacy.cCreds = sc.cCreds;
    legacy.paCred = sc.paCred;
    legacy.grbitEnabledProtocols = server ? SP_PROT_TLS1_2_SERVER : SP_PROT_TLS1_2_CLIENT;
    legacy.dwFlags = sc.dwFlags;
    return ::AcquireCredentialsHandleW(nullptr, const_cast<LPWSTR>(UNISP_NAME_W),
                                       server ? SECPKG_CRED_INBOUND : SECPKG_CRED_OUTBOUND,
                                       nullptr, &legacy, nullptr, nullptr, out, &expiry);
}

} // namespace

// server credentials

struct server_cred_t::impl_t {
    CredHandle h{};
    bool valid = false;
    ~impl_t() {
        if (valid) ::FreeCredentialsHandle(&h);
    }
};

server_cred_t::server_cred_t() : p_(std::make_unique<impl_t>()) {}
server_cred_t::~server_cred_t() = default;
void* server_cred_t::handle() { return &p_->h; }

std::shared_ptr<server_cred_t> server_cred_t::create(const _CERT_CONTEXT* cert,
                                                     std::string* error) {
    std::shared_ptr<server_cred_t> c(new server_cred_t());
    const SECURITY_STATUS ss = acquire(true, cert, &c->p_->h);
    if (ss != SEC_E_OK) {
        if (error) *error = "server credentials rejected by Schannel (" + hr_text(ss) + ")";
        return nullptr;
    }
    c->p_->valid = true;
    return c;
}

// stream

struct stream_t::impl_t {
    SOCKET s = INVALID_SOCKET;
    bool server = false;
    CredHandle client_cred{};
    bool own_cred = false;
    CredHandle* cred = nullptr;
    CtxtHandle ctx{};
    bool has_ctx = false;
    std::wstring target;
    SecPkgContext_StreamSizes sizes{};
    std::vector<uint8_t> in;       // undecrypted bytes
    std::vector<uint8_t> plain;    // decrypted, not yet returned
    size_t plain_off = 0;
    bool closed = false;
    std::string error;
    // 16 KiB recv scratch, kept on the heap: a stack buffer of this size trips
    // MSVC /analyze C6262 (function uses 16396 bytes of stack)
    std::vector<uint8_t> recv_buf = std::vector<uint8_t>(16384);

    ~impl_t() {
        if (has_ctx) ::DeleteSecurityContext(&ctx);
        if (own_cred) ::FreeCredentialsHandle(&client_cred);
    }

    int recv_more() {
        const int r = ::recv(s, reinterpret_cast<char*>(recv_buf.data()),
                             static_cast<int>(recv_buf.size()), 0);
        if (r > 0) in.insert(in.end(), recv_buf.begin(), recv_buf.begin() + r);
        return r;
    }

    bool send_token(SecBuffer& b) {
        bool ok = true;
        if (b.cbBuffer && b.pvBuffer)
            ok = send_all(s, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(b.pvBuffer), b.cbBuffer);
        if (b.pvBuffer) ::FreeContextBuffer(b.pvBuffer);
        b.pvBuffer = nullptr;
        b.cbBuffer = 0;
        return ok;
    }

    SECURITY_STATUS step(SecBufferDesc* in_desc, SecBufferDesc* out_desc) {
        ULONG attrs = 0;
        if (server) {
            const ULONG flags = ASC_REQ_SEQUENCE_DETECT | ASC_REQ_REPLAY_DETECT |
                                ASC_REQ_CONFIDENTIALITY | ASC_REQ_EXTENDED_ERROR |
                                ASC_REQ_ALLOCATE_MEMORY | ASC_REQ_STREAM;
            const SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::AcceptSecurityContext(
                cred, has_ctx ? &ctx : nullptr, in_desc, flags, 0, &ctx, out_desc, &attrs,
                nullptr);
            if (!has_ctx && (ss == SEC_E_OK || ss == SEC_I_CONTINUE_NEEDED)) has_ctx = true;
            return ss;
        }
        const ULONG flags = ISC_REQ_SEQUENCE_DETECT | ISC_REQ_REPLAY_DETECT |
                            ISC_REQ_CONFIDENTIALITY | ISC_REQ_EXTENDED_ERROR |
                            ISC_REQ_ALLOCATE_MEMORY | ISC_REQ_STREAM |
                            ISC_REQ_MANUAL_CRED_VALIDATION;
        const SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::InitializeSecurityContextW(
            cred, has_ctx ? &ctx : nullptr, target.empty() ? nullptr : target.data(), flags, 0,
            0, in_desc, 0, &ctx, out_desc, &attrs, nullptr);
        if (!has_ctx && (ss == SEC_E_OK || ss == SEC_I_CONTINUE_NEEDED)) has_ctx = true;
        return ss;
    }

    // drives AcceptSecurityContext / InitializeSecurityContext until SEC_E_OK,
    // consuming `in`; bytes after the handshake stay in `in`
    bool handshake_loop(bool need_input_first) {
        bool need_read = need_input_first && in.empty();
        for (int rounds = 0; rounds < 64; ++rounds) {
            if (need_read) {
                const int r = recv_more();
                if (r <= 0) {
                    error = r == 0 ? "peer closed during the TLS handshake"
                                   : "socket error/timeout during the TLS handshake";
                    return false;
                }
            }
            SecBuffer ib[2] = {
                {static_cast<unsigned long>(in.size()), SECBUFFER_TOKEN, in.empty() ? nullptr : in.data()},
                {0, SECBUFFER_EMPTY, nullptr}};
            SecBufferDesc id{SECBUFFER_VERSION, 2, ib};
            SecBuffer ob[1] = {{0, SECBUFFER_TOKEN, nullptr}};
            SecBufferDesc od{SECBUFFER_VERSION, 1, ob};
            const bool have_input = !in.empty();
            SECURITY_STATUS ss = step(have_input ? &id : nullptr, &od);
            if (ss == SEC_E_INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE) {
                need_read = true;
                continue;
            }
            if (!send_token(ob[0])) {
                error = "socket send failed during the TLS handshake";
                return false;
            }
            if (ss == SEC_I_INCOMPLETE_CREDENTIALS) ss = SEC_I_CONTINUE_NEEDED;   // no client cert
            if (ss != SEC_E_OK && ss != SEC_I_CONTINUE_NEEDED) {
                error = "TLS handshake failed (" + hr_text(ss) + ")";
                return false;
            }
            if (have_input) {
                if (ib[1].BufferType == SECBUFFER_EXTRA && ib[1].cbBuffer <= in.size())
                    in.erase(in.begin(), in.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(ib[1].cbBuffer));
                else
                    in.clear();
            }
            if (ss == SEC_E_OK) return true;
            need_read = in.empty();
        }
        error = "TLS handshake did not converge";
        return false;
    }

    bool finish_setup() {
        const SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::QueryContextAttributesW(&ctx, SECPKG_ATTR_STREAM_SIZES, &sizes);
        if (ss != SEC_E_OK) {
            error = "stream sizes unavailable (" + hr_text(ss) + ")";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool verify_peer(const client_options_t& opt) {
        PCCERT_CONTEXT peer = nullptr;
        SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::QueryContextAttributesW(&ctx, SECPKG_ATTR_REMOTE_CERT_CONTEXT, &peer);
        if (ss != SEC_E_OK || !peer) {
            error = "server presented no certificate";
            return false;
        }
        HCERTCHAINENGINE engine = nullptr;
        if (opt.exclusive_roots) {
            CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG cfg{};
            cfg.cbSize = sizeof(cfg);
            cfg.hExclusiveRoot = static_cast<HCERTSTORE>(opt.exclusive_roots);
            if (!::CertCreateCertificateChainEngine(&cfg, &engine)) {
                ::CertFreeCertificateContext(peer);
                error = "cannot create the certificate chain engine";
                return false;
            }
        }
        LPSTR usages[] = {const_cast<LPSTR>(szOID_PKIX_KP_SERVER_AUTH)};
        CERT_CHAIN_PARA para{};
        para.cbSize = sizeof(para);
        para.RequestedUsage.dwType = USAGE_MATCH_TYPE_AND;
        para.RequestedUsage.Usage.cUsageIdentifier = 1;
        para.RequestedUsage.Usage.rgpszUsageIdentifier = usages;
        PCCERT_CHAIN_CONTEXT chain = nullptr;
        bool ok = ::CertGetCertificateChain(engine, peer, nullptr, peer->hCertStore, &para, 0,
                                            nullptr, &chain) != FALSE;
        if (!ok) {
            error = "certificate chain could not be built";
        } else {
            SSL_EXTRA_CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_PARA ssl{};
            ssl.cbSize = sizeof(ssl);
            ssl.dwAuthType = AUTHTYPE_SERVER;
            ssl.pwszServerName = target.data();
            CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_PARA pp{};
            pp.cbSize = sizeof(pp);
            pp.pvExtraPolicyPara = &ssl;
            CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_STATUS ps{};
            ps.cbSize = sizeof(ps);
            ok = ::CertVerifyCertificateChainPolicy(CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_SSL, chain, &pp, &ps) &&
                 ps.dwError == 0;
            if (!ok) {
                char buf[96];
                std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "server certificate rejected (0x%08lX)",
                              static_cast<unsigned long>(ps.dwError));
                error = buf;
            }
            ::CertFreeCertificateChain(chain);
        }
        if (engine) ::CertFreeCertificateChainEngine(engine);
        ::CertFreeCertificateContext(peer);
        return ok;
    }

    bool record_complete() const {
        if (in.size() < 5) return false;
        const size_t len = (static_cast<size_t>(in[3]) << 8) | in[4];
        return in.size() >= 5 + len;
    }
};

stream_t::stream_t() : p_(std::make_unique<impl_t>()) {}
stream_t::~stream_t() = default;

std::unique_ptr<stream_t> stream_t::accept(socket_t s, server_cred_t& cred, int timeout_ms,
                                           std::string* error) {
    std::unique_ptr<stream_t> st(new stream_t());
    impl_t& p = *st->p_;
    p.s = static_cast<SOCKET>(s);
    p.server = true;
    p.cred = static_cast<CredHandle*>(cred.handle());
    set_timeouts(p.s, timeout_ms);
    if (!p.handshake_loop(true) || !p.finish_setup()) {
        if (error) *error = p.error;
        return nullptr;
    }
    return st;
}

std::unique_ptr<stream_t> stream_t::connect(socket_t s, const std::string& host,
                                            const client_options_t& opt, int timeout_ms,
                                            std::string* error) {
    std::unique_ptr<stream_t> st(new stream_t());
    impl_t& p = *st->p_;
    p.s = static_cast<SOCKET>(s);
    p.server = false;
    std::string h = host;
    if (h.size() >= 2 && h.front() == '[' && h.back() == ']') h = h.substr(1, h.size() - 2);
    p.target = widen(h);
    const SECURITY_STATUS ss = acquire(false, nullptr, &p.client_cred);
    if (ss != SEC_E_OK) {
        if (error) *error = "client credentials unavailable (" + hr_text(ss) + ")";
        return nullptr;
    }
    p.own_cred = true;
    p.cred = &p.client_cred;
    set_timeouts(p.s, timeout_ms);
    if (!p.handshake_loop(false) || !p.finish_setup() || (opt.verify && !p.verify_peer(opt))) {
        if (error) *error = p.error;
        return nullptr;
    }
    return st;
}

int stream_t::read(uint8_t* buf, size_t cap) {
    impl_t& p = *p_;
    for (;;) {
        if (p.plain_off < p.plain.size()) {
            const size_t n = std::min(cap, p.plain.size() - p.plain_off);
            std::memcpy(buf, p.plain.data() + p.plain_off, n);
            p.plain_off += n;
            if (p.plain_off == p.plain.size()) {
                p.plain.clear();
                p.plain_off = 0;
            }
            return static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(n, INT_MAX));
        }
        if (p.closed) return 0;
        if (!p.in.empty()) {
            SecBuffer b[4] = {{static_cast<unsigned long>(p.in.size()), SECBUFFER_DATA, p.in.data()},
                              {0, SECBUFFER_EMPTY, nullptr},
                              {0, SECBUFFER_EMPTY, nullptr},
                              {0, SECBUFFER_EMPTY, nullptr}};
            SecBufferDesc d{SECBUFFER_VERSION, 4, b};
            const SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::DecryptMessage(&p.ctx, &d, 0, nullptr);
            if (ss == SEC_E_OK || ss == SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE || ss == SEC_I_CONTEXT_EXPIRED) {
                std::vector<uint8_t> extra;
                for (auto& sb : b) {
                    if (sb.BufferType == SECBUFFER_DATA && sb.cbBuffer)
                        p.plain.insert(p.plain.end(), static_cast<uint8_t*>(sb.pvBuffer),
                                       static_cast<uint8_t*>(sb.pvBuffer) + sb.cbBuffer);
                    else if (sb.BufferType == SECBUFFER_EXTRA && sb.cbBuffer)
                        extra.assign(static_cast<uint8_t*>(sb.pvBuffer),
                                     static_cast<uint8_t*>(sb.pvBuffer) + sb.cbBuffer);
                }
                p.in = std::move(extra);
                if (ss == SEC_I_CONTEXT_EXPIRED) {
                    p.closed = true;
                } else if (ss == SEC_I_RENEGOTIATE) {
                    // TLS 1.3 post-handshake message (session ticket / key update):
                    // feed the remaining bytes back through the handshake call
                    if (!p.handshake_loop(false)) return -1;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (ss != SEC_E_INCOMPLETE_MESSAGE) {
                p.error = "TLS decrypt failed (" + hr_text(ss) + ")";
                return -1;
            }
        }
        const int r = p.recv_more();
        if (r == 0) {
            p.closed = true;
            return 0;
        }
        if (r < 0) {
            p.error = "socket error/timeout";
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

bool stream_t::write(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    impl_t& p = *p_;
    const size_t max_msg = p.sizes.cbMaximumMessage ? p.sizes.cbMaximumMessage : 16384;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(p.sizes.cbHeader + max_msg + p.sizes.cbTrailer);
    while (n > 0) {
        const size_t chunk = std::min(n, max_msg);
        std::memcpy(buf.data() + p.sizes.cbHeader, d, chunk);
        SecBuffer b[4] = {
            {p.sizes.cbHeader, SECBUFFER_STREAM_HEADER, buf.data()},
            {static_cast<unsigned long>(chunk), SECBUFFER_DATA, buf.data() + p.sizes.cbHeader},
            {p.sizes.cbTrailer, SECBUFFER_STREAM_TRAILER, buf.data() + p.sizes.cbHeader + chunk},
            {0, SECBUFFER_EMPTY, nullptr}};
        SecBufferDesc desc{SECBUFFER_VERSION, 4, b};
        const SECURITY_STATUS ss = ::EncryptMessage(&p.ctx, 0, &desc, 0);
        if (ss != SEC_E_OK) {
            p.error = "TLS encrypt failed (" + hr_text(ss) + ")";
            return false;
        }
        if (!send_all(p.s, buf.data(), b[0].cbBuffer + b[1].cbBuffer + b[2].cbBuffer)) {
            p.error = "socket send failed";
            return false;
        }
        d += chunk;
        n -= chunk;
    }
    return true;
}

bool stream_t::pending() const {
    return p_->plain_off < p_->plain.size() || p_->record_complete();
}

void stream_t::close_notify() {
    impl_t& p = *p_;
    if (!p.has_ctx) return;
    DWORD type = SCHANNEL_SHUTDOWN;
    SecBuffer tb{sizeof(type), SECBUFFER_TOKEN, &type};
    SecBufferDesc td{SECBUFFER_VERSION, 1, &tb};
    if (::ApplyControlToken(&p.ctx, &td) != SEC_E_OK) return;
    SecBuffer ob{0, SECBUFFER_TOKEN, nullptr};
    SecBufferDesc od{SECBUFFER_VERSION, 1, &ob};
    p.step(nullptr, &od);
    p.send_token(ob);
}

std::string stream_t::protocol() const {
    SecPkgContext_ConnectionInfo ci{};
    if (::QueryContextAttributesW(&p_->ctx, SECPKG_ATTR_CONNECTION_INFO, &ci) != SEC_E_OK)
        return "unknown";
    if (ci.dwProtocol & SP_PROT_TLS1_3) return "TLS 1.3";
    if (ci.dwProtocol & SP_PROT_TLS1_2) return "TLS 1.2";
    if (ci.dwProtocol & SP_PROT_TLS1_1) return "TLS 1.1";
    if (ci.dwProtocol & SP_PROT_TLS1_0) return "TLS 1.0";
    return "unknown";
}

const std::string& stream_t::last_error() const {
    return p_->error;
}

} // namespace slop::core::network::tls
```

`src/core/network/tls_stream.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/tls_stream.hpp
// Schannel TLS over a connected blocking socket: server side for the MITM
// proxy (per-host leaf certificates from mitm_pki), client side for the proxy
// upstream, proxy replay and the pinned-address web client. Client streams
// validate the server chain and name themselves (system trust by default, an
// exclusive root store for tests)

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

struct _CERT_CONTEXT;

namespace slop::core::network::tls {

using socket_t = uintptr_t;   // SOCKET

// server credentials for one certificate (its private key must be reachable
// through CERT_KEY_PROV_INFO so LSA can use it)
class server_cred_t {
public:
    static std::shared_ptr<server_cred_t> create(const _CERT_CONTEXT* cert, std::string* error);
    ~server_cred_t();
    server_cred_t(const server_cred_t&) = delete;
    server_cred_t& operator=(const server_cred_t&) = delete;
    void* handle();                   // CredHandle*

private:
    server_cred_t();
    struct impl_t;
    std::unique_ptr<impl_t> p_;
};

struct client_options_t {
    void* exclusive_roots = nullptr;  // HCERTSTORE: trust only these roots; null = system trust
    bool  verify = true;              // chain + host name validation
};

class stream_t {
public:
    ~stream_t();
    stream_t(const stream_t&) = delete;
    stream_t& operator=(const stream_t&) = delete;

    // handshakes; the socket must be connected and blocking. timeout_ms bounds
    // each socket read during the handshake (and stays as SO_RCVTIMEO)
    static std::unique_ptr<stream_t> accept(socket_t s, server_cred_t& cred, int timeout_ms,
                                            std::string* error);
    static std::unique_ptr<stream_t> connect(socket_t s, const std::string& host,
                                             const client_options_t& opt, int timeout_ms,
                                             std::string* error);

    // > 0 plaintext bytes, 0 = peer closed (close_notify or EOF), < 0 = error
    int  read(uint8_t* buf, size_t cap);
    bool write(const uint8_t* d, size_t n);
    // decrypted bytes or a complete TLS record are buffered (read won't block)
    bool pending() const;
    // sends close_notify (best effort)
    void close_notify();
    std::string protocol() const;     // "TLS 1.2" | "TLS 1.3" | ...
    const std::string& last_error() const;

private:
    stream_t();
    struct impl_t;
    std::unique_ptr<impl_t> p_;
};

} // namespace slop::core::network::tls

```

`src/core/network/tls_stream_posix.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/tls_stream_posix.cpp
// OpenSSL twin of tls_stream.cpp. The client side (web client, proxy
// upstream, proxy replay) is complete; the server side needs a certificate
// with a reachable private key, which the MITM proxy mints through CNG on
// Windows only, so accept() reports that instead of pretending.

#include "core/network/tls_stream.hpp"

#include <openssl/err.h>
#include <openssl/ssl.h>
#include <openssl/x509v3.h>

#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>

namespace slop::core::network::tls {

namespace {

std::once_flag g_ssl_once;

void init_ssl() {
    std::call_once(g_ssl_once, [] {
        ::SSL_library_init();
        ::SSL_load_error_strings();
        ::OpenSSL_add_all_algorithms();
    });
}

std::string ssl_error_text() {
    const unsigned long e = ::ERR_get_error();
    if (e == 0) return "no OpenSSL error";
    char buf[256];
    ::ERR_error_string_n(e, buf, sizeof(buf));
    return buf;
}

} // namespace

struct server_cred_t::impl_t {};

server_cred_t::server_cred_t() : p_(std::make_unique<impl_t>()) {}
server_cred_t::~server_cred_t() = default;

std::shared_ptr<server_cred_t> server_cred_t::create(const _CERT_CONTEXT*, std::string* error) {
    if (error)
        *error = "server-side TLS needs a certificate with a reachable private key; the MITM "
                 "proxy mints those through CNG on Windows only";
    return nullptr;
}

void* server_cred_t::handle() { return nullptr; }

struct stream_t::impl_t {
    SSL*     ssl = nullptr;
    SSL_CTX* ctx = nullptr;
    int      fd  = -1;
    std::string last_error;

    ~impl_t() {
        if (ssl) ::SSL_free(ssl);
        if (ctx) ::SSL_CTX_free(ctx);
    }
};

stream_t::stream_t() : p_(std::make_unique<impl_t>()) {}
stream_t::~stream_t() = default;

std::unique_ptr<stream_t> stream_t::accept(socket_t, server_cred_t&, int, std::string* error) {
    if (error)
        *error = "server-side TLS is not implemented on this platform (no certificate store)";
    return nullptr;
}

std::unique_ptr<stream_t> stream_t::connect(socket_t s, const std::string& host,
                                            const client_options_t& opt, int timeout_ms,
                                            std::string* error) {
    init_ssl();
    auto out = std::unique_ptr<stream_t>(new stream_t());
    out->p_->fd = static_cast<int>(s);

    // system trust store; exclusive_roots is a Windows test hook and is
    // ignored here (tests that pin a root do not run on this platform)
    (void)opt.exclusive_roots;
    out->p_->ctx = ::SSL_CTX_new(::TLS_client_method());
    if (!out->p_->ctx) {
        if (error) *error = "SSL_CTX_new failed: " + ssl_error_text();
        return nullptr;
    }
    ::SSL_CTX_set_min_proto_version(out->p_->ctx, TLS1_2_VERSION);
    if (opt.verify) {
        ::SSL_CTX_set_verify(out->p_->ctx, SSL_VERIFY_PEER, nullptr);
        if (::SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths(out->p_->ctx) != 1) {
            if (error) *error = "no system trust store: " + ssl_error_text();
            return nullptr;
        }
    } else {
        ::SSL_CTX_set_verify(out->p_->ctx, SSL_VERIFY_NONE, nullptr);
    }

    out->p_->ssl = ::SSL_new(out->p_->ctx);
    if (!out->p_->ssl) {
        if (error) *error = "SSL_new failed: " + ssl_error_text();
        return nullptr;
    }
    if (timeout_ms > 0) {
        timeval tv{timeout_ms / 1000, (timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000};
        ::setsockopt(out->p_->fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
        ::setsockopt(out->p_->fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
    }
    ::SSL_set_fd(out->p_->ssl, out->p_->fd);
    if (opt.verify) {
        ::SSL_set_hostflags(out->p_->ssl, X509_CHECK_FLAG_NO_PARTIAL_WILDCARDS);
        if (::SSL_set1_host(out->p_->ssl, host.c_str()) != 1) {
            if (error) *error = "cannot pin the host name: " + host;
            return nullptr;
        }
    }
    ::SSL_set_tlsext_host_name(out->p_->ssl, host.c_str());
    if (::SSL_connect(out->p_->ssl) != 1) {
        out->p_->last_error = ssl_error_text();
        if (error) *error = out->p_->last_error;
        return nullptr;
    }
    return out;
}

int stream_t::read(uint8_t* buf, size_t cap) {
    if (!p_->ssl || cap == 0) return 0;
    const int n = ::SSL_read(p_->ssl, buf, static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(cap, 1 << 20)));
    if (n > 0) return n;
    const int err = ::SSL_get_error(p_->ssl, n);
    if (err == SSL_ERROR_ZERO_RETURN) return 0;
    if (err == SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ || err == SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE) return -1;
    p_->last_error = ssl_error_text();
    return -1;
}

bool stream_t::write(const uint8_t* d, size_t n) {
    if (!p_->ssl) return false;
    while (n > 0) {
        const int w = ::SSL_write(p_->ssl, d, static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(n, 1 << 20)));
        if (w <= 0) {
            p_->last_error = ssl_error_text();
            return false;
        }
        d += w;
        n -= static_cast<size_t>(w);
    }
    return true;
}


bool stream_t::pending() const {
    return p_->ssl && ::SSL_pending(p_->ssl) > 0;
}

void stream_t::close_notify() {
    if (p_->ssl) ::SSL_shutdown(p_->ssl);
}

std::string stream_t::protocol() const {
    if (!p_->ssl) return {};
    return ::SSL_get_version(p_->ssl);
}

const std::string& stream_t::last_error() const { return p_->last_error; }

} // namespace slop::core::network::tls

```

`src/core/network/traffic_store.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/traffic_store.cpp

#include "core/network/traffic_store.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

namespace slop::core::network {

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kProtoTcp = 6;
constexpr uint32_t kProtoUdp = 17;

const char* proto_label(uint32_t p) {
    return p == kProtoTcp ? "tcp" : p == kProtoUdp ? "udp" : "ip";
}

void put16(std::vector<uint8_t>& v, size_t at, uint32_t x) {
    v[at] = static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 8) & 0xFF);
    v[at + 1] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x & 0xFF);
}

void put32(std::vector<uint8_t>& v, size_t at, uint32_t x) {
    v[at] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x >> 24);
    v[at + 1] = static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 16) & 0xFF);
    v[at + 2] = static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 8) & 0xFF);
    v[at + 3] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x & 0xFF);
}

uint16_t ipv4_checksum(const uint8_t* h, size_t n) {
    uint32_t sum = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < n; i += 2)
        sum += (static_cast<uint32_t>(h[i]) << 8) | h[i + 1];
    while (sum >> 16) sum = (sum & 0xFFFF) + (sum >> 16);
    return static_cast<uint16_t>(~sum & 0xFFFF);
}

bool parse_port(const std::string& s, uint32_t& out) {
    if (s.empty() || s.size() > 5) return false;
    uint32_t v = 0;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c < '0' || c > '9') return false;
        v = v * 10 + static_cast<uint32_t>(c - '0');
    }
    if (v > 65535) return false;
    out = v;
    return true;
}

} // namespace

traffic_store_t::traffic_store_t(size_t max_packets) {
    lim_.max_packets = max_packets;
}

traffic_store_t::traffic_store_t(limits_t limits) : lim_(limits) {
    // one full stream must always fit the global budget
    lim_.max_stream_bytes = std::max(lim_.max_stream_bytes, 2 * lim_.max_direction_bytes);
    lim_.max_streams = std::max<size_t>(lim_.max_streams, 1);
}

void traffic_store_t::clear() {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    pkts_.clear();
    streams_.clear();
    by_id_.clear();
    lru_.clear();
    stream_bytes_ = 0;
    next_id_ = 1;
    next_stream_id_ = 1;
    packets_evicted_ = streams_evicted_ = bytes_dropped_ = 0;
    quic_packets_ = 0;
    pkt_notes_.clear();
    stream_notes_.clear();
}

void traffic_store_t::evict_streams(const stream_rec_t* keep) {
    while (!lru_.empty() &&
           (streams_.size() > lim_.max_streams || stream_bytes_ > lim_.max_stream_bytes)) {
        stream_rec_t* victim = lru_.back();
        if (victim == keep) {
            if (lru_.size() == 1) break;
            // keep is never the least recent after a touch; defensive only
            lru_.splice(lru_.begin(), lru_, victim->lru);
            continue;
        }
        stream_bytes_ -= victim->c2s.size() + victim->s2c.size();
        by_id_.erase(victim->id);
        stream_notes_.erase(victim->id);
        lru_.pop_back();
        streams_.erase(victim->key);
        ++streams_evicted_;
    }
}

void traffic_store_t::index_stream(packet_record_t& p) {
    stream_key_t key;
    key.protocol = p.protocol;

    // stable tuple normalization: lower (addr,port) is side a
    const bool local_is_a =
        p.local_addr < p.remote_addr ||
        (p.local_addr == p.remote_addr && p.local_port <= p.remote_port);
    key.a_addr = local_is_a ? p.local_addr : p.remote_addr;
    key.a_port = local_is_a ? p.local_port : p.remote_port;
    key.b_addr = local_is_a ? p.remote_addr : p.local_addr;
    key.b_port = local_is_a ? p.remote_port : p.local_port;

    auto it = streams_.find(key);
    if (it == streams_.end()) {
        it = streams_.emplace(key, stream_rec_t{}).first;
        stream_rec_t& rec = it->second;
        rec.key = key;
        rec.id = next_stream_id_++;
        rec.first_ms = p.at_ms;
        lru_.push_front(&rec);
        rec.lru = lru_.begin();
        by_id_.emplace(rec.id, &rec);
    } else {
        lru_.splice(lru_.begin(), lru_, it->second.lru);
    }
    stream_rec_t& s = it->second;
    p.stream_id = s.id;
    s.last_ms = p.at_ms;
    if (!s.has_client && p.direction == 0) {
        s.has_client  = true;
        s.client_addr = p.local_addr;
        s.client_port = p.local_port;
        s.server_addr = p.remote_addr;
        s.server_port = p.remote_port;
    }
    // the client is the local side of the first outbound packet, so outbound
    // bytes are client->server for the whole stream
    const bool c2s = p.direction == 0;
    auto& buf = c2s ? s.c2s : s.s2c;
    const size_t room = buf.size() < lim_.max_direction_bytes
                            ? lim_.max_direction_bytes - buf.size() : 0;
    const size_t take = std::min(p.payload.size(), room);
    if (take) {
        buf.insert(buf.end(), p.payload.begin(), p.payload.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(take));
        stream_bytes_ += take;
    }
    if (take < p.payload.size()) {
        s.truncated = true;
        bytes_dropped_ += p.payload.size() - take;
    }
    ++(c2s ? s.c2s_packets : s.s2c_packets);
    evict_streams(&s);
}

void traffic_store_t::add(packet_record_t pkt) {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    pkt.id = next_id_++;
    if (pkt.protocol == kProtoUdp && (pkt.local_port == 443 || pkt.remote_port == 443) &&
        parse::parse_quic(pkt.payload.data(), pkt.payload.size()))
        ++quic_packets_;
    index_stream(pkt);
    pkts_.push_back(std::move(pkt));
    while (pkts_.size() > lim_.max_packets) {
        pkt_notes_.erase(pkts_.front().id);
        pkts_.pop_front();
        ++packets_evicted_;
    }
}

traffic_store_t::page_t traffic_store_t::packets(uint64_t from_id,
                                                 size_t limit) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    page_t out;
    // ids are contiguous in the ring: jump straight to the first newer id
    size_t start = 0;
    if (!pkts_.empty() && from_id >= pkts_.front().id)
        start = static_cast<size_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(from_id - pkts_.front().id + 1, pkts_.size()));
    for (size_t i = start; i < pkts_.size(); ++i) {
        if (out.items.size() >= limit) { out.truncated = true; break; }
        out.items.push_back(pkts_[i]);
    }
    return out;
}

traffic_store_t::page_t traffic_store_t::packets_tail(size_t limit) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    page_t out;
    const size_t start = pkts_.size() > limit ? pkts_.size() - limit : 0;
    out.truncated = start > 0;
    out.items.assign(pkts_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(start), pkts_.end());
    return out;
}

size_t traffic_store_t::size() const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    return pkts_.size();
}

stream_summary_t traffic_store_t::summarize(const stream_rec_t& s) const {
    stream_summary_t sum;
    sum.id = s.id;
    sum.protocol = s.key.protocol;
    const bool v6a = s.key.a_addr.find(':') != std::string::npos;
    const bool v6b = s.key.b_addr.find(':') != std::string::npos;
    sum.key = std::string(proto_label(s.key.protocol)) + " " +
              (v6a ? "[" + s.key.a_addr + "]" : s.key.a_addr) + ":" +
              std::to_string(s.key.a_port) + "<->" +
              (v6b ? "[" + s.key.b_addr + "]" : s.key.b_addr) + ":" +
              std::to_string(s.key.b_port);
    sum.client_addr = s.has_client ? s.client_addr : s.key.a_addr;
    sum.client_port = s.has_client ? s.client_port : s.key.a_port;
    sum.server_addr = s.has_client ? s.server_addr : s.key.b_addr;
    sum.server_port = s.has_client ? s.server_port : s.key.b_port;
    sum.bytes = s.c2s.size() + s.s2c.size();
    sum.packets = s.c2s_packets + s.s2c_packets;
    sum.truncated = s.truncated;
    sum.first_ms = s.first_ms;
    sum.last_ms = s.last_ms;
    return sum;
}

std::vector<stream_summary_t> traffic_store_t::streams(size_t limit) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    std::vector<stream_summary_t> out;
    out.reserve(std::min(limit, lru_.size()));
    for (const stream_rec_t* s : lru_) {
        if (out.size() >= limit) break;
        out.push_back(summarize(*s));
    }
    return out;
}

std::optional<stream_summary_t> traffic_store_t::stream(uint64_t id) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    const auto it = by_id_.find(id);
    if (it == by_id_.end()) return std::nullopt;
    return summarize(*it->second);
}

std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> traffic_store_t::stream_bytes(
    uint64_t id, size_t offset, size_t len) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    const auto it = by_id_.find(id);
    if (it == by_id_.end()) return std::nullopt;
    const stream_rec_t& s = *it->second;
    const size_t total = s.c2s.size() + s.s2c.size();
    if (offset >= total) return std::vector<uint8_t>{};
    const size_t take = std::min(len, total - offset);
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    out.reserve(take);
    if (offset < s.c2s.size()) {
        const size_t first = std::min(take, s.c2s.size() - offset);
        out.insert(out.end(), s.c2s.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset),
                   s.c2s.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset + first));
        offset = 0;
    } else {
        offset -= s.c2s.size();
    }
    const size_t remaining = take - out.size();
    out.insert(out.end(), s.s2c.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset),
               s.s2c.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(offset + remaining));
    return out;
}

traffic_store_t::stats_t traffic_store_t::stats() const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    stats_t s;
    s.packets = pkts_.size();
    s.streams = streams_.size();
    s.stream_bytes = stream_bytes_;
    s.packets_evicted = packets_evicted_;
    s.streams_evicted = streams_evicted_;
    s.stream_bytes_dropped = bytes_dropped_;
    s.packets_total = next_id_ - 1;
    s.quic_packets = quic_packets_;
    return s;
}

size_t traffic_store_t::active_streams(int64_t now_ms, int64_t window_ms) const {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    size_t n = 0;
    for (const stream_rec_t* s : lru_) {
        if (now_ms - s->last_ms > window_ms) break;   // lru_ is recency ordered
        ++n;
    }
    return n;
}

// filters

bool traffic_store_t::filter_t::match(const packet_record_t& p) const {
    for (const auto& t : terms_) {
        bool pass = false;
        switch (t.kind) {
        case term_t::kind_t::port:
            pass = p.local_port == t.number || p.remote_port == t.number;
            break;
        case term_t::kind_t::host: {
            const auto la = parse::parse_ip(p.local_addr);
            const auto ra = parse::parse_ip(p.remote_addr);
            pass = (la && parse::cidr_contains(t.cidr, *la)) ||
                   (ra && parse::cidr_contains(t.cidr, *ra));
            break;
        }
        case term_t::kind_t::text:
            pass = std::search(p.payload.begin(), p.payload.end(),
                               t.text.begin(), t.text.end()) != p.payload.end();
            break;
        case term_t::kind_t::proto:
            pass = p.protocol == t.number;
            break;
        case term_t::kind_t::dir:
            pass = p.direction == t.number;
            break;
        }
        if (!pass) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

std::optional<traffic_store_t::filter_t> traffic_store_t::compile_filter(
    const std::string& expr, std::string* error) {
    static constexpr char kSyntax[] =
        " (syntax: port=80 | host:1.2.3.4 | host:10.0.0.0/8 | text:foo | proto:tcp|udp|N | "
        "dir:in|out, joined with ';')";
    auto bad = [&](const std::string& why) -> std::optional<filter_t> {
        if (error) *error = "filter: " + why + kSyntax;
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    filter_t f;
    size_t begin = 0;
    while (begin <= expr.size()) {
        size_t end = expr.find(';', begin);
        if (end == std::string::npos) end = expr.size();
        std::string term = expr.substr(begin, end - begin);
        begin = end + 1;
        while (!term.empty() && (term.front() == ' ' || term.front() == '\t')) term.erase(term.begin());
        while (!term.empty() && (term.back() == ' ' || term.back() == '\t')) term.pop_back();
        if (term.empty()) continue;

        // name followed by '=', '==' or ':'
        const size_t sep = term.find_first_of("=:");
        if (sep == std::string::npos) return bad("missing value in '" + term + "'");
        const std::string name = parse::lower(term.substr(0, sep));
        size_t vstart = sep + 1;
        if (term[sep] == '=' && vstart < term.size() && term[vstart] == '=') ++vstart;
        const std::string value = term.substr(vstart);

        filter_t::term_t t;
        if (name == "port") {
            t.kind = filter_t::term_t::kind_t::port;
            if (!parse_port(value, t.number)) return bad("bad port '" + value + "'");
        } else if (name == "host") {
            t.kind = filter_t::term_t::kind_t::host;
            auto c = parse::parse_cidr(value);
            if (!c) return bad("host expects an IP address or CIDR, got '" + value + "'");
            t.cidr = *c;
        } else if (name == "text") {
            t.kind = filter_t::term_t::kind_t::text;
            if (value.empty()) return bad("empty text");
            t.text = value;
        } else if (name == "proto") {
            t.kind = filter_t::term_t::kind_t::proto;
            const std::string v = parse::lower(value);
            if (v == "tcp") t.number = kProtoTcp;
            else if (v == "udp") t.number = kProtoUdp;
            else if (!parse_port(v, t.number) || t.number > 255) return bad("bad proto '" + value + "'");
        } else if (name == "dir") {
            t.kind = filter_t::term_t::kind_t::dir;
            const std::string v = parse::lower(value);
            if (v == "out" || v == "outbound") t.number = 0;
            else if (v == "in" || v == "inbound") t.number = 1;
            else return bad("dir expects in|out");
        } else if (name == "pid") {
            return bad("pid filters are not supported: raw capture cannot attribute packets to "
                       "processes; filter by host:<console ip> instead");
        } else {
            return bad("unknown predicate '" + name + "'");
        }
        f.terms_.push_back(std::move(t));
    }
    return f;
}

traffic_store_t::page_t traffic_store_t::packets_filtered(
    uint64_t from_id, size_t limit, const std::string& expr, std::string* error) const {
    page_t out;
    const auto f = compile_filter(expr, error);
    if (!f) return out;
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    for (const auto& p : pkts_) {
        if (p.id <= from_id) continue;
        if (!f->match(p)) continue;
        if (out.items.size() >= limit) { out.truncated = true; break; }
        out.items.push_back(p);
    }
    return out;
}

// pcap / pcapng

namespace {

// synthesizes the IPv4/IPv6 + TCP/UDP frame a stored packet describes; the
// first `incl_payload` bytes of the captured payload follow it
bool build_frame(const packet_record_t& p, std::vector<uint8_t>& f, size_t& incl_payload,
                 size_t& wire_payload, std::string* error) {
    auto fail = [&](const std::string& why) {
        if (error) *error = why;
        return false;
    };
    const auto la = parse::parse_ip(p.local_addr);
    const auto ra = parse::parse_ip(p.remote_addr);
    if (!la || !ra)
        return fail("packet " + std::to_string(p.id) + ": unparseable address '" +
                    (la ? p.remote_addr : p.local_addr) + "'");
    if (la->family != ra->family)
        return fail("packet " + std::to_string(p.id) + ": mixed IPv4/IPv6 addresses");
    if (p.protocol != kProtoTcp && p.protocol != kProtoUdp)
        return fail("packet " + std::to_string(p.id) + ": protocol " +
                    std::to_string(p.protocol) + " cannot be synthesized");

    const bool out_dir = p.direction == 0;
    const parse::ip_addr_t& src = out_dir ? *la : *ra;
    const parse::ip_addr_t& dst = out_dir ? *ra : *la;
    const uint16_t sport = out_dir ? p.local_port : p.remote_port;
    const uint16_t dport = out_dir ? p.remote_port : p.local_port;
    const bool udp = p.protocol == kProtoUdp;
    const bool v6 = la->family == 6;
    const size_t ip_hdr = v6 ? 40 : 20;
    const size_t l4_hdr = udp ? 8 : 20;
    // the 16-bit IP length fields bound what one record can describe
    const size_t max_payload = 65535 - l4_hdr - (v6 ? 0 : ip_hdr);
    wire_payload = std::min<size_t>(std::max<size_t>(p.wire_len, p.payload.size()), max_payload);
    incl_payload = std::min(p.payload.size(), wire_payload);

    f.assign(ip_hdr + l4_hdr, 0);
    if (v6) {
        f[0] = 0x60;
        put16(f, 4, static_cast<uint32_t>(l4_hdr + wire_payload));
        f[6] = static_cast<uint8_t>(p.protocol);
        f[7] = 64;
        std::memcpy(f.data() + 8, src.b.data(), 16);
        std::memcpy(f.data() + 24, dst.b.data(), 16);
    } else {
        f[0] = 0x45;
        put16(f, 2, static_cast<uint32_t>(ip_hdr + l4_hdr + wire_payload));
        put16(f, 4, static_cast<uint32_t>(p.id & 0xFFFF));
        f[6] = 0x40;                                  // DF
        f[8] = 64;
        f[9] = static_cast<uint8_t>(p.protocol);
        std::memcpy(f.data() + 12, src.b.data(), 4);
        std::memcpy(f.data() + 16, dst.b.data(), 4);
        put16(f, 10, ipv4_checksum(f.data(), 20));
    }
    const size_t l4 = ip_hdr;
    put16(f, l4, sport);
    put16(f, l4 + 2, dport);
    if (udp) {
        put16(f, l4 + 4, static_cast<uint32_t>(8 + wire_payload));
    } else {
        put32(f, l4 + 4, p.tcp_seq);
        put32(f, l4 + 8, p.tcp_ack);
        f[l4 + 12] = 0x50;
        f[l4 + 13] = p.tcp_flags ? p.tcp_flags : 0x18;   // PSH|ACK when unknown
        put16(f, l4 + 14, 0xFFFF);
    }
    return true;
}

void push_u16(std::vector<uint8_t>& v, uint32_t x) {
    v.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 8) & 0xFF));
    v.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(x & 0xFF));
}

void push_u32(std::vector<uint8_t>& v, uint32_t x) {
    v.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(x >> 24));
    v.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 16) & 0xFF));
    v.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 8) & 0xFF));
    v.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(x & 0xFF));
}

void push_u64(std::vector<uint8_t>& v, uint64_t x) {
    push_u32(v, static_cast<uint32_t>(x >> 32));
    push_u32(v, static_cast<uint32_t>(x & 0xFFFFFFFFu));
}

void pad4(std::vector<uint8_t>& v) {
    while (v.size() % 4) v.push_back(0);
}

// pcapng block: type, total length, body, total length again
void append_block(std::vector<uint8_t>& out, uint32_t type, const std::vector<uint8_t>& body) {
    const uint32_t total = static_cast<uint32_t>(12 + body.size());
    push_u32(out, type);
    push_u32(out, total);
    out.insert(out.end(), body.begin(), body.end());
    push_u32(out, total);
}

bool write_file(const std::string& path, const std::vector<uint8_t>& out, std::string* error) {
    std::FILE* fp = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!fp) {
        if (error) *error = "cannot open output file '" + path + "'";
        return false;
    }
    const size_t wrote = std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), fp);
    const bool flushed = std::fflush(fp) == 0;
    const bool closed = std::fclose(fp) == 0;
    if (wrote != out.size() || !flushed || !closed) {
        std::remove(path.c_str());
        if (error) *error = "write failed for '" + path + "' (disk full or I/O error)";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace

bool traffic_store_t::write_pcap(const std::string& path,
                                 const std::vector<packet_record_t>& pkts,
                                 std::string* error) const {
    // build every record first so a bad packet never leaves a half file behind
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    out.reserve(24 + pkts.size() * 128);
    auto push = [&](const void* p, size_t n) {
        const auto* b = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p);
        out.insert(out.end(), b, b + n);
    };
    const uint32_t global[6] = {0xa1b2c3d4u, 0x00040002u /* 2.4 */, 0, 0, 65535u, 101u /* RAW */};
    push(global, sizeof(global));

    for (const auto& p : pkts) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> f;
        size_t incl_payload = 0, wire_payload = 0;
        if (!build_frame(p, f, incl_payload, wire_payload, error)) return false;

        const uint32_t rec[4] = {
            static_cast<uint32_t>(p.at_ms / 1000),
            static_cast<uint32_t>((p.at_ms % 1000) * 1000),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(f.size() + incl_payload),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(f.size() + wire_payload),
        };
        push(rec, sizeof(rec));
        push(f.data(), f.size());
        if (incl_payload) push(p.payload.data(), incl_payload);
    }

    return write_file(path, out, error);
}

bool traffic_store_t::write_pcapng(const std::string& path,
                                   const std::vector<packet_record_t>& pkts,
                                   std::string* error) const {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    out.reserve(64 + pkts.size() * 160);

    // section header: little-endian, version 1.0, unknown section length
    std::vector<uint8_t> shb;
    push_u32(shb, 0x1A2B3C4Du);
    push_u16(shb, 1);
    push_u16(shb, 0);
    push_u64(shb, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull);
    append_block(out, 0x0A0D0D0Au, shb);

    // interface description: LINKTYPE_RAW, microsecond timestamps
    std::vector<uint8_t> idb;
    push_u16(idb, 101);
    push_u16(idb, 0);
    push_u32(idb, 65535);
    push_u16(idb, 9);                     // if_tsresol
    push_u16(idb, 1);
    idb.push_back(6);                     // 10^-6 s
    pad4(idb);
    push_u16(idb, 0);                     // opt_endofopt
    push_u16(idb, 0);
    append_block(out, 0x00000001u, idb);

    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    for (const auto& p : pkts) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> f;
        size_t incl_payload = 0, wire_payload = 0;
        if (!build_frame(p, f, incl_payload, wire_payload, error)) return false;

        std::vector<uint8_t> body;
        const uint64_t ts = static_cast<uint64_t>(p.at_ms) * 1000;   // microseconds
        push_u32(body, 0);                                           // interface id
        push_u32(body, static_cast<uint32_t>(ts >> 32));
        push_u32(body, static_cast<uint32_t>(ts & 0xFFFFFFFFu));
        push_u32(body, static_cast<uint32_t>(f.size() + incl_payload));
        push_u32(body, static_cast<uint32_t>(f.size() + wire_payload));
        body.insert(body.end(), f.begin(), f.end());
        if (incl_payload)
            body.insert(body.end(), p.payload.begin(),
                        p.payload.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(incl_payload));
        pad4(body);

        std::string comment;
        if (auto it = pkt_notes_.find(p.id); it != pkt_notes_.end()) comment = it->second;
        else if (auto st = stream_notes_.find(p.stream_id); st != stream_notes_.end())
            comment = st->second;
        if (!comment.empty()) {
            push_u16(body, 1);                                    // epb_comment
            push_u16(body, static_cast<uint32_t>(comment.size()));
            body.insert(body.end(), comment.begin(), comment.end());
            pad4(body);
        }
        push_u16(body, 0);                                        // opt_endofopt
        push_u16(body, 0);
        append_block(out, 0x00000006u, body);
    }
    return write_file(path, out, error);
}

bool traffic_store_t::annotate_packet(uint64_t id, std::string comment) {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    const auto it = std::lower_bound(pkts_.begin(), pkts_.end(), id,
                                     [](const packet_record_t& p, uint64_t v) { return p.id < v; });
    if (it == pkts_.end() || it->id != id) return false;
    if (comment.empty()) pkt_notes_.erase(id);
    else pkt_notes_[id] = std::move(comment);
    return true;
}

bool traffic_store_t::annotate_stream(uint64_t id, std::string comment) {
    std::lock_guard lk(mu_);
    if (!by_id_.contains(id)) return false;
    if (comment.empty()) stream_notes_.erase(id);
    else stream_notes_[id] = std::move(comment);
    return true;
}

} // namespace slop::core::network
```

`src/core/network/traffic_store.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

// in memory traffic store: bounded packet ring, per-tuple stream reassembly
// under a global byte budget with LRU stream eviction, display filters, and
// pcap export (LINKTYPE_RAW) with synthesized IPv4/IPv6 + TCP/UDP headers

#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <list>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"

namespace slop::core::network {

struct packet_record_t {
    uint64_t              id = 0;          // monotonic store id
    int64_t               at_ms = 0;       // wall clock
    uint32_t              protocol = 0;    // 6 TCP / 17 UDP
    uint32_t              direction = 0;   // 0 outbound (local -> remote), 1 inbound
    uint8_t               ip_version = 4;  // 4 | 6
    std::string           local_addr;
    uint16_t              local_port = 0;
    std::string           remote_addr;
    uint16_t              remote_port = 0;
    uint32_t              wire_len = 0;    // payload bytes on the wire (>= payload.size(); 0 = same)
    uint32_t              tcp_seq = 0;
    uint32_t              tcp_ack = 0;
    uint8_t               tcp_flags = 0;
    uint64_t              stream_id = 0;   // assigned by the store
    std::vector<uint8_t>  payload;         // captured payload (may be a prefix of the wire payload)
};

struct stream_summary_t {
    uint64_t    id = 0;
    uint32_t    protocol = 0;
    std::string key;            // "tcp 10.0.0.2:1234<->1.1.1.1:80"
    std::string client_addr;    // first outbound sender, else the lower tuple
    uint16_t    client_port = 0;
    std::string server_addr;
    uint16_t    server_port = 0;
    size_t      bytes = 0;      // reassembled bytes held (both directions)
    size_t      packets = 0;
    bool        truncated = false;   // a direction hit the per-stream cap
    int64_t     first_ms = 0;
    int64_t     last_ms = 0;
};

class traffic_store_t {
public:
    struct limits_t {
        size_t max_packets = 20000;
        size_t max_streams = 4096;
        size_t max_stream_bytes = 64u << 20;      // all streams, both directions
        size_t max_direction_bytes = 1u << 20;    // one direction of one stream
    };

    explicit traffic_store_t(size_t max_packets = 20000);
    explicit traffic_store_t(limits_t limits);

    void clear();
    void add(packet_record_t pkt);                       // assigns id

    // Packets oldest-first with id > from_id, capped
    struct page_t { std::vector<packet_record_t> items; bool truncated = false; };
    page_t packets(uint64_t from_id, size_t limit) const;
    // the newest `limit` packets, oldest-first; truncated when older ones exist
    page_t packets_tail(size_t limit) const;

    // streams, most recently active first
    std::vector<stream_summary_t> streams(size_t limit = SIZE_MAX) const;
    std::optional<stream_summary_t> stream(uint64_t id) const;

    // Reassembled payload slice of one stream: client->server bytes, then
    // server->client bytes (each in arrival order)
    std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> stream_bytes(uint64_t id,
                                                     size_t offset, size_t len) const;

    // display filters: predicates ANDed with ';'
    //   port=80 | port==80 | port:80   either side port (strict 0..65535)
    //   host:1.2.3.4 | host:10.0.0.0/8 | host:fe80::1   exact address or CIDR, either side
    //   text:foo                       payload byte substring
    //   proto:tcp|udp|<num>
    //   dir:in|out
    // unknown predicates and malformed values are errors
    class filter_t {
    public:
        bool match(const packet_record_t& p) const;
    private:
        friend class traffic_store_t;
        struct term_t {
            enum class kind_t { port, host, text, proto, dir } kind = kind_t::port;
            uint32_t number = 0;
            parse::cidr_t cidr;
            std::string text;
        };
        std::vector<term_t> terms_;
    };
    static std::optional<filter_t> compile_filter(const std::string& expr,
                                                  std::string* error = nullptr);
    // invalid expressions set *error and return an empty page
    page_t packets_filtered(uint64_t from_id, size_t limit, const std::string& expr,
                            std::string* error = nullptr) const;

    // pcap (LINKTYPE_RAW) export. Unparseable or mixed-family addresses and
    // write failures are errors; the partial file is removed. orig_len carries
    // the wire length when the capture kept only a payload prefix
    bool write_pcap(const std::string& path,
                    const std::vector<packet_record_t>& pkts,
                    std::string* error = nullptr) const;

    // pcapng (LINKTYPE_RAW) export: one EPB per packet, carrying the packet's
    // annotation as an epb_comment when it has one (a stream annotation applies
    // to every packet of that stream)
    bool write_pcapng(const std::string& path,
                      const std::vector<packet_record_t>& pkts,
                      std::string* error = nullptr) const;

    // annotations for pcapng export; false when the id is unknown
    bool annotate_packet(uint64_t id, std::string comment);
    bool annotate_stream(uint64_t id, std::string comment);

    size_t size() const;

    struct stats_t {
        size_t   packets = 0;
        size_t   streams = 0;
        size_t   stream_bytes = 0;          // reassembly bytes currently held
        uint64_t packets_evicted = 0;       // fell off the packet ring
        uint64_t streams_evicted = 0;       // LRU-evicted (count or byte budget)
        uint64_t stream_bytes_dropped = 0;  // payload not kept (per-direction cap)
        uint64_t packets_total = 0;         // ever added
        uint64_t quic_packets = 0;          // UDP/443 packets with a QUIC long header
    };
    stats_t stats() const;
    // streams with activity in [now_ms - window_ms, now_ms]
    size_t active_streams(int64_t now_ms, int64_t window_ms) const;

private:
    struct stream_key_t {
        uint32_t protocol = 0;
        std::string a_addr; uint16_t a_port = 0;
        std::string b_addr; uint16_t b_port = 0;
        bool operator<(const stream_key_t& o) const {
            if (protocol != o.protocol) return protocol < o.protocol;
            if (a_addr != o.a_addr) return a_addr < o.a_addr;
            if (a_port != o.a_port) return a_port < o.a_port;
            if (b_addr != o.b_addr) return b_addr < o.b_addr;
            return b_port < o.b_port;
        }
    };

    struct stream_rec_t {
        stream_key_t key;
        std::vector<uint8_t> c2s;      // client -> server bytes
        std::vector<uint8_t> s2c;
        size_t c2s_packets = 0, s2c_packets = 0;
        int64_t first_ms = 0, last_ms = 0;
        uint64_t id = 0;
        bool has_client = false;
        bool truncated = false;
        std::string client_addr;
        uint16_t    client_port = 0;
        std::string server_addr;
        uint16_t    server_port = 0;
        std::list<stream_rec_t*>::iterator lru;
    };

    limits_t lim_;
    mutable std::mutex mu_;
    std::deque<packet_record_t> pkts_;
    uint64_t next_id_ = 1;

    std::map<stream_key_t, stream_rec_t> streams_;      // node-based: stable addresses
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, stream_rec_t*> by_id_;
    std::list<stream_rec_t*> lru_;                      // front = most recent
    uint64_t next_stream_id_ = 1;
    size_t   stream_bytes_ = 0;
    uint64_t packets_evicted_ = 0, streams_evicted_ = 0, bytes_dropped_ = 0;
    uint64_t quic_packets_ = 0;
    std::map<uint64_t, std::string> pkt_notes_, stream_notes_;

    void index_stream(packet_record_t& p);
    void evict_streams(const stream_rec_t* keep);
    stream_summary_t summarize(const stream_rec_t& s) const;
};

} // namespace slop::core::network
```

`src/core/network/web_fetch.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/core/network/web_fetch.cpp

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#else
#include "core/compat/posix_socket.hpp"
#endif

#include "core/network/web_fetch.hpp"

#include "core/network/net_socket.hpp"
#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"
#include "core/network/tls_stream.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>

namespace slop::core::util {

namespace parse = slop::core::network::parse;
namespace sock = slop::core::network::sock;
namespace tls = slop::core::network::tls;

namespace {

struct url_t {
    bool        https = false;
    std::string host;          // lowercase, no brackets
    uint16_t    port = 0;
    std::string authority;     // as sent in Host
    std::string target;        // origin-form path + query
};

int64_t mono_ms() {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
               std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

bool parse_url(const std::string& u, url_t& out, std::string* error) {
    auto fail = [&](const std::string& why) {
        if (error) *error = why;
        return false;
    };
    const std::string lu = parse::lower(u.substr(0, 8));
    size_t skip = 0;
    if (lu.rfind("https://", 0) == 0) { out.https = true; skip = 8; }
    else if (lu.rfind("http://", 0) == 0) { out.https = false; skip = 7; }
    else return fail("URL must start with http:// or https://");
    std::string rest = u.substr(skip);
    if (const size_t frag = rest.find('#'); frag != std::string::npos) rest.resize(frag);
    const size_t end = rest.find_first_of("/?");
    out.authority = rest.substr(0, end);
    std::string target = end == std::string::npos ? "/" : rest.substr(end);
    if (!target.empty() && target[0] == '?') target = "/" + target;
    if (out.authority.find('@') != std::string::npos)
        return fail("credentials in URLs are not supported");
    std::string host;
    uint16_t port = 0;
    if (!sock::split_authority(out.authority, out.https ? 443 : 80, &host, &port))
        return fail("bad host or port in URL");
    host = parse::lower(host);
    if (!parse::valid_host(host)) return fail("invalid host '" + parse::escape_nonprintable(host) + "'");
    out.host = host;
    out.port = port;
    // percent-encode what may not appear raw in a request line
    static constexpr char kHex[] = "0123456789ABCDEF";
    out.target.clear();
    for (char ch : target) {
        const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(ch);
        if (c <= 0x20 || c >= 0x7F) {
            out.target += '%';
            out.target += kHex[c >> 4];
            out.target += kHex[c & 0xF];
        } else {
            out.target += ch;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

std::string resolve_location(const url_t& base, const std::string& loc) {
    const std::string l = parse::lower(loc.substr(0, 8));
    if (l.rfind("http://", 0) == 0 || l.rfind("https://", 0) == 0) return loc;
    const std::string origin = std::string(base.https ? "https://" : "http://") + base.authority;
    if (loc.rfind("//", 0) == 0) return std::string(base.https ? "https:" : "http:") + loc;
    if (!loc.empty() && loc[0] == '/') return origin + loc;
    std::string dir = base.target.substr(0, base.target.find('?'));
    dir = dir.substr(0, dir.rfind('/') + 1);
    return origin + (dir.empty() ? "/" : dir) + loc;
}

std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> vet(const std::string& host, const egress_policy_t& policy,
                                  std::string* error) {
    const auto addrs = sock::resolve(host, error);
    if (addrs.empty()) return {};
    bool host_exempt = false;
    for (const auto& p : policy.allowlist)
        if (parse::host_pattern_match(p, host, nullptr)) host_exempt = true;
    std::vector<parse::ip_addr_t> out;
    for (const auto& ip : addrs) {
        bool ok = policy.allow_private || host_exempt || !parse::is_non_public(ip);
        for (const auto& p : policy.allowlist)
            if (!ok && parse::host_pattern_match(p, host, &ip)) ok = true;
        if (ok) out.push_back(ip);
    }
    if (out.empty() && error)
        *error = "blocked: '" + host + "' resolves to non-public address " +
                 parse::to_string(addrs.front()) +
                 " (loopback/link-local/private/reserved); enable web_allow_private or add the "
                 "host to web_allowlist";
    return out;
}

struct hop_result_t {
    uint32_t status = 0;
    std::string location;
    std::string content_type;
    std::string body;
    bool truncated = false;
    std::string remote;
};

bool do_hop(const url_t& url, const std::string& method, const std::string& body,
            const std::string& content_type, const egress_policy_t& policy, int64_t deadline,
            size_t max_body, hop_result_t& out, std::string* error) {
    auto fail = [&](const std::string& why) {
        if (error) *error = why;
        return false;
    };
    const auto addrs = vet(url.host, policy, error);
    if (addrs.empty()) return false;

    sock::socket_t s = sock::kInvalid;
    std::string err;
    for (const auto& ip : addrs) {
        const int64_t left = deadline - mono_ms();
        if (left <= 0) return fail("timed out connecting to " + url.host);
        s = sock::connect(ip, url.port, static_cast<int>(left), nullptr, &err);
        if (s != sock::kInvalid) {
            out.remote = parse::to_string(ip);
            break;
        }
    }
    if (s == sock::kInvalid) return fail(err);
    struct closer_t {
        sock::socket_t s;
        ~closer_t() { sock::close(s); }
    } closer{s};

    std::unique_ptr<tls::stream_t> t;
    if (url.https) {
        tls::client_options_t copt;
        copt.exclusive_roots = policy.exclusive_roots;
        const int64_t left = std::max<int64_t>(deadline - mono_ms(), 1);
        t = tls::stream_t::connect(s, url.host, copt, static_cast<int>(left), &err);
        if (!t) return fail("TLS to " + url.host + " failed: " + err);
    }
    const int64_t left = std::max<int64_t>(deadline - mono_ms(), 1);
    sock::set_timeouts(s, static_cast<int>(left), static_cast<int>(left));

    std::string req = method + " " + url.target + " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: " + url.authority +
                      "\r\nUser-Agent: reverse-slop\r\nAccept: */*\r\n"
                      "Accept-Encoding: identity\r\nConnection: close\r\n";
    if (!body.empty() || method == "POST" || method == "PUT") {
        req += "Content-Type: " + (content_type.empty() ? std::string("application/octet-stream")
                                                        : content_type) + "\r\n";
        req += "Content-Length: " + std::to_string(body.size()) + "\r\n";
    }
    req += "\r\n";
    req += body;
    const bool sent = t ? t->write(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(req.data()), req.size())
                        : sock::send_all(s, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(req.data()), req.size());
    if (!sent) return fail("sending the request failed");

    parse::http_framer_t fr(true);
    fr.expect_response_to(method);
    std::vector<uint8_t> raw;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(32768);
    const size_t cap = max_body + 64 * 1024;          // head allowance
    bool capped = false;
    for (;;) {
        if (fr.messages_completed() >= 1) break;
        if (raw.size() >= cap) { capped = true; break; }
        const int64_t l = deadline - mono_ms();
        if (l <= 0) return fail("timed out waiting for the response from " + url.host);
        if (!(t && t->pending()) && !sock::wait_readable(s, static_cast<int>(l), nullptr))
            return fail("timed out waiting for the response from " + url.host);
        const size_t want = std::min(buf.size(), cap - raw.size());
        const int n = t ? t->read(buf.data(), want)
                        : ::recv(static_cast<SOCKET>(s), reinterpret_cast<char*>(buf.data()),
                                 static_cast<int>(want), 0);
        if (n < 0) return fail("connection error while reading the response");
        if (n == 0) {
            fr.finish();
            break;
        }
        raw.insert(raw.end(), buf.begin(), buf.begin() + n);
        fr.feed(buf.data(), static_cast<size_t>(n));
    }

    const size_t head_end = parse::find_head_end(raw.data(), raw.size());
    if (head_end == std::string::npos) return fail("no complete HTTP response head received");
    const auto head = parse::parse_http_head(
        std::string_view(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(raw.data()), head_end), true);
    if (!head) return fail("malformed HTTP response head");
    out.status = head->status;
    if (const std::string* ct = head->get("content-type")) out.content_type = *ct;
    if (const std::string* loc = head->get("location")) out.location = *loc;

    const uint8_t* b = raw.data() + head_end;
    const size_t bn = raw.size() - head_end;
    const std::string* te = head->get("transfer-encoding");
    const std::string* cl = head->get("content-length");
    std::vector<uint8_t> decoded;
    if (te && parse::lower(*te).find("chunked") != std::string::npos) {
        if (!parse::decode_chunked(b, bn, decoded) && !capped)
            return fail("malformed chunked response body");
        out.body.assign(decoded.begin(), decoded.end());
    } else if (cl) {
        const size_t want = static_cast<size_t>(std::strtoull(cl->c_str(), nullptr, 10));
        out.body.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b), std::min(bn, want));
    } else {
        out.body.assign(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b), bn);
    }
    if (out.body.size() > max_body) {
        out.body.resize(max_body);
        capped = true;
    }
    out.truncated = capped;
    return true;
}

} // namespace

std::vector<std::string> vet_destination(const std::string& host, const egress_policy_t& policy,
                                         std::string* error) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (const auto& ip : vet(parse::lower(host), policy, error)) out.push_back(parse::to_string(ip));
    return out;
}

std::optional<http_response_t> http_request(const http_request_t& req,
                                            const egress_policy_t& policy, std::string* error) {
    auto fail = [&](const std::string& why) -> std::optional<http_response_t> {
        if (error) *error = why;
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    std::string method = req.method.empty() ? "GET" : req.method;
    for (char c : method)
        if (c < 'A' || c > 'Z') return fail("bad HTTP method '" + parse::escape_nonprintable(method) + "'");
    for (char c : req.content_type)
        if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') return fail("content_type must not contain line breaks");

    const int64_t deadline = mono_ms() + std::max(req.timeout_ms, 1);
    http_response_t res;
    std::string url_text = req.url;
    std::string body = req.body;
    for (int hop = 0;; ++hop) {
        url_t url;
        std::string err;
        if (!parse_url(url_text, url, &err)) return fail(err);
        hop_result_t hr;
        if (!do_hop(url, method, body, req.content_type, policy, deadline, req.max_body, hr, &err))
            return fail(hop ? err + " (after redirect to " + url_text + ")" : err);
        const bool redirect = (hr.status == 301 || hr.status == 302 || hr.status == 303 ||
                               hr.status == 307 || hr.status == 308) && !hr.location.empty();
        if (!redirect) {
            res.status = hr.status;
            res.content_type = std::move(hr.content_type);
            res.body = std::move(hr.body);
            res.body_truncated = hr.truncated;
            res.final_url = url_text;
            res.remote_addr = hr.remote;
            return res;
        }
        if (hop >= req.max_redirects)
            return fail("too many redirects (" + std::to_string(req.max_redirects) + ")");
        url_text = resolve_location(url, hr.location);
        res.redirects.push_back(url_text);
        if (hr.status == 303 || ((hr.status == 301 || hr.status == 302) && method == "POST")) {
            if (method != "HEAD") method = "GET";
            body.clear();
        }
    }
}

std::optional<http_response_t> http_get(const std::string& url, const egress_policy_t& policy,
                                        int timeout_ms, std::string* error) {
    http_request_t r;
    r.url = url;
    r.timeout_ms = timeout_ms;
    return http_request(r, policy, error);
}

std::optional<http_response_t> http_post(const std::string& url, const std::string& body,
                                         const std::string& content_type,
                                         const egress_policy_t& policy, int timeout_ms,
                                         std::string* error) {
    http_request_t r;
    r.method = "POST";
    r.url = url;
    r.body = body;
    r.content_type = content_type;
    r.timeout_ms = timeout_ms;
    return http_request(r, policy, error);
}

} // namespace slop::core::util
```

```hpp
#pragma once

// src/core/network/web_fetch.hpp
// HTTP(S) client backing the MCP web tool. Each hop resolves the host once,
// refuses loopback / link-local / private / reserved destinations unless the
// policy allows them, and connects to exactly the vetted address (no
// re-resolution, so DNS rebinding cannot swap it). Redirects are followed
// manually and every hop is re-checked. TLS is Schannel with system trust

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace slop::core::util {

struct egress_policy_t {
    bool allow_private = false;            // settings: web_allow_private
    std::vector<std::string> allowlist;    // settings: web_allowlist (host, *.suffix, IP, CIDR)
    void* exclusive_roots = nullptr;       // HCERTSTORE trust override (tests)
};

struct http_response_t {
    uint32_t    status = 0;
    std::string content_type;
    std::string body;
    bool        body_truncated = false;    // body exceeded max_body
    std::string final_url;
    std::vector<std::string> redirects;    // URLs followed, in order
    std::string remote_addr;               // address actually connected to
};

struct http_request_t {
    std::string method = "GET";
    std::string url;
    std::string body;
    std::string content_type;
    int         timeout_ms = 15000;        // whole request, every hop
    size_t      max_body = 32u << 20;
    int         max_redirects = 5;
};

std::optional<http_response_t> http_request(const http_request_t& req,
                                            const egress_policy_t& policy,
                                            std::string* error = nullptr);

std::optional<http_response_t> http_get(const std::string& url, const egress_policy_t& policy,
                                        int timeout_ms = 15000, std::string* error = nullptr);
std::optional<http_response_t> http_post(const std::string& url, const std::string& body,
                                         const std::string& content_type,
                                         const egress_policy_t& policy, int timeout_ms = 15000,
                                         std::string* error = nullptr);

// the addresses of `host` that `policy` lets a request reach; empty with an
// explanatory *error when every address is blocked or resolution fails
std::vector<std::string> vet_destination(const std::string& host, const egress_policy_t& policy,
                                         std::string* error);

} // namespace slop::core::util
```
