`src/engine/engine_main.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/engine/engine_main.cpp
// headless host for the core, same boot and same mcp surface minus the window
// prints SLOP_ENGINE_READY <port> on stdout when listening and exits clean
// on ctrl c or shutdown so the driver never gets stranded
//
// token handshake: a spawner that sets SLOP_MCP_TOKEN brings its own bearer,
// the engine accepts it and the READY line carries no token. without it the
// legacy "SLOP_ENGINE_READY <port> <token>" form is printed
// if something is already listening we hand over that endpoint and leave; with
// SLOP_MCP_TOKEN set the spawner's token is registered with the running engine
//
// --stdio: MCP over stdin/stdout for stdio-only clients (Claude Desktop). Each
// stdin line is POSTed to the engine's own /mcp (or the running engine's) with
// a per-process token; each reply is one stdout line. Everything else that
// would reach stdout (handshake, logs) is moved to stderr.

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <io.h>
#include <iostream>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#include "core/infra/app_control.hpp"
#include "core/infra/event_bus.hpp"
#include "core/infra/lifecycle.hpp"
#include "core/infra/settings.hpp"

#include <httplib.h>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

namespace {

namespace lifecycle = slop::core::infra::lifecycle;
namespace control   = slop::core::infra::app_control;
namespace bus       = slop::core::infra::event_bus;

struct options_t {
    bool     mcp_onboarding = true;
    bool     quiet          = false;   // quiet the mirrored output
    uint32_t parent_pid     = 0;       // watch this pid and exit when it dies
    bool     stdio          = false;   // MCP over stdin/stdout
    uint16_t port           = 0;       // --port <n>, 0 = settings / SLOP_MCP_PORT
};

FILE* g_rpc_out = nullptr;   // the real stdout in --stdio mode, nullptr otherwise

BOOL WINAPI ctrl_handler(DWORD type) {
    switch (type) {
    case CTRL_C_EVENT:
    case CTRL_BREAK_EVENT:
    case CTRL_CLOSE_EVENT:
    case CTRL_LOGOFF_EVENT:
    case CTRL_SHUTDOWN_EVENT:
        control::request_quit("console signal");
        // close event gives us about 5 seconds, the main loop sees the flag and tears down
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(2500));
        return TRUE;
    default:
        return FALSE;
    }
}

std::string env_token() {
    const char* t = std::getenv("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN");
    return (t && *t) ? std::string(t) : std::string{};
}

void emit(const char* line) {
    std::fputs(line, stdout);
    std::fputc('\n', stdout);
    std::fflush(stdout);
}

// keep the real stdout for JSON-RPC only and point fd 1 / STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE at
// stderr, so printf, spdlog and emit() can never corrupt the protocol stream
void claim_stdout_for_rpc() {
    std::fflush(stdout);
    const int rpc_fd = _dup(1);
    _dup2(2, 1);
    ::SetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE, ::GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE));
    g_rpc_out = _fdopen(rpc_fd, "wb");
}

std::string random_token() {
    std::random_device rd;   // MSVC: rand_s, a CSPRNG
    std::string t;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        char b[9];
        std::snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "%08x", rd());
        t += b;
    }
    return t;
}

// one JSON-RPC message per stdin line -> POST /mcp -> one reply line (none
// for notifications); returns when stdin closes
void run_stdio_bridge(uint16_t port, const std::string& token) {
    httplib::Client cli("127.0.0.1", port);
    cli.set_connection_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(5));
    cli.set_read_timeout(std::chrono::minutes(30));   // long tool calls (scans, analysis)
    std::string session, line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        if (line.find_first_not_of(" \t\r") == std::string::npos) continue;
        httplib::Headers h{{"Authorization", "Bearer " + token}};
        if (!session.empty()) h.emplace("Mcp-Session-Id", session);
        auto res = cli.Post("/mcp", h, line, "application/json");
        nlohmann::json reply;
        if (res) {
            if (res->has_header("Mcp-Session-Id")) session = res->get_header_value("Mcp-Session-Id");
            if (res->status == 202 || res->body.empty()) continue;   // notification
            reply = nlohmann::json::parse(res->body, nullptr, false);
        }
        if (!res || reply.is_discarded()) {
            const auto req = nlohmann::json::parse(line, nullptr, false);
            if (!req.is_object() || !req.contains("id")) continue;   // nobody to answer
            reply = {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", req["id"]},
                     {"error", {{"code", -32603}, {"message", "engine unreachable"}}}};
        }
        const std::string out = reply.dump() + "\n";   // dump() never emits a raw newline
        std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), g_rpc_out);
        std::fflush(g_rpc_out);
    }
}

options_t parse_args(int argc, char** argv) {
    options_t o;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const char* a = argv[i];
        if (std::strcmp(a, "--no-onboard") == 0)  o.mcp_onboarding = false;
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--quiet") == 0)       o.quiet = true;
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--port") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            // carried in the boot config, not the environment: an env var would
            // leak into child processes and lose to nothing
            const unsigned long p = std::strtoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
            if (p > 0 && p < 65536) o.port = static_cast<uint16_t>(p);
        }
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--parent-pid") == 0 && i + 1 < argc)
            o.parent_pid = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 10));
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--stdio") == 0) {
            o.stdio = true;
            o.mcp_onboarding = false;   // the stdio client already has its own config entry
        }
        // accepted and ignored, this binary is always headless
    }
    return o;
}

} // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const options_t opts = parse_args(argc, argv);
    if (opts.stdio) {
        claim_stdout_for_rpc();
        if (env_token().empty()) ::_putenv_s("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", random_token().c_str());
    }

    // already served, hand the caller that endpoint and get out of the way.
    // engine.json can name a pid that is alive but not serving (or a reused
    // port), so the registration only counts after an authenticated round trip
    const std::string own_token = env_token();
    lifecycle::endpoint_t live;
    if (lifecycle::read_endpoint(live) && lifecycle::endpoint_serving(live)) {
        if (own_token.empty()) {
            emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(live.port) + " " + live.token).c_str());
        } else {
            // teach the running engine the spawner's token instead of leaking ours
            httplib::Client cli("127.0.0.1", live.port);
            cli.set_connection_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(2));
            cli.set_read_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(5));
            httplib::Headers h;
            if (!live.token.empty()) h.emplace("Authorization", "Bearer " + live.token);
            const nlohmann::json body = {{"tool", "app"},
                                         {"action", "register_token"},
                                         {"params", {{"token", own_token}}}};
            auto res = cli.Post("/api", h, body.dump(), "application/json");
            const auto reply = res ? nlohmann::json::parse(res->body, nullptr, false)
                                   : nlohmann::json();
            if (!res || res->status != 200 || !reply.is_object() || !reply.value("ok", false)) {
                emit("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED running engine refused the spawner token");
                return 1;
            }
            emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(live.port)).c_str());
        }
        emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING " + std::to_string(live.pid)).c_str());
        if (opts.stdio) run_stdio_bridge(live.port, own_token);
        return 0;
    }
    if (lifecycle::drop_stale_endpoint())
        std::fprintf(stderr, "stale engine registration dropped (endpoint did not answer)\n");

    ::SetConsoleCtrlHandler(ctrl_handler, TRUE);

    // exit when the parent ui dies, the job object is just the backstop
    HANDLE parent = nullptr;
    if (opts.parent_pid != 0) {
        parent = ::OpenProcess(SYNCHRONIZE, FALSE, opts.parent_pid);
        if (parent == nullptr)
            std::fprintf(stderr, "parent pid %lu not open-able; watch disabled\n",
                         static_cast<unsigned long>(opts.parent_pid));
    }

    lifecycle::config_t cfg;
    cfg.mcp_onboarding = opts.mcp_onboarding;
    cfg.mcp_port       = opts.port;
    lifecycle::begin(std::move(cfg));

    // mirror the boot story to stderr so it never collides with the stdout handshake
    uint64_t mirrored = 0;
    const auto drain_output = [&] {
        if (opts.quiet) return;
        for (const auto& l : bus::output_since(mirrored)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", l.text.c_str());
            mirrored = l.seq;
        }
        std::fflush(stderr);
    };

    bool announced = false;
    std::thread bridge;
    while (!control::quit_requested()) {
        lifecycle::advance();
        lifecycle::tick();
        drain_output();

        if (!announced) {
            const auto boot = lifecycle::result();
            if (boot.mcp_ok) {
                // never announce an endpoint that does not answer: a spawner
                // trusts this line and would hand its client a dead port
                const lifecycle::endpoint_t self{static_cast<uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId()),
                                                 boot.mcp_port,
                                                 slop::core::infra::settings::mcp_token()};
                announced = true;
                if (!lifecycle::endpoint_serving(self, 3000)) {
                    emit("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED mcp endpoint did not answer after boot");
                    control::request_quit("mcp endpoint probe failed");
                } else {
                    if (own_token.empty())
                        emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(boot.mcp_port) + " " +
                              slop::core::infra::settings::mcp_token())
                                 .c_str());
                    else
                        emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(boot.mcp_port)).c_str());
                    if (opts.stdio)
                        bridge = std::thread([port = boot.mcp_port, own_token] {
                            run_stdio_bridge(static_cast<uint16_t>(port), own_token);
                            control::request_quit("stdin closed");
                        });
                }
            } else if (lifecycle::booted()) {
                emit("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED mcp server did not bind");
                announced = true;
                control::request_quit("mcp bind failure");
            }
        }

        // nothing here is frame paced, 10ms keeps shutdown snappy without spinning a core
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));

        if (parent != nullptr && ::WaitForSingleObject(parent, 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0)
            control::request_quit("front end exited");
    }

    if (parent != nullptr) ::CloseHandle(parent);

    drain_output();
    lifecycle::shutdown();
    drain_output();   // teardown story lands here
    // a quit from elsewhere leaves the bridge blocked on stdin; nothing left to flush
    if (bridge.joinable()) bridge.detach();
    return 0;
}


```

`src/engine/engine_main_posix.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/engine/engine_main_posix.cpp
// headless host for the core on POSIX: same boot, same MCP surface, no window.
// prints SLOP_ENGINE_READY <port> [<token>] on stdout when listening and exits
// clean on SIGINT/SIGTERM so a driver never gets stranded.
//
// --stdio: MCP over stdin/stdout for stdio-only clients. Each stdin line is
// POSTed to the engine's own /mcp with a per-process token; each reply is one
// stdout line, everything else goes to stderr.

#include <csignal>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#include "core/infra/app_control.hpp"
#include "core/infra/event_bus.hpp"
#include "core/infra/lifecycle.hpp"
#include "core/infra/settings.hpp"

#include <httplib.h>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <unistd.h>

namespace {

namespace lifecycle = slop::core::infra::lifecycle;
namespace control   = slop::core::infra::app_control;
namespace bus       = slop::core::infra::event_bus;

struct options_t {
    bool     mcp_onboarding = true;
    bool     quiet          = false;
    uint32_t parent_pid     = 0;
    bool     stdio          = false;
    uint16_t port           = 0;
};

FILE* g_rpc_out = nullptr;

void on_signal(int) {
    control::request_quit("console signal");
}

std::string env_token() {
    const char* t = std::getenv("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN");
    return (t && *t) ? std::string(t) : std::string{};
}

void emit(const char* line) {
    std::fputs(line, stdout);
    std::fputc('\n', stdout);
    std::fflush(stdout);
}

// keep the real stdout for JSON-RPC only and point fd 1 at stderr, so printf,
// spdlog and emit() can never corrupt the protocol stream
void claim_stdout_for_rpc() {
    std::fflush(stdout);
    const int rpc_fd = ::dup(1);
    ::dup2(2, 1);
    g_rpc_out = ::fdopen(rpc_fd, "wb");
}

std::string random_token() {
    std::random_device rd;
    std::string t;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        char b[9];
        std::snprintf(b, sizeof(b), "%08x", rd());
        t += b;
    }
    return t;
}

void run_stdio_bridge(uint16_t port, const std::string& token) {
    httplib::Client cli("127.0.0.1", port);
    cli.set_connection_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(5));
    cli.set_read_timeout(std::chrono::minutes(30));
    std::string session, line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        if (line.find_first_not_of(" \t\r") == std::string::npos) continue;
        httplib::Headers h{{"Authorization", "Bearer " + token}};
        if (!session.empty()) h.emplace("Mcp-Session-Id", session);
        auto res = cli.Post("/mcp", h, line, "application/json");
        nlohmann::json reply;
        if (res) {
            if (res->has_header("Mcp-Session-Id")) session = res->get_header_value("Mcp-Session-Id");
            if (res->status == 202 || res->body.empty()) continue;
            reply = nlohmann::json::parse(res->body, nullptr, false);
        }
        if (!res || reply.is_discarded()) {
            const auto req = nlohmann::json::parse(line, nullptr, false);
            if (!req.is_object() || !req.contains("id")) continue;
            reply = {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", req["id"]},
                     {"error", {{"code", -32603}, {"message", "engine unreachable"}}}};
        }
        const std::string out = reply.dump() + "\n";
        std::fwrite(out.data(), 1, out.size(), g_rpc_out);
        std::fflush(g_rpc_out);
    }
}

options_t parse_args(int argc, char** argv) {
    options_t o;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const char* a = argv[i];
        if (std::strcmp(a, "--no-onboard") == 0)  o.mcp_onboarding = false;
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--quiet") == 0)  o.quiet = true;
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--port") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            const unsigned long p = std::strtoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
            if (p > 0 && p < 65536) o.port = static_cast<uint16_t>(p);
        }
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--parent-pid") == 0 && i + 1 < argc)
            o.parent_pid = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::strtoul(argv[++i], nullptr, 10));
        else if (std::strcmp(a, "--stdio") == 0) {
            o.stdio = true;
            o.mcp_onboarding = false;
        }
    }
    return o;
}

// SIGKILL-proof parent watch: /proc/<pid> disappearing is the only signal we
// get when the front end is killed hard
bool parent_alive(uint32_t pid) {
    if (pid == 0) return true;
    return ::kill(static_cast<pid_t>(pid), 0) == 0;
}

} // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const options_t opts = parse_args(argc, argv);
    if (opts.stdio) {
        claim_stdout_for_rpc();
        if (env_token().empty()) ::setenv("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", random_token().c_str(), 1);
    }

    const std::string own_token = env_token();
    lifecycle::endpoint_t live;
    if (lifecycle::read_endpoint(live) && lifecycle::endpoint_serving(live)) {
        if (own_token.empty()) {
            emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(live.port) + " " + live.token).c_str());
        } else {
            httplib::Client cli("127.0.0.1", live.port);
            cli.set_connection_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(2));
            cli.set_read_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(5));
            httplib::Headers h;
            if (!live.token.empty()) h.emplace("Authorization", "Bearer " + live.token);
            const nlohmann::json body = {{"tool", "app"},
                                         {"action", "register_token"},
                                         {"params", {{"token", own_token}}}};
            auto res = cli.Post("/api", h, body.dump(), "application/json");
            const auto reply = res ? nlohmann::json::parse(res->body, nullptr, false)
                                   : nlohmann::json();
            if (!res || res->status != 200 || !reply.is_object() || !reply.value("ok", false)) {
                emit("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED running engine refused the spawner token");
                return 1;
            }
            emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(live.port)).c_str());
        }
        emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING " + std::to_string(live.pid)).c_str());
        if (opts.stdio) run_stdio_bridge(live.port, own_token);
        return 0;
    }
    if (lifecycle::drop_stale_endpoint())
        std::fprintf(stderr, "stale engine registration dropped (endpoint did not answer)\n");

    std::signal(SIGINT, on_signal);
    std::signal(SIGTERM, on_signal);
    std::signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);

    lifecycle::config_t cfg;
    cfg.mcp_onboarding = opts.mcp_onboarding;
    cfg.mcp_port       = opts.port;
    lifecycle::begin(std::move(cfg));

    uint64_t mirrored = 0;
    const auto drain_output = [&] {
        if (opts.quiet) return;
        for (const auto& l : bus::output_since(mirrored)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", l.text.c_str());
            mirrored = l.seq;
        }
        std::fflush(stderr);
    };

    bool announced = false;
    std::thread bridge;
    while (!control::quit_requested()) {
        lifecycle::advance();
        lifecycle::tick();
        drain_output();

        if (!announced) {
            const auto boot = lifecycle::result();
            if (boot.mcp_ok) {
                const lifecycle::endpoint_t self{static_cast<uint32_t>(::getpid()),
                                                 boot.mcp_port,
                                                 slop::core::infra::settings::mcp_token()};
                announced = true;
                if (!lifecycle::endpoint_serving(self, 3000)) {
                    emit("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED mcp endpoint did not answer after boot");
                    control::request_quit("mcp endpoint probe failed");
                } else {
                    if (own_token.empty())
                        emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(boot.mcp_port) + " " +
                              slop::core::infra::settings::mcp_token())
                                 .c_str());
                    else
                        emit(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY " + std::to_string(boot.mcp_port)).c_str());
                    if (opts.stdio)
                        bridge = std::thread([port = boot.mcp_port, own_token] {
                            run_stdio_bridge(static_cast<uint16_t>(port), own_token);
                            control::request_quit("stdin closed");
                        });
                }
            } else if (lifecycle::booted()) {
                emit("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED mcp server did not bind");
                announced = true;
                control::request_quit("mcp bind failure");
            }
        }

        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));

        if (!parent_alive(opts.parent_pid)) control::request_quit("front end exited");
    }

    drain_output();
    lifecycle::shutdown();
    drain_output();
    if (bridge.joinable()) bridge.detach();
    return 0;
}

```

```txt
# src/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt
# libFuzzer harnesses for the parsers that consume untrusted input (ELF/PE/
# Mach-O loaders, .ipa, ZIP, the ps4debug wire format, .NET metadata).
#
# MSVC only: /fsanitize=fuzzer needs the MSVC libFuzzer runtime. ASan is part
# of the same instrumentation (the STL container annotations must match across
# every object in the link), so the preset sets SLOP_SANITIZE=address for the
# whole tree instead of instrumenting the harness alone.

if(NOT SLOP_BUILD_FUZZ)
    return()
endif()

if(NOT MSVC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SLOP_BUILD_FUZZ needs MSVC (/fsanitize=fuzzer)")
endif()
if(NOT SLOP_SANITIZE STREQUAL "address")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SLOP_BUILD_FUZZ needs SLOP_SANITIZE=address: the libFuzzer "
                        "runtime and the ASan-instrumented libraries must come from one "
                        "build (see the ninja-msvc-fuzz preset)")
endif()

set(SLOP_FUZZ_TARGETS elf pe macho ipa zip ps4 dotnet)

foreach(_name IN LISTS SLOP_FUZZ_TARGETS)
    add_executable(fuzz_${_name} fuzz_${_name}.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(fuzz_${_name} PRIVATE slop_core)
    # /fsanitize=fuzzer at compile time also emits the libFuzzer runtime's
    # defaultlib, so the link needs no extra switch (link.exe would reject it)
    target_compile_options(fuzz_${_name} PRIVATE /W4 /WX /EHsc /bigobj /fsanitize=fuzzer)
    set_target_properties(fuzz_${_name} PROPERTIES
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fuzz")
endforeach()

# Regenerates src/fuzz/corpus/<target>/ from the in-memory test fixtures.
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_dotnet.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_dotnet.cpp
// libFuzzer target: the ECMA-335 metadata reader (table layout, heaps, coded
// indices, signature blobs) that managed assemblies go through.

#include "core/dotnet/dotnet_metadata.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace mdt = hype::mdt;

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    hype::MetadataReader r;
    if (!r.init(data, size)) return 0;

    size_t touched = r.version().size();
    (void)r.assembly_name();
    (void)r.string_at(0);
    (void)r.user_string_at(0);

    // cap the per-input work: a crafted row count must not turn one run into
    // a million accessor calls
    constexpr uint32_t kMaxRows = 24;
    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < mdt::kCount; ++t) {
        const uint32_t rows = std::min(r.table_rows(t), kMaxRows);
        for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= rows; ++rid) {
            const uint32_t token = (t << 24) | rid;
            touched += r.type_name(token).size() + r.method_name(token).size() +
                       r.field_name(token).size() + r.token_name(token).size();
            (void)r.decode_coded(hype::MetadataReader::Coded::TypeDefOrRef, rid);
            (void)r.call_info(token);
            (void)r.constant_for(t, rid);
        }
    }

    const uint32_t types = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::TypeDef), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= types; ++rid) {
        const auto td = r.type_def(rid);
        (void)r.type_name((mdt::TypeDef << 24) | rid);
        (void)r.nested_enclosing(rid);
        (void)r.field_decl_type(rid);
        (void)r.method_decl_type(rid);
        touched += td.name + td.ns;   // heap offsets, not strings
    }
    const uint32_t methods = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::MethodDef), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= methods; ++rid) {
        const auto md = r.method_def(rid);
        const auto sig = r.parse_method_sig(md.sig);
        touched += sig.ret.size() + sig.params.size() + r.method_decl_type(rid);
        (void)r.field_type(md.sig);
    }
    const uint32_t fields = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::Field), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= fields; ++rid) {
        const auto f = r.field(rid);
        touched += r.field_type(f.sig).size() + r.field_decl_type(rid);
    }
    const uint32_t params = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::Param), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= params; ++rid) {
        const auto p = r.param(rid);
        touched += p.name + p.seq;   // heap offset + sequence, both integers
    }
    const uint32_t props = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::Property), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= props; ++rid) {
        const auto p = r.property(rid);
        touched += r.property_type(p.sig).size() + r.property_decl_type(rid);
    }
    const uint32_t events = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::Event), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= events; ++rid) {
        const auto e = r.event_row(rid);
        touched += e.name + r.event_decl_type(rid);   // heap offset + rid
    }
    const uint32_t sem = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::MethodSemantics), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= sem; ++rid) (void)r.method_semantics(rid);
    const uint32_t ifaces = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::InterfaceImpl), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= ifaces; ++rid) (void)r.iface_impl(rid);
    const uint32_t nested = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::NestedClass), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= nested; ++rid) (void)r.nested_class(rid);
    const uint32_t attrs = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::CustomAttribute), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= attrs; ++rid) (void)r.custom_attribute(rid);

    // standalone signatures: the local-variable signature table
    const uint32_t sigs = std::min(r.table_rows(mdt::StandAloneSig), kMaxRows);
    for (uint32_t rid = 1; rid <= sigs; ++rid)
        touched += r.parse_local_sig((mdt::StandAloneSig << 24) | rid).size();

    volatile size_t sink = touched;
    (void)sink;
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_elf.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_elf.cpp
// libFuzzer target: hype::ELFLoader over an untrusted executable or memory
// dump (PS4 eboots, dumped SELF segments, Linux binaries). Built by the
// ninja-msvc-fuzz preset (SLOP_BUILD_FUZZ=ON).

#include "core/loader/elf_loader.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    if (!hype::ELFLoader::is_elf(data, size)) return 0;

    hype::ELFLoader loader;
    if (auto img = loader.load_buffer(data, size)) {
        // walk what the loader built so the parse stays observable
        volatile size_t n = img->segments.size() + img->imports.size() +
                            img->exports.size() + img->symbols.size() +
                            img->runtime_funcs.size();
        (void)n;
        (void)img->base;
        (void)img->entry;
        (void)loader.header_base();
    }

    // relocations write into the image: fuzz them over a mutable copy, with
    // the load base taken from the input so both the in-place and the
    // relocated layouts are reached
    std::vector<uint8_t> copy(data, data + size);
    hype::va_t load_base = 0;
    if (size >= 8) {
        load_base = (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[0]) << 56) |
                    (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[1]) << 48) |
                    (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[2]) << 40) |
                    (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[3]) << 32) |
                    (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[4]) << 24) |
                    (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[5]) << 16) |
                    (static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[6]) << 8) |
                    static_cast<hype::va_t>(copy[7]);
        load_base &= ~hype::va_t(0xFFF);   // page aligned, as a real mapping is
    }
    const auto stats = hype::ELFLoader::apply_relocations(std::span<uint8_t>(copy), load_base);
    volatile size_t applied = stats.applied + stats.imported + stats.skipped;
    (void)applied;
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_ipa.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_ipa.cpp
// libFuzzer target: .ipa (ZIP + Info.plist + Mach-O payload) resolution.
// The archive is untrusted: the bundle name, the plist and the executable
// entry all come from the container.

#include "core/disasm/ipa.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace ipa = slop::core::disasm::ipa;

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    // bounded so a deflate bomb cannot make the fuzzer allocate without limit
    if (size > (1u << 18)) return 0;
    if (!ipa::looks_like_ipa(data, size)) return 0;
    const auto r = ipa::extract_main_binary(data, size);
    volatile size_t n = r.binary.size() + r.bundle.executable.size() +
                        r.bundle.bundle_id.size() + r.bundle.version.size() +
                        r.bundle.min_os.size() + r.error.size();
    (void)n;
    (void)r.ok;
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_macho.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_macho.cpp
// libFuzzer target: Mach-O (thin, FAT, FAT64) into the analyzer's PE-shaped
// image, including the slice selection an .ipa or a dumped dylib goes through.

#include "core/loader/macho_loader.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    if (!hype::MachOLoader::is_macho(data, size)) return 0;
    const auto slice = hype::MachOLoader::select_slice(data, size);
    if (!slice || slice->offset > size || slice->size > size - slice->offset) return 0;

    hype::MachOLoader loader;
    if (auto img = loader.load_buffer(data, size)) {
        volatile size_t n = img->segments.size() + img->imports.size() +
                            img->exports.size() + img->symbols.size() +
                            img->runtime_funcs.size();
        (void)n;
        (void)img->base;
        (void)img->entry;
        (void)img->encrypted;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_pe.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_pe.cpp
// libFuzzer target: the dependency-free PE32+ parser that every loaded
// Windows image, dump and capture goes through.

#include "core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    const auto pe = slop::core::disasm::pe_parse(data, size);
    if (!pe.ok) return 0;

    // exercise the RVAs the analyzer derives from the parsed tables
    volatile size_t n = pe.sections.size() + pe.imports.size() + pe.exports.size() +
                        pe.runtime_funcs.size();
    (void)n;
    for (const auto& s : pe.sections) {
        (void)pe.section_for_rva(s.rva);
        if (auto off = pe.rva_to_offset(s.rva)) (void)pe.offset_to_va(*off);
        if (auto off = pe.rva_to_offset(s.rva + s.virtual_size)) (void)pe.offset_to_va(*off);
    }
    for (const auto& e : pe.exports) {
        if (auto off = pe.rva_to_offset(e.rva)) (void)pe.offset_to_va(*off);
        (void)pe.va_to_offset(pe.image_base + e.rva);
    }
    for (const auto& d : pe.imports) {
        for (const auto& f : d.functions) (void)pe.va_to_offset(f.iat_rva);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_ps4.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_ps4.cpp
// libFuzzer target: the ps4debug-NG wire format — the fixed-size port-755
// debug-event packet, the stream reassembler that rebuilds packets from
// arbitrary TCP chunking, and a CMD_PROC_LIST reply body.

#include "core/runtime/backend_ps4.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/ps4_protocol.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace rt  = slop::core::runtime;
namespace ps4 = slop::core::runtime::ps4;

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    // 1. one debug-event packet straight from the input
    rt::ps4_event_t ev{};
    if (rt::ps4_decode_event(data, size, ev)) {
        volatile uint64_t s = ev.status + ev.signal + ev.lwpid + ev.dr[6];
        (void)s;
    }

    // 2. the port-755 stream: any packet size, any chunking
    if (size > 0) {
        const size_t pkt_size = 1 + (data[0] % ps4::kDebugEventSize);
        rt::ps4_event_reassembler_t ra(pkt_size);
        size_t off = 1;
        while (off < size) {
            const size_t chunk = std::min<size_t>(1 + (data[off] % 97), size - off);
            // decode each delivered packet with its own length: a short
            // packet must be rejected, not read as a full 0x4A0 event
            ra.feed(data + off, chunk, [pkt_size](const uint8_t* pkt) {
                rt::ps4_event_t e{};
                (void)rt::ps4_decode_event(pkt, pkt_size, e);
            });
            off += chunk;
        }
    }

    // 3. a CMD_PROC_LIST reply body
    const auto procs = rt::ps4_parse_proc_list(data, size);
    volatile size_t n = procs.size();
    (void)n;
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/fuzz_zip.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/fuzz_zip.cpp
// libFuzzer target: the in-memory ZIP reader (central directory, ZIP64,
// stored/deflate extraction) behind .ipa, .hdb bundles and web-fetch archives.

#include "core/util/zip_reader.hpp"

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace zip = slop::core::util::zip;

extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
    if (!zip::has_zip_magic(data, size)) return 0;
    zip::archive_t ar;
    std::string err;
    if (!ar.open(data, size, &err)) return 0;

    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    for (const auto& e : ar.entries()) {
        // 1 MiB cap: a crafted entry must not turn one input into gigabytes
        if (ar.extract(e, out, &err, 1u << 20)) {
            volatile size_t n = out.size();
            (void)n;
        }
        (void)ar.find(e.name);
    }
    return 0;
}
```

`src/fuzz/gen_corpus.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/fuzz/gen_corpus.cpp
// Writes the seed corpora under src/fuzz/corpus/<target>/ from the same
// in-memory fixtures the test suite uses, so the seeds stay in sync with the
// formats the parsers are expected to accept.
//
//   build-ninja-msvc-fuzz/fuzz/slop_fuzz_corpus.exe src/fuzz/corpus
//
// Only re-run after a fixture or format change; the generated files are
// committed (they are small).

#include "core/dotnet/dotnet_metadata.h"
#include "core/runtime/ps4_protocol.hpp"

#include "elf_fixture.hpp"
#include "macho_fixture.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
namespace mf = slop_test::macho;
namespace ps4 = slop::core::runtime::ps4;

namespace {

int g_written = 0;

void put(const fs::path& dir, const char* name, const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    fs::create_directories(dir);
    std::ofstream out(dir / name, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()),
              static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
    if (!out) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot write %s\n", (dir / name).string().c_str());
        std::exit(1);
    }
    std::printf("  %-28s %6zu bytes\n", (dir / name).string().c_str(), bytes.size());
    ++g_written;
}

// a minimal but structurally valid PE32+ (one .text section) — the same shape
// the magicmida tests build
std::vector<uint8_t> make_pe(bool x64) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(0x400, 0);
    auto put16 = [&bytes](size_t at, uint16_t v) { std::memcpy(bytes.data() + at, &v, 2); };
    auto put32 = [&bytes](size_t at, uint32_t v) { std::memcpy(bytes.data() + at, &v, 4); };
    bytes[0] = 'M';
    bytes[1] = 'Z';
    put32(0x3c, 0x80);
    bytes[0x80] = 'P';
    bytes[0x81] = 'E';
    put16(0x84, x64 ? 0x8664 : 0x014c);
    put16(0x86, 1);
    put16(0x94, x64 ? 0xf0 : 0xe0);
    const size_t optional = 0x98;
    put16(optional, x64 ? 0x20b : 0x10b);
    put32(optional + 16, 0x1000);
    put32(optional + 56, 0x2000);
    put32(optional + 60, 0x200);
    put32(optional + (x64 ? 108 : 92), 16);
    const size_t section = optional + (x64 ? 0xf0 : 0xe0);
    std::memcpy(bytes.data() + section, ".text", 5);
    put32(section + 8, 0x100);
    put32(section + 12, 0x1000);
    put32(section + 16, 0x200);
    put32(section + 20, 0x200);
    put32(section + 36, 0x60000020);
    bytes[0x200] = 0xc3;
    return bytes;
}

// A minimal ECMA-335 metadata root: BSJB header, a #~ table stream with one
// row each in Module/TypeDef/MethodDef/Field, and a #Strings heap. Enough for
// MetadataReader::init to accept it, so the fuzzer starts from a valid layout
// instead of rediscovering the header from noise.
std::vector<uint8_t> make_metadata_root() {
    std::vector<uint8_t> b;
    auto u8  = [&b](uint8_t v) { b.push_back(v); };
    auto u16 = [&b](uint16_t v) { b.push_back(uint8_t(v)); b.push_back(uint8_t(v >> 8)); };
    auto u32 = [&b](uint32_t v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) b.push_back(uint8_t(v >> (8 * i)));
    };
    auto u64 = [&b](uint64_t v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) b.push_back(uint8_t(v >> (8 * i)));
    };
    auto pad4 = [&b] { while (b.size() % 4) b.push_back(0); };

    // root header
    for (char c : std::string("BSJB")) u8(uint8_t(c));
    u16(1);            // major
    u16(1);            // minor
    u32(0);            // reserved
    const std::string version = "v4.0.30319";
    u32(uint32_t(version.size() + 1));
    b.insert(b.end(), version.begin(), version.end());
    u8(0);
    pad4();
    u16(0);            // flags
    u16(2);            // stream count

    // "#~" stream header (offset patched below) + "#Strings"
    const size_t tilde_hdr = b.size();
    u32(0);            // offset, patched
    u32(0);            // size, patched
    for (char c : std::string("#~")) u8(uint8_t(c));
    u8(0);
    pad4();
    const size_t strings_hdr = b.size();
    u32(0);            // offset, patched
    u32(0);            // size, patched
    for (char c : std::string("#Strings")) u8(uint8_t(c));
    u8(0);
    pad4();

    // #~ tables stream
    const size_t tilde = b.size();
    u32(0);            // reserved
    u8(2);             // major
    u8(0);             // minor
    u8(0);             // heap sizes: 2-byte string/guid/blob indices
    u8(1);             // reserved
    u64((1ull << 0x00) | (1ull << 0x02) | (1ull << 0x04) | (1ull << 0x06));  // Module, TypeDef, Field, MethodDef
    u64(0);            // sorted
    u32(1);            // Module
    u32(1);            // TypeDef
    u32(1);            // Field
    u32(1);            // MethodDef
    // Module row: Generation u16, Name, Mvid, EncId, EncBaseId
    u16(0); u16(1); u16(0); u16(0); u16(0);
    // TypeDef row: Flags u32, Name, Namespace, Extends, FieldList, MethodList
    u32(0); u16(2); u16(3); u16(0); u16(1); u16(1);
    // Field row: Flags u16, Name, Sig
    u16(0x0006); u16(4); u16(5);
    // MethodDef row: RVA u32, ImplFlags u16, Flags u16, Name, Sig, ParamList
    u32(0x2000); u16(0); u16(0x0016); u16(6); u16(7); u16(1);
    const size_t tilde_end = b.size();

    // #Strings heap: empty string, then the names referenced above
    const size_t strings = b.size();
    u8(0);
    for (const char* s : {"<Module>", "Program", "Main", "counter", "sig"}) {
        for (const char* p = s; *p; ++p) u8(uint8_t(*p));
        u8(0);
    }
    const size_t strings_end = b.size();

    auto patch = [&b](size_t at, uint32_t v) {
        std::memcpy(b.data() + at, &v, 4);
    };
    patch(tilde_hdr, uint32_t(tilde));
    patch(tilde_hdr + 4, uint32_t(tilde_end - tilde));
    patch(strings_hdr, uint32_t(strings));
    patch(strings_hdr + 4, uint32_t(strings_end - strings));
    return b;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> make_debug_event() {
    ps4::debug_event_packet_t pkt{};
    pkt.lwpid  = 0x1234;
    pkt.status = 0x0000007F;   // stopped, SIGTRAP
    std::strncpy(pkt.tdname, "main", sizeof(pkt.tdname) - 1);
    pkt.regs.rip = 0x400500;
    pkt.regs.rsp = 0x7FFF00008000ull;
    pkt.regs.rbp = 0x7FFF00007FF0ull;
    pkt.regs.rax = 0x2A;
    pkt.regs.rflags = 0x202;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
        reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(pkt.dbregs)[i] = 0xD000 + uint64_t(i);
    std::vector<uint8_t> out(sizeof(pkt));
    std::memcpy(out.data(), &pkt, sizeof(pkt));
    return out;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> make_proc_list() {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    for (const auto& [name, pid] : {std::pair{"eboot.bin", 1234}, std::pair{"SceShellUI", 42}}) {
        ps4::proc_list_entry_t e{};
        std::strncpy(e.p_comm, name, sizeof(e.p_comm) - 1);
        e.pid = pid;
        const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&e);
        out.insert(out.end(), p, p + sizeof(e));
    }
    return out;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> make_ipa(bool deflate) {
    const auto exe = mf::build_arm64_exe();
    const auto plist = mf::build_bplist({{"CFBundleExecutable", "Demo"},
                                         {"CFBundleIdentifier", "com.example.demo"},
                                         {"CFBundleShortVersionString", "1.0"},
                                         {"MinimumOSVersion", "14.0"}});
    const std::vector<mf::zip_entry_t> entries = {
        {"Payload/", {}, false},
        {"Payload/Demo.app/", {}, false},
        {"Payload/Demo.app/Info.plist", plist, false},
        {"Payload/Demo.app/Demo", exe, std::nullopt},
    };
    return mf::build_zip(entries, deflate);
}

std::vector<uint8_t> make_zip() {
    const std::vector<mf::zip_entry_t> entries = {
        {"readme.txt", mf::bytes_of("reverse-slop corpus seed\n"), std::nullopt},
        {"dir/", {}, false},
        {"dir/data.bin", std::vector<uint8_t>(256, 0x41), std::nullopt},
    };
    return mf::build_zip(entries, true);
}

} // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const fs::path root = argc > 1 ? fs::path(argv[1]) : fs::path("src/fuzz/corpus");

    std::printf("elf_loader:\n");
    put(root / "elf", "ps4_elf.bin", elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf());
    put(root / "elf", "header_below_segment.bin",
        elf_fixture::build_header_below_segment_elf(0x400000));
    put(root / "elf", "extended_numbering.bin",
        elf_fixture::build_extended_numbering_elf());
    put(root / "elf", "arm64_adrp.bin", elf_fixture::build_arm64_adrp_elf());

    std::printf("pe_parser:\n");
    put(root / "pe", "pe64.bin", make_pe(true));
    put(root / "pe", "pe32.bin", make_pe(false));

    std::printf("macho_loader:\n");
    const auto exe = mf::build_arm64_exe();
    put(root / "macho", "arm64_exe.bin", exe);
    put(root / "macho", "x86_64_stub.bin", mf::build_x86_64_stub());
    put(root / "macho", "fat_two_slices.bin",
        mf::build_fat({{0x0100000C, 0, exe, 14}, {0x01000007, 3, mf::build_x86_64_stub(), 14}}));

    std::printf("ipa:\n");
    put(root / "ipa", "demo_deflate.ipa", make_ipa(true));
    put(root / "ipa", "demo_stored.ipa", make_ipa(false));

    std::printf("zip_reader:\n");
    put(root / "zip", "bundle.zip", make_zip());

    std::printf("ps4:\n");
    put(root / "ps4", "debug_event.bin", make_debug_event());
    put(root / "ps4", "proc_list.bin", make_proc_list());

    std::printf("dotnet:\n");
    const auto meta = make_metadata_root();
    {
        hype::MetadataReader r;
        if (!r.init(meta.data(), meta.size())) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "dotnet seed does not parse: fix make_metadata_root()\n");
            return 1;
        }
        std::printf("  metadata root accepted, %u TypeDef row(s)\n",
                    r.table_rows(hype::mdt::TypeDef));
    }
    put(root / "dotnet", "metadata_root.bin", meta);

    std::printf("%d seed file(s) under %s\n", g_written, root.string().c_str());
    return 0;
}
```

```txt
# Vendored hyperion engine (github.com/Sidenai/hyperion-disassembler)
#
# Only core/ (disasm, loaders, analyzer, decompiler, types, database) and
# threading/ are ported, hyperion's own ui/, debugger/, scripting/ and mcp/
# are replaced by reverse-slop's. The `hype` namespace is kept verbatim so
# upstream changes stay diffable
#
# Include root is `src/hyperion/` so the vendored sources keep their original
# `#include "core/..."` / `#include "threading/..."` paths without colliding
# with reverse-slop's own `src/`-rooted `core/...` includes

file(GLOB_RECURSE SLOP_HYPERION_SOURCES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core/*.h"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/threading/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/threading/*.h"
)

add_library(slop_hyperion STATIC ${SLOP_HYPERION_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(slop_hyperion PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

target_link_libraries(slop_hyperion PUBLIC
    Zydis             # x86/x64 decode (same vendored v4.1.1 as slop_core)
    fmt::fmt
    spdlog::spdlog
    capstone          # ARM/ARM64/MIPS/PPC decode
    # hyperion itself no longer uses zlib (the FLIRT loader is gone), but
    # slop_core's zip_reader and the test fixtures get <zlib.h> through here
    ZLIB::ZLIB
)

if(WIN32)
    # PdbLoader walks symbol streams via DbgHelp
    target_link_libraries(slop_hyperion PRIVATE dbghelp)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    # Vendored engine: keep the build quiet, we do not own its warnings
    target_compile_options(slop_hyperion PRIVATE /W0 /permissive-)
    target_compile_definitions(slop_hyperion PRIVATE
        _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS NOMINMAX
    )
endif()

# Upstream hyperion compiled with this PCH; several sources rely on it for
# <algorithm>/<functional>/<filesystem>/<thread>/<mutex>/<atomic>/<span>
target_precompile_headers(slop_hyperion PRIVATE
    <cstdint>
    <string>
    <vector>
    <unordered_map>
    <unordered_set>
    <memory>
    <algorithm>
    <functional>
    <thread>
    <mutex>
    <atomic>
    <filesystem>
    <fstream>
    <optional>
    <cstring>
    <cstdio>
    <span>
)
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/analysis_db.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/types.h"
#include "core/types/type_system.h"
#include "core/disasm/disassembler.h"
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <string>
#include <mutex>
#include <set>

namespace hype {

enum class DataSize : u8 { Byte = 1, Word = 2, Dword = 4, Qword = 8 };

enum class DataStyle : u8 { Raw, Pointer, String, Import, Align };

// X64 is the Microsoft x64 convention (rcx, rdx, r8, r9); SysV is the System V
// AMD64 ABI used by PS4/FreeBSD, Linux and macOS (rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, r9);
// AAPCS64 passes x0-x7, AAPCS (32-bit ARM) r0-r3
enum class CallConv : u8 { Unknown, Cdecl, Stdcall, Fastcall, Thiscall, X64, SysV, AAPCS64, AAPCS };

// Default convention for an image: arch first, then the container's platform
inline CallConv default_callconv(Arch arch, ImageFormat format) {
    switch (arch) {
    case Arch::X64:   return format == ImageFormat::PE ? CallConv::X64 : CallConv::SysV;
    case Arch::ARM64: return CallConv::AAPCS64;
    case Arch::ARM:   return CallConv::AAPCS;
    case Arch::X86:   return CallConv::Cdecl;
    default:          return CallConv::Unknown;
    }
}

inline const char* callconv_name(CallConv c) {
    switch (c) {
    case CallConv::Cdecl:    return "cdecl";
    case CallConv::Stdcall:  return "stdcall";
    case CallConv::Fastcall: return "fastcall";
    case CallConv::Thiscall: return "thiscall";
    case CallConv::X64:      return "win64";
    case CallConv::SysV:     return "sysv_amd64";
    case CallConv::AAPCS64:  return "aapcs64";
    case CallConv::AAPCS:    return "aapcs";
    default:                 return "unknown";
    }
}

struct DataItem {
    va_t      addr;
    DataSize  size;
    DataStyle style = DataStyle::Raw;
    bool      is_string = false;
};

struct BasicBlock {
    va_t              start;
    va_t              end;
    std::vector<Insn> insns;
    std::vector<va_t> succs;
    std::vector<va_t> preds;
};

struct LoopInfo {
    va_t header;
    va_t back_edge_src;
    u16  induction_reg = 0;
};

struct Function {
    va_t                                     entry;
    std::string                              name;
    std::vector<va_t>                        block_addrs;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, BasicBlock>     blocks;
    bool                                     analyzed = false;
    bool                                     noreturn = false;
    CallConv                                 callconv = CallConv::Unknown;
    std::vector<LoopInfo>                    loops;
    std::vector<std::pair<va_t, va_t>>        ranges;
};

enum class XrefType : u8 { CodeCall, CodeJump, DataRead, DataWrite, DataOffset };

struct Xref {
    va_t     from;
    va_t     to;
    XrefType type;
};

struct Vtable {
    va_t              addr;
    std::vector<va_t> entries;
};

struct Global {
    va_t        addr;
    u32         size;
    std::string name;
};

struct FuncSignature {
    std::vector<std::string> param_names;
    std::vector<std::string> param_types;
    std::string return_type = "int64_t";
    int param_count = 0;
};

struct AnalysisDB {
    Arch                                        arch = Arch::X64;
    CallConv                                    abi = CallConv::X64;   // image default, see default_callconv
    va_t                                        image_base = 0;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, Insn>              insns;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, Function>          funcs;
    std::vector<Xref>                           xrefs;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::vector<Xref>> xrefs_to;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::vector<Xref>> xrefs_from;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::string>       names;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::string>       comments;
    std::vector<std::pair<va_t, std::string>>   strings;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, DataItem>          data_items;
    std::unordered_set<va_t>                    hex_display;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::vector<u8>>   patches;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, u32>              applied_types;
    std::vector<Vtable>                         vtables;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, Global>            globals;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, va_t>              resolved_indirect;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, FuncSignature>     signatures;
    // call instruction VA -> parameter types of its direct callee, filled by
    // the one-level inter-procedural pass (propagate_call_arg_types)
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::vector<std::string>> call_arg_types;
    TypeSystem                                  types;
    mutable std::mutex                          mtx;

    void add_xref(const Xref& x) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        add_xref_unlocked(x);
    }

    void add_xref_unlocked(const Xref& x) {
        xrefs.push_back(x);
        xrefs_to[x.to].push_back(x);
        xrefs_from[x.from].push_back(x);
    }

    void add_func(Function f) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        auto e = f.entry;
        funcs[e] = std::move(f);
    }

    void set_name(va_t addr, std::string n) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        names[addr] = std::move(n);
    }

    void define_data(va_t addr, DataSize sz, DataStyle style = DataStyle::Raw) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        insns.erase(addr);
        data_items[addr] = {addr, sz, style, false};
    }

    void define_string(va_t addr) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        insns.erase(addr);
        data_items[addr] = {addr, DataSize::Byte, DataStyle::String, true};
    }

    void undefine(va_t addr) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        insns.erase(addr);
        data_items.erase(addr);
    }

    void toggle_hex(va_t addr) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        if (hex_display.count(addr)) hex_display.erase(addr);
        else hex_display.insert(addr);
    }

    void patch_nop(va_t addr, u8 len) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mtx);
        patches[addr] = std::vector<u8>(len, 0x90);
    }
};

}
```
