`src/hyperion/core/analysis/analyzer.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/loader/pe_loader.h"
#include "core/disasm/disassembler.h"
#include "core/disasm/capstone_disasm.h"
#include "analysis_db.h"
#include "signatures.h"
#include "rtti.h"
#include "core/dotnet/dotnet_disasm.h"
#include "threading/worker_pool.h"
#include "threading/task_scheduler.h"
#include "threading/parallel.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <mutex>
#include <queue>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace hype {

// This thread's Capstone handle for `arch` (opened on first use). Capstone
// handles carry decode state, so sharing one across workers meant a mutex
// around every ARM decode; one handle per thread decodes in parallel
CapstoneDisasm& thread_capstone(Arch arch);

// One-level inter-procedural type propagation, both bounded single passes.
// propagate_call_arg_types copies each direct callee's parameter types onto
// the call instruction (AnalysisDB::call_arg_types) so callers render typed
// arguments. promote_rtti_this_types turns the first parameter of every
// method recovered through RTTI into `Class* this`. Both return how many
// entries they filled; neither invents types for unanalyzed code.
size_t propagate_call_arg_types(AnalysisDB& db);
size_t promote_rtti_this_types(const std::vector<RTTIClass>& classes, AnalysisDB& db);

class Analyzer {
public:
    Analyzer(PEImage& img, WorkerPool& pool);

    void run();
    void apply_signatures();
    float progress() const { return progress_.load(); }

    // Instruction ceiling for the descent phases, 0 for unlimited. An image
    // whose code section runs to hundreds of megabytes decodes to tens of
    // millions of instructions, and the DB keeps one record per instruction
    // plus another per basic block, so an unbounded run on such an image
    // exhausts memory long before it finishes. With a budget the run lands on
    // a smaller but coherent DB and says so through budget_reached()
    void set_insn_budget(size_t max_insns) { insn_budget_ = max_insns; }
    size_t insn_budget() const { return insn_budget_; }
    bool budget_reached() const { return budget_hit_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

    // Cooperative cancellation: set from any thread; run() checks between
    // phases (and inside the big walks) and bails out leaving the DB
    // partially built. A cancelled run never reports ready.
    void request_cancel() {
        cancel_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        cancel_shared_->store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    bool was_cancelled() const { return cancelled_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

    AnalysisDB& db() { return db_; }
    const AnalysisDB& db() const { return db_; }
    SignatureMatcher& sig_matcher() { return sigmatch_; }
    const SignatureMatcher& sig_matcher() const { return sigmatch_; }
    RTTIParser& rtti_parser() { return rtti_; }
    const RTTIParser& rtti_parser() const { return rtti_; }
    // Managed-code view. valid() only after run() on a CLI image; the IL
    // methods it recovers are also folded into db() as Functions/Insns.
    const DotNetDisassembler& dotnet() const { return dotnet_; }
    bool is_dotnet() const { return dotnet_.valid(); }

private:
    void recursive_descent();
    void detect_functions();
    void detect_thunks();
    // `only`, when set, restricts the pass to those function entries. The
    // fixed point uses it so later rounds touch just the functions whose CFG
    // actually changed instead of rebuilding the whole image every round
    void build_cfgs(const std::unordered_set<va_t>* only = nullptr);
    // One function's CFG; disjoint per function so the parallel_for in
    // build_cfgs can run these concurrently (reads shared maps, writes only
    // the one Function).
    void build_one_cfg(Function& func);
    void discover_cfg_fixed_point();
    void remove_junk_code();
    void detect_switches(const std::unordered_set<va_t>* only = nullptr);
    void build_xrefs();
    void find_strings();
    void find_string_refs();
    void detect_vtables();
    bool imm_is_address(const Insn& insn, va_t v) const;
    u32 find_arm64_page_refs(const std::unordered_set<va_t>& str_addrs);
    int param_reg_index(u16 reg) const;            // -1 unless an ABI arg register
    int count_register_params(const Function& func) const;
    void detect_globals();
    void apply_names();
    void detect_noreturn();
    void detect_tail_calls();
    void detect_calling_conventions();
    void detect_main();
    void propagate_dataflow(const std::unordered_set<va_t>* only = nullptr);
    void detect_loops();
    void recover_structs();
    void populate_data_sections();
    void propagate_interproc_types();

    void descend(va_t addr, std::unordered_set<va_t>& visited);
    // Shared BFS body: drains a thread-local queue while `visited` and the
    // instruction DB stay shared under descend_mu_, so every address is
    // decoded exactly once no matter how roots are sharded across workers.
    void descend_queue(std::queue<va_t>& wl, std::unordered_set<va_t>& visited);
    bool over_budget();   // latches budget_hit_ the first time it trips
    const u8* va_to_ptr(va_t addr, size_t* max_len = nullptr);
    bool is_iat_addr(va_t addr) const;
    bool is_code_addr(va_t addr) const;
    bool in_section(va_t addr, const char* name) const;
    const Segment* section_for(va_t addr) const;

    // Address -> segment in log(segments) instead of a linear walk. The walk
    // showed up everywhere: once per decoded instruction in descend, once per
    // pointer slot across every data section in the vtable and data sweeps
    struct SegmentSpan {
        va_t           va;
        va_t           end;      // va + virtual size
        const Segment* seg;
        bool           executable;
    };
    void build_segment_index();
    const SegmentSpan* span_for(va_t addr) const;
    std::vector<SegmentSpan> segment_index_;   // sorted by va, non-overlapping

    bool use_capstone() const {
        return img_.arch != Arch::X86 && img_.arch != Arch::X64;
    }
    bool decode_insn(va_t addr, const u8* data, size_t len, Insn& out);
    std::vector<Insn> decode_insn_range(va_t start, const u8* data, size_t len);

    PEImage&           img_;
    Disassembler       disasm_;
    AnalysisDB         db_;
    WorkerPool&        pool_;
    TaskScheduler      sched_;
    SignatureMatcher   sigmatch_;
    RTTIParser         rtti_;
    DotNetDisassembler dotnet_;
    std::atomic<float> progress_{0.f};
    std::atomic<bool>  cancel_{false};
    std::atomic<bool>  cancelled_{false};
    size_t             insn_budget_ = 0;
    std::atomic<bool>  budget_hit_{false};
    // Shared with sweep workers so decode_range can probe cancellation.
    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> cancel_shared_{std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false)};
    // Guards the shared descent state (visited sets + db_.insns inserts +
    // budget accounting). Decode itself runs outside the lock (Zydis is
    // stateless, Capstone handles are per thread).
    std::mutex descend_mu_;
    // Guards recovered_edges_, cfg_dirty_ and resolved_indirect during the
    // parallel per-function passes (switches, dataflow).
    std::mutex edge_mu_;
    // Guards db_.funcs structure (insert/find) during parallel phases whose
    // hot loop is otherwise read-only (thunk scan). Value writes stay
    // disjoint per function.
    std::mutex funcs_mu_;
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::vector<va_t>> recovered_edges_;
    // functions that gained an edge or a resolved target in the last round
    std::unordered_set<va_t> cfg_dirty_;
};

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/bindiff.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "bindiff.h"
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <numeric>

namespace hype {

uint64_t BinDiff::now_ms() {
    return static_cast<uint64_t>(
        std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}

std::vector<DiffResult> BinDiff::compare(const AnalysisDB& a, const AnalysisDB& b) {
    return compare_budgeted(a, b, options_t{}).results;
}

BinDiff::outcome_t BinDiff::compare_budgeted(const AnalysisDB& a,
                                             const AnalysisDB& b,
                                             const options_t& opt) {
    outcome_t out;
    std::unordered_set<va_t> matched_b;

    // Name index for the fast path: legacy code scanned all of b for every
    // function in a (O(N*M) string compares before any similarity work).
    std::unordered_multimap<std::string, va_t> names_b;
    names_b.reserve(b.funcs.size() * 2 + 1);
    for (const auto& [eb, fb] : b.funcs) {
        if (!fb.name.empty()) names_b.emplace(fb.name, eb);
    }

    // Byte cache: legacy recomputed func_bytes(fa) once per pair (each call
    // sorts blocks + copies all insn bytes), turning O(N*M) pairs into
    // O(N*M*(sort+alloc)). Cache once per function instead.
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::vector<u8>> bytes_a, bytes_b;
    bytes_a.reserve(a.funcs.size() * 2 + 1);
    bytes_b.reserve(b.funcs.size() * 2 + 1);
    auto bytes_of_a = [&](va_t va, const Function& f) -> const std::vector<u8>& {
        auto it = bytes_a.find(va);
        if (it != bytes_a.end()) return it->second;
        return bytes_a.emplace(va, func_bytes(f)).first->second;
    };
    auto bytes_of_b = [&](va_t va, const Function& f) -> const std::vector<u8>& {
        auto it = bytes_b.find(va);
        if (it != bytes_b.end()) return it->second;
        return bytes_b.emplace(va, func_bytes(f)).first->second;
    };

    auto check_stop = [&]() -> bool {
        if (opt.cancel && *opt.cancel && (*opt.cancel)()) {
            out.cancelled = true;
            return true;
        }
        if (opt.deadline_ms && now_ms() >= opt.deadline_ms) {
            out.timed_out = true;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    };
    auto report_progress = [&]() {
        if (!opt.progress || !*opt.progress || !opt.max_pairs) return;
        (*opt.progress)(std::min(1.0f, static_cast<float>(out.pairs_evaluated) /
                                           static_cast<float>(opt.max_pairs)));
    };

    for (const auto& [ea, fa] : a.funcs) {
        if (check_stop()) break;
        bool found = false;
        if (!fa.name.empty()) {
            auto range = names_b.equal_range(fa.name);
            for (auto it = range.first; it != range.second; ++it) {
                const va_t eb = it->second;
                if (matched_b.count(eb)) continue;
                const auto fit = b.funcs.find(eb);
                if (fit == b.funcs.end()) continue;
                const float sim = compute_similarity_cached(
                    bytes_of_a(ea, fa), bytes_of_b(eb, fit->second));
                ++out.pairs_evaluated;
                auto st = sim >= 0.999f ? DiffResult::Identical : DiffResult::Modified;
                out.results.push_back({ea, eb, fa.name, sim, st});
                matched_b.insert(eb);
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (found) continue;

        float best_sim = 0.f;
        va_t best_eb = 0;
        const auto& ba = bytes_of_a(ea, fa);
        for (const auto& [eb, fb] : b.funcs) {
            if (matched_b.count(eb)) continue;
            const auto& bb = bytes_of_b(eb, fb);
            // Size prefilter: byte-compare pairs 4x apart cannot reach 0.5.
            if (!ba.empty() && !bb.empty()) {
                const size_t mx = std::max(ba.size(), bb.size());
                const size_t mn = std::min(ba.size(), bb.size());
                if (mx > static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<float>(mn) * opt.size_prefilter_ratio)) {
                    ++out.pairs_skipped_size;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (opt.max_pairs && out.pairs_evaluated >= opt.max_pairs) {
                out.timed_out = true;
                break;
            }
            const float sim = compute_similarity_cached(ba, bb);
            ++out.pairs_evaluated;
            if (sim > best_sim) { best_sim = sim; best_eb = eb; }
            if ((out.pairs_evaluated & 0xFFF) == 0) {
                report_progress();
                if (check_stop()) break;
            }
        }
        if (out.cancelled || out.timed_out) {
            // Budget exhausted: this and all remaining a-funcs report as
            // removed (the trailing b-loop reports unmatched as added), so
            // totals stay meaningful without more pair evaluations.
            std::string nm = fa.name.empty() ? fmt::format("sub_{:X}", ea) : fa.name;
            out.results.push_back({ea, 0, nm, 0.f, DiffResult::Removed});
            continue;
        }
        if (best_sim >= 0.5f && best_eb) {
            auto st = best_sim >= 0.999f ? DiffResult::Identical : DiffResult::Modified;
            std::string nm = fa.name.empty() ? fmt::format("sub_{:X}", ea) : fa.name;
            out.results.push_back({ea, best_eb, nm, best_sim, st});
            matched_b.insert(best_eb);
        } else {
            std::string nm = fa.name.empty() ? fmt::format("sub_{:X}", ea) : fa.name;
            out.results.push_back({ea, 0, nm, 0.f, DiffResult::Removed});
        }
    }

    for (const auto& [eb, fb] : b.funcs) {
        if (matched_b.count(eb)) continue;
        std::string nm = fb.name.empty() ? fmt::format("sub_{:X}", eb) : fb.name;
        out.results.push_back({0, eb, nm, 0.f, DiffResult::Added});
    }

    std::sort(out.results.begin(), out.results.end(), [](const auto& x, const auto& y) {
        return x.status < y.status;
    });
    return out;
}

float BinDiff::compute_similarity(const Function& fa, const Function& fb) {
    auto ba = func_bytes(fa);
    auto bb = func_bytes(fb);
    return compute_similarity_cached(ba, bb);
}

float BinDiff::compute_similarity_cached(const std::vector<u8>& ba,
                                         const std::vector<u8>& bb) {
    if (ba.empty() && bb.empty()) return 1.f;
    if (ba.empty() || bb.empty()) return 0.f;

    size_t match = 0;
    size_t total = std::max(ba.size(), bb.size());
    size_t cmp_len = std::min(ba.size(), bb.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < cmp_len; ++i)
        if (ba[i] == bb[i]) ++match;

    return static_cast<float>(match) / static_cast<float>(total);
}

std::vector<u8> BinDiff::func_bytes(const Function& f) {
    std::vector<u8> out;
    std::vector<const BasicBlock*> blocks;
    blocks.reserve(f.blocks.size());
    for (const auto& [_, bb] : f.blocks)
        blocks.push_back(&bb);
    std::sort(blocks.begin(), blocks.end(), [](const BasicBlock* a, const BasicBlock* b) {
        return a->start < b->start;
    });
    for (const BasicBlock* bb : blocks)
        for (const auto& insn : bb->insns)
            out.insert(out.end(), insn.bytes, insn.bytes + insn.len);
    return out;
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/bindiff.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "analysis_db.h"
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

namespace hype {

struct DiffResult {
    va_t        addr_a;
    va_t        addr_b;
    std::string name;
    float       similarity;
    enum Status : u8 { Added, Removed, Modified, Identical };
    Status      status;
};

class BinDiff {
public:
    struct options_t {
        // Abort the quadratic fallback once this many similarity pairs have
        // been evaluated; remaining functions are reported as added/removed.
        // 0 = no cap (legacy behavior, can hang on 10k+ function binaries).
        size_t max_pairs = 500000;
        // Skip byte-compare pairs whose sizes differ by more than this ratio.
        float size_prefilter_ratio = 4.0f;
        // Optional cooperative cancel + wall-clock deadline.
        const std::function<bool()>* cancel = nullptr;
        uint64_t deadline_ms = 0; // steady_clock ms, 0 = none
        // Optional progress sink (0..1 fraction of max_pairs), invoked
        // periodically from the quadratic fallback loop. May be null.
        const std::function<void(float)>* progress = nullptr;
    };
    struct outcome_t {
        std::vector<DiffResult> results;
        bool timed_out = false;
        bool cancelled = false;
        size_t pairs_evaluated = 0;
        size_t pairs_skipped_size = 0;
    };
    std::vector<DiffResult> compare(const AnalysisDB& a, const AnalysisDB& b);
    // no default argument here: options_t is a nested class and its default
    // member initializers are not in scope inside the enclosing class (clang
    // diagnoses `opt = {}`; MSVC accepts it as an extension). The 2-arg
    // overload forwards from a member body, where the class is complete.
    outcome_t compare_budgeted(const AnalysisDB& a, const AnalysisDB& b) {
        return compare_budgeted(a, b, options_t{});
    }
    outcome_t compare_budgeted(const AnalysisDB& a, const AnalysisDB& b,
                               const options_t& opt);

private:
    float compute_similarity(const Function& fa, const Function& fb);
    float compute_similarity_cached(const std::vector<u8>& ba,
                                    const std::vector<u8>& bb);
    std::vector<u8> func_bytes(const Function& f);
    static uint64_t now_ms();
};

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/itanium_rtti.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "itanium_rtti.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace hype {

namespace {

constexpr size_t kMaxNameLen = 1024;
constexpr int    kMaxDepth   = 64;

std::string join(const std::vector<std::string>& parts) {
    std::string out;
    for (const auto& p : parts) {
        if (p.empty()) continue;
        if (!out.empty()) out += ", ";
        out += p;
    }
    return out;
}

// The <type> subset type_info names use: class/enum names (nested, std::,
// template, anonymous namespace, unnamed types and lambdas, abi tags) and,
// inside template arguments, builtins, cv/pointer/reference/array/function/
// member-pointer types, literals, packs and substitutions
class Demangler {
public:
    explicit Demangler(std::string_view s) : s_(s) {}

    std::optional<std::string> class_type() {
        const char c = peek();
        if (!(c == 'N' || c == 'S' || is_digit(c))) return std::nullopt;
        auto t = type();
        if (!t || p_ != s_.size()) return std::nullopt;
        return t;
    }

private:
    std::string_view         s_;
    size_t                   p_ = 0;
    int                      depth_ = 0;
    std::vector<std::string> subs_;

    struct depth_guard {
        int& d;
        ~depth_guard() { --d; }
    };

    char peek(size_t k = 0) const { return p_ + k < s_.size() ? s_[p_ + k] : '\0'; }
    bool eof() const { return p_ >= s_.size(); }
    bool eat(char c) {
        if (peek() != c) return false;
        ++p_;
        return true;
    }
    static bool is_digit(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }

    bool number(size_t& n) {
        if (!is_digit(peek())) return false;
        n = 0;
        while (is_digit(peek())) {
            n = n * 10 + static_cast<size_t>(s_[p_++] - '0');
            if (n > kMaxNameLen) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    // [<number>] _  ->  1 for "_", n + 2 for "<n>_"
    std::optional<size_t> discriminator() {
        size_t idx = 1;
        if (is_digit(peek())) {
            size_t n = 0;
            if (!number(n)) return std::nullopt;
            idx = n + 2;
        }
        if (!eat('_')) return std::nullopt;
        return idx;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> source_name() {
        size_t n = 0;
        if (!number(n) || n == 0 || p_ + n > s_.size()) return std::nullopt;
        const std::string_view id = s_.substr(p_, n);
        p_ += n;
        if (id.rfind("_GLOBAL__N", 0) == 0) return std::string("(anonymous namespace)");
        if (is_digit(id[0])) return std::nullopt;
        for (char c : id)
            if (!(std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '_' || c == '$' || c == '.'))
                return std::nullopt;
        return std::string(id);
    }

    bool abi_tags(std::string& name) {
        while (peek() == 'B') {
            ++p_;
            auto tag = source_name();
            if (!tag) return false;
            name += "[abi:" + *tag + "]";
        }
        return true;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> unqualified_name() {
        if (is_digit(peek())) return source_name();
        if (peek() == 'U' && peek(1) == 't') {
            p_ += 2;
            auto idx = discriminator();
            if (!idx) return std::nullopt;
            return "{unnamed type#" + std::to_string(*idx) + "}";
        }
        if (peek() == 'U' && peek(1) == 'l') {
            p_ += 2;
            std::vector<std::string> params;
            while (!eof() && peek() != 'E') {
                auto t = type();
                if (!t) return std::nullopt;
                params.push_back(*t);
            }
            if (!eat('E')) return std::nullopt;
            auto idx = discriminator();
            if (!idx) return std::nullopt;
            if (params.size() == 1 && params[0] == "void") params.clear();
            return "{lambda(" + join(params) + ")#" + std::to_string(*idx) + "}";
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    // at 'S', not "St"
    std::optional<std::string> substitution() {
        if (!eat('S')) return std::nullopt;
        switch (peek()) {
        case 'a': ++p_; return std::string("std::allocator");
        case 'b': ++p_; return std::string("std::basic_string");
        case 's': ++p_; return std::string("std::string");
        case 'i': ++p_; return std::string("std::istream");
        case 'o': ++p_; return std::string("std::ostream");
        case 'd': ++p_; return std::string("std::iostream");
        case '_':
            ++p_;
            if (subs_.empty()) return std::nullopt;
            return subs_[0];
        default: break;
        }
        size_t id = 0;
        bool any = false;
        while (is_digit(peek()) || (peek() >= 'A' && peek() <= 'Z')) {
            const char c = s_[p_++];
            id = id * 36 + static_cast<size_t>(is_digit(c) ? c - '0' : c - 'A' + 10);
            any = true;
            if (id > 4096) return std::nullopt;
        }
        if (!any || !eat('_') || id + 1 >= subs_.size()) return std::nullopt;
        return subs_[id + 1];
    }

    std::optional<std::string> template_args() {
        if (!eat('I')) return std::nullopt;
        std::vector<std::string> args;
        while (!eof() && peek() != 'E') {
            auto a = template_arg();
            if (!a) return std::nullopt;
            args.push_back(*a);
        }
        if (!eat('E')) return std::nullopt;
        return "<" + join(args) + ">";
    }

    std::optional<std::string> template_arg() {
        if (peek() == 'L') {
            ++p_;
            if (peek() == '_') return std::nullopt;   // L_Z <encoding> E
            auto t = type();
            if (!t) return std::nullopt;
            const bool neg = eat('n');
            std::string digits;
            while (!eof() && peek() != 'E') digits += s_[p_++];
            if (!eat('E') || digits.empty()) return std::nullopt;
            if (*t == "bool") return std::string(digits == "0" ? "false" : "true");
            const std::string v = (neg ? "-" : "") + digits;
            if (*t == "int") return v;
            if (*t == "unsigned int") return v + "u";
            if (*t == "long") return v + "l";
            if (*t == "unsigned long") return v + "ul";
            if (*t == "long long") return v + "ll";
            if (*t == "unsigned long long") return v + "ull";
            return "(" + *t + ")" + v;
        }
        if (peek() == 'J') {
            ++p_;
            std::vector<std::string> pack;
            while (!eof() && peek() != 'E') {
                auto a = template_arg();
                if (!a) return std::nullopt;
                pack.push_back(*a);
            }
            if (!eat('E')) return std::nullopt;
            return join(pack);
        }
        if (peek() == 'X') return std::nullopt;   // expressions
        return type();
    }

    std::optional<std::string> builtin() {
        static constexpr std::pair<char, const char*> kOne[] = {
            {'v', "void"}, {'w', "wchar_t"}, {'b', "bool"}, {'c', "char"},
            {'a', "signed char"}, {'h', "unsigned char"}, {'s', "short"},
            {'t', "unsigned short"}, {'i', "int"}, {'j', "unsigned int"},
            {'l', "long"}, {'m', "unsigned long"}, {'x', "long long"},
            {'y', "unsigned long long"}, {'n', "__int128"}, {'o', "unsigned __int128"},
            {'f', "float"}, {'d', "double"}, {'e', "long double"},
            {'g', "__float128"}, {'z', "..."}};
        for (const auto& [k, v] : kOne)
            if (peek() == k) { ++p_; return std::string(v); }
        if (peek() == 'D') {
            static constexpr std::pair<char, const char*> kTwo[] = {
                {'n', "decltype(nullptr)"}, {'s', "char16_t"}, {'i', "char32_t"},
                {'u', "char8_t"}, {'a', "auto"}, {'c', "decltype(auto)"}, {'h', "half"}};
            for (const auto& [k, v] : kTwo)
                if (peek(1) == k) { p_ += 2; return std::string(v); }
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> template_param() {   // at 'T'
        ++p_;
        size_t idx = 0;
        if (is_digit(peek())) {
            size_t n = 0;
            if (!number(n)) return std::nullopt;
            idx = n + 1;
        }
        if (!eat('_')) return std::nullopt;
        return "T" + std::to_string(idx);
    }

    std::optional<std::string> nested_name() {
        if (!eat('N')) return std::nullopt;
        while (peek() == 'r' || peek() == 'V' || peek() == 'K') ++p_;
        if (peek() == 'R' || peek() == 'O') ++p_;
        std::string prefix;
        while (!eof() && peek() != 'E') {
            if (peek() == 'S') {
                if (peek(1) == 't') {        // "std" is never a substitution
                    if (!prefix.empty()) return std::nullopt;
                    p_ += 2;
                    prefix = "std";
                    continue;
                }
                auto sub = substitution();
                if (!sub || !prefix.empty()) return std::nullopt;
                prefix = *sub;
                continue;
            }
            if (peek() == 'I') {
                if (prefix.empty()) return std::nullopt;
                auto a = template_args();
                if (!a) return std::nullopt;
                prefix += *a;
                subs_.push_back(prefix);
                continue;
            }
            if (peek() == 'T') {
                if (!prefix.empty()) return std::nullopt;
                auto t = template_param();
                if (!t) return std::nullopt;
                prefix = *t;
                subs_.push_back(prefix);
                continue;
            }
            auto u = unqualified_name();
            if (!u) return std::nullopt;
            std::string name = *u;
            if (!abi_tags(name)) return std::nullopt;
            prefix = prefix.empty() ? name : prefix + "::" + name;
            subs_.push_back(prefix);
        }
        if (!eat('E') || prefix.empty() || prefix == "std") return std::nullopt;
        return prefix;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> class_enum_type() {
        if (peek() == 'N') return nested_name();
        std::string name;
        if (peek() == 'S' && peek(1) == 't') {
            p_ += 2;
            auto u = unqualified_name();
            if (!u) return std::nullopt;
            name = "std::" + *u;
        } else {
            auto u = unqualified_name();
            if (!u) return std::nullopt;
            name = *u;
        }
        if (!abi_tags(name)) return std::nullopt;
        subs_.push_back(name);
        if (peek() == 'I') {
            auto a = template_args();
            if (!a) return std::nullopt;
            name += *a;
            subs_.push_back(name);
        }
        return name;
    }

    std::optional<std::string> type() {
        if (++depth_ > kMaxDepth) { --depth_; return std::nullopt; }
        depth_guard guard{depth_};

        if (auto b = builtin()) return b;
        const char c = peek();
        switch (c) {
        case 'P': case 'R': case 'O': {
            ++p_;
            auto t = type();
            if (!t) return std::nullopt;
            std::string r = *t + (c == 'P' ? "*" : c == 'R' ? "&" : "&&");
            subs_.push_back(r);
            return r;
        }
        case 'K': case 'V': case 'r': {
            ++p_;
            auto t = type();
            if (!t) return std::nullopt;
            std::string r = *t + (c == 'K' ? " const" : c == 'V' ? " volatile" : " restrict");
            subs_.push_back(r);
            return r;
        }
        case 'A': {
            ++p_;
            size_t n = 0;
            if (!number(n) || !eat('_')) return std::nullopt;
            auto t = type();
            if (!t) return std::nullopt;
            std::string r = *t + "[" + std::to_string(n) + "]";
            subs_.push_back(r);
            return r;
        }
        case 'F': {
            ++p_;
            eat('Y');
            auto ret = type();
            if (!ret) return std::nullopt;
            std::vector<std::string> params;
            while (!eof() && peek() != 'E') {
                if ((peek() == 'R' || peek() == 'O') && peek(1) == 'E') { ++p_; continue; }
                auto t = type();
                if (!t) return std::nullopt;
                params.push_back(*t);
            }
            if (!eat('E')) return std::nullopt;
            if (params.size() == 1 && params[0] == "void") params.clear();
            std::string r = *ret + " (" + join(params) + ")";
            subs_.push_back(r);
            return r;
        }
        case 'M': {
            ++p_;
            auto cls = type();
            if (!cls) return std::nullopt;
            auto mem = type();
            if (!mem) return std::nullopt;
            std::string r = *mem + " " + *cls + "::*";
            subs_.push_back(r);
            return r;
        }
        case 'T': {
            auto t = template_param();
            if (!t) return std::nullopt;
            std::string r = *t;
            subs_.push_back(r);
            if (peek() == 'I') {
                auto a = template_args();
                if (!a) return std::nullopt;
                r += *a;
                subs_.push_back(r);
            }
            return r;
        }
        case 'D':
            if (peek(1) == 'p') {
                p_ += 2;
                auto t = type();
                if (!t) return std::nullopt;
                std::string r = *t + "...";
                subs_.push_back(r);
                return r;
            }
            return std::nullopt;   // decltype / vendor types
        case 'S':
            if (peek(1) != 't') {
                auto sub = substitution();
                if (!sub) return std::nullopt;
                if (peek() == 'I') {
                    auto a = template_args();
                    if (!a) return std::nullopt;
                    std::string r = *sub + *a;
                    subs_.push_back(r);
                    return r;
                }
                return sub;
            }
            return class_enum_type();
        default:
            if (c == 'N' || is_digit(c) || c == 'U') return class_enum_type();
            return std::nullopt;
        }
    }
};

// Bounds-checked reads over the spans, sorted by VA
class Reader {
public:
    Reader(std::span<const RttiSpan> spans, unsigned ps)
        : spans_(spans.begin(), spans.end()), ps_(ps) {
        std::erase_if(spans_, [](const RttiSpan& s) { return s.data.empty(); });
        std::sort(spans_.begin(), spans_.end(),
                  [](const RttiSpan& a, const RttiSpan& b) { return a.va < b.va; });
    }

    const std::vector<RttiSpan>& spans() const { return spans_; }

    const RttiSpan* find(va_t va) const {
        auto it = std::upper_bound(spans_.begin(), spans_.end(), va,
                                   [](va_t v, const RttiSpan& s) { return v < s.va; });
        // overlapping spans (RELRO inside a LOAD): any earlier one may hold va
        for (int back = 0; it != spans_.begin() && back < 4; ++back) {
            --it;
            if (va - it->va < it->data.size()) return &*it;
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    bool read(va_t va, void* out, size_t n) const {
        const RttiSpan* s = find(va);
        if (!s) return false;
        const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(va - s->va);
        if (off + n > s->data.size()) return false;
        std::memcpy(out, s->data.data() + off, n);
        return true;
    }

    std::optional<u64> ptr(va_t va) const {
        if (ps_ == 8) {
            u64 v = 0;
            if (!read(va, &v, 8)) return std::nullopt;
            return v;
        }
        u32 v = 0;
        if (!read(va, &v, 4)) return std::nullopt;
        return v;
    }

    std::optional<i64> sptr(va_t va) const {
        auto v = ptr(va);
        if (!v) return std::nullopt;
        return ps_ == 8 ? static_cast<i64>(*v) : static_cast<i64>(static_cast<i32>(*v));
    }

    bool exec(va_t va) const {
        const RttiSpan* s = find(va);
        return s && s->exec;
    }

    std::optional<std::string_view> cstr(va_t va) const {
        const RttiSpan* s = find(va);
        if (!s) return std::nullopt;
        const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(va - s->va);
        const size_t lim = std::min(s->data.size(), off + kMaxNameLen + 1);
        size_t end = off;
        while (end < lim && s->data[end] != 0) ++end;
        if (end >= lim) return std::nullopt;
        return std::string_view(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(s->data.data() + off), end - off);
    }

private:
    std::vector<RttiSpan> spans_;
    unsigned              ps_;
};

} // namespace

std::optional<std::string> demangle_itanium_type(std::string_view mangled) {
    if (mangled.empty() || mangled.size() > kMaxNameLen) return std::nullopt;
    return Demangler(mangled).class_type();
}

std::vector<ItaniumClass> scan_itanium_rtti(std::span<const RttiSpan> spans, unsigned ptr_size) {
    if (ptr_size != 4 && ptr_size != 8) return {};
    const Reader rd(spans, ptr_size);
    const unsigned ps = ptr_size;

    // every pointer-aligned slot of every span, with its value
    const auto for_each_slot = [&](auto&& fn) {
        for (const auto& s : rd.spans()) {
            const va_t first = (s.va + ps - 1) / ps * ps;
            const va_t end   = s.va + s.data.size();
            for (va_t va = first; va + ps <= end; va += ps) {
                const u8* at = s.data.data() + (va - s.va);
                u64 v = 0;
                if (ps == 8) std::memcpy(&v, at, 8);
                else { u32 w = 0; std::memcpy(&w, at, 4); v = w; }
                fn(va, v);
            }
        }
    };

    struct ti_t {
        std::string       mangled, name;
        std::vector<va_t> bases, vtables, methods;
        bool              primary = false;
    };
    std::map<va_t, ti_t> tis;

    // pass 1: type_info objects, found by their name pointer (+P) landing on
    // a string that demangles as a class type
    std::unordered_map<va_t, std::optional<std::string>> names;
    for_each_slot([&](va_t slot, u64 v) {
        if (!v || slot < ps) return;
        const RttiSpan* tgt = rd.find(v);
        if (!tgt) return;
        const u8 c0 = tgt->data[static_cast<size_t>(v - tgt->va)];
        if (!(c0 == 'N' || c0 == 'S' || (c0 >= '1' && c0 <= '9'))) return;
        auto it = names.find(v);
        if (it == names.end()) {
            std::optional<std::string> dm;
            if (auto sv = rd.cstr(v)) dm = demangle_itanium_type(*sv);
            it = names.emplace(v, std::move(dm)).first;
        }
        if (!it->second) return;
        const va_t ti = slot - ps;
        if (tis.count(ti)) return;
        ti_t t;
        t.mangled = std::string(*rd.cstr(v));
        t.name    = *it->second;
        tis.emplace(ti, std::move(t));
    });
    if (tis.empty()) return {};

    // pass 2: __si_class_type_info (one base pointer) or
    // __vmi_class_type_info (flags, count, {base, offset_flags}...)
    std::unordered_set<va_t> base_slots;
    for (auto& [ti, t] : tis) {
        const va_t p2 = ti + 2 * ps;
        if (auto b = rd.ptr(p2); b && *b != ti && tis.count(*b)) {
            t.bases.push_back(*b);
            base_slots.insert(p2);
            continue;
        }
        u32 flags = 0, count = 0;
        if (!rd.read(p2, &flags, 4) || !rd.read(p2 + 4, &count, 4)) continue;
        if (flags > 3 || count == 0 || count > 64) continue;
        const va_t arr = p2 + 8;
        std::vector<va_t> bs;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            auto bp = rd.ptr(arr + i * 2ull * ps);
            if (!bp || *bp == ti || !tis.count(*bp)) { bs.clear(); break; }
            bs.push_back(*bp);
        }
        if (bs.empty()) continue;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) base_slots.insert(arr + i * 2ull * ps);
        t.bases = std::move(bs);
    }

    // pass 3: vtables, a type_info pointer preceded by offset_to_top (0 for
    // the primary vtable, minus the subobject offset for secondary ones)
    for_each_slot([&](va_t slot, u64 v) {
        if (!v || slot < ps || base_slots.count(slot) || tis.count(slot)) return;
        auto it = tis.find(v);
        if (it == tis.end()) return;
        auto top = rd.sptr(slot - ps);
        if (!top || *top > 0 || *top < -0x1000000) return;
        auto& t = it->second;
        const va_t ap = slot + ps;
        if (std::find(t.vtables.begin(), t.vtables.end(), ap) != t.vtables.end()) return;
        std::vector<va_t> methods;
        for (va_t e = ap; methods.size() < 4096; e += ps) {
            auto fn = rd.ptr(e);
            if (!fn || !*fn || !rd.exec(*fn)) break;
            methods.push_back(*fn);
        }
        if (*top == 0 && !t.primary) {
            t.vtables.insert(t.vtables.begin(), ap);
            t.methods = std::move(methods);
            t.primary = true;
        } else {
            t.vtables.push_back(ap);
        }
    });

    // a type_info nothing's vtable names (and no polymorphic class derives
    // from) is indistinguishable from a stray pointer to a lookalike string
    std::unordered_set<va_t> keep;
    for (const auto& [ti, t] : tis) {
        if (t.vtables.empty()) continue;
        keep.insert(ti);
        keep.insert(t.bases.begin(), t.bases.end());
    }

    std::vector<ItaniumClass> out;
    out.reserve(keep.size());
    for (const auto& [ti, t] : tis) {
        if (!keep.count(ti)) continue;
        ItaniumClass c;
        c.mangled   = t.mangled;
        c.name      = t.name;
        c.type_info = ti;
        c.vtables   = t.vtables;
        c.methods   = t.methods;
        for (va_t b : t.bases) c.bases.push_back(tis.at(b).name);
        out.push_back(std::move(c));
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const ItaniumClass& a, const ItaniumClass& b) {
        return a.name != b.name ? a.name < b.name : a.type_info < b.type_info;
    });
    return out;
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/itanium_rtti.h`:

```h
#pragma once
// Itanium C++ ABI RTTI / vtable recovery (clang and gcc on ELF: PS4 Orbis,
// Linux, Android). Works on any byte spans with their VAs so the analyzer
// (PEImage segments) and reverse-slop's quick scanner (pe_image_t sections)
// share one implementation. Pointers must already be relocated
//
// layouts (P = pointer size):
//   type_info            [vptr][const char* name]
//   __si_class_type_info [vptr][name][base type_info*]
//   __vmi_class_type_info[vptr][name][u32 flags][u32 base_count]
//                        {[base type_info*][long offset_flags]} * base_count
//   vtable               ...[offset_to_top][type_info*][vfn0][vfn1]...
//                        the object's vptr points at vfn0 (the address point)
#include "core/types.h"
#include <optional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace hype {

struct RttiSpan {
    va_t                va = 0;
    std::span<const u8> data;
    bool                exec = false;
};

struct ItaniumClass {
    std::string              mangled;     // type_info name string: "N3foo3BarE"
    std::string              name;        // demangled: "foo::Bar"
    va_t                     type_info = 0;
    std::vector<va_t>        vtables;     // address points, primary (offset_to_top 0) first
    std::vector<va_t>        methods;     // primary vtable's virtual functions
    std::vector<std::string> bases;       // direct bases, demangled
};

// Demangle a type_info name (an Itanium <type> without the _Z prefix) that
// names a class/struct/union/enum. nullopt for anything else or malformed
std::optional<std::string> demangle_itanium_type(std::string_view mangled);

// Classes that own at least one vtable, plus the bases they name. ptr_size
// is 8 (x64/AArch64) or 4 (x86/ARM)
std::vector<ItaniumClass> scan_itanium_rtti(std::span<const RttiSpan> spans,
                                            unsigned ptr_size = 8);

}
```

```cpp
constexpr bool table_sorted() {
    for (size_t i = 1; i < std::size(kTable); ++i)
        if (kTable[i - 1].num >= kTable[i].num) return false;
    return true;
}
static_assert(table_sorted(), "kTable must be strictly sorted by number");

} // namespace

const char* orbis_syscall_name(u64 num) noexcept {
    if (num > kTable[std::size(kTable) - 1].num) return nullptr;
    const auto it = std::lower_bound(
        std::begin(kTable), std::end(kTable), num,
        [](const entry_t& e, u64 n) { return e.num < n; });
    return (it != std::end(kTable) && it->num == num) ? it->name : nullptr;
}

size_t orbis_syscall_count() noexcept { return std::size(kTable); }

} // namespace hype
```

```h
#pragma once
// Orbis OS (PS4) syscall numbering: the FreeBSD 9 amd64 table the kernel was
// forked from plus Sony's additions from 532 up and the network slots Sony
// reused in the BSD compat range. The signature matcher names libkernel /
// payload-SDK syscall stubs from it; reverse-slop's xray and emulator reach
// it through slop::core::analysis::ps4_syscall_name
#include "core/types.h"
#include <cstddef>

namespace hype {

// Name without the "sys_" prefix ("getpid", "dynlib_dlsym"), nullptr for
// numbers that are unassigned, obsolete or compat-only on Orbis

// Number of named entries in the table
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/packer_detect.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "packer_detect.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <fmt/format.h>

namespace hype {

namespace {

bool sect_name_match(const Segment& seg, const char* name) {
    return seg.name == name;
}

bool has_section(const PEImage& img, const char* name) {
    for (auto& s : img.segments)
        if (sect_name_match(s, name)) return true;
    return false;
}

bool has_wx_section(const PEImage& img) {
    for (auto& s : img.segments)
        if (s.writable() && s.executable()) return true;
    return false;
}

} // anon

float PackerDetector::section_entropy(const Segment& seg) const {
    if (seg.data.empty()) return 0.f;
    u32 freq[256] = {};
    for (u8 b : seg.data) ++freq[b];
    double ent = 0.0;
    double total = static_cast<double>(seg.data.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
        if (freq[i] == 0) continue;
        double p = freq[i] / total;
        ent -= p * std::log2(p);
    }
    return static_cast<float>(ent);
}

bool PackerDetector::entry_in_section(const PEImage& img, const Segment& seg) const {
    return img.entry >= seg.va && img.entry < seg.va + seg.size;
}

int PackerDetector::section_index_of_entry(const PEImage& img) const {
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(img.segments.size()); ++i) {
        if (entry_in_section(img, img.segments[i])) return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

std::vector<PackerInfo> PackerDetector::detect(const PEImage& img) {
    std::vector<PackerInfo> results;
    check_upx(img, results);
    check_themida(img, results);
    check_vmprotect(img, results);
    check_aspack(img, results);
    check_pecompact(img, results);
    check_mpress(img, results);
    if (results.empty())
        check_generic(img, results);
    return results;
}

bool PackerDetector::check_upx(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    bool has_upx_sec = has_section(img, "UPX0") || has_section(img, "UPX1") || has_section(img, ".UPX");
    int ep_idx = section_index_of_entry(img);
    bool ep_last = ep_idx >= 0 && ep_idx == static_cast<int>(img.segments.size()) - 1;
    bool low_imports = img.imports.size() <= 3;

    float conf = 0.f;
    std::string det;
    if (has_upx_sec) { conf += 0.5f; det += "UPX section names; "; }
    if (ep_last)     { conf += 0.25f; det += "EP in last section; "; }
    if (low_imports) { conf += 0.2f; det += fmt::format("{} imports; ", img.imports.size()); }

    if (conf >= 0.4f) {
        conf = (std::min)(conf, 1.f);
        out.push_back({"UPX", conf, det});
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool PackerDetector::check_themida(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    bool has_sec = has_section(img, ".themida") || has_section(img, ".winlice");
    float max_ent = 0.f;
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.executable()) max_ent = (std::max)(max_ent, section_entropy(seg));
    }
    bool high_ent = max_ent > 7.8f;

    float conf = 0.f;
    std::string det;
    if (has_sec)  { conf += 0.6f; det += "Themida/WinLicense section; "; }
    if (high_ent) { conf += 0.3f; det += fmt::format("high entropy {:.2f}; ", max_ent); }

    if (conf >= 0.5f) {
        conf = (std::min)(conf, 1.f);
        out.push_back({"Themida/WinLicense", conf, det});
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool PackerDetector::check_vmprotect(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    bool has_sec = has_section(img, ".vmp0") || has_section(img, ".vmp1");
    int ep_idx = section_index_of_entry(img);
    bool ep_non_first = ep_idx > 0;
    float max_ent = 0.f;
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.executable()) max_ent = (std::max)(max_ent, section_entropy(seg));
    }
    bool high_ent = max_ent > 7.5f;

    float conf = 0.f;
    std::string det;
    if (has_sec)       { conf += 0.55f; det += "VMProtect section; "; }
    if (ep_non_first)  { conf += 0.2f; det += "EP not in first section; "; }
    if (high_ent)      { conf += 0.2f; det += fmt::format("entropy {:.2f}; ", max_ent); }

    if (conf >= 0.5f) {
        conf = (std::min)(conf, 1.f);
        out.push_back({"VMProtect", conf, det});
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool PackerDetector::check_aspack(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    if (has_section(img, ".aspack") || has_section(img, ".adata")) {
        out.push_back({"ASPack", 0.85f, "ASPack section names"});
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool PackerDetector::check_pecompact(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    if (has_section(img, ".pec") || has_section(img, "PEC2")) {
        out.push_back({"PECompact", 0.85f, "PECompact section names"});
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool PackerDetector::check_mpress(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    if (has_section(img, ".MPRESS1") || has_section(img, ".MPRESS2")) {
        out.push_back({"MPRESS", 0.9f, "MPRESS section names"});
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void PackerDetector::check_generic(const PEImage& img, std::vector<PackerInfo>& out) {
    float score = 0.f;
    std::string det;

    int ep_idx = section_index_of_entry(img);
    bool ep_in_text = false;
    if (ep_idx >= 0 && ep_idx < static_cast<int>(img.segments.size()))
        ep_in_text = img.segments[ep_idx].name == ".text";

    if (!ep_in_text && ep_idx >= 0) {
        score += 0.15f;
        det += "EP not in .text; ";
    }

    int high_ent_count = 0;
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.data.empty()) continue;
        if (section_entropy(seg) > 7.5f) ++high_ent_count;
    }
    if (high_ent_count > 0 && high_ent_count >= static_cast<int>(img.segments.size()) - 1) {
        score += 0.3f;
        det += fmt::format("{}/{} sections high entropy; ", high_ent_count, img.segments.size());
    }

    if (img.imports.size() < 5) {
        score += 0.2f;
        det += fmt::format("only {} imports; ", img.imports.size());
    }

    if (has_wx_section(img)) {
        score += 0.15f;
        det += "W+X section; ";
    }

    if (score >= 0.4f) {
        score = (std::min)(score, 1.f);
        out.push_back({"Generic packer", score, det});
    }
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/pdb_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "pdb_loader.h"
#include <spdlog/spdlog.h>
#include <fmt/format.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <dbghelp.h>
#endif

namespace hype {

std::filesystem::path PDBLoader::pdb_for(const std::filesystem::path& binary) {
    auto p = binary;
    p.replace_extension(".pdb");
    if (std::filesystem::exists(p)) return p;
    return {};
}

bool PDBLoader::load(const std::filesystem::path& pdb_path, va_t base, AnalysisDB& db) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(pdb_path)) {
        status_ = "No PDB found. For better analysis, place the .pdb next to the binary.";
        found_ = false;
        return false;
    }

    found_ = true;
    status_ = fmt::format("PDB found: {} \xe2\x80\x94 loading symbols", pdb_path.filename().string());
    spdlog::info("pdb: loading {}", pdb_path.string());

    HANDLE hProc = GetCurrentProcess();
    if (!SymInitialize(hProc, nullptr, FALSE)) {
        status_ = "PDB: SymInitialize failed";
        spdlog::warn("pdb: SymInitialize failed: {}", GetLastError());
        return false;
    }

    SymSetOptions(SYMOPT_UNDNAME | SYMOPT_DEFERRED_LOADS | SYMOPT_LOAD_LINES);

    DWORD64 mod_base = SymLoadModuleExW(hProc, nullptr, pdb_path.c_str(), nullptr,
                                         base, 0x7FFFFFFF, nullptr, 0);
    if (!mod_base) {
        spdlog::warn("pdb: SymLoadModuleEx failed: {}", GetLastError());
        SymCleanup(hProc);
        status_ = "PDB: SymLoadModuleEx failed";
        return false;
    }

    struct EnumCtx { AnalysisDB* db; u32 count; };
    EnumCtx ctx{&db, 0};

    SymEnumSymbols(hProc, mod_base, "*", [](PSYMBOL_INFO si, ULONG, PVOID user) -> BOOL {
        auto* c = static_cast<EnumCtx*>(user);
        if (!si->Name || !si->Name[0]) return TRUE;
        va_t addr = static_cast<va_t>(si->Address);
        std::string name(si->Name);

        c->db->set_name(addr, name);

        if (si->Tag == 5 /* SymTagFunction */) {
            auto fit = c->db->funcs.find(addr);
            if (fit != c->db->funcs.end())
                fit->second.name = name;
        }
        c->count++;
        return TRUE;
    }, &ctx);

    SymUnloadModule64(hProc, mod_base);
    SymCleanup(hProc);

    status_ = fmt::format("PDB: loaded {} symbols from {}", ctx.count, pdb_path.filename().string());
    spdlog::info("pdb: loaded {} symbols", ctx.count);
    return true;
#else
    (void)pdb_path; (void)base; (void)db;
    status_ = "PDB loading not supported on this platform";
    found_ = false;
    return false;
#endif
}

}

```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/rtti.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "rtti.h"
#include "itanium_rtti.h"
#include <spdlog/spdlog.h>
#include <fmt/format.h>
#include <cstring>
#include <unordered_map>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <dbghelp.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "dbghelp.lib")
#endif

namespace hype {

namespace {

[[maybe_unused]] const u8* va_to_ptr(PEImage& img, va_t addr, size_t* max_len = nullptr) {
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.contains(addr)) {
            const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(addr - seg.va);
            if (off >= seg.data.size()) return nullptr;
            if (max_len) *max_len = seg.data.size() - off;
            return seg.data.data() + off;
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

bool is_code_addr(PEImage& img, va_t addr) {
    for (auto& seg : img.segments)
        if (seg.executable() && seg.contains(addr)) return true;
    return false;
}

const Segment* find_rdata(PEImage& img) {
    for (auto& seg : img.segments)
        if (seg.name == ".rdata" && !seg.data.empty()) return &seg;
    return nullptr;
}

std::string demangle_rtti(const std::string& mangled) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    std::string decorated = "?" + mangled.substr(4);
    char buf[1024];
    DWORD r = UnDecorateSymbolName(decorated.c_str(), buf, sizeof(buf),
        UNDNAME_NAME_ONLY);
    if (r > 0) return buf;
#endif
    auto pos = mangled.find("@@");
    if (pos == std::string::npos) return mangled;
    std::string raw = mangled.substr(4, pos - 4);

    std::string result;
    size_t i = raw.size();
    while (i > 0) {
        auto at = raw.rfind('@', i - 1);
        if (at == std::string::npos) {
            result += raw.substr(0, i);
            break;
        }
        result += raw.substr(at + 1, i - at - 1) + "::";
        i = at;
    }
    return result;
}

} // namespace

}

namespace hype {

void RTTIParser::parse(PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db) {
    classes_.clear();
    itanium_ = false;
    if (img.format == ImageFormat::ELF) {
        parse_itanium(img, db);
        return;
    }
    if (img.arch != Arch::X64) return;

    find_type_descriptors(img);
    if (classes_.empty()) return;

    find_vtables(img, db);
    name_methods(img, db);

    spdlog::info("RTTI: found {} classes", classes_.size());
}

void RTTIParser::parse_itanium(PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db) {
    itanium_ = true;
    const unsigned ptr_size =
        (img.arch == Arch::X64 || img.arch == Arch::ARM64 || img.arch == Arch::PPC) ? 8 : 4;
    std::vector<RttiSpan> spans;
    spans.reserve(img.segments.size());
    for (const auto& seg : img.segments)
        if (!seg.data.empty()) spans.push_back({seg.va, seg.data, seg.executable()});

    for (auto& c : scan_itanium_rtti(spans, ptr_size)) {
        if (c.vtables.empty()) continue;   // base named by a type_info, no vtable here
        RTTIClass r;
        r.mangled_name    = std::move(c.mangled);
        r.demangled_name  = std::move(c.name);
        r.type_descriptor = c.type_info;
        r.vtable          = c.vtables.front();
        r.methods         = std::move(c.methods);
        r.bases           = std::move(c.bases);
        classes_.push_back(std::move(r));
    }
    if (classes_.empty()) return;
    name_methods(img, db);
    spdlog::info("RTTI: found {} Itanium classes", classes_.size());
}

void RTTIParser::find_type_descriptors(PEImage& img) {
    [[maybe_unused]] constexpr std::string_view kPattern = ".?AV";

    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.executable() || seg.data.empty()) continue;
        if (seg.name != ".rdata" && seg.name != ".data") continue;

        const u8* data = seg.data.data();
        size_t sz = seg.data.size();

        for (size_t i = 0; i + 24 < sz; ++i) {
            if (data[i] != '.' || data[i + 1] != '?' ||
                data[i + 2] != 'A' || data[i + 3] != 'V')
                continue;

            size_t end = i + 4;
            while (end < sz && data[end] != 0) ++end;
            if (end >= sz) continue;
            if (end - i < 8) continue;
            if (i < 16) continue;

            std::string name(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data + i), end - i);
            if (name.find("@@") == std::string::npos) continue;

            // type descriptor starts 2 * sizeof(void*) before the name
            va_t td_addr = seg.va + i - 16;

            RTTIClass cls;
            cls.mangled_name = name;
            cls.demangled_name = demangle_rtti(name);
            cls.type_descriptor = td_addr;
            classes_.push_back(std::move(cls));
        }
    }
}

void RTTIParser::find_vtables(PEImage& img, [[maybe_unused]] AnalysisDB& db) {
    const Segment* rdata = find_rdata(img);
    if (!rdata) return;

    // Map: type_descriptor_rva -> class index
    std::unordered_map<u32, size_t> td_rva_to_idx;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < classes_.size(); ++i) {
        u32 rva = static_cast<u32>(classes_[i].type_descriptor - img.base);
        td_rva_to_idx[rva] = i;
    }

    const u8* data = rdata->data.data();
    size_t sz = rdata->data.size();

    // Find Complete Object Locators by scanning for signature + known td RVA
    // COL layout (x64): [sig:4][offset:4][cdOffset:4][pTypeDesc:4][pClassHier:4][pSelf:4] = 24 bytes
    struct COLEntry { va_t col_addr; size_t class_idx; };
    std::vector<COLEntry> cols;

    for (size_t i = 0; i + 24 <= sz; i += 4) {
        u32 sig = 0;
        std::memcpy(&sig, data + i, 4);
        if (sig != 1) continue;

        u32 td_rva = 0;
        std::memcpy(&td_rva, data + i + 12, 4);

        auto it = td_rva_to_idx.find(td_rva);
        if (it == td_rva_to_idx.end()) continue;

        u32 self_rva = 0;
        std::memcpy(&self_rva, data + i + 20, 4);
        u32 expected_self = static_cast<u32>((rdata->va + i) - img.base);
        if (self_rva != expected_self) continue;

        va_t col_addr = rdata->va + i;
        cols.push_back({col_addr, it->second});
    }

    // For each COL, find the pointer to it in .rdata (vtable[-1])
    // The qword AFTER that pointer is the vtable start
    std::unordered_map<va_t, size_t> col_addr_to_idx;
    for (auto& [addr, idx] : cols)
        col_addr_to_idx[addr] = idx;

    for (size_t i = 0; i + 8 <= sz; i += 8) {
        va_t val = 0;
        std::memcpy(&val, data + i, 8);

        auto it = col_addr_to_idx.find(val);
        if (it == col_addr_to_idx.end()) continue;

        va_t vtable_addr = rdata->va + i + 8;
        size_t cls_idx = it->second;

        if (classes_[cls_idx].vtable != 0) continue;
        classes_[cls_idx].complete_locator = val;
        classes_[cls_idx].vtable = vtable_addr;

        // Read method pointers from vtable
        size_t remaining = sz - (i + 8);
        const u8* vt_data = data + i + 8;

        for (size_t j = 0; j + 8 <= remaining; j += 8) {
            va_t method = 0;
            std::memcpy(&method, vt_data + j, 8);
            if (!is_code_addr(img, method)) break;
            classes_[cls_idx].methods.push_back(method);
        }
    }

    // Remove classes where we couldn't find a vtable
    std::erase_if(classes_, [](const RTTIClass& c) { return c.vtable == 0; });
}

void RTTIParser::name_methods([[maybe_unused]] PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db) {
    for (auto& cls : classes_) {
        db.set_name(cls.vtable, cls.demangled_name + (itanium_ ? "::vtable" : "::vftable"));

        for (size_t i = 0; i < cls.methods.size(); ++i) {
            va_t method = cls.methods[i];

            auto existing = db.names.find(method);
            if (existing != db.names.end() && !existing->second.empty() &&
                existing->second.rfind("sub_", 0) != 0) {
                std::string cur = existing->second;
                if (cur.find("::") == std::string::npos)
                    db.set_name(method, cls.demangled_name + "::" + cur);
            } else {
                db.set_name(method, fmt::format("{}::vfunc_{}", cls.demangled_name, i));
            }

            auto fit = db.funcs.find(method);
            if (fit != db.funcs.end()) {
                auto name_it = db.names.find(method);
                if (name_it != db.names.end())
                    fit->second.name = name_it->second;
            }
        }
    }
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/rtti.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/loader/pe_loader.h"
#include "analysis_db.h"
#include <vector>
#include <string>

namespace hype {

struct RTTIClass {
    std::string   mangled_name;
    std::string   demangled_name;
    va_t          type_descriptor = 0;    // MSVC TypeDescriptor / Itanium type_info
    va_t          complete_locator = 0;   // MSVC only
    va_t          vtable = 0;             // primary vtable (address point)
    std::vector<va_t> methods;
    std::vector<std::string> bases;       // Itanium: direct bases from the type_info
};

// MSVC RTTI on x64 PE images, Itanium ABI RTTI (core/analysis/itanium_rtti.h)
// on ELF images of any 32/64-bit arch
class RTTIParser {
public:
    void parse(PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db);
    const std::vector<RTTIClass>& classes() const { return classes_; }
    bool itanium() const { return itanium_; }

private:
    void parse_itanium(PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db);
    void find_type_descriptors(PEImage& img);
    void find_vtables(PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db);
    void name_methods(PEImage& img, AnalysisDB& db);

    std::vector<RTTIClass> classes_;
    bool itanium_ = false;
};

}
```

```cpp
#include "signatures.h"
#include "orbis_syscalls.h"
#include <spdlog/spdlog.h>
#include <cstring>

namespace hype {

namespace {

Signature make_sig(const char* name, const char* lib, std::initializer_list<int> bytes,
                   Arch arch = Arch::X64, SigFormat format = SigFormat::PE) {
    Signature s;
    s.name = name;
    s.library = lib;
    s.arch = arch;
    s.format = format;
    s.pattern.reserve(bytes.size());
    s.mask.reserve(bytes.size());
    for (int b : bytes) {
        if (b < 0) {
            s.pattern.push_back(0);
            s.mask.push_back(0x00);
        } else {
            s.pattern.push_back(static_cast<u8>(b));
            s.mask.push_back(0xFF);
        }
    }
    return s;
}

// mov r10, rcx in both encodings, as libkernel stubs shuffle arg 4
bool is_mov_r10_rcx(const u8* p) {
    return (p[0] == 0x4C && p[1] == 0x8B && p[2] == 0xD1) ||
           (p[0] == 0x49 && p[1] == 0x89 && p[2] == 0xCA);
}

// `mov r10, rcx ; syscall` at p
bool is_r10_syscall(const u8* p, size_t len) {
    return len >= 5 && is_mov_r10_rcx(p) && p[3] == 0x0F && p[4] == 0x05;
}

}

    // _seh_filter_exe
    sigs_.push_back(make_sig("_seh_filter_exe", "msvcrt",
        {0x48, 0x89, 0x5C, 0x24, -1, 0x48, 0x89, 0x74, 0x24, -1, 0x57, 0x48, 0x83, 0xEC, 0x20, 0x8B, 0xDA, 0x8B, 0xF9}));

    // Orbis (PS4) / FreeBSD amd64, ELF only. Orbis libc and libkernel derive
    // from FreeBSD 9, whose amd64 string primitives are hand-written assembly
    // (lib/libc/amd64/string/*.S) and so byte-identical wherever they are
    // statically linked (payload/homebrew ELFs, libkernel and kernel dumps).
    // libkernel's syscall wrappers are named separately from the syscall
    // number in syscall_stub_name()
    // bcopy.S built as memcpy/memmove: mov rax,rdi ; mov rcx,rdx ; mov r8,rdi ;
    // sub r8,rsi ; cmp r8,rcx ; jb overlap ; cld ; shr rcx,3 ; rep movsq
    sigs_.push_back(make_sig("memcpy", "freebsd-libc",
        {0x48, 0x89, 0xF8, 0x48, 0x89, 0xD1, 0x49, 0x89, 0xF8, 0x49, 0x29, 0xF0,
         0x49, 0x39, 0xC8, 0x72, -1, 0xFC, 0x48, 0xC1, 0xE9, 0x03, 0xF3, 0x48, 0xA5},
        Arch::X64, SigFormat::ELF));
    // bcopy.S as bcopy: xchg rdi,rsi then the same body
    sigs_.push_back(make_sig("bcopy", "freebsd-libc",
        {0x48, 0x87, 0xFE, 0x48, 0x89, 0xD1, 0x49, 0x89, 0xF8, 0x49, 0x29, 0xF0,
         0x49, 0x39, 0xC8, 0x72, -1, 0xFC, 0x48, 0xC1, 0xE9, 0x03, 0xF3, 0x48, 0xA5},
        Arch::X64, SigFormat::ELF));
    // memset.S: mov rax,rsi ; and rax,0xff ; mov rcx,rdx ; mov r11,rdi ; cld ;
    // cmp rcx,0xf ; jle short
    sigs_.push_back(make_sig("memset", "freebsd-libc",
        {0x48, 0x89, 0xF0, 0x48, 0x25, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x48, 0x89, 0xD1,
         0x49, 0x89, 0xFB, 0xFC, 0x48, 0x83, 0xF9, 0x0F, 0x7E},
        Arch::X64, SigFormat::ELF));
    // bzero.S: mov rcx,rsi ; xor eax,eax ; shr rcx,3 ; cld ; rep stosq ;
    // mov rcx,rsi ; and rcx,7 ; rep stosb ; ret
    sigs_.push_back(make_sig("bzero", "freebsd-libc",
        {0x48, 0x89, 0xF1, 0x31, 0xC0, 0x48, 0xC1, 0xE9, 0x03, 0xFC, 0xF3, 0x48,
         0xAB, 0x48, 0x89, 0xF1, 0x48, 0x83, 0xE1, 0x07, 0xF3, 0xAA, 0xC3},
        Arch::X64, SigFormat::ELF));

    spdlog::info("signatures: loaded {} patterns", sigs_.size());
}

SigFormat SignatureMatcher::image_format(const PEImage& img) {
    switch (img.format) {
    case ImageFormat::PE:    return SigFormat::PE;
    case ImageFormat::ELF:   return SigFormat::ELF;     // SELF payloads load as ELF
    case ImageFormat::MachO: return SigFormat::MachO;
    }
    return SigFormat::Any;
}

int SignatureMatcher::sig_count(Arch arch, SigFormat format) const {
    int n = 0;
    for (const auto& s : sigs_)
        if (s.arch == arch && (s.format == SigFormat::Any || s.format == format)) ++n;
    return n;
}

std::string SignatureMatcher::syscall_stub_name(const u8* p, size_t len, va_t entry,
                                                const PEImage& img) const {
    u64  num = 0;
    size_t load = 0;
    if (len >= 7 && p[0] == 0x48 && p[1] == 0xC7 && p[2] == 0xC0) {   // mov rax, imm32
        i32 v = 0;
        std::memcpy(&v, p + 3, 4);
        if (v < 0) return {};
        num = static_cast<u64>(v);
        load = 7;
    } else if (len >= 5 && p[0] == 0xB8) {                              // mov eax, imm32
        u32 v = 0;
        std::memcpy(&v, p + 1, 4);
        num = v;
        load = 5;
    } else {
        return {};
    }

    bool stub = is_r10_syscall(p + load, len - load);
    // payload SDK: mov rax, n ; jmp syscall_macro (mov r10, rcx ; syscall ...)
    if (!stub && len >= load + 5 && p[load] == 0xE9) {
        i32 rel = 0;
        std::memcpy(&rel, p + load + 1, 4);
        const va_t target = entry + load + 5 + static_cast<i64>(rel);
        size_t tlen = 0;
        if (const u8* t = func_bytes(target, img, &tlen)) stub = is_r10_syscall(t, tlen);
    }
    if (!stub) return {};
    if (const char* n = orbis_syscall_name(num)) return std::string("sys_") + n;
    return "sys_" + std::to_string(num);
}

bool SignatureMatcher::match_one(const u8* data, size_t len, const Signature& sig) const {
    if (len < sig.pattern.size()) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sig.pattern.size(); ++i) {
        if (sig.mask[i] && data[i] != sig.pattern[i])
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

const u8* SignatureMatcher::func_bytes(va_t addr, const PEImage& img, size_t* out_len) const {
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (seg.contains(addr)) {
            const size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(addr - seg.va);
            if (off >= seg.data.size()) return nullptr;
            if (out_len) *out_len = seg.data.size() - off;
            return seg.data.data() + off;
        }
    }
    if (out_len) *out_len = 0;
    return nullptr;
}

int SignatureMatcher::match_functions(AnalysisDB& db, const PEImage& img) {
    const SigFormat format = image_format(img);
    std::vector<const Signature*> eligible;
    for (const auto& sig : sigs_)
        if (sig.arch == img.arch &&
            (sig.format == SigFormat::Any || sig.format == format))
            eligible.push_back(&sig);
    const bool orbis_stubs = format == SigFormat::ELF && img.arch == Arch::X64;
    if (eligible.empty() && !orbis_stubs) {
        spdlog::info("signatures: no signature set for this arch/format");
        return 0;
    }

    int matches = 0;
    for (auto& [entry, func] : db.funcs) {
        const auto named = db.names.find(entry);
        if (named != db.names.end() && !named->second.empty() &&
            named->second.rfind("sub_", 0) != 0)
            continue;   // export / symbol / thunk name beats a pattern guess

        size_t avail = 0;
        const u8* ptr = func_bytes(entry, img, &avail);
        if (!ptr || avail < 4) continue;

        const size_t check_len = std::min<size_t>(avail, 64);
        std::string name;
        if (orbis_stubs) name = syscall_stub_name(ptr, check_len, entry, img);
        if (name.empty()) {
            for (const Signature* sig : eligible) {
                if (match_one(ptr, check_len, *sig)) { name = sig->name; break; }
            }
        }
        if (name.empty()) continue;
        func.name = name;
        db.names[entry] = std::move(name);
        ++matches;
    }
    spdlog::info("signatures: matched {} functions", matches);
    return matches;
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/analysis/signatures.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/types.h"
#include "analysis_db.h"
#include "core/loader/pe_loader.h"
#include <vector>
#include <string>

namespace hype {

// Container family a signature set was built from. MSVC CRT prologues only
// mean anything inside PE images, Orbis/FreeBSD code only inside ELF ones
enum class SigFormat : u8 { Any, PE, ELF, MachO };

struct Signature {
    std::string name;
    std::string library;
    std::vector<u8> pattern;
    std::vector<u8> mask;   // 0xFF = exact, 0x00 = wildcard
    Arch        arch   = Arch::X64;
    SigFormat   format = SigFormat::PE;
};

class SignatureMatcher {
public:
    SignatureMatcher();

    // Names functions in `db` whose entry bytes match a signature of the
    // image's arch and container format. Functions that already carry a
    // real name (export, symbol, import thunk) keep it
    int match_functions(AnalysisDB& db, const PEImage& img);
    int sig_count() const { return static_cast<int>(sigs_.size()); }
    // Signatures eligible for an image of this arch and format
    int sig_count(Arch arch, SigFormat format) const;

    // Signature family for the image's container format
    static SigFormat image_format(const PEImage& img);

private:
    bool match_one(const u8* data, size_t len, const Signature& sig) const;
    const u8* func_bytes(va_t addr, const PEImage& img, size_t* out_len) const;
    // Orbis syscall stub at `ptr` (libkernel inline form, or the payload SDK
    // `mov rax, n ; jmp common` form): the stub's name, empty when none
    std::string syscall_stub_name(const u8* ptr, size_t len, va_t entry,
                                  const PEImage& img) const;

    std::vector<Signature> sigs_;
};

}
```
