```cpp
// A .bss larger than this is not materialized (the analyzer sees the file
// bytes only); keeps a bogus p_memsz from allocating gigabytes
constexpr u64 kMaxZeroFill = 256ull << 20;
constexpr u64 kPage = 0x1000;

u32 elf_to_pe_flags(u32 pflags) {
    u32 f = 0;
    if (pflags & PF_R) f |= 0x40000000;
    if (pflags & PF_W) f |= 0x80000000;
    if (pflags & PF_X) f |= 0x20000000;
    return f;
}

template <class T>
bool rd(const u8* base, size_t size, u64 off, T& out) {
    if (off > size || sizeof(T) > size - off) return false;
    std::memcpy(&out, base + off, sizeof(T));
    return true;
}

struct Phdr { u32 type = 0, flags = 0; u64 offset = 0, vaddr = 0, filesz = 0, memsz = 0; };
struct Shdr { u32 name = 0, type = 0; u64 flags = 0, addr = 0, offset = 0, size = 0; u32 link = 0, info = 0; u64 entsize = 0; };
struct Sym  { u32 name = 0; u8 info = 0, other = 0; u16 shndx = 0; u64 value = 0, size = 0; };
struct Reloc { u64 offset = 0; u32 sym = 0, type = 0; i64 addend = 0; };

std::string_view cstr_at(const u8* base, size_t size, u64 off, u64 limit_end) {
    const u64 end = std::min<u64>(limit_end, size);
    if (off >= end) return {};
    const char* s = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(base + off);
    const size_t max = static_cast<size_t>(end - off);
    const void* nul = std::memchr(s, 0, max);
    return nul ? std::string_view(s, static_cast<const char*>(nul) - s) : std::string_view{};
}

} // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// View: every read is bounds-checked against the buffer, 32-bit structures
// come back widened to the 64-bit shapes

struct ELFLoader::View {
    const u8* b = nullptr;
    size_t    n = 0;
    bool      is64 = true;
    u64 phoff = 0, shoff = 0;
    u32 phnum = 0, shnum = 0, shstrndx = 0;
    u16 phentsize = 0, shentsize = 0;

    bool phdr(u32 i, Phdr& p) const {
        const u64 off = phoff + u64{i} * phentsize;
        if (is64) {
            if (phentsize < 56) return false;
            return rd(b, n, off, p.type) && rd(b, n, off + 4, p.flags) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 8, p.offset) && rd(b, n, off + 16, p.vaddr) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 32, p.filesz) && rd(b, n, off + 40, p.memsz);
        }
        if (phentsize < 32) return false;
        u32 v[8];
        if (!rd(b, n, off, v)) return false;
        p = {v[0], v[6], v[1], v[2], v[4], v[5]};
        return true;
    }
    bool shdr(u32 i, Shdr& s) const {
        if (!shoff) return false;
        const u64 off = shoff + u64{i} * shentsize;
        if (is64) {
            if (shentsize < 64) return false;
            return rd(b, n, off, s.name) && rd(b, n, off + 4, s.type) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 8, s.flags) && rd(b, n, off + 16, s.addr) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 24, s.offset) && rd(b, n, off + 32, s.size) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 40, s.link) && rd(b, n, off + 44, s.info) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 56, s.entsize);
        }
        if (shentsize < 40) return false;
        u32 v[10];
        if (!rd(b, n, off, v)) return false;
        s = {v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7], v[9]};
        return true;
    }
    u64 sym_size() const { return is64 ? 24 : 16; }
    bool sym(u64 off, Sym& s) const {
        if (is64)
            return rd(b, n, off, s.name) && rd(b, n, off + 4, s.info) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 5, s.other) && rd(b, n, off + 6, s.shndx) &&
                   rd(b, n, off + 8, s.value) && rd(b, n, off + 16, s.size);
        u32 name = 0, value = 0, size = 0;
        if (!rd(b, n, off, name) || !rd(b, n, off + 4, value) || !rd(b, n, off + 8, size) ||
            !rd(b, n, off + 12, s.info) || !rd(b, n, off + 13, s.other) ||
            !rd(b, n, off + 14, s.shndx))
            return false;
        s.name = name;
        s.value = value;
        s.size = size;
        return true;
    }
    u64 reloc_size(bool rela) const { return is64 ? (rela ? 24 : 16) : (rela ? 12 : 8); }
    bool reloc(u64 off, bool rela, Reloc& r) const {
        if (is64) {
            u64 info = 0;
            if (!rd(b, n, off, r.offset) || !rd(b, n, off + 8, info)) return false;
            r.sym = static_cast<u32>(info >> 32);
            r.type = static_cast<u32>(info);
            r.addend = 0;
            return !rela || rd(b, n, off + 16, r.addend);
        }
        u32 o = 0, info = 0;
        if (!rd(b, n, off, o) || !rd(b, n, off + 4, info)) return false;
        r.offset = o;
        r.sym = info >> 8;
        r.type = info & 0xFF;
        i32 a = 0;
        if (rela && !rd(b, n, off + 8, a)) return false;
        r.addend = a;
        return true;
    }
    // file offset backing `va` inside some PT_LOAD's file bytes
    bool va_to_off(u64 va, u64 need, u64& out) const {
        for (u32 i = 0; i < phnum; ++i) {
            Phdr p;
            if (!phdr(i, p) || p.type != PT_LOAD) continue;
            if (va < p.vaddr || va - p.vaddr >= p.filesz) continue;
            if (p.filesz - (va - p.vaddr) < need) return false;
            out = p.offset + (va - p.vaddr);
            return out <= n && need <= n - out;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

struct ELFLoader::DynTables {
    bool sce = false;
    // absolute file offsets / byte sizes; 0 = absent
    u64 rela_off = 0, rela_sz = 0;
    bool rela_is_rela = true;
    u64 jmprel_off = 0, jmprel_sz = 0;
    bool jmprel_is_rela = true;
    u64 sym_off = 0, sym_end = 0;
    u64 str_off = 0, str_end = 0;
    std::vector<std::pair<u64, u32>> import_libs;     // lib id -> name offset
    std::vector<std::pair<u64, u32>> needed_modules;  // module id -> name offset

    bool has_symbols() const { return sym_off && str_off && sym_end > sym_off; }
};

ELFLoader::View ELFLoader::view() const {
    View v;
    v.b = base_;
    v.n = size_;
    v.is64 = is64_;
    v.phoff = phoff_;
    v.shoff = shoff_;
    v.phnum = phnum_;
    v.shnum = shnum_;
    v.shstrndx = shstrndx_;
    v.phentsize = phentsize_;
    v.shentsize = shentsize_;
    return v;
}

ELFLoader::DynTables ELFLoader::find_dyn_tables(const View& v) const {
    DynTables t;
    Phdr dyn, dynlib;
    bool have_dyn = false, have_dynlib = false;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < v.phnum; ++i) {
        Phdr p;
        if (!v.phdr(i, p)) break;
        if (p.type == PT_DYNAMIC && !have_dyn) { dyn = p; have_dyn = true; }
        if (p.type == PT_SCE_DYNLIBDATA && !have_dynlib) { dynlib = p; have_dynlib = true; }
    }
    if (!have_dyn || dyn.offset >= size_) return t;
    if (have_dynlib && dynlib.offset >= size_) have_dynlib = false;

    const u64 ent = is64_ ? 16 : 8;
    const u64 dyn_end = std::min<u64>(dyn.offset + dyn.filesz, size_);
    std::unordered_map<i64, u64> tags;
    for (u64 off = dyn.offset; off + ent <= dyn_end; off += ent) {
        i64 tag = 0;
        u64 val = 0;
        if (is64_) {
            if (!rd(base_, size_, off, tag) || !rd(base_, size_, off + 8, val)) break;
        } else {
            i32 t32 = 0;
            u32 v32 = 0;
            if (!rd(base_, size_, off, t32) || !rd(base_, size_, off + 4, v32)) break;
            tag = t32;
            val = v32;
        }
        if (tag == DT_NULL) break;
        if (tag == DT_SCE_IMPORT_LIB) t.import_libs.emplace_back(val >> 48, static_cast<u32>(val));
        else if (tag == DT_SCE_NEEDED_MODULE) t.needed_modules.emplace_back(val >> 48, static_cast<u32>(val));
        else tags.emplace(tag, val);
    }
    const auto tag = [&](i64 k) -> u64 {
        const auto it = tags.find(k);
        return it == tags.end() ? 0 : it->second;
    };

    if (have_dynlib && tags.count(DT_SCE_STRTAB) && tags.count(DT_SCE_SYMTAB)) {
        // PS4: offsets are relative to PT_SCE_DYNLIBDATA's file bytes
        t.sce = true;
        const u64 lo = dynlib.offset;
        const u64 hi = std::min<u64>(dynlib.offset + dynlib.filesz, size_);
        const auto place = [&](u64 rel, u64 sz, u64& off, u64& end_or_sz, bool is_size) {
            if (!sz || rel > hi - lo || sz > hi - lo - rel) return;
            off = lo + rel;
            end_or_sz = is_size ? sz : lo + rel + sz;
        };
        place(tag(DT_SCE_STRTAB), tag(DT_SCE_STRSZ), t.str_off, t.str_end, false);
        place(tag(DT_SCE_SYMTAB), tag(DT_SCE_SYMTABSZ), t.sym_off, t.sym_end, false);
        place(tag(DT_SCE_RELA), tag(DT_SCE_RELASZ), t.rela_off, t.rela_sz, true);
        place(tag(DT_SCE_JMPREL), tag(DT_SCE_PLTRELSZ), t.jmprel_off, t.jmprel_sz, true);
        return t;
    }

    // standard: tag values are virtual addresses
    const auto map = [&](u64 va, u64 sz, u64& off) {
        u64 o = 0;
        if (va && v.va_to_off(va, sz ? sz : 1, o)) off = o;
    };
    if (u64 sz = tag(DT_STRSZ); tag(DT_STRTAB)) {
        map(tag(DT_STRTAB), sz, t.str_off);
        if (t.str_off) t.str_end = t.str_off + sz;
    }
    if (tag(DT_SYMTAB)) {
        map(tag(DT_SYMTAB), v.sym_size(), t.sym_off);
        if (t.sym_off) t.sym_end = size_;   // DT_SYMTAB carries no size
    }
    if (tag(DT_RELA)) {
        map(tag(DT_RELA), tag(DT_RELASZ), t.rela_off);
        if (t.rela_off) t.rela_sz = tag(DT_RELASZ);
    } else if (tag(DT_REL)) {
        map(tag(DT_REL), tag(DT_RELSZ), t.rela_off);
        if (t.rela_off) { t.rela_sz = tag(DT_RELSZ); t.rela_is_rela = false; }
    }
    if (tag(DT_JMPREL)) {
        map(tag(DT_JMPREL), tag(DT_PLTRELSZ), t.jmprel_off);
        if (t.jmprel_off) {
            t.jmprel_sz = tag(DT_PLTRELSZ);
            const u64 pltrel = tag(DT_PLTREL);
            t.jmprel_is_rela = pltrel ? pltrel == static_cast<u64>(DT_RELA) : is64_;
        }
    }
    (void)DT_SYMENT;
    return t;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool ELFLoader::is_elf(const u8* data, size_t size) {
    u32 magic = 0;
    return rd(data, size, 0, magic) && magic == ELF_MAGIC;
}

std::optional<PEImage> ELFLoader::load_buffer(const u8* data, size_t size) {
    if (!data || size < 52) return std::nullopt;
    PEImage img;
    img.raw = std::span<const u8>(data, size);
    base_ = data;
    size_ = size;
    return finish_load(img);
}

std::optional<PEImage> ELFLoader::load(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!f) return std::nullopt;

    const auto end = f.tellg();
    if (end < 52) return std::nullopt;
    // Same 2 GiB cap as the PE and Mach-O loaders; without it any path could
    // be read whole into memory.
    constexpr std::streamoff kMaxFile = 2ll << 30;
    if (end > kMaxFile) return std::nullopt;
    const size_t sz = static_cast<size_t>(end);
    f.seekg(0);

    auto file = std::make_shared<std::vector<u8>>(sz);
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(file->data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(sz));
    if (!f) return std::nullopt;
    if (apply_relocs_) apply_relocations(*file);

    PEImage img;
    img.storage.push_back(file);
    img.raw = *file;
    base_ = file->data();
    size_ = sz;
    auto out = finish_load(img);
    if (out)
        spdlog::info("elf: loaded {}", path.filename().string());
    return out;
}

std::optional<PEImage> ELFLoader::finish_load(PEImage& img) {
    img.format = ImageFormat::ELF;
    if (!parse_header(img)) return std::nullopt;
    if (!parse_segments(img)) return std::nullopt;
    parse_sections(img);
    parse_symbols(img);
    parse_dynamic(img);
    if (img.imports.empty()) parse_sce_dynlibdata(img);

    spdlog::info("elf: base=0x{:X} entry=0x{:X} segs={} imports={} exports={}",
                 img.base, img.entry, img.segments.size(), img.imports.size(),
                 img.exports.size());
    return std::move(img);
}

bool ELFLoader::parse_header(PEImage& img) {
    if (size_ < 52) return false;
    u32 magic = 0;
    rd(base_, size_, 0, magic);
    if (magic != ELF_MAGIC) return false;

    const u8 ei_class = base_[4];
    const u8 ei_data  = base_[5];
    if (ei_class == ELFCLASS64) is64_ = true;
    else if (ei_class == ELFCLASS32) is64_ = false;
    else return false;
    if (ei_data != ELFDATA2LSB) {
        spdlog::warn("elf: big-endian images are not supported");
        return false;
    }
    if (is64_ && size_ < 64) return false;

    rd(base_, size_, 18, machine_);
    u16 phnum16 = 0, shnum16 = 0, shstrndx16 = 0;
    if (is64_) {
        u64 entry = 0;
        rd(base_, size_, 24, entry);
        rd(base_, size_, 32, phoff_);
        rd(base_, size_, 40, shoff_);
        rd(base_, size_, 54, phentsize_);
        rd(base_, size_, 56, phnum16);
        rd(base_, size_, 58, shentsize_);
        rd(base_, size_, 60, shnum16);
        rd(base_, size_, 62, shstrndx16);
        img.entry = entry;
    } else {
        u32 entry = 0, phoff = 0, shoff = 0;
        rd(base_, size_, 24, entry);
        rd(base_, size_, 28, phoff);
        rd(base_, size_, 32, shoff);
        rd(base_, size_, 42, phentsize_);
        rd(base_, size_, 44, phnum16);
        rd(base_, size_, 46, shentsize_);
        rd(base_, size_, 48, shnum16);
        rd(base_, size_, 50, shstrndx16);
        img.entry = entry;
        phoff_ = phoff;
        shoff_ = shoff;
    }

    switch (machine_) {
    case EM_X86_64:  img.arch = Arch::X64;   break;
    case EM_386:     img.arch = Arch::X86;   break;
    case EM_AARCH64: img.arch = Arch::ARM64; break;
    case EM_ARM:     img.arch = Arch::ARM;   break;
    case EM_MIPS:    img.arch = Arch::MIPS;  break;
    case EM_PPC:
    case EM_PPC64:   img.arch = Arch::PPC;   break;
    default:
        spdlog::warn("elf: unsupported machine 0x{:X}", machine_);
        return false;
    }

    // Extended numbering: the real counts live in section header 0
    phnum_ = phnum16;
    shnum_ = shnum16;
    shstrndx_ = shstrndx16;
    if (shoff_ && (phnum16 == PN_XNUM || shnum16 == 0 || shstrndx16 == SHN_XINDEX)) {
        Shdr s0;
        View v = view();
        if (v.shdr(0, s0)) {
            if (phnum16 == PN_XNUM) phnum_ = s0.info;
            if (shnum16 == 0) shnum_ = static_cast<u32>(std::min<u64>(s0.size, 0xFFFFFFFFu));
            if (shstrndx16 == SHN_XINDEX) shstrndx_ = s0.link;
        }
    }
    // cap counts by what the file can hold so a hostile header can't spin
    if (phentsize_ && phoff_ < size_)
        phnum_ = static_cast<u32>(std::min<u64>(phnum_, (size_ - phoff_) / phentsize_));
    else
        phnum_ = 0;
    if (shentsize_ && shoff_ && shoff_ < size_)
        shnum_ = static_cast<u32>(std::min<u64>(shnum_, (size_ - shoff_) / shentsize_));
    else
        shnum_ = 0;
    return true;
}

bool ELFLoader::parse_segments(PEImage& img) {
    const View v = view();
    std::vector<Phdr> loads, relros;
    for (u32 i = 0; i < v.phnum; ++i) {
        Phdr p;
        if (!v.phdr(i, p)) break;
        if (p.type == PT_LOAD && p.memsz) loads.push_back(p);
        else if (p.type == PT_SCE_RELRO && p.memsz) relros.push_back(p);
    }
    if (loads.empty() && relros.empty()) return false;

    auto make_seg = [&](const Phdr& p, u64 va, u64 memsz, std::string name) {
        Segment seg;
        seg.name     = std::move(name);
        seg.va       = va;
        seg.size     = memsz;
        const u64 skip = va - p.vaddr;
        seg.file_off = p.offset + skip;
        seg.file_sz  = p.filesz > skip ? std::min(p.filesz - skip, memsz) : 0;
        seg.flags    = elf_to_pe_flags(p.flags);
        if (seg.file_sz && seg.file_off <= size_ && seg.file_sz <= size_ - seg.file_off) {
            const u64 mem = memsz - seg.file_sz <= kMaxZeroFill ? memsz : seg.file_sz;
            seg.data = segment_bytes(img, base_ + seg.file_off,
                                     static_cast<size_t>(seg.file_sz), static_cast<size_t>(mem));
        } else if (!seg.file_sz && memsz <= kMaxZeroFill) {
            seg.data = segment_bytes(img, base_, 0, static_cast<size_t>(memsz));
        }
        return seg;
    };
    auto perm_name = [](u32 pflags) -> std::string {
        if (pflags & PF_X) return ".text";
        if (pflags & PF_W) return ".data";
        return ".rodata";
    };

    for (const auto& p : loads)
        img.segments.push_back(make_seg(p, p.vaddr, p.memsz, perm_name(p.flags)));

    // PT_SCE_RELRO is mapped by the PS4 loader on its own. When a LOAD
    // already covers (part of) it, only the uncovered pieces become segments
    // so no byte is analyzed twice
    for (const auto& r : relros) {
        std::vector<std::pair<u64, u64>> pieces{{r.vaddr, r.vaddr + r.memsz}};
        for (const auto& l : loads) {
            const u64 ls = l.vaddr, le = l.vaddr + l.memsz;
            std::vector<std::pair<u64, u64>> next;
            for (auto [s, e] : pieces) {
                if (le <= s || ls >= e) { next.emplace_back(s, e); continue; }
                if (s < ls) next.emplace_back(s, ls);
                if (le < e) next.emplace_back(le, e);
            }
            pieces = std::move(next);
        }
        for (auto [s, e] : pieces)
            img.segments.push_back(make_seg(r, s, e - s, ".data.rel.ro"));
    }

    std::sort(img.segments.begin(), img.segments.end(),
              [](const Segment& a, const Segment& b) { return a.va < b.va; });

    // image base: lowest mapped address, page-aligned down
    const Phdr* first = nullptr;
    for (const auto& p : loads)
        if (!first || p.vaddr < first->vaddr) first = &p;
    const va_t lo = img.segments.front().va;
    img.base = lo & ~(kPage - 1);
    header_base_ = img.base;
    if (first && first->vaddr >= first->offset) {
        const va_t hb = first->vaddr - first->offset;
        if ((hb & (kPage - 1)) == 0) header_base_ = hb;
    }
    return true;
}

void ELFLoader::parse_sections(PEImage& img) {
    const View v = view();
    if (!v.shnum) return;

    u64 shstr_off = 0, shstr_end = 0;
    Shdr strsh;
    if (v.shstrndx && v.shstrndx < v.shnum && v.shdr(v.shstrndx, strsh)) {
        shstr_off = strsh.offset;
        shstr_end = strsh.offset + strsh.size;
    }
    if (!shstr_end) return;

    // name each segment after the largest allocated section it holds
    std::vector<u64> best(img.segments.size(), 0);
    for (u32 i = 1; i < v.shnum; ++i) {
        Shdr sh;
        if (!v.shdr(i, sh)) break;
        if (!(sh.flags & SHF_ALLOC) || sh.addr == 0 || sh.size == 0) continue;
        const auto name = cstr_at(base_, size_, shstr_off + sh.name, shstr_end);
        if (name.empty()) continue;
        for (size_t s = 0; s < img.segments.size(); ++s) {
            auto& seg = img.segments[s];
            if (!seg.contains(sh.addr)) continue;
            if (sh.size > best[s]) {
                best[s] = sh.size;
                seg.name = std::string(name);
            }
            break;
        }
    }
}

void ELFLoader::parse_symbols(PEImage& img) {
    const View v = view();
    for (u32 si = 0; si < v.shnum; ++si) {
        Shdr sh;
        if (!v.shdr(si, sh)) break;
        if (sh.type != SHT_SYMTAB && sh.type != SHT_DYNSYM) continue;
        if (sh.entsize < v.sym_size() || sh.offset > size_ || sh.size > size_ - sh.offset) continue;
        Shdr strsh;
        if (sh.link >= v.shnum || !v.shdr(sh.link, strsh)) continue;
        const u64 str_end = strsh.offset + strsh.size;

        const u64 count = sh.size / sh.entsize;
        std::unordered_set<va_t> export_addrs;
        for (const auto& e : img.exports) export_addrs.insert(e.addr);
        for (u64 i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
            Sym sym;
            if (!v.sym(sh.offset + i * sh.entsize, sym)) break;
            const u8 bind = sym.info >> 4;
            const u8 type = sym.info & 0xF;
            if (type != STT_FUNC || sym.value == 0 || sym.shndx == 0) continue;
            const auto name = cstr_at(base_, size_, strsh.offset + sym.name, str_end);
            if (name.empty()) continue;
            // ARM Thumb functions carry the mode in bit 0
            const va_t addr = img.arch == Arch::ARM ? (sym.value & ~u64{1}) : sym.value;

            if (bind == STB_GLOBAL || bind == STB_WEAK) {
                // .dynsym repeats the exported subset of .symtab
                if (!export_addrs.insert(addr).second) continue;
                Export exp;
                exp.name = std::string(name);
                exp.addr = addr;
                img.exports.push_back(std::move(exp));
            } else if (bind == STB_LOCAL) {
                img.symbols.push_back({std::string(name), addr});
            }
        }
    }
}

void ELFLoader::parse_dynamic(PEImage& img) {
    const View v = view();
    const DynTables t = find_dyn_tables(v);
    if (t.sce || !t.has_symbols() || !t.str_off) return;

    std::unordered_set<va_t> seen;
    auto emit = [&](u64 off, u64 sz, bool rela) {
        if (!off || !sz) return;
        const u64 esz = v.reloc_size(rela);
        for (u64 o = off; o + esz <= off + sz; o += esz) {
            Reloc r;
            if (!v.reloc(o, rela, r)) break;
            if (!r.sym) continue;
            Sym sym;
            const u64 soff = t.sym_off + u64{r.sym} * v.sym_size();
            if (soff + v.sym_size() > t.sym_end || !v.sym(soff, sym)) continue;
            if (sym.shndx != 0) continue;   // defined here: not an import
            const auto name = cstr_at(base_, size_, t.str_off + sym.name, t.str_end);
            if (name.empty() || !seen.insert(r.offset).second) continue;
            Import imp;
            imp.dll = "extern";
            imp.name = std::string(name);
            imp.ordinal = 0;
            imp.iat_addr = r.offset;
            img.imports.push_back(std::move(imp));
        }
    };
    emit(t.jmprel_off, t.jmprel_sz, t.jmprel_is_rela);
    emit(t.rela_off, t.rela_sz, t.rela_is_rela);
}

// PS4 OELF: imports/exports live in PT_SCE_DYNLIBDATA. Symbol names are
// "<nid>#<lib id>#<module id>"; DT_SCE_IMPORT_LIB maps library ids to names
// (libkernel, libSceGnmDriver, ...), DT_SCE_NEEDED_MODULE maps module ids
void ELFLoader::parse_sce_dynlibdata(PEImage& img) {
    if (!is64_) return;
    const View v = view();
    const DynTables t = find_dyn_tables(v);
    if (!t.sce || !t.has_symbols()) return;

    const auto sce_str = [&](u32 off) { return cstr_at(base_, size_, t.str_off + off, t.str_end); };
    std::unordered_map<u64, std::string> lib_names, module_names;
    for (const auto& [id, off] : t.import_libs) lib_names[id] = std::string(sce_str(off));
    for (const auto& [id, off] : t.needed_modules) module_names[id] = std::string(sce_str(off));

    // "<nid>#L#M" -> resolved name (or the bare NID) and the library name
    auto resolve = [&](std::string_view raw, std::string& name, std::string& lib) {
        const size_t h1 = raw.find('#');
        const std::string_view nid_s = raw.substr(0, h1);
        auto resolved = nid::lookup(nid_s);
        name = resolved ? *resolved : std::string(nid_s);
        lib.clear();
        if (h1 == std::string_view::npos) return;
        const size_t h2 = raw.find('#', h1 + 1);
        const std::string_view lib_s = raw.substr(h1 + 1, h2 == std::string_view::npos
                                                            ? std::string_view::npos : h2 - h1 - 1);
        u64 lib_id = 0, mod_id = 0;
        if (nid::decode_id(lib_s, lib_id)) {
            if (auto it = lib_names.find(lib_id); it != lib_names.end() && !it->second.empty()) {
                lib = it->second;
                return;
            }
        }
        if (h2 != std::string_view::npos && nid::decode_id(raw.substr(h2 + 1), mod_id)) {
            if (auto it = module_names.find(mod_id); it != module_names.end() && !it->second.empty()) {
                lib = it->second;
                return;
            }
        }
        lib = fmt::format("lib#{}", lib_s);
    };

    std::unordered_set<va_t> seen;
    auto emit = [&](u64 off, u64 sz) {
        if (!off || !sz) return;
        const u64 esz = v.reloc_size(true);
        for (u64 o = off; o + esz <= off + sz; o += esz) {
            Reloc r;
            if (!v.reloc(o, true, r)) break;
            if (!r.sym) continue;
            Sym sym;
            const u64 soff = t.sym_off + u64{r.sym} * v.sym_size();
            if (soff + v.sym_size() > t.sym_end || !v.sym(soff, sym)) continue;
            if (sym.shndx != 0) continue;
            const auto raw = sce_str(sym.name);
            if (raw.empty() || !seen.insert(r.offset).second) continue;
            Import imp;
            resolve(raw, imp.name, imp.dll);
            imp.ordinal = 0;
            imp.iat_addr = r.offset;
            img.imports.push_back(std::move(imp));
        }
    };
    emit(t.jmprel_off, t.jmprel_sz);
    emit(t.rela_off, t.rela_sz);

    // exported (defined) functions: module_start, prx entry points
    for (u64 soff = t.sym_off + v.sym_size(); soff + v.sym_size() <= t.sym_end; soff += v.sym_size()) {
        Sym sym;
        if (!v.sym(soff, sym)) break;
        const u8 bind = sym.info >> 4;
        if (sym.shndx == 0 || sym.value == 0 || (sym.info & 0xF) != STT_FUNC) continue;
        if (bind != STB_GLOBAL && bind != STB_WEAK) continue;
        const auto raw = sce_str(sym.name);
        if (raw.empty()) continue;
        Export exp;
        std::string lib;
        resolve(raw, exp.name, lib);
        exp.addr = sym.value;
        img.exports.push_back(std::move(exp));
    }

    if (!img.imports.empty())
        spdlog::info("elf: PS4 dynlibdata: {} imports from {} libraries",
                     img.imports.size(), lib_names.size());
}

ELFLoader::RelocStats ELFLoader::apply_relocations(std::span<u8> file, va_t load_base) {
    RelocStats st;
    ELFLoader L;
    L.base_ = file.data();
    L.size_ = file.size();
    PEImage scratch;
    if (!L.parse_header(scratch) || !L.is64_) return st;
    const bool x64 = L.machine_ == EM_X86_64;
    const bool a64 = L.machine_ == EM_AARCH64;
    if (!x64 && !a64) return st;

    const View v = L.view();
    // natural base = lowest PT_LOAD, page-aligned (parse_segments' rule)
    u64 lo = ~u64{0};
    for (u32 i = 0; i < v.phnum; ++i) {
        Phdr p;
        if (!v.phdr(i, p)) break;
        if ((p.type == PT_LOAD || p.type == PT_SCE_RELRO) && p.memsz && p.vaddr < lo) lo = p.vaddr;
    }
    if (lo == ~u64{0}) return st;
    const u64 natural = lo & ~(kPage - 1);
    const u64 bias = load_base ? load_base - natural : 0;

    const DynTables t = L.find_dyn_tables(v);
    // slot -> file offset; PS4 RELRO slots are mapped too
    auto slot_off = [&](u64 va, u64& out) {
        if (v.va_to_off(va, 8, out)) return true;
        for (u32 i = 0; i < v.phnum; ++i) {
            Phdr p;
            if (!v.phdr(i, p) || p.type != PT_SCE_RELRO) continue;
            if (va < p.vaddr || va - p.vaddr >= p.filesz || p.filesz - (va - p.vaddr) < 8) continue;
            out = p.offset + (va - p.vaddr);
            return out + 8 <= L.size_;
        }
        return false;
    };

    auto apply = [&](u64 off, u64 sz, bool rela) {
        if (!off || !sz || !rela) return;   // ELF64 x86-64/AArch64 use RELA only
        const u64 esz = v.reloc_size(true);
        for (u64 o = off; o + esz <= off + sz; o += esz) {
            Reloc r;
            if (!v.reloc(o, true, r)) break;
            const bool relative = (x64 && r.type == R_X86_64_RELATIVE) ||
                                  (a64 && r.type == R_AARCH64_RELATIVE);
            const bool abs64    = (x64 && r.type == R_X86_64_64) ||
                                  (a64 && r.type == R_AARCH64_ABS64);
            const bool slot     = (x64 && (r.type == R_X86_64_GLOB_DAT ||
                                           r.type == R_X86_64_JUMP_SLOT)) ||
                                  (a64 && (r.type == R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT ||
                                           r.type == R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT));
            if (!relative && !abs64 && !slot) { ++st.skipped; continue; }

            u64 value = 0;
            if (relative) {
                value = bias + static_cast<u64>(r.addend);
            } else {
                Sym sym;
                const u64 soff = t.sym_off + u64{r.sym} * v.sym_size();
                if (!r.sym || !t.has_symbols() || soff + v.sym_size() > t.sym_end ||
                    !v.sym(soff, sym)) { ++st.skipped; continue; }
                if (sym.shndx == 0) { ++st.imported; continue; }
                const u64 s = bias + sym.value;
                // x86-64 GLOB_DAT/JUMP_SLOT are S; AArch64 slots and both ABS64 are S + A
                value = (x64 && slot) ? s : s + static_cast<u64>(r.addend);
            }
            u64 foff = 0;
            if (!slot_off(r.offset, foff)) { ++st.skipped; continue; }
            std::memcpy(file.data() + foff, &value, 8);
            ++st.applied;
        }
    };
    apply(t.rela_off, t.rela_sz, t.rela_is_rela);
    apply(t.jmprel_off, t.jmprel_sz, t.jmprel_is_rela);
    return st;
}

}

```

`src/hyperion/core/loader/elf_loader.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/types.h"
#include "pe_loader.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <span>

namespace hype {

class ELFLoader {
public:
    static bool is_elf(const u8* data, size_t size);

    // Reads the file and keeps its bytes in PEImage::storage. A file on disk
    // is unrelocated, so relocations are applied at the natural image base
    // unless set_apply_relocations(false) was called
    std::optional<PEImage> load(const std::filesystem::path& path);

    // Borrows `data` (it must outlive the image, as with PELoader). Nothing
    // is copied and nothing is relocated: a memory dump already carries the
    // console's relocations, and a caller that owns a file image applies them
    // in place with apply_relocations() first
    std::optional<PEImage> load_buffer(const u8* data, size_t size);

    void set_apply_relocations(bool on) { apply_relocs_ = on; }

    // Address of the ELF header for the last load: the lowest PT_LOAD's
    // p_vaddr - p_offset when that is a valid page-aligned address, else the
    // image base. Equals PEImage::base unless the headers sit below the first
    // loadable segment (base + 0x1000 starting layouts)
    va_t header_base() const { return header_base_; }

    struct RelocStats {
        size_t applied  = 0;   // slots written
        size_t imported = 0;   // undefined-symbol slots left for the runtime linker
        size_t skipped  = 0;   // unsupported types or slots outside the file bytes
    };
    // Applies R_X86_64_{RELATIVE,64,GLOB_DAT,JUMP_SLOT} and
    // R_AARCH64_{RELATIVE,ABS64,GLOB_DAT,JUMP_SLOT} from PT_DYNAMIC (standard
    // and PS4 PT_SCE_DYNLIBDATA tables) over `file` in place, as if the image
    // were mapped at `load_base` (0 = its natural base). RELA writes are
    // absolute, so applying twice gives the same bytes. ELF64 only
    static RelocStats apply_relocations(std::span<u8> file, va_t load_base = 0);

private:
    struct View;        // bounds-checked, class-normalized header/table reader
    struct DynTables;   // relocation/symbol tables located via PT_DYNAMIC
    View view() const;
    DynTables find_dyn_tables(const View& v) const;

    bool parse_header(PEImage& img);
    bool parse_segments(PEImage& img);
    void parse_sections(PEImage& img);
    void parse_symbols(PEImage& img);
    void parse_dynamic(PEImage& img);
    void parse_sce_dynlibdata(PEImage& img);  // PS4 OELF import/export resolution
    std::optional<PEImage> finish_load(PEImage& img);

    const u8* base_ = nullptr;
    size_t size_ = 0;
    bool is64_ = false;
    bool apply_relocs_ = true;
    u16  machine_ = 0;
    // header fields with extended numbering resolved
    u64  phoff_ = 0, shoff_ = 0;
    u32  phnum_ = 0, shnum_ = 0, shstrndx_ = 0;
    u16  phentsize_ = 0, shentsize_ = 0;
    va_t header_base_ = 0;
};

}
```

```cpp
constexpr size_t kMaxFileSize = 2ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
// zero-fill sections and segment tails beyond this get no backing buffer: a
// malformed size would otherwise turn into a multi-gigabyte allocation
constexpr u64    kMaxZeroFill = 256ULL * 1024 * 1024;

constexpr u32 MH_MAGIC_32  = 0xFEEDFACE;
constexpr u32 MH_MAGIC_64  = 0xFEEDFACF;
constexpr u32 MH_CIGAM_32  = 0xCEFAEDFE;
constexpr u32 MH_CIGAM_64  = 0xCFFAEDFE;
// FAT headers are big-endian on disk; compared against be32() reads

constexpr u32 CPU_TYPE_X86    = 0x00000007;
constexpr u32 CPU_TYPE_X86_64 = 0x01000007;
constexpr u32 CPU_TYPE_ARM    = 0x0000000C;
constexpr u32 CPU_TYPE_ARM64  = 0x0100000C;

constexpr u32 LC_SEGMENT            = 0x01;
constexpr u32 LC_SYMTAB             = 0x02;
constexpr u32 LC_UNIXTHREAD         = 0x05;
constexpr u32 LC_DYSYMTAB           = 0x0B;
constexpr u32 LC_LOAD_DYLIB         = 0x0C;
constexpr u32 LC_SEGMENT_64         = 0x19;
constexpr u32 LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB    = 0x20;
constexpr u32 LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO    = 0x21;
constexpr u32 LC_FUNCTION_STARTS    = 0x26;
constexpr u32 LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO_64 = 0x2C;
constexpr u32 LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB    = 0x80000018;
constexpr u32 LC_REEXPORT_DYLIB     = 0x8000001F;

constexpr u32 LC_MAIN               = 0x80000028;

constexpr u32 VM_PROT_WRITE   = 2;

constexpr size_t kFatHeaderSize = 8;
constexpr size_t kFatArchSize   = 20;   // cputype, cpusubtype, offset, size, align
constexpr size_t kFatArch64Size = 32;   // cputype, cpusubtype, u64 offset, u64 size, align, reserved

bool range_ok(size_t size, u64 off, u64 len) {
    return off <= size && len <= size - off;
}

template <class T>
bool read_at(const u8* base, size_t size, u64 off, T& out) {
    if (!range_ok(size, off, sizeof(T))) return false;
    std::memcpy(&out, base + off, sizeof(T));
    return true;
}

u32 le32(const u8* p) {
    u32 v = 0;
    std::memcpy(&v, p, 4);
    return v;
}

u32 be32(const u8* p) {
    return (u32(p[0]) << 24) | (u32(p[1]) << 16) | (u32(p[2]) << 8) | u32(p[3]);
}

u64 be64(const u8* p) {
    return (u64(be32(p)) << 32) | be32(p + 4);
}

// FAT slice preference, lower is better; -1 for architectures we cannot analyze
int cpu_rank(u32 cputype) {
    switch (cputype) {
    case CPU_TYPE_ARM64:  return 0;
    case CPU_TYPE_X86_64: return 1;
    case CPU_TYPE_ARM:    return 2;
    case CPU_TYPE_X86:    return 3;
    default:              return -1;
    }
}

u32 prot_to_flags(u32 prot) {
    u32 f = 0;
    if (prot & VM_PROT_READ)    f |= 0x40000000;
    if (prot & VM_PROT_WRITE)   f |= 0x80000000;
    if (prot & VM_PROT_EXECUTE) f |= 0x20000000;
    return f;
}

bool is_zerofill(u32 sect_flags) {
    u32 type = sect_flags & SECTION_TYPE;
    return type == S_ZEROFILL || type == S_GB_ZEROFILL || type == S_THREAD_LOCAL_ZEROFILL;
}

std::string fixed_name(const char* s) {
    return std::string(s, strnlen(s, 16));
}

std::string_view strip_underscore(std::string_view name) {
    if (!name.empty() && name[0] == '_') name.remove_prefix(1);
    return name;
}

} // anon

bool MachOLoader::is_macho(const u8* data, size_t len) {
    if (!data || len < 4) return false;
    u32 le = le32(data);
    if (le == MH_MAGIC_32 || le == MH_MAGIC_64 || le == MH_CIGAM_32 || le == MH_CIGAM_64)
        return true;
    u32 be = be32(data);
    return be == FAT_MAGIC || be == FAT_MAGIC_64;
}

std::optional<MachOLoader::Slice> MachOLoader::select_slice(const u8* data, size_t len) {
    if (!data || len < 4) return std::nullopt;

    u32 le = le32(data);
    if (le == MH_MAGIC_64) {
        if (len < sizeof(MachHeader64)) return std::nullopt;
        return Slice{0, len};
    }
    if (le == MH_MAGIC_32) {
        if (len < sizeof(MachHeader32)) return std::nullopt;
        return Slice{0, len};
    }

    u32 magic = be32(data);
    if (magic != FAT_MAGIC && magic != FAT_MAGIC_64) return std::nullopt;
    if (len < kFatHeaderSize) return std::nullopt;

    bool   fat64    = magic == FAT_MAGIC_64;
    size_t entry_sz = fat64 ? kFatArch64Size : kFatArchSize;
    u64    narch    = (std::min<u64>)(be32(data + 4), (len - kFatHeaderSize) / entry_sz);

    int   best_rank = -1;
    Slice best;
    for (u64 i = 0; i < narch; ++i) {
        const u8* p = data + kFatHeaderSize + i * entry_sz;
        int rank = cpu_rank(be32(p));
        if (rank < 0) continue;

        u64 off = fat64 ? be64(p + 8)  : be32(p + 8);
        u64 sz  = fat64 ? be64(p + 16) : be32(p + 12);
        if (!range_ok(len, off, sz) || sz < sizeof(MachHeader32)) continue;

        // the slice itself must be a thin little-endian Mach-O
        u32 inner = le32(data + off);
        if (inner != MH_MAGIC_32 && inner != MH_MAGIC_64) continue;
        if (inner == MH_MAGIC_64 && sz < sizeof(MachHeader64)) continue;

        if (best_rank < 0 || rank < best_rank) {
            best_rank = rank;
            best = {static_cast<size_t>(off), static_cast<size_t>(sz)};
        }
    }
    if (best_rank < 0) return std::nullopt;
    return best;
}

std::optional<PEImage> MachOLoader::load(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!f) {
        spdlog::error("macho: cannot open: {}", path.string());
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    auto file_sz = static_cast<size_t>(f.tellg());
    if (file_sz > kMaxFileSize) {
        spdlog::error("macho: file too large: {} bytes (max {})", file_sz, kMaxFileSize);
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    auto raw = std::make_shared<std::vector<u8>>(file_sz);
    f.seekg(0);
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(raw->data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(file_sz));
    if (!f) {
        spdlog::error("macho: short read: {}", path.string());
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    // load_buffer only borrows, so the image keeps the bytes it was parsed from
    auto img = load_buffer(raw->data(), raw->size());
    if (img) img->storage.push_back(std::move(raw));
    return img;
}

std::optional<PEImage> MachOLoader::load_buffer(const u8* data, size_t len) {
    *this = MachOLoader{};

    auto slice = select_slice(data, len);
    if (!slice) {
        u32 le = (data && len >= 4) ? le32(data) : 0;
        if (le == MH_CIGAM_32 || le == MH_CIGAM_64)
            spdlog::error("macho: big-endian Mach-O is not supported");
        else
            spdlog::error("macho: not a Mach-O, or no usable slice ({} bytes)", len);
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    PEImage img;
    img.arch  = Arch::X64;
    img.base  = 0;
    img.entry = 0;
    img.raw   = {data, len};

    base_ = data + slice->offset;
    size_ = slice->size;

    if (!parse_header(img)) return std::nullopt;

    // two passes: symtab, dysymtab, dylibs and __TEXT may come in any order
    collect_load_commands(img);
    if (img.segments.empty()) {
        spdlog::error("macho: no mapped segments");
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    resolve_base_entry(img);
    validate_symtab();
    parse_symtab(img);
    parse_dysymtab(img);
    parse_function_starts(img);

    if (img.encrypted)
        spdlog::warn("macho: code is encrypted (cryptid != 0), disassembly will be noise");

    spdlog::info("macho: base=0x{:X} entry=0x{:X} segs={} imports={} exports={} symbols={} funcs={}",
                 img.base, img.entry, img.segments.size(), img.imports.size(),
                 img.exports.size(), img.symbols.size(), img.runtime_funcs.size());
    return img;
}

bool MachOLoader::parse_header(PEImage& img) {
    MachHeader32 hdr{};
    if (!read_at(base_, size_, 0, hdr)) return false;

    if (hdr.magic == MH_MAGIC_64) {
        is64_ = true;
        header_size_ = sizeof(MachHeader64);
    } else if (hdr.magic == MH_MAGIC_32) {
        is64_ = false;
        header_size_ = sizeof(MachHeader32);
    } else {
        spdlog::error("macho: bad magic 0x{:08X}", hdr.magic);
        return false;
    }
    if (size_ < header_size_) return false;

    img.format = ImageFormat::MachO;
    switch (hdr.cputype) {
    case CPU_TYPE_X86_64: img.arch = Arch::X64;   break;
    case CPU_TYPE_X86:    img.arch = Arch::X86;   break;
    case CPU_TYPE_ARM64:  img.arch = Arch::ARM64; break;
    case CPU_TYPE_ARM:    img.arch = Arch::ARM;   break;
    default:
        spdlog::error("macho: unsupported cputype 0x{:08X}", hdr.cputype);
        return false;
    }

    ncmds_      = hdr.ncmds;
    sizeofcmds_ = hdr.sizeofcmds;
    flags_      = hdr.flags;
    return true;
}

void MachOLoader::collect_load_commands(PEImage& img) {
    size_t end = header_size_ + static_cast<size_t>((std::min<u64>)(sizeofcmds_, size_ - header_size_));
    size_t off = header_size_;

    for (u32 i = 0; i < ncmds_; ++i) {
        LoadCmd lc{};
        if (end - off < sizeof(LoadCmd)) break;
        std::memcpy(&lc, base_ + off, sizeof(lc));
        if (lc.cmdsize < sizeof(LoadCmd) || lc.cmdsize > end - off) {
            spdlog::warn("macho: load command {} has bad size {}", i, lc.cmdsize);
            break;
        }

        switch (lc.cmd) {
        case LC_SEGMENT:
        case LC_SEGMENT_64:
            parse_segment(img, off, lc.cmdsize, lc.cmd == LC_SEGMENT_64);
            break;
        case LC_SYMTAB: {
            SymtabCmd sc{};
            if (lc.cmdsize >= sizeof(sc) && read_at(base_, size_, off, sc)) {
                symoff_  = sc.symoff;
                nsyms_   = sc.nsyms;
                stroff_  = sc.stroff;
                strsize_ = sc.strsize;
            }
            break;
        }
        case LC_DYSYMTAB: {
            DysymtabCmd dc{};
            if (lc.cmdsize >= sizeof(dc) && read_at(base_, size_, off, dc)) {
                indirectsymoff_ = dc.indirectsymoff;
                nindirectsyms_  = dc.nindirectsyms;
            }
            break;
        }
        case LC_LOAD_DYLIB:
        case LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB:
        case LC_REEXPORT_DYLIB:
        case LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB:
        case LC_LOAD_UPWARD_DYLIB:
            parse_dylib(off, lc.cmdsize);
            break;
        case LC_MAIN: {
            EntryPointCmd ep{};
            if (lc.cmdsize >= sizeof(ep) && read_at(base_, size_, off, ep)) {
                have_main_ = true;
                entryoff_  = ep.entryoff;
            }
            break;
        }
        case LC_UNIXTHREAD:
            parse_thread(img, off, lc.cmdsize);
            break;
        case LC_FUNCTION_STARTS: {
            LinkeditDataCmd ld{};
            if (lc.cmdsize >= sizeof(ld) && read_at(base_, size_, off, ld)) {
                fstarts_off_  = ld.dataoff;
                fstarts_size_ = ld.datasize;
            }
            break;
        }
        case LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO:
        case LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO_64: {
            EncryptionInfoCmd ec{};
            if (lc.cmdsize >= sizeof(ec) && read_at(base_, size_, off, ec) && ec.cryptid != 0)
                img.encrypted = true;
            break;
        }
        default:
            break;
        }
        off += lc.cmdsize;
    }
}

std::span<const u8> MachOLoader::file_view(PEImage& img, u64 off, u64 file_sz, u64 mem_sz,
                                           u64& backed) const {
    // a truncated slice backs only what it has
    size_t avail = off < size_ ? static_cast<size_t>((std::min<u64>)(file_sz, size_ - off)) : 0;
    const u8* p = avail ? base_ + off : base_;
    backed = avail;
    if (mem_sz > avail && mem_sz <= kMaxZeroFill)
        return segment_bytes(img, p, avail, static_cast<size_t>(mem_sz));
    return {p, avail};
}

void MachOLoader::parse_segment(PEImage& img, size_t off, u32 cmdsize, bool seg64) {
    std::string segname;
    u64 vmaddr = 0, vmsize = 0, fileoff = 0, filesize = 0;
    u32 initprot = 0, nsects = 0;
    size_t hdr_sz = 0;

    if (seg64) {
        SegmentCmd64 sc{};
        if (cmdsize < sizeof(sc) || !read_at(base_, size_, off, sc)) return;
        segname  = fixed_name(sc.segname);
        vmaddr   = sc.vmaddr;
        vmsize   = sc.vmsize;
        fileoff  = sc.fileoff;
        filesize = sc.filesize;
        initprot = sc.initprot;
        nsects   = sc.nsects;
        hdr_sz   = sizeof(sc);
    } else {
        SegmentCmd32 sc{};
        if (cmdsize < sizeof(sc) || !read_at(base_, size_, off, sc)) return;
        segname  = fixed_name(sc.segname);
        vmaddr   = sc.vmaddr;
        vmsize   = sc.vmsize;
        fileoff  = sc.fileoff;
        filesize = sc.filesize;
        initprot = sc.initprot;
        nsects   = sc.nsects;
        hdr_sz   = sizeof(sc);
    }

    if (segname == "__TEXT" && !have_text_) {
        have_text_    = true;
        text_vmaddr_  = vmaddr;
        text_fileoff_ = fileoff;
    }
    if (filesize > 0 && vmaddr < low_vmaddr_) low_vmaddr_ = vmaddr;

    // __PAGEZERO maps 4 GiB of nothing at 0; __LINKEDIT is loader metadata
    if (segname == "__PAGEZERO" || segname == "__LINKEDIT") return;
    if (vmsize == 0 && filesize == 0) return;

    u32 prot_flags = prot_to_flags(initprot);

    if (nsects == 0) {
        Segment seg;
        seg.name     = segname;
        seg.va       = vmaddr;
        seg.size     = vmsize;
        seg.file_off = fileoff;
        seg.flags    = prot_flags;
        seg.data     = file_view(img, fileoff, filesize, vmsize, seg.file_sz);
        img.segments.push_back(std::move(seg));
        return;
    }

    size_t sect_sz = seg64 ? sizeof(Section64) : sizeof(Section32);
    size_t room    = (cmdsize - hdr_sz) / sect_sz;
    if (nsects > room) {
        spdlog::warn("macho: segment {} claims {} sections, command holds {}", segname, nsects, room);
        nsects = static_cast<u32>(room);
    }

    for (u32 s = 0; s < nsects; ++s) {
        size_t sect_off = off + hdr_sz + s * sect_sz;
        SectInfo info;
        std::string name;
        u32 offset = 0;

        if (seg64) {
            Section64 sec{};
            if (!read_at(base_, size_, sect_off, sec)) break;
            name = fixed_name(sec.segname) + "." + fixed_name(sec.sectname);
            info = {sec.addr, sec.size, sec.flags, sec.reserved1, sec.reserved2};
            offset = sec.offset;
        } else {
            Section32 sec{};
            if (!read_at(base_, size_, sect_off, sec)) break;
            name = fixed_name(sec.segname) + "." + fixed_name(sec.sectname);
            info = {sec.addr, sec.size, sec.flags, sec.reserved1, sec.reserved2};
            offset = sec.offset;
        }

        Segment seg;
        seg.name  = std::move(name);
        seg.va    = info.addr;
        seg.size  = info.size;
        seg.flags = prot_flags & ~0x20000000u;
        // __TEXT also holds __cstring / __const: only instruction sections execute
        if ((initprot & VM_PROT_EXECUTE) &&
            (info.flags & (S_ATTR_PURE_INSTRUCTIONS | S_ATTR_SOME_INSTRUCTIONS)))
            seg.flags |= 0x20000000;

        if (is_zerofill(info.flags)) {
            seg.file_off = 0;
            seg.file_sz  = 0;
            if (info.size <= kMaxZeroFill)
                seg.data = segment_bytes(img, base_, 0, static_cast<size_t>(info.size));
        } else {
            seg.file_off = offset;
            seg.data     = file_view(img, offset, info.size, 0, seg.file_sz);
        }

        sects_.push_back(info);
        img.segments.push_back(std::move(seg));
    }
}

void MachOLoader::parse_dylib(size_t off, u32 cmdsize) {
    // every dylib command takes an ordinal slot, even an unreadable one
    std::string name;
    u32 name_off = 0;
    if (cmdsize >= 12 && read_at(base_, size_, off + 8, name_off) &&
        name_off >= 8 && name_off < cmdsize) {
        const char* p = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(base_ + off + name_off);
        std::string_view install(p, strnlen(p, cmdsize - name_off));
        auto slash = install.rfind('/');
        if (slash != std::string_view::npos) install.remove_prefix(slash + 1);
        name = install;
    }
    dylibs_.push_back(std::move(name));
}

void MachOLoader::parse_thread(PEImage& img, size_t off, u32 cmdsize) {
    // thread_command: cmd, cmdsize, flavor, count, then the register state
    size_t index = 0, width = 0;
    switch (img.arch) {
    case Arch::X64:   index = 16; width = 8; break;   // rip
    case Arch::ARM64: index = 32; width = 8; break;   // pc
    case Arch::X86:   index = 10; width = 4; break;   // eip
    case Arch::ARM:   index = 15; width = 4; break;   // r15
    default: return;
    }
    size_t at = 16 + index * width;
    if (cmdsize < at + width) return;

    if (width == 8) {
        u64 pc = 0;
        if (!read_at(base_, size_, off + at, pc)) return;
        thread_pc_ = pc;
    } else {
        u32 pc = 0;
        if (!read_at(base_, size_, off + at, pc)) return;
        thread_pc_ = pc;
    }
    have_thread_ = true;
}

void MachOLoader::resolve_base_entry(PEImage& img) {
    if (have_text_)
        img.base = text_vmaddr_;
    else
        img.base = low_vmaddr_ != INVALID_VA ? low_vmaddr_ : 0;

    // LC_MAIN's entryoff is a file offset into __TEXT. Guard the subtraction:
    // entryoff_ < text_fileoff_ underflowed to a bogus entry VA.
    if (have_main_) {
        if (have_text_ && entryoff_ >= text_fileoff_)
            img.entry = text_vmaddr_ + entryoff_ - text_fileoff_;
        else if (!have_text_)
            img.entry = img.base + entryoff_;
        // else: LC_MAIN disagrees with __TEXT; leave 0 for the segment fallback
    } else if (have_thread_) {
        img.entry = thread_pc_;
    }

    // thumb entry points carry the mode in bit 0
    if (img.arch == Arch::ARM) img.entry &= ~va_t(1);

    if (img.entry == 0) {
        auto exec = std::find_if(img.segments.begin(), img.segments.end(),
                                 [](const Segment& s) { return s.executable(); });
        img.entry = exec != img.segments.end() ? exec->va : img.segments.front().va;
        return;
    }

    bool mapped = std::any_of(img.segments.begin(), img.segments.end(),
                              [&](const Segment& s) { return s.contains(img.entry); });
    if (!mapped) spdlog::warn("macho: entry point 0x{:X} not within any section", img.entry);
}

void MachOLoader::validate_symtab() {
    size_t nl_sz = is64_ ? sizeof(Nlist64) : sizeof(Nlist32);
    if (!range_ok(size_, symoff_, u64(nsyms_) * nl_sz)) {
        if (nsyms_) spdlog::warn("macho: symbol table out of bounds");
        nsyms_ = 0;
    }
    if (!range_ok(size_, stroff_, strsize_)) {
        if (strsize_) spdlog::warn("macho: string table out of bounds");
        strsize_ = 0;
    }
    if (!range_ok(size_, indirectsymoff_, u64(nindirectsyms_) * 4)) {
        if (nindirectsyms_) spdlog::warn("macho: indirect symbol table out of bounds");
        nindirectsyms_ = 0;
    }
}

bool MachOLoader::read_nlist(u32 index, Nlist& out) const {
    if (index >= nsyms_) return false;
    if (is64_) {
        Nlist64 nl{};
        if (!read_at(base_, size_, u64(symoff_) + u64(index) * sizeof(Nlist64), nl)) return false;
        out = {nl.n_strx, nl.n_type, nl.n_sect, nl.n_desc, nl.n_value};
    } else {
        Nlist32 nl{};
        if (!read_at(base_, size_, u64(symoff_) + u64(index) * sizeof(Nlist32), nl)) return false;
        out = {nl.n_strx, nl.n_type, nl.n_sect, nl.n_desc, nl.n_value};
    }
    return true;
}

std::string_view MachOLoader::sym_name(const Nlist& nl) const {
    if (nl.strx >= strsize_) return {};
    const char* p = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(base_ + stroff_ + nl.strx);
    return {p, strnlen(p, strsize_ - nl.strx)};
}

std::string MachOLoader::dylib_for(u16 desc) const {
    // flat namespace images carry no library ordinals
    if (!(flags_ & MH_TWOLEVEL)) return {};
    u32 ordinal = (desc >> 8) & 0xFF;   // GET_LIBRARY_ORDINAL
    if (ordinal == 0 || ordinal == DYNAMIC_LOOKUP_ORDINAL || ordinal == EXECUTABLE_ORDINAL)
        return {};
    if (ordinal > dylibs_.size()) return {};
    return dylibs_[ordinal - 1];
}

void MachOLoader::parse_symtab(PEImage& img) {
    for (u32 i = 0; i < nsyms_; ++i) {
        Nlist nl;
        if (!read_nlist(i, nl)) break;
        if (nl.type & N_STAB) continue;
        if ((nl.type & N_TYPE) != N_SECT) continue;
        if (nl.value == 0) continue;

        auto name = strip_underscore(sym_name(nl));
        if (name.empty()) continue;

        if (nl.type & N_EXT) {
            Export exp;
            exp.name = std::string(name);
            exp.addr = nl.value;
            img.exports.push_back(std::move(exp));
        } else {
            img.symbols.push_back({std::string(name), nl.value});
        }
    }
}

void MachOLoader::parse_dysymtab(PEImage& img) {
    if (!nindirectsyms_) return;
    const u64 ptr_sz = is64_ ? 8 : 4;

    for (const auto& s : sects_) {
        u32  type  = s.flags & SECTION_TYPE;
        bool ptrs  = type == S_NON_LAZY_SYMBOL_POINTERS || type == S_LAZY_SYMBOL_POINTERS ||
                     type == S_LAZY_DYLIB_SYMBOL_POINTERS;
        bool stubs = type == S_SYMBOL_STUBS;
        if (!ptrs && !stubs) continue;

        u64 stride = ptrs ? ptr_sz : s.reserved2;
        if (stride == 0) continue;

        u64 count = s.size / stride;
        for (u64 j = 0; j < count; ++j) {
            u64 idx = u64(s.reserved1) + j;
            if (idx >= nindirectsyms_) break;

            u32 isym = le32(base_ + indirectsymoff_ + idx * 4);
            if (isym & (INDIRECT_SYMBOL_LOCAL | INDIRECT_SYMBOL_ABS)) continue;

            Nlist nl;
            if (!read_nlist(isym, nl)) continue;
            auto name = strip_underscore(sym_name(nl));
            if (name.empty()) continue;

            va_t at = s.addr + j * stride;
            if (ptrs) {
                Import imp;
                imp.dll      = dylib_for(nl.desc);
                imp.name     = std::string(name);
                imp.ordinal  = 0;
                imp.iat_addr = at;
                img.imports.push_back(std::move(imp));
            } else {
                img.symbols.push_back({std::string(name), at});
            }
        }
    }
}

void MachOLoader::parse_function_starts(PEImage& img) {
    if (!fstarts_size_) return;
    if (!range_ok(size_, fstarts_off_, fstarts_size_)) {
        spdlog::warn("macho: function starts out of bounds");
        return;
    }

    // ULEB128 deltas, the first from the __TEXT start, terminated by 0
    const u8* p = base_ + fstarts_off_;
    const u8* e = p + fstarts_size_;
    va_t addr = have_text_ ? text_vmaddr_ : img.base;
    std::vector<va_t> starts;
    while (p < e) {
        u64 delta = 0;
        unsigned shift = 0;
        bool done = false;
        while (p < e) {
            u8 b = *p++;
            if (shift < 64) delta |= u64(b & 0x7F) << shift;
            shift += 7;
            if (!(b & 0x80)) { done = true; break; }
        }
        if (!done || delta == 0) break;
        addr += delta;
        starts.push_back(img.arch == Arch::ARM ? addr & ~va_t(1) : addr);
    }
    std::sort(starts.begin(), starts.end());
    starts.erase(std::unique(starts.begin(), starts.end()), starts.end());

    std::vector<const Segment*> exec;
    for (const auto& seg : img.segments)
        if (seg.executable() && seg.size) exec.push_back(&seg);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < starts.size(); ++i) {
        va_t start = starts[i];
        auto it = std::find_if(exec.begin(), exec.end(),
                               [&](const Segment* s) { return s->contains(start); });
        if (it == exec.end()) continue;
        va_t end = (*it)->va + (*it)->size;
        if (i + 1 < starts.size()) end = (std::min)(end, starts[i + 1]);
        img.runtime_funcs.push_back({start, end});
    }
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/loader/macho_loader.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/types.h"
#include "pe_loader.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace hype {

// Little-endian Mach-O (thin, or the preferred slice of a FAT / FAT64 file)
// into the PE-shaped image the analyzer consumes. One segment per section,
// named "<seg>.<sect>"; file offsets are relative to the analyzed slice
class MachOLoader {
public:
    std::optional<PEImage> load(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // In-memory variant: borrows `data` (must outlive the image) exactly like
    // PELoader::load_buffer. FAT input analyzes the slice select_slice() picks
    std::optional<PEImage> load_buffer(const u8* data, size_t len);

    struct Slice { size_t offset = 0; size_t size = 0; };
    // Thin little-endian Mach-O -> whole buffer. FAT / FAT64 -> preferred
    // slice: arm64, then x86_64, then arm, then x86. nullopt when not a
    // Mach-O or no usable slice
    static std::optional<Slice> select_slice(const u8* data, size_t len);
    // Thin (either endianness) or FAT/FAT64 magic in the first 4 bytes
    static bool is_macho(const u8* data, size_t len);

private:
    struct SectInfo {
        va_t addr      = 0;
        u64  size      = 0;
        u32  flags     = 0;
        u32  reserved1 = 0;
        u32  reserved2 = 0;
    };
    struct Nlist {
        u32 strx  = 0;
        u8  type  = 0;
        u8  sect  = 0;
        u16 desc  = 0;
        u64 value = 0;
    };

    bool parse_header(PEImage& img);
    // pass 1: emit segments, record every other command's fields
    void collect_load_commands(PEImage& img);
    void parse_segment(PEImage& img, size_t off, u32 cmdsize, bool seg64);
    void parse_dylib(size_t off, u32 cmdsize);
    void parse_thread(PEImage& img, size_t off, u32 cmdsize);
    // pass 2: everything that depends on more than one command
    void resolve_base_entry(PEImage& img);
    void validate_symtab();
    void parse_symtab(PEImage& img);
    void parse_dysymtab(PEImage& img);
    void parse_function_starts(PEImage& img);

    std::span<const u8> file_view(PEImage& img, u64 off, u64 file_sz, u64 mem_sz,
                                  u64& backed) const;
    bool read_nlist(u32 index, Nlist& out) const;
    std::string_view sym_name(const Nlist& nl) const;
    std::string dylib_for(u16 desc) const;

    const u8* base_ = nullptr;   // analyzed slice
    size_t    size_ = 0;
    bool      is64_ = true;
    size_t    header_size_ = 0;
    u32       ncmds_ = 0;
    u32       sizeofcmds_ = 0;
    u32       flags_ = 0;

    bool      have_text_ = false;
    va_t      text_vmaddr_ = 0;
    u64       text_fileoff_ = 0;
    va_t      low_vmaddr_ = INVALID_VA;   // lowest file-backed segment

    bool      have_main_ = false;
    u64       entryoff_ = 0;
    bool      have_thread_ = false;
    va_t      thread_pc_ = 0;

    u32       symoff_ = 0;
    u32       nsyms_ = 0;
    u32       stroff_ = 0;
    u32       strsize_ = 0;
    u32       indirectsymoff_ = 0;
    u32       nindirectsyms_ = 0;
    u32       fstarts_off_ = 0;
    u32       fstarts_size_ = 0;

    std::vector<std::string> dylibs_;   // load order = two-level library ordinal - 1
    std::vector<SectInfo>    sects_;
};

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/loader/pe_loader.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "pe_loader.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <cstring>
#include <spdlog/spdlog.h>
#include <fmt/format.h>

namespace hype {

namespace {

constexpr size_t kMaxFileSize   = 2ULL * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
constexpr u16    kMaxSections   = 256;
constexpr u32    kMaxImports    = 1'000'000;
constexpr u32    kMaxExports    = 1'000'000;
constexpr u32    kMaxNameLen    = 1024;
constexpr u32    kMaxILTEntries = 500'000;

#pragma pack(push, 1)
struct DosHdr {
    u16 magic;
    u8  pad[58];
    u32 lfanew;
};

struct CoffHdr {
    u16 machine;
    u16 num_sections;
    u32 timestamp;
    u32 sym_table;
    u32 num_symbols;
    u16 opt_size;
    u16 characteristics;
};

struct DataDir {
    u32 rva;
    u32 size;
};

struct OptHdr64 {
    u16 magic;
    u8  link_maj, link_min;
    u32 code_sz, idata_sz, udata_sz;
    u32 entry_rva, code_base;
    u64 image_base;
    u32 sect_align, file_align;
    u16 os_maj, os_min, img_maj, img_min, sub_maj, sub_min;
    u32 win32ver;
    u32 image_sz, hdr_sz, checksum;
    u16 subsys, dll_chars;
    u64 stack_res, stack_com, heap_res, heap_com;
    u32 loader_flags, num_dd;
    DataDir dd[16];
};

struct OptHdr32 {
    u16 magic;
    u8  link_maj, link_min;
    u32 code_sz, idata_sz, udata_sz;
    u32 entry_rva, code_base, data_base;
    u32 image_base;
    u32 sect_align, file_align;
    u16 os_maj, os_min, img_maj, img_min, sub_maj, sub_min;
    u32 win32ver;
    u32 image_sz, hdr_sz, checksum;
    u16 subsys, dll_chars;
    u32 stack_res, stack_com, heap_res, heap_com;
    u32 loader_flags, num_dd;
    DataDir dd[16];
};

struct SectHdr {
    char name[8];
    u32  vsize;
    u32  vrva;
    u32  raw_sz;
    u32  raw_ptr;
    u32  reloc_ptr;
    u32  line_ptr;
    u16  num_relocs;
    u16  num_lines;
    u32  chars;
};

struct ImpDesc {
    u32 orig_thunk;
    u32 timestamp;
    u32 forwarder;
    u32 name_rva;
    u32 thunk;
};

struct ExpDir {
    u32 chars, timestamp;
    u16 maj, min;
    u32 name_rva, ord_base;
    u32 num_funcs, num_names;
    u32 funcs_rva, names_rva, ords_rva;
};
#pragma pack(pop)

template<typename T>
const T* ptr_at(const u8* base, size_t off, size_t total) {
    if (off + sizeof(T) > total) return nullptr;
    return reinterpret_cast<const T*>(base + off);
}

bool safe_add(size_t a, size_t b, size_t& result) {
    result = a + b;
    return result >= a;
}

[[maybe_unused]] bool safe_add32(u32 a, u32 b, u32& result) {
    result = a + b;
    return result >= a;
}

std::string safe_string(const u8* base, size_t off, size_t total, size_t max_len = kMaxNameLen) {
    if (off >= total) return {};
    size_t avail = total - off;
    size_t limit = std::min(avail, max_len);
    auto* start = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(base + off);
    size_t len = strnlen(start, limit);
    return std::string(start, len);
}

u32 rva_to_raw(const PEImage& img, u32 rva) {
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        u32 seg_rva = static_cast<u32>(seg.va - img.base);
        if (rva >= seg_rva && rva < seg_rva + seg.file_sz)
            return static_cast<u32>(seg.file_off + (rva - seg_rva));
    }
    return 0;
}

bool entry_in_section(const PEImage& img, va_t entry) {
    for (auto& seg : img.segments) {
        if (entry >= seg.va && entry < seg.va + seg.size)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool sections_overlap(const std::vector<Segment>& segs) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < segs.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < segs.size(); ++j) {
            va_t a_start = segs[i].va, a_end = segs[i].va + segs[i].size;
            va_t b_start = segs[j].va, b_end = segs[j].va + segs[j].size;
            if (a_start < b_end && b_start < a_end) return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

} // anon

std::optional<PEImage> PELoader::load_buffer(const u8* data, size_t len) {
    if (!data || len < sizeof(DosHdr)) {
        spdlog::error("buffer too small for DOS header ({} bytes)", len);
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    // borrowed, not copied: a multi-hundred-megabyte image was held here and
    // again per section on top of the caller's own buffer
    PEImage img;
    img.raw = {data, len};

    base_ = data;
    size_ = len;

    if (!parse_headers(img)) return std::nullopt;
    if (!parse_sections(img)) return std::nullopt;

    if (!entry_in_section(img, img.entry) && img.entry != img.base) {
        spdlog::warn("entry point 0x{:X} not within any section", img.entry);
    }

    if (sections_overlap(img.segments)) {
        spdlog::warn("overlapping section RVAs detected");
    }

    parse_imports(img);
    parse_exports(img);
    parse_exceptions(img);

    spdlog::info("PE: {} segs, {} imports, {} exports, {} runtime_funcs",
                 img.segments.size(), img.imports.size(), img.exports.size(),
                 img.runtime_funcs.size());
    return img;
}

std::optional<PEImage> PELoader::load(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!f) {
        spdlog::error("cannot open: {}", path.string());
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    auto file_sz = static_cast<size_t>(f.tellg());
    if (file_sz > kMaxFileSize) {
        spdlog::error("file too large: {} bytes (max {})", file_sz, kMaxFileSize);
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    auto raw = std::make_shared<std::vector<u8>>(file_sz);
    f.seekg(0);
    f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(raw->data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(file_sz));
    if (raw->size() < sizeof(DosHdr)) {
        spdlog::error("file too small for DOS header");
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    // load_buffer only borrows, so the image keeps the bytes it was parsed from
    auto img = load_buffer(raw->data(), raw->size());
    if (img) img->storage.push_back(std::move(raw));
    return img;
}

bool PELoader::parse_headers(PEImage& img) {
    auto dos = ptr_at<DosHdr>(base_, 0, size_);
    if (!dos || dos->magic != 0x5A4D) return false;

    u32 pe_off = dos->lfanew;
    size_t pe_sig_end;
    if (!safe_add(pe_off, 4, pe_sig_end) || pe_sig_end > size_) return false;
    if (std::memcmp(base_ + pe_off, "PE\0\0", 4) != 0) return false;

    size_t coff_off;
    if (!safe_add(pe_off, 4, coff_off)) return false;
    auto coff = ptr_at<CoffHdr>(base_, coff_off, size_);
    if (!coff) return false;

    if (coff->num_sections > kMaxSections) {
        spdlog::error("too many sections: {}", coff->num_sections);
        return false;
    }

    size_t opt_off;
    if (!safe_add(coff_off, sizeof(CoffHdr), opt_off)) return false;
    if (opt_off + 2 > size_) return false;

    u16 magic = 0;
    std::memcpy(&magic, base_ + opt_off, 2);

    if (magic == 0x20B) {
        img.arch = Arch::X64;
        auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr64>(base_, opt_off, size_);
        if (!opt) return false;
        img.base = opt->image_base;
        img.entry = img.base + opt->entry_rva;

        if (opt->image_base % opt->sect_align != 0 && opt->sect_align != 0) {
            spdlog::warn("image_base 0x{:X} not aligned to section_alignment 0x{:X}",
                         opt->image_base, opt->sect_align);
        }
    } else if (magic == 0x10B) {
        img.arch = Arch::X86;
        auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr32>(base_, opt_off, size_);
        if (!opt) return false;
        img.base = opt->image_base;
        img.entry = img.base + opt->entry_rva;

        if (opt->image_base % opt->sect_align != 0 && opt->sect_align != 0) {
            spdlog::warn("image_base 0x{:X} not aligned to section_alignment 0x{:X}",
                         opt->image_base, opt->sect_align);
        }
    } else {
        spdlog::error("unknown PE optional magic: 0x{:X}", magic);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool PELoader::parse_sections(PEImage& img) {
    auto dos = ptr_at<DosHdr>(base_, 0, size_);
    if (!dos) return false;
    u32 pe_off = dos->lfanew;

    size_t coff_off;
    if (!safe_add(pe_off, 4, coff_off)) return false;
    auto coff = ptr_at<CoffHdr>(base_, coff_off, size_);
    if (!coff) return false;

    size_t sec_off;
    if (!safe_add(coff_off, sizeof(CoffHdr) + coff->opt_size, sec_off)) return false;

    for (u16 i = 0; i < coff->num_sections; ++i) {
        size_t entry_off;
        if (!safe_add(sec_off, static_cast<size_t>(i) * sizeof(SectHdr), entry_off)) break;
        auto sh = ptr_at<SectHdr>(base_, entry_off, size_);
        if (!sh) break;

        Segment seg;
        seg.name.assign(sh->name, strnlen(sh->name, 8));
        seg.va = img.base + sh->vrva;
        seg.size = sh->vsize ? (std::max)(sh->vsize, sh->raw_sz) : sh->raw_sz;
        seg.file_off = sh->raw_ptr;
        seg.file_sz = sh->raw_sz;
        seg.flags = sh->chars;

        size_t raw_end;
        if (safe_add(sh->raw_ptr, sh->raw_sz, raw_end) && raw_end <= size_) {
            seg.data = {base_ + sh->raw_ptr, sh->raw_sz};
        }
        img.segments.push_back(std::move(seg));
    }
    return true;
}

bool PELoader::parse_imports(PEImage& img) {
    auto dos = ptr_at<DosHdr>(base_, 0, size_);
    if (!dos) return false;
    u32 pe_off = dos->lfanew;

    size_t opt_off;
    if (!safe_add(static_cast<size_t>(pe_off) + 4, sizeof(CoffHdr), opt_off)) return false;
    if (opt_off + 2 > size_) return false;

    u16 magic = 0;
    std::memcpy(&magic, base_ + opt_off, 2);

    DataDir idir{};
    if (magic == 0x20B) {
        auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr64>(base_, opt_off, size_);
        if (!opt || opt->num_dd < 2) return false;
        idir = opt->dd[1];
    } else {
        auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr32>(base_, opt_off, size_);
        if (!opt || opt->num_dd < 2) return false;
        idir = opt->dd[1];
    }
    if (idir.rva == 0) return true;

    u32 off = rva_to_raw(img, idir.rva);
    if (!off) return false;
    bool x64 = (img.arch == Arch::X64);

    u32 desc_count = 0;
    for (;;) {
        if (desc_count >= kMaxImports) {
            spdlog::warn("import descriptor limit reached");
            break;
        }
        auto desc = ptr_at<ImpDesc>(base_, off, size_);
        if (!desc || (!desc->orig_thunk && !desc->thunk)) break;

        u32 nm_off = rva_to_raw(img, desc->name_rva);
        std::string dll = safe_string(base_, nm_off, size_);

        u32 thunk_rva = desc->orig_thunk ? desc->orig_thunk : desc->thunk;
        u32 iat_rva = desc->thunk;
        u32 t_off = rva_to_raw(img, thunk_rva);

        u32 ilt_count = 0;
        while (t_off && t_off < size_) {
            if (ilt_count >= kMaxILTEntries) {
                spdlog::warn("ILT iteration limit for {}", dll);
                break;
            }
            u64 entry = 0;
            if (x64) {
                if (t_off + 8 > size_) break;
                std::memcpy(&entry, base_ + t_off, 8);
                t_off += 8;
            } else {
                u32 e32 = 0;
                if (t_off + 4 > size_) break;
                std::memcpy(&e32, base_ + t_off, 4);
                entry = e32;
                t_off += 4;
            }
            if (!entry) break;

            Import imp;
            imp.dll = dll;
            imp.iat_addr = img.base + iat_rva;
            iat_rva += x64 ? 8 : 4;

            u64 ord_flag = x64 ? (1ULL << 63) : (1ULL << 31);
            if (entry & ord_flag) {
                imp.ordinal = static_cast<u16>(entry & 0xFFFF);
                imp.name = fmt::format("ord_{}", imp.ordinal);
            } else {
                u32 h_off = rva_to_raw(img, static_cast<u32>(entry));
                if (h_off && h_off + 2 < size_) {
                    std::memcpy(&imp.ordinal, base_ + h_off, 2);
                    imp.name = safe_string(base_, static_cast<size_t>(h_off) + 2, size_);
                }
            }
            img.imports.push_back(std::move(imp));
            ++ilt_count;
        }
        off += sizeof(ImpDesc);
        ++desc_count;
    }
    return true;
}

bool PELoader::parse_exports(PEImage& img) {
    auto dos = ptr_at<DosHdr>(base_, 0, size_);
    if (!dos) return false;
    u32 pe_off = dos->lfanew;

    size_t opt_off;
    if (!safe_add(static_cast<size_t>(pe_off) + 4, sizeof(CoffHdr), opt_off)) return false;
    if (opt_off + 2 > size_) return false;

    u16 magic = 0;
    std::memcpy(&magic, base_ + opt_off, 2);

    DataDir edir{};
    if (magic == 0x20B) {
        auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr64>(base_, opt_off, size_);
        if (!opt || opt->num_dd < 1) return false;
        edir = opt->dd[0];
    } else {
        auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr32>(base_, opt_off, size_);
        if (!opt || opt->num_dd < 1) return false;
        edir = opt->dd[0];
    }
    if (edir.rva == 0) return true;

    u32 off = rva_to_raw(img, edir.rva);
    if (!off) return false;

    auto dir = ptr_at<ExpDir>(base_, off, size_);
    if (!dir) return false;

    if (dir->num_funcs > kMaxExports || dir->num_names > kMaxExports) {
        spdlog::error("export table too large: {} funcs, {} names", dir->num_funcs, dir->num_names);
        return false;
    }
    if (dir->ord_base > 0xFFFF) {
        spdlog::warn("suspicious ordinal_base: {}", dir->ord_base);
    }

    const u32 funcs_off = rva_to_raw(img, dir->funcs_rva);
    const u32 names_off = rva_to_raw(img, dir->names_rva);
    const u32 ords_off  = rva_to_raw(img, dir->ords_rva);
    if (!funcs_off) return false;

    std::vector<std::string> names(dir->num_funcs);
    for (u32 i = 0; i < dir->num_names && names_off && ords_off; ++i) {
        const size_t name_entry_off = static_cast<size_t>(names_off) + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 4;
        const size_t ord_entry_off  = static_cast<size_t>(ords_off) + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 2;
        if (name_entry_off + 4 > size_ || ord_entry_off + 2 > size_) break;
        u32 name_rva = 0;
        u16 ord_idx = 0;
        std::memcpy(&name_rva, base_ + name_entry_off, 4);
        std::memcpy(&ord_idx, base_ + ord_entry_off, 2);
        if (ord_idx < names.size())
            names[ord_idx] = safe_string(base_, rva_to_raw(img, name_rva), size_);
    }

    for (u32 ord_idx = 0; ord_idx < dir->num_funcs; ++ord_idx) {
        const size_t func_entry_off = static_cast<size_t>(funcs_off) + static_cast<size_t>(ord_idx) * 4;
        if (func_entry_off + 4 > size_) break;
        u32 func_rva = 0;
        std::memcpy(&func_rva, base_ + func_entry_off, 4);
        if (!func_rva) continue;

        Export exp;
        exp.name = names[ord_idx];
        exp.ordinal = static_cast<u16>(ord_idx + dir->ord_base);
        exp.addr = img.base + func_rva;
        const u64 export_end = static_cast<u64>(edir.rva) + edir.size;
        if (func_rva >= edir.rva && static_cast<u64>(func_rva) < export_end) {
            exp.forwarded = true;
            exp.forwarder = safe_string(base_, rva_to_raw(img, func_rva), size_);
        }
        img.exports.push_back(std::move(exp));
    }
    return true;
}

void PELoader::parse_exceptions(PEImage& img) {
    if (img.arch != Arch::X64) return;

    auto dos = ptr_at<DosHdr>(base_, 0, size_);
    if (!dos) return;
    u32 pe_off = dos->lfanew;

    size_t opt_off;
    if (!safe_add(static_cast<size_t>(pe_off) + 4, sizeof(CoffHdr), opt_off)) return;
    auto opt = ptr_at<OptHdr64>(base_, opt_off, size_);
    if (!opt || opt->num_dd < 4) return;

    DataDir pdata = opt->dd[3];
    if (pdata.rva == 0 || pdata.size == 0) return;

    u32 raw_off = rva_to_raw(img, pdata.rva);
    if (!raw_off) return;

    struct RtFunc { u32 begin_rva; u32 end_rva; u32 unwind_rva; };
    u32 count = pdata.size / sizeof(RtFunc);

    [[maybe_unused]] constexpr u32 kMaxExceptions = 500'000;
    if (count > kMaxExceptions) count = kMaxExceptions;

    for (u32 i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        size_t entry_off;
        if (!safe_add(raw_off, static_cast<size_t>(i) * sizeof(RtFunc), entry_off)) break;
        auto rf = ptr_at<RtFunc>(base_, entry_off, size_);
        if (!rf || rf->begin_rva == 0) break;
        img.runtime_funcs.push_back({img.base + rf->begin_rva, img.base + rf->end_rva});
    }
}

}
```

`src/hyperion/core/loader/pe_loader.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "core/types.h"
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>

namespace hype {

struct RuntimeFunc {
    va_t start;
    va_t end;
};

struct PEImage {
    Arch                       arch;
    va_t                       base;
    va_t                       entry;
    ImageFormat                format = ImageFormat::PE;
    std::vector<Segment>       segments;
    std::vector<Import>        imports;
    std::vector<Export>        exports;
    std::vector<RuntimeFunc>   runtime_funcs;
    std::vector<Symbol>        symbols;
    // Code bytes are encrypted on disk (Mach-O LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO cryptid != 0,
    // a FairPlay-protected App Store binary): decoded instructions are noise
    bool                       encrypted = false;
    // Whole file bytes. load_buffer() borrows the caller's buffer, which must
    // outlive the image; load() and the ELF/Mach-O loaders keep what they read,
    // plus any zero-extended segment tails, alive in `storage`
    std::span<const u8>                           raw;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<std::vector<u8>>> storage;
};

// `file_sz` bytes at `p` as segment data, zero-extended to `mem_sz` when the
// segment maps more than the file backs. Only that extended case copies
inline std::span<const u8> segment_bytes(PEImage& img, const u8* p, size_t file_sz,
                                         size_t mem_sz = 0) {
    if (mem_sz <= file_sz) return {p, file_sz};
    auto tail = std::make_shared<std::vector<u8>>(p, p + file_sz);
    tail->resize(mem_sz, 0);
    img.storage.push_back(tail);
    return *tail;
}

class PELoader {
public:
    std::optional<PEImage> load(const std::filesystem::path& path);
    // In-memory variant (reverse-slop port): parse from a byte buffer —
    // e.g. the session's patched `file` image — instead of re-reading disk.
    std::optional<PEImage> load_buffer(const u8* data, size_t len);

private:
    bool parse_headers(PEImage& img);
    bool parse_sections(PEImage& img);
    bool parse_imports(PEImage& img);
    bool parse_exports(PEImage& img);
    void parse_exceptions(PEImage& img);

    const u8* base_ = nullptr;
    size_t    size_ = 0;
};

}
```
