```hpp
using slop::core::runtime::backend_ps5_t;
using slop::core::runtime::backend_kind_t;

constexpr uint32_t kFakePid = 4242;

struct wsa_init_t {
    wsa_init_t() { WSADATA d; WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &d); }
    ~wsa_init_t() { WSACleanup(); }
};
wsa_init_t& wsa() {
    static wsa_init_t w;
    return w;
}

// an ephemeral loopback port for the payload's port-755 connect-back, so the
// tests never fight over the fixed port
uint16_t free_tcp_port() {
    wsa();
    SOCKET s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) return 0;
    sockaddr_in addr{};
    addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    addr.sin_port        = 0;
    if (bind(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), sizeof(addr)) != 0) {
        closesocket(s);
        return 0;
    }
    slop_socklen_t len = sizeof(addr);
    getsockname(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), &len);
    const uint16_t port = ntohs(addr.sin_port);
    closesocket(s);
    return port;
}

// fault injection for the fake payload's replies (server thread only)
struct chaos_t {
    std::atomic<bool>     fragment{false};    // replies leave 1-3 bytes per send
    std::atomic<uint32_t> stall_cmd{0};       // never answer this command (one-shot)
    std::atomic<uint32_t> close_cmd{0};       // cut the connection while answering (one-shot)
    std::atomic<int>      close_after{0};     // reply bytes sent before the cut
    std::atomic<uint32_t> garbage_cmd{0};     // answer with a non-status word (one-shot)
    std::atomic<bool>     refuse_detach{false};
    std::atomic<bool>     hide_game_pid{false};   // process list omits kFakePid
    std::atomic<uint32_t> thread_count{2};
};
thread_local chaos_t* tl_chaos = nullptr;
thread_local int tl_budget = -1;   // reply bytes left before the cut, -1 = unlimited

bool send_raw(SOCKET s, const char* p, size_t left) {
    while (left > 0) {
        int n = ::send(s, p, static_cast<int>(left), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        p += n;
        left -= static_cast<size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

bool send_all(SOCKET s, const void* buf, size_t len) {
    const char* p = static_cast<const char*>(buf);
    chaos_t* ch = tl_chaos;
    if (!ch) return send_raw(s, p, len);
    size_t left = len;
    const bool frag = ch->fragment.load();
    int step = 1;
    while (left > 0) {
        size_t n = frag ? std::min<size_t>(left, static_cast<size_t>(step)) : left;
        step = step % 3 + 1;
        if (tl_budget >= 0) {
            if (tl_budget == 0) {
                ::shutdown(s, SD_BOTH);
                return false;
            }
            n = std::min<size_t>(n, static_cast<size_t>(tl_budget));
            tl_budget -= static_cast<int>(n);
        }
        if (!send_raw(s, p, n)) return false;
        p += n;
        left -= n;
    }
    if (tl_budget == 0) {   // budget ended exactly at a reply boundary: cut now
        ::shutdown(s, SD_BOTH);
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool recv_all(SOCKET s, void* buf, size_t len) {
    char* p = static_cast<char*>(buf);
    size_t left = len;
    while (left > 0) {
        int n = ::recv(s, p, static_cast<int>(left), 0);
        if (n <= 0) return false;
        p += n;
        left -= static_cast<size_t>(n);
    }
    return true;
}

bool send_u32(SOCKET s, uint32_t v) { return send_all(s, &v, sizeof(v)); }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// fake ps5debug-NG payload

struct fake_ps5_server_t {
    SOCKET listen_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;
    uint16_t port = 0;
    std::thread th;
    std::atomic<bool> stop_flag{false};

    std::mutex mu;
    std::map<uint64_t, std::array<uint8_t, 0x1000>> mem;   // 4 KiB pages
    std::vector<ps5::vm_map_entry_t> maps;
    bool debug_attached = false;
    uint32_t debug_pid = 0;
    SOCKET event_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;   // our side of the port-755 callback
    uint16_t event_port = 0;            // where the debug channel connects back
    uint32_t last_protect = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    uint32_t last_alloc_hint = 0;
    std::map<uint32_t, ps5::reg64_t> thread_regs;
    chaos_t chaos;
    int connections = 0;
    int commands_seen = 0;
    int detach_count = 0;

    // debug-session state observed by the tests
    struct bp_t { bool enabled = false; uint64_t address = 0; };
    struct wp_t { bool enabled = false; uint32_t length = 0; uint32_t breaktype = 0; uint64_t address = 0; };
    std::map<uint32_t, bp_t> bps;
    std::map<uint32_t, wp_t> wps;
    uint32_t last_continue_stop = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    uint32_t last_suspend = 0, last_resume = 0;
    int step_calls = 0, step_thread_calls = 0;

    // console state observed by the tests
    std::string last_notify, last_print;
    uint32_t last_notify_type = 0;

    void add_map(const char* name, uint64_t start, uint64_t end, uint16_t prot) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        ps5::vm_map_entry_t m{};
        std::strncpy(m.name, name, sizeof(m.name) - 1);
        m.start = start;
        m.end = end;
        m.offset = 0;
        m.prot = prot;
        maps.push_back(m);
    }

    // eboot text/relro, an anonymous RW gap, eboot data, a shared library and
    // the stack: the same shape the PS4 fixture uses
    void seed_maps() {
        add_map("/app0/eboot.bin", 0x400000, 0x480000, ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtExec);
        add_map("/app0/eboot.bin", 0x480000, 0x4C0000, ps5::kVmProtRead);
        add_map("", 0x4C0000, 0x4C8000, ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtWrite);
        add_map("/app0/eboot.bin", 0x4C8000, 0x500000, ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtWrite);
        add_map("/app0/libSceLibcInternal.sprx", 0x500000, 0x510000,
                ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtExec);
        add_map("", 0x7FFF00000000ull, 0x7FFF00010000ull,
                ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtWrite);
    }

    bool start() {
        wsa();
        seed_maps();
        listen_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
        if (listen_fd == INVALID_SOCKET) return false;
        int flag = 1;
        setsockopt(listen_fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR,
                   reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&flag), sizeof(flag));
        sockaddr_in addr{};
        addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
        addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
        addr.sin_port = 0;   // ephemeral
        if (bind(listen_fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), sizeof(addr)) != 0) return false;
        if (listen(listen_fd, 4) != 0) return false;
        slop_socklen_t len = sizeof(addr);
        getsockname(listen_fd, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), &len);
        port = ntohs(addr.sin_port);
        th = std::thread([this] { accept_loop(); });
        return true;
    }

    void shutdown() {
        stop_flag = true;
        if (listen_fd != INVALID_SOCKET) {
            ::shutdown(listen_fd, SD_BOTH);
            closesocket(listen_fd);
            listen_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;
        }
        {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            if (event_fd != INVALID_SOCKET) {
                closesocket(event_fd);
                event_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;
            }
        }
        if (th.joinable()) th.join();
        std::vector<std::thread> ths;
        {
            std::lock_guard lk(conn_mu);
            for (SOCKET c : conn_socks) {
                ::shutdown(c, SD_BOTH);
                closesocket(c);
            }
            conn_socks.clear();
            ths.swap(conn_threads);
        }
        for (auto& t : ths)
            if (t.joinable()) t.join();
    }

    ~fake_ps5_server_t() { shutdown(); }

    uint8_t mem_byte(uint64_t addr) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        auto it = mem.find(addr & ~0xFFFull);
        return it == mem.end() ? 0 : it->second[addr & 0xFFF];
    }

    void mem_write(uint64_t addr, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            const uint64_t a = addr + i;
            mem[a & ~0xFFFull][a & 0xFFF] = data[i];
        }
    }

    // drop the port-755 channel the way the payload's teardown does
    void close_event_channel() {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        debug_attached = false;
        bps.clear();
        wps.clear();
        if (event_fd != INVALID_SOCKET) {
            ::shutdown(event_fd, SD_BOTH);
            closesocket(event_fd);
            event_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;
        }
    }

    // push one stop packet on the port-755 channel (false when not attached)
    bool send_event(uint32_t lwpid, uint32_t status, const char* name, uint64_t rip) {
        SOCKET ev = INVALID_SOCKET;
        {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            ev = event_fd;
        }
        if (ev == INVALID_SOCKET) return false;
        const auto pkt = make_event(lwpid, status, name, rip);
        return send_raw(ev, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&pkt), sizeof(pkt));
    }

    ps5::debug_event_packet_t make_event(uint32_t lwpid, uint32_t status, const char* name,
                                         uint64_t rip) {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        ps5::debug_event_packet_t pkt{};
        pkt.lwpid  = lwpid;
        pkt.status = status;
        std::strncpy(pkt.tdname, name, sizeof(pkt.tdname) - 1);
        pkt.regs = thread_regs[lwpid];
        if (pkt.regs.rip == 0) {
            pkt.regs.rip = 0x400123;
            pkt.regs.rsp = 0x7FFF00008000ull;
            pkt.regs.rbp = 0x7FFF00007FF0ull;
            pkt.regs.rax = 0x2A;
            pkt.regs.rflags = 0x202;
        }
        if (rip) pkt.regs.rip = rip;
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
            const uint64_t v = 0x1000ull + static_cast<uint64_t>(i);
            std::memcpy(pkt.dbregs + i * 8, &v, sizeof(v));
        }
        return pkt;
    }

private:
    void accept_loop() {
        while (!stop_flag) {
            fd_set rset;
            FD_ZERO(&rset);
            FD_SET(listen_fd, &rset);
            timeval tv{};
            tv.tv_sec = 0;
            tv.tv_usec = 200 * 1000;
            if (select(0, &rset, nullptr, nullptr, &tv) <= 0) continue;
            SOCKET c = accept(listen_fd, nullptr, nullptr);
            if (c == INVALID_SOCKET) continue;
            std::lock_guard lk(conn_mu);
            conn_socks.push_back(c);
            conn_threads.emplace_back([this, c] { handle_conn(c); });
        }
    }

    std::mutex conn_mu;
    std::vector<SOCKET> conn_socks;
    std::vector<std::thread> conn_threads;

    void handle_conn(SOCKET c) {
        tl_chaos = &chaos;
        tl_budget = -1;
        {
            // the payload keeps debug state per connection: reset it when the
            // new connection starts, not when the old one ends
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            ++connections;
            debug_attached = false;
            debug_pid = 0;
            bps.clear();
            wps.clear();
            if (event_fd != INVALID_SOCKET) {
                ::shutdown(event_fd, SD_BOTH);
                closesocket(event_fd);
                event_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;
            }
        }
        handle_conn_loop(c);
        ::shutdown(c, SD_BOTH);
    }

    void handle_conn_loop(SOCKET c) {
        while (!stop_flag) {
            ps5::packet_header_t hdr{};
            if (!recv_all(c, &hdr, sizeof(hdr))) return;
            if (hdr.magic != ps5::kPacketMagic) return;
            if (hdr.datalen > ps5::kMaxDatalen) { send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_TOO_MUCH_DATA); return; }
            std::vector<uint8_t> body(hdr.datalen);
            if (hdr.datalen > 0 && !recv_all(c, body.data(), hdr.datalen)) return;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                ++commands_seen;
            }
            const bool ok = dispatch(c, hdr.cmd, body.data(), hdr.datalen);
            tl_budget = -1;
            if (!ok) return;
        }
    }

    // block until the client gives up on this connection (stall injection)
    static void wait_for_close(SOCKET c, const std::atomic<bool>& stop) {
        char sink[256];
        while (!stop) {
            fd_set rset;
            FD_ZERO(&rset);
            FD_SET(c, &rset);
            timeval tv{0, 100 * 1000};
            if (select(0, &rset, nullptr, nullptr, &tv) <= 0) continue;
            if (::recv(c, sink, sizeof(sink), 0) <= 0) return;
        }
    }

    bool dispatch(SOCKET c, uint32_t cmd, const uint8_t* body, uint32_t bodylen) {
        if (cmd != 0 && chaos.stall_cmd.load() == cmd) {
            chaos.stall_cmd = 0;
            wait_for_close(c, stop_flag);
            return false;
        }
        if (cmd != 0 && chaos.close_cmd.load() == cmd) {
            chaos.close_cmd = 0;
            tl_budget = chaos.close_after.load();
        }
        if (cmd != 0 && chaos.garbage_cmd.load() == cmd) {
            chaos.garbage_cmd = 0;
            return send_u32(c, 0x12345678u);   // not a status word at all
        }
        return dispatch_cmd(c, cmd, body, bodylen);
    }

    bool dispatch_cmd(SOCKET c, uint32_t cmd, const uint8_t* body, uint32_t bodylen) {
        switch (cmd) {
        case ps5::CMD_VERSION: {
            const char* v = "1.3";
            const uint32_t len = 3;
            return send_u32(c, len) && send_all(c, v, len);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_BRANDING: {
            static const char b[] = "ps5debug-NG by OSR v1.3.2 [test000000000000]\0" "1.1";
            const uint32_t len = static_cast<uint32_t>(sizeof(b) - 1);
            return send_u32(c, len) && send_all(c, b, len);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_FW_VERSION: {
            const uint16_t fw = 900;   // 9.00
            return send_all(c, &fw, sizeof(fw));
        }
        case ps5::CMD_PLATFORM_ID: {
            const uint16_t tag = ps5::kPlatformPs5;
            return send_all(c, &tag, sizeof(tag));
        }
        case ps5::CMD_PROC_NOP:
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_LIST: {
            const bool hide = chaos.hide_game_pid.load();
            if (!send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS)) return false;
            if (!send_u32(c, hide ? 1u : 2u)) return false;
            ps5::proc_list_entry_t e{};
            if (!hide) {
                std::strncpy(e.name, "eboot.bin", sizeof(e.name) - 1);
                e.pid = static_cast<int32_t>(kFakePid);
                if (!send_all(c, &e, sizeof(e))) return false;
            }
            std::memset(&e, 0, sizeof(e));
            std::strncpy(e.name, "SceShellCore", sizeof(e.name) - 1);
            e.pid = 42;
            return send_all(c, &e, sizeof(e));
        }

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_INFO: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_info_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::proc_info_packet_t*>(body);
            if (p->pid != kFakePid && p->pid != 42) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            ps5::proc_info_response_t r{};
            r.pid = p->pid;
            std::strncpy(r.name, p->pid == kFakePid ? "eboot.bin" : "SceShellCore",
                         sizeof(r.name) - 1);
            std::strncpy(r.path, p->pid == kFakePid ? "/app0/eboot.bin" : "/system/sce_shell.elf",
                         sizeof(r.path) - 1);
            std::strncpy(r.titleid, "PPSA00001", sizeof(r.titleid) - 1);
            std::strncpy(r.contentid, "UP0000-PPSA00001_00-TEST000000000000",
                         sizeof(r.contentid) - 1);
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS) && send_all(c, &r, sizeof(r));
        }

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_READ: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_read_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::proc_read_packet_t*>(body);
            if (!send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS)) return false;
            std::vector<uint8_t> out(p->length, 0);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->length; ++i) {
                    const uint64_t a = p->address + i;
                    auto it = mem.find(a & ~0xFFFull);
                    if (it != mem.end()) out[i] = it->second[a & 0xFFF];
                }
            }
            // stream in 64 KiB chunks like the payload
            for (size_t off = 0; off < out.size(); off += ps5::kChunkSize) {
                const size_t n = std::min<size_t>(ps5::kChunkSize, out.size() - off);
                if (!send_all(c, out.data() + off, n)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_WRITE: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_write_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::proc_write_packet_t*>(body);
            if (!send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS)) return false;   // ack, then the data phase
            std::vector<uint8_t> data(p->length, 0);
            if (p->length > 0 && !recv_all(c, data.data(), data.size())) return false;
            mem_write(p->address, data.data(), data.size());
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_MAPS: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_maps_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            if (!send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS)) return false;
            if (!send_u32(c, static_cast<uint32_t>(maps.size()))) return false;
            for (const auto& m : maps)
                if (!send_all(c, &m, sizeof(m))) return false;
            return true;
        }

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_PROTECT: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_protect_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::proc_protect_packet_t*>(body);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                last_protect = p->newprot;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }

        case ps5::CMD_PROC_ALLOC: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_alloc_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::proc_alloc_packet_t*>(body);
            const uint64_t addr = 0x600000;
            add_map("", addr, addr + p->length, ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtWrite);
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS) && send_all(c, &addr, sizeof(addr));
        }
        case ps5::CMD_PROC_ALLOC_HINTED: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_alloc_hinted_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::proc_alloc_hinted_packet_t*>(body);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                last_alloc_hint = static_cast<uint32_t>(p->hint);
            }
            const uint64_t addr = p->hint;
            add_map("", addr, addr + p->length, ps5::kVmProtRead | ps5::kVmProtWrite);
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS) && send_all(c, &addr, sizeof(addr));
        }
        case ps5::CMD_PROC_FREE: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::proc_free_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }

        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_ATTACH: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_attach_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_attach_packet_t*>(body);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                if (debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ALREADY_DEBUG), true;
                debug_attached = true;
                debug_pid = p->pid;
            }
            // the payload connects back to the client's port 755 or attach fails
            SOCKET ev = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
            if (ev != INVALID_SOCKET) {
                sockaddr_in dst{};
                dst.sin_family      = AF_INET;
                dst.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
                dst.sin_port        = htons(event_port);
                if (::connect(ev, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&dst), sizeof(dst)) != 0) {
                    closesocket(ev);
                    ev = INVALID_SOCKET;
                }
            }
            if (ev == INVALID_SOCKET) {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                debug_attached = false;
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            }
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                event_fd = ev;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_DETACH: {
            if (chaos.refuse_detach.load()) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                ++detach_count;
                debug_attached = false;
                debug_pid = 0;
                bps.clear();
                wps.clear();
                if (event_fd != INVALID_SOCKET) {
                    ::shutdown(event_fd, SD_BOTH);
                    closesocket(event_fd);
                    event_fd = INVALID_SOCKET;
                }
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_GET_THREAD_LIST: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            const uint32_t n = chaos.thread_count.load();
            if (!send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS)) return false;
            if (!send_u32(c, n)) return false;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const uint32_t lwpid = 101 + i;
                if (!send_all(c, &lwpid, sizeof(lwpid))) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_THREAD_INFO: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_lwpid_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_lwpid_packet_t*>(body);
            ps5::debug_thread_info_response_t r{};
            r.lwpid = p->lwpid;
            r.priority = 80;
            std::strncpy(r.name, p->lwpid == 101 ? "main" : "worker", sizeof(r.name) - 1);
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS) && send_all(c, &r, sizeof(r));
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_GETREGS: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_lwpid_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_lwpid_packet_t*>(body);
            ps5::reg64_t reg{};
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                reg = thread_regs[p->lwpid];
            }
            if (reg.rip == 0) {
                reg.rip = 0x400123;
                reg.rsp = 0x7FFF00008000ull;
                reg.rbp = 0x7FFF00007FF0ull;
                reg.rax = 0x2A;
                reg.rflags = 0x202;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS) && send_all(c, &reg, sizeof(reg));
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_SETREGS: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_setregs_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_setregs_packet_t*>(body);
            if (!send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS)) return false;   // ack, then the blob
            ps5::reg64_t reg{};
            if (p->length != sizeof(reg) || !recv_all(c, &reg, sizeof(reg))) return false;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                thread_regs[p->lwpid] = reg;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_set_breakpoint_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_set_breakpoint_packet_t*>(body);
            if (p->index >= ps5::kMaxSwBreakpoints)
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_INVALID_INDEX), true;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                bps[p->index] = {p->enabled != 0, p->address};
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_SET_WATCHPOINT: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_set_watchpoint_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_set_watchpoint_packet_t*>(body);
            if (p->index >= ps5::kMaxWatchpoints)
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_INVALID_INDEX), true;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                wps[p->index] = {p->enabled != 0, p->length, p->breaktype, p->address};
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_CONTINUE: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_continue_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_continue_packet_t*>(body);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                last_continue_stop = p->stop;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_STEP: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                ++step_calls;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_STEP_THREAD: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                ++step_thread_calls;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_SUSPEND:
        case ps5::CMD_DEBUG_RESUME: {
            if (!debug_attached) return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), true;
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::debug_lwpid_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::debug_lwpid_packet_t*>(body);
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                if (cmd == ps5::CMD_DEBUG_SUSPEND) last_suspend = p->lwpid;
                else last_resume = p->lwpid;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }

        case ps5::CMD_CONSOLE_NOTIFY: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::console_notify_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::console_notify_packet_t*>(body);
            std::string text(p->length, '\0');
            if (p->length > 0 && !recv_all(c, text.data(), text.size())) return false;
            if (!text.empty() && text.back() == '\0') text.pop_back();   // trailing NUL
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                last_notify = text;
                last_notify_type = p->messageType;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_CONSOLE_PRINT: {
            if (bodylen < sizeof(ps5::console_print_packet_t))
                return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_DATA_NULL), false;
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const ps5::console_print_packet_t*>(body);
            std::string text(p->length, '\0');
            if (p->length > 0 && !recv_all(c, text.data(), text.size())) return false;
            {
                std::lock_guard lk(mu);
                last_print = text;
            }
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        }
        case ps5::CMD_CONSOLE_INFO:
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS);
        case ps5::CMD_CONSOLE_FOREGROUND_APP: {
            ps5::console_foreground_app_response_t r{};
            r.pid = kFakePid;
            std::strncpy(r.titleid, "PPSA00001", sizeof(r.titleid) - 1);
            std::strncpy(r.contentid, "UP0000-PPSA00001_00-TEST000000000000",
                         sizeof(r.contentid) - 1);
            std::strncpy(r.name, "Test Game", sizeof(r.name) - 1);
            std::strncpy(r.app_ver, "01.02", sizeof(r.app_ver) - 1);
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_SUCCESS) && send_all(c, &r, sizeof(r));
        }

        default:
            // the payload answers CMD_ERROR and closes the client
            return send_u32(c, ps5::CMD_ERROR), false;
        }
    }
};

struct server_guard_t {
    fake_ps5_server_t srv;
    server_guard_t() { REQUIRE(srv.start()); }
    ~server_guard_t() { srv.shutdown(); }
};

// drop the global PS5 connection even when a REQUIRE throws mid-test
struct ps5_disconnect_guard_t {
    ~ps5_disconnect_guard_t() {
        slop::core::process::target_disconnect_ps5();
    }
};

bool wait_until(const std::function<bool()>& pred, int timeout_ms) {
    const auto until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < until) {
        if (pred()) return true;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
    }
    return pred();
}

} // namespace
```

`src/tests/test_analysis.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_analysis.cpp
// Packer/protector heuristics + crypto signature hunt against the real
// SlopTarget.exe fixture and patched variants of it

#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/analysis/packer.hpp"
#include "core/analysis/signatures.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp"
#include "core/analysis/signatures.h"   // hyperion SignatureMatcher
#include "core/decompiler/lifter_arm64.h"
#include "core/disasm/capstone_disasm.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

using namespace slop::core::analysis;
namespace disasm = slop::core::disasm;

namespace {

std::vector<uint8_t>& slop_target_bytes() {
    static std::vector<uint8_t> bytes = [] {
        std::ifstream f(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH, std::ios::binary);
        return std::vector<uint8_t>(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f),
                                    std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{});
    }();
    return bytes;
}

// Patch section name #index in a PE copy (headers only, layout untouched)
bool patch_section_name(std::vector<uint8_t>& img, size_t index,
                        const char* name) {
    if (img.size() < 0x400) return false;
    const uint32_t e_lfanew =
        *reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(img.data() + 0x3C);
    const uint16_t opt_size = *reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(
        img.data() + e_lfanew + 4 + 16);
    const size_t first_hdr = e_lfanew + 4 + 20 + opt_size;
    const size_t off = first_hdr + index * 40;
    if (off + 8 > img.size()) return false;
    std::memset(img.data() + off, 0, 8);
    std::memcpy(img.data() + off, name, std::min<size_t>(strlen(name), 8));
    return true;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(entropy_basics) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> zeros(4096, 0x00);
    REQUIRE(shannon_entropy(zeros.data(), zeros.size()) < 0.01);

    std::mt19937 rng(1234);
    std::vector<uint8_t> noise(65536);
    for (auto& b : noise) b = static_cast<uint8_t>(rng());
    REQUIRE(shannon_entropy(noise.data(), noise.size()) > 7.9);
}

TEST_CASE(packer_clean_binary_not_flagged) {
    const auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    auto v = packer_analyze(pe, bytes);
    REQUIRE(!v.packed);
    REQUIRE(v.confidence < 0.5);
    REQUIRE(v.family.empty());
}

TEST_CASE(packer_upx_section_names_identify_family) {
    auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    REQUIRE(patch_section_name(bytes, 0, "UPX0"));
    REQUIRE(patch_section_name(bytes, 1, "UPX1"));

    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    auto v = packer_analyze(pe, bytes);
    REQUIRE(v.packed);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(v.family.c_str(), "UPX");

    bool named_hit = false;
    for (const auto& d : v.detections)
        if (d.type == "section_name" && d.protector == "UPX") named_hit = true;
    REQUIRE(named_hit);
}

TEST_CASE(packer_vmp_names_identify_family) {
    auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    REQUIRE(patch_section_name(bytes, 0, ".vmp0"));
    REQUIRE(patch_section_name(bytes, 1, ".vmp1"));

    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    auto v = packer_analyze(pe, bytes);
    REQUIRE(v.packed);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(v.family.c_str(), "VMProtect");
}

TEST_CASE(packer_high_entropy_exec_section_flagged) {
    auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    REQUIRE(pe.sections.size() > 0);

    // Fill the first executable section's raw payload with PRNG noise
    bool filled = false;
    for (const auto& sec : pe.sections) {
        if (!sec.is_executable() || sec.raw_size < 4096) continue;
        if (static_cast<size_t>(sec.raw_offset) + sec.raw_size > bytes.size())
            continue;
        std::mt19937 rng(99);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < sec.raw_size; ++i)
            bytes[sec.raw_offset + i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(rng());
        filled = true;
        break;
    }
    REQUIRE(filled);

    auto repacked = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(repacked.ok);
    auto v = packer_analyze(repacked, bytes);

    bool entropy_hit = false;
    for (const auto& d : v.detections)
        if (d.type == "high_entropy") entropy_hit = true;
    REQUIRE(entropy_hit);
}

TEST_CASE(packer_noisy_data_sections_plus_tls_stays_clean) {
    // Regression: clean Rust-style image (.rdata/.rsrc ~7.8 entropy + TLS
    // directory) used to score 0.2+0.2+0.1=0.50 -> packed:Unknown. Weak
    // signals alone must not tip the verdict without a strong indicator.
    auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    // Fill from the end so the import table (.rdata, early) survives and no
    // spurious "no imports" signal pollutes the score.
    int filled = 0;
    for (auto it = pe.sections.rbegin(); it != pe.sections.rend(); ++it) {
        const auto& sec = *it;
        if (sec.is_executable() || sec.raw_size < 4096) continue;
        if (static_cast<size_t>(sec.raw_offset) + sec.raw_size > bytes.size())
            continue;
        std::mt19937 rng(0xC0FFEE + filled);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < sec.raw_size; ++i)
            bytes[sec.raw_offset + i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(rng());
        if (++filled == 2) break;
    }
    REQUIRE_EQ(filled, 2);

    // Set a TLS directory size (weak signal, normal in Rust/MSVC CRT)
    {
        const uint32_t e_lfanew =
            *reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(bytes.data() + 0x3C);
        const size_t oh = e_lfanew + 4 + 20;
        const size_t tls_size_off = oh + 112 + 9 * 8 + 4;
        REQUIRE_LT(tls_size_off + 4, bytes.size());
        const uint32_t tls_size = 0x18;
        std::memcpy(bytes.data() + tls_size_off, &tls_size, 4);
    }

    auto reparsed = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(reparsed.ok);
    auto v = packer_analyze(reparsed, bytes);
    REQUIRE(!v.packed);
    REQUIRE(v.family.empty());
}

TEST_CASE(crypto_hunt_finds_planted_aes_sbox) {
    auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    // Plant the AES forward S-box prefix into the last raw section
    const uint8_t sbox[16] = {0x63, 0x7C, 0x77, 0x7B, 0xF2, 0x6B, 0x6F, 0xC5,
                              0x30, 0x01, 0x67, 0x2B, 0xFE, 0xD7, 0xAB, 0x76};
    size_t plant_off = 0;
    bool planted = false;
    for (auto it = pe.sections.rbegin(); it != pe.sections.rend(); ++it) {
        if (it->raw_size < 64) continue;
        if (static_cast<size_t>(it->raw_offset) + it->raw_size > bytes.size())
            continue;
        plant_off = it->raw_offset + it->raw_size - 32;
        std::memcpy(bytes.data() + plant_off, sbox, sizeof(sbox));
        planted = true;
        break;
    }
    REQUIRE(planted);

    auto reparsed = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    auto hits = crypto_hunt(reparsed, bytes);
    bool found = false;
    for (const auto& h : hits) {
        if (h.name == "AES S-box (forward)" && h.offset == plant_off &&
            !h.in_overlay)
            found = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(found);
}

TEST_CASE(crypto_hunt_clean_image_no_false_sbox) {
    const auto bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    auto hits = crypto_hunt(pe, bytes);
    // SlopTarget is a plain MSVC build, no AES tables expected. Base64 may
    // legitimately appear in CRT data; only assert on absence of crypto-core
    // constants here
    for (const auto& h : hits) {
        REQUIRE(h.name.find("AES") == std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE(h.name.find("SHA") == std::string::npos);
    }
}

namespace {

// one executable segment at 0x1000 holding `code`
struct sig_image_t {
    std::vector<uint8_t> raw;
    hype::PEImage        img{};

    sig_image_t(hype::ImageFormat format, hype::Arch arch,
                const std::vector<uint8_t>& code) {
        raw.resize(0x100, 0);
        const size_t code_off = raw.size();
        raw.insert(raw.end(), code.begin(), code.end());
        img.arch   = arch;
        img.format = format;
        img.base   = 0x1000;
        img.entry  = 0x1000;
        img.raw    = raw;
        hype::Segment seg{};
        seg.name     = ".text";
        seg.va       = 0x1000;
        seg.size     = code.size();
        seg.file_off = code_off;
        seg.file_sz  = code.size();
        seg.flags    = 0x60000020;
        seg.data     = std::span<const uint8_t>(raw.data() + code_off, code.size());
        img.segments.push_back(seg);
    }
};

void add_fn(hype::AnalysisDB& db, hype::va_t va) {
    hype::Function f{};
    f.entry = va;
    f.name  = "sub_" + std::to_string(va);
    db.funcs[va] = std::move(f);
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(analysis_signatures_orbis_set_is_elf_only) {
    // 0x1000 libkernel getpid stub, 0x1010 payload-sdk mmap stub jumping to
    // the shared `mov r10, rcx ; syscall` tail at 0x1030, 0x1040 FreeBSD bzero
    std::vector<uint8_t> code(0x60, 0xCC);
    const uint8_t getpid[] = {0x48, 0xC7, 0xC0, 0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                              0x49, 0x89, 0xCA, 0x0F, 0x05, 0x72, 0x01, 0xC3};
    std::memcpy(code.data(), getpid, sizeof(getpid));
    const uint8_t mmap_stub[] = {0x48, 0xC7, 0xC0, 0xDD, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00,
                                 0xE9, 0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};   // -> 0x1030
    std::memcpy(code.data() + 0x10, mmap_stub, sizeof(mmap_stub));
    const uint8_t tail[] = {0x49, 0x89, 0xCA, 0x0F, 0x05, 0xC3};
    std::memcpy(code.data() + 0x30, tail, sizeof(tail));
    const uint8_t bzero[] = {0x48, 0x89, 0xF1, 0x31, 0xC0, 0x48, 0xC1, 0xE9,
                             0x03, 0xFC, 0xF3, 0x48, 0xAB, 0x48, 0x89, 0xF1,
                             0x48, 0x83, 0xE1, 0x07, 0xF3, 0xAA, 0xC3};
    std::memcpy(code.data() + 0x40, bzero, sizeof(bzero));

    hype::SignatureMatcher m;
    REQUIRE_GT(m.sig_count(hype::Arch::X64, hype::SigFormat::ELF), 0);
    REQUIRE_GT(m.sig_count(hype::Arch::X64, hype::SigFormat::PE),
               m.sig_count(hype::Arch::X86, hype::SigFormat::PE));
    REQUIRE_EQ(m.sig_count(hype::Arch::ARM64, hype::SigFormat::MachO), 0);

    {
        sig_image_t elf(hype::ImageFormat::ELF, hype::Arch::X64, code);
        REQUIRE(hype::SignatureMatcher::image_format(elf.img) == hype::SigFormat::ELF);
        hype::AnalysisDB db;
        for (hype::va_t va : {0x1000ull, 0x1010ull, 0x1040ull}) add_fn(db, va);
        db.names[0x1040] = "already_named";
        REQUIRE_EQ(m.match_functions(db, elf.img), 2);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names[0x1000].c_str(), "sys_getpid");
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names[0x1010].c_str(), "sys_mmap");
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names[0x1040].c_str(), "already_named");

        hype::AnalysisDB db2;
        add_fn(db2, 0x1040);
        REQUIRE_EQ(m.match_functions(db2, elf.img), 1);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db2.names[0x1040].c_str(), "bzero");
    }
    {
        // same bytes inside a PE: neither stubs nor FreeBSD libc apply
        sig_image_t pe(hype::ImageFormat::PE, hype::Arch::X64, code);
        hype::AnalysisDB db;
        for (hype::va_t va : {0x1000ull, 0x1010ull, 0x1040ull}) add_fn(db, va);
        REQUIRE_EQ(m.match_functions(db, pe.img), 0);
    }
    {
        // MSVC x64 CRT prologue matches in a PE, not in an ELF
        std::vector<uint8_t> msvc = {0x48, 0x3B, 0x0D, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44,
                                     0x75, 0x02, 0xC3, 0xCC, 0xCC};
        sig_image_t pe(hype::ImageFormat::PE, hype::Arch::X64, msvc);
        hype::AnalysisDB db;
        add_fn(db, 0x1000);
        REQUIRE_EQ(m.match_functions(db, pe.img), 1);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names[0x1000].c_str(), "__security_check_cookie");

        sig_image_t elf(hype::ImageFormat::ELF, hype::Arch::X64, msvc);
        hype::AnalysisDB db2;
        add_fn(db2, 0x1000);
        REQUIRE_EQ(m.match_functions(db2, elf.img), 0);

        // arch gate: an ARM64 PE never sees x64 MSVC patterns
        sig_image_t arm(hype::ImageFormat::PE, hype::Arch::ARM64, msvc);
        hype::AnalysisDB db3;
        add_fn(db3, 0x1000);
        REQUIRE_EQ(m.match_functions(db3, arm.img), 0);
    }
}

namespace {

// lift one ARM64 instruction (little-endian word) into pcode
struct arm64_lifted {
    hype::Insn      insn{};
    hype::PcodeFunc pf;

    explicit arm64_lifted(uint32_t word) {
        hype::CapstoneDisasm cs;
        cs.set_arch(hype::Arch::ARM64);
        uint8_t bytes[4];
        std::memcpy(bytes, &word, 4);
        REQUIRE(cs.decode(0x1000, bytes, 4, insn));
        hype::Function fn{};
        fn.entry = 0x1000;
        fn.name = "f";
        hype::BasicBlock bb{};
        bb.start = 0x1000;
        bb.end = 0x1004;
        bb.insns.push_back(insn);
        fn.blocks[0x1000] = bb;
        hype::AnalysisDB db;
        hype::LifterARM64 lifter;
        pf = lifter.lift(fn, db);
        REQUIRE_EQ(pf.blocks.size(), 1u);
    }
    size_t count(hype::PcodeOp op) const {
        size_t n = 0;
        for (const auto& p : pf.blocks[0].ops) n += p.op == op;
        return n;
    }
    bool has_const(hype::PcodeOp op, uint64_t value) const {
        for (const auto& p : pf.blocks[0].ops)
            if (p.op == op)
                for (const auto& in : p.inputs)
                    if (in.is_const() && in.offset == value) return true;
        return false;
    }
    // a COPY into the named register
    bool writes(const char* reg) const {
        for (const auto& p : pf.blocks[0].ops)
            if (p.op == hype::PcodeOp::COPY && p.output.is_reg() && p.output.name == reg)
                return true;
        return false;
    }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(analysis_arm64_lifter_asr_is_arithmetic) {
    arm64_lifted l(0x9343FC20);                     // asr x0, x1, #3
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(l.insn.mnemonic, "asr");
    REQUIRE_EQ(l.count(hype::PcodeOp::SHIFT_ARIGHT), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(l.count(hype::PcodeOp::SHIFT_RIGHT), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(analysis_arm64_register_index_scaled_and_extended) {
    arm64_lifted lsl(0xF8627820);                   // ldr x0, [x1, x2, lsl #3]
    REQUIRE_EQ(lsl.insn.ops[1].type, hype::OpType::Mem);
    REQUIRE_EQ(lsl.insn.ops[1].mem.scale, 8);
    REQUIRE(lsl.has_const(hype::PcodeOp::INT_MULT, 8));
    REQUIRE_EQ(lsl.count(hype::PcodeOp::LOAD), 1u);

    arm64_lifted sxtw(0xF862D820);                  // ldr x0, [x1, w2, sxtw #3]
    REQUIRE(sxtw.insn.ops[1].mem.ext == hype::IndexExt::Sxtw);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sxtw.count(hype::PcodeOp::INT_SEXT), 1u);
    REQUIRE(sxtw.has_const(hype::PcodeOp::INT_MULT, 8));
}

TEST_CASE(analysis_arm64_pair_writeback) {
    arm64_lifted pre(0xA9BF7BFD);                   // stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    REQUIRE(pre.insn.ops[2].writeback());
    REQUIRE(!pre.insn.ops[2].post_index());
    REQUIRE_EQ(pre.count(hype::PcodeOp::STORE), 2u);
    REQUIRE(pre.writes("sp"));
    REQUIRE(pre.has_const(hype::PcodeOp::ADD, static_cast<uint64_t>(-16)));

    arm64_lifted post(0xA8C17BFD);                  // ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16
    REQUIRE(post.insn.ops[2].post_index());
    REQUIRE_EQ(post.count(hype::PcodeOp::LOAD), 2u);
    REQUIRE(post.writes("x29"));
    REQUIRE(post.writes("x30"));
    REQUIRE(post.writes("sp"));
    REQUIRE(post.has_const(hype::PcodeOp::ADD, 16));
    // the first load reads straight from sp (post-index: no offset first)
    const auto& ops = post.pf.blocks[0].ops;
    const auto first_load = std::find_if(ops.begin(), ops.end(), [](const hype::PcodeInsn& p) {
        return p.op == hype::PcodeOp::LOAD;
    });
    REQUIRE(first_load != ops.end());
    REQUIRE(first_load->inputs[0].is_reg());
    REQUIRE(first_load->inputs[0].name == "sp");
}

TEST_CASE(analysis_arm64_movk_lane_from_shift) {
    arm64_lifted l(0xF2A24680);                     // movk x0, #0x1234, lsl #16
    REQUIRE_EQ(l.insn.ops[1].val, 0x12340000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(l.insn.ops[1].shift_amount(), 16u);
    REQUIRE(l.has_const(hype::PcodeOp::AND, ~(0xFFFFull << 16)));
    REQUIRE(l.has_const(hype::PcodeOp::OR, 0x12340000ull));
}

TEST_CASE(analysis_capstone_operands_and_thumb) {
    hype::CapstoneDisasm a32;
    a32.set_arch(hype::Arch::ARM);
    // push {r4-r11, lr}: 9 register operands, 5 kept, the rest reported
    const uint8_t push_arm[] = {0xF0, 0x4F, 0x2D, 0xE9};
    hype::Insn in{};
    REQUIRE(a32.decode(0x2000, push_arm, sizeof(push_arm), in));
    REQUIRE_EQ(in.op_count, 5);
    REQUIRE_EQ(in.ops_total, 9);
    REQUIRE(in.ops_truncated());

    // Thumb `push {r4, lr}` (B5 10) at an odd address decodes as Thumb
    const uint8_t thumb[] = {0x10, 0xB5, 0x00, 0xBF};   // push {r4, lr} ; nop
    hype::Insn t{};
    REQUIRE(a32.decode(0x3001, thumb, sizeof(thumb), t));
    REQUIRE_EQ(t.addr, 0x3000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(t.len, 2);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(t.mnemonic, "push");
    auto range = a32.decode_range(0x3001, thumb, sizeof(thumb));
    REQUIRE_EQ(range.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(range[1].mnemonic, "nop");
    REQUIRE_EQ(range[1].addr, 0x3002ull);

    hype::CapstoneDisasm thumb_default;
    thumb_default.set_arch(hype::Arch::ARM, true);
    hype::Insn d{};
    REQUIRE(thumb_default.decode(0x3000, thumb, sizeof(thumb), d));
    REQUIRE_EQ(d.len, 2);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(d.mnemonic, "push");
}
```

```cpp
#include "harness.hpp"
#include "core/memory/memscan.hpp"
#include "core/network/traffic_store.hpp"
#include "core/infra/diag.hpp"

TEST_CASE(app_perf_stream_slices_match_concatenation) {
    network::traffic_store_t store;
    network::packet_record_t packet;
    packet.protocol = 6; packet.payload = {1, 2, 3};
    store.add(packet);
    packet.direction = 1; packet.payload = {4, 5}; store.add(packet);
    const std::vector<uint8_t> merged{1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < 8; ++offset) {
        for (size_t len : {size_t{0}, size_t{1}, size_t{3}, size_t{10}, std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()}) {
            const size_t start = std::min(offset, merged.size());
            const size_t take = std::min(len, merged.size() - start);
            const auto actual = store.stream_bytes(1, offset, len);
            REQUIRE(actual.has_value());
            CHECK(*actual == std::vector<uint8_t>(merged.begin() + start, merged.begin() + start + take));
        }
    }
    CHECK(!store.stream_bytes(999, 0, 2));
}

TEST_CASE(app_perf_diag_tail_and_revision) {
    infra::diag::init();
    for (int i = 0; i < 9000; ++i) infra::diag::info("test", std::to_string(i));
    auto tail = infra::diag::snapshot(0, 2);
    REQUIRE(tail.entries.size() == 2);
    CHECK(tail.entries[0].message == "8998");
    CHECK(tail.revision == 9000);
    CHECK(infra::diag::snapshot(8999, 32).entries.size() == 1);
    CHECK(infra::diag::snapshot(9000, 32).entries.empty());
    CHECK(infra::diag::snapshot(0, 0).entries.empty());
    bool error = false;
    const auto reply = mcp::call_tool("app", {{"action", "diag"}, {"limit", 2}}, error,
                                      /*cancel=*/{}, /*allow_app=*/true);
    CHECK(!error);
    CHECK(reply.dump().find("8999") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(app_perf_output_cursor_eviction_and_clear) {
    infra::event_bus::reset();
    for (int i = 0; i < 5000; ++i) infra::event_bus::output("line");
    CHECK(infra::event_bus::output_since(0).size() == 4096);
    auto tail = infra::event_bus::output_since(4998);
    REQUIRE(tail.size() == 2);
    CHECK(tail.front().seq == 4999);
    CHECK(infra::event_bus::output_since(5000).empty());
    infra::event_bus::output_clear();
    infra::event_bus::output("after clear");
    CHECK(infra::event_bus::output_since(5000).size() == 1);
    infra::event_bus::reset();
}

TEST_CASE(app_perf_changed_event_serialization_and_dedup) {
    infra::event_bus::reset();
    auto subscriber = infra::event_bus::subscribe();
    const nlohmann::json data = {{"text", "a\nb"}, {"value", 42}};
    std::string frame;
    infra::event_bus::publish_changed("state", data);
    REQUIRE(subscriber->wait(frame, 0));
    CHECK(frame == "event: state\ndata: " + data.dump() + "\n\n");
    infra::event_bus::publish_changed("state", data);
    REQUIRE(subscriber->wait(frame, 0));
    CHECK(frame.empty());
    infra::event_bus::reset();
}

TEST_CASE(app_perf_dense_scan_stops_inside_chunk) {
    struct reader final : memory::reader_t {
        size_t calls = 0;
        bool read(uintptr_t, void* dst, size_t n) override {
            ++calls; std::memset(dst, 0, n); return true;
        }
    } r;
    for (bool all : {false, true}) {
        memory::scan_config_t cfg;
        cfg.width = memory::value_width_t::u8;
        cfg.max_results = 3; cfg.threads = 1; cfg.scan_all_types = all;
        cfg.chunk_bytes = 4096;
        memory::memscan_t scan;
        r.calls = 0;
        REQUIRE(scan.first_scan(r, {{0x10000, 1024 * 1024, 4, 0x20000}}, cfg, {}));
        CHECK(scan.results().size() == 3);
        CHECK(scan.stats().truncated);
        CHECK(r.calls == 1);
        CHECK(scan.stats().slots_scanned <= 3);
    }
}
```

`src/tests/test_decomp.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_decomp.cpp
// Hyperion-backed decompiler tests + Zydis-encoder assembly roundtrips
// (The old in-house "decompiler-lite" was removed; hyperion is the engine.)

#include "harness.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

#include "core/disasm/binary_state.hpp"
#include "core/mcp/mcp_tools.hpp"
#include "core/re/type_catalog.hpp"
#include "elf_fixture.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/hyperion_session.hpp"
#include "hyperion/core/decompiler/emitter.h"
#include "hyperion/core/decompiler/decompiler.h"
#include "hyperion/core/disasm/disassembler.h"
#include "hyperion/core/decompiler/propagate.h"
#include "hyperion/core/decompiler/ssa.h"
#include "hyperion/core/decompiler/cf_struct.h"

#include <Zydis/Zydis.h>
#include <Zydis/Encoder.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#include <windows.h>

namespace disasm = slop::core::disasm;
namespace hs     = slop::core::disasm::hyperion_session;

namespace {

bool wait_hype_ready(int timeout_ms = 30000) {
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
                          std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
        if (disasm::binary_state::hype_ready()) return true;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
    }
    return disasm::binary_state::hype_ready();
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(decomp_function_from_loaded_image) {
    REQUIRE(disasm::binary_state::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());
    auto& bin = disasm::binary_state::get();
    REQUIRE(bin.hype != nullptr);

    // A real function to decompile, largest block count, like the legacy
    // test's "first function" but skipping entry thunks
    const hype::Function* best = nullptr;
    for (const auto& [entry, f] : bin.hype->db().funcs) {
        (void)entry;
        if (!best || f.blocks.size() > best->blocks.size()) best = &f;
    }
    REQUIRE(best != nullptr);

    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> out;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(bin.hype->decompile(best->entry, out, err));
    if (!out.empty()) {
        REQUIRE_GT(out.size(), 1u);

        bool has_brace_or_stmt = false;
        for (const auto& l : out) {
            if (l.text.find('{') != std::string::npos ||
                l.text.find(';') != std::string::npos)
                has_brace_or_stmt = true;
        }
        REQUIRE(has_brace_or_stmt);
    }
    disasm::binary_state::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_unknown_address_errors_cleanly) {
    REQUIRE(disasm::binary_state::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());
    auto& bin = disasm::binary_state::get();

    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> out;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE_FALSE(bin.hype->decompile(0xDEADBEEFull, out, err));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(err.empty());
    disasm::binary_state::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_propagation_preserves_single_use_expression) {
    hype::PcodeFunc func;
    func.blocks.resize(1);
    auto a = hype::vn_temp(0);
    auto b = hype::vn_temp(1);
    auto c = hype::vn_temp(2);
    auto sum = hype::vn_temp(3);
    auto product = hype::vn_temp(4);
    a.offset = 1; b.offset = 2; c.offset = 3; sum.offset = 4; product.offset = 5;
    func.blocks[0].ops = {
        hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::ADD, sum, {a, b}),
        hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::INT_MULT, product, {sum, c}),
        hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::RETURN, {}, {product}),
    };

    hype::Propagate propagate;
    propagate.run(func);

    bool kept_add = false;
    bool multiply_uses_sum = false;
    for (const auto& op : func.blocks[0].ops) {
        if (op.op == hype::PcodeOp::ADD && op.output == sum) kept_add = true;
        if (op.op == hype::PcodeOp::INT_MULT && !op.inputs.empty() && op.inputs[0] == sum)
            multiply_uses_sum = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(kept_add);
    REQUIRE(multiply_uses_sum);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_propagation_preserves_phi_versions) {
    hype::PcodeFunc func;
    func.blocks.resize(1);
    auto merged = hype::vn_reg(0, "rax");
    auto left = merged;
    auto right = merged;
    merged.offset = 3;
    left.offset = 1;
    right.offset = 2;
    hype::PcodeInsn phi = hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::COPY, merged, {left, right});
    phi.seq = -1;
    func.blocks[0].ops = {phi, hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::RETURN, {}, {merged})};

    hype::Propagate propagate;
    propagate.run(func);

    REQUIRE_EQ(func.blocks[0].ops.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(func.blocks[0].ops[0].seq, -1);
    REQUIRE(func.blocks[0].ops[0].output == merged);
    REQUIRE_EQ(func.blocks[0].ops[0].inputs.size(), 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_emitter_preserves_returns_call_results_and_precedence) {
    hype::CFunc func;
    func.name = "semantic_fixture";
    func.entry = 0x1000;

    hype::CStmt call;
    call.kind = hype::StmtKind::Assign;
    call.dst = hype::vn_reg(0, "rax");
    call.dst.offset = 1;
    call.expr = hype::CExpr::call("callee", {hype::CExpr::imm(7)});

    hype::CStmt expression;
    expression.kind = hype::StmtKind::Assign;
    expression.dst = hype::vn_reg(1, "rcx");
    expression.dst.offset = 2;
    expression.expr = hype::CExpr::binop(
        hype::PcodeOp::INT_MULT,
        hype::CExpr::binop(hype::PcodeOp::ADD, hype::CExpr::imm(1), hype::CExpr::imm(2)),
        hype::CExpr::imm(3));

    hype::CStmt ret;
    ret.kind = hype::StmtKind::Return;
    ret.expr = hype::CExpr::imm(0);
    func.body = {call, expression, ret};

    hype::Emitter emitter;
    const auto lines = emitter.emit(func);
    std::string text;
    for (const auto& line : lines) text += line.text + "\n";

    REQUIRE(text.find("rax = callee(7);") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("rcx = (1 + 2) * 3;") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("return 0;") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("void semantic_fixture") == std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_ssa_uses_actual_entry_and_graph_order) {
    hype::PcodeFunc func;
    func.entry = 0x3000;
    func.blocks.resize(4);
    // Address order differs from traversal: entry block is index 2
    func.blocks[0].id = 0; func.blocks[0].addr = 0x1000; func.blocks[0].succs = {3}; func.blocks[0].preds = {2};
    func.blocks[1].id = 1; func.blocks[1].addr = 0x2000; func.blocks[1].succs = {3}; func.blocks[1].preds = {2};
    func.blocks[2].id = 2; func.blocks[2].addr = 0x3000; func.blocks[2].succs = {0, 1};
    func.blocks[3].id = 3; func.blocks[3].addr = 0x4000; func.blocks[3].preds = {0, 1};
    auto rax = hype::vn_reg(0, "rax");
    func.blocks[0].ops.push_back(hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::COPY, rax, {hype::vn_const(1)}));
    func.blocks[1].ops.push_back(hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::COPY, rax, {hype::vn_const(2)}));
    func.blocks[3].ops.push_back(hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::RETURN, {}, {rax}));

    hype::SSABuilder ssa;
    ssa.build(func);

    REQUIRE_FALSE(func.blocks[3].ops.empty());
    REQUIRE_EQ(func.blocks[3].ops.front().seq, -1);
    REQUIRE_EQ(func.blocks[3].ops.front().inputs.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_NE(func.blocks[3].ops.front().inputs[0].offset,
               func.blocks[3].ops.front().inputs[1].offset);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_structurer_preserves_every_cfg_edge) {
    hype::PcodeFunc func;
    func.name = "edge_fixture";
    func.entry = 0x3000;
    func.blocks.resize(3);
    func.blocks[0].id = 0; func.blocks[0].addr = 0x3000; func.blocks[0].succs = {1, 2};
    func.blocks[1].id = 1; func.blocks[1].addr = 0x1000; func.blocks[1].has_return = true;
    func.blocks[2].id = 2; func.blocks[2].addr = 0x2000; func.blocks[2].has_return = true;
    auto cond = hype::vn_temp(1); cond.offset = 1;
    func.blocks[0].ops.push_back(hype::PcodeInsn::make(
        hype::PcodeOp::CBRANCH, {}, {hype::vn_const(0x1000), cond}, 0x3004));
    func.blocks[1].ops.push_back(hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::RETURN, {}, {hype::vn_const(1)}, 0x1000));
    func.blocks[2].ops.push_back(hype::PcodeInsn::make(hype::PcodeOp::RETURN, {}, {hype::vn_const(2)}, 0x2000));

    hype::CFStructure structurer;
    hype::Emitter emitter;
    const auto lines = emitter.emit(structurer.structure(func));
    std::string text;
    for (const auto& line : lines) text += line.text + "\n";

    REQUIRE(text.find("loc_3000:") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("loc_1000:") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("loc_2000:") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("goto loc_1000;") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("goto loc_2000;") != std::string::npos);
}

namespace {

// Decode raw bytes into a single-block hyperion Function for pipeline tests
hype::Function function_from_bytes(const uint8_t* code, size_t len, const char* name) {
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X64);
    hype::Function func;
    func.entry = 0x1000;
    func.name = name;
    hype::BasicBlock block;
    block.start = 0x1000;
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < len) {
        hype::Insn insn{};
        if (!decoder.decode(0x1000 + off, code + off, len - off, insn)) break;
        block.insns.push_back(insn);
        block.end = insn.addr + insn.len;
        if (insn.is_ret()) break;
        off += insn.len;
    }
    func.block_addrs.push_back(block.start);
    func.blocks[block.start] = std::move(block);
    func.analyzed = true;
    return func;
}

std::string decompile_text(const hype::Function& func) {
    hype::AnalysisDB db;
    db.arch = hype::Arch::X64;
    db.image_base = 0;
    hype::Decompiler decompiler;
    std::string text;
    for (const auto& line : decompiler.decompile(func, db, nullptr))
        text += line.text + "\n";
    return text;
}

}

TEST_CASE(decomp_lifter_conditions_without_decode_text) {
    // Same expectations as decomp_lifter_signed_and_unsigned_conditions, but
    // the instructions carry no formatted text (analysis builds skip it):
    // condition mapping must come from the mnemonic id, not the string.
    auto lift_naked = [](const uint8_t* code, size_t len) {
        hype::Disassembler decoder;
        decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X64);
        hype::Function func;
        func.entry = 0x1000;
        hype::BasicBlock block;
        block.start = 0x1000;
        size_t off = 0;
        while (off < len) {
            hype::Insn insn{};
            if (!decoder.decode(0x1000 + off, code + off, len - off, insn, false)) break;
            REQUIRE(insn.op_str[0] == '\0');
            block.insns.push_back(insn);
            block.end = insn.addr + insn.len;
            if (insn.is_ret()) break;
            off += insn.len;
        }
        func.block_addrs.push_back(block.start);
        func.blocks[block.start] = std::move(block);
        func.analyzed = true;
        return decompile_text(func);
    };

    // cmp eax, 5 ; jl target ; ret  then signed less: SF != OF
    static const uint8_t jl[] = {0x83, 0xF8, 0x05, 0x7C, 0x02, 0xC3};
    REQUIRE(lift_naked(jl, sizeof(jl)).find("SF != OF") != std::string::npos);

    // cmp eax, 5 ; jbe target ; ret  then unsigned below-or-equal: CF || ZF
    static const uint8_t jbe[] = {0x83, 0xF8, 0x05, 0x76, 0x02, 0xC3};
    REQUIRE(lift_naked(jbe, sizeof(jbe)).find("CF || ZF") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_lifter_unsupported_without_text_stays_visible) {
    // aesdec with no formatted text must still render as __asm with operands:
    // the fallback re-renders from the stored bytes on demand.
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X64);
    static const uint8_t aes[] = {0x66, 0x0F, 0x38, 0xDE, 0xCA, 0xC3};
    hype::Function func;
    func.entry = 0x1000;
    hype::BasicBlock block;
    block.start = 0x1000;
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < sizeof(aes)) {
        hype::Insn insn{};
        if (!decoder.decode(0x1000 + off, aes + off, sizeof(aes) - off, insn, false)) break;
        block.insns.push_back(insn);
        block.end = insn.addr + insn.len;
        if (insn.is_ret()) break;
        off += insn.len;
    }
    func.block_addrs.push_back(block.start);
    func.blocks[block.start] = std::move(block);
    func.analyzed = true;
    const std::string text = decompile_text(func);
    REQUIRE(text.find("__asm") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("aesdec") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("xmm") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_lifter_signed_and_unsigned_conditions) {
    // cmp eax, 5 ; jl target ; ret  then signed less: SF != OF
    static const uint8_t jl[] = {0x83, 0xF8, 0x05, 0x7C, 0x02, 0xC3};
    std::string text = decompile_text(function_from_bytes(jl, sizeof(jl), "cond_jl"));
    REQUIRE(text.find("SF != OF") != std::string::npos);

    // cmp eax, 5 ; jbe target ; ret  then unsigned below-or-equal: CF || ZF
    static const uint8_t jbe[] = {0x83, 0xF8, 0x05, 0x76, 0x02, 0xC3};
    text = decompile_text(function_from_bytes(jbe, sizeof(jbe), "cond_jbe"));
    REQUIRE(text.find("CF || ZF") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_lifter_subregister_write_updates_full_register) {
    // mov al, 2 ; ret then AL write must keep upper RAX bits and stay visible
    static const uint8_t al[] = {0xB0, 0x02, 0xC3};
    std::string text = decompile_text(function_from_bytes(al, sizeof(al), "write_al"));
    REQUIRE(text.find("PIECE") == std::string::npos);  // emitted as shifts/or
    REQUIRE(text.find("<<") != std::string::npos || text.find("|") != std::string::npos);

    // mov eax, 7 ; ret then 32-bit write zero-extends into RAX
    static const uint8_t eax[] = {0xB8, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xC3};
    text = decompile_text(function_from_bytes(eax, sizeof(eax), "write_eax"));
    REQUIRE(text.find("(uint64_t)") != std::string::npos ||
            text.find("uint64") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_lifter_unsupported_instruction_stays_visible) {
    // aesdec xmm1, xmm2, no lifter semantics; must appear as __asm, not vanish
    static const uint8_t aes[] = {0x66, 0x0F, 0x38, 0xDE, 0xCA, 0xC3};
    std::string text = decompile_text(function_from_bytes(aes, sizeof(aes), "unsupported"));
    REQUIRE(text.find("__asm") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(text.find("aesdec") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(assembler_encodes_known_instructions) {
    auto encode = [](const std::string& text) -> std::string {
        ZydisEncoderRequest req{};
        req.machine_mode = ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LONG_64;
        req.allowed_encodings = ZYDIS_ENCODABLE_ENCODING_DEFAULT;

        // mnemonic
        std::string mn = text, rest;
        const size_t sp = text.find(' ');
        if (sp != std::string::npos) {
            mn = text.substr(0, sp);
            rest = text.substr(sp + 1);
        }
        bool found = false;
        for (int m = 1; m < ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MAX_VALUE; ++m) {
            const auto mm = static_cast<ZydisMnemonic>(m);
            if (ZydisMnemonicGetString(mm) &&
                _stricmp(ZydisMnemonicGetString(mm), mn.c_str()) == 0) {
                req.mnemonic = mm;
                found = true;
            }
        }
        if (!found) return "";

        // two register operands "rax, rbx" style
        size_t pos = 0;
        int op_idx = 0;
        while (pos < rest.size() && op_idx < ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT) {
            const size_t comma = rest.find(',', pos);
            std::string tok = comma == std::string::npos
                                  ? rest.substr(pos)
                                  : rest.substr(pos, comma - pos);
            pos = comma == std::string::npos ? rest.size() : comma + 1;
            while (!tok.empty() && tok.front() == ' ') tok.erase(tok.begin());
            while (!tok.empty() && tok.back() == ' ') tok.pop_back();
            if (tok.empty()) continue;

            for (int i = 1; i < ZYDIS_REGISTER_MAX_VALUE; ++i) {
                const auto rr = static_cast<ZydisRegister>(i);
                if (ZydisRegisterGetString(rr) &&
                    _stricmp(ZydisRegisterGetString(rr), tok.c_str()) == 0) {
                    auto& op = req.operands[req.operand_count++];
                    op.type = ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER;
                    op.reg.value = rr;
                    break;
                }
            }
            ++op_idx;
        }

        uint8_t buf[16];
        ZyanUSize len = sizeof(buf);
        if (ZYAN_FAILED(ZydisEncoderEncodeInstruction(&req, buf, &len)))
            return "";
        return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(buf),
                           static_cast<size_t>(len));
    };

    // mov rax, rbx -> 48 89 D8
    const std::string mov = encode("mov rax, rbx");
    REQUIRE_EQ(mov.size(), 3u);
    REQUIRE(static_cast<unsigned char>(mov[0]) == 0x48);
    REQUIRE(static_cast<unsigned char>(mov[2]) == 0xD8);

    // xor ecx, ecx -> 31 C9
    const std::string xorx = encode("xor ecx, ecx");
    REQUIRE_GE(xorx.size(), 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(assembler_decodes_roundtrip) {
    // Encode then decode: bytes must disassemble back to the same mnemonic
    ZydisEncoderRequest req{};
    req.machine_mode = ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LONG_64;
    req.mnemonic = ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADD;
    auto& d0 = req.operands[req.operand_count++];
    d0.type = ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER;
    d0.reg.value = ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX;
    auto& d1 = req.operands[req.operand_count++];
    d1.type = ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE;
    d1.imm.u = 3;

    uint8_t buf[16];
    ZyanUSize len = sizeof(buf);
    REQUIRE(ZYAN_SUCCESS(ZydisEncoderEncodeInstruction(&req, buf, &len)));

    ZydisDecoder dec;
    REQUIRE(ZYAN_SUCCESS(ZydisDecoderInit(&dec, ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LONG_64,
                                          ZYDIS_STACK_WIDTH_64)));
    ZydisDecodedInstruction insn{};
    ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
    REQUIRE(ZYAN_SUCCESS(
        ZydisDecoderDecodeFull(&dec, buf, len, &insn, ops)));
    REQUIRE_EQ(insn.mnemonic, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADD);
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_elf_function_sysv_and_canonical_names) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    namespace bs = disasm::binary_state;
    constexpr uint64_t base = 0x400000;
    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf(), "decomp_elf");
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(tf.path.string(), base));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());

    // engine path: (a, b, c) -> a*b+c lifts with three SysV parameters
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(bs::state_mutex());
        auto& bin = bs::get();
        std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> lines;
        std::string err;
        REQUIRE(bin.hype->decompile(base + L::kFunc2, lines, err));
        REQUIRE(!lines.empty());
        std::string head;
        for (const auto& l : lines)
            if (l.text.find("sub_400140(") != std::string::npos) { head = l.text; break; }
        REQUIRE(!head.empty());
        const auto open = head.find('('), close = head.find(')');
        REQUIRE(open != std::string::npos && close != std::string::npos);
        const std::string params = head.substr(open + 1, close - open - 1);
        for (const auto& l : lines) std::printf("DIAG func2: %s\n", l.text.c_str());
        REQUIRE_EQ(std::count(params.begin(), params.end(), ','), 2);

        // calls render the callee's canonical / exported name
        REQUIRE(bin.hype->decompile(base + L::kEntry, lines, err));
        std::string all;
        for (const auto& l : lines) all += l.text + "\n";
        REQUIRE(all.find("sub_400140") != std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE(all.find("module_start") != std::string::npos);
    }

    // MCP surface: calling convention + recovered signature
    bool is_error = false;
    const auto out = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "decomp", {{"action", "function"}, {"addr", base + L::kFunc2}}, is_error);
    std::printf("DIAG mcp: %s\n", out.dump().c_str());
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("callconv", std::string{}), "sysv_amd64");
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("function_va", uint64_t{0}), base + L::kFunc2);
    const std::string sig = out.value("signature", std::string{});
    REQUIRE(sig.find("sub_400140(") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE_EQ(std::count(sig.begin(), sig.end(), ','), 2);
    bs::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(decomp_disasm_functions_filters_and_pages_server_side) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    namespace bs = disasm::binary_state;
    constexpr uint64_t base = 0x400000;
    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf(), "decomp_fns");
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(tf.path.string(), base));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());

    bool is_error = false;
    auto call = [&](nlohmann::json args) {
        args["action"] = "functions";
        auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("disasm", args, is_error);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
        return r;
    };
    const auto all = call({{"limit", 1000}});
    const size_t total = all.value("total", size_t{0});
    REQUIRE_GE(total, size_t{3});
    REQUIRE_EQ(all.value("matched", size_t{0}), total);
    REQUIRE_EQ(all.value("returned", size_t{0}), all["functions"].size());

    // by name (case-insensitive) and by hex address
    const auto by_name = call({{"filter", "MODULE_start"}});
    REQUIRE_EQ(by_name.value("matched", size_t{0}), size_t{1});
    REQUIRE_EQ(by_name["functions"][0].value("va", uint64_t{0}), base + L::kFunc3);
    const auto by_va = call({{"filter", "0x400140"}});
    REQUIRE_EQ(by_va.value("matched", size_t{0}), size_t{1});
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(by_va["functions"][0].value("name", std::string{}), "sub_400140");
    REQUIRE_EQ(by_va.value("total", size_t{0}), total);

    // paging walks every match exactly once
    std::vector<uint64_t> seen;
    size_t offset = 0;
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 64; ++guard) {
        const auto page = call({{"limit", 1}, {"offset", offset}});
        for (const auto& f : page["functions"]) seen.push_back(f.value("va", uint64_t{0}));
        if (!page.value("truncated", false)) break;
        offset = page.value("next_offset", size_t{0});
    }
    REQUIRE_EQ(seen.size(), total);
    REQUIRE(std::is_sorted(seen.begin(), seen.end()));
    bs::unload();
}

namespace {

// points the per-binary annotation/type stores at a temp dir so a mutation
// test never touches the real user profile
struct scoped_localappdata_t {
    std::string old;
    bool        had = false;
    explicit scoped_localappdata_t(const std::string& dir) {
        char buf[MAX_PATH]{};
        const DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableA("LOCALAPPDATA", buf, MAX_PATH);
        if (n > 0 && n < MAX_PATH) { had = true; old.assign(buf, n); }
        SetEnvironmentVariableA("LOCALAPPDATA", dir.c_str());
    }
    ~scoped_localappdata_t() {
        SetEnvironmentVariableA("LOCALAPPDATA", had ? old.c_str() : nullptr);
    }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(decomp_rerenders_after_type_edit) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    namespace bs = disasm::binary_state;
    namespace tc = slop::core::re::type_catalog;

    const auto dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() /
                     ("slop_types_" + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir, ec);
    {
        scoped_localappdata_t env(dir.string());
        elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf(), "decomp_types");
        REQUIRE(bs::load_file(tf.path.string(), 0x400000));
        REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());

        bool is_error = false;
        const auto call = [&](const char* tool, nlohmann::json args) {
            auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(tool, std::move(args), is_error);
            REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
            return r;
        };

        const uint64_t target = 0x400000 + L::kFunc2;
        const auto before = call("decomp", {{"action", "function"}, {"addr", target}});
        REQUIRE(before.contains("lines"));
        const uint64_t gen_before = before.value("types_generation", uint64_t{0});

        // struct edit bumps the generation; the next decomp.function reports
        // the new generation (the session re-renders instead of serving cache)
        const auto created = call("types", {{"action", "create_struct"},
                                            {"decl", "struct SlopRerender { u32 a; u64 b; };"}});
        REQUIRE_EQ(created.value("declared", size_t{0}), size_t{1});
        const uint64_t gen_struct = tc::generation();
        REQUIRE_GT(gen_struct, gen_before);

        const auto after = call("decomp", {{"action", "function"}, {"addr", target}});
        REQUIRE_GT(after.value("types_generation", uint64_t{0}), gen_before);
        REQUIRE_EQ(after["lines"].size(), before["lines"].size());

        // enum edits bump it again
        const auto en = call("types", {{"action", "create_enum"},
                                       {"name", "SlopRerenderKind"},
                                       {"values", nlohmann::json::array(
                                           {{{"name", "A"}, {"value", 1}}})}});
        REQUIRE(en.value("created", false));
        REQUIRE_GT(tc::generation(), gen_struct);
        bs::unload();
    }
    std::filesystem::remove_all(dir, ec);
}
```

```cpp
// src/tests/test_detect_fs.cpp
// Deferred manager, fs utilities, the web client's egress guard over loopback
// origins, and the MITM PKI against in-memory trust stores

#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/infra/deferred.hpp"
#include "core/network/web_fetch.hpp"
#include "core/network/mitm_pki.hpp"

TEST_CASE(deferred_manager_roundtrip) {
    auto& m = infra::deferred_manager_t::get();

    int executed_with = 0;
    REQUIRE(m.bind_executor("test_kind",
                            [&](const std::string& params,
                                std::string* result) {
                                executed_with =
                                    std::stoi(params);
                                *result = "\"ok\"";
                                return true;
                            }));
    // Duplicate bind rejected
    REQUIRE(!m.bind_executor("test_kind", [](const std::string&, std::string*) {
        return false;
    }));

    const uint64_t id = m.submit("test_kind", "77");
    REQUIRE_GT(id, 0ull);

    auto before = m.get(id);
    REQUIRE(before.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(before->status.c_str(), "pending");

    REQUIRE_EQ(m.execute_pending("test_kind"), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(executed_with, 77);

    auto after = m.get(id);
    REQUIRE(after.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(after->status.c_str(), "done");
    REQUIRE(after->result_json.find("ok") != std::string::npos);

    REQUIRE(m.cancel(id) == false);   // already done
    m.clear();
}

TEST_CASE(fs_tools_roundtrip_and_grep) {
    const std::string dir = temp_dir();

                             {'h', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o'}, false));
```
