```cpp
namespace {

struct web_origin_t {
    httplib::Server srv;
    int port = 0;
    std::thread th;
    web_origin_t() {
        srv.Get("/probe", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content("web-ok-1234", "text/plain");
        });
        srv.Get("/redir-local", [this](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_redirect("http://127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(port) + "/probe");
        });
        srv.Get("/redir-rel", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_redirect("/probe");
        });
        srv.Post("/ct", [](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content("ct=" + req.get_header_value("Content-Type") + ";body=" + req.body,
                            "text/plain");
        });
        srv.Get("/chunked", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_chunked_content_provider("text/plain", [](size_t off, httplib::DataSink& sink) {
                if (off == 0) {
                    sink.write("part-one|", 9);
                    sink.write("part-two", 8);
                }
                sink.done();
                return true;
            });
        });
        srv.Get("/binary", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content(std::string("\xFF\xFE\x00\x01", 4), "application/octet-stream");
        });
        port = srv.bind_to_any_port("127.0.0.1");
        th = std::thread([this] { srv.listen_after_bind(); });
        srv.wait_until_ready();
    }
    ~web_origin_t() {
        srv.stop();
        if (th.joinable()) th.join();
    }
    std::string url(const char* path) const {
        return "http://127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(port) + path;
    }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(network_web_egress_guard) {
    web_origin_t o;
    REQUIRE_GT(o.port, 0);
    std::string err;

    // default policy: loopback is refused before any connection is made
    util::egress_policy_t deny;
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get(o.url("/probe"), deny, 5000, &err).has_value());
    REQUIRE(err.find("blocked") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(util::vet_destination("169.254.169.254", deny, &err).empty());
    REQUIRE(util::vet_destination("10.0.0.1", deny, &err).empty());
    REQUIRE(util::vet_destination("[::1]", deny, &err).empty());
    REQUIRE_EQ(util::vet_destination("8.8.8.8", deny, &err).size(), 1u);

    // web_allow_private opens it
    util::egress_policy_t open;
    open.allow_private = true;
    auto resp = util::http_get(o.url("/probe"), open, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(resp->status, 200u);
    REQUIRE(resp->body.find("web-ok-1234") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->remote_addr, "127.0.0.1");

    // allowlisted host (by name) and by IP
    util::egress_policy_t by_name;
    by_name.allowlist = {"localhost"};
    resp = util::http_get("http://localhost:" + std::to_string(o.port) + "/probe", by_name, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE(resp->body.find("web-ok-1234") != std::string::npos);
    util::egress_policy_t by_ip;
    by_ip.allowlist = {"127.0.0.0/8"};
    REQUIRE(util::http_get(o.url("/probe"), by_ip, 5000, &err).has_value());

    // redirects are re-checked: localhost is allowlisted, 127.0.0.1 is not
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get("http://localhost:" + std::to_string(o.port) + "/redir-local",
                            by_name, 5000, &err).has_value());
    REQUIRE(err.find("blocked") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(err.find("after redirect") != std::string::npos);
    resp = util::http_get(o.url("/redir-local"), open, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(resp->redirects.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE(resp->final_url.find("/probe") != std::string::npos);
    resp = util::http_get(o.url("/redir-rel"), open, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE(resp->body.find("web-ok-1234") != std::string::npos);

    // POST carries the content type; chunked bodies are decoded
    resp = util::http_post(o.url("/ct"), "{\"a\":1}", "application/x-test", open, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE(resp->body.find("ct=application/x-test;body={\"a\":1}") != std::string::npos);
    resp = util::http_get(o.url("/chunked"), open, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->body, "part-one|part-two");
    resp = util::http_get(o.url("/binary"), open, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(resp->body.size(), 4u);

    // body cap is reported
    util::http_request_t capped;
    capped.url = o.url("/probe");
    capped.max_body = 3;
    resp = util::http_request(capped, open, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE(resp->body_truncated);
    REQUIRE_EQ(resp->body.size(), 3u);

    // malformed input
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get("ftp://x/", open, 1000, &err).has_value());
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get("http://user:pw@127.0.0.1/", open, 1000, &err).has_value());
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get("http://127.0.0.1:1/", open, 2000, &err).has_value());
    util::http_request_t inj;
    inj.method = "POST";
    inj.url = o.url("/ct");
    inj.content_type = "text/plain\r\nX-Evil: 1";
    REQUIRE(!util::http_request(inj, open, &err).has_value());
}

namespace {

struct mem_store_t {
    HCERTSTORE h = ::CertOpenStore(CERT_STORE_PROV_MEMORY, 0, 0, 0, nullptr);
    ~mem_store_t() { ::CertCloseStore(h, 0); }
};

uint64_t ft_ticks(const FILETIME& f) {
    return (static_cast<uint64_t>(f.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | f.dwLowDateTime;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(network_pki_issuance_and_trust) {
    namespace mitm = slop::core::network::mitm;
    mem_store_t trust;
    mitm::pki_options_t opt;
    opt.key_prefix = L"reverse-slop-test-" + std::to_wstring(::GetCurrentProcessId()) + L"-pki";
    opt.trust_store = trust.h;          // never the real CurrentUser\ROOT
    opt.max_cached_leaves = 2;
    mitm::pki_t pki(opt);
    struct cleanup_t {
        mitm::pki_t& p;
        ~cleanup_t() { p.destroy(); }
    } cleanup{pki};

    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(!pki.leaf_for("target.local", &err));          // CA first
    REQUIRE(pki.ensure_ca(&err));
    REQUIRE(pki.has_ca());
    REQUIRE(pki.ca_path().empty());                         // memory mode writes nothing
    REQUIRE_EQ(pki.ca_thumbprint().size(), 40u);

    auto leaf = pki.leaf_for("Target.Local", &err);
    REQUIRE(leaf != nullptr);
    const CERT_INFO* info = leaf->pCertInfo;
    // 128-bit positive serial (CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB is little-endian: [15] is the MSB)
    REQUIRE_EQ(info->SerialNumber.cbData, 16u);
    REQUIRE_LT(info->SerialNumber.pbData[15], 0x80);
    // validity: now-1d .. now+397d
    const uint64_t day = 864000000000ull;
    const uint64_t span = ft_ticks(info->NotAfter) - ft_ticks(info->NotBefore);
    REQUIRE_GE(span, 397 * day);
    REQUIRE_LE(span, 399 * day);
    // SAN dNSName is the (lowercased) host
    const CERT_EXTENSION* san = ::CertFindExtension(szOID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME2, info->cExtension,
                                                    info->rgExtension);
    REQUIRE(san != nullptr);
    CERT_ALT_NAME_INFO* alt = nullptr;
    DWORD cb = 0;
    REQUIRE(::CryptDecodeObjectEx(X509_ASN_ENCODING, X509_ALTERNATE_NAME, san->Value.pbData,
                                  san->Value.cbData, CRYPT_DECODE_ALLOC_FLAG, nullptr, &alt, &cb));
    REQUIRE_EQ(alt->cAltEntry, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(alt->rgAltEntry[0].dwAltNameChoice, static_cast<DWORD>(CERT_ALT_NAME_DNS_NAME));
    REQUIRE(std::wstring(alt->rgAltEntry[0].pwszDNSName) == L"target.local");
    ::LocalFree(alt);
    REQUIRE(::CertFindExtension(szOID_ENHANCED_KEY_USAGE, info->cExtension, info->rgExtension));

    // the leaf chains to the CA with SSL policy for that name
    {
        HCERTSTORE roots = ::CertOpenStore(CERT_STORE_PROV_MEMORY, 0, 0, 0, nullptr);
        const auto ca = pki.ca_der();
        ::CertAddEncodedCertificateToStore(roots, X509_ASN_ENCODING, ca.data(),
                                           static_cast<DWORD>(ca.size()), CERT_STORE_ADD_NEW, nullptr);
        CERT_CHAIN_ENGINE_CONFIG cfg{};
        cfg.cbSize = sizeof(cfg);
        cfg.hExclusiveRoot = roots;
        HCERTCHAINENGINE engine = nullptr;
        REQUIRE(::CertCreateCertificateChainEngine(&cfg, &engine));
        CERT_CHAIN_PARA para{};
        para.cbSize = sizeof(para);
        PCCERT_CHAIN_CONTEXT chain = nullptr;
        REQUIRE(::CertGetCertificateChain(engine, leaf.get(), nullptr, nullptr, &para, 0, nullptr, &chain));
        wchar_t name[] = L"target.local";
        SSL_EXTRA_CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_PARA ssl{};
        ssl.cbSize = sizeof(ssl);
        ssl.dwAuthType = AUTHTYPE_SERVER;
        ssl.pwszServerName = name;
        CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_PARA pp{};
        pp.cbSize = sizeof(pp);
        pp.pvExtraPolicyPara = &ssl;
        CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_STATUS ps{};
        ps.cbSize = sizeof(ps);
        REQUIRE(::CertVerifyCertificateChainPolicy(CERT_CHAIN_POLICY_SSL, chain, &pp, &ps));
        REQUIRE_EQ(ps.dwError, 0u);
        ::CertFreeCertificateChain(chain);
        ::CertFreeCertificateChainEngine(engine);
        ::CertCloseStore(roots, 0);
    }

    // cached per host; IP literals get an IP SAN; bad names never reach a file/container name
    REQUIRE(pki.leaf_for("target.local", &err).get() == leaf.get());
    REQUIRE(pki.leaf_for("10.0.0.5", &err) != nullptr);
    for (const char* bad : {"..\\..\\evil", "../x", "a b", "", "x/y", "-lead.example"})
        REQUIRE(pki.leaf_for(bad, &err) == nullptr);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pki.issued(), 2u);
    // LRU cap of 2: a third host evicts the least recent, re-issuing it later
    REQUIRE(pki.leaf_for("third.example", &err) != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(pki.leaf_for("target.local", &err) != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pki.issued(), 4u);

    // trust install / uninstall against the injected store only
    REQUIRE_FALSE(pki.root_installed());
    REQUIRE(pki.install_root(&err));
    REQUIRE(pki.root_installed());
    REQUIRE(pki.uninstall_root(&err));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(pki.root_installed());
    REQUIRE(pki.install_root(&err));
    REQUIRE(pki.destroy(&err));                             // removes trust too
    REQUIRE_FALSE(pki.has_ca());
    PCCERT_CONTEXT left = ::CertEnumCertificatesInStore(trust.h, nullptr);
    REQUIRE(left == nullptr);
}
```

```cpp
// Uses the real built SlopTarget.exe as a live PE fixture

namespace {

std::vector<uint8_t>& slop_target_bytes() {
    static std::vector<uint8_t> bytes = [] {
        std::ifstream f(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH, std::ios::binary);
        return std::vector<uint8_t>(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f),
                                    std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{});
    }();
    return bytes;
}

// === engine ===

TEST_CASE(engine_decode_pe32_default_widths) {
    engine_t engine;
    REQUIRE(engine.init(false));
    static const uint8_t bytes[] = {0x8B, 0x01};
    const auto instruction = engine.decode(0x401000, bytes, sizeof(bytes));
    REQUIRE(instruction.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(instruction->length, 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(instruction->ops[0].reg, ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX);
    REQUIRE_EQ(instruction->ops[1].mem_base, ZYDIS_REGISTER_ECX);
}

TEST_CASE(engine_init_and_decode_mov) {
    engine_t e;
    REQUIRE(e.init());

    // 48 89 E8 = mov rax, rbp (formatter uppercases mnemonics)
    const uint8_t code[] = {0x48, 0x89, 0xE8};
    auto insn = e.decode(0x140001000, code, sizeof(code));
    REQUIRE(insn.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(insn->length, 3);

    std::string lower = insn->text;
    std::transform(lower.begin(), lower.end(), lower.begin(),
                   [](unsigned char c) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c)); });
    REQUIRE(lower.find("mov") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(lower.find("rax") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(lower.find("rbp") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(insn->flow == flow_t::none);
}

TEST_CASE(engine_call_rel32_resolves_target) {
    engine_t e;
    REQUIRE(e.init());

    // e8 10 00 00 00 = call +0x10 -> target = va + 5 + 16
    const uint8_t code[] = {0xE8, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};
    const uint64_t va = 0x140010000;
    auto insn = e.decode(va, code, sizeof(code));
    REQUIRE(insn.has_value());
    REQUIRE(insn->flow == flow_t::call);
    REQUIRE(insn->has_rel_target);
    REQUIRE_EQ(insn->rel_target, va + 5 + 0x10);
}

TEST_CASE(engine_ret_and_garbage) {
    engine_t e;
    REQUIRE(e.init());

    const uint8_t ret_b[] = {0xC3};
    auto r = e.decode(0x1000, ret_b, sizeof(ret_b));
    REQUIRE(r.has_value());
    REQUIRE(r->flow == flow_t::ret);

    const uint8_t junk[] = {0xFF, 0xFF};
    REQUIRE(!e.decode(0x1000, junk, sizeof(junk)).has_value());
}

// === pe_parser against the real SlopTarget.exe ===

TEST_CASE(pe_parse_slop_target_headers) {
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    REQUIRE_GT(bytes.size(), 1024u);

    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    REQUIRE(pe.pe32plus);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pe.machine, 0x8664);          // AMD64
    REQUIRE(pe.entry_rva != 0);
    REQUIRE_GE(pe.sections.size(), 3u);       // .text/.rdata/.data at minimum
    REQUIRE(pe.image_base != 0);

    // Entry point must map back into the file
    REQUIRE(pe.rva_to_offset(pe.entry_rva).has_value());
}

// Regression: a crafted e_lfanew near 4 GiB wrapped in uint32_t arithmetic
// (0xFFFFFFF0 + 0x18 == 8), so the "PE\0\0" signature compare read at a wild
// address. Found by src/fuzz/fuzz_pe.cpp.
TEST_CASE(pe_parse_rejects_wrapping_e_lfanew) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(0x40, 0);
    bytes[0] = 'M';
    bytes[1] = 'Z';
    for (uint32_t e_lfanew : {0xFFFFFFF0u, 0xFFFFFFFFu, 0xFFFFFFF8u}) {
        std::memcpy(bytes.data() + 0x3C, &e_lfanew, sizeof(e_lfanew));
        auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
        CHECK(!pe.ok);
    }
    // one byte short of the 0x18 the signature compare needs
    std::vector<uint8_t> tight(0x3C + 4 + 0x17, 0);
    tight[0] = 'M';
    tight[1] = 'Z';
    const uint32_t e_lfanew = 0x3C + 4;
    std::memcpy(tight.data() + 0x3C, &e_lfanew, sizeof(e_lfanew));
    CHECK(!pe_parse(tight.data(), tight.size()).ok);
}

TEST_CASE(pe_parse_slop_target_sections_roundtrip) {
    auto pe = pe_parse(slop_target_bytes().data(), slop_target_bytes().size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    bool has_text = false;
    bool text_exec = false;
    for (const auto& s : pe.sections) {
        if (std::string(s.name) == ".text") {
            has_text = true;
            text_exec = s.is_executable();
        }
    }
    REQUIRE(has_text);
    REQUIRE(text_exec);

    // offset_to_va inverts va_to_offset for the entrypoint
    auto entry_off = pe.rva_to_offset(pe.entry_rva);
    REQUIRE(entry_off.has_value());
    auto entry_va = pe.offset_to_va(*entry_off);
    REQUIRE(entry_va.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(*entry_va, pe.image_base + pe.entry_rva);
}

TEST_CASE(pe_parse_imports_present) {
    auto pe = pe_parse(slop_target_bytes().data(), slop_target_bytes().size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    REQUIRE(!pe.imports.empty());

    bool any_kernel32 = false;
    for (const auto& dll : pe.imports) {
        // Every import must have a plausible DLL name
        REQUIRE(!dll.dll.empty());
        if (_stricmp(dll.dll.c_str(), "KERNEL32.dll") == 0)
            any_kernel32 = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(any_kernel32);   // MSVC-linked exes always import kernel32
}

// === strings: synthetic determinism first ===

TEST_CASE(strings_synthetic_ascii_and_utf16) {
    // Layout: non-printable junk, "hello world\0", junk byte, UTF-16 L"ABC\0"
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf;
    const uintptr_t base = 0x1000;

    buf.insert(buf.end(), {0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC});                    // @0 non-printable
    const size_t ascii_off = buf.size();
    for (const char c : std::string("hello world"))
        buf.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(c));
    buf.push_back(0x00);
    buf.push_back(0xEE);                                          // separator junk

    const size_t u16_off = buf.size();
    buf.insert(buf.end(), {'A', 0x00, 'B', 0x00, 'C', 0x00, 0x00, 0x00});

    auto hits = extract_strings(buf.data(), buf.size(), base, 2);
    REQUIRE_GE(hits.size(), 2u);

    bool found_a = false, found_u = false;
    for (const auto& h : hits) {
        if (!h.utf16 && h.text == "hello world" && h.va == base + ascii_off)
            found_a = true;
        if (h.utf16 && h.text == "ABC" && h.va == base + u16_off)
            found_u = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(found_a);
    REQUIRE(found_u);
}

TEST_CASE(strings_reject_short_and_unterminated) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf;
    for (const char c : std::string("abc"))                       // too short (<4)
        buf.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(c));
    buf.push_back(0x00);
    for (const char c : std::string("no-terminator-string"))      // truly unterminated
        buf.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(c));                   // (std::string range excludes NUL)

    string_stats_t st;
    auto hits = extract_strings(buf.data(), buf.size(), 0x2000, 4, 1000, &st);
    REQUIRE(hits.empty());
    REQUIRE(!st.truncated);
}

TEST_CASE(strings_scan_real_image_finds_data) {
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    // Scan every non-executable section with raw data
    size_t total_hits = 0;
    for (const auto& s : pe.sections) {
        if (s.is_executable() || s.raw_size == 0) continue;
        if (static_cast<size_t>(s.raw_offset) + s.raw_size > bytes.size()) continue;
        auto hits = extract_strings(bytes.data() + s.raw_offset, s.raw_size,
                                    pe.image_base + s.rva, 6);
        total_hits += hits.size();
        for (const auto& h : hits) {
            REQUIRE(!h.text.empty());
            REQUIRE(h.text.size() >= 6u);
        }
    }
    REQUIRE_GT(total_hits, 10u);   // MSVC binaries carry plenty of strings
}

TEST_CASE(pe_parse_slop_target_runtime_funcs) {
    auto pe = pe_parse(slop_target_bytes().data(), slop_target_bytes().size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    // x64 MSVC output carries .pdata with thousands of exact function ranges
    REQUIRE_GT(pe.runtime_funcs.size(), 1000u);
    for (const auto& rf : pe.runtime_funcs) {
        REQUIRE(rf.end_rva > rf.begin_rva);
        // Every entry must land in the file inside an executable section
        REQUIRE(pe.rva_to_offset(rf.begin_rva).has_value());
        const auto* sec = pe.section_for_rva(rf.begin_rva);
        REQUIRE(sec != nullptr);
        REQUIRE(sec->is_executable());
    }
}

// === function index + xrefs against the real image ===

TEST_CASE(function_index_discovers_entrypoint) {
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    engine_t eng;
    REQUIRE(eng.init());

    function_index_t fi;
    REQUIRE(fi.build(pe, bytes, eng, pe.image_base));
    REQUIRE(!fi.functions().empty());

    const uint64_t entry_va = pe.image_base + pe.entry_rva;

    // Entrypoint must be a discovered function start..
    bool entry_listed = false;
    for (const auto& f : fi.functions())
        if (f.va == entry_va) { entry_listed = true; break; }
    REQUIRE(entry_listed);

    // ...and containing() resolves it
    auto owner = fi.containing(entry_va);
    REQUIRE(owner.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(*owner, entry_va);
}

TEST_CASE(function_index_seeded_from_pdata_and_covers_terminator) {
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    REQUIRE_GT(pe.runtime_funcs.size(), 1000u);

    engine_t eng;
    REQUIRE(eng.init());

    function_index_t fi;
    REQUIRE(fi.build(pe, bytes, eng, pe.image_base));

    // Compiler-reported functions are all present (plus heuristic extras)
    REQUIRE_GE(fi.functions().size(), pe.runtime_funcs.size());

    // Spot-check: a .pdata start is a discovered function start
    const uint64_t pdata_start = pe.image_base + pe.runtime_funcs.front().begin_rva;
    bool found = false;
    for (const auto& f : fi.functions())
        if (f.va == pdata_start) { found = true; break; }
    REQUIRE(found);

    // The terminating instruction belongs to its function: containing() must
    // resolve the last byte, not just the entry address
    const uint64_t entry_va = pe.image_base + pe.entry_rva;
    const function_t* entry_fn = nullptr;
    for (const auto& f : fi.functions())
        if (f.va == entry_va) { entry_fn = &f; break; }
    REQUIRE(entry_fn != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_GT(entry_fn->size, 1u);
    auto last = fi.containing(entry_fn->va + entry_fn->size - 1);
    REQUIRE(last.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(*last, entry_fn->va);
}

TEST_CASE(xref_index_builds_and_consistent) {
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    engine_t eng;
    REQUIRE(eng.init());

    xref_index_t xi;
    REQUIRE(xi.build(pe, bytes, eng, pe.image_base));

    // A linked exe has plenty of calls + rip-relative data refs
    REQUIRE_GT(xi.total(), 20u);

    // Spot-check consistency on a sample of targets
    auto targets = xi.targets();
    REQUIRE(!targets.empty());
    size_t checked = 0;
    size_t seen_refs = 0;
    for (uint64_t t : targets) {
        const auto& refs = xi.refs_to(t);
        seen_refs += refs.size();
        for (const auto& r : refs)
            REQUIRE_EQ(r.to, t);
        if (++checked >= 64) break;
    }
    REQUIRE(seen_refs > 0);
}

TEST_CASE(binary_state_parallel_load_deterministic) {
    // The sync stages (functions/xrefs/strings) build concurrently: two
    // loads must produce identical indexes.
    namespace bs = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
    size_t prev_fns = 0, prev_xrefs = 0, prev_strings = 0;
    uint64_t prev_first = 0, prev_last = 0;
    for (int run = 0; run < 2; ++run) {
        REQUIRE(bs::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
        const auto& bin = bs::get();
        REQUIRE(bin.ready);
        const size_t nf = bin.fns.functions().size();
        REQUIRE_GT(nf, 1000u);
        if (run > 0) {
            REQUIRE_EQ(nf, prev_fns);
            REQUIRE_EQ(bin.xrefs.total(), prev_xrefs);
            REQUIRE_EQ(bin.strings.size(), prev_strings);
            REQUIRE_EQ(bin.fns.functions().front().va, prev_first);
            REQUIRE_EQ(bin.fns.functions().back().va, prev_last);
        }
        prev_fns = nf;
        prev_xrefs = bin.xrefs.total();
        prev_strings = bin.strings.size();
        prev_first = bin.fns.functions().front().va;
        prev_last = bin.fns.functions().back().va;
        bs::unload();
    }
}

    const char* path = R"(C:\Users\kozydot\Downloads\Compressed\FileRecoverySrvE\FileRecoverySrv.exe)";
    std::ifstream probe(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!probe) return; // Skip if local fixture not present

    REQUIRE(pack.packed);
    bs::unload();
}

// === ELF / SELF / PS4 ===

namespace {

namespace bs = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
using elf_fixture::ps4_layout;

const pe_import_dll_t* find_dll(const pe_image_t& pe, const std::string& dll) {
    for (const auto& d : pe.imports)
        if (d.dll == dll) return &d;
    return nullptr;
}

bool has_import(const pe_import_dll_t* d, const std::string& name, uint32_t rva) {
    if (!d) return false;
    return std::any_of(d->functions.begin(), d->functions.end(), [&](const auto& f) {
        return f.name == name && f.iat_rva == rva;
    });
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(disasm_default_function_name_canonical) {
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(default_function_name(0x4DDA48), "sub_4DDA48");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(default_function_name(0), "sub_0");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(default_function_name(0x7FF6ABCD0010ull), "sub_7FF6ABCD0010");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(default_function_name(~0ull), "sub_FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF");
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_ps4_nid_hash_matches_published_values) {
    // pairs from ps4libdoc (name -> encoded_id)
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(hype::nid::encode("sceKernelUsleep"), "1jfXLRVzisc");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(hype::nid::encode("__stack_chk_fail"), "Ou3iL1abvng");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(hype::nid::encode("sceKernelStopUnloadModule"), "QKd0qM58Qes");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(hype::nid::encode("sceKernelPollEventFlag"), "9lvj5DjHZiA");
    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::nid::hash("sceKernelStopUnloadModule"), 0x40A774A8CE7C41EBull);

    uint64_t v = 0;
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::decode("QKd0qM58Qes", v));
    REQUIRE_EQ(v, 0x40A774A8CE7C41EBull);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(hype::nid::decode("short", v));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(hype::nid::decode("QKd0qM58Qe!", v));

    uint64_t id = 0;
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::decode_id("A", id));
    REQUIRE_EQ(id, 0u);
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::decode_id("B", id));
    REQUIRE_EQ(id, 1u);
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::decode_id("BA", id));
    REQUIRE_EQ(id, 64u);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_ps4_nid_database_and_overrides) {
    hype::nid::clear_overrides();   // never read the real user profile here
    REQUIRE_GT(hype::nid::builtin_count(), 40000u);
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::lookup("1jfXLRVzisc").value_or("") == "sceKernelUsleep");
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::lookup("1jfXLRVzisc#A#B").value_or("") == "sceKernelUsleep");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(hype::nid::lookup("AAAAAAAAAAA").has_value());

    // override file: bare name (NID computed) and "<nid> name"; overrides win
    const std::string custom_nid = hype::nid::encode("myGameInternalFn");
    const std::string file =
        "# comment\r\n\r\nmyGameInternalFn\r\n1jfXLRVzisc renamedUsleep\r\nbad line here\r\n";
    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(std::vector<uint8_t>(file.begin(), file.end()), "nids");
    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::nid::load_overrides(tf.path), 2u);
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::lookup(custom_nid).value_or("") == "myGameInternalFn");
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::lookup("1jfXLRVzisc").value_or("") == "renamedUsleep");
    hype::nid::add_override("AAAAAAAAAAA", "zeroNid");
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::lookup("AAAAAAAAAAA#A#A").value_or("") == "zeroNid");
    hype::nid::clear_overrides();
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::lookup("1jfXLRVzisc").value_or("") == "sceKernelUsleep");
    REQUIRE_FALSE(hype::nid::lookup("AAAAAAAAAAA").has_value());
    REQUIRE(hype::nid::default_override_path().filename() == "nids.txt");
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_ps4_elf_imports_resolved_and_grouped_by_library) {
    hype::nid::clear_overrides();
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    const auto img = open_image(elf);
    REQUIRE(img.ok);
    REQUIRE(img.format == image_format_t::elf);
    REQUIRE_EQ(img.pe.image_base, 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(img.pe.entry_rva, static_cast<uint32_t>(ps4_layout::kEntry));

    const auto* kernel = find_dll(img.pe, "libkernel");
    const auto* libc   = find_dll(img.pe, "libSceLibcInternal");
    REQUIRE(kernel != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(libc != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(has_import(kernel, "sceKernelUsleep", static_cast<uint32_t>(ps4_layout::kSlotUsleep)));
    REQUIRE(has_import(kernel, "__stack_chk_guard", static_cast<uint32_t>(ps4_layout::kSlotGuard)));
    REQUIRE(has_import(kernel, "AAAAAAAAAAA", static_cast<uint32_t>(ps4_layout::kSlotUnknown)));
    REQUIRE(has_import(libc, "memset", static_cast<uint32_t>(ps4_layout::kSlotMemset)));
    REQUIRE(find_dll(img.pe, "sce_imports") == nullptr);

    // defined dynlib symbols become exports with resolved names
    REQUIRE(std::any_of(img.pe.exports.begin(), img.pe.exports.end(), [](const auto& e) {
        return e.name == "module_start" && e.rva == ps4_layout::kFunc3;
    }));
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_elf_load_buffer_borrows_bytes) {
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    hype::ELFLoader loader;
    const auto img = loader.load_buffer(elf.data(), elf.size());
    REQUIRE(img.has_value());
    REQUIRE(img->raw.data() == elf.data());
    REQUIRE(img->storage.empty());   // no copy of the file, no zero-fill tails here
    for (const auto& seg : img->segments) {
        REQUIRE(seg.data.data() >= elf.data());
        REQUIRE(seg.data.data() + seg.data.size() <= elf.data() + elf.size());
    }
    REQUIRE(img->format == hype::ImageFormat::ELF);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_elf_entry_when_header_sits_below_first_segment) {
    // item 38: ELF header at base, first PT_LOAD at base + 0x1000
    constexpr uint64_t base = 0x7000000;
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_header_below_segment_elf(base);
    const auto img = open_image(elf);
    REQUIRE(img.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(img.pe.image_base, base + 0x1000);
    REQUIRE_EQ(img.header_base, base);
    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf, "elf38");
    const std::string path = tf.path.string();
    for (uint64_t override_base : {uint64_t{0}, base, base + 0x1000}) {
        REQUIRE(bs::load_file(path, override_base));
        const auto& bin = bs::get();
        REQUIRE_EQ(bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva, base + 0x1010);
        REQUIRE(bin.offset_of(base + 0x1010).value_or(0) == 0x1010u);
    }
    // any other runtime base shifts relative to the lowest segment
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(path, 0x9000000));
    REQUIRE_EQ(bs::get().base + bs::get().pe.entry_rva, 0x9000010u);
    bs::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_elf_relocations_applied_on_file_load) {
    using L = ps4_layout;
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();

    // static helper over a copy: natural base, then idempotent re-apply
    auto copy = elf;
    auto st = hype::ELFLoader::apply_relocations(copy);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.applied, size_t{2});
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.imported, size_t{4});
    REQUIRE_EQ(elf_fixture::get64(copy, L::file_off(L::kSlotRel)), L::kFunc2);
    REQUIRE_EQ(elf_fixture::get64(copy, L::file_off(L::kSlotRelro)), L::kString);
    auto again = copy;
    hype::ELFLoader::apply_relocations(again);
    REQUIRE(again == copy);

    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf, "elfrel");
    const std::string path = tf.path.string();
    // runtime base: pointers follow the rebase
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(path, 0x400000));
    {
        const auto& bin = bs::get();
        REQUIRE_EQ(bin.base, 0x400000u);
        REQUIRE_EQ(bin.relocations_applied, size_t{2});
        REQUIRE_EQ(elf_fixture::get64(bin.file, L::file_off(L::kSlotRel)), 0x400000u + L::kFunc2);
        REQUIRE_EQ(elf_fixture::get64(bin.file, L::file_off(L::kSlotRelro)), 0x400000u + L::kString);
        // import slots stay for the runtime linker
        REQUIRE_EQ(elf_fixture::get64(bin.file, L::file_off(L::kSlotUsleep)), 0u);
    }
    // memory dumps carry their own relocations: leave the bytes alone
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(path, 0x400000, /*apply_relocs=*/false));
    REQUIRE_EQ(bs::get().relocations_applied, size_t{0});
    REQUIRE_EQ(elf_fixture::get64(bs::get().file, L::file_off(L::kSlotRel)), 0u);
    // the annotation key ignores relocation
    const uint64_t hash_unrelocated = bs::get().file_hash;
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(path));
    REQUIRE_EQ(bs::get().file_hash, hash_unrelocated);
    bs::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_self_fake_signed_and_compressed_unwrap) {
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    for (auto mode : {elf_fixture::self_mode::plain, elf_fixture::self_mode::compressed}) {

        const auto img = open_image(self);
        REQUIRE(img.ok);
        REQUIRE(img.format == image_format_t::self);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(image_format_name(img.format), "self");
        REQUIRE(find_dll(img.pe, "libkernel") != nullptr);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_loaded_counts_strings_and_publishes_image_changed) {
    auto sub = slop::core::infra::event_bus::subscribe();
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf, "elfstr");
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(tf.path.string()));
    // strings are collected at load, no strings call needed
    const auto& bin = bs::get();
    REQUIRE(std::any_of(bin.strings.begin(), bin.strings.end(),
                        [](const string_hit_t& s) { return s.text == "hello ps4 world"; }));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(image_format_name(bin.format), "elf");

    auto saw = [&](const char* needle) {
        const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(5);
        std::string frame;
        while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
            if (!sub->wait(frame, 200)) return false;
            if (frame.find("image.changed") != std::string::npos &&
                frame.find(needle) != std::string::npos)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    };
    REQUIRE(saw("\"loaded\":true"));
    bs::unload();
    REQUIRE(saw("\"loaded\":false"));
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_arm64_decode_fills_operands) {
    // ldr x0, [x1, #8]
    const uint8_t ldr[] = {0x20, 0x04, 0x40, 0xF9};
    insn_t in;
    REQUIRE(hyperion_session::session_t::decode(0x1000, ldr, sizeof(ldr), in, hype::Arch::ARM64));
    REQUIRE_EQ(in.op_count, 2u);
    REQUIRE(in.ops[0].cls == op_class_t::reg);
    REQUIRE_NE(in.ops[0].arm_reg, 0u);
    REQUIRE(in.ops[0].reg == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE);
    REQUIRE(in.ops[1].cls == op_class_t::mem);
    REQUIRE_NE(in.ops[1].arm_base, 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(in.ops[1].disp, 8);
    // b #+0x10 keeps its branch target
    const uint8_t b[] = {0x04, 0x00, 0x00, 0x14};
    REQUIRE(hyperion_session::session_t::decode(0x2000, b, sizeof(b), in, hype::Arch::ARM64));
    REQUIRE(in.has_rel_target);
    REQUIRE_EQ(in.rel_target, 0x2010u);
    REQUIRE(in.ops[0].cls == op_class_t::imm);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_arm64_decode_parallel_per_thread_handles) {
    const uint8_t ldr[] = {0x20, 0x04, 0x40, 0xF9};
    insn_t ref;
    REQUIRE(hyperion_session::session_t::decode(0x1000, ldr, sizeof(ldr), ref, hype::Arch::ARM64));
    std::atomic<int> bad{0};
    std::vector<std::thread> threads;
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {
        threads.emplace_back([&, t] {
            for (int i = 0; i < 2000; ++i) {
                insn_t in;
                const uint64_t va = 0x1000 + static_cast<uint64_t>(t) * 0x10000 + static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * 4;
                if (!hyperion_session::session_t::decode(va, ldr, sizeof(ldr), in, hype::Arch::ARM64) ||
                    in.text != ref.text || in.va != va)
                    ++bad;
            }
        });
    }
    for (auto& th : threads) th.join();
    REQUIRE_EQ(bad.load(), 0);
}

// === unified function index (Hyperion merge) ===

TEST_CASE(function_index_merges_hyperion_starts) {
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);

    engine_t eng;
    REQUIRE(eng.init());
    function_index_t fi;
    REQUIRE(fi.build(pe, bytes, eng, pe.image_base));
    const size_t before = fi.functions().size();
    const uint64_t entry = pe.image_base + pe.entry_rva;

    // entry is already a start; entry+1 is not, and is passed twice
    const function_t* entry_fn = nullptr;
    for (const auto& f : fi.functions())
        if (f.va == entry) { entry_fn = &f; break; }
    REQUIRE(entry_fn != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_GT(entry_fn->size, 2u);

    const size_t added = fi.merge_starts({{entry, 16}, {entry + 1, 0}, {entry + 1, 0}});
    REQUIRE_EQ(added, size_t{1});
    REQUIRE_EQ(fi.functions().size(), before + 1);
    REQUIRE_EQ(fi.stats().hype_functions, size_t{1});

    const function_t* merged = nullptr;
    const function_t* kept = nullptr;
    for (const auto& f : fi.functions()) {
        if (f.va == entry) kept = &f;
        if (f.va == entry + 1) merged = &f;
    }
    REQUIRE(kept != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(merged != nullptr);
    // the decode-built entry keeps ownership; its extent clips at the new start
    REQUIRE(kept->source == fn_source_t::index);
    REQUIRE_EQ(kept->size, size_t{1});
    REQUIRE(merged->source == fn_source_t::hyperion);
    REQUIRE_GE(merged->size, size_t{1});
    // sorted + containing() agrees
    REQUIRE(std::is_sorted(fi.functions().begin(), fi.functions().end(),
                           [](const function_t& a, const function_t& b) {
                               return a.va < b.va;
                           }));
    REQUIRE_EQ(*fi.containing(entry + 1), entry + 1);
}

// === string decoding previews ===

TEST_CASE(strings_decode_candidates_finds_obfuscation) {
    const auto has = [](const std::vector<decode_candidate_t>& cs,
                        const std::string& scheme, const std::string& text) {
        return std::any_of(cs.begin(), cs.end(), [&](const decode_candidate_t& c) {
            return c.scheme == scheme && c.text == text;
        });
    };

    // single-byte XOR
    const std::string plain = "hello obfuscated world";
    std::vector<uint8_t> xored(plain.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < plain.size(); ++i)
        xored[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(plain[i]) ^ 0x5A;
    REQUIRE(has(decode_candidates(xored.data(), xored.size()), "xor:0x5A", plain));

    // base64
    const std::string b64 = "aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=";   // "hello world"
    REQUIRE(has(decode_candidates(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(b64.data()),
                                  b64.size()),
                "base64", "hello world"));

    // UTF-16LE
    std::vector<uint8_t> u16;
    for (char c : std::string("wide string")) {
        u16.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(c));
        u16.push_back(0);
    }
    REQUIRE(has(decode_candidates(u16.data(), u16.size()), "utf16le", "wide string"));

    // ROT13
    const std::string rot = "uryyb jbeyq";        // "hello world"
    REQUIRE(has(decode_candidates(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(rot.data()),
                                  rot.size()),
                "rot13", "hello world"));

    // entropy gate: uniform bytes score 8 bits, plain text much lower
    std::vector<uint8_t> uniform(256);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < uniform.size(); ++i) uniform[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(i);
    REQUIRE_GT(shannon_entropy(uniform.data(), uniform.size()), 7.9);
    REQUIRE_LT(shannon_entropy(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(plain.data()),
                               plain.size()), 5.0);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_strings_decode_action_returns_candidates) {
    bool is_error = false;
    auto out = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "disasm", {{"action", "strings"}, {"path", SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH},
                   {"decode", true}, {"limit", 50}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(out.contains("decoded"));
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("decoded_count", size_t{99}), out["decoded"].size());
    for (const auto& c : out["decoded"]) {
        REQUIRE(c.contains("scheme"));
        REQUIRE(c.contains("score"));
        REQUIRE_GT(c.value("score", 0.0), 0.9);
    }
}

// === FLIRT import ===
namespace {

void flirt_le16(std::vector<uint8_t>& b, uint16_t v) {
    b.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF));
    b.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(v >> 8));
}
void flirt_le32(std::vector<uint8_t>& b, uint32_t v) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) b.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((v >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF));
}
void flirt_be16(std::vector<uint8_t>& b, uint16_t v) {
    b.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(v >> 8));
    b.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(v & 0xFF));
}

// Minimal FLIRT v6 file: one leaf module with `pattern` and one public name.
// `compressed` sets the zlib feature bit and deflates the pattern stream.
std::vector<uint8_t> build_flirt(const std::vector<uint8_t>& pattern,
                                 const std::string& name, bool compressed) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out = {'I', 'D', 'A', 'S', 'G', 'N'};
    out.push_back(6);                 // version
    out.push_back(0);                 // arch: 386
    flirt_le32(out, 0x800);           // file_types: PE
    flirt_le16(out, 2);               // os_types
    flirt_le16(out, 0x100);           // app_types: 32-bit
    flirt_le16(out, compressed ? 0x10 : 0);   // features
    flirt_le16(out, 0);               // old_n_functions
    flirt_le16(out, 0);               // crc16
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; ++i) out.push_back(0);   // ctype
    out.push_back(6);                 // library name length
    flirt_le16(out, 0);               // ctypes_crc16
    flirt_le32(out, 1);               // nfuncs
    for (char c : std::string("libxyz")) out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(c));

    std::vector<uint8_t> tree;
    tree.push_back(0);                // root: pattern length
    tree.push_back(0);                // root: variant mask (max_2_bytes)
    tree.push_back(1);                // root: one child node
    tree.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(pattern.size()));   // leaf length (<0x10)
    tree.push_back(0);                // leaf variant mask
    tree.insert(tree.end(), pattern.begin(), pattern.end());
    tree.push_back(0);                // leaf: no children -> modules
    tree.push_back(0);                // crc_len
    flirt_be16(tree, 0);              // crc
    tree.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(pattern.size()));   // module length
    tree.push_back(0);                // public function offset
    tree.push_back(0);                // flags -> next byte starts the name
    for (char c : name) tree.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(c));
    tree.push_back(0);                // terminating flags: no more names/modules

    if (!compressed) {
        out.insert(out.end(), tree.begin(), tree.end());
        return out;
    }
    uLongf clen = compressBound(static_cast<uLong>(tree.size()));
    std::vector<uint8_t> z(clen);
    REQUIRE_EQ(compress(z.data(), &clen, tree.data(),
                        static_cast<uLong>(tree.size())), Z_OK);
    z.resize(clen);
    out.insert(out.end(), z.begin(), z.end());
    return out;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(flirt_sig_import_parses_and_matches) {
    namespace analysis = slop::core::analysis;
    const std::vector<uint8_t> pattern = {0x48, 0x89, 0x5C, 0x24, 0x08, 0x48, 0x83, 0xEC};

    for (bool compressed : {false, true}) {
        const auto sig = build_flirt(pattern, "test_func", compressed);
        std::string err;
        auto parsed = analysis::parse_flirt_sig(sig.data(), sig.size(), &err);
        REQUIRE(parsed.has_value());
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(parsed->library, "libxyz");
        REQUIRE_EQ(parsed->version, 6);
        REQUIRE_EQ(parsed->sigs.size(), size_t{1});
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(parsed->sigs[0].name, "test_func");
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(parsed->sigs[0].pattern,
                       std::string("48 89 5C 24 08 48 83 EC"));
    }

    // hostile input: truncated header / truncated tree fail cleanly
    {
        const auto full = build_flirt(pattern, "test_func", false);
        std::string err;
        REQUIRE_FALSE(analysis::parse_flirt_sig(full.data(), 12, &err));
        REQUIRE(!err.empty());
        REQUIRE_FALSE(analysis::parse_flirt_sig(full.data(), full.size() - 3, &err));
        REQUIRE(!err.empty());
    }

    // end to end: a pattern taken from real code matches in SlopTarget.exe.
    // Pick a window that occurs exactly once in the file so the scan's single
    // per-section hit is guaranteed to be inside an indexed function.
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    auto pe = pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    engine_t eng;
    REQUIRE(eng.init());
    function_index_t fi;
    REQUIRE(fi.build(pe, bytes, eng, pe.image_base));
    const auto entry_off = pe.rva_to_offset(pe.entry_rva);
    REQUIRE(entry_off.has_value());

    std::vector<uint8_t> real_pattern;
    uint64_t expected_va = 0;
    for (size_t off = 0; off + 8 <= 96 && real_pattern.empty(); ++off) {
        const size_t fo = *entry_off + off;
        if (fo + 8 > bytes.size()) break;
        std::vector<uint8_t> window(bytes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(fo),
                                    bytes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(fo + 8));
        size_t occurrences = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 8 <= bytes.size() && occurrences < 2; ++i)
            if (std::equal(window.begin(), window.end(),
                           bytes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(i)))
                ++occurrences;
        if (occurrences != 1) continue;
        const uint64_t va = pe.image_base + pe.entry_rva + off;
        if (!fi.containing(va)) continue;
        real_pattern = std::move(window);
        expected_va = va;
    }
    REQUIRE(!real_pattern.empty());

    const auto sig = build_flirt(real_pattern, "entry_like", false);
    std::string err;
    auto parsed = analysis::parse_flirt_sig(sig.data(), sig.size(), &err);
    REQUIRE(parsed.has_value());
    const auto hits = analysis::libsig_scan(pe, bytes, fi, parsed->sigs);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits.size(), size_t{1});
    // the imported pattern anchors at the exact VA it was taken from, and the
    // hit maps back to the indexed function that owns it
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits[0].va, expected_va);
    REQUIRE(hits[0].function_va.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(*hits[0].function_va, *fi.containing(expected_va));
}

TEST_CASE(flirt_sig_import_via_re_tool) {
    const std::vector<uint8_t> pattern = {0x48, 0x89, 0x5C, 0x24, 0x08, 0x48, 0x83, 0xEC};

    REQUIRE(out.contains("hits"));
}

    namespace bs = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
    const auto self = elf_fixture::wrap_self(elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf(),

// === CFG graph endpoints ===

TEST_CASE(disasm_blocks_and_xray_cfg_return_graph) {
    namespace bs = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(30);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline && !bs::hype_ready())
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
    REQUIRE(bs::hype_ready());

    // pick the function with the most blocks so the graph has edges
    uint64_t target = 0;
    size_t best_blocks = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lk(bs::state_mutex());
        for (const auto& [entry, f] : bs::get().hype->db().funcs)
            if (f.blocks.size() > best_blocks) { best_blocks = f.blocks.size(); target = entry; }
    }
    REQUIRE(target != 0);

    bool is_error = false;
    auto blocks = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "disasm", {{"action", "blocks"}, {"addr", target}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(blocks.contains("graph"));
    const auto& g = blocks.at("graph");
    REQUIRE_EQ(g.at("nodes").size(), blocks.at("blocks").size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(g.at("nodes").at(0).value("id", uint64_t{0}),
               g.at("nodes").at(0).value("start", uint64_t{1}));
    REQUIRE(g.at("nodes").at(0).contains("summary"));
    size_t succ_total = 0;
    for (const auto& b : blocks.at("blocks"))
        succ_total += b.at("succs").size();
    REQUIRE_EQ(g.at("edges").size(), succ_total);
    bool kind_ok = true;
    for (const auto& e : g.at("edges")) {
        const std::string kind = e.value("kind", std::string{});
        if (kind != "fallthrough" && kind != "branch") kind_ok = false;
    }
    REQUIRE(kind_ok);

    auto cfg = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "xray", {{"action", "cfg"}, {"addr", target}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(cfg.contains("graph"));
    REQUIRE_EQ(cfg.at("graph").at("nodes").size(), cfg.at("blocks").size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(cfg.at("graph").at("edges").size(), cfg.value("edge_count", size_t{0}));
    bs::unload();
}
```

```cpp
#include "harness.hpp"
#include "disasm_accuracy.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/xrefs.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace {
void require_exact(const disasm_accuracy::result& report) {
    for (const auto& [field, count] : report.mismatches)
        std::printf("  %s: %zu mismatches\n", field.c_str(), count);
    std::printf("  accuracy: %zu/%zu exact, %zu valid\n", report.exact, report.cases, report.decoded);
    REQUIRE_GT(report.decoded, 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(report.exact, report.cases);
}
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_x64_fixtures) {
    require_exact(disasm_accuracy::evaluate(disasm_accuracy::fixtures(true), true));
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_x86_fixtures) {
    require_exact(disasm_accuracy::evaluate(disasm_accuracy::fixtures(false), false));
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_x64_random) {
    require_exact(disasm_accuracy::evaluate(disasm_accuracy::random_samples(true), true));
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_x86_random) {
    require_exact(disasm_accuracy::evaluate(disasm_accuracy::random_samples(false), false));
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_reused_record_clears_inactive_fields) {
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    hype::Insn out{};
    const uint8_t load[] = {0x48, 0x8B, 0x05, 0x10, 0, 0, 0};
    const uint8_t ret[] = {0xC3};
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, load, sizeof(load), out));
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x2000, ret, sizeof(ret), out));
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.op_count, 0u);
    for (const auto& operand : out.ops) {
        CHECK(operand.type == hype::OpType::None);
        CHECK(operand.val == 0);
        CHECK(!operand.read && !operand.write);
    }
    for (size_t i = out.len; i < sizeof(out.bytes); ++i) CHECK(out.bytes[i] == 0);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_golden_targets_and_fifth_operand) {
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    hype::Insn out{};
    const uint8_t compare[] = {0x62, 0xF1, 0x64, 0x49, 0xC2, 0xCC, 0x03};
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, compare, sizeof(compare), out));
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.op_count, 5u);
    CHECK(out.ops[4].type == hype::OpType::Imm);
    CHECK(out.ops[4].val == 3);
    CHECK(out.ops[0].write);

    const uint8_t eip_load[] = {0x67, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x05, 0x10, 0, 0, 0};
    disasm_accuracy::ds::engine_t engine;
    REQUIRE(engine.init());
    const auto load = engine.decode(0x1FFFFFFFC, eip_load, sizeof(eip_load));
    REQUIRE(load.has_value());
    CHECK(load->has_rip_rel);
    CHECK(load->rip_rel_target == 0x14);

    decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X86);
    const uint8_t jump[] = {0xE9, 0x10, 0, 0, 0};
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0xFFFFFFFC, jump, sizeof(jump), out));
    CHECK(out.branch_target() == 0x11);
    const uint8_t absolute[] = {0x8B, 0x05, 0, 0x20, 0x40, 0};
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x401000, absolute, sizeof(absolute), out));
    CHECK(out.ops[1].val == 0x402000);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_indirect_slot_is_data_not_code_xref) {
    namespace ds = disasm_accuracy::ds;
    const std::vector<uint8_t> bytes{
        0xFF, 0x15, 0xFA, 0x0F, 0, 0, // call [rip+0xFFA] -> slot 0x402000
        0xE8, 0x05, 0, 0, 0,          // direct call -> 0x401010
        0xC3
    };
    ds::pe_image_t image;
    image.ok = true;
    image.image_base = 0x400000;
    image.size_of_image = 0x3000;
    ds::pe_section_t text;
    text.rva = 0x1000;
    text.raw_size = static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes.size());
    text.characteristics = 0x60000020;
    image.sections.push_back(text);
    ds::engine_t engine;
    REQUIRE(engine.init());
    ds::xref_index_t refs;
    REQUIRE(refs.build(image, bytes, engine, image.image_base));
    const auto& slot_refs = refs.refs_to(0x402000);
    REQUIRE(slot_refs.size() == 1);
    CHECK(slot_refs.front().kind == ds::xref_kind_t::data);
    const auto& calls = refs.refs_to(0x401010);
    REQUIRE(calls.size() == 1);
    CHECK(calls.front().kind == ds::xref_kind_t::call);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_iret_terminates_cfg) {
    hype::PEImage image{};
    image.arch = hype::Arch::X64;
    image.base = 0x400000;
    image.entry = 0x401000;
    hype::Segment text{};
    text.name = ".text";
    text.va = image.entry;
    text.flags = 0x60000020;
    static constexpr hype::u8 kText[] = {0x48, 0xCF, 0xB8, 0x2A, 0, 0, 0, 0xC3}; // iretq; unreachable mov/ret
    text.data = kText;
    text.size = text.file_sz = text.data.size();
    image.segments.push_back(std::move(text));
    hype::WorkerPool pool(1);
    hype::Analyzer analyzer(image, pool);
    analyzer.run();
    const auto& database = analyzer.db();
    REQUIRE(database.insns.size() == 1);
    CHECK(database.insns.at(image.entry).is_ret());
    const auto& function = database.funcs.at(image.entry);
    REQUIRE(function.blocks.size() == 1);
    CHECK(function.blocks.begin()->second.succs.empty());
    CHECK(function.blocks.begin()->second.end == image.entry + 2);
}

TEST_CASE(disasm_accuracy_nested_loops_terminate_with_dominator_back_edges) {
    // Entry jumps into an outer loop whose body jumps into a self-looping
    // inner block: both headers have a pred outside the loop plus a latch,
    // the shape detect_loops used to spin on forever inside intersect().
    // Headers are only reached by jumps (never by fallthrough) so the CFG
    // builder's blocks don't overlap and each header is a single block
    hype::PEImage image{};
    image.arch = hype::Arch::X64;
    image.base = 0x400000;
    image.entry = 0x401000;
    hype::Segment text{};
    text.name = ".text";
    text.va = image.entry;
    text.flags = 0x60000020;
    static constexpr hype::u8 kText[] = {
        0x31, 0xC9,         // +00 xor ecx, ecx
        0xEB, 0x0F,         // +02 jmp +13
        0xFF, 0xC2,         // +04 inc edx        inner header + latch
        0x83, 0xFA, 0x04,   // +06 cmp edx, 4
        0x75, 0xF9,         // +09 jne +04
        0xFF, 0xC1,         // +0B inc ecx        outer latch
        0x83, 0xF9, 0x04,   // +0D cmp ecx, 4
        0x75, 0x01,         // +10 jne +13
        0xC3,               // +12 ret
        0x31, 0xD2,         // +13 xor edx, edx   outer header
        0xEB, 0xED,         // +15 jmp +04
    };
    text.data = kText;
    text.size = text.file_sz = text.data.size();
    image.segments.push_back(std::move(text));
    hype::WorkerPool pool(1);
    hype::Analyzer analyzer(image, pool);
    analyzer.run();

    auto loops = analyzer.db().funcs.at(image.entry).loops;
    REQUIRE_EQ(loops.size(), 2u);
    std::sort(loops.begin(), loops.end(),
              [](const hype::LoopInfo& a, const hype::LoopInfo& b) { return a.header < b.header; });
    CHECK(loops[0].header == image.entry + 0x04);
    CHECK(loops[0].back_edge_src == image.entry + 0x04);
    CHECK(loops[1].header == image.entry + 0x13);
    CHECK(loops[1].back_edge_src == image.entry + 0x0B);
}
```

`src/tests/test_emu.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_emu.cpp
// Unicorn emulation engine + dynamic taint propagation. Hermetic: synthetic
// code snippets only, no target processes

#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/disasm/binary_state.hpp"
#include "core/emu/session.hpp"
#include "core/emu/taint.hpp"
#include "core/mcp/mcp_tools.hpp"

#include "elf_fixture.hpp"
#include "macho_fixture.hpp"

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include <Zydis/Zydis.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

using namespace slop::core::emu;

namespace {

run_request_t base_req(std::initializer_list<uint8_t> code,
                       uint64_t code_base = 0x400000) {
    run_request_t req;
    req.code = std::vector<uint8_t>(code.begin(), code.end());
    req.code_base = code_base;
    return req;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(taint_canonical_reg_maps_subregisters) {
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_AL), (uint32_t)ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_AH), (uint32_t)ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX), (uint32_t)ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX), (uint32_t)ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_R8D), (uint32_t)ZYDIS_REGISTER_R8);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_R15W), (uint32_t)ZYDIS_REGISTER_R15);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM0), 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(taint_canonical_reg(ZYDIS_REGISTER_CS), 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(taint_shadow_memory_roundtrip) {
    taint_tracker_t t;
    t.mark_memory(0x1000, 4);
    REQUIRE(t.memory_any(0x1000, 4));
    REQUIRE(t.memory_any(0x0FFC, 8));       // spans the marked bytes
    REQUIRE(!t.memory_any(0x1010, 4));

    auto ranges = t.tainted_ranges();
    REQUIRE_EQ(ranges.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(ranges[0].addr, 0x1000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(ranges[0].len, 4u);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_add_run_and_return_sentinel) {

                         0x83, 0xC0, 0x03,

    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");

    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rax"], 5u);

TEST_CASE(taint_propagates_through_memory_load_store) {
    // mov al,[0x500000]      A0 00 00 30 00 00 00 00 00
    // mov [0x500100],al      88 04 25 00 01 30 00
    // ret                    C3
    auto req = base_req({0xA0, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x88, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x01, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x200, 0x41);
    req.maps.push_back(data);

    req.taint_sources.push_back({0x500000, 8});   // input window tainted
    req.watch_addr = 0x500100;
    req.watch_len  = 8;

    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");

    bool out_marked = false;
    for (const auto& rg : r.taint_ranges) {
        if (rg.addr <= 0x500107 && rg.addr + rg.len > 0x500100)
            out_marked = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(out_marked);
    REQUIRE(r.output_tainted);
    REQUIRE(!r.taint_events.empty());
}

TEST_CASE(taint_propagates_through_registers) {
    // mov cl,[0x500000]      8B 0D ... -> use mov ecx,[..] then xor into eax
    // mov edx,[0x500000]     8B 14 25 00 00 30 00
    // xor eax,edx            31 D0   (eax untainted before, edx tainted after load)
    // mov [0x500200],eax     89 04 25 00 02 30 00
    // ret                    C3
    auto req = base_req({0x8B, 0x14, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0x31, 0xD0,
                         0x89, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x02, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x300, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(data);
    req.regs["rax"] = 0;

    req.taint_sources.push_back({0x500000, 4});
    req.watch_addr = 0x500200;
    req.watch_len  = 4;

    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE(r.output_tainted);
}

TEST_CASE(taint_zeroing_idiom_clears_flow) {
    // mov edx,[0x500000]     tainted
    // xor edx,edx            zeroing clears
    // mov [0x500200],edx     store must NOT be tainted
    // ret
    auto req = base_req({0x8B, 0x14, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0x31, 0xD2,
                         0x89, 0x14, 0x25, 0x00, 0x02, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x300, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(data);

    req.taint_sources.push_back({0x500000, 4});
    req.watch_addr = 0x500200;
    req.watch_len  = 4;

    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE(!r.output_tainted);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_trace_captures_instruction_text) {
    // inc eax / dec eax / ret
    auto req = base_req({0xFF, 0xC0,
                         0xFF, 0xC8,
                         0xC3});
    req.trace = true;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.trace.size(), 3u);
    bool saw_inc = false, saw_dec = false;
    for (const auto& t : r.trace) {
        std::string lower = t.text;
        std::transform(lower.begin(), lower.end(), lower.begin(),
                       [](unsigned char ch) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch)); });
        if (lower.find("inc") != std::string::npos) saw_inc = true;
        if (lower.find("dec") != std::string::npos) saw_dec = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(saw_inc);
    REQUIRE(saw_dec);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_timeout_reports_timeout_reason) {
    // jmp $ with an instruction budget it can never reach
    auto req = base_req({0xEB, 0xFE});
    req.max_instructions = 1ull << 40;
    req.timeout_ms = 200;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "timeout");
    REQUIRE_GT(r.instructions, 0u);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_cancel_token_stops_running_loop) {
    // jmp $ with a 20 s budget; cancellation must end it long before that
    auto req = base_req({0xEB, 0xFE});
    req.max_instructions = 1ull << 40;
    req.timeout_ms = 20000;
    slop::core::infra::cancel_source_t source;
    req.cancel = source.token();

    const auto started = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    std::thread canceller([&source] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(200));
        source.request();
    });
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    canceller.join();
    const auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - started).count();

    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "cancelled");
    REQUIRE_LT(elapsed, 5000);
}


namespace {

// Page source over a sparse fake image: page va -> bytes (zero padded)
page_source_t fake_pages(std::map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint8_t>> pages) {
    return [pages = std::move(pages)](uint64_t page, uint8_t* out) {
        auto it = pages.find(page);
        if (it == pages.end()) return false;
        std::memset(out, 0, kPageSize);
        std::memcpy(out, it->second.data(), std::min(it->second.size(), kPageSize));
        return true;
    };
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(emu_page_in_follows_call_outside_slice) {
    // call 0x401000 / ret ; the callee page is only in the source
    auto req = base_req({0xE8, 0xFB, 0x0F, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    req.page_in = fake_pages({{0x401000, {0xB8, 0x34, 0x12, 0x00, 0x00,   // mov eax,0x1234
                                          0xC3}}});                       // ret
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rax"], 0x1234u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.paged_in, 1u);
    REQUIRE(!r.fault.has_value());
}

TEST_CASE(emu_page_in_completes_partial_code_page) {
    // a 2-byte slice runs on into the source's bytes, not zero fill
    auto req = base_req({0x90, 0x90});
    req.page_in = fake_pages({{0x400000, {0x90, 0x90,
                                          0xB8, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,   // mov eax,7
                                          0xC3}}});
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rax"], 7u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.paged_in, 0u);   // completion is not demand paging
}

TEST_CASE(emu_page_in_refusal_and_budget_still_fault) {
    // mov eax,[0xDEAD0000] / ret, the source has no such page
    auto req = base_req({0xA1, 0x00, 0x00, 0xAD, 0xDE, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    req.page_in = fake_pages({});
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "invalid_mem_read");
    REQUIRE(!r.page_in_exhausted);

    // the page exists but the budget is spent
    req.page_in = fake_pages({{0xDEAD0000, {0x11}}});
    req.page_in_max = 0;
    r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "invalid_mem_read");
    REQUIRE(r.page_in_exhausted);

    req.page_in_max = 1;
    r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rax"], 0x11u);
}

namespace {

// mov ecx,0x11 / call [rip+0x1FF5] (IAT slot 0x402000) / add rax,1 / ret
run_request_t import_call_req() {
    auto req = base_req({0xB9, 0x11, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xFF, 0x15, 0xF5, 0x1F, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x48, 0x83, 0xC0, 0x01,
                         0xC3});
    req.imports.push_back({0x402000, "kernel32.dll!Sleep"});
    req.api_ret = 41;
    req.trace = true;
    return req;
}

void require_one_sleep_call(const run_result_t& r) {
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rax"), 42u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.total_api_calls, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.api_calls[0].name.c_str(), "kernel32.dll!Sleep");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].ip, 0x400005ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].ret, 0x40000Bull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].args[0], 0x11ull);
    bool traced = false;
    for (const auto& t : r.trace)
        if (t.text == "api kernel32.dll!Sleep") traced = true;
    REQUIRE(traced);
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(emu_import_stub_in_mapped_iat) {
    auto req = import_call_req();
    emu_mem_region_t iat;
    iat.addr = 0x402000;
    iat.bytes.assign(8, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(iat);
    require_one_sleep_call(emulate_run(req));
}

TEST_CASE(emu_import_stub_patched_on_page_in) {
    // the IAT page holds the on-disk hint/name rva until the stub patch lands
    auto req = import_call_req();
    req.page_in = fake_pages({{0x402000, {0x34, 0x12, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00}}});
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    require_one_sleep_call(r);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.paged_in, 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_teb_peb_behind_gs) {
    // mov rax,gs:[0x30] / mov rcx,gs:[0x60] / mov rdx,[rcx+0x10] /
    // movzx r8d,byte [rcx+2] / ret
    auto req = base_req({0x65, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x04, 0x25, 0x30, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x65, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x0C, 0x25, 0x60, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x48, 0x8B, 0x51, 0x10,
                         0x44, 0x0F, 0xB6, 0x41, 0x02,
                         0xC3});
    req.image_base = 0x140000000;
    req.regs["r8"] = 0xFF;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE(r.teb_mapped);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rax"], r.regs["gs_base"]);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rcx"], r.regs["gs_base"] + 0x2000);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rdx"], 0x140000000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["r8"], 0u);             // BeingDebugged

    // a caller gs_base replaces the fake TEB
    req.regs["gs_base"] = 0x500000;
    emu_mem_region_t teb;
    teb.addr = 0x500000;
    teb.bytes.assign(0x100, 0);
    teb.bytes[0x30] = 0x77;
    req.maps.push_back(teb);
    req.code.resize(9);                       // just the first load
    req.code.push_back(0xC3);
    r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(!r.teb_mapped);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs["rax"], 0x77u);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_dump_and_write_values) {
    // mov dword [0x500000],0xDEADBEEF / ret
    auto req = base_req({0xC7, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xEF, 0xBE, 0xAD, 0xDE,
                         0xC3});
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x10, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(data);
    // untouched source page, an unmapped range, and one straddling the end
    req.page_in = fake_pages({{0x600000, {0xAA, 0xBB}}});
    req.dumps = {{0x500000, 8}, {0x600000, 2}, {0x900000, 4}, {0x500FFE, 4}};
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");

    REQUIRE_EQ(r.writes.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.writes[0].len, 4u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.writes[0].value, 0xDEADBEEFull);

    REQUIRE_EQ(r.memory.size(), 4u);
    const std::vector<uint8_t> want = {0xEF, 0xBE, 0xAD, 0xDE, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    REQUIRE(r.memory[0].bytes == want);
    REQUIRE(r.memory[1].bytes == std::vector<uint8_t>({0xAA, 0xBB}));
    REQUIRE(r.memory[2].bytes.empty());
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.memory[3].bytes.size(), 2u);   // cut at the unmapped page
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.paged_in, 0u);                 // dumps never map pages
}

// === SysV / PS4 environment (item 55) ========================================

TEST_CASE(emu_sysv_import_args_use_sysv_registers) {
    // mov edi,0x11 / call [rip+0x1FF5] (IAT slot 0x402000) / add rax,1 / ret
    auto req = base_req({0xBF, 0x11, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xFF, 0x15, 0xF5, 0x1F, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x48, 0x83, 0xC0, 0x01,
                         0xC3});
    req.abi = abi_t::sysv;
    req.imports.push_back({0x402000, "libkernel!sceKernelUsleep"});
    req.api_ret = 41;
    req.regs["rsi"] = 0x22;
    req.regs["r9"]  = 0x66;
    emu_mem_region_t iat;
    iat.addr = 0x402000;
    iat.bytes.assign(8, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(iat);
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rax"), 42u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].arg_count, 6u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].args[0], 0x11ull);   // rdi
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].args[1], 0x22ull);   // rsi
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].args[5], 0x66ull);   // r9
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(abi_name(req.abi), "sysv");
}

TEST_CASE(emu_win64_import_args_stay_win64) {
    auto req = import_call_req();
    emu_mem_region_t iat;
    iat.addr = 0x402000;
    iat.bytes.assign(8, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(iat);
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].arg_count, 4u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.api_calls[0].args[0], 0x11ull);   // rcx
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(abi_name(req.abi), "win64");
}

TEST_CASE(emu_sysv_tcb_behind_fs) {
    // mov rax,fs:[0] / mov rcx,fs:[8] / mov rdx,[rcx+0x10] / mov r8,fs:[-8] / ret
    auto req = base_req({0x64, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x64, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x0C, 0x25, 0x08, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x48, 0x8B, 0x51, 0x10,
                         0x64, 0x4C, 0x8B, 0x04, 0x25, 0xF8, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF,
                         0xC3});
    req.abi = abi_t::sysv;
    req.regs["r8"] = 0xFF;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE(r.tls_mapped);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(r.teb_mapped);
    const uint64_t tp = r.regs.at("fs_base");
    REQUIRE(tp != 0);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rax"), tp);              // tcb_self
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rdx"), tp - 0x2000);     // dtv[2]: static TLS block
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("r8"), 0u);               // static TLS reads zero

    // a caller fs_base replaces the fake TCB
    req.regs["fs_base"] = 0x500000;
    emu_mem_region_t tcb;
    tcb.addr = 0x500000;
    tcb.bytes.assign(0x100, 0);
    tcb.bytes[0] = 0x77;
    req.maps.push_back(tcb);
    req.code.resize(9);
    req.code.push_back(0xC3);
    r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(r.tls_mapped);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rax"), 0x77u);
}

namespace {

const char* test_syscall_name(uint64_t num) {
    switch (num) {
    case 4:  return "write";
    case 20: return "getpid";
    default: return nullptr;
    }
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(emu_syscall_hook_logs_names_args_and_returns) {
    // mov eax,20 / mov edi,7 / mov r10d,9 / syscall / mov rbx,rax /
    // mov eax,4 / stc / syscall / mov eax,99 / syscall / ret
    auto req = base_req({0xB8, 0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xBF, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x41, 0xBA, 0x09, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x0F, 0x05,
                         0x48, 0x89, 0xC3,
                         0xB8, 0x04, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xF9,
                         0x0F, 0x05,
                         0x48, 0x89, 0xC6,                 // mov rsi,rax
                         0xB8, 0x63, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x0F, 0x05,
                         0xC3});
    req.abi = abi_t::sysv;
    req.syscall_ret = 0x55;
    req.syscall_returns[20] = 1234;
    req.syscall_name = test_syscall_name;
    req.trace = true;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.total_syscalls, 3u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls.size(), 3u);

    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls[0].ip, 0x400010ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls[0].num, 20u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.syscalls[0].name.c_str(), "getpid");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls[0].args[0], 7u);    // rdi
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls[0].args[3], 9u);    // r10, the 4th syscall arg
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls[0].ret, 1234u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rbx"), 1234u);

    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.syscalls[1].name.c_str(), "write");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rsi"), 0x55u);
    REQUIRE(r.syscalls[2].name.empty());      // unknown number
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.syscalls[2].num, 99u);

    // rcx = next rip, CF cleared even after stc
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rcx"), 0x400027ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.regs.at("rflags") & 1u, 0u);

    bool named = false;
    for (const auto& t : r.trace)
        if (t.ip == 0x400010 && t.text.find("; getpid") != std::string::npos) named = true;
    REQUIRE(named);
}

// === write log keeps wide stores (item 75) ===================================

TEST_CASE(emu_write_log_keeps_wide_store_values) {
    // movups xmm0,[0x500000] / movups [0x500010],xmm0 / mov qword [0x500020],rcx / ret
    auto req = base_req({0x0F, 0x10, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0x0F, 0x11, 0x04, 0x25, 0x10, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0x48, 0x89, 0x0C, 0x25, 0x20, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    req.regs["rcx"] = 0x1122334455667788ull;
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x40, 0);
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) data.bytes[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(0xA0 + i);
    req.maps.push_back(data);
    req.dumps = {{0x500000, 0x40}};
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.stopped_reason.c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.memory.size(), 1u);
    const auto& mem = r.memory[0].bytes;

    size_t vec_bytes = 0;
    bool saw_qword = false;
    for (const auto& w : r.writes) {
        REQUIRE(w.addr >= 0x500000 && w.addr + w.len <= 0x500040);
        // the logged value is the low (up to 8) bytes actually stored
        const size_t n = std::min<size_t>(w.len, 8);
        uint64_t want = 0;
        std::memcpy(&want, mem.data() + (w.addr - 0x500000), n);
        REQUIRE_EQ(w.value, want);
        REQUIRE_EQ(w.truncated, w.len > 8);
        if (w.addr >= 0x500010 && w.addr < 0x500020) vec_bytes += w.len;
        if (w.addr == 0x500020 && w.len == 8) {
            saw_qword = true;
            REQUIRE_EQ(w.value, 0x1122334455667788ull);
        }
    }
    REQUIRE_EQ(vec_bytes, 16u);
    REQUIRE(saw_qword);
    REQUIRE(r.writes.front().value != 0);   // the vector store is not logged as 0
}

// === emulate tool: arch gate on every source (56) and abi selection (55) =====

namespace {

nlohmann::json emulate_call(const nlohmann::json& args, bool& is_error) {
    return slop::core::mcp::call_tool("emulate", args, is_error);
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(emu_tool_hex_arch_selection) {
    bool is_error = false;
    auto out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", "90c3"}, {"arch", "vax"}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);

    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", "90c3"}, {"arch", "x64"}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("arch", "").c_str(), "x64");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("stopped_reason", "").c_str(), "return");

    // arm64 raw bytes: mov w0,#7 / ret
    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", "e0008052c0035fd6"}, {"arch", "arm64"}},
                       is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("arch", "").c_str(), "arm64");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("abi", "").c_str(), "aapcs64");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("stopped_reason", "").c_str(), "return");
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.at("regs").value("x0", 0ull), 7ull);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_tool_abi_selection_and_syscall_log) {
    namespace ds = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
    ds::unload();
    bool is_error = false;

    // no console, no image: hex defaults to the win64 environment
    auto out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", "90c3"}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("abi", "").c_str(), "win64");
    REQUIRE(out.value("teb_mapped", false));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(out.contains("tls_mapped"));

    // mov eax,20 (getpid) / mov edi,5 / syscall / ret on the PS4 abi
    const std::string code = "b814000000" "bf05000000" "0f05" "c3";
    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", code}, {"abi", "sysv"},
                        {"syscall_returns", {{"getpid", 77}}}, {"trace", true}},
                       is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("abi", "").c_str(), "sysv");
    REQUIRE(out.value("tls_mapped", false));
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.at("regs").value("rax", 0ull), 77ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("total_syscalls", 0ull), 1ull);
    const auto& sc = out.at("syscalls").at(0);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sc.value("num", 0ull), 20ull);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(sc.value("name", "").c_str(), "getpid");
    REQUIRE_EQ(sc.at("args").size(), 6u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sc.at("args").at(0).get<uint64_t>(), 5ull);

    // numeric keys and the default return
    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", code}, {"abi", "sysv"},
                        {"syscall_returns", {{"0x14", 9}}}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.at("regs").value("rax", 0ull), 9ull);
    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", code}, {"abi", "sysv"},
                        {"syscall_ret", 3}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.at("regs").value("rax", 0ull), 3ull);

    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", code}, {"abi", "sysv"},
                        {"syscall_returns", {{"not_a_syscall", 1}}}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"}, {"hex", code}, {"abi", "vax"}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
}

// === snapshot/restore + persistent sessions (audit 54) ======================

namespace {

// inc dword [0x500000] / mov eax,[0x500000] / jmp 0x400000
run_request_t counter_req() {
    auto req = base_req({0xFF, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0x8B, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xEB, 0xF0});
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x10, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(data);
    return req;
}

std::string lower_copy(std::string s) {
    std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(),
                   [](unsigned char ch) { return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch)); });
    return s;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(emu_session_snapshot_restore_is_deterministic) {
    std::string err;
    auto s = emulation_session_t::create(counter_req(), &err);
    REQUIRE(s != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(s->step(6, 1000, {}, &err));   // two loop iterations
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->state().regs.at("rax"), 2u);
    REQUIRE(s->snapshot(&err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->snapshot_pages(), 1u);   // the counter page

    REQUIRE(s->step(6, 1000, {}, &err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->state().regs.at("rax"), 4u);
    REQUIRE(s->restore(&err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->state().regs.at("rax"), 2u);
    REQUIRE(s->step(6, 1000, {}, &err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->state().regs.at("rax"), 4u);

    // a second cycle lands on the same state again
    REQUIRE(s->snapshot(&err));
    REQUIRE(s->step(3, 1000, {}, &err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->state().regs.at("rax"), 5u);
    REQUIRE(s->restore(&err));
    REQUIRE(s->step(3, 1000, {}, &err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(s->state().regs.at("rax"), 5u);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_tool_session_actions) {
    bool is_error = false;
    auto out = emulate_call({{"action", "session_create"},
                             {"hex", "ff0425000050008b042500005000ebf0"},

                                          {nlohmann::json{{"addr", 0x500000},
```
