```cpp
// === dynamic backward slicing (audit 55) ====================================

TEST_CASE(emu_backward_slice_registers) {
    // mov eax,1 / mov esi,7 / mov ecx,2 / add eax,ecx / ret
    auto req = base_req({0xB8, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xBE, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0xB9, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x01, 0xC8,
                         0xC3});
    req.trace = true;
    req.record_slice = true;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.trace.size(), 5u);

    slice_request_t s;
    s.reg = "rax";
    auto sl = emulate_slice(r, s);
    REQUIRE(sl.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices.size(), 3u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices[0], 0u);   // mov eax,1
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices[1], 2u);   // mov ecx,2
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices[2], 3u);   // add eax,ecx
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.insns.back().ip, 0x40000Full);

    // at the add: only the mov eax,1 defines the value there
    s.at = 0x40000F;
    sl = emulate_slice(r, s);
    REQUIRE(sl.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices[0], 0u);

    // an unknown target register is an error, not an empty slice
    s = {};
    s.reg = "notareg";
    sl = emulate_slice(r, s);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(sl.ok);
}

TEST_CASE(emu_backward_slice_memory) {
    // mov eax,5 / mov [0x500000],eax / ret
    auto req = base_req({0xB8, 0x05, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
                         0x89, 0x04, 0x25, 0x00, 0x00, 0x50, 0x00,
                         0xC3});
    emu_mem_region_t data;
    data.addr = 0x500000;
    data.bytes.assign(0x10, 0);
    req.maps.push_back(data);
    req.trace = true;
    req.record_slice = true;
    auto r = emulate_run(req);
    REQUIRE(r.ok);

    slice_request_t s;
    s.addr = 0x500000;
    s.len  = 4;
    auto sl = emulate_slice(r, s);
    REQUIRE(sl.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices[0], 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(sl.indices[1], 1u);
}

// === Orbis syscall emulation on a synthetic PS4 ELF (audit 56) ==============

TEST_CASE(emu_orbis_syscalls_on_ps4_elf) {
    namespace bs = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
    bs::unload();
    auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    const uint64_t base = 0x10000000;
    const uint64_t str_va = base + elf_fixture::ps4_layout::kString;

    std::vector<uint8_t> code;
    auto b = [&](std::initializer_list<uint8_t> v) { code.insert(code.end(), v); };
    auto d32 = [&](uint32_t v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) code.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(v >> (8 * i)));
    };
    b({0xB8}); d32(4);                          // mov eax,4 (write)
    b({0x8B, 0x0C, 0x25}); d32(static_cast<uint32_t>(str_va));  // mov ecx,[str]
    b({0xBF}); d32(1);                          // mov edi,1
    b({0xBE}); d32(static_cast<uint32_t>(str_va));
    b({0xBA}); d32(5);                          // mov edx,5
    b({0x0F, 0x05});                            // syscall
    b({0xB8}); d32(20);                         // getpid
    b({0x0F, 0x05});
    b({0xB8}); d32(477);                        // mmap
    b({0x31, 0xFF});                            // xor edi,edi
    b({0xBE}); d32(0x2000);                     // len
    b({0xBA}); d32(3);                          // prot rw
    b({0x41, 0xBA}); d32(0x1002);               // MAP_ANON|MAP_PRIVATE
    b({0x49, 0xC7, 0xC0}); d32(0xFFFFFFFF);     // mov r8,-1
    b({0x45, 0x31, 0xC9});                      // xor r9d,r9d
    b({0x0F, 0x05});
    b({0xB8}); d32(5);                          // open -> ENOSYS
    b({0x0F, 0x05});
    b({0xB8}); d32(1);                          // exit(7)
    b({0xBF}); d32(7);
    b({0x0F, 0x05});

    std::memcpy(elf.data() + elf_fixture::ps4_layout::file_off(elf_fixture::ps4_layout::kEntry),
                code.data(), code.size());
    elf_fixture::temp_file_t tf(elf, "emu_orbis");
    REQUIRE(bs::load_file(tf.path.string(), base));

    bool is_error = false;
    auto out = emulate_call({{"action", "run"},
                             {"file_addr", base + elf_fixture::ps4_layout::kEntry},
                             {"entry", base + elf_fixture::ps4_layout::kEntry},
                             {"code_len", code.size()},
                             {"abi", "sysv"},
                             {"orbis_syscalls", true},
                             {"trace", true}},
                            is_error);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(out.value("stopped_reason", "").c_str(), "exit");
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("stdout", ""), std::string("hello"));
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("exit_code", 0ull), 7ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("syscall_enosys", 0ull), 1ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.value("total_syscalls", 0ull), 5ull);

    const auto& sc = out.at("syscalls");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(sc.at(0).value("name", "").c_str(), "write");
    REQUIRE_EQ(sc.at(0).value("ret", 0ull), 5ull);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(sc.at(1).value("name", "").c_str(), "getpid");
    REQUIRE_EQ(sc.at(1).value("ret", 0ull), 1000ull);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(sc.at(2).value("name", "").c_str(), "mmap");
    REQUIRE_GE(sc.at(2).value("ret", 0ull), 0x700000000000ull);
    REQUIRE(sc.at(3).value("enosys", false));
    REQUIRE_EQ(sc.at(3).value("ret", 0ull), 78ull);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(sc.at(4).value("name", "").c_str(), "exit");
    bs::unload();
}
```

`src/tests/test_harness.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_harness.cpp
// Self-tests for harness.hpp: area naming, area selection and the per-test
// watchdog (a child slop_tests run whose only test hangs must die with 124).

#include "harness.hpp"

#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>

namespace {

struct child_result_t {
    int exit_code = -1;
    std::string output;
};

// Runs this test binary again with extra environment, capturing stdout.
child_result_t run_self(const char* filter, const char* area, const char* victim) {
    char exe[MAX_PATH] = {};
    ::GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH);

    // the child inherits the environment; restore ours afterwards
    const auto set = [](const char* key, const char* value) { ::_putenv_s(key, value ? value : ""); };
    std::string old_filter, old_area;
    if (const char* v = std::getenv("SLOP_TEST_FILTER")) old_filter = v;
    if (const char* v = std::getenv("SLOP_TEST_AREA")) old_area = v;
    set("SLOP_TEST_FILTER", filter);
    set("SLOP_TEST_AREA", area);
    set("SLOP_TEST_HARNESS_VICTIM", victim);

    child_result_t r;
    // cmd /c strips one outer pair of quotes, keep the exe path quoted inside
    const std::string cmd = "\"\"" + std::string(exe) + "\" 2>&1\"";
    if (FILE* pipe = ::_popen(cmd.c_str(), "r")) {
        char buf[512];
        while (std::fgets(buf, static_cast<int>(sizeof buf), pipe)) r.output += buf;
        r.exit_code = ::_pclose(pipe);
    }

    set("SLOP_TEST_FILTER", old_filter.c_str());
    set("SLOP_TEST_AREA", old_area.c_str());
    set("SLOP_TEST_HARNESS_VICTIM", nullptr);
    return r;
}

} // namespace

// Only does something inside the child spawned below: blocks far past its
// 1 s deadline so the watchdog has to end the process.
TEST_CASE_TIMEOUT(harness_watchdog_victim, 1) {
    const char* victim = std::getenv("SLOP_TEST_HARNESS_VICTIM");
    if (!victim || std::string(victim) != "1") return;
    ::Sleep(60'000);
}

TEST_CASE(harness_area_of_strips_prefix_and_extension) {
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slop_test::area_of("C:\\repo\\src\\tests\\test_network.cpp"), "network");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slop_test::area_of("/repo/src/tests/test_disasm_accuracy.cpp"), "disasm_accuracy");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slop_test::area_of("test_harness.cpp"), "harness");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slop_test::area_of("bench.cpp"), "bench");
}

TEST_CASE(harness_area_selection_is_exact_and_listable) {
    CHECK(slop_test::area_selected("network", nullptr));
    CHECK(slop_test::area_selected("network", ""));
    CHECK(slop_test::area_selected("network", "memory,network"));
    CHECK(slop_test::area_selected("disasm", "disasm"));
    CHECK(!slop_test::area_selected("disasm", "disasm_accuracy"));
    CHECK(!slop_test::area_selected("disasm_accuracy", "disasm"));
}

TEST_CASE(harness_registers_this_file_as_area_harness) {
    bool found = false;
    for (const auto& tc : slop_test::registry())
        if (std::string(tc.name) == "harness_watchdog_victim") found = tc.area == "harness" && tc.timeout_sec == 1;
    CHECK(found);
}

TEST_CASE(harness_watchdog_kills_hung_test) {
    const auto r = run_self("harness_watchdog_victim", "harness", "1");
    CHECK(r.exit_code == 124);
    CHECK(r.output.find("[TIMEOUT] harness_watchdog_victim") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(harness_unmatched_area_fails_the_run) {
    const auto r = run_self(nullptr, "no_such_area", nullptr);
    CHECK(r.exit_code == 2);
    CHECK(r.output.find("no test matched") != std::string::npos);
}
```

`src/tests/test_hyperion.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_hyperion.cpp
// Hyperion engine integration: decode parity vs the legacy Zydis wrapper,
// analyzer sanity on SlopTarget.exe, decompiler determinism, and the
// hype::Insn → slop insn_t compat shim.

#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/disasm/binary_state.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/hyperion_session.hpp"
#include "core/infra/event_bus.hpp"
#include "threading/parallel.h"
#include "core/loader/elf_loader.h"
#include "core/loader/ps4_nid.h"

#include "elf_fixture.hpp"

#include <Zydis/Zydis.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

namespace hs = slop::core::disasm::hyperion_session;
namespace ds = slop::core::disasm::binary_state;
namespace disasm = slop::core::disasm;

namespace {

std::vector<uint8_t>& slop_target_bytes() {
    static std::vector<uint8_t> bytes = [] {
        std::ifstream f(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH, std::ios::binary);
        return std::vector<uint8_t>(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f),
                                    std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{});
    }();
    return bytes;
}

// Wait for background hyperion analysis with a generous timeout (analysis of
// SlopTarget is sub-second, but CI machines vary).
bool wait_hype_ready(int timeout_ms = 30000) {
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() +
                          std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout_ms);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
        if (ds::hype_ready()) return true;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
    }
    return ds::hype_ready();
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(hyperion_session_analyzes_slop_target) {
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());

    auto& bin = ds::get();
    REQUIRE(bin.hype != nullptr);

    const auto& db = bin.hype->db();
    REQUIRE_GT(db.funcs.size(), 0u);
    REQUIRE_GT(db.insns.size(), 0u);
    REQUIRE_GT(db.strings.size(), 0u);

    // Every function with decoded code at its entry has at least one basic
    // block. Entries that were never decoded (an unreached .pdata entry, a
    // stub with no code) are name placeholders with no blocks rather than
    // zero-length ones.
    for (const auto& [entry, f] : db.funcs) {
        (void)entry;
        if (db.insns.count(f.entry)) REQUIRE_FALSE(f.blocks.empty());
    }

    ds::unload();
    REQUIRE_FALSE(ds::hype_ready());
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decode_parity_with_legacy_engine) {
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    auto& bin = ds::get();

    // Walk the first executable section, decoding via both engines.
    const auto* text = &bin.pe.sections.front();
    for (const auto& s : bin.pe.sections)
        if (s.is_executable()) { text = &s; break; }

    disasm::engine_t eng;
    REQUIRE(eng.init());

    const uint64_t va0 = bin.base + text->rva;
    const uint8_t*  p  = bin.file.data() + text->raw_offset;
    const size_t    n  = std::min<size_t>(text->raw_size, 4096);  // bounded

    size_t off = 0, parity = 0, decoded = 0;
    while (off + 1 < n) {
        auto legacy = eng.decode(va0 + off, p + off, n - off);
        hype::Insn hin;
        bool hok = hs::shared_decoder().decode(va0 + off, p + off, n - off, hin);
        if (legacy && hok) {
            ++decoded;
            const auto conv = hs::session_t::convert(hin);
            const bool same_len  = conv.length == legacy->length;
            const bool same_mnem = conv.mnemonic == legacy->mnemonic;
            bool same_target = true;
            if (legacy->has_rel_target && conv.has_rel_target)
                same_target = conv.rel_target == legacy->rel_target;
            if (same_len && same_mnem && same_target) ++parity;
        }
        const size_t step = legacy ? legacy->length : hok ? hin.len : 1;
        off += step ? step : 1;
    }
    // Almost everything must agree — tolerate a few classification edge
    // cases (e.g. exotic prefixes) but require the overwhelming majority.
    REQUIRE_GT(decoded, 100u);
    REQUIRE_GT(parity, decoded * 95 / 100);
    ds::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decompile_deterministic_and_sane) {
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());
    auto& bin = ds::get();

    // Find a real (non-thunk) function: prefer one with several blocks.
    const hype::Function* best = nullptr;
    for (const auto& [entry, f] : bin.hype->db().funcs) {
        if (f.blocks.size() < 2) continue;
        if (!best || f.blocks.size() > best->blocks.size()) best = &f;
    }
    REQUIRE(best != nullptr);

    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> a, b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(bin.hype->decompile(best->entry, a, err));
    REQUIRE(bin.hype->decompile(best->entry, b, err));
    REQUIRE_GT(a.size(), 3u);

    // Determinism: identical output across runs.
    REQUIRE_EQ(a.size(), b.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i)
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(a[i].text, b[i].text);

    // Output looks like C: braces + a statement marker.
    bool has_brace = false, has_stmt = false;
    for (const auto& l : a) {
        if (l.text.find('{') != std::string::npos) has_brace = true;
        if (l.text.find(';') != std::string::npos) has_stmt = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(has_brace);
    REQUIRE(has_stmt);

    ds::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decompile_entry_point_function) {
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());
    auto& bin = ds::get();

    const hype::Function* f = bin.hype->function_entry(bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva);
    if (!f) f = bin.hype->function_at(bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva);
    REQUIRE(f != nullptr);

    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> out;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(bin.hype->decompile(f->entry, out, err));

    ds::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_analyze_stop_cancels_or_noops) {
    // stop() racing a fast analysis must land in a consistent state:
    // either the cancel won (not ready, "cancelled" error) or the analysis
    // won (ready, DB usable). And stop() on a settled session never flips
    // ready back off.
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    auto& bin = ds::get();
    REQUIRE(bin.hype != nullptr);

    ds::hype_stop();

    const bool ready = wait_hype_ready(5000);
    if (!ready) {
        // Cancel won the race: error explains it, DB never reported usable.
        const std::string err = bin.hype->error();
        REQUIRE(err.find("cancelled") != std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(bin.hype->ready());
    }

    // Settled-session stop() is a no-op: ready state survives untouched.
    if (bin.hype->ready()) {
        const size_t funcs_before = bin.hype->db().funcs.size();
        ds::hype_stop();
        REQUIRE(bin.hype->ready());
        REQUIRE_EQ(bin.hype->db().funcs.size(), funcs_before);
    }
    ds::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_status_snapshot_tracks_lifecycle) {
    // No binary: empty snapshot, and stop() without a session is safe.
    REQUIRE_FALSE(ds::hype_status().has_image);
    ds::hype_stop();

    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    {
        const auto st = ds::hype_status();
        REQUIRE(st.has_image);
        REQUIRE(st.engine_present);
        // Either still running or already done — both valid immediately
        // after load; never "not ready and not running and no error".
        if (!st.ready && !st.running)
            REQUIRE_FALSE(st.engine_error.empty());
    }
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());
    {
        const auto st = ds::hype_status();
        REQUIRE(st.ready);
        REQUIRE_FALSE(st.running);
        REQUIRE_EQ(st.progress, 1.0f);
    }
    ds::unload();
    REQUIRE_FALSE(ds::hype_status().has_image);
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decode_without_text_keeps_classification) {
    // Analysis builds skip the formatter: mnemonic id, type, operands and
    // branch targets must be intact with op_str empty, and format_text()
    // must restore display text from the stored bytes on demand.
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X64);
    hype::Insn out{};

    static const uint8_t call[] = {0xE8, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x140001000, call, sizeof(call), out, false));
    REQUIRE(out.op_str[0] == '\0');
    REQUIRE(out.mnemonic[0] != '\0');
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Call);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.branch_target(), 0x140001000ull + 5 + 0x10);

    const std::string text = hype::Disassembler::format_text(out, hype::Arch::X64);
    REQUIRE(text.find("call") != std::string::npos);

    // Full-text decode still embeds operands directly.
    hype::Insn full{};
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x140001000, call, sizeof(call), full));
    REQUIRE(full.op_str[0] != '\0');
    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::Disassembler::format_text(full, hype::Arch::X64), text);
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_parallel_matches_serial) {
    // Single-threaded analysis must produce the same database as the
    // multi-threaded run: same decoded set, functions, xrefs and strings.
    // SLOP_WORKER_THREADS is read per session (no cache), so the suite can
    // flip counts within one process.
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();

    _putenv_s("SLOP_WORKER_THREADS", "1");
    hs::session_t serial;
    REQUIRE(serial.start_sync(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), 0));
    const auto& sdb = serial.db();
    const size_t s_insns = sdb.insns.size(), s_funcs = sdb.funcs.size();
    const size_t s_xrefs = sdb.xrefs.size(), s_strings = sdb.strings.size();
    const size_t s_vtables = sdb.vtables.size(), s_globals = sdb.globals.size();
    uint64_t s_sum = 0;
    for (const auto& [addr, insn] : sdb.insns) s_sum += addr;
    REQUIRE_GT(s_insns, 1000u);

    _putenv_s("SLOP_WORKER_THREADS", "");
    hs::session_t parallel;
    REQUIRE(parallel.start_sync(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), 0));
    const auto& pdb = parallel.db();
    REQUIRE_EQ(pdb.insns.size(), s_insns);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pdb.funcs.size(), s_funcs);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pdb.xrefs.size(), s_xrefs);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pdb.strings.size(), s_strings);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pdb.vtables.size(), s_vtables);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pdb.globals.size(), s_globals);
    uint64_t p_sum = 0;
    for (const auto& [addr, insn] : pdb.insns) p_sum += addr;
    REQUIRE_EQ(p_sum, s_sum);
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_parallel_deterministic) {
    // Two multi-threaded runs must agree exactly (chunk merges are index
    // ordered, descent claims are atomic): catches data races that only
    // show up as fluctuating counts.
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    _putenv_s("SLOP_WORKER_THREADS", "");

    size_t prev_insns = 0, prev_funcs = 0, prev_xrefs = 0;
    uint64_t prev_sum = 0;
    for (int run = 0; run < 2; ++run) {
        hs::session_t session;
        REQUIRE(session.start_sync(bytes.data(), bytes.size(), 0));
        const auto& db = session.db();
        uint64_t sum = 0;
        size_t blocks = 0, edges = 0;
        for (const auto& [entry, f] : db.funcs) {
            (void)entry;
            blocks += f.blocks.size();
            for (const auto& [ba, bb] : f.blocks) {
                (void)ba;
                edges += bb.succs.size();
            }
        }
        for (const auto& [addr, insn] : db.insns) sum += addr;
        if (run > 0) {
            REQUIRE_EQ(db.insns.size(), prev_insns);
            REQUIRE_EQ(db.funcs.size(), prev_funcs);
            REQUIRE_EQ(db.xrefs.size(), prev_xrefs);
            REQUIRE_EQ(sum, prev_sum);
        }
        prev_insns = db.insns.size();
        prev_funcs = db.funcs.size();
        prev_xrefs = db.xrefs.size();
        prev_sum = sum;
        REQUIRE_GT(blocks, 0u);
        REQUIRE_GT(edges, 0u);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decoder_preserves_operand_actions) {
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X64);
    hype::Insn out{};

    static const uint8_t load[] = {0x48, 0x8B, 0x01};       // mov rax, [rcx]
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, load, sizeof(load), out));
    REQUIRE(out.ops[0].write);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(out.ops[0].read);
    REQUIRE(out.ops[1].read);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(out.ops[1].write);

    static const uint8_t store[] = {0x48, 0x89, 0x01};      // mov [rcx], rax
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, store, sizeof(store), out));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(out.ops[0].read);
    REQUIRE(out.ops[0].write);
    REQUIRE(out.ops[1].read);

    static const uint8_t rmw[] = {0x48, 0x01, 0x01};        // add [rcx], rax
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, rmw, sizeof(rmw), out));
    REQUIRE(out.ops[0].read);
    REQUIRE(out.ops[0].write);
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_converter_flow_and_targets) {
    // call rel32 / jcc rel32 / rip-relative lea — the fields every legacy
    // consumer (xray/devirt/recover/debugger) reads.
    static const uint8_t code_call[] = {0xE8, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};
    static const uint8_t code_jcc[]  = {0x75, 0x0A};
    static const uint8_t code_lea[]  = {0x48, 0x8D, 0x05, 0x10, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};

    disasm::insn_t out;
    REQUIRE(hs::session_t::decode(0x140001000, code_call, sizeof(code_call), out));
    REQUIRE(out.flow == disasm::flow_t::call);
    REQUIRE(out.has_rel_target);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.rel_target, 0x140001000ull + 5 + 0x10);

    REQUIRE(hs::session_t::decode(0x140001000, code_jcc, sizeof(code_jcc), out));
    REQUIRE(out.flow == disasm::flow_t::jcc);
    REQUIRE(out.has_rel_target);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.rel_target, 0x140001000ull + 2 + 0x0A);

    REQUIRE(hs::session_t::decode(0x140001000, code_lea, sizeof(code_lea), out));
    REQUIRE(out.flow == disasm::flow_t::none);
    REQUIRE(out.has_rip_rel);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.rip_rel_target, 0x140001000ull + 7 + 0x10);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.ops[0].reg, ZYDIS_REGISTER_RAX);
    REQUIRE(out.ops[0].write);   // lea dest is written
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decoder_classifies_signed_and_conditional_operations) {
    hype::Disassembler decoder;
    decoder.set_arch(hype::Arch::X64);
    hype::Insn out{};

    static const uint8_t jz[]    = {0x74, 0x02};
    static const uint8_t movzx[] = {0x0F, 0xB6, 0xC0};
    static const uint8_t movsx[] = {0x0F, 0xBE, 0xC0};
    static const uint8_t imul[]  = {0x48, 0x0F, 0xAF, 0xC1};
    static const uint8_t idiv[]  = {0x48, 0xF7, 0xF9};
    static const uint8_t sar[]   = {0x48, 0xD1, 0xF8};

    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, jz, sizeof(jz), out));
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Jcc);
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, movzx, sizeof(movzx), out));
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Movzx);
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, movsx, sizeof(movsx), out));
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Movsx);
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, imul, sizeof(imul), out));
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Imul);
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, idiv, sizeof(idiv), out));
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Idiv);
    REQUIRE(decoder.decode(0x1000, sar, sizeof(sar), out));
    REQUIRE(out.type == hype::InsnType::Sar);
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_pe_load_buffer_matches_path_load) {
    hype::PELoader from_path, from_buf;
    auto a = from_path.load(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH);
    auto b = from_buf.load_buffer(slop_target_bytes().data(),
                                  slop_target_bytes().size());
    REQUIRE(a.has_value());
    REQUIRE(b.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(a->segments.size(), b->segments.size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(a->imports.size(), b->imports.size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(a->exports.size(), b->exports.size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(a->base, b->base);
    REQUIRE_EQ(a->entry, b->entry);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a->segments.size(); ++i) {
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(a->segments[i].name, b->segments[i].name);
        REQUIRE_EQ(a->segments[i].va, b->segments[i].va);
        REQUIRE_EQ(a->segments[i].size, b->segments[i].size);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_segments_borrow_the_image_bytes) {
    // Segments view the caller's buffer instead of copying it: the copies held
    // a large image in memory three times over and ran big binaries out of RAM
    const auto& bytes = slop_target_bytes();
    hype::PELoader loader;
    auto img = loader.load_buffer(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(img.has_value());
    REQUIRE(img->raw.data() == bytes.data());
    for (const auto& seg : img->segments) {
        if (seg.data.empty()) continue;
        REQUIRE(seg.data.data() >= bytes.data());
        REQUIRE(seg.data.data() + seg.data.size() <= bytes.data() + bytes.size());
    }

    // load(path) has no caller buffer to borrow, so the image owns its bytes
    auto owned = loader.load(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH);
    REQUIRE(owned.has_value());
    REQUIRE(!owned->storage.empty());
    REQUIRE(owned->raw.data() == owned->storage.front()->data());
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_parallel_for_joins_before_rethrow) {
    // A failing chunk must not unwind the caller while sibling chunks still run
    // against its locals; a bad_alloc on a huge image became a use-after-free
    hype::WorkerPool pool(4);
    std::atomic<int> finished{0};
    bool threw = false;
    try {
        hype::parallel_for_chunks(pool, 8, [&](size_t chunk, size_t, size_t) {
            if (chunk == 0) throw std::runtime_error("chunk failed");
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
            ++finished;
        });
    } catch (const std::runtime_error&) {
        threw = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(threw);
    REQUIRE_EQ(finished.load(), 7);
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_reanalysis_preserves_runtime_base) {
    constexpr uint64_t runtime_base = 0x180000000ull;
    hype::PELoader loader;
    auto parsed = loader.load_buffer(slop_target_bytes().data(), slop_target_bytes().size());
    REQUIRE(parsed.has_value());
    if (parsed->base == runtime_base) return;

    hs::session_t session;
    REQUIRE(session.start_sync(slop_target_bytes().data(), slop_target_bytes().size(), runtime_base));
    REQUIRE_EQ(session.image().base, runtime_base);

    session.reanalyze(slop_target_bytes());
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(30);
    while (session.running() && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline)
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));

    REQUIRE(session.ready());
    REQUIRE_EQ(session.image().base, runtime_base);
    REQUIRE(session.function_entry(session.image().entry) != nullptr);
}

// === ELF / PS4 ===

namespace {

bool has_xref(const hype::AnalysisDB& db, uint64_t to, uint64_t from, hype::XrefType type) {
    const auto it = db.xrefs_to.find(to);
    if (it == db.xrefs_to.end()) return false;
    return std::any_of(it->second.begin(), it->second.end(), [&](const hype::Xref& x) {
        return x.from == from && x.type == type;
    });
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(hyperion_param_count_defaults_to_zero) {
    hype::FuncSignature sig;
    REQUIRE_EQ(sig.param_count, 0);
    REQUIRE(hype::default_callconv(hype::Arch::X64, hype::ImageFormat::PE) == hype::CallConv::X64);
    REQUIRE(hype::default_callconv(hype::Arch::X64, hype::ImageFormat::ELF) == hype::CallConv::SysV);
    REQUIRE(hype::default_callconv(hype::Arch::X64, hype::ImageFormat::MachO) == hype::CallConv::SysV);
    REQUIRE(hype::default_callconv(hype::Arch::ARM64, hype::ImageFormat::ELF) == hype::CallConv::AAPCS64);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(std::string(hype::callconv_name(hype::CallConv::SysV)), "sysv_amd64");
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_elf_session_analyzes_ps4_elf) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    hype::nid::clear_overrides();
    auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    hype::ELFLoader::apply_relocations(elf);
    hs::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.start_sync(elf.data(), elf.size(), 0));
    REQUIRE(s.ready());
    REQUIRE(s.image().format == hype::ImageFormat::ELF);
    const auto& db = s.db();
    REQUIRE(db.abi == hype::CallConv::SysV);

    // all three functions recovered, SysV everywhere
    for (uint64_t f : {L::kEntry, L::kFunc2, L::kFunc3}) {
        REQUIRE(db.funcs.count(f) == 1);
        REQUIRE(db.funcs.at(f).callconv == hype::CallConv::SysV);
    }
    // (a, b, c) -> a*b+c reads edi, esi, edx: three SysV arguments
    REQUIRE(db.signatures.count(L::kFunc2) == 1);
    REQUIRE_EQ(db.signatures.at(L::kFunc2).param_count, 3);
    REQUIRE_EQ(db.signatures.at(L::kFunc3).param_count, 1);
    REQUIRE_EQ(db.signatures.at(L::kEntry).param_count, 0);

    // canonical and resolved names
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.funcs.at(L::kFunc2).name, "sub_140");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names.at(L::kFunc3), "module_start");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names.at(L::kSlotUsleep), "libkernel!sceKernelUsleep");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.names.at(L::kSlotMemset), "libSceLibcInternal!memset");
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_data_xrefs_validated_against_segments) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    hs::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.start_sync(elf.data(), elf.size(), 0));
    const auto& db = s.db();
    // find the instruction VAs in the entry function
    uint64_t lea_va = 0, mov_va = 0, and_va = 0;
    for (const auto& [ba, bb] : db.funcs.at(L::kEntry).blocks) {
        for (const auto& in : bb.insns) {
            if (in.type == hype::InsnType::Lea && in.op_count == 2 && in.ops[1].val == L::kString) lea_va = in.addr;
            if (in.type == hype::InsnType::Mov && in.op_count == 2 &&
                in.ops[1].type == hype::OpType::Imm && in.ops[1].val == L::kString) mov_va = in.addr;
            if (in.type == hype::InsnType::And) and_va = in.addr;
        }
    }
    REQUIRE_NE(lea_va, 0u);
    REQUIRE_NE(mov_va, 0u);
    REQUIRE_NE(and_va, 0u);
    REQUIRE(has_xref(db, L::kString, lea_va, hype::XrefType::DataOffset));   // string ref via LEA
    REQUIRE(has_xref(db, L::kString, mov_va, hype::XrefType::DataOffset));   // mov reg, address
    // base-0 image: small constants (mov edi, 5) and arithmetic immediates
    // that happen to fall inside a segment (and eax, 0x1F00) are not xrefs
    REQUIRE(db.xrefs_to.find(0x1F00) == db.xrefs_to.end());
    REQUIRE(db.xrefs_to.find(5) == db.xrefs_to.end());
    // a call's immediate is a code xref only
    REQUIRE(has_xref(db, L::kFunc2, L::kEntry + 0x13, hype::XrefType::CodeCall));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(has_xref(db, L::kFunc2, L::kEntry + 0x13, hype::XrefType::DataOffset));
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_arm64_adrp_pairs_make_string_xrefs) {
    const auto elf = elf_fixture::build_arm64_adrp_elf();
    hs::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.start_sync(elf.data(), elf.size(), 0));
    REQUIRE(s.ready());
    const auto& db = s.db();
    REQUIRE(db.abi == hype::CallConv::AAPCS64);
    REQUIRE(std::any_of(db.strings.begin(), db.strings.end(),
                        [](const auto& p) { return p.first == 0x20010 && p.second == "arm64 string here"; }));
    REQUIRE(has_xref(db, 0x20010, 0x10004, hype::XrefType::DataOffset));
    // the adrp page itself is not a reference
    REQUIRE(db.xrefs_to.find(0x20000) == db.xrefs_to.end());
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decomp_cache_is_lru) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    hs::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.start_sync(elf.data(), elf.size(), 0));
    s.set_decomp_cache_capacity(2);
    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> out;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kEntry, out, err));
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kFunc2, out, err));
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kEntry, out, err));   // hit: entry becomes most recent
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kFunc3, out, err));   // evicts func2, not everything
    REQUIRE_EQ(s.decomp_cache_size(), size_t{2});
    REQUIRE(s.decomp_cached(L::kEntry));
    REQUIRE(s.decomp_cached(L::kFunc3));
    REQUIRE_FALSE(s.decomp_cached(L::kFunc2));
    // a cached result is returned unchanged
    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> again;
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kFunc3, again, err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(again.size(), out.size());
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_functions_merge_into_index) {
    auto sub = slop::core::infra::event_bus::subscribe();
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    REQUIRE(wait_hype_ready());
    const auto& bin = ds::get();
    REQUIRE(bin.hype != nullptr);

    // every analyzer function start is now an index start, and the rows the
    // merge added are marked with their source
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> starts;
    for (const auto& f : bin.fns.functions()) starts.insert(f.va);
    for (const auto& [entry, f] : bin.hype->db().funcs) {
        (void)f;
        REQUIRE(starts.count(entry) != 0);
    }
    REQUIRE_GT(bin.fns.stats().hype_functions, 0u);
    bool saw_source = false;
    for (const auto& f : bin.fns.functions())
        if (f.source == disasm::fn_source_t::hyperion) saw_source = true;
    REQUIRE(saw_source);

    // the UI is told the index changed
    bool saw_event = false;
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(5);
    std::string frame;
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
        if (!sub->wait(frame, 200)) break;
        if (frame.find("disasm.index_updated") != std::string::npos &&
            frame.find("\"functions\"") != std::string::npos) {
            saw_event = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    REQUIRE(saw_event);
    ds::unload();
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_interproc_types_propagate_to_call_sites) {
    hype::AnalysisDB db;
    hype::Function caller;
    caller.entry = 0x1000;
    caller.analyzed = true;
    hype::BasicBlock bb;
    bb.start = 0x1000;
    bb.end = 0x1010;
    hype::Insn call{};
    call.addr = 0x1004;
    call.type = hype::InsnType::Call;
    call.op_count = 1;
    call.ops[0].type = hype::OpType::Imm;
    call.ops[0].val = 0x2000;
    bb.insns.push_back(call);
    caller.blocks[0x1000] = bb;
    caller.block_addrs = {0x1000};
    db.funcs[0x1000] = caller;

    hype::FuncSignature sig;
    sig.param_types = {"void*", "size_t"};
    sig.param_names = {"dst", "n"};
    sig.param_count = 2;
    db.signatures[0x2000] = sig;

    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::propagate_call_arg_types(db), size_t{1});
    REQUIRE(db.call_arg_types.count(0x1004) != 0);
    REQUIRE_EQ(db.call_arg_types[0x1004].size(), size_t{2});
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.call_arg_types[0x1004][0], "void*");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.call_arg_types[0x1004][1], "size_t");
    // second pass is a no-op
    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::propagate_call_arg_types(db), size_t{0});
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_rtti_promotes_this_types) {
    hype::AnalysisDB db;
    hype::FuncSignature sig;
    sig.param_types = {"int64_t"};
    sig.param_names = {"a1"};
    sig.param_count = 1;
    db.signatures[0x3000] = sig;

    hype::RTTIClass cls;
    cls.demangled_name = "Player";
    cls.methods = {0x3000};
    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::promote_rtti_this_types({cls}, db), size_t{1});
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.signatures[0x3000].param_types[0], "Player*");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.signatures[0x3000].param_names[0], "this");

    // a declared type is never overwritten
    db.signatures[0x3000].param_types[0] = "MyStruct*";
    REQUIRE_EQ(hype::promote_rtti_this_types({cls}, db), size_t{0});
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(db.signatures[0x3000].param_types[0], "MyStruct*");
}

TEST_CASE(hyperion_decomp_cache_rekeys_on_type_generation) {
    using L = elf_fixture::ps4_layout;
    auto elf = elf_fixture::build_ps4_elf();
    hs::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.start_sync(elf.data(), elf.size(), 0));

    std::atomic<uint64_t> gen{1};
    s.set_type_generation([&gen] { return gen.load(std::memory_order_acquire); });

    const auto text_of = [](const std::vector<hype::PseudoLine>& lines) {
        std::string t;
        for (const auto& l : lines) t += l.text + "\n";
        return t;
    };

    std::vector<hype::PseudoLine> first, cached, rerendered;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kEntry, first, err));
    REQUIRE(!text_of(first).empty());

    // a name edit without a generation bump serves the cached render
    s.db_mut().names[L::kFunc2] = "renamed_callee";
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kEntry, cached, err));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(text_of(cached), text_of(first));

    // bumping the generation (a type/name edit) re-renders from the DB
    gen.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    REQUIRE(s.decompile(L::kEntry, rerendered, err));
    REQUIRE(text_of(rerendered).find("renamed_callee") != std::string::npos);
}
```

```cpp
TEST_CASE(pool_submit_and_complete) {
    slop::core::infra::pool::start(2);
    std::atomic<int> counter{0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        slop::core::infra::pool::submit([&] { counter.fetch_add(1); });
    }
    // Wait for completion
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(500));
    auto stats = slop::core::infra::pool::snapshot();
    REQUIRE_EQ(counter.load(), 100);
    REQUIRE(stats.completed >= 100u);
    slop::core::infra::pool::stop(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(pool_parallel_for_basic) {
    slop::core::infra::pool::start(4);
    std::vector<std::atomic<int>> results(50);
    for (auto& a : results) a.store(0);

    slop::core::infra::cancel_source_t src;
    slop::core::infra::pool::parallel_for(50, src.token(),
        [&](size_t idx, uint32_t /*slot*/) {
            results[idx].store(static_cast<int>(idx * 2));
        });

    for (size_t i = 0; i < 50; ++i) {
        REQUIRE_EQ(results[i].load(), static_cast<int>(i * 2));
    }
    slop::core::infra::pool::stop(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(pool_parallel_for_cancel) {
    slop::core::infra::pool::start(4);
    std::atomic<int> count{0};
    slop::core::infra::cancel_source_t src;

    // Cancel after a short delay
    std::thread canceller([&] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
        src.request();
    });

    slop::core::infra::pool::parallel_for(1000000, src.token(),
        [&](size_t /*idx*/, uint32_t /*slot*/) {
            count.fetch_add(1);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(1));
        });

    canceller.join();
    // Should have been cancelled before completing all 1M items
    REQUIRE(count.load() < 1000000);
    slop::core::infra::pool::stop(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(jobs_submit_and_complete) {
    slop::core::infra::pool::start(2);
    std::atomic<bool> ran{false};

    auto id = slop::core::infra::jobs::submit({
        .label = "test job",
        .owner = "test",

            (void)ctx;
            ran.store(true);

    REQUIRE(id != 0);

    REQUIRE(!slop::core::infra::jobs::alive(id));
    REQUIRE(ran.load());

    slop::core::infra::jobs::reap();
    auto snap = slop::core::infra::jobs::snapshot();

    REQUIRE(!snap->empty());
    REQUIRE_EQ((*snap)[0].state, slop::core::infra::job_state_t::succeeded);

    slop::core::infra::jobs::shutdown(1000);
    slop::core::infra::pool::stop(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(jobs_cancel) {
    slop::core::infra::jobs::reset();
    slop::core::infra::pool::start(2);

    auto id = slop::core::infra::jobs::submit({
        .label = "cancellable",
        .owner = "test",
        .cancellable = true,
        .body = [](slop::core::infra::job_context_t& ctx) {
            while (!ctx.cancelled()) {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
            }
        }
    });
    REQUIRE(id != 0);

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
    REQUIRE(slop::core::infra::jobs::cancel(id));

    for (int i = 0; i < 100 && slop::core::infra::jobs::alive(id); ++i) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
    }
    REQUIRE(!slop::core::infra::jobs::alive(id));

    slop::core::infra::jobs::reap();
    auto snap = slop::core::infra::jobs::snapshot();
    bool found_cancelled = false;
    for (auto& j : *snap) {
        if (j.id == id && j.state == slop::core::infra::job_state_t::cancelled)
            found_cancelled = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(found_cancelled);

    slop::core::infra::jobs::shutdown(1000);
    slop::core::infra::pool::stop(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(jobs_progress_reporting) {

        .owner = "test",

            ctx.set_progress(0.5f);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));

            ctx.set_progress(1.0f);

            REQUIRE_EQ(j.state, slop::core::infra::job_state_t::succeeded);
        }

    REQUIRE(found);

// === settings / atomic writes / onboarding (never the real profile) ===

namespace {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using njson = nlohmann::json;

// unique scratch dir under %TEMP%, removed on scope exit
struct scratch_dir_t {
    fs::path dir;
    scratch_dir_t() {
        dir = fs::temp_directory_path() /
              ("slop_infra_" + std::to_string(::GetCurrentProcessId()) + "_" +
               std::to_string(slop::core::infra::steady_ms()) + "_" +
               std::to_string(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(this) & 0xFFFF));
        fs::create_directories(dir);
    }
    ~scratch_dir_t() {
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::remove_all(dir, ec);
    }
    std::string str(const char* leaf = nullptr) const {
        return leaf ? (dir / leaf).string() : dir.string();
    }
};

std::string slurp(const fs::path& p) {
    std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
    std::stringstream ss;
    ss << f.rdbuf();
    return ss.str();
}

void spit(const fs::path& p, const std::string& text) {
    fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
    std::ofstream f(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f << text;
}

// points USERPROFILE / APPDATA at a scratch dir for the onboarder, restores on exit
struct env_sandbox_t {
    std::string old_profile, old_appdata;
    bool had_profile = false, had_appdata = false;
    explicit env_sandbox_t(const std::string& root) {
        char buf[32768];
        DWORD n = ::GetEnvironmentVariableA("USERPROFILE", buf, sizeof(buf));
        had_profile = n > 0 && n < sizeof(buf);
        if (had_profile) old_profile.assign(buf, n);
        n = ::GetEnvironmentVariableA("APPDATA", buf, sizeof(buf));
        had_appdata = n > 0 && n < sizeof(buf);
        if (had_appdata) old_appdata.assign(buf, n);
        ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("USERPROFILE", (root + "\\profile").c_str());
        ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("APPDATA", (root + "\\appdata").c_str());
    }
    ~env_sandbox_t() {
        ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("USERPROFILE", had_profile ? old_profile.c_str() : nullptr);
        ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("APPDATA", had_appdata ? old_appdata.c_str() : nullptr);
    }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(infra_atomic_write_replaces_existing) {
    namespace paths = slop::core::infra::paths;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    const std::string file = tmp.str("sub\\cfg.json");
    REQUIRE(paths::write_file_atomic(file, "first"));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slurp(file).c_str(), "first");
    REQUIRE(paths::write_file_atomic(file, "second, longer"));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slurp(file).c_str(), "second, longer");
    REQUIRE(!fs::exists(file + ".tmp"));
    // a destination that cannot be replaced (a directory) leaves it untouched
    fs::create_directories(tmp.dir / "isdir");
    REQUIRE(!paths::write_file_atomic(tmp.str("isdir"), "x"));
    REQUIRE(fs::is_directory(tmp.dir / "isdir"));
}

TEST_CASE(infra_settings_first_run_generates_token_and_persists) {
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    settings::set_file_for_testing(tmp.str("settings.json"));
    settings::load();
    const std::string tok = settings::mcp_token();
    REQUIRE_EQ(tok.size(), 64u);
    REQUIRE(tok.find_first_not_of("0123456789abcdef") == std::string::npos);
    // persisted right away, not only at shutdown
    const njson disk = njson::parse(slurp(tmp.dir / "settings.json"));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(disk.at("mcp_token").get<std::string>().c_str(), tok.c_str());
    // a reload keeps the same token
    settings::load();
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(settings::mcp_token().c_str(), tok.c_str());
    REQUIRE_NE(settings::generate_token(), tok);
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});
}

TEST_CASE(infra_settings_typed_accessors_and_immediate_save) {
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    settings::set_file_for_testing(tmp.str("settings.json"));
    settings::load();
    REQUIRE(!settings::get<bool>("script_unsafe", false));
    REQUIRE(settings::set("script_unsafe", true));
    REQUIRE(settings::get<bool>("script_unsafe", false));
    REQUIRE(settings::set("web_allowlist", njson::array({"example.com"})));
    const auto list = settings::get<std::vector<std::string>>("web_allowlist", {});
    REQUIRE_EQ(list.size(), 1u);
    // type mismatch falls back to the default instead of throwing
    REQUIRE_EQ(settings::get<int>("web_allowlist", 7), 7);
    REQUIRE(njson::parse(slurp(tmp.dir / "settings.json")).at("script_unsafe").get<bool>());
    // null erases
    REQUIRE(settings::set("script_unsafe", nullptr));
    REQUIRE(settings::get_json("script_unsafe").is_null());
    // out of range ports never truncate
    settings::set("mcp_port", 70000);
    REQUIRE_EQ(settings::mcp_port(), 8765);
    settings::set("mcp_port", 9001);
    REQUIRE_EQ(settings::mcp_port(), 9001);
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});
}

TEST_CASE(infra_settings_corrupt_or_non_object_file_is_backed_up) {
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    const fs::path file = tmp.dir / "settings.json";
    spit(file, "[1, 2, 3]");
    settings::set_file_for_testing(file.string());
    settings::load();
    REQUIRE(settings::snapshot().is_object());
    REQUIRE_EQ(settings::mcp_token().size(), 64u);
    bool backup = false;
    for (const auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(tmp.dir))
        if (e.path().filename().string().rfind("settings.json.corrupt-", 0) == 0) {
            backup = true;
            REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slurp(e.path()).c_str(), "[1, 2, 3]");
        }
    REQUIRE(backup);
    spit(file, "{not json");
    settings::load();
    REQUIRE(settings::snapshot().is_object());
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});
}

TEST_CASE(infra_onboard_survives_non_object_mcp_and_refreshes_stale_entries) {
    namespace onboard = slop::core::infra::mcp_onboard;
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    env_sandbox_t env(tmp.str());
    settings::set_file_for_testing(tmp.str("settings.json"));
    settings::load();
    // this case covers the plaintext rewrite path; the env reference is the default
    REQUIRE(settings::set("mcp_token_in_configs", true));
    const fs::path vscode = tmp.dir / "appdata" / "Code" / "User" / "settings.json";
    const fs::path cursor = tmp.dir / "profile" / ".cursor" / "mcp.json";
    spit(vscode, R"({"mcp": true, "editor.fontSize": 14})");
    spit(cursor, R"({"mcpServers":{"slopstation":{"url":"http://127.0.0.1:1111/mcp","env":{"K":"V"}},"other":{"url":"x"}}})");

    const auto results = onboard::install_all(8765, "tok-new");
    bool vscode_err = false;
    for (const auto& r : results)
        if (r.client == "VS Code") vscode_err = !r.error.empty() && !r.installed;
    REQUIRE(vscode_err);
    // the user's non-object value is left exactly as it was
    REQUIRE(njson::parse(slurp(vscode)).at("mcp") == true);

    // stale port/token rewritten in place, user keys and other servers kept
    const njson c = njson::parse(slurp(cursor));
    const njson& ours = c.at("mcpServers").at("slopstation");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(ours.at("url").get<std::string>().c_str(), "http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(ours.at("headers").at("Authorization").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "Bearer tok-new");
    REQUIRE(ours.at("env").at("K") == "V");
    REQUIRE(c.at("mcpServers").contains("other"));

    // refresh never creates entries for clients we never registered with
    const fs::path windsurf = tmp.dir / "profile" / ".codeium" / "windsurf" / "mcp_config.json";
    REQUIRE(fs::exists(windsurf));   // install_all registered it
    fs::remove(windsurf);
    onboard::refresh_existing(9000, "tok-2");
    REQUIRE(!fs::exists(windsurf));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(njson::parse(slurp(cursor)).at("mcpServers").at("slopstation")
                       .at("url").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "http://127.0.0.1:9000/mcp");
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});
}

TEST_CASE(infra_onboard_tern_entry_insert_update_and_preserve_others) {
    namespace onboard = slop::core::infra::mcp_onboard;
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    env_sandbox_t env(tmp.str());
    settings::set_file_for_testing(tmp.str("settings.json"));
    settings::load();

    const fs::path tern = tmp.dir / "appdata" / "tern" / "settings.json";
    spit(tern, R"({"theme":"dark","agents":{"mcp":[{"name":"other","transport":"stdio","command":"x"}]}})");

    // Tern installed -> the auto policy targets Tern alone
    const auto auto_clients = onboard::default_clients();
    REQUIRE_EQ(auto_clients.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(auto_clients.at(0).c_str(), "Tern");

    const auto first = onboard::install_all(8765, "tok");
    REQUIRE_EQ(first.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE(first.at(0).installed);
    // the other clients were not touched
    REQUIRE(!fs::exists(tmp.dir / "profile" / ".cursor" / "mcp.json"));

    njson cfg = njson::parse(slurp(tern));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(cfg.at("theme").get<std::string>().c_str(), "dark");
    const njson& arr = cfg.at("agents").at("mcp");
    REQUIRE_EQ(arr.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(arr.at(0).at("name").get<std::string>().c_str(), "other");
    const njson& ours = arr.at(1);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(ours.at("name").get<std::string>().c_str(), "slopstation");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(ours.at("transport").get<std::string>().c_str(), "http");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(ours.at("url").get<std::string>().c_str(), "http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp");
    // Tern always gets the env reference, even with plaintext opted in
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(ours.at("headers").at("Authorization").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "Bearer ${SLOP_MCP_TOKEN}");
    REQUIRE(ours.at("enabled") == true);
    REQUIRE(ours.at("agents").is_array());
    REQUIRE(ours.at("agents").empty());

    // a user key on our entry survives a port change, and nothing duplicates
    cfg["agents"]["mcp"][1]["custom"] = 7;
    spit(tern, cfg.dump(2));
    const auto second = onboard::install_all(9000, "tok2");
    REQUIRE(second.at(0).installed);
    cfg = njson::parse(slurp(tern));
    REQUIRE_EQ(cfg.at("agents").at("mcp").size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(cfg.at("agents").at("mcp").at(1).at("url").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "http://127.0.0.1:9000/mcp");
    REQUIRE_EQ(cfg.at("agents").at("mcp").at(1).at("custom").get<int>(), 7);

    // uninstall removes only our entry
    bool removed = false;
    for (const auto& r : onboard::uninstall_all())
        if (r.client == "Tern") removed = r.installed;
    REQUIRE(removed);
    cfg = njson::parse(slurp(tern));
    REQUIRE_EQ(cfg.at("agents").at("mcp").size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(cfg.at("agents").at("mcp").at(0).at("name").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "other");
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});
}

TEST_CASE(infra_onboard_client_and_token_policy) {
    namespace onboard = slop::core::infra::mcp_onboard;
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    env_sandbox_t env(tmp.str());
    settings::set_file_for_testing(tmp.str("settings.json"));
    settings::load();

    // no Tern -> every known client; an explicit list wins over the auto policy
    REQUIRE(onboard::default_clients().size() > 1u);
    REQUIRE(settings::set("mcp_onboard_clients", njson::array({"Cursor"})));
    auto results = onboard::install_all(8765, "tok");
    REQUIRE_EQ(results.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(results.at(0).client.c_str(), "Cursor");
    const fs::path cursor = tmp.dir / "profile" / ".cursor" / "mcp.json";
    REQUIRE(fs::exists(cursor));
    REQUIRE(!fs::exists(tmp.dir / "profile" / ".codeium" / "windsurf" / "mcp_config.json"));

    // default policy: env reference, no plaintext anywhere
    REQUIRE(!settings::mcp_token_in_configs());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(njson::parse(slurp(cursor)).at("mcpServers").at("slopstation")
                       .at("headers").at("Authorization").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "Bearer ${SLOP_MCP_TOKEN}");
    REQUIRE(onboard::plaintext_token_clients().empty());

    // opting into plaintext rewrites in place and is reported for the warning banner
    REQUIRE(settings::set("mcp_token_in_configs", true));
    results = onboard::install_all(8765, "tok");
    REQUIRE(results.at(0).installed);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(njson::parse(slurp(cursor)).at("mcpServers").at("slopstation")
                       .at("headers").at("Authorization").get<std::string>().c_str(),
                   "Bearer tok");
    const auto flagged = onboard::plaintext_token_clients();
    REQUIRE_EQ(flagged.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(flagged.at(0).c_str(), "Cursor");

    // back to the reference clears the warning
    REQUIRE(settings::set("mcp_token_in_configs", false));
    onboard::install_all(8765, "tok");
    REQUIRE(onboard::plaintext_token_clients().empty());
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});
}

TEST_CASE(infra_token_generation_is_32_bytes_of_csprng_and_differs) {
    namespace settings = slop::core::infra::settings;
    std::vector<std::string> seen;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        const std::string t = settings::generate_token();
        REQUIRE_EQ(t.size(), 64u);   // 32 random bytes, hex encoded
        REQUIRE(t.find_first_not_of("0123456789abcdef") == std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE(std::find(seen.begin(), seen.end(), t) == seen.end());
        seen.push_back(t);
    }
}

// === concurrency regressions ===

TEST_CASE(infra_jobs_reap_never_joins_under_the_registry_lock) {
    namespace jobs = slop::core::infra::jobs;
    jobs::reset();
    std::atomic<uint64_t> my_id{0};
    std::atomic<bool> body_done{false};
    const uint64_t id = jobs::submit({
        .label = "fails then keeps calling into jobs",
        .owner = "test",
        .body = [&](slop::core::infra::job_context_t& ctx) {
            ctx.fail("early failure");
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
            (void)jobs::alive(my_id.load());   // takes the registry lock
            body_done = true;
        }});
    REQUIRE_NE(id, 0u);
    my_id = id;
    auto fut = std::async(std::launch::async, [&] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 200 && !body_done.load(); ++i) {
            jobs::reap();
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
        }
        jobs::reap();
    });
    REQUIRE(fut.wait_for(std::chrono::seconds(10)) == std::future_status::ready);
    REQUIRE(body_done.load());
    jobs::shutdown(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(infra_jobs_shutdown_deadline_bounds_the_whole_sweep) {
    namespace jobs = slop::core::infra::jobs;
    jobs::reset();
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        jobs::submit({.label = "ignores cancel", .owner = "test",
                      .body = [](slop::core::infra::job_context_t&) {
                          std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1500));
                      }});
    const int64_t t0 = slop::core::infra::steady_ms();
    jobs::shutdown(200);
    REQUIRE_LT(slop::core::infra::steady_ms() - t0, 1000);
    jobs::reset();
}

TEST_CASE(infra_pool_stop_is_bounded_and_drops_queued_work) {
    namespace pool = slop::core::infra::pool;
    pool::start(1);
    std::atomic<int> ran{0};
    pool::submit([&] {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1500));
        ran.fetch_add(1);
    });
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
    pool::submit([&] { ran.fetch_add(100); });   // queued behind the busy worker
    const int64_t t0 = slop::core::infra::steady_ms();
    pool::stop(200);
    REQUIRE_LT(slop::core::infra::steady_ms() - t0, 1000);
    // a fresh pool works while the straggler finishes on its own
    pool::start(2);
    std::atomic<int> fresh{0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) pool::submit([&] { fresh.fetch_add(1); });
    for (int i = 0; i < 200 && fresh.load() < 8; ++i)
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
    REQUIRE_EQ(fresh.load(), 8);
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1700));
    REQUIRE_EQ(ran.load(), 1);   // the queued task was dropped at stop
    pool::stop(1000);
}

TEST_CASE(infra_deferred_executor_runs_outside_the_lock) {
    auto& dm = slop::core::infra::deferred_manager_t::get();
    dm.clear();
    static bool bound = false;
    if (!bound) {
        bound = dm.bind_executor("test_reentrant", [](const std::string& params, std::string* out) {
            // re-entering the manager from an executor used to deadlock
            auto& m = slop::core::infra::deferred_manager_t::get();
            *out = std::to_string(m.list().size()) + ":" + params;
            m.submit("never_bound", "{}");
            return true;
        });
    }
    const uint64_t id = dm.submit("test_reentrant", "p");
    auto fut = std::async(std::launch::async, [&] { return dm.execute_pending("test_reentrant"); });
    REQUIRE(fut.wait_for(std::chrono::seconds(5)) == std::future_status::ready);
    REQUIRE_EQ(fut.get(), 1u);
    const auto a = dm.get(id);
    REQUIRE(a.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(a->status.c_str(), "done");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(a->result_json.c_str(), "1:p");
    dm.clear();
}

TEST_CASE(infra_fs_walks_skip_junctions_and_honor_cancel) {
    namespace util = slop::core::util;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    spit(tmp.dir / "real" / "needle_file.txt", "has needle inside\n");
    // a junction back to the root would loop (and double every hit) if followed
    const std::string cmd = "cmd /c mklink /J \"" + tmp.str("real\\loop") + "\" \"" +
                            tmp.str() + "\" >NUL 2>&1";
    const bool junction = std::system(cmd.c_str()) == 0 && fs::exists(tmp.dir / "real" / "loop");
    const auto found = util::search_files(tmp.str(), "needle_file", 100);
    REQUIRE_EQ(found.size(), 1u);
    const auto hits = util::grep_in_files(tmp.str(), "needle", ".txt", 100);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits.size(), 1u);
    if (junction) {
        bool flagged = false;
        for (const auto& e : util::list_directory(tmp.str("real")))
            if (e.name == "loop") flagged = e.reparse;
        REQUIRE(flagged);
        ::RemoveDirectoryW((tmp.dir / "real" / "loop").wstring().c_str());
    }
    slop::core::infra::cancel_source_t src;
    src.request();
    REQUIRE(util::search_files(tmp.str(), "needle_file", 100, src.token()).empty());
    REQUIRE(util::grep_in_files(tmp.str(), "needle", "", 100, src.token()).empty());
}

TEST_CASE(infra_resolve_mcp_port_precedence) {

TEST_CASE(infra_endpoint_probe_and_stale_registration_reap) {
    namespace lifecycle = slop::core::infra::lifecycle;
    namespace mcp = slop::core::mcp;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    // reset the override even when an assertion throws
    struct override_guard_t {
        explicit override_guard_t(std::string p) {
            lifecycle::set_endpoint_path_for_testing(std::move(p));
        }
        ~override_guard_t() { lifecycle::set_endpoint_path_for_testing({}); }
    } guard(tmp.str("engine.json"));
    const std::string reg = tmp.str("engine.json");

    // a live server answers the authenticated round trip
    mcp::server_config_t cfg;
    cfg.token = std::string(64, 'a');
    REQUIRE(mcp::start(cfg));
    const uint16_t port = mcp::port();
    const lifecycle::endpoint_t live{static_cast<uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId()), port,
                                     cfg.token};
    REQUIRE(lifecycle::endpoint_serving(live, 3000));
    // wrong token: not our endpoint, even though the port answers
    REQUIRE(!lifecycle::endpoint_serving(
        {static_cast<uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId()), port, std::string(64, 'b')}, 3000));

    // a registration whose pid is alive but whose port no longer serves is stale
    const std::wstring exe = [&] {
        wchar_t buf[MAX_PATH * 2]{};
        const DWORD n = ::GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, buf, static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(buf)));
        return std::wstring(buf, n);
    }();
    std::string exe_utf8;
    {
        const int n = ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, exe.data(), static_cast<int>(exe.size()),
                                           nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
        exe_utf8.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n));
        ::WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, exe.data(), static_cast<int>(exe.size()),
                              exe_utf8.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    }
    // a port nothing holds right now
    uint16_t dead = 0;
    SOCKET s = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    REQUIRE(s != INVALID_SOCKET);
    sockaddr_in a{};
    a.sin_family      = AF_INET;
    a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    a.sin_port        = 0;
    if (::bind(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), sizeof(a)) == 0) {
        int len = sizeof(a);
        if (::getsockname(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), &len) == 0) dead = ntohs(a.sin_port);
    }
    ::closesocket(s);
    REQUIRE_GT(dead, 0);

    spit(reg, njson{{"pid", static_cast<uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId())},
                    {"port", dead},
                    {"exe", exe_utf8}}
                 .dump());
    REQUIRE(lifecycle::drop_stale_endpoint());   // nothing serves that port
    REQUIRE(!fs::exists(reg));

    // a live server with a token-less registration counts as serving (health probe)
    spit(reg, njson{{"pid", static_cast<uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId())},
                    {"port", port},
                    {"exe", exe_utf8}}
                 .dump());
    REQUIRE(!lifecycle::drop_stale_endpoint());
    REQUIRE(fs::exists(reg));
    mcp::stop();
}

TEST_CASE(infra_engine_honors_port_flag) {
    namespace lifecycle = slop::core::infra::lifecycle;
    scratch_dir_t tmp;
    // the child must never touch the real profile
    char old_local[MAX_PATH]{};
    const DWORD old_local_n = ::GetEnvironmentVariableA("LOCALAPPDATA", old_local, MAX_PATH);
    ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("LOCALAPPDATA", tmp.str().c_str());
    const std::string token = std::string(64, 'e');
    char old_tok[128]{};
    const DWORD old_tok_n = ::GetEnvironmentVariableA("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", old_tok, sizeof(old_tok));
    ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", token.c_str());

    // a port nothing holds right now
    uint16_t want = 0;
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 5 && want == 0; ++attempt) {
        SOCKET s = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        REQUIRE(s != INVALID_SOCKET);
        sockaddr_in a{};
        a.sin_family      = AF_INET;
        a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
        a.sin_port        = 0;
        if (::bind(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), sizeof(a)) == 0) {
            int len = sizeof(a);
            if (::getsockname(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), &len) == 0)
                want = ntohs(a.sin_port);
        }
        ::closesocket(s);
    }
    REQUIRE_GT(want, 0);

    wchar_t buf[MAX_PATH * 2]{};
    const DWORD n = ::GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, buf, static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(buf)));
    const fs::path engine = fs::path(std::wstring(buf, n)).parent_path().parent_path() /
                            "src" / "engine" / "reverse-slop-engine.exe";
    REQUIRE(fs::exists(engine));

    const std::string cmd = "\"" + engine.string() + "\" --port " + std::to_string(want) +
                            " --no-onboard --quiet";
    FILE* pipe = _popen(cmd.c_str(), "r");
    REQUIRE(pipe != nullptr);
    std::string line;
    char buf_line[512];
    bool ready = false;
    while (std::fgets(buf_line, sizeof(buf_line), pipe)) {
        line = buf_line;
        if (line.rfind("SLOP_ENGINE_READY", 0) == 0) {
            ready = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    REQUIRE(ready);
    const uint16_t announced =
        static_cast<uint16_t>(std::strtoul(line.c_str() + std::strlen("SLOP_ENGINE_READY"), nullptr, 10));
    REQUIRE_EQ(announced, want);   // --port reached the bind, not the settings port

    // and the announced endpoint really serves
    REQUIRE(lifecycle::endpoint_serving(
        {static_cast<uint32_t>(::GetCurrentProcessId()), announced, token}, 5000));

    httplib::Client cli("127.0.0.1", announced);
    cli.set_read_timeout(std::chrono::seconds(15));
    const njson body = {{"tool", "app"}, {"action", "shutdown"}};
    auto res = cli.Post("/api/v1", {{"Authorization", "Bearer " + token}}, body.dump(),
                        "application/json");
    REQUIRE(res);
    REQUIRE_EQ(res->status, 200);
    while (std::fgets(buf_line, sizeof(buf_line), pipe)) {
    }
    REQUIRE_EQ(_pclose(pipe), 0);

    ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("LOCALAPPDATA", old_local_n ? old_local : nullptr);
    ::SetEnvironmentVariableA("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", old_tok_n ? old_tok : nullptr);
}
```

`src/tests/test_ipa.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_ipa.cpp
// .ipa support: ZIP container, Info.plist executable resolution, Mach-O
// (thin/FAT) loading into hyperion, the format-neutral image open, and the
// shared binary session driving an arm64 executable end to end. Every input
// is built in memory by macho_fixture.hpp

#include "harness.hpp"
#include "macho_fixture.hpp"

#include "core/disasm/binary_state.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/hyperion_session.hpp"
#include "core/disasm/image_open.hpp"
```
