```cpp
// === memscan: all-types scan ===

TEST_CASE(all_types_scan_matches_multiple_widths) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uint32_t needle = 7;                    // also 7 as u8, u16; and 7.0f? no, bits differ
    r.write(0xA0004, &needle, 4);

    memscan_t engine;
    scan_config_t cfg = cfg_for(scan_type_t::exact_value, value_width_t::u32, 7);
    cfg.scan_all_types = true;
    cfg.fast = fastscan_method_t::alignment;
    cfg.fast_alignment = 4;

    REQUIRE(engine.first_scan(r, {rw_region(0xA0000, 0x100)}, cfg,
                              cancel_token_t{}, nullptr));

    // u8 7 at 0xA0004, u16 7 at 0xA0004, u32 7 at 0xA0004 -> 3 rows
    size_t u8_hits = 0, u16_hits = 0, u32_hits = 0;
    for (const auto& h : engine.results()) {
        if (h.matched == value_width_t::u8)  ++u8_hits;
        if (h.matched == value_width_t::u16) ++u16_hits;
        if (h.matched == value_width_t::u32) ++u32_hits;
    }
    REQUIRE_EQ(u8_hits, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(u16_hits, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(u32_hits, 1u);
}

// === pointer scan ===

TEST_CASE(pointer_scan_depth_one) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget  = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kHolder  = 0xA0000;
    const uint64_t val = kTarget - 16; // holder + off 16 -> target
    r.write(kHolder, &val, 8);

    pointer_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.target     = kTarget;
    opt.depth      = 1;
    opt.min_offset = -4096;
    opt.max_offset = 4096;
    opt.alignment  = 8;

    auto chains = pointer_scan(r, {rw_region(0xA0000, 0x10000)}, opt,
                               cancel_token_t{}, nullptr);
    REQUIRE_GE(chains.size(), 1u);

    bool found = false;
    for (auto& c : chains) {
        if (c.depth() == 1 && c.addresses[0] == kHolder && c.offsets[0] == 16)
            found = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(found);
}

TEST_CASE(pointer_scan_depth_two_chain) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kMid    = 0xA0000; // points to target
    const uintptr_t kRoot   = 0xB0000; // points near mid

    const uint64_t mid_val = kTarget - 16;
    const uint64_t root_val = kMid - 8;
    r.write(kMid, &mid_val, 8);
    r.write(kRoot, &root_val, 8);

    pointer_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.target     = kTarget;
    opt.depth      = 2;
    opt.min_offset = -4096;
    opt.max_offset = 4096;
    opt.alignment  = 8;

    auto chains = pointer_scan(r, {rw_region(0xA0000, 0x20000)}, opt,
                               cancel_token_t{}, nullptr);
    REQUIRE_GE(chains.size(), 1u);

    bool found = false;
    for (auto& c : chains) {
        if (c.depth() == 2 &&
            c.addresses[0] == kRoot && c.offsets[0] == 8 &&
            c.addresses[1] == kMid && c.offsets[1] == 16)
            found = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(found);
}

TEST_CASE(pointer_scan_static_roots_filter) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kHeapRoot  = 0xA0000; // private-memory holder
    const uintptr_t kCodeRoot  = 0xB0000; // module-backed holder
    const uint64_t v1 = kTarget - 16;
    const uint64_t v2 = kTarget - 16;
    r.write(kHeapRoot, &v1, 8);
    r.write(kCodeRoot, &v2, 8);

    pointer_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.target     = kTarget;
    opt.depth      = 1;
    opt.min_offset = -4096;
    opt.max_offset = 4096;
    opt.alignment  = 8;
    opt.only_module_backed = true;

    std::vector<scan_region_t> regions = {
        {kHeapRoot, 0x1000, kRW, kPrivate},   // private heap
        {kCodeRoot, 0x1000, kRO, kImage},     // module image
    };
    auto chains = pointer_scan(r, regions, opt, cancel_token_t{}, nullptr);
    REQUIRE_GE(chains.size(), 1u);
    for (auto& c : chains)
        REQUIRE_EQ(c.addresses[0], kCodeRoot); // only module-backed roots
}

// === snapshot ===

TEST_CASE(snapshot_capture_and_diff) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    std::vector<uint8_t> region(256);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < region.size(); ++i) region[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(i);
    r.write(0xD0000, region.data(), region.size());

    auto snap_a = snapshot_capture(r, 0xD0000, 256, cancel_token_t{},
                                   slop::core::infra::limits::max_snapshot_region_bytes);
    REQUIRE(snap_a.complete);
    REQUIRE_EQ(snap_a.bytes[10], 10);

    // Mutate two runs: [50..54) and [100..101)
    const uint8_t five[5] = {0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA};
    r.write(0xD0000 + 50, five, 5);
    const uint8_t one[1] = {0xBB};
    r.write(0xD0000 + 100, one, 1);

    auto snap_b = snapshot_capture(r, 0xD0000, 256, cancel_token_t{},
                                   slop::core::infra::limits::max_snapshot_region_bytes);
    auto d = snapshot_diff(snap_a, snap_b);
    REQUIRE(d.valid);
    REQUIRE_EQ(d.changed.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(d.changed[0].offset, 50u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(d.changed[0].length, 5u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(d.changed[1].offset, 100u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(d.changed[1].length, 1u);
}

TEST_CASE(snapshot_diff_invalid_on_mismatch) {
    region_snapshot_t a, b;
    a.base = 0x1000; a.bytes = {1, 2, 3};
    b.base = 0x1000; b.bytes = {1, 2};
    auto d = snapshot_diff(a, b);
    REQUIRE(!d.valid);

    b.bytes = {9, 9, 9};
    b.base = 0x2000;
    d = snapshot_diff(a, b);
    REQUIRE(!d.valid);
}

// ===========================================================================
// Remote-aware scheduling, read-ahead, coalescing (audit items 39/40)
// ===========================================================================

namespace {

// Wraps a fake reader, reports chosen hints and records every read
struct hinted_reader_t final : public reader_t {
    fake_reader_t& inner;
    reader_hints_t h;
    std::atomic<int> in_flight{0};
    std::atomic<int> max_in_flight{0};
    std::mutex mu;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    std::vector<std::pair<uintptr_t, size_t>> calls;

    hinted_reader_t(fake_reader_t& r, reader_hints_t hints) : inner(r), h(hints) {}

    bool read(uintptr_t addr, void* dst, size_t len) override {
        const int now = ++in_flight;
        int prev = max_in_flight.load();
        while (now > prev && !max_in_flight.compare_exchange_weak(prev, now)) {}
        // widen the window so concurrent workers would visibly overlap
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(300));
        const bool ok = inner.read(addr, dst, len);
        {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            calls.push_back({addr, len});
        }
        cv.notify_all();
        --in_flight;
        return ok;
    }
    reader_hints_t hints() const noexcept override { return h; }

    size_t call_count() {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        return calls.size();
    }
    void reset_calls() {
        std::lock_guard lk(mu);
        calls.clear();
    }
};

scan_config_t exact_u32(uint32_t v) {
    scan_config_t c;
    c.type   = scan_type_t::exact_value;
    c.width  = value_width_t::u32;
    c.value1 = static_cast<double>(v);
    c.value2 = static_cast<double>(v);
    return c;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(memory_remote_hints_single_worker_big_chunks) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    std::vector<scan_region_t> regions;
    std::vector<uint8_t> zeros(64 * 1024, 0);
    const uint32_t needle = 0x5EED5EED;
    for (uintptr_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        const uintptr_t base = 0x1000000 + i * 0x20000;
        r.write(base, zeros.data(), zeros.size());
        r.write(base + 0x100, &needle, 4);
        regions.push_back(rw_region(base, zeros.size()));
    }
    // one big region: the first wire read must use the remote chunk size
    const uintptr_t big = 0x4000000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> big_bytes(9u << 20, 0);
    r.write(big, big_bytes.data(), big_bytes.size());
    r.write(big + (8u << 20) + 0x40, &needle, 4);
    regions.push_back(rw_region(big, big_bytes.size()));

    hinted_reader_t hr(r, remote_reader_hints());
    memscan_t engine;
    scan_config_t cfg = exact_u32(needle);
    cfg.threads = 16;   // asked for many, the serialized reader caps it at 1
    REQUIRE(engine.first_scan(hr, regions, cfg, cancel_token_t{}));
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().size(), 17u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hr.max_in_flight.load(), 1);

    bool saw_big_chunk = false;
    for (const auto& c : hr.calls) {
        REQUIRE_LE(c.second, kRemoteChunkBytes + 3);   // chunk + u32 overlap tail
        if (c.first == big && c.second == kRemoteChunkBytes + 3) saw_big_chunk = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(saw_big_chunk);
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.stats().regions_scanned, 17u);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_read_ahead_prefetches_next_chunk) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t base = 0x2000000;
    const size_t chunk = 0x4000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(chunk * 4);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes.size(); ++i) bytes[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(i * 7);
    r.write(base, bytes.data(), bytes.size());

    hinted_reader_t hr(r, {});
    detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
    walk.chunk = chunk;
    walk.read_ahead = true;

    std::vector<uint8_t> seen;
    bool prefetched = false;
    detail::chunked_read(hr, {{base, bytes.size()}}, walk, cancel_token_t{},
        [&](size_t range, uintptr_t addr, const uint8_t* data, size_t len,
            uintptr_t limit) {
            REQUIRE_EQ(range, 0u);
            REQUIRE_EQ(addr, base + seen.size());
            REQUIRE_EQ(limit, addr + len);
            if (addr == base) {
                // while chunk 0 is being processed the producer must already
                // be fetching chunk 1 (double buffering)
                std::unique_lock lk(hr.mu);
                prefetched = hr.cv.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::seconds(10), [&] {
                    for (const auto& c : hr.calls) if (c.first == base + chunk) return true;
                    return false;
                });
            }
            seen.insert(seen.end(), data, data + len);
            return true;
        });
    REQUIRE(prefetched);
    REQUIRE(seen == bytes);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_read_ahead_stops_early_and_spans_ranges) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    std::vector<uint8_t> page(0x3000, 0x11);
    r.write(0x3000000, page.data(), page.size());
    r.write(0x3100000, page.data(), page.size());
    r.write(0x3200000, page.data(), page.size());

    detail::chunk_walk_t walk;
    walk.chunk = 0x1000;
    walk.read_ahead = true;
    const std::vector<detail::read_range_t> ranges = {
        {0x3000000, 0x3000}, {0x3100000, 0}, {0x3100000, 0x3000}, {0x3200000, 0x3000}};

    // full walk: every range in order, empty ranges skipped
    std::vector<size_t> order;
    uint64_t total = 0;
    detail::chunked_read(r, ranges, walk, cancel_token_t{},
        [&](size_t range, uintptr_t, const uint8_t*, size_t len, uintptr_t) {
            if (order.empty() || order.back() != range) order.push_back(range);
            total += len;
            return true;
        });
    REQUIRE((order == std::vector<size_t>{0, 2, 3}));
    REQUIRE_EQ(total, 0x9000u);

    // early stop: returning false ends the walk and joins the producer
    size_t delivered = 0;
    detail::chunked_read(r, ranges, walk, cancel_token_t{},
        [&](size_t, uintptr_t, const uint8_t*, size_t, uintptr_t) {
            return ++delivered < 2;
        });
    REQUIRE_EQ(delivered, 2u);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_scan_finds_value_straddling_chunk_border) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t base = 0x5000000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> zeros(0x2000, 0);
    r.write(base, zeros.data(), zeros.size());
    const uint32_t needle = 0xA1B2C3D4;
    r.write(base + 0xFFE, &needle, 4);   // crosses the 0x1000 chunk border
    r.write(base + 0x10, &needle, 4);

    for (const bool remote : {false, true}) {
        hinted_reader_t hr(r, remote ? remote_reader_hints() : reader_hints_t{});
        memscan_t engine;
        scan_config_t cfg = exact_u32(needle);
        cfg.chunk_bytes = 0x1000;
        cfg.threads = 1;
        REQUIRE(engine.first_scan(hr, {rw_region(base, zeros.size())}, cfg, cancel_token_t{}));
        REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().size(), 2u);   // found once, no overlap duplicate
        REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results()[0].address, base + 0x10);
        REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results()[1].address, base + 0xFFE);
        REQUIRE_EQ(engine.stats().bytes_scanned, zeros.size());
    }
}

TEST_CASE(memory_aob_finds_pattern_straddling_chunk_border) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t base = 0x5100000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> zeros(0x2000, 0);
    r.write(base, zeros.data(), zeros.size());
    const uint8_t pat[] = {0xDE, 0xAD, 0xBE, 0xEF};
    r.write(base + 0xFFE, pat, sizeof(pat));

    auto p = aob_compile("DE AD BE EF", err_placeholder());
    REQUIRE(p.has_value());
    aob_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.chunk_bytes = 0x1000;
    hinted_reader_t hr(r, remote_reader_hints());
    aob_stats_t st{};
    auto hits = aob_scan(hr, {rw_region(base, zeros.size())}, *p, opt, cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits[0], base + 0xFFE);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.bytes_scanned, zeros.size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(hr.max_in_flight.load(), 1);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_remote_rescan_coalesces_reads) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t base = 0x6000000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> zeros(0x2000, 0);
    r.write(base, zeros.data(), zeros.size());
    const uint32_t v = 77;
    for (uintptr_t i = 0; i < 100; ++i) r.write(base + i * 16, &v, 4);
    r.write(base + 0xFFC, &v, 4);    // last slot of page 0
    r.write(base + 0x1000, &v, 4);   // first slot of page 1

    hinted_reader_t hr(r, remote_reader_hints());
    memscan_t engine;
    scan_config_t cfg = exact_u32(v);
    REQUIRE(engine.first_scan(hr, {rw_region(base, zeros.size())}, cfg, cancel_token_t{}));
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().size(), 102u);

    // address-list rescan: neighbouring rows ride one wire read
    hr.reset_calls();
    scan_config_t again = exact_u32(v);
    REQUIRE(engine.next_scan(hr, again, cancel_token_t{}));
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().size(), 102u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hr.call_count(), 1u);

    // page 1 disappears: the group read fails, rows settle one by one
    r.pages.erase(base + 0x1000);
    hr.reset_calls();
    REQUIRE(engine.next_scan(hr, again, cancel_token_t{}));
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().size(), 101u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().back().address, base + 0xFFC);

    // a local reader keeps one read per row
    hinted_reader_t local(r, reader_hints_t{});
    REQUIRE(engine.next_scan(local, again, cancel_token_t{}));
    REQUIRE_EQ(local.call_count(), 101u);
}

// ===========================================================================
// Pointer chains: module-backed roots + verify pass (audit item 43)
// ===========================================================================

TEST_CASE(memory_pointer_scan_module_root_checks_chain_root) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kMid    = 0xA0000;   // heap object pointing at target
    const uintptr_t kRoot   = 0xB0000;   // module global pointing at mid
    const uint64_t mid_val  = kTarget - 16;
    const uint64_t root_val = kMid - 8;
    r.write(kMid, &mid_val, 8);
    r.write(kRoot, &root_val, 8);

    pointer_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.target = kTarget;
    opt.depth = 2;
    opt.alignment = 8;
    opt.only_module_backed = true;
    std::vector<scan_region_t> regions = {
        {kMid, 0x1000, kRW, kPrivate},
        {kRoot, 0x1000, kRO, kImage},
    };
    auto chains = pointer_scan(r, regions, opt, cancel_token_t{}, nullptr);
    REQUIRE_GE(chains.size(), 1u);
    bool two_level = false;
    for (const auto& c : chains) {
        REQUIRE_EQ(c.addresses[0], kRoot);   // the root, not the last holder
        if (c.depth() == 2 && c.addresses[1] == kMid) two_level = true;
    }
    REQUIRE(two_level);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_pointer_verify_drops_stale_chains) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kMid    = 0xA0000;
    const uintptr_t kRoot   = 0xB0000;
    const uint64_t mid_val  = kTarget - 16;
    const uint64_t root_val = kMid - 8;
    r.write(kMid, &mid_val, 8);
    r.write(kRoot, &root_val, 8);

    pointer_chain_result_t good;     // root -> mid -> target
    good.addresses = {kRoot, kMid};
    good.offsets   = {8, 16};
    pointer_chain_result_t wrong;    // lands 8 bytes off
    wrong.addresses = {kRoot, kMid};
    wrong.offsets   = {8, 24};
    pointer_chain_result_t dead;     // root page unmapped
    dead.addresses = {0xC0000};
    dead.offsets   = {0};

    auto landed = pointer_chain_resolve(r, good);
    REQUIRE(landed.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(*landed, kTarget);

    pointer_verify_options_t vo;
    vo.target = kTarget;
    vo.samples = 3;
    pointer_verify_stats_t st{};
    auto kept = pointer_verify(r, {good, wrong, dead}, vo, cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(kept.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(kept[0].offsets[1], 16);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.checked, 3u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.dropped_mismatch, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.dropped_unreadable, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.samples_done, 3u);
    // memoized per pass: kRoot and kMid read once per sample on pass 1 for
    // two chains (+1 for the dead root), then once each on passes 2 and 3
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.reads, 3u + 2u + 2u);

    // the object moves: the chain follows live pointers (root re-pointed)
    const uintptr_t kMid2 = 0xA0800;
    r.write(kMid2, &mid_val, 8);
    const uint64_t root_val2 = kMid2 - 8;
    r.write(kRoot, &root_val2, 8);
    auto still = pointer_verify(r, kept, vo, cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(still.size(), 1u);

    // the target itself moves: verifying against the old address drops it
    const uint64_t mid_val2 = 0x91000 - 16;
    r.write(kMid2, &mid_val2, 8);
    auto gone = pointer_verify(r, kept, vo, cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(gone.size(), 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.dropped_mismatch, 1u);
    vo.target = 0x91000;
    REQUIRE_EQ(pointer_verify(r, kept, vo, cancel_token_t{}, nullptr).size(), 1u);
}

// ===========================================================================
// Console AOB multi-match walk (audit item 44)
// ===========================================================================

namespace {

// emulates CMD_PROC_SCAN_AOB: first full match inside [addr, addr+len)
struct fake_console_t {
    uintptr_t base = 0x400000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> mem;
    std::vector<uint8_t> pat;
    size_t calls = 0;
    size_t fail_after = SIZE_MAX;
    bool   lie = false;

    console_find_fn fn() {
        return [this](uint64_t addr, uint32_t len, uint64_t& hit) {
            if (++calls > fail_after) return false;
            hit = 0;
            if (lie) { hit = addr + len + 64; return true; }
            const uint64_t end = addr + len;
            for (uint64_t a = addr; a + pat.size() <= end; ++a) {
                if (a < base || a + pat.size() > base + mem.size()) continue;
                if (std::memcmp(mem.data() + (a - base), pat.data(), pat.size()) == 0) {
                    hit = a;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return true;
        };
    }
    void plant(size_t off) { std::memcpy(mem.data() + off, pat.data(), pat.size()); }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(memory_console_aob_returns_every_match) {
    fake_console_t fc;
    fc.mem.assign(1024, 0);
    fc.pat = {0x48, 0x8B, 0x05, 0x90};
    // 61 straddles the first window end, 129 the border of a no-hit slide
    for (size_t off : {size_t{0}, size_t{61}, size_t{66}, size_t{129}, size_t{200},
                       size_t{1020}})
        fc.plant(off);

    console_aob_options_t opt;
    opt.pattern_len = fc.pat.size();
    opt.window = 64;   // tiny windows: matches straddle window borders
    console_aob_stats_t st{};
    auto hits = console_aob_all(fc.fn(), {rw_region(fc.base, fc.mem.size())}, opt,
                                cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    const std::vector<uint64_t> want = {fc.base + 0,   fc.base + 61,  fc.base + 66,
                                        fc.base + 129, fc.base + 200, fc.base + 1020};
    REQUIRE(hits == want);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.matches, 6u);
    REQUIRE(!st.truncated);
    REQUIRE(!st.failed);
    REQUIRE_GE(st.calls, 5u);

    // alignment keeps only aligned hits; the walk still steps past the rest
    opt.alignment = 4;
    hits = console_aob_all(fc.fn(), {rw_region(fc.base, fc.mem.size())}, opt,
                           cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE((hits == std::vector<uint64_t>{fc.base, fc.base + 200, fc.base + 1020}));

    // cap -> truncated with the first max_results hits
    opt.alignment = 1;
    opt.max_results = 2;
    hits = console_aob_all(fc.fn(), {rw_region(fc.base, fc.mem.size())}, opt,
                           cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE(st.truncated);

    // transport failure mid-walk -> partial results + failed flag
    opt.max_results = 0;
    opt.window = 1u << 20;
    fc.calls = 0;
    fc.fail_after = 2;
    hits = console_aob_all(fc.fn(), {rw_region(fc.base, fc.mem.size())}, opt,
                           cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hits.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE(st.failed);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.failed_at, fc.base + 62);

    // a reply outside the asked window is a protocol error, not a hit
    fc.fail_after = SIZE_MAX;
    fc.lie = true;
    hits = console_aob_all(fc.fn(), {rw_region(fc.base, fc.mem.size())}, opt,
                           cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE(hits.empty());
    REQUIRE(st.failed);
    REQUIRE(st.bad_reply);
}

// ===========================================================================
// Watchlist freeze: dirty check, write cap, failure surfacing (items 41/42)
// ===========================================================================

namespace {

struct fake_io_t final : public watch::detail::pass_io_t {
    std::map<uint64_t, uint64_t> mem;
    std::set<uint64_t> read_only;
    size_t reads = 0;
    size_t writes = 0;

    bool read(uint64_t addr, void* dst, size_t n) override {
        ++reads;
        auto it = mem.find(addr);
        if (it == mem.end()) return false;
        std::memcpy(dst, &it->second, n);
        return true;
    }
    bool write(uint64_t addr, const void* src, size_t n) override {
        ++writes;
        if (read_only.count(addr) || !mem.count(addr)) return false;
        std::memcpy(&mem[addr], src, n);
        return true;
    }
};

watch::entry_t frozen_u32(uint64_t id, uint64_t addr, uint64_t hold) {
    watch::entry_t e;
    e.id = id;
    e.addr = addr;
    e.width = value_width_t::u32;
    e.freeze = true;
    e.frozen_bits = hold;
    return e;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(memory_watch_freeze_dirty_check_and_failures) {
    fake_io_t io;
    io.mem[0x1000] = 5;
    io.mem[0x2000] = 9;
    io.mem[0x3000] = 1;
    io.read_only.insert(0x3000);
    std::vector<watch::entry_t> entries = {
        frozen_u32(1, 0x1000, 5),   // already holds the value
        frozen_u32(2, 0x2000, 5),   // drifted
        frozen_u32(3, 0x3000, 5),   // write rejected
    };
    size_t cursor = 0;
    watch::detail::pass_stats_t st{};
    auto vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, {}, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(vals.size(), 3u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.clean_holds, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.writes, 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.write_failures, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.mem[0x2000], 5u);

    REQUIRE(vals[0].ok);
    REQUIRE(vals[0].held);
    REQUIRE(!vals[0].hold_failed);
    REQUIRE_EQ(vals[0].bits, 5u);
    REQUIRE(vals[1].ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(vals[1].bits, 5u);
    REQUIRE(!vals[2].ok);
    REQUIRE(vals[2].hold_failed);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(vals[2].text, "-");

    // next pass: everything that can hold is clean, so no writes except the
    // rejected one, which keeps reporting the failure
    io.writes = 0;
    vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, vals, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.writes, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.clean_holds, 2u);
    REQUIRE(vals[2].hold_failed);

    // the page becomes writable: the hold recovers
    io.read_only.clear();
    vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, vals, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE(vals[2].ok);
    REQUIRE(!vals[2].hold_failed);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.mem[0x3000], 5u);

    // narrow widths compare only their bytes (frozen_bits carries junk above)
    io.mem[0x4000] = 0xFFFFFF00000000AAull;
    watch::entry_t b = frozen_u32(4, 0x4000, 0x12345600000000AAull);
    b.width = value_width_t::u8;
    io.writes = 0;
    vals = watch::detail::sample_pass({b}, {}, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.writes, 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(vals[0].bits, 0xAAu);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_watch_pass_caps_writes_and_rotates) {
    fake_io_t io;
    std::vector<watch::entry_t> entries;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
        io.mem[0x10000 + i * 8] = 1;   // all drifted from the hold
        entries.push_back(frozen_u32(i + 1, 0x10000 + i * 8, 7));
    }
    size_t cursor = 0;
    watch::detail::pass_stats_t st{};
    auto vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, {}, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.writes, 16u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.deferred, 4u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(cursor, 16u);   // next pass starts at the first deferred entry
    REQUIRE_EQ(vals[16].bits, 1u);   // deferred rows show the live (drifted) value
    REQUIRE(vals[16].held);

    vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, vals, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.writes, 4u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.clean_holds, 16u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.deferred, 0u);
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 20; ++i) REQUIRE_EQ(io.mem[0x10000 + i * 8], 7u);

    // read budget: unreached rows keep their previous sample and go first next
    std::vector<watch::entry_t> plain;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        io.mem[0x20000 + i * 8] = i;
        watch::entry_t e;
        e.id = 100 + i;
        e.addr = 0x20000 + i * 8;
        e.width = value_width_t::u64;
        plain.push_back(e);
    }
    cursor = 0;
    io.reads = 0;
    vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(plain, {}, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.reads, 64u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(cursor, 64u);
    REQUIRE(vals[63].ok);
    REQUIRE(!vals[64].ok);   // never sampled yet
    vals = watch::detail::sample_pass(plain, vals, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st);
    REQUIRE(vals[99].ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(vals[99].bits, 99u);
    REQUIRE(vals[0].ok);     // carried / re-read, never blanked
    REQUIRE_EQ(cursor, 28u);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_remote_snapshot_page_granular_holes) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t base = 0x7000000;
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(0x3000);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes.size(); ++i) bytes[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(i ^ 0x5A);
    r.write(base, bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    r.pages.erase(base + 0x1000);   // middle page unreadable

    hinted_reader_t hr(r, remote_reader_hints());
    auto snap = snapshot_capture(hr, base, bytes.size(), cancel_token_t{},
                                 slop::core::infra::limits::max_snapshot_region_bytes);
    REQUIRE(!snap.complete);
    REQUIRE_EQ(snap.bytes.size(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(std::equal(bytes.begin(), bytes.begin() + 0x1000, snap.bytes.begin()));
    REQUIRE(std::equal(bytes.begin() + 0x2000, bytes.end(), snap.bytes.begin() + 0x2000));
    for (size_t i = 0x1000; i < 0x2000; ++i) REQUIRE_EQ(snap.bytes[i], 0u);
    // page-granular probing: a handful of wire reads, not a byte bisect
    REQUIRE_LE(hr.call_count(), 8u);
}

// ===========================================================================
// MCP: hex-string addresses everywhere (item 46), pointerscan_verify (43)
// ===========================================================================

namespace {

nlohmann::json mem_call(const nlohmann::json& args, bool& is_err) {
    return slop::core::mcp::call_tool("memory", args, is_err);
}

std::string hex_str(uint64_t v) {
    char buf[32];
    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "0x%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(v));
    return buf;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(memory_mcp_watch_accepts_hex_string_addresses) {
    using nlohmann::json;
    bool e = false;
    mem_call({{"action", "watch_clear"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);

    json r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", "0x1234"}, {"width", "u32"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    const uint64_t id = r.value("id", uint64_t{0});
    REQUIRE_NE(id, 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r["entries"][0].value("addr", uint64_t{0}), 0x1234u);

    // byte-count width and padded hex
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", " 0x20 "}, {"width", 4}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r["entries"][1].value("width", std::string{}), "u32");

    // garbage gets a readable message, never a raw json type_error
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", "player_hp"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(e);
    const std::string msg = r.value("error", std::string{});
    REQUIRE(msg.find("addr") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(msg.find("not a number") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(msg.find("json.exception") == std::string::npos);

    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", 16}, {"width", 3}}, e);
    REQUIRE(e);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("1, 2, 4 or 8") != std::string::npos);

    // ids accept strings too
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_set"}, {"id", hex_str(id)}, {"label", "hp"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_remove"}, {"id", std::to_string(id)}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r["entries"].size(), 1u);

    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_list"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    REQUIRE(r.contains("hold_failures"));
    mem_call({{"action", "watch_clear"}}, e);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_mcp_pointerscan_verify_live_process) {
    using nlohmann::json;
    // two private pages: A holds the static-like root, B the object + target
    auto* base = static_cast<uint8_t*>(
        VirtualAlloc(nullptr, 0x2000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE));
    REQUIRE(base != nullptr);
    const uintptr_t A = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(base);
    const uintptr_t B = A + 0x1000;
    const uintptr_t mid = B + 0x100;
    const uintptr_t target = B + 0x800;
    *reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(mid) = target - 0x10;   // mid + 0x10 -> target
    *reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(A)   = mid - 8;         // root + 8   -> mid

    REQUIRE(slop::core::process::target_attach(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    bool e = false;

    json r = mem_call({{"action", "pointerscan"}, {"target", hex_str(target)},
                       {"begin", hex_str(A)}, {"end", hex_str(A + 0x2000)},
                       {"depth", 2}, {"alignment", 8}, {"min_offset", "-0x1000"},
                       {"limit", 1000}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  pointerscan: %s\n", r.dump().c_str());
    bool has_root_chain = false;
    for (const auto& c : r["chains"]) {
        if (c["addresses"].size() == 2 && c["addresses"][0].get<uint64_t>() == A &&
            c["offsets"][0].get<int64_t>() == 8 && c["offsets"][1].get<int64_t>() == 16)
            has_root_chain = true;
    }
    CHECK(has_root_chain);
    const size_t total = r.value("total", size_t{0});

    // verify the stored list: everything still lands on target
    r = mem_call({{"action", "pointerscan_verify"}, {"samples", 2}, {"interval_ms", 0}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  verify: %s\n", r.dump().c_str());
    CHECK(r.value("kept", size_t{0}) == total);
    CHECK(r.value("samples", 0u) == 2u);
    CHECK(r.value("source", std::string{}) == "last_pointerscan");

    // the root goes stale: every chain that starts at A is dropped
    *reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(A) = 0;
    r = mem_call({{"action", "pointerscan_verify"}, {"samples", 1}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK(r.value("kept", size_t{0}) < total);
    for (const auto& c : r["chains"]) CHECK(c["addresses"][0].get<uint64_t>() != A);

    // explicit chains with hex strings, verified against a given target
    *reinterpret_cast<uint64_t*>(A) = mid - 8;
    r = mem_call({{"action", "pointerscan_verify"},
                  {"chains", json::array({json{{"base", hex_str(A)},
                                               {"offsets", json::array({8, "0x10"})}}})},
                  {"target", hex_str(target)}, {"samples", 1}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK(r.value("kept", size_t{0}) == 1u);
    CHECK(r.value("source", std::string{}) == "args");

    r = mem_call({{"action", "pointerscan_verify"},
                  {"chains", json::array({json{{"offsets", json::array({8})}}})},
                  {"target", 1}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    CHECK(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("addresses[] or base") != std::string::npos);

    slop::core::process::target_detach();
    VirtualFree(base, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_scan_export_import_roundtrip) {
    // scan persistence: rows survive an engine restart as an address-list scan
    memscan_t engine;
    std::vector<scan_result_t> rows = {
        {0x1000, 0x41, value_width_t::u32},
        {0x2000, 0x42, value_width_t::u32},
        {0x3000, 0x43, value_width_t::u8},
    };
    REQUIRE(engine.import_results(rows, value_width_t::u32));
    REQUIRE(engine.has_results());
    REQUIRE_EQ(engine.results().size(), rows.size());

    std::vector<scan_result_t> out;
    value_width_t width = value_width_t::i8;
    REQUIRE(engine.export_results(out, width));
    REQUIRE_EQ(width, value_width_t::u32);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out.size(), rows.size());
    REQUIRE_EQ(out[0].address, 0x1000u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out[0].bits, 0x41u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(out[2].matched, value_width_t::u8);

    // an empty row set is not a usable scan state
    REQUIRE(!engine.import_results({}, value_width_t::u32));
}

TEST_CASE(offsets_manifest_is_fingerprint_gated_and_fail_closed) {
    using nlohmann::json;
    std::vector<uint8_t> text(0x400, 0x90);
    const uint8_t anchor[] = {0x48, 0x8B, 0x05, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44};
    std::memcpy(text.data() + 0x120, anchor, sizeof(anchor));
    text[0x300] = 0x48;   // a near-miss prefix must not count as a second hit
    offsets_input_t in;
    in.title_id = "CUSA00001";
    in.app_ver = "01.02";
    in.text_base = 0x400000;
    in.text = text.data();
    in.text_len = text.size();
    const std::string sha = slop::core::util::sha256_hex(text.data(), text.size());
    REQUIRE(sha.size() == 64);

    json m = {{"title_id", "CUSA00001"}, {"app_ver", "01.02"}, {"module", "eboot.bin"},
              {"text_sha256", sha},
              {"offsets", {{{"name", "player"}, {"rva", "0x123"}, {"aob", "48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ??"},
                            {"aob_offset", 3}},
                           {{"name", "fn"}, {"aob", "48 8B 05 11"}}}}};
    json r = verify_offsets(m, in);
    CHECK(r["ok"] == true);
    CHECK(r["resolved"]["player"] == 0x400123u);
    CHECK(r["resolved"]["fn"] == 0x400120u);

    // a different build: hash mismatch, nothing resolved
    auto bad = m;
    bad["text_sha256"] = std::string(64, '0');
    r = verify_offsets(bad, in);
    CHECK(r["ok"] == false);
    CHECK(r["resolved"].empty());

    // wrong title / missing hash both refuse up front
    bad = m;
    bad["title_id"] = "CUSA99999";
    CHECK(verify_offsets(bad, in)["ok"] == false);
    bad = m;
    bad.erase("text_sha256");
    CHECK(verify_offsets(bad, in)["ok"] == false);

    // one bad entry poisons the whole manifest
    bad = m;
    bad["offsets"][0]["rva"] = "0x124";
    r = verify_offsets(bad, in);
    CHECK(r["ok"] == false);
    CHECK(r["resolved"].empty());

    // an anchor that matches twice is rejected
    std::memcpy(text.data() + 0x200, anchor, sizeof(anchor));
    in.text = text.data();
    m["text_sha256"] = slop::core::util::sha256_hex(text.data(), text.size());
    r = verify_offsets(m, in);
    CHECK(r["ok"] == false);
    CHECK(r["errors"].dump().find("not unique") != std::string::npos);
}

TEST_CASE(dissect_classifies_slots) {
    // fake address space: code at 0x1000, a vtable at 0x2000 (slot 0 -> code),
    // an object at 0x3000 (starts with the vtable), a C string at 0x4000
    std::map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint8_t>> mem;
    auto put64 = [&](uint64_t a, uint64_t v) { auto& b = mem[a]; b.resize(8); std::memcpy(b.data(), &v, 8); };
    put64(0x2000, 0x1010);
    put64(0x3000, 0x2000);
    mem[0x4000] = {'h', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o', 0, 0, 0};
    dissect_env_t env;
    env.readable = [](uint64_t v) { return v >= 0x1000 && v < 0x5000; };
    env.executable = [](uint64_t v) { return v >= 0x1000 && v < 0x2000; };
    env.symbolize = [](uint64_t v) { return v < 0x2000 ? std::string("eboot.bin+") + std::to_string(v) : std::string(); };
    env.read = [&](uint64_t v, void* out, size_t n) -> size_t {
        auto it = mem.find(v);
        if (it == mem.end()) return 0;
        const size_t k = std::min(n, it->second.size());
        std::memset(out, 0, n);
        std::memcpy(out, it->second.data(), k);
        return n;
    };
    uint64_t slots[8];
    float fl[2] = {1.5f, -32.25f};
    double dbl = 1234.5;
    slots[0] = 0;
    slots[1] = 0x1040;   // code
    slots[2] = 0x3000;   // object
    slots[3] = 0x4000;   // char*
    std::memcpy(&slots[4], fl, 8);
    std::memcpy(&slots[5], &dbl, 8);
    slots[6] = 42;
    std::memcpy(&slots[7], "abcdefg", 8);
    auto rows = dissect(0x9000, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(slots), sizeof(slots), env);
    REQUIRE(rows.size() == 8u);
    CHECK(rows[0]["kind"] == "zero");
    CHECK(rows[1]["target"]["kind"] == "code");
    CHECK(rows[2]["target"]["kind"] == "object");
    CHECK(rows[2]["target"]["vtable"] == 0x2000u);
    CHECK(rows[3]["target"]["kind"] == "char*");
    CHECK(rows[3]["target"]["text"] == "hello");
    CHECK(rows[4]["kind"] == "float2");
    CHECK(rows[5]["kind"] == "double");
    CHECK(rows[6]["kind"] == "int64");
    CHECK(rows[7]["kind"] == "text");
}

// ===========================================================================
// Unknown-initial flow, relative deltas, multi-level pointers, CT, sig formats
// ===========================================================================

namespace {

std::string read_text_file(const std::filesystem::path& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    return std::string{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(compare_changed_by_more_and_less_than) {
    // ints: magnitude in either direction, 0 is not a change
    REQUIRE(check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than, value_width_t::i32, 5),
                        value_width_t::i32, 20, 10));
    REQUIRE(!check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than, value_width_t::i32, 5),
                         value_width_t::i32, 15, 10));
    REQUIRE(check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than, value_width_t::i32, 5),
                        value_width_t::i32, 10, 20));       // decrease counts too
    REQUIRE(check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than, value_width_t::i32, 5),
                        value_width_t::i32, 12, 10));
    REQUIRE(!check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than, value_width_t::i32, 5),
                         value_width_t::i32, 10, 10));      // no change at all
    REQUIRE(!check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than, value_width_t::i32, 5),
                         value_width_t::i32, 20, 10));

    // signed neighbours do not overflow the magnitude
    REQUIRE(check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than, value_width_t::i64, 1),
                        value_width_t::i64,
                        static_cast<uint64_t>(INT64_MAX),
                        static_cast<uint64_t>(INT64_MIN)));

    // floats: exact delta on the value, not on the bits
    REQUIRE(check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than, value_width_t::f32, 0.5),
                        value_width_t::f32, value_from_double(value_width_t::f32, 1.75),
                        value_from_double(value_width_t::f32, 1.0)));
    REQUIRE(!check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_more_than, value_width_t::f32, 0.5),
                         value_width_t::f32, value_from_double(value_width_t::f32, 1.25),
                         value_from_double(value_width_t::f32, 1.0)));
    REQUIRE(check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than, value_width_t::f64, 0.5),
                        value_width_t::f64, value_from_double(value_width_t::f64, 1.25),
                        value_from_double(value_width_t::f64, 1.0)));
    REQUIRE(!check_value(cfg_for(scan_type_t::changed_by_less_than, value_width_t::f64, 0.5),
                         value_width_t::f64, value_from_double(value_width_t::f64, 1.0),
                         value_from_double(value_width_t::f64, 1.0)));
}

TEST_CASE(pointer_scan_two_levels_with_negative_offset) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kMid    = 0xA0000;   // holds target - 0x20
    const uintptr_t kRoot   = 0x80000;   // holds mid + 0x10, so its offset is -0x10
    uint64_t v = kMid + 0x10;
    r.write(kRoot, &v, 8);
    v = kTarget - 0x20;
    r.write(kMid, &v, 8);

    pointer_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.target    = kTarget;
    opt.alignment = 8;
    opt.levels    = {{-0x100, 0x100, 0, false}, {-0x100, 0x100, 0, false}};
    opt.modules   = {{"game.exe", kRoot, 0x1000}};

    pointer_scan_stats_t st{};
    auto chains = pointer_scan(r, {rw_region(0x80000, 0x30000)}, opt,
                               cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    // the depth-1 chain (mid -> target) is a valid result too, so pick the
    // two-hop one by its root
    const pointer_chain_result_t* chain = nullptr;
    for (const auto& c : chains)
        if (c.addresses.size() == 2 && c.addresses.front() == kRoot) chain = &c;
    REQUIRE(chain != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_EQ(chain->addresses[1], kMid);
    REQUIRE_EQ(chain->offsets[0], -0x10);
    REQUIRE_EQ(chain->offsets[1], 0x20);
    // the root is inside the module, so the chain is restart-safe
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(chain->module, "game.exe");
    REQUIRE_EQ(chain->module_offset, 0u);

    // the chain resolves back to the target and survives verification
    auto landed = pointer_chain_resolve(r, *chain);
    REQUIRE(landed.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(*landed, kTarget);
    pointer_verify_options_t vo;
    vo.target  = kTarget;
    vo.samples = 1;
    pointer_verify_stats_t vst{};
    auto kept = pointer_verify(r, {*chain}, vo, cancel_token_t{}, &vst);
    REQUIRE_EQ(kept.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(vst.kept, 1u);

    // the same chain is invisible to a range that excludes -0x10
    pointer_scan_options_t tight = opt;
    tight.levels[0] = {0, 0x100, 0, false};
    auto none = pointer_scan(r, {rw_region(0x80000, 0x30000)}, tight,
                             cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    for (const auto& c : none) REQUIRE(c.addresses.front() != kRoot);
}

TEST_CASE(pointer_scan_wildcard_level_accepts_any_offset) {
    fake_reader_t r;
    const uintptr_t kTarget = 0x90000;
    const uintptr_t kHolder = 0xA0000;
    const uint64_t v = kTarget + 0x123456;   // far outside the default range
    r.write(kHolder, &v, 8);

    pointer_scan_options_t opt;
    opt.target    = kTarget;
    opt.alignment = 8;
    opt.levels    = {{0, 0, 0, true}};       // one hop, any offset
    pointer_scan_stats_t st{};
    auto chains = pointer_scan(r, {rw_region(0xA0000, 0x1000)}, opt,
                               cancel_token_t{}, &st);
    REQUIRE_EQ(chains.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(chains[0].addresses[0], kHolder);
    REQUIRE_EQ(chains[0].offsets[0], -0x123456);

    // without the wildcard the same holder is out of range
    opt.levels = {{-0x1000, 0x1000, 0, false}};
    REQUIRE(pointer_scan(r, {rw_region(0xA0000, 0x1000)}, opt,
                         cancel_token_t{}, &st).empty());
}

TEST_CASE(watch_per_entry_interval_gates_sampling) {
    fake_io_t io;
    io.mem[0x1000] = 1;
    io.mem[0x2000] = 2;
    std::vector<watch::entry_t> entries(2);
    entries[0].id = 1; entries[0].addr = 0x1000; entries[0].width = value_width_t::u32;
    entries[0].interval_ms = 100;
    entries[1].id = 2; entries[1].addr = 0x2000; entries[1].width = value_width_t::u32;
    entries[1].interval_ms = 1000;

    size_t cursor = 0;
    watch::detail::pass_stats_t st{};
    auto v1 = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, {}, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st, 10'000);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.reads, 2u);              // never sampled: both are due
    REQUIRE(v1[0].sampled);
    REQUIRE(v1[1].sampled);

    entries[0].last_sample_ms = 10'000;
    entries[1].last_sample_ms = 10'000;
    st = {};
    auto v2 = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, v1, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st, 10'050);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.reads, 2u);              // nothing new was read
    REQUIRE(!v2[0].sampled);
    REQUIRE(!v2[1].sampled);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.rate_skipped, 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.deferred, 0u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(v2[0].bits, 1u);            // the last sample is still shown

    st = {};
    auto v3 = watch::detail::sample_pass(entries, v2, io, {64, 16}, cursor, &st, 10'100);
    REQUIRE(v3[0].sampled);                // 100 ms elapsed
    REQUIRE(!v3[1].sampled);               // 1000 ms not yet
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.rate_skipped, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(io.reads, 3u);
}

TEST_CASE(watch_ct_round_trip) {
    watch::clear();
    REQUIRE_NE(watch::add(0x7FF00100, value_width_t::i32, "player hp"), 0u);
    REQUIRE_NE(watch::add(0x7FF00200, value_width_t::f32, "ammo & \"clip\""), 0u);
    REQUIRE_NE(watch::add(0x7FF00300, value_width_t::u8, ""), 0u);

    const std::string xml = watch::export_ct();
    REQUIRE(xml.find("<CheatTable") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(xml.find("<VariableType>4 Bytes</VariableType>") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(xml.find("<VariableType>Float</VariableType>") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(xml.find("<VariableType>Byte</VariableType>") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(xml.find("&amp;") != std::string::npos);      // escaped, still valid XML
    REQUIRE(xml.find("7FF00100") != std::string::npos);

    watch::clear();
    std::string warn;
    REQUIRE_EQ(watch::import_ct(xml, &warn), 3u);
    REQUIRE(warn.empty());
    auto list = watch::list();
    REQUIRE_EQ(list.size(), 3u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(list[0].addr, 0x7FF00100u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(list[0].label, "player hp");
    REQUIRE_EQ(list[0].width, value_width_t::i32);
    REQUIRE_EQ(list[1].width, value_width_t::f32);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(list[1].label, "ammo & \"clip\"");
    REQUIRE_EQ(list[2].width, value_width_t::i8);          // CE has no unsigned byte

    // module-relative addresses cannot be resolved here: skipped, not guessed
    const std::string rel =
        "<CheatTable><CheatEntries><CheatEntry><Address>game.exe+1234</Address>"
        "<VariableType>4 Bytes</VariableType></CheatEntry></CheatEntries></CheatTable>";
    REQUIRE_EQ(watch::import_ct(rel, &warn), 0u);
    REQUIRE(!warn.empty());
    REQUIRE_EQ(watch::list().size(), 3u);

    // junk input is an error, not a crash
    REQUIRE_EQ(watch::import_ct("<not-xml>", &warn), 0u);
    REQUIRE(!warn.empty());
    watch::clear();
}

TEST_CASE(sig_formats_render_each_dialect) {
    auto p = aob_compile("48 8B ?? ?? 0F 84 ?? ?? ?? ??", err_placeholder());
    REQUIRE(p.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(aob_to_ida(*p), "48 8B ? ? 0F 84 ? ? ? ?");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(aob_to_x64dbg(*p), "48 8B ?? ?? 0F 84 ?? ?? ?? ??");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(aob_to_ce(*p), "48 8B ?? ?? 0F 84 ?? ?? ?? ??");

    const auto code = aob_to_code(*p);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(code.bytes, "\\x48\\x8B\\x00\\x00\\x0F\\x84\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(code.mask, "xx??xx????");

    // nibble wildcards keep their nibble in every dialect
    auto n = aob_compile("4? 8B", err_placeholder());
    REQUIRE(n.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(aob_to_ida(*n), "4? 8B");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(aob_to_x64dbg(*n), "4? 8B");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(aob_to_code(*n).mask, "?x");
}

TEST_CASE(memory_mcp_unknown_initial_flow_live_process) {
    using nlohmann::json;
    auto* base = static_cast<uint8_t*>(
        VirtualAlloc(nullptr, 0x1000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE));
    REQUIRE(base != nullptr);
    std::memset(base, 0, 0x1000);
    const uintptr_t A = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(base);
    *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(base + 0x40) = 100;

    REQUIRE(slop::core::process::target_attach(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    bool e = false;
    mem_call({{"action", "scan_reset"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);

    // unknown initial: snapshot the range, no address rows yet
    json r = mem_call({{"action", "scan"}, {"kind", "unknown"}, {"width", "u32"},
                       {"begin", hex_str(A)}, {"end", hex_str(A + 0x1000)},
                       {"alignment", 4}, {"max_stash_bytes", 0x1000}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  unknown scan: %s\n", r.dump().c_str());
    CHECK(r.value("region_scan_active", false));
    CHECK((r.value("slots_tracked", uint64_t{0})) == (uint64_t{0x1000}));   // bytes copied
    CHECK((r.value("total", size_t{1})) == (size_t{0}));

    // the value moved: increased narrows to the one address
    *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(base + 0x40) = 250;
    r = mem_call({{"action", "rescan"}, {"kind", "increased"}, {"width", "u32"},
                  {"limit", 100}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  increased: %s\n", r.dump().c_str());
    CHECK((r.value("total", size_t{0})) == (size_t{1}));
    CHECK((r["hits"][0].value("addr", uint64_t{0})) == (uint64_t{A + 0x40}));

    // relative deltas on the same address
    *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(base + 0x40) = 260;   // +10 from 250
    r = mem_call({{"action", "rescan"}, {"kind", "changed_by_more_than"},
                  {"width", "u32"}, {"value", 5}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK((r.value("total", size_t{0})) == (size_t{1}));
    r = mem_call({{"action", "rescan"}, {"kind", "changed_by_less_than"},
                  {"width", "u32"}, {"value", 5}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK((r.value("total", size_t{0})) == (size_t{0}));

    // a negative magnitude is rejected up front
    r = mem_call({{"action", "rescan"}, {"kind", "changed_by_more_than"},
                  {"width", "i32"}, {"value", -1}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    CHECK(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("non-negative") != std::string::npos);

    mem_call({{"action", "scan_reset"}}, e);
    slop::core::process::target_detach();
    VirtualFree(base, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
}

TEST_CASE(memory_mcp_exports_csv_ct_and_diff) {
    using nlohmann::json;
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    auto* base = static_cast<uint8_t*>(
        VirtualAlloc(nullptr, 0x1000, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE));
    REQUIRE(base != nullptr);
    std::memset(base, 0, 0x1000);
    const uintptr_t A = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(base);
    *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(base + 0x10) = 7;
    *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(base + 0x20) = 9;

    REQUIRE(slop::core::process::target_attach(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    bool e = false;
    const fs::path dir = fs::temp_directory_path();

    // scanner results -> CSV (the whole set, not the returned page)
    mem_call({{"action", "scan_reset"}}, e);
    json r = mem_call({{"action", "scan"}, {"kind", "exact"}, {"width", "u32"},
                       {"value", 7}, {"begin", hex_str(A)}, {"end", hex_str(A + 0x1000)},
                       {"alignment", 4}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK((r.value("total", size_t{0})) == (size_t{1}));
    const fs::path csv = dir / "slop_scan_export_test.csv";
    r = mem_call({{"action", "scan_export"}, {"path", csv.string()}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK((r.value("rows", size_t{0})) == (size_t{1}));
    {
        const std::string text = read_text_file(csv);
        CHECK(text.find("address,type,value") == 0u);
        CHECK(text.find(",u32,7") != std::string::npos);
    }
    fs::remove(csv);

    // snapshot diff -> CSV with before/after bytes
    mem_call({{"action", "snapshot_free"}, {"all", true}}, e);
    r = mem_call({{"action", "snapshot"}, {"addr", hex_str(A)}, {"len", 0x1000}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    const uint64_t ida = r.value("id", uint64_t{0});
    *reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(base + 0x20) = 0xDEADBEEF;
    r = mem_call({{"action", "snapshot"}, {"addr", hex_str(A)}, {"len", 0x1000}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    const uint64_t idb = r.value("id", uint64_t{0});
    const fs::path dcsv = dir / "slop_diff_export_test.csv";
    r = mem_call({{"action", "diff"}, {"a", ida}, {"b", idb},
                  {"export", {{"format", "csv"}, {"path", dcsv.string()}}}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  diff export: %s\n", r.dump().c_str());
    CHECK(r["export"]["spans"].get<size_t>() >= 1u);
    {
        const std::string text = read_text_file(dcsv);
        CHECK(text.find("offset,address,length,before,after") == 0u);
        CHECK(text.find("09000000") != std::string::npos);   // before
        CHECK(text.find("EFBEADDE") != std::string::npos);   // after
    }
    fs::remove(dcsv);
    // a bad format is refused, not silently written
    r = mem_call({{"action", "diff"}, {"a", ida}, {"b", idb},
                  {"export", {{"format", "xml"}, {"path", dcsv.string()}}}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    CHECK(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("csv or json") != std::string::npos);
    mem_call({{"action", "snapshot_free"}, {"all", true}}, e);

    // watchlist -> .CT and back, with the per-entry rate
    mem_call({{"action", "watch_clear"}}, e);
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", hex_str(A + 0x10)}, {"width", "u32"},
                  {"label", "hp"}, {"interval_ms", 250}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK((r["entries"][0].value("interval_ms", 0u)) == (250u));
    const fs::path ct = dir / "slop_watch_test.CT";
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_export_ct"}, {"path", ct.string()}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    CHECK((r.value("entries", size_t{0})) == (size_t{1}));
    mem_call({{"action", "watch_clear"}}, e);
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_import_ct"}, {"path", ct.string()}}, e);
    CHECK(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  ct import: %s\n", r.dump().c_str());
    CHECK((r.value("imported", size_t{0})) == (size_t{1}));
    CHECK((r["entries"][0].value("addr", uint64_t{0})) == (uint64_t{A + 0x10}));
    CHECK(r["entries"][0].value("label", std::string{}) == "hp");
    CHECK((r["entries"][0].value("interval_ms", 0u)) == (100u));   // .CT carries no rate
    fs::remove(ct);
    mem_call({{"action", "watch_clear"}}, e);

    // missing file / missing path are readable errors
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_import_ct"}, {"path", (dir / "nope.CT").string()}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    CHECK(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("cannot open") != std::string::npos);
    r = mem_call({{"action", "watch_export_ct"}}, e);
    CHECK(e);

    mem_call({{"action", "scan_reset"}}, e);
    slop::core::process::target_detach();
    VirtualFree(base, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
}
```

`src/tests/test_module_dump.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/disasm/pe_parser.hpp"
#include "core/process/module_dump.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/backend_registry.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/session.hpp"

#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <map>
#include <vector>

namespace {

constexpr uintptr_t kImageBase = 0x140000000ull;

std::vector<uint8_t> make_mapped_image() {
    std::vector<uint8_t> image(0x3000, 0);

    auto* dos = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(image.data());
    dos->e_magic = IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE;
    dos->e_lfanew = 0x80;

    auto* nt = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64*>(image.data() + dos->e_lfanew);
    nt->Signature = IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE;
    nt->FileHeader.Machine = IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64;
    nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections = 2;
    nt->FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader = sizeof(IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64);
    nt->FileHeader.Characteristics = IMAGE_FILE_EXECUTABLE_IMAGE |
                                     IMAGE_FILE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE;
    nt->OptionalHeader.Magic = IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC;
    nt->OptionalHeader.AddressOfEntryPoint = 0x1000;
    nt->OptionalHeader.BaseOfCode = 0x1000;
    nt->OptionalHeader.ImageBase = kImageBase;
    nt->OptionalHeader.SectionAlignment = 0x1000;
    nt->OptionalHeader.FileAlignment = 0x200;
    nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage = 0x3000;
    nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfHeaders = 0x200;
    nt->OptionalHeader.Subsystem = IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_CUI;
    nt->OptionalHeader.NumberOfRvaAndSizes = IMAGE_NUMBEROF_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES;

    auto* sections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    std::memcpy(sections[0].Name, ".text", 5);
    sections[0].Misc.VirtualSize = 0x180;
    sections[0].VirtualAddress = 0x1000;
    sections[0].SizeOfRawData = 0x200;
    sections[0].PointerToRawData = 0x200;
    sections[0].Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_CNT_CODE | IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE |
                                  IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ;

    std::memcpy(sections[1].Name, ".data", 5);
    sections[1].Misc.VirtualSize = 0x100;
    sections[1].VirtualAddress = 0x2000;
    sections[1].SizeOfRawData = 0x200;
    sections[1].PointerToRawData = 0x400;
    sections[1].Characteristics = IMAGE_SCN_CNT_INITIALIZED_DATA |
                                  IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ | IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE;

    std::fill_n(image.begin() + 0x1000, 0x200, uint8_t{0x90});
    image[0x1000] = 0xCC;
    std::fill_n(image.begin() + 0x2000, 0x200, uint8_t{0x42});
    image[0x2000] = 0x7A;
    return image;
}

slop::core::process::module_read_fn_t reader_for(
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& image, uintptr_t fail_begin = 0,
    uintptr_t fail_end = 0) {
    return [&image, fail_begin, fail_end](uintptr_t address, void* output,
                                          size_t size) {
        slop::core::runtime::io_result_t result;
        if (address < kImageBase || size > image.size() ||
            address - kImageBase > image.size() - size ||
            (fail_begin < fail_end && address < fail_end &&
             address + size > fail_begin)) {
            result.error = ERROR_PARTIAL_COPY;
            return result;
        }
        std::memcpy(output, image.data() + (address - kImageBase), size);
        result.ok = true;
        result.bytes = size;
        return result;
    };
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(module_dump_reconstructs_file_layout) {
    const auto mapped = make_mapped_image();
    std::vector<uint8_t> output;
    const auto result = slop::core::process::reconstruct_mapped_pe(
        kImageBase, static_cast<uint32_t>(mapped.size()), reader_for(mapped), output);

    REQUIRE(result.ok);
    REQUIRE(result.complete);
    REQUIRE_EQ(result.section_count, size_t{2});
    REQUIRE_EQ(output.size(), size_t{0x600});
    REQUIRE_EQ(output[0x200], uint8_t{0xCC});
    REQUIRE_EQ(output[0x201], uint8_t{0x90});
    REQUIRE_EQ(output[0x400], uint8_t{0x7A});
    REQUIRE_EQ(output[0x401], uint8_t{0x42});

    const auto pe = slop::core::disasm::pe_parse(output.data(), output.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    REQUIRE_EQ(pe.sections.size(), size_t{2});
    REQUIRE_EQ(pe.sections[0].raw_offset, uint32_t{0x200});
    REQUIRE_EQ(pe.sections[1].raw_offset, uint32_t{0x400});
}

TEST_CASE(module_dump_rejects_invalid_headers) {
    auto mapped = make_mapped_image();
    mapped[0] = 0;
    std::vector<uint8_t> output;
    const auto result = slop::core::process::reconstruct_mapped_pe(
        kImageBase, static_cast<uint32_t>(mapped.size()), reader_for(mapped), output);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(result.ok);
    REQUIRE(output.empty());
    REQUIRE_FALSE(result.error.empty());
}

TEST_CASE(module_dump_strict_and_best_effort_reads) {
    const auto mapped = make_mapped_image();
    const auto failing_reader = reader_for(mapped, kImageBase + 0x2000,
                                           kImageBase + 0x2200);
    std::vector<uint8_t> output;

    auto strict = slop::core::process::reconstruct_mapped_pe(
        kImageBase, static_cast<uint32_t>(mapped.size()), failing_reader, output);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(strict.ok);
    REQUIRE(output.empty());

    slop::core::process::module_dump_options_t options;
    options.strict_reads = false;
    auto best_effort = slop::core::process::reconstruct_mapped_pe(
        kImageBase, static_cast<uint32_t>(mapped.size()), failing_reader, output,
        options);
    REQUIRE(best_effort.ok);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(best_effort.complete);
    REQUIRE_EQ(output[0x400], uint8_t{0});
    REQUIRE_EQ(output[0x5FF], uint8_t{0});
}

TEST_CASE(module_dump_captures_live_test_process) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    if (runtime::active_kind() != runtime::backend_kind_t::user_mode) {
        std::printf("  [skip] live self-dump requires user-mode backend\n");
        return;
    }

    runtime::session_t session;
    REQUIRE(session.open(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    auto modules = runtime::active().enum_modules(session.handle());
    REQUIRE(modules.ok);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(modules.items.empty());
    if (!modules.ok || modules.items.empty()) return;

    const auto module = modules.items.front();
    const auto path = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() /
                      L"reverse_slop_live_module_dump.exe";
    const auto result = process::dump_module_pe(session, module, path.string());
    REQUIRE(result.ok);
    REQUIRE(result.complete);
    REQUIRE(result.bytes_written >= 1024);

    std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
    const std::vector<uint8_t> bytes{std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file),
                                     std::istreambuf_iterator<char>{}};
    REQUIRE_EQ(bytes.size(), result.bytes_written);
    const auto pe = disasm::pe_parse(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    REQUIRE(pe.ok);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(pe.sections.empty());

    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::remove(path, ec);
    session.close();
}

namespace {

// a fake address space: three segments with an unmapped gap and a hole
struct fake_space_t {
    std::map<uint64_t, uint8_t> bytes;   // sparse; absent = 0
    uint64_t bad_lo = 0, bad_hi = 0;     // reads touching this range fail
    slop::core::runtime::io_result_t read(uintptr_t a, void* dst, size_t n) const {
        slop::core::runtime::io_result_t r;
        if (a < bad_hi && a + n > bad_lo) { r.error = 5; return r; }
        auto* out = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dst);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            auto it = bytes.find(a + i);
            out[i] = it == bytes.end() ? 0 : it->second;
        }
        r.ok = true;
        r.bytes = n;
        return r;
    }
};

template <typename T>
T rd(const std::vector<uint8_t>& v, size_t off) {
    T x{};
    std::memcpy(&x, v.data() + off, sizeof(T));
    return x;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(module_dump_rebuilds_elf_from_segments) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    fake_space_t mem;
    mem.bytes[0x400000] = 0xC3;
    mem.bytes[0x401234] = 0x90;
    mem.bytes[0x480010] = 0xAB;
    mem.bytes[0x4C8FFF] = 0xEE;
    const std::vector<process::mapped_segment_t> segs = {
        {0x400000, 0x480000, 5},    // r-x
        {0x480000, 0x4C0000, 1},    // r--
        {0x4C8000, 0x500000, 3},    // rw-
    };
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    process::elf_rebuild_info_t info;
    auto res = process::reconstruct_elf_from_segments(
        segs, [&](uintptr_t a, void* d, size_t n) { return mem.read(a, d, n); }, out, {}, &info);
    REQUIRE(res.ok);
    REQUIRE(res.complete);
    CHECK(res.module_base == 0x400000u);
    CHECK(info.segments == 3u);
    CHECK(!info.had_header);
    CHECK(info.entry == 0u);
    CHECK(!res.warnings.empty());   // says the header was rebuilt
    REQUIRE(out.size() > 64u);
    CHECK(std::memcmp(out.data(), "\x7f" "ELF", 4) == 0);
    CHECK(out[4] == 2);
    CHECK(out[5] == 1);
    CHECK(rd<uint16_t>(out, 16) == 2);    // ET_EXEC
    CHECK(rd<uint16_t>(out, 18) == 62);   // EM_X86_64
    CHECK(rd<uint64_t>(out, 24) == 0u);   // entry unknown
    CHECK(rd<uint64_t>(out, 32) == 64u);  // phoff
    CHECK(rd<uint16_t>(out, 54) == 56);   // phentsize
    REQUIRE(rd<uint16_t>(out, 56) == 3);  // phnum
    CHECK(rd<uint16_t>(out, 60) == 0);    // no section headers
    const uint32_t want_flags[3] = {5, 4, 6};
    uint64_t prev_end = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        const size_t ph = 64 + i * 56;
        const uint64_t off = rd<uint64_t>(out, ph + 8);
        const uint64_t va = rd<uint64_t>(out, ph + 16);
        const uint64_t fsz = rd<uint64_t>(out, ph + 32);
        CHECK(rd<uint32_t>(out, ph) == 1u);   // PT_LOAD
        CHECK(rd<uint32_t>(out, ph + 4) == want_flags[i]);
        CHECK(va == segs[i].start);
        CHECK(fsz == segs[i].end - segs[i].start);
        CHECK(rd<uint64_t>(out, ph + 40) == fsz);
        CHECK(off % 0x4000 == va % 0x4000);
        CHECK(off >= prev_end);
        prev_end = off + fsz;
        REQUIRE(off + fsz <= out.size());
        // every byte sits at p_offset + (va - p_vaddr)
        for (const auto& [a, b] : mem.bytes)
            if (a >= va && a < va + fsz) CHECK(out[off + (a - va)] == b);
    }
}

TEST_CASE(module_dump_elf_keeps_in_memory_header_entry) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    fake_space_t mem;
    // an in-memory ELF header with a PIE-relative entry (ET_SCE_DYNEXEC style)
    const uint8_t ident[8] = {0x7F, 'E', 'L', 'F', 2, 1, 1, 9};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(ident); ++i) mem.bytes[0x800000 + i] = ident[i];
    const uint16_t type = 0xFE10;
    mem.bytes[0x800010] = static_cast<uint8_t>(type & 0xFF);
    mem.bytes[0x800011] = static_cast<uint8_t>(type >> 8);
    const uint64_t entry = 0x1230;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) mem.bytes[0x800018 + i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(entry >> (8 * i));
    const std::vector<process::mapped_segment_t> segs = {{0x800000, 0x810000, 5}};
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    process::elf_rebuild_info_t info;
    auto res = process::reconstruct_elf_from_segments(
        segs, [&](uintptr_t a, void* d, size_t n) { return mem.read(a, d, n); }, out, {}, &info);
    REQUIRE(res.ok);
    CHECK(info.had_header);
    CHECK(info.source_type == 0xFE10);
    CHECK(info.entry == 0x801230u);
    CHECK(rd<uint64_t>(out, 24) == 0x801230u);
}

TEST_CASE(module_dump_elf_unreadable_pages_strict_and_lenient) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    fake_space_t mem;
    mem.bytes[0x400000] = 0x11;
    mem.bad_lo = 0x404000;
    mem.bad_hi = 0x405000;
    const std::vector<process::mapped_segment_t> segs = {{0x400000, 0x410000, 5}};
    auto rf = [&](uintptr_t a, void* d, size_t n) { return mem.read(a, d, n); };
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    process::module_dump_options_t strict;
    strict.chunk_size = 0x1000;
    strict.strict_reads = true;
    auto res = process::reconstruct_elf_from_segments(segs, rf, out, strict);
    CHECK(!res.ok);
    CHECK(res.error.find("0x404000") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(out.empty());

    process::module_dump_options_t lenient = strict;
    lenient.strict_reads = false;
    res = process::reconstruct_elf_from_segments(segs, rf, out, lenient);
    REQUIRE(res.ok);
    CHECK(!res.complete);
    bool named = false;
    for (const auto& w : res.warnings)
        if (w.find("0x404000..0x405000") != std::string::npos) named = true;
    CHECK(named);

    // bad layouts are refused
    std::vector<process::mapped_segment_t> overlap = {{0x400000, 0x402000, 1}, {0x401000, 0x403000, 1}};
    CHECK(!process::reconstruct_elf_from_segments(overlap, rf, out).ok);
    CHECK(!process::reconstruct_elf_from_segments({}, rf, out).ok);
}

TEST_CASE(module_dump_raw_span_zero_fills_gaps) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    fake_space_t mem;
    mem.bytes[0x400000] = 0x01;
    mem.bytes[0x401FFF] = 0x02;
    mem.bytes[0x403000] = 0x03;
    mem.bytes[0x402800] = 0x77;   // inside the gap: must not appear
    const std::vector<process::mapped_segment_t> segs = {{0x400000, 0x402000, 5}, {0x403000, 0x404000, 3}};
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    auto res = process::dump_raw_span(
        segs, [&](uintptr_t a, void* d, size_t n) { return mem.read(a, d, n); }, out);
    REQUIRE(res.ok);
    REQUIRE(out.size() == 0x4000u);
    CHECK(out[0] == 0x01);
    CHECK(out[0x1FFF] == 0x02);
    CHECK(out[0x2800] == 0x00);
    CHECK(out[0x3000] == 0x03);
    CHECK(res.section_count == 2u);
}
```

`src/tests/test_network.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_network.cpp
// Network slice: parsers (IP/L4/fragments/DNS/SNI/HTTP framing) incl. a
// deterministic mutation fuzz pass, the capture pipeline through its test
// hooks (no sockets, no admin), the traffic store (ring, LRU byte budget,
// filters, pcap records), and the proxy over real loopback sockets (plain
// HTTP, CONNECT, auth, allowlists, caps, timeouts, replay, TLS interception)

#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/network/capture_service.hpp"
#include "core/network/http_proxy.hpp"
#include "core/network/mitm_pki.hpp"
#include "core/network/net_socket.hpp"
#include "core/network/parsers.hpp"
#include "core/network/pcap_import.hpp"
#include "core/network/redact.hpp"
#include "core/network/tls_stream.hpp"
#include "core/network/traffic_store.hpp"
#include "core/mcp/mcp_tools.hpp"

#include <httplib.h>

#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <wincrypt.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

using namespace slop::core::network;

namespace {

// packet builders

std::vector<uint8_t> addr_bytes(const char* a) {
    const auto ip = parse::parse_ip(a);
    if (!ip) return {};
    return std::vector<uint8_t>(ip->b.begin(), ip->b.begin() + (ip->family == 4 ? 4 : 16));
}

void put16(std::vector<uint8_t>& v, size_t at, uint32_t x) {
    v[at] = static_cast<uint8_t>((x >> 8) & 0xFF);
    v[at + 1] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x & 0xFF);
}

std::vector<uint8_t> tcp_seg(uint16_t sp, uint16_t dp, const std::string& payload, uint32_t seq = 1000) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> t(20, 0);
    put16(t, 0, sp);
    put16(t, 2, dp);
    t[4] = static_cast<uint8_t>(seq >> 24);
    t[5] = static_cast<uint8_t>((seq >> 16) & 0xFF);
    t[6] = static_cast<uint8_t>((seq >> 8) & 0xFF);
    t[7] = static_cast<uint8_t>(seq & 0xFF);
    t[12] = 0x50;
    t[13] = 0x18;
    t.insert(t.end(), payload.begin(), payload.end());
    return t;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> udp_dgram(uint16_t sp, uint16_t dp, const std::vector<uint8_t>& payload) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> u(8, 0);
    put16(u, 0, sp);
    put16(u, 2, dp);
    put16(u, 4, static_cast<uint32_t>(8 + payload.size()));
    u.insert(u.end(), payload.begin(), payload.end());
    return u;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> ipv4(const char* src, const char* dst, uint8_t proto,
                          const std::vector<uint8_t>& l4, uint16_t id = 7,
                          uint16_t frag = 0x4000, size_t pad = 0) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> p(20, 0);
    p[0] = 0x45;
    put16(p, 2, static_cast<uint32_t>(20 + l4.size()));
    put16(p, 4, id);
    put16(p, 6, frag);
    p[8] = 64;
    p[9] = proto;
    const auto s = addr_bytes(src), d = addr_bytes(dst);
    std::memcpy(p.data() + 12, s.data(), 4);
    std::memcpy(p.data() + 16, d.data(), 4);
    p.insert(p.end(), l4.begin(), l4.end());
    p.insert(p.end(), pad, 0xEE);
    return p;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> ipv6(const char* src, const char* dst, uint8_t next,
                          const std::vector<uint8_t>& rest) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> p(40, 0);
    p[0] = 0x60;
    put16(p, 4, static_cast<uint32_t>(rest.size()));
    p[6] = next;
    p[7] = 64;
    const auto s = addr_bytes(src), d = addr_bytes(dst);
    std::memcpy(p.data() + 8, s.data(), 16);
    std::memcpy(p.data() + 24, d.data(), 16);
    p.insert(p.end(), rest.begin(), rest.end());
    return p;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> dns_response(const char* name, const std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>>& a4,
                                  const std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>>& a6) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> m = {0x12, 0x34, 0x81, 0x80, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    put16(m, 6, static_cast<uint32_t>(a4.size() + a6.size()));
    std::string n = name;
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= n.size()) {
        size_t dot = n.find('.', start);
        if (dot == std::string::npos) dot = n.size();
        m.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(dot - start));
        m.insert(m.end(), n.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(start),
                 n.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(dot));
        start = dot + 1;
    }
    m.push_back(0);
    m.insert(m.end(), {0, 1, 0, 1});
    auto answer = [&](uint16_t type, const std::vector<uint8_t>& rd) {
        m.insert(m.end(), {0xC0, 0x0C});                  // pointer to the question name
        m.push_back(0);
        m.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(type));
        m.insert(m.end(), {0, 1, 0, 0, 0x0E, 0x10});      // class IN, ttl 3600
        m.push_back(0);
        m.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(rd.size()));
        m.insert(m.end(), rd.begin(), rd.end());
    };
    for (const auto& a : a4) answer(1, a);
    for (const auto& a : a6) answer(28, a);
    return m;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> client_hello(const std::string& sni) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> ext;
    if (!sni.empty()) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> list;
        list.push_back(0);
        list.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(sni.size() >> 8));
        list.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(sni.size() & 0xFF));
        list.insert(list.end(), sni.begin(), sni.end());
        std::vector<uint8_t> body = {static_cast<uint8_t>(list.size() >> 8),
                                     static_cast<uint8_t>(list.size() & 0xFF)};
        body.insert(body.end(), list.begin(), list.end());
        ext = {0, 0, static_cast<uint8_t>(body.size() >> 8), static_cast<uint8_t>(body.size() & 0xFF)};
        ext.insert(ext.end(), body.begin(), body.end());
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> hello = {0x03, 0x03};
    hello.insert(hello.end(), 32, 0xAB);                   // random
    hello.push_back(0);                                     // session id
    hello.insert(hello.end(), {0, 2, 0x13, 0x01});          // one suite
    hello.insert(hello.end(), {1, 0});                      // null compression
    hello.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(ext.size() >> 8));
    hello.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(ext.size() & 0xFF));
    hello.insert(hello.end(), ext.begin(), ext.end());
    std::vector<uint8_t> hs = {1, 0, static_cast<uint8_t>(hello.size() >> 8),
                               static_cast<uint8_t>(hello.size() & 0xFF)};
    hs.insert(hs.end(), hello.begin(), hello.end());
    std::vector<uint8_t> rec = {0x16, 0x03, 0x01, static_cast<uint8_t>(hs.size() >> 8),
                                static_cast<uint8_t>(hs.size() & 0xFF)};
    rec.insert(rec.end(), hs.begin(), hs.end());
    return rec;
}

packet_record_t mk_packet(int sport, int dport, const char* local = "10.0.0.2",
                          const char* remote = "93.184.216.34", uint32_t dir = 0,
                          const std::string& body = "hello") {
    packet_record_t p;
    p.at_ms = 1700000000000;
    p.protocol = 6;
    p.direction = dir;
    p.local_addr = local;
    p.local_port = static_cast<uint16_t>(sport);
    p.remote_addr = remote;
    p.remote_port = static_cast<uint16_t>(dport);
    p.payload.assign(body.begin(), body.end());
    return p;
}

std::string temp_path(const char* name) {
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s\\slop_net_%u_%s", std::getenv("TEMP"),
                  static_cast<unsigned>(::_getpid()), name);
    return path;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> read_all(const std::string& path) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    std::FILE* f = nullptr;
    if (fopen_s(&f, path.c_str(), "rb") != 0 || !f) return out;
    uint8_t buf[4096];
    size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f)) > 0) out.insert(out.end(), buf, buf + n);
    std::fclose(f);
    return out;
}

uint32_t le32(const std::vector<uint8_t>& v, size_t at) {
    return static_cast<uint32_t>(v[at]) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(v[at + 1]) << 8) |
           (static_cast<uint32_t>(v[at + 2]) << 16) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(v[at + 3]) << 24);
}

uint32_t be16v(const std::vector<uint8_t>& v, size_t at) {
    return (static_cast<uint32_t>(v[at]) << 8) | v[at + 1];
}

// loopback socket helpers (every socket gets timeouts so a regression fails
// instead of hanging the suite)

SOCKET dial(uint16_t port) {
    SOCKET c = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (c == INVALID_SOCKET) return c;
    DWORD tv = 5000;
    ::setsockopt(c, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&tv), sizeof(tv));
    ::setsockopt(c, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&tv), sizeof(tv));
    sockaddr_in a{};
    a.sin_family = AF_INET;
    a.sin_port = htons(port);
    a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    if (::connect(c, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), sizeof(a)) != 0) {
        ::closesocket(c);
        return INVALID_SOCKET;
    }
    return c;
}

void send_str(SOCKET s, const std::string& d) {
    ::send(s, d.data(), static_cast<int>(d.size()), 0);
}

std::string recv_all(SOCKET s) {
    std::string out;
    char buf[4096];
    int r;
    while ((r = ::recv(s, buf, sizeof(buf), 0)) > 0) out.append(buf, static_cast<size_t>(r));
    return out;
}

std::string recv_head(SOCKET s) {
    std::string out;
    char c;
    while (out.find("\r\n\r\n") == std::string::npos && ::recv(s, &c, 1, 0) == 1) out.push_back(c);
    return out;
}

std::string exchange(uint16_t port, const std::string& req) {
    SOCKET c = dial(port);
    if (c == INVALID_SOCKET) return {};
    send_str(c, req);
    std::string resp = recv_all(c);
    ::closesocket(c);
    return resp;
}

struct origin_t {
    httplib::Server srv;
    int port = 0;
    std::thread th;
    origin_t() {
        srv.Get("/hi", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content("origin-body", "text/plain");
        });
        srv.Post("/echo", [](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content("echo:" + req.body, "text/plain");
        });
        // echoes the credential headers so a replay can be checked for them
        srv.Get("/auth", [](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_header("Set-Cookie", "sid=set-cookie-secret; HttpOnly");
            res.set_content("auth:" + req.get_header_value("Authorization") +
                                "|cookie:" + req.get_header_value("Cookie") +
                                "|target:" + req.target,
                            "text/plain");
        });
        port = srv.bind_to_any_port("127.0.0.1");
        th = std::thread([this] { srv.listen_after_bind(); });
        srv.wait_until_ready();
    }
    ~origin_t() {
        srv.stop();
        if (th.joinable()) th.join();
    }
};

const proxy_entry_t* find_entry(const std::vector<proxy_entry_t>& v, const char* kind,
                                const char* path) {
    for (const auto& e : v)
        if (e.kind == kind && (!path || e.path == path)) return &e;
    return nullptr;
}

// xorshift: deterministic fuzz input
struct rng_t {
    uint64_t s;
    explicit rng_t(uint64_t seed) : s(seed ? seed : 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) {}
    uint64_t next() {
        s ^= s << 13;
        s ^= s >> 7;
        s ^= s << 17;
        return s;
    }
    size_t below(size_t n) { return n ? static_cast<size_t>(next() % n) : 0; }
};

std::vector<uint8_t> mutate(rng_t& r, std::vector<uint8_t> v) {
    const size_t ops = 1 + r.below(4);
    for (size_t k = 0; k < ops; ++k) {
        switch (r.below(5)) {
        case 0: if (!v.empty()) v[r.below(v.size())] ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(1u << r.below(8)); break;
        case 1: if (!v.empty()) v[r.below(v.size())] = static_cast<uint8_t>(r.next()); break;
        case 2: if (!v.empty()) v.resize(r.below(v.size() + 1)); break;
        case 3: v.insert(v.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(r.below(v.size() + 1)),
                         static_cast<uint8_t>(r.next())); break;
        default:
            if (v.size() >= 2) {   // stomp a 16-bit length-like field with an extreme value
                const size_t at = r.below(v.size() - 1);
                const uint16_t vals[] = {0, 1, 0x7F, 0x80, 0xFF, 0xFFFF, 0x8000};
                const uint16_t x = vals[r.below(7)];
                v[at] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x >> 8);
                v[at + 1] = static_cast<uint8_t>(x & 0xFF);
            }
```
