```cpp
std::string temp_db_path() {
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s\\slop_sessions_%u.db",
                  std::getenv("TEMP"), static_cast<unsigned>(::_getpid()));
    return path;
}

fs::path temp_project(const char* tag) {
    fs::path p = fs::path(std::getenv("TEMP")) /
                 ("slop_hdb_" + std::string(tag) + "_" + std::to_string(::_getpid()));
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(p, ec);
    return p;
}

void write_file(const fs::path& p, const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    std::ofstream f(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));
}

template <class T> void put(std::vector<uint8_t>& b, T v) {
    const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&v);
    b.insert(b.end(), p, p + sizeof(T));
}

// a small analyzed-looking DB: 2 functions, names, a comment, xrefs, a
// struct referencing a builtin and an applied type
void fill_db(hype::AnalysisDB& db) {
    for (hype::va_t va : {0x401000ull, 0x401100ull}) {
        hype::Function f{};
        f.entry = va;
        f.name = va == 0x401000 ? "main" : hype::default_func_name(va);
        db.funcs[va] = std::move(f);
    }
    db.names[0x401000] = "main";
    db.names[0x403000] = "g_config";
    db.comments[0x401004] = "checks the license";
    db.add_xref({0x401010, 0x401100, hype::XrefType::CodeCall});
    db.add_xref({0x401020, 0x403000, hype::XrefType::DataRead});
    const uint32_t s = db.types.add_struct("Config", 16);
    db.types.add_field(s, "flags", db.types.find_by_name("u32")->id, 0);
    db.types.add_field(s, "next", db.types.find_by_name("ptr64")->id, 8);
    db.applied_types[0x403000] = s;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(session_store_roundtrip) {
    const std::string path = temp_db_path();
    remove(path.c_str());

    {
        session_store_t db;
        std::string err;
        REQUIRE(db.open(path, &err));
        REQUIRE(err.empty());

        auto id = db.save_session("first", R"({"pid":1234,"bps":[]})", &err);
        REQUIRE(id.has_value());
        REQUIRE_GT(*id, 0u);

        id = db.save_session("second", R"({"pid":42})", &err);
        REQUIRE(id.has_value());

        auto rows = db.list_sessions();
        REQUIRE_EQ(rows.size(), 2u);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(rows[0].name.c_str(), "second");   // newest first

        auto loaded = db.load_session(rows[1].id);
        REQUIRE(loaded.has_value());
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(loaded->data.c_str(), R"({"pid":1234,"bps":[]})");

        // kv table
        REQUIRE(db.kv_set("layout_main", "{\"dock\":\"left\"}"));
        auto v = db.kv_get("layout_main");
        REQUIRE(v.has_value());
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(v->c_str(), "{\"dock\":\"left\"}");

        // overwrite
        REQUIRE(db.kv_set("layout_main", "v2"));
        v = db.kv_get("layout_main");
        REQUIRE(v.has_value());
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(v->c_str(), "v2");
    }

    // Reopen: data persists
    {
        session_store_t db;
        REQUIRE(db.open(path));
        auto rows = db.list_sessions();
        REQUIRE_EQ(rows.size(), 2u);

        REQUIRE(db.delete_session(rows[0].id));
        REQUIRE(!db.delete_session(rows[0].id));   // already gone
        REQUIRE_EQ(db.list_sessions().size(), 1u);
    }
    remove(path.c_str());
}

TEST_CASE(session_store_unopen_is_safe) {
    session_store_t db;
    REQUIRE(!db.ok());
    REQUIRE_EQ(db.list_sessions().size(), 0u);
    REQUIRE(!db.load_session(1).has_value());
    REQUIRE(!db.delete_session(1));
    REQUIRE(!db.kv_set("k", "v"));
    REQUIRE(!db.kv_get("k").has_value());
}


TEST_CASE(persist_hdb_roundtrip_loads_every_section) {
    const fs::path dir = temp_project("rt");
    hype::PEImage img{};
    img.arch = hype::Arch::X64;
    img.format = hype::ImageFormat::ELF;
    img.base = 0x400000;
    img.entry = 0x401000;
    hype::AnalysisDB db;
    fill_db(db);

    hype::Database io;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(io.save(dir, img, db, &err));

    hype::PEImage li{};
    hype::AnalysisDB loaded;
    REQUIRE(io.load(dir, li, loaded, &err));
    REQUIRE(err.empty());
    REQUIRE(li.format == hype::ImageFormat::ELF);
    REQUIRE_EQ(li.base, 0x400000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(loaded.names.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(loaded.comments[0x401004].c_str(), "checks the license");
    REQUIRE_EQ(loaded.funcs.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(loaded.funcs[0x401000].name.c_str(), "main");
    REQUIRE_EQ(loaded.xrefs.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(loaded.xrefs_to[0x403000].size(), 1u);
    const hype::TypeDef* cfg = loaded.types.find_by_name("Config");
    REQUIRE(cfg != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_EQ(cfg->fields.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE(loaded.types.get(cfg->fields[1].type_id) != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(loaded.types.get(cfg->fields[1].type_id)->name.c_str(), "ptr64");
    REQUIRE_EQ(loaded.applied_types[0x403000], cfg->id);

    // merge into a live DB that already has one xref and its own types
    hype::AnalysisDB live;
    hype::Function f{};
    f.entry = 0x401100;
    f.name = hype::default_func_name(0x401100);
    live.funcs[0x401100] = f;
    live.add_xref({0x401010, 0x401100, hype::XrefType::CodeCall});
    live.types.add_struct("Other", 4);
    const auto st = hype::Database::merge(loaded, live);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.names, 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.comments, 1u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.xrefs, 1u);                  // the duplicate call is skipped
    REQUIRE_EQ(live.xrefs.size(), 2u);
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.types, 1u);                  // Config; builtins map by name
    REQUIRE_EQ(st.applied_types, 1u);
    const hype::TypeDef* live_cfg = live.types.find_by_name("Config");
    REQUIRE(live_cfg != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_EQ(live.applied_types[0x403000], live_cfg->id);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(live.names[0x401000].c_str(), "main");
    REQUIRE(live.funcs.count(0x401000) == 0);  // unknown to the live DB: name only

    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(dir, ec);
}

TEST_CASE(persist_hdb_rejects_corrupt_projects) {
    const fs::path dir = temp_project("bad");
    hype::PEImage img{};
    img.arch = hype::Arch::X64;
    hype::AnalysisDB db;
    fill_db(db);
    hype::Database io;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(io.save(dir, img, db, &err));

    const auto try_load = [&](std::string& why) {
        hype::PEImage li{};
        hype::AnalysisDB out;
        why.clear();
        return io.load(dir, li, out, &why);
    };

    // a count claiming 4 billion names must fail before allocating
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> names = {'N', 'A', 'M', 'S'};
        put<uint32_t>(names, 2);
        put<uint32_t>(names, 0xFFFFFFF0u);
        write_file(dir / "names.bin", names);
        REQUIRE(!try_load(err));
        REQUIRE(err.find("names.bin") != std::string::npos);
    }
    // a string length running past the end of the file
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> names = {'N', 'A', 'M', 'S'};
        put<uint32_t>(names, 2);
        put<uint32_t>(names, 1);
        put<uint64_t>(names, 0x401000);
        put<uint32_t>(names, 0x7FFFFFFF);
        names.push_back('x');
        write_file(dir / "names.bin", names);
        REQUIRE(!try_load(err));
        REQUIRE(err.find("record 0") != std::string::npos);
    }
    // wrong section tag
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> names = {'C', 'M', 'T', 'S'};
        put<uint32_t>(names, 2);
        put<uint32_t>(names, 0);
        write_file(dir / "names.bin", names);
        REQUIRE(!try_load(err));
        REQUIRE(err.find("tag") != std::string::npos);
    }
    // bad magic, then an unsupported version
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> meta(36, 0);
        std::memcpy(meta.data(), "NOTAHDB", 8);
        write_file(dir / "meta.bin", meta);
        REQUIRE(!try_load(err));
        REQUIRE(err.find("magic") != std::string::npos);
        std::memcpy(meta.data(), "HYPEHDB", 8);
        const uint32_t v = 99;
        std::memcpy(meta.data() + 8, &v, 4);
        write_file(dir / "meta.bin", meta);
        REQUIRE(!try_load(err));
        REQUIRE(err.find("version 99") != std::string::npos);
    }
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(dir, ec);
}

TEST_CASE(persist_hdb_reads_v1_projects) {
    // pre-versioning layout: 17-byte meta, untagged sections, u16 lengths
    const fs::path dir = temp_project("v1");
    fs::create_directories(dir);
    std::vector<uint8_t> meta;
    put<uint8_t>(meta, static_cast<uint8_t>(hype::Arch::X64));
    put<uint64_t>(meta, 0x140000000ull);
    put<uint64_t>(meta, 0x140001000ull);
    write_file(dir / "meta.bin", meta);
    std::vector<uint8_t> names;
    put<uint32_t>(names, 1);
    put<uint64_t>(names, 0x140001000ull);
    put<uint16_t>(names, 4);
    names.insert(names.end(), {'m', 'a', 'i', 'n'});
    write_file(dir / "names.bin", names);
    std::vector<uint8_t> empty_count;
    put<uint32_t>(empty_count, 0);
    write_file(dir / "comments.bin", empty_count);
    write_file(dir / "funcs.bin", empty_count);
    write_file(dir / "xrefs.bin", empty_count);
    std::vector<uint8_t> types = empty_count;   // 0 defs
    put<uint32_t>(types, 0);                    // 0 applied
    write_file(dir / "types.bin", types);

    hype::Database io;
    hype::PEImage li{};
    hype::AnalysisDB loaded;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(io.load(dir, li, loaded, &err));
    REQUIRE_EQ(li.base, 0x140000000ull);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(loaded.names[0x140001000ull].c_str(), "main");
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(dir, ec);
}

TEST_CASE(persist_tool_rejects_oversized_payloads) {
    // the checks run before the store is opened, so nothing here touches
    // the user's session database
    bool is_error = false;
    nlohmann::json big = std::string(17u << 20, 'a');
    auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "persist", {{"action", "save"}, {"name", "huge"}, {"data", big}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("limit") != std::string::npos);

    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "persist", {{"action", "kv_set"}, {"key", "k"}, {"value", std::string(2u << 20, 'v')}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("limit") != std::string::npos);

    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "persist", {{"action", "save"}, {"name", std::string(300, 'n')}, {"data", 1}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("name longer") != std::string::npos);
}

// === schema migrations ===

namespace {

// SQLite keeps PRAGMA user_version in the database header at byte 60, big
// endian. Poking it is how these tests build a store written by another build
// without linking sqlite into the test target
bool poke_user_version(const std::string& path, uint32_t v) {
    std::fstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::in | std::ios::out);
    if (!f) return false;
    f.seekp(60, std::ios::beg);
    const unsigned char b[4] = {
        static_cast<unsigned char>(v >> 24), static_cast<unsigned char>(v >> 16),
        static_cast<unsigned char>(v >> 8),  static_cast<unsigned char>(v)};
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b), 4);
    f.flush();
    return static_cast<bool>(f);
}

// LOCALAPPDATA is where the per-hash annotation stores live; pointing it at a
// scratch folder keeps these tests off the real user profile
struct env_guard_t {
    std::string name, prev;
    bool had = false;
    env_guard_t(const char* n, const std::string& value) : name(n) {
        char buf[32768];
        const DWORD len = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name.c_str(), buf,
                                                  static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(buf)));
        had = len > 0 && len < sizeof(buf);
        if (had) prev.assign(buf, len);
        SetEnvironmentVariableA(name.c_str(), value.c_str());
    }
    ~env_guard_t() {
        SetEnvironmentVariableA(name.c_str(), had ? prev.c_str() : nullptr);
    }
};

void spit(const fs::path& p, const std::string& text) {
    fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
    std::ofstream f(p, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f.write(text.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(text.size()));
}

std::string slurp(const fs::path& p) {
    std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
    return std::string(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f),
                       std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(persist_store_migrates_and_refuses_newer_schema) {
    const std::string path = temp_db_path();
    remove(path.c_str());

    // a fresh file lands on the current schema
    {
        session_store_t db;
        std::string err;
        REQUIRE(db.open(path, &err));
        REQUIRE(err.empty());
        REQUIRE_EQ(db.schema_version(), session_store_t::kSchemaVersion);
        REQUIRE(db.save_session("kept", R"({"a":1})", &err).has_value());
    }

    // a file from before versioning: same tables, user_version 0. It must be
    // adopted in place, data included, not recreated
    REQUIRE(poke_user_version(path, 0));
    {
        session_store_t db;
        std::string err;
        REQUIRE(db.open(path, &err));
        REQUIRE_EQ(db.schema_version(), 1);
        REQUIRE_EQ(db.list_sessions().size(), 1u);
        REQUIRE(db.kv_set("layout", "v1"));
    }

    // a file written by a newer build is refused with a clear reason instead
    // of being guessed at
    REQUIRE(poke_user_version(path, 99));
    {
        session_store_t db;
        std::string err;
        REQUIRE(!db.open(path, &err));
        REQUIRE(!db.ok());
        REQUIRE(err.find("newer") != std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE(err.find("99") != std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE(err.find("upgrade") != std::string::npos);
        REQUIRE_EQ(db.schema_version(), -1);
    }
    remove(path.c_str());
}

// === fs_root jail ===

TEST_CASE(persist_fs_jail_canonicalises_escape_forms) {
    const fs::path base = temp_project("jail");
    const fs::path jail = base / "jail";
    const fs::path outside = base / "outside";
    spit(jail / "sub" / "ok.txt", "inside\n");
    spit(outside / "secret.txt", "outside\n");

    std::string root;
    REQUIRE(util::canonical_path(jail.string(), &root));
    std::string c;

    // plain inside path
    REQUIRE(util::canonical_path((jail / "sub" / "ok.txt").string(), &c));
    REQUIRE(util::path_within(c, root));

    // `..` traversal out of the jail
    REQUIRE(util::canonical_path(
        (jail / "sub" / ".." / ".." / "outside" / "secret.txt").string(), &c));
    REQUIRE(!util::path_within(c, root));

    // NTFS alternate data streams judge the file, not the stream name
    REQUIRE(util::canonical_path((outside / "secret.txt:hidden").string(), &c));
    REQUIRE(!util::path_within(c, root));
    REQUIRE(util::canonical_path((jail / "sub" / "ok.txt:hidden").string(), &c));
    REQUIRE(util::path_within(c, root));   // same file, still inside

    // \\?\ prefix cannot smuggle a path past the jail
    REQUIRE(util::canonical_path("\\\\?\\" + (outside / "secret.txt").string(), &c));
    REQUIRE(!util::path_within(c, root));

    // 8.3 short names resolve to the long path they name
    {
        wchar_t short_path[MAX_PATH]{};
        const fs::path target = outside / "a_long_directory_name_for_short_names";
        fs::create_directories(target);
        const DWORD n = GetShortPathNameW(target.wstring().c_str(), short_path, MAX_PATH);
        std::string short_utf8;
        if (n > 0 && n < MAX_PATH) {
            const int len = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, short_path,
                                                static_cast<int>(n), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
            if (len > 0) {
                short_utf8.resize(static_cast<size_t>(len));
                WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, short_path, static_cast<int>(n),
                                    short_utf8.data(), len, nullptr, nullptr);
            }
        }
        if (!short_utf8.empty() && short_utf8 != target.string()) {
            REQUIRE(util::canonical_path(short_utf8, &c));
            REQUIRE(!util::path_within(c, root));
        }
    }

    // a junction inside the jail that points outside is judged by its target
    {
        const std::string cmd = "cmd /c mklink /J \"" + (jail / "link").string() +
                                "\" \"" + outside.string() + "\" >NUL 2>&1";
        const bool linked = std::system(cmd.c_str()) == 0 &&
                            fs::exists(jail / "link");
        if (linked) {
            REQUIRE(util::canonical_path((jail / "link" / "secret.txt").string(), &c));
            REQUIRE(!util::path_within(c, root));
            REQUIRE(util::canonical_path((jail / "link").string(), &c));
            REQUIRE(!util::path_within(c, root));
            ::RemoveDirectoryW((jail / "link").wstring().c_str());
        }
    }

    // UNC to a share that does not exist cannot be resolved, so it cannot be
    // smuggled in as "inside"
    {
        const std::string unc = "\\\\slop-jail-" + std::to_string(::_getpid()) +
                                "\\share\\x.txt";
        const bool resolved = util::canonical_path(unc, &c);
        REQUIRE(!resolved || !util::path_within(c, root));
    }

    // path_within is case-insensitive and separator aware
    REQUIRE(util::path_within(root, root));
    std::string upper = root;
    for (char& ch : upper)
        ch = static_cast<char>(toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
    REQUIRE(util::path_within(upper, root));
    REQUIRE(!util::path_within(root + "_sibling", root));

    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(base, ec);
}

TEST_CASE(persist_fs_tool_honours_fs_root) {
    const fs::path base = temp_project("fsroot");
    spit(base / "jail" / "ok.txt", "needle inside\n");
    spit(base / "outside" / "secret.txt", "needle outside\n");

    settings::set_file_for_testing((base / "settings.json").string());
    REQUIRE(settings::set("fs_root", nlohmann::json::array({(base / "jail").string()})));

    bool is_error = false;
    auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "read_file"}, {"path", (base / "jail" / "ok.txt").string()}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("text", std::string{}).find("needle") != std::string::npos);

    // every action refuses a path outside the root, `..` included
    for (const char* action : {"read_file", "list_directory", "create_directory",
                               "delete_path"}) {
        r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
            "fs", {{"action", action},
                   {"path", (base / "outside" / "secret.txt").string()}},
            is_error);
        REQUIRE(is_error);
        REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("fs_root") != std::string::npos);
    }
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "read_file"},
               {"path", (base / "jail" / ".." / "outside" / "secret.txt").string()}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "write_file"},
               {"path", (base / "outside" / "new.txt").string()},
               {"text", "x"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);

    // walks are jailed at the root, so nothing outside can be listed or grepped
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "search_files"}, {"root", (base / "outside").string()},
               {"needle", "secret"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "grep_in_files"}, {"root", (base / "outside").string()},
               {"needle", "needle"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);

    // the same walks inside the root work
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "search_files"}, {"root", (base / "jail").string()},
               {"needle", "ok"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("count", 0u), 1u);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "grep_in_files"}, {"root", (base / "jail").string()},
               {"needle", "needle"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("count", 0u), 1u);

    // a malformed fs_root fails closed instead of silently dropping the jail
    REQUIRE(settings::set("fs_root", 42));
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "read_file"}, {"path", (base / "jail" / "ok.txt").string()}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("fs_root") != std::string::npos);

    // unset fs_root restores the historic behaviour
    REQUIRE(settings::set("fs_root", nullptr));
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "fs", {{"action", "read_file"}, {"path", (base / "outside" / "secret.txt").string()}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    settings::set_file_for_testing({});

    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(base, ec);
}

// === web egress: DNS pinning ===

namespace {

// loopback origin with a redirect to a denied destination. The client must
// refuse the hop instead of resolving and connecting to it
struct web_origin_t {
    httplib::Server srv;
    int port = 0;
    std::thread th;

    web_origin_t() {
        srv.Get("/probe", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content("pinned-ok", "text/plain");
        });
        srv.Get("/redir-meta", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_redirect("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/");
        });
        srv.Get("/redir-private", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_redirect("http://10.255.255.1/");
        });
        srv.Get("/redir-ok", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_redirect("/probe");
        });
        srv.Get("/host", [](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            res.set_content("host=" + req.get_header_value("Host"), "text/plain");
        });
        port = srv.bind_to_any_port("127.0.0.1");
        th = std::thread([this] { srv.listen_after_bind(); });
        srv.wait_until_ready();
    }
    ~web_origin_t() {
        srv.stop();
        if (th.joinable()) th.join();
    }
    std::string url(const char* path) const {
        return "http://127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(port) + path;
    }
};

// a symbol store: accepts an upload and serves it back, so notes.push and
// notes.pull can be exercised without a real server
struct symbol_store_t {
    httplib::Server srv;
    int port = 0;
    std::thread th;
    std::mutex mu;
    std::map<std::string, std::string> files;
    int puts = 0;

    symbol_store_t() {
        srv.Post(R"(/symbols/(.*))", [this](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            files[req.matches[1]] = req.body;
            ++puts;
            res.status = 201;
        });
        srv.Get(R"(/symbols/(.*))", [this](const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
            std::lock_guard lk(mu);
            auto it = files.find(req.matches[1]);
            if (it == files.end()) {
                res.status = 404;
                return;
            }
            res.set_content(it->second, "application/json");
        });
        port = srv.bind_to_any_port("127.0.0.1");
        th = std::thread([this] { srv.listen_after_bind(); });
        srv.wait_until_ready();
    }
    ~symbol_store_t() {
        srv.stop();
        if (th.joinable()) th.join();
    }
    std::string base() const { return "http://127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(port); }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(persist_notes_push_and_pull_shared_store) {
    const fs::path data = temp_project("notesync");
    fs::create_directories(data);
    env_guard_t env("LOCALAPPDATA", data.string());
    // the store is on loopback, which the web egress policy denies by default
    slop::core::infra::settings::set("web_allow_private", true);

    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    uint64_t entry = 0;
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        entry = bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva;
    }

    bool is_error = true;
    auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry}, {"text", "shared"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);

    symbol_store_t store;
    // push publishes this image's file under its hash
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "push"}, {"url", store.base()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("pushed", false));
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.value("status", 0), 201);
    REQUIRE_EQ(store.puts, 1);
    REQUIRE_EQ(store.files.size(), 1u);
    const std::string body = store.files.begin()->second;
    REQUIRE(body.find("reverse-slop-symbols") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(body.find("shared") != std::string::npos);

    // a local edit is replaced by the published text with merge=theirs
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry}, {"text", "local"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "pull"}, {"url", store.base()}, {"merge", "theirs"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("pulled", false));
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("comments", 0u), 1u);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "get_comment"}, {"addr", entry}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.value("comment", "").c_str(), "shared");

    // merge=ours keeps the local text
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry}, {"text", "mine"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "pull"}, {"url", store.base()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "get_comment"}, {"addr", entry}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.value("comment", "").c_str(), "mine");

    // a store without this image's file answers 404 and the tool says so
    store.files.clear();
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "pull"}, {"url", store.base()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("no annotations") != std::string::npos);

    // a reachable-but-not-a-store answer is refused, not applied
    store.files["x"] = "not json";
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "pull"}, {"url", store.base()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);

    ds::unload();
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(data, ec);
}

TEST_CASE(persist_web_dns_pin_denies_redirect_to_private_target) {
    web_origin_t origin;
    REQUIRE_GT(origin.port, 0);
    std::string err;

    // only the origin's address is allowed: every hop is vetted separately
    util::egress_policy_t policy;
    policy.allowlist = {"127.0.0.1"};

    auto resp = util::http_get(origin.url("/probe"), policy, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(resp->status, 200u);
    // the request went to the vetted address, not to a re-resolved one
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->remote_addr, "127.0.0.1");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->body, "pinned-ok");

    // a redirect into link-local metadata is refused before connecting
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get(origin.url("/redir-meta"), policy, 5000, &err).has_value());
    REQUIRE(err.find("blocked") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(err.find("after redirect") != std::string::npos);
    // and so is one into RFC1918 space
    REQUIRE(!util::http_get(origin.url("/redir-private"), policy, 5000, &err).has_value());
    REQUIRE(err.find("blocked") != std::string::npos);

    // an allowed redirect hop still works
    resp = util::http_get(origin.url("/redir-ok"), policy, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_EQ(resp->redirects.size(), 1u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->body, "pinned-ok");

    // a name is resolved once and the connection made to that address while
    // the Host header keeps the name (SNI/Host handling with a pinned IP)
    util::egress_policy_t by_name;
    by_name.allowlist = {"localhost"};
    resp = util::http_get("http://localhost:" + std::to_string(origin.port) + "/host",
                          by_name, 5000, &err);
    REQUIRE(resp.has_value());
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->remote_addr, "127.0.0.1");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(resp->body, "host=localhost:" + std::to_string(origin.port));
    REQUIRE_GE(util::vet_destination("localhost", by_name, &err).size(), 1u);
}

// === persisted patch journal ===

TEST_CASE(persist_patch_journal_survives_reload) {
    const fs::path data = temp_project("patchstore");
    fs::create_directories(data);
    env_guard_t env("LOCALAPPDATA", data.string());

    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    uint64_t entry = 0;
    size_t off = 0;
    uint8_t original = 0;
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        entry = bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva;
        auto o = bin.offset_of(entry);
        REQUIRE(o.has_value());
        off = *o;
        original = bin.file[off];
    }
    // the journal is keyed by image hash and shared by every test in this run,
    // so an earlier patch of the same fixture is still armed: clear it before
    // asserting on a known-good byte
    if (!ds::get().patches.empty()) {
        bool revert_error = true;
        slop::core::mcp::call_tool("patch", {{"action", "revert_all"}}, revert_error);
        REQUIRE(!revert_error);
    }
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        original = bin.file[off];
        REQUIRE(bin.patches.empty());
    }

    bool is_error = true;
    auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "patch", {{"action", "write_bytes"}, {"addr", entry}, {"hex", "9090"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("journal_total", 0u), 2u);
    ds::unload();

    // reload: the journal comes back from the per-hash store and the bytes are
    // already patched, so a session survives a restart
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        REQUIRE_GE(bin.patches.size(), 2u);
        REQUIRE_EQ(bin.file[off], 0x90);
        REQUIRE(bin.indexes_dirty);   // indexes were built from clean bytes
    }
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("patch", {{"action", "journal"}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("total", 0u), 2u);

    // revert_all still restores the originals and empties the journal
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("patch", {{"action", "revert_all"}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("bytes_changed", 0ull), 2ull);
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        REQUIRE(bin.patches.empty());
        REQUIRE_EQ(bin.file[off], original);
    }
    ds::unload();

    // the empty journal is what the store now holds
    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        REQUIRE(ds::get().patches.empty());
        REQUIRE_EQ(ds::get().file[off], original);
    }
    ds::unload();

    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(data, ec);
}

// === notes export / import (Git-friendly team annotations) ===

TEST_CASE(persist_notes_export_import_merge) {
    const fs::path data = temp_project("notestore");
    const fs::path share = temp_project("noteshare");
    fs::create_directories(data);
    fs::create_directories(share);
    env_guard_t env("LOCALAPPDATA", data.string());

    REQUIRE(ds::load_file(SLOP_TARGET_EXE_PATH));
    uint64_t entry = 0;
    {
        ds::binary_lock_t lk;
        auto& bin = ds::get();
        entry = bin.base + bin.pe.entry_rva;
    }

    bool is_error = true;
    auto r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry}, {"text", "team comment"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry + 0x10},
                  {"text", "second"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "types", {{"action", "declare"}, {"decl", "struct TeamRec { u32 a; u64 b; };"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);

    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "export"}, {"path", share.string()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    const std::string file = r.value("path", std::string{});
    REQUIRE(fs::exists(file));
    REQUIRE(file.find("symbols") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.value("comments", 0u), 2u);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("structs", 0u), 1u);

    const std::string first = slurp(file);
    REQUIRE(!first.empty());
    REQUIRE_EQ(first.back(), '\n');
    const auto doc = nlohmann::json::parse(first);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(doc.value("format", std::string{}).c_str(), "reverse-slop-symbols");
    REQUIRE(doc.contains("names"));
    REQUIRE(doc.contains("comments"));
    REQUIRE(doc.contains("bookmarks"));
    REQUIRE(doc.contains("structs"));
    REQUIRE(doc.contains("enums"));
    // zero padded VA keys: a lexicographic dump is a numeric VA order
    std::string prev_key;
    for (auto it = doc.at("comments").begin(); it != doc.at("comments").end(); ++it) {
        REQUIRE_EQ(it.key().size(), 16u);
        REQUIRE(it.key() > prev_key);
        prev_key = it.key();
    }

    // exporting the same state twice is byte identical (diff friendly)
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "export"}, {"path", share.string()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slurp(file), first);

    // theirs: the file wins a conflict
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry}, {"text", "local edit"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "import"}, {"path", share.string()}, {"merge", "theirs"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_GE(r.value("comments", 0u), 1u);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "get_comment"}, {"addr", entry}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.value("comment", "").c_str(), "team comment");

    // ours (default): a local value survives, a cleared one is refilled
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry}, {"text", "local wins"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "set_comment"}, {"addr", entry + 0x10}, {"text", ""}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "import"}, {"path", share.string()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    REQUIRE_EQ(r.value("comments", 0u), 1u);   // only the cleared one came back
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "get_comment"}, {"addr", entry}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.value("comment", "").c_str(), "local wins");
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "get_comment"}, {"addr", entry + 0x10}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.value("comment", "").c_str(), "second");

    // union merges bookmarks/structs without dropping local text
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "bookmark_toggle"}, {"addr", entry}}, is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "notes", {{"action", "import"}, {"path", share.string()}, {"merge", "union"}},
        is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "get_comment"}, {"addr", entry}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(r.value("comment", "").c_str(), "local wins");

    // a folder without the image's file is a clear error, not a silent no-op
    const fs::path empty_dir = temp_project("notesempty");
    fs::create_directories(empty_dir);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "import"}, {"path", empty_dir.string()}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(is_error);
    REQUIRE(r.value("error", std::string{}).find("no annotation file") != std::string::npos);
    r = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("notes", {{"action", "export"}, {"path", share.string()},
                                             {"merge", "bogus"}},
                                   is_error);
    REQUIRE(!is_error);   // merge is ignored by export
    ds::unload();

    std::error_code ec;
    fs::remove_all(data, ec);
    fs::remove_all(share, ec);
    fs::remove_all(empty_dir, ec);
}
```

`src/tests/test_process_tables.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_process_tables.cpp
// Tests for core/process job-based tables: process list, threads, modules,
// handles, va_to_module, and the session epoch clock

#include "harness.hpp"

#include "core/infra/jobs.hpp"
#include "core/process/handle_table.hpp"
#include "core/process/module_table.hpp"
#include "core/process/process_list.hpp"
#include "core/process/target_service.hpp"
#include "core/process/thread_table.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/backend_registry.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/session.hpp"

#include <windows.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace {

bool wait_job(uint64_t id) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 500 && slop::core::infra::jobs::alive(id); ++i)
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
    const bool alive = slop::core::infra::jobs::alive(id);
    slop::core::infra::jobs::reap();
    return !alive;
}

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(session_epoch_uses_steady_clock) {
    slop::core::runtime::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.epoch_ms() == 0);
    REQUIRE(s.open(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    REQUIRE(s.epoch_ms() > 0);
    s.close();
    REQUIRE(s.epoch_ms() == 0);
}

TEST_CASE(process_list_refresh_publishes_snapshot) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    if (runtime::active_kind() != runtime::backend_kind_t::user_mode) {
        std::printf("  [skip] process list test requires user-mode backend\n");
        return;
    }
    // earlier suites may have left the job system shut down
    infra::jobs::reset();

    const uint64_t id = process::refresh_processes(true);
    REQUIRE(id != 0);
    REQUIRE(wait_job(id));

    const auto snap = process::cached_processes();
    REQUIRE(snap != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(snap->sampled_ms > 0);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(snap->items.empty());
    bool found_self = false;
    for (const auto& p : snap->items)
        if (p.pid == GetCurrentProcessId()) found_self = true;
    REQUIRE(found_self);
}

TEST_CASE(tables_refresh_against_attached_target) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    if (runtime::active_kind() != runtime::backend_kind_t::user_mode) {
        std::printf("  [skip] table test requires user-mode backend\n");
        return;
    }
    infra::jobs::reset();
    REQUIRE(process::target_attach(GetCurrentProcessId()));

    const uint64_t jm = process::refresh_modules();
    const uint64_t jt = process::refresh_threads();
    const uint64_t jh = process::refresh_handles();
    REQUIRE(jm != 0);
    REQUIRE(jt != 0);
    REQUIRE(jh != 0);
    REQUIRE(wait_job(jm));
    REQUIRE(wait_job(jt));
    REQUIRE(wait_job(jh));

    const auto mods = process::cached_modules();
    REQUIRE(mods != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(mods->items.empty());
    REQUIRE(mods->sampled_ms > 0);

    const auto thrs = process::cached_threads();
    REQUIRE(thrs != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(thrs->items.empty());

    const auto hnds = process::cached_handles();
    REQUIRE(hnds != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(hnds->sampled_ms > 0);

    // va_to_module resolves module bases and middles, rejects holes
    const auto& m0 = mods->items.front();
    const auto* hit = process::va_to_module(m0.base);
    REQUIRE(hit != nullptr);
    REQUIRE_EQ(hit->base, m0.base);
    REQUIRE(process::va_to_module(m0.base + m0.size / 2) != nullptr);
    REQUIRE(process::va_to_module(0x1) == nullptr);

    process::target_detach();

    // without a target the refreshes are rejected
    REQUIRE(process::refresh_threads() == 0);
    REQUIRE(process::refresh_modules() == 0);
    REQUIRE(process::refresh_handles() == 0);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_modules_coalesce_same_named_segments) {
    using slop::core::runtime::ps4_segment_t;
    auto seg = [](const char* n, uint64_t s, uint64_t e, uint16_t prot) {
        ps4_segment_t x;
        x.name = n; x.start = s; x.end = e; x.prot = prot;
        return x;
    };
    // unsorted input, anonymous mapping between eboot segments, a library
    // in between two runs of the same name starts a new module
    std::vector<ps4_segment_t> maps = {
        seg("/app0/eboot.bin", 0x4C8000, 0x500000, 3),
        seg("/app0/eboot.bin", 0x400000, 0x480000, 5),
        seg("", 0x4C0000, 0x4C8000, 3),
        seg("/app0/eboot.bin", 0x480000, 0x4C0000, 1),
        seg("libkernel.sprx", 0x800000, 0x840000, 5),
        seg("libkernel.sprx", 0x840000, 0x848000, 3),
        seg("", 0x900000, 0x910000, 3),
        seg("/app0/eboot.bin", 0xA00000, 0xA01000, 1),
    };
    const auto mods = slop::core::runtime::ps4_coalesce_modules(maps);
    REQUIRE(mods.size() == 3u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(mods[0].name, "eboot.bin");
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(mods[0].path, "/app0/eboot.bin");
    REQUIRE_EQ(mods[0].base, 0x400000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(mods[0].end, 0x500000ull);
    REQUIRE(mods[0].segments.size() == 3u);   // the anonymous map is not a segment
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(mods[1].name, "libkernel.sprx");
    REQUIRE_EQ(mods[1].end - mods[1].base, 0x48000ull);
    REQUIRE_EQ(mods[2].base, 0xA00000ull);    // separate run of the same name
    REQUIRE(slop::core::runtime::ps4_coalesce_modules({}).empty());
}

TEST_CASE(session_binds_backend_and_handle_info) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    if (runtime::active_kind() != runtime::backend_kind_t::user_mode) {
        std::printf("  [skip] session binding test requires user-mode backend\n");
        return;
    }
    runtime::session_t s;
    REQUIRE(s.open(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    REQUIRE(s.backend() == &runtime::active());
    // name/path come from the attach handle, not a full process walk
    REQUIRE_FALSE(s.info().path.empty());
    REQUIRE(s.name().find(".exe") != std::string::npos);
    REQUIRE(s.arch() == runtime::arch_t::x64);
    s.close();
    REQUIRE(s.backend() == nullptr);
    REQUIRE_FALSE(s.valid());
}

TEST_CASE(tables_jobs_drop_results_of_detached_session) {
    using namespace slop::core;
    if (runtime::active_kind() != runtime::backend_kind_t::user_mode) {
        std::printf("  [skip] table test requires user-mode backend\n");
        return;
    }
    infra::jobs::reset();
    REQUIRE(process::target_attach(GetCurrentProcessId()));
    auto held = process::active_session();
    const uint64_t jm = process::refresh_modules();
    REQUIRE(jm != 0);
    // detach while the job may still run: the job keeps its own reference,
    // so the handle it uses stays open until it is done
    process::target_detach();
    REQUIRE(held->valid());
    REQUIRE(wait_job(jm));
    held.reset();
    REQUIRE(process::active_session() == nullptr);
}
```

`src/tests/test_ps4.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_ps4.cpp
// PS4 (ps4debug-NG) tests against the fake payload in ps4_fixture.hpp:
// backend handshake, memory, threads, registry/session, the MCP target tool
// and the saved-console manager (switch between two fake consoles).

#include "ps4_fixture.hpp"

#include "core/infra/settings.hpp"
#include "core/memory/watch_service.hpp"
#include "core/runtime/console_manager.hpp"

#include <filesystem>
#include <tuple>

namespace {

// the console manager persists through the settings store: point it at a
// scratch file so the real profile is never touched
struct scratch_settings_t {
    std::filesystem::path dir;
    scratch_settings_t() {
        dir = std::filesystem::temp_directory_path() /
              ("slop_ps4_consoles_" + std::to_string(::GetCurrentProcessId()) + "_" +
               std::to_string(static_cast<long long>(::GetTickCount64())));
        std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
        slop::core::infra::settings::set_file_for_testing((dir / "settings.json").string());
        slop::core::infra::settings::load();
    }
    ~scratch_settings_t() {
        // back to the default store; the real profile is never read or written
        slop::core::infra::settings::set_file_for_testing({});
    }
};

} // namespace

TEST_CASE(ps4_backend_handshake_and_enums) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    if (!err.empty()) std::printf("  connect err: %s\n", err.c_str());
    CHECK(b.connected());
    CHECK(b.ping());
    CHECK(b.kind() == backend_kind_t::ps4);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(b.badge(), "PS4");
    CHECK(b.branding().find("ps4debug-NG") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(b.fw_version() == 1100);
    CHECK(b.endpoint() == "127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(g.srv.port));

    auto procs = b.enum_processes();
    REQUIRE(procs.ok);
    CHECK(procs.items.size() == 2u);
    bool found = false;
    for (const auto& p : procs.items) {
        if (p.pid == kFakePid) {
            found = true;
            REQUIRE_STR_EQ(p.name, "eboot.bin");
            CHECK(p.arch == slop::core::runtime::arch_t::x64);
            CHECK(p.elevation == slop::core::runtime::elevation_t::system);
        }
    }
    CHECK(found);

    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());
    auto bad = b.attach(9999);
    CHECK(!bad.valid());

    auto regions = b.enum_regions(h);
    REQUIRE(regions.ok);
    CHECK(regions.items.size() == 6u);   // eboot text/relro/data + anon gap + sprx + stack
    bool saw_eboot = false;
    for (const auto& r : regions.items) {
        if (r.base == 0x400000) {
            saw_eboot = true;
            CHECK(r.size == 0x80000);    // the text segment only
            CHECK(r.protect == 0x20);   // PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
        }
    }
    CHECK(saw_eboot);

    // one record per module: the three eboot segments coalesce into one
    // module spanning text..data (item: per-segment "modules")
    auto mods = b.enum_modules(h);
    REQUIRE(mods.ok);
    int eboot_records = 0;
    for (const auto& m : mods.items) {
        if (m.name == "eboot.bin") {
            ++eboot_records;
            CHECK(m.base == 0x400000);
            CHECK(m.size == 0x100000);
            REQUIRE_STR_EQ(m.path, "/app0/eboot.bin");
        }
    }
    CHECK(eboot_records == 1);
    CHECK(mods.items.size() == 2u);   // eboot + libSceLibcInternal
    auto segs = b.ps4_modules(h);
    REQUIRE(segs.ok);
    REQUIRE(!segs.items.empty());
    CHECK(segs.items[0].name == "eboot.bin");
    REQUIRE(segs.items[0].segments.size() == 3u);
    CHECK(segs.items[0].segments[1].start == 0x480000);
    CHECK(segs.items[0].segments[2].start == 0x4C8000);

    // the handle knows its name/path without another enumeration
    slop::core::runtime::process_info_t pi;
    REQUIRE(b.handle_info(h, pi));
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(pi.path, "/app0/eboot.bin");
    CHECK(pi.arch == slop::core::runtime::arch_t::x64);

    CHECK(b.query_arch(h) == slop::core::runtime::arch_t::x64);
    CHECK(b.query_elevation() == slop::core::runtime::elevation_t::system);

    b.detach(h);
    CHECK(!h.valid());
    b.disconnect();
    CHECK(!b.connected());
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_backend_memory_rw_protect_alloc) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());

    // write then read back
    std::vector<uint8_t> pattern(64);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < pattern.size(); ++i) pattern[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(0xA0 + i);
    auto w = b.write_memory(h, 0x400100, pattern.data(), pattern.size());
    REQUIRE(w.ok);
    CHECK(w.bytes == pattern.size());
    std::vector<uint8_t> back(pattern.size(), 0);
    auto r = b.read_memory(h, 0x400100, back.data(), back.size());
    REQUIRE(r.ok);
    CHECK(std::memcmp(back.data(), pattern.data(), pattern.size()) == 0);
    // the fake console really got the bytes
    for (size_t i = 0; i < pattern.size(); ++i)
        CHECK(g.srv.mem_byte(0x400100 + i) == pattern[i]);

    // larger multi-chunk transfer (128 KiB crosses the server 64 KiB chunking)
    std::vector<uint8_t> big(0x20000);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < big.size(); ++i) big[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(i * 7 + 1);
    REQUIRE(b.write_memory(h, 0x400000, big.data(), big.size()).ok);
    std::vector<uint8_t> bigback(big.size(), 0);
    REQUIRE(b.read_memory(h, 0x400000, bigback.data(), bigback.size()).ok);
    CHECK(std::memcmp(bigback.data(), big.data(), big.size()) == 0);

    // read spanning two adjacent maps (eboot -> sprx) is covered
    std::vector<uint8_t> cross(0x20, 0);
    CHECK(b.read_memory(h, 0x4FFFF0, cross.data(), cross.size()).ok);

    // unmapped read must fail (reader contract: false on any unreadable part)
    std::vector<uint8_t> junk(16, 0);
    auto bad = b.read_memory(h, 0xDEAD0000, junk.data(), junk.size());
    CHECK(!bad.ok);

    // protect translates PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE -> VM_PROT_ALL and reports old
    uint32_t old = 0;
    auto pr = b.protect_memory(h, 0x500000, 0x1000, 0x40, &old);
    REQUIRE(pr.ok);
    CHECK(old == 0x20);                 // was PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
    CHECK(g.srv.last_protect == ps4::kVmProtAll);

    // alloc / free
    uintptr_t alloc_addr = 0;
    auto al = b.allocate_memory(h, 0, 0x2000, 0x04, &alloc_addr);
    REQUIRE(al.ok);
    CHECK(alloc_addr == 0x600000);
    auto fr = b.free_memory(h, 0x600000);
    CHECK(fr.ok);

    b.detach(h);
    b.disconnect();
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_backend_threads_and_regs) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());

    // enum_threads triggers the lazy debug attach (with the 755 callback)
    auto thr = b.enum_threads(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(thr.ok);
    CHECK(thr.items.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(thr.items[0].tid == 101);
    CHECK(thr.items[1].tid == 102);
    CHECK(thr.items[0].owner_pid == kFakePid);
    CHECK(thr.items[0].priority == 80);

    slop::core::runtime::thread_context_t ctx{};
    auto gr = b.get_thread_context(101, ctx);
    REQUIRE(gr.ok);
    CHECK(ctx.rip == 0x400123);
    CHECK(ctx.rsp == 0x7FFF00008000ull);
    CHECK(ctx.rax == 0x2A);
    CHECK(ctx.flags == 0x202);

    ctx.rip = 0x400999;
    ctx.rax = 0x1234;
    auto sr = b.set_thread_context(101, ctx);
    REQUIRE(sr.ok);
    slop::core::runtime::thread_context_t ctx2{};
    REQUIRE(b.get_thread_context(101, ctx2).ok);
    CHECK(ctx2.rip == 0x400999);
    CHECK(ctx2.rax == 0x1234);

    b.detach(h);   // detaches the debug session too
    b.disconnect();
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_registry_session_and_mcp_tool) {
    server_guard_t g;
    ps4_disconnect_guard_t guard;   // leaves the registry clean on REQUIRE failure

    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake_registry(g.srv, err));
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4_active());
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::active_kind() == backend_kind_t::ps4);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(slop::core::runtime::active_badge(), "PS4");
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4_endpoint() ==
          "127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(g.srv.port));
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4_branding().find("ps4debug-NG") != std::string::npos);

    // attach a session through the normal target service path
    REQUIRE(connect_fake_target(g.srv, kFakePid, err));
    auto s = slop::core::process::active_session();
    REQUIRE(s && s->valid());
    CHECK(s->pid() == kFakePid);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(s->name(), "eboot.bin");
    CHECK(s->arch() == slop::core::runtime::arch_t::x64);

    // session hot-path read/write over the wire
    const uint64_t val = 0x1122334455667788ull;
    REQUIRE(s->write(0x400200, &val, sizeof(val)).ok);
    uint64_t back = 0;
    REQUIRE(s->read(0x400200, &back, sizeof(back)).ok);
    CHECK(back == val);

    // MCP: target.list now enumerates the console
    {
        bool is_err = false;
        json res = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "list"}}, is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        CHECK(res.value("count", 0) == 2);
    }
    // MCP: target.status reports the PS4 backend + endpoint
    {
        bool is_err = false;
        json res = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "status"}}, is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(res.value("backend", ""), "PS4");
        CHECK(res.value("attached", false) == true);
        CHECK(res.value("pid", 0) == kFakePid);
        CHECK(res.contains("ps4"));
        CHECK(res["ps4"].value("endpoint", "") == "127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(g.srv.port));
    }
    // MCP: memory.read rides the session
    {
        bool is_err = false;
        json res = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
            "memory",
            {{"action", "read"}, {"addr", 0x400200}, {"len", 8}, {"format", "u64"}},
            is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        REQUIRE(res.contains("values"));
        CHECK(res["values"].size() == 1);
        CHECK(res["values"][0].get<uint64_t>() == val);
    }
    // MCP: memory.write then read back through the tool surface
    {
        bool is_err = false;
        const uint64_t nv = 0xCAFEBABEDEADBEEFull;
        json wres = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
            "memory",
            {{"action", "write"}, {"addr", 0x400210}, {"hex", "efbeaddebebafeca"}},
            is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        json rres = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
            "memory",
            {{"action", "read"}, {"addr", 0x400210}, {"len", 8}, {"format", "u64"}},
            is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        CHECK(rres["values"][0].get<uint64_t>() == nv);
    }

    // MCP: disconnect drops the console and returns to the local backend
    {
        bool is_err = false;
        json res = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "ps4_disconnect"}}, is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        CHECK(res.value("connected", true) == false);
    }
    CHECK(!slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4_active());
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::active_kind() != backend_kind_t::ps4);
    CHECK(!slop::core::process::active_session());

    // MCP: ps4_connect with pid attaches in one call
    {
        bool is_err = false;
        json res = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
            "target",
            {{"action", "ps4_connect"}, {"host", "127.0.0.1"}, {"port", g.srv.port}, {"pid", kFakePid}},
            is_err);
        CHECK(!is_err);
        if (is_err) std::printf("  ps4_connect error: %s\n", res.dump().c_str());
        CHECK(res.value("connected", false) == true);
        CHECK(res.value("attached", false) == true);
        CHECK(res.value("pid", 0) == kFakePid);
        REQUIRE_STR_EQ(res.value("name", ""), "eboot.bin");
        CHECK(slop::core::runtime::active_kind() == backend_kind_t::ps4);

        // threads over MCP while attached
        bool is_err2 = false;
        json tres = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "threads"}}, is_err2);
        CHECK(!is_err2);
        CHECK(tres.value("count", 0) == 2);

        json dres = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "ps4_disconnect"}}, is_err2);
        CHECK(!is_err2);
        CHECK(dres.value("connected", true) == false);
    }
    CHECK(!slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4_active());
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_connect_refuses_non_ps4debug_server) {
    // a plain TCP listener that never speaks the protocol must fail the handshake
    wsa();
    SOCKET ls = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    REQUIRE(ls != INVALID_SOCKET);
    sockaddr_in addr{};
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    addr.sin_port = 0;
    REQUIRE(bind(ls, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), sizeof(addr)) == 0);
    REQUIRE(listen(ls, 1) == 0);
    slop_socklen_t len = sizeof(addr);
    getsockname(ls, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), &len);
    const uint16_t port = ntohs(addr.sin_port);
    std::atomic<bool> stop{false};
    std::thread th([&] {
        while (!stop) {
            fd_set rset;
            FD_ZERO(&rset);
            FD_SET(ls, &rset);
            timeval tv{0, 100 * 1000};
            if (select(0, &rset, nullptr, nullptr, &tv) <= 0) continue;
            SOCKET c = accept(ls, nullptr, nullptr);
            if (c == INVALID_SOCKET) continue;
            char buf[64];
            ::recv(c, buf, sizeof(buf), 0);   // swallow the handshake, say nothing
            closesocket(c);
        }
    });

    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    CHECK(!b.connect("127.0.0.1", port, err));
    CHECK(!err.empty());
    CHECK(!b.connected());

    stop = true;
    ::shutdown(ls, SD_BOTH);
    closesocket(ls);
    th.join();
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_consoles_crud_persists_and_validates) {
    scratch_settings_t cfg;
    bool e = false;

    json saved = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target",
        {{"action", "consoles_save"},
         {"name", "devkit-a"},
         {"host", "127.0.0.1"},
         {"port", 744},
         {"notes", "primary devkit"},
         {"default_pid", kFakePid},
         {"title_filter", "eboot"},
         {"auto_connect", true},
         {"profile", {{"watchlist", "a-set"}, {"scan_width", "u32"}, {"scan_kind", "changed"}}}},
        e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(saved.value("saved", false));
    CHECK(saved["console"].value("name", "") == "devkit-a");
    CHECK(saved["console"].value("default_pid", 0u) == kFakePid);
    CHECK(saved["console"]["profile"].value("scan_width", "") == "u32");

    // upsert: the same name replaces instead of appending
    saved = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target",
        {{"action", "consoles_save"}, {"name", "devkit-a"}, {"host", "10.0.0.9"},
         {"port", 745}, {"notes", "moved"}},
        e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    json listed = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_list"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(listed.value("count", 0) == 1);
    CHECK(listed["consoles"][0].value("host", "") == "10.0.0.9");
    CHECK(listed["consoles"][0].value("port", 0) == 745);
    CHECK(listed["consoles"][0].value("notes", "") == "moved");
    CHECK(listed.value("active", "x").empty());

    // invalid endpoint values are refused, the list is untouched
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target", {{"action", "consoles_save"}, {"name", "bad name"}, {"host", "1.2.3.4"}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    e = false;
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target", {{"action", "consoles_save"}, {"name", "empty-host"}, {"host", ""}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    e = false;
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target", {{"action", "consoles_save"}, {"name", "bad-port"}, {"host", "1.2.3.4"},
                   {"port", 70000}},
        e);
    CHECK(e);
    e = false;
    listed = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_list"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(listed.value("count", 0) == 1);

    // persisted: the settings file holds the list and a reload reads it back
    const json raw = slop::core::infra::settings::get_json("target_consoles");
    REQUIRE(raw.is_array());
    CHECK(raw.size() == 1);
    slop::core::infra::settings::load();
    listed = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_list"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(listed.value("count", 0) == 1);
    CHECK(listed["consoles"][0].value("name", "") == "devkit-a");

    // remove drops the endpoint and its watchlist set
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_remove"}, {"name", "devkit-a"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    listed = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_list"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(listed.value("count", 0) == 0);
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_remove"}, {"name", "devkit-a"}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_consoles_switch_between_two_consoles_restores_profile) {
    scratch_settings_t cfg;
    server_guard_t a;
    server_guard_t b;
    ps4_disconnect_guard_t guard;
    bool e = false;

    // two saved consoles, each with its own profile
    for (const auto& [name, port, set, width, kind] :
         {std::tuple{"devkit-a", a.srv.port, "a-set", "u32", "changed"},
          std::tuple{"devkit-b", b.srv.port, "b-set", "f32", "exact"}}) {
        slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
            "target",
            {{"action", "consoles_save"},
             {"name", name},
             {"host", "127.0.0.1"},
             {"port", port},
             {"default_pid", kFakePid},
             {"profile",
              {{"watchlist", set}, {"scan_width", width}, {"scan_kind", kind}}}},
            e);
        REQUIRE(!e);
    }

    // switch to A: connects, attaches its default pid, applies its scan defaults
    json sw = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target", {{"action", "consoles_switch"}, {"name", "devkit-a"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  switch a: %s\n", sw.dump().c_str());
    CHECK(sw.value("switched", false));
    CHECK(sw.value("name", "") == "devkit-a");
    CHECK(sw.value("attached", false));
    CHECK(sw.value("pid", 0u) == kFakePid);
    CHECK(sw.value("endpoint", "") == "127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(a.srv.port));
    CHECK(sw["profile"].value("scan_width", "") == "u32");
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::consoles::active() == "devkit-a");
    json st = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "status"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(st.value("console", "") == "devkit-a");

    // the fake payload connects its debug channel back to the fixture's own
    // ephemeral port, not the machine-global 755
    REQUIRE(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4() != nullptr);
    slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4()->set_event_port(a.srv.event_port);

    // a watch entry and an armed breakpoint belong to A
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "memory", {{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", 0x400200}, {"width", "u32"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(slop::core::memory::watch::size() == 1);
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool("debugger", {{"action", "ps4_attach"}, {"pid", kFakePid}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool("debugger", {{"action", "ps4_bp_set"}, {"addr", 0x400500}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    REQUIRE(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4() != nullptr);
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4()->ps4_breakpoints().size() == 1);

    // switch to B: the session, the debugger slots and the watchlist go, B's
    // profile comes back (empty set + its scan defaults)
    sw = slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target", {{"action", "consoles_switch"}, {"name", "devkit-b"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    if (e) std::printf("  switch b: %s\n", sw.dump().c_str());
    CHECK(sw.value("previous", "") == "devkit-a");
    CHECK(sw.value("pid", 0u) == kFakePid);
    CHECK(sw.value("endpoint", "") == "127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(b.srv.port));
    CHECK(sw.value("watchlist_entries", 99) == 0);
    CHECK(sw["profile"].value("scan_width", "") == "f32");
    CHECK(sw["profile"].value("scan_kind", "") == "exact");
    CHECK(slop::core::memory::watch::size() == 0);
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4()->ps4_breakpoints().empty());
    json scan = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("memory", {{"action", "scan_state"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(scan.value("width", "") == "f32");
    CHECK(scan.value("kind", "") == "exact");

    // B gets its own watch entry, then switching back restores A's set
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "memory", {{"action", "watch_add"}, {"addr", 0x500000}, {"width", "u8"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool(
        "target", {{"action", "consoles_switch"}, {"name", "devkit-a"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    CHECK(slop::core::memory::watch::size() == 1);
    const auto entries = slop::core::memory::watch::list();
    REQUIRE(entries.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(entries[0].addr == 0x400200);
    CHECK(entries[0].width == slop::core::memory::value_width_t::u32);
    // A was last seen on its own port, and the switch recorded firmware
    json listed = slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_list"}}, e);
    REQUIRE(!e);
    bool saw_fw = false;
    for (const auto& c : listed["consoles"]) {
        if (c.value("name", "") != "devkit-a") continue;
        saw_fw = c.value("last_fw", "") == "11.00";
        CHECK(c.value("active", false));
        CHECK(c.value("last_seen_ms", int64_t{0}) > 0);
    }
    CHECK(saw_fw);

    // switching to an unknown name fails without dropping the live console
    slop::core::mcp::call_tool("target", {{"action", "consoles_switch"}, {"name", "nope"}}, e);
    CHECK(e);
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::registry_ps4_active());
    CHECK(slop::core::process::active_session() != nullptr);
}

// The CMD_PROC_LIST reply body decoder is pure (no socket), so it is also the
// ps4debug-NG reply parser the fuzz target drives. A short or garbage body
// must never read past the buffer.
TEST_CASE(ps4_parse_proc_list_body) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> body;
    const auto append = [&body](const char* name, int32_t pid) {
        ps4::proc_list_entry_t e{};
        std::strncpy(e.p_comm, name, sizeof(e.p_comm) - 1);
        e.pid = pid;
        const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&e);
        body.insert(body.end(), p, p + sizeof(e));
    };
    append("eboot.bin", 1234);
    append("SceShellUI", 42);

    auto procs = slop::core::runtime::ps4_parse_proc_list(body.data(), body.size());
    REQUIRE(procs.size() == 2u);
    CHECK(procs[0].pid == 1234u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(procs[0].name, "eboot.bin");
    CHECK(procs[0].arch == slop::core::runtime::arch_t::x64);
    CHECK(procs[1].pid == 42u);
    REQUIRE_STR_EQ(procs[1].name, "SceShellUI");

    // a trailing partial entry is ignored, not decoded from a short read
    body.push_back(0xAA);
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::ps4_parse_proc_list(body.data(), body.size()).size() == 2u);
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::ps4_parse_proc_list(body.data(), 0).empty());
    CHECK(slop::core::runtime::ps4_parse_proc_list(nullptr, 0).empty());

    // an unterminated p_comm stops at the field boundary
    std::vector<uint8_t> full(sizeof(ps4::proc_list_entry_t), 'A');
    procs = slop::core::runtime::ps4_parse_proc_list(full.data(), full.size());
    REQUIRE(procs.size() == 1u);
    REQUIRE(procs[0].name.size() == sizeof(ps4::proc_list_entry_t::p_comm));
}
```

`src/tests/test_ps4_chaos.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/tests/test_ps4_chaos.cpp
// PS4 (ps4debug-NG) tests against the fake payload in ps4_fixture.hpp:
// wire fault injection, reconnect, event reassembly, slots and the console composites.

#include "ps4_fixture.hpp"

TEST_CASE(ps4_io_error_strings) {
    CHECK(ps4::io_error_str(ps4::kErrNotConnected).find("not connected") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(ps4::io_error_str(ps4::kErrTimeout).find("did not answer in time") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(ps4::io_error_str(ps4::kErrDataNull).find("CMD_DATA_NULL") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(ps4::io_error_str(ps4::kErrNoSlot).find("no free slot") != std::string::npos);
    // local backend Win32 codes get the system text
    CHECK(ps4::io_error_str(ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED).find("Win32 error 5") == 0);
    CHECK(ps4::io_error_str(0xE00000FFu).find("0xE00000FF") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(ps4::status_to_err(ps4::CMD_ALREADY_DEBUG) == ps4::kErrAlreadyDebug);
    CHECK(ps4::status_to_err(0x12345678u) == ps4::kErrProtocol);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_chaos_fragmented_replies_still_work) {
    // every reply leaves the fake in 1..3-byte pieces: headers, status words
    // and payloads all arrive split
    server_guard_t g;
    g.srv.chaos.fragment = true;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    CHECK(b.fw_string() == "11.00");
    CHECK(b.ps4_authed());
    auto procs = b.enum_processes();
    REQUIRE(procs.ok);
    CHECK(procs.items.size() == 2u);
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());
    std::vector<uint8_t> data(300);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < data.size(); ++i) data[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>(i * 13);
    REQUIRE(b.write_memory(h, 0x7FFF00000100ull, data.data(), data.size()).ok);
    std::vector<uint8_t> back(data.size());
    REQUIRE(b.read_memory(h, 0x7FFF00000100ull, back.data(), back.size()).ok);
    CHECK(back == data);
    CHECK(b.connected());
    b.detach(h);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_chaos_peer_close_drops_socket_and_reconnect_restores) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());
    REQUIRE(b.ps4_debug_attach(kFakePid, err));
    uint32_t bpi = 0, wpi = 0;
    REQUIRE(b.ps4_bp_arm(0x400500, backend_ps4_t::kAutoSlot, bpi).ok);
    REQUIRE(b.ps4_wp_arm(0x7FFF00001000ull, 8, ps4::kWpWrite, backend_ps4_t::kAutoSlot, wpi).ok);

    // the console drops the connection in the middle of a read reply
    g.srv.chaos.close_after = 6;   // status word + 2 data bytes, then the cut
    g.srv.chaos.close_cmd = ps4::CMD_PROC_READ;
    uint8_t buf[64]{};
    auto io = b.read_memory(h, 0x400000, buf, sizeof(buf));
    CHECK(!io.ok);
    CHECK(io.error == ps4::kErrRecvFailed);
    CHECK(!b.connected());
    CHECK(b.lost());
    CHECK(b.drop_count() == 1u);
    CHECK(!b.lost_reason().empty());
    CHECK(!b.ps4_debug_attached());   // the payload drops debug state per connection
    // slots are kept for the reconnect but are not armed right now
    auto bps = b.ps4_breakpoints();
    REQUIRE(bps.size() == 1u);
    if (bps.size() != 1u)
        std::printf("  chaos: bps.size=%zu wps.size=%zu\n", bps.size(), b.ps4_watchpoints().size());
    CHECK(!bps[0].armed);

    // every later call fails fast instead of paying another timeout
    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    io = b.read_memory(h, 0x400000, buf, sizeof(buf));
    CHECK(!io.ok);
    CHECK(io.error == ps4::kErrNotConnected);
    CHECK(!b.ping());
    CHECK(ms_since(t0) < 500);

    // reconnect: handshake + auth again, debuggee re-attached, slots re-armed
    backend_ps4_t::reconnect_report_t rep;
    REQUIRE(b.reconnect(err, &rep));
    CHECK(b.connected());
    CHECK(!b.lost());
    CHECK(rep.authed);
    CHECK(rep.debug_pid == kFakePid);
    CHECK(rep.debug_restored);
    CHECK(rep.bp_rearmed == 1u);
    CHECK(rep.wp_rearmed == 1u);
    CHECK(rep.bp_failed == 0u);
    CHECK(b.ps4_debug_attached());
    CHECK(g.srv.connections == 2);
    CHECK(g.srv.bps[bpi].enabled);
    CHECK(g.srv.bps[bpi].address == 0x400500);
    CHECK(g.srv.wps[wpi].enabled);
    CHECK(g.srv.wps[wpi].address == 0x7FFF00001000ull);
    bps = b.ps4_breakpoints();
    REQUIRE(bps.size() == 1u);
    CHECK(bps[0].armed);
    // the handle from before the drop keeps working
    REQUIRE(b.read_memory(h, 0x400000, buf, sizeof(buf)).ok);
    b.detach(h);
    b.disconnect();
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_chaos_stall_hits_idle_timeout) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());
    // the tight command budget is for the stall below; the handshake above
    // runs with the default budget so a loaded machine cannot time it out
    b.set_timeouts(250, 2000, 2000);
    g.srv.chaos.stall_cmd = ps4::CMD_PROC_WRITE;   // the payload never answers
    const uint8_t v[4] = {1, 2, 3, 4};
    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    auto io = b.write_memory(h, 0x7FFF00000000ull, v, sizeof(v));
    CHECK(!io.ok);
    CHECK(io.error == ps4::kErrTimeout);
    CHECK(ms_since(t0) < 1500);
    CHECK(!b.connected());
    // a fresh connection serves again
    std::string rerr;
    REQUIRE(b.reconnect(rerr));
    CHECK(b.ping());
    b.detach(h);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_chaos_dribble_hits_command_deadline) {
    // one byte every 40 ms never trips the 250 ms idle timeout, but the whole
    // command budget (600 ms) stops it instead of stalling for minutes
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());
    b.set_timeouts(250, 600, 600);
    std::vector<uint8_t> warm(16);
    // fill the maps cache first so only the read itself is dribbled
    REQUIRE(b.read_memory(h, 0x400000, warm.data(), warm.size()).ok);
    g.srv.chaos.dribble_ms = 40;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buf(512);
    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    auto io = b.read_memory(h, 0x400000, buf.data(), buf.size());
    const int64_t took = ms_since(t0);
    CHECK(!io.ok);
    CHECK(io.error == ps4::kErrTimeout);
    CHECK(took >= 400);
    CHECK(took < 3000);
    CHECK(!b.connected());
    g.srv.chaos.dribble_ms = 0;
    b.detach(h);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_chaos_garbage_status_is_protocol_error) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    auto h = b.attach(kFakePid);
    REQUIRE(h.valid());
    // a word that is no status at all means the stream is misaligned
    g.srv.chaos.garbage_cmd = ps4::CMD_PROC_WRITE;
    const uint8_t v[2] = {9, 9};
    auto io = b.write_memory(h, 0x7FFF00000000ull, v, sizeof(v));
    CHECK(!io.ok);
    CHECK(io.error == ps4::kErrProtocol);
    CHECK(!b.connected());
    CHECK(b.lost_reason().find("desync") != std::string::npos);
    // a non-success *status* is a clean error that keeps the connection
    REQUIRE(b.reconnect(err));
    auto bad = b.attach(9999);   // CMD_PROC_INFO -> CMD_ERROR, list fallback misses
    CHECK(!bad.valid());
    CHECK(b.connected());
    b.detach(h);
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_disasm_region_drains_to_sentinel) {
    server_guard_t g;
    g.srv.chaos.disasm_extra = 50;   // the payload streams past max_entries
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    std::vector<backend_ps4_t::ps4_disasm_entry_t> out;

    REQUIRE(io.ok);
    CHECK(out.size() == 10u);
    CHECK(truncated);
    // the stream is still aligned: the next command parses cleanly
    CHECK(b.ping());
    CHECK(b.connected());
    io = b.ps4_disasm_region(kFakePid, 0x400000, 0x100, 100, out, &truncated);
    REQUIRE(io.ok);
    CHECK(out.size() == 52u);
    CHECK(!truncated);
    CHECK(b.ping());
}

TEST_CASE(ps4_read_stack_truncated_bundle_reports_error) {
    server_guard_t g;
    backend_ps4_t b;
    std::string err;
    REQUIRE(connect_fake(b, g.srv, err));
    // two-frame chain at 0x7FFF00007FF0 -> 0x7FFF00008100 -> 0
    uint64_t v = 0x7FFF00008100ull;
    g.srv.mem_write(0x7FFF00007FF0ull, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&v), 8);
    v = 0x400111;
    g.srv.mem_write(0x7FFF00007FF8ull, reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&v), 8);
    std::vector<backend_ps4_t::ps4_stack_frame_t> frames;
    auto io = b.ps4_read_stack(kFakePid, 0x7FFF00007FF0ull, 0x7FFF00007F00ull, 8, frames);
    REQUIRE(io.ok);
    const size_t full = frames.size();
    CHECK(full >= 2u);
    g.srv.chaos.stack_truncate = true;   // bundle claims one frame more than it holds
    io = b.ps4_read_stack(kFakePid, 0x7FFF00007FF0ull, 0x7FFF00007F00ull, 8, frames);
    CHECK(!io.ok);
    CHECK(io.error == ps4::kErrProtocol);
    CHECK(frames.size() == full);   // what parsed is kept
    CHECK(b.connected());           // the bundle was consumed: stream in sync
    CHECK(b.ping());
}
```
