`tools/check_binaries.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/check_binaries.ps1
# Release-artifact hardening gate: every shipped .exe must carry the
# mitigation flags we build with, and must not import or expose anything the
# build does not expect (a new import or section means a new dependency, a
# dropped /MT, or code injected after the build).
#
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/check_binaries.ps1 -Path build\src\engine\reverse-slop-engine.exe
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/check_binaries.ps1 -Path dist\SlopStation\SlopStation.exe -AllowImport KERNEL32.dll,USER32.dll
#
# Runs in release.yml before publish. Needs dumpbin (the Visual Studio C++
# toolset), located through vswhere like tools/build.ps1.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]]$Path,
    [string[]]$AllowImport = @(
        'ADVAPI32.dll', 'bcrypt.dll', 'CRYPT32.dll', 'dbghelp.dll', 'GDI32.dll',
        'IPHLPAPI.DLL', 'KERNEL32.dll', 'ncrypt.dll', 'ole32.dll', 'Secur32.dll',
        'SHELL32.dll', 'USER32.dll', 'WS2_32.dll'
    ),
    [string[]]$AllowSection = @('.text', '.rdata', '.data', '.pdata', '.fptable', '.rsrc', '.reloc'),
    # DllCharacteristics lines dumpbin prints for the flags we require
    [string[]]$RequireFlag = @(
        # no 'Control Flow Guard' / 'CET compatible': the Unicorn JIT executes
        # generated code that neither mitigation can validate, see SECURITY.md
        'Dynamic base', 'NX compatible', 'High Entropy Virtual Addresses'
    ),
    [string]$VsRoot = $env:SLOP_VS_ROOT
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

if (-not $VsRoot) {
    $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) {
        $VsRoot = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath
    }
}
if (-not $VsRoot -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $VsRoot 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'))) {
    throw 'Visual Studio with C++ tools not found (pass -VsRoot or set SLOP_VS_ROOT)'
}
$vcvars = Join-Path $VsRoot 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'
cmd /c "call `"$vcvars`" > NUL 2>&1 && set" | ForEach-Object {
    if ($_ -match '^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$') {
        Set-Item -Path ("Env:" + $Matches[1]) -Value $Matches[2]
    }
}

$problems = @()
foreach ($file in $Path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file)) { throw "binary not found: $file" }
    $file = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($file)
    Write-Host "==> $file"

    $headers = & dumpbin /nologo /headers $file
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dumpbin /headers failed for $file" }
    $imports = & dumpbin /nologo /imports $file
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dumpbin /imports failed for $file" }

    $text = ($headers -join "`n")
    foreach ($flag in $RequireFlag) {
        if ($text -notmatch [regex]::Escape($flag)) {
            $problems += "$file : missing mitigation flag '$flag'"
        }
    }

    # "   .text name" -> .text  (section names are the only lines ending in " name")
    $sections = @($headers | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*(\.[A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s+name\s*$' } |
        ForEach-Object { $Matches[1] })
    foreach ($s in $sections) {
        if ($AllowSection -notcontains $s) { $problems += "$file : unexpected section '$s'" }
    }

    # import table entries: "    KERNEL32.dll" (delay imports print the same way)
    $dlls = @($imports | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s{4}([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.dll)\s*$' } |
        ForEach-Object { $Matches[1] } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($dlls.Count -eq 0) { $problems += "$file : no imports parsed (dumpbin output format changed?)" }
    foreach ($d in $dlls) {
        if ($AllowImport -notcontains $d) { $problems += "$file : unexpected import '$d'" }
    }

    Write-Host ("    flags:    " + (($RequireFlag | Where-Object { $text -match [regex]::Escape($_) }) -join ', '))
    Write-Host ("    sections: " + ($sections -join ' '))
    Write-Host ("    imports:  " + ($dlls -join ' '))
}

if ($problems.Count -gt 0) {
    $problems | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "FAIL: $_" }
    throw "$($problems.Count) binary hardening problem(s)"
}
Write-Host "==> every binary carries the required mitigations and imports nothing unexpected"

```

`tools/ci_timings.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][long]$RunId,
    # owner/name; defaults to this checkout's `origin` remote
    [string]$Repository = '',
    [string]$OutputPath
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not $Repository) {
    $origin = & git -C (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) remote get-url origin 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $origin -notmatch 'github\.com[:/]([^/]+/[^/]+?)(\.git)?/?$') {
        throw 'cannot derive the GitHub repository from the origin remote; pass -Repository owner/name'
    }
    $Repository = $Matches[1]
}
$base = "https://api.github.com/repos/$Repository/actions/runs/$RunId"
$run = Invoke-RestMethod $base
$jobs = @()
for ($page = 1; ; $page++) {
    $batch = Invoke-RestMethod "$base/jobs?per_page=100&page=$page"
    $jobs += $batch.jobs
    if ($batch.jobs.Count -lt 100) { break }
}
$rows = @($jobs | ForEach-Object {
    $job = $_
    [ordered]@{
        name = $job.name
        conclusion = $job.conclusion
        seconds = if ($job.completed_at) {
            ([datetime]$job.completed_at - [datetime]$job.started_at).TotalSeconds
        } else { $null }
        steps = @($job.steps | ForEach-Object {
            [ordered]@{
                name = $_.name
                conclusion = $_.conclusion
                seconds = if ($_.started_at -and $_.completed_at) {
                    ([datetime]$_.completed_at - [datetime]$_.started_at).TotalSeconds
                } else { $null }
            }
        })
    }
})
$result = [ordered]@{
    run_id = $RunId
    sha = $run.head_sha
    url = $run.html_url
    status = $run.status
    conclusion = $run.conclusion
    # End at the last job, not updated_at (which can change after completion).
    elapsed_seconds = if ($run.status -eq 'completed' -and $jobs.Count) {
        $end = ($jobs | Where-Object completed_at | Sort-Object completed_at | Select-Object -Last 1).completed_at
        ([datetime]$end - [datetime]$run.created_at).TotalSeconds
    } else { $null }
    jobs = $rows
}
$json = $result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
if ($OutputPath) { $json | Set-Content -LiteralPath $OutputPath }
$json

```

`tools/clang_tidy.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Build tree with compile_commands.json (CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS is on)
    [string]$BuildDir = '',
    # Regex over repo-relative source paths to analyze (first-party code only)
    [string]$Include = '^src/(core|engine|ui|app|live|target|tests)/.*\.(cpp|cc|cxx)$',
    [int]$Jobs = [Environment]::ProcessorCount,
    # clang-tidy.exe; defaults to the one shipped with Visual Studio's LLVM tools
    [string]$ClangTidy = ''
)
# Runs clang-tidy (config: .clang-tidy) over every first-party translation unit
# in compile_commands.json, in parallel. Exits 1 when any file produces an
# error-level finding (WarningsAsErrors) or clang-tidy fails on a file.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $BuildDir) { $BuildDir = Join-Path $root 'build' }
$db = Join-Path $BuildDir 'compile_commands.json'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $db)) { throw "missing ${db}: configure the build first" }

if (-not $ClangTidy) {
    $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
    $vs = & $vswhere -latest -products * -property installationPath
    $ClangTidy = Join-Path $vs 'VC\Tools\Llvm\x64\bin\clang-tidy.exe'
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ClangTidy)) {
    throw "clang-tidy not found at $ClangTidy (install the VS 'C++ Clang tools' component or pass -ClangTidy)"
}

$rootNorm = $root.Replace('\', '/').TrimEnd('/') + '/'
$files = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $db -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object {
    $f = $_.file.Replace('\', '/')
    $rel = if ($f.StartsWith($rootNorm, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $f.Substring($rootNorm.Length) } else { $f }
    if ($rel -match $Include) { $f }
} | Sort-Object -Unique)
if ($files.Count -eq 0) { throw "no translation unit matched '$Include'" }
Write-Host "==> clang-tidy: $($files.Count) files, $Jobs jobs, $ClangTidy"

$results = $files | ForEach-Object -ThrottleLimit $Jobs -Parallel {
    $out = & $using:ClangTidy -p $using:BuildDir --quiet $_ 2>&1 | Out-String
    [pscustomobject]@{ File = $_; Exit = $LASTEXITCODE; Output = $out }
}

$failed = 0
$warnings = 0
foreach ($r in $results | Sort-Object File) {
    $text = $r.Output.Trim()
    $warnings += ([regex]::Matches($text, ': warning: ')).Count
    if ($r.Exit -ne 0) {
        $failed++
        Write-Host "::group::FAIL $($r.File)"
        Write-Host $text
        Write-Host '::endgroup::'
    } elseif ($text -match ': warning: ') {
        Write-Host "::group::warnings $($r.File)"
        Write-Host $text
        Write-Host '::endgroup::'
    }
}
Write-Host "==> clang-tidy: $($files.Count) files, $warnings warnings, $failed files with errors"
if ($failed -gt 0) { exit 1 }

```

`tools/clean.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/clean.ps1
# Drops the generated trees that pile up in a checkout: the CMake build dirs
# (one per preset) and the dependency sub-builds. Downloaded dependency
# sources in _ext\*-src are kept unless -All is passed, so the next build does
# not re-download them.
#
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/clean.ps1            # build trees only
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/clean.ps1 -All       # + deps sources, node_modules, cargo target
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/clean.ps1 -DryRun    # print what would go

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # also drop _ext\*-src, app\node_modules, app\src-tauri\target and the
    # release/coverage scratch files (a full re-fetch on the next build)
    [switch]$All,
    [switch]$DryRun
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

$targets = @()

# CMake build dirs: build\ plus one build-<preset>\ per non-release preset
$targets += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $repoRoot -Directory -Filter 'build*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'build' -or $_.Name -like 'build-*' })

$ext = Join-Path $repoRoot '_ext'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ext) {
    $targets += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ext -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*-build' -or $_.Name -like '*-subbuild' })
    if ($All) {
        $targets += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ext -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*-src' })
    }
}

if ($All) {
    foreach ($rel in @('app\node_modules', 'app\src-tauri\target', 'dist', '_release', 'fuzz-artifacts')) {
        $p = Join-Path $repoRoot $rel
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $targets += Get-Item -LiteralPath $p }
    }
    foreach ($rel in @('coverage.xml', 'analyze.log', 'mcp_live_results.json')) {
        $p = Join-Path $repoRoot $rel
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $targets += Get-Item -LiteralPath $p }
    }
}

if ($targets.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host 'nothing to clean'
    return
}

$freed = 0L
foreach ($t in ($targets | Sort-Object FullName -Unique)) {
    $size = if ($t.PSIsContainer) {
        (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $t.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    } else { $t.Length }
    if (-not $size) { $size = 0 }
    $freed += $size
    $rel = $t.FullName.Substring($repoRoot.Length).TrimStart('\')
    if ($DryRun) {
        Write-Host ("would remove {0} ({1:N1} MB)" -f $rel, ($size / 1MB))
    } else {
        Write-Host ("removing {0} ({1:N1} MB)" -f $rel, ($size / 1MB))
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t.FullName -Recurse -Force
    }
}
$verb = if ($DryRun) { 'would free' } else { 'freed' }
Write-Host ("{0} {1:N1} GB" -f $verb, ($freed / 1GB))

param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Baseline,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Candidate
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$before = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Baseline -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$after = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Candidate -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach ($row in $before.workloads) {
    $next = @($after.workloads | Where-Object name -EQ $row.name)
    if ($next.Count -ne 1) { throw "Missing or duplicate workload: $($row.name)" }
    $next = $next[0]
    if ($row.result -ne $next.result) { throw "Result changed: $($row.name)" }
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Workload = $row.name
        BeforeMs = $row.median_ms
        AfterMs = $next.median_ms
        Speedup = [Math]::Round($row.median_ms / $next.median_ms, 2)
        BeforeBytes = $row.allocated_bytes
        AfterBytes = $next.allocated_bytes
    }
}

`tools/coverage_ratchet.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/coverage_ratchet.ps1
# Line-coverage ratchet for src/core, fed by the Cobertura report the nightly
# coverage lane produces (OpenCppCoverage over a Debug build).
#
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/coverage_ratchet.ps1 -Cobertura coverage.xml
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/coverage_ratchet.ps1 -Cobertura coverage.xml -Update
#
# The baseline lives in docs/coverage-baseline.txt. A run fails when src/core
# line coverage drops more than -Tolerance points below it; -Update rewrites
# the baseline after an intentional improvement.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Cobertura = 'coverage.xml',
    [string]$Baseline = 'docs/coverage-baseline.txt',
    [double]$Tolerance = 0.5,
    # only files under this path fragment count (the report also covers src/ui,
    # src/engine, ... — the ratchet is on the core library)
    [string]$Scope = '\src\core\',
    [switch]$Update
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Cobertura)) { throw "coverage report not found: $Cobertura" }

[xml]$doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Cobertura
$pattern = [regex]::Escape($Scope)
$classes = @($doc.SelectNodes('//class'))
if ($classes.Count -eq 0) { throw "$Cobertura has no <class> entries (not a Cobertura report?)" }

$valid = 0
$covered = 0
$files = 0
foreach ($c in $classes) {
    if (-not $c.filename -or $c.filename -notmatch $pattern) { continue }
    $files++
    foreach ($line in $c.SelectNodes('lines/line')) {
        $valid++
        if ([int]$line.hits -gt 0) { $covered++ }
    }
}
if ($valid -eq 0) { throw "no instrumented lines under $Scope in $Cobertura" }

$pct = [math]::Round(100.0 * $covered / $valid, 2)
Write-Host "src/core line coverage: $pct% ($covered/$valid lines, $files files)"

$summary = $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
if ($summary) { "### src/core line coverage: $pct%" | Add-Content -LiteralPath $summary }

$baselinePct = 0.0
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Baseline) {
    $m = Select-String -LiteralPath $Baseline -Pattern '^\s*core_line_coverage\s*=\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*$'
    if ($m) { $baselinePct = [double]$m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value }
}
$floor = [math]::Round($baselinePct - $Tolerance, 2)

if ($Update) {
    $text = @(
        '# Line coverage of src/core, measured by the nightly coverage lane',
        '# (tools/coverage_ratchet.ps1 over the OpenCppCoverage Cobertura report).',
        '# A run fails when the value drops more than 0.5 points below this one;',
        '# raise it with -Update after an intentional improvement.',
        "core_line_coverage = $pct"
    ) -join "`n"
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $Baseline -Value ($text + "`n") -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline
    Write-Host "baseline updated: $pct%"
    exit 0
}

if ($baselinePct -le 0) {
    Write-Host "no baseline yet (core_line_coverage = 0); commit this value to ${Baseline}:"
    Write-Host "  powershell -NoProfile -File tools/coverage_ratchet.ps1 -Cobertura $Cobertura -Update"
    exit 0
}

if ($pct -lt $floor) {
    throw "src/core line coverage dropped to $pct% (baseline $baselinePct%, floor $floor%): " +
          "add tests for the new code, or re-baseline with -Update if the drop is intentional"
}
Write-Host "ok: $pct% >= floor $floor% (baseline $baselinePct%)"
if ($pct -gt $baselinePct) {
    Write-Host "coverage improved; re-baseline with -Update to lock it in"
}

```

`tools/dep_hash.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # One or more archive URLs (FetchContent URL lines in cmake/deps.cmake)
    [Parameter(Mandatory, ValueFromRemainingArguments)][string[]]$Url
)
# Prints the `URL_HASH SHA256=...` line for each URL so a dependency bump in
# cmake/deps.cmake can update URL and hash together.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$tmp = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "slop-dep-hash-$PID"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
try {
    foreach ($u in $Url) {
        $file = Join-Path $tmp ([IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName())
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -OutFile $file -UseBasicParsing
        $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
        Write-Output "$u"
        Write-Output "    URL_HASH SHA256=$hash"
    }
} finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

`tools/fetch_ps4debug.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/fetch_ps4debug.ps1
# Fetch the latest ps4debug-NG release payload for bundling. The release job
# runs this before the Tauri bundle, so every build carries the newest payload
# without pinning a tag in the repo.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Re-download even when the manifest already names the latest tag
    [switch]$Force,
    # Destination directory (default: build/ps4debug-ng)
    [string]$OutDir = ''
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $OutDir) { $OutDir = Join-Path $repoRoot 'build/ps4debug-ng' }
$api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG/releases/latest'
$headers = @{ 'User-Agent' = 'SlopStation-build'; 'Accept' = 'application/vnd.github+json' }
# CI passes the workflow token: unauthenticated runner IPs share a 60/h limit.
if ($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) { $headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer $env:GITHUB_TOKEN" }

Write-Host "==> ps4debug-NG: querying $api"
$release = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $api -Headers $headers
$tag = [string]$release.tag_name
if (-not $tag) { throw 'ps4debug-NG latest release has no tag' }

$asset = @($release.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match '\.bin$' } | Select-Object -First 1)
if ($asset.Count -ne 1) {
    throw "ps4debug-NG $tag has no .bin asset (assets: $((@($release.assets | ForEach-Object name)) -join ', '))"
}
$asset = $asset[0]

$manifestPath = Join-Path $OutDir 'manifest.json'
if (-not $Force -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) {
    $old = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $bin = Join-Path $OutDir 'ps4debug-ng.bin'
    if ($old.tag -eq $tag -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bin)) {
        Write-Host "==> ps4debug-NG $tag already staged"
        exit 0
    }
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null
$binPath = Join-Path $OutDir 'ps4debug-ng.bin'
Write-Host "==> ps4debug-NG ${tag}: $($asset.name) ($([math]::Round($asset.size / 1MB, 1)) MB)"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $asset.browser_download_url -Headers $headers -OutFile $binPath -UseBasicParsing

# GPLv3 payload: ship the license text and the source pointer next to it.
$licensePath = Join-Path $OutDir 'LICENSE.ps4debug-NG.txt'
try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG/master/LICENSE.txt' -Headers $headers -OutFile $licensePath -UseBasicParsing
} catch {
    Write-Warning "could not fetch the ps4debug-NG license: $($_.Exception.Message)"
}

$sha = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $binPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$manifest = [ordered]@{
    repo         = 'Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG'
    tag          = $tag
    name         = [string]$release.name
    published_at = [string]$release.published_at
    asset        = [string]$asset.name
    url          = [string]$asset.browser_download_url
    sha256       = $sha
    fetched_at   = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
    license      = 'GPL-3.0'
    source       = 'https://github.com/Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG'
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($manifestPath, ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Write-Host "==> ps4debug-NG ${tag} staged: $binPath (sha256 $sha)"

```

`tools/gen_help_index.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// tools/gen_help_index.mjs — build the in-app help search index from docs/**/*.md.
//
//   node tools/gen_help_index.mjs                       JSON on stdout
//   node tools/gen_help_index.mjs --out <path>          write a file instead
//   node tools/gen_help_index.mjs --base /SlopStation/  prefix every url (Pages sub-path)
//
// Output contract: docs/help-index.md. Entries follow SUMMARY.md order, anchors follow
// mdBook's slug rules so `url` opens the right heading on the built site.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const repo = path.resolve(here, "..");
const SRC = path.join(repo, "docs");
const EXCERPT = 240;

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (name, fallback = null) => {
  const i = args.indexOf(name);
  return i >= 0 && i + 1 < args.length ? args[i + 1] : fallback;
};
const OUT = opt("--out");
const BASE = opt("--base", "");

// mdBook's anchor rule: keep letters/digits/_/-/space, drop everything else, lowercase,
// spaces to '-', then de-duplicate with -1, -2, ... per page.
function slug(text, seen) {
  let s = text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s_-]/gu, "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-");
  if (s === "") s = "section";
  const n = seen.get(s) ?? 0;
  seen.set(s, n + 1);
  return n === 0 ? s : `${s}-${n}`;
}

// markdown -> the text a reader sees: drop code fences, images, link targets and emphasis
function plain(md) {
  return md
    .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, " ")
    .replace(/!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)/g, " ")
    .replace(/\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/[`*_>#|]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function summaryOrder() {
  const file = path.join(SRC, "SUMMARY.md");
  if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return [];
  return [...fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").matchAll(/\]\(([^)]+\.md)\)/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
}

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.name === "book" || e.name.startsWith(".")) continue;
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p, out);
    else if (e.name.endsWith(".md") && e.name !== "SUMMARY.md") out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

const rel = (p) => path.relative(SRC, p).split(path.sep).join("/");

// SUMMARY order first, then anything not listed (so a new page is never silently lost)
const listed = summaryOrder();
const files = [
  ...listed.map((r) => path.join(SRC, r)).filter((p) => fs.existsSync(p)),
  ...walk(SRC).filter((p) => !listed.includes(rel(p))),
];

const entries = [];
for (const file of files) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const page = rel(file).replace(/\.md$/, "");
  const seen = new Map();
  // split on ATX headings, keeping the heading line with its body
  const parts = text.split(/^(#{1,6})[ \t]+(.+)$/gm);
  let headings = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i += 3) {
    const heading = parts[i + 1].replace(/\s*#+\s*$/, "").trim();
    const body = parts[i + 2] ?? "";
    headings++;
    const anchor = slug(heading, seen);
    entries.push({
      title: heading,
      anchor,
      section: heading,
      text: plain(body).slice(0, EXCERPT),
      url: `${BASE}${page}.html#${anchor}`,
      path: rel(file),
    });
  }
  if (headings === 0) {
    console.error(`no heading in ${rel(file)}`);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
}

if (entries.length === 0) {
  console.error("no entries: docs/ has no markdown headings");
  process.exit(1);
}

const index = {
  generated: new Date().toISOString(),
  source: "docs",
  count: entries.length,
  entries,
};
const json = JSON.stringify(index, null, 2) + "\n";

if (OUT) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.resolve(OUT)), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(OUT, json);
  console.error(`help index: ${entries.length} entries, ${files.length} pages -> ${OUT}`);
} else {
  process.stdout.write(json);
}

```

`tools/gen_packages.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/gen_packages.ps1 — fill the winget / Scoop / Chocolatey manifests from a
# release's SHA256SUMS.
#
#   powershell -File tools/gen_packages.ps1 -Version 0.2.3 -Sums SHA256SUMS -OutDir _packages
#   powershell -File tools/gen_packages.ps1 -Version 0.2.3            # downloads the sums
#
# The templates in packaging/ carry __PLACEHOLDER__ tokens (see packaging/README.md);
# this script substitutes them and fails if any token survives, so a manifest can never
# ship with a stale version or a zero hash.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Product version, without the leading v (default: the VERSION file)
    [string]$Version,
    # Release tag (default: v<Version>)
    [string]$Tag,
    # SHA256SUMS file for the release (default: download it with gh)
    [string]$Sums,
    # Where the filled manifests go (default: _packages)
    [string]$OutDir = '_packages',
    # GitHub repo slug
    [string]$Repo = 'NetVar1337/SlopStation',
    # Release date for the winget manifest (default: today, UTC)
    [string]$ReleaseDate
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

if (-not $Version) {
    $Version = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'VERSION') -TotalCount 1).Trim()
}
if (-not $Tag) { $Tag = "v$Version" }
if (-not $ReleaseDate) { $ReleaseDate = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }
if ($Version -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+([-.][0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$') {
    throw "bad version '$Version' (expected x.y.z)"
}

# ---- SHA256SUMS ------------------------------------------------------------
# "<sha256>  <file name>" per line, as the release workflow writes it.
$tmp = $null
try {
    if (-not $Sums) {
        $tmp = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "slop-sums-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
        Write-Host "downloading SHA256SUMS for $Tag from $Repo..."
        gh release download $Tag -R $Repo -p SHA256SUMS -D $tmp
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "gh release download $Tag failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" }
        $Sums = Join-Path $tmp 'SHA256SUMS'
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Sums)) { throw "no SHA256SUMS at $Sums" }

    $hashes = @{}
    foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $Sums) {
        if ($line -match '^\s*([0-9a-fA-F]{64})\s+\*?(.+?)\s*$') {
            $hashes[$Matches[2]] = $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()
        }
    }
    if ($hashes.Count -eq 0) { throw "no hashes parsed from $Sums" }

    # asset names come from .github/workflows/release.yml: the installer carries the
    # bare version, the portable zip carries the tag
    $setupName = @($hashes.Keys | Where-Object { $_ -like "*_${Version}_x64-setup.exe" })
    $zipName   = @($hashes.Keys | Where-Object { $_ -like "*portable-$Tag.zip" })
    if ($setupName.Count -ne 1) {
        throw "expected one *_${Version}_x64-setup.exe in SHA256SUMS, found: $($setupName -join ', ')"
    }
    if ($zipName.Count -ne 1) {
        throw "expected one *portable-$Tag.zip in SHA256SUMS, found: $($zipName -join ', ')"
    }
    $setupName = $setupName[0]
    $zipName   = $zipName[0]

    $base = "https://github.com/$Repo/releases/download/$Tag"
    $tokens = @{
        '__VERSION__'      = $Version
        '__TAG__'          = $Tag
        '__RELEASE_DATE__' = $ReleaseDate
        '__SETUP_URL__'    = "$base/$setupName"
        '__SETUP_SHA256__' = $hashes[$setupName].ToUpperInvariant()   # winget convention
        '__ZIP_URL__'      = "$base/$zipName"
        '__ZIP_SHA256__'   = $hashes[$zipName]
    }

    # ---- templates ---------------------------------------------------------
    $out = if ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($OutDir)) { [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutDir) }
           else { [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Get-Location).Path $OutDir)) }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $out) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out -Recurse -Force }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null

    $pkgRoot = Join-Path $root 'packaging'
    $prefix = $pkgRoot.TrimEnd('\', '/') + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
    $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $pkgRoot -Recurse -File |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension -in @('.yaml', '.json', '.nuspec', '.ps1') })
    if ($files.Count -eq 0) { throw 'no templates under packaging/' }

    # Windows PowerShell 5.1 has no [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath and no utf8NoBOM
    $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        $rel = $f.FullName.Substring($prefix.Length)
        $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw -Encoding UTF8
        foreach ($k in $tokens.Keys) { $text = $text.Replace($k, $tokens[$k]) }
        if ($text -match '__[A-Z0-9_]+__') {
            throw "$rel still has a placeholder after substitution: $($Matches[0])"
        }
        $dest = Join-Path $out $rel
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $dest) | Out-Null
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($dest, $text, $utf8)
        Write-Host "  $rel"
    }

    # ---- self-check --------------------------------------------------------
    # the generated manifests must carry the version and the real hashes
    $wingetInstaller = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'winget/NetVar1337.SlopStation.installer.yaml') -Raw
    foreach ($needle in @("PackageVersion: $Version", $tokens['__SETUP_SHA256__'], $setupName)) {
        if (-not $wingetInstaller.Contains($needle)) { throw "winget installer manifest is missing '$needle'" }
    }
    $scoop = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'scoop/slopstation.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($scoop.version -ne $Version) { throw "scoop version is $($scoop.version), expected $Version" }
    if ($scoop.architecture.'64bit'.hash -ne $tokens['__ZIP_SHA256__']) {
        throw 'scoop hash does not match the portable zip'
    }
    $nuspec = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $out 'choco/slopstation.nuspec') -Raw
    if (-not $nuspec.Contains("<version>$Version</version>")) { throw 'nuspec version is wrong' }
    [xml]$null = $nuspec   # well-formedness

    Write-Host "manifests for $Version ($Tag) written to $out"
    Write-Host "  installer: $setupName  $($tokens['__SETUP_SHA256__'])"
    Write-Host "  portable : $zipName  $($tokens['__ZIP_SHA256__'])"
}
finally {
    if ($tmp -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force }
}

```

`tools/gen_third_party_notices.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md from the real dependency trees.

Sources (all local, no network):
  * _ext/<dep>-src        C/C++ deps fetched by cmake/deps.cmake (configure first)
  * app/node_modules      frontend packages (run `npm ci` in app/ first)
  * cargo metadata        Rust crates of app/src-tauri (registry must be cached)
  * tools/licenses/       license texts for bundled binaries without a local copy

Usage:  python tools/gen_third_party_notices.py [--check]
--check exits 1 when the committed file differs from what would be generated.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
EXT = ROOT / "_ext"
APP = ROOT / "app"
OUT = ROOT / "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"
VERSION = (ROOT / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
MAGICMIDA_VERSION = (ROOT / "tools" / "magicmida-version.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split()[0]

# C/C++ dependencies fetched by cmake/deps.cmake. `files` are paths inside
# _ext/<dir>-src whose full text is reproduced; `extract` pulls a comment block
# out of a header for projects that ship their notice only in source.
NATIVE = [
    dict(name="fmt", version="11.1.4", url="https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt", spdx="MIT",
         dir="fmt", files=["LICENSE"], used="engine, tests (via spdlog/hyperion)"),
    dict(name="spdlog", version="1.15.3", url="https://github.com/gabime/spdlog", spdx="MIT",
         dir="spdlog", files=["LICENSE"], used="engine (hyperion logging)"),
    dict(name="Capstone", version="5.0.6", url="https://github.com/capstone-engine/capstone",
         spdx="BSD-3-Clause AND NCSA", dir="capstone", files=["LICENSE.TXT", "LICENSE_LLVM.TXT"],
         used="engine (ARM/ARM64 decoding)"),
    dict(name="zlib", version="1.3.1", url="https://github.com/madler/zlib", spdx="Zlib",
         dir="zlib_kr", files=["LICENSE"], used="engine"),
    dict(name="FreeType", version="2.13.3", url="https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/freetype/freetype",
         spdx="FTL (chosen from FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later)", dir="freetype",
         files=["LICENSE.TXT", "docs/FTL.TXT"], used="legacy ImGui shell (reverse-slop.exe)",
         note="Portions of this software are copyright (c) 2024 The FreeType Project "
              "(www.freetype.org). All rights reserved."),
    dict(name="JSON for Modern C++ (nlohmann/json)", version="3.12.0", url="https://github.com/nlohmann/json",
         spdx="MIT", dir="nlohmann_json", files=["LICENSE.MIT"], used="engine, tests"),
    dict(name="Zydis", version="4.1.1", url="https://github.com/zyantific/zydis", spdx="MIT",
         dir="zydis", files=["LICENSE"], used="engine (x86/x64 decoder + encoder)"),
    dict(name="Zycore", version="(Zydis 4.1.1 submodule)", url="https://github.com/zyantific/zycore-c",
         spdx="MIT", dir="zydis", files=["dependencies/zycore/LICENSE"], used="engine (via Zydis)"),
    dict(name="Dear ImGui", version="1.92.1-docking", url="https://github.com/ocornut/imgui", spdx="MIT",
         dir="imgui", files=["LICENSE.txt"], used="legacy ImGui shell"),
    dict(name="cpp-httplib", version="0.18.7", url="https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib", spdx="MIT",
         dir="httplib", files=["LICENSE"], used="engine (MCP/HTTP server, web tool)"),
    dict(name="Unicorn Engine", version="2.1.4", url="https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn",
         spdx="GPL-2.0-only (parts LGPL-2.1-or-later)", dir="unicorn", files=["COPYING", "COPYING.LGPL2"],
         used="engine (emulator, statically linked)",
         note="Unicorn is licensed under the GNU GPL version 2. Because reverse-slop-engine.exe "
              "statically links Unicorn, the distributed engine binary as a whole is subject to "
              "GPL-2.0 terms: the complete corresponding source is this repository plus the Unicorn "
              "2.1.4 release archive pinned (with SHA-256) in cmake/deps.cmake. reverse-slop's own "
              "source remains MIT-licensed, which is GPL-2.0 compatible."),
    dict(name="SQLite", version="3.50.4", url="https://www.sqlite.org", spdx="blessing (public domain)",
         dir="sqlite", extract=("sqlite3.h", r"/\*\n(\*\* 2001-09-15.*?)\*{10,}"), used="engine (session store)"),
    dict(name="Lua", version="5.4.7", url="https://www.lua.org", spdx="MIT", dir="lua",
         extract=("src/lua.h", r"/\*{10,}\n(\* Copyright \(C\).*?)\*{10,}/"), used="engine (scripting)"),
]

# Code or data vendored into this repository (not fetched at build time).
VENDORED = [
    dict(name="Hyperion", path="src/hyperion",
         url="https://github.com/Sidenai/hyperion-disassembler",
         text="Vendored analysis/decompiler engine (`hype` namespace), modified for reverse-slop. "
              "The upstream repository declares no license; copyright remains with its authors. "
              "Redistribution of this directory relies on the upstream authors' permission."),
    dict(name="PS4 NID symbol names", path="src/hyperion/data/ps4_nid_names.inc",
         url="https://github.com/idc/ps4libdoc (branch doc, commit 8bff4863ac2f788149bbbf13a7eddc1222aec08b)",

              "license; the file is a list of public PS4 SDK symbol identifiers used to resolve NID "

              "`%LOCALAPPDATA%\\reverse-slop\\nids.txt` (one `name` or `NID name` per line)."),
    dict(name="ps4debug-NG wire protocol", path="src/core/runtime/ps4_protocol.hpp",
         url="https://github.com/Pharaoh2k/ps4debug-NG",

              "debugger/include/protocol.h. No upstream code is copied; the upstream repository "
              "declares no license."),
    dict(name="reverse-slap (fork origin)", path="(repository history)",
         url="https://github.com/kaizer1308/reverse-slap",
         text="reverse-slop is a fork of reverse-slap. The upstream repository declares no license; "
              "code inherited from it remains copyright its authors."),
]

# Separately downloaded executables shipped inside the installer/portable dist.
BUNDLED = [
    dict(name="Magicmida", version=MAGICMIDA_VERSION, url="https://github.com/Hendi48/Magicmida",
         spdx="GPL-3.0", license="tools/licenses/GPL-3.0.txt",
         text="Shipped unmodified as separate executables under engine/tools/magicmida "
              "(mere aggregation). Corresponding source: the tagged release "
              f"https://github.com/Hendi48/Magicmida/releases/tag/{MAGICMIDA_VERSION}."),
    dict(name="ScyllaHide (inside the Magicmida x64 package)", version="as packaged by Magicmida",
         url="https://github.com/x64dbg/ScyllaHide", spdx="GPL-3.0", license="tools/licenses/GPL-3.0.txt",
         text="Shipped unmodified inside the Magicmida x64 package. Corresponding source: "
              "https://github.com/x64dbg/ScyllaHide."),
]

LICENSE_FILE_RE = re.compile(r"^(licen[cs]e|copying|notice|copyright|unlicense)([-._].*)?$", re.I)


def read_text(p: Path) -> str:
    return p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").replace("\r\n", "\n").strip()


def native_texts(dep: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    src = EXT / f"{dep['dir']}-src"
    if not src.is_dir():
        sys.exit(f"missing {src}: configure the CMake build first")
    out = []
    for rel in dep.get("files", []):
        p = src / rel
        if not p.is_file():
            sys.exit(f"missing license file {p}")
        out.append((rel, read_text(p)))
    if "extract" in dep:
        rel, pattern = dep["extract"]
        m = re.search(pattern, read_text(src / rel), re.S)
        if not m:
            sys.exit(f"license block not found in {src / rel}")
        block = "\n".join(re.sub(r"^\s*\*{1,2} ?", "", line) for line in m.group(1).splitlines())
        out.append((rel, block.strip()))
    return out


def license_files(directory: Path) -> list[Path]:
    if not directory.is_dir():
        return []
    return sorted(p for p in directory.iterdir() if p.is_file() and LICENSE_FILE_RE.match(p.name))


def npm_packages() -> list[dict]:
    lock = json.loads((APP / "package-lock.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pkgs = []
    for path, info in lock.get("packages", {}).items():
        if not path.startswith("node_modules/") or info.get("dev") or info.get("devOptional"):
            continue
        name = path.rsplit("node_modules/", 1)[1]
        d = APP / path
        if not d.is_dir():
            sys.exit(f"missing {d}: run `npm ci` in app/ first")
        meta = json.loads((d / "package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        lic = info.get("license") or meta.get("license") or "UNKNOWN"
        if isinstance(lic, dict):
            lic = lic.get("type", "UNKNOWN")
        repo = meta.get("repository")
        if isinstance(repo, dict):
            repo = repo.get("url")
        pkgs.append(dict(name=name, version=info.get("version", meta.get("version", "")),
                         license=lic, url=repo or meta.get("homepage") or f"https://www.npmjs.com/package/{name}",
                         files=license_files(d)))
    return sorted(pkgs, key=lambda p: (p["name"], p["version"]))


def cargo_crates() -> list[dict]:
    r = subprocess.run(["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version", "1", "--locked", "--offline",
                        "--filter-platform", "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"],
                       cwd=APP / "src-tauri", capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"cargo metadata failed (fetch the crates once with `cargo fetch`):\n{r.stderr}")
    meta = json.loads(r.stdout)
    by_id = {p["id"]: p for p in meta["packages"]}
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in meta["resolve"]["nodes"]}
    root = meta["resolve"]["root"]
    # normal (shipped) dependency closure; build-only deps never reach the binary
    seen, stack = set(), [root]
    while stack:
        cur = stack.pop()
        for dep in nodes[cur]["deps"]:
            if any(k["kind"] is None for k in dep["dep_kinds"]) and dep["pkg"] not in seen:
                seen.add(dep["pkg"])
                stack.append(dep["pkg"])
    crates = []
    for pid in seen:
        p = by_id[pid]
        d = Path(p["manifest_path"]).parent
        files = license_files(d)
        if p.get("license_file"):
            lf = d / p["license_file"]
            if lf.is_file() and lf not in files:
                files.append(lf)
        crates.append(dict(name=p["name"], version=p["version"], license=p.get("license") or "see license file",
                           url=p.get("repository") or f"https://crates.io/crates/{p['name']}", files=files))
    return sorted(crates, key=lambda c: (c["name"], c["version"]))


def grouped_texts(items: list[dict]) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    """Dedupe identical license texts, keep the packages each one covers."""
    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for it in items:
        for f in it["files"]:
            groups.setdefault(read_text(f), []).append(f"{it['name']} {it['version']}")
    return sorted(((t, sorted(set(n))) for t, n in groups.items()), key=lambda g: g[1][0].lower())


def fence(text: str) -> str:
    ticks = "````" if "```" in text else "```"
    return f"{ticks}text\n{text}\n{ticks}\n"


def md_cell(s: str) -> str:
    return str(s).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")


def generate() -> str:
    o: list[str] = []
    w = o.append
    w("# Third-party notices\n")
    w(f"reverse-slop {VERSION} is MIT-licensed (see `LICENSE`, copyright (c) 2026 NetVar1337). "
      "It builds on, links, bundles or derives from the components below; each keeps its own "
      "license. This file is generated by `tools/gen_third_party_notices.py` and ships next to "
      "the application in the installer and the portable build.\n")

    w("## Native dependencies (fetched by `cmake/deps.cmake`, SHA-256 pinned)\n")
    w("| Component | Version | License | Used by | Source |\n|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for d in NATIVE:
        w(f"| {md_cell(d['name'])} | {md_cell(d['version'])} | {md_cell(d['spdx'])} | {md_cell(d['used'])} | {d['url']} |")
    w("")
    w("## Vendored code and data\n")
    for v in VENDORED:
        w(f"### {v['name']}\n\n- Location: `{v['path']}`\n- Origin: {v['url']}\n\n{v['text']}\n")
    w("## Bundled third-party executables\n")
    for b in BUNDLED:
        w(f"### {b['name']} ({b['version']})\n\n- License: {b['spdx']} (full text in the appendix)\n"
          f"- Source: {b['url']}\n\n{b['text']}\n")
    w("Windows installers may also embed or download the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime "
      "bootstrapper, redistributed under the Microsoft WebView2 distribution terms.\n")

    npm = npm_packages()
    w("## Frontend packages bundled into the UI (`app/package-lock.json`, runtime only)\n")
    w("| Package | Version | License | Source |\n|---|---|---|---|")
    for p in npm:
        w(f"| {md_cell(p['name'])} | {p['version']} | {md_cell(p['license'])} | {md_cell(p['url'])} |")
    w("")
    crates = cargo_crates()
    w("## Rust crates linked into the UI host (`app/src-tauri/Cargo.lock`, Windows, normal deps)\n")
    w("| Crate | Version | License | Source |\n|---|---|---|---|")
    for c in crates:
        w(f"| {md_cell(c['name'])} | {c['version']} | {md_cell(c['license'])} | {md_cell(c['url'])} |")
    w("")

    w("---\n\n# License texts\n")
    w("## Native dependencies\n")
    for d in NATIVE:
        w(f"### {d['name']} {d['version']}\n")
        if d.get("note"):
            w(d["note"] + "\n")
        for rel, text in native_texts(d):
            w(f"`{rel}`:\n")
            w(fence(text))
    w("## Bundled executables\n")
    done = set()
    for b in BUNDLED:
        if b["license"] in done:
            w(f"### {b['name']}\n\nSame {b['spdx']} text as above.\n")
            continue
        done.add(b["license"])
        w(f"### {b['name']}\n")
        w(fence(read_text(ROOT / b["license"])))
    for title, items in (("Frontend packages", npm), ("Rust crates", crates)):
        w(f"## {title}\n")
        missing = [f"{i['name']} {i['version']} ({i['license']})" for i in items if not i["files"]]
        if missing:
            w("Packages that ship no separate license file (license per their SPDX id and "
              "source headers): " + ", ".join(missing) + ".\n")
        for text, names in grouped_texts(items):
            w("Applies to: " + ", ".join(names) + "\n")
            w(fence(text))
    return "\n".join(o).rstrip() + "\n"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="fail when THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is stale")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    text = generate()
    if args.check:
        current = OUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if OUT.exists() else ""
        if current != text:
            print("THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is stale: run python tools/gen_third_party_notices.py", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print("THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is up to date")
        return 0
    OUT.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(f"wrote {OUT.relative_to(ROOT)} ({len(text) // 1024} KiB)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tools/install_magicmida.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\reverse-slop\tools\magicmida\<version>
    [string]$InstallRoot,
    [switch]$Force
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
# Single version source: tools/magicmida-version.txt. Line 1 is the release
# (read by CMake as SLOP_MAGICMIDA_VERSION, build.ps1 and the CI cache key),
# the following `<arch> <sha256>` lines pin that release's packages.
$versionLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'magicmida-version.txt') | Where-Object { $_.Trim() })
$release = $versionLines[0].Trim()
$sha = @{}
foreach ($line in $versionLines | Select-Object -Skip 1) {
    $arch, $hash = $line.Trim() -split '\s+', 2
    $sha[$arch] = $hash.ToLowerInvariant()
}
foreach ($arch in 'x86', 'x64') {
    if (-not $sha[$arch]) { throw "tools/magicmida-version.txt has no SHA-256 line for $arch" }
}
if (-not $InstallRoot) {
    if (-not $env:LOCALAPPDATA) { throw 'LOCALAPPDATA is not set; pass -InstallRoot explicitly' }
    $InstallRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "reverse-slop\tools\magicmida\$release"
}
$packages = @(
    @{
        Arch = 'x86'
        Url = "https://github.com/Hendi48/Magicmida/releases/download/$release/Magicmida.zip"
        Sha256 = $sha['x86']
    },
    @{
        Arch = 'x64'
        Url = "https://github.com/Hendi48/Magicmida/releases/download/$release/Magicmida64.zip"
        Sha256 = $sha['x64']
    }
)

$tempRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP "reverse-slop-magicmida-$PID"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tempRoot -Force | Out-Null
try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $InstallRoot -Force | Out-Null
    foreach ($package in $packages) {
        $destination = Join-Path $InstallRoot $package.Arch
        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $destination 'Magicmida.exe')) -and -not $Force) {
            Write-Host "==> $($package.Arch) already installed: $destination"
            continue
        }

        $archive = Join-Path $tempRoot "$($package.Arch).zip"
        Write-Host "==> downloading Magicmida $($package.Arch) $release"
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $package.Url -OutFile $archive -UseBasicParsing
        $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
        if ($actual -ne $package.Sha256) {
            throw "SHA-256 mismatch for $($package.Arch): expected $($package.Sha256), got $actual"
        }

        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $destination -Recurse -Force
        }
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination -Force | Out-Null
        Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $destination -Force
        Write-Host "==> installed $($package.Arch): $destination"
    }

    $sourceNotice = @(
        "Magicmida $release is GPLv3 software maintained at:",
        'https://github.com/Hendi48/Magicmida',
        '',
        'The downloaded x64 package contains ScyllaHide components:',
        'https://github.com/x64dbg/ScyllaHide',
        '',
        'Use the corresponding tagged source when redistributing these binaries.'
    )
    Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $InstallRoot 'SOURCE.txt') -Value $sourceNotice -Encoding ASCII
    Write-Host "==> Magicmida ready: $InstallRoot"
} finally {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tempRoot) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force
    }
}

```

`tools/mcp_live_test.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Live MCP battery against a real reverse-slop engine.

By default it spawns build/src/engine/reverse-slop-engine.exe on a free port
with a fresh bearer token, waits for the SLOP_ENGINE_READY handshake, checks
/health, loads SlopTarget.exe as the shared image, waits for Hyperion, then
drives every MCP tool. Negative cases (bad actions, unmapped reads, SSRF to
loopback, ...) must fail; everything else must succeed. Exit code: 0 all
passed, 1 at least one case failed, 2 setup failed (engine/health/image).

Every path comes from argv or the environment, nothing is machine-specific:
  --engine   / SLOP_ENGINE_EXE   engine executable to spawn
  --target   / SLOP_TARGET_EXE   PE fixture to load (SlopTarget.exe)
  --url      / SLOP_MCP_URL      use an already-running engine instead
  --token    / SLOP_MCP_TOKEN    bearer token (generated when spawning)
  --workdir                      scratch dir for fs/persist cases (temp dir)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import secrets
import shutil
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PROTOCOL = "2025-06-18"


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--engine", default=os.environ.get("SLOP_ENGINE_EXE",
                    str(REPO / "build" / "src" / "engine" / "reverse-slop-engine.exe")))
    ap.add_argument("--target", default=os.environ.get("SLOP_TARGET_EXE",
                    str(REPO / "build" / "src" / "app" / "SlopTarget.exe")))
    ap.add_argument("--url", default=os.environ.get("SLOP_MCP_URL", ""),
                    help="base URL of a running engine (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8765); skips spawning")
    ap.add_argument("--token", default=os.environ.get("SLOP_MCP_TOKEN", ""))
    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("SLOP_MCP_PORT", "0") or 0),
                    help="port for the spawned engine (default: a free port)")
    ap.add_argument("--workdir", default="", help="scratch directory (default: a new temp dir, removed after)")
    ap.add_argument("--results", default="", help="write per-case JSON results here")
    ap.add_argument("--startup-timeout", type=float, default=60.0)
    ap.add_argument("--ready-timeout", type=float, default=180.0, help="seconds to wait for hype.ready")
    ap.add_argument("--allow-existing", action="store_true",
                    help="accept a handover to an engine that is already running (it gets mutated)")
    return ap.parse_args()


class Engine:
    """Spawned engine process with stdout handshake and stderr capture."""

    def __init__(self, exe: str, port: int, token: str, log_path: Path):
        self.log_path = log_path
        env = dict(os.environ, SLOP_MCP_TOKEN=token)
        args = [exe, "--no-onboard", "--port", str(port), "--parent-pid", str(os.getpid())]
        self.log = open(log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=self.log, env=env,
                                     text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                                     creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0))
        self.lines: list[str] = []
        self._ready = threading.Event()
        threading.Thread(target=self._pump, daemon=True).start()

    def _pump(self) -> None:
        assert self.proc.stdout is not None
        for line in self.proc.stdout:
            self.lines.append(line.rstrip("\n"))
            if line.startswith(("SLOP_ENGINE_READY", "SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED")):
                self._ready.set()
        self._ready.set()

    def wait_ready(self, timeout: float) -> tuple[int, bool]:
        """Returns (port, existing) from the handshake or raises."""
        if not self._ready.wait(timeout):
            raise RuntimeError(f"no SLOP_ENGINE_READY within {timeout:.0f}s (log: {self.log_path})")
        time.sleep(0.2)  # let a following SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING line arrive
        ready = next((l for l in self.lines if l.startswith("SLOP_ENGINE_READY")), None)
        if ready is None:
            failed = next((l for l in self.lines if l.startswith("SLOP_ENGINE_FAILED")), "engine exited")
            raise RuntimeError(f"{failed} (exit={self.proc.poll()}, log: {self.log_path})")
        port = int(ready.split()[1])
        return port, any(l.startswith("SLOP_ENGINE_EXISTING") for l in self.lines)

    def stop(self) -> None:
        if self.proc.poll() is None:
            # ctrl-break reaches the engine's console handler -> clean shutdown
            try:
                self.proc.send_signal(getattr(__import__("signal"), "CTRL_BREAK_EVENT"))
                self.proc.wait(timeout=15)
            except Exception:
                self.proc.kill()
                self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
        self.log.close()


class Client:
    def __init__(self, base: str, token: str):
        self.base = base.rstrip("/")
        self.token = token
        self.session = ""
        self.next_id = 1

    def _post(self, body: dict, timeout: float) -> tuple[dict | None, dict]:
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream",
                   "MCP-Protocol-Version": PROTOCOL}
        if self.token:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.token}"
        if self.session:
            headers["Mcp-Session-Id"] = self.session
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.base + "/mcp", data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
            raw = r.read()
            return (json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else None), dict(r.headers)

    def health(self, timeout: float = 5.0) -> dict:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(self.base + "/health", timeout=timeout) as r:
            return json.loads(r.read())

    def initialize(self) -> dict:
        d, headers = self._post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": self._id(), "method": "initialize",
                                 "params": {"protocolVersion": PROTOCOL, "capabilities": {},
                                            "clientInfo": {"name": "mcp_live_test", "version": "1"}}}, 30)
        if not d or "result" not in d:
            raise RuntimeError(f"initialize failed: {d}")
        self.session = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if k.lower() == "mcp-session-id"), "")
        self._post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"}, 30)
        return d["result"]

    def _id(self) -> int:
        self.next_id += 1
        return self.next_id

    def call(self, name: str, params: dict, timeout: float = 60) -> dict:
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            d, _ = self._post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": self._id(), "method": "tools/call",
                               "params": {"name": name, "arguments": params}}, timeout)
            d = d or {}
            res = d.get("result", {})
            content = res.get("content", [])
            text = content[0].get("text", "") if content else ""
            try:
                payload = json.loads(text) if text else {}
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                payload = {"_raw": text[:500]}
            if "error" in d:
                payload = {"rpc_error": d["error"]}
            err = bool(res.get("isError")) or "error" in d or (isinstance(payload, dict) and "error" in payload)
            return {"ok": not err, "dt": round(time.time() - t0, 2), "payload": payload}
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            body = e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:300]
            return {"ok": False, "dt": round(time.time() - t0, 2), "payload": {"http": e.code, "body": body}}
        except Exception as e:  # timeouts, refused connections
            return {"ok": False, "dt": round(time.time() - t0, 2), "payload": {"exception": str(e)[:300]}}


class Battery:
    def __init__(self, client: Client):
        self.c = client
        self.results: list[dict] = []

    def case(self, label: str, tool: str, params: dict, check=None, expect: str = "ok",
             timeout: float = 60) -> dict:
        """expect: 'ok' (must succeed), 'error' (must fail), 'any' (only `check` decides)."""
        r = self.c.call(tool, params, timeout)
        passed = {"ok": r["ok"], "error": not r["ok"], "any": True}[expect]
        note = ""
        if passed and check is not None:
            try:
                verdict = check(r["payload"])
                if verdict is False:
                    passed, note = False, "check failed"
                elif isinstance(verdict, str):
                    note = verdict
            except Exception as e:
                passed, note = False, f"check threw: {e!s:.200}"
        self.results.append({"label": label, "tool": tool, "params": params, "expect": expect,
                             "passed": passed, "call_ok": r["ok"], "dt": r["dt"], "note": note,
                             "brief": json.dumps(r["payload"])[:300]})
        print(f"[{'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'}] {label} ({r['dt']}s) {note}")
        if not passed:
            print("   ->", json.dumps(r["payload"])[:250])
        return r


def free_port() -> int:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


def run_battery(b: Battery, target: str, work: Path, port: int) -> None:
    call = b.c.call
    st = call("target", {"action": "status"})
    image = st["payload"].get("image", {}) if st["ok"] else {}
    base, entry = image.get("base"), image.get("entry_va")
    if not base or not entry:
        raise RuntimeError(f"target.status has no image base/entry: {json.dumps(st['payload'])[:300]}")
    print("base=%X entry=%X hype.ready=%s" % (base, entry, (image.get("hype") or {}).get("ready")))

    # target
    b.case("target.status", "target", {"action": "status"}, lambda p: p["image"]["ready"] is True)
    b.case("target.list", "target", {"action": "list"})
    b.case("target.modules (no attach)", "target", {"action": "modules"}, expect="any")
    b.case("target.bad action", "target", {"action": "nope"}, expect="error")

    # disasm
    b.case("disasm.loaded", "disasm", {"action": "loaded"}, lambda p: p.get("ready") is True)
    b.case("disasm.pe", "disasm", {"action": "pe"}, lambda p: "%d sections" % len(p["sections"]))
    fns = b.case("disasm.functions", "disasm", {"action": "functions", "limit": 50},
                 lambda p: "total=%s" % p["total"] if p["functions"] else False)
    fn0 = fns["payload"]["functions"][0]["va"] if fns["ok"] and fns["payload"].get("functions") else entry
    b.case("disasm.disassemble at entry", "disasm", {"action": "disassemble", "addr": entry, "count": 8},
           lambda p: "got %d insns, first=%s" % (p["count"], p["instructions"][0]["text"]))
    b.case("disasm.disassemble garbage addr", "disasm", {"action": "disassemble", "addr": "0x1400", "count": 4},
           expect="any")
    b.case("disasm.xrefs at entry", "disasm", {"action": "xrefs", "addr": entry}, lambda p: "count=%d" % p["count"])
    b.case("disasm.blocks at fn", "disasm", {"action": "blocks", "addr": fn0}, lambda p: "%d blocks" % p["count"])
    b.case("disasm.vtables", "disasm", {"action": "vtables"}, lambda p: "%d vtables" % p["count"])
    b.case("disasm.globals", "disasm", {"action": "globals"}, lambda p: "%d globals" % p["count"])
    b.case("disasm.strings", "disasm", {"action": "strings", "limit": 20},
           lambda p: "%d strings" % len(p["strings"]) if p["strings"] else False)
    b.case("disasm.symbols", "disasm", {"action": "symbols"}, lambda p: "%d symbols" % p["count"])
    b.case("disasm.assemble", "disasm", {"action": "assemble", "text": "mov rax, rbx"},
           lambda p: "bytes=%s" % p["bytes"])
    b.case("disasm.assemble bad", "disasm", {"action": "assemble", "text": "frobnicate rax"}, expect="error")
    b.case("disasm.unknown action", "disasm", {"action": "zzz"}, expect="error")

    # decomp
    b.case("decomp.function at fn0", "decomp", {"action": "function", "addr": fn0},
           lambda p: "lines=%d vars=%d" % (len(p["lines"]), len(p["vars"])), timeout=120)
    b.case("decomp.function bad addr", "decomp", {"action": "function", "addr": "0x12345678"}, expect="error")
    b.case("decomp bad action", "decomp", {"action": "nope"}, expect="error")

    # re
    r = b.case("re.rtti_scan", "re", {"action": "rtti_scan"}, lambda p: "classes=%d" % p["count"])
    vt_va = (r["payload"].get("classes") or [{}])[0].get("vtable_va") if r["ok"] else None
    if vt_va:
        b.case("re.vftable", "re", {"action": "vftable", "addr": vt_va}, lambda p: "count=%d" % p["count"])
    shared = b.case("re.danger", "re", {"action": "danger"}, lambda p: "%d hits" % p["count"])
    b.case("re.danger with explicit path", "re", {"action": "danger", "path": target},
           lambda p: (p["count"] == shared["payload"].get("count")) or
           f"path hits {p['count']} != shared {shared['payload'].get('count')}")
    b.case("re.libsig bad", "re", {"action": "libsig", "sigset": "{}"}, expect="error")

    # analyze
    b.case("analyze.packer", "analyze", {"action": "packer"}, lambda p: "packed=%s" % p.get("packed"))
    b.case("analyze.signatures", "analyze", {"action": "signatures"}, lambda p: "count=%s" % p.get("count"))
    b.case("analyze.diff self", "analyze", {"action": "diff", "path_a": target, "path_b": target},
           lambda p: "totals=%s" % json.dumps(p.get("totals")), timeout=300)

    # xray
    for action in ("cfg", "complexity", "cff", "obfuscation", "indirect_calls", "anti_analysis", "strings_recon"):
        b.case(f"xray.{action} at fn0", "xray", {"action": action, "addr": fn0})
    b.case("xray.hooks", "xray", {"action": "hooks"})
    b.case("xray.syscalls", "xray", {"action": "syscalls"})
    b.case("xray.apihash ror13", "xray", {"action": "apihash", "hash": "0xC2B9DBB1", "algorithm": "ror13"})
    b.case("xray.entropy", "xray", {"action": "entropy", "addr": entry, "size": 2048},
           lambda p: "verdict=%s" % p.get("verdict"))
    b.case("xray.pages", "xray", {"action": "pages", "addr": entry, "size": 8192})
    b.case("xray.crypto_range", "xray", {"action": "crypto_range", "addr": base, "size": 65536})
    b.case("xray.gadgets", "xray", {"action": "gadgets", "limit": 20}, lambda p: "count=%d" % p["count"])

    # types
    b.case("types.declare struct", "types",
           {"action": "declare", "decl": "struct LiveTestHdr { u32 magic; u32 len; char tag[8]; } packed;"})
    b.case("types.get_struct", "types", {"action": "get_struct", "name": "LiveTestHdr"})
    b.case("types.list_structs", "types", {"action": "list_structs"})
    b.case("types.read_field (image)", "types",
           {"action": "read_field", "struct": "LiveTestHdr", "field": "magic", "addr": base})
    b.case("types.format_at", "types", {"action": "format_at", "type": "LiveTestHdr", "addr": base, "size": 16})
    b.case("types.create_enum", "types", {"action": "create_enum", "name": "LiveTestTag",
                                          "values": [{"name": "A", "value": 1}, {"name": "B", "value": 2}]})
    b.case("types.get_enum", "types", {"action": "get_enum", "name": "LiveTestTag"})
    b.case("types.remove_struct", "types", {"action": "remove_struct", "name": "LiveTestHdr"})

    # notes (every mutation is undone)
    b.case("notes.set_comment", "notes", {"action": "set_comment", "addr": entry, "text": "mcp live test"})
    b.case("notes.get_comment", "notes", {"action": "get_comment", "addr": entry},
           lambda p: p.get("comment") == "mcp live test")
    b.case("notes.comments", "notes", {"action": "comments"})
    b.case("notes.bookmark_toggle", "notes", {"action": "bookmark_toggle", "addr": entry})
    b.case("notes.bookmarks", "notes", {"action": "bookmarks"})
    b.case("notes.bookmark_toggle (undo)", "notes", {"action": "bookmark_toggle", "addr": entry})
    b.case("notes.set_comment (clear)", "notes", {"action": "set_comment", "addr": entry, "text": ""})

    # persist
    ps = b.case("persist.save", "persist", {"action": "save", "name": "mcp_live_test", "data": {"foo": "bar"}})
    pid_ = ps["payload"].get("id") if ps["ok"] else None
    b.case("persist.list", "persist", {"action": "list"})
    if pid_:
        b.case("persist.load", "persist", {"action": "load", "id": pid_})
    b.case("persist.kv_set", "persist", {"action": "kv_set", "key": "mcp_live_test", "value": {"x": 1}})
    b.case("persist.kv_get", "persist", {"action": "kv_get", "key": "mcp_live_test"})
    if pid_:
        b.case("persist.delete", "persist", {"action": "delete", "id": pid_})
    hdb = work / "hdb"
    b.case("persist.hype_save", "persist", {"action": "hype_save", "dir": str(hdb)}, timeout=120)
    b.case("persist.hype_load", "persist", {"action": "hype_load", "dir": str(hdb)}, timeout=120)

    # emulate
    b.case("emulate.run hex", "emulate", {"action": "run", "hex": "B839050000C3", "count": 16},
           lambda p: "reason=%s rax=%s" % (p.get("stopped_reason"), (p.get("regs") or {}).get("rax")))
    b.case("emulate.run file_addr", "emulate", {"action": "run", "file_addr": entry, "code_len": 64, "count": 32},
           lambda p: "stopped_reason" in p or p.get("ok") is True, expect="any")
    b.case("emulate.run taint", "emulate",
           {"action": "run", "hex": "8B0425AABBCCDD", "count": 8, "taint": [{"addr": "0xAABBCCDD", "len": 4}]},
           expect="any")

    # memory (no target attached: image fallback)
    b.case("memory.read hex @entry", "memory", {"action": "read", "addr": entry, "len": 32},
           lambda p: "len=%s" % p.get("len"))
    b.case("memory.read utf8", "memory", {"action": "read", "addr": entry, "len": 16, "format": "utf8"})
    b.case("memory.read u32", "memory", {"action": "read", "addr": base, "len": 16, "format": "u32"})
    b.case("memory.read unmapped", "memory", {"action": "read", "addr": "0xFFFFFFFFFFF00000", "len": 16},
           expect="error")
    b.case("memory.scan (no target)", "memory", {"action": "scan", "value": 42}, expect="error")
    b.case("memory.snapshots", "memory", {"action": "snapshots"})

    # patch (journal only)
    b.case("patch.journal", "patch", {"action": "journal"})
    b.case("patch.nop_junk fn0", "patch", {"action": "nop_junk", "addr": fn0, "aggressive": False}, expect="any")

    # devirt
    b.case("devirt.iat_audit", "devirt", {"action": "iat_audit"})
    b.case("devirt.identify at fn0", "devirt", {"action": "identify", "addr": fn0}, expect="any")
    b.case("devirt.prove_predicates fn0", "devirt", {"action": "prove_predicates", "addr": fn0, "runs": 2},
           expect="any", timeout=120)
    b.case("devirt.invariants fn0", "devirt", {"action": "invariants", "addr": fn0, "runs": 2},
           expect="any", timeout=120)

    # network / proxy
    for action in ("status", "packets", "connections", "stats"):
        b.case(f"network.{action}", "network", {"action": action})
    b.case("network.bad action", "network", {"action": "zzz"}, expect="error")
    b.case("proxy.status", "proxy", {"action": "status"})
    b.case("proxy.entries", "proxy", {"action": "entries"})

    # debugger (no console connected)
    b.case("debugger.status", "debugger", {"action": "status"})
    b.case("debugger.ps4_wait (no console)", "debugger", {"action": "ps4_wait"}, expect="error")

    # fs, confined to the scratch dir
    scratch = work / "fs_case.txt"
    b.case("fs.write_file", "fs", {"action": "write_file", "path": str(scratch), "text": "hello from mcp"})
    b.case("fs.read_file", "fs", {"action": "read_file", "path": str(scratch)},
           lambda p: "hello from mcp" in json.dumps(p))
    b.case("fs.list_directory", "fs", {"action": "list_directory", "path": str(work)},
           lambda p: "fs_case.txt" in json.dumps(p))
    b.case("fs.grep_in_files", "fs", {"action": "grep_in_files", "root": str(work), "needle": "hello from",
                                      "suffix": ".txt", "limit": 5}, lambda p: "fs_case.txt" in json.dumps(p))
    b.case("fs.delete_path", "fs", {"action": "delete_path", "path": str(scratch)},
           lambda p: not scratch.exists())

    # web: loopback / unresolvable hosts are refused (SSRF guard)
    b.case("web.fetch loopback refused", "web",
           {"action": "fetch", "url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health", "timeout_ms": 5000}, expect="error")
    b.case("web.fetch bad host", "web", {"action": "fetch", "url": "http://nonexistent.invalid/x"}, expect="error")

    # script
    b.case("script.run", "script", {"action": "run", "code": "return 'hello from lua'"},
           lambda p: "hello from lua" in p.get("output", ""))
    b.case("script.run infinite (timeout)", "script",
           {"action": "run", "code": "while true do end", "timeout_ms": 2000},
           lambda p: p.get("ok") is not True, expect="any", timeout=30)
    b.case("script sandbox blocks os.execute", "script",
           {"action": "run", "code": "return os.execute == nil and io == nil"},
           lambda p: "return: true" in p.get("output", ""))

    # unknown tool
    b.case("unknown tool", "zzztool", {"action": "x"}, expect="error")


def wait_hype_ready(client: Client, timeout: float) -> None:
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    last = {}
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r = client.call("disasm", {"action": "loaded"}, timeout=15)
        last = r["payload"]
        hype = (last.get("hype") or {}) if isinstance(last, dict) else {}
        if hype.get("ready"):
            return
        if hype.get("error"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"hyperion analysis failed: {hype['error']}")
        time.sleep(1)
    raise RuntimeError(f"hype not ready after {timeout:.0f}s: {json.dumps(last)[:300]}")


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    target = str(Path(args.target).resolve())
    if not Path(target).is_file():
        print(f"setup: target fixture not found: {target} (--target / SLOP_TARGET_EXE)", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    own_work = not args.workdir
    work = Path(args.workdir or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="slop-mcp-live-"))
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    engine = None
    try:
        if args.url:
            base, token = args.url, args.token
        else:
            exe = Path(args.engine)
            if not exe.is_file():
                print(f"setup: engine not found: {exe} (--engine / SLOP_ENGINE_EXE)", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
            token = args.token or secrets.token_hex(32)
            engine = Engine(str(exe), args.port or free_port(), token, work / "engine.log")
            port, existing = engine.wait_ready(args.startup_timeout)
            if existing and not args.allow_existing:
                print(f"setup: an engine is already running on port {port}; refusing to mutate it "
                      "(close it or pass --allow-existing)", file=sys.stderr)
                return 2
            base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
        client = Client(base, token)
        port = int(base.rsplit(":", 1)[1].split("/")[0])

        health = client.health()
        if not health.get("ok"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"/health not ok: {health}")
        print(f"health: {health}")
        info = client.initialize()
        print(f"initialize: protocol={info.get('protocolVersion')} server={info.get('serverInfo')}")

        load = client.call("disasm", {"action": "load", "path": target}, timeout=120)
        if not load["ok"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"disasm.load failed: {json.dumps(load['payload'])[:300]}")
        wait_hype_ready(client, args.ready_timeout)

        battery = Battery(client)
        run_battery(battery, target, work, port)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"setup: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        if engine is not None and engine.log_path.exists():
            engine.log.flush()
            print("--- engine log tail ---", file=sys.stderr)
            print("\n".join(engine.log_path.read_text("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()[-40:]), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    finally:
        if engine is not None:
            engine.stop()
        if own_work:
            shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)

    if args.results:
        Path(args.results).write_text(json.dumps(battery.results, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    failed = [r for r in battery.results if not r["passed"]]
    print(f"\n=== SUMMARY: {len(battery.results) - len(failed)}/{len(battery.results)} passed ===")
    for r in failed:
        print(f"  FAILED: {r['label']} (expect {r['expect']}): {r['brief'][:160]}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
