`tools/mcp_stdio_test.py`:

```py
"""Smoke test for `reverse-slop-engine --stdio`: initialize, a notification,
tools/list and a tool call over stdin/stdout; every stdout line must be one
JSON-RPC reply, and closing stdin must end the engine.

    python tools/mcp_stdio_test.py [--engine path]
"""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--engine", default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
                                        / "build/src/engine/reverse-slop-engine.exe"))
args = ap.parse_args()

msgs = [
    {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize",
     "params": {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18", "capabilities": {},
                "clientInfo": {"name": "stdio-test", "version": "0"}}},
    {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"},
    {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list"},
    {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 3, "method": "tools/call",
     "params": {"name": "target", "arguments": {"action": "status"}}},
]
stdin = "".join(json.dumps(m) + "\n" for m in msgs)
p = subprocess.run([args.engine, "--stdio", "--port", "0"], input=stdin, capture_output=True,
                   text=True, timeout=180)

lines = [ln for ln in p.stdout.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
fail = []
replies = {}
for ln in lines:
    try:
        r = json.loads(ln)
        replies[r.get("id")] = r
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        fail.append(f"non-JSON stdout line: {ln[:120]!r}")
if sorted(replies) != [1, 2, 3]:
    fail.append(f"expected replies for ids 1,2,3 (none for the notification), got {sorted(replies)}")
if replies.get(1, {}).get("result", {}).get("serverInfo", {}).get("name") != "slopstation":
    fail.append(f"initialize: {replies.get(1)}")
tools = {t["name"] for t in replies.get(2, {}).get("result", {}).get("tools", [])}
if "target" not in tools:
    fail.append(f"tools/list missing 'target': {sorted(tools)[:10]}")
if "error" in replies.get(3, {}) or replies.get(3, {}).get("result", {}).get("isError"):
    fail.append(f"target.status failed: {replies.get(3)}")

for f in fail:
    print("FAIL", f)
if fail:
    print("--- stderr tail ---\n" + "\n".join(p.stderr.splitlines()[-20:]))
    sys.exit(1)
print(f"PASS stdio: {len(lines)} replies, {len(tools)} tools, engine exit {p.returncode}")

```

`tools/record_demo.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/record_demo.ps1 — capture the connect -> scan -> freeze demo.
#
# There is no checked-in GIF. This script produces the frames and the ffmpeg command;
# whether a GIF exists is decided by running it, not by this file.
#
#   powershell -File tools/record_demo.ps1                 # frames only
#   powershell -File tools/record_demo.ps1 -Encode         # frames + GIF (needs ffmpeg)
#
# What it actually does today:
#   1. runs `node app/e2e/run.mjs screenshots` (real engine + SlopTarget fixture +
#      headless Chrome) with SLOP_E2E_OUT pointed at -FramesDir, so the PNGs come from
#      the real UI;
#   2. writes frames.txt (ffmpeg concat list) and the exact ffmpeg command.
#
# What it does NOT do: it does not record a live interaction. The e2e driver's
# screenshots mode captures a fixed set of views (workspace, memory, disassembly,
# strings, debugger, pe, scripts, settings, command-palette, theme-nord), not a
# connect -> scan -> freeze sequence. For a true recording, either
#   - drive the UI by hand and capture with OBS/ScreenToGif (see the recipe below), or
#   - add a `demo` mode to app/e2e/run.mjs that takes a screenshot after each step
#     (attach -> scan First -> scan Next -> watch_add -> freeze) and then run this
#     script with -SkipCapture against that frame directory.
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Where the PNG frames live / are written
    [string]$FramesDir,
    # Frames per second for the encoded animation (0.5 = one frame every 2 s)
    [double]$Fps = 1,
    # Run ffmpeg when it is on PATH
    [switch]$Encode,
    # Reuse the frames already in -FramesDir instead of re-capturing
    [switch]$SkipCapture,
    # Skip the app/e2e npm install step
    [switch]$SkipInstall
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $FramesDir) { $FramesDir = Join-Path $root 'docs/demo/frames' }

$ffmpeg = Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$gif = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $FramesDir) 'slopstation-demo.gif'

if (-not $SkipCapture) {
    $engine = Join-Path $root 'build\src\engine\reverse-slop-engine.exe'
    $fixture = Join-Path $root 'build\src\app\SlopTarget.exe'
    foreach ($exe in @($engine, $fixture)) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) {
            throw "missing $exe - build first: powershell -File tools/build.ps1 -NoFrontend"
        }
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'app\node_modules\vite\bin\vite.js'))) {
        Write-Host 'installing app npm deps...'
        npm --prefix (Join-Path $root 'app') ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund
    }
    if (-not $SkipInstall) {
        Write-Host 'installing app/e2e npm deps...'
        npm --prefix (Join-Path $root 'app\e2e') ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund
    }

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $FramesDir | Out-Null
    $env:SLOP_E2E_OUT = $FramesDir
    try {
        Write-Host "capturing frames into $FramesDir ..."
        & node (Join-Path $root 'app\e2e\run.mjs') screenshots
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "screenshot run failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" }
    }
    finally {
        Remove-Item Env:SLOP_E2E_OUT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $FramesDir)) { throw "no frame directory at $FramesDir" }
$frames = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $FramesDir -Filter '*.png' -File | Sort-Object Name)
if ($frames.Count -eq 0) { throw "no PNG frames in $FramesDir" }

# ffmpeg concat list: one frame per line, held for 1/fps seconds
$list = Join-Path $FramesDir 'frames.txt'
$hold = 1.0 / $Fps
$lines = foreach ($f in $frames) {
    "file '$($f.FullName -replace '\\', '/')'"
    "duration $hold"
}
$lines += "file '$($frames[-1].FullName -replace '\\', '/')'"   # concat demuxer needs the last frame twice
Set-Content -LiteralPath $list -Value $lines -Encoding ascii

$filter = "fps=$Fps,scale=1280:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen[p];[b][p]paletteuse"
$ffmpegArgs = @(
    '-y', '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', "`"$list`"",
    '-vf', "`"$filter`"", '-loop', '0', "`"$gif`""
)

Write-Host ''
Write-Host "$($frames.Count) frames in $FramesDir"
Write-Host "concat list: $list"
Write-Host 'ffmpeg command:'
Write-Host "  ffmpeg $($ffmpegArgs -join ' ')"

if ($Encode) {
    if (-not $ffmpeg) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host 'ffmpeg not on PATH - install it (winget install Gyan.FFmpeg) or run the command above elsewhere.'
        exit 2
    }
    & ffmpeg @ffmpegArgs
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "ffmpeg failed ($LASTEXITCODE)" }
    Write-Host "wrote $gif"
}
else {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'frames only (-Encode was not passed): no GIF was produced.'
}

Write-Host @'

Manual recipe for a true connect -> scan -> freeze recording
------------------------------------------------------------
1. powershell -File tools/build.ps1 -NoFrontend      # engine + SlopTarget.exe
2. .\build\src\app\SlopTarget.exe                    # note the values.* addresses
3. Launch the app, Targets -> "List this PC's processes instead" -> attach SlopTarget.
4. Start a capture (OBS window capture, or ScreenToGif at 10 fps, 1280x800).
5. Scanner: width u32, kind exact, value 100 -> First.
   In the SlopTarget console: "auto 2" so health decreases, then type the new value -> Next.
6. Add a hit to the watchlist, toggle Freeze, show the value holding.
7. Stop the capture, export as GIF (or PNG sequence) and drop it in docs/demo/.
Keep the host process list hidden before recording - it is real machine data.
'@

```

`tools/run_benchmarks.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Skip building slop_app_bench (use the existing build\tests binary)
    [switch]$SkipBuild,
    # Skip the frontend SSR benchmark (needs app\node_modules)
    [switch]$SkipUi,
    # Fail when a workload's median exceeds baseline * this factor. CI runners
    # are noisier than the machine that recorded the baseline, so the default
    # only catches real regressions (algorithmic blow-ups, lost caches).
    [double]$MaxSlowdown = 3.0,
    # Overwrite docs\benchmarks\*-after.json with this run (after an intended
    # performance change; commit the result)
    [switch]$UpdateBaseline,
    # Where this run's JSON goes
    [string]$OutDir = ''
)
# Runs the app benchmarks and compares them with the committed baselines in
# docs\benchmarks (see docs\benchmarks\README.md). Exit 1 on a regression or a
# changed workload result.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$docs = Join-Path $root 'docs\benchmarks'
if (-not $OutDir) { $OutDir = Join-Path $root 'build\bench' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null

if (-not $SkipBuild) {
    & powershell -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'build.ps1') -NoFrontend -Targets 'slop_app_bench' `
        -CmakeExtra '-DSLOP_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DSLOP_BUILD_TEST_TARGET=ON'
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'building slop_app_bench failed' }
}

$failures = [Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$rows = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function Add-Row($suite, $name, $base, $now) {
    $ratio = if ($base -gt 0) { [Math]::Round($now / $base, 2) } else { $null }
    $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Suite = $suite; Workload = $name; BaselineMs = $base; Ms = $now; Ratio = $ratio })
    if ($ratio -and $ratio -gt $MaxSlowdown) {
        $failures.Add("$suite/$name median $now ms is ${ratio}x the baseline $base ms (limit ${MaxSlowdown}x)")
    }
}

# native: slop_app_bench (scanner, traffic store, event bus, MCP output paths)
$appOut = Join-Path $OutDir 'app.json'
& (Join-Path $root 'build\tests\slop_app_bench.exe') $appOut | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "slop_app_bench failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
$app = Get-Content -LiteralPath $appOut -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$appBase = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $docs 'app-after.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach ($b in $appBase.workloads) {
    $n = @($app.workloads | Where-Object name -EQ $b.name)
    if ($n.Count -ne 1) { $failures.Add("app/$($b.name): workload missing from this run"); continue }
    if ("$($n[0].result)" -ne "$($b.result)") {
        $failures.Add("app/$($b.name): result changed $($b.result) -> $($n[0].result)")
    }
    Add-Row 'app' $b.name $b.median_ms $n[0].median_ms
}

# frontend: OutputPanel SSR render + the 1M row virtualized list
# (app\scripts\bench-ui.mjs)
if (-not $SkipUi) {
    $uiOut = Join-Path $OutDir 'ui.json'
    Push-Location (Join-Path $root 'app')
    try {
        & node scripts/bench-ui.mjs $uiOut | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "bench-ui.mjs failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    } finally { Pop-Location }
    $ui = Get-Content -LiteralPath $uiOut -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $uiBase = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $docs 'ui-after.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($b in $uiBase.workloads) {
        $n = @($ui.workloads | Where-Object workload -EQ $b.workload)
        if ($n.Count -ne 1) { $failures.Add("ui/$($b.workload): workload missing from this run"); continue }
        if ($null -ne $b.median_ms) {
            Add-Row 'ui' $b.workload ([Math]::Round($b.median_ms, 3)) ([Math]::Round($n[0].median_ms, 3))
        }
        # the 1M row list's hot path is a scroll frame, and it gets a tighter
        # budget than the generic slowdown factor
        if ($null -ne $b.scroll_frame_ms) {
            $ratio = if ($b.scroll_frame_ms -gt 0) { [Math]::Round($n[0].scroll_frame_ms / $b.scroll_frame_ms, 2) } else { $null }
            $rows.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Suite = 'ui'; Workload = "$($b.workload)/scroll_frame"; BaselineMs = $b.scroll_frame_ms; Ms = $n[0].scroll_frame_ms; Ratio = $ratio })
            if ($ratio -and $ratio -gt 1.25) {
                $failures.Add("ui/$($b.workload): scroll frame $($n[0].scroll_frame_ms) ms is ${ratio}x the baseline $($b.scroll_frame_ms) ms (limit 1.25x)")
            }
        }
    }
}

$table = $rows | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
Write-Host $table
if ($env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) {
    $md = @('| Suite | Workload | Baseline ms | This run ms | Ratio |', '|---|---|---|---|---|')
    $md += $rows | ForEach-Object { "| $($_.Suite) | $($_.Workload) | $($_.BaselineMs) | $($_.Ms) | $($_.Ratio) |" }
    $md += ''
    $md += if ($failures.Count) { $failures | ForEach-Object { "- :x: $_" } } else { "- no regression beyond ${MaxSlowdown}x" }
    $md -join "`n" | Add-Content -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
}

if ($UpdateBaseline) {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $appOut -Destination (Join-Path $docs 'app-after.json') -Force
    if (-not $SkipUi) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $OutDir 'ui.json') -Destination (Join-Path $docs 'ui-after.json') -Force }
    Write-Host '==> baselines updated in docs\benchmarks (commit them)'
    exit 0
}
if ($failures.Count) {
    $failures | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "REGRESSION: $_" }
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "==> benchmarks within ${MaxSlowdown}x of baseline"

```

`tools/run_fuzzers.ps1`:

```ps1
# tools/run_fuzzers.ps1
# Runs the libFuzzer targets from the ninja-msvc-fuzz preset for a fixed time
# each and fails on a crash (libFuzzer writes the reproducer into
# <ArtifactDir>/<target>/).
#
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/run_fuzzers.ps1 -Seconds 60
#   powershell -NoProfile -File tools/run_fuzzers.ps1 -Targets ps4,zip -Seconds 300
#
# The seeds in src/fuzz/corpus/<target>/ are copied to a scratch corpus first:
# libFuzzer appends new units to the corpus directory and the checkout must
# stay clean.

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Preset = 'ninja-msvc-fuzz',
    # seconds per target
    [int]$Seconds = 60,
    # comma list of target suffixes (elf, pe, macho, ipa, zip, ps4, dotnet)
    [string]$Targets = '',
    [string]$ArtifactDir = 'fuzz-artifacts',
    [int]$MaxLen = 65536,
    [string]$VsRoot = $env:SLOP_VS_ROOT
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

function Resolve-PresetBinaryDir([string]$name) {
    $presets = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repoRoot 'CMakePresets.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).configurePresets
    $cur = $presets | Where-Object name -EQ $name
    if (-not $cur) { throw "unknown configure preset '$name'" }
    $dir = $null
    while ($cur -and -not $dir) {
        if ($cur.binaryDir) { $dir = $cur.binaryDir; break }
        $parent = @($cur.inherits)[0]
        $cur = if ($parent) { $presets | Where-Object name -EQ $parent } else { $null }
    }
    if (-not $dir) { throw "preset '$name' has no binaryDir" }
    return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($dir.Replace('${sourceDir}', $repoRoot).Replace('${presetName}', $name))
}

# The fuzzers are ASan-instrumented: clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll lives in
# the MSVC toolset bin dir, so run them with the vcvars environment.
if (-not $VsRoot) {
    $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere) {
        $VsRoot = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath
    }
}
if (-not $VsRoot -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $VsRoot 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'))) {
    throw 'Visual Studio with C++ tools not found (pass -VsRoot or set SLOP_VS_ROOT)'
}
$vcvars = Join-Path $VsRoot 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'
cmd /c "call `"$vcvars`" > NUL 2>&1 && set" | ForEach-Object {
    if ($_ -match '^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$') {
        Set-Item -Path ("Env:" + $Matches[1]) -Value $Matches[2]
    }
}

$binaryDir = if ($env:SLOP_BUILD_DIR) { [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:SLOP_BUILD_DIR) } else { Resolve-PresetBinaryDir $Preset }
$fuzzDir = Join-Path $binaryDir 'fuzz'
$all = @('elf', 'pe', 'macho', 'ipa', 'zip', 'ps4', 'dotnet')
$names = if ($Targets.Trim()) { $Targets.Split(',', [System.StringSplitOptions]::RemoveEmptyEntries).Trim() } else { $all }

$artifactRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $repoRoot $ArtifactDir))
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $artifactRoot -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $artifactRoot | Out-Null

$failed = @()
foreach ($name in $names) {
    $exe = Join-Path $fuzzDir "fuzz_$name.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { throw "fuzz_$name.exe not built in $fuzzDir (build the $Preset preset)" }

    # scratch corpus: seeds copied, mutations stay out of the checkout
    $corpus = Join-Path $env:TEMP "slop-fuzz-corpus-$name"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $corpus) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $corpus -Recurse -Force }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $corpus | Out-Null
    $seeds = Join-Path $repoRoot "src/fuzz/corpus/$name"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $seeds) { Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $seeds '*') -Destination $corpus -Recurse -Force }
    $artifacts = Join-Path $artifactRoot $name
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $artifacts | Out-Null

    Write-Host "==> fuzz_$name for $Seconds s"
    $fuzzArgs = @("$corpus", "-max_total_time=$Seconds", "-max_len=$MaxLen",
                  "-artifact_prefix=$artifacts\", "-print_final_stats=1")
    & $exe @fuzzArgs
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    $crashes = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $artifacts -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    if ($code -ne 0 -or $crashes.Count -gt 0) {
        $failed += "$name (exit $code, $($crashes.Count) artifact(s))"
        $crashes | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  crash: $($_.FullName)" }
    }
}

if ($failed.Count -gt 0) {
    throw "fuzz targets failed: $($failed -join '; ') (reproducers in $artifactRoot)"
}
Write-Host "==> every fuzz target ran $Seconds s without a crash"

```

`tools/run_target.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # SlopTarget.exe; defaults to the build tree next to this checkout
    [string]$Target = (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'build\src\app\SlopTarget.exe'),
    # How long the target runs before it is told to quit
    [int]$RunMilliseconds = 3000
)
# Smoke-runs the SlopTarget fixture: starts it, lets it publish its report,
# asks it to quit, then prints its stdout and the head of its JSON report.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Target)) {
    throw "SlopTarget not found at $Target (build target slop_target, or pass -Target)"
}
$psi = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new($Target)
$psi.RedirectStandardInput = $true
$psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
$psi.UseShellExecute = $false
$psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
$proc = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi)
$outTask = $proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $RunMilliseconds
$proc.StandardInput.WriteLine('quit')
$proc.StandardInput.Close()
if (-not $proc.WaitForExit(5000)) {
    $proc.Kill()
    throw 'SlopTarget did not exit within 5 s of quit'
}
Write-Host $outTask.Result
$jsonPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP "sloptarget-$($proc.Id).json"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $jsonPath) {
    Write-Host '--- JSON OK ---'
    Get-Content -LiteralPath $jsonPath | Select-Object -First 5
} else {
    Write-Host "--- JSON NOT found: $jsonPath ---"
    exit 1
}
```

`tools/sync_version.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Report mismatches and exit 1 instead of rewriting (CI)
    [switch]$Check,
    # Additionally require this git tag (v1.2.3 or 1.2.3) to equal VERSION
    [string]$Tag = ''
)
# The root VERSION file is the single product version. CMake reads it directly
# (project VERSION, VERSIONINFO, manifests); this script copies it into the
# version fields of the frontend/Tauri manifests and lockfiles, touching only
# those fields (no reformatting).
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$version = (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'VERSION') -TotalCount 1).Trim()
if ($version -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { throw "VERSION must be MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, got '$version'" }

# file -> regex whose group 2 is the version; group 1/3 are kept verbatim.
# Every pattern must match exactly `Count` times.
$targets = @(
    @{ Path = 'app/package.json'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(?m)^(  "version":\s*")([^"]*)(")' },
    @{ Path = 'app/package-lock.json'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(?s)(\A\{\s*"name":\s*"[^"]*",\s*"version":\s*")([^"]*)(")' },
    @{ Path = 'app/package-lock.json'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(?s)("packages":\s*\{\s*"":\s*\{\s*"name":\s*"[^"]*",\s*"version":\s*")([^"]*)(")' },
    @{ Path = 'app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(?m)^(  "version":\s*")([^"]*)(")' },
    @{ Path = 'app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(?ms)\A(.*?^\[package\][^\[]*?^version\s*=\s*")([^"]*)(")' },
    @{ Path = 'app/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(?m)(^name = "reverse-slop-ui"\r?\nversion = ")([^"]*)(")' },
    @{ Path = 'README.md'; Count = 1
       Pattern = '(img\.shields\.io/badge/version-)(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)(-)' }
)

$bad = @()
foreach ($t in $targets) {
    $file = Join-Path $root $t.Path
    $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($file)
    $found = [regex]::Matches($text, $t.Pattern)
    if ($found.Count -ne $t.Count) {
        throw "$($t.Path): expected $($t.Count) version field(s), matched $($found.Count); update tools/sync_version.ps1"
    }
    $stale = @($found | Where-Object { $_.Groups[2].Value -ne $version })
    if (-not $stale) { continue }
    if ($Check) {
        $bad += "$($t.Path): $(($stale | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[2].Value }) -join ', ') != $version"
        continue
    }
    $text = [regex]::Replace($text, $t.Pattern, { param($m) $m.Groups[1].Value + $version + $m.Groups[3].Value })
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($file, $text, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    Write-Host "updated $($t.Path) -> $version"
}

if ($Tag) {
    $tagVersion = $Tag -replace '^refs/tags/', '' -replace '^v', ''
    if ($tagVersion -ne $version) { $bad += "tag '$Tag' != VERSION $version" }
}

if ($bad) {
    $bad | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "version mismatch: $_" }
    Write-Host 'run: pwsh tools/sync_version.ps1  (after editing VERSION)'
    exit 1
}
if ($Check) { Write-Host "versions consistent: $version" }

```
